title: Succeed, Hated, Composure / Thursday / Stunned
body:
![IMG_20260528_083828.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXS1g6BH9621qzkKFAeKend8CayD71DUzjyzXZZy1mpLU/IMG_20260528_083828.jpg)

### Succeed, Hated, Composure
We should be happy seeing people succeed. Too bad others have the tendency to be envious of someone's success, despite being close to that person. They hide their disgust, pretending to be happy for the person. I'm glad I'm not like them. We shouldn't view our lives as a competition, or else we keep losing.

Hated
We may experience being hated by people, and they may do things that can be hurtful to us. Don't let ourselves become as bad as them. Being hated when we did nothing wrong means we're the good ones. We should maintain being that way.

Composure
As we're being hated, we should maintain our composure. We can avoid haters and focus on ourselves. Love yourself and keep improving. That will be the best revenge we can take for ourselves.

### Thursday 
The extreme heat continues. Waking up in the morning sweating despite the fans are on. Meanwhile, it was forecasted that rainy season will come next week, something we should also be prepared. 

### Stunned
I am always stunned visiting places such as this. Buguias, Benguet is such a beautiful place to visit for mountains and flowers.

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/b0e31a8f)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body:

<center>
![H387dWjbmvT2Oda5_IMG_20260527_194047.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/H387dWjbmvT2Oda5_IMG_20260527_194047/H387dWjbmvT2Oda5_IMG_20260527_194047.webp)

那个12345的投诉电话，打过去他们接不到，他们打过来我又没空接，然后他们发短信叫我有事去小程序诉求受理，然后我补充了材料，但是他们打来我去监考又没接到，他们又叫我去小程序。

反反复复折腾，最后还是没有联系上，没有处理好，距离发生事件已经过去一周了，这个市场监督管理局始终没有和我以及商贩沟通到具体事宜。他们也没有专门的负责人、或者电话可以畅通投诉路径，其实我感觉就是形同虚设。后续上班时间我联系了他们，也是打不通，说什么话务忙，挺搞笑的。

以前买课被骗好像也是找过一次警察，他们说属于经济纠纷，不属于诈骗，也是没有受理，那会被骗了好几千。当时他们喊我找法院起诉。但是我们哪里懂怎么搞，递交材料又说格式有问题，搞了半天也没搞好。

最后连门槛都没进去，当时那些材料密密麻麻建了一个文件夹专门放着，但是后面也没有心力去起诉了。然后我就删掉了。仿佛这件事已经过去了。但是卷走我们钱的人还在逍遥法外，让我们放下真的是难。

大家都在说大环境不好，钱不好挣，平时买东西都想看看有没有支付宝红包、碰一碰立减的人，突然被骗了那么多钱，怎么可能咽下这口气。

有时候总觉得那些有关部门不是干实事的，甚至是助长那些做坏事的人，他们对受害者非常严苛，却丝毫不联系加害方，他们要求受害者提供各种材料，却对加害方置之不理，任其逍遥法外。。。。。。

body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g68086cbb8527d5179b26dee94f3e671859219317cb1e1f9e19b2fb6d88d54d41679d7ef00bd7273299b5ffb25a21672a97d7cb9256e0334dcff86a4f57abc640_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue bastante emocionante. Empecé mi recorrido por un parque donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. Había una mujer que parecía ser instructora, y su energía era contagiosa; todos se movían al unísono bajo el sol de la mañana. Más adelante, me encontré con un artista callejero pintando un mural. Era impresionante ver cómo transformaba una pared gris en una explosión de color. Hablé brevemente con él, y me contó que se inspira en la vida cotidiana de la ciudad y la diversidad de sus habitantes. A medida que avanzaba, noté que la ciudad estaba llena de vida: familias paseando, ciclistas disfrutando de la brisa y grupos de amigos riendo en las terrazas de los cafés. Ese ambiente vibrante me hizo recordar lo importante que es tomarse un tiempo para disfrutar de los pequeños momentos y la comunidad que nos rodea. Sin duda, cada caminata es una nueva aventura llena de historias por descubrir. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: The Most Expensive Thing Hive Can Do Right Now Is \
// PART 2😅
title.body:
![Screenshot (2123).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lordbutterfly/23tRvZvjwZR1QVKPnvzFj2ucft4jxMTwFMvEcYvVMTNs7Stft22cBqBxAopd2RFvKTNwx.png)




# Build For The Problem. Not For The Cool.

## \

Is Not A Strategy

There is a certain type of builder who falls in love with the idea before they understand the problem. They design the solution first. They make it beautifly. They make it exciting. They tell everyone about it.

And then they discover the thing they built has nowhere to go. Because the problem they were solving was not actually a problem anyone had. Or the solution they built assumed something underneath it that does not exist. Or the people who were supposed to want it never asked for it. 

**Building something cool is \

. Building something that solves a real problem is hard.**

The difference between the two is not talent. It is not resources. It is whether you started with the problem or with the solution. 

## The Hard Layer Nobody Wants To Build

Every product that actually changes behavior has something invisible underneath it. Infrastructure that nobody sees, that took years to build, that most people assumed already existed or assumed someone else would figure out.

That invisible layer is always the hard part. It is always the part that separates the products that work from the products that look great in a pitch deck and die on contact with reality. 

**The builders who change things are the ones who go underground first.** Who spend years on the thing nobody can see so that when someone builds on top of it, it actually works.
*What is the most valuable innovation of today? How sure are you that it is what you can point to that has a name, a brand, a flock of influencers pushing it on social media? How sure are you that it is not something entirely invisible to the public?*

# Your Vision Needs A Point

A developer will build whatever you spec out. 
A construction worker will dig whatever hole you point at. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lordbutterfly/48hHbxPoaN8MFYJ2B7Q4n1fBezVJ22hcsZ55NuB5odbpEyAR73i8tw7hrrQPQs2bbK.png)


*A bridge to nowhere? No problem!... A super, high tech tunnel with LEDs, solar powered fans for ventilation and a complementary lemonade stand with a carbon monoxide after taste, that leads to a pit on the other side? Sign us up!*

They are skilled, they are professional, and they will deliver exactly what you asked for. The bridge to nowhere gets built on time and on budget. The tunnel that leads straight into a pit gets finished with clean edges and good lighting.

The question of whether it should exist at all, that is on you.



## The Built-In Ceiling

Some ideas have a ceiling baked into them before the first line of code gets written. Not because the execution is bad. Because the premise is wrong.

You can execute perfectly on an idea that cannot go anywhere having spent everything to get there. The idea looked exciting. The pitch made sense. People nodded along. Developers built it. And then it met reality and reality said 👎.

**The ceiling is not a bug you fix later. It is loadbearing. It is in the foundation.**

## Scrutinize The Idea Before You Build It

The job before the job is figuring out whether the idea deserves to exist.

Not, is it technically interesting. Not, can it be built. Not, does it sound good when you explain it. Those questions are easy and they do not tell you anything useful. 
The real questions are harder:

**Who specifically has this problem right now?**

**What is the adoption ceiling?** 

Good ideas fail often, but bad ideas fail always. 

## The Stone Horse

Someone has an idea. They get excited. They describe it to people and the people nod. They start building. They tell more people. They build more. They are riding hard and fast and the wind is in their face and they are absolutely certain they are moving.

And then they look down and realize they are sitting on a rock in their backyard going yee-haw.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lordbutterfly/48aYK37faK9WB4PwxWt4v7UBubpYJyVZocZnz7XLLx5zxDYzZ3BCvtNyFsjgzo5NjB.png)


**The motion felt real. The excitement felt real. The work was real. The destination never was.**

The point is, if the thing cannot make anyone's life better, if the architecture prevents it, if the ceiling is in the foundation, then no amount of \

changes where you end up. 
This is kind of where the point of this post is... **Build, yes, but build with purpose.** 

Scrutinize the idea. Before you pay anyone. Before you write a line of code. Before you get on the horse.

**Make sure the horse is real**.

## The Only Question That Matters

Not - is your idea cool.

Not - do people in this community like it.

**Is there a real problem? Are real people outside this ecosystem suffering from it? Does what you are building actually solve it at the layer where the problem lives?**

If yes, build. Now! Not when you are ready. Not when the tools are better. Not when someone else validates it. Now. Today or better yesterday!

**Solve this first before anything you do and after that comes the easy part... hard work and dedication.**

![portada_gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/EogLRhDtdzNsraGtZHSM2tMcneQ2BQXmfvxjnJHS1g1AZsuToXyiD5kEpBYZ8XFL9tn.gif)
![separador_hiveblue2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23xKJTNXg9o8mSnEue9fX631AZb5Z1htiBAVuKVJYVnkesCsWvNwywHb6pZ2BZN551Quo.png)
Desde esta publicación extendemos las gracias a quienes hicieron posible el evento [HIVEBLUE 2026💙5ta.Fiesta Azul en Hive 🥳🎉](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/hiveblue-2026-5ta-fiesta-azul). Así que, vaya nuestro agradecimiento a los amigos del autismo, a quienes participaron en las actividades para extender un mensaje de concienciación por el TEA. a los curadores, a los miembros de nuestro equipo azul, columnistas, moderadores y administradores Abril es el mes que se pinta de azul en el mundo y en la comunidad Mundo Autismo no nos quedamos atrás. Por cinco años consecutivos nos hemos sumado para que desde Hive, también se alce la voz por los derechos de las personas con el espectro autistas. La programación del #HiveBlue, llamada maratón de actividades azules, consistió en tres concursos que permitieron expresar con creatividad mensajes que ayudan a comprender el estilo de vida azul, incluyendo a los niños, adolescentes, jóvenes y adultos con la condición, a sus familiares y a cuidadores en general. Este año, no se hizo entrega de un donativo como parte de la programación, por la baja en el precio del Hive y la alta devaluación del Bolívar, la moneda de Venezuela, país donde realizamos los donativos de artículos escolares en alguna institución educativa que atienda niños con TEA. Sin embargo, esto no significa que no se pueda hacer en otro momento del año. >! [English] We would like to extend our thanks to everyone who made the event [HIVEBLUE 2026💙5th Blue Party in Hive 🥳🎉](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/hiveblue-2026-5ta-fiesta-azul) possible. So, our thanks go out to our friends in the autism community, to those who participated in the activities to spread awareness about ASD, to the curators, to the members of our Blue Team, columnists, moderators, and administrators April is the month that turns blue around the world, and the Mundo Autismo community is no exception. For five consecutive years, we have joined in so that Hive can also raise its voice for the rights of people on the autism spectrum. The #HiveBlue program, called the “Blue Activities Marathon,” consisted of three contests that allowed participants to creatively express messages that help people understand the “blue lifestyle,” including children, adolescents, young adults, and adults with autism, as well as their families and caregivers in general. This year, no donation was made as part of the program due to the drop in Hive’s price and the sharp devaluation of the Bolívar, the currency of Venezuela—the country where we typically donate school supplies to an educational institution serving children with ASD. However, this does not mean we cannot do so at another time of the year.
![separador_hiveblue2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23xKJTNXg9o8mSnEue9fX631AZb5Z1htiBAVuKVJYVnkesCsWvNwywHb6pZ2BZN551Quo.png)
#### Todos son el #HiveBlue 2026 El evento, como siempre, fue posible gracias a los amigos del autismo, a los proyectos de curación, a nuestro equipo azul y todos los amigos de nuestra comunidad. Destacamos la labor de los columnistas, curadores y administradores por eso mencionamos a: @belkyscabrera, @sandracabrera, @esthersanchez, @nanyuris, @emiliorios, @amjdancer (@sorprendente), @gsbilbao, @parauri, @alberto0607 con su proyecto @visualblock y @takeru255 con su proyecto [Bokura No Digital World ](https://hivesigner.com/login?client_id=steem.app&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fhive.vote%2Fcallback.php&scope=login). #### Agradecimientos especiales A @belkyscabrera, quien donó **4.000 Puntos Ecency** para que sean distribuidos como premios de los concursos. A @edwing357 quien apoyó el tercer concurso con su valioso proyecto @creativecuisine. A el proyecto @aliento. Recuerda votar por el Testigo [**Aliento**](https://vote.hive.uno/@aliento) >! [English] **Everyone is #HiveBlue 2026** As always, this event was made possible thanks to our friends in the autism community, the healing projects, our blue team, and all our friends in the community. We highlight the work of the columnists, curators, and administrators, so we’d like to mention: @belkyscabrera, @sandracabrera, @esthersanchez, @nanyuris, @emiliorios, @amjdancer (@sorprendente), @gsbilbao, @parauri, @alberto0607 with his project @visualblock, and @takeru255 with his project [Bokura No Digital World ](https://hivesigner.com/login?client_id=steem.app&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fhive.vote%2Fcallback.php&scope=login). **Special Thanks** To @belkyscabrera, who donated **4,000 Ecency Points** to be distributed as contest prizes. To @edwing357, who supported the third contest with his valuable project @creativecuisine. To the @aliento project. Remember to vote for the Witness [**Aliento**](https://vote.hive.uno/@aliento)
![separador_hiveblue2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23xKJTNXg9o8mSnEue9fX631AZb5Z1htiBAVuKVJYVnkesCsWvNwywHb6pZ2BZN551Quo.png)
#### Entregamos los premios En el desarrollo de los tres concursos azules participaron varios amigos del autismo, con excelentes y útiles contenidos que demuestran interés por el bienestar de la vida autista. Hicimos entrega de 80 HIVE y 4000 Puntos Ecency, distribuidos entre todos los participantes. --- --- - En el primer concurso, [Juego & Aprendizaje Azul](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/juego-and-aprendizaje-azul-1er-concurso-hiveblue-2026) entregamos 35 HIVE (de parte de @mundo.autismo) y 1200 Puntos Ecency (cortesía de @belkyscabrera). title.title: Wednesday Walk: \
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpTE13aqz7yPu4PsHUrk9HJNkkx83ums78rRzxLT93Q6/1779934847022.jpg)

Hello Friends, and thank you for your visit!
🙋🏻‍♀️☺️🙋🏻‍♀️
It is #wednesdaywalk #21 of 2026, and I wanted to take a look at Lakeview Park to see if the recent rain had made any difference in the water level.

But first as always I want to thank @tattoodjay for this community -
\

!

So in-between the rain showers I drove over to Lakeview Park, about 7 miles 11.265 kilometers from my house.

First thing I saw was this Pigeon and Seagull (Laughing Gull, the type of Seagull these all are) giving each other the \

,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWZ8WxPLtmUxE44CY9mHySZtZdnnHVQsYgvG3BN1ttAA/1779934938778.jpg)

And from the other side - with a Seagull,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUegfETBAbtTjeR96kndfpch1MUbTMrwh4bipvKXEGKTm/1779934952946.jpg)

Very strange looking Ducks, you would think they are some other kind of bird!

And in the Parking Lot the feral Chickens were hanging around! I was surprised to see the two Roosters again!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQwdPdXqvaKfz8sMZJrDCup3SuMGhd7tVQmzBozcwcAMj/1779935232714.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbTZ5TnRfFU5xVBUB8CYCdsi21qxmLd316TZ9t55ztoU/1779935232914.jpg)

This is a few views of \

and the level has increased - quite a bit! This is down the backside, the white dots in the distance are Geese,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSf34hQ97KYWP4HeFnvcwafoqEA5mMAWCuJg1tJN5sw5k/1779934985951.jpg)

And straight across the Pond,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPY7d2HiwoYXXbY8xBrYPp5QjcMfcw9Ux2223Ebz3dJu/1779935002432.jpg)

And on my way back up from the water I found a few of these growing on the banks,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwiA1AT4e4SoAi3mqaRTMFR6awuLQXa5vYdNvzeUWcwE/1779935030063.jpg)

Well, by this time things were getting slippery so I thought it might be a good time to leave! On the way I passed these Seagulls on a fence,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNA9CDCfd9VjrqUB55LrjsQU4KAgRJHKmFgZC9dgLAke/1779935043219.jpg)

And a partial front view,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS5LaAZe6JGukRKPjVM6sWgzA8y2FTYXGo2F35GCyCfDN/1779935070686.jpg)

In the fields across the street all the yellow is Sunflowers!
This one left the fence and came and landed pretty close by,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcoTDKkJbksdBwMGGzAhUAauhERqmFJBKeCYDdX5cxb8/1779935081445.jpg)

Walking back to the vehicle I passed the Kiddy area. Luckily there was no Kiddos so I took a photo,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVs5SXY4qVcKnFwKTt9TidqHs9EtqMSzTXH8sWhEwqWDX/1779935098068.jpg)

And when I got back to the vehicle a number of birds had collected there, and some right on the roof!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQDc3eJZgmw4PXD6LfeERokphNU6vxJAXnZZb3Z1Jfxn/1779935107677.jpg)

Definitely time to go, and it was nehinito sprinkle a load well!
And that was my #wednesdaywalk this week, I want to thank you again for your visit - \
!\nPlease Take Care of Your Loved Ones - \

🙋👍🏼🙏🏼😇🙏🏼👍🏼🙋

title.title: 💻 Estudiantes Crear Aplicaciones con IA en HIVEED ‍🚀 [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
/>

* * *

Hoy fue un día increíble. Se marcó un hito en el programa de HIVEED. Pasamos de las clases de marca personal y finanzas con tareas de publicaciones en Hive, a construir aplicaciones con IA; por supuesto en Hive.

Esto es algo que querías hacer hace años, pero al no ser desarrollador, lo vi muy difícil. Tuvimos una pequeña \

con un proyecto de desarrollo en Hive, pero no resultó. Ahora con la IA, lo pude materializar.

Hace unas semanas me puse a crear con IA. Al principio fue bastante difícil, ya que la usé para que me guiara. No sabía que tenía la capacidad de hacer las cosas desde cero. Había escuchado de Claude, pero está bloqueada para Venezuela y me dio flojera saltar ese bloqueo. Así que me decidí por probar aistudio de Google y es increíble. Demoré haciendo la primera parte de la app asistido, semanas. Aistudio lo hizo en minutos.

En ese momento dije que tenía que enseñarlo a los chicos. Me quedaban cuatro semanas de clases, así que tenía que correr. Me arreglaron el horario del salón de informática y lo vamos a lograr. Es muy poco el tiempo, porque la capacidad del salón obliga a dividirlos y eso reduce el tiempo a la mitad, pero las ganas y lo que se pueda hacer remoto, nos darán los resultados.

Por supuesto que antes de hoy, que fue la primera clase; yo había terminado mi aplicación. En este momento la estamos probando para hacer el lanzamiento en los próximos días. Así que ya tengo la experiencia para guiar a los chicos.

Puedo decir que el proceso es sencillo, aunque lleva tiempo. Por cada promt la IA se demora minutos. Por ser la versión gratuita, hay límite de tokens. Esto hace que un proyecto robusto pueda demorar. Sin embargo crear una aplicación básica, minimalista, sin tantas herramientas, puedes hacerse en dos clases. Aunque la verdad hoy fue un poco atropellado por ser la primera clase. La próxima seguro será más fluida.

Los chicos están usando dos entornos de IA, Gemini y aistudio. La primera para el pensamiento rápido y búsquedas y la segunda para el trabajo pesado de construcción y código. También usan Peakd para buscar en Hive. Deben tener un nicho porque la dapp será de un tema específico, entonces se conectan a una comunidad o una etiqueta, dependiendo el caso.

Esto es un gran salto para \

, porque muestra otra cara importante de Hive; la facilidad de conectarse a la blockchain, para sacar los mejores beneficios. Además de esto, están aprendiendo sobre modelos de negocio que pueden aplicar a su emprendimiento digital. Ya están viendo, que en Hive no solo se gana por crear contenido, sino por crear aplicaciones. Ahora espero que los tiempos nos den y que logren finalizar las dapps. Cualquiera sea el caso, tendrán un aprendizaje enorme estos días y en eso me incluyo también. Les estaré contando el desarrollo...

/>

* * *

English
=======

Today was an incredible day. A milestone was reached in the HIVEED program. We transitioned from personal branding and finance classes—with Hive posting assignments—to building applications with AI; on Hive, of course.

This is something I wanted to do years ago, but not being a developer, I saw it as very difficult. We had a small \

with a development project on Hive, but it didn't work out. Now, with AI, I was able to make it happen.

A few weeks ago, I started creating with AI. At first, it was quite difficult because I was using it just for guidance. I didn't know it had the capability to build things from scratch. I had heard of Claude, but it's blocked in Venezuela and I was too lazy to bypass that restriction. So, I decided to try Google's AI Studio, and it is incredible. It took me weeks to do the first part of the app with assistance; AI Studio did it in minutes.

At that moment, I knew I had to teach this to the kids. I had four weeks of classes left, so I had to rush. They rearranged the computer lab schedule for me, and we are going to make it happen. Time is very tight because the lab's capacity forces us to split them into groups, cutting our time in half, but their enthusiasm and what we can accomplish remotely will give us results.

Of course, before today—which was the first class—I had already finished my own application. Right now, we are testing it for a launch in the coming days. So, I already have the experience to guide the kids.

I can say the process is straightforward, though it takes time. For each prompt, the AI takes a few minutes. Since it's the free version, there is a token limit. This means a robust project can take a while. However, creating a basic, minimalist application without too many tools can be done in two classes. To be honest, today was a bit chaotic since it was the first class. The next one will surely be much smoother.

The kids are using two AI environments: Gemini and AI Studio. The former for quick thinking and searches, and the latter for the heavy lifting of building and coding. They are also using PeakD to search on Hive. They must choose a niche because the DApp will be about a specific topic, so they connect to a community or a tag, depending on the case.

This is a huge leap forward for \

because it shows another important side of Hive: how easy it is to connect to the blockchain to reap the best benefits. In addition to this, they are learning about business models that they can apply to their digital entrepreneurship. They are already seeing that on Hive, you don't just earn by creating content, but also by creating applications. Now, I just hope time is on our side and that they manage to finalize their DApps. Whatever the case may be, they will gain an enormous amount of knowledge these days—and I include myself in that too. I will keep you posted on our progress... * * *

title.title: DATE WITH FRIENDS
title.body: > Hello everyone! This is @lorene08 back again with another blog to share!! This is a simple but memorable blog for me and for you to read as well. It’s true what they say that spontaneous gala or hangouts are the ones that usually happen because most planned outings don’t push through HAHAHAHAHA. So if you and your friends want to go out, plan it within the week or even the next day so it will really happen! HAHAHAHA!! ![Messenger_creation_435B77F9-A14D-4F95-979A-0FADE46E982D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23w2mLTQ5fWA9kiKW1XLjKfMo1RSftqb1ixTdFerMPCa5kuqm2rEcgNKSKWP3oPzb9Lqf.jpeg) Since most of us were super bored staying at home and doing the same routines every day, one of our friends decided that we should go out because the last time we saw each other was during our graduation day. So out of 11 of us, only 4 were available. But because we really missed each other already, we decided to continue the gala even though less than half of us were available that time. Micah, one of my friends, recommended that we should meet up and eat halo-halo at Sol’s. Halo-halo is a popular Filipino cold dessert made with crushed ice, milk, sweet fruits, beans, jelly, and ice cream mixed together. She said their palamig was very delicious, and truth to be told, it was indeed yummy! I would rate it 100/10 and would surely recommend it to you guys as well, especially if you live in Poblacion, San Remigio, or near San Remigio. ![Messenger_creation_BAA1B506-D676-48B4-94A4-D72467070986.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23w2kyEhqjzDJL673mcTqCvN22Bc1e4dMu9DYKYWDSVEP4YQcXFqbRRHgk1Bz1Qocgbf8.jpeg) While eating, the four of us were just updating each other about our lives, and we also talked about our universities in college. Also, one of our friends was late lol HAHAHAHAHAHA!! ![Messenger_creation_399D6FBF-F783-4A50-949B-336C542E02A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23wC7qs1nUtN4PKXTcp7DKtLh1VjbkpnijbpHwEzHiu2DK62vi7u94ydY1GXf5WSX65cr.jpeg) After eating, our actual agenda was to have snacks first and then eat dinner at Lapyahan. Since it was already almost 5 p.m. that time and we still had to walk, we decided to take a shortcut that passed by our old high school. When we arrived, the view at Lapyahan was mesmerizing, especially the sunset. It would surely make your day better!! ![Messenger_creation_617245AF-7C00-4CDF-B451-95E13A8C8AD9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23u6DR6uEWpAVVS9MewTEDRkQZJ2D8YxMzkRLUKy5mdtUcTx5tEZ5574WbicaLE2iAxrx.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_6DEB471B-5721-47E8-920A-B6FFA241290E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23x1Kq832qytcw9H62MvvwYBYUvkXzMYM2BYisbv4JrAXvptNjW35aiwopnyxcUtBqEU8.jpeg) The first thing we did upon arriving was find a great spot and take group pictures. And of course, me being me, a gala is never complete without me taking at least one picture HAHAHAHA. Well, thanks to AJ and my ever-supportive friends, I was able to take nice photos with the beautiful sunset. ![Messenger_creation_B39DAC3D-A284-4FD5-B53E-F93C275FE0E9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23ywnxGQrgpX7vMUDTmw3uvYmc7BxGq3jma6DGwG885aoik3YficEuo5NW5zh8XZWKpm3.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_438B6227-6404-4F05-B4D7-25943A38886C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/EopuLGAhbpuM9hcpgVFLS7PnRwijo86UxosCoPNMnHSHYVMC5v9jRZb82wg2BeSzCZ1.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_5C56D4FA-528C-4FF9-A4FB-B363777A411A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorene08/23yJSyu2fY5SqHfcUthtvqqT9pxC2paKBK7xhVzhpgmSmeRUuBsm8duc9KhiEh9yL3W8F.jpeg) At around 6 p.m., we were about to order barbecue when we suddenly bumped into my mother. So ayun, our dinner became free. My friends were a little shy at first, but my mother insisted on paying for our food. While waiting, we made TikToks, and while waiting for Micah’s family car, Micah bought some toys. We ended up playing like little kids without caring about other people around us, and we just kept on laughing. And that’s one of my most memorable gala moments this vacation with my best friends. That’s all everyone, and thank you so much for reading! See you in my next blogs!!

title.title: A delicious tropical smoothie [ENG-ESP]
title.body: >Greetings, dear friends at Amazing Drinks, and welcome to my blog. Over the weekend, I visited a place called Tu Colonial, a well-known fruit and vegetable market in the city. However, they also sell other products, including chilled coconut water and coconut candies. It was noon and the sun was beating down, so I wanted to cool off a bit with some coconut water. The coconut was tender and had some meat in it—great, I thought—so I decided to make a coconut candy. I also bought some sliced pineapple, and it occurred to me that instead of making coconut candy, I’d better combine it with the coconut to make a delicious smoothie.

>Instead of regular water, I decided to use coconut water; I had a little over a cup left from the liter I bought near my house. Whenever I can, I drink coconut water to stay hydrated and replenish my electrolytes. The smoothie turned out delicious—the mild coconut flavor with a hint of pineapple tartness, which was very subtle because I added powdered milk. Here are the details on how to make it.
## Ingredients
>- 100 g of young coconut flesh\n

>1.-. Cut the coconut flesh into pieces and place it in the blender.
![1779931498725.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfLEimyXKmDDLBKURACSK79CeqPkRDYjeauQKrbWUd6SP/1779931498725.jpg)

>2.- Cut the pineapple into slices and place them in the blender.
![1779931498738.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR8KayS93GvqjwGgbrDmMd6cvrD1kT22jWCyb7sJ4sBY4/1779931498738.jpg)
![1779931498841.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfJMCJk3ULAoU6Aq3BsZk2WiD6f826NHh1iqUxHy382Y/1779931498841.jpg)

> Add the coconut water, powdered milk, sugar to taste, and vanilla, then blend until the ingredients are well combined.
![1779931498711.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcgZKkCDLQpZXwR3TuPDegZ9kgKGNwoad3Lmu19ByK7U/1779931498711.jpg)

> There you go—it's as easy as it is delicious. Serve it up and all that's left to do is enjoy this drink.

title.title: From Chaos to Clarity: Real Business Lessons from Someone Who Actually Lived Them
title.body:
There are tons of financial advice on the internet, and when you look at them, you will see people sharing both theoretical and practical advice. You get all the answers you want from the internet, but while some people share what they have previously learned from books, I will share based on my experience as someone who runs a small business. Trust me, the size of a company depends on scaling and management, but what keeps both small and large businesses going is literally the same set of principles.

 https://storage.needpix.com/rsynced_images/no-1513027_1280.jpg 
[Image](https://www.needpix.com/photo/673698/no-road-sign)

You see, in my business journey, there are days I feel like I know what I am doing, and there are days I don't have a clue about everything around me. I remember when I started my business, I had a lot of customers, but as time passed, a lot of them just left without a reason. Business wasn't as I envisioned at the beginning, with starting and ladder climbing so fast that I would have expanded in 1 year. The first year came with its own challenges, as did the second and the third.



Because I needed to be financially liquid, I had to do other businesses; therefore, I couldn't achieve my goal of full-time commitment. To keep the business going, I had to make a full-time hire, but it was a disaster because while we both thought she could do the job, she couldn't. Still on the lessons learned, I sold a lot of product at very low prices, not taking into consideration many things, including adding VAT, Rent, services, and so on.


 https://www.plannthat.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/sun-and-hazel-1-2048x1337.jpg 
[Image](https://www.plannthat.com/social-media-side-hustle-sun-hazel/)


Hiring is one process that is delicate. If you hire an underperformer, it will show in the result, and the team will have to pick up the slack if such a person is fired. One thing I have learned in the process of hiring is never to talk badly about your former employee or former employer, even if things didn't go well between you both. Talking badly about your employees puts your company in a bad light, making it look like a toxic place to work. In fact, you shouldn't talk about your former employee in the presence of your present employee. Talking about your employer is a bad one entirely because the person who intends to hire you sees a possibility of what you would do if you leave the firm in the future.



 https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6728434e6acc931f0e498d31/695f592ad4c6edb8cbcae989_side-hustle-ideas-australia-content-creation-setup.jpeg 
[Image](https://www.pracskills.com.au/blog/side-hustle-ideas-australia)

We need to understand that employees and employers are humans; we make mistakes, and we are growing. Remember that while you are the employer or the employee, you are not the perfect of both. This said, when you hire an employee, do not create policies that will make them want to hide things from you. If you are starting a business, expect that your employees who believe in the vision would also have their side hustles and so on, because they might be entrepreneurial.



One last thing I would share with you is not to hire employees because you like them, want to be friends with them, or because you see yourself in them. Hire employees for their abilities and their job description. Take your hiring process seriously because hiring and firing sporadically isn't a good look for your business.

title.title: Harmony
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g35511a7def0af02318adcb04b51bf4690b0d76028a5573b0d3f99573773f4a82493718cc4fbe7c2c433f930ae147d4fe66675e71f44ae61c478a294c6c443e59_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a quaint village nestled between rolling hills and lush forests, there lived a community known for its unparalleled harmony. The villagers, a diverse group of individuals from various backgrounds, shared a common goal: to live peacefully and support one another.

## The Festival of Unity

Every year, the village held the **Festival of Unity**, a grand celebration where everyone contributed their unique talents. Musicians played enchanting melodies, artists showcased their vibrant creations, and chefs prepared delicious dishes from their cultural heritage. The festival was a testament to their diverse backgrounds and the strength found in unity.

## The Arrival of the Stranger

One year, a stranger arrived in the village during the festival preparations. He was a traveler who had seen many lands and experienced various cultures. Intrigued by the village's harmony, he decided to stay and observe.

As the festival commenced, the stranger noticed something peculiar. While the villagers celebrated their differences, there was an unspoken rule: everyone was expected to conform to the collective spirit of harmony. Those who dared to voice dissent or express individual opinions were gently silenced, their ideas dismissed as disruptive.

## The Broken String

During the festival, a talented musician named Elara decided to play a song that reflected her personal struggles and dreams. As she played, her melody clashed with the joyful tunes of her fellow musicians. The villagers, taken aback by the dissonance, quickly hushed her, insisting that harmony was paramount.

Feeling rejected, Elara put down her instrument and left the celebration. The stranger, witnessing this, approached the villagers and spoke, \

## The Lesson Learned

The villagers pondered the stranger's words. They realized that their pursuit of harmony had inadvertently stifled individuality. In their quest to maintain peace, they had overlooked the richness that diverse voices could bring to their community.

The next day, they sought out Elara and invited her back to the village. This time, they encouraged her to share her song, and they listened with open hearts. As her music filled the air, something magical happened; the villagers began to harmonize with her, blending their melodies with her unique tune.

## The New Festival of Harmony

From that day forward, the village celebrated a new tradition: the **Festival of Harmony and Individuality**. They learned to embrace differences, understanding that true harmony is not the absence of discord but the ability to create beauty from it.

## The Wisdom of the Village

As years passed, the village thrived, becoming a beacon of unity in diversity. The villagers understood that:

- **Harmony is not uniformity**: It is the ability to appreciate and incorporate different perspectives.
- **Voices matter**: Every individual has something valuable to contribute, and dissent can lead to growth.
- **Celebrate differences**: True strength lies in embracing what makes us unique rather than suppressing it.

And so, the village flourished, a testament to the wisdom that harmony, when rooted in understanding and acceptance, can create a symphony far more beautiful than any single note.

---

### Reflective Questions

- How can we ensure that our pursuit of harmony does not silence individual voices?
- In what ways can we celebrate diversity within our own communities?
- What lessons can we learn from the village's journey towards true harmony?

title.body: > Hola amigos de Ladies Of Hive, espero que todos estén teniendo una buena semana. He estado un poco desconectada de Hive y sobre todo de esta comunidad donde me gusta participar en cada concurso que se propone por semana. [Las preguntas que @saffisara](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-290) nos da me llevan a pensar en aquello que siempre me genera bienestar y que de alguna manera me hacen sentir mejor en los momentos en los que la vida parece ser más difícil y todo parece estar estancado. Me gustaría invitar a @erigm y @gabsartbook para que también nos cuenten más sobre estas preguntas mediante sus respuestas 💗

> Hello, friends at Ladies Of Hive, I hope you’re all having a good week. I’ve been a bit out of touch with Hive and, above all, with this community, where I usually like to take part in every weekly contest. [The questions @saffisara](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-290) has given us make me think about the things that always bring me a sense of well-being and that somehow make me feel better at times when life seems hardest and everything seems to be at a standstill. I’d like to invite @erigm and @gabsartbook to share their thoughts on these questions through their answers too 💗 ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png)
> **¿Cuál es tu paraíso seguro favorito para relajarte y por qué?**

> **What is your favorite safe heaven for relaxation and why?** ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png) ![1000034497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23z79Prff2T4NW9ATd8CWAuXUTiTHHuak9o3kGGcHdCdtFhoNVgPgrQGQfn4o7K3ih6c1.jpg)

> Sin duda mi lugar favorito siempre ha sido mi casa, no siempre comprendo cuando las personas dicen que no pueden estar demasiado tiempo en sus casas. Para mi llegar a mi hogar es sinónimo de tranquilidad y de paz, me alegra poder reencontrarme luego de un día largo con mi mascota, también con mis hermanos y mi mamá. Es algo que valoro mucho y que siempre agradezco, sobre todo en estos tiempos donde existe tanta maldad y delincuencia, llegar a salvo a casa es sinónimo de agradecimiento hacia Dios, a quien tengo siempre muy presente. Pero no solo el estar en casa me genera bienestar, también la música me ayuda mucho a concentrarme o incluso a llegar a un estado de calma que me hace sentir segura. Es algo que llevo años disfrutando y que pienso que nunca me va a dejar de gustar, al menos hasta que pueda escuchar si así Dios lo permite. Entre las canciones que escucho a veces suelo repetir algunas, esa forma de repetición me hace sentir seguridad y también me recuerda momentos en los que las cosas iban bastante bien en mi vida. Eso me ayuda a estar más en conexión con lo que me agrada y con el placer de estar en un lugar seguro, donde solo yo puedo tener la posibilidad de conectar y desconectarme de la realidad del mundo.

> Without a doubt, my favourite place has always been my home; I don’t always understand when people say they can’t spend too much time at home. For me, coming home is synonymous with tranquillity and peace; it makes me happy to be reunited with my pet after a long day, as well as with my siblings and my mum. It’s something I value greatly and am always grateful for, especially in these times when there is so much evil and crime; arriving home safely is synonymous with gratitude towards God, whom I always keep very much in mind. But it’s not just being at home that brings me a sense of well-being; music also helps me a lot to concentrate or even to reach a state of calm that makes me feel safe. It’s something I’ve been enjoying for years and which I don’t think I’ll ever stop liking, at least until I can no longer hear, God willing. Among the songs I listen to, I often repeat some of them; this repetition makes me feel secure and also reminds me of times when things were going quite well in my life. That helps me feel more connected to what I enjoy and to the pleasure of being in a safe place, where only I have the chance to connect with and disconnect from the reality of the world. ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png)
> **Si pudieras intercambiar vidas con un personaje famoso, ¿quién sería y por qué?**

> **If you could swap lives with a famous person, who would it be, and why?** ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png) ![IMG_20260515_130723_176.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhuRCRXnyqcE3vb9f7AhSXj3WAbVdS8jcqtw74DT1Sbdtxms7uJZyKf1u7rchJ5sTiQ.webp)

> Cuando era más niña solía soñar más en cómo sería mi vida si pudiese intercambiar con la de algún famoso. Realmente pienso ahora siendo adulta que no sería nada fácil llevar una vida llena de tanta fama y de tantas cámaras a mi alrededor. Pero si tuviese la oportunidad de vivir una vida diferente a la mía, tal vez me gustaría ser una cantante como Taylor Swift, y tener esa habilidad y creatividad para crear mundos dentro de su repertorio musical, que de hecho disfruto y soy muy fan. También me gustaría ser alguna directora de cine, tal vez sería alguien como Guillermo Del Toro, me parece un ser humano excepcional y una persona que tiene tanta creatividad que se puede evidenciar en sus obras. Sería divertido poder estar en el mundo del arte, siento que tal vez en otra vida me hubiera gustado ser artista, me gusta mucho la música y el cine, siento que son cosas que si tuviera la oportunidad de ser famosa, me gustaría poder ejercer como un estilo de vida. Sería increíble realmente, y también tendría la posibilidad de mostrar desde mi perspectiva otras ideas y mundos que tal vez no han sido conocidos o explorados, tal vez también me gustaría ser una escritora, es algo que me gusta hacer aunque nunca he intentado escribir un libro porque pienso que no tengo la suficiente experiencia para hacerlo. Pero vale la pena intentarlo y ver si sale bien. 🥹

> When I was younger, I used to daydream about what my life would be like if I could swap places with a celebrity. Now that I’m an adult, I really do think it wouldn’t be easy at all to lead a life filled with so much fame and so many cameras around me. But if I had the chance to live a life different from my own, perhaps I’d like to be a singer like Taylor Swift, and have that ability and creativity to create worlds within her musical repertoire – which I actually enjoy and am a big fan of. I’d also like to be a film director; perhaps someone like Guillermo del Toro. I think he’s an exceptional human being and a person with such creativity that it’s evident in his work. It would be fun to be in the world of art; I feel that perhaps in another life I might have liked to be an artist. I really love music and cinema; I feel that if I had the chance to be famous, I’d like to be able to pursue them as a way of life. It would be absolutely amazing, and it would also give me the chance to share, from my own perspective, other ideas and worlds that perhaps haven’t been discovered or explored yet. I might even like to become a writer; it’s something I enjoy doing, although I’ve never tried writing a book because I don’t think I have enough experience to do so. But it’s worth giving it a go and seeing if it works out. 🥹 ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png)
>Espero que les gustara este post, también me gustaría que me dejen sus comentarios; con gusto los leeré y responderé. Un abrazo grande. 🤗\n\n

>I hope you liked this post, and I would also like you to leave me your comments; I will gladly read them and will respond to them. Big hugs. 🤗 ![1000034522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uR9mLS3FAAkmXRXpdgrLzezdkWmk4eZryyc7H9dRWeGPEPCVbF4ey1RtgdYiWHWdcPZ.png) Todo el texto de esta publicación es de mi autoría - All the text in this publication is my own. title.title: The Germination Process, Procedures, Steps  And Engagement Practices Through Practical Application For Individual Farmer On How To Ensure Healthy Planting Of MAIZE SEEDS 🌽🌽🌽
title.body:
![IMG_20260516_160448_804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xybNNoduDS4sYmgwryrzgKYR2PKBiBtDVdQQVWB9L55o2KfuMuzuJFJaRAiNL2wSFqu.jpg)








Hello Hivers 💕💘,






---
---
---





In agriculture you must always push forward and ahead till you achieve your aim and that is why farming is not always easy for short. For those that are actually into farming you notice that there are some steps you will take in farming that you will pass through and also will never take records of it. That is also by the way but in this case I would like to also give us a clue about planting of maize. Yes we all know that in Nigeria we have different types of season whereby you can always utilize the season. Although it is a matter of choice as well but I will always try to tell people that it is when you get into the field practically you know more about agriculture not even when you read the internet or books. It's involved physical practice. 

A planting of maize can be of different styles and Method depending on individual choices. But in this case I put down step by step which I also covered some few days ago and I know that it will always give me a very good outcome. After clearing the agricultural piece of land. I went ahead too pick all the necessary would stump and so on. This is to ensure a very good and smooth planting season likewise the growth and development of the seed I am going to plant at this point in time. Thereafter I went ahead to bring out the seed which is as shown below. 

* The clearing of land took me a while because it somehow a water field environment. Which means that there is always constant most on this particular agricultural soil. Which is some how best for crops like rice, Millet, and to some extent pineapple and Maize. 



![IMG_20260516_155250_562.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoH2oX1Xw62PUJsWt84AUg4eP65xGnL2axiJmt3cF5D7KksRWj6kMY4AgXVfwfXWdx5.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160431_418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Eo6QHrFBA7gq52VjzC8L3aUUeCt1bR7T6nuVFjCBaCt2zK8F4sn55kbU5SRnHVAiggU.jpg)


This was the maize that I bought sometimes ago and it is now the due time for planting. Every agricultural crop has its own due time. Although in my own case I always plant all year round. So I was able to manage a lot of crops from one section to another. 

![IMG_20260516_160433_575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Eokg1pAcaoK1bKgfJCZ7M4P8REyy7cBkHJZ5uCbCxoVQpKi7XgKTbkEsHWqJEdywEd9.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160438_510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Eo8XdJyYZF7zoWmsgutrL815FaufwpLfRJq8PoiRcFKzzVX4mPdT2JfQuoRhXjXu4mM.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160444_726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23w2wwUARHbu3DThxUbHapNNzeKpucVe8kN7weTkwyhSaHL31UQ8NWqdUoKHumiAnWoxK.jpg)


We have different types of Maize. Which reaches from 2 months and a half, 3 months or 3 months and a half, and so on. These are the duration when the Maize will be ready for harvesting. That is why the time is not waiting for anybody. You grab your seed and you plant. So this was how the planting began. After the digging out the agricultural soil slightly not extremely too deep with the cutlass has shown in the picture.  



![IMG_20260516_160517_252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EopwFdHU5dxnbYRLjCRq9xFvs77wWiuToekNS867FDrxbVMoeoCi78kbJoXBQECxiZB.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160522_298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoeGsQSEmgxavxAGQfSu9qAD2qMPdCafFyvf6yiuts1tBdgZFP59kiZ8Kj8nHqTfHJA.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160534_356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EokfxjhCEzB6m5NMrBisr4aiUeRZyjfv6Q6A7MSHrRPBzgo425mHLfjyzy4fKdrBc8J.jpg)


The whole must not be too shallow or deep. It must be moderate. Why I said it must not be too shallow is because there are some animals that dig out already planted seed just like squirrels , birds, grasscutter




![IMG_20260516_160541_989.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EogRkSNJLpoKzbvV5eWqyuEjxX362aMCn7HxxDihJxjhaTadLFwUbH6BacSF9T9gSTc.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160546_423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoCkyqjGx713sypYJGcziRYicsjRZQZcfs16xhVimD28zHNyspKJzB6skTZ4upHsacc.jpg)


---
---
---


# **HOW DO THE MAIZE SEEDS LOOKS LIKE?** 



* The Maize seed is always numerous in the sense that even when you harvest your already matured Maize and you intend to save the seed for another planting season. You will always extract the SEEDS. And store them in a very cool environment then you add preservatives to it. That makes it more easy and also give it a very long duration in terms of storage. That was why I said your maize is always numerous. 


![IMG_20260516_160554_961.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EowJbD7PUtnzGQ77LNoWhfQcrKJNnT9WWZR1JUreHZ521hjZ1zHoti7shz4exQtJ56D.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160559_638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EonoQty51gUNqiC5CJv47Mg6MhrjwP7MCF8qKF3KcTw437paUzBvkuV2nrNmZcBQW6R.jpg)


![IMG_20260516_160604_811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoyRvhBLBHsacFvBZpSsXG9vUxwb7p9AMx83SEPB7wN7x1JjssZaNgwv5YXb7m6KuDC.jpg)

As the planting continues you must also know that. The counting of the Maize seeds depends on individual choices as well. there are some farmers that Plants only two seeds in a hole. But in my own case I planted four seeds for a reason. I noticed that animals such as squirrel always visit the farm and damage the seeds. So it's for a reason and a purpose.  

![IMG_20260516_160610_689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EouAhq4unFrskb9GvVfBVHP3J5nqN4QZG5U7z5A3PNTuKa4QGpX2U9T1wTk5zhSU9qm.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160613_085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Eo8ViFESYB9AS1m9zFdVUjMxTTXcEdiQi9wUvTppMTw2G6P7SnBbxqi3W1RaMrvPTCm.jpg)

![IMG_20260516_160615_674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoeGop8DZN47taH2zXUgmZQbkDtPEGX8na5ivkavnuYu6uj4kQjqRvJuLpobeqrifAP.jpg)


Then I placed the seeds into the already open up holes. As soon in the pictures. I am giving more illustrative pictures so that it will be easy for more people to remember and also trace my steps. After that I also covered the soil heavily sometimes because of erosion. That is why agriculture is always with one step at a time. If you forgot this step it is just a waste of time in Planting. Now the Maize is ready for germination.  


![IMG_20260516_160632_924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Eo8UibeecCgoTbbLbrxoEAdBBBEjGqESjeiGJFqybgGoguHGAB4EAwQBxEfwW6xz429.jpg)

title.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory (1971)Is a Strange, Funny, and Timeless Family Classic. Even with Some Corny Moments, It Still Has a Certain Magic That Never Goes Away.
title.body:
Released in 1971, Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory is one of those movies that generations keep discovering over and over again. It is weird, colorful, funny, and sometimes a little creepy, but that is part of what makes it so memorable. Even though parts of the movie can feel corny by today’s standards, it still holds up because of its charm and imagination.

![IMG_2260.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbdorrvgaZP98yhz5XrWJCA7cBQ5Enh6NedQj8EJT6C8g/IMG_2260.webp)

The film was directed by Mel Stuart and based on the classic Roald Dahl novel. Stuart gives the movie a dreamlike feel that works perfectly for the story. The film constantly feels like it exists somewhere between fantasy and reality, which adds to its unique atmosphere.

Gene Wilder stars as Willy Wonka, and honestly it is impossible to imagine anyone else in the role. Wilder gives one of the most unforgettable performances in movie history. He plays Wonka as funny, mysterious, sarcastic, and slightly unhinged all at once. You are never quite sure if he is a genius or completely insane, and that unpredictability makes the character fascinating.

Peter Ostrum plays Charlie Bucket, the kind hearted young boy who wins a golden ticket to tour Wonka’s famous chocolate factory. Charlie is the emotional center of the film. Unlike the other children, he is humble and appreciative, which is why audiences naturally root for him.

![IMG_2259.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmezzaLhXyjVhjWjSVocgPSKtRR5pHMVXcaj22Rqus6GZL/IMG_2259.webp)

The supporting cast is a huge part of the fun. Each child who visits the factory represents a different bad behavior or personality flaw. Augustus Gloop is greedy, Veruca Salt is spoiled, Violet Beauregarde is obnoxious, and Mike Teevee is obsessed with television. Watching chaos unfold around them becomes one of the film’s biggest strengths.

The plot follows Charlie after he finds one of the five golden tickets hidden inside Wonka chocolate bars. Winning the ticket gives him the chance to tour the mysterious chocolate factory that nobody has entered in years.

Once the group enters the factory, the movie becomes a series of strange and imaginative set pieces. Chocolate rivers, edible landscapes, wild inventions, and bizarre rooms make the factory feel completely unpredictable. You genuinely never know what strange thing is coming next.

Even though some effects and performances feel dated now, there is still something charming about the old school style of the film. The practical sets and handmade look give the movie personality that many modern family films are missing.

![IMG_2261.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSKHQdmcj9i6euxfVfJbE9REAJxY94mYUBsbYwxMB8cRo/IMG_2261.webp)

The songs are another major part of the experience. Some are silly, some are catchy, and some are intentionally strange. They add to the odd atmosphere of the movie and help make it unforgettable.

Gene Wilder completely carries the film from beginning to end. His delivery, expressions, and timing are perfect. He can go from warm and funny to unsettling in seconds, and that balance is what makes his version of Wonka so iconic.

There is also a surprisingly dark edge underneath the family friendly surface. Some scenes are genuinely unsettling, especially for younger viewers, but that strange tone is part of why the movie stands out so much.

At its core, the film is really about character and morality. Charlie succeeds not because he is smarter or luckier than everyone else, but because he stays honest and kind when it matters most.

Even with some cheesy dialogue and old fashioned moments, the movie still works because it has heart. It never feels cynical or manufactured. It feels creative in a way that modern films sometimes struggle to capture.

![IMG_2262.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQsYpyUbGCnn3wWYyZWs2D34Dr6exYJMoPF3eKnehK3Cf/IMG_2262.webp)

Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory remains a true classic because it is completely unique. Funny, strange, imaginative, and a little corny at times, but that is honestly part of its charm. It is one of those films that sticks with you long after it ends.

title.title: Fashion Trends and the Pressure to Look Perfect
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZbzsREHv2eGCSCZkYWjx5dTkwkLLQJmtNuPvdpHVs8JZ/1779916351217.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnfpToVBdmWbujW7TJwozVfoUvnrTrPiNtzohLFuGkkE/1779916351287.jpg)

Nowadays, fashion is no longer limited to clothes only. Almost every second person on social media is following some kind of trend. Sometimes oversized shirts become popular, sometimes sneakers, and sometimes styles go viral that do not even seem practical in real life. Honestly, it feels like people enjoy fashion less and compete more.
I have personally noticed that whenever a new fashion trend appears, people immediately try to copy it. It does not matter whether it suits their personality or not. They just want to fit in or look good online. This pressure is especially strong among young people.
One of my friends once spent almost half of his salary just to buy trending shoes. When I asked him why he spent so much money, he laughed and said, “Bro, style matters too.” But after a few weeks, those same shoes were no longer considered trendy. That was the moment I realized that fashion never stops. What is trending today can become outdated tomorrow.
That does not mean fashion is a bad thing. Fashion is actually a way of expressing yourself. The way a person dresses often reflects their personality. The real problem starts when people make themselves uncomfortable just to impress others.
These days, street fashion is becoming very popular. Loose shirts, cargo pants, caps, and clean sneakers are everywhere. Personally, I prefer simple fashion. Nothing too heavy or overloaded with fake brands. Just clean and comfortable. Because real confidence does not come from clothes; it comes from a person’s behavior and attitude.
Social media has made the fashion industry move very fast. One viral reel can change market trends overnight. Even in Pakistan, fashion trends change quickly now. Local brands are also following international styles. Still, I believe we should value our cultural dressing too. Traditional shalwar kameez has its own elegance that never gets old.
In the end, I would simply say: follow fashion, but do not ignore your comfort or financial limits. Not every trend is made for everyone. The best fashion is the one that naturally suits you.
“Clothes do not only cover the body; sometimes they also cover insecurities and build confidence.”

title.title: El deseo de robarte una noche (Parte 3) (🇪🇸ES-EN🇺🇸)/ The Desire to Steal a Night Away (Part 3)
title.body:
/>

Rafael dijo que no tenía que robarlo. Que solo debía pedírselo y él vendría a mí. 

Y yo, que siempre tengo una respuesta para todo, esta vez, me quedé callada como boba.

Él se acercó un poco más. Ya no había un metro de distancia. Se podía sentir el calor de su cuerpo y un silencio que pesaba más que cualquier palabra.

—¿Por qué tan silenciosa, Sofía? —susurró—. La mujer que conocí hace dos años no se callaba nunca.

—Porque esa mujer no esperaba escuchar una respuesta así —dije, y mi voz sonó más frágil de lo que quería.

---

Rafael said he didn't have to steal it. That I just had to ask him, and he would come to me.

And I, who always have an answer for everything, this time, stood there silent like a fool.

He moved a little closer. There was no longer a meter between us. You could feel the heat of his body and a silence that weighed more than any words.

\

I said, and my voice sounded more fragile than I wanted it to.

---

Rafael levantó la mano y rozó mi barbilla con sus dedos. Fue un gesto tan suave que me dolió.

—Entonces deja de calcular todo —dijo—. Solo por esta noche.

Y justo en ese momento sonó un teléfono. El suyo. 

Rafael sacó el móvil del bolsillo del pantalón. Miró la pantalla y sus gestos se llenaron de tensión. No contestó, pero yo alcancé a ver el nombre de la llamada.

Yenifer.

La mujer que estaba con él en la fiesta. La que mis hombres dejaron plantada sin más. 

—¿No vas a contestar? —pregunté, cruzando los brazos.

—No —dijo, y apagó el teléfono.

Me quedé mirándolo. Cinco segundos, tal vez diez.

---

Rafael raised his hand and brushed my chin with his fingers. It was such a gentle gesture that it hurt.

\

And right at that moment, a phone rang. His.

Rafael took the mobile out of his pants pocket. He looked at the screen and his demeanor became tense. He didn't answer, but I managed to see the name of the caller.

Yenifer.

The woman who was with him at the party. The one my men left stranded without a second thought.

\

he said, and turned off the phone.

I just stood there looking at him. Five seconds, maybe ten.

---

—¿Quién es Yenifer? —pregunté, aunque ya me sabía la respuesta.

—Alguien con quien he salido estos meses —dijo, sin rodeos—. Nada serio.

—Nada serio —repetí, y solté una risa amarga—. Como yo hace dos años, ¿no? Un encuentro en una fiesta, nada serio, y mira dónde estamos.

Rafael me miró fijo. No se echó atrás.

—Tú no fuiste nada serio porque tú lo quisiste así, desapareciste —dijo, y esta vez su voz sí se quebró un poco—. Yo te busqué. Pregunté por ti. Nadie quiso darme tu nombre completo. Solo sabía que te llamabas Sofía y que eras dueña de un negocio. ¿Crees que no lo intenté?

---

\
I asked, even though I already knew the answer.\n\n\
I repeated, and let out a bitter laugh. \

Rafael stared at me. He didn't back down.

\
he said, and this time his voice did break a little. \

---

Eso sí que me dejó helada.

Durante dos años creí que él había seguido con su vida como si nada. Que nuestra conversación aquella noche había sido solo eso: una conversación. Pero ahora me decía que me había buscado.

—No lo sabía —dije en voz baja.

—Porque te alejaste sin más —respondió él.

El teléfono volvió a sonar.

Otra vez Yenifer.

---

That left me completely frozen.

For two years I thought he had gone on with his life as if nothing had happened. That our conversation that night had been just that: a conversation. But now he was telling me he had looked for me.

\

he replied.

The phone rang again.

Yenifer again.

---

Esta vez Rafael lo agarró, miró la pantalla un instante… y lo dejó caer sobre la cama. No apagado. Simplemente lo dejó allí, vibrando, mientras me volvía a mirar.

—Te pedí una noche —dije, tragando saliva—. No te pedí que fueras mío para siempre. 

—Y yo te estoy diciendo que una noche no me alcanza —respondió él.

Y ahí fue cuando entendí que el plan de robarme a un hombre por una noche se había salido de control. 

Porque la que terminó robada fui yo.

Y yo no sabía si quería ser devuelta.

Continuará...

---

This time Rafael grabbed it, looked at the screen for a moment... and let it drop onto the bed. Not turned off. He just left it there, vibrating, while he turned to look at me again.

\

he replied.

And that was when I understood that the plan to steal a man for one night had spiraled out of control.

Because the one who ended up stolen was me.

And I didn't know if I wanted to be given back.

To be continúe...

----

¿Creen que Yenifer va a aparecer en el hotel? ¿Y si Rafael le mintió a Sofía sobre haberla buscado? En la Parte 4: lo que pasó cuando alguien tocó la puerta de la habitación 309…

---

Do you think Yenifer is going to show up at the hotel? And what if Rafael lied to Sofía about having looked for her? In Part 4: what happened when someone knocked on the door of room 309…

title.title: Pintando Sueños con Manitos Pequeñas ✨| Painting Dreams with Little Hands ✨
title.body:
>

La iniciación musical es mucho más que aprender teoría o dominar un instrumento; es un camino de descubrimiento donde el juego y el arte son los mejores aliados. Como docentes, entendemos que para conectar realmente con los niños, es vital romper las barreras y ponerse a su nivel.

​Hoy en nuestro programa decidimos transformar nuestra dinámica habitual. En lugar de sentarnos en sillas, nos bajamos al suelo para convertir el espacio en un lienzo gigante. Fue una experiencia preciosa ver cómo, entre colores y dibujos, todos compartimos materiales y sonrisas, pasando una tarde distinta y llena de magia.

​Cuando nos colocamos a su nivel, no solo fomentamos su creatividad, sino que fortalecemos el vínculo emocional y la confianza necesaria para su desarrollo artístico. La música y la pintura son lenguajes que se entrelazan para dar voz a su imaginación. Gracias a mis pequeños artistas por recordarme que, a veces, lo más sencillo es lo que más impacto deja en el corazón. ¡Seguimos creciendo y creando juntos en esta maravillosa aventura musical!


__________

Musical education is much more than just learning theory or mastering an instrument; it is a journey of discovery in which play and art are our best allies. As teachers, we understand that to truly connect with children, it is essential to break down barriers and meet them where they are.

Today, in our program, we decided to change up our usual routine. Instead of sitting in chairs, we sat on the floor to turn the space into a giant canvas. It was a wonderful experience to see how, amidst colors and drawings, we all shared materials and smiles, spending a unique afternoon full of magic.

When we get down to their level, we not only foster their creativity but also strengthen the emotional bond and trust necessary for their artistic development. Music and painting are languages that intertwine to give voice to their imagination. Thank you to my little artists for reminding me that, sometimes, the simplest things are the ones that leave the deepest impact on the heart. We continue to grow and create together on this wonderful musical adventure!
