title.title: The Verdict (La condena) [EN/ES]
title.body:
> “Mr. Arnold Weir is charged with the first-degree murder of Jerry Hause.” The judge opened the hearing. The prosecutor took the stand and then stood up to address the judge and the jury. “During this trial, I intend to prove that Mr. Arnold is guilty of murdering his lover, Jerry Hause, with malice aforethought.” The prosecutor paced back and forth, gesturing and lending an almost theatrical drama to his presentation of the case. “Objection, Your Honor. The prosecutor is getting nowhere with this over-the-top presentation.” The defense attorney rose energetically from his seat. “Sustained, Mr. Prosecutor. Please get to the point.” The judge admonished him. “Excuse me, Your Honor. On the morning of December 23, Mr. Arnold Weir went to the deceased’s home. After a few hours, he left the premises, around 4 p.m. Mr. Jerry Hause was found by the housekeeper with multiple injuries.” “Objection, Your Honor. The prosecutor is making assertions without presenting concrete evidence.” The defense attorney raised his arm forcefully. “Sustained. Prosecutor, please present evidence or witnesses to support what you are saying,” the judge urged him. “Allow me, Your Honor, I’m going to call the defendant’s wife. Mrs. Terry Smith.” Terry stepped out from among the attendees, moving elegantly. Her fur coat, wide-brimmed hat, and dark glasses caught everyone’s attention. She walked slowly to the witness stand, and Arnold’s eyes widened. Terry walked past her husband, ignoring him. An officer administered the oath to the woman, and she sat down on the mahogany-colored wooden bench. The prosecutor approached Terry. “Good afternoon, Mrs. Terry. How long have you been married to Mr. Arnold?” “I’ve held out until today, because after finding out about that man’s infidelity—and what’s even more outrageous, with another man—I’ve had enough of this charade. I can’t believe it!” Terry took off her glasses and began to weep uncontrollably. “Objection, Your Honor. The witness must refer to the events of the day Mr. Jerry Hause was murdered.” The lawyer spoke up again. “Sustained, Ms. Terry. Please refer to the events of December 23rd.” The judge admonished the distraught woman. “Ms. Terry, what happened on December 23rd?” The prosecutor stared intently at the woman. “That day, Arnold and I had an argument; our relationship had been deteriorating for years. I didn’t know that man’s sexual preferences had changed until I found out about the affair Arnold was having with Jerry. I started following him to confirm his infidelity. On December 23, after fighting with me, he grabbed his jacket and a cap and stormed out of the house. I followed him, and he went into that house. I couldn’t believe it.” Terry pulled out a white silk handkerchief and wiped her tearful eyes. “He stood there for several minutes and then ran away.” “Mrs. Terry, could you tell us the exact time when Mr. Arnold ran out of the house?” the prosecutor asked the distraught woman. “It was around 3:45 p.m.” “That woman is lying!” Arnold stood up indignantly. The judge tapped his gavel lightly on the bench. “Order, order in the courtroom.” “Objection, Your Honor, Mrs. Terry must have evidence to support what she is claiming,” the lawyer interjected forcefully. “Mrs. Terry has photos she took with her cell phone.” The prosecutor handed the printed photos to the judge. “Objection, Your Honor, the photos could have been taken at any time.” “Sustained, Mr. Prosecutor. How can we know that these photos are from that time?” The judge looked intently at the prosecutor. “Check the metadata for the photos, Your Honor.” The prosecutor handed Terry’s cell phone over. The judge looked closely at each photo on the phone. “The date and time match what Ms. Terry said, although the photos don’t focus very well on Mr. Arnold’s face, his build and the clothes he was wearing that day match perfectly.” The judge passed the phone back to the prosecutor. “Counsel, do you have any objections to the evidence presented?” “Not at this time, Your Honor.” “That concludes my presentation, Your Honor.” The prosecutor returned to his seat. “Counsel, do you have any questions for Mrs. Terry?” The judge rested his hand on his chin. “Yes.” The attorney stood up and walked over to Terry. “Mrs. Terry, when did you find out that your husband was cheating on you?” “Objection, Your Honor, I don’t see how this question relates to the case.” The prosecutor stood up from his seat. “Sustained, Counsel. What are you trying to get at with this question?” The judge adjusted his glasses to see better. “Your Honor, I just want to verify dates to ensure accuracy regarding the times and dates mentioned here.” “I see no problem with that, but if Mrs. Terry does not wish to answer, that is her right.” The judge gave the woman a subtle nod. “I see no problem with that—it was a month before the murder.” Terry continued to dab her eyes with the handkerchief. “Although Mr. Arnold claims that you had confronted him about his infidelity a week before the murder of Mr. Jerry Hause, is that true?” Terry began looking around and showing slight nervousness. “Objection, Your Honor, this is irrelevant to the case.” The prosecutor spoke up again. “Sustained, Counsel. Please limit your questions to matters relevant to the case, or else call your next witness.” “I have no further questions.” The lawyer returned to his seat. “Mr. Prosecutor, do you have your next witness?” The judge looked at him. “He’s not a witness. I’d like to call Mr. Arnold Weir to the stand.” Arnold stood up in response to the call. “Mr. Arnold, can you tell us what happened on the afternoon of December 23rd?” “I left the house after arguing with Terry and went to Jerry’s house, but he only met me at the door; he was acting a little strange. Then I went to the supermarket to do some shopping, and then to see an old friend.” “What time did you arrive at the supermarket?” The prosecutor stared intently at Arnold. “At 3:45 p.m.” “What time did you leave your house to go to Jerry’s?” “I left at 3:00 p.m. It took me half an hour to get to Jerry’s house, and I was there for about five minutes. Then I went to the supermarket, which is 20 minutes away, and after that I headed to my friend’s place, which is five minutes from the supermarket.” Arnold crossed his arms. “So technically there’s a half-hour where you can’t confirm your whereabouts, right?” The prosecutor flashed a malicious smile. “Well, well…” Arnold looked nervous. “What time were the photos taken?” The prosecutor gestured exaggeratedly to the jury. “That woman is lying; I’m telling the truth.” Arnold was losing his temper. Some officers tried to restrain Arnold. The judge banged his fist on the bench, and chaos broke out in the courtroom. “Order in the courtroom! Order in the courtroom! Or I’ll have you all arrested for contempt.” The courtroom fell silent, and everyone returned to their seats. “Your Honor, I believe there is no need for further investigation; Mr. Arnold is guilty of first-degree murder.” The prosecutor was about to close his case. “It appears this trial is coming to an end. Members of the jury, you may now deliberate and notify me of your verdict,” the judge finished speaking, just as Arnold’s friend came running in. “Wait a minute, I have proof that Arnold is innocent.” The man showed the judge a shopping receipt. “Indeed, this receipt shows the exact time, 3:45, the same time as the photos, so there is no consistency in the evidence presented by the prosecutor.” The judge looked at the worried prosecutor. After much investigation, it was discovered that Terry had planned everything out of revenge, hiring a hitman and then staging the crime to frame Arnold. Terry was convicted, along with the hitman, for the murder of Jerry Hause.

The end

![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)
Español #### La condena

> «El señor Arnold Weir, es acusado por asesinado en primer grado de Jerry Hause». El juez daba comienzo a la audiencia. El fiscal tomaba la palabra y luego se paraba para dirigirse hasta el juez y al jurado. «En el trascurso de este juicio, me propongo demostrar que el señor Arnold es culpable de asesinar a su amante Jerry Hause con premeditación y alevosía». El fiscal se movía se un lado a otro gesticulando y dándole un dramatismo casi teatral a la exposición del caso. «Protesto, señor juez. El fiscal no está llegando a ningún lado con esta sobreactuada exposición». El abogado, enérgico se levantaba del asiento. «Ha lugar, señor fiscal, vaya al grano, por favor». El juez le llamaba la atención. «Disculpe, su señoría. La mañana del 23 de diciembre el señor Arnold Weir, fue a la casa del occiso. Luego de algunas horas, salió del lugar, eso de las3.45 pm. El señor Jerry Hause fue encontrado por la empleada de servicio, con múltiples traumatismos». «Protesto, señor juez. El fiscal afirma sin presentar pruebas concisas». El abogado levantaba el brazo enérgicamente. «Ha lugar. Señor fiscal, por favor, presente pruebas o testigos de lo que está diciendo», el juez lo instaba. «Permítame, señor juez, voy a llamar a la esposa del acusado. La señora Terry Smith». De entre los asistentes salía Terry, se movía elegantemente. El abrigo de piel, el sobrero de ala ancha y las gafas oscuras, llamaban la atención de todos. Lentamente iba al estrado y Arnold abría los ojos al máximo. Terry pasaba e ignoraba a su esposo. Un oficial tomaba el juramento de la mujer y se sentaba en el banquillo de madera de color caoba. El fiscal se acercaba hasta Terry. «Buena tarde, señora Terry, ¿cuánto tiempo lleva de casada con el señor Arnold?». «Llevaba hasta el día de hoy, porque después de saber la infidelidad de ese hombre, y lo más indignante con otro hombre, he terminado con esta farsa. ¡No puedo creerlo!». Terry se sacaba las gafas y empezaba a llorar desconsoladamente. «Protesto, señor juez, la testigo debe remitirse al hecho del día del asesinato del señor Jerry Hause». El abogado volvía a intervenir. «Ha lugar, señora Terry, por favor remítase al hecho del 23 de diciembre». El juez llamaba la atención a la desconsolada mujer. «¿Señora Terry, qué pasó el 23 de diciembre?». El fiscal miraba fijamente a la mujer. «Ese día discutimos con Arnold, nuestra relación estaba deteriorada hacía años. Yo no sabía que las preferencias sexuales de ese hombre habían cambiado, hasta que me llegue a enterar de la aventura que Arnold sostenía con Jerry. Yo empecé a seguirlo para comprobar su infidelidad. El 23 de diciembre después de pelear conmigo tomó su chaqueta y una gorra y salió furioso de la casa. Yo lo seguí y él entraba en esa casa. No lo podía creer». Terry sacaba un pañuelo de seda blanco y lo pasaba por sus ojos lagrimosos. «En ese lugar estuvo varios minutos y luego salió corriendo». «Señora Terry, ¿podría decirnos la hora exacta, cuando el señor Arnold salió corriendo de la casa?», el fiscal preguntaba a la angustiada mujer. «Eran alrededor de las 3:45 pm». «¡Esa mujer está mintiendo!». Arnold se levantaba indignado. El juez movía el mazo golpeando en escritorio con sutileza. «Orden, orden en la sala». «Protesto, señor juez, la señora Terry debe tener pruebas de lo que está afirmando», el abogado intervenía enérgicamente. «La señora Terry tiene fotos que tomó con su celular». El fiscal pasaba las fotos impresas juez. «Protesto, señor juez, las fotos pudieron ser tomadas en cualquier momento». «Ha lugar, señor fiscal, cómo podemos saber que estás fotos son de aquella hora». El juez miraba atentamente al fiscal. «Revise los metadatos de las fotos, señor juez». El fiscal pasaba el celular de Terry. El juez miraba detenidamente cada foto en el celular. «La fecha y hora corresponden a lo que dice la señora Terry, aunque las fotos no enfocan muy bien el rostro del señor Arnold, el físico y la ropa que llevaba ese día coinciden totalmente». El juez pasaba el celular al fiscal. «Señor abogado, ¿tiene alguna objeción a las pruebas presentadas?». «Por el momento no, señor Juez». «Con esto termino mi intervención, señor juez». El fiscal volvía a su puesto. «Señor abogado, ¿tiene alguna pregunta para la señora Terry?». El juez se colocaba la mano en la barbilla. «Sí». El abogado se levantaba y se dirigía hasta Terry. «Señora Terry, ¿cuándo supo que su esposo le era infiel?». «Protesto, señor juez, no veo la relación de la pregunta con el caso». El fiscal se levantaba del asiento. «Ha lugar, señor abogado, ¿a dónde quiere llegar con esta pregunta?». El juez se acomodaba las gafas para ver mejor. «Señor juez, solo quiero corroborar fechas para tener exactitud entre tiempos y fechas aquí dichas». «No le veo inconveniente, pero si la señora Terry no quiere contestar está en su derecho». El juez hacia un gesto sutil a la mujer «No le veo inconveniente fue un mes antes del asesinato». Terry seguía pasando el pañuelo sobre los ojos. «Aunque el señor Arnold afirma que usted le había reclamado por la infidelidad hacía una semana antes del asesinato del señor Jerry Hause, ¿es verdad?». Terry empezó a mirar a todos lados y mostrar un leve nerviosismo. «Protesto, señor Juez, esto no tiene relevancia al caso». El fiscal volvía a intervenir. «Ha lugar, señor abogado, remítase a hacer preguntas concernientes al caso o de lo contrario llame a su siguiente testigo». «No tengo más preguntas». El abogado volvía a su lugar. «Señor Fiscal, ¿tiene a su siguiente testigo?». El juez lo miraba. «No es testigo. Quiero llamar al estrado al Señor Arnold Weir». Arnold se levantaba atendiendo el llamado. «Señor Arnold, ¿puede decirnos que aconteció el 23 de diciembre en las horas de la tarde?» «Salí de la casa después de discutir con Terry y fui a la casa de Jerry, pero solo me recibió de la puerta, actuaba algo extraño. Luego salí hacia el supermercado a hacer unas compras, para luego ir donde un viejo amigo». «¿A qué horas llegó al supermercado?». El fiscal miraba fijamente a Arnold «A las 3:45 pm de la tarde». «¿A qué hora salió de su casa para ir con Jerry?». «Salí a las 3:00 pm, me tomó media hora llegar a casa de Jerry y ahí estuve unos cinco minutos, luego salí al supermercado que está a 20 minutos, después me dirigí a donde mi amigo, que su casa se encuentra a cinco minutos del supermercado». Arnold cruzaba los brazos. «Asi que técnicamente hay media hora donde no podría confirmar su paradero, ¿verdad?». El fiscal mostraba una sonrisa malévola. «Pues, pues...». Arnold se mostraba nervioso. «¿A que hora fueron tomadas las fotos?». El fiscal gesticulaba exageradamente al jurado. «Esa mujer miente, yo estoy diciendo la verdad». Arnold se salía de sus casillas. Unos oficiales trataban de contener a Arnold. El juez golpeaba enérgicamente el escritorio y el caos se desató en la sala. «¡Orden en la sala! ¡Orden en la sala! O los haré arrestar por desacato a todos». La sala quedaba en silencio y todos volvían a sus lugares. «Señor juez, creo que no hay más que seguir investigando, el señor Arnold es culpable de homicidio en primer grado». El fiscal daba paso a la ofuscación. «Me parece que este juicio está por terminar. Señores del jurado pueden deliberar para notificarme su veredicto», el juez terminaba de hablar, en ese momento, el amigo Arnold entraba corriendo. «Momento, tengo la prueba de que Arnold es inocente». El hombre mostraba un recibo de compras al juez. «Efectivamente, este recibo muestra la hora exacta 3:45, la misma hora de las fotos, así que no hay coherencia en las pruebas presentadas por el señor fiscal». El juez miraba al preocupado fiscal. Después de muchas indagaciones se descubrió que Terry había planeado todo por venganza, contratando a un asesino y luego hizo un montaje para inculpar a Arnold. Terry fue condenada al igual que el asesino por el homicidio de Jerry Hause.

Fin

title.title: Cristo Rey Amigurumi
title.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, hace unos días se comunicó una cliente expresándome su interés en un amigurumi, pero ella tenía la duda de si se podía hacer de pequeño tamaño para un llavero, en ese momento me sentí muy complacida de poderle decir que sí, pues aunque algunas personas que hacen amigurumis prefieren evitar hacer amigurumis pequeños por el gran esfuerzo físico que representa, a mí me encanta hacerlos y retarme a mí misma en la cantidad de detales que puedo hacer en esa escala, en esta ocasión el personaje es un Cristo Rey, ella me envió algunas referencias hechas con IA pero ni con eso lograron convencerme, así que busque la imagen realista y ahí si pude ver cuáles eran los atributos iconográficos de la imagen, como por ejemplo el corazón en el pecho, la capa ropa y la corono, a partir de allí hice mi propio patrón 😊, lo mejor es que la cliente quedó muy feliz con el resultado y yo de haber cumplido con el reto. > Greetings, dear community! A few days ago, a client contacted me expressing interest in an amigurumi. She was wondering if it could be made small enough for a keychain. I was delighted to say yes, because while some amigurumi makers prefer to avoid small ones due to the physical effort involved, I love making them and challenging myself with the level of detail I can achieve at that scale. This time, the character is Christ the King. She sent me some AI-generated references, but even those didn't convince me. So, I looked for a realistic image, and that's when I could see the iconic attributes, such as the heart on his chest, the cape, and the crown. From there, I created my own pattern. 😊 The best part is that the client was very happy with the result, and I was thrilled to have met the challenge.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Eos579XWMX4cHJsfkc9xpyFqfmAMhTqdVkVuozXybpfrFEzTH2ZxEY2gdyMaGyx7CY6.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Trabajé con hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25 mm, comencé con al suela de las sandalias con hilo marrón y 3 cadenas de base, hice dos hileras con aumentos en las esquinas para obtener un óvalo de 12, cambié a hilo color piel hice 2 hileras sin aumentos y una hilera con 4 disminuciones en la punta para obtener el tobillo de 8 y continué la pierna con 3 hileras, uní las piernas por dos cadenas, trabajé con 20 puntadas por 4 hileras, aparte hice la falda con 30 cadenas en círculo y 8 hileras, uní a la cintura y continué el tronco solo con 20 puntadas. > I worked with acrylic yarn and a 1.25 mm crochet hook. I started with the sole of the sandals using brown yarn and 3 base chains. I made two rows with increases at the corners to obtain an oval of 12. I changed to skin-colored yarn and made 2 rows without increases and one row with 4 decreases at the toe to obtain the ankle of 8. I continued the leg with 3 rows, joined the legs by two chains, and worked with 20 stitches for 4 rows. Separately, I made the skirt with 30 chains in a circle and 8 rows, joined it to the waist, and continued the torso with only 20 stitches.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJpkWc1u7mfeRUduRgSRA171D5HGyhauD4zX1nDbeyr6a4uwkxtXZa6DYP3vti9.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Aparte hice los brazos con 8 puntos bajos en una nillo y 3 hileras, aparte hice la manga de 12 cadenas en círculo y 1 hilera de puntos bajos, uní al brazo y continué con 8 puntadas por 4 hileras, uní los brazos a los lados del tronco y continué con las disminuciones de los hombros, cambié a color piel para continuar el cuello de 12 puntadas, para la cabeza hice 6 aumentos por hilera hasta obtener 36, hice 10 hileras sin aumentos, coloqué los ojos y luego 6 disminuciones por hilera hasta cerrar. > Separately I made the arms with 8 single crochet stitches in a ring and 3 rows, separately I made the sleeve with 12 chains in a circle and 1 row of single crochet stitches, I joined it to the arm and continued with 8 stitches for 4 rows, I joined the arms to the sides of the torso and continued with the decreases for the shoulders, I changed to skin color to continue the neck with 12 stitches, for the head I made 6 increases per row until I got 36, I made 10 rows without increases, I placed the eyes and then 6 decreases per row until closed.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJmsdWfUNRVQuiZDsAV5iXzda1d4wTnxX2tPbhtgjbRK6VWr8zw2T75S36frQTS.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para el cabello hice un círculo de 24 puntadas y luego 24 mechones de 18 cadena y 18 puntos deslizados en las cadenas, hice la barba y bordé los detalles de los ojos y la nariz, también hice las orejas, bordé los detalles del corazón, el cinturón y las sandalias, con hilo rojo hice la capa con un borde de color trigo, también del mismo color trigo hice la corona tomando como referencia el circulo baje del cabello. > For the hair I made a circle of 24 stitches and then 24 strands of 18 chain stitches and 18 slip stitches in the chains, I made the beard and embroidered the details of the eyes and nose, I also made the ears, embroidered the details of the heart, the belt and the sandals, with red thread I made the cape with a wheat-colored border, also in the same wheat color I made the crown taking as a reference the circle I made for the hair.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJj1UHnoV5yyh1eTWUZW6k4ZJWeooyenGTJqSs3SXdyYJTCMr5HNih6BsaHMn8E.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbeRT8mGgkLCaL6PSN5Xtap38e1etWn8vEiLQHQb8unY7/image.png)

>[Anchor]
Ukraine's President Zelenskyy has sent a letter to U.S. President Trump at a time when Russia has predicted a massive attack.
He appealed for additional support for Patriot missiles, the core power of the air defense network.
He urgently asked for help, saying there was a serious lack of weapons to prevent Russian missiles.
I'm correspondent Song Young-seok in Berlin.

>[Report]
The city sky was covered with black smoke.
Eleven people, including two children, were injured when Russian forces struck the southern Ukrainian port city of Odesa.
Private commercial facilities were the main targets.

>[Marina Averina/Odesa State Emergency Management Agency spokesperson: \

]
Russia, which predicted a large-scale airstrike targeting the capital Kyiv on the 25th, has been attacking Ukraine with an average of about 100 drones a day since then.
Compared to the fact that hundreds of drones were bombarded every day immediately after the Victory Day, the offensive seems to have subsided somewhat.

>However, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy sent an urgent letter to U.S. President Trump because he doesn't know when Russia will launch another high-intensity attack.
There is a serious shortage of air defense missiles.
In particular, he said he relies entirely on the United States to intercept Russian ballistic missiles and earnestly asked for additional support for his key air defense weapon, the Patriot missile system.
[Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky: \

]

>Russia has urged diplomats from countries in Kyiv to withdraw, but tensions are also rising in Kyiv as the EU and some Western countries refuse and strongly protest.
I'm Song Young-seok of KBS News in Berlin.
Video editing: Han Mi-hee/Research: Kim Dae-young

title.title: ¡Los zombies me comen! | [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Zombies_invading_garden_plants_d…_202605272108.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23x1BcNev6wjGJ3XcPmAZZ23izgQMM925seyS2gddCgQumLdy6Hf4GZBmPDf2f61hPpQw.jpeg)
*(Imagen generada con Flow).*

Hace unas semanas atrás cuando estaba algo enferma y desganada decidí descargarme un juego que me gustaba mucho jugar cuando era pequeña, este era Plantas vs Zombies.

Era uno de los pocos juegos que acabé de jugar por completo, pero al descargarlo de nuevo me di cuenta que me faltó jugar los minijuegos jeje así que me puse en campaña para jugar lo más posible y conocer más a fondo las demás características.

![portada juego.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23wgF9PQaKwd949BgAdiDHbyr24WMCWwgkX7dvNE3DkZEQDaEXR2fdHuBssfWYCCmRNDN.png)
Inicio del juego. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Como era de esperarse recordé casi todos los tips que había para lograr ganar más rápido, pero ya cuando se puso difícil, en especial los juegos secundarios, ahí si ya no pude pasar del todo, pero es lo es interesante de volver a jugar, que puedes mejorar tus estrategias y encontrar cosas nuevas para divertirte.

Como cualquier juego, esto me genera cierta adrenalina, estrés y ansiedad jeje de que los zombies no entren a mi casa y me coman. Pero ayuda a pasar el rato y a crear mejores estrategias para ganar.

![plantas.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23wXA9o7LWzGtebMGQKz2E965f67vYtYeZqLAUGNaowKJUyoCx4nrHSJ8WoF1WZ1P7okj.png)
Mi colección de plantas. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

![zombies.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EoyQYjpFkTDodR5BDQpUNMJ1em5ygTgbgNjB1mKFDFJ9DyFC8HHPzouaDwUX9XFrbPi.png)
Los zombies que logré encontrar. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Quizá varios lo conozcan y además de que salió una segunda versión, esa aún no la juego porque quiero terminar bien el primero. Hay varias cosas que me gustan del juego, como ciertas plantas y ciertos zombies pero que más odio que salgan jeje.

Por ejemplo, en plantas me gusta mucho las que hacen explotar a grandes grupos de zombies como el cherry, la que se parece a una pera, el ají y el hongo negro, son mis mejores aliados cuando hay hordas de zombies y sobre todo de los más fuertes.

![plantas preferidas.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23y94PqEJhyetXiduuX84cXnpyziLB2hSiXJ5eq2p5dotQsghufVxB81e8gYbvfCNY7Fh.png)
Mis plantas favoritas. *(Capturas de pantalla del juego).*

En cuanto a los zombies que detesto que me salgan son varios jeje como ser: el futbolista, el que baila disco, el que tiene su auto que congela todo a su paso, el que tiene su caja sorpresa que hace explotar todo, el que es minero, el que parece araña y se roba plantas, el que tiene su catapulta y el super grande que parece el monstruo de Frankestein.

![zombies odiados.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EnywjCCzZGnx9nVLR6vzv5xPypb4EhHZQfr6bD8goAHQYnXwuPFu87SdE3tHMJ8UM2K.png)
Zombies odiados. *(Capturas de pantalla del juego).*

Creo que me conozco todo lo que tiene este juego, algo que me gusta es que también puedes tener tu jardín zen donde cuidas a tus propias plantas, ganas dinero y puedes venderlas también. Y también puedes hacer crecer un árbol que te da muy buenos consejos para mejorar y ganar las partidas, con él aprendí varias cositas para ganar.

![jardines.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EpT3Eo5D3zAaYYRHbMpBovj1ZZnUWhCStf2u9wr5KPpK7qzVzgdNrTvRaAqNZvGT37b.png)
Los jardines zen y el árbol sabio. *(Capturas de pantalla del juego).*

Otra persona que también ayuda mucho es el vecino… el gran Dave jeje que, aunque diga que está loco, siempre te da tips y te trata de apoyar con sus cosas, como su tienda, también te compra tus plantas y te avisa cuando van a venir grandes hordas de zombies.

![dave vende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23y8uskbqf9ozKNzLv6Hw9iE8kHrVx29oX4oSYjd9Jr7phyL2Jm6dkNbE65BqzqUyKxX1.png)
El loco vecino Dave. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Ahora pasando a los minijuegos y demás juegos secundarios que vienen, uno de los que más me gustan es la de los jarrones donde debes romperlos para que salga o una planta o un zombie y obviamente no dejar que lleguen a tu casa.

![puzzle.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23wCNEnkqYjyCaUEuuXvnBPPpyPQPHnfEAGvaSHJ7WmRY41iD1hjY5Bh87uQtYhDCZiXd.png)
Puzzles ganados. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Otro que me gusta mucho es cuando te pones en el lugar de los zombies y tienes que comerte a las plantas y los cerebros, no solo ves el otro lado del juego sino también te sirve para tomar nota y crear nuevas estrategias de juego.

![minijuegos.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EonoNvyqKvuPXKkJ52b3cpYS73JCdb7g3tF52nNRCaxrd4ebWdtC1Z37xT38DhaM5zz.png)
Minijuegos. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Ahora los juegos de sobrevivencia no solo te ayudan a practicar lo que aprendiste, sino que también puedes conseguir plantas nuevas, coleccionar varios soles y entre otras cosas que te ayudan también a ganar premios que tiene el juego.

![sobrevivir.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23wgayX7M3vvSx3Z82iSkcQZXSXw6YfgZnULPE1aK9C46CmCPHkNXmqjRZhDhNswsaP1Q.png)
Juegos de supervivencia. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Y hablando de esos premios, aquí tengo algunos que pude ganar, pero aún me faltan varios, son algo complicados de lograr, y me di cuenta que el árbol sabio te da ciertos tips para poder pasarlos.

![logros.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EokbGG8GxELDVrW8oHgCi1BBzF7affATawoLxV9kNhxu58ww8uCh6C33swvturJcgYA.png)
Logros obtenidos. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Algunos lo verán como un juego que te divierte y te hace pasar el tiempo, pero ahora que lo analicé más a detalle me puse a pensar que por detrás hay muchas estrategias que uno debe armar para lograr sobrevivir a los ataques de los zombies.

Por otra parte, también te da mucha energía para hacer otras cosas, bueno es lo que sentí que me pasa, te da cierta adrenalina que te dan este tipo de juegos y te pone muy despierta jeje.

![jugando.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/23wqiH92Ar3mc8JcqQof525yGAZJLfije4xPpU4eNypkMRgVhmaVfCdQe8Z7mza3nSJda.png)
Empezando un nivel nuevo. *(Captura de pantalla del juego).*

Hoy quise compartirles uno de mis juegos favoritos desde pequeña, en un siguiente post les iré contando de otros que también me gusta jugar ya que ahora tengo un poco más de tiempo para jugarlos.

Gracias por leerme, quisiera que me cuenten sus juegos favoritos de niños.

<details>
<summary> Read in English</summary>

# The zombies are eating me!

A few weeks ago, when I was feeling a little sick and under the weather, I decided to download a game I used to love playing when I was little: Plants vs. Zombies.

It was one of the few games I’d actually finished all the way through, but when I downloaded it again, I realized I’d missed out on the mini-games, haha, so I made it my mission to play as much as possible and explore the other features in more depth.

As expected, I remembered almost all the tips for winning faster, but once it got tough—especially the side games—I couldn’t quite get past them. But that’s the fun part of playing again: you can improve your strategies and discover new ways to have fun.

Like any game, this gives me a bit of an adrenaline rush, stress, and anxiety, haha, that the zombies won’t break into my house and eat me. But it helps pass the time and come up with better strategies to win.

Maybe some of you know it, and besides the fact that a second version came out, I haven’t played that one yet because I want to finish the first one properly. There are several things I like about the game, like certain plants and certain zombies, but there are others I really hate seeing show up, haha.

For example, when it comes to plants, I really like the ones that blow up large groups of zombies, like the cherry, the pear-shaped one, the chili pepper, and the black mushroom—they’re my best allies when there are hordes of zombies, especially the strongest ones.

As for the zombies I hate seeing pop up, there are quite a few, haha, like: the soccer player, the one who dances disco, the one with a car that freezes everything in its path, the one with a surprise box that blows everything up, the miner, the one that looks like a spider and steals plants, the one with a catapult, and the super-sized one that looks like Frankenstein’s monster.

I think I know everything this game has to offer. One thing I like is that you can also have your own Zen garden where you take care of your own plants, earn money, and sell them too. And you can also grow a tree that gives you great tips on how to improve and win games—I learned a few tricks from it to help me win.

Another person who helps a lot is the neighbor… the great Dave, haha, who, even though he says he’s crazy, always gives you tips and tries to support you with his stuff, like his shop; he also buys your plants and warns you when huge hordes of zombies are coming.

Now moving on to the mini-games and other side games that come with it, one of my favorites is the one with the vases where you have to break them so either a plant or a zombie comes out—and obviously, you can’t let them reach your house.

Another one I really like is when you take on the role of the zombies and have to eat the plants and brains; not only do you see the other side of the game, but it also helps you take notes and come up with new game strategies.

Now, survival games not only help you practice what you've learned, but you can also find new plants, collect various suns, and do other things that help you earn the game's rewards.

And speaking of those prizes, here are a few I’ve managed to win, but I’m still missing several—they’re a bit tricky to get, and I realized that the wise tree gives you some tips on how to beat them.

Some might see it as a game that’s just fun and helps pass the time, but now that I’ve analyzed it more closely, I started thinking that there are actually a lot of strategies you need to develop to survive the zombie attacks.

On the other hand, it also gives you a lot of energy to do other things—well, that’s what I felt happened to me. It gives you that adrenaline rush that these kinds of games provide and really wakes you up, haha.

Today I wanted to share one of my favorite games from when I was little. In a future post, I’ll tell you about others I also like to play since I now have a little more time to play them.

Thanks for reading. I’d love for you to tell me about your favorite childhood games.

*(Translated with DeepL)*

 👣 𝐹𝑒𝑐ℎ𝑎 𝑑𝑒 𝑁𝑎𝑐𝑖𝑚𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑜: 28 de marzo

![IMG_20260527_212505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23xyfjNweoNb41XRbCKokwtTRi7USRWjBYRu1XPrbM6FYt4nHJDR7Npr5qprHhBAc8X8k.jpg)

Lo más difícil de ser padre y madre no es el cansancio, ni las noches sin dormir, ni los berrinches. Lo más difícil es entender que no te quedas con todas las versiones de tu hijo.

El bebé que se acurrucaba en tu pecho. El niño que decía palabras mal pronunciadas y te hacía reír sin querer. La vocecita que gritaba “¡mamá!” o “¡papá!” cien veces al día. Cada etapa se va y se va antes de que estés listo.
![IMG_20260527_212518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/243zk6dg6u7ruADDHvkhTSxzkavuMp2aUDntNFnk6HmGuiLCg9hALvmBJ7a97HrM1LjHb.jpg)


Nadie te advierte que criar también es despedirse. Que cada cumpleaños es una celebración, y una pequeña despedida de una etapa que no regresará. Que amar a alguien que cambia tan rápido duele de una forma que no sabías que existía.

Y lo más curioso es que no hay un día exacto en que se va. No hay una alarma que te diga “hoy fue la última vez que te pidió que lo cargaras”. Simplemente un día te das cuenta que ya no lo hace. Y te preguntas cuándo fue la última vez sin haberlo notado.

Pero eso también es amor, es amar a ese ser que crece, que se transforma, que se aleja un poco más cada día, y seguir ahí, firme, celebrando cada nueva versión, aunque extrañes sin apegarte a la anterior.

Porque ser padre no es retener, es acompañar, es mirar cómo florece alguien que alguna vez cupo entero en tus brazos
![IMG20260115182401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23tmFR3eqtwdxoeWMehT6mtUP9oYuwoMhRRBGGjBjn6z1ZNYTa7tjhThA2racWXCHgHP6.jpg)
Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛

title.title: A Warm Revisit to Nornnuea Cafe in Chom Tong
title.body:
There are some places that you visit once and somehow they stay in your memory, not just because of the food, but because of the feeling that the place gives you. During our second visit to Chiang Mai, we knew that we wanted to drop by Chom Tong again and revisit Nornnuea Cafe. It was one of those places that gave us a very warm memory from our first trip, so of course we had to come back hahaha.


![1000161985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep3hBHEekuT1JnKvaEq3WyqeX8nGYEhV51fM7QXizHxMdcxHX6RLRbfiatz6P6Ltgid.jpg)


One of the main reasons why we returned was because we missed their food. But aside from that, we also wanted to say hi and catch up with the Auntie who runs the place. During our first visit, she was very helpful to us. She took the time to teach us how to navigate Chom Tong, where to go, and how to move around the area. For travelers like us, that kind of kindness really makes a big difference. It made the cafe feel more personal and memorable.


![1000160963.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep1YMRSU78U4U8a6uYrMo5s84vuZLXMZryCBh2kMpEZADpHUNDcynvc1ETYxQfk7VH7.jpg)


![1000160964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoCi8P4ahdD8BbgQFsNJpBCC7wykBJpt8hB31gP4BiewfDftaCfFcxvGUYkEK8e1ECp.jpg)

![1000160973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EppMCQJ1WpKyzbBWNt3KzRDpPxXZwhL9188K3kUSAwt4LnUVApXJmY8hQssFwAEBGjN.jpg)

![1000160975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGyx4v3CDaLU677aUBQ37gowGKijF4ek5Na4rHtSfWx11JiGrq5HSJrWq32RY81Zep.jpg)



The cafe itself still has that calm and cozy charm that I really like. The wooden tables, soft colors, green plants, and warm lighting make the whole place feel peaceful. It is the kind of cafe where you do not feel rushed. You can sit down, relax, enjoy your meal, and just appreciate the slow and simple rhythm of the day. The ambiance is really perfect, especially if you want a quiet lunch away from the busy tourist spots.


![1000160980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGzqitHbGgc9ujXNKzzYqKmvGhwYUo1WFSV5a67H26nMsgNeKe6pCEX1ZqbHj8jrPQ.jpg)

![1000160981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoAd49gBaQ7JampwEASMEanQJuLKf9qw8pJyeDMeku9aLJfo6H9PrEisNFPEQysK9zi.jpg)


After catching up with Auntie for a few minutes, we finally ordered our food. Since we were not super hungry, we decided to share our favorite dish, which is the fried rice with pork. It was really more about missing the taste and wanting to experience it again. We also ordered drinks, and mine was Thai milk tea. Of course, being in Thailand, I wanted to enjoy that authentic Thai milk tea experience here in Chom Tong. We also added something sweet to the meal, which was a simple waffle with syrup and sliced almonds.


![1000160982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeHKvTe44Xr9cNYKMsXR6UvNK4TMeZcVfDFbV7rxBMTNNAJJXikJadLc1SKBWEiRJZ.jpg)

![1000160983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogQi9Q9MFamxg2p2wV3ub8z5vGo8yRYDFiTsRp5RAataL1Nqtgy76nmG4qowLeojoo.jpg)


The first items served were the drinks, and honestly, just by looking at the presentation, I was already impressed. The Thai milk tea had this beautiful orange color, topped with a soft layer of foam, while the green drink beside it also looked refreshing. We asked for the drinks to be less sweet because sometimes Thai drinks can be quite sweet, but this one was perfectly balanced. The sweetness was just right, and the flavor was still very present. I really enjoyed it so much.

Then came the fried rice with pork, and yes, it was still as good as I remembered. The rice was flavorful, nicely cooked, and mixed with generous bits of pork, egg, and vegetables. It had that homemade comfort but still tasted special enough to feel like a cafe dish. I also liked the fresh vegetables on the side because they added a nice refreshing balance to the meal.

For dessert, the waffle was such a satisfying treat. It had a crunchy exterior but was soft inside, almost like a nice doughnut. With the syrup and sliced almonds, it became simple but very enjoyable. It was not too complicated, but sometimes that is exactly what makes dessert good.


![1000160978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCAuBMVfHJ7eP3MKSGqHo8ZMzLtWku1W9R9aUixc19QoYfku46CTdcixghbWGTckLc.jpg)

![1000160976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eos1p3cxLnk2FBrgutxj7kyimrssJFvVXLznKMqRPHMhUcKFV91FdpGSiAfYQzNvWMd.jpg)

![1000160979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowJ4xXA3nmJQwzwvWis7ePA6Uds9u6se8Lv9AqWhSSVa3NT8czYCVoe879VkhJ8tcq.jpg)

![1000160974.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGyPwgPm98eTEmpWPAEZ1gWWRQSV5VhD6jm649NZ6eWBy26HXnuq1Ncyc3Hi8Ec8ZJ.jpg)


***Overall, our revisit to Nornnuea Cafe was such a lovely experience. The food was still good, the drinks were well balanced, the dessert was enjoyable, and the ambiance was still very relaxing. But more than anything, it was the warmth of the place and the kindness of Auntie that made this visit special again.***

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 27 2026
title.body:
Day 20 humbled me a little. Woke up feeling off — low energy, heavy body, the kind of morning where even a short walk sounds like work. Part of me wanted to stay in bed and forget the challenge for the day, especially being this close to finishing it. But I still went out for a bit, kept the walk slow, mixed in very light jogging, and did a few small exercises just to keep myself moving. Honestly, the body wasn’t cooperating much today. I could feel the sickness draining the energy pretty quickly, so I didn’t force it. Ended up with around 6k steps before calling it. A few weeks ago I probably would’ve seen this as failure. Now I’m starting to see it differently. Consistency isn’t about pretending every day feels strong — sometimes it’s just about adjusting without quitting completely. Day 20 done, even if it wasn’t pretty 👟 One more day left.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Trump’s pitch is simple: stop governing crypto by mood swing and start locking in rules that survive the next administration. That’s the real headline here—not just “Trump likes crypto,” but a promise to hard-code a market structure law that future regulators can’t casually wreck. If that actually happens, it changes the game for exchanges, token issuers, and U.S.-based builders.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says Trump framed the U.S. as the new center of digital asset innovation after years of what he cast as anti-crypto regulation under Gary Gensler. His argument: enforcement-first policy pushed bitcoin activity, perpetuals, exchanges, and startup talent offshore, and his administration is now trying to reverse that. The political message is obvious—crypto isn’t being treated as a niche sector here, but as part of America’s financial infrastructure. 📎 [Source](https://news.bitcoin.com/trump-vows-crypto-market-structure-law-that-cannot-be-undone/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The policy meat is in “market structure.” That’s the unsexy phrase that decides who regulates what, which assets count as securities vs commodities, how exchanges operate, how derivatives are supervised, and what disclosures or custody rules apply. In plain English: this is the rulebook for the entire U.S. crypto market. If that rulebook becomes durable law instead of agency interpretation, the industry gets something it has been begging for—clarity instead of regulatory roulette. 📎 [Source](https://news.bitcoin.com/trump-vows-crypto-market-structure-law-that-cannot-be-undone/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The SEC angle matters too. Paul Atkins is presented as pushing a very different model from the last regime: less punishment-by-lawsuit, more formal rulemaking, updated disclosures, innovation exemptions, and tighter SEC/CFTC coordination. That includes clearer boundaries around tokenized securities, commodities, custody, cybersecurity, and even on-chain trading for compliant assets. Translation: the agencies may be trying to move from “we’ll sue first and explain later” to an actual framework. That would be a massive shift if it sticks. 📎 [Source](https://news.bitcoin.com/trump-vows-crypto-market-structure-law-that-cannot-be-undone/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The bottleneck is Congress. The article points to the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act as the vehicle for turning pro-crypto rhetoric into binding law, with the Senate Banking Committee having already advanced it in a bipartisan 15-9 vote on May 14. That’s progress, but not victory. Bills still get watered down, stalled, or Frankensteined in reconciliation. So the takeaway is this: the rhetoric is bullish as hell, but the part that matters is whether Congress actually nails down a durable framework. 📎 [Source](https://news.bitcoin.com/trump-vows-crypto-market-structure-law-that-cannot-be-undone/)\n\n#threadstorm

body.title: Miles Davis, otro cronopio del jazz (Esp | Eng)
body.body:
En su libro La vuelta al día en ochenta mundos (1967), el escritor Julio Cortázar recrea al gran compositor, trompetista y cantante estadounidense del blues y el jazz, Louis Armstrong, en un encantador (literalmente) ensayo que titula “Louis enormísimo cronopio”. El cuentista, novelista y ensayista argentino había caracterizado a los cronopios como seres creativos, soñadores, desordenados y de espíritu libre, contrapuestos a las famas y las esperanzas. Tomando esa caracterización y la visión de Cortázar, titulo este post, situando al trompetista y compositor Miles Davis entre esas criaturas diferentes al común.
![Miles Davis.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/EoCasUVTJFkQqdSd8QtWspi3CytumWGdouym123yXUdfrNeqH8enbjWUaaSojtDQnPr.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.jambase.com/article/miles-davis-quincy-jones-montreux-1991)

Entramos en el centenario del nacimiento de [Miles Davis](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miles_Davis) ocurrido en Illinois el 26 de mayo de 1926. Supongo que será celebrado en su tierra natal, en todo EEUU y el mundo musical jazzístico. No soy músico; soy solamente un receptor y degustador de la buena música; de modo que intentaré en este post en homenaje a él, una apreciación sencilla y breve. Hace dos años, en el Día Internacional de Jazz, le dediqué una microficción, que pueden leer en este [enlace](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@josemalavem/y-que-microficcion-para-miles-davis-en-el-dia-internacional-del-jazzesp-or-eng). Sabemos que Miles Davis fue una especie de outsider desde sus comienzos, tanto por su alejamiento de la formación musical académica como por su inclinación a las drogas. Logró ser un cultivador de las más diversas expresiones del jazz, desde el [bebop](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bebop), el [cool jazz](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cool_(jazz)), el llamado [jazz modal](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jazz_modal) y el jazz en fusión con el rock y el funk. Compartió con grandes del jazz como Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, John Coltrane, Glis Evans, entre otros muchos.
![Miles Davis 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23wqeDSC8BPvR3fgtb24R3oUdkL75AgjiX2wpD6xo2EXAzDo14Z9SvyTUXCdDWtfdcyMN.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.grammy.com/news/miles-davis-deep-cuts-you-need-to-know)

Destaca su condición de ejecutor de la trompeta por el uso de la sordina, con la que logró expresiones muy características, únicas del jazz. Con ello está asociado su carácter creativo e improvisador, haciendo honor al mejor sentido originario de esa manifestación musical, pero también promoviendo relevantes cambios en ella. En sus conciertos es muy llamativa la posición del cuerpo que asumió luego, en la que solía dar la espalda al público, encorvarse durante su ejecución o jugar corporalmente con algunos de los principales músicos acompañantes. Davis grabó más de 50 discos; recibió 9 premios Grammy; en el 2006 pasó al Salón de la Fama del Rock and Roll y en 2009 su disco “Kind of Blue” fue reconocido como tesoro nacional por el Congreso de EEUU. A continuación, quiero compartir con ustedes cuatro de sus interpretaciones más importantes, por supuesto, en la disposición de escucharlas, abriéndose al tempo que la modalidad jazzística de Miles Davis nos pide, donde entrar en consonancia con el ritmo, el sonido, la pausa y el silencio es fundamental para experimentar su extraordinaria expresión.
![Trompeta.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/Eq7RhAtneBg42UfZijCxt8ksYNCyrH3877F6BbBDRWasrVWwRXscz7YhQYahTH85b4m.png)

(English versión)

Miles Davis, Another Cronopio of Jazz In his book *Around the Day in Eighty Worlds* (1967), writer Julio Cortázar recreates the great American blues and jazz composer, trumpeter, and singer, Louis Armstrong, in a charming (literally) essay titled \

The Argentine short story writer, novelist, and essayist had characterized cronopios as creative, dreamy, disorganized, and free-spirited beings, the antithesis of famas and esperanzas. Taking this characterization and Cortázar's vision as my title for this post, I place the trumpeter and composer Miles Davis among these creatures who are different from the norm. We are entering the centenary of the birth of [Miles Davis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miles_Davis), which took place in Illinois on May 26, 1926. I imagine it will be celebrated in his home state, throughout the US, and in the jazz world. I am not a musician; I am merely a receiver and connoisseur of good music; so, in this post dedicated to him, I will attempt a simple and brief appreciation. Two years ago, on International Jazz Day, I dedicated a microfiction to him, which you can read at this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@josemalavem/y-que-microficcion-para-miles-davis-en-el-dia-internacional-del-jazzesp-or-eng). We know that Miles Davis was something of an outsider from the beginning, both because of his rejection of formal musical training and his inclination towards drugs. He became a master of diverse jazz expressions, from bebop and cool jazz to modal jazz and jazz fusion with rock and funk. His trumpet playing is notable for his use of the mute, which allowed him to achieve highly distinctive and unique jazz expressions. This is associated with his creative and improvisational nature, honoring the original essence of this musical form while also promoting significant changes within it. His distinctive posture in concerts is striking; he often turned his back to the audience, hunched over during his playing, or engaged in physical play with some of the principal accompanying musicians. Davis recorded more than 50 albums and received 9 Grammy Awards. In 2006, he was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, and in 2009, his album \

was recognized as a national treasure by the U.S. Congress. Next, I want to share with you four of his most important performances, of course, with the understanding that you should listen to them with an openness to the tempo that Miles Davis's jazz style demands, where connecting with the rhythm, the sound, the pauses, and the silence is fundamental to experiencing his extraordinary expression.
So What (1959) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqNTltOGh5c
Freddie Freeloader (1959) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5-nuaBFF1PQ
Time after time (Live in Germany 1988) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FpZHjvFXprk

body.title: I Built a Python Hardware Monitor That Reveals Your Laptop's Real Health
body.body:
My laptop battery is lying to me. Windows says it's at 100% — but I ran a quick Python script and found out it's actually at **74% of its original design capacity** after 8 years. Worse, my CPU is hitting **83°C at just 20% load**. These aren't edge case problems. Windows just hides this stuff from you.

So I built a hardware monitoring tool that pulls the real numbers — the kind your manufacturer doesn't want you obsessing over.

## What the Tool Actually Reads

This isn't just a `psutil` wrapper. The tool goes deeper:

- **Battery wear level** — real design capacity vs. current full charge capacity via WMI
- **CPU per-core temperatures** — not the average, each core individually  
- **GPU temperature** — via `nvidia-smi` for NVIDIA cards
- **SSD health / wear indicator** — drive health percentage
- **RAM usage + swap** — so you know if you're thrashing

---

## Battery Wear Detection (via WMI)

```python
import wmi

def get_battery_health():
    c = wmi.WMI(namespace=\

: round(wear_pct, 1)
    }
```

Running this on my Lenovo after 8 years: **design 56,000 mWh -> current 41,500 mWh = 74.1% health**. Not dead, but it explains why my laptop dies in 3 hours instead of 5.

---

## GPU Temperature (via nvidia-smi)

```python
import subprocess

def get_gpu_temp():
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [\

: parts[2]
            }
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
```

My RTX 3060 was sitting at 67 degrees C at idle. That was the moment I realized I needed to clean the fans.

---

## CPU Per-Core Temps

```python
import psutil

def get_cpu_temps():
    temps = psutil.sensors_temperatures()
    # On Windows, use OpenHardwareMonitor or LibreHardwareMonitor
    # On Linux: temps.get(\

)
    return temps
```

On Windows, psutil alone won't give CPU temps — you need **LibreHardwareMonitor** running as a service, then query it. The full tool handles this automatically.

---

## What I Found On My Own Machine

| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Battery health | 74.1% | Degraded (expected at 8yr) |
| CPU temp at 20% load | 83C | High — thermal paste due |
| GPU temp idle | 67C | Acceptable, needs cleaning |
| SSD health | 96% | Good |
| RAM usage | 61% at idle | Acceptable |

The CPU temp number is what got me. 83C at 20% load means when I actually push it, I'm hitting thermal throttle territory. Windows Task Manager told me nothing.

---

## The Tool Is Available

I packaged this up as a standalone Windows script with a clean terminal dashboard. It runs at startup, logs to SQLite, and Telegram-alerts you if anything spikes.

Grab it on Gumroad for $5: **https://milkyway801.gumroad.com/l/ekpeqp**

It's a single Python file + a config JSON. No installer, no telemetry, no nonsense.

---

## Why HIVE?

I post here because I actually want feedback. If you've built something similar, or if you know a better way to read CPU temps on Windows without LHM overhead, drop it in the comments. The battery WMI method especially — I've seen some implementations that pull from different namespaces and get different numbers.

The afternoon breeze blew gently across the golden rice fields while dark clouds slowly gathered in the sky. In the middle of that peaceful scenery, two simple plastic bottles hung quietly on a wooden stick. To some people they may look like useless objects, but for farmers, the sound created by the wind helps keep birds away from the rice plants.

Simple things like this remind me that life in the countryside is always connected to creativity. Not everything valuable has to be expensive. Sometimes, items considered trash can become useful tools in the field. From this, I learned that simplicity often carries its own important value.

Today I spent some time standing beside the rice field, watching the plants move softly with the wind. There was a feeling of calm that is difficult to describe. Behind the hard work, mud, heat, and rain, there is always hope for a good harvest. Farming teaches patience because no result comes instantly.

The cloudy sky made the evening atmosphere feel even more beautiful. Nature seemed to send a message that every process needs time. Just like rice, which must grow slowly before it is finally ready to be harvested.

Hopefully this season will bring good harvests and blessings for all farmers.

When I saw words Unlocked on  screen I was really happy. I did not know how  express my feelings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfULci37VEdSDtFd6kFa74jCxx49csWcwTE6RSEd4k3Uf/1779931808681.jpg)

Sometimes people only see result.This rank is not a gaming level for me but it shows my patience, confidence and continuous hard work.

* I learned that playing games requires more than having strong cards.

* You also need the strategy

* the ability to make timely decisions

* and the mentality of understanding your opponent.

In the beginning I made a lot of mistakes. It took me a time to understand when to use which card, when to defend and not attack or when to take risks.. I learned something new from each match. After losing I tried not get discouraged but find out where I went wrong.

This mentality may have brought me where I am today. When I saw notification that I had reached Diamond III League it felt like dream had come true. I was so emotion that moment.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbLh7rBDTBFijice3oYYCho5Lu9UtGAi1kyGPxsim1sbo/1779931808946.jpg)

Behind this achievement are nights playing fighting against tough opponents and sometimes  exciting experience coming back  win a match last minute. Every win made me more confident. Every loss taught me  be stronger.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuvuAW1wrNnMuUQ8TKk6ELzZCbho951QoyZgmRRjyjB5/1779931808817.jpg)

* scrolls,

The whole experience was very exciting. Especially when the rewards were opened one after another it felt like a new surprise was waiting inside each chest.

What I liked the most was the feeling of getting some cards. When the Shadowcomb Duskrose card came to my attention I was really surprised. The design of the card is beautiful. Its presence also felt very powerful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme68BefzqJwUwsxekZRm31ZAZqdsN45fzofaZ6JnmAuyo/1779931809232.jpg)

Getting cards in the game is always a great joy for a player. Because a good card not enhances the beauty of the collection but can also play a big role in future battles.

Another interesting thing was getting the Palimpsest Prophet card. I found the artwork and style of this card very unique. The game developers really design each card well.

Not the power or stats but also the visual aspect of the cards attracts players a lot. I always try to keep cards in my collection that're beautiful to look at and at the same time effective in battle.

The energy and entries I received in the rewards are also very important to me. Because they will help me move forward in battles and events.

Sometimes small rewards bring benefits later. So I always give importance to each reward. I am not happy by getting big cards but rather try to understand the use and future importance of each item.

I always keep one thing in mind while playing the game – I cannot lose patience. Sometimes if I lose a matches in a row I get upset. It seems that it is not possible to move anymore.

Because every loss is actually an opportunity learn something

Todays Diamond III rank is the result of that effort.

Another special aspect of this achievement is the increase in confidence. Earlier when I used to play matches against opponents fear often acted as a factor.

Now I can play with much more confidence. Because I know that if I play patiently and with the plan it is possible to do well in any match.

Games are not a means of entertainment they also improve our patience, strategy and mental strength.

I always try to enjoy every match. I play not to win, but also to learn. Because every match is an experience.

Sometimes I learn a strategy sometimes I understand which card combination is the most effective. This learning process makes me more interested in the game.

Todays achievement has motivated me more. Now my goal is to rise and strengthen my deck.

I know that difficult competitions await but now I am ready to accept that challenge. Because each new rank means experiences, new excitement and an opportunity to improve my skills.

One of the things I like most about the game is that learning never ends here. The higher you climb the new strategies come to the fore.

Each players playing style is different. Thats why each match feels different. This diversity is what makes the game so interesting.

Todays reward opening wasn't about getting some items for me. It was a recognition of my work.

As I watched the rewards one after another on the screen it felt like each and every thing was a reward for my long-term efforts. This feeling is truly a joy.

Finally I would like to say that reaching Diamond III will be a chapter in my gaming journey.

There may be great achievements ahead but the feeling unlocking this rank for  first time will always special.

I hope be able  collect cards in future build stronger decks and achieve victories against tougher opponents.

Today reminded me again – with patience, hard work and confidence any goal is possible.

These small achievements in the game also teach us lessons, in real life.. That is why I enjoy every moment and am inspired to move forward.

body.title: BBA Zero - Let the games begin.
body.body: <center>[Juomaposti](https://juomaposti.fi/brasilia-jarjestaa-maailman-ensimmaisen-taysin-alkoholittomille-oluille-omistetun-kilpailun/)</center>\nEven if you (personally speaking) are not an enthusiast of non-alcoholic beers, the market has already understood that it is impossible to ignore this \

within the production chain. For example, here in **Brazil**, at least **5%** of the **production** of this **non-alcoholic** version is already part of the official figures. This means that a considerable part of the entire beer production chain already focuses on this type of manufacturing (which over the years has proven to be very profitable).\nBetting on a pioneering aspect, Brazil (more precisely through the **Northeast** region, in **Alagoinhas**... which is in **Bahia**) has decided once again to innovate, and in **November** of this year (between the **1st** and **6th**) will launch the ** 1st edition** of **BBA Zero - International Alcohol-Free Beer Awards**, creating a new \

for brewers (although the base product is no longer so new), and further fostering a market that will grow by leaps and bounds in the near future.\n<center>[Impossibrew](https://impossibrew.co.uk/blogs/journal/how-non-alcoholic-beers-shape-social-drinking-today)</center>\nThe first edition of this event will take place alongside the **3rd edition** of the **Brazilian International Beer Awards** (BBA), becoming the world's first competition entirely dedicated to this segment, which is still relatively \

to so many consumers. If the event is successful (a reality that will likely happen without much effort), other editions will certainly take place, further strengthening Brazil's name on an unprecedented journey.\nIt's not just about another new beer competition; it's about meeting the demands of a new type of audience that is emerging, one that seeks to prioritize well-being and new lifestyles for better health without giving up the consumption of a beverage that is still \

by so many people around the world. Not recognizing this diversity of styles and demands is, literally, to place oneself outside of a rapidly expanding market. ---
**BBA Zero - Que empiecen los juegos.**
Aunque personalmente no seas un entusiasta de las cervezas sin alcohol, el mercado ya ha comprendido que es imposible ignorar esta evolución en la cadena de producción. Por ejemplo, aquí en **Brasil**, al menos el **5%** de la **producción** de esta versión **sin alcohol** ya forma parte de las cifras oficiales. Esto significa que una parte considerable de toda la cadena de producción cervecera se centra en este tipo de elaboración (que a lo largo de los años ha demostrado ser muy rentable). Apostando por un enfoque pionero, Brasil (más precisamente en la región **Noreste**, en **Alagoinhas** - **Bahía**) ha decidido innovar una vez más y, en **noviembre** de este año (entre los dias **1** y el **6**), lanzará la **1ª edición** del concurso **BBA Zero - International Alcohol-Free Beer Awards**, creando una nueva “vía” para los cerveceros (aunque el producto base ya no sea tan novedoso) e impulsando aún más un mercado que crecerá a pasos agigantados en un futuro próximo. La primera edición de este evento se celebrará junto con la tercera edición de los **Brazilian International Beer Awards** (BBA), convirtiéndose en la primera competición mundial dedicada íntegramente a este segmento, todavía relativamente “peculiar” para muchos consumidores. Si el evento resulta exitoso (algo que probablemente sucederá sin mucho esfuerzo), sin duda se celebrarán otras ediciones, consolidando aún más la reputación de Brasil en una trayectoria sin precedentes. No se trata solo de una nueva competición de cerveza; se trata de satisfacer las demandas de un nuevo tipo de público emergente, que busca priorizar el bienestar y nuevos estilos de vida para una mejor salud sin renunciar al consumo de una bebida que aún es “estigmatizada” por muchas personas en todo el mundo. Ignorar esta diversidad de estilos y demandas es, literalmente, quedar fuera de un mercado en rápida expansión. ---
**BBA Zero - Que comecem os jogos.**
Mesmo que você (particularmente falando) não seja um entusiasta de cervejas sem álcool, o mercado já entendeu que é impossível ignorar esta “evolução” dentro da cadeia produtiva. Por exemplo, aqui no **Brasil**, ao menos **5%** da **produção** dessa versão **não alcoólica** já faz parte dos números oficiais. Isso quer dizer que uma parte considerável de toda cadeia produtiva cervejeira já mantém o foco nesse tipo de fabricação (que ao longo de anos vem se mostrando bem rentável). Apostando em um aspecto vanguardista, o Brasil (mais precisamente através da região **Nordeste**, em **Alagoinhas**... que fica na **Bahia**) decidiu mais uma vez inovar, e em **novembro** deste no (entre os dias **1º** e **6º**) irá lançar a **1ª edição** do **BBA Zero - International Alcohol-Free Beer Awards**, criando uma nova “rota” para os cervejeiros (embora o produto base não seja mais tão novo assim), e fomentando com ainda mais força um mercado que crescerá a passos largos no futuro próximo. A primeira edição desse evento acontecerá paralelamente à **3ª edição** do **Brazilian International Beer Awards** (BBA), se tornando o primeiro concurso do mundo totalmente dedicado a esse segmento ainda relativamente “peculiar” a tantos consumidores. Caso o evento seja bem sucedido (uma realidade que provavelmente acontecerá sem maiores esforços), outras edições certamente irão acontecer, fortalecendo ainda mais o nome do Brasil em uma jornada sem precedentes. Não se trata apenas de mais uma nova competição de cervejas; se trata sobre conseguir atender as demandas de um novo tipo público que está emergindo, e que busca priorizar o bem-estar e os novos estilos de vida para ter uma melhor saúde sem deixar de lado o consumo de uma bebida que ainda é “demonizada” por tantas pessoas mundo à fora. Não reconhecer essa diversidade de estilos e demandas é, literalmente, se colocar fora de um mercado em franca expansão. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/bba-zero-let-the-games-begin-cqj)

body.title: The small square of Juan Cristosomo is a pleasant place to take a stroll.| Pequeña plaza Juan Cristosomo buen paseo.
body.body:
> **Grato saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta comunidad de Lifestyle en este miércoles ombligo de semana.** **Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this Lifestyle community on this midweek Wednesday.** Ya saben todo lo que me gusta y apasionada a visitar lugares distintos a la ciudad de Maracaibo, especialmente espacios que han sido remodelados recientemente como es en esta oportunidad, la plaza Juan Cristosomo mofalcón ubicada al lado de la plaza de la muñeca en el sector Santa Lucía, justamente en toda, la avenida de Bella Vista, podemos evidenciarla una plaza bastante hermosa, apesar de lo pequeña que cuenta con sus bancas, chicas columpios una casita para gatos, entre otro que buscar rendir un tributo especial a este heroico hombre de la patria. >You already know how much I love and am passionate about visiting different places in the city of Maracaibo, especially spaces that have been recently refurbished, as is the case here: Juan Cristosomo Mofalcón Square, located next to La Muñeca Square in the Santa Lucía district, right on Bella Vista Avenue. It is a rather beautiful square, despite its small size, featuring benches, swings and a little cat house, amongst other features, all designed to pay special tribute to this heroic national hero. ![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Sencillo Blanco y negro_20260527_213109_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTUhbH8kT7YsL8Mg1Lb9QUmtQEQ8VbA3P7g2QFuByGDc/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20Feliz%20San%20Valent%C3%ADn%20Sencillo%20Blanco%20y%20negro_20260527_213109_0000.png) El año pasado había visitado esta plaza y justamente se encontraba en estado completo de abandono, donde la maleza la cubría no estaba pintada, estaba deteriorada incluso era un almacenamiento de puro sucio y ahora hasta una cesta para los gatos tienen para poder alimentarlos, sin duda alguna, me encanta que se recupere nuevos espacios y que se le pueda dar una visión diferente a cada espacio de la ciudad para poder embellecerla, y que también las personas tengan nuevos lugares a que acudir y que los niños también puedan distraerse, jugar ir hacia espacios totalmente diferentes. >I visited this square last year and it was in a complete state of neglect: it was overgrown with weeds, unpainted and dilapidated; it was even being used as a dumping ground. Now, however, they’ve even put out a feeding bowl for the cats. Without a doubt, I love seeing new spaces being revitalised and a fresh perspective being brought to every part of the city to make it more beautiful, and that people also have new places to go and that children can have fun, play and explore completely different spaces. ![20260418_085640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXc9M3eHhVnYBXmEXFxt7Q561EYstGBKCyz7M1pwcqjhG/20260418_085640.jpg) ![20260418_085652.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc8qKYgwdjHwXU4XPe7EfCTRVa6S2eZhpuM6vfxQ9Pbde/20260418_085652.jpg) ![20260418_085721.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWzQZ1ryE9jmnGSKpJjfs8JhMKj6rToQY7P16xD8T5yP/20260418_085721.jpg) Ahora bien Juan Cristosomo Falcón, y es por eso que a través de su apellido es que se le decide colocar a este estado tan maravilloso, su nombre quisieron poner una estatua del para rendirle su tributo, especialmente en los primeros 100 años del natalicio de Rafael Urdaneta, este hombre fue el fundador de Venezuela la federación Venezuela, como se decía antes, qué podemos ver su escultura en un pedestal está elevada en 1 base totalmente de mármol, en donde también podemos ver sus luces, qué le ofrecen alumbramiento más que toda la noche y unas letras bastantes lindas que dicen ¡Venite pa' Maracaibo! >Now, Juan Cristosomo Falcón and it is for this reason, through his surname, that this wonderful state was named after him they wished to erect a statue in his honour, particularly to mark the first 100 years since the birth of Rafael Urdaneta, this man was the founder of the Venezuelan Federation, as it was known in the past. We can see his sculpture standing on a pedestal, set on a base made entirely of marble, where we can also see the lights that illuminate it throughout the night, and some rather lovely lettering that reads: ‘Come to Maracaibo!’ ![20260418_085736.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXihTLDRJZQ4LqEVCPd5pQ5RXun1dL59bvT5UFot57Cv8/20260418_085736.jpg) ![20260418_085857.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPTzMQdQ79Zo2n2gmEsFSPduV27n5DDPW2aJJbzSCtcGd/20260418_085857.jpg) Santa Lucia, es uno de los lugares que más me llama la atención de Maracaibo, no solamente por su antigüedad, también por sus tradiciones cultura música, pues se dice que en este humilde barrio, fue donde nació la gaita, donde nacieron sus artistas más influyentes de este agradable género musical que le da son a esta gran música que se distribuye a lo largo de Venezuela, en verdad es bonito ver cómo Santa Lucía tiene tantas plazas hermosas que se pueden ir a visitar. >Santa Lucía is one of the places in Maracaibo that most captures my attention, not only because of its age, but also because of its cultural and musical traditions, as it is said that this humble neighbourhood was the birthplace of the gaita, and the home of the most influential artists of this delightful musical genre, which gives life to this wonderful music that is enjoyed throughout Venezuela. It really is lovely to see how Santa Lucía has so many beautiful squares that are well worth a visit. ![20260418_085936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxu7N1gDgemvgTXEzYeXKnFiH8LyzDmvdi1xpwr6DpxB/20260418_085936.jpg) Por último, fue agradable visitar la plaza de Juan cristosomo Falcón, luego nos fuimos caminando hacia el centro de la ciudad de Maracaibo, junto con mi hermano Alcides, y fue realmente un gran recorrido, sin duda alguna visitar nuevos lugares me gusta mucho y poder hacerlo acompañada mientras converso, es lo ideal, espero que protentamente puedan visitar este lugar hasta pronto mis queridos amigos me despido con un fuerte abrazo. >Finally, it was lovely to visit Juan Cristosomo Falcón Square. Afterwards, we walked towards the centre of Maracaibo with my brother Alcides, and it really was a great walk. I certainly love visiting new places, and being able to do so in good company whilst chatting is just perfect. I hope you’ll be able to visit this place soon. See you soon, my dear friends. I’ll sign off with a big hug. ![20260418_085816.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZojgDn6YZkychXYrYidJtw1NrjGsc3vdmzisExfbGEQh/20260418_085816.jpg) ![20260418_085819.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUzrM3rU3e7LAh1xy2MhkREGE9FR126Sr5aTjjwiWdLhk/20260418_085819.jpg)

body.title: liketu is live - a new photo-first Hive app
body.body:
![](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/launch-hero-v2.png)

The new liketu is live at https://liketu.net.

If you remember the old liketu, this is its sequel. 

We rebuilt the photo-first experience for Hive from the ground up around how people actually share, browse, and remember content in 2026: a faster web app, an edge-to-edge feed that lets the photograph carry the page, and a posting flow that gets out of your way so the photo can do the work.

## What stayed the same

Your Hive identity is still the foundation. 

There is no liketu account separate from your Hive account, and there never will be. Sign in with Hive Keychain or your posting key, and your follow graph, your post history, your reputation, and your wallet all come with you. 

liketu has never been a separate network. It is a window onto Hive - and the new app makes that more obvious, not less.

## What's new

- **A faster web app.** The old build struggled on mobile. The new liketu is mobile-first by default, with the desktop experience built around the same rhythm: familiar gestures, clear tap targets, and a feed that stays fast.
- **A photo-first feed.** Photos go edge to edge. The interface recedes. Captions, comments, votes, and follows are still right where you expect them, but they no longer compete with the photograph.
- **Posting that doesn't interrupt.** Add your photos, write your story, and publish. Drafts persist, your Hive account signs the post, and liketu never stores your posting key.
- **Voice posts and rooms.** When a photo is not enough, you can speak. Rooms are fully transcribed live audio sessions that are published on Hive as a comment when the call ends, giving the conversation a permanent on-chain home owned by the host.
- **Wallet, market, and stats inherit the same shell.** No separate finance brand. No separate analytics dashboard. Wallet is just where the numbers live.

## How to post in 3 steps

![Your first liketu post in 3 steps](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/three-step-guide-v2.png)

1. Choose your photos.
2. Write your story.
3. Publish to Hive.

That's the entire learning curve. Everything else — votes, comments, follows, wallet - is on the surface where you need it.

## Launch challenge

We're running a launch challenge for the first ten days. It's a referral-and-retention contest, not a photo contest — bring new photographers onto liketu through your referral link, and your score is the **average D7 / D30 active-user count** across everyone you bring in. 

Top sponsors split the prize pool, paid out on-chain. 

**Full challenge post and rules to follow shortly.**

This is the same metric we will use for ambassadors long-term in the growth console, so the launch leaderboard reflects the system we will keep using after launch.

## Old liketu users — welcome back

If you posted on the old liketu years ago, your photos and follow graph are still on Hive.

They came with you.

Open https://liketu.net, sign in with the same Hive account, and your work is there. Nothing to migrate. Nothing to recover.

Bring a friend. The new feed gets better the more photographers show up.

## Discord launch party

We're hosting a launch party in Discord. Quick app demo, walkthrough of the launch challenge, and an open Q&A. More details to follow. 

[JOIN US ON DISCORD](https://discord.gg/eAEjWMGYr)

## Built on Hive

liketu is the photo-first app layer. Hive is the network. 

Your identity, your history, and your wallet stay yours and they are not stored in a database we can lose. That is the whole point.

We've been working on this rebuild for months and planning it for much longer. We're proud of where it landed. 

Open it, post something, and tell us what's broken. 

Photographers carried the old liketu and they're carrying this one too.

We can't wait to see you there!
https://liketu.net

#liketu #hive #photography #photo

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![GbhPC8dEp29VKqCJ_mmexport1779759524820_edit_2312224810748735.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/GbhPC8dEp29VKqCJ_mmexport1779759524820_edit_2312224810748735/GbhPC8dEp29VKqCJ_mmexport1779759524820_edit_2312224810748735.webp)
