links.title: [ESP/ENG] Un seminario menos y una victoria más en Traumatología 🩺✨ // One less seminar and one more victory in Traumatology 🩺✨
links.body: > ¡Hola, querida comunidad de Hive!✨️🥰 Espero que estén teniendo una excelente semana. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes cómo se vivió un día lleno de emociones intensas, rutina hospitalaria y, al final, una enorme satisfacción en mi rotación de Traumatología. El día comenzó como cualquier otra mañana en el piso de hospitalización. La rutina aquí no se detiene: empezar temprano con las evoluciones de los pacientes, actualizar las órdenes médicas en las carpetas y, por supuesto, realizar las curas correspondientes. Es un trabajo constante, pero que te conecta muchísimo con la realidad de cada persona que está bajo nuestro cuidado.

> Hello, dear Hive community!✨️🥰 I hope you are all having a great week. Today I want to share with you what a day full of intense emotions, hospital routine, and ultimately, a huge sense of satisfaction looked like during my Traumatology rotation. The day started like any other morning on the hospitalization floor. The routine here never stops: starting early with patient evolutions, updating medical orders in the charts, and of course, doing the respective wound dressings. It is a constant job, but one that deeply connects you with the reality of each person under our care.

> Sin embargo, a pesar de estar concentrada en mis labores de rutina, había algo en mi mente que me tenía el corazón acelerado. Ese día nos tocaba presentar el seminario de **Osteomielitis**, una infección ósea bastante compleja y de gran importancia en el área de traumatología, ya que requiere un diagnóstico certero y un tratamiento antibiótico y quirúrgico oportuno para evitar complicaciones graves. A medida que se acercaba la hora y esperábamos la llegada del Doctor Especialista, los nervios empezaron a hacer de las suyas. Aunque había estudiado muchísimo, dominaba el tema y me sentía preparada, siempre está ese temor latente. El miedo de que al especialista no le guste el enfoque, de que haga correcciones severas o de que la tensión del momento juegue en contra, siempre está presente en la vida de un estudiante de medicina.

> However, despite being focused on my routine duties, there was something on my mind that had my heart racing. That day we had to present our seminar on **Osteomyelitis**, a fairly complex bone infection of great importance in the area of orthopedics and traumatology, as it requires an accurate diagnosis and timely antibiotic and surgical treatment to avoid serious complications. As the hour approached and we awaited the arrival of the Specialist Doctor, the jitters began to kick in. Even though I had studied a lot, mastered the topic, and felt prepared, there is always that lingering fear. The dread that the specialist might not like the approach, make severe corrections, or that the tension of the moment might play against you, is always present in the life of a medical student.
![IMG-20260526-WA0014.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSFw9xfRXb77bR42W5ckZERquQ4qWoL1zNFeGBW6SXs3G/IMG-20260526-WA0014.jpeg)
---

> ¡Pero llegó el momento de la verdad! Y para mi gran alivio, el seminario fue todo un éxito. Desde que inicié la exposición, sentí que tenía un buen manejo de la información. Lo mejor de todo fue que, a medida que avanzaba, las afirmaciones y gestos de aprobación del doctor me iban devolviendo la calma. Al terminar, el Especialista nos felicitó, dijo que le había gustado mucho y que el seminario estuvo muy bueno. ¡No se imaginan el logro que esto significa! Quienes estamos en el mundo médico sabemos que hay docentes sumamente difíciles de complacer, y él es uno de ellos.

> But the moment of truth arrived! And to my great relief, the seminar was a total success. From the moment I started the presentation, I felt I had a good grasp of the information. The best part of all was that, as I moved forward, the doctor's affirmations and nods of approval kept restoring my calm. When we finished, the Specialist congratulated us, said he liked it very much, and that the seminar was very good. You cannot imagine what an achievement this means! Those of us in the medical world know that there are professors who are extremely difficult to please, and he is one of them.
![Screenshot_20260527_182339_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRmWCaxKBLSt9Vp8KtVT933yYneJA8KvWUPV3r3xYjKtq/Screenshot_20260527_182339_Gallery.jpg)
---

> Salimos de ese salón con una sonrisa gigante, el pecho inflado de orgullo y, por supuesto, la felicidad inmensa de decir: ¡Como dicen por ahí, un seminario menos, jajaja! 🎉 Para cerrar con broche de oro un día tan genial, nos fuimos directo al cafetín a celebrar nuestro logro con un merecido heladito. No hay mejor recompensa después de tanta tensión que compartir un dulce momento con el equipo. Gracias por leerme y acompañarme en este camino. ¿Qué tal lidian ustedes con los nervios antes de una gran presentación? ¡Los leo en los comentarios!

> We left that room with giant smiles, chests puffed with pride, and, of course, the immense happiness of saying: As they say around here, one less seminar, hahaha! 🎉 To top off such a great day, we went straight to the cafeteria to celebrate our achievement with a well-deserved ice cream. There is no better reward after so much tension than sharing a sweet moment with the team. Thank you for reading and accompanying me on this journey. How do you deal with jitters before a big presentation? See you in the comments!
![35890f95e9afc67b558c4da961e3f350_0.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdD2CqbNXG4qw27eHRFYLDxKokJ2CsauGLQ4PPjVAsBBh/35890f95e9afc67b558c4da961e3f350_0.jpeg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQciy3ME5Ju9KsYzV4q4XHcZyfSQJ3zqMF56EfQuigiza/img_2079.jpg)



之前說過, 最近迷上了跟湘開車去一些比較遠的公園. 所以, 吃完個Brunch 之後, 我們便出發繼續我們的行程. 嗯, 專程開車去公園散步. 在一些人眼中, 大概實在多餘. 小區沒的你散步? 的確, 光是為了散步的話, 下樓走三圈就好了. 但我醉翁之意不在酒, 散步只是附帶的啦哈.

啊對, 昨天提及了, 臨出發前我突然肚子痛, 趕回餐廳就地解決了一下之後, 順便自己再洗了個車再出發, 有時候, 不需要開車, 把我的車洗的乾乾淨淨, 已經是一大樂趣. 自己的愛車, 自己多洗. 偶然出去給阿叔洗, 又是另一層洗的保養, 兩者幾乎沒衝突.

洗完車, 出發, 在公園附近找了個停車場, 我嫌它不是很好, 但勝在夠近, 隨便了, 反正就2小時左右會回來拿車走人. 將就停一下無妨了. 這個公園, 在小紅書上看好像很大, 但原來小得可憐. 看公園的導覽圖就看出來了. 大概1小時可以逛完那種.

唯一拖我們時間的是, 這個公園是在山上的, 我們要麼爬樓梯上去, 要麼走坡上去, 走坡上就要兜路走更遠, 但我們取易不取難, 爬樓梯這回事...上次紅花山沒爬夠? 幾乎要了我的命, 這次打死都爬坡算了.

去到那個馬鞭草花田一帶, 好多人在拍照打卡. 我心想, 走到草叢中拍照? 不拍蚊咬你啊? 你們慢慢拍, 我們兩個DUCK可不必了. 一下子我們就了山頂, 山頂上有個大提琴的觀景台, 給大家上去再居高臨下看看附近的面貌. 雖然也沒多高, 但都到這裡了, 肯定也要上去拍一下. 我也跟湘自拍一下.雖然湘已經減了好多重, 但最近她的面色不是很好, 所以就不放我們的自拍照上來了.

那觀景台....說實在, 也看不到甚麼, 四周都是高樓, 看的遠景不過也是各種買不起的高樓層商品房, 沒意思. 罷了, 我們要過一個relax weekend 的目的已經達到, 慢慢走下去, 看看另一個角落吧. 那個叫甚麼英式花園的...留在下帖再寫一下. 

大家都知我換工作之後比以前忙多了, 現在能寫一帖都不容易,  暫時估計也沒辦法像從前天天動不動800-1000+字了. 突然, 又懷念在老頭那裡的日子...哎...回不去了...自己當初說要走的, 現在不惜代價也要把這條路走下去, 不然白費當初大家對我的祝福了囉.

但話說回來, 如果可以時光倒流回去四月初, 我大概不會因為那件事動怒, 那就不會存在辭職這個連帶的動作了, 然後, 大概我今天也仍然罵罵咧咧的數落老頭, 一邊當了公司是我家這樣囉. 嗯, 就在夢中繼續我跟前公司的羈絆吧. 

2026.5.28

links.title: A Sunday of coastal lizards
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZm6eMbNVxkAK6p6uLmXGKBmeKyukL1bdyAwpVoTK3EXv/1779926505909.jpg)



***
***

Last weekend I did what works best for me when I need to clear my head: escaping to the beach, not to the wide crowded part, but to that rocky stretch where the sea crashes more fiercely and people almost never bother to go because, among other things, I love the sea. Not just its vastness or the sound of the waves, but what it hides in its corners.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQsWzQoe9r1xHcVTWZeFd5QHohGbwwDZ7KEYUJwDZmvd/1779925711887.jpg)



***
I arrived early, with the sun still horizontal, and sat on a smooth rock to look around. The air smelled of salt and dry seaweed, and suddenly a quick movement between the cracks caught my attention. I leaned in carefully and there they were, some small brownish grey lizards with a darker line on their sides and a very long coiled tail. I already knew what they were called, I had seen them in photos before: coastal lizards. The name always seemed to me an adorable contradiction because they are not dogs, they do not play fetch, nor do they bark, but they have something playful and wary at the same time that makes them endearing.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThwFw7Pd12FPiYGoyVWnoZ2VNHCZ9VUhVe2Lvmmk8W2C/1779925712288.jpg)


***
They were shy, I found that out immediately because as soon as I tried to move my phone a couple of centimetres closer, they ran away as if I had made the worst noise. They hid among the rocks, under the limpets, in cracks that seemed impossible, but I am stubborn and besides, I had time.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCPPefQGfJZKTcg1Xe88dNLN9eXj8FcBEJoPi4faDZv1/1779925712089.jpg)


***
I stayed still, without making sudden movements, waiting while I learned not to look at them directly, to pretend I was watching the horizon while following them out of the corner of my eye. Little by little, they began to come out again, first the boldest one, poking out its head, and then another, smaller one, stretching out in the sun on a hot rock. And then, without thinking too much, I took out my phone with the gentleness of someone who does not want to burst a bubble and I shot several times, almost blindly. Most came out blurry or with the tail already disappearing behind a rock.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaUWAYwmxqkE9VzY6pYmvtiDjRBQBETdtN2YwWogBjwaj/1779925953941.jpg)


***
And so here are these photos with the coastal lizard posing sideways, one front paw resting on the rock as if it knew that was its best angle, while it looks at me with a round, bright eye, as if saying, okay, I will let you have this one, but do not push it.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZaH2NDaFMKTJzmXWV5inpJcoeNNsDWRtGKdmjjPYWJjv/1779926179594.jpg)

***
I went home with sand stuck to my feet and the happiness of those small victories. I did not bring back a treasure or live a great adventure, but just the photo of a lizard was more than enough.


<center>🌊</center>
<center>🌊</center>

***

```markdown
물결 속의 시간

파도가 속삭이는 밤,  
은빛 물결에 담긴 꿈,  
사라지는 기억들,  
흘러가는 모래처럼.  

한 줄기 바람에 실려,  
어디로 가는지 모르는  
시간의 흐름 속에  
우리는 그저 떠내려가네.  

잠시 머무는 순간,  
물결은 다시 일어설 때,  
영원한 듯 보이는  
우리의 사랑도 그리움으로.  
```

links.title: Visita al taladro escuela | Visit to the drill school
links.body: > Mi trabajo es muy interesante, me ha permitido desarrollarme en varias facetas y nunca termino de aprender. Sin contar que me hace sentir útil, algo muy valioso para mí como persona. Anoche recibí un mensaje para asistir hoy a la reinauguración del taladro escuela, que por cierto, el área de perforación es mi mayor debilidad, porque siempre he estado en el área científica y no operacional. Entonces hoy, guardé mi braga y mis botas en mi camioneta y me fui a la oficina.

> My job is very interesting; it has allowed me to grow in many different ways, and I never stop learning. Not to mention that it makes me feel useful, which is very important to me as a person. Last night I got a message asking me to attend the reopening of the training rig today. links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![IPbwi0cDBS14CeYV_bxw7.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/IPbwi0cDBS14CeYV_bxw7/IPbwi0cDBS14CeYV_bxw7.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天早上正常出门准备上班，刚到楼下看到外面居然在下雨。我在门口犹豫了一会，用不用回去拿雨衣呢。看到雨下的不大我决定不回去了，直接骑着电动车上班去了。前一天晚上我明明看过天气预报显示不下雨，看来天气预报拿最近的天气完全没办法，雨云飘的太快，谁知道啥时候下雨。我到了公司这一路都是很小的雨，不至于淋湿，估计下一会儿就会停。结果我又预计错了，到了中午吃饭时候，雨下的大起来了，必须要打伞才能出行。

如果下午接孩子放学时候还下这么大的雨可怎么办，早知道早上就回去拿雨衣了，现在说什么都晚了，只能盼着雨赶紧停。到了下午3点左右，雨果然小了许多，只有稀稀拉拉的雨滴，这种雨量就跟没下差不多，根本淋不湿。今年截止目前为止，算得上是风调雨顺吧，每周必下雨。而且只要稍微热上两天，马上就转阴天然后下上两天雨，雨量时大时小，主打一个热不起来。经常下雨确实凉快，而且空气里湿度很大，外出相当于护肤补水。

其实我就一个要求，上下学时候不要下雨，尤其不要下大雨，否则非常麻烦。我记得去年7月份进入酷暑之前也是经常下雨，可是一进入酷暑连着十多天不下雨，气温直接爆表，不知道今年夏天是不是同样的剧本。如果类似的话，只能好好享受现在的天气。

---

links.title: Pages, shadows and the art of letting go.
links.body:
> They say the eyes are the window to the soul, but in my case, my eyes decided to tell a different story from a very early age. My vision, limited by biology but expanded by imagination, forced me to build shelters where others saw only shadows. Today, 16 years after putting down roots in Canada and with the perspective that only grey hair and well-healed scars can provide, I look back and realise that my answer to stress and heartbreak was never at the bottom of a bottle, but on the spine of a book. Let me explain.
# ***
My logbook in the face of adversity
*** From a young age, reading was my soothing catalyst. Whilst others sought to drown the sorrows of unrequited love or the frustration of a quarrel between friends in alcohol, I lost myself in literary and scientific texts. If the outside world became chaotic, I would open a book, for there, between the paragraphs, the stress would fade away. It was my way of realising that my problems, however great they might seem, had already been experienced and recounted by others centuries ago.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRY6zg3qH8KEskYPim5MfkKmvx53YeuNxEVs9KUfeGTFD/n1.jpg)
That young man I once was, deeply sheltered by a loving mother because of my visual impairment, had to learn to let go early on. At the age of 15, out of sheer conviction, I let go of my mother’s hand. It was my first major exercise in independence, my first unfiltered encounter with reality. That determination shaped me: I became a discerning man, perhaps a bit of a perfectionist, especially in matters of the heart. I wasn’t the sort to fall into just any arms; I sought a connection as profound as the books I devoured.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFRgcStNnEn4LN5UZ1umZRSaLUVQ6YrbW4AFdeZ4X9hq/n2.jpg)
However, life teaches you that not everything can be controlled, not even with the most meticulous of perfectionism. My greatest heartbreak, the one that tore at the very fabric of my existence, did not come from a romantic break-up, but from loss. Seventeen years ago, my daughter Sofía slipped from my grasp at the age of eleven. That is a pain that cannot be healed by chapters, but is borne with the peace of knowing that love is not possession. Blessings, my dear ‘Pan de leche’!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaWuGmzoaB7CvdSQFg8xBBrrX6KdpES64LF3vuxJSKzp/n3.jpg)
I have had two great loves, two very different worlds. Sofía’s mother, in my beloved Venezuela, and the mother of my son Matthew, here in the white lands of Canada. In both cases, when the cycle came to an end, the parting was amicable, almost poetic. Many are surprised by this lack of conflict, but the fact is that my migration was not just geographical, but emotional. I learnt that to love is, fundamentally, to know how to let go. You cannot hold captive someone who no longer wants to be, or should not be, by your side.
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Q7-uoqB1eXM
[Music knows no boundaries...](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Q7-uoqB1eXM)
Today, living this cultural duality — where Latin warmth blends with the serene pragmatism of the first world — I understand that stress and heartbreak are merely teachers disguised as crises. My refuge remains books and the piano keys; my son Matthew is my present; and Sofía is that light I don’t need to see with my eyes to feel every day. My recipe has been simple: read to understand, love to set free, and live with the certainty that, even if a single note on the piano goes out of tune, the heart always finds its way back to peace. *** ***

links.title: LOH290 || Where is my relaxation paradise? ...
links.body:
>

Without a doubt, for my self-esteem, which I have first on the list of my priorities, my sanctuaries of relaxation are: the activities that I do outdoors and in my room. They are safe places to achieve the things I love to do, they are my paradises to let go of traumas, take charge of my mental peace and rebuild myself little by little, to adapt to new places, situations and achieve a state of greater well-being, grow, expand my life, be more aware, be more emotionally available, respond to life's challenges, and make my own dreams come true. >Why, are my paradises safe for relaxation? Because that way I honor my physical and mental health. Because it is my best fuel to recharge the well-being of my brain with oxygen, glucose and love.They are the most magnificent spaces to relax, relieve stress and recharge after a long day at work. My other sanctuary, is my room, it's a place where I can disconnect and escape from any situation. Every day in my room, I try to create a warm and cozy atmosphere, with soft lights, I use a splash, I usually call it *Mist* because it is an organic mixture that I prepare with lavender and lemon essential oils, it is super relaxing. Not everything has to be productivity. I also deserve to rest. I deserve a moment without guilt, without the corri corri and without demanding so much of myself. Sometimes, resting is also healing. In my room I give myself pause, silence, calm... or just time for myself, I enjoy my hair styler with my personal things like my makeup, among other things, perfumes and routine to cleanse and moisturize my skin. Big hug for everyone. Nice day. Janitze.🐝

links.title: Geopolitical Firestorms and ETF Exodus: Crypto Markets Crawl Through Fear Zone on May 27, 2026
links.body:
![Crypto Market Alert](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmZKbEa1gM5Lx61eXkgPVQy94rNckThZZEMh8BjmvAVp9Z)

# Geopolitical Firestorms and ETF Exodus: Crypto Markets Crawl Through Fear Zone on May 27, 2026

The cryptocurrency market is navigating one of its most tense weeks in recent memory. Bitcoin has slipped below the psychologically critical $75,000 level, Ethereum is struggling to hold above $2,000, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index has plunged into Extreme Fear territory at just 25 — a stark drop from 34 just yesterday. The twin pressures of escalating US-Iran military tensions and persistent institutional ETF outflows are creating a perfect storm that is testing the resilience of digital asset investors worldwide.

## The Geopolitical Shadow Over Crypto

The dominant narrative driving markets today is the fragile ceasefire between the United States and Iran, which appears to be unraveling. US military \

strikes on Iranian missile sites and mine-laying vessels have prompted the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to threaten retaliation, describing the strikes as a ceasefire violation. The IRGC reportedly downed a US drone and fired at a fighter jet, though both nations are said to be working behind the scenes to finalize a Memorandum of Understanding — particularly around language and Iran's nuclear program.

For crypto markets, geopolitical uncertainty is a poison pill. When global tensions spike, risk assets of all kinds tend to sell off as investors flee to traditional safe havens. The total crypto market capitalization has dropped 1.21% over the past 24 hours to $2.54 trillion, while trading volume has surged 41% to $95.4 billion — a sign that panic selling and opportunistic buying are both active in the market.

## Bitcoin's Technical Breakdown

Bitcoin is currently trading around $74,288 to $75,600 depending on the exchange, down 1.5% to 2% over the past day. The technical picture is decidedly bearish in the near term. BTC remains trapped beneath a dense cluster of moving averages: the 50-day EMA at $76,724, the 100-day EMA at $76,847, and the 200-day EMA near $81,220 all sit overhead as resistance.

The Relative Strength Index on the daily chart hovers in the low-40s, and the MACD histogram remains firmly negative — both signals pointing to continued downside pressure. Immediate support lies at a rising trendline around $70,574; losing that level would likely trigger deeper retracements. On the upside, BTC needs a sustained break above $76,847 to even begin rebuilding bullish momentum.

## Ethereum and Altcoins Under Pressure

Ethereum is facing similar headwinds, trading around $2,021 to $2,072 — down 1.2% to 2.4%. ETH is also trapped below its key EMAs, with the 50-day at $2,211 and the 200-day near $2,513 acting as overhead resistance. The RSI at 38 suggests lingering bearish pressure, though the $2,000 level remains a critical psychological floor. A break below it would expose demand around $1,900.

XRP is trading at $1.31 to $1.32, down nearly 1% on the day, with resistance at the 50-day EMA of $1.40. Solana has slipped to around $82, down 1.5%, while BNB holds relatively steadier at $648. Dogecoin is essentially flat at $0.10, showing some resilience amid the broader sell-off.

## The ETF Outflow Problem

Perhaps more concerning than the geopolitical backdrop is the persistent institutional retreat from crypto ETFs. Bitcoin spot ETFs saw $334 million in outflows on Tuesday alone, driving cumulative inflows down to $56.75 billion with total assets under management moderating to $98.40 billion. Ethereum spot ETFs faced similar pressure with $35 million in outflows, leaving cumulative inflows at $11.58 billion and AUM at $11.79 billion.

There is one bright spot: XRP spot ETFs have maintained a steady bullish streak over the past two weeks with $1.55 million in inflows on Tuesday, bringing cumulative inflows to $1.41 billion and AUM to $1.12 billion. Meanwhile, Hyperliquid's ETF products have extended an impressive 8-day inflow win streak despite the broader market weakness.

## DeFi and Alternative Narratives

Amid the macro fear, some pockets of activity are worth noting. DeFi Total Value Locked has dipped 1.2% to $81.1 billion, with Lido leading at $18.4 billion but also declining 0.76%. However, Nyke Finance has posted a staggering 315,188% TVL spike over the past 24 hours — a remarkable outlier that deserves monitoring.

Bitmine has been aggressively accumulating Ethereum, adding 5.4 million ETH to its reserves — a bullish signal from one of the largest corporate ETH holders. On the regulatory front, UK authorities have blacklisted Justin Sun's HTX exchange over $1.5 billion in alleged Russian sanction circumvention, adding another layer of regulatory scrutiny to the industry.

Stablecoins have hit a record $322 billion in total supply, which some analysts view as both a sign of growing crypto adoption and a potential warning — dry powder that could flood into risk assets on any positive catalyst, or trigger bank-run dynamics if confidence wavers.

## Looking Ahead: What's Next for Crypto?

The immediate outlook remains cautious. The US-Iran situation is the single biggest wildcard — any escalation could push Bitcoin below $70,000 and send the broader market into a deeper correction. Conversely, if a ceasefire MOU is successfully finalized, we could see a rapid risk-on rally as pent-up demand returns.

Technically, Bitcoin needs to reclaim the $76,800 zone to signal any meaningful recovery. Ethereum must hold above $2,000 to maintain its broader bullish structure. The Fear & Greed Index at 25 is historically a contrarian buy signal — extreme fear has often preceded sharp reversals.

For investors, the key question is whether this dip represents a healthy correction within a longer-term bull market or the beginning of a more sustained bearish phase. With Bitcoin still up significantly year-to-date and institutional adoption continuing through ETF products, the long-term thesis remains intact. But in the short term, geopolitical risk and institutional profit-taking are combining to create a challenging environment that demands caution.

links.title: New York My Kind of Town
links.body:
Wait. I'm from Chicago. Chicago is my kind of town... but it turns out that so is New York. 

![](https://hostelgeeks.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/fun-things-to-do-new-york-city-usa.jpg)

The reason I haven't posted lately is that my family and I were away on a trip to New York city. We went there specifically to see Daniel Radcliffe star in a play called Every Brilliant Thing. But because I am obsessed with efficiency, I couldn't justify the cost of a plane trip and hotel stay just to see one show. So being the good American I am, my solution was to... spend even more money!!!

What started out as a simple trip to see one play turned into a four day Odyssey that we will never forget. 

On the first day, we went to our favorite diner called Ellen's Stardust Diner. It is simply amazing. The waitstaff at Ellen's Stardust Diner are all Broadway hopefuls. They sing while they take your order, work the register and bring your food. And when I say they sing... oh my god do they sing. They are simply amazing. The food is overpriced and not very good, but for some reason they do not charge a cover charge for some of the best live singing you will ever hear. It is amazing!

![](https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/image/TWCNews/ellen_s_stardustdinersoftopen1198920371225_11162021)

Later that night we saw a play called \

. It was incredible! i cannot believe how funny the play was. They managed to make us laugh for about one and a half hours without dropping a single swear word. Now that shows creativity! The play is a spoof of local theater troops. In it, well.... everything goes wrong. The dialogue gets confused, the set falls apart,the stage manager forgets to do his job and many actors get injured. It was delightful!

The following day, my wife, daughter and I solved two escape rooms. neither one had a very good theme but the puzzles were fun. One was stealing back the Mona Lisa while the other was based on the Movie Now You See Me. Of the two the Now You See Me Room was better as we enjoyed some of the magic based puzzles. But we have done better ones.

That night we saw one of the coolest things we will ever see. Danielle Radcliffe starred in a play called Every Brilliant Thing. The theater is very small and Danielle Radcliffe works the crowd before the show so he can find people to play small roles in the play. Aside from these very small roles, Radcliffe is the only actor. He must improvise a lot but what is written is so beautiful that it makes me tear up thinking about it. And when I said he worked the crowd, I mean he was in every row chatting with people. We sat upstairs so he did not come up there, but when I was in line waiting to buy candy, he was about 5 feet away from me talking to people like they were his best friends in the world.

![](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/ba/73/93/ba7393c0be1a239c63ac6864e7ea4891.jpg)

The following afternoon was dedicated to seeing a incredibly beautiful play called Hadestown. It is a modern take of the tragedy of Hades, Persephone, Orpheus and Eurydice. It is set to new Orleans style jazz music and singing. It was unforgettable. Although I usually like my musicals with a bit more whimsy, this one was so moving that I couldn't help but love it. 

On the final day we hit Ellen's Stardust Diner one more time and then headed to the airport. When I returned I definitely needed a vacation from my vacation. But I'm not complaining. It was incredible!

I'll write up full reviews later but I really wanted to explain why I have been gone. It was for the best reason!

​

​

​

​

​

links.title: Digital Archaeology: Floppy Disk #14 – COMPUTER.DOC
links.body:
></center>

A summary for those that haven't necessarily been keeping up with this series:

I found a number of 5.25\

disk drive and extracting the contents a several years back. Since then, I have been occasionally posting the content here.

Based on the contents, most or all of these disks were apparently once owned by someone named Connie who used to run the “Close Encounters” Special Interest Group (SIG) on Delphi in the mid 1980s.

The following description of this SIG was found in a document on one of the disks: \

This service was text based and was accessed via a modem and whatever terminal program you had available for your computer to dial in with. Many of these disks have forum messages, e-mails and chat session logs. All of this is pre-internet stuff and I am not aware of any archives in existence today that contain what was on Delphi in the 1980s.

>
</center>

This post includes the contents of COMPUTER.DOC. This file is dated September 2nd, 1985 and is in a subdirectory called TELEPSYC. This is an article on types of computer addiction (\

). No name or other credit is listed in the file. I tried doing a web search on a few strings from this article but couldn't find anything so I'm not sure who wrote it. Based on the name of the subdirectory and the mention near the end of the file itself, I believe this article came from a special interest group or some other kind of feature on Delphi called \

.

Todos estuvimos en algún momento en ese lugar donde sentimos que no podemos más. Donde el peso de lo que cargamos parece más grande que nuestras fuerzas.

> Porque el que quiera salvar su vida, la perderá; pero el que pierda su vida por causa de mí y del evangelio, la salvará.

links.title: The Garden Around My Church!
links.body:
My church, St. Ambrose Catholic Parish, Omoba Road is built on a hill. Surrounding it, is a vibrant landscape that reflects care and life. From the left wing, the right wing to the front and back of the compound, the environment is alive with lush green vegetation.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvcaGHiZxaD3dS1jPTM5ErKR1Z5CCzChCNjtFtQ1YiaA/1779925398584.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXnXtor9KkHuN27DX2xpDNaxwBRFUMqmADhs9d9uQwZZk/1779925398932.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdW79YZxhQkyzj4ymdCzkYeymBGHYexrGgAoQsKzMKQme/1779925399112.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTF9Fdn5mVD7PCJvuN999YrAmZq9D8cu7vD76JhhWdoRt/1779925399322.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbd2MVdvCKRL36A7uU289CJSBSuHrBzeGTT4567ckik9/1779925399582.jpg)




The garden has a mix of fruit trees, flowering plants, shrubs, and well-maintained carpet grass. The space isn’t just neat — it’s thriving, with birds often seen perched on the trees and around the grass, butterflies and other insects flitting between the flowers, adding to the natural beauty.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPfqGwz72YjVoAbDpXbmAKsHoUTwDgwQhemJRfgZsikL2/1779925619317.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcek3wSyReThqgMtwTGYUiv5jw5YfR1cBjViiKt3meBHo/1779925619485.jpg)



There's the Orange jasmine flowers, which surrounds the church in a beautiful layout. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnC6HxzHBvcitbPAkZpNVm6frU6XxkQapRagMhC76VSG/1779925482517.jpg)

At the right wing, the showy, cluster-forming Oleander (Nerium oleander)  is visible, it's pinky bloom adding color to the environment. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUSrwoC4CQ5m1eMajctdNJuex5vJRCmYDSzbAAqSsx1t4/1779925482000.jpg)









There's also the Plumeria pudica, commonly known as the White Frangipani. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPEHyz8Uj3tzxAqh21GAJqe4T8EsesYsjn27deAFBkcna/1779925482097.jpg)

***
***
The White Ixora  
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbz51fsQKjDJHnGZ4TeV4Uag56Grz89QXGG7ukUxuSvGR/1779925482290.jpg)

And then the Canna indica, commonly known as the Indian shot or African arrowroot.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPtLcKvTPSKjRddCxwm11chRGFPAPf1qvs4WFoaKJj4ZW/1779925482360.jpg)
***

This green space creates a peaceful atmosphere for worshippers and stands as a testament to what a community can maintain when it values its environment.

links.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1407 - Hive Keychain and Hive Swap Both Allow Swapping Any Layer-1 or Layer-2 Asset for Any Other  - Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Tuesday, May 26, 2026
links.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_094038106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmDUhxzuPvc85U9wZayCgv5LRtAy5cGyWjq6LNksrysP5jpbAP3LDEmnM83YxuoosCC.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 22.41% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.061 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.992 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.01996008 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.1087735 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00108031 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.180020 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001587 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 75,101.3 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 342.40 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 52.29 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,459.04 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 74.70 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/485.7k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 One excellent asset-management implementation that I've come very much to appreciate and utilize is the ability to swap any Hive layer-1 or layer-2 asset for any other, regardless of whether the two have a shared liquidity pool or not. So far there are two ways to do this. This exceedingly useful feature can be accessed and executed via the '*Swap*' tab in Hive Keychain, and also now via the '*Swap*' tab on [***Hive Swap***](https://hive-swap.com), which is a new, and very good, Hive asset-management frontend. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_150949459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWvxR3Coc3rUgLLgXJT3swrWi3hpZdrkfkwrVWMrfHQ2KGcFiMpbxcVgYJJruVJ9WSf.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_151308740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u61B82CHHQTkGV8UuWWZQ1FokiCaZvbntSMSH7eg86qHHVvk8Bx1y7koGyF1znDPejW.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Given that most layer-2 tokens on Hive Engine don't have liquidity pools, this kind of anything-for-anything, multi-hop swapping is extraordinarily helpful, and it opens up a great many more asset-management and asset-leveraging possibilities. If any layer-2 tokens can be swapped for HIVE, then this might be a means to help generate sufficient HIVE for the We Are Alive Tribe's daily and weekly operations, like paying our HP delegators, and sending out HIVE in our daily ALIVE dividends. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_151418320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFRYGS3SpPFakuTmtJWmjfKq7mEoRKfnBBM3gBW6JBjGtxmvsvCLVuc4Cuk9tqvmxtg.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_151759304_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC3BwYhTowC9KHE3adDdo5txgvA3SWivawBAfBtJavtuqZD8eHmngyhbTjbEpL1W2sH.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Between our notably-increased BEE income, from the recall of our substantial delegation of BEE from @bee.voter, and this ability to swap any layer-1 or layer-2 asset for any other, offered by Hive Keychain and Hive Swap, there may just be a light at the end of the tunnel for our 'We Are Alive Tribe' economy. These possibilities also don't tie our community economy to income streams from any particular project, which is very good indeed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152103474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC1Z3UGbfXG5GyCHYM3oNPQrRPTSABUTKrVpmaGb8nzyLt3QXaymVoUkzoj4q8eQ2R8.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152315762.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tc1RRwgQimFfyPiEW74SHxEvWQXFZ8UQTWJKyN2BmDget3H8nGvssZx3ATAsdvRUeYg.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I'm very interested to see what our BEE income at the end of the week will be, and whether delegating a portion of our BEE to @centtoken would provide more. Growing our liquid and staked BEE as quickly as possible is the goal. We also have a fair bit of BEE growing in various diesel/liquidity pools as well, which can be removed to utilize as needed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152349992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQrH7qJiQnfX1up9bYuy2fmcVs2MckyB1nuiFGc8eA9LubHxTsYDn9qYL6LCQFMYNd2.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152436711_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5zowPNJKFRekyMXZdgJKM1uc79dWoyMCaFFgr7E5k8wM1f5jk8QykgE4fwjhSJoKEA.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Originally, Erik (@flaxz) was able to grow our sizable BEE holding of 20.4k staked BEE on @aliveandsocial by delegating all BEE on all 'We Are Alive Tribe' accounts to that account, thus effectively focusing BEE votes and income in a very efficient manner. I'm considering reimplementing that dynamic soon, to see if I can take our BEE holding to new heights. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152524643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xAY7KZUMg9UiJWCAdY2aKX6xWhtgoBg2WypVUf8WHiZUKRp7tkzACPgfAqM1DF8njUg.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152659975_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23ynX3kEVazeCyxE7WnHDVLmGnxfPTjgwDtFyy7SMLMehmqMeKrSfQEuNE2a8Jb5xemQT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, after finishing up with my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, and taking a round of photos for my posts by a little after 2PM, I met up with a friend (*to whom I give regular sessions*) to begin the process of crafting her own personal neural-resonance subliminal-affirmation audio tracks. That did not go as planned, however, and for an incredibly sad and disturbing reason; two well-known and loved older men in the local Lower Puna community, and even quite close to GaiaYoga, we're murdered the night before, apparently by the same deranged individual. The shock of that hit everyone hard indeed. I had the unhappy news of sharing this with Ano, who'd known one of the deceased fellows for most of his 25+ years on the Island. Given the circumstances, I didn't do any work on the property. After my friend left, I went to Wabisabi to heat up some food that I had in the fridge, to collect my leftover superfood fire coffee, and with those in hands I headed back to the Flow House, to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by a bit after 10PM, and after some asset management, and working with Hermes, I went to bed, way too late again, by just after 1AM (*yeah, ouch*). I woke up just after 8AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to write this post. It's now just before 2PM, so it's an exceedingly good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's incarnation of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_152912072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhrzSRZa9YZniNdD1iE46DHrLd716Yi3kmuchxxJtUciGMdkDEBLmeAhjuC4mFy2gDM.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260525_153116063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvY12zQdFxFCMsYrcv1Ao1pjSRhjgUcywpCT5wdcadC6mariTxf4yU9N2J9e3Q5RBRm.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. links.title: 🍓 {27/05/26} ✦ KoiFest, Tanabata Festival, Mcbo. Edo Zulia 2026 🌙 🎋 🎐 | Eventos Otaku, Venezuela ✦ 🇪🇸 │ 🇺🇸
links.body:
<center>![cover_minorei_tanabata_hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23zGioZcbcB4NVrpBMbRw2aCwrBEnMuhWfqHwAAXRuTaT9ig9Xia668QruivyMYLdXhJi.png)

<sub>✦ What's the scene like for manga and anime events in my city? 💙 - Collage & Edition in FotoJet, photos by @Tesmoforia ✦</sub></center>

<center>![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)</center>

<div class=\
>\n\n🇪🇸 ~ El pasado domingo 17 de Mayo asistí a la **\

,** un evento otaku-cosplayer del que hace meses estaba atenta porque en sus anteriores actividades han manejado varias de mis temáticas favoritas _(alusión a seres sobrenaturales y festivales propios de la cultura Japonesa)._

Esta es una nueva organización y una nueva línea de eventos en mi ciudad, en su [cuenta de instagram](https://www.instagram.com/koifest.ve/) podrán encontrar más información sobre quiénes son, sus personajes originales (OC) con su respectivo lore, y lo que considero mas importante, **la ventana directa para conocer su visión y toda la data importante sobre qué clase de propuesta es este proyecto.**

Hoy día en Maracaibo hay lo que considero un \

de eventos de entretenimiento, tanto de entrada paga como entrada gratuita, en salones cerrados o espacios abiertos incluyendo diferentes centros comerciales, podemos decir que hay opciones para todos los gustos y todos los presupuestos.\n\n<center>Yo ubicaría al **\

** como una de esas pautas bonitas que no te puedes perder si quieres experimentar lo mejor de 2 épocas: **El presente,** con mejores recursos en cuanto sonido, pantallas y diversificación de actividades; **y el pasado,** porque es un evento organizado por y para fans _(este no es el tipo de propuesta que tiene como verdadero y principal objetivo generar ganancias en vista de la enorme popularidad que ha ganado el tema anime-manga-cosplay-kpop)._ >! [ENGLISH VERSION] > 🇺🇸 ~ Last Sunday, May 17, I attended the **“Koifest, Tanabata Festival,”** an otaku-cosplay event I’d been looking forward to for months because their past events have featured several of my favorite themes _(referring to supernatural beings and festivals unique to Japanese culture)._ > > This is a new organization and a new series of events in my city. On their [Instagram account,](https://www.instagram.com/koifest.ve/) you can find more information about who they are, their original characters (OCs) with their respective lore, and what I consider most important: **A direct window into their vision and all the key details about what this project entails.** > > These days in Maracaibo, there’s what I consider a “boom” in entertainment events—both paid and free, in indoor venues and open spaces, including various shopping malls. We can say there are options for all tastes and budgets. > >
I would place **“KoiFest”** among those must-see highlights you can’t miss if you want to experience the best of two eras:
> > **The present,** with better resources in terms of sound, screens, and a variety of activities; **and the past,** because it’s an event organized by and for fans _(this isn’t the kind of event whose true and primary goal is to generate profits, given the enormous popularity that anime, manga, cosplay, and K-pop have gained)._
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
![1779136690304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23zGcDKi2xSmfUPsMkLygqW7yLW2nmVvBRMgipMeTFEhtbG1Q6pMa5mJBpwp6GFxBj5qr.jpg) [✦ Por fin pude conocer en persona a Lilu Witch, que asistió como Lady Black Moon de la serie Sailor Moon, unos gustos finos uwu ✦](https://www.instagram.com/lilu.witch/)
|![1779136690321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23zGaH1EanWZSK9RHEyuPgeWS4puGcqXfyAUrHDRMtHsK1V4d1uo6t2dQFMxbxS2zMpej.jpg)|![1779136690265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xyQqDxajp7pSyWfA8kqXcbXRff8QyU1v8TJxLbqBiKX4uohv9LAfe4FMwEcJWoYZvi6.jpg)| |-|-| |![1779136689933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EoCbtniyPVHjVmHAm394hFRZUKDsDCx7ujmSxmFYmxnbPrEp7jtigEu6mfDr7CnGMM6.jpg)|![1779136690215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wMYHwupR4oL5waXspZNxWJupiXp1k4wtVQ4LQY3sy5NX6uYFFCHbjCj7G1rZMHBZ7bC.jpg)|
![1779136689920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23yJLtzzbVHGz9amfEQtx6rLLGdv3BRo9eQKjbTAu3iTYcUj3dn6eAktKm4sVeVsJ5gB3.jpg) [✦ Y Nury Jiejie asistió como Howl, me comentó que hace mucho tiempo quería sacar este personaje y leagrego detalles extra a la chaqueta, lastima que no se nota aquí ✦](https://www.instagram.com/nurycos_/)
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
>\n\nLas entradas para este evento se compraron con antelación (todas VIP), y no había visitado \

antes, es como su nombre indica un bar, de dos pisos y con todo su interior pintado de color oscuro. En la planta baja estaba ubicado el escenario principal con su respectiva pantalla, y en el piso superior estaban las tiendas (me gusto mucho la variedad y calidad de mercancía disponible) con un espacio para los talleres pre-anunciados en cronograma, mas un bonito set de fotografía bien iluminado.

> Tickets for this event were purchased in advance (all VIP), and I hadn’t visited “Aventura Bar” before; as the name suggests, it’s a bar—two stories high, with the entire interior painted in dark colors. The main stage with its screen was located on the ground floor, and on the upper floor were the shops (I really liked the variety and quality of the merchandise available), along with a space for the workshops announced in the schedule, plus a nice, well-lit photo set.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/48fMnPVwbPcaMGbFfqZ3bie4cHFuVL2wutH3jwXG7RigjFCSnFee6Wr8KQF4WdVcDH.png) [✦ I had planned to take part in the origami workshop, but I arrived late—I ran into a few hiccups before leaving ✦](https://www.instagram.com/p/DYQZsQFjk99/?img_index=1)

> Como llegue un poco tarde quise pasar la mayoría del tiempo conversando con las amigas que tenia mucho tiempo sin ver en persona, no estuve tan atenta al cronograma de escenario como normalmente me gustaría pero así sucede cuando tienes el tiempo contado durante un evento, debes escoger qué hacer con esas horas y sobre todo estar atento al reloj, porque el tiempo pasa SUPER VOLANDO, pero doy fé que el Concurso de Cosplay, la Pasarela y el concierto fueron muy bonitos.

> Since I arrived a little late, I wanted to spend most of my time chatting with friends I hadn’t seen in person in a long time. I didn’t pay as much attention to the stage schedule as I usually would, but that’s how it goes when you’re short on time at an event—you have to choose what to do with those hours and, above all, keep an eye on the clock, because time flies by SO FAST, but I can attest that the Cosplay Contest, and the concert were everything we hoped for and went off without a hitch.
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
|![1779136690017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wMYkwDx1KTfwnzDHgtqEzSP8ZPG7oBEC6cbpb2dtXJysanbyEhv1kGWgo5nKYkXx1i1.jpg)|![1779136690047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/243WY3U7BhHttwaQd8FHRKirWd58wMuBTWGZz8aavenvptPaZSYxzNMZigmiPydTuk57K.jpg)| |-|-|
![1779136689828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wC1Z2U7thSoZpwWDRc1NDWgTxWNTra5bHAXBfPRetAkAivCE9VJd58By1ReTPUUZKaY.jpg) ✦ And it was really hot—the whole city is sweltering right now—but thank goodness there was this bar serving cold boba drinks ✦
![1779136689741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xAVbnot5CW3s8Mkt7g1iofdALRufxsnr7iCymmbyppiSN1mECWGhbbmCsSuVpMVpCrt.jpg) ✦ There were a lot of really cute cosplayers, but since I spent almost the entire afternoon chatting, I was only able to ask for a few group photos ✦
![1779136689602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EoeFKdcRz5nRBDHu5Dw8SaytZXXCM7D8rR9CvoWM3HzcqwSN8bhHd9GaDjJAWsT17k4.jpg) ✦ That really is a beautiful set, and you can use it for free! ✦
|![1779136689690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/Ep5mi2QHcN1uKTejuK4DvF2zYefAiCfPg1UTccG3kGb9ua734hyotduLBTr79RwcQKF.jpg)|![1779136689707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EonmUwuinGdKVMqv1x4Vsbx1YJDYsjqYgPfL3guEcF2nFiTXMpZSYGmAcGVtgKGWQgh.jpg)| |-|-|
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)

>

Después del evento teníamos una pauta para cenar en otro lugar así que tuvimos que irnos temprano, normalmente me gusta quedarme hasta el final del evento pero hubiera sido muy tarde por la noche.

Pero pude alcanzar a escuchar las premiaciones y creo que los resultados del Concurso de Cosplay fueron justos. Muy bien merecido ese primer lugar a un bello dual de \
.\n\nNoten que a la salida también había este lindo \

para tomarte fotos, es la clase de detalles que me enamoran de los eventos temáticos, aprecio el esfuerzo de las organizaciones por incluir cosas así porque sé que no es fácil (ni comisionarlas, transportarlas o almacenarlas). >! [ENGLISH VERSION] > After the event, we had plans to have dinner somewhere else, so we had to leave early. I usually like to stay until the end of the event, but it would have been way too late at night. > > But I managed to catch the awards ceremony, and I think the results of the Cosplay Contest were fair. That first-place win was well deserved by a beautiful “EPIC” duo. > > Note that there was also this cute “Tori” at the exit for taking photos—it’s the kind of detail that makes me fall in love with themed events. I appreciate the organizers’ effort to include things like this because I know it’s not easy (whether commissioning, transporting, or storing them).
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
|![1779136689188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wCDgp3ywxV1yVQxYifyUi27iLK2u1DoqoiKgk7cHPTRH1S94JHs5YfSK4TM5X3sRwTP.jpg)|![1779136689199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xAc3qBtSCU9cJjtnmoxqZ5nrnp1ZPRfff9DKQuKvhks19YwU5CrANiqygCHDFNvoaCa.jpg)|![1779136689214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23vsUYKmKaEcK7zWNLDp3qxZS1iPMezT9bBTSAths43NWjYivvSHMigK6Eajkk55rZdTs.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![1779136689227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EogPK7nHNAqhZs7C1KJgVDfj6Uuo8VVGpqurJcWDUptidTFBVmCbeJGPs5i9W2xqRn4.jpg) ✦ VIP tickets to events of this kind often include limited-edition merchandise themed around the event ✦
![1779136689269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EogPHP3y8sjFrcuttxSkV9rXw5cWULjMJp5f1q2rSewj5d8xrqxKDFHU4cKKeh8nJPT.jpg) ✦ They really poured their hearts into their characters! ✦

香辣虾是一道令人垂涎欲滴的美味。每一只虾都被鲜香的调料包裹，经过火辣的烹饪，散发出诱人的香气。一口咬下去，鲜嫩的虾肉与香辣的味道交织在一起，瞬间点燃味蕾。尤其是那种微微的麻辣感，让人欲罢不能，吃完之后总是忍不住再来一份！在这样的美食面前，心情都变得格外愉悦。

***

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Frontier: In the Spotlight
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfUEUq77oMdwu6Q8iQd1ZDM3gxCUZhkzRAgyxCHoXwUVH/Portada%20-%20Frontier%20en%20los%20Reflectores.png</center>

<center>In recent weeks, **Splinterlands** has experienced a series of highly interesting developments through its official patch notes. Looking back, many players of the **Frontier** format felt a certain disconnection from recent patches, as several of the new rulesets introduced into the game were not enabled for this specific format. However, the updates on **19 de mayo** and **26 de mayo de 2026** have taken a radical turn on this trend, dumping a massive amount of content, mechanics, and incentives directly into **Frontier**.</center>

><center>En las últimas semanas, **Splinterlands** ha experimentado una serie de novedades muy interesantes a través de sus notas de actualización oficiales. Si echamos la mirada atrás, muchos jugadores del formato **Frontier** sentíamos cierta desconexión con los parches recientes, ya que varias de las nuevas rulesets introducidas en el juego no estaban habilitadas para este formato específico. Sin embargo, las actualizaciones del **19 de mayo** y del **26 de mayo de 2026** han dado un giro radical a esta tendencia, volcando una enorme cantidad de contenido, mecánicas e incentivos directamente sobre **Frontier**.</center>

<center>In these two patches, we will evaluate how the arrival of the cosmetics shop, the new currency, and the incentives to retain novice users are reshaping the experience inside the arena.</center>

><center>En estos dos parches, evaluaremos cómo la llegada de la tienda de cosméticos, la nueva divisa y los incentivos para retener a los usuarios novatos están reconfigurando la experiencia dentro de la arena.</center>

### <center>[The May 26 Update: Retaining New Players and Frontier Skins| La Actualización del 26 de Mayo: Retención de Nuevos Jugadores y SkinsFrontier](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-05-26)</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ1KuSzrAfZ2h9KmrCXAr1Msju9Wb4SZ8PN5Q6FkhcY45/Sombreros%20V2.png</center>

<center>The most recent update, deployed yesterday, **26 de mayo de 2026**, has proven that the development team has a very clear focus: strengthening the user base by attracting and securing the permanence of new players in the **Frontier** format. To achieve this, two highly successful direct stimulus measures have been implemented:</center>

><center>La actualización más reciente, desplegada ayer **26 de mayo de 2026**, ha demostrado que el equipo de desarrollo tiene un enfoque muy claro: fortalecer la base de usuarios atrayendo y asegurando la permanencia de los nuevos jugadores en el formato **Frontier**. Para lograrlo, se han implementado dos medidas de estímulo directo muy acertadas:</center>


- **Welcome Glint Incentive**: New players will now receive **30** Glint for each of their first **10** battles in **Frontier**. This equates to a total of **300** guaranteed Glint at the start of their journey, allowing them to interact immediately with the game's reward economy without experiencing the initial friction of resource scarcity found in the **Modern** and **Wild** formats. This will also serve as a hook to draw them into those formats if they want more Glint to spend.

>- **Incentivo de Glint de Bienvenida**: Los nuevos jugadores ahora recibirán **30** Glint por cada una de sus primeras **10** batallas en **Frontier**. Esto equivale a un total de **300** Glint garantizados al inicio de su viaje, permitiéndoles interactuar de inmediato con la economía de recompensas del juego sin experimentar la fricción inicial de la falta de recursos en los formatos **Modern** y **Wild**, lo que también serviría para que sean atraídos a esos formatos si quieren más Glints para gastar.

- **Identity Reward (Avatar Hat)**: After completing their first **5** battles in **Frontier**, novice (and not-so-novice) players will be awarded a hat for their avatar. This addition not only promotes customization from day **1** but also generates a sense of early accomplishment that is highly necessary in the **Splinterlands** learning curve.

>- **Recompensa de Identidad (Avatar Hat)**: Tras completar sus primeras **5** batallas en **Frontier**, los jugadores novatos o no tan novatos serán galardonados con un sombrero para su avatar. Este añadido no solo fomenta la personalización desde el primer día, sino que genera un sentido de logro temprano muy necesario en la curva de aprendizaje de **Splinterlands**.

<center>Beyond beginner incentives, yesterday's patch heavily focused on visual customization. Multiple skins (aesthetic aspects) were introduced, giving special prominence to the latest exclusive cards from the **Vouchers Shop** as well as the long-awaited debut of the **Electrofox** card. This aesthetic injection refreshes the visual appeal of **Splinterlands** boards, demonstrating that collecting in the game is no longer limited to the statistical power of the cards, but also to the visual prestige of the decks.</center>

><center>Más allá de los incentivos para principiantes, el parche de ayer estuvo fuertemente enfocado en la personalización visual. Se introdujeron múltiples skins (aspectos estéticos), otorgando especial protagonismo tanto a las últimas tarjetas exclusivas de la **Vouchers Shop** como al esperado debut de la tarjeta **Electrofox**. Esta inyección estética renueva el atractivo visual de los tableros de **Splinterlands**, demostrando que el coleccionismo en el juego ya no solo se limita al poder estadístico de las cartas, sino también al prestigio visual de los mazos.</center>

### <center>[The May 19 Revolution: Lux’s Favor, Sparks, and the Daily Wheel | La Revolución del 19 de Mayo: Lux’s Favor, Sparks y la Ruleta Diaria](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-05-19)</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSUkacJ1Ra6cgCUmcSZs4pUF2Gfqyx1UUAWKN857jv1SE/Ruleta.png</center>

<center>To understand the full impact of what we are experiencing in **Frontier**, we must connect yesterday's patch with the colossal update from last week, dated **19 de mayo de 2026**. This update brought us the content package known as **Lux’s Favor**, which completely altered our daily routine through highly addictive gamification systems.</center>

><center>Para comprender el impacto total de lo que estamos viviendo en **Frontier**, debemos conectar el parche de ayer con la colosal actualización de la semana pasada, fechada el **19 de mayo de 2026**. Esta actualización nos trajo el paquete de contenido conocido como **Lux’s Favor**, el cual alteró por completo nuestra rutina diaria en el juego mediante sistemas de gamificación muy adictivos.</center>

<center>The central pillar of this reform was the introduction of a new prize wheel (**Prize Wheel**) in **Frontier**. Upon logging in each day, players have the opportunity to spin this wheel to claim a wide variety of essential assets: **Frontier Energy**, direct entry passes for the challenging **Pitt Challenges**, and a revolutionary new currency called **Sparks**.</center>

><center>El pilar central de esta reforma fue la introducción de una nueva ruleta de premios (**Prize Wheel**) en **Frontier**. Al iniciar sesión cada día, los jugadores tienen la oportunidad de girar esta ruleta para reclamar una gran variedad de activos esenciales: **Frontier Energy**, pases de entrada directos para los desafiantes **Pitt Challenges**, y una nueva y revolucionaria divisa denominada **Sparks**.</center>

<center>The **Sparks** ecosystem was designed under a strict loyalty structure: if you perform your daily spin consecutively for several days, the system will grant you a streak **Sparks** bonus, allowing you to scale through different reward tiers. These accumulated **Sparks** can be immediately invested in the new **Sparks Shop**, a specialized store that debuted with a diverse selection of skins and cosmetics for avatars, promising to expand its catalog constantly in the coming months.</center>

><center>El ecosistema de los **Sparks** se diseñó bajo una estructura de fidelidad muy estricta: si realizas tu giro diario de manera consecutiva durante varios días, el sistema te otorgará un bono de **Sparks** por racha, permitiéndote escalar a través de diferentes niveles (tiers) de recompensa. Estos **Sparks** acumulados pueden ser invertidos de inmediato en la nueva **Sparks Shop**, una tienda especializada que debutó con una variada selección de skins y cosméticos para los avatares, y que promete expandir su catálogo de forma constante en los próximos meses.</center>

### <center>The Impact of the **Pitt Challenges** and the Counterweight to Rulesets** | El Impacto de los **Pitt Challenges** y el Contrapeso a las Rulesets</center>

<center>The arrival of **Lux's Favor** also marked the landing of the **Pitt Challenges**, a **PvE** (Player vs. Environment) mode that has revitalized the gaming experience. As we analyzed in previous publications, the possibility of testing our decks against bosses with predetermined mechanics adds a refreshing layer of strategy that moves away from the traditional competitive stress of season rankings.</center>

><center>La llegada de **Lux's Favor** también marcó el desembarco de los **Pitt Challenges**, una modalidad **PvE** (Jugador contra Entorno) que ha revitalizado la experiencia de juego. Como hemos analizado en publicaciones anteriores, la posibilidad de medir nuestros mazos contra jefes con mecánicas predeterminadas añade una capa de estrategia refrescante que se aleja del estrés competitivo tradicional de las clasificaciones de la temporada.</center>

<center>This constant flow of exclusive content for **Frontier** arrives at the ideal moment. During past months, the **Frontier** community watched with some resignation as core design updates focused on modifying global mechanics through rulesets we could not enjoy at our tables. By centralizing the **Sparks** economy, the daily wheel, skins, and boss challenges within the **Frontier** interface, the format reclaims its identity as a vibrant, modern, and high-priority ground for the developers.</center>

><center>Este flujo constante de contenido exclusivo para **Frontier** llega en el momento idóneo. Durante los meses pasados, la comunidad de **Frontier** miraba con cierta resignación cómo las actualizaciones de diseño se centraban en modificar mecánicas globales mediante reglas que no podíamos disfrutar en nuestras mesas de juego. Al centralizar la economía de los **Sparks**, la ruleta diaria, las skins y los desafíos de jefes dentro de la interfaz de **Frontier**, el formato recupera su identidad como un terreno vibrante, moderno y prioritario para los desarrolladores.</center>

### <center>Conclusion and Future Expectations | Conclusión y Expectativas de Futuro</center>

<center>The balance of the last two weeks for **Frontier** is highly positive. **Splinterlands** has successfully connected economic accessibility for newcomers with prestige content and customization for veterans. This seems to mark a transition from a simpler format meant to function as a tutorial to an experimental mode where new things can be tested, either to reward players or as a testing ground for features that will later arrive in other formats.</center>

><center>El balance de las últimas dos semanas para **Frontier** es sumamente positivo. **Splinterlands** ha logrado conectar la accesibilidad económica para los recién llegados con el contenido de prestigio y personalización para los veteranos. Esto parece marcar una transición de un formato más sencillo y simple para funcionar como tutorial a un modo experimental donde probar cosas nuevas, ya sea para premiar a los jugadores o como campo de prueba para novedades que llegarán a otros formatos.</center>

<center>This indicates that the journey does not end here. With **Frontier** consolidating itself in the spotlight, the hope remains to see even deeper improvements in the coming months. The next logical step to increase the format's appeal would be the introduction of exclusive **Frontier** rulesets, specifically designed to exploit the unique interactions of its cards, alongside game mechanics that continue expanding its teaching function for new players while remaining entertaining for anyone.</center>

><center>Esto marca que el viaje no termina aquí. Con **Frontier** consolidándose en el foco de atención, se mantiene la esperanza de ver mejoras aún más profundas en los próximos meses. El siguiente paso lógico para aumentar el atractivo del formato sería la introducción de Rulesets exclusivas para **Frontier**, diseñadas específicamente para aprovechar las interacciones únicas de sus cartas, junto con mecánicas de juego que continúen expandiendo su función de enseñanza para los jugadores nuevos pero entretenidos para cualquier jugador.</center>

<center>What about you, players? What prize did you get on the **Frontier** **Prize Wheel** this week? Have you already spent your first **Sparks** in the shop or are you saving up for the upcoming skins? What do you expect to be the next big thing arriving in **Frontier**? See you in the **Frontier** arena!</center>

><center>¿Y ustedes, Jugadores? ¿Qué premio les ha tocado en la **Prize Wheel** de **Frontier** esta semana? ¿Ya gastaron sus primeros **Sparks** en la tienda o están ahorrando para los próximos aspectos? ¿Qué esperan sea lo nuevo en llegar a **Frontier**? ¡Nos vemos en la arena de **Frontier**!</center>

body.title: The Ups and Downs of My Hive Journey
body.body:
Hive has been an amazing platform that has influenced lives positively in diverse ways, from financially to intellectually, amongst many others, to name but a few. I myself have been a beneficiary of HIVE in multiple ways, and that's why I'm still here to date. Besides that, blogging has become a habit that's quite difficult for me to let go of or quit. But then we can't lie that there have been people who wanted to leave or have left due to one reason or another. Have I ever found myself in that situation? Find out about it via my experience shared below. ![1000855074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23vsQChgDCjMESjZCJuTapKce7NJFVPCPBm42mrH2bTFFMApwhsbTXK5mKu121LoT5vmz.jpg) You see, when I joined Hive Blockchains, I really loved it and enjoyed my time here; besides, it was impacting my life positively and also meeting my financial needs. However, there have been cases and situations that made me want to rethink my stake here, and those are what I want to state below. Firstly, that is how the dispute and war between two whales usually leaves a mark on us, the innocent bloggers who are just finding a way to survive. I really don't like how many whales pick on innocent people because of their anger towards another person, and each time I fall victim, I do wish, like, I could just get the F out of here. Secondly is the high level of mischievousness among some creators and project initiators. I can vividly remember I was barely a year on Hive when I saw play-to-earn games such as PsyberX called for investors, but at the end of the day, it went down the drain, with my investments gone with it, without the whales having anything to do with helping people recover their money or protecting investors from future harm. The most annoying thing that made me think of leaving the most was when I was planning towards my wedding and had plans to sell some of my Hive Engine tokens, such as BRO and LGM, but at the end of the day, I watched them go down the drain. It was annoying; I even spoke to a friend that I'm fed up and that I'll leave, but then here I am still because it's still a source of income to me, regardless of how small, and until I'm able to see somewhere better, I guess I'd just stick with Hive. Besides, I'm fond of blogging daily and here, and that's why I'm still here despite the numerous letdowns. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/the-ups-and-downs-of-my-hive-journey-kt1)
