body.body:
>


Después de 7 años, la producción original de Amazon Prime Video, **\

**, llegó a su final en lo que fue su muy criticada 5.ª temporada. Esta producción basada en el cómic del mismo nombre ofreció una panorámica diferente a lo que se estaba consumiendo con respecto a tanto películas como series basadas en héroes de cómic y, en el momento de su estreno, fue más que un aire fresco, ya que en esta oportunidad los llamados héroes, desde sus imperfecciones y corrompidos por sus poderes, cumplieron la función de villanos y un grupo de marginados con sed de venganza eran quienes tenían la difícil misión de detenerlos, eso sí, sin la gran necesidad de ser llamados héroes.
> After seven years, the Amazon Prime Video original series, **\

**, came to an end with its highly criticized fifth season. This series, based on the comic book of the same name, offered a different perspective from what was typically seen in both movies and TV shows featuring comic book heroes. At the time of its premiere, it was more than just a breath of fresh air, as this time around the so-called heroes, with their flaws and corrupted by their powers, played the role of villains, and a group of outcasts thirsting for revenge were the ones tasked with the difficult mission of stopping them—though they certainly didn’t need to be called heroes.
![1000300468.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Ep1V2DpiMjpFg94AozWLU1jxCv3FYfZYHTwBmYVCZFYVxRfPUSq6WZhLN7BqH2RxgTa.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://www.thewrap.com/creative-content/what-to-watch/the-boys-season-5-new-episodes-schedule/)

Ahora, enfocándome en lo que fue la temporada final de esta serie, no diré que la expectativa causada por lo que era su final fue algo que no había visto en anterioridad, pero justamente esa emoción en fans (y otros no tanto) de la serie, personalmente, me hizo ser precavido con cómo se iba a relatar esta parte de la historia, a sabiendas de que el enfrentamiento final entre sus protagonistas era lo más evidente que sucediera, así que con eso dicho, solo quedaba ver cómo deberían llevar a cabo la nueva misión de este grupo de locos personajes que de una forma u otra debería concretarse y justamente en eso es en lo que critico (de manera negativa) tanto esta temporada como las dos anteriores, en donde el generar una idea para poner fin a la poderosa amenaza de los \

se hizo repetitiva; no molesta, pero creo que en eso se extendió la historia a pesar de durar tan solo 5 temporadas.
> Now, focusing on the final season of this series, I won’t say that the anticipation surrounding its ending was something I hadn’t seen before, but it was precisely that excitement among fans (and others who aren’t quite as devoted) of the series that, personally, made me cautious about how this part of the story would be told, knowing that the final showdown between the main characters was the most obvious outcome, so with that said, all that was left was to see how this group of crazy characters would carry out their new mission, which in one way or another had to come to fruition—and that is precisely what I criticize (negatively) about both this season and the two previous ones, where coming up with a way to put an end to the powerful threat of the “Supes” became repetitive; It’s not annoying, but I think that’s where the story dragged on, even though it only lasted five seasons.
![1000300469.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eo6BoTR3QqXaMoe9gAVqDcSjqgkHyR2mMDgBNXRCbV77mWVDVa2NoLhfQzVCADfCFbv.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://collider.com/the-boys-season-5-review-prime-video/)

El guion posiblemente fue el más correcto para funcionar como una despedida y posiblemente eso fue lo que generó el rechazo en ciertos fans con respecto a decisiones que rehusaron aceptar; el hecho de generar o desarrollar las historias de muchos de los personajes en esta temporada posiblemente generó menos tiempo en escena a los considerados como favoritos, pero personalmente creo que ciertas decisiones fueron acertada y otras no tanto, por ejemplo las que considero acertada fue dar protagonismo a \
o a la relación muy disfuncional entre \
y entre las no acertadas fue la historia familiar de \
o los cameos sin ninguna relevancia de personajes del ya cancelado spin-off \

, a todo eso debo sumar los signos de fatiga que presentaba Prime Video con su exitosa producción; lamentablemente, el presupuesto debió ser muy bajo porque la calidad de escenas fue muy pobre, y estuve convencido de que el mayor gasto se hizo en la batalla dentro del campo de concentración y, por supuesto, el enfrentamiento final, pero aparte de todo eso, lo demás no fue para nada bueno.
> The script was probably the best choice for a farewell, and that may be what led certain fans to reject decisions they refused to accept; the fact that this season focused on developing the stories of many characters likely meant less screen time for fan favorites, but personally, I think some decisions were spot-on and others not so much. For example, I think it was a good call to give a prominent role to “Ashley,” \
or the highly dysfunctional relationship between \
family storyline or the irrelevant cameos of characters from the now-canceled spin-off \

To all that, I must add the signs of fatigue Prime Video was showing with its hit production; unfortunately, the budget must have been very low because the quality of the scenes was very poor, and I was convinced that the biggest expense went into the battle inside the concentration camp and, of course, the final showdown, but aside from all that, the rest was not good at all.
![1000300470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoJyYNRaeve3A4eo1KPzocvLTXrcuwgmoo5nptXV1wBEshYcfWee4ahwpJSenqhy6C2.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://www.slashfilm.com/2140979/the-boys-season-5-review/)

Uno de los factores influyentes en el éxito de la serie se debió a la interpretación de sus personajes, en especial el trabajo de _**Antony Starr**_ y _**Karl Urban**_ como \

; personajes más que icónicos, no solo en la serie, sino en la cultura pop actual, y entre ellos (como debe ser) está el mantener a flote la temporada, y creo que cumplieron con ese importante rol y, repito, sé que se tenían altas expectativas con ambos personajes, en especial con el visto como un imponente dios, pero creo que su interpretación en esta temporada, rompiendo toda expectativa del público, fue correcta a todo lo que ofreció en temporadas anteriores y esta puede ser una opinión muy impopular, pero creo que Homelander como personaje no podía ofrecer más porque se haría aún más repetitivo; de igual manera ofrezco mi opinión sobre Butcher, que siempre fue fiel a su reacción primordial y a lo que motivó al desarrollo de esa historia y regreso a que su personaje, como los demás, pareciera ser parte de un círculo vicioso que avanzaba muy poco de la historia, pero al ser este el fin, puedo decir que tanto su cierre como el de su gran rival fue muy correcto.
> One of the key factors in the series' success was the portrayal of its characters, particularly the performances of _**Antony Starr**_ and _**Karl Urban**_ as \

—characters who are more than just iconic, not only in the series but in today's pop culture as well. Among their roles (as it should be) is keeping the season afloat, and I believe they fulfilled that important role. I know there were high expectations for both characters, especially for the one seen as an imposing god, but I think their portrayal this season—defying all audience expectations—was on par with everything they offered in previous seasons. This may be a very unpopular opinion, but I believe that Homelander, as a character, couldn’t have offered more because it would have become even more repetitive; Similarly, I’d like to offer my opinion on Butcher, who always remained true to his core reaction and to what drove the development of that story. I’ll come back to the fact that his character, like the others, seemed to be part of a vicious cycle that moved the story forward very little, but since this was the end, I can say that both his conclusion and that of his great rival were very well done.
![1000300471.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EpVAbneh7vP8GuAZSMmB2fist2KeZ5qkyhaWkNLhaQMvz79G45MTRoasm3g6isAqjFE.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Recap/TheBoysS05E08BloodAndBone)

La temporada final no fue perfecta, pero afirmo que varias de sus decisiones fueron acertadas para generar el cierre satisfactorio de su episodio final llamado \

; me pareció genial que justamente el final fuese relatado desde dos puntos de vista, primeramente por parte de Butcher, que se le presentó una oportunidad única en donde no podía posponer su venganza así estuvieran involucradas personas a quienes de alguna manera él ama. Ese relato sobre la necesidad de hacer justicia y poner fin al trauma que causó Homelander fue perfecto, pero así como él fue un gran protagonista, también necesitó que alguien relatara su historia y el encargado fue \

, quien es la parte bondadosa de **The Boys**, lo verdaderamente correcto o, por lo menos, esa imagen buena (por así decirlo) que te habla en uno de tus hombros; creo que esa fue la mejor decisión del showrunner de la serie y de sus guionistas para hacer un muy buen episodio acorde no solo a la temporada, sino a toda la historia, lo cual generó uno de los finales más satisfactorios que he visto en los últimos años. The Boys fue muy buena serie, su crítica constante usando la sátira para burlarse primeramente de la explotación del genero de superhéroes y que se extendió a muchos otros ámbitos de la sociedad actual, fue lo que más me gustó, ya que hubo momentos en dónde describir a esta producción no como una serie, sino como un documental y aunque en esta temporada posiblemente no se sintió como tal, ya que era primordial preparar al cierre de la historia, creo que hubo elementos que hicieron referencia a la realidad, creo que eso es lo que más me gustó de esta serie que se atrevió a hacer una crítica justa y que actualmete no se observa y espero que en las próximas producciones a estrenar siga con ese tematica y que por supuesto sigan siendo de alta calidad. 
> The final season wasn't perfect, but I'd argue that several of its decisions were spot-on in delivering a satisfying conclusion to the finale, titled \

; I thought it was brilliant that the ending was told from two perspectives—first from Butcher's point of view, who was presented with a unique opportunity where he couldn't put off his revenge, even if it involved people he loves in some way. That narrative about the need to seek justice and put an end to the trauma caused by Homelander was perfect, but just as he was a great protagonist, the story also needed someone to tell his side, and that role fell to \
who represents the kind-hearted side of **The Boys**—the voice of what’s truly right, or at least that \

image (so to speak) whispering in your ear; I think that was the best decision by the showrunner and the writers to create a truly great episode that fit not only the season but the entire story, resulting in one of the most satisfying endings I’ve seen in recent years. *The Boys* was a very good series; its constant critique, using satire to mock first and foremost the exploitation of the superhero genre—and which extended to many other areas of today’s society—was what I liked most, since there were moments where I could describe this production not as a series, but as a documentary. And although this season may not have felt like one, since it was essential to set the stage for the story’s conclusion, I think there were elements that referenced reality. I believe that’s what I liked most about this series—that it dared to offer a fair critique, something rarely seen today—and I hope that upcoming productions will continue with this theme and, of course, remain of high quality.

body.title: Base Launches Base MCP: Connecting Crypto Wallets to AI Agents—Are We Truly Ready to Hand Over the Keys to the Machine?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYtLUvRKZnPK8jzqqmgetTH4P2XoDp4HKvHsdqKBNY1in/coinbase-ai.png 


Coinbase’s Layer-2 network, Base, has officially rolled out \

(Model Context Protocol), an integration framework designed to bridge the gap between prominent Artificial Intelligence agents—such as OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude—and on-chain crypto wallets. This infrastructure essentially enables AI clients to execute a wide variety of decentralized finance (DeFi) activities directly inside a standard conversational interface using natural language commands. Users can instruct the AI to check asset balances, review transaction histories, execute token swaps, transfer funds, and interact seamlessly with various decentralized applications within the Base ecosystem, including prominent protocols like Uniswap, Morpho, Moonwell, Aerodrome, and Avantis.

From a structural and technical architecture standpoint, Base MCP functions as a secure gateway rather than a fully autonomous custodian. Security protocols dictate that the AI agent does not possess, manage, or have access to the user's private keys. Instead, when an AI agent proposes an on-chain transaction based on a user's prompt, the platform triggers a separate Base Account wallet approval window. This workflow mimics traditional smart contract interactions: the user is presented with a simulation of the expected asset changes and must manually authorize or reject the transaction. This implementation aims to prevent unauthorized drainages and mitigate execution errors while expanding the utility of the previously introduced x402 protocol—Coinbase's agentic payment standard focused on enabling seamless micro-transactions between automated entities.

However, a professional deep dive into this setup reveals significant logical friction that veteran market participants must critically analyze. While the framework delivers clean, minimalist abstraction of complex DeFi operations, it inherently introduces new vectors of user error and systemic risk. Empirical testing of smaller, localized agent models often uncovers structural weaknesses in trap-detection and reasoning, alongside persisting tendencies for data hallucination. In a fast-moving, hostile on-chain environment where transactions are immutable, relying on a generative language model to draft financial transactions poses a fundamental threat to risk management. The illusion of safety provided by the final manual approval step heavily relies on the user's constant vigilance. If a trader suffers from cognitive fatigue and reflexively approves a faulty or malicious transaction generated by a compromised or confused AI agent, the financial loss is immediate and irreversible. The integration undeniably accelerates the onset of an AI-native economy, but market participants should treat it as an experimental tool rather than a flawless investment assistant.

Source : [cointelegraph.com](https://cointelegraph.com/news/base-launches-mcp-ttol-to-connect-crypto-wallets-to-ai-agents?utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed)

body.title: Alabama Zack – Chapter VIII
body.body:
is a 40-chapter science fiction serial, published in the Scholar and Scribe community once a week on Wednesdays. You can start the serial from the beginning by visiting the [Curated Collection.](https://peakd.com/hive-199275/@cliffagreen/alabama-zack)
Previously in our story
*Alabama Zack, our hero and a war veteran, found himself standing on a train station platform in another time and dimension. At his feet lay a man in a brown suit. The man was dead, and Zack was arrested and jailed.* *Zack can not remember how he had arrived on that platform, let alone whether or not he had anything to do with the man's death.* ***In last week's chapter,*** *the doctor took Zack into town to meet the private investigator Cork McGraw. Zack, confused and lost by his amnesia and his strange experiences in that dimension, broke down crying. Cork asked his maid Matilda to make tea and takes them out to the front stoop to talk things over.* ![goldenhills (1280 x 40 px) (1280 x 780 px).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tvgH8He7JW34HU7j6gitV9YpfFyae7LQhhxuQrjMW9Z77Sw7NmM9LwWmytnJZubowBA.png) Matilda put the kettle on the cast iron stove, then put her hands on her hips. She was a heavy woman, and wise to the ways of the world, which to her meant being wise to the ways of men. And she'd had plenty of experience with that lot. Her experience with one abusive man after another had finally led her to Cork McGraw's door one drenching wet night, in search of a P.I., or anyone who could make her latest man stop bothering her. In a couple of days, the man had disappeared, and Matilda had stayed on in gratitude, as Cork's cook and maid. The kettle began to hiss. Since she had been at Cork's, she had seen one man after another come through his door, many with the same hangdog expression of doom and gloom as this new man, and most with problems whose solution required someone who stood just a little outside the law. She'd been around for quite a few disappearances, all of them warranted as far as she could tell. But word had it this new man didn't need a disappearance. He needed a scapegoat or a guilty party, and if Cork took him on, he would provide whichever the situation needed. She placed a tea pack of yolanta leaves, Cork's favorite, in the bottom of three mugs, and when the water boiled she poured steamy water on top. The pack would dissolve, and the leaves would condense into a green sludge, which she would likely have to scrape out when she washed the mug. “Men,” she said with a grimace. “If they don' beat you, they leave you, and if they don' leave you, they leave a mess.” She loaded the mugs onto a tray and left the kitchen, her skirt whispering against the door frame. Outside, Cork and the doctor – “Oh, that doctor,” she thought, and she saw herself shaking a dark fist at the heavens – sat with the man they called Zack. Zack's face was wet with crying, and Matilda almost dropped the tray before she placed it on the bench beside Cork. She couldn't remember the last time she'd seen a man with tears on his face. It had the same effect that crying young ones had on her: an urge to sweep them up and smother them with love. She left the men discreetly. She didn't think they had noticed her staring at Zack and wanting to wipe the tears out of that big yellow mustache of his. She returned to the kitchen and sat in her rocker in front of the stove and rocked for awhile. Before long her bosom shook a little and a smile that matched the twinkle in her brown eyes pierced her round cheeks. She stopped rocking and threw her head back in a loud spat of laughter. And then she rocked and laughed some more, until her own face was wet with tears. “Oh, Lord have mercy,” she said, using her apron to wipe her tears away. “I sure did think I was done with all of that. Sure did. And who woulda thought a man's tears could remind me that I'm not. Yes, indeed. Who woulda thought.” Matilda stood up and fluffed the curl in her hair. *** **Next week in our story** *He stared unseeing at the dirt. He searched again the gaping hole in his mind, that black maw where his memory should be. It seemed like more and more of his memory was falling into that hole. He could remember his cell, the cave and the strange robed being, but how had he arrived back at the platform? Flying? He struggled with a fleeting image of the countryside and a train rolling underneath him. Had that really happened?* **Chapter IX (link to come)** **[Start at the beginning](https://peakd.com/hive-199275/@cliffagreen/alabama-zack)** *** *** ![2r8F9rTBenJQfQgENfxADE6EVYabczqmSF5KeWefV5WL9WCwdLfK8wNVLEHQvZYiQREccyWxK5G2ch4CSZgaYyLkDLsrmU75s1vZ.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cliffagreen/23tbAxe9UurHqj93C1PyF6RHyMNFBdcbTNZ9aHXXBCbKxa46oDwugrXpfRaF9sW4BWAtP.gif) *** ***

body.title: My first IRT /Mi primer IRT
body.body:
EnglishEspañol
Greetings to my friends at @hive from the chess community who always share their love for chess. On Sunday, May 24th, I participated in my first FIDE-rated tournament. I learned to move the chess pieces at 16. I was born in Caracas, Venezuela, but moved to the interior of the country and had little contact with the 64 squares. Then, at 20, I arrived in Valencia del Rey, and in that city, I started acquiring chess materials, reading voraciously, and wanting to play like Kasparov, Anand, and other greats of the time.I entered several tournaments and played well in some and not so well in others, but I believed it was all valid for FIDE. But now, after more than 20 years, I find out that it wasn't and I had to start again. Through a friend here, I registered, and that's why this is my first FIDE-valid tournament. Saludos a mis amigos de @hive de la comunidad de ajedrez que siempre comparte el amor por el ajedrez.El domingo 24 de mayo estuve en mi primera competencia valida para ELO FIDE, les cuento aprendí a mover las piezas en el ajedrez a los 16 años , nací en Caracas Venezuela pero me mudé al interior del país y tenía poco contacto con las 64 casillas. Luego a los 20 años llegue a Valencia del Rey y en esa ciudad empecé a conseguir material de ajedrez y a leer como loco y a querer jugar como Kasparov, Anand y otros grandes de la época.Me inscribí en varios torneos y jugue bien y en otros no tan bien pero a todoas estas creía que era valido para la FIDE, pero ahora despues de más de 20 años me entero que no era así y tuve que empezar de nuevo , mediante un amigo aquí hice el registro y por eso es mi primer torneo valido para FIDE.

>**La entrada del centro comercial donde se dió el encuentro**
EnglishEspañol
Let me tell you a little about the event. The format was rapid games of 10 minutes + 5 seconds increment, and it was an open format with a cash prize, so there were going to be a lot of sharks looking for blood in this tournament : ) I'm telling you, there were many above 2100 Les cuento un poco acerca del evento el formato era en partidas rápidas de 10 minutos + 5 segundos de incremento y el formato era abierto con premio en efectivo así que hiban a estar muchos tiburones buscando sangre en este torneo : ) le sdigo que habían muchos por encima de 2100

>**Poster of IRT**
EnglishEspañol
That day I prepared everything early. I was a little nervous, it had been over a year since I'd played in-person games in a tournament, and I knew I needed to start training systematically to reach my goal of becoming a Candidate Master. But anyway, that goal is a medium- to long-term one. If you have any methods for training and improving, write them below. Ese día preparé todo desde temprano estaba un poco nerviioso,mas de un año que no jugaba partidas presenciales en un torneo y sabiendo la necesidad de empezar a entrenar de manera sistematica para llegar a mi meta CM osea candidato a maestro.Pero bueno esa meta es de mediano a largo plazo si tienen algun metodo para entrenar y mejorar me escriben abajo

> **Antes de empezar el evento**
EnglishEspañol
The event started and I began with white. I opened with a Spanish Opening and my opponent, who had black pieces, played quite well until he made a mistake and allowed me to pin his queen. I took a lot of risks and ended up falling into a perpetual draw. The final result was a draw.Empezó el evento y comencé con blancas salí con una apertura española y mi rival que llevaba piezas negras me jugó bastante bien hasta que se equivocó y permitió que clavara su dama, me arriesgué bastante y terminé cayendo en un perpetuo el resultado final , tablas

> **my first game with white, result draw ;(**
EnglishEspañol
The second game was with Black. I quite liked the Two Knights variation. He launched a Fegatello attack, which I was able to withstand and win, and ultimately, without letting my guard down, I won. The third game was with White. I played the Morra Gambit against the Sicilian, but a lapse in concentration during the opening ended up burying my game. I also lost the fourth game with Black and the fifth with White. By this point, I was very sad and had little hope. The last game was against a nine-year-old boy who plays very well and with great composure. I had to hold on and wait for him to make a mistake so I could gain an advantage and deliver checkmate. After several hours, I finished my six rounds with 2.5 out of 6 and my ego badly bruised, which made me realize that if I want to progress, systematic study and training must be a priority.La segunda partida fue con negras me gusto bastante variante de los dos caballos me lanzó un ataque fegatello que pude resistir y salir airoso y finalmente sin descuidarme la gané. La tercera partida la jugué con blancas jugué gambito morra contra la siciliana pero un descuido en plena apertura terminó sepultando mi partida.Así tambien perdí la cuarta tambien con negras y la quinta con blancas, a esta altura estaba muy triste y con pocas esperanza la ultima la jugué con un niño de nueve años que juega muy bien y de sangre fría tuve que aguantar y esperar que se descuidara para poder sacar ventaja y dar jaque mate. Despues de varias horas terminé mis 6 rondas con 2,5 de 6 y con el ego bien golpeado lo que me hizo ateerizar y darme cuenta que si quiero progresar el estudio y el entrenamiento sistemático debe ser un hábito

> **Participants playing in the last round at the first table/Participantes jugando en la última ronda en la primera mesa**
EnglishEspañol
At the end of the day, I finished in 22nd place, and now I'm taking steps to better prepare for the next in-person event. One thing chess teaches you is that it makes you aware of your current form, so it's time to start preparing. I hope you enjoyed my report, and I look forward to continuing to share my journey, both in-person and online, as well as teaching chess. A big hug to everyone. Below you'll find the final standings for the event; I finished in 22nd place, as I mentioned before.Al final de toda la jornada he terminado en el puesto 22 y ahora tomando las previsiones para prepararme mejor para el próximo evento presencial.Algo que te enseña el ajedrez es que te da conciencia de como estas, así que hay que empezar la preparación espero les haya gustado mi crónica y espero seguir compartiendo mis derroteros tanto en la parte presencial, en linea como la enseñanza del ajedrez un abrazo a todos. Les dejo abajo la tabla final del evento estoy de número 22 como lo señalé antes.

body.title: The Wall of Winnipeg and Me || Unfiltered romance || Book Review 📖
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSuU93Uv4aW5ZkW16bmh8H8hSmT9KYUsAF98Lxq19vL79/1779923186054.jpg)


I finally decided to set it solid, I've been very much away but this time around am back with another review.

If you love unfiltered romance stories then this book is a must read.

So. Vanessa Mazur. Van. This woman has been working herself to the bone for two years — not just as a personal assistant, but as basically everything short of a wife. She's managing social media, handling emails, scheduling appointments, cooking, cleaning, all for one man and that man? Aiden Graves. The top defensive end in the National Football Organisation. The Wall of Winnipeg.  And here's the thing that got me — he's not outright cruel, he never crosses the line into being unnecessarily mean but he is a big hulk of brooding, untouchable, un-cuddly man.  He barely acknowledges her existenc, for two years, he couldn't find it in him to tell her good morning or congratulate her on her birthday.  Two years! I'm sorry but that would have broken me.

So Van finally does what any self-respecting woman should do — she stops making excuses to herself, gives him a very generous open-ended notice, then Aiden acts like a jerk, and she rage quits.  And honestly? I was cheering. Get out, girl, you have a dream. She wants to be a graphic designer. DoShe has plans and none of them include washing extra-large underwear longer than necessary gosh I actually laughed out loud at that line.

But then — then — Aiden shows up at her door and not to apologise, not with flowers, not with any normal romantic emotional gestures but guess what he plainly asked her to enter a fake marriage so he can stay in the country well he's Canadian, and his visa is set to expire.  So In order to become a resident in time, he needs to marry a U.S. citizen, and Vanessa seems to be the best option.  Can you imagine the absolute audacity of this man, the sheer unbothered confidence which he possessed. He doesn't even lead with warmth but  with a transaction.

But here's where it gets complicated and real and honestly a little painful. If she marries him, he'll pay off her student loans and buy her a house. And her student loans are putting so much weight on her shoulders. They meticulously draft an agreement — roles, responsibilities, a timeline. She had to insists on maintaining her autonomy, keeping things strictly professional, despite the intimate nature of marriage and I sat with that for a moment because how many of us have made practical decisions with our hearts quietly screaming something different?

Since they're married, they have to live together. Forced proximity for the romance, and this is where Mariana Zapata does what she does better than almost any author alive — she makes the mundane unbearably tender. It's not grand gestures, It's the noticing, It's Aiden gradually, almost imperceptibly, starting to see Van. The way he says her name, the way he moves around her in the kitchen. 

Aiden doesn't have many friends, doesn't go out much, and mainly just lets his life revolve around football. He's an enigma, and even though she's worked for him for two years and knows the ins and outs of his daily life, he has never shared anything personal with her.  So every crack in that wall — every single moment he lets her in — feels enormous like a huge or big deal. Oh and then there's the scene, the one that lives rent-free in my head. 

Some man gets too close to Van, too comfortable, and the Wall of Winnipeg stares down at the much smaller man and says in a voice as cool and unattached as possible, \
I was like Wtf! 😊🥹 I put the book down, I picked it back up , I put it down again.\nAnd the intimacy that finally breaks through? \

That's it, That's the whole thing, no grand speech. I'm not spilling any more juice just go and read it and let me know what you think in the comments section.


Spoiler Alert,: I laughed, I cried, I swooned and cried some more. This book will wreck you slowly and put you back together even slower. So Read it.

body.title: Un Tesoro Cultural Escondido entre las Montañas - Hidden Cultural Treasure Among the Mountains [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
>Lo que les voy a contar ni yo me lo creía, producto a mi ignorancia casi me pierdo la visita a un lugar que salvaguarda un patrimonio inmenso, una parte de la historia de mi país y lo que posteriormente se adoptaría como parte intrínseca de nuestra cultura. Y es que por el año 2019, cuando al fin pude visitar por primera vez Santiago de Cuba, este lugar, del que les voy a contar hoy no estaba contemplado en nuestro modesto itinerario, de hecho ni lo conocía, incluso después de haber revisado múltiples guías de turismo y rebuscar los lugares que se debían visitar en el recorrido por esa parte del oriente del país no encontré nada. Se podrán imaginar lo mayúsculo de mi asombro cuando de casualidad encontramos tanta historia y tradición escondida entre las faldas de la Sierra de la Gran Piedra.

> What I’m about to tell you is something I could hardly believe myself. Because of my own ignorance, I almost missed the chance to visit a place that safeguards an immense heritage — a fragment of my country’s history, and something that would later become an intrinsic part of our culture. > > Back in 2019, when I was finally able to visit Santiago de Cuba for the first time, this place I’m telling you about today wasn’t even on our modest itinerary. In fact, I didn’t know it existed. Even after combing through multiple travel guides and digging for every “must‑see” spot in that corner of eastern Cuba, I found nothing. > > You can imagine the magnitude of my astonishment when, by pure chance, we stumbled upon so much history and tradition hidden among the slopes of the Sierra de la Gran Piedra.

>Y es que, como reza la placa conmemorativa, este lugar el 29 de noviembre de 2000, en la XXIV Sesión del Comité de Patrimonio Mundial que tuvo lugar en Cairns, Australia, quedó inscrito en la Lista de Patrimonio Mundial, el Paisaje Arquitectónico de las Primeras Plantaciones Cafetaleras en el Sudeste de Cuba en la categoría de Sitio Cultural (compuesto por 171 ruinas localizadas entre la provincia de Santiago de Cuba y Guantánamo) por ser un testimonio único y elocuente de una forma de explotación agrícola que ejemplifica una etapa significativa en el desarrollo del sistema de producción del Café.

> And as the commemorative plaque states, on November 29, 2000, during the 24th Session of the World Heritage Committee held in Cairns, Australia, this place was inscribed on the World Heritage List. It became part of the Archaeological Landscape of the First Coffee Plantations in the Southeast of Cuba, under the Cultural Site category — a designation that includes 171 ruins located between the provinces of Santiago de Cuba and Guantánamo. > > It earned this recognition for being a unique and eloquent testimony to a form of agricultural exploitation that exemplifies a significant stage in the development of the coffee‑production system.

>¡Asombroso todo lo que leíamos! pero aún más asombroso todo lo que dentro de aquella casona-talles se guardaba, toda la historia que resguardaba aquellas paredes, todo aquel estilo vernáculo que conserva, la increíble estructura de la casa principal de dos plantas donde la planta baja estaba ocupada por los talleres del cafetal y la planta alta por la casa del patrón. Una casa que ostenta una de las vigas anti-sísmicas considerada pionera en Cuba, construido a más de 1100 metros sobre el nivel del mar con piedra y materiales encontrado en la extensa cordillera.

> Everything we read was astonishing — but even more astonishing was what that workshop‑house held inside. The history guarded by those walls, the vernacular style preserved in every corner, the incredible structure of the two‑story main house: the ground floor once occupied by the coffee plantation’s workshops, and the upper floor serving as the master’s residence. > > A house that features one of the anti‑seismic beams considered pioneering in Cuba, built at more than 1,100 meters above sea level, using stone and materials gathered from the vast mountain range.

>A pesar del paso del tiempo y de los atentados sufridos en la construcción, sobretodo en la etapa de los mambises que incendiaron, a los estragos de los ciclones Sandy y Melissa y muchos factores externos, el cafetal hoy se considera uno de los lugares mejores conservados de su tipo en el país (hace poco, auspiciado por la Oficina del Historiador de Santiago de Cuba se realizó una reforma capital en otras de las ruinas de cafetales en el oriente del país, pero esta vez le toco al Cafetal La Fraternidad, que está en las cercanías de Songo-La Maya, un lugar que en fotos aparenta ser excepcional). A pesar de los estragos del tiempo, aún en la Isabelica se respira historia y misterio.

> Despite the passing of time and the damage the structure has endured — especially during the Mambí era, when it was set on fire, and later from the devastation caused by hurricanes Sandy and Melissa, along with many other external factors — the plantation is still considered one of the best‑preserved sites of its kind in the country. > > Recently, under the auspices of the Office of the Historian of Santiago de Cuba, a major restoration was carried out on another set of coffee‑plantation ruins in eastern Cuba — this time at Cafetal La Fraternidad, near Songo‑La Maya, a place that, judging by the photos, looks exceptional. > > And yet, despite the wear of time, La Isabelica still breathes history and mystery.

/> Y aprovechando, por supuesto, el hilo con las publicaciones anteriores relacionadas con la existencia de los cafetales en Cuba, ya habíamos hablado de Angerona y El Buenavista (estos dos en el occidente de Cuba) no podíamos dejar de hablar de este Paisaje Arqueológico debido a su importancia, a toda la cultura que trajeron los colones franceses junto a sus esclavos después de que estallara la Revolución Haitiana, de ese legado culturar que vive hasta nuestros días en la cultura del café, en la Tumba Francesa y en todas las descendencia presente aún en las lomas del oriente, en Baracoa, Guantánamo, Santiago y buena parte de Granma. > And taking advantage, of course, of the thread from the previous posts about the existence of coffee plantations in Cuba — since we had already talked about Angerona and El Buenavista (both in western Cuba) — we couldn’t leave this Archaeological Landscape unmentioned. Its importance is immense: the culture brought by the French colonists and their enslaved people after the outbreak of the Haitian Revolution, the cultural legacy that still lives today in Cuba’s coffee traditions, in the Tumba Francesa, and in the descendants who remain throughout the eastern mountains — in Baracoa, Guantánamo, Santiago, and much of Granma.

/> No podía faltar la historia de amor que aun late como una grieta luminosa en medio de un sistema esclavista brutal, donde los protagonistas se enfrentaron a los prejuicios, el silencio y el aislamiento. Y es que La Isabelica también tiene sus misterios. La historia de amor entre Víctor Constantin Couzo y Isabel María es, quizá, la fibra más delicada y persistente que sostiene la memoria del cafetal. Él, colono francés, ella mujer mestiza de inigualable belleza. No se conocía, a diferencia de otros colonos, ni mujer blanca ni vida social, todo lo ocupaba Isabel en la casa, tanto es así que hay anécdotas de visitantes que afirman sentir la presencia espiritual de Isabel María rondando por la casa de forma silenciosa. Nadie sabe como acabó esa historia, los lugareños afirman que murió joven otros que vivió allí hasta los últimos días de su vida pero en realidad no hay certeza. > And of course, the love story could not be left out — a story that still beats like a luminous crack in the middle of a brutal slave system, where its protagonists faced prejudice, silence, and isolation. Because La Isabelica, too, has its mysteries. > > The love between Víctor Constantin Couzo and Isabel María is perhaps the most delicate and enduring thread holding together the memory of the plantation. He, a French colonist; she, a mixed‑race woman of incomparable beauty. Unlike other colonists, he was not known to have a white wife or any social life — Isabel occupied everything in that house. So much so that there are anecdotes from visitors who claim to feel Isabel María’s spiritual presence silently wandering through the rooms. > > No one knows how their story ended. Locals say she died young; others insist she lived there until her final days. But in truth, nothing is certain.

/> Allí todo estaba envuelto en esa atmósfera mágica, en cada paso se respiraba tradición, historia, pasado. Es evidencia de el enriquecimiento de la cultura cubana. Ya la Isabelica quedó allá arriba en la cima de las montañas nubosas de la cierra, allí se comprobó que se conserva la historia y las tradiciones, me hubiera dolido mucho haber visitado la Gran Piedra y no haber visitado este hermoso lugar que re-dimensionó cada taza de café que tome, porque es imposible después de su visita no tener presente tan dura y hermosa historia. Cada paso que se dio en aquel lugar late aún en mi mente. > Everything there was wrapped in a kind of magic — with every step you could breathe tradition, history, the past. It stands as living evidence of the richness that has shaped Cuban culture. > > La Isabelica now remains up there, on the summit of those cloud‑covered mountains, where it becomes clear that history and tradition are still preserved. It would have pained me deeply to visit the Gran Piedra and miss this beautiful place — a place that has re‑dimensioned every cup of coffee I drink, because after being there, it’s impossible not to carry its harsh and beautiful story with you. > > Every step taken in that place still beats in my mind.

/>

* * *

body.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, travelers from around the world. I’m thrilled to share with you today the last place we visited in the magical state of Mérida before returning to our beloved home state of Zulia. The truth is, it’s a mix of emotions every time a trip comes to an end on one hand, sadness at saying goodbye to the place, but also great joy knowing it was an unforgettable journey. ![InShot_20260526_084309848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYvD4kHvZTDoikUg9U85cNCe75zYu15VRj9oxiuDuJ1ui/InShot_20260526_084309848.jpg) The Pine Forest, located in the Parámo Valley of La Culata, is a very popular natural area. Upon arrival, we were surprised by the height of the pine trees and their sheer number there are so many that sunlight barely penetrates the forest. ![20260404_114754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4gnY7mzkbaZ2EVSGY5h9mCsYcxmnwYE5hAgZ8V6res5/20260404_114754.jpg) ![20260404_114648.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVX3hazt13v7dKwtnaBjLcpfQVCzJjSCdg4Tqws2xBep/20260404_114648.jpg) ![20260404_114650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQoeLsrzj5jVs3Fbnxan8BEgeYghGyw8Q1eTW9nKvwSZ/20260404_114650.jpg) ![20260404_114932.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZByCQS2uiaoStcHxKpbV1G8kM4oPvJTvnGa58C7ABgwn/20260404_114932.jpg) ![20260404_114951.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdExZpDbKWuLZMpnvD9SDaHSRuc3miFxnBAJoU6FZJH1D/20260404_114951.jpg) Before starting our walk through the forest, we had dessert some delicious strawberries and cream, just what we needed to satisfy our sweet tooth but there were also other options like waffles, coffee, hot chocolate, and some sweets and snacks. ![20260404_115000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYPCe2YZh1P2bwxqPG1rC3P2gLFQGUuj8ZCrQFUA2hcV2/20260404_115000.jpg) ![20260404_115249.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWN3gePACboQyGz68E6MNxNyZzq3V9bd47qf7keZvfZee/20260404_115249.jpg) ![20260404_115343.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYoAW2QENQzaMRPMdZd98cGK12XoSzH3ua3m3fsYc7XNk/20260404_115343.jpg) Then we set off on the trail that led us directly to a small log bridge built to help us cross and continue exploring the forest; a small river flowed beneath it, likely originating from the highest mountains. ![20260404_115539.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUnTosYDmMrEYitrPppoFRFQot9VBqHF5EkTcWxLDmzj8/20260404_115539.jpg) ![20260404_115809.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetppu8h8oJQhMjGEc6NzGzQfQbSFH2AHB2LXWmvYo83e/20260404_115809.jpg) ![20260404_115830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRU2VCGFTLBNg6HqDMoq7Dj2Zu2vSNkNc984rQG86tRjC/20260404_115830.jpg) ![20260404_115834.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbEFDfBBU2mKJppWwZzMyMHVGc5CLyqKaZwWWMQFFUTa8/20260404_115834.jpg) ![20260404_121718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb9DigmztJLhiXJUFwPfJ8edLP8fhS1cRxYdnJwPzGM2Y/20260404_121718.jpg) ![20260404_121731.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYAEP9zi466LVxNLtTwzW2MEfoZXiU7ugxG7hMgpjNDnA/20260404_121731.jpg) I couldn’t believe my eyes from tiny makeshift homes built by animals to heart-shaped rocks. It’s so wonderful how nature holds such small details that make it so unique. ![20260404_115958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQCiJC8428xJVq4meMAeSgv2xhg2CQ3cwsEPvqc4YPJb/20260404_115958.jpg) ![20260404_115848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPauxkq8eVX7GRCiem3SBPs83sZrfGq8PKr9kBiv7SD8/20260404_115848.jpg) ![20260404_121216.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRiyPPqjp52eXt5o37kvsZb9dbgH83Zkv7d4EzaCFbAZC/20260404_121216.jpg) We arrived at the center of the Pine Forest, and there I was, hugging the trees to connect with their inner energy. There’s nothing that brings more peace and tranquility than this; it’s a caress for the soul. I really love the scent the pines give off, and the air in this forest feels fresh and clean. ![20260404_120031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBNHgXNgqbBWdYvhEV5qS3gMXetoBMNFVC3fJcW82mMp/20260404_120031.jpg) ![20260404_120046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDLRsUho253mJcMyJomfvr34ZGLkK4Dsu3ss18VRZHwg/20260404_120046.jpg) ![20260404_120126.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeropEQ3bxhGHS9n7BtxUdT2nYsrTsenhHNpbyj6zkgwE/20260404_120126.jpg) ![20260404_120226.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNezyHDRUJDVSRfHUHMyjkauYNthFEkzUd8w6nrUWxahT/20260404_120226.jpg) We also collected some small pinecones; there were many scattered on the ground that will surely grow into new pine trees in a few years. ![20260404_120725.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDajRn5XFCz76u3XaraKCGLJZ2aq49AT2CgxCDdw3fNU/20260404_120725.jpg) ![20260404_120716.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNz1BpCZPGVhcr9M16wHVpCTf3mjpLTXSeYk1JQ689YDC/20260404_120716.jpg) ![20260404_120003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVzs3P6Fa2mpuHp6LtGrJxgaVHUtY8RBMFb1K8BaZDhwp/20260404_120003.jpg) I really enjoyed visiting this Pine Forest; it’s always good to connect with nature and all its elements. I felt great being there.

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola, viajeros de todo el mundo.

Con mucha alegría hoy les compartiré el último lugar que visitamos en el mágico Estado Mérida antes de volver al Estado Zulia nuestro terruño amado y la verdad es que es una mezcla de emociones cada vez que un viaje llega a su fin, por una parte tristeza por despedirnos del sitio, pero también mucha alegría nos deja saber que fue un viaje inolvidable. 

![InShot_20260526_084309848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYvD4kHvZTDoikUg9U85cNCe75zYu15VRj9oxiuDuJ1ui/InShot_20260526_084309848.jpg)

El Bosque de los Pinos, se encuentra ubicado en el Valle del Parámo de la Culata, es un espacio natural muy concurrido, al llegar nos sorprendió la altura de los pinos y la cantidad que hay de los mismos, son tantos que escasamente entra la luz del sol al bosque.

![20260404_114754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4gnY7mzkbaZ2EVSGY5h9mCsYcxmnwYE5hAgZ8V6res5/20260404_114754.jpg)

![20260404_114648.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVX3hazt13v7dKwtnaBjLcpfQVCzJjSCdg4Tqws2xBep/20260404_114648.jpg)

![20260404_114650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQoeLsrzj5jVs3Fbnxan8BEgeYghGyw8Q1eTW9nKvwSZ/20260404_114650.jpg)

![20260404_114932.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZByCQS2uiaoStcHxKpbV1G8kM4oPvJTvnGa58C7ABgwn/20260404_114932.jpg)

![20260404_114951.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdExZpDbKWuLZMpnvD9SDaHSRuc3miFxnBAJoU6FZJH1D/20260404_114951.jpg)

Antes de iniciar nuestro recorrido por el bosque, nos comimos un postre, unas deliciosas fresas con crema necesarias para matar el antojo, pero también habían otras opciones como obleas, café, chocolate caliente y algunas chucherías y snacks.

![20260404_115000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYPCe2YZh1P2bwxqPG1rC3P2gLFQGUuj8ZCrQFUA2hcV2/20260404_115000.jpg)

![20260404_115249.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWN3gePACboQyGz68E6MNxNyZzq3V9bd47qf7keZvfZee/20260404_115249.jpg)

![20260404_115343.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYoAW2QENQzaMRPMdZd98cGK12XoSzH3ua3m3fsYc7XNk/20260404_115343.jpg)

Después iniciamos la ruta que nos llevo directamente a un pequeño puente de troncos de árboles para facilitarnos el paso y así poder seguir explorando el bosque, por debajo corría un pequeño río que seguramente nace desde las montañas más altas.

![20260404_115539.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUnTosYDmMrEYitrPppoFRFQot9VBqHF5EkTcWxLDmzj8/20260404_115539.jpg)

![20260404_115809.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetppu8h8oJQhMjGEc6NzGzQfQbSFH2AHB2LXWmvYo83e/20260404_115809.jpg)

![20260404_115830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRU2VCGFTLBNg6HqDMoq7Dj2Zu2vSNkNc984rQG86tRjC/20260404_115830.jpg)

![20260404_115834.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbEFDfBBU2mKJppWwZzMyMHVGc5CLyqKaZwWWMQFFUTa8/20260404_115834.jpg)

![20260404_121718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb9DigmztJLhiXJUFwPfJ8edLP8fhS1cRxYdnJwPzGM2Y/20260404_121718.jpg)

![20260404_121731.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYAEP9zi466LVxNLtTwzW2MEfoZXiU7ugxG7hMgpjNDnA/20260404_121731.jpg)

Me parecía increíble como habían desde pequeños hogares improvisados hechos por animales hasta rocas en forma de corazón es tan maravilloso los pequeños detalles que aguarda la naturaleza que la hacen tan única.

![20260404_115958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQCiJC8428xJVq4meMAeSgv2xhg2CQ3cwsEPvqc4YPJb/20260404_115958.jpg)

![20260404_115848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPauxkq8eVX7GRCiem3SBPs83sZrfGq8PKr9kBiv7SD8/20260404_115848.jpg)

![20260404_121216.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRiyPPqjp52eXt5o37kvsZb9dbgH83Zkv7d4EzaCFbAZC/20260404_121216.jpg)

Llegamos al centro del Bosque de los Pinos, y allí estaba yo abrazando a los árboles para conectar con la energía de su interior, no hay nada que de más paz y tranquilidad que esto, es una caricia para el alma, me gusta mucho el aroma que desprenden los pinos, es fresco, además el aire en este bosque se siente limpio.

![20260404_120031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBNHgXNgqbBWdYvhEV5qS3gMXetoBMNFVC3fJcW82mMp/20260404_120031.jpg)

![20260404_120046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDLRsUho253mJcMyJomfvr34ZGLkK4Dsu3ss18VRZHwg/20260404_120046.jpg)

![20260404_120126.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeropEQ3bxhGHS9n7BtxUdT2nYsrTsenhHNpbyj6zkgwE/20260404_120126.jpg)

![20260404_120226.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNezyHDRUJDVSRfHUHMyjkauYNthFEkzUd8w6nrUWxahT/20260404_120226.jpg)

También recolectamos algunas piñitas, en la tierra se encontraban muchas dispersas que seguramente serán nuevos pinos dentro de algunos años.

![20260404_120725.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDajRn5XFCz76u3XaraKCGLJZ2aq49AT2CgxCDdw3fNU/20260404_120725.jpg)

![20260404_120716.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNz1BpCZPGVhcr9M16wHVpCTf3mjpLTXSeYk1JQ689YDC/20260404_120716.jpg)

![20260404_120003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVzs3P6Fa2mpuHp6LtGrJxgaVHUtY8RBMFb1K8BaZDhwp/20260404_120003.jpg)

Me gustó mucho conocer este Bosque de los Pinos siempre es bueno conectar con la noble naturaleza y todos los elementos que la conforman, me sentí muy bien estando ahí.

body.title: DIAMOND 3 UNLOCKED: The Ambush Assault That Shattered the Meta!
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZg14YiBhJXjp2vq4YcM7BTrJkmZv7yMHJNXz8xmPBrr5/1779842441137.jpg)








**Hulala**! 🎉, Good morning warriors!!

I was just staring at my phone when I saw the notification.I couldn’t believe my eyes 👀,I finally hit Diamond 3 this season!.

This is my first time ever reaching Diamond, and the feeling is amazing. From struggling in lower ranks to climbing all the way up, every battle, every lesson, and every grind has been worth it.

I’m dedicating this milestone to the entire #Splinterlands community. You guys have been incredible — the love,guidance, tips and constant support mean more than you know. Whether it was strategy discussions, encouragement during tough seasons, or just good vibes, you all played a huge part in this.

I only started grinding seriously last year, and now here I am.This one is for the community!
Massive thank you once again, #Splinterlands fam. Let’s keep pushing and building this game together! 🔥



**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**UNBOXING**
This is my favorite part — that thrilling anxiety and sweet anticipation is an absolute delight!



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjz6e59Vo1eAHEquyVHpFthhXzZSyDTtS3q2NW49t7L5/1779849412182.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKc7fbzqvTgaBSHGrNK7YcS4TaockUPGFkWvoLsxJNiX/1779849412260.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcowjbVdsfe9kbDyTHtDPwhxu5iaEeKGfij7C41RYkDr/1779849412307.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd6Q3C9DAE8BLU34GFmdGSKuDy5nMHzy22KCddx8BaBmo/1779849412366.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQbRtuJ4toT88Xu78ahnHLTJcHygfzZmsh2eq3k6EtoWi/1779849412422.jpg)

Something happened to my phone as I was about to open the various chests and I could not get that part back.So I had to go to my owned cards to see what was there since I always upgrade them.And found that I was given these following monsters;

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcejY1s7bKc6TVZE4HNoU85ksSzAwqGQEauH1cotihU7D/1779849955733.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaAXSr23HPW85u2T6rTDz5XYdbGE9ZQwjvdXLxnVpuq5K/1779849955785.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCrHXr4SvafhVLj3R4pPoJ3ABWjsqyismVREcCjjR989/1779849955832.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9ns3u3Z3XueqM68o2dQYFn3utiwqnqspDA88tGUhm5U/1779849955863.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQmoqGYEbzrzHsVDjW59aRLrBySz5NtS5tS4eek2EpPy/1779849955907.jpg)

I so much like them,most especially **TANDI JANDA**, having it for the first time and it is from the Ulund bloodline.I am so happy and I would just upgrade right away.My **Stonebird Matron ad Husk of the Hunter** are now in level 3 respectively.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMaEkadYMkBi7EUPi3LziasmKvNDFzNDsCypZNuCPoTX/1779850223247.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVCP7AAYaFNQhyvpZz66VWTfDpauKgDDo11XiHZKVurRe/1779850223295.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwbvEcFJFkqsSPTeqpvAiDL9cVKZFsxrpBue2NegFjnZ/1779850223336.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYsyYPb6txqUNYs1cysrT2AhFxQi4WE479rgJKMip9xj/1779850223376.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**The Battle That Unlocked Diamond 💎 3**.
The ruleset and Line up
Yesterday I did an extensive write of the duo monsters Chaos Jailer and Night Stalker, highlighting on their deadly combination.And now,they just delivered to me Diamond 💎 III on a platter.Watch their exploit once more in this replay I am about to share.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQn3AvqrHu9n5Z7yiqrseXYeeRuzthc8uf8mqQWFxkANV/1779865633365.jpg)
The total mana cost for this battle was 36,and you are to choose units from fire,water life, death and dragon elements.
The rules are:
>Rare + Common only | No Magic Attacks Allowed

**Lineups**.

My summoner: **Cryptic**— a master of disruption,with surgical buffs and debuffs:
**Poison + Expose** slapped on two key monsters and turning every hit into a ticking time.Also 
**-1 Speed + Blind** rained down on enemy units and crippling their initiative and accuracy.

**My Lineup – The Chaos Engine**
**Nim Guard Captain** (Tank) – **Void armor**: absorbing the worst of the frontline punishment.

**Surgehammer**– **Flying + Opportunity**: Aerial menace ready to punish any opening.

**Tidal Tsunamist** – **Sneak**: Slipping through defenses like water through cracks.

**Chaos Jailer** – **Opportunity + Ambush + Poison**: The MVP Disruptor.

**Night Stalker** – **Sneak + Execute**: The Executioner.

**Bristleborn Brigand** – **Ranged + Snipe**/: Picking off high-value targets from the back.




**My opponent’s Lineup – The Heavy Charge**.
Summoner:**Prophet Rosa**– Boosting ranged output.

**Port Guardian** (Tank) – Corrosive Ward.

**Ironwing Juggernaut** – Weary + Charge.

**Surgeblade** – Charge + Reveal.

**Grimward Ruinshot** – Dispel + Relentless Strike +piercing.Really posed a threat.

**Aerial Shieldmaiden** – Flying + Opportunity.

My opponent came loaded for a brutal melee brawl with strong charge potential and dispel utility.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)



**Ambush Round**.The moment the horn sounded(buffs and debuffs activated by summoners), **Chaos Jailer’s** Ambush triggered first — completely bypassing their speed advantage.That created an immediate chaos in their formation.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBHJK5cR9VvDLRMjG2MjNrdovs36H2P7zudcxfwUeXQp/1779873927350.jpg)

**Round 1,scene 12my tank was taken out by one of the ranged attack monsters of my opponent**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRtWmLdpzVZbHYwMrjF36trmxuUt2nnbmnuTuQdTrMY8n/1779874399348.jpg)

**Round 2,scene 2, night stalker took out one of the ranged monster with execute ability,It was brutal**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPbzE1fxh4dRsEt757yc4MSDi1CEgKRPeWwhSRK86CUG/1779874693599.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLnWiyhhXqZ2LQweu9mYoe8Fx1PPPiCGVs171jvFFapv/1779874693654.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQxQ56gyPW1oFayUfbuQZBx7VTufM1owXUs49E4j4oHZP/1779874693701.jpg)


**Round 2,scene 12,I lost Surgehammer, while my opponent lost Surgeblade**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbf2GHScADUggWUbMTdK7mSonQv9Kx2HNPCzjsjB7j1td/1779874997734.jpg)


**Round 4, scene 2,I took his last ranged attack monster,who was really a menace**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbrWqBdt9exotHSk9kSFFhJh35hQeYHTnb4YMenPGLaMC/1779875168941.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbobfnRy5C2xpq222SHtqUZDyJQYFxpMmX8LvEM9TvPgz/1779875168999.jpg)




**Round 4, scene 6,I lost another monster, Tidal tsunamist**,same with my opponent.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeH73qe61WpaZhyC1eFDgEXk6DfVrw4CNuWNYFGxmrUCd/1779896932932.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcZED5CkVuR6gETuSvQrhEZuRp1q1MdgsmngPY9UGUSqm/1779896932985.jpg)



**Round 4, scene10,three against one**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPXTaT9d6m9dhMqL1NRcMAVreBM1pcG3C5R5A7ytV9oB/1779896933035.jpg)

**Game Over**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRucbgK7gKeKBVzG2RdMzQcSEMdGveKNEC4j4MLveNPHf/1779896933080.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTm2VocLwiREYGHe35MB9EEcMchcD64DZPiKqifLuf7tG/1779871190889.jpg)

[Watch the replay](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_996a3185df906a204d52d65c0cf28245?ref=zusi78)






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading and watching my post. @zusi78 signing off.

body.title: 27 May 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3116: Garnish Sandwich.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ2ReutszsepLWQPT7n35fffE2Xe3K6LbQ3DCCL2CZFUj/1779922767688.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/meals-on-table-9702312)

This is my post on #freewriters3116 #dailyprompt garnish sandwich hosted by @marinnewest's.
The midday sun beat down on the small courtyard in Uyo, but under the shade of the mango tree, the mood was light. Eti-eno stood at the wooden counter, her focus entirely on the culinary masterpiece unfolding before her. Isaac sat nearby, leaning forward, his eyes tracking her every movement with playful intensity.
​\
Isaac teased, though his mouth watered. \
\n​Eti-eno laughed, shaking her head as she meticulously layered thin slices of vine-ripened tomatoes over the crisp lettuce. \

​She reached for the garnish—a vibrant mixture of finely diced red onions, fresh parsley, and a secret pinch of toasted black pepper. With the precision of an artist, she sprinkled the garnish across the spread, ensuring the flavors would bloom with every bite. The contrast of the bright greens and deep reds against the golden, toasted bread was enough to make anyone hungry.
​As she pressed the top slice down and performed a swift, clean diagonal cut, the aroma of fresh herbs filled the air. She slid the plate toward Isaac, who looked at it with newfound respect.
​He picked up a half, took a deliberate bite, and let out a soft sigh of appreciation. The crunch of the toast gave way to the vibrant, seasoned garnish. \
\n​Eti-eno grinned, picking up her own plate. \

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - Garbage Sandwich
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Garbage Sandwich. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTWJc8-yQYRIHwS74iEGDB9J-exUbH6wqeo8SDlxs5Omg&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTWJc8-yQYRIHwS74iEGDB9J-exUbH6wqeo8SDlxs5Omg&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTWJc8-yQYRIHwS74iEGDB9J-exUbH6wqeo8SDlxs5Omg&s=10)

\

yelled Sally

Garbage Sandwich, looking at the recipe looks simple ad easy to prepare, and depending on what we have n the kitchen, can be quick to improvised. As it's a bread, it makes a good choice if we need something fast, mobile munching on the move and being a stable food, it fills us up. Thus, it's an excellent choice for a quick meal too.

As there are 2 variations to garbage sandwich, the garbage bread or the Rochester garbage plate sandwich. Both looking delicious and a generous variety of ingredients. But with different structure, if as we discussed above, need it easy and mobile, the garbage bread would be the better option, but if wecan afford time to grab a seat and have a heart filled meal. The Rochester version would be a great joy. 

But while it is wrapped, the garbage bread version is baked thus it might consume more preparation time. 

But food a necessity in life and resources on Mother Earth getting depleted, we should all treasure food and no waste food no matter which version of garbage sandwich we like.

So, wich version do you like more?

body.title: The Boroughs  (Review) [ESP-ENG] by edwardstobia
body.body:
> Hace unos días terminé de ver Margo y posteriormente al culminarla empezamos a ver The Boroughs, la nueva serie de Netflix producida por los hermanos Duffer que estaba rodando mucho la información en la red sobre esta serie lo que después de leer opiniones tan divididas llegué con expectativas neutrales y bueno, creo que salí igual. La serie no me pareció tan mala ni tan buena, la trama es bastante predecible aunque las actuaciones de cada uno de los actores estuvieron excelentes en sus papeles. Aunque no puedo negar que en ocasiones me reía ver como unos abuelos se convertían en una rebelión de jubilados. >_A few days ago, I finished watching ¨Margo¨, and right after that, we started watching ¨The Boroughs¨, the new Netflix series produced by the Duffer brothers. There was a lot of buzz online about this show, and after reading such mixed reviews, I went in with neutral expectations and well, I think I came away feeling the same way. I didn’t think the series was that bad or that good; the plot is pretty predictable, although the performances by each of the actors were excellent in their roles. Though I can’t deny that at times I laughed watching a group of grandparents turn into a rebellion of retirees._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23u5V5d4UeWD4kbdhgJ4Cgi3Y7ZNZ7wuD1Pxpnd3hBsMp9ZtYm7RNH7Vs8ejB8m4Hfnet.png)](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/the-boroughs-cast)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tRtg2wTSYwPm8skUoBxBoykzLCeNWUVKB6fZn26D3kMhy4ho95hrSBZubA96y6Lo9w8.png Y digo predecible porque si has visto al menos un par de series de ciencia ficción en tu vida y además de eso eres un fanático de las mismas, vas a adivinar el 90% de los giros dado que la estructura como digo, es bastante predecible, los clichés del género están ahí y en varios momentos sentí que ya sabía exactamente hacia dónde se dirigía la historia. La verdad es que cuando leí que era como ver Stranger things pero sin Once, Will, Lucas y sus amigos. Literalmente es ver a unos abuelos convertirse en héroes y lograr salvar el mundo. [Image source](https://www.quever.news/netflix/los-hermanos-duffer-vuelven-the-boroughs-trailer-su-nueva-serie-terror-sobrenatural-pero-esta-vez-adultos-n1496658) >_And I say predictable because if you’ve watched at least a couple of sci-fi series in your life and are also a fan of the genre, you’ll guess 90% of the plot twists since, as I said, the structure is pretty predictable; the genre’s clichés are all there, and at several points I felt like I already knew exactly where the story was headed. The truth is, when I read that it was like watching Stranger Things but without Eleven, Will, Lucas, and their friends. It’s literally watching a bunch of grandparents become heroes and manage to save the world._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tGcPGCzhpAYbrLrFU9FVuZjxeH5WyfAVjssrMBzzp2jthZFPcxjTobLm4L8CmZ8rfik.png)](https://elcomercio.pe/mag/fama/que-ver/the-boroughs-jubilacion-rebelde-de-que-trata-y-fecha-de-estreno-guia-completa-de-la-serie-de-netflix-video-nnda-nnlt-noticia/)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23xVPA9kNDYBdWCEJEPHwtdvpdsk7TDp8KJEvVgQCZEyAHQVuPFrGjdctfFgfFLS7g4ug.png Los actores aun a pesar de que para mí tuvieron una actuación aceptable los mismos estuvieron presos en una narración muy establecida y con tramas en ocasiones sin sentido. Supongo que la serie quiso inclinarse un poco hacia la comedia porque no cabe duda que en ocasiones eso era lo que provocaba, risa. Nos encontramos con actores como Alfred Molina y Geena Davis quienes lideran un elenco con una química entre ellos es muy genuina y logran transmitir esa mezcla de vulnerabilidad, sabiduría y rebeldía que solo los años pueden dar. [Image source](https://www.whats-on-netflix.com/news/the-boroughs-alfred-molina-geena-davis-and-bill-pullman-among-six-cast/) > _Even though I thought the actors gave acceptable performances, they were constrained by a very formulaic narrative and plots that sometimes made no sense. I suppose the series wanted to lean a bit toward comedy because there’s no doubt that at times that’s exactly what it did: make us laugh. We have actors like Alfred Molina and Geena Davis leading a cast with very genuine chemistry between them, and they manage to convey that blend of vulnerability, wisdom, and rebelliousness that only the years can bring._
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQfpqNCu93oioztVR2Qun4iaXJJMu2G3yNuyXxZGS7cZEegQDEVfZQ8kFrf2JLRg3JD.png)](https://marieclaire.com.mx/the-boroughs-serie-netflix/)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23xAeQnA1CzpUeYJS5WjFoZ2dm2CsBbFntjZJGm1HYdfDJLLdhyK2VQML97QPHyyBLwKY.jpg)](https://time.com/article/2026/05/14/the-boroughs-review-netflix/)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tv8FLNDwNoHdRhq3mU61REtc3yqpn8VMUVaJVU2yHMYSwYRRXuY7Xe7gUsKGV6LUQvU.png Ahora si hablamos un poco sobre el estilo de la serie, la acertada elección de colores y fotografías, la verdad es que estuvo muy amateur o sea, después de que los hermanos Duffer nos regalaran Stranger things no sé qué les paso con este nuevo trabajo. La verdad es que sin duda The Boroughs no es la serie del año, pero tampoco merece el hate que ha recibido pues es un thriller de ciencia ficción correcto con un elenco excepcional que logra sostener una historia predecible así que podría decir que si buscas algo ligero, con buenas actuaciones y no te molesta saber lo que viene, darle una oportunidad a esta serie no estaría nada mal. [Image source](https://mundocine.es/criticas/series/the-boroughs-jubilacion-rebelde-2026-netflix/) > _Now, if we talk a little about the show’s style, the color palette, and cinematography, the truth is that it felt very amateurish. I mean, after the Duffer brothers gave us ¨Stranger Things¨, I don’t know what happened with this new project. The truth is, The Boroughs is definitely not the series of the year, but it doesn’t deserve the hate it’s received either, since it’s a decent sci-fi thriller with an exceptional cast that manages to carry a predictable story. So I’d say that if you’re looking for something light, with good performances, and you don’t mind knowing what’s coming, giving this series a chance wouldn’t be a bad idea at all._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uEmavf46tva5SAWRQciaqp42mMLA6htTphn43WoV5VYAxNLLunB5aiLo4Fc3gPtezDn.png)](https://culturageek.com.ar/netflix-nueva-serie-the-boroughs/) [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tGVdSFBrYVLEbJomGV7PfWSbZZvUuC6hxfzFFSY8QHNDn2By39uv57jZ39WWdEtfKr1.jpg)](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=674576) [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/48He4X6N6W3tHhdJHAmYsNVMChRPkzdJNSLh8cBvcjRv38TMLqDCjMu91Cgb9Nu5Q3.png)](https://www.anmtvla.com/2026/04/the-boroughs-nueva-serie-de-los.html)

body.title: Una mirada a las estrellas del firmamento que con los ojos no veo.  /Es-En/  A look at the stars in the firmament that I cannot see with my eyes.
body.body: Luego de una jornada de intenso trabajo en el taller de jabonería, me senté a terminar de ver la película Sumberland en Netflix. Ligera y entretenida, me resultó muy simpática. Ahora me senté a ver los mensajes en las redes y las publicaciones de quienes sigo aquí en Hive, pero se me ocurrió escribir estas líneas a manera de versos sin métrica ni rima. Pero juntando las escenas de la película y algunas ideas o creencias preexistentes en mi mente consciente. Si tuviera que ponerle título, en este momento se me ocurre uno muy largo. ## Una mirada a las estrellas del firmamento que con los ojos no veo. Un faro y un sueño. La brújula junto al timón. Un barco velero o uno de papel. La mascota del héroe. Un mapa sin paralelos ni meridianos. La coordenada de la ilusión. Un musical de las esferas más melodiosas que las sirenas. La llave y la clave. Un objetivo y un destino. La ley de los mandamientos. Un legado de prohibiciones. La fe y la esperanza. Un grano de confianza. La semilla de mostaza. Un sermón de bienaventuranzas. La promesa de inmortalidad. Un salto al infinito. Más allá de la eternidad. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfxr5SrYRMR6m6Xb9G24W253E5RJJcfa6KMgib8KtnXK/image.png) La imagen fue creada con ChatGPT a partir del texto y algunas instrucciones para modificar su propuesta inicial. Como de costumbre, escribo en mi lengua materna, el español, y el texto en inglés es generado por el traductor Google. Gracias por acompañarme en esta exploración usando la IA. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTovBpBa7aPDYNPhmVtXBWw6rNDmJ4wVee51JKmSDEJE/image.png) [MY PARTICULAR VIEW OF THE WORLD @felixmarranz artisan soap maker] # A look at the stars in the firmament that I cannot see with my eyes. After a long day of work at the soap-making workshop, I sat down to finish watching the movie Sumberland on Netflix. Light and entertaining, I found it very enjoyable. Now I've been looking at the messages on social media and the posts of those I follow here on Hive, but it occurred to me to write these lines as verses without meter or rhyme. But combining scenes from the movie with some pre-existing ideas or beliefs in my conscious mind. If I had to give it a title, a very long one comes to mind right now. ## A glance at the stars in the firmament that I cannot see with my eyes. A lighthouse and a dream. The compass next to the helm. A sailboat or a paper one. The hero's pet. A map without parallels or meridians. The coordinate of illusion. A musical of spheres more melodious than sirens. The key and the code. An objective and a destiny. The law of the commandments. A legacy of prohibitions. Faith and hope. A grain of trust. The mustard seed. A sermon of beatitudes. The promise of immortality. A leap into infinity. Beyond eternity. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfxr5SrYRMR6m6Xb9G24W253E5RJJcfa6KMgib8KtnXK/image.png) The image was created with ChatGPT from the text and some instructions to modify its initial proposal. As usual, I write in my native language, Spanish, and the English text is generated by Google Translate.

El pasado domingo fue el reconocimiento de ruta para la carrera de 10k de Farmatina 2026. Por supuesto que asistí para ir calentando bien esos motores pues estamos a tan solo dos semanas del gran evento, y aquí te vengo a mostrar como me fue y que tal mi experiencia.💪🏻

---

<center>![1002084246.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23wC9hwhcKhTjFbwWEBrtXkSewGdBDvb5CtCaznQSb2mAtXMMippCxbkDCCdrn1x3Ajqv.jpg)</center>

---

Últimamente, entrenar en equipo me ha sentado bien, pues he ido mejorando con la motivación de estar en grupo y esa pequeña competencia amistosa. Así que, a pesar de no haber descansado y haber dormido poco, hice un excelente tiempo, tan bueno que Strava lo reconoció como mi PR en 10k (no es así, pero es cuento largo).

Me sentí bastante bien durante el recorrido, los primeros 6km los hice con un chico que ni siquiera conozco pero llevábamos el mismo ritmo, a decir verdad llegó un punto en el que sentía que uno motivaba al otro. alrededor del kilómetro 6 tuve que adelantarlo porque empezó a caminar, me rescató uno de los pacer de 60 minutos, que empezó a motivarme y decirme que no caminara sino que terminara corriendo. Gracias a la motivación tanto del desconocido como del pacer logré el recorrido sin caminar.

<center>![1002084133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tGaDaf414og2b2MvtfodnexWxAFuj3dKCabvKAVmGyTpE2K5ii691VxNCtkVik2mPAu.jpg)</center>|<center>![1002084134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tbK2esTDLMw4QeeycT4d3bbX4fPRLqYf2MnghQrSNBVAKpQTcpzWpSfGmtG7MFR1rh4.jpg)</center>
-|-

Mi ritmo promedio fue de 5:54 /km, lo que resultó en un recorrido de 59 minutos con 13 segundos. ¡Bajar de la hora de sintió genial! Ahora, si ese fue el reconocimiento de ruta, debo esforzarme mucho más para bajar mi tiempo del año pasado, que fueron 56 minutos y algunos segundos. 

La preparación continúa, y he estado haciendo cosas nuevas para mejorar como runner, cosas que espero compartirles pronto. Mientras tanto, ¡muchas gracias por pasar leyéndome!🔥

<center><sub>*English <a id=\

>* --- **Happy midweek to everyone here!**✨ Last Sunday was the course preview for the Farmatina 2026 10K race. Of course, I went to really get those engines revving since we’re just two weeks away from the big event, and here I am to show you how it went and what my experience was like.💪🏻 ---
![1002084246.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23wC9hwhcKhTjFbwWEBrtXkSewGdBDvb5CtCaznQSb2mAtXMMippCxbkDCCdrn1x3Ajqv.jpg)
--- Lately, training with a team has been good for me, as I’ve been improving thanks to the motivation of being in a group and that little bit of friendly competition. So, even though I hadn’t rested and had slept very little, I posted an excellent time—so good that Strava recognized it as my 10K PR (it isn’t, but that’s a long story). I felt pretty good during the run; I ran the first 6 km with a guy I didn’t even know, but we were keeping the same pace. To tell the truth, there came a point where I felt like we were motivating each other. Around the 6 km mark, I had to pass him because he started walking. One of the 60-minute pacers came to my rescue, started motivating me, and told me not to walk but to finish running. Thanks to the encouragement from both the stranger and the pacer, I managed to complete the course without walking.
![1002084133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artsyjose/23tGaDaf414og2b2MvtfodnexWxAFuj3dKCabvKAVmGyTpE2K5ii691VxNCtkVik2mPAu.jpg)
|

-|- My average pace was 5:54/km, which resulted in a time of 59 minutes and 13 seconds. Breaking the one-hour mark felt great! Now, if that was just a course reconnaissance run, I’ll have to work much harder to beat my time from last year, which was 56 minutes and a few seconds. Training continues, and I’ve been trying new things to improve as a runner—things I hope to share with you soon. In the meantime, thank you so much for stopping by to read this!🔥

body.title: In the countryside, I learn to unlearn. [Eng/Esp]
body.body: > One of the things that makes me love the countryside is that I can forget I’m a photographer. What do I mean by that? Let me explain: when I’m out there in the middle of nature, I suddenly forget about composition rules, measuring light, and all those things I’d normally be focused on in other circumstances; here, I just breathe and let my mind wander. Then eventually these photos come out, as if everything just flows and breathes life into my bones.

> Una de las cosas que me hacen amar el campo es que puedo olvidarme de que soy fotógrafo, ¿cómo se entiende eso? Me explico mejor: allí, cuando estoy en medio de la naturaleza, de pronto me olvido de reglas de composición, de medir la luz, de todo eso de lo que normalmente estaría pendiente en otras circunstancias; aquí solamente respiro y desconecto las neuronas. Entonces eventualmente salen estas fotos, así como que todo fluye y va dando vida a mis huesos.  ![1000480160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000480160.jpg)
