title.title: «Cubanos: Eddy Pineda» (ESP/ENG)
title.body:
> Su nombre es Eddy Pineda Chacón. Comenzó en la profesión en 1978. Tenía 23 años. Y todo llegó de manera fortuita. Porque en la infancia no tenía inclinación marcada por la enseñanza. Eso lo dice claro. Pero su maestro de primaria, René Naranjo, veía algo. Veía cierta tendencia hacia el magisterio, decía. Por su desenvolvimiento. Eddy no lo entendía entonces. Después lo entendió. Nació y creció en San Benito de Mayarí. Familia humilde. Su padre, Roberto Pineda, obrero agrícola. Autodidacta. En el poco tiempo libre que tenía, se sentaba con los vecinos que no pudieron ir a la escuela. Les enseñaba a leer. A escribir. De él heredó la vocación. De él y de las caminatas. Porque las escuelas quedaban lejos. Muy lejos. Y él caminaba. ***
![IMG-20260525-WA0047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EonjcirGqMBZfHWR8jgg1Exei3oyZ69btSThxf9Zm4PH7f5hhpw481f6YqvarcMf9wx.jpg)
***
>\n\nA los cuatro años ya leía. Su padre lo enseñó. Los vecinos de apellido Liranzo no lo creían. Le daban papeles. \

, le decían. Y él leía. Después se mudaron. Problemas de trabajo. Fueron a una cooperativa agraria en Yerba de Guinea. Hoy es Songo-La Maya. Allí estaba el río. Y en el río, una poza. La llamaban El Camue. Todos los niños del barrio se escapaban hacia allá. Él también. ***
![IMG-20260525-WA0045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EokcBSaaxY3yq2tBe155QwDi6MMaxHggnJ5kRfz4umWLY3vxWFMbArD7kE93EuPPnUo.jpg)
***

> La mayor parte de su adolescencia y juventud la pasó estudiando. A los 13 años lo becaron. Plan beca de Miramar. Secundaria Manuel Bisbe. Cuatro años. Luego el preuniversitario Carlos Marx. Tres años más. No tenía entre sus sueños ser maestro. Eso también lo dice claro. Terminaba la secundaria básica cuando comenzó la captación para el destacamento pedagógico Manuel Ascunce. Él, dijo que sí. Pero sus padres dijeron que no. Ellos esperaban un médico en la familia. También su profesora guía, una bella profesora de Español, le dijo que él estaba destinado a otras profesiones. Por sus rendimientos académicos. Por su aprendizaje avanzado. También podía ser útil, decía, pero desde otro lugar. Así que al culminar el preuniversitario fue a parar a la Escuela de Aviación Capitán Carlos Ulloa. Sandino, Pinar del Río. Iba a ser piloto de aviación. Luego estudiaría Ingeniería Aeronáutica en la antigua URSS. Para esa carrera seleccionaron 50 jóvenes en todo el país. Por desempeño académico. Por méritos estudiantiles. Por un riguroso examen médico. Eddy estaba entre ellos. Preparación: 1976-1977. Dos años de curso teórico. Recibió muchas asignaturas interesantes. Pero su delirio era la meteorología. La navegación. Los idiomas: inglés, ruso. Y sobre todo las matemáticas. Las recibía puras. O aplicadas a la mecánica y la navegación. Le fascinaban. Terminado el curso teórico, comenzó el práctico. Una serie de ejercicios. Hasta el ejercicio siete volaba con instructor. El ejercicio ocho era el soleo. El primer día que volaba solo. Ese día era todo un acontecimiento. Sus compañeros esperaban su aterrizaje. Le preparaban maldades y jaranas. Cubos de agua. Aceite de motor encima. Participaban los instructores. Participaban los compañeros. Una fiesta. Todo iba saliendo bien. ***
![1779719619772.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/ALAFWpSK6KRnLqek39T2seHy7RcCRAsAB3Z916Bh2hfnmM14QZ7SY7NTu1Tu64G.jpg)
***

> Hasta que un día regresaba de un vuelo en zona. Olvidó un procedimiento en el aterrizaje. Provocó un accidente. Milagrosamente no le costó la vida. Pero le costó la carrera. Transcurría 1978. Tenía 22 años, casi 23. Tenía que dar un nuevo rumbo a su vida. Sus compañeros de generación estaban por concluir su segundo año universitario. Él, aunque tenía derecho a ingresar en la carrera que quisiera, sentía que había perdido tiempo para el estudio. Sus intereses y necesidades ya no eran las mismas. Y la situación económica de su familia no le permitía reiniciar la Universidad por el primer año después de dos cursos perdidos. Así que buscó plaza laboral. Le propusieron desarrollar un programa de quinto y sexto semestre de la asignatura Matemática en la Facultad Obrera Campesina. Un contrato a prueba. Un mes. Si daba la talla, lo alargaban. También le ofrecieron preparación para la profesión en una institución llamada ISE, en Los Maisales. Allí preparaban a educadores emergentes para luego estudiar carreras pedagógicas. Su mes a prueba tuvo excelente acogida. Alumnos. Directivos. Funcionarios. No solo lo contrataron permanente. Lo mandaron a trabajar al IPUEC 109. Y allí descubrió su verdadera vocación. Descubrió que todo lo anterior fue sueño de adolescente. Que su vocación verdadera era enseñar. ***
![1779719606650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/23wCE6UVG7vvWCs7bQHdsHtY9Fv2ML6iLFs6zsupTT98XKH6irWEV5jm4dZnmw4JfgLHK.jpg)
***

> Lleva ya 48 años en esta profesión. Y dice, sin dudar, que si pudiera revertir el tiempo, esta vez sin vacilación escogería la enseñanza. En estos 48 años ha transitado por distintas funciones. Jefe de cátedra. Secretario docente. Subdirector docente. Metodólogo. Responsable de asignatura municipal. Jefe de departamento de la filial pedagógica. Ha enseñado en dos países: Nicaragua y Venezuela. Pero nunca ha dejado el aula. Eso es lo que realmente le gusta. Lo que disfruta. Ni cuando el periodo especial, cuando muchos abandonaron obligados por el momento, él siguió en el aula. Pasando todas las vicisitudes de aquellos tiempos. Sin tiza. Sin papel. Sin transporte. Él seguía yendo. Sigue aportando sus conocimientos y enseñanzas a las nuevas generaciones. Cree que lo hará hasta que sus facultades mentales lo permitan. No hay más regocijo para él que sus estudiantes, ya varias generaciones, recuerden sus clases. Saber que contribuyó a su crecimiento personal en una etapa de sus vidas. Ese es su premio. Eddy Pineda sí supo volar. Solo que nunca necesitó un avión. Necesitó una pizarra. Una clase. *** Imágenes cortesía de Eddy Pineda **© Marabuzal, 2026. Contenido original. Todos los derechos reservados.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCBMLrCe1r8x98QE2vRuUp6seGUjji2vAArciyFkjC8N/1768407559541.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg)

> His name is Eddy Pineda Chacón. He began his teaching career in 1978. He was 23 years old. And it all happened by chance. Because as a child, he had no particular inclination towards teaching. He says that clearly. But his elementary school teacher, René Naranjo, saw something. He saw a certain tendency towards teaching, he said. Because of his natural talent. Eddy didn't understand it then. Later he did. He was born and raised in San Benito de Mayarí. A humble family. His father, Roberto Pineda, was a farm laborer. Self-taught. In the little free time he had, he would sit with the neighbors who couldn't go to school. He taught them to read. To write. He inherited his vocation from him. From him and from the walks. Because the schools were far away. Very far away. And he walked. ****
![IMG-20260525-WA0047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EonjcirGqMBZfHWR8jgg1Exei3oyZ69btSThxf9Zm4PH7f5hhpw481f6YqvarcMf9wx.jpg)
***
>\n\nHe could read by the age of four. His father taught him. The neighbors, surnamed Liranzo, didn't believe it. They gave him papers. \

they told him. And he read. Later they moved. Work problems. They went to an agricultural cooperative in Yerba de Guinea. Today it's Songo-La Maya. There was a river there. And in the river, a pool. They called it El Camue. All the neighborhood kids used to run away there. He did too. ***
![IMG-20260525-WA0045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EokcBSaaxY3yq2tBe155QwDi6MMaxHggnJ5kRfz4umWLY3vxWFMbArD7kE93EuPPnUo.jpg)
*** ***

> He spent most of his adolescence and early adulthood studying. At 13, he received a scholarship. Miramar Scholarship Program. Manuel Bisbe High School. Four years. Then Carlos Marx Pre-University. Three more years. Being a teacher wasn't among his dreams. He makes that clear. He was finishing junior high when recruitment began for the Manuel Ascunce Pedagogical Detachment. He said yes. But his parents said no. They had hoped for a doctor in the family. His homeroom teacher, a lovely Spanish teacher, also told him that he was destined for other professions. Because of his academic performance. Because of his advanced learning. He could also be useful, she said, but in a different way. So, upon completing his pre-university studies, he ended up at the Captain Carlos Ulloa Aviation School in Sandino, Pinar del Río. He was going to be a pilot. Later, he would study Aeronautical Engineering in the former USSR. For that program, 50 young people were selected nationwide. Based on academic performance. Student merit. A rigorous medical exam. Eddy was among them. Preparation: 1976-1977. Two years of theoretical coursework. He took many interesting subjects. But his passion was meteorology. Navigation. Languages: English and Russian. And above all, mathematics. He received it in its pure form. Or applied to mechanics and navigation. It fascinated him. Once the theoretical course was finished, the practical one began. A series of exercises. Up to exercise seven, he flew with an instructor. Exercise eight was soloing. The first day he flew alone. That day was quite an event. His classmates awaited his landing. They prepared pranks and jokes for him. Buckets of water. Engine oil all over him. The instructors joined in. The classmates joined in. A party. Everything was going well. ***
![1779719619772.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/ALAFWpSK6KRnLqek39T2seHy7RcCRAsAB3Z916Bh2hfnmM14QZ7SY7NTu1Tu64G.jpg)
***

> Until one day, returning from a flight in the area, he forgot a landing procedure. He caused an accident. Miraculously, it didn't cost him his life. But it cost him his career. It was 1978. He was 22, almost 23. He had to give his life a new direction. His classmates were about to finish their second year of university. He, although he had the right to enroll in any program he wanted, felt he had wasted time studying. Her interests and needs were no longer the same. And her family's financial situation did not allow her to restart university for the first year after missing two courses. So he looked for a job. He was offered a position developing a fifth- and sixth-semester math program at the Workers' and Peasants' Faculty. A trial contract. One month. If he performed well, they would extend it. They also offered him professional development at an institution called ISE, in Los Maisales. There, they prepared emerging educators to later pursue teaching degrees. His trial month was very well received. Students. Administrators. Staff. Not only did they hire him permanently, but they also assigned him to work at IPUEC 109. And there he discovered his true calling. He discovered that everything before had been a teenage dream. That his true vocation was teaching. ***
![1779719606650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/23wCE6UVG7vvWCs7bQHdsHtY9Fv2ML6iLFs6zsupTT98XKH6irWEV5jm4dZnmw4JfgLHK.jpg)
*** ***

> He has been in this profession for 48 years. And he says, without hesitation, that if he could turn back time, this time he would choose teaching without a doubt. In these 48 years, he has held various positions: Head of Department, Academic Secretary, Assistant Director of Academic Affairs, Methodologist, Municipal Subject Coordinator, and Head of Department at the Pedagogical Branch. He has taught in two countries: Nicaragua and Venezuela. But he has never left the classroom. That's what he truly loves. What he enjoys. Not even during the Special Period, when many were forced to abandon their studies, did he remain in the classroom. He endured all the hardships of those times. Without chalk. Without paper. Without transportation. He kept going. He continues to share his knowledge and teachings with new generations. He believes he will do so as long as his mental faculties allow. There is no greater joy for him than knowing that his students, now several generations, remember his classes. Knowing that he contributed to their personal growth at a certain stage of their lives. That is his reward. Eddy Pineda did know how to fly. He just never needed a plane. He needed a blackboard. A classroom. *** Images courtesy of Eddy Pineda **© Marabuzal, 2026. Original content. All rights reserved.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR4iAzr2GRzXZYx3kViUYm4hvGC4Cm72oqo1eUjTMnYKk/1776352087971.png)

I see a couple people already helped you here and by now you might have a better educated guess about these two:

> By the way, this brings up a question I wanted to ask: I often see links to other posts. It annoys me when people jump between different platforms (PeakD, Ecency, Hive.blog, etc.). How should I personally handle links in my posts? Is there a go-to page where you can never go wrong, like PeakD, or does it make sense to offer readers the convenience I miss in many posts by including links to all major front-ends directly ourselves?

> Furthermore, I’ve inevitably noticed that I’ve never encountered a Hive blog post in my everyday use of search engines. Of course I’d be happy if my content—hopefully perceived as high quality—could increase the platform’s reach. Is the poor Google presence due to the few posts, or is SEO optimization so bad?

First, welcome. Is hard these days to experience people that have been watching this chain and then decided by their own to try it. I really value those people that do that.

This is a decentralized place, so, if you want your content to be consistent with some sort of platform, you only need to change the first part of the address usually and you can keep reading the same on your preferred front end. I know... annoying... and some platforms swap it by default, but not always the case because the content should be displayed in its true form (or at least default to that, and if people want, enable features on the front ends that do those tricks).

The reason Hive posts were not very much scraped by google was because there were (until recently) sitemap.xml in most of them. This is now fixed on most of them (peakd I can confirm for example). So slowly things will start to get scraped and depending on google hits, it might become easily searchable.

Now, to the reason that made me come to your first post. Are your experience into microelectronics? Or are you hobby learning them?

Estas son foticos que resumen mis últimos días. Hay mucho cambio ahora mismo en mi día a día. Estoy consciente de que necesito orden y organización, además de crear algún sistema para crear y trabajar en otra cosa a la vez, porque la vida acá lo requiere. ¿Será que lo conseguimos? 

---

body.title: (ENG/ESP) 😇💚✨My experience going to the movies alone for the first time / Mi experiencia yendo al cine sola por primera vez 😇💚✨
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello everyone in this community! Yesterday I had the wonderful opportunity to go to the movies for the first time on my own. What do I mean by this? My first time going to the movies was when I was in elementary school. I remember seeing the Disney movie *Hercules* with my siblings and parents. As I grew up, I went to the movies many more times, but this time with friends or partners.
However, I had never gone without any company. It wasn't that the idea didn't appeal to me; in fact, I did want to do it... But just like going out to eat alone in a crowded place, I felt uncomfortable thinking about other people giving me strange looks for being completely alone, because it's happened to me before, haha. So I dismissed the idea of ​​going to the movies alone, until I completely forgot about it, haha. It wasn't until a few days ago, when my boyfriend gave me a movie ticket (he's in another state), that I realized it was time to have this solo experience I'd been wanting to have for so long. 😎
![1000425605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowFdyBSKLXga79kSpyBG4HZcRqBFHER7tma9wWqnntx23fKR3sXaLqgC77S1mj5iha.jpg)

The movie I wanted to see hadn't premiered yet, and the other one that caught my eye only had one showing at night, so I decided to see a movie that started at noon. This way, I'd have plenty of time to get there without rushing and could leave without having to worry about long lines of people waiting for transportation back home.
So, yesterday I got up early to make myself a nutritious breakfast, as well as my lunch. After that, I got ready, and once I was all set, I left without any hurry. Luckily, the ride was quite quick and pleasant, unlike other times I've used the subway. I arrived an hour before the movie, so I took the opportunity to explore the mall. I bought some snacks and something nice that I couldn't resist treating myself to.
|![1000424895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wCG1NSUEoibrFxPgXTxZUeJb2KrEyMavJBD27zSGxoHwVahg48915cgiwV7vUoATn6V.jpg)|![1000424896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2sLtcRRAR8JZ1z3MTjG45EucfaQVtMyVgTBqbG55Qjn6FH1ywbyCsnswAY1kRWWcQm.jpg)|![1000424594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgQCqTa4r6L9fgBMkzBZRJWU98sa3EcxoP9cmgq1qkAc4tUB3nT1NDRhwfXFWdr5dtb.jpg)| |-|-|-|
**💚 On my way to the mall. I lied... I wasn't alone, \

, the teddy bear, came with me, wearing the blue jeans outfit I sewed for him a while ago 💚**
Afterwards, I went to the movies, answered my last few messages, and put my phone away because I wanted to stay focused on the film. Since my phone is always on silent (for peace of mind, haha), I knew nothing would bother me. The movie I saw was **Michael**, which tells the story of *Michael Jackson*, the singer. I grew up listening to his songs, so the whole time I felt like I was being transported back to that time in my childhood when I listened to that music. It was really beautiful.
|![1000424898.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsBr3kj3doxHBXtBV62h48oXivCSd6q2sAZfevNaAgCFonBVNbqtuEjiupfPHEFpG4K.jpg)|![1000424849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoATyY16ZqX2HkcBXeCEK5b8HUZHpQLTBuFZL5rFeG1eZCeaiLLBa1cJeTjtL3THTDt.jpg)|![1000424852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u5ZJzDCVstY7u7Ff8XhXoMHkgq7JCsvJtbKU4WHYMHyQEKANfpNSoBWxNVmZgNPxJum.jpg)| |-|-|-| |**💚A quick photo before the show started💚**|**💚I wanted to stay through the credits, but the theater emptied out immediately and I felt bad being the only one there haha💚**|**💚Papi Papita said it was really good, he loved the movie💚**|
Before I knew it, the show was over, so I took a quick look around before leaving. That's when I stumbled upon a small but beautiful aquarium, full of multicolored fish. It was quite pleasant and reminded me of a [collage ](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@suezoe/engesp-lets-make-a-collage-round-248-visit-to-the-aquarium-visita-al-acuario)I made recently, where I mentioned that I wanted to go to an aquarium... I think my desire led me to that place, now that I think about it.
|![1000424875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep9z6D8auDgPcPF93j6DFdcyfnpDDEPePGztJ4BSG9niQuFSupfpxfe28n9M8A4KdyH.jpg)|![1000424876.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoc1CT2d7HohxcaFPGV5YAk7BnQdkySNUPR7vTZutkhHjKCzXS3vifSXr4mq9ZfU1Cb.jpg)|![1000424874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK4NvMnwsPuuryHAyCbE2HdnH12vXPtHLz76bKTeZS93tgNeBr2jc9tPxPLE2zuvji.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000424870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wCBw9uA9XK3uEkQKK6pcaqhgjeDZoyoCWRZ4rT1t1MM1yrT9xmUoubYHJBkTF8ggtag.jpg)|![1000424859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWxy3Xd2BvCdurHnTRzfbeaDb22kqjGr2uXqumpWgCtAJ5ACchZpnXVoEkv4Qdtrme8.jpg)|![1000424857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xyWxW42Y9VLLDGskfvX5LK4Egnq8vNwBeYc6AZqbmfi2CKTpB4Z4AAqsDW8LHyKy9br.jpg)| |-|-|-|
**💚 Moments of Contemplation 💚**

Before leaving, I had lunch even though I wasn't that hungry. I knew the trip back would be long, so it was best to have enough energy for it. It was definitely a pleasant experience that I'd like to repeat, especially since lately they've been showing older films in theaters, like Studio Ghibli movies and classic films; that way, I'd not only have the opportunity to see the movies on the big screen, but I'd really be able to concentrate on the film, without any external distractions, haha.
|![1000424900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2sWZy8jXTkPbzQHdTFUSdwcnWmBFD7g9RErGXSyqW5xdXzMGs2Axdygt8pBPVqz7VW.jpg)|![1000424894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ynUjK4rZy5CYxzoQPXcVC53nyRd5r7JvTSpcek6p3c3RCbvqSKgPwSoCxA9Hadyw4r2.jpg)|![1000424893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23yd7niQk2BaFTyh7V9zG1VR6jMapW4fYHCBuutr8XUtXp42B59tVX7L6NpQHytxUEaSL.jpg)| |-|-|-| |💚**Going shopping**💚|💚**Papi papita posing**💚|💚**Lunch to recharge**💚|
If you've never been to the movies alone and you're hesitant because you think someone will take pictures of you and make a melancholic or sad edit with them, don't think about that, haha, and go enjoy your own company. We need to normalize dedicating time to ourselves without it being seen as a selfish act or a descent into madness 🤣
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sue fashion.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AKApRZDfJ8S1XQadkEKLoT6hVkfsbSDY4iys2SXE1yLtn9dxqSTUgNJxyCrzpZ2.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad! El día de ayer tuve la maravillosa oportunidad de ir al cine por primera vez estando sola. ¿A qué me refiero con esto? Mi primera vez yendo al cine fue cuando estaba en primaria, recuerdo que vi la película de **Hércules** de *Disney*, junto a mis hermanos y mis padres. Ya al crecer, fui muchas veces más al cine, pero esta vez con amigos o parejas.
Sin embargo, nunca había ido sin ninguna clase de compañía. No era que la idea no me llamase la atención, es mas, si quería hacerlo... Pero al igual que ir a comer sola a un lugar lleno de gente, me resultaba incómodo pensar en que las demás personas me mirasen de forma extraña por estar en un lugar completamente sola, porque me ha pasado jaja Así que descarté la idea de ir al cine sola, hasta que se me olvidó jaja No fue sino hasta unos días atrás, que mi novio me regaló una entrada para el cine (él está en otro estado), que me di cuenta de que era el momento de tener esta experiencia en solitario que hacía tanto que deseaba vivir 😎
![1000425605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowFdyBSKLXga79kSpyBG4HZcRqBFHER7tma9wWqnntx23fKR3sXaLqgC77S1mj5iha.jpg)

La película que quería ver aún no la han estrenado y la otra que me llamó la atención, tenía una única función en horario nocturno, por lo que decidí mirar una película que empezaba a mediodía, con la finalidad de tener tiempo de llegar sin prisa, para poder retirarme sin tener que preocuparme por las largas filas de personas para tomar el transporte hacia el lugar en donde habito.
De esa forma, el día de ayer me levanté temprano para prepararme un nutritivo desayuno, así como mi almuerzo. Luego de ello me arreglé y una vez que estuve lista, salí sin ninguna clase de apuro. Por suerte el recorrido fue bastante rápido y ameno, a diferencia de otras veces que he utilizado el subterráneo. Llegué con una hora de antelación a la función, así que aproveché de recorrer el centro comercial. Compré algunas golosinas así como algo lindo que no pude resistirme a regalarme.
|![1000424895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wCG1NSUEoibrFxPgXTxZUeJb2KrEyMavJBD27zSGxoHwVahg48915cgiwV7vUoATn6V.jpg)|![1000424896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2sLtcRRAR8JZ1z3MTjG45EucfaQVtMyVgTBqbG55Qjn6FH1ywbyCsnswAY1kRWWcQm.jpg)|![1000424594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgQCqTa4r6L9fgBMkzBZRJWU98sa3EcxoP9cmgq1qkAc4tUB3nT1NDRhwfXFWdr5dtb.jpg)| |-|-|-|
**💚 En camino al centro comercial. Les mentí... no fui sola, me acompañó \

, el osito, con su outfit de bluejeans que cosí para él hace un tiempo 💚**
Seguidamente fui a al cine, respondí los últimos mensajes y guardé mi teléfono, pues quería mantenerme concentrada en la función. Cómo mi teléfono siempre está en silencio (por cuestiones de paz mental diaria jaja), sabía que no nada me molestaría. La película que vi fue **Michael**, la cual muestra la vida de *Michael Jackson*, el cantante. Yo crecí escuchando sus canciones, por lo que en todo momento, me sentí como transportándome a esa época de mi infancia en la que escuchaba aquella música. Fue muy bonito.
|![1000424898.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsBr3kj3doxHBXtBV62h48oXivCSd6q2sAZfevNaAgCFonBVNbqtuEjiupfPHEFpG4K.jpg)|![1000424849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoATyY16ZqX2HkcBXeCEK5b8HUZHpQLTBuFZL5rFeG1eZCeaiLLBa1cJeTjtL3THTDt.jpg)|![1000424852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u5ZJzDCVstY7u7Ff8XhXoMHkgq7JCsvJtbKU4WHYMHyQEKANfpNSoBWxNVmZgNPxJum.jpg)| |-|-|-| |**💚Fotito antes de iniciar la función💚**|**💚Queriendo quedarme durante todos los créditos, pero la sala se vació de inmediato y me dió pena ser la única allí jaja💚**|**💚Papi papita dijo que estuvo muy buena, le encantó la película💚**|
Cuando menos lo esperé la función había terminado, así que di una pequeña vuelta por el lugar antes de irme. En ese preciso momento en el que me hallé con un pequeño pero hermoso acuario, lleno de peces multicolores. Fue bastante grato y me recordó a un [collage ](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@suezoe/engesp-lets-make-a-collage-round-248-visit-to-the-aquarium-visita-al-acuario)que hice hace poco, en donde mencionaba que quería ir a un acuario... Creo que mi deseo me llevó hasta ese lugar, ahora que lo pienso.
|![1000424875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep9z6D8auDgPcPF93j6DFdcyfnpDDEPePGztJ4BSG9niQuFSupfpxfe28n9M8A4KdyH.jpg)|![1000424876.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoc1CT2d7HohxcaFPGV5YAk7BnQdkySNUPR7vTZutkhHjKCzXS3vifSXr4mq9ZfU1Cb.jpg)|![1000424874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK4NvMnwsPuuryHAyCbE2HdnH12vXPtHLz76bKTeZS93tgNeBr2jc9tPxPLE2zuvji.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000424870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wCBw9uA9XK3uEkQKK6pcaqhgjeDZoyoCWRZ4rT1t1MM1yrT9xmUoubYHJBkTF8ggtag.jpg)|![1000424859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWxy3Xd2BvCdurHnTRzfbeaDb22kqjGr2uXqumpWgCtAJ5ACchZpnXVoEkv4Qdtrme8.jpg)|![1000424857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xyWxW42Y9VLLDGskfvX5LK4Egnq8vNwBeYc6AZqbmfi2CKTpB4Z4AAqsDW8LHyKy9br.jpg)| |-|-|-|
**💚 Momentos de contemplación 💚**

Antes de irme almorcé aunque no tenía tanta hambre. Sabía que el camino de regreso sería tardado, así que lo mejor era tener energía suficiente para ello. Sin duda fue una grata experiencia que me gustaría volver a repetir, sobre todo porque últimamente están proyectando en los cines funciones antiguas, como películas del *estudio Ghibli* y clásicos del cine; así, no sólo tendría la oportunidad de ver las películas en pantalla grande, sino que realmente me concentraría en el largometraje, sin distracciones externas jaja.
|![1000424900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2sWZy8jXTkPbzQHdTFUSdwcnWmBFD7g9RErGXSyqW5xdXzMGs2Axdygt8pBPVqz7VW.jpg)|![1000424894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ynUjK4rZy5CYxzoQPXcVC53nyRd5r7JvTSpcek6p3c3RCbvqSKgPwSoCxA9Hadyw4r2.jpg)|![1000424893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23yd7niQk2BaFTyh7V9zG1VR6jMapW4fYHCBuutr8XUtXp42B59tVX7L6NpQHytxUEaSL.jpg)| |-|-|-| |💚**Yendo de compras**💚|💚**Papi papita posando**💚|💚**Almuerzo para recuperar energía**💚|
Si nunca han ido solos al cine y no se animan porque sienten que alguien les va a tomar fotografías y van a hacer una edición melancólica o triste con ellas, no piensen en eso jaja y vayan a disfrutar de su propia compañía. Hay que normalizar dedicarnos tiempo a nosotros mismos sin que eso se vea como un acto egoísta o de descenso a la locura 🤣

Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!


I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world.


My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

SPS coin is a very important component of the Splinterlands game, and last year, I made it a holding of 125K coins, which is staked in the game account. It is valuable because it plays a very important role in the game ecosystem, where rewards are linked with how much any player takes from the game, and liquid token holding is not considered. When I purchased the SPS from the market, the price was low at that time, but I had no idea that in the future the price would go further down, as I would have waited, but it's fine because it is the market, and many things we just contradict and cannot even control them. Similarly, with Hive, I also had to go through the same, where when I purchased, the price was around $0.20 to $0.25, but later on, it started dropping, and now we know where it is, so if I had waited till now, then surely my holding would have been much bigger than what I hold currently.

This APR is not very high, to be honest, but I think it is not bad because in the current situation, when the market is really going through a tough time, this APR can be considered as good, and it is surely not bad.

body.title: Los monstruos crecieron // The monsters grew
body.body:
>

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  Today, I want to dedicate this to the child we once were and the person we are now, because back then we had many dreams and fears of fantastic things, and now we suffer from the reality of life, and that makes me question.
> 
>  And if the monsters didn't leave... Did they just learn to behave?
Before, I was afraid of the noise in my head and that ghost we thought was lurking when the lights went out, but now I'm scared to open my wallet.

  Este día quiero hacer una dedicatoria a ese niño que fuimos y a esa persona que somos ahora, porque antes teníamos muchos sueños y miedos a cosas fantásticas y ahora sufrimos por la realidad de una vida y eso me hace cuestionar.

  Y si los monstruos no se fueron… ¿Solo aprendieron a comportarse?
Antes tenía miedo al ruido en mi cabeza y a ese fantasma que al apagar la luz creíamos que nos acecha, mas ahora me asusta abrir la cartera.


|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tHGcgGPVNBDKJZjkUwrmbVjXLmevtsk3yPsFMg7gtnc8bJbhCXmEkwN66VLjA4ZGTqu.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tSeuoxZ4dDMWVd1DjEsXusHneRNc7ghAWrfnBskA5RyjjhQ81b8QorYnsbvp9BABvyq.png)|
|-|-|

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  Before, I trembled if the wind blew, and now I tremble when silence speaks to me; I used to dream of those shadows under the mattress, and today I carry them inside my heart. For the fears of the past slept during the day, and today's fears no longer have courtesy.

  Antes temblaba si el viento soplaba, y ahora tiemblo cuando el silencio me habla; yo soñaba con esas sombras bajo el colchón y hoy las cargo dentro del corazón. Pues los miedos de antes dormían de día y los de hoy ya no tienen cortesía.

 
|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tHGcaPxADAWGMYrcpyjPia2u558BWW6s4nzBMbSZ13geK3hCMw7fzZKb5ydXQsWVbZm.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23w2sG3CG9VQeVPaJKdKw3RhGHHwqRpdMLhzBzKawkc2jFDs2degaxuebNzR6aoc7dxSZ.png)|
|-|-|

[English Version] > >   The little monsters used to make me laugh, but the ones now know very well how to persuade; they offer me calm and reason, but they gently squeeze your heart, so I gave them names, routines, and voices, and even so, they eat me, but with manners.   Los monstruos pequeños me hacían reír, pero los de ahora saben muy bien cómo persuadir; ellos me ofrecen calma y dan razón, pero van apretándote suave el corazón, así que les puse nombre, rutina y voz, y aun así me comen, pero con educación. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23uFcWYvCWNfTFnWxUMNwgukmjx66weuvYo778FkgXRVMR6Ar56rZVzEmQgNMBxHGuyoU.png) >! Y si... Crecí... sin gran elección, cambié mi inocencia por precaución.   A veces pienso en el niño que fui. body.body:

￼

Bitcoin is testing the $75,000 psychological level. This is the third test in two weeks. The first two held. Will the third?

￼
📉 What the Chart Shows

Price: $75,424 — sitting right on the $75K line
RSI: Neutral to bearish — momentum fading, not oversold yet

￼

￼
The structure is shifting. Two weeks ago we were debating $82K breakouts. Today we're defending $75K. That's how fast crypto moves.

￼
📊 The $75K Test — Why It Matters

$75,000 is not just a round number. It's the Fibonacci 0.236 retracement from the April low to May high. It's where the April rally paused before breaking higher. It's where buyers stepped in on May 4 and May 13.
If ￼66K → $82K) is intact. We consolidate, then retry $80K.

￼
🐋 What the Whales Are Doing
ETF Flows: Mixed. 30-day inflows still positive at approximately +$1.75 billion, but weekly flows have turned negative ​￼. Institutions are not panic-selling, but they're also not buying aggressively at these levels.

Exchange Supply: Still at 7-year lows ​￼. Long-term holders are not moving coins to exchanges. This is the bullish counter-narrative — supply remains tight even as price falls.

Open Interest: Dropped 21% from the May 11 peak ​￼. Leverage has been flushed. The market is cleaner, but also thinner — meaning moves in either direction could accelerate quickly.

Options Market: Put/call ratio rising. Traders are buying downside protection. The June 26 $76,000 put saw 22.5% surge in open interest ​￼. Smart money is hedging, not betting on collapse.

￼
📉 The Bigger Picture — May 2026 in Context
￼
Look at the monthly chart. Bitcoin is down ~30% from its all-time high of $126,273 in October 2025. But it's up ~13% from the April low of $66,891.

We are in no-man's land. Not a bull market. Not a bear market. A chop market. And chop markets destroy impatient traders.

The 200-day EMA is rising at $72,035 ​￼. As long as price holds above this, the long-term trend is technically bullish. But the shorter-term picture is deteriorating — we're below the 50-day EMA, below the bull market support band, and testing key horizontal support.

￼
📊 Two Scenarios for the Next Week

Scenario 1: $75K Holds — Bounce to ￼80K — 50% likelihood

Buyers defend $75K. A higher low is established. RSI resets without reaching oversold. We bounce toward ￼78K first, then retry the ￼80K bull market support band. This requires volume confirmation on the bounce — light volume bounces get sold.

Scenario 2: $75K Breaks — Drop to ￼74K — 50% likelihood

$75K fails. The Fib 0.382 at $74,397 gets tested quickly. If that fails, the 200-day EMA at $72,035 is the last major support before $70K psychological. A break below $72K would confirm a larger distribution pattern and open the door to ￼68K (April lows).

The probability is split because $75K is genuinely a coin-flip level. Both scenarios are equally valid until the market decides.

￼
🎯 Key Levels I'm Watching

$75,000 — Psychological. Must hold for bullish structure. Testing now.

$74,397 — Fib 0.382. First support if $75K breaks.

$72,035 — 200-day EMA. Long-term trend floor. Rising since May 2025 ​￼.

$72,000 — 100-day MA. Major medium-term support.

$77,200 — Previous support, now resistance. Reclaim for short-term momentum.

$79,025 — Fib 0.5 / Bull Market Support Band. Reclaim for bullish continuation.

$80,000 — Psychological. The wall that separates consolidation from trend.

$82,228 — May high / 200-day EMA. Full trend reversal confirmed.

￼
🧠 What I'm Doing (Ghana Learner's Strategy)

I'm not selling. I didn't buy Bitcoin to trade $2K moves. 
I bought it to hold through cycles.

I'm watching $72K. If the 200-day EMA breaks, I reassess my conviction. Not panic — reassess. The trend that has been rising since May 2025 would be broken. That matters.

I'm still DCA'ing. Smaller amounts, same schedule. The cedi doesn't care about Bitcoin's $75K test. It keeps falling. Bitcoin at $75K is still Bitcoin.

I'm building Hive. While BTC chops, Hive pays me to show up. Two horses, one race.

I'm ignoring Twitter. The same people who bought at $82K two weeks ago are calling for $50K today. Recency bias is real. Zoom out.

￼

https://i.ecency.com/DQmafHwYg6Mu4uNhcrf2vEt8MKx5831Z5pTscK9GZPC9gi2/img_7431.webp

￼
In Ghana, we know about tests.

The cedi tests our patience every year. Inflation tests our savings every month. The power grid tests our resilience every week.

But we adapt. We find ways. We keep walking.

Bitcoin at $75K is a test. Not of the technology — Bitcoin works exactly the same at $75K as it did at $82K. It's a test of conviction. Of patience. Of whether you believe in the thing you bought, or just the price you bought it at.

The chicken that walks slowly reaches the market. Even when the road is muddy. Even when it rains. Even when the market is red for two weeks and everyone is calling for $50K.
I'm still walking.

￼

While Bitcoin tests $75K, Hive keeps paying me to learn.

No bank. No boss. No gatekeeper.

When I power up HIVE, I'm not just saving money. I'm buying influence in a community that rewards builders, not just traders.

My wallet is real. My rewards are real. My growth is slow — but it's mine.

❓ Question to You

May 27. Bitcoin is at $75K. The third test in two weeks. Are you:

 • Buying the test, trusting $75K holds?

 • Waiting for $72K (200-day EMA) or clarity above $80K?

body.title: Trust, Security And Reassurance Can Bring Healing To Our Society
body.body:
MASKS PEOPLE WEAR IN SOCIETY
Hello #scifimultiverse, hope you are doing great today? Happy Eid el-Kabir. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqULciJPNcAomGfahupJDWFu1ugJDN5uMeSGNCkJgPBj/image.png) [Rivail Júnior](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1623073050933-142b532342ae?q=80&w=1137&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Mask can be defined as hiding or covering someone’s true identity for either positive or negative reasons. For example, some celebrities do not like revealing many details about themselves, so they mask their identities while in public places for security reasons. In my country of origin, we have a musician who masks himself. He also has reasons for doing that. People can purposely mask themselves for positive or negative reasons. In this prompt, we are focused on that negative masking. People who are going through turbulent times but are afraid or shy to reveal their true situation for fear of being ridiculed. Most times, these kinds of individuals slip into depression and eventually become suicidal because they are afraid of opening up to people. This is also because of trust issues. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMdpfzjHjfuH8kb615eidzrdjvTjempZajsYrEnETRYW/image.png) Last year, I noticed a serious change in one employee, all of a sudden, he started coming to work late, underperforming, and absent-minded while on duty. I noticed that on the monthly workforce productivity data insight and called him for a one-to-one discussion. I informed him of my observations, backed by the data I received for the month. I requested that he open up to me if there is any challenge. I also told him that the management will support him even if it is a financial burden. He smiled and said, “It is well”. I went further and advised him to take some time off duty to rest in case he is stressed. After that discussion, a few days later, the employee got his hand trapped in a machine, but God was faithful, and he was saved. His hand was fractured. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNifmNQmuyiFaykKNjopCAR7KnxdKLPx5QZ3nwD6BHRYn/image.png) When he was interviewed at the clinic, he revealed that he was troubled and was operating the machine absent-mindedly before the incident happened. After the bone was attended to, he called me a few days later and shared his burden with me. I asked why it took him that long to open up. He responded that he was afraid of being ridiculed and shamed for speaking up. He also said he was not sure that management would provide him with the support needed. At that point, I encouraged him and asked him to make a formal support request, which I followed up with and got approval for him to clear the children's school fees, which had become a burden of indebtedness to him. At that point, I opened an online channel where employees can log in and request any form of support, physical, financial, mental, and otherwise. Also, we now have boxes where they can drop requests for help, and my team will reach out to the particular employee for further engagement and support. This worked very well for us and has since reduced the employee’s level of sick leave and absenteeism and improved workforce productivity. Feel free to join the contest [here](https://ecency.com/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-69-edition-or-2-the-mask-people-wear-in-the-society) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbU2hSgaX1Af4R4dWfwNG3TcPhZMquzbJbmqGKqd7BpTd/1779919782429.gif)

body.title: ## MI RESEÑA DE LA PELÍCULA EL DIABLO VISTE A LA MODA 2  (ES / EN)
body.body:
>

## MI RESEÑA DE LA PELÍCULA EL DIABLO VISTE A LA MODA 2 

<div class= \

> ![español.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23yd9wZPBaPKw5HFDYLUPN9j4qLYrD8Xci2NgBKrFwgWe14NHavfwHUnjC1sQvQXLjGFp.png) Hola cinéfilos de Hive, Es mi primera participación en esta comunidad 👏🏻 Pero, me encantan las películas y las series de televisión y no quería dejar de comentar lo que vi recientemente en el cine 😁😇 Estamos acostumbrados a escuchar esa frase que dice: *“las segundas partes nunca fueron buenas”*. Pues, tuve la oportunidad de ir a ver este fin de semana la tan esperada y comentada secuela de *El diario viste a la moda, parte 2*, y rompió esta regla. No me decepcionó, al contrario es un guión fresco con un toque más moderno y reflexivo. Veinte años después, volvemos al fascinante mundo de la moda y el periodismo. La trama gira en torno a la revista *Runway* y los desafíos que conllevan la era digital. Las protagonistas Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) y Andrea Sachs (Anne Hathaway) se “unen” para intentar mantener en pie los medios impresos, actualmente en declive, con el avance de la tecnología. Miranda sigue siendo la temida editora en jefe de la prestigiosa revista de moda, pero representa a lo que fue el periodismo tradicional (el papel); Andrea (o Andy) vuelve más fuerte, ahora es una editora experimentada y representa la conexión entre periodismo de papel y el digital, debe intentar captar la atención del público hacia la revista combinando ambas cosas y generar contenido de impacto pero adaptado a los nuevos tiempos. La película expone temas con la aparición de la Inteligencia Artificial en contraste como pensamiento y la creatividad humana; así como la influencia de los anunciantes en las editoriales, que ha existido siempre, pero que en la era digital se ha intensificado considerablemente. El elenco de esta secuela es espectacular. Aparecen otros personajes que hablan de nuevos talentos y herramientas. Se ve la relación entre varias generaciones: la experiencia vs. la innovación, lo tradicional vs. lo moderno, que le dan frescura al guión. Mi favorita, Anne Hathaway, se luce en esta película como todo lo que hace. ¿A quién no le gusta *Mia Thermopolis* de *Diario de una Princesa*?. Es una actriz muy versátil, con una chispa única, es didáctica en su forma de encarar a un personaje. ¡Espectacular!

>

## MY REVIEW OF THE MOVIE THE DEVIL WEARS PRADA 2

<div class= \

> ![ingles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23ynYxDZufJebWDsXDADMnf4UrueESVTkKmtp3k8NsBqytTwT4tYy4fXexYVGR6T8BUkp.png) Hello, Hive movie lovers, This is my first post in this community 👏🏻 But I love movies and TV shows, and I didn’t want to miss the chance to share what I recently saw at the theater 😁😇 We’re used to hearing that saying: *“sequels are never any good.”* Well, this weekend I had the chance to see the long-awaited and much-talked-about sequel to *The Devil Wears Prada 2*, and it broke that rule. I wasn’t disappointed; on the contrary, it’s a fresh script with a more modern and thoughtful touch. Twenty years later, we return to the fascinating world of fashion and journalism. The plot revolves around *Runway* magazine and the challenges brought on by the digital age. The protagonists, Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) and Andrea Sachs (Anne Hathaway), “team up” to try to keep print media afloat—currently in decline—amidst the advance of technology. Miranda remains the feared editor-in-chief of the prestigious fashion magazine, but she represents what traditional journalism (print) once was; Andrea (or Andy) returns stronger, now an experienced editor who embodies the bridge between print and digital journalism. She must try to capture the public’s attention for the magazine by combining both worlds and creating impactful content adapted to the new era. The film explores themes such as the emergence of artificial intelligence in contrast to human thought and creativity, as well as the influence of advertisers on publishers—an influence that has always existed but has intensified considerably in the digital age. The cast of this sequel is spectacular. New characters appear, showcasing fresh talent and tools. We see the relationship between different generations—experience versus innovation, tradition versus modernity—which brings a fresh perspective to the script. My favorite, Anne Hathaway, shines in this film just as she does in everything she does. Who doesn’t love *Mia Thermopolis* from *The Princess Diaries*? She is a very versatile actress with a unique spark; she is insightful in the way she approaches a character. Spectacular! *** ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zGwLtB2cfzz8rHQRDCv7Kuryr4JHQDFzPpXXBLMsssfx9a2Yzue7PDQYdeQBQuKWmKx.png) ***

body.title: Freewrite - “Garbage Sandwich”
body.body:
The problem with the world, according to Charlene, was that there weren't nearly enough optimists. Sure, bad and good existed everywhere but with the right outlook, even the darkest of clouds could be convinced to reveal its silver lining.

Her recent firing from that soul crushing job was probably just the nudge she needed to start taking her writing career more seriously. And she finally had time for both yoga and meditation now.

The boyfriend who had left the country the day after she told him she loved him was clearly not her soul mate at all. The end of that relationship had probably placed her in much greater alignment with the universe and her higher self.

The fly she had found in her soup was probably an excellent source of protein and…okay she wasn't ready to spin that one into a positive just yet. But all things considered, she had air in her lungs, a granola bar in her purse, a smile on her face and a heart full of hope and love for humanity.

She never saw the asteroid coming.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ3dzkLebjLudLLGCF9ymsVWFuLpf89zZu4X32kfTuMhB/1000012985.jpg 

[*Image*](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-space-galaxy-trash-9060728/)

******

Is life an adventure full of exciting twists and turns or is it a garbage sandwich, just a massive helping of crap sandwiched between two thick slices of disappointment? I like to believe that it has the potential to be absolutely anything.

body.title: Un día de locos
body.body: > # Que llegue el siguiente día. Todos los días hay momentos que pueden resultar parecidos unos a otros, todo derivado a la rutina que nos alcanza. Sin embargo, en ocasiones nos damos cuenta, hasta que comienzan a pasar cosas que descuadran el día o que simplemente no son comunes y hacen que debamos tomar decisiones diferentes. Hoy fue un día de esos, donde solo esperaba que terminara pronto, porque desde que inició con algunos inconvenientes, empezando por la alarma del despertador que no sonó y eso hizo que me quedara dormida, se suma que pasé mala noche debido a una fuerte gripe, que hizo que no dejara de toser por un largo tiempo. Comenzar el día de forma apresurada hizo que todo cambiara, porque no me dio la oportunidad de llegar a la oficina, así que tocó solucionar desde casa y hacer lo que tenía que hacer en horas tempranas desde el departamento. Finalmente, todo lo que acontece lo fui resolviendo, pero mientras daba solución a una cosa, se sumaba una más, que no tenía planificada. Así se fue desarrollando el día hasta terminar con un diente partido, una de mis pesadillas, perder los dientes. Todo esto, para hacerme recordar lo vulnerable que podemos ser, pese a lo fuerte que solemos ser ante los demás. Espero pronto poder solucionar y volver a sonreír, ya que los dientes para mí son una parte muy importante de mi vida y desenvolvimiento en público, además de que me encanta reírme. Quizás esto que pasó viene a decirme algo que debo analizar, porque siempre intento buscar el lado positivo a todo y analizar qué debo aprender. Pero no estar bien también puede resultar interesante; todo depende del punto de vista y la actitud que demostremos. Ahora, cuéntame, ¿Cómo ha sido un día fuera de lo común en tu vida? Los invito a compartir sus momentos en Liketu y sus @talentos. Con cariño Angelica7 **English version** # Bring on the next day. Every day has moments that can seem similar, all stemming from the routine that surrounds us. However, sometimes we only realize it when things start happening that throw our day off track or are simply unusual, forcing us to make different decisions. Today was one of those days, where I just hoped it would end quickly. It started with some problems, beginning with my alarm not going off and causing me to oversleep. Then I had a bad night due to a severe flu that left me coughing nonstop for a long time. Starting the day in a rush changed everything, because it didn't give me the chance to get to the office. So I had to solve problems from home and get what I had to do done early in the morning from my apartment. Finally, I managed to resolve everything that happened, but while I was solving one problem, another one popped up, one I hadn't planned for. That's how the day unfolded, ending with a chipped tooth—one of my worst nightmares, losing teeth. All of this served as a reminder of how vulnerable we can be, despite how strong we usually appear to others. I hope to get it fixed soon and smile again, since my teeth are a very important part of my life and how I present myself in public, and besides, I love to laugh. Perhaps this incident is trying to tell me something I should reflect on, because I always try to find the positive side of everything and analyze what I should learn. But not being okay can also be interesting; it all depends on your perspective and the attitude you show. Now, tell me, what has an unusual day been like in your life? I invite you to reflect and share your moments with Liketu and your @talentos too. Fondly Angelica7

body.title: Nuestro Liceo participa en el desfile del 304 aniversario de la fundación de Villa de Cura ( video ) by @gaborockstar
body.body:
> Este pasado día 25 de mayo se celebró en las calle bolívar de la ciudad de Villa de Cura el desfile anual que r realiza con motivo a la conmemoración del 304 aniversario de la fundación de la ciudad. Esta actividad fue una iniciativa impulsada por las autoridades locales del Municipio Zamora donde participaron además d e instituciones educativas en todos sus niveles agrupaciones folcloristas, dancísticas y demás colectivos culturales que pertenecen a nuestra ciudad. Acá en este video pueden observar parte de lo que fue nuestra participación como Complejo Educativo Manuel Morales Carabaño, institución que tiene más de medio siglo impartiendo clases en Villa de cura y que rindió homenaje póstumo a quien fuera el director del teatro estable de Villa de Cura por más de 43 años, el dramaturgo y actor Orlando Ascanio QEPD. Esperando que sea de su agrado nos vemos en un próxima oportunidad, su amigo y profesor @gaborockstar.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaborockstar/23uFTrMA9bkukGVCZfq75CPZwsDTBnSvHQMEUt8H8R9hrKSDeYnCyyscxLAh87dkW77Ng.PNG

>
>On May 25, the annual parade was held on Bolívar Street in the city of Villa de Cura to commemorate the 304th anniversary of the city’s founding. >This event was an initiative promoted by the local authorities of the Municipality of Zamora, in which, in addition to educational institutions at all levels, folklore groups, dance troupes, and other cultural organizations from our city participated. >In this video, you can see part of our participation as the Manuel Morales Carabaño Educational Complex, an institution that has been teaching in Villa de Cura for over half a century and that paid a posthumous tribute to the late playwright and actor Orlando Ascanio, who served as director of the Villa de Cura Repertory Theater for over 43 years. Hoping you enjoy it, see you next time, your friend and teacher @gaborockstar.

body.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZLuRSsTZZce9sMmmLJEkAzWkJi9YzSi6U5WP7PtoP3kc/escalation_warriors.png)</center>   
      
<center><sub>Imagen elaborada en Canva / Image created in Canva </sub></center>   
    
 ----   
      
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)   
</center>   

<div class=\

> Hello, good morning or afternoon, my dear fellow Praetorians. This season, I decided to add a few copies of some cards from the Escalation mini-set. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Escalation Purchases

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Over the past few seasons, I’ve been keeping an eye on the market, looking for a good opportunity to add some warriors to my Modern battle deck. I’m interested in several cards from the Arcane Conclave set and the Escalation mini-set; for the Arcane Conclave set, I’m looking for a good price on the Archons or some epic and legendary cards. As for the Escalation mini-set, I’m gradually buying up the common and rare cards, with the goal of upgrading them to a level that’s somewhat interesting for battle. This season, I took advantage of the good prices on some Escalation warriors and decided to buy the ones that caught my eye the most because of the abilities they gained. In total, I spent 3,180.82 DEC on five cards; one of them I didn’t already have.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAZkgedjTKCvarH7pKT6NkpSCzxbAVxF3THyadD9VvJo/comp_esc.gif)
--- --- Lady Stealthfire is my latest addition from the mini-set; I thought she’d be a good fit for my deck; she’s a ranged warrior with camouflage, and I’m particularly interested in having her at level three because of her armor-repair ability.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3RSqfPEJaJTSJL16unwL88SB5WDZngiuB3GEspPjGET/image.png)
--- --- The following four warriors are the ones that level up thanks to the copies I bought. I’ll start with my common warrior, and the rest are rare warriors. Blue Wyrm Travesty: I’ve been using this common warrior regularly in battle and was waiting for the chance to level him up to three. I wanted him at that level because of his ability to slow down the opponent’s warriors. This Undead warrior has good attack and vitality; with that ability added, he’s become one of my most-used warriors in the Water element.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmevLyqSPKUY6LaAYSg8djSWMiYpAvoAWFY21xissqCx1v/esc_1.gif)
Ashveil Tactician: This fire-element elf has no attack power of its own, but I have the option to pair it with the right card to give it some sort of attack, or to use it on its own. What I like about it is that I can use it based on either its element or its lineage; at level two, it has the ability to inspire and boost the melee attack power of its allies.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFrknVjEKwnBHC5dpbQkuLNXDqKh56oH7541oxXVEVQw/esc_2.gif)
Earthwork Sentinel: This earth elemental doesn't have an attack either. What interested me was adding a strong unit with the ability to slow down the enemy's attack speed; I wanted to have this ability available in battles where I use the earth element.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZtEndLR8tvUiPhd3adaQMhEw5ALRza3SMUi52BwWGAu/esc_3.gif)
Empusan Darkguard: Another earth-element warrior, a skilled opportunistic fighter with melee attacks. I was particularly struck by his Shadow Focus ability, which camouflages him when he’s in the back row and prevents him from attacking; however, it grants his allies a +1 power boost and the Resolve ability. I found it very interesting to use him in battle with this ability.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVp2b3ijZcyHb14eKcECQPLxeupn2kLyTBYkEaSccYCR/image.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhFSQcWxMXG7P4fNECJGuUTouqv8DRb2VzVdYVWDSb8M/esc_4.gif)
Note: The “Determined” ability activates when an attack misses, allowing you to make a second attack against the same opponent.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNAjNoqjHdCqx4ydxMKDigLiJsBjfogRvbSjcQiUemjE/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> These are my first purchases in a while; the warriors I’m sharing in this post are the ones I decided to buy based on their abilities and the fact that I have Archons I can use with them. There are several warriors I’m interested in acquiring, but I have to be patient and wait for the right opportunity. One thing I need to do is study those new abilities a bit; there are several I’m unfamiliar with, and I need to understand both their advantages and disadvantages in combination with the different battle rules. For now, I’m just thinking about improving my deck for the Modern format, but I’ll start considering adding some cards from previous sets to participate in the Survival format and tournaments. -----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Esta temporada decidí sumar algunas copias de algunas cartas del mini-set Escalation. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Compras Escalation

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Durante estas últimas temporadas he estado observando el mercado, buscando una buena oportunidad para agregar algunos guerreros a mi mazo de batalla para el formato Modern. Tengo interés en varias cartas del set Conclave Arcana y el mini-set Escalation; para el set CA estoy buscando un buen precio para los arcontes o algunas cartas épicas y legendarias. En cuanto al mini-set Escalation, voy comprando de a poco las cartas comunes y raras, pensando en subirlas a un nivel más o menos interesante para la batalla. Esta temporada aproveché el buen precio de algunos guerreros Escalation y decidí comprar los que me llamaban más la atención por las habilidades que ganaban. En total gasté 3,180.82 DEC en cinco cartas; una de ellas no la tenía.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAZkgedjTKCvarH7pKT6NkpSCzxbAVxF3THyadD9VvJo/comp_esc.gif)
--- --- Lady Stealthfire es mi nueva adquisición del mini-set; me pareció una buena opción para sumar a mi mazo; es una guerrera a distancia con camuflaje y que me llama la atención tenerla en el nivel tres por su habilidad de reparar la armadura.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3RSqfPEJaJTSJL16unwL88SB5WDZngiuB3GEspPjGET/image.png)
--- --- Los siguientes cuatro guerreros son los que suben de nivel por las copias que compré. Inicio con mi guerrero común y los siguientes son guerreros raros. Blue Wyrm Travesty: Este guerrero común lo he estado usando habitualmente en batalla y estuve esperando para tener la oportunidad de llevarlo al nivel tres. Me interesaba tenerlo en ese nivel por su habilidad de disminuir la velocidad de los guerreros del oponente. Este Undead es un guerrero con un buen ataque y vitalidad; al sumarle esa habilidad, se ha convertido en uno de mis guerreros más usados en el elemento agua.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmevLyqSPKUY6LaAYSg8djSWMiYpAvoAWFY21xissqCx1v/esc_1.gif)
Ashveil Tactician: Este elfo del elemento fuego no posee ataque, pero tengo la opción de combinarlo con la carta adecuada para que tenga algún tipo de ataque o usarlo sin él. Lo que me gusta al tenerlo es que puedo usarlo tanto en su elemento o relacionado con su linaje; al tenerlo en el nivel dos, posee la habilidad de inspirar y aumentar el poder de ataque melee de sus aliados.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFrknVjEKwnBHC5dpbQkuLNXDqKh56oH7541oxXVEVQw/esc_2.gif)
Earthwork Sentinel: Este elemental de tierra tampoco posee ataque. Lo que me interesó es sumar una buena unidad con la habilidad de disminuir la velocidad de ataque; quería tener disponible esta habilidad en las batallas donde use el elemento tierra en batalla.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZtEndLR8tvUiPhd3adaQMhEw5ALRza3SMUi52BwWGAu/esc_3.gif)
Empusan Darkguard: Otro guerrero del elemento tierra, un buen guerrero oportunista con ataque melee. Me llamó la atención su habilidad Shadow Focus, la cual tiene el efecto de camuflar a este guerrero cuando está en la última posición y no le permite atacar; sin embargo, le otorga a sus aliados un aumento de poder +1 y la habilidad determinado. Se me hizo muy interesante el poder usarlo en batalla con esta habilidad.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVp2b3ijZcyHb14eKcECQPLxeupn2kLyTBYkEaSccYCR/image.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhFSQcWxMXG7P4fNECJGuUTouqv8DRb2VzVdYVWDSb8M/esc_4.gif)
Nota: La habilidad Determinado se activa al momento de fallar un ataque, permitiendo realizar un segundo ataque contra el mismo oponente.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNAjNoqjHdCqx4ydxMKDigLiJsBjfogRvbSjcQiUemjE/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Estas son mis primeras compras desde hace un tiempo; los guerreros que comparto en esta publicación fueron los que consideré adquirir en base a sus habilidades y al contar con arcontes que se pueden usar. Hay varios guerreros que estoy interesado en adquirir, pero tengo que ser paciente y esperar a una oportunidad. Algo que debo hacer es estudiar un poco esas nuevas habilidades; hay varias que desconozco y es necesario saber tanto sus ventajas como desventajas en combinación con las diferentes reglas de batalla. Por ahora solo estoy pensando en mejorar mi mazo para el formato moderno, pero iré considerando tener algunas cartas de sets anteriores para participar en el formato survival y torneos. -----

> Muchas gracias a los que leen mis publicaciones y muchas gracias por sus votos o comentarios. En el siguiente enlace podrás unirte al juego y conocer este fantástico mundo: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99). Espero verlos pronto en un Challenge contando sus batallas y experiencias. Nota: Esta publicación no es un consejo de inversión; realicen sus propias investigaciones. ___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxXswzbWQTYK9VKwK2Wy5BQfQUwDKD8c2TK4EK89eWbb/image.png)

body.body: ¡Qué alegría leerte y qué valioso testimonio nos compartes! @beaescribe. Gracias por enriquecer la conversación con tu experiencia personal. \n\nEs fascinante lo que planteas. Bueno, al leerte, me doy cuenta de que quizás la palabra *\

* se nos queda corta para describir esa fuerza que te impulsó. Lo que tú viviste al elegir la literatura, a pesar de las advertencias, suena más a una **convicción profunda** o a una **certeza de propósito**.\n\nA veces, la esperanza se malinterpreta como un *\

* que el viento sople a favor. Pero lo que tú hiciste fue distinto: ***tú no esperaste a que el panorama fuera favorable, tú te convertiste en el motor del cambio.*** 

Quizá la diferencia está ahí: *la esperanza es la chispa que nos hace mirar hacia adelante, pero es la **voluntad** y el **coraje** (como el que tú tuviste) lo que realmente nos saca de la esclavitud o del conformismo*. Me quedo con tu idea: ***si la esperanza es el motor que enciende la acción, entonces es una herramienta poderosa.*** Pero si es un refugio para no actuar, es donde se vuelve peligrosa (hasta rima).

¡Gracias por recordarnos, con tu carrera como escritora, que cuando la visión es clara, la acción es imparable! ¡Bendiciones!

body.title: Una Manada Dispareja (Es/ En)
body.body:
> Hay historias que te enamoran y esta es una de ellas. Mi amiga Daysi, radicada en Chile, se ha convertido en una mamá humana de una adorable perra que rescató de su antiguo domicilio donde vivía alquilada; esta perrita estaba en la calle y recibía muchos maltratos, entonces mi amiga, al ver su situación, la rescató, la llevó al veterinario, pues presentaba muchas escoriaciones en la piel y desnutrición, brindándole todas las atenciones necesarias, aparte del amor que nació entre ambas; así fue que Samanta llegó a su familia. Con el tiempo, mi amiga se mudó a un espacio más grande, donde le recomendaron adoptar a un gato para que le ayudara a mantener a raya algunos animales indeseables, ya que esta casa está en un área de campo, y ella aceptó adoptar a un pequeño gato naranja, al principio con ese propósito. Pero le preocupaba la relación que pudiera establecer con Samanta, pues según la naturaleza, gatos y perros no se llevan, decían... Sin embargo, al llegar este pequeñín, de una vez vio en Samanta a la madre que necesitaba e incluso buscaba que ella le diera pecho y la perra, como por complacerlo, lo dejaba y así, sin más, los dos establecieron un vínculo muy especial donde ambos se acompañaban a todo tiempo. Mi amiga se quedó asombrada ante la cercanía que ambos establecieron, porque se acicalaban cada uno a su manera, jugaban, dormían juntos y así hasta que Samanta salió en embarazo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23wX5TyXDt9cKGgFSeLVHn2pT2ZtxVUeUJ4sFmeSVm9mcayxnEfP4TyEELThyVMgdKsuf.png)
Para cuando ella empezó con este proceso, el pequeño Gaspar, como le pusieron, ya no tan chiquito, la cuidaba en todo momento, así hasta cuando le llegó el momento de traer a sus criaturas al mundo. Gaspar fue el fiel compañero para Samanta en esos momentos tan intensos, claro, aparte de mi amiga, quien ha documentado toda esta experiencia, arrancándonos a quienes les hemos conocido desde un inicio sonrisas y sorpresa ante esta manada dispareja; ahora son Samanta, Gaspar y 7 hermosos cachorritos. Esta es una historia en donde los animales nos enseñan lecciones de vida, con la empatía que demuestran, el amor, la protección, la fidelidad y, sobre todo, el saberse que son parte de una misma familia sin hacer distinción de razas ni colores; solo existe amor y compañía. Qué sabia es esta manada dispareja. Quise compartirles esta historia e imágenes que me comparte mi amiga de sus adorables mascotas. ¡Saludos, amigos!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/242Y7vgxWDy2dNZ7utqH949HorBhdXcDG36hgT5dxrtwFXuH9fyfRzSv5egwsE6CypxF6.png)

English

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23viAQJRfPXGoDMiq5xcnpnTHqvxcR2MkV4vfs6LNDd25VVCTfH62zxwQMFFYWLniJCw4.png)
There are stories that steal your heart, and this is one of them. My friend Daysi, who lives in Chile, has become a human mom to an adorable dog she rescued from her old rental home; This little dog was on the street and had been severely mistreated, so when my friend saw her situation, she rescued her and took her to the vet, as she had many skin abrasions and was malnourished. My friend gave her all the necessary care, along with the love that blossomed between them; that’s how Samanta became part of her family. Over time, my friend moved to a larger place, where she was advised to adopt a cat to help keep some unwanted animals at bay, since this house is in a rural area, and she agreed to adopt a little orange cat, initially for that purpose. But she was worried about the relationship he might form with Samanta, since, as they say, cats and dogs don’t get along by nature… However, as soon as this little one arrived, he immediately saw Samanta as the mother he needed and even tried to get her to nurse him, and the dog, as if to please him, let him—and just like that, the two formed a very special bond where they were together all the time. My friend was amazed by the closeness they developed, because they groomed each other in their own ways, played, slept together, and so on until Samanta became pregnant. By the time she went through this process, little Gaspar—as they named him, though he wasn’t so little anymore—looked after her at all times, right up until the moment she gave birth to her puppies. Gaspar was Samanta’s faithful companion during those intense moments—of course, aside from my friend, who has documented this entire experience, bringing smiles and surprise to those of us who have known them from the start at the sight of this unlikely pack; now they are Samanta, Gaspar, and seven beautiful puppies. This is a story where animals teach us life lessons through the empathy they show, the love, the protection, the loyalty, and, above all, the knowledge that they are part of the same family without distinction of breed or color; there is only love and companionship. How wise this mismatched pack is. I wanted to share this story and these photos with you that my friend sent me of her adorable pets. Cheers, friends!
![Añadir un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/EpLjnqM8ptWQ4Du5t5CwS6WYp1eCBU7DpXt3ACNMACzh5nnshNkUPpfATytGxcHuqFx.png)

body.title: DHF(Decentralized Hive Fund)
body.body:
> DHF - Is the DHF (Decentralized Hive Fund) truly decentralized, or does it largely depend on whale decisions? How do you think the DHF could be improved to be more decentralized? How do you think making the DHF more decentralized would help the blockchain, its users and projects?

The Decentralized Hive Fund (DHF) is an on-chain, proposal-based Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) on the Hive blockchain that funds community projects and core development.

The Decentralized Hive Fund may have the framework of decentralization, but it still depends on a user's Hive Power (staked Hive), considered as whales on the platform. This means projects that are funded are mostly influenced by the votes of a few whales, even when small accounts win in number. A project is likely not to be funded if whales give little or no support for the project—their vote weight.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHHBwmuaXtjPAAsxpy4NVKXHGiPXVnJaocn9DRs8XbQD/1779918857171.png)

**Image gnerated using Gemini AI**

**How to Improve DHF**

If votes are based on numbers instead of the weight of one's vote, it could improve how funds are distributed to the right projects. Numbers often show the heart of the people, but leaving the decision in the hands of a few with the advantage of high staked Hive introduces bias.

Additionally, votes could depend majorly on reputation rather than Hive Power. Reputation could mean influence and years of one's dedication on the platform rather than fixing it on whale decisions.

**How it Would Help the Blockchain**

1- It would prevent centralization: if everyone has an equal chance to vote, it would promote decentralization and eradicate centralization.

2- It promotes true community governance: it puts power in the hands of the community.

3- Transparency: accountability is easy, and people can see for themselves how the funds are allocated and which projects are voted for.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4dGL9aYjHECn1EajrVV4xSAesbKGGeUSrjhJN9vgC5X/1779918220803.jpg)

It's a subtle flash that the ground explodes,
the first word that the seed pronounces,
a living mantle that shines on the mountain
and against the gray of time he fights.

Green is not a color, it is a state:
the secret miracle of the leaf,
the sunlight that the faithful tree strips
to become nourished fruit.

In the veins of the jungle and the orchard,
The green circulates like a gentle river;
It is the corner that offers your rest
and gives life in the middle of the desert.

In the plant: it is the stubborn resistance,
the tender sprout that breaks the rock.
In life: it is the calm that we have,
the naked faith of one's own existence.

Looking at green is breathing quickly,
to know that the world, despite everything, insists;
that as long as a green branch exists,
No corner of the soul will be sad.

It is the color of time that blooms,
the eternal pulse of mother earth,
the beautiful truce that dissolves the war...
Green is life that never perishes!

Poem of my authorship.

Es un destello sutil que el suelo estalla,
la primera palabra que pronuncia la semilla,
un manto vivo que en el monte brilla
y contra el gris del tiempo da batalla.

El verde no es color, es un estado:
el milagro secreto de la hoja,
la luz del sol que el árbol fiel despoja
para volverse fruto alimentado.

En las venas de la selva y del huerto,
circula el verde como un río manso;
es el rincón que ofrece su descanso
y da la vida en medio del desierto.

En la planta: es la terca resistencia,
el brote tierno que rompe la roca.
En la vida: es la calma que nos toca,
la fe desnuda de la propia existencia.

Mirar el verde es respirar de prisa,
saber que el mundo, a pesar de todo, insiste;
que mientras una rama verde exista,
ningún rincón del alma estará triste.

Es el color del tiempo que florece,
el pulso eterno de la madre tierra,
la tregua hermosa que disuelve la guerra...
¡El verde es vida que jamás perece!

body.title: Is Healthcare a Right or a Luxury?
body.body: > As human as we are, there are some things we can’t do away with. We all expect and hope to live a healthy life but we can’t cheat nature, we are bound to slip when it comes to our health. We will along the line fall sick and need to seek medical attention. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHUXiAQEhY1ogGapbC8BVTPibEm2kY6X2eSvFELJhVzd/c483958b_6ddd_4aeb_8191_c028edabf3aa.jpeg) Healthcare is an integral part of human life. It’s not only about going to the hospital when you’re ill but also going for routine check ups to make sure everything is in place. When it comes to healthcare, we all know that healthcare isn’t free and it can be free. In Ghana here, the government tries their best to make healthcare very affordable for the average citizen but most are still not able to afford it. The good thing about healthcare in Ghana is that every citizen has the right to own a health insurance card which subsidizes every cost for you should in case you need to visit the hospital. Once you don’t have it, you’d have to cover the cost of everything and that’s why every citizen is encouraged to have their national health insurance card. Speaking of healthcare, we know and understand that the health practitioners who take care of us at the hospital on the daily basis are also human and that’s their source of livelihood. The doctors, nurses and even lab guys we meet in the hospitals all the time are not working out of the charity. That’s their job, the work day and night to keep us well and at the end of the month, they expect to be paid what is due to them so a they can also cater for themselves and their families as they also have their needs. Let’s not forget that the air conditioning, the electricity, the water and every other thing you get I enjoy at the hospital during your short or long visit is being paid for and maintained with money. The hospital you see didn’t just jump from heaven to where it is now. Money was invested in it and as a customer, you’re expected to pay what you’re due so as to keep the hospital running and ready serve you whenever you come around. Now, let’s talk about health practitioners and the general idea that most of them are in for the money. Let’s be honest, being a doctor means that you’re sworn an oath to protect the lives for others and cause no harm to them. But let’s not forget that doctors also feed from the work they do at the hospital and the institution runs and is maintained on integrally generated funds. Some people make decisions they know they’re not ready to fund, example pregnancy and then expect the hospital to take care of them for free. Things don’t always work this way because we can’t always work for free. Doctors do help people all the time- free surgeries, free drugs and what have you. But until when will we keep funding the lifestyle of others when it comes to their health. If you want to get pregnant and have kids, make sure you have enough money to cater for your pregnancy and any unforeseen circumstances because anything could go wrong an you would not expect your issue to be another charity case. We can’t help everyone with issues out there. We do the best we can as healthcare providers. Clients should also do try to help in one way or the other instead of just expecting everything to be given to them for free. If anything, the system needs to work to solve all these issues. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)
