body.title: On the edge of the sea/En el borde del mar(ENG-ESP)
body.body:
Yesterday I went out to explore part of my city. As I walked, I realized I was always at the edge of the sea, because this is a city surrounded by water. The waters surrounding an island make this city an island within an island.

I decided to take these photos, which show the reality and relationship of the city and its people with the sea that surrounds it, since Cienfuegos is located on a peninsula that itself grows into several other peninsulas, all extending into the vastness of the water.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQkxmZSogkTHWdvWUt4NeEPbgYVS3kEeeBC2got3pa71P/img_20260524_154505_809.jpg)

The colors then vibrate with the radiant sunlight, showcasing the essence of the Caribbean. Wide streets and houses with high ceilings and large windows to let in the breeze, small and large boardwalks, long and seemingly endless, where we can sit and enjoy the sunsets.

I remember coming here many times as a child to enjoy the rowing, canoeing, and kayaking regattas.
I also often swam in these waters under the blazing sun and had girlfriends who have since faded into oblivion.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6RLsqTCkX8yXmBiLD5nJPFKuDnzobSnBEmNh39w7Dzj/img_20260524_154458_295.jpg)

I also poured out my sorrows and loneliness into them, enjoyed the company of friends along with the cold breeze that comes from the sea at dawn, and I also knew how to behave in the face of the most beautiful love.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcFW6gSoG4zeBYPCqoaE42M14yuFcjrsLuhvixwWJs3sf/20260524_135236.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTrS7wUQWyg119yQzEWVAXSpXU8KTcxVGGYoDjyKmidR/20260524_134007.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbzC3QdgEHrqVRpx5rB9GzL3UEaWiuKNwftf2fZvbpUBi/20260524_133959.jpg)

And like him, I poured out my fisherman's longing that we all carry within us, here on the edge of the sea or the land (depending on how we see it), the edge of the city and of all the abysses.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRKPxk6KaPCa55HteHq5DatJ72abGnBtp7CJPFXFjoE8/20260524_134024.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVY4EGuTB3o3vzY8R4UPP3dV29hXJfLBVDNx5eRYcTprx/versi_n_en_espa_ol_2_.jpg)</center>

Ayer salí a recorrer parte de mi ciudad, mientras caminaba, me di cuenta que me encontraba siempre en el borde del mar, porque esta es una ciudad rodeada por las aguas, la circunstancia de las aguas que rodean una isla y esta ciudad se convierte entonces en una isla dentro de otra isla.
Me decidí entonces a tomar estas fotos, que muestran la realidad y relación de la ciudad y su gente con el mar la rodea, por estar Cienfuegos situada en una península que a su vez crece en otras varias penínsulas, todas adentrándose hacia la inmensidad de las aguas. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQkxmZSogkTHWdvWUt4NeEPbgYVS3kEeeBC2got3pa71P/img_20260524_154505_809.jpg)

Los colores vibran entonces con la luz radiante del sol y muestran todo el estilo del caribe. Calles amplias y casas de techos altos con amplios ventanales para permitir la brisa, pequeños y gigantes malecones, largos y eternos donde podemos sentarnos a disfrutar los atardeceres.
Recuerdo que de niño muchas veces vine a este lugar a disfrutar de las otroras regatas de remo, canoa y kayak.
También muchas veces me bañe bajo el sol ardiente en estas aguas y tuve las novias que han pasado hacia el olvido. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6RLsqTCkX8yXmBiLD5nJPFKuDnzobSnBEmNh39w7Dzj/img_20260524_154458_295.jpg)

También vertí en ellas mis dolores y soledades, disfrute la compañía de los amigos junto a la fría brisa que viene del mar en la madrugada, y también supe comportarme ante el amor más hermoso.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcFW6gSoG4zeBYPCqoaE42M14yuFcjrsLuhvixwWJs3sf/20260524_135236.jpg)

Y también como él, vertí mis ansias de pescador que todos llevamos dentro, aquí en el borde del mar o de la tierra (según lo veamos), el borde de la ciudad y de todos los abismos.

### Welcome to

# Wednesday ☀️ 12376

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779916705.643821) 

It was warm again this morning, over 10 degrees, but windy and therefore very refreshing. I did my usual walk around the peninsula using interval walking, but I didn’t feel quite as fit as usual because I’d slept restlessly last night, it was way too warm. I enjoyed the morning walk in a relaxed way and wasn’t really in the mood to look for photo subjects, but then this cute snail who was sitting on a tree at eye level caught my eye after all. I did a few breathing exercises at the usual spots. Oh, and the iris flower I brought home yesterday as a table decoration underwent an unexpected transformation overnight. It folded up completely and turned the water a deep blue, wow, but see for yourself.

body.title: Memories for Money
body.body: > This is not usually talked of, but memories make a good part of our humanity. It's that which keeps records of deeds, actions, moments, events, and all of that which we experienced. It's the reason why we can remember things that happened in the past, and even what is happening now will become a memory. Something that baffles me is how the human mind can keep records of memories; from childhood till adulthood. How we can remember certain events and many events make me wonder how large our memory is. With technology, we have the Read Only Memory (ROM) which allows storage of files and that has its limitations. With the human mind, I wonder if there's a limit. Well, I don't think there's a limit. However, we don't choose the things stored in our memories. From the bad and unpleasant ones to the good and beautiful ones, we have all of them in there. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSBHyGwDzaVzmi9ctvkicx7HX56htX2ZDgDQi5Qm5HqAP/photo-1608085575931-d0bd0aacd0d1.jpeg [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-glass-jar-on-brown-wooden-table-M6dAnUgiOlQ) Now, the prompt leaves the question, would I like to sell my memories for the sake of gaining money? Even when I know I would lose ownership of the memories and that can't be recovered, would I be willing to still trade them for money? That's actually a tricky one, because I reckon the fact that there are bad and unpleasant memories, losing them for money could be a win-win. I mean, you gain the money, you lose such memories. Good trade, probably. I don't want to completely see it as such. I know some people have gone through traumatic experiences and the memories might still be heavy upon them. It's fine if such people want to sell their memories. I'll say that, I don't think I'll be doing that. These memories are part of me but beyond just that, there are lessons even from the unpleasant memories. Our memories are part of what make us humans. We can't totally embrace the beauty and override the pains. Sometimes, those painful memories are a connection to people in the past. Like the memories of a loved one that was lost. Though such memories could bring pain, they still remind one of these people and one can ultimately find some solace or relief in these memories. From such memories and the pains or unpleasantness, we learn to make meaning of life and help others. I've come across people who went through situations that left painful memories. Rather than throwing them away, they healed and used them to make an impact and help others learn from their pain. I'm not touching the part of beautiful memories because I doubt I would even consider that, or that most people would. And if selling the memories involves all, not selective, it would be a big no from the onset. Even devices have memories, so why will I give up mine then? --- ###### Thank you for reading! Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@daverick/memories-for-money-d6p)

body.title: Solidaridad... el aliado más inesperado | Solidarity... the most unexpected ally
body.body: >\n\nHace poco leía una profunda reflexión de @damarysvibra sobre la solidaridad en los momentos de vulnerabilidad. Hubo una frase en su escrito que se quedó vibrando en mi mente con mucha fuerza: \

. Esas palabras me trasladaron de inmediato a una de las etapas más retadoras, dolorosas y, al mismo tiempo, sagradas de mi vida. Quienes hemos estado al frente del cuidado de un ser querido, sabemos que ese rol no se elige por descarte; se asume desde el amor más puro, transformando nuestra propia realidad en el proceso. En el año 2008, la salud de mi papá comenzó a deteriorarse sin un diagnóstico claro. Los desmayos recurrentes en las madrugadas nos desgastaban física y mentalmente a mi mamá y a mí, lo que me llevó a tomar una decisión radical: poner en pausa mi ascendente carrera profesional para dedicarme por completo a él. No hubo espacio para la duda o para delegar su cuidado en manos externas; él me había cuidado desde el primer día de mi vida, y acompañarlo en su debilidad era la única forma de devolverle tanto amor. Fueron diez meses de entrega absoluta, hasta que el destino nos llevó a buscar un descanso para él en un clima frente al mar. Nunca olvidaré la dolorosa certeza que se rompió dentro de mí al verlo en esa silla de ruedas en el aeropuerto; un presentimiento que se cumplió dos meses después, cuando cerró sus ojos para siempre.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9U5rMArqetedhEy7Y5KFbH7gEEe82pBoD7p1LjfW6C8/image.png) [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-hombre-viejo-anciano-8481979/)

> La vida, sin embargo, no suele ser una línea recta y pronto me tocó enfrentar una marea aún más compleja. Mi madre, una mujer de un temple admirable, fuerte, independiente, trabajadora y viajera incansable, guardaba sus tormentos en un hermetismo absoluto. Ese silencio le pasó factura tras la partida de mi padre, manifestándose en cuatro accidentes cerebrovasculares en el lapso de un año. El último de ellos provocó una caída, una fractura de cadera y, con ello, una entrega silenciosa a la cama; simplemente se rindió. A partir de allí, el panorama se tornó verdaderamente abrumador: la pérdida de uno de sus riñones y la necesidad de diálisis tres veces por semana. En ese punto me encontraba yo, con un bebé de apenas un año de vida y con una madre que dependía por completo de mí para su aseo, su comida y sus necesidades más básicas. Lo que más me dolía en el alma era verla plenamente consciente de su vulnerabilidad, saber que aquella mujer tan libre estaba ahora a merced de mis manos.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY3CLivaFDHCMKsRgmLSq7Kfcz4etFgH8R8Kwvhur6wCq/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/papel-pintado-de-navidad-las-manos-2906458/)

> Es aquí donde la perspectiva de la solidaridad muestra sus matices más íntimos y, a veces, los más solitarios. Mientras en los hospitales muchos se conmueven ante el apoyo de desconocidos, puertas adentro, en una casa, la realidad del cuidador principal puede ser un territorio de profundo aislamiento. De cuatro hermanos, siendo yo la menor, me tocó asumir el peso de esa realidad en absoluta soledad. El resto continuó con sus vidas, sus viajes y sus distracciones, sin que existiera un solo ofrecimiento para relevarme, aunque fuera por un solo día, para respirar aire puro. Sin embargo, la solidaridad es misteriosa y se manifiesta a través de los matices más inesperados. En medio de ese desierto familiar, quien tendió la mano no compartía ningún lazo sanguíneo con mi madre: fue mi exesposo. Después de haber transitado por un divorcio complicado, él salía de su trabajo y venía a casa a ayudarme; decía que amaba a mi mamá y por eso lo hacía. No quise, ni quiero hoy en día, cuestionar si en el fondo guardaba la esperanza de volver conmigo; lo que realmente importó fue su acción genuina. Los sábados, su día libre, se convertía en mi mayor apoyo para llevar a mamá a la diálisis: él era quien la cargaba desde la cama, el sofá o la silla de ruedas hasta el carro, y del carro al centro de salud.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVESX2WR3TVmVCrA1wrf8mQRcNZ5ZJHFX1SXbVzRg7dK/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/feliz-navidad-hombre-mujer-perro-2425121/)

> Ese esfuerzo compartido en el territorio del dolor transformó por completo nuestra historia. Aquel proceso tan duro nos fue puliendo por dentro, limando las asperezas del pasado y convirtiéndonos, poco a poco, en mejores amigos. Hoy en día, después de varios años, nuestra relación es tan sólida y cercana como la de dos hermanos. Al final, el post de Damarys me dejó una gran certeza: la solidaridad no se ha perdido, pero hay que saber dónde mirar. A veces no está en el círculo que por obligación debería cobijarte, sino en las almas que eligen quedarse a tu lado cuando el panorama se torna oscuro. Mi exesposo fue esa luz para nosotros, demostrándome que la verdadera entrega es un pacto silencioso que no entiende de títulos ni de contratos, sino de puro y auténtico amor. # ## _English_ #
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPrmLeYLbrBfAYoi2BXn9bFhCAh4LfvhrhjzoprabjPoY/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/fondo-del-dia-de-san-valentin-pareja-1845334/)
#
>\n\nRecently, I read a profound reflection by @damarysvibra about solidarity in times of vulnerability. There was a phrase in her writing that resonated very strongly in my mind: \

Those words immediately transported me back to one of the most challenging, painful, and, at the same time, sacred stages of my life. Those of us who have been at the forefront of caring for a loved one know that this role is not chosen by default; it is assumed from the purest love, transforming our own reality in the process. In 2008, my father's health began to deteriorate without a clear diagnosis. Recurrent fainting spells in the early hours of the morning wore my mother and me down both physically and mentally, which led me to make a radical decision: to put my rising professional career on pause to dedicate myself entirely to him. There was no room for doubt or for delegating his care to outside hands; he had cared for me since the very first day of my life, and accompanying him in his weakness was the only way to return so much love. It was ten months of absolute devotion, until destiny led us to seek rest for him in a seaside climate. I will never forget the painful certainty that shattered inside me upon seeing him in that wheelchair at the airport; a presentiment that came true two months later, when he closed his eyes forever.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9U5rMArqetedhEy7Y5KFbH7gEEe82pBoD7p1LjfW6C8/image.png) [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-hombre-viejo-anciano-8481979/)

> Life, however, is rarely a straight line, and soon I had to face an even more complex tide. My mother, a woman of admirable mettle—strong, independent, hardworking, and an untiring traveler—kept her torments in absolute secrecy. That silence took its toll after my father's departure, manifesting as four strokes within a single year. The last one caused a fall, a broken hip, and, with it, a silent surrender to her bed; she simply gave up. From then on, the landscape became truly overwhelming: the loss of one of her kidneys and the need for dialysis three times a week. That was where I found myself, with a baby just one year old and a mother who depended entirely on me for her bathing, her food, and her most basic needs. What hurt my soul the most was seeing her fully aware of her vulnerability, knowing that this once-free woman was now at the mercy of my hands.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY3CLivaFDHCMKsRgmLSq7Kfcz4etFgH8R8Kwvhur6wCq/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/papel-pintado-de-navidad-las-manos-2906458/)

> It is here where the perspective of solidarity shows its most intimate and, at times, its loneliest nuances. While in hospitals many are moved by the support of strangers, behind closed doors, at home, the reality of the primary caregiver can be a territory of profound isolation. Of four siblings, being the youngest, I had to carry the weight of that reality in absolute solitude. The rest continued with their lives, their trips, and their entertainment, without a single offer to relieve me, even for a single day, to breathe some fresh air. However, solidarity is mysterious and manifests itself through the most unexpected nuances. In the midst of that family desert, the person who extended a helping hand shared no blood bond with my mother: it was my ex-husband. After having gone through a complicated divorce, he would leave his job and come to our house to help me; he said he loved my mother and that was why he did it. I did not want to, nor do I want to today, question whether deep down he harbored hopes of getting back together with me; what truly mattered was his genuine action. On Saturdays, his day off, he became my greatest support in taking my mother to dialysis: he was the one who carried her from the bed, the couch, or the wheelchair to the car, and from the car to the health center.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZVESX2WR3TVmVCrA1wrf8mQRcNZ5ZJHFX1SXbVzRg7dK/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/feliz-navidad-hombre-mujer-perro-2425121/)

> That shared effort in the territory of pain completely transformed our history. That harsh process refined us from within, smoothing out the rough edges of the past and turning us, little by little, into best friends. Today, after several years, our relationship is as solid and close as that of siblings. In the end, Damarys's post left me with a great certainty: solidarity is not lost, but one must know where to look. Sometimes it is not found within the circle that by obligation should shelter you, but in the souls who choose to stay by your side when the horizon turns dark. My ex-husband was that light for us, proving to me that true devotion is a silent pact that does not understand titles or contracts, but pure and authentic love. > >![FOR YOUR INFORMATION] > >Las imágenes son cortesía de Pixabay. body.title: Detrás de mi experiencia en estos bazares🌸 [Esp][Eng]
body.body:
>

Hola amigos ✨, por acá nuevamente **Rousess** con una nueva historia que contarles💜.

![2  bazares.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/Ep3h9X95kNp7995BFkW65sS52ZjGTNs1twwME8tWVDZYqriYSRmwfNQBYcfCxFeWSyd.png)

Hace exactamente un mes me animé a participar en un bazar aprovechando que estaba elaborando nuevos productos y también porque ya estaba por cumplirse **1 año** desde la última vez que fui a uno 😳 (sí… pasó bastante tiempo). La semana previa al primer bazar fue un verdadero caos entre fabricación, compras, pedidos pendientes y además los cortes eléctricos que comenzaron en abril. De verdad, si les digo que fueron días intensos, me quedo corta. Pero bueno, a pesar de todo, se lograron los objetivos y eso era lo importante.

El primer bazar tuvo lugar en la **Plaza La 4 Caras** en Barcelona 📍 y gracias a Dios comenzaba a la 1PM, así que tuve tiempo de arreglarme, desayunar y terminar de organizar todo con calma. Como a eso de las 11AM ya iba camino al lugar y, como cosa rara… el calor estaba a **1 MILLÓN**. Cuando llegué todavía no había muchos emprendimientos montados, así que empecé tranquila a armar mis mesas y colocar los manteles. Pero en pleno proceso se me acercan dos chicos del staff para decirme que ese no era mi puesto 😃… y yo tipo: *¿cómo que no?* JAJAJA. Resulta que el croquis que me habían enviado anteriormente estaba distinto y mi lugar realmente era en una esquina pegada a uno de los muritos 🙃.


<div class=\

> ![2 bazares 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/EopvMekzDpwn3ABDgTfzgZxxq5jMxaNdmsPw4N4fsexNRShrLNEF8Zp4kiaRCwEPztL.png) Mi cara debió ser un poema porque honestamente me pareció súper injusto 😭, pero para no seguir estresándome con eso, moví todas mis cosas y continué decorando con la mejor actitud posible. No les miento cuando les digo que había DEMASIADA gente 😳. Pero casualmente teníamos al lado y al frente dos puestos enormes que terminaron opacando bastante la visibilidad de nuestro espacio. La mayoría de las personas se acercaban cuando el flujo bajaba un poquito. Aun así, gracias a Dios logré vender varias cositas 💕, aunque siento que nos hubiese ido muchísimo mejor con una mejor ubicación. Pero bueno, con fe y paciencia todo salió adelante. Ese día casi no pude pasear ni ver los otros emprendimientos porque me mantuve full pendiente del stand 😅, aunque por lo que me comentaron había muchas cosas similares a otros bazares anteriores. El evento terminó a las 10PM , pero como a eso de las 8:30PM ya había bajado bastante la afluencia de personas y muchos stands estaban recogiendo, decidí comenzar a guardar mis cosas también. Ahora, pasando al segundo evento, este se realizó en el **Paseo Andrés Bello**, ubicado en la Av. Intercomunal 📍. También fue en la tarde, pero esta vez me tocó cubrirlo completamente sola. En el primero me habían acompañado Mafer, mi novio y otros dos amigos, así que pensé que estar sola sería mucho más intimidante… pero sorprendentemente no fue así.

> ![2 bazares 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/EoEszeH4PKT9Aju4ikiXQV3huWGgGnphvbBqS2fDELAfRcWi79yuFngwxJKeXhH2efz.png) Todo estuvo bastante tranquilo, TAN tranquilo que ese día solo hice dos ventas 😂. Creo que ese lugar no suele atraer tantas personas para este tipo de eventos y además muchos de los asistentes iban buscando productos de anime muy específicos, mientras que mi emprendimiento tiene una vibra totalmente distinta. Por suerte, como a las 3PM apareció mi novio para acompañarme un rato 🥺💛 y honestamente eso me ayudó muchísimo porque ya tenía un dolor de cabeza horrible y la humedad me estaba acabando. Y para completar… GENTE, LLOVIÓ 🌧️😭. Menos mal estaba bajo techo, aunque igual una pareja emprendedora que estaba al lado mío tuvo que ayudarme a mover la mesa rápidamente para evitar que mis productos de papel se mojaran 🥹. De verdad, esas pequeñas ayudas en medio del caos se agradecen muchísimo. A pesar del cansancio, el calor, la lluvia, el estrés y todo lo inesperado… volver a los bazares me recordó cuánto disfruto conectar con personas, mostrar mis productos y ver cómo poco a poco Saikoma sigue creciendo 💖✨. Hay algo muy bonito en volver a espacios donde alguna vez soñaste estar y darte cuenta de que, aunque todavía queda mucho camino, ya he avanzado muchísimo . Definitivamente, fueron experiencias agotadoras, pero también llenas de aprendizaje, risas y momentos que valieron totalmente la pena. Espero seguir participando en más eventos, mejorando cada vez más y trayéndoles nuevas cositas bonitas 🫶✨. Gracias por acompañarme y leerme una vez más 💌. Nos vemos en el próximo post 🌷 **English ver.** Hey friends ✨, Rousess here again with another story to share with you 💜. Exactly a month ago, I decided to join a local bazaar since I was already working on new products and it had also been almost **a whole year** since the last time I participated in one 😳 (yes… it had been a long time). The week before the first bazaar was absolute chaos between production, shopping for supplies, fulfilling orders, and on top of that, the power outages that started in April. Honestly, if I told you those days were intense, that would still be an understatement. But thankfully, despite everything, I managed to get things done, and that’s what mattered 🤍. The first bazaar took place at **Plaza La 4 Caras** in Barcelona 📍, and thankfully it started at 1 PM, which gave me enough time to get ready, have breakfast, and organize everything calmly. Around 11 AM I was already on my way there, and of course… the heat was at a **LEVEL ONE MILLION**. When I arrived, there weren’t many businesses set up yet, so I peacefully started arranging my tables and putting the tablecloths on. But right in the middle of setting everything up, two staff members came over to tell me that wasn’t actually my spot 😃… and I was like: *what do you mean it’s not?* LOL. Turns out the layout they had sent me weeks before was different, and my actual spot was in a corner next to one of the walls 🙃. My face must’ve been priceless because honestly, it felt super unfair 😭. But instead of stressing over it, I moved all my things and kept decorating with the best attitude possible. I’m not exaggerating when I say there were SO MANY people 😳. But unfortunately, we had two huge booths right next to and in front of us, which ended up blocking a lot of our visibility. Most people only approached our stand when the crowd cleared a little. Even so, thankfully I managed to sell several things 💕, although I honestly feel we would’ve done much better with a better location. Still, with faith and patience, everything worked out. That day I barely had time to walk around or check out the other businesses because I stayed busy at the stand the whole time 😅, although people told me there were a lot of similar products to previous bazaars. The event officially ended at 10 PM, but around 8:30 PM the crowd had already died down quite a bit, and many vendors had started packing up, so I decided to do the same. Now moving on to the second event, this one took place at **Paseo Andrés Bello**, located on Avenida Intercomunal 📍. It was also in the afternoon, but this time I had to handle everything completely on my own 😳. At the first bazaar, Mafer, my boyfriend, and two other friends had accompanied me, so I thought being alone would feel much more intimidating… but surprisingly, it wasn’t. Everything was pretty calm SO calm that I only made two sales that day 😂. I think that location just doesn’t attract many people for these types of events, and most attendees were specifically looking for anime-related products , while my brand has a completely different vibe. Thankfully, around 3 PM my boyfriend showed up to keep me company for a while 🥺💛, and honestly that helped me so much because I already had a terrible headache and the humidity was making me feel awful. And to make things even more dramatic… GUYS, IT STARTED RAINING 🌧️😭. Luckily, I was under a roof, but even then, a couple who had a booth next to mine helped me quickly move my table to make sure my paper products wouldn’t get wet 🥹. Honestly, those little acts of kindness in the middle of stressful moments mean so much. Despite the exhaustion, the heat, the rain, the stress, and all the unexpected moments… going back to bazaars reminded me how much I enjoy connecting with people, showcasing my products, and seeing how little by little Saikoma continues to grow 💖✨. There’s something really beautiful about returning to spaces where you once dreamed of being and realizing that, even though there’s still a long way to go, you’ve already come so far. It was definitely exhausting, but also full of learning experiences, laughter, and moments that made everything worth it. I truly hope I can continue participating in more events, improving each time, and bringing even more beautiful things to share with you all 🫶✨. Thank you so much for reading and being here with me once again 💌. See you in the next post 🌷 **Créditos** - La traducción del texto fue hecho a través
>Cambridge\n- El diseño de la portada fue hecho en
>Canva\n- Las fotos fueron tomadas por mí y otras por mi novio y Mafer.

body.title: An Unhappy Children's Day!
body.body:
![Black and Yellow Grunge Cooking Youtube Thumbnail (50).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23u632earV8xGjqxX1F9VGCU1KgGTx5WraQtfXHXhKtP17rHEVWVoqtpteKu2K2HvSori.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) So, today is Children’s Day, and I just didn’t have it in me to say anything about it. I was mostly silent because what was I going to say? How could I say anything without sounding like a hypocrite and a liar? And so, I didn’t say anything, because there is nothing to be happy about, instead, there is evidence that there is fire on the mountain, and no one is even the slightest bit interested in putting it out And that’s the reality of the average Nigerian. There is fire on the mountain, and instead of working together to put out the fire, we’re individually focused on how best we can endure the heat. We look left and look right, we see people getting burned by the fire, but we do nothing, and we say nothing. Because we’re not the ones being burned. As long as it’s not us, the bad things are happening to, then we’re all good and fine. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) In the not-so-distant past, we used to blame our parents for not standing up to the government and making us inherit a shitty country with a shitty set of leaders. But now, many of us who made those arguments are now adults, and we can no longer blame our parents for their poor choices because now we’re the ones making them. We’re the ones watching as our leaders keep borrowing money, sending us further into debt, for projects that never get to see the light of day. We’re the ones living in constant fear and terror because nowhere at all is safe. Not too long ago, a group of children was kidnapped during a school assembly. Some teachers were also taken, one of them was beheaded. Yeah, that’s how terrible these guys are. 40+ kids were abducted, teachers were kidnapped, with one beheaded on camera and shared for the world to watch the horror. And then what happened? ![IMG_20230528_113916~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/242rM25kCuPuDkPWm9n5gHpAAPogvwjTWUku1doohfp2fhue6c7LALoA4JzWXAQqJ3sb8.jpg) The next day, more children still went to school. More teachers still picked up their bags and went to teach. Life continued. While I can’t blame the individual teachers, I do blame their union, because how will a member of your union suffer such a fate and you’ll keep quiet? That is what we’re facing in the country right now. Everyone who has a platform and has a voice to make remarkable changes that will benefit the people they lead is keeping quiet! People who should stand up and fight for the rights of their charge are docile as lambs being led to slaughter. It’s terrible because, despite how bad things are, there are those who are still speaking in favor of this bad government. There are still people blinded by party allegiance, religion, and tribe. Crazy things are happening, but what can we do? Nigeria gets worse every day. The insecurity keeps spreading, and we choose to be concerned by inconsequential things. I just hope that we find our way and get back to the right path. And I hope that the children and teachers will be found in one piece, because as long as they are in custody, as long as no one is safe in this country, then we can’t wish anyone a Happy anything. There is absolutely nothing to be happy about in this country. ![IMG_20230607_001140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/244xS7pJVBS2EcjA99Z1w5HjFettUYJDFDXebvWvXmH2Lq92JVcGvKE7AvY7cim2qxo5Z.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***

body.title: Walk on Fossestein/Waterfall-Path
body.body: > Hello, friends, travelers, and community! I hope you are all doing well and enjoying time with your loved ones. Today is Wednesday, which means many of us will share or read about the Wednesday walk in the community #wednesdaywalk, created by @tattoodjay. I’d like to share my post about my walk that started with a bit of discomfort but ended up being very pleasant and joyful. After spending a night at Hov Hyttegrend near the Likeholfossen waterfall, Started moving on to our next destination. A few kilometers down the road, we stopped to see a wooden plank bridge. After asking some locals, we found that we could walk to Fossestein/Waterfall Walk after crossing the bridge. We decided to take the opportunity for a little adventure instead of spending the entire day driving to our overnight stop in Stryn. It's a long drive, but the long summer days make it easier.

> We were walking along the Gaula River, which flows down into the Viksdalen Valley. On one side of the river, the landscape is covered by a forest, while on the other side, there are some farmhouses located beside the main road. The river creates a series of small waterfalls along this walking path, totaling 14 in number. Although they are charming, they are very small compared to the impressive Big Likholefossen.

> The Fossestein path was not clearly marked at the beginning. After noticing the uneven, slanted trail, I became concerned about my back. However, our curiosity about the waterfalls and our desire to rejuvenate our bodies and minds in nature motivated us to continue our walk.
> We walked a couple of kilometers to find the trail. Although it was a bit difficult, but the lush green surroundings and the soft sound of flowing water made it easier.
> Finally, we found the trail quite uncomfortable, walking on wooden stairs carefully beside the slanted ground with bushes connected to water very hard to know how deep it was.

> We found 4-5 small waterfalls at a lower elevation. They are very nice, calm, making a softer, gentle sound. At one place, I felt a spiritual atmosphere, but there was no place to sit. We did sit on those wooden stairs and just got lost in those very calming moments, in the sound of nature.

> And the very best part of the whole walk made us happy; we felt our walk was worthwhile. The forest was so beautifully covered with small rocky moss, with pine straight trees standing like soldiers. Tall tops of trees are trying to touch the sky. blue sky behind the tree top, beautiful scene of nature.
> The scene in this part of the forest inspires us to go further, but after 1/2 kilometer, we couldn't find the trail, so we turned back.
> After talking with people, looking at the surroundings, and moving back on the road,
> The place called Vik, Beautiful Norwegian houses alongside the road, and at the bottom of the mountains,

>

Driving along the road that winds between a range of small mountains, houses, and farms on one side and a beautiful lake surrounded by mountains and lush green trees on the other was wonderful. We were truly enjoying our trip in the amazing natural scenery. 
Thank you.

body.body:

Hello everyone I welcome you all to hive music festival week 189 round 3
And today I will be singing this mysterious song by Lawrence oyor with the song title,.
7 eyes 7 wings 7 scroll .

And today I choose to make it in an African high life music pattern combining it with my loop and the piano 

There are songs you like, and there are songs that read your mail. Lawrence Oyor’s _7 Eyes, 7 Wings, 7 Scrolls_ did the second one to me. The first time it came on, I wasn’t even in “worship mode.” I was just scrolling, tired, half-praying, half-worrying. Then that chant dropped: _“7 eyes, 7 wings, 7 scrolls”_ and my whole body went still. 

It sounded like Revelation 5 with a pulse. Ancient, urgent, alive. But the part that put me on my knees was right after: _“You are welcome oh breaker invade.”_ I had to pause the song the first time I heard it. _Breaker invade._ That’s not polite Christianity. That’s hospital-crash-cart faith. That’s “God, don’t just visit — interrupt.” I’d been managing problems, decorating cycles, trying to be strong. That line gave me permission to be weak and invite a stronger One. Since then, “breaker invade” has been my 3AM whisper, my prayer before job interviews, my text to heaven when Hive payouts delay. I don’t need God to knock anymore. I need Him to invade.

Then Oyor sings the line that stitched me back together: _“My deliverer is not asleep. I’m not helpless. I don’t fight alone.”_ I can’t explain what that did to me. I was in a week where everything that could go silent went silent — friends, opportunities, even my own motivation. I played that line on repeat while trekking under Abuja sun with ₦200 in my pocket. _Not asleep._ So the delay isn’t denial. _Not helpless._ So I still have authority even when I feel powerless. _Don’t fight alone._ So the math in my battles has already changed. I cried on that walk, but it was the kind of crying that empties you so God can fill you again.

_“Eh eh eh eh eh eh eh you are welcome oh breaker invade”_ is not just melody to me now. It’s protocol. It’s how I open rooms in the spirit before I step into them in the physical. And _“Oh oh oh oh oh oh I’m not helpless I don’t walk alone”_ is the footnote I add to every fear that tries to write a story over my life.


I’m not bringing perfect vocals to Week 189. I’m bringing a witness. If one person hears me sing _“breaker invade”_ and finally gives God access to that locked room in their heart, then my entry is already a win. If someone plays my cover on a bad day and remembers _“my deliverer is not asleep,”_ then the blockchain did more than store a video — it stored hope. 


Song lyrics 

7 eyes 7 wings 7 scroll 

You are welcome oh breaker invade 

My deliverer is not asleep 

I'm not helpless I don't fight/walk alone

### 1/🧵   The Busiest I've Ever Been Wrong

body.title: Drybone Raider: One Card Packed With Offensive Power!
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNLqXwSMqQGzD8G9vD4jNRb1TA1upBVvtJqyikYtLTy7Q/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

The Outsider ruleset is fast becoming one of my favorites. It has breathe new life in my Chaos Legion cards that I have left. I now regret selling my Djinn Oshannus and other cards that would have rocked today's meta in Modern mode. Luckily, I still have my legendary Drybone Raider. It's probably one of the cards built for pure offensive power. In today's post, we'll go through her lore, stats and abilities and show a sample battle where it effectively combos with another card.

***

# Lore

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6DjggAcBUkf4URXbSwmEMTg3LFcJzjHsc8esJBZMr1X/image.png)

From the Splinterlands lore on Drybone Raiders:

>*The Drybone Raiders are part of a tribalistic and fractious collective of anarchists led by the llamataur warlord, Eternan Brune. They control the Drybone Badlands in the Wild Northeast of Praetoria and often conduct predatory incursions into neighboring lands, attacking settlements for loot, plunder, and fun.*

>*Drybone Raiders generally armor themselves in primitive furs and leathers, wield all manner of swords and spears, and sometimes ride large, beast-drawn war machines into combat. They are known to create warpaint from dyes and the bones of their enemies. While undisciplined and disorderly, they are feared throughout the Drybone Badlands and its outlying areas for their ferociousness and tenacity.*

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUarubcnDWSEfPuergdgfL66VFhg26FWSgjWF4gcVufX/image.png)

The Drybone Raider is a legendary neutral card that is packed with offensive power. At maxed level, it deals dual damage of two range and three melee. It's a bit slow with only two speed but it also has decent defensive stats with three armor and eight health. It has only three abilities but they are all geared toward offense. The deadliest is her Dual Strike ability which makes her attack four times per round. She also has Shatter that removes her target's armor. Finally, she has Cripple that decreases her target's max health with each strike.

Too bad my Drybone Raider is only at level one but she is already deadly at that level. I would have wanted her at level two where she gains one more range attack and the Shatter ability but I didn't get any copies before the rewards were changed.


***

# Combos and Rulesets

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUDd4dAV6ohdY35NMg2ePoVjnaAYwaC7Wu284Mu9Waf5i/image.png)

Ideally, the Drybone Raider should play in the back because she doesn't have defensive abilities of a tank. Also, her range attack will be useless in the first position. She would thrive in rulesets that allow melee attacks from afar like Equal Opportunity or Super Sneak. This would allow her to attack four times in a round. She can combo with cards that have the Flank ability which would grant her Reach. Then she could be placed in second position to do her job.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhEoaF5g93nV3bCv1QPPSk9c4x4iA72WcZMp7nwgby26/image.png)

The featured battle was from one of my own. I chose my favorite Earth splinter with the elf archon that grants Execute ability to elves. I had the Doomshield Warden in first position. He has the Flank ability that grants Reach to the second position unit. This is where I put my Drybone Raider to take advantage of the Reach ability. From this position, she can attack four times in round with her dual attack and Double Strike ability. In third, I had the giant Forlorn Geomant. In fourth, I had the Foundation card Sorrow Harvester who decreases the enemy's life by one. In fifth I had the Ujurak Elder who buffs my team with an additional health stat.

The enemy had a higher level archon but his units and positioning were not that good and put him at a disadvantage inspite of his archon's level. My team defeated his tank and Taunt unit and soon his damage dealers were exposed to attack and got defeated.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0a2c286bd85d221b927b1993249dded1?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.body:

_____________________________________________________

So yesterday I ended up drawing 2nd position on the league table, but it was a league full of legends. The teams there are no joke, and honestly I wasn’t even set up right from the start. I messed up my lineup – I didn’t align my defenders properly with my keeper. They were all over the place, not on the same line, so every time the other team attacked it felt like free space for them.

Because of that one mistake, I ended up conceding more goals across all 6 games than I normally do. It was weird because I hadn’t been losing like that before. But yesterday was different. From the first whistle I found myself just defending, defending, defending for over 30 minutes straight. It looked like I didn’t even come prepared to play, but deep down I knew exactly where the problem was – my positioning.

Still, I had no choice but to play it out till the end and try to adjust on the fly. I was struggling the whole match, trying to fix things while under pressure. I know it sounds surprising, but at halftime I was already down 2:0. By full time it was 3:0. 

It really got to me. Losing like that, especially when I know it was avoidable if I had just set my team up right, is frustrating as hell 😭. But lesson learnt – against legends, you can’t afford to give them that kind of advantage.

body.title: KISS BLOG IDEAS: WEEK #213: Remember the good🪷
body.body: > Depending on who you ask, I might be someone who remembers everything or someone who remembers very little, but what I can say is that when something matters to me, I store every detail as if I were putting them in a personal box, and they're there for when I need them. On the other hand, when something isn't of interest to me, I forget it easily. No matter how hard I try to remember, I can't bring it back to my mind, and if I do manage to retrieve it, it's just fleeting glimpses, fragments, almost nothing.

> So, according to this, there's a certain control over what we remember, and that has to do with the attention we give to the things we experience. I believe that if we spend too much time dwelling on unpleasant and negative things, our memories will surely return again and again to those negative experiences, and what's worse, since remembering is living, we'll be reliving sad, traumatic, and devastating events over and over again, just like the first time.

> That's why I try, and often succeed, to only remember the good things, what I learn, the rewarding aspects, the useful things. Even from a negative experience, I try to remember the good things it left me with and even be grateful for what I experienced. For example, the last days of my nephew's life, who died of cancer, often come to mind. Remembering his illness and his premature death is so painful that it can make me sick. So, when those memories surface, I overlay them with the beautiful memories my nephew left me with: his smile, the stories he told me. Those memories make me smile and thank God for giving me the opportunity to have an angel as a nephew.

></center>\n\nObviously, sometimes it's inevitable to recall unpleasant experiences: memories jump to our minds without any logic. But when that happens, I don't dwell on those unpleasant memories; I don't \

or overthink it. I prioritize my mental health, my peace, my harmony. Because as long as I carry dark memories, I feel like I'm carrying a shadow that could break me at any moment. So the best thing I can do is forget, or at least not dwell on those memories.\n\nI once read that just as humans have learned to memorize facts to preserve their existence, they are also capable of erasing \

from their memory that could be detrimental. They can have a kind of selective amnesia, a partial erasure, according to their own convenience. This leads me to think that remembering or forgetting can be an act of survival. That's why, depending on who's looking at it, I can remember a lot or a little, because I try to remember the good things, the beautiful things, the things that make me happy, and I quickly forget the other things.\n\n
>All images are from my personal gallery and the text was translated with Google
>Thank you for your support, for reading, and for your comments, friends. Until next time

Fleece Johnson Attacks Chris Hansen During An Online Sex-Sting Operation https://youtu.be/3d200DatLtU?si=2lDicjGr4O3ZYh0q I was curious to know how Mr. Hansen felt about this cartoon video. In an interview, he didn't seem all that concerned about it. He even went as far as laughing it off, although he did admit that it made him feel uncomfortable. Below is the video. Chris Hansen Provides His Thoughts About The Cartoon Video Of Fleece Johnson Raping Him https://youtu.be/GhYHLsPYnCE?si=N3Cn6SAkw0sf5nSe According to recent information that has come to my attention, Mr. Johnson claims that he never committed any of the homosexual rapes in prison for which he previously took credit. series. However, Mr. Hansen hasn't seemed to be able to keep himself out of trouble with the law ever since the National Broadcasting Company (\

) canned him.

body.title: THE EVOLUTION OF CONTENT\n\nPart 2 — The Digital Revolution in Medicine and the Impending Compute Crisis
body.body: /> In my previous post, I defined my transition from a traditional Web2 copywriter to an Independent Web3 Researcher and Content Architect. I stated that the future belongs to those who build deep networks of knowledge rather than those who chase algorithms. To demonstrate this, we must dive into a critical intersection: the digital revolution in healthcare and the infrastructure bottleneck threatening its progress. Modern healthcare faces a silent crisis of scale. The global ecosystem generates petabytes of complex data daily—from high-resolution scans and genomic sequences to real-time biometric feeds. Our traditional infrastructure relies on human cognitive limits. Doctors are overworked, diagnostic errors persist, and life-saving patterns in rare diseases often go unnoticed until it is too late. The human brain was not designed to process this exponential volume of medical data alone. It is a massive computational challenge.

>Decoding Complexity: How Neural Networks Redefine Precision We aren't talking about robots replacing doctors, but about deploying advanced neural networks as an analytical lens. Where a radiologist relies on sight under pressure, a convolutional neural network (CNN) processes images as dense mathematical matrices. It can detect micro-anomalies statistically invisible to the human eye. This shift is unfolding across three clinical fronts:

>1. Early-Stage Oncology and Computer Vision Early detection dictates survival. Traditional screening often misses tumors until they cause structural changes. Today, computer vision models screen tens of thousands of scans simultaneously. By cross-referencing these against massive datasets, systems flag cellular irregularities years before clinical symptoms appear.

>2. Genomic Sequencing and Rare Diseases\n\nMapping one genome generates ~200 gigabytes of data. Finding a single mutation responsible for a rare disease involves analyzing 3 billion base pairs—historically a \
problem. Today, deep learning architectures process these datasets in minutes, pinpointing hereditary disorders with absolute precision.\n\n

>3. Predictive Cardiology Traditional medicine is reactive. The digital revolution shifts healthcare into a proactive, generative model. By routing data from wearables through predictive neural networks, systems analyze compounding anomalies in heart rate and blood flow. The algorithm detects signatures of a cardiovascular event hours before symptoms manifest.

>From Trial-and-Error to Generative Medicine The disruption goes beyond diagnostics; it reshapes how therapies are designed. The traditional drug discovery pipeline is a broken, multi-billion-dollar process of trial-and-error, taking 10–12 years to bring a drug to market. Generative technologies have flipped this paradigm. AI architectures like AlphaFold have predicted the 3D structures of virtually all known proteins. Because a protein's shape dictates its function, we can now simulate molecular interactions virtually in hours.

/>

Instead of blind guessing, researchers use deep learning to design synthetic molecules engineered to target specific diseases. Medicine is transitioning from treating symptoms to programming cures.

<h3 style=\

>The Centralized Bottleneck: The Compute Crisis As an independent researcher, I look past corporate PR to the underlying infrastructure. This medical renaissance is heading into a centralized bottleneck: The Compute Crisis. To train a neural network capable of processing genomic data or molecular simulations, you need astronomical computational infrastructure—access to thousands of enterprise-grade GPUs and immense distributed storage.

/> Currently, this is monopolized by Big Tech (AWS, Azure, Google). This creates three dangers: **Financial Exclusion**: Independent labs and startups are priced out. Innovation becomes a luxury only mega-corporations afford. **The Privacy Paradox:** Medical data is protected by frameworks like HIPAA or GDPR. Networks cannot ethically upload patient records to centralized clouds due to data-leak risks.

/>

**Structural Vulnerability:** Relying on a few data centers creates a single point of failure. If a provider changes its pricing or suffers an outage, critical global medical projects are throttled instantly.

<h3 style=\

>Conclusion: The Blueprint for Sovereign Infrastructure The science is solid, but the foundation of this future is structurally fragile and dangerously monopolized. To make life-saving medical AI resilient, we must decouple computational power from corporate gatekeepers. We need sovereign, decentralized infrastructure that cannot be throttled. In the next part, we will explore how Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN) are breaking the tech monopoly, turning idle global computing power into a censorship-resistant supercomputing network. Stay tuned.

>Follow my profile so you don’t miss the next parts of this series! 🔔\n\n**Disclaimer**: _This series is for informational purposes only. It does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice. Research and evaluate projects independently before participating in any decentralized networks_.

body.title: The Busiest I've Ever Been Wrong
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>




There was a period I was doing everything possible. Getting out of bed so early, doing what is necessary, replying to all text messages as fast as possible, and jumping from one task to the next without holding back. Some people around me were observant enough to see it. \

a friend told me, and that sounds very warm to me, which I love. And a few months later, I looked at myself and my schedule of work, and that was when I got to know that I had just been busy and busy with nothing that actually mattered. Like the way we do it over here, there's the trap no one cautions us about that celebrates hustle in a way that getting busy with something always has a feeling. It looks similar to progress in that we can spend a lot of time doing it. But we are heading towards the wrong direction, and we might not even pay attention to it until we are tired and we're still at the point we started. That year, the motion I had, I confused it with movement. Doing things that look so important but they were not connecting any dot to what I was doing. No feasible result. ![251093.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/251093.png) When I talk about being productive, the one I have learned slowly is so uncomfortable. It always entails dealing with one difficult task for a long time before actually finishing it while looking away from some works that seem urgent, but they are just a distraction. From the outside, it won't look impressive. It is very easy to perform being busy. But when it comes to being productive, that one is very hard, especially when one is not actually being it. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.title: Se que está versión mia no es tu favorita ✨
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrkThtmJ4EgvUHkiie2Ux7vqaRbQrU7FE6X3Jd8QSpdw/1779909727067.jpg)




Se que está versión mia no es tu favorita. Me ves cansada, uso pijama todo el día y mi cabello es un completo desastre. Ni hablar de mi cuerpo, lleno de estrías y kilos demás. Se que cambie, cambie tanto, que es fácil pasar de largo y no mirarme. Ya no soy esa chica y nunca más lo seré. Pero en medio de todos estos cambios, quiero que recuerdes quien fui, quiero que decidas cuidarme y valorarme. De mi, para mí. Porque me doy cuenta de cómo nos hablamos últimamente en la intimidad de nuestra mente. Veo la dureza en la mirada cuando cruzamos accidentalmente con nuestro reflejo en el espejo del pasillo, esa mueca de desaprobación que se asoma antes de que tengamos tiempo de apartar la vista. Hemos sido implacables, nos hemos convertido en la jueza y el verdugo de este cuerpo que, si te detienes a pensarlo con justicia, no ha hecho más que sostener un milagro tras otro.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3qKQuyVoEFv6Sv4pjEivGYww1EazWZerQHhrMANpwXz/1779910613270.jpg)


¿Recuerdas cómo era el silencio? Ese silencio absoluto que antes nos envolvía a voluntad, donde podíamos pensar sin interrupciones, trazar planes perfectos, perdernos en nuestras propias historias y proyectos, siendo dueñas absolutas de nuestro tiempo. Hoy, ese silencio es un lujo inalcanzable, una reliquia de otra vida. Nuestra casa respira ahora con el eco constante de dos voces pequeñitas, de risas, de llantos, de pasos apresurados y de demandas que no saben de esperas, ni de pausas, ni de nuestro propio agotamiento. Sé que hay días en los que el ruido simplemente abruma, en los que te escondes un par de minutos más en el baño o en la cocina, cerrando los ojos solo para respirar, anhelando desesperadamente un solo instante de aquella soledad que antes dábamos por sentada.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrxn1HG7PXqkVX9ejcUNiFkhS39EjLUZ4hfhuTNtJd9D/1779910663284.jpg)

Y quiero decirte algo muy importante: no te sientas culpable por extrañarla. Sentir que a veces no puedes más no te hace una mala madre; te hace humana. Te hace una mujer que se está entregando por completo, dividiendo su corazón y su energía todos los días, a veces hasta sentir que te quedas vacía por dentro.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTmpqbv5kWmRa13ef3RCRqgFM8rBUL2ECwanv1z7iBATN/1779910846079.jpg)

He visto cómo, casi sin darte cuenta, te dejas siempre para el final de la lista. El café que se enfría en la mesa porque hubo que atender un berrinche o limpiar un derrame, las noches de sueño fragmentado que te dejan los ojos pesados, la agenda dividida en mil pedazos intentando hacer malabares con el hogar, las responsabilidades, la necesidad visceral de crear y la exigencia de estar siempre presente. Y en medio de ese torbellino imparable, hemos olvidado a la mujer que sostiene todo este pequeño mundo.
Nos hemos convencido, casi como un castigo, de que este cuerpo marcado es un cuerpo estropeado. Qué ceguera la nuestra. Este cuerpo es un mapa. Cada estría es un río valiente por donde navegó la vida, el lienzo sagrado donde se dibujaron, milímetro a milímetro, nuestras dos historias más preciosas. Esos kilos de más, que tanto te mortifican cuando intentas probarte la ropa de antes, son en realidad el refugio cálido que ellas han buscado cuando el mundo les asusta, el nido mullido donde encuentran la paz absoluta que a ti, últimamente, te falta.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZBkTrJJ9LesPvZCEg5y6iVAPBfWyoJkeX1Wbhc1btVSw/1779913697253.jpg)

Por eso, hoy quiero pedirte perdón. Un perdón profundo y sincero. Perdón por las veces que te he exigido ser la de antes, sabiendo perfectamente que la de antes no habría soportado ni la mitad del peso que tú sostienes hoy con tanta gracia y entereza. Aquella chica del pasado era libre, sí, y era hermosa en su ligereza, en su ingenuidad frente al mundo. Pero tú... tú eres extraordinariamente fuerte. Tienes una profundidad en el alma que ella ni siquiera era capaz de imaginar. Has descubierto rincones de tu corazón que estaban a oscuras y que ahora se encuentran inundados por el amor más fiero, instintivo y desinteresado que existe en el universo. Has aprendido a amar doliendo, a cuidar estando rota.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJFjRB1pgvagAC5c77txxGTqCFjMupErtmHFj9YbCESM/1779914375066.jpg)

A veces te sientas a intentar crear, a darle forma a tus ideas, a recuperar esa chispa de mujer productiva, y la mente está tan nublada por el cansancio que parece que todo cuesta el doble. Te exiges rendir como si no llevaras el inmenso peso emocional de criar y sostener a otros. Pero, ¿acaso no ves el mérito enorme de seguir intentándolo? De seguir buscando tu propia voz en medio de todo este hermoso ruido constante.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNujUZnFqjMHd5mm9RRXYub8hBTF6rEFvtcqkFBgHvMct/1779914776078.jpg)

Por eso te escribo esto. Para hacer un pacto inquebrantable entre tú y yo. Necesito que, a partir de este preciso momento, me mires con la misma ternura absoluta con la que miras a tus hijas cuando duermen. Para ellas, tú eres un universo entero, eres el hogar, la seguridad, la criatura más hermosa y fuerte de la tierra. ¿Por qué te empeñas en contradecirlas? Ellas ven tu esencia, no tus medidas ni tu agotamiento. Necesitamos empezar a tratarnos con esa misma gracia, con una paciencia infinita y reparadora.
Si el pijama es nuestro uniforme de batalla estos días, que así sea. Si el moño despeinado es nuestra corona, llevémosla con la dignidad de quien está construyendo los cimientos emocionales del futuro. Pero te lo ruego: no te olvides de mí. No me dejes rezagada en el rincón de las prioridades. Tómate el tiempo de abrazarme en el silencio de la madrugada, de mirarme a los ojos frente al espejo y decirme que lo estamos haciendo bien, que somos suficientes. Permítete equivocarte sin castigarte, permítete llorar a mares cuando la carga sea demasiado pesada de llevar, pero nunca, nunca vuelvas a dudar de tu valor incalculable.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVtPZ4jyUgReug7WXKccJs97xJrBGF1oBgguB7g3acxMk/1779914893635.jpg)

Ya no somos la chica que éramos, es una verdad irrefutable. Hemos perdido algunas cosas en el camino, hemos soltado partes de nuestra antigua identidad para hacer espacio a algo mucho más inmenso y trascendental. Pero lo que está naciendo de estas cenizas de agotamiento diario es una mujer real, genuina, poderosa, que ama con una ferocidad que estremece el mundo. Así que, por favor, decide cuidarme. Decide quererme con convicción en esta etapa de transición incierta, en este caos hermoso y terrible que es dar vida y criar. Prométeme que, incluso en los días más grises, donde el espejo no sea nuestro amigo y el cansancio amenace con ganarnos la partida, cerraremos los ojos, respiraremos profundo y recordaremos que somos nuestro propio hogar. De mí, para mí, con todo el respeto, la compasión y el amor infinito que merecemos y que, por tanto tiempo, nos hemos atrevido a negarnos.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWsrCMBPxqYQxKsvtoBSfFudyLg55biWbfSk8vymCrmcm/1779915227215.jpg)

body.title: Un cafe + pensamiento sobre (IA)
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enrique89/23x1DPxsHheL6G3dNyBodqfAARvrX5BJgkxBEbbUN7ZL6WWAzKKUioHMRqthsaQGFKhsY.png)


Durante varios meses he estado congelado en el tiempo creando muchas cosas con la inteligencia artificial (IA), tomando dos direcciones: la primera, donde solo pienso en innovación, y la segunda, donde pienso en los límites como humanos que usamos una palabra común que es creatividad.

Hace unos días, mientras me tomaba un café, pensaba si realmente la IA nos da poder o capacidad real de avanzar, porque a pesar de que tengo muchas ideas en desarrollo, son pocas las que logro cerrar. Claro, son aplicaciones muy ambiciosas, que quizás necesitan bajarle el nivel, pero ¿por qué limitarnos?

Tomar café en una cafetería me hace pensar hacia dónde vamos debido a los grandes avances, pero también en cómo mejoramos nuestra habilidad de avanzar y cuestionar lo que nos genera la IA, sobre todo a nivel de código y diseño, porque por ahora no supera al humano en toma de decisiones.

Creo que allí está uno de los puntos más interesantes de todo esto. La IA puede darte velocidad, estructura, ideas, caminos y hasta soluciones que antes podían tardar semanas. Pero si no sabes preguntar, revisar, descartar y volver a construir, entonces solo estás usando una máquina para llenar espacios.

La creatividad no muere con la IA, pero sí cambia la forma en que la entendemos.

Antes quizás pensábamos que ser creativo era comenzar desde cero, tener una idea única o construir algo sin ayuda. Ahora siento que la creatividad también puede estar en saber conectar piezas, interpretar respuestas, corregir errores y decidir qué tiene sentido para una comunidad, un producto o una visión.

En el caso de Hive, esto me hace pensar mucho más. Porque no se trata solamente de crear herramientas con IA, sino de entender cómo esas herramientas pueden fortalecer una blockchain social, mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios y abrir nuevas formas de hacer marketing, contenido y desarrollo dentro de Web3.

A medida que pasen los años, quizás podamos tener mejores modelos, mejores formas de integrar IA en Hive y mejores procesos para que esto funcione de una manera más natural. Pero allí es donde la IA puede generar cierto caos con respecto a la forma de ver el trabajo.

Porque si una persona puede crear más rápido, diseñar más rápido y programar más rápido, entonces la pregunta no será quién usa IA, sino quién tiene mejor criterio para usarla.

Mientras terminaba mi café, llegué a una idea que todavía no cierro del todo: quizás la IA no viene a darnos todas las respuestas, sino a obligarnos a pensar mejor las preguntas.


Y en ese punto, creo que apenas estamos comenzando a entender lo que viene.


Saludos.

body.title: Nice day at the Danube river
body.body:
When the weather is getting warmer I like to spend my day at the danube river driving with my bycicle or walking on the river shore. When the weather is so nice and warm I also try to enjoy the cold water with my feet. In the past years I also enjoyed swimming in the river in summer time, this year it was a bit too early for swimming. But getting my feet wet is always nice there with the cold water on a hot day like in the last days. I was swimming at tha Lake Pichlinger already and the water there was already pretty warm, I assume it was nearly 20 degrees but I didn't meassure it, a woman there told me it was more like 18 according to her feeling. 

I am already looking forward to my visit in greece where I can swim in the sea again. This summer I will fly to greece again for 2 weeks and enjoy the beautiful mediteranean sea there.

body.title: On the trail of a Wemyss Cat 🐈
body.body: Hello Hello Hivers, Hivians and any other wonderful being who has stumbled onto this! I am back with another wee stroll in the spring sunshine here in the Kingdom of Fife in Scotland, come let's walk the now.
/> * * * ### Today it seemed we were on the trail of a very large fluffing cat! We have had some wonderfully warm weather and I had to have a wee stroll in to town to get some messages!
/> I just love a blue sky. Give me settled weather and my bones are happy.
/> I was in a hurry so was not really in a snap happy mode, although there are a few as the light when it is like this is the best!

/> You can still tell we have only hit spring, as this lavender bush once it blooms is a huge haven for bees, they are lots of them there in the summer, and it truly is a sight to behold! I have spent many a wee while chatting to the wifey that owns the house and snapping the bees. Talk about happy work!
/> Just round the corner are these two wee palm trees. Seeing them in the blue sky, anyone would think this is a warm country🤣
/> Down Swan Road and towards the sea front we go.
/> I love this big tree in the middle of the road! Nature at her finest. You are going to box me over with a road well fluff you I will come up through it!
/> We need to cut through this square as there is something there that I want to see..
/> It is one of the Wemyss Pottery cat styles.

/> I won't spoil the cat story too much as there are 17 to find ... [The Wemyss Ware Cat Trail](https://www.cattrail.uk/) is what it is all about! They will be the subject of a separate post... * * * And there we have it. That is my last Wednesday walk in May which happened to be yesterday. Anyway, have a good one.
/> This post is for #wednesdaywalk which was inspired by @tattoodjay ### Thanks for visiting and I hope you managed to get out for a walk this week.

/>

**_All images and ramblings are from me, the mad Scotsman TengoLoTodo unless otherwise stated. Note images are all snapped by me with my Google Pixel 9 XL Pro smartphone on Tuesday May 26th 2026. @tengolotodo May 27th 2026_**

DO WHAT YOU LOVE AND DO IT OFTEN
--------------------------------

body.title: From the Malecon of Havana Bay [EN/ES]
body.body:
![Cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wqpX4ph3BceCy2ucq11bWff68hZJCC9TUyASPBT8JjE6CdR6G5NvLNCjeEfTqLskALS.jpg) # English Version In Old Havana, from the Malecón and the Avenue of the Port, one enjoys one of the most beautiful views of the city. Not only because of the sea that offers a unique landscape, but because here there is shared an unrepeatable mixture of history, art, and daily life. It was precisely in this area where it was decided to begin building the city of Havana more than 500 years ago. With the passing of the centuries, the city grew and transformed, although some elements remain stopped in time. That permanence is part of what makes this place so special. # ![IMG_20260415_075953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/242NeoQaBV1knqhhx4KXvkcuU4xT1zNF9Xzq6M6n3kr26a7XP8qqUg8FhdwmBJ1jv6oXP.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_080119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/Eq9UDroGHyMMyXTo5KjffR2mAaDjpEqSE2xxVtn58bHVjLm29ryW3iEVTSMStdxn6B5.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_080902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EpxrDLDo1hbMxXpTLvKUPozW9ByPjyYetczz61ZpyUXnzwJKZe1jD5SaNGGniRuz4Jx.jpg)
From the entrance of the bay the ancient fortresses are still preserved, which served as a shield against enemy attacks, recognized for their great resistance and considered almost impregnable. On the other shore rises the Morro with its lighthouse, guide of navigators and inseparable symbol of Havana and of Cuba. Next to it, the fortress of La Cabaña, one of the best military constructions built in America by the Spanish colony, today converted into a museum and declared World Heritage. All this ensemble merges with the blue of the sky and the calm of the sea. # ![IMG_20260415_081554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23ywpnJZxvNDYoMqJtGpGHQJ2eF24yNGWAukLBeYfsx1CiJRzaoAs8jPzY8KNWG4HoHX7.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_081805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23zGcMTrBtVrEMd7huJhJbjHSXvYvrtREHV1xxs6Wq7Uj41Jj2TF9Lkur5DR2qfwhBUvM.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_081501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23zRxws5yyoFg78nTc1TP5RFwdJqkP1Boz97cVyooqL1Xb4SZk9x9UhHbFArtt8YWTEXR.jpg)
But not everything is history and antiquity. In this space modern art also mixes with urban life, creating a surprising atmosphere. An example of this is the great metallic sculpture of a Buddha in meditation, which stops the gaze of passersby and adds a contemporary nuance to the surroundings. # ![IMG_20260415_081216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EpvhyJqUVEzXAgEGfS2gtCYPcCB3Yzif7uzQQVzr2vNsUKZB714nKeTanQAUG1XVKrG.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_081647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wgQ5czJXSXsFT2oRKCeKoGqpHjTthjbJ6UH3NoP87bfb9F43nququs2gMpVKwsYEwgE.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_082117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wqi8xwLsXUmNfbF9TY1D922pTXXb56JDXhiLcM167KpbNKHz8rqdPHJGCzdp9zS96Vy.jpg)
The landscape is completed with the presence of people. The fishermen, with their simple rods, wait patiently seated on the wall. Families, young people, and tourists often walk around, enjoying the sea breeze and the calm atmosphere. It is a place where each visitor always finds a reason to stop. # ![IMG_20260415_081655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23wMWbCV8WX4GXJLyqFW55r1G41kX5ikXVLZFoEMUFvCz3LcKX6kBXXA2HUisGeUYoPGe.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_081810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/Ep3eo87n18KShTQy4ULx5gRgQG3VcxgrJFhYCcwTBswoXGEpAn91y7bMFMXb6cCctyE.jpg) # ![IMG_20260415_082333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23yd1Vjesro5LtiR9jqL7FmwyqGjpYXktKxs4hB2eYUf8GfDVfrqN7gTdpnrFnBiQHXeC.jpg)
That is why the Malecón and the bay are at the same time a stage of history, art, and daily life. A space that reflects the essence of Havana and that continues being an inseparable part of its identity. I hope you have enjoyed this tour through this beautiful area of my city. Cheers, until next time! [//]:# (!worldmappin 23.14521 lat -82.35528 long d3scr)

En la Habana Vieja, desde el Malecón y la Avenida del Puerto, se disfruta una de las vistas más hermosas de la ciudad. No solo por el mar que ofrece un paisaje único, sino porque aquí se comparte una mezcla irrepetible de historia, arte y vida cotidiana. Fue precisamente en esta zona donde se decidió comenzar a construir la ciudad de La Habana hace más de 500 años. Con el paso de los siglos, la ciudad fue creciendo y transformándose, aunque algunos elementos permanecen detenidos en el tiempo. Esa permanencia es parte de lo que hace de este sitio un lugar tan especial. Desde la entrada de la bahía aún se conservan las antiguas fortalezas que sirvieron de escudo contra los ataques enemigos, reconocidas por su gran resistencia y consideradas casi inexpugnables. En la otra orilla se alza el Morro con su faro, guía de navegantes y símbolo inseparable de La Habana y de Cuba. Junto a él, la fortaleza de la Cabaña, una de las mejores construcciones militares levantadas en América por el coloniaje español, hoy convertida en museo y declarada Patrimonio de la Humanidad. Todo este conjunto se funde con el azul del cielo y la calma del mar. Pero no todo es historia y antigüedad. En este espacio también se mezcla el arte moderno con la vida urbana, creando un ambiente sorprendente. Ejemplo de ello es la gran escultura metálica de un Buda en meditación, que detiene la mirada de los transeúntes y añade un matiz contemporáneo al entorno. El paisaje se completa con la presencia de las personas. Los pescadores, con sus cañas sencillas, esperan pacientemente acomodados en el muro. Familias, jóvenes y turistas pasean por los alrededores, disfrutando de la brisa marina y del ambiente tranquilo. Es un sitio donde cada visitante encuentra siempre un motivo para detenerse. Por eso, el Malecón y la bahía son al mismo tiempo escenario de historia, arte y vida cotidiana. Un espacio que refleja la esencia de La Habana y que sigue siendo parte inseparable de su identidad. Espero que hayan disfrutado este recorrido por esta hermosa zona de mi ciudad. Un Saludo, hasta la próxima!

body.title: Being Careful And Smart In The Online Space Full Of Scammers
body.body: > Everyday a lot of people get scammed online because these scammers come with different tactics. Being aware of this, I don't easily give in to their urgent antics because that is one thing that is common among them. They create fear, claiming to be in a haste just to pressure their victims to fall prey to their scam. I'm very careful when it comes to clicking on random links sent on messages or putting out my personal information online. When I receive messages from friends asking me to click certain links, before doing that, I'd first call to confirm what the message is all about. I also confirm if the link is a secured one or not. I got a call sometime ago in the year 2021 from a supposedly “customer service” of one of the banks I bank with. The caller mentioned my name in full, telling me that the date of birth on my bank account did not tally with that of my BVN (Bank Verification Number). With urgency in his voice, asking me which is the correct one. I asked to know the particular bank he was calling from because I bank with more than one bank. He became angry saying I was wasting his time, asking me if I didn't know the name of my bank. But I insisted he give me the bank name, he then hung up the call. I laughed out loud. 🤣 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmemGDfKsSNaE8f4BAPK3heVtENZGf9XtZ1NvB3G7y1KMa/1779914359025.png) There was a day I received a chat from one of my top business partners asking me to quickly make a transfer of 70k to a certain beneficiary, that she had exceeded her limit for the day. This is someone I have much respect for and I also considered a friend and mentor. Out of our over 8 years in partnership, she'd never made such a request from me, so that got me thinking. Though I almost fell for it, a second thought asked me to call her for confirmation. It turned out that her phone was hacked. Scams from unsuspected family or friends are the most dangerous, because they target one's emotion, knowing it's from a loved one. To stay safe from scammers on the online space, one has to be extremely cautious, because those guys are smart. But one has to outsmart them by always verifying the source of any message received before replying. Ensure to use a safe payment method while making purchases online and avoid using gift cards for online purchases. A lot of people had been scammed through this means. It's also important to regularly update the operating system and antivirus software to avoid being vulnerable to scammer's schemes. Lastly, like I mentioned earlier, scammers use urgency tactics to pressure their victims to fall for their schemes, through making hasty decisions as a result of pressure, false claims or threats. It's very important to identify such tactics and be calm so as not to fall for their antics. Also, passwords should be strong, containing numbers, letters and symbols, with these one could to a very large extent avoid being scammed. This is how I protect myself from online thieves.
