body.title: The Tale of Alicia - ENG- SPA
body.body: > In life, timing and place are often essential to achieving our goals and dreams. When these two things are misaligned with our vision, the result isn't what we expect. Alicia had to learn this the hard way because she experienced it firsthand when she wanted to start out as an independent singer and guitarist. Back then, she had big dreams and a strong desire to go far. She had been through a lot in the past, but the hope of becoming who she wanted to be gave her the strength to keep going. The problem for her was that she was going to run up against the law of life, the one that dictates and decides when it's your time to shine. Because you can have many desires to be famous, but if life decides it's not your time, you won't achieve it, and Alicia wasn't ready to face that. She lived in a country that didn't have much of a musical culture. Most people weren't interested in learning music or dedicating themselves to it. Although people did listen to music, most listened to international artists; local artists weren't well-received in most cases because there wasn't a culture of listening to them. It was that simple. Alicia ran into this wall, the first one she had to overcome at full speed because of her burning desire to be a singer.

> En la vida muchas veces el momento y el lugar son indispensable para poder alcanzar nuestras metas y sueños. Cuando esas dos cosas a veces están desalineadas con nuestra visón de las cosas que buscamos pues el resultado no es el que esperamos. Alicia tuvo que aprender de esto por las malas porque pasó por esto cuando quería iniciar como cantante y guitarrista independiente. En aquel entonces tenía grandes sueños y muchos deseos de poder llegar lejos. Ella había pasado por mucho en el pasado pero la esperanza de ser quien quería le daba fuerzas para continuar. El problema para ella es que se iba a tocar con la lay de la vida, la que manda y decide cuando es tu momento de brillar. Porque puedes tener muchos deseos de ser alguien famoso pero si la vida decide que no es tu momento pues no lo lograrás, y eso Alicia aún no estaba preparada para conocerlo. Ella vivía en un país que no tenía mucha cultura musical. A la mayoría no le interesaba aprender música o dedicarse a ella. Aunque la gente si escuchaba música la mayoría lo hacia de cantantes internaciones, los locales no eran bien recibidos en la mayoría de los casos porque no existía la cultura de escucharlos. Así de simple era todo. Alicia chocó contra este muro que fue el primero con el que tuvo que impactar a toda velocidad por los grandes deseos que tenia de ser cantante.
![hannah-mcatamney-lqYIflLaX-A-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGTZ1P9ZYRuSNbHmGSTxWbMLNJAVuyrTMckJRNAxWp5ztR8YsJZRpkZvVtqWP7ZLcSR.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> That first wall was called location. Because she was in the wrong place to grow as the singer she aspired to be. At that moment, she didn't redeem herself immediately. Hope still drove her, and she thought that although she hadn't had any luck locally, perhaps if fate smiled upon her and life placed her in other places, she would be heard as an international singer. But then she crashed against the second great wall, the most difficult because it ended the last hope she had left: the merciless moment. She wasn't in the best position to start singing. She lacked singing experience, and at that time, people preferred other types of music. So, as before, she couldn't make it as a singer. Her dream, then, with these two hard blows, began to crumble. It was like the drop that broke the camel's back, a glass already full to the brim. And the worst part was that there wasn't much she could do, at least from her perspective. There weren't many options left. One option was to move, but she didn't have the money or the energy for that. And just thinking about waiting for a more convenient moment made her sick. She didn't want to wait any longer; she wanted to shine now, because she had already waited long enough. Since she couldn't do anything to change things, she felt so awful that she rejected the idea and thought that perhaps her dream was too high for someone like her. Perhaps she had aspired to too much without realizing it. For that reason, she put music aside and started doing whatever work was available in her town: housework, cleaning, and things like that. Even so, deep in her heart, a tiny bit of hope remained, waiting to sprout again.

> Ese primer muro se llamaba lugar. Porque se encontraba en el lugar incorrecto para poder crecer como una cantante a la que aspiraba. En ese momento ella no se redimió a la primera. La esperanza aún la movía y pensaba que aunque no hubo suerte de forma local tal vez si la suerte quería y la vida la dejaba en otros lugares si la escucharían como una cantante internacional. Pero ahí impactó contra el segundo gran muro y el más difícil porque acabó con la esperanza que le quedaba, el despiadado momento. Ella no estaba en el mejor momento para empezar a cantar. Le faltaba experiencia en el canto y en ese entonces las personas preferían otros tipos de música. Así que como en la vez anterior no pudo salir adelante como cantante. Su sueño entonces con estos dos golpes tan duros empezó a derrumbarse. Fue como la gota que derramó el baso que ya estaba lleno hasta el borde. Y lo peor es que no había mucho que se pudiera hacer, al menos desde su perspectiva. No habían muchas opciones a seguir. Una opción era mudarse pero no tenía el dinero para eso ni las energías. Y solo pensar en esperar a un momento más conveniente la enfermaba. No quería esperar más ella quería brillar ya, pues ya había esperado bastante. Al no poder hacer nada para cambiar las cosas simplemente se sintió tan mal que rechazó la idea y pensó que quizás su sueño era demasiado alto para alguien como ella. Quizás aspiró a mucho sin saberlo. Por esa razón dejó la música a un costado y empezó a hacer lo que había disponible en su pueblo. Trabajos de casa en casa, limpieza y cosas así. Aún así en su corazón, en lo más profundo quedaba un poquito de esperanza esperando brotar de nuevo.
![vitaly-gariev-b-7yKCvivnA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uQp2awUyBeE6obzKXXh6aniBwAXH1kBB3eia1idbDTpQEzK2Yz69GgoQJghLXVzDEwz.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> A long time later, she met Gustavo. He would become her husband. Together they moved to another country and later had children. Throughout their marriage and the years that followed with their children, circumstances were changing, but Alicia hadn't noticed because she was so busy with her home life. Then one day, it seemed that luck and life itself smiled upon her once more. Gustavo was on the sofa browsing the internet and listening to music. She recognized the music; it was the kind she used to sing and play when she was starting out, though it never amounted to anything. She asked him if people liked that music now. He said yes, it was incredibly popular. It was the most listened-to music at the moment. That was clearly the sign she had been waiting for, and the hope that had been kept hidden in her heart was waiting to blossom again. So, shortly after, with renewed hope, she tried her luck once more. But now she was in a new country, and at a different time. So, yes, for the first time, she was able to begin to achieve her goal. Of course, she'll have to work hard to get where she wants, but everything is in her favor now. From all this, she's learned that sometimes you just have to wait and know when to start. Success awaits her.

> Mucho tiempo después ella conoció a Gustavo. El sería su futuro esposo. Juntos se fueron a vivir a otro país y luego tuvieron hijos. En todo ese tiempo de casamiento y los años venideros con hijos las circunstancias estaban cambiando solo que Alicia aún no lo había notado porque estaba ocupada en su vida en el hogar. Pero cierto día, parece que la suerte y la vida juntas llegaron de nuevo a su vida. Gustavo estaba en el sofá viendo el internet y escuchando un poco de música. Ella reconoció esa música, pues era el tipo que le gustaba cantar y tocar cuando estaba empezando, lo que nunca llegó a nada. Ella le preguntó que si a la gente le gustaba esa música ahora. Y él le dijo que sí, que era súper popular. Era la más escuchada del momento. Eso claramente fue la señal que ella esperaba y que la esperanza que estaba guardada en su corazón estaba esperando para brotar de nuevo. Así que poco después con la esperanza renovada probó suerte de nuevo. Pero ahora estaba en nuevo país, y en un momento distinto. Así que si, pudo por primera vez empezar a alcanzar su meta. Claro habrá que trabajar mucho para poder llegar hasta donde quiere, pero ella tiene todo ahora su favor. De todo esto ella aprendió que a veces solo hay que esperar y saber elegir el mejor momento para comenzar. El éxito ahora la espera.
![tony-pham-7YfMrHWBm0U-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/Eoprv8RCU7ix43VUgt2idpCUTxjoirDPdKCcJgzLVoT39MuUp3Z8NyQfLigrdJSMLjz.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

body.title: Ya se siente la fiebre Mundialista ⚽️
body.body:
![1000997700.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqieFZzS9CS3nBZatDFJ4s3Zf1ozFAvyDv8eRQyvNs6zFnvWaft5sFcizmobcxsT7w1.png)
---
En mi casa ya se siente la fiebre mundialista y es que desde siempre me ha gustado el Mundial de Fútbol, más aún desde que vivo en Ecuador, pues aquí el deporte con mayor fanáticada y renombre es el fútbol. Siempre que pases por un estadio o sea el mes de Octubre y Noviembre, podrás conseguir todo lo relacionado al fútbol y ver tanto a grandes como adultos lucir con orgullo sus camisetas. Ecuador participará en el Mundial 2026 y en esta oportunidad estará con una potencia en el fútbol como lo es Alemania quienes incluso fueron campeones del mundo, a pesar de las opiniones encontradas. Por otra parte, en el equipo que está (Equipo E), existen otros países que podría darle la oportunidad a Ecuador de llegar un poco más lejos, dependiendo también de su actuación en la cancha.
![20260525_210131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tmKwd6wDFPcrtpApU19oB6ePmiuwE9mDXs8XBG9Tfi4bY9KRe5e1QRMfpgc8rsXCRid.jpg) ![20260525_210158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wgKcm6fXrkYPHJXstCH6Xfsz6r4Rgygqr5efUUdceCRLSbJGv7GJEWBacVj7jeeDGR6.jpg)
Uno de los recuerdos que tenía de cuando era niña y adolescente, era que llevábamos álbumes sobre el Mundial y mis hijos ahora son los que disfrutan de hacer los mismo. Casi en todas partes venden el álbum y los cromos del Mundial, así que es casi una obligación tener uno jajaja. Los cromos cuestan $1.20 y hasta ahora no han salido el favorito de mis hijos: Messi. También hay premios de balones por órdenes de compra. Hace poco nos ganamos uno y aunque no es oficial, los niños se alegran de tenerlo y se dirviente con el. Este álbum es muy completo. Muestra las mascotas que han existido durante cada Mundial, recordándonos que este año tendremos 3, ya que el mundial se llevará acabo en 3 países distintos. Lo cuál ha traído algo de controversia entre la fanáticada que visita los estadios.
![20260525_210241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tvg5z7eiA7CtMB2NhaUwU75ep6cz6nStrJ6bzXi7RgTyk8HJxhmESRfuGaCXdSrvjL5.jpg) ![20260525_210253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tvryQJFMyjsSzhPj3PuUzy5P7Kw38SGyzzQ5STodKSt3gBFpDGeNB8aGu753N5sYniF.jpg)
En este álbum tambien encontrarás la historia de los Mundiales, podrás llevar los goles anotados, equipos que vayan ganando y concer sobre los récords mundiales que existen. |![1000994670.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23w2j7Dkm4C2B7hxAibmYcZ63sAUZFuSjETNRCryqWeEwj3XHfJ8PTtsX5xxLWB2sL36N.jpg)|![1000994660.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23w2jHSSkneYeQDPegGJFSXzfsjm9b4k2t2FpMMAL2Diy1W9PKsH7Qe8Qhv7iXqpPzQnW.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260527_144307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqnf7AmwNRVTWKj9jfTUdD2Vj9CEJvFZVfGPGquypo7KcHxahZ5Ynszs4VjappTcumt.jpg)|![1000997815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xVM8vMGBzQrxwor2ANbuMq2zFkZq69Fcpt2CqpARGZHdRqzvKcPimFkxQkoZoEQDWUG.jpg)| |-|-| Este es un álbum muy completo, un coleccionable como les decía yo, ya que en mis tiempos teníamos guardados en casa de mis padres, algunos álbumes. Aún no sale ningún cromo de la selección de Ecuador, pero ya nos salió el del Balón Oficial. La más emocionada en llenar este álbum es mi hija mayor, aunque ella realmente se preocupa más es por conseguir a Messi, como ya les dije jajaja. Esta es mi forma de hablar sobre deporte, desde la pasión que nos lleva a disfrutarlo aún sin estar en la cancha, desde la vivencia de los es sucede más allá de las estadísticas y desde el corazón hincha que motiva a tu equipo.
---

body.title: ‎Patience Is More Than Just Waiting
body.body:
‎
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎Before, I used to think patience simply meant waiting silently for things to happen. But I realized with time that patience is actually much harder than that. It’s not about sitting around doing nothing but it’s about continuing to put in effort even when you’re not seeing results yet.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTECN2pWEth5NRTjtW1nKzsXJtRQd9WRo9xDJS6Qash9K/denfran-stone-tower-4519290_1920%201.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/stone-tower-balance-meditation-4519290/)

‎Honestly, that part can be truly be frustrating.
‎
‎There have been times when I felt like I was doing everything right but nothing seemed to change. You work hard, stay consistent, and still feel stuck in the same spot. Sometimes you even start comparing yourself to people who seem to be progressing faster than you. I have been in that situation many times.
‎
‎And one thing I have learned though is that life does not always immediately reward people. Some things just take time.
‎
‎I like using the example of planting something. When you sow a seed, you don’t expect it to grow overnight. But you keep watering it even when you cannot see anything on the surface yet. That doesn’t mean nothing is happening. Growth is still taking place behind the scenes.
‎
‎That’s how patience works in real life too.
‎
‎Patience is still applying for opportunities after getting ignored several times. It’s still learning, improving yourself, and showing up every day even when motivation is low. It’s continuing the journey without rushing the outcome.
‎
‎I used to think successful people had some special secret, but now I feel a lot of them simply refused to stop too early. While others gave up because results were slow, they stayed consistent.
‎
‎And to be honest, consistency is not always easy. Because there are days you will feel tired and discouraged. Days when quitting feels easier than continuing. I have had moments like that myself. But the breakthrough sometimes comes after the stage where most people decide to stop trying.
‎
‎That’s why I now try to focus less on immediate results and more on steady progress. Even small improvement is still improvement.
‎
‎And at the end of the day, patience is not about doing nothing. It’s about doing everything you can while understanding that some results need time before they finally show up.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

body.title: #Monomad Challenge - not static
body.body:
### Good afternoon, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes. > ##### _A New Day_ How often do we realize that when we wake up, we are actually being given the chance to live another day, a few more hours, or even just one more minute? It is always something we are granted, not something that is guaranteed. One day, we will not wake up, or perhaps we will not even fall asleep—in the true sense of the word, not in some romanticized way. Rarely do we have the true opportunity, upon waking, to simply let the silence wash over us. We transition from one state to another, and often adopt automatic behaviors without even thinking or truly realizing that we are doing them. We wake up, turn on the bedside lamp, slip on our slippers, and almost mechanically head to the bathroom for our morning routine. Minutes later, we realize we’ve probably taken longer than we should have, especially on this day, when we wanted to get to work early so we could start working on that report that should have been finished twenty-four hours ago... Once at work, we drink our coffee, still half-asleep and unaware of the true miracle unfolding before us. This week, almost everything was just as I’ve just described. But fortunately, not everything. In fact, I woke up, and instead of jumping out of bed, after turning on the table lamp, I went to open the blinds. The day was already making itself known. It was still 5:45 a.m., but there was already enough light that the streetlights didn’t need to be on. I gazed for a few moments at the view I always see from my bedroom window, but today I lingered a little longer. I let myself be carried away by the pleasant sensation of connection with the outside world. Nothing different happened outside of me. Only I had the sense that I could do something different. I followed the same morning hygiene routine, but even though it took the same amount of time—or roughly the same amount of time as it always does—I didn’t worry particularly about whether I was half a minute late or not. That wasn’t important. The first rays of light entered me, and it seemed as though my body woke up more quickly. When I arrived at work, I lingered a while in the outdoor park and the entrance lobby. Everything was probably just the same as on other mornings this week, but I took it all in as if it might actually be my last morning. Nothing could guarantee that I’d be here tomorrow to witness the new day. _Everything looked the same on the outside._ The world was exactly the same. Not static. > ###### _And inside me, I let that small difference I made at the start of my morning leave me not static, but completely different._

body.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: JUANA LA VIRGEN (2002).
body.body:
***Hola mi gente bella espero que todos esten super bien, un gran abrazo para todos, el dia de hoy les traigo la ediciòn sobre una de las novelas mas grandes que se ha realizado en el pais, que tuvo muchisiomo exito y la cual se ha realizado varios versiones mas actualizadas en otros paises. Espero les guste.***

---

![205..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23x1KynUxzfsFPRiqMtbntC78UfpSqvt4Fw7tCkMiyh4nrDJqqzhnQekxbcuhw1YfuEfP.jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***Juana la virgen es una telenovela venezolana producida y transmitida por RCTV en el año 2002. Fue creada y escrita por la célebre autora Perla Farías. La producción rompió con todos los moldes tradicionales del melodrama al presentar una premisa insólita, audaz y controvertida para la época: una adolescente de 17 años que queda embarazada siendo virgen, debido a un error médico de inseminación artificial. La novela se convirtió en un fenómeno social y de audiencia tanto en Venezuela como en el exterior.***

---

<center>![httpsjanethevirgin.fandom.comwikiJuana_la_Virgenfile=Newjuanalavirgen.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/Eq5E1eq3GBKdanCzCdYaACpSrLyGr4U6Q8uX2TaFebtbSxK9fXM84eG4VFk9t2fzUb9.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsjanethevirgin.fandom.comwikiJuana_la_Virgenfile=Newjuanalavirgen.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***-Titulo Original: Juana La Virgen.
-Productora: Radio Caracas Televisión (RCTV).
​-Año: 2002 (153 episodios).
​-Guion: Perla Farías.
​-Dirección: Tony Rodríguez.
​-Protagonistas: Daniela Alvarado y Ricardo Álamo.
​-Antagonistas: Roxana Díaz, Norkys Batista, Eduardo Serrano y Eliana López.
​-Elenco Estelar: Juan Carlos Alarcón, Jonathan Montenegro, Marisa Román y la primera actriz Amanda Gutiérrez.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por Los Bacanos.***

---

<center>![httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesSpv-target-images94b80ccdfc2c1f30f0ee965a051853e6016e849e7c25731def37f6ecc3828240.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EogPCzAr4tVNtpsb4rACqYDC18XQho2sfLqWHtZkGxwyDhQD1cBuHTJZSHhEm4MdXD4.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesSpv-target-images94b80ccdfc2c1f30f0ee965a051853e6016e849e7c25731def37f6ecc3828240.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***Juana Pérez (Daniela Alvarado) es una joven alegre, humilde y optimista de 17 años que sueña con ganarse una beca para estudiar periodismo en el extranjero y jura mantenerse virgen hasta el matrimonio. Por su parte, Mauricio de la Vega (Ricardo Álamo) es un exitoso empresario, director de una prestigiosa revista, que acaba de superar un cáncer, quedando estéril; su única esperanza de ser padre es una última muestra de semen congelada.***

***​El destino se sale de control cuando Juana asiste a una consulta ginecológica de rutina y, por una terrible negligencia médica, es inseminación artificialmente con la muestra de Mauricio. Al poco tiempo, Juana descubre que está embarazada estando virgen, desatando el rechazo de la sociedad, la confusión de su humilde familia en el barrio y el asombro de los médicos. Cuando Mauricio se entera de que existe una mujer que lleva a su único hijo biológico, inicia una búsqueda desesperada por encontrarla, sin imaginar que el amor nacerá entre ellos en medio de los feroces ataques de la ambiciosa esposa de Mauricio, Carlota Vivas (Roxana Díaz).***

---

<center>![httpswww.facebook.com100071240721459postsqu%C3%A9-clase-de-personajescarlota-mauricio-y-juana-juana-la-virgen-rctv-2002dram%C3%A1ti615726964145322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EpvjpShE8aQbwki1GmphQTRPBQditgWV8AYckTdsfzzxYYWQDFa7UxK5GA1e6Hcmgyx.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.facebook.com100071240721459postsqu%C3%A9-clase-de-personajescarlota-mauricio-y-juana-juana-la-virgen-rctv-2002dram%C3%A1ti615726964145322)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***​Esta telenovela es ampliamente considerada una obra maestra de la televisión contemporánea. Daniela Alvarado ofreció una actuación magistral, cargada de frescura y madurez, logrando que el público empatizara profundamente con el drama psicológico y social de Juana. La química con Ricardo Álamo fue explosiva, consolidándolo a él como el gran galán del momento.***

***​La crítica aplaudió a Perla Farías por abordar con respeto, realismo y toques de humor negro temas tabú como la negligencia médica, el fanatismo religioso y el embarazo juvenil. Además, la novela sirvió como el gran trampolín para Norkys Batista (como la sensual Desirée de Rojas) y regaló una de las villanas más glamorosas y despiadadas de la década interpretada por Roxana Díaz. Su banda sonora, liderada por la agrupación zuliana Los Bacanos, musicalizó de manera perfecta el ambiente urbano y juvenil de la historia.***

---

<center>![httpswww.filmaffinity.comesfilm395076.html.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/245ciwgYbwhVcStC9QFJtD8jeYtwpPVukiK3MfGZHNkS1bAgaukE8FiGePsnkRJoKHX2b.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.filmaffinity.comesfilm395076.html)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Juana la virgen no solo paralizó a Venezuela, sino que se convirtió en uno de los formatos más exportados y versionados de la historia de la televisión. Su éxito trascendió fronteras a tal punto de generar múltiples adaptaciones en todo el mundo, siendo la más famosa la exitosa serie estadounidense \

(protagonizada por Gina Rodriguez), además de versiones en México, España, Turquía y Polonia. Su legado reside en haber demostrado que se podía refrescar el melodrama clásico con ideas completamente innovadoras y de altísima calidad escrita.***

---

<center>![httpsencrypted-tbn0.gstatic.comimagesq=tbnANd9GcRmqgIvp8Eu-U8xVosD7P1BcwzrMhAAz3kCRQ&s.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/AJmrQjEQLFD6dooiGSdF4w3DHTZTh6cqjZgtChCrFHR8TB8uR3GC2Q5q3yNogfY.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de la novela](httpsencrypted-tbn0.gstatic.comimagesq=tbnANd9GcRmqgIvp8Eu-U8xVosD7P1BcwzrMhAAz3kCRQ&s)</center>

---

body.title: Street Art #888 Wynwood Miami Part XII : Few And Far & Distort
body.body: We continued our tour of the **Wynwood** neighborhood in **Miami**. We left the warehouse district. There was still so much to see, but I ran out of time—maybe next time 🤞. Back towards the \

of the neighborhood, there were two great murals: one by the [**Few & Far** crew](https://www.instagram.com/fewandfarwomen/), which showcases female artists, and the other by [**Distort**](https://www.instagram.com/distoart/). Two different styles, but both high-quality murals.\n\n> *Nous continuons la visite du quartier de **Wynwood** à **Miami**. Nous sortons de la zone des entrepôts. Il y avait encore beaucoup à voir mais le temps me manquait, peut-être pour une prochaine fois* 🤞. *De retour vers le \

du quartier, il y avait deux murs intéressants : un par le collectif [**Few & Far**](https://www.instagram.com/fewandfarwomen/) qui met les artistes féminines de l'avant et l'autre de [**Distort**](https://www.instagram.com/distoart/). Deux styles différents mais deux murs de grande qualité.*

![Distort](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/245T9gBdiQqXGa9YgoBWLmPGeVVdf9oV1UvgNTtoXbWWW9HWyanJERbm91gvL7mETfEb1.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

These two murals are located on 28th Street in Wynwood, Miami, back among the tourists. The map shows all the posts about this neighborhood. The number in red corresponds to the relevant Street Art post. Example: 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).

![Wynwood.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tcJUwvP5Vxcg9iWmhKwAypHHjfVoA6GZWmgsnqtnRa5462hVJTwxv83nvGL1t8z78N8.jpg)

> *Ces deux murales se trouvent sur la 28ème rue à Wynwood à Miami en retournant parmi les touristes. Sur la carte, il y a tous les posts au sujet de ce quartier. Le numéro en rouge correspond au post StreetArt correspond. Exemple : 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=17/25.800876/-80.199037)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 25.80291 lat -80.20205 long Murals by Few & Far and Distort d3scr)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Few & Far

![Few & Far... too bad these two cars :-(](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xKrGaDJikpczFJfAAoE6QTty7zaFaGF459UFSAKkghJqSeVuYN43u849ZUrkjyfRpGQ.JPG)

We'll start with the [**Few & Far**](https://www.instagram.com/fewandfarwomen/) crew and their motto \

During **Art Basel** in 2022, 63 female artists participated, creating works on several walls in the Wynwood neighborhood. I couldn't find out exactly who created this particular wall, but I saw that the French artist [**Wuna**](https://www.instagram.com/wuna_graffiti/), based in Montreal, is credited, so I wonder if the Medusa lettering in the center of the composition is the work of another Montreal artist [**Medusa**](https://www.instagram.com/psyqueenmedusa/). In any case, it's a superb wall; it's a shame it disappeared after I visited.\n\n> *On commence avec le collectif [**Few & Far**](https://www.instagram.com/fewandfarwomen/) avec leur motto \

(Des femmes qui perfectionnent l'art de la rue). Lors du **Art Basel** en 2022, 63 artites féminines ont participé à l'édition réparties sur plusieurs murs dans le quartier de Wynwood. Je n'ai pas trouvé qui a réalisé ce mur exactement mais j'ai vu que l'artiste française [**Wuna**](https://www.instagram.com/wuna_graffiti/) basée à Montréal alors je me demande si le lettrage Medusa au centre de la composition est l'oeuvre d'une autre artiste montréalaise [**Medusa**](https://www.instagram.com/psyqueenmedusa/). En tout cas, superbe mur, dommage qu'il a disparu après mon passage.*

![Few & Far](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/2432FMNDrhSjDFUSBt6wbSavxUXeAo2f4AKnuom7iwbr39oUfxXhns2wVPUXuVhd76Cgg.JPG)

***

## Distort

![Distort](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/243M14f5NEAKMBNWa5ojsnTR8jLF54vmwfahW6zayy9Zr9ejsfKNjhnYDGM14LsHs5w9C.JPG)

Still on 28th Street, in the parking lot of a store that looks like it's been closed for a while, there's a mural by [**Distort**](https://www.instagram.com/distoart/). It feels like we're in a dream; there are references everywhere. On his Instagram account, he says: \

No other posts about it, so I guess we'll have to figure it out ourselves 😀.\n\n> *Toujours sur la 28ème rue, dans un parking d'un magasin qui semble fermé depuis quelque temps. On retrouve une murale de [**Distort**](https://www.instagram.com/distoart/). On semble être plongé dans un rêve, il y a des références partout. Sur son compte Instagram, il dit : \

(Cette œuvre regorge de références artistiques cachées que j'expliquerai peut-être plus tard, ou que je vous laisserai découvrir par vous-même.) Aucun autre post à ce sujet, je pense qu'on doit se débrouiller* 😀.

![Distort](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23zkfyMfjNQVgYbi55QybWTv1g8UaonU4uNVktjBGBkHVnDABudtoin6xQUs88KvyakM6.JPG)

There are elements everywhere, like the Monopoly character (often used by **Alec**) tied up at the bottom, a Reaper drone, a **Jeff Koons** style balloon deflating in mid-air, the **Kaws** character being eaten by an ogre... And where's the subway? Not sure I'd get on it.

> *Il y a des éléments partout comme le personnage de Monopoly (souvent utilisé par **Alec**) est ligoté en bas, un drone Reaper, un ballon style **Jeff Koons** qui se dégonflent dans les airs, le personnage de **Kaws** qui se fait dévoré par un ogre... Et où mème ce métro ? Pas sûr que j'y monterai à bord.*

![DSC09063.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xozPhPXGuNuQCAyBrqGPn3513gRc5rkyXnVCKHQkyK8jvJaktMmoNWi9RjREwvkChUU.JPG)

The shop front is more colorful with various artworks. On the far right is [**Mauro**](https://www.instagram.com/mauro149_trulydesign/) with a cat chasing a snake; the style is quite appealing. 
My usual question: **Any favorite pieces?**

> *La devanture du magasin est plus colorée avec différentes œuvres. Complétement à droite, il s'agit de [**Mauro**](https://www.instagram.com/mauro149_trulydesign/) avec ce chat chassant un serpent, le style est bien sympathique. 
Ma question habituelle : **Une oeuvre préférée ?***

![DSC09065.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xVHD26Y1f7fCCBUmdMpwmy7VhfP67LFDB3CvSCdq4DK7LHQiJecakqshYSyVnWJcA1x.JPG)

Saludos cordiales @hivecreators 

Llevo 20 años escribiendo y publicando libros. Tal vez un poco más. Sé reconocer cuando alguien plantea algo con coherencia y cuando no.

Esto tiene coherencia.

Lo que más me gusta:

1. Que asuman la responsabilidad colectiva. Pocos proyectos en Hive tienen la honestidad de decir \

. Eso los separa del 90% de los discursos vacíos.

2. Proof of Use. Por fin alguien entiende que mostrar casos reales vale más que cualquier campaña de marketing genérico. El ejemplo del panadero en los comentarios es más valioso que diez infografías.

3. Que hablen de ingresos propios sin depender del DHF. Eso es sostenibilidad. 
Si necesitan que alguien revise informes, edite textos o les ayude a que lo que escriban no suene vacío, avisen. Eso sí sé hacer.

Y una sugerencia: cada cosa que lancen, que tenga un registro público de lo que salió mal también. No solo los logros. Eso genera más confianza que cualquier promesa.

Suerte. Van por buen camino, pero el camino es largo y está lleno de proyectos que empezaron igual y desaparecieron.

Sé que este es diferente.

Mucho éxito!!📍

# <center><u>English Version</u></center>
# <center><u>My Battle with Cancer #4: PET-CT</u></center>

**<u>Note</u>**: For this video, I wanted to try out a GIF thumbnail since I’ve seen other users doing it.

I recorded this video on 05-25-2026. It took me a while to get it out because I've had a hard time working on it; severe pain has returned. Anyway, here I’m going to show you a test result where things didn’t actually go badly, but I’m still not completely cancer-free. Why? body.title: 🐰✨ Bringing Back Childhood Memories with Pencil Art ✨🐰/🐰✨ Reviviendo recuerdos de la infancia con dibujo a lápiz ✨🐰
body.body: > Hello amazing Sketchbook community! 🎨🖌️ Today I want to share with you a cartoon-style pencil drawing I created of the legendary Bugs Bunny 😎🐰. Ever since I was a child, I’ve always loved classic cartoons like _Looney Tunes_. Their funny personalities, expressive poses, and unique character designs inspired me a lot to start drawing and improving my creativity little by little. 💫📺 This was actually a quick sketch that I made during my free time, but even though it was done fast, I still tried to focus on keeping the drawing clean, expressive, and full of personality. ⚡✏️ Sometimes the quickest drawings end up having the most natural energy and flow.

> This artwork was completely sketched using graphite pencils on paper ✏️📄. For this piece, I focused heavily on clean linework, character proportions, and smooth shading transitions to give Bugs Bunny a cool and modern attitude. 😎🔥 The sunglasses and relaxed pose were added to create a more urban and stylish vibe while still preserving the recognizable essence of the character. From a technical perspective, I used soft gradient shading techniques to create volume in the clothes and glasses, while applying controlled hatching in some shadowed areas for extra texture and depth. 🖤✍️ I also worked carefully on the silhouette flow and facial expression because cartoon characters rely strongly on gesture and attitude to communicate personality. One of my favorite details was balancing the dark graphite tones of the glasses and pants against the softer tones of the fur and shirt. This contrast helps guide the viewer’s eye naturally through the composition. 🎭✨ Creating traditional pencil drawings always gives me a special feeling because every stroke feels organic and authentic. Even in the digital era, sketching by hand remains one of the best ways to improve observation, control, and artistic confidence. 💯🎨 I hope you enjoy this nostalgic fan art as much as I enjoyed drawing it! 🐰🔥 Thank you for visiting my post and supporting my art journey. 🙌✨ * * *

> ¡Hola increíble comunidad de Sketchbook! 🎨🖌️ Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes un diseño estilo caricatura que realicé a lápiz del legendario Bugs Bunny 😎🐰. Desde pequeño siempre me encantaron estas caricaturas clásicas como _Looney Tunes_. Sus personajes divertidos, las expresiones exageradas y los diseños tan creativos fueron una gran inspiración para comenzar a dibujar y desarrollar mi imaginación. 💫📺 Este fue realmente un dibujo rápido que hice durante un momento libre, pero aunque fue realizado en poco tiempo, traté de mantener un acabado limpio, expresivo y lleno de personalidad. ⚡✏️ Muchas veces los dibujos rápidos terminan teniendo una energía más natural y espontánea.

></center>

Este dibujo fue realizado completamente con lápices de grafito sobre papel ✏️📄. En esta ilustración me enfoqué bastante en mantener un lineado limpio, buenas proporciones caricaturescas y sombras suaves para darle al personaje una apariencia moderna y con mucha actitud. 😎🔥 Los lentes oscuros y la pose relajada ayudan a transmitir una vibra más urbana sin perder la esencia clásica de Bugs Bunny.

Desde el punto de vista técnico, utilicé técnicas de degradado suave para generar volumen en la ropa y los lentes, además de aplicar trazos de hatching controlado en ciertas zonas de sombra para añadir textura y profundidad visual. 🖤✍️ También trabajé cuidadosamente la silueta y la expresión facial, ya que en las caricaturas la postura y los gestos son fundamentales para transmitir personalidad.

Uno de los detalles que más disfruté fue equilibrar los tonos oscuros del grafito en los pantalones y lentes con tonos más suaves en el pelaje y la camiseta. Este contraste ayuda a dirigir la mirada del espectador a través de toda la composición. 🎭✨

Crear dibujos tradicionales siempre me genera una sensación especial porque cada trazo se siente auténtico y natural. Incluso en la era digital, dibujar a mano sigue siendo una de las mejores formas de mejorar la observación, el control y la confianza artística. 💯🎨

Espero que disfruten este fan art nostálgico tanto como yo disfruté dibujándolo. 🐰🔥  
¡Gracias por visitar mi publicación y apoyar mi camino artístico! 🙌✨

LinkedIn but in real life

Instead of living alone like GenZ better to work on building connection cause you'd need it more in coming days than anyone else. that's all folks.

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: bola de cristal / 5 Minute Freewrite: crystal ball
body.body:
>


# Deseos

​

#



A veces la vida es tan cuesta arriba que quisiera que ocurra un milagro y cambiar todo lo que está pasando, dando por terminada la mala racha que llevas atravesando mucho tiempo. Es ese momento cuando sientes tanto peso sobre tus hombros que te impide avanzar, no es que todo sea lento o rápido sino muy pesado; entonces sucede que el camino parece imposible de recorrer y bueno llegaste a tu límite de paciencia y aguante que gritas, te caes, totalmente agotada te desvaneces hasta quedar así como perdida y devastada.

Nada fuera de lo común en la vida de las personas, que en distintas ocasiones viven situaciones que los afectan mucho y bueno a pesar de todo las enfrentan una y otra vez, pero llega un punto en que es tanto que te superan y derriban. Miras al cielo y preguntas por qué todos los problemas te los dieron a ti como una carga tan fuerte que ya no puedes más; claro que el deseo a gritos es que ya termine todo deseándolo tanto que si ves una **bola de cristal** le pides desesperadamente que te cumpla un único deseo aunque en el fondo no crees en eso, pero sin más opciones sobre la mesa que puedes perder ya.

Lo de la bola de cristal, que aparezca un genio de los deseos o que ocurra un milagro son pensamientos que cruzan por la cabeza de quien está evidentemente desesperado; si bien la lógica indica que solo en la vida real y con las herramientas que tengas disponibles podrás salir de ese hoyo, es válido apelar a que aparezca una varita mágica que cambien todo.
​


​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>

​

#  Wishes

​

#
Sometimes life is such an uphill battle that I wish for a miracle to happen and change everything that’s going on, putting an end to the rough patch you’ve been going through for so long. It’s that moment when you feel such a heavy weight on your shoulders that it stops you from moving forward—it’s not that everything is slow or fast, but just so heavy; then the path seems impossible to walk, and well, you’ve reached the limit of your patience and endurance, so you scream, you fall, and, totally exhausted, you fade away until you’re left feeling lost and devastated.
 
There’s nothing unusual about this in people’s lives; we all go through situations that deeply affect us, and despite everything, we face them time and time again. But there comes a point when it all becomes too much, and it overwhelms and knocks you down. You look up at the sky and ask why all these problems were given to you as such a heavy burden that you can’t take it anymore; of course, your heart’s cry is for it all to end—you want it so badly that if you saw a **crystal ball**, you’d desperately ask it to grant you a single wish, even though deep down you don’t believe in that, but with no other options left on the table, you have nothing left to lose.

The idea of a crystal ball, a genie granting wishes, or a miracle happening are thoughts that cross the mind of someone who is clearly desperate; even though logic tells you that only in real life and with the tools you have available can you climb out of that hole, it’s valid to hope for a magic wand to appear and change everything.
​


#

body.title: Ich denke sehr sehr oft darueber nach in letzter Zeit, meine Arbeit in der Oeffentlichkeit einzustellen!
body.body:
Das passt dann auch mit meinen eigenen Vorhersagen ueberein, die ich hier drinstehen habe, sozusagen, auf das Jahr genau. 

Und warum???

Weil ich keine Lust mehr habe, die Gratistante zu spielen. :-)

Die wenisten Ausnahmen, lesen sowieso mein Zeug wirklich. Viele Lesen nichtmal, obwohl sie dafuer ja alle Zeit der Welt entscheiden koennten, wenn ich ihnen direkt schreibe.

Ich habe hier mal reingeschrieben, und auch oefter widerholt, das des schoen ist, das man einfach Zeit haben kann und eben nicht alles auf einmal macht.

Man kann mit der Zeit spielen... Vielleicht spiele ich jetzt mal, mit meiner Zeit.

Ich habe sowieso Lust, mehr fuer mich zu machen in Zukunft, mir eine huepsche junge Frau zu suchen, ein Kind zu machen und mein Leben zu genießen, und einfach ein bisschen was Arbeiten.

Aber nix mehr fuer alle, und auch die, die so richtig an mir dranzuhaengen scheinen und jede Grenze ueberschreiten damit, die wuerden sich auch Wundern, wenn es auf einmal Dunkel wird um mich herum.

Vielleicht, mache ich das, vielleicht, mache ich das nicht. Wer weis das schon. Ich weis auf jeden Fall, das ich das nicht tun muesste, um auch Gluecklich zu werden, was ich tue. 

Ich komme sehr Gut, mit mir selbst Zurecht und weis mich umso Besser auch ohne Oeffentlichkeit zu beschaeftigen.

Salve

Sascha Pürner

I entered the daily streak in the FRONTIER league and today is my 9th day ever since I started entering it and claimed some SPARKS from the wheelspin since im in the Tier II in the spin mode so I won 150 SPARKS and additional 1000 SPARKS was awarded to me. body.title: IT'S NOT JUST ABOUT MONEY
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

The medical system of the world is different in different countries and continents of the world. This is why we can't judge things universally especially when talking about a controversial topic about the medical system. In most African countries, let's be first aware that our government has failed us and thus we can not really blame how the private institutions run their affairs. If we really wish to look at things with a conscience and without any form of bias, we can agree that in the medical system, there are certain level of medical care that are expensive not because someone decided to just make them so, but because they require intense effort and precision, plus the personnels who handle such treatments are either rear or few. Knowing this, it will never be cheap to cover the logistics for such treatments.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRWvrJnhaf9Z1HmgeBJFbZ71apmsCEmJxqMAESfew7oC2/1000067095.jpg 
<a href=\

>Image by DC Studio on Magnific Let's use the MRI machine for example, it's a very fragile mechanism that requires 24 hour power supply which is a very big issue in Nigeria. This means any hospital that has it will be spending a lot on electricity, and if they must continue treating patients with it, they need something to continue running such expenses. Therefore any patient who needs an MRI would be charged a lot for it. If they can't afford it, there is nothing the hospital can do. Some people like to blame hospitals when the cost of treatment is high, but think about it this way. These private hospitals require money and manpower to work, the only place they can get the money to pay for manpower is by charging their patients. Some of these hospitals hire the very best medical personnels to handle their patients and these personnels don't come cheap especially when you think about how much they have spent to get to the level they are. I do not want to believe that anyone who works in the medical field up to the position of an attendee knowing what it took to get there would simply decide to be considerate to those who can't afford to pay their bills. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) Doctors are humans too, humans who need to feed and pay bills. The doctors are meant to save lives, but the doctors must live to save lives. Would you trust your life or the life of your loved one to a hungry doctor?. The fact is that we can not blame the private hospitals for these things when the government inflates goods, and has not found a way to make the cost of living better. There should be a level of medical care every citizen of a country is entitled to, and there should be subsidies with the ones that are very expensive. But when there are no jobs and the standard of living is low, we can't control what happens next. Obviously it will be hard for the less privileged to access a certain level of medical care. In developed countries, the government pays for these things through taxes, but at least they give jobs so their citizens can pay taxes, this is something our government can not do. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO HIVE LEARNER'S [PROMPT](https://discord.com/channels/928986840747372636/929001473231183873/1509110081940230275) FOR WEEK 219 EPISODE 2 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/its-not-just-about-money--dvw)

> ### English Hello friends of the Black and White community! (I definitely need to find a new opening greeting soon). I went out early to train today; sports are a fundamental part of my routine. Staying active and strong helps my mind rest as well. I find the mind-muscle connection fascinating—being able to truly control your body. In fact, I got so caught up in my thoughts while writing this that I missed my bus stop by five blocks! Well, after walking back, training, and finishing my errands, I can finally sit down to publish today's series. I've been busy editing and uploading photos from the press event I mentioned earlier, and I'm exhausted. I hope you enjoy another day in my crazy Lima. This series is always made with lots of love and good vibes. Happy mid-week to everyone! ### Español ¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro! body.title: Adjustable bracelet in red and silver. Pulsera ajustable en rojo y plateado.[ENG-SPA].
body.body:
>Hello, creative friends of the #DIYHub community. Happy day to everyone. We always take a break to gather our thoughts and come back with our batteries recharged, which is why I’m here today to share a beautiful adjustable bracelet made with seed beads, Murano glass beads, and glass beads. I chose red for this design because it’s a color that exudes elegance; plus, at first glance, the accessories really stand out. It pairs perfectly with silver, creating a visual balance in the design. Now, I want to mention that this project isn’t difficult, it takes very little time, and the materials are inexpensive. This bracelet is adjustable, so you can just slip it on your wrist and you’re good to go. I invite you to join me for a step-by-step walkthrough of this new project.

>Hola, amigos creativos de la comunidad #DIYHub. Feliz día para todos. Siempre nos damos un respiro para ordenar algunas ideas y volver con las pilas recargadas, es por eso que hoy estoy por aquí para compartir una bonita pulsera ajustable hecha con mostacillas, muranos y balines. Escogí el rojo para este diseño por ser un color que proyecta elegancia; además, a simple vista, los accesorios resultan llamativos. Combina perfectamente con el plateado, produciendo un equilibrio visual al diseño. Ahora bien, les quiero comentar que el trabajo no tiene dificultad, se invierte poco tiempo, además, el gasto en materiales es de bajo costo. Dicha pulsera es ajustable, ideal para colocar en la muñeca y listo. Los invito a que me acompañen en el paso a paso de este nuevo contenido. #

🔴***MATERIALS//MATERIALES***🔴
* Red glass beads. * Silver seed beads. * Silver ball beads. * Chinese thread. * Scissors. * Lighter. >* Muranos rojos. >* Mostacillas plateadas. >* Balines plateados. >* Hilo chino. >* Tijera. >* Encendedor.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXMp3ZQ4PupqhxjbBShHc6kabJbemcV3XSVK3FER8cU3d/image.png)
#
🔴***STEPS//PASOS***🔴
* Cut two strands of black Chinese thread, each 50 centimeters long. Bring both ends together, leaving about 10 centimeters free, then tie a simple knot. Secure it to the work surface. Separate the two strands, then thread 1 Murano bead onto each strand, followed by 4 silver beads. >* Cortar dos hebras de hilo chino de color negro de 50 centímetros cada una. Juntar ambas puntas y dejar unos 10 centímetros libres, luego hacer un nudo simple. Fijar a la tabla de trabajo. Separar ambos hilos, luego introducir en cada hilo 1 murano, seguido de 4 mostacillas plateadas.

> https://images.hive.blog/DQmWNADYnjbgo876ZZYxFd8tFVg4XdMvYSVbqqrC3pKQgBc/image.png * Continuar introduciendo 1 murano en cada hilo. >* Continue inserting 1 Murano bead onto each strand.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdfVXmdrrfAFv5bxQmPnv4vEe91m6v4v4JshgaZqJyQZ/image.png)
* Continue threading 1 silver bead onto the right strand, then pass the left strand through the bead from back to front, and pull both strands to close the section. >* Seguir introduciendo 1 balín plateado por el hilo de la derecha, luego atravesar el balín con el hilo de la izquierda, de atrás hacia delante, tirar ambos hilos para cerrar la sección.

> https://images.hive.blog/DQmZzgJsQMf8GRdHUvwVsZjsm7kbr9qUoXSdmxvC2whi1uR/image.png * Separate the strands again and thread 1 Murano bead onto each strand, followed by 4 seed beads and 1 Murano bead, as shown in the photo. Close this section by threading on 1 silver bead. >* Nuevamente separar los hilos para introducir 1 murano en cada hilo, más 4 mostacillas y 1 murano como lo indico en la fotografía. Cerrar dicha sección introduciendo 1 balín plateado.

> https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdofa9ZBHNqfabprocu5Dgr5vJPkVW7aU9AqKoxDcwSe/image.png * Repeat the same procedure until the bracelet reaches the desired length. >* Repetir el mismo procedimiento hasta alcanzar el largo deseado de la pulsera.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYHtSbvZVmE5VD1k2fc7toKBUHLzwiA9ap4U2nr5uxBib/image.png)
* Once you've reached the desired length for the bracelet, bring the two strands together and tie a simple knot. >* Después de obtener el largo deseado de la pulsera, juntar ambos hilos y hacer un nudo sencillo.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwwjoEGasfV4bVoXMWuSTzW9aVV2CTigqQaiPXzeztXU/image.png)
* Now let’s close the bracelet. For this step, we’ll use a flat slipknot, so I cut 25 cm of cord. Secure the hanging threads with tape, then pass the Chinese thread under the base thread, tie a simple knot, continue forming a P with the right thread passing over the base, then pass the left thread under the base, coming out through the belly of the P. Now repeat the procedure but with the P inverted. Repeat the flat knot 5 times. >* Ahora vamos a cerrar la pulsera. Para este paso vamos a trabajar con el nudo plano corredizo, para lo cual corté 25 cm de hilo chino. Sujetar los hilos colgantes con una cinta adhesiva, luego pasar el hilo chino por debajo del hilo base, hacer un nudo sencillo, continuar haciendo una P con el hilo de la derecha pasando por encima de la base, luego pasar el hilo de la izquierda por debajo de la base saliendo por la barriga de la P. Ahora repetir el procedimiento pero con la P invertida. Repetir 5 veces el nudo plano.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZZJVEN2zmgsZA6vou5HNdu7m6rc9GqAz9vkdU9cA2tBB/image.png)
* Trim the excess material and then seal the edges with a lighter. Decorate the hanging strands with beads. >* Cortar el material sobrante y luego sellar con el encendedor. Decorar con cuentas los hilos colgantes.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRERWN7LLyes9NkgH2GeBKXZAfhdtBTLY26N7hfQ7mp7A/image.png)

body.title: MY SAFE HEAVEN ISN'T FANCY,BUT IT'S MINE🌸✨- LOH CONTEST #290
body.body:
Hello beautiful Ladies of Hive 💜

When I saw the prompt for LOH Contest #290 about a \

, I didn’t have to think twice. My safe space isn’t a beach house or a library. It’s right here in my little bedroom corner.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWNZVHECvzF6vu7mLdWT2NSzBUPcrGYfXqPAFcvj9cTwE/1779909682203.png)




This room is where I drop everything at the  end of the day. The noise, the stress, the \

mask. Here, I can just breathe and be completely myself without worry.

The best part is this little corner with my black sofa and window. 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMPQXfX7LD9hqz3bfQcFhooBGFJFtMyxPBzuNBnbZfCQ/1779909654360.png)




When I sit here with the curtains half open, some quiet music, and my phone on DND, the whole world feels slower. Sometimes I read, sometimes I just sit and think, sometimes I cry it out. No judgment. No performance. Just me.

I’ve learned that you don’t need a big space or expensive decor to feel at peace. You just need a spot that feels like \

. A place where your mind can rest without explaining itself.

For me, this corner is my reset button. It’s where I remind myself that I’m allowed to rest, to feel, and to start again tomorrow with fresh strength.



  What about you, Ladies of Hive?
Where is your safe haven? Is it a room, a spot outside, or even a person?

Share it below. I’d love to read about the places that hold you together.



🌸🌸All photos are mine, taken in my personal space. 🌸🌸

body.title: When Life Comes First but Payment Comes First
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

In a gathering some days ago, a man shared a story about the birth of his first child. He shared a lot about the chaos and how his wife struggled so much to birth the child, in the midst of prayers and singing praises to God by families, friends, even nurses and other workers in the hospital.

All that part of the story was emotional but it got to the part where the man was asked to sign a document consenting to doing a CS for his wife so they could save both of them and save time. He said he reluctantly signed it but it wasn't because he was scared of losing any of them, he was actually worried of the bills to be paid first.

Surprisingly, they let him sign the document and before he could even rally round for money to pay deposit so they could commence the process, he was called that the surgery went successfully and his wife and baby boy are well and healthy. We all screamed in the house when we heard it.

The scream wasn't for the safe delivery through CS, it was for the \

made that the hospital didn't bother about before doing their work to save lives. They offered the man time to pay his bills long after he has his wife and his son with him. We all thought it was quite impossible.

![file_00000000840471f4bdb71d73092c1d87.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23yd3Zq5ehSFRnsqaA382RLGFYxu258gD12ETEgLTnpaNGXhN5twNYaNbquakME64U2hu.png)

It sounded like an impossible story because we knew well enough the country we're in especially. We had never heard of such a pardon in a hospital before even in more critical life and death situations. I remember how I escaped a \

surgery because of no deposit paid. In that situation, I was thankful but I can not help but imagine situations where the patients or their families don't have any way to get money fast for a life to be cared for and treated. It's a sad reality today, only few doctors are in hospitals to save lives. Most hospitals think of the hospital's expenses to bill patients, not how to save them. It's funny to think that doctors took an oath to save lives at any cost but a lot of patients seem to not be able to pay for the cost charged at them. I really don't know who exactly is to be blamed in all of this because most of the time, these doctors are working under a hospital's policy so they can't just go easy on the patients. And then, there are really costs to carrying out some treatments that should be paid for before it commences. This is where the government of the place comes in, I believe patients will have less worries if there are more free medical equipments and drugs donated to hospitals too. I don't see a better way to handle turning patients down when they can't pay than everyone being considerate of one another and the Government playing their roles for her citizens. I believe there is no perfect way to go about this because any way decided will still birth human selfishness. **Image used is AI generated.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/when-life-comes-first-but-payment-comes-first-e2j)

body.title: The Day Compassion Cost A Doctor
body.body:
> *One of the things I fear the most right now is hospital bills, so I practice prevention more these days because prevention is less expensive than a cure…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTQ226exRBUFgFsFuLYQTeMThTohgHBY38WT498pCMXT6/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/hospital-emergency-room-clinic-room-6700680/) *The last time I was in the hospital was when my child was sick. Immediately his mum got to the hospital, and he was diagnosed, she was asked to deposit a sum of 40,000 naira before he could be admitted. I got the call, and the news was exactly what I feared. I had no choice but to send the money immediately because my child’s life is priceless. Even if it meant borrowing, I would!* *One good thing about this particular hospital that asked for a 40k deposit before admission was that when they first got there, the doctor attended to my boy immediately. He was running a very high fever, and they gave him injections to stabilize him first, at least to take him out of the critical stage, because if nothing had been done immediately, only God knows what could have happened…* *So they did well. They saved my boy first, then asked for payment to continue treatment. That is something every hospital should be doing…* *I have heard about cases where people were rushed to the hospital in critical conditions involving life and death, yet the hospital refused to treat or admit them unless a certain amount was paid first… should we blame the hospitals???* *Honestly, this situation can be compared to lending people money*… *The way some people switch up can be very crazy. At one point, they become emotional and look so pitiful when they need help, but the moment they get that help, and it is time to fulfill their promise, they suddenly become a different person…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCaabBJjUc9wzuV6zvjQPUAxrukWaouMr7DbrK3Rz1E4/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/hospital-intensive-care-oxygen-6701653/) *A doctor once told a story that made him heartless when it comes to patients. Like every hospital, the one he worked for always asked for payment before treatment.* *One day, a pregnant woman in labour was rushed in. Her husband was with her. They were asked to make a deposit, but the husband said he had no money and begged them to attend to his wife first while he looked for a way to get the money. The nurses on duty refused, and both the husband and wife kept begging.* *The doctor on duty took pity on them and instructed the nurses to admit her. He attended to the woman, she delivered safely, and after she gave birth, she called her husband to tell him the good news*… *That was the last time anyone saw the husband.* *He never came back to the hospital after that night. The woman kept eating hospital food while the bills kept piling up, yet no one showed up for her.* *After a week, the doctor instructed them to discharge her. Since he was the one who ordered her admission without payment, the bill was deducted from his salary.* *That day taught him a hard lesson: always follow protocol and never pity anyone too much because if he had insisted on payment first, they would have found the money somehow, even if it meant calling their enemies…* *The saddest part was that five months later, he saw the woman, her husband, and their newborn baby at a mall shopping together*… *The same husband who disappeared from the hospital.* *At that moment, he became convinced that his wife knew about everything too. Since then, he lost his soft heart when it comes to patients.* *When I heard the story, I also understood why hospital staff strictly follow protocol because people can truly be wicked…* *The bad ones often deprive the good ones of kindness.* *But it is what it is…* *We can do better as humans.*

body.title: ‎⚽ Some Players Leave a Club, But Never Really Leave the Hearts of Fans ‎
body.body:
‎
‎When I came across the news that Chelsea wants Thiago Silva back in a coaching role, I won’t lie, I felt really happy about it. Some footballers come to a club, do their job their part, and quietly leave. But Thiago Silva was different.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQAuXm26kwDQvRj71PGjhJM4C4oX51imB3LyEriJA3Pq3/Thiago_Silva_Chelsea_vs_Tottenham.jpeg 

‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.chelseafc.com/en/news/article/thiago-silva-the-six-chelsea-games-i-will-always-remember&ved=2ahUKEwjWjrKSl9qUAxXmXEEAHVSzOUQQr4kDegQIHxAA&usg=AOvVaw1Vnb236COhQYbVX_QQJu81)
‎
‎Even though he has already left Chelsea as a player, it still feels strange not seeing him in that blue shirt anymore. The man brought so much experience, calmness and leadership to the team, most especially during difficult moments. There were games where the defense looked completely lost until Silva stepped in and organized everything again.
‎
‎What actually impressed me most about him was not even the goals or appearances. It was the way he carried himself. Because many defenders struggle with the pace of the Premier League at his age, but Thiago Silva still played like someone in his prime sometimes. His positioning, composure, and reading of the game were just on another level.
‎
‎I personally think younger Chelsea defenders learned a lot from him, whether directly or indirectly. You could tell the way they respected him. He always looked like a leader without needing to shout too much or try to prove himself.
‎
‎So hearing that Chelsea’s management reportedly wants him to join Xabi Alonso’s coaching staff honestly feels like a smart move to me. Football today is not only about tactics and formations. Sometimes young players need experienced people around them who understand pressure, mentality, and responsibility to look up to.
‎
‎And let’s be honest, fans also love seeing their former players return to help the club. It creates that emotional connection again. Thiago Silva gave Chelsea everything during his time there despite his short span there, and I don’t think supporters have forgotten that.
‎
‎His stats at Chelsea were good too to ignore, 155 appearances with 9 goals and 5 assists as a defender is impressive but numbers alone still don’t fully explain his impact. Some players leave memories that stats cannot capture properly.
‎
‎I honestly feel players like Thiago Silva are rare in modern football. Professional, humble, experienced, and fully committed to the badge.
‎
‎If Chelsea really brings him back in a coaching role, I think it could be something very positive for the club, especially for the younger players  and defenders coming through.
‎
‎Some legends don’t just need to score hundreds of goals before fans appreciate them. Sometimes their character alone is enough to leave a lasting impact.
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/-some-players-leave-a-club-but-never-really-leave-the-hearts-of-fans--lkk)

body.title: ✨🌊✨🌊 Returning to the Ocean's Magic  🌊/ Regresando a la magia del océano 🌊(ENG-ESP))
body.body:
╔══════ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══════╗
          ESPAÑOL 
╚══════ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══════╝
![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)


Buenas tardes queridos amigos.Hoy quiero compartir un nuevo proceso artístico inspirado en el increíble mundo de Holozing. Una de las cosas que más disfruto al crear fan art es poder tomar personajes que ya tienen su propia esencia e interpretarlos a través de mi propio estilo, añadiendo detalles, texturas y tratando de darles más vida con cada capa.

Para esta ilustración, decidí trabajar en la Sanadora del Mar junto con su dragón compañero. Me encanta la energía mágica que rodea a la Sanadora del Mar. Su diseño siempre me ha transmitido una sensación de calma y elegancia, a la vez que conserva esa misteriosa esencia fantástica que encaja a la perfección en el universo de Holozing.

Como con toda obra de arte digital, todo comenzó con líneas simples que poco a poco se transformaron en una ilustración completa.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Fase de Boceto**

![10 sin título_20260522092748.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23tHbKgySEA2W5sDUxHvwy5DCrLdNyri4xUsoQwJMspKv7HsvWV4u9CMrW3uGrDA4Njq3.png)


Lo primero en lo que trabajé fue en el boceto. Para este paso utilicé el pincel **Lápiz de Grafito**.

Creé a la  Sanadora Marina y al dragón en capas separadas porque quería tener más libertad al trabajar y un mejor control sobre cada elemento individualmente. Trabajar con capas separadas me ayuda a ajustar las proporciones y los detalles sin afectar el resto de la ilustración.

En esta etapa me centré principalmente en la posición, las expresiones y la composición general.

Aunque los bocetos suelen parecer simples, creo que son una de las partes más importantes de cualquier obra de arte, ya que constituyen la base que sustenta todo lo que viene después.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Proceso de Piel**


![10 sin título_20260522114154.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23twC3gxaequPkyWD5iYaTbAQLKq8pAhnH33Qm2SnToQV857NqinrPngUzoYU2qbZiNck.png)


Para la piel, comencé con la Sanadora Marina. Oculté la capa del boceto y comencé a añadir los colores gradualmente.

Para crear los colores base, utilicé el pincel **Lápiz de Mezcla**, mientras que las sombras y los brillos los creé con el **Aerógrafo Normal**.

Suelo disfrutar dedicando tiempo extra a la piel, ya que pequeños ajustes en las sombras y la iluminación pueden cambiar por completo el estado de ánimo y la expresión de un personaje.

Crear la piel es como darle vida al personaje poco a poco.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Cabello y Rasgos Faciales**


![10 sin título_20260522114210.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23wN2F4fi4NPCCDqb8JMe2XhqvrpVNAbZaaTSjydzJrfVyBuaeQ8nnUXPdPgXBE4Ycm3x.png)


![10 sin título_20260522124338.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23wXQmiAr4y6k8M5f9UEaViUfVB51oziPGzN2UJwrEPiQGtXrTiqJ466vqjtN5z6sCr2F.png)

La siguiente etapa se centró en el cabello, que creé en una capa aparte.

Para este proceso utilicé:

✦ **Lápiz de Mezcla**

✦ **Aerógrafo Normal**

✦ **Detalle de Cabello 4 de Chris**

El pincel adicional para el cabello me ayudó a crear más textura y movimiento, logrando una apariencia más suave y natural.

Después, pasé a los detalles faciales, empezando por los ojos.

Para los ojos, volví a usar:

✦ **Pincel Lápiz Difuminado**

✦ **Aerógrafo Normal**

Siempre he pensado que los ojos son uno de los elementos más importantes, ya que pueden definir por completo la personalidad y las emociones de un personaje.

La nariz y los labios recibieron los últimos retoques con:

✦ **Aerógrafo Normal**

✦ **Pincel Plano de Acuarela**

Normalmente empiezo con estos rasgos al principio del proceso de la piel y luego los refino y perfecciono.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Ropa y Accesorios**


![10 sin título_20260522124351.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23xf71wMSkYqLppdS87QV9Ei47QrSSa2ornQd9jRgfQrccuEzUuGC2BDzKuiT1cSjcRaJ.png)


Una vez terminado el rostro, pasé a la ropa y los elementos decorativos.

Para esta parte utilicé:

✦ **Aerógrafo normal**

✦ **Pincel dorado**

✦ **Pincel perla**

Mientras trabajaba en esta capa, aproveché para añadir detalles como el bastón y las conchas marinas.

Quería que estos elementos transmitieran magia, manteniendo a la vez la esencia oceánica que rodea al Sanador Marino.

A veces, estos elementos decorativos parecen pequeños, pero suelen convertirse en piezas importantes que enriquecen la composición final.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Compañero dragón**


![10 sin título_20260523110515.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23xpVkgHeihs6CLky5JHhSK83nzb4YyGB4gjwyZCJ3Ydngst1TqpPWGZfWXPavuePBNgA.png)

![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)


El dragón se creó en una capa aparte.

Como la estructura era más sencilla, decidí trabajar completamente en una sola capa.

Para este proceso utilicé:

✦ Pincel de lápiz de mezcla para los colores base
✦ Aerógrafo normal y pincel plano de acuarela para los detalles
✦ Pincel de escamas para los ajustes finales de textura

Aunque el dragón requería un proceso más sencillo, quería que se sintiera conectado con el Sanador Marino y que mantuviera la armonía dentro de la obra en general.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Resultado final**


![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)


Ver cómo un dibujo evoluciona lentamente desde trazos iniciales hasta convertirse en una obra completa es siempre una de mis partes favoritas del arte digital.

Cada capa, cada detalle, cada pincelada se convierte gradualmente en parte de algo más grande.

Crear fan art de Holozing es algo que disfruto muchísimo porque me permite combinar mi creatividad con un universo lleno de fantasía, criaturas, magia y hermosos diseños de personajes.

Muchas gracias por visitar mi publicación y apoyar mi trabajo ✨🌊
╔══════ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══════╗
          ENGLISH 
╚══════ ❀•°❀°•❀ ══════╝
![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)
Today I want to share a new artistic process inspired by the incredible world of Holozing. One of the things I enjoy the most about creating fan art is being able to take characters that already have their own essence and interpret them through my own style, adding details, textures, and trying to give them more life with each layer.

For this illustration I decided to work on the Sea Healer together with her dragon companion. I really love the magical energy that surrounds the Sea Healer. Her design has always given me a calm and elegant feeling, while still maintaining that mysterious fantasy essence that fits perfectly into the Holozing universe.

As with every digital artwork, everything began with simple lines that slowly transformed into a complete illustration.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Sketch Phase**

![10 sin título_20260522092748.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23tHbKgySEA2W5sDUxHvwy5DCrLdNyri4xUsoQwJMspKv7HsvWV4u9CMrW3uGrDA4Njq3.png)


The first thing I worked on was the sketch. For this step I used the **Graphite Pencil brush**.

I created the Sea Healer and the dragon on separate layers because I wanted to have more freedom while working and also keep better control over every element individually. Working with separate layers usually helps me adjust proportions and details without affecting the rest of the illustration.

At this stage I focused mainly on positioning, expressions, and the overall composition.

Even though sketches usually look simple, I think they are one of the most important parts of any artwork because they become the foundation that supports everything that comes later.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Skin Process**

![10 sin título_20260522114154.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23twC3gxaequPkyWD5iYaTbAQLKq8pAhnH33Qm2SnToQV857NqinrPngUzoYU2qbZiNck.png)

For the skin I started with the Sea Healer. I hid the sketch layer and began building the colors gradually.

To create the base colors I used the **Blending Pencil brush**, while shadows and highlights were created using the **Normal Airbrush**.

I usually enjoy spending extra time on skin because small adjustments in shadows and lighting can completely change the mood and expression of a character.

Creating skin feels like slowly bringing the character to life.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Hair and Facial Features**

![10 sin título_20260522114210.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23wN2F4fi4NPCCDqb8JMe2XhqvrpVNAbZaaTSjydzJrfVyBuaeQ8nnUXPdPgXBE4Ycm3x.png)


![10 sin título_20260522124338.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23wXQmiAr4y6k8M5f9UEaViUfVB51oziPGzN2UJwrEPiQGtXrTiqJ466vqjtN5z6sCr2F.png)


The next stage was focused on the hair, which I created on a separate layer.

For this process I used:

✦ **Blending Pencil Brush**
✦ **Normal Airbrush**
✦ **Hairs Detail 4 by Chris**

The additional hair brush helped me create more texture and movement, giving a softer and more natural appearance.

After that, I moved to facial details beginning with the eyes.

For the eyes I worked again using:

✦ **Blending Pencil Brush**
✦ **Normal Airbrush**

I always feel that eyes are one of the most important elements because they can completely define the personality and emotions of a character.

The nose and lips were given their final touches using:

✦ **Normal Airbrush**
✦ **Flat Watercolor Brush**

I usually begin these features earlier during the skin process and later come back to refine and improve them.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Clothing and Accessories**

![10 sin título_20260522124351.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23xf71wMSkYqLppdS87QV9Ei47QrSSa2ornQd9jRgfQrccuEzUuGC2BDzKuiT1cSjcRaJ.png)

Once the face was finished, I moved on to the clothing and decorative elements.

For this part I used:

✦ **Normal Airbrush**
✦ **Gold Brush**
✦ **Pearl Brush**

While working on this layer, I also took the opportunity to create additional details such as the staff and sea shells.

I wanted these elements to feel magical while still maintaining the oceanic essence surrounding the Sea Healer.

Sometimes these decorative elements seem small, but they often become important pieces that enrich the final composition.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Dragon Companion**

![10 sin título_20260523110515.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23xpVkgHeihs6CLky5JHhSK83nzb4YyGB4gjwyZCJ3Ydngst1TqpPWGZfWXPavuePBNgA.png)

![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)

The dragon was created on a separate layer.

Since the structure was simpler, I decided to work entirely within a single layer.

For this process I used:

✦ **Blending Pencil Brush** for base colors
✦ **Normal Airbrush** and **Flat Watercolor Brush** for details
✦ **Scale Brush** for the final texture adjustments

Even though the dragon required a simpler process, I still wanted it to feel connected with the Sea Healer and maintain harmony within the overall artwork.

༺━━━━━━ 🌊 ━━━━━━༻

**Final Result**

![10 sin título_20260523114736.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/babyl/23z7X39SdB7HufKSX5Yx4RPL7NLkT3U58p3GpiS2WSGJiCLGXKM1QdhEBq1qDuq2SvGyY.png)

Watching a drawing slowly evolve from rough lines into a complete artwork is always one of my favorite parts of digital art.

Every layer, every detail, every brush stroke gradually becomes part of something larger.

Creating fan art for Holozing is something I really enjoy because it allows me to mix my own creativity with a universe filled with fantasy, creatures, magic, and beautiful character designs.

Thank you very much for visiting my post and supporting my work ✨🌊
