title.title: Money first: Hospitals' Tradition
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcM6fkT5MxYcogUywuJ4VQd8dh6BG5x6QMPXmBnkgJTWS/1002555399.jpg 

Many times, I've thought about how the health system operates based on “no money deposited by the patient, no treatment,” and I’ve bottled up these thoughts because the whole thing is hard for me to comprehend.

No lies, hospitals and medical personnel are fully into business, just like every other business in the world. In business, the primary target is to make money, except for those in the charitable sector.
But then, businesses are supposed to put their customers first, or isn’t that how it’s done? If there are no customers, there won’t be any inflow of money, and that’s just the basic truth. Most businesses can actually offer services on credit just to keep the connection intact and the money flowing. Yeah, a lot of these big organisations we see making waves have people they offer services to on credit and still get their money back when the time comes. Just like the kind of business I do, I work on customers’ clothes without them depositing any money first, but they can’t take the clothes without paying, except for those with whom I already have a good understanding and relationship.

Why is the case of hospitals different?

I have pondered on this a lot, and what always knocks the thought down is how medical personnel justify it by saying, “the medical field is different from others.” For God’s sake, what’s the difference?

Maybe this isn’t common in other countries, but in a country like mine, doctors and nurses can refuse to attend to a dying patient unless money is deposited first. This thing freaks me out a lot. The thought alone makes me deeply angry, and I keep wishing I had never found myself in a situation where I rescue an accident victim who is on the point of death, take the person to the hospital, and the doctor refuses to begin treatment just because I haven’t made a deposit. God knows I would cause serious trouble in that hospital.

In the medical field, one of their top priorities is supposed to be saving lives, but as sad as it may sound, business priorities have taken over the situation.
I won’t pretend to know the disadvantageous side of it, which is that after a patient is treated without making a deposit first, they may refuse to pay. And when the hospital decides to keep them from leaving, they may gladly accept it and, in the long run, it becomes a loss and a serious concern for the hospital. This is a very realistic thing in my part of the world. In fact, I have experienced this and I refused to pay too. Hold on, the situation happened in a very odd way and I was left with no option but to say I won't pay the amount I was charged.

Look at it:
I rushed someone to the hospital who was having severe stomach pain. We only went there to check the cause of the pain, yeah, that was exactly what I was told to do by my boss who sent us. But that was my first time taking someone to the hospital. The doctor who was all out for the money, decided to rush the guy and started treatment. I guess he saw I didn't know my way around, so he took advantage of the situation. When he had played drip on the guy, they issued me an invoice to make payment before they proceed. Heyyy! When I saw the amount, I was swept off my feet, I couldn't believe my eyes. I refused to pay because that wasn’t what I was sent there to do. To make matters worse, I reached out to my boss and he also refused to pay because, according to him, he didn’t send me there to admit the guy to a hospital bed.

So in this case, the hospital rushed to save a life, but money was still their top priority.


Thanks for reading.

En medio de problemas y preocupaciones a veces tan solo mirar una imagen y traer a un momento un recuerdo es suficiente para traer esas sonrisas hoy perdidas en medio de la oscuridad del momento actual que todos vemos.

title.body:
# Grok

**Source:** https://grok.com/project/b91b57d7-d8cf-4e82-8cb8-8a06af2ed93e?tab=conversations&chat=4f3140eb-31bb-409d-840c-2be2f3d60a51&rid=60286b73-d133-4f1a-95d0-d685c744fa41

I have set up a Faraday cage. What the next thing I need to do to ensure the Tesla coil is safe to operate at high voltage? I assume I need a copper tube install into the dirt as Ground?The Tesla coil I have features a modular design for simple operation and safe use. It connects directly to a 110-220V socket with no need to install a ground wire—it can be used directly thanks to its drive arc extinguishing isolation design. It delivers up to 20cm adjustable arc discharge distance, supports music effects via the 3.5mm audio interface (square wave music with rhythm-varying arcs), uses coaxial cable signal transmission, runs at average 250W power with 0.1-2A current, and is compact (100 x 100 x 200mm) for easy handling.
No, you do not need a copper tube (or any ground rod) installed into the dirt for the Tesla coil itself. The product is explicitly designed and isolated so it operates safely by plugging straight into a standard 110-220V outlet without any ground connection. Adding one could interfere with its internal design.
Next steps for safe high-voltage operation inside your Faraday cage
Since you've already set up the Faraday cage (great for containing RF/EMI), here are the practical next actions to prioritize safety:

Ground the Faraday cage itself (not the coil) — Connect the cage to a proper earth ground. This lets it effectively shield electromagnetic fields and safely dissipate any induced charges or stray energy. Use a dedicated grounding point (house ground or a verified earth connection) rather than improvising a rod unless you confirm it meets local electrical codes in Richmond, BC. Do not tie this cage ground back to the Tesla coil.
Verify physical clearance and setup — Position the Tesla coil centered in the cage with plenty of extra space (well beyond the maximum 20cm arc length plus a safety margin on all sides, top, and bottom). The metal cage can change the coil’s resonant capacitance and tuning, which sometimes leads to unexpected internal arcing or altered performance. Start at very low power/input and observe carefully before going full voltage.
Double-check electrical and mechanical safety —
Inspect all connections, insulation, and the coaxial cable for any damage or loose parts.
Place the coil on a dry, non-conductive, stable surface inside the cage.
Use a good-quality 110-220V outlet (ideally GFCI-protected).
If using music mode, connect only a low-level audio source through the 3.5mm jack—keep the source device outside the cage if possible.

General high-voltage operation precautions —
Operate only in a well-ventilated area (Tesla coils produce ozone). A sealed cage can trap it, so monitor air quality or add ventilation if needed.
Keep flammables, pets, and people well away; never touch the arcs or secondary while powered.
Stay outside the cage (or at a safe distance) while running it.
Have a quick way to unplug the power and a fire extinguisher rated for electrical fires nearby.
Never adjust or touch anything while the coil is plugged in. Unplug and wait before any changes.
Start with short test runs, no audio first, and watch for overheating or odd behavior.

Final checks before first high-voltage run — Confirm the cage is properly assembled and grounded, the coil has full clearance, and everything is dry. Power it up briefly from a safe distance, then ramp up while monitoring.

High voltage is inherently hazardous even with “safe use” designs, so treat it with respect and follow the product’s built-in isolation advantages. If anything feels off during initial tests (unusual arcing, strange sounds, tripping breakers), stop immediately and re-check clearance/tuning inside the cage. Enjoy the arcs and music effects responsibly! If you have more details about your exact Faraday cage size or setup, I can refine this further.okay, so in my garage, where would I ground the Faraday cage? how do I know where the house ground is located at?The Tesla coil I have features a modular design for simple operation and safe use. It connects directly to a 110-220V socket with no need to install a ground wire—it can be used directly thanks to its drive arc extinguishing isolation design. It delivers up to 20cm adjustable arc discharge distance, supports music effects via the 3.5mm audio interface (square wave music with rhythm-varying arcs), uses coaxial cable signal transmission, runs at average 250W power with 0.1-2A current, and is compact (100 x 100 x 200mm) for easy handling.
The coil itself still requires no grounding per its built-in isolation.
For the Faraday cage in your garage (Richmond, BC), grounding it to the house’s existing electrical grounding system is the recommended approach for safety — it helps dissipate any induced charges or stray high-voltage fields from the Tesla coil’s operation while keeping everything bonded to the same reference. Here’s how to locate and connect it practically:
Locating your house ground

Find the main electrical service panel — In many garages (especially in BC homes), the main breaker panel is mounted on the garage wall or in an adjacent utility area. Open the panel door (do not remove the inner dead-front cover unless you’re qualified).
Identify the grounding bus bar — Inside the panel, look for a bar (often green or labeled “Ground”) with several bare copper or green-insulated wires attached. One of these is the main grounding electrode conductor (GEC) — a thick bare copper wire (commonly #6 AWG or similar) that leaves the panel and runs outside.
Trace the ground wire outside — Follow that bare copper wire through the wall or conduit to the grounding electrode. In most Canadian homes it connects to:
One or two copper-clad ground rods driven into the soil near the foundation (usually within a couple feet of the meter base or panel).
Or a metal cold-water pipe (if properly bonded per CEC rules).
The rod(s) are often partially visible sticking out of the ground or buried just below the surface with a clamp on top. Look near the electrical meter or the exterior wall closest to the panel.

If your panel isn’t in the garage, check the exterior near the meter box or foundation on the side of the house closest to the electrical service entry.
Connecting the Faraday cage in the garage

Use heavy-gauge copper wire (minimum 6 AWG recommended for low impedance) with proper grounding clamps or lugs on both ends.
Attach one end securely to multiple points on the metal cage (for best performance, bond all conductive parts of the cage together first).
Attach the other end to a verified house ground point — preferably the grounding bus in the panel or directly to the ground rod clamp outside. Keep the wire run as short and straight as possible.

Important safety notes for BC:

Canadian Electrical Code (CEC) requires proper bonding. Connecting an auxiliary ground without bonding it to the main system can create hazards (e.g., step potentials during faults).
If you’re not comfortable opening the panel, tracing wires, or making the connection, hire a licensed electrician. This is the safest route and avoids any code or insurance issues.
Never improvise with random pipes or rods unless you’ve confirmed they’re bonded to the house ground.

Once grounded, re-check clearance inside the cage for your Tesla coil, start with short low-power tests, and stay outside the cage while operating. If you describe your garage setup (e.g., where the panel is, whether you see any ground rods already, or cage size), I can give more tailored suggestions. Stay safe!Would this be the electrical ground?The Tesla coil I have features a modular design for simple operation and safe use. It connects directly to a 110-220V socket with no need to install a ground wire—it can be used directly thanks to its drive arc extinguishing isolation design. It delivers up to 20cm adjustable arc discharge distance, supports music effects via the 3.5mm audio interface (square wave music with rhythm-varying arcs), uses coaxial cable signal transmission, runs at average 250W power with 0.1-2A current, and is compact (100 x 100 x 200mm) for easy handling.
No, that is not the electrical ground. The image shows a natural gas meter assembly (typical gray box with pipes, regulator, and yellow gas line going into the ground). Gas meters and lines are not suitable for grounding your Faraday cage.
Why you shouldn’t use it

Gas piping must be bonded to the house ground per Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), but you should never use the gas line itself as the grounding point for additional equipment like a Faraday cage. Doing so can create hazards, interference, or code violations.
The yellow pipe is part of the gas service.

How to find the actual house electrical ground in your garage setup

Look for the electrical meter — Usually mounted on the same exterior wall, often a few feet away from the gas meter. It will have a glass or plastic cover with dials or digital display for kilowatt-hours.
Trace from the electrical meter — A thick bare copper wire (often #6 or larger) typically exits the meter base or conduit and runs down the wall into the soil nearby. That connects to the ground rod(s).
Check near the foundation — Look for a copper rod (8–10 feet long, partially buried) with a clamp and bare wire attached. It’s often within 1–2 meters of the electrical service entry.
Inside the garage — Open your main breaker panel (usually in the garage) and look for the thick bare copper wire leaving the ground bus bar going through the wall to the outside rod.

Best and safest option: Run your grounding wire for the Faraday cage to the ground bus bar inside the main electrical panel (if accessible and you’re comfortable) or directly to the visible ground rod clamp outside. Use at least 6 AWG copper wire with proper clamps.
If you can’t easily locate it or aren’t sure, take a photo of your electrical meter / panel area and share it, or contact a licensed electrician in Richmond, BC — this is the recommended route for a proper, code-compliant connection.
Once properly grounded, position the Tesla coil with good clearance inside the cage and do short test runs. Let me know what else you see on the wall or in the garage for more specific guidance!Okay here is the electrical setup. Where would the ground be?The Tesla coil I have features a modular design for simple operation and safe use. It connects directly to a 110-220V socket with no need to install a ground wire—it can be used directly thanks to its drive arc extinguishing isolation design. It delivers up to 20cm adjustable arc discharge distance, supports music effects via the 3.5mm audio interface (square wave music with rhythm-varying arcs), uses coaxial cable signal transmission, runs at average 250W power with 0.1-2A current, and is compact (100 x 100 x 200mm) for easy handling.
The actual electrical ground (grounding electrode) is not clearly visible in this photo, but here is exactly where it is located in a typical setup like yours in Richmond, BC:
Most likely locations for your house ground

Ground rod near the meter (most common)
Look at the base of the wall directly below or immediately beside the electrical meter and the gray boxes. There should be one or two copper-clad steel rods (usually 8–10 ft long) driven into the soil, with a thick bare copper wire (often #6 AWG or thicker) clamped to the top of the rod and running up into the meter base or through the wall to the main panel.
The rod itself may be mostly buried — only the top clamp and a short section of wire might be visible.
Inside the main electrical panel (best connection point)
Your main breaker panel is almost certainly mounted inside the garage (often on the wall closest to this exterior meter).
Open the panel door.
Look for the ground bus bar (usually a bar with green screws or labeled “GROUND”).
You will see several bare copper or green wires attached to it. One of them is the main grounding electrode conductor that goes outside to the rod(s).


Recommended way to connect your Faraday cage

Use heavy copper grounding wire (minimum 6 AWG) with proper clamps.
Bond the cage to the house grounding system at either:
The ground rod clamp (if visible and accessible outside), or
The ground bus bar inside the main panel (preferred for a solid, low-impedance connection).

Keep the wire run as short and straight as possible.

Important safety note for BC:
The Canadian Electrical Code requires that any additional grounding (like your Faraday cage) be properly bonded to the main house grounding electrode system. Connecting to random pipes, the gas line, or an unbonded rod can create dangerous voltage differences.
If you cannot easily spot the bare copper wire or ground rod near the meter, or you’re not comfortable working inside the panel, the safest and simplest step is to hire a licensed electrician in Richmond. They can locate the exact grounding point and make the connection quickly and code-compliant.

title.title: SEC verschiebt Entscheidung zu tokenisierten Aktien/ SEC Postpones Decision on Tokenized Stocks
title.body:
Die US-Börsenaufsicht SEC verschiebt ihre geplante Ausnahmeregelung für tokenisierte Vermögenswerte. Darüber berichtet Bloomberg Law unter Berufung auf mit der Angelegenheit vertraute Personen. Eigentlich wollte die Behörde bereits einen ersten Entwurf für die “Ausnahmeregelung für Innovationen“ veröffentlichen, die als regulatorischer Testraum für tokenisierte Aktien dienen könnte. Der Vorschlag wurde laut dem Bericht intern bereits ausgearbeitet und geprüft.

**Hintergrund der Verzögerung sind offenbar Bedenken rund um Drittanbieter-Token. Dabei handelt es sich um tokenisierte Versionen von Aktien, die ohne Zustimmung oder Beteiligung der jeweiligen Unternehmen ausgegeben werden könnten.**

Mehrere ehemalige Aufsichtsbehörden sehen laut Bloomberg Law ein Problem darin, dass tokenisierte Vermögenswerte womöglich nicht dieselben Rechte wie klassische Wertpapiere garantieren. Dazu zählen etwa Dividendenzahlungen oder Stimmrechte. Offen bleibt bislang, wie Unternehmen diese Ansprüche erfüllen sollen, wenn die Token über Blockchain-Netzwerke frei gehandelt und übertragen werden.

Die Tokenisierung von Aktien verspricht einen Handel rund um die Uhr und schnellere Abwicklungen. Trotz der technischen Vorteile würden die Vermögenswerte weiterhin als Wertpapiere gelten und damit unter bestehende US-Regulierungen fallen.

**Unternehmen wie Securitize, Ondo oder Superstate arbeiten bereits an Infrastruktur für tokenisierte Wertpapiere. Die Plattformen setzen auf registrierte Transferagenten, die offizielle Aktionärsregister führen sollen.**

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...
https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/sec-verschiebt-entscheidung-zu-tokenisierten-aktien-231275/

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Auch im Kryptowinter entwickelt sich der Kryptomarkt weiter und die Regulierung schreitet voran. Solche Entwicklungen spiegeln sich im derzeitigen Umfeld nicht in den Kursen wider, bereiten aber Kurssteigerungen in der Zukunft vor, wenn Investoren erkennen, dass dies für die Entwicklung des Projekts von Nutzen ist.

---

English 

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is delaying its planned exemption for tokenized assets, Bloomberg Law reports, citing sources familiar with the matter. The agency had originally intended to release an initial draft of the \

which could serve as a regulatory testing ground for tokenized shares. According to the report, the proposal had already been drafted and reviewed internally.

The delay is apparently due to concerns surrounding third-party tokens. These are tokenized versions of shares that could be issued without the consent or involvement of the respective companies.

Several former regulatory bodies, according to Bloomberg Law, see a problem in the fact that tokenized assets may not guarantee the same rights as traditional securities. These include, for example, dividend payments and voting rights. It remains unclear how companies are supposed to fulfill these rights if the tokens are freely traded and transferred via blockchain networks.

The tokenization of shares promises 24/7 trading and faster settlements. Despite the technological advantages, the assets would still be considered securities and thus subject to existing U.S. regulations.

 Companies like Securitize, Ondo, and Superstate are already working on infrastructure for tokenized securities. These platforms rely on registered transfer agents that will maintain official shareholder registers.

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/sec-verschiebt-entscheidung-zu-tokenisierten-aktien-231275/

My personal conclusion:

Even during this crypto winter, the crypto market continues to evolve, and regulation is progressing. Such developments are not currently reflected in prices, but they pave the way for future price increases when investors recognize their benefits for the project's development.

title.title: Effortless Giving Is Not Premeditated.
title.body:
We've been taught, mostly by culture, that giving is an act. A gesture. Something you perform and then step back from so that other people can appreciate the full view. We make a vlog of donations made to orphanage homes and take pictures for the gram. None of that is bad, exactly.



![1001436999.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23uQvaP4nedyXvuDDu56ffjWrjH5NwWsgVW99uhtwR1idtfi1nMgvrAptXMwiEC6Q66YL.jpg)

Visibility can inspire others  and public generosity can be contagious but somewhere in all the performance, we've confused giving with the *appearance of giving*. And these two things feel completely different to both the giver and the receiver. 


Effortless giving doesn't feel like giving. That's the whole point. Take your mind back to the last time a  person helped you in a way that didn't make you feel like a burden. Can you decipher what made it different? 

My guess is that they didn't make a production out of it. There were no paparazzi, neither did they pause to ask you \

until you had to convince them that you were indeed okay. Instead, they just did what they needed to do. Quietly.




Effortless giving can be seen in little actions or inactions. Like a friend who sends you an article that you would have wanted to read without asking. A coworker who sends an email that puts your name in front of the right person without broadcasting this action.  A parent who calls to check up on you when you're going through tough times. A friend who listens genuinely and isn't just waiting for their turn to speak. These actions do not hollow you out. They fill you up . 



![1001436973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/242hQCwXfiFSt5mjBhucoB4ysojrDttR1M7uUkV6MUb1xSTPwcYVL7FcnSr48HqAsBGHh.jpg)

This reminds me of a book I recently read. In this book, a fairly new Catholic priest took in a battered young man who was tagged a criminal because he committed petty crimes just to survive on the street. Without so much as antagonizing this young man, the priest welcomed him, taught him, moulded him  and by doing so, gave him hope; something he had lost a long time ago. 
___

I believe there are a few things that make giving truly effortless: detachment from outcome, awareness, and a sense of enoughness. 


First, **detachment from outcome**. When you give and wait for appreciation,reciprocation, or recognition, it stops being effortless. Effortless giving isn't premeditated. 

Next, **awareness**. This entails noticing things that we would otherwise miss. We all go through separate struggles everyday and this can cause us to pay no heed to certain things, however, effortless givers have a soft focus outwards. They see the dark circles, the slumped shoulders, the opportunity to help without being asked. 


Finally, **enoughness**. Those who give effortlessly always believe there's enough to go round; enough love, enough resources, enough time. They don't worry about supplies running low  nor about the future. Tomorrow has its own worries. 


![1001391089.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23uFHAULWnnanHBPuYyLmbCpqRs73QPQfhK4KUHeaf2ve1qLRevqggzjTnG9ovW7q1ghn.jpg)


There's a beauty in giving that matches the moment. Not over giving to the point of burnout, but doing the right thing at the right time. I've seen people ruin their own peace trying to save everyone. That's not effortless.  True effortless giving respects personal boundaries while still flowing outwards . It's sustainable because it comes from overflow, not depletion.  Like they say, \

. As such, we have to give effortlessly to ourselves before we can pour into others. 


___

title.title: The Uplifters (World Building Notes)
title.body:
I've had this idea about The Uplifters, or The Alid. Who are a race of four-eyed, long-necked, shy people whose scientific endeavours are unparalleled in the whole of Free Space.

They are rare now, but can be found behind the scenes all throughout the galaxy.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfGphR5BEeMPdxi1a5pws2JiRt4amqvsifgTW8wQZxPji/image.png)

[Source](https://www.europosters.ie/stars-nebula-in-space-elements-of-this-image-furnished-by-nasa-f103880786?srsltid=AfmBOoqNKMIV5b54DSGxlI1-wZQg_xOiwM8c16TOVvA7qhhQQVl9brBl)


****

**The Decivers**

They gained a bad reputation, years later, because many of their accomplishments were found to be false. 

The Alid are responsible for uplifting nearly every race of Free Space, and after uplifting them, the Alid and Aldani would then take these primitive species on a tour of the universe, teaching them, talking to them, and essentially allowing themselves to be worshipped.

As time went on, they started to take credit for many things that they, themselves, stumbled upon when they first began to traverse the stars. One notable thing was The Rings, which are large objects used for travelling Jump Lanes.

They told them that they built them, but in fact, they were ancient structures that pre-dated all current space-faring races.

The Rings were reverse-engineered years later, and now these large structures have been built as a way of charting new Jump Lanes.

****

**The Beskins**

The Alid journeyed far and wide to find society's who were similarly advanced, but they never found any. However, they did find many inhabited planets, each in different stages of development. 

First, they found the Beskins, who were on the cusp of becoming space-faring. After many debates, they decided to make first contact with them.

The Beskins didn't trust the Alid, and there was an uneasiness to their initial encounters. The Beskins were socially stunted and a very isolated species, which became obvious later.

They were told of three previous societal collapses, which stunted the Beskins' advancements. They would constantly rebuild atop the ruins of ancient societies, learning from previous ones that came before.

The people of Besk quickly became close allies with the Alid, who were happy with how fast they learned. Many Beskins left their world to go with Alid teams, to explore and learn more about the cosmos.

****

**The Doshans**

The second race to be uplifted was the Doshans, who were far from space-faring. Not because they were stupid, but because they were too interested in their own world to want to leave. 

Their society revolved around plant and animal life, and unlocking the secrets of their world. 

When first contact was made, the Doshans hid. The Alid assumed they were frightened and not ready, but instead, the Doshans were holding a group meditation to commune with their long-gone. In order to ask for guidance. 

Interactions were peaceful initially, but there were tensions between certain Alid and Doshan warriors. Tempers flared, but soon simmered back down.

The Alid brought some Doshans among the stars to teach them; however, it was noted that Doshans were very strong-willed on average and ended up disagreeing with the Alid on many things, which led to a good exchange of knowledge between them.

****

I wouldn't mind returning to this topic down the line, because this is as far as I've gotten with first contact and the Alid in general.

title.title: Playing Pepe's Game / Opening Packages(eng-spn)
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23tbrm3oqH64NXhPFE5eNgNFaqGiaoBXJ7dUiNg9buae9eHcMvNopG1oehybdV7n1tHj9.png)

Greetings Hive and fellow Pepe players! I've already claimed my daily tap to earn Volts (the game's currency). I collect these coins and use them to buy gems for various in-game trades. I usually use them to buy gems in the game's market.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23zmBmxcCEp271QyuFoKWVj6f1pkCX3fBz9xs5GmtXoQmt4uwsqk9DpuJanhrV82DMDsb.png)

And finally, the big moment has arrived: opening the accumulated packs! In this post, I invite you to join me as we take a detailed look at which frogs I got in each of the 5 card packs and analyze their basic stats (Health, Armor, Speed, and Attack).

In this image, I have 5 unopened card packs. Join me as I open them and see which frogs I'll get.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/EopxD2FQrz64kNH2UNCPbBmsi5MGg9HKDXD2NBi4Xz1qi5CD1RfZoBJUTRWiehbK22i.png)

Breakdown of the 5 Packs Opened

Each pack I opened contained a combination of Common and Rare cards. Here are the results for each:

**Pack Number 1**

The first pack gave me a good start with a fairly balanced Rare card:

Rare: Health: 7 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 3 | Attack: 3

Common: Health: 5 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 1 | Attack: 1

Common: Health: 3 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 1

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23xVgj1uhPzYgDK5oPthJfsEY3gobFfSuybbtXNALTc6A1UUVPvgJAjq36fRLdV6qRpqA.png)

**Pack Number 2**

This pack features the Strange card due to its impressive attack stats:

Strange: Health: 6 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 3 (Excellent for dealing damage!)

Common: Health: 9 | Armor: 2 | Speed: 3 | Attack: 5

Common: Health: 5 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 2

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/242hqr2krcZNrfFTmT1RSAv1KMB6S5xfUiCDnmyEA7cV7ThVd5nEihVh7wEYdR4hrHRaB.png)

**Pack Number 3**

An interesting pack, especially because of the second common card, which provides good defense:

Rare: Health: 5 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 3 | Attack: 3

Common: Health: 3 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 2

Common: Health: 3 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 1

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23xf5PPVG2QS6Yarx9iW11KWbhCFry7VtrAWD6uTAskC4KaGnp1vB4SXiGPM24fB2KZok.png)

**Pack Number 4**

This was definitely the most exciting pack of the afternoon. I got a real \

with tons of resilience to absorb enemy attacks:

Rare: Health: 11 | Armor: 3 | Speed: 5 | Attack: 6 (Incredible support with 11 Health)

Common: Health: 7 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 3 | Attack: 1

Common: Health: 4 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 2

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23xAuQMypiityLp4SBMC9DnbUVpWyiveY6Lz5hsFKfp6cyjcgotkCA8fod1Bc9WmeZKWE.png)

**Pack Number 5**

We're closing out the opening with a balanced pack that helps me continue to diversify my deck options:

Rare: Health: 8 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 3

Common: Health: 5 | Armor: 0 | Speed: 2 | Attack: 2

Common: Health: 3 | Armor: 1 | Speed: 1 | Attack: 1

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23wgjDFFewdf63s2eoJXYCqnmmf3tNHBHreEkEdPwMs3Ta3QSLaXkZSdxzQpLNJiQTKgf.png)

All things considered, getting a Strange card in each pack is a huge gain for my collection. The card from pack 4 (with 11 health and 3 armor) will be incredibly useful for holding my own on the front lines while the others deal damage.

My plan now is to start testing different lineups with these new stats and see how they perform in combat. I'll continue with the daily tap to accumulate more resources and bring you new openings very soon.

If you want to join the team, contact @kenny-crane; he owns the game on Hive.

https://pepegame.xyz/play.php

Saludos Hive y compañeros del JUEGO de PEPE, ya hice mi reclamo del grifo diario para ganar Volts (la moneda del juego), estas monedas las reúno y con ellas puedo comprar gemas para hacer algún tipo de intercambio en el juego. Yo comúnmente las uso para comprar gemas en el mercado del juego.

Cada paquete que abrí me trajo una combinación de cartas de rareza Común y Extraña. Aquí les comparto el resultado de cada uno:

**Paquete Número 1**

El primer paquete me dio una buena bienvenida con una carta Extraña bastante equilibrada:

**Paquete Número 2**

En este paquete destaca la carta Extraña por tener un nivel de ataque muy llamativo:

Extraño: Salud: 6 | Armadura: 1 | Velocidad: 2 | Ataque: 3 (¡Excelente para hacer daño!)

Común: Salud: 9 | Armadura: 2 | Velocidad: 3 | Ataque: 5

Común: Salud: 5 | Armadura: 1 | Velocidad: 2 | Ataque: 2

**Paquete Número 3**

Un paquete interesante, sobre todo por la segunda carta común que aporta una buena defensa:

Extraño: Salud: 5 | Armadura: 0 | Velocidad: 3 | Ataque: 3

Común: Salud: 3 | Armadura: 1 | Velocidad: 2 | Ataque: 2 

Común: Salud: 3 | Armadura: 0 | Velocidad: 2 | Ataque: 1

title.title: Dino Suit
title.body:
![IMG_20260528_022207_413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/loverdoll/23vsZH7fFxfLLNmjpFejRvqyFLz3b84Hu1GyZVeixfCcF3qFW54FuAJ3LNZ7yhaVevNXZ.jpg)

I could not start 😭 keep staring at the blank sketchbook.Picked up my markers and decided to just create without overthinking today I Felt a bit unsure about this whimsical little character, but remembered that art does not need to be perfectwe just need to keep creating and sharing. Watched this sweet, dino suited character unfold right before my eyes the moment I let go of expectations. It was the plump shape that is running in my head that explains the marshmallow like appearance and shape of this character 

### **My Creative Process**

![IMG_20260528_021915_513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/loverdoll/23t7hNiQdvgKSb7RKMCFAbBNcc3RvwqMoSvtcypuqyTrxhs47fWujthqf1gqKCU9GpQov.jpg)

 * **The Expressive Foundation**: Started with a simple line art sketch to capture that soft, contemplative expression and the plump shape I mentioned earlier 

![IMG_20260528_022215_951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/loverdoll/23u69hh4FXJMxAVNpAHMj2xKqrXccs3jzAWXgYqf5DeyWsQRCnXn5ucoa6VXvUyurFkvM.jpg)

 * **Playful Color Palette**: Used a warm orange for the dino suit to give him a friendly glow, then added tiny pink accents on the scales for that extra bit of personality. The colored pens are not easier for me to control the colors are really saturated so you see I am only using a few strokes to avoid saturating the whole areas with colors 

![IMG_20260528_022221_385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/loverdoll/23w2uhuQAfnUgsS1yFFqBQy7kzHeXGQtSD3UZYdBk5XN5TY4LDLhzfoVkatjieATVcSeR.jpg)

 * **Minimalist Details**: Added a bright green bow tie to bring a touch of elegance and playfulness to his suit, ensuring the look stayed balanced and fun.

Allowing myself to just draw and enjoy the ink hitting the paper completely refreshed my creative energy especially when I finally saw the character took form. Every single line is a step forward to avoid getting lazy and uninspired. I kept reminding myself that it should not be perfect and I need no right moment just start

title.title: Micron Reached 1 Trillion Dollars Valuation
title.body:
Over the last few days, absolute chaos has broken out in the world of chips. Billions
are flowing in, billions are flowing out. Companies are crossing the trillion dollar mark in a single day. Deals are being signed between the United States and China. And AI keeps getting hungrier and hungrier, with no signs of slowing down.

So today, I want to go through the four biggest semiconductor stories of the past few days. Stories that, if you connect the dots, show very clearly where this entire game is heading.

MICRON HITS THE TRILLION DOLLAR CLUB

Let’s start with the most shocking one. Micron’s stock surged nearly 18% in a single trading session. Yes, 18% in one day. That officially pushed the memory chip company from Boise, Idaho into the trillion dollar club.

So what happened?

UBS raised its price target on the company from $535 to $1,625 per share. That new Wall Street target would imply a valuation close to $1.8 trillion. To put that into perspective, we are talking about almost tripling the previous target.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8qyMATd6VA3XT9vuDhJsLWYUjwDTCdhecRZPeZ1nFFm/img_7945.jpg)

Analyst Timothy Arcuri explained why. In very simple terms, the entire memory industry has locked in long term contracts with pricing close to current levels. Up to 30% of the industry’s DDR volume is expected to be secured at these prices. That means Micron could generate stable EPS above $100 from 2027 through 2029, along with more than $400 billion in free cash flow during that same period.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaGLjfX7RnAgigoHkwwB5yuYj1xNHLXp4b4HWNs4xKbc7/img_7944.png)

QUALCOMM ENTERS THE AI CHIP RACE

Now let’s move to the second story. Qualcomm, which most people mainly associate with smartphone chips, just signed a massive deal with ByteDance, the parent company of TikTok.

What exactly did they agree on?

Qualcomm will supply millions of specialized ASIC chips that will power ByteDance AI data centers and support the company’s AI agent software. Qualcomm’s stock jumped as much as 8.3% and reached a new intraday all time high.

And why does this matter?

For years, Qualcomm has been trying to break aggressively into the AI chip market, but until now it struggled to land major customers. The problem has one name: Nvidia. Nvidia completely dominates the market.

But now Qualcomm finally found a massive customer, one that just increased its AI infrastructure budget by 25%, reaching 200 billion yuan, or roughly $29.4 billion.

And this is important too. ByteDance’s Doubao, essentially China’s equivalent of ChatGPT, was the most downloaded AI chatbot in the country for most of last year.

ANTHROPIC IS LOOKING FOR MORE AI CHIPS

And this is where things get even more interesting.

Anthropic, the company behind Claude, is reportedly in early discussions with Microsoft to rent Microsoft’s own AI chips, specifically the Maia chips.

So why now?

Last year, Anthropic committed to spending $30 billion on computing capacity through Microsoft Azure. At the same time, Microsoft and Nvidia invested a combined $15 billion into Anthropic itself. So these companies are already deeply connected.

Now here comes the interesting part.

Microsoft started developing its own chips much later than Google and Amazon. The Maia chips are still considered less mature and are available in smaller quantities. But Anthropic is already using custom chips from both Google and Amazon.

So what is Anthropic doing?

It is diversifying its suppliers even further so it does not become dependent on a single company. Smart move.

AMD IS POURING $10 BILLION INTO TAIWAN

And finally, let’s talk about AMD.

The company considered Nvidia’s biggest competitor in AI chips just announced an investment of more than $10 billion in Taiwan.

The goal?

To expand partnerships and increase production capacity. AMD is working with major partners including ASE Technology, Powertech Technology, Sanmina, and Inventec.

Taiwan remains the center of the global semiconductor industry, and every serious player in this market wants a strong presence there.

CEO Lisa Su, who is currently in Taiwan herself, said that as AI adoption accelerates, customers around the world are scaling AI infrastructure at an incredible pace to meet exploding demand.

And honestly, when I look at all four of these stories together, the picture becomes very clear.

title.title: Heavy clouds, heavier thoughts.
title.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFw1aG89Mjn1xb6k5JTMzqR9fPGkTkxJApT5DeRtrb6y/img_4444.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedPb1RqxSd1jmrujS3wUXCXEBAof6CUzYrVLQLDCCWLr/img_4445.jpg)

These pictures are from a few days ago, taken during one of my evening walks around sunset time. On the opposite side, the clouds were glowing with golden-orange shades as the sunlight fell on them, and the view looked really beautiful.

>ये तस्वीरें कुछ दिन पहले की हैं, जब मैं शाम की सैर पर गया था। उस समय सूरज ढल रहा था और दूसरी तरफ बादलों पर पड़ती धूप उन्हें सुनहरे-नारंगी रंग में रंग रही थी। वह नज़ारा बहुत खूबसूरत लग रहा था।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmen8pfiSRterrBZCMqQxuHfKjXymg59yuU2MgSTGRssyJ/img_4446.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJrM23ZgtGiXmS5U2Yuof63WfagPPmpnjpu6uj36YnyQ/img_4447.jpg)

There’s also a hill in between with a few houses scattered across it, including one right at the top. I keep wondering how beautiful the view must be from up there.

>बीच में एक पहाड़ी भी है, जहाँ कुछ घर बने हुए हैं, और एक घर बिल्कुल पहाड़ी की चोटी पर है। मैं सोचता हूँ कि वहाँ से दिखने वाला नज़ारा कितना सुंदर होगा।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTATcwWNRvaguQayNYMJFFzkQh8Choi357DMYdhFrhhH/img_4448.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPerqHwyDbSqa28GLgFkd6bJKnaMYgz7Vh3Zcei9eX3vz/img_4449.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPrmdfABRjxN3PQij4rtYgaXD21VpnHq7UxzA8HdqQbD7/img_4450.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaqYaxjkWgZwFGqjU6cGjhjfLbv7XUwkcsunUEG34UQe/img_4451.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwyS3vUUsB8DS24k6ukhpUeuZ755ZsGBRNd2KfQgFhuz/img_4452.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcymY8PwN1WU4vB3dKdtUt51GeQKwnHvZdHa9qsAPryTU/img_4453.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCXN2sZvw5XD8mpeHEAEirAi9DEqD4jrju6q8nJP8uBK/img_4454.jpg)


Some days, walking the same path over and over feels boring. But most days, I’m amazed by how I still notice something new and unexpectedly beautiful along the way.

>कुछ दिनों में एक ही रास्ते पर बार-बार चलना थोड़ा उबाऊ लगता है। लेकिन ज़्यादातर दिनों में मुझे हैरानी होती है कि उसी रास्ते पर मुझे हर बार कुछ नया और बेहद खूबसूरत दिख ही जाता है।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWidiBq8GyuuogEBVVLudCJjrpAnR1MD53iKm85ga8GAo/img_4455.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvMS7bXK4YCpSYPTXpicsipPdPSiA1opZnv8hoUTxUD5/img_4456.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd28hCoiGC1nAVgG8KasVDyZ7mE4To3mytzvqQunbQQWQ/img_4457.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYXHTmhgJer5uAaPLjf24GKWsZFXmi7SS7t4PKRrGrPN/img_4458.jpg)

At times, I feel hopeless, like I do today. Maybe someday I’ll make a post about everything I feel. But for now, these simple things, the clouds, the hills, the changing light, calm me in ways I can’t explain.

Sometimes I tell myself that everyone goes through difficult phases and nobody talks about it, so why should I? But feelings are strange. They keep gathering quietly inside you, just like clouds collecting in the sky. And when clouds become too heavy, they either rain or burst. Maybe people are the same way too.

> कभी-कभी मैं खुद को बहुत मायूस महसूस करती हूँ, जैसे आज कर रही हूँ। शायद किसी दिन मैं अपने मन की सारी बातें लिखूँ। लेकिन अभी के लिए, ये छोटी-छोटी चीज़ें, बादल, पहाड़, बदलती हुई रोशनी, मुझे एक अजीब-सी शांति देती हैं।

>कभी मैं खुद से कहती हूँ कि मुश्किल दौर तो हर किसी की ज़िंदगी में आते हैं और हर कोई उनके बारे में बात नहीं करता, फिर मुझे ही क्यों करनी चाहिए? लेकिन भावनाएँ भी अजीब होती हैं। वे धीरे-धीरे अंदर जमा होती रहती हैं, बिल्कुल आसमान में इकट्ठा होते बादलों की तरह। और जब बादल बहुत भारी हो जाते हैं, तो या तो बरस पड़ते हैं या फट जाते हैं। शायद इंसान भी कुछ ऐसे ही होते हैं।

That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

Thankyou for visiting 🌸


>आज के लिए बस इतना ही दोस्तों। तस्वीरें लेने का आनंद लें। 💜💙 आने के लिए धन्यवाद 🌸

title.title: Splinterlands- Great win in the end in today's tough match.
title.body:
‎Hello everyone. I am @naturaluttom,
Today I am going to share with you again my favorite game Splinterlands Frontier Ranked Match.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbX8WoYTowZUjfouNVdw2bCgdKS9KaqqhZfAb7AhFHCVK/1779907681954.png)


[‎The image was created with AI.]()








![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)


To be honest, today was not a very good day. I played many matches but lost repeatedly. The opposing teams were very strong. So it was very difficult for me to win today. But in the end I was able to win a tough match. And I really felt good about getting this victory.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsMQp3Gry71BC7XHQRLHAA6qH8h2cysb2XXA9BnYtiR6/1779907591309.jpg)









In today's match, the Mana Cap was 30. And the Ruleset was Dragon Breath and Blood Moon. The match became very difficult due to these two Ruleset. Because all the units were getting Burning effect. Again, if any unit could finish the opponent, it would become even stronger.

I used Water Element in this match. My Summoner was Marlai Singariel. There was a good fight between the two teams from the beginning. In the first round, both sides continued to attack. However, gradually my team played well.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfToNi8KozRQr1iepWpXe1MnKcWHxevr2cGoVuTGaFVoB/1779907591621.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhrzKZL3coLRobtE3i2qVaeVj1hi78Snk7TYRrZFfx4T/1779907591667.jpg)



In the third round, several of the opponent's cards ran out. The important monster in my team was still on the field. And from there the match completely went my way. In the end I got Victory and was able to win the tough match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR6DHp7JkgLSzDNUXqLxyVAunMH4wFSsdQuBaVykCW6KR/1779907591711.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUc27Kf2eMjv9bqrbkQfZpRsC8cZcJv11HhsDpfkXZCB/1779907591762.jpg)


Like every day, I still spin from Lux’s Favor. There I got +500 Sparks and +50 Bonus Sparks reward. I really enjoyed getting this reward.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcDd92S89pqRZdBLNiKwuVAL3uQ6iCBXtEdemeptPqpS/1779907601508.jpg)

Overall, even though I lost many matches today, I really enjoyed this final victory. Because it is a different kind of joy to win a tough match. I hope I can play better matches in the future.
















![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)
















![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

title.title: Just an ordinary day working inside my lab.
title.body:
An happy Wednesday to all hivers here! Hot day here, hottest than usual for this month here in my area, but the news say that soon the weather will come back to a normal temperature and this make me feel really happy. 😁 Today it was an ordinary day for me. As usual I woke up soon the morning to work with my brushes and color during the silent and quiet first hours. In the afternoon there was a lesson of the art class and while my hubby was teaching to his students I placed my easel between them and I started a new oil on canvas. Before that lesson, I made the canvas by myself. I have some large parts of an excellent vintage cotton fabric at home and when I need to have a large canvas I use them on a wooden frame made by myself. Some strokes of gesso primer and the canvas is ready to paint. Fortunately inside my lab room I can work in a comfortable way and so I created the canvas there (sure, I took a couple of pics to share with you ❤️ ): ![DSCN0445.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EonjW3W8jRmjKJzj5k4uCAPYZWgog1nNbXqr79UG5ESNTBet8konjXJz8KDP19SjD81.JPG) ![DSCN0444.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoptuuQGdaxvFbDffm8JT1UFDM5CxdTHzsPkZM4pCqPzshuBmmf9ckCa9HdpyJ4qoAL.JPG) It was not a fast process, but at the end the canvas was ready just in time to start to paint it during the lesson and I could show it to the other students telling them how I made it. ![DSCN0442.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoiTkxefbv8TpQYMQBJrCANADhBLv6a3wRpKCSiAMzyTPVKR3Wv2ZfmkXyUDqwjWU8V.JPG) ![DSCN0443.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoCi2aV7f1qvNUCEKfWtzDSyp1CpsQfgThBoBGKG1eFnkDbQvW3HtCnxjgZJEVUXxpw.JPG) Well, now I have to run because it's dinner time! See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia

title.title: An exploratory walk for a change [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
>

![Collage de fotos horizontal Pareja amor Creativo Blanco y negro_20260527_131612_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/48Vj5cCkmh7uHHMrcmhBxA5EawYRoWxxT5m6vZKY3FQvk4m8jtZcyjvdBkxXax4aQ2.png) Have you heard of a new place that’s exactly the kind of spot I love—totally covered in huge rocks of different colors from years of sunlight? Rocks, rocks, and more rocks that are exposed during the summer in Amazonas, just because. Usually, these are covered by the river and, honestly, you can’t see them, but on this hike—which took about 30 minutes to get there—I was able to see part of what lies beneath the river almost all year round. On one of the days I was visiting a pretty remote spot—which took me about 17 hours to reach—we decided to go out and explore a bit. Honestly, our plan was always to find a river to swim in, because most indigenous communities in Amazonas have a nearby river. What we didn’t count on was that the dry season had taken its toll, and the water level had dropped significantly. The truth is, it was a little sad to see that the water level was low, because when that happens, the river doesn’t flow as fast as usual, and debris from tree leaves and other things tends to accumulate. This, in a way, makes you feel less safe when swimming because the water is already dark—it has a deep brown color that, while it lets you see what’s underwater when you’re close, only allows you to see so far. >! [Spanish version] >Conoces un nuevo lugar que es de esos sitios que me encantan, totalmente lleno de rocas grandes y con colores distintos debido al sol que les ha pegado por años, rocas, rocas y más rocas que quedan al descubierto cuando es verano en Amazonas, porque sí. Por lo general, estas están cubiertas por el río y, honestamente, no se ven, pero en esta caminata que duró alrededor de unos 30 minutos para llegar allí, pude apreciar parte de lo que hay debajo del río casi todo el año. > >En uno de los días que estuve de visita en un sitio bastante lejano, al que me tomó unas 17 horas llegar, decidimos salir a explorar un poco. Honestamente, nuestra intención siempre fue conseguir un río en el cual bañarnos, porque en la mayoría de las comunidades indígenas de Amazonas hay un río cercano, con lo que no contábamos era que el verano había hecho de las suyas y este había bajado un montón. > >La verdad fue un poquito triste ver que estaba baja el agua, porque cuando es así, pues el río no fluye con tanta rapidez como de costumbre y se acumula un poco el sucio de las hojas de los árboles y demás. Esto, de alguna manera, hace que uno no se sienta tan seguro al bañarse porque ya de por sí el agua es oscura, tiene un marrón intenso que, si bien cuando estás cerca te permite ver qué hay debajo del agua, la visión llega hasta cierto punto. ![IMG_20260527_123619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23yTccSgikGhf9NnKJB1w7ZaobYtHdYPsST3Gtn3DarBQ4wtdKNSgtmS6fRGaPP2jjKxR.jpg) ![IMG_20260527_123607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23wCJEyfx8ceP1foLJfFD43z1NeNbtHcGCXhc5CKGPgFaVTasj1xkQHgRnKnNcsG26ihi.jpg) ![IMG_20260527_123601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23w2wpCwTzdtVWvtGMrbsyu4k4HHdcpFMzgsyHjdwrv22o1bxiQfiJ3RabPpQZm1jGf5i.jpg) ![IMG_20260527_101829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23z7BQZWbVtNS1kt52XJ5rE4fxUcK6DzezriUukWgLdEnCdcmt2LNpqacE6e5cskupGxn.jpg) However, I focused on the positive: for the first time in my life, I was able to walk over a river by stepping on the rocks that are normally beneath it. In fact, I made my way to the other side of the community, because the rocks allowed me to hop from one to the next. And the truth is that this little while we spent exploring was a unique moment in which I could only marvel at just how full of surprises creation is. Obviously, summer was in full swing and the heat was pretty extreme, and it would have been great if we could have cooled off in the water. Even so, we were able to spend some time there observing, taking photos, and watching how the locals—being used to these changes in the river—were just going about their business, swimming in the deepest part of the river that remained. >! [Spanish version] >Sin embargo, me centré en lo positivo y es que por primera vez en mi vida pude pasar por sobre un río cruzando por las rocas que normalmente están debajo de él, de hecho crucé hacia el otro lado de la comunidad, porque las piedras me permitieron llegar de brinco en brinco. Y la verdad es que este ratito en el que estuvimos explorando fue un momento único en el que solo pude maravillarme por lo llena de sorpresas que está la creación. > >Obviamente el verano pues estaba haciendo de las suyas y el calor era bastante extremo, y hubiese sido genial que hubiésemos podido pasar el calor dentro del agua, aún así pudimos estar un rato allí observando, tomando fotos y viendo cómo las personas de la zona, al estar ya acostumbradas a estos cambios en el río, estaban como si nada bañándose en la zona más profunda que quedaba de este. ![IMG_20260527_102031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/243qDCZU3R6VpuX31rdMjq8qQdhPioxAWeeheFWr6eoALjvjvDu4Nb4wX8z87CSvJk9VH.jpg) ![IMG_20260527_101753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23ywwQYDAzz5yhpkziC9JuhEghvhbJYvYpYwEvyubew92XMdybTgj5SMAps3q8BGPzuFN.jpg) ![IMG_20260527_101702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23tvqBMDs8wvDLEy9kmsuFqsHBCi6Z3X29fWrtnVkmg22nAdjAfYP1Gz7zWJJs41uonbj.jpg) Something that really caught my attention is that this river was part of the Orinoco River, and it surprises me that, even though the Orinoco is a massive river and, to be honest, if you look at it up close it doesn’t seem like its depth changes at all, the truth is that passing through areas like this makes it clear that it does, in fact, on the highest rocks we could see the mark left by last winter, which caused the water to rise higher than usual, and I find it amazing how there can be such a huge change from one season to the next and how people have already adapted to this. This hike was a moment of total relaxation for me because it was in a place completely removed from the city, and yes, I love small towns and very remote places where the most valuable thing is the beauty that surrounds you. That day I climbed rocks nonstop, and honestly, the experience was amazing. And although I explored many places during my time in Puerto Samariapo, in Venezuela’s Amazonas state, this was one of my favorites. >! [Spanish version] >Algo que llamó muchísimo mi atención es que este río era parte del río Orinoco, y me sorprende que, aunque el río Orinoco es un río enorme y que la verdad si lo ves de cerca no pareciera que bajara en absoluto su profundidad, la verdad es que pasar por zonas como esta deja claro que sí lo hace, de hecho en las rocas más altas podíamos ver la marca del último invierno que hizo que el agua subiera más de la cuenta, y me parece muy loco cómo puede haber un cambio de una temporada a otra tan grande y cómo las personas ya se han adaptado a esto. > >Esta caminata fue un momento de relajación total para mí porque fue en un sitio totalmente apartado de la ciudad, y sí, me encantan los pueblos pequeños y los lugares bien remotos en los que lo más valioso que hay es la belleza que habita alrededor de ti. Este día subí piedras sin parar y la verdad estuvo genial la experiencia, y aunque varios de los días que estuve en Puerto Samariapo, en el estado Amazonas de Venezuela, exploré muchos lugares, este fue de mis favoritos. ![Banner Horizontal Minimalista Joyería (400 x 150 px)_20241205_220827_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/242DZCJkjqsqAFYiumZQQ3ztrn1pMQZK9AWwd8kja6ekrSknbNMVppTN8UJPK4LPCP7rg.png) -Content entirely of my authorship and inspiration. -Original text in Spanish, translated at DeepL. -Personal photographs, taken with my Huawei p30 Lite Phone. -Banners designed in Canva Pro. -Contenido completamente de mi autoria e inspiración. -Texto original en español, traducido en DeepL. -Fotografías personales, tomadas con mi teléfono Huawei p30 Lite. -Banners diseñados en Canva Pro.

title.title: Bosque Zaninelli - Unilivre 🍃 | Curitiba - Brasil 🇧🇷📍 [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
![1000283037.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/48Y9CLjXuDfa6tUY2zhN7RQXYjgcZz2HXxCko2Nptgv3mnxpPPz51RQuoM75kDcdqm.png)
**_Imagen de mi propiedad editada en canva/Image of my property edited in canva_**
[//]:# (!worldmappin -25.39841 lat -49.28241 long d3scr)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV76NVvUB2vveMfqDbpX8gfTGbWMSHHAHiWKxsf4PGuWt/_bienvenidos_a_mi_blog_.jpg)
  _Para poder rendir el tiempo de mis vacaciones estoy visitando al menos 2 lugares en cada salida y luego de visitar el **Bosque Alemão** descubrí que muy cerca estaba otro bosque que también quería conocer, asi que para aprovechar la tarde al terminar mi recorrido por el primer bosque me fui directo al siguiente._ >_To make the most of my vacation time, I'm visiting at least two places on each outing. After visiting the **Bosque Alemão**, I discovered another forest nearby that I also wanted to explore, so to make the most of the afternoon, after finishing my visit to the first forest, I headed straight to the next._ _Nuestra siguiente parada fue el **Bosque Zaninelli** conocido también como la sede de la Universidad Libre del Medio Ambiente (Unilivre), la cual fue construida en el interior del bosque como proyecto de recuperación y transformación de espacios._ >_Our next stop was the **Bosque Zaninelli**, also known as the headquarters of the Universidad Libre do Medio Ambiente (Unilivre), which was built within the forest as part of a project to recover and transform spaces._
![1000283039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/241tNPJ5gYyX2SC8GDAr85iAtmt4VaHqXq8B5CNSVmLn2R3ceKRTf78Jr4v2zTYeggxFP.jpg)
![1000283038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23tSNJhE3qwbycPLBHicArxJXcxjiJ6cw2gvxKroLs6GWxsnDGY946STQ5NLQC7Wcdggc.jpg)
_En un inicio esta zona era una una cantera de extracción de granito propiedad de la familia **Zaninelli** y debido a esas actividades el terreno sufrió grandes cambios formando enormes muros de piedra que a su vez hacen parte de el entorno natural que es hoy en día._ >_Initially, this area was a granite quarry owned by the Zaninelli family. Due to these activities, the terrain underwent significant changes, forming enormous stone walls that are now part of the natural environment._ _En 1992 se inauguró la **Unilivre**, construida en una estructura de madera y metal y diseñada para harmonizar con el entorno natural, aprovechando este espacio libre que a su vez forma parte no solo del bosque sino también de la arquitectura del lugar._ >_In 1992, Unilivre was inaugurated. Built with a wood and metal structure, it was designed to harmonize with the natural surroundings, taking advantage of this open space that is not only part of the forest but also an integral part of the local architecture._
![1000283040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uFMcM7H9Q4JcChHgmeF9ctrAaxpmNp8QZjnMQQ9AvWWkgPk1BLYF9SdV9U5ChBZmUu5.jpg)
_La entrada al bosque es bastante linda y llamativa contando también con una pequeña cabaña que es una tienda de regalos donde puedes comprar detalles o recuerdos de tu visita o simplemente un refrigerio._ >_The entrance to the forest is quite lovely and eye-catching, and it also features a small cabin that serves as a gift shop where you can buy souvenirs or mementos of your visit, or simply a snack._
![1000283041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Ep3cTqNfA1ur4yS5hALw8ikiogRyYcoJPGHRNBTMGtBf95JWNas2S7pbhtgEWwCZfkW.jpg)
_Encontramos en la entrada del sendero un pequeño monumento conmemorativo en honor a la familia **Zaninelli**, antiguos dueños de la cantera que existia en este lugar y por quienes el bosque recibió su nombre._ >_At the entrance to the trail, we found a small commemorative monument honoring the Zaninelli family, former owners of the quarry that once stood here and after whom the forest is named._ _El símbolo de este monumento es lo que se conoce como una **muela de molino**, una herramienta muy común que se utilizaba en aquel entonces para la explotación de la cantera._ >_The symbol on this monument is a millstone, a common tool used in the quarrying industry at that time._
![1000283042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23tmBGufYcgm8U96yfQhSPaJLWZBndWGZ9KF7Dx8SaVXTAqYFcBQo1BnNAhp5MQobJTGH.jpg)
_Para adentrarnos al bosque debemos recorrer el sendero único que nos lleva hasta el final de este, un camino construido en madera que te permite caminar por el interior del bosque y disfrutar de la naturaleza durante el recorrido._ >_To enter the forest, we must follow the unique path that leads to its end, a wooden walkway that allows you to stroll through the heart of the woods and enjoy nature along the way._
![1000283043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Eo8QqQ7Rv5Sox9RxwN8mxz3TXswEYwdhBBadwRs5zpBmfqzxxeADrc9KFrh2GY3zLzd.jpg)
![1000283044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Eo8LeWycTD4ocptumCkHwGeebmZ1Yq7KLYffNkD3ceyjjjgHh6K2cv8Z9yrCmzJDupk.jpg)
_Al final del sendero encontramos la famosa cantera de piedra y el hermoso lago central del bosque, un escenario visual perfecto para apreciar la naturaleza y la belleza de este lugar._ >_At the end of the trail we found the famous stone quarry and the beautiful central lake of the forest, a perfect visual setting to appreciate the nature and beauty of this place._
![1000283045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EoK4U3gxMQnH4RHAvo3xXke16587RjTBH6sbFM1KCF8wQWsFoAenPKzJZVgqmWoiXjD.jpg)
_El lago es producto de la acumulación de agua de lluvia y los manantiales que salieron a flote luego de detener la actividad minera de la cantera, convirtiéndose en un ecosistema lleno de vida que además alberga fauna local como aves de diferentes especies, en especial patos._ >_The lake is the result of the accumulation of rainwater and springs that surfaced after mining activity at the quarry ceased, becoming a vibrant ecosystem that also shelters local fauna such as birds of different species, especially ducks._
![1000283046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EopsWJLATmSrHxok81Kci1fp4LvNAJYT6Xu7g4hebg6fsEBcVHRqx9Gvyt4EcTPji5M.jpg)

![1000283048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EoeEPMzCTP9gdRuKsgEHo69BF5syeoguyQf5Zig7GkHghgfUybU2pkREceKjVHuzx3A.jpg)
![1000283049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Ep1WW9qb17bxppBpxaMWiHbEk5rNtxSHjnnZCLi7cD2B9Q389DVCAgiaBFj8Zvd3QX2.jpg)
_Al fondo del lago se logra apreciar la inmensa pared de rocas que quedó de la cantera como resultado de la extracción minera que tuvo lugar allí durante muchísimos años, siendo este un escenario natural perfecto para admirar y fotografiar._ >_At the bottom of the lake, you can see the immense rock wall left over from the quarry, a result of the mining that took place there for many years, making it a perfect natural setting to admire and photograph._
![1000283050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpGNJn2bFnQ388H9kcGynnWyGqUKQeVbpxQfdnVQJ8jy454c4z4kamzn4kWu2bShfxP.jpg)
_A un lado del lago hay una especie de auditorio al aire libre, un espacio pensado para que tanto los visitantes como los estudiantes de la **Unilivre** puedan sentarse frente al lago bien sea para utilizar ese hermoso fondo como inspiración para sus clases y demostraciones o simplemente para contemplar la belleza de este increíble lugar._ >_On one side of the lake there is a kind of open-air auditorium, a space designed so that both visitors and students of **Unilivre** can sit facing the lake, either to use that beautiful backdrop as inspiration for their classes and demonstrations or simply to contemplate the beauty of this incredible place._
![1000283061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EqL14PcfeCNADSVCpZH17a9RT2vwwyp7byq6cfJiQtZuWmwaXhUirj6qVqzBkhpmAwg.jpg)
_Decidimos subir la estructura de madera que forma parte de la **Unilivre**, la cual cuenta con una gran altura y finaliza con un tranquilo y pacífico mirador rodeado de vegetación, donde puedes admirar y contemplar lo hermoso y pacífico de ese lugar desde las alturas, obteniendo una mejor vista de la pared de piedra y del lago._ >_We decided to climb the wooden structure that is part of **Unilivre**, which is quite tall and ends with a quiet and peaceful viewpoint surrounded by vegetation, where you can admire and contemplate the beauty and tranquility of the place from above, getting a better view of the stone wall and the lake._
![1000283062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpzwiLUtR4wcgdhWeqLn5s9jFwFbpNAnduds9H3HruUDan7ifT6fEA7qyS32eAHsHE1.jpg)
![1000283063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpxpMDeZPjV78H2JBrfAnHnNEEZ8YjaEGFsPo6ZQPmMVP9wPvbGPtJaWgkfTawifqAS.jpg)
![1000283064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EqSTycmvxmcnJCnjTmUSetY3UDNYcieDHTajNFYp7gm679pKg7WM34C31jfg2kRxGxR.jpg)

![1000283066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EorxqMsxMw6AS57bJLX4viLhqyZ5YuGM6YzUyyU5nnpdfmGGaqjRzB9KWQYtBwSmEhY.jpg)

title.body:
**Your core point lands:** most people are not lying in a cartoon-villain way, they’re **protecting themselves**. The image works well for that — the cracked metallic masks and exposed brain motif make the idea of a polished outer self vs. hidden inner pressure very clear.

Usually the “fake self” comes from two ugly but common forces: **social survival** and **status management**. People hide weakness because they fear judgment, rejection, or losing respect; psychology writing on social masking frames it as a defense for acceptance and belonging ([Manhattan Psychology Group](https://manhattanpsychologygroup.com/MPG-blog/understanding-masking-the-hidden-struggle-for-social-acceptance/), [Wikipedia overview](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masking_(behavior))). Research around self-presentation and stigma also ties that kind of masking to mental strain rather than real strength ([PMC study, Aug 11 2024](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11528950/), [ScienceDirect, Feb 15 2025](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1053811925000485)).

A nice angle in your post is that you’re **not just accusing people of being fake** — you’re pointing out that some masks are worn out of pain, not arrogance. That makes the piece more human and less preachy. A related community angle shows up in [this post by @merit.ahama](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/life-beyond-screens-relearning-r...) about fake lives and social pressure online, which fits your theme from a different direction.

title.title: Fake mask is either to protect or for evil intention
title.body:
>

Humans are social beings, and they live in society. In society, there are various kinds of people. Some can be good, and some can be bad, and there is no way to fully understand if a person is good or bad. It’s because human thoughts are quite complex and difficult to understand. There are people whom we meet in society on a regular basis, and unfortunately, very few people actually share their genuine thoughts. It’s like people are trying to hide behind a face mask. The intention can be good or evil, both depending on the person. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVNtX1AwcshhLA1fSzfH6fxUeX7TMLaHnffYLnkbjnvdz/ai-image-1779906061451.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki There are many people who are going through various kinds of difficulties and struggling in life, but they are not showing their sufferings and struggles in front of others. Some people are going through mental pressure, and still they choose to hide it from people. They try to show their strength. If they don’t have real strength, they show fake strength, and they want the recognition of people in society. They are ready to suffer but not ready to share their fragile side. Why are people so persistent in keeping fake profiles? Is it necessary to keep a fake profile or achievement? I don’t know too much about people, and I don’t try to understand everyone, as for me it’s not necessary to understand people. There is no way to understand if anyone is revealing their genuine self or the fake one unless there are any flaws. Even if I don’t pay attention, I can understand many things, as I am good at understanding human psychology, which gives me an advantage. Till now I have met many people, and, in my eyes, I figured out two reasons why people show their fake selves, and today I am going to share them. The first reason is that the people in society are quite complex to understand, and it is very difficult to understand if anyone is a good person or a bad person. If we share our genuine thoughts or genuine self in front of good people, it has advantages, and they can guide us or help us in various ways. Their suggestions can help us make our suffering easier or overcome it. But what if the people are not good ones? They will try to take advantage of understanding our weakness. Even general people don’t try to understand, and they mock the person who is going through difficulties, and it gives extra mental pressure and adds more suffering to those people. Sometimes it’s hard to bear everything, and people choose to do something that actually harms them in return. That is the reason people try to show their good side and try to show they are an ideal person. Their intention in hiding their true nature is not to deceive others; they try to protect themselves from others. And if you don’t have the right to protect yourself. There is also another type of person who always tries to show their good side in front of others. They are quite strong but don’t reveal their genuine nature. They pretend to be good in front of everyone and try to make a good profile. The reason for making a good profile is to take advantage of people. Actually, they usually have evil intentions, and they try to achieve something using a good profile when their genuine profile is almost the opposite. Such kinds of people are dangerous to society. Figuring them out is not so easy either. Their fake profile is the shield for their evil thoughts.

/> But by lunchtime it hit me like a ton of bricks The situation improved instantly with a delectable burger and a cooling Pesta Kulfi ice bench – now Табу Моча was really getting, so to speak. To be fair, sweet and savory has always seemed like the right mix. 🍔🍦

/> This was a whole-dinner-in-a-bowl, full of flavor and not too serious-type lunch. Proper desi food happiness on the table came from crispy fried chicken and spicy fried fish. Every bite felt worth it.

/>\n\nOf course Eid nights are incomplete without the late night chiller of ice creams. The entire day seemed special with a meal, laughter and the exuberance of the peaceful qurbani Eid atmosphere. ♥️

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTczx2WcFikS4S1xDc86XdGzG1PLQvavsvs6vGBy6cScg/1779906178409.jpg)




Hey everyone! 

I'll be honest  today wasn't the flashiest day in terms of STARBITS, but sometimes the quiet days are the ones that matter most. Let me tell you why! 


 Level 43  Another One Done!

Woke up this morning, ran a couple of missions and  boom  Level 43 unlocked! It honestly never gets old seeing that level bar tick over. Started this journey at Level 39 just two weeks ago and now sitting comfortably at 43. The progress feels real and I'm proud of the consistency! 
Each level brings me closer to that magic Level 50 milestone where the STARBITS Millionaire mission becomes available. Nine more levels to go  the road is long but I'm enjoying every step of it!

 Ego Finally Heading South 77.46%!

This is the stat I'm most excited about today. Ego dropped another -1.65% down to 77.46% and the cost to combat it today was only 199 STARBITS  a fraction of what it used to be! A few weeks ago this number was sitting above 1,400 STARBITS daily. That difference is entirely down to doing Music Lessons every single day without exception.
I know it can feel boring to do lessons instead of missions but trust me  the numbers don't lie. Less Ego means more STARBITS per mission. It's that simple! 

 Skill Hits 810  A New Personal Best!

Skill crossed 800 today for the first time, landing at 810! This is a big deal because higher Skill is the foundation of everything in Rising Star  it keeps Ego down, increases earnings, and makes the whole account more efficient over time.
Getting to 810 Skill from 558 when I started these reports is one of the things I'm most proud of. That's +252 Skill points in just 13 days purely from daily Music Lessons! 

 Slow But Steady STARBITS Day

Only +192 STARBITS today compared to yesterday's record of +1,635. Honestly? That's fine. Not every day is a big day and that's completely normal in Rising Star. Energy was low from yesterday's hard grind so I focused more on lessons and lighter missions today to let things recover. Tomorrow I'll push harder! 
The Mid Week Support Slot is still my go-to mission  30 STARBITS per run with 9 other players running it alongside me right now. Good company on the grind! 

 Goals Progress

Reach Level 43  DONE! 
Skill above 800 — 810! 
Ego below 78% — 77.46%! 
Build STARBITS to 10,000 — 4,389 so far
Bring Ego below 25%  every lesson helps!
Reach Level 50 — 7 more levels!
Accumulate 1,000,000 STARBITS
