links.title: Coconut kisses, gluten-free version  (ENG-EPS)
links.body:
***Greetings, dear foodie community 😊***

+ ***Saludos querida comunidad foodies 😊***

---
---
![photo_4951782956976508503_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23ywydfjsvtDWWE1Geaasjz13CLoowrUo8nzYcUSQxbQzFXLAap5U3muH5ADkxayjs11s.jpg)

---
---
Today we'll make a recipe that's very traditional here in my country (Venezuela). I've shared my favorite coconut kiss recipe before, but today we're going to make a slightly healthier version. We won't be using traditional wheat flour; instead, we'll use cassava flour, so it's highly recommended for those who can't eat gluten.

This version also contains protein because we'll be adding egg, although it's optional. I've used butter, but you can opt for any vegetable oil. Ideally, this treat should be as healthy as possible.

As for the flavor, it's practically the same, and the texture seems softer to me than the traditional version. I encourage you to try this recipe because it's fantastic! 👌

+ Hoy haremos una receta que aquí en mi país (Venezuela) es muy tradicional, en otra ocasión compartí mi receta preferida de besitos de coco, pero hoy vamos a hacer una versión un poco más saludable, no usaremos la tradicional harina de trigo, en su lugar vamos a usar harina de mandioca, así que es muy recomendada para aquellas personas que no pueden consumir gluten.

+ Esta versión también contiene proteínas porque le agregaremos huevo, aunque es opcional, yo le he puesto mantequilla, pero puedes optar por algún aceite vegetal, lo ideal es que este dulce sea lo más saludable posible.

+ En cuanto al sabor, prácticamente es igual y la textura me parece más suave que la versión tradicional, te invito a que pruebes esta receta porque esta estupenda 👌

***Come with me! 😉***

+ ***Acompáñame! 😉***

# Ingredients:
-1 cup cassava flour
-190 grams shredded coconut
-250 grams panela (unrefined cane sugar)
-800 ml water
-1 egg (optional)
-1 tablespoon butter, at room temperature
-2 cinnamon sticks
-10 cloves
-1 teaspoon baking powder

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -1 taza de harina de mandioca.
+ -190 gramos de coco seco rallado.
+ -250 gramos de panela.
+ -800 ml de agua.
+ -1 huevo, opcional.
+ -1 cucharada de mantequilla a temperatura ambiente.
+ -2 ramas de canela.
+ -10 clavitos de olor.
+ -1 cucharadita de polvo para hornear.

![photo_4951782956976508480_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpCANpUHDUfqhV3gVEsGsA9H4fuLdbxuQ3Kj7Vzk9cDKqMDPnxRCyWECS7FMz8p1AQi.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

In a pot, add the panela (I've cut it into three pieces), the cinnamon, the cloves, and the water. Cook over high heat until the panela is completely melted. You can let it simmer for a couple more minutes over medium heat so the panela caramel absorbs more of the spice aroma.

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ En una olla vamos a echar la panela, esta la piqué en tres partes, le agregamos la canela, los clavitos y el agua, llevamos a cocinar a fuego alto hasta que la panela se derrita por completo, puedes dejar hervir un par de minutos más a fuego medio para que el caramelo de panela absorba más el aroma de las especias.

![photo_4951782956976508481_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23vhyWESxboWwEMCZ26XYJ6jxNGGHxfnbwo3UC1BSuDNmAwtUPSi94UsFNFoY4VkCXke6.jpg)

Then we strain our mixture, add the grated coconut and cook over medium-high heat until the liquid evaporates, stirring occasionally, and let it cook for approximately 30 minutes, making sure the coconut doesn't dry out completely.

+ Luego colamos nuestra preparación, le agregamos el coco rallado y llevamos a cocinar a fuego medio alto hasta que el líquido se evapore, revolvemos de vez en cuando, dejamos cocinar aproximadamente 30 minutos, pendientes que el coco no quede completamente seco.

![photo_4951782956976508482_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoyQzx2GreCvaDY2dUc7iadJwvgKccP5Gr4Zx4rgWco45Vpco553Lw86QjWaotm8TuC.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508483_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eo8TEBhQakL5XNgSm37FGse77omSAGcvNhE76BxSULd6cnXWVEfDNjfgpEQXco7VkEg.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508484_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23w2uVpWDyTKmPaXemGfa7uHh1yxVu3paTw2srvq4YCCvn3sCYF88cxHZUhpz7CzQYtQo.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508485_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23vsSXnK8483wovst3rFt5h29qpbeFk6GA81QjnQPgv8n55BCSzNi3PNTvJURWVfRm468.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508486_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiWDGU39P2eHd9hNiA3LHn4JS8SQkQZ5fsJa7urvutVVDAKMgkgRY7DAfbMbwNt6Et.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508487_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoyQw8tXgo2PZBrVjvYJRxEA8tyTTVZF7Pq4k9VaaaoDecDDfRsCmQchb2UrSP4DJw5.jpg)

When we see that there is little liquid left, we add the butter, mix well and remove from the heat, let it rest for about 15 minutes so that the preparation cools down a little.

+ Cuando veamos que le queda poco liquido agregamos la mantequilla, mezclamos bien y bajamos del fuego, dejamos reposar unos 15 minutos para que la preparación se enfríe un poco.

![photo_4951782956976508488_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoptQrEqb8XBBYh2NUdTtK8p9yJLobxG6FWhKd3qhPg2365Pn7tCj2K4WAHVRW7jZHw.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508489_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EopuSU4VqYHSoW2KMxQi9Co9r4mTCRRrmugGJHGkS4jZrpXdZc7HLx3zibDuTH2GGsD.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508490_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eokce1PqH6N58JR4HiQM3ff9f5BpkpjoE4cwW4k3rowmjMjQB4rqDnron4uegHjTRbt.jpg)

We turn on the oven to 180 degrees.

+ Encendemos el horno a 180 grados.

![photo_4951782956976508491_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xySuf2LumLpb4mJFGaPNgbG4DqjxwjSSQ3uNKwd6pAFfgTcjvyQGkovxTmaGbtHcPNu.jpg)

Now we add the flour and baking powder, and mix.

+ Ahora añadimos la harina y el polvo para hornear, mezclamos.

![photo_4951782956976508492_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoK6kKrNB7Zp1f8zMEQ8oyVoJZjnDAJ9ZZHPUiPyBqjpXkBjd5c8Gmsk5kEoA3fjm8m.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508493_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoK5sQtGAnKqrpguz9gVBMwAv3BTk3pBbRFEkA3Xr41Q5GkNSmZWk5ycgMFHqnfkUAj.jpg)

We add an egg, you can skip this step, I like it because it adds protein to this recipe, we mix very well, if the mixture is too runny just add a little more flour.

+ Agregamos un huevo, este paso lo puedes obviar, a mí me gusta porque agrega proteína a esta receta, mezclamos muy bien, si la mezcla queda muy aguada solo coloca un poco más de harina.

![photo_4951782956976508494_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EokcZduNJ8vYpFJaHtqm3qgbfkiWBwK4GbuM9AatCe9wKo7gTfdi9z5cQqX67nySKU6.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508495_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiVGTM8FNsN27wNLDjTT6utp1MPNCGuPpNGMhesK6y1rzkz97bZqpGyqDGkuqUgUrC.jpg)

Now, using a soup spoon, we take portions of the mixture and place them on a baking sheet; I used greased parchment paper.

+ Ahora con una cuchara de sopa agarramos las porciones de la mezcla y las vamos colocando en una placa para horno, yo he usado papel encerado previamente engrasado.

![photo_4951782956976508496_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEQLc7AgrRqUkxFFvCjzM94nvKbJzZZLnd1XzRQAGRFWMQYBtNG2yampQZJPQ7KFd.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508497_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EopuLMtHUzN2WrVpwTBj4HYSpADbh4k3awTJtvmMzDHjsJbYYKaMycwktaVxDyScjD9.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508498_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoCi5J6bKRU2ke4yZCcT3fyyHTyB61xnPpDEAAaTH2fiMPpdB3iHUbz2KujMbuKQfwQ.jpg)

We put them in our oven for approximately 20 minutes or until the kisses are golden brown.

+ Llevamos a nuestro horno por aproximadamente 20 minutos o hasta que los besos estén dorados.

![photo_4951782956976508499_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EonkzgYWaGADdNWfJo5HJJsLAkwFMyDBMBDvgqaaaMYv2nN67U2rwNqAsqmMAu9Subw.jpg)

***Take them out of the oven, let them cool for a couple of minutes, and enjoy! They're delicious warm! 😋 A gluten-free and protein-packed option, I love it! 😍***

+ ***¡Sacamos del horno, deja enfriar un par de minutos y disfrútalos! calentitos son deliciosos! 😋 una opción sin gluten y con proteínas, me encanta 😍***

![photo_4951782956976508500_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EogNpq1HjtuETCafT26YZpAWE8B3jzAt3SLMQcKSa4M7zznrpZEu5mpMLn1E3UrHYsS.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508501_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpJZW1cTakpUq7D1kxnK8rjuJsFHpR9PB8ZLzZsg8Ztm2TmAoNC2PvEUiJotXLh3qyR.jpg)

---
![photo_4951782956976508502_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Ep1YJTbrp7m7F2xtCCtDSd4af5z8fyeg9WkyD19jF4ThJsm78tviTn3pMVZKc6Spp9q.jpg)

---
---
**Yields:** 10 kisses 😍

+ **Rinde:** 10 besos 😍

**I hope you'll try this recipe, and let me know how it goes!**

+ **¡Espero y te animes a preparar esta receta, luego me cuentas como te fue!**

# <center>Thank you for your kind company and support, may the Creator bless you generously 🙏</center>

+ # <center>Gracias por tu amable compañía y apoyo, el Creador te bendiga generosamente 🙏</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xyJS2AUDf3cWu9TAjY4ePXM561wJq2zYBCkQ2259J4wa9HrpU6mQgWproGhgbt4txRq.png)

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23ydNqerpZy6z3GSRT2ZBu1NBmA9q7VEBFSC6yTyQY3YxxYMQTYutoB62eVbRSkf9n2RR.png)</center>

Separators and shapes from Microsoft Word:
Collage used: CollageMaker.</sub></center>

links.title: Mi Jade preciosa | My precious Jade
links.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante genial, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos de uno de mis hermosos gatos, la cual es Jade. Debido a que he estado un poco full de actividades del trabajo y de la universidad no he podido postear a las horas que quisiera, sin embargonsiempre, como cada semana, les traigo un post de mis gatos. Estos últimos días la pasé en mi casa, he tenido actividades del trabajo los fines de semana y me tienen sumamente agotada, y gracias a ello al estar en mi casa he podido pasar más tiempos con mis hermosos gatitos. Jade es una de las que más me ha hecho compañía en estos días, ya que suele dormir todos los días conmigo, y cuando no estoy suele dormir en mi cuarto en mi ausencia, y eso me parece sumamente hermoso. He estado muy estresada estos días, lo he expresado en posts anteriores, creo que en todos, pero la verdad es que si he tenido muchas cosas que hacer y no ha sido sencillo. Sin embargo la compañía de mis gatos siempre me cura el alma, sobre todo de Jade. Ella es la más tranquila de los tres gatos, adoro lo bien que se porta, pero a veces tiene sus momentos. Hace unos días se metió en mi closet que estaba medio abierto e hizo tremendo desastre con toda mi ropa. A ella le gusta mucho dormir en mi ropa y me parece muy genial, pero a veces no me deja ordenar mi closet en paz, porque a veces pongo la ropa en mi cama para ordenar la y al voltear me un momento, ya ella está montada allí. Me encanta tomarle fotos porque es muy coqueta y hermosa, así que hoy les comparto algunas que tomé en estos días, espero que les guste!
Hello again! Today I’m bringing you another awesome post, this time featuring a new photo set of one of my beautiful cats, Jade. Since I’ve been pretty swamped with work and college, I haven’t been able to post as often as I’d like, but as always, just like every week, I’m sharing a post about my cats. I’ve spent the last few days at home, I’ve had work commitments on the weekends that have left me completely exhausted, and thanks to that, being at home has allowed me to spend more time with my beautiful kitties. Jade is one of the ones who’s kept me the most company lately, since she usually sleeps with me every day, and when I’m not there, she usually sleeps in my room while I’m away, and I find that absolutely lovely. I’ve been really stressed out lately, I’ve mentioned it in previous posts, I think in all of them, but the truth is, I’ve had a lot on my plate and it hasn’t been easy. However, spending time with my cats always soothes my soul, especially Jade. She’s the calmest of the three cats; I love how well-behaved she is, but she has her moments sometimes. A few days ago, she snuck into my closet, which was left slightly open, and made a huge mess with all my clothes. She really loves sleeping on my clothes, and I think it’s so cute, but sometimes she won’t let me tidy up my closet in peace, because sometimes I put my clothes on my bed to organize them, and the moment I turn around, she’s already perched right there. I love taking pictures of her because she’s so cute and beautiful, so today I’m sharing some I took over the last few days, I hope you like them!

links.title: Dziennik #92/2026 - izolacja
links.body:
>

Dobry wieczór.

Moja depresja się pogłębia. W pracy było mi bardzo ciężko. Ciężko z tego względu, że po prostu z każdą godziną zapaść była coraz większa, a moim zadaniem w pracy jest być w formie, a nie epatować swoimi problemami. Chciałam wyjść wcześniej, ale nie mogłam, bo miałam kilka spotkań, a jak ja skończyłam swoje to spotkania miał mój kierownik, a ktoś musiał zostać na magazynie. Przetrwałam, ale było bardzo ciężko.

Po powrocie do domu napisałam przyjaciółce, że muszę zniknąć na trochę. Nie umiem znowu przelewać na nią depresji. W sensie nie chcę tego. To już prawie rok jak podnosi mnie z podłogi i ja po prostu już nie umiem jej obciążać. Ma dość swoich problemów i będzie dla niej lepiej jak zostanę sama. Choć jest mi z tym kurwa ciężko..

Bardzo boli mnie ciało. Boli mnie serce, a przy oddychaniu czuję paraliżujący ból między łopatkami. Nie mogę spać, mam podkrążone oczy, nie mam apetytu. Jestem tak rozchwiana emocjonalnie, że poszłam dzisiaj po alkohol, ale wygrałam i kupiłam słodycze. Których pewnie nie zjem, bo nie mam apetytu, ale przynajmniej nie złamię abstynencji. Żeby zobrazować mój stan emocjonalny powiem tylko tyle, że wracając z Biedronki weszłam do Rossmanna, bo kończy mi się dezodorant, nie było mojego ulubionego, więc się prawie rozpłakałam, że muszę kupić inny. Rozumiecie to? I poza tym, że się prawie rozpłakałam to nowy wybierałam jakieś 15 minut. Ludzie krócej małżonka wybierają..

Wróciłam do domu i po prostu zaszyłam się w swojej jamie. W jamie jest burdel, ja mam w sobie burdel, wszystko się zgadza. Jutro idę na terapię, bo udało się to zorganizować, ale z każdą godziną tracę wiarę w to, że to dobry pomysł. Nie wiem jak, ale do poniedziałku muszę się pozbierać, bo mój kierownik idzie na urlop i będę go zastępować. Nie mam na to siły ani zasobów. 

Jest mi ciężko i bardzo źle. Piszę tego posta z nadzieją, że jak kiedyś do niego wrócę to stwierdzę \
, ale na dzisiaj wiary nie mam w to wcale. W nic już nie mam wiary. I najgorsze w tym wszystkim jest to, że przez moją pokręconą logikę zostałam z tym sama. Brawo Paula, winszuję.\n\n

links.title: ElReyLobo capitulo 3: La luz después del final del túnel
links.body:
Contexto: hay una escena donde ElReyLobo grita: AHHHH y pensarán que fue un errde escritura, pero no ya ese es el significado del crecimiento de ElReyLobo, osea que todos los personajes animales pueden hablar, y también el dolor que sintió cuando le dispararon el láser.

El zumbido del barco se mezclaba con el sonido de los monitores. ElReyLobo despierta y ve que hay varias personas con batas blancas caminando alrededor del barco.

ElReyLobo decide bajar de la cuna donde estaba, pero uno de los hombres con una sonrisa macabra le dice: —Ah donde vas pequeño lobito—. Dice el científico.
_____________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRXDM3C2VcHeLyKE3jWFbQbyQLLYTVJtoKLmnZtWQWs9H/1779905516268.png)

ElReyLobo no entendía nada y trata huir, pero el científico lo toma entre sus brazos, y se ríe diciendole: —Ahora eres parte de mi mayor idea, y te convertiré en mi mejor creación pequeño —.

El científico escucha el llamado para iniciar con el experimento 4LF, y lleva al pequeño cachorro a una cama para experimento, y ElReyLobo no entendía que pasaba, solamente se escuchaba: —Inicio del experimento 4LF, iniciando proceso para el primer rayo—. De pronto un rayo de luz infrarroja sale disparada hacia el cuerpo del cachorro, ocasionando que el pequeño cachorro empezará a maullar del dolor.
_________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfLUdHtmZr3vL9ye1Q8BsHHe8AdkdnYMkZ4iuwZLe8xtc/1779905493550.png)

El rayo parecía cada vez aumentarse, y ElReyLobo se empieza a frustrar del dolor, que una luz de energía empieza a salir en sus ojos. —Oh vamos cachorro, yo sabía que este experimento iba a salir victorioso —. Dice el científico.

Pero la energía empieza aumentar haciendo que que los científicos se empezarán a preocupar. —AHHHH—. Gritaba el pequeño cachorro.
Derrepente alguien aprieta un botón ocasionando una explosión en el barco.

El mar pareciera que hubiera llovido objetos científicos, y ElReyLobo logra sobrevivir, flotando con un pedazo de barco, que lo ayudaba a flotar, cuando el pequeño cachorro llega a tierra firme, ElReyLobo nota que estaba en tierra.

ElReyLobo se levanta y empieza a caminar lentamente perdido, sin saber para donde iba, y a donde iba a quedar a dormir. Pero el pequeño cachorro cae en un pequeño barro, vencido y cansado y llora sintiendose perdido, y sin nadie que lo quiera.
_________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsRqMs8cZXpiNmmR1n13v3t8K3BiVYkhBd6gUV3bE17A/1779905475063.png)

Llega la noche, y una chica linda, con un cabello rizado y largo, aparece donde estaba ElReyLobo: —vaya que hermoso animal, oye cachorro de donde llegaste?—. Dice la chica.

El cachorro no entendía a la chica y se esconde en un árbol. La chica se ríe y alza sus manos, en rendición —Calma pequeño, yo no soy mala y te lo voy a demostrar—. Y de su pequeño bolso sacá un pequeño sándwich que le había sobrado.
El cachorro sale corriendo, y con una rapidez se lo come de un solo bocado.

 La chica se ríe y se queda sorprendida, luego ve su collar: 4LF 
—Vaya 4LF parece que tenía mucha hambre cierto, tranquilo en mi casa te puedo dar más de eso, ah y se me olvidaba me llamo*luna*—. Dice la chica.

ElReyLobo no confía mucho en luna y se vuelve a esconder en el árbol, luna nota la inseguridad del cachorro, y va rápidamente a su casa a preparar otro sándwich más para el pequeño. ElReyLobo Salta de emoción y se vuelve a comer de un solo bocado, y acepta seguirla.
______________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuBRAaLBoCV5PDNW282hWzEMEaUMjmFTLb6b5BzFYSTx/1779905545784.png)
Así fue el promt que le di a Géminis para crear las imágenes

links.title: The Mendoza House / La Casa Mendoza
links.body:
![Collage día de las madres simple beige café blanco (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23vsbDu8RPyJjM9gZtMeX2RijeY7Y9VwiGfn9a1D9eu23c4BPcm7yHyf2wdPTDSunymWa.png)


*Design created with Canva / Diseño creado con Canva*


<div class=\

> Today I want you to join me in exploring a corner of Caracas that struck me as extraordinary. But first, I must tell you that I have returned to this city after flying more than 600 km, leaving behind my home at the foot of the Andes, to once again face the contradictions of modern Caracas. Yet here we can also find a historic heart that continues to beat with strength, pride, and betrayal.

> Hoy quiero que me acompañen a conocer un rincón de Caracas que me pareció extraordinario, Pero antes que nada debo contarles que nuevamente llegó a esta ciudad después de haber volado más de 600 km, dejando atrás mi hogar al pie de los Andes, para enfrentarme de nuevo a las divergencias de la Caracas moderna. Pero en donde también podemos encontrar un corazón histórico que sigue latiendo con fuerza, orgullo y traición.
![IMG_20260505_113542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/242NfGVXbeYtXeD2R21uLzpA3t85ZuaqUANzXxneicsop9rtYDFYaLHoHiEuEzC1D6DgR.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23ycyGCzTdu9ym1r4KJLLcBe4foNG7zFC6VXk91crWNTRZmykLDdasrHtndfarUs6fndh.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zbKpafUcSF4v4W42NvaspbgTwHjGMe9FGw4QKTt8ph3QQpMHXTGsFGbBtrVZkDKVp4m.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpCBJYCN7gDkLfMsQQPUiTdRuWbPofymUKWSQuaFmcuzcWnt1Tm65RtbqibHmbVBqh5.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EprT525crP3raVKdSKctLRWYFyf85ddv1YGk9ELSSjyEwbWvcQhH3Rca5riwAWoKGJq.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpnDJvc1okY8pHjP5kPwLytacZCFmS2Mb74nDdYMoa8FB8HDQLQZYpFokynTap41rj1.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpJZ6jjt1YnKZent157CuFFozQE2UGBbkjrpKY6jtpeLSmuMJiXf41tXmammVPiqRn3.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xKvht6UCkbP2BjoQKmPJkcaGiN1d1cXaHNkF9gyo5Bw73XYpuXjj2akRn41G29hHSun.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zGc6za4LF9NZUirddbprjhNJrkoycrmbERuoFMPemB1FyCCRhm72jrZnBexU7RqJ3hz.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eptb1UDqvXkRRadXCY7Ra8ysLJUYE6UFe33xxrb1ec5mKM3bwoTRmcLUgKzgbCs7Amx.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_120349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xehc1mqnjx37oomTJcqFVYcj3sHu6AphAuwngnpp5FNCcW2oSp9L1NiXBywoDpfXQCF.jpg)

> When we mention the surname Mendoza in these parts, we immediately picture a national economic and commercial empire, but without realizing it, it also signifies history, politics, and lineage. This explains why, just a few blocks north of Plaza Bolívar in the city center, right in the heart of the historic district, we come across an old mansion with colonial features, named after the scholar of Venezuelan history Lorenzo Armando Mendoza Quintero—a gathering place for all of society, where not only are art, knowledge, and music fostered, but we can also find traces of a vast past, where houses were built with attention to detail, functionality, and their surroundings, always projecting grandeur and power.

> Cuando por estas latitudes nombramos el apellido Mendoza, inmediatamente nos imaginamos un Emporio económico y comercial de características nacionales, pero sin darnos cuenta también significa historia, política y abolengo. Es así como podemos explicar que A pocas cuadras al norte de la plaza Bolívar del centro de la ciudad, en pleno casco histórico, nos encontremos con una vieja casona de características coloniales, cuyo nombre es el de la casa de estudios de la historia venezolana Lorenzo Armando Mendoza Quintero, un lugar de encuentro para toda la sociedad, en donde no solo se propicia el arte, el conocimiento y la música, sino que también podemos encontrar los rastros de un pasado inmenso, en donde las casas se construían pensando en los detalles, la funcionalidad y su entorno, siempre proyectando grandeza y poder.
![IMG_20260505_113733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23uFYHHLDojr1JHQLidmWUXgopHgSPJJXhXf3VZuxVh1WadiZCMjq1TP4pVe7qW7VGiUy.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eos2FGPZkokuL3vRTkCw3HrAJtgesByNTrGLNt2jMncuPGd5JGf7z2EskxRWjU7y1Q3.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23w2mG5ViibUp8k6RJY1q9AAt2zTpMJLBzcAqBGr9ASwFfjay66XD8VBnPLaBXcHtkKY3.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23yJGg8YxBWDjQMsXFpwCbyXJR3uoXCXBhmeUo62NsqiZQnrd6y8oj18dzjj5ckyY6NeR.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpzyC9gtXDEGeuWwNVyzH1wBkyxok8u6UdPMFsBnPryKdf7G14X7zFr7oL3oSgcn5Wz.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eq5E1R82BqdVwWX5Dq4rjDvV7SkcGUuHd1XyyoTev56mpPtHzN8Dhx7ZtYdy9WKWqMi.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep1Xt714fvrxuYVGScURT6MjgzaHMNi7jnF42CmTrxKvz4VWP6ztwdUKDDxmemH17MM.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23zkn69PRaEmtFz5HdL3AQYpCvoyWz3S9ZDdkze9EoRBmHddkoSQADoLJRK5GCZgyvomV.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EptazaTswgYUJFNWLb4FbZMJ2YHoABvVAHtLmWCoZahfimTxqwTFWgrfVCZczwnxfcy.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_120002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243BeLckGgQgS2qAQSm3ByTPiAFdTv4bgNLBgv7XDyRZeiiQxWeEUsi7EVazVsRGQzLkN.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_120109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpGPgam9Q9hAdmUCZWDtxCMnsD5KFzNG8DKG1QqbhGTu9AoAnTst3gdBCnNjsv2wT89.jpg)

> Decades have passed, yet the structure remains impeccably preserved, the furnishings are perfectly maintained, and works of art gleam in every corner—making it easy to imagine what life was like in those days, when the city was divided according to the crown’s dictates and where freedoms were prioritized.

> Han pasado decenas de años y la estructura se mantiene de manera impecable, el mobiliario está perfectamente conservado, las obras de arte relucen en cada esquina y es así como fácilmente nos podemos imaginar como era la vida en aquellos tiempos, en donde la ciudad se dividía según lo que dictara la corona y en donde las libertades tenían preferencias.
![IMG_20260505_113518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23ynMtVFojp9Sgvthf4e1xb9EJe2FUuMcvthebjEJvz11NsirA2h56hPwX78BgDqz89Eg.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23yJGkXmxjPWsapVx3TvzdaTgKqsATJLBVE7tJ1UPFjd88BAwL3ZMk8m7ZPezByU1ug9R.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eo8UFNXyVKsH69Fd65oEJzyHMsPZvB1noB1sdV5ypyzpBXE9fCXt4wDKRo8gGE5GZNj.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep1VRvm4CLyHR4gb4d13tDSvoLfBjji4RfzAd3N2Lv8VMBmFXoXZhZiwYMcjihCpKVG.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep3fJxiGqoAUPkgcVYHD4KHfcpuvvxM2AXceSQiqYaqh7AbWPeSrK43zwXw3ZqVvaxK.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoEqwuSFY6F5pHov14XqtGujvHmvdPLptgPCJkFUAjk1ZCLZbUjJaVWPMZXUtGUUCPd.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EowH5k2LrySPrJqpozN5dvuLK7Nt35uaX5wcpKnW5BHgu5itcr2hN8ERRPhQTAo7PHz.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23w2qCAE4MxJaezXPmfhrCWDQzWhsJJu2sCVi68fkwnQ898gydWXoRmFznKZq2dmSBPKN.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/242NmYQnk1XsL7qC2crHwCQPQ3EHdCH5bsUQp8vqKzJiv6VAFsXrVgpQdwMtETNjhnWh5.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoiXfteCPyzoqK8Lq87fsFgLsxjwMRHTij1nV8wmxsyeUBhodERhnqY2w5xgp72ENvj.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xejxw4mvEqa3FpWjJtavRNhUa6HS2GAbp2iRx5sEa5cpDnoxLw2EPHmwx1kNXrvjnM8.jpg)

> It is even more incredible to discover that this is a true treasure nestled in the heart of a capital that has grown over its history, where thousands of houses have been demolished to make way for modern urban developments, yet this building has managed to withstand the pressure of the years, individual ambitions, and collective follies.

> Es aún más increíble poder descubrir que este es un verdadero tesoro enclavado en el corazón de una capital que ha ido creciendo sobre su historia, en donde se han demolido miles de casas para darle paso a desarrollos urbanísticos de características modernas, pero que en esta oportunidad este inmueble ha logrado soportar la presión de los años, las ambiciones individuales y las locuras colectivas.
![IMG_20260505_113854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoCj7bqKCnCMpNbseufgvDSkC6z2xsVAjSMbbidqQdLSgGeR3SbKq97TTWU2cxzrqRq.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpA3Qcg5HTGKVqtKmNMg31UYAnJYxzXryqYCgF5J3vi7wsw5nzTkKKxBQPynoyoxhzo.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_113949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23tmHi1yLaYJhbPBzmbvMAfM2qxUSyGc4XKAWcjyFRCgfU33yCUF8EpqMpwmJz3aL2NLk.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EowGdCB719GHd3vspUkJYw28jePJ4DXX6rpiyRgaV4jV7b1zaUCe897xsS3F6CQcu4r.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23x1BF8Z9WuiMFR2ZByEXVH6ADfWBCp8fXcfiXUFSogtGCmwahXohr7w3zSfDYKzkAGQp.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpVBeAzNMjgW4or8tPEM2iT6JRAiRkt2CWX7KDNBYGG7JjQ8QRPMNbmthoHVZkH6UpQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eos2DWio7Bsw7oZquUpjCvVYDuHoUTtKMyUF65zVF1GWGt4v8R23jU9V2h7fMifbuDE.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_114218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpQvro92SjFxuYPYWfrZGumpHfQ7RKXZqevzJ7vqG1cGVtg8CArU5NLnjbbh1dSG3fT.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpT5feTuMd7i2rdcACrBsPxP9hEeSQ9tN3yRcofnfBTtYt3QPb4DvfU1Qnvgb99febC.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23uFYA3KcCPzKAfkHGNofs5kqx8YpkLTHqCJ9k5W6zDt9BNN7fRvVh2k2JVH8m2brfXBu.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_115511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23xAa4jPiweQaZzQE6BVakm1qLPYTcS2F3acLskLzdk7VB4zYa25mVgdH1upcfyg8qejj.jpg)

> Walking through its mosaic-filled hallways is a true luxury; discovering large gardens brimming with freshness and small, functional fountains is to fall in love with a bygone era. For a moment, you can feel the stampede of horses and hear the characteristic sound of carts passing through the streets, sense the coolness of the valley from those years, yet at the same time, perceive the divide among the citizens.

> Caminar a través de sus Pasillos repletos de mosaicos es un verdadero lujo, descubrir grandes jardines llenos de frescura y pequeñas fuentes a un funcionales es enamorarse de una época ya pasada, por un momento se puede sentir el tropel de los caballos y el sonido típico de Las Carretas pasando por las calles, la frescura del valle de aquellos años, pero al mismo tiempo la diferencia entre los ciudadanos.

links.title: Splinterlands: This season's goal shifts from Legendary to Rare cards!🔥
links.body: >Today—for the second time this season—I have once again decided to purchase Rare draws. There are several reasons for this decision; one of the primary ones is that my deck currently contains numerous copies of Common and Rare cards that remain at Level 1, whereas I now possess two to three Archons that have reached Level 2 or even higher. Higher-level Archons serve as the primary and most crucial key that enables you to summon higher-level cards; however, I now face a paradox: I simply do not possess the specific cards that I could utilize in the most optimal manner, leveraging the power of these Archons. Typically, players encounter the opposite situation: their cards continue to upgrade, but they lack a high-level Archon to utilize them effectively. Consequently, I have decided to slightly moderate the \

mindset I have maintained over the past four to five seasons and, for the time being, focus on acquiring draws of other rarities as well.

\n\n

>So, once again, I purchased a batch of 10 Rare Draws simultaneously. At a cost of 1,500 Glint per draw, I ended up paying a total of 15,000 Glint for them. As you can see in the screenshot above, the chances of obtaining a Gold Foil card are a mere 0.5%; while this probability can be doubled to 1% by utilizing Alchemy Potions, even at this doubled rate, 1% remains so incredibly low that the likelihood of actually obtaining a Gold card is practically negligible. Indeed, my personal experience confirms this: one never seems to pull a Gold card from these draws. I have been playing this game for nearly three years now, and during that time, I have purchased these Rarity Draws dozens of times—always using Alchemy Potions—yet not a single time have I ever received a Gold card. To be honest, having faced such consistent disappointment, I no longer held any real hope for a positive outcome; however, since I happened to have a few Alchemy Potions lying around, I decided to give it one last try just to put them to use—though, deep down, I likely already knew what the result would be.

\n\n

>So, since I had no expectations to begin with, the fact that it didn't happen made absolutely no difference to me. Among the 10 rare cards I extracted, the majority were cards of which I already possessed multiple copies in my deck—cards that I utilize in almost all of my battles. Examples include the Life Element's Anchor-Hex Adept, the Water Element's Torrent Sniper, and the Death Element's Mindless Thrall. These magic cards prove to be excellent for maintaining power balance; although I previously only held Level 1 versions of all these cards, with my new strategy, I will likely be able to level them up much faster than before. Additionally, I frequently use another Water Element card—the melee attacker Surgehammer—in my low-mana battles. The one card that stands out as completely new and unique from this haul is the Death Element's melee attacker, Grove Doomblade. As you can see, it is a massive melee attacker that boasts a melee attack power of 5 right from Level 1. Although its health is quite low and its speed is absolutely minimal, I believe that—with the right kind of support—this card could be turned into a nightmare for opponents. I will certainly share the battles in which I use this card with all of you; if you have any suggestions on how to utilize this card even more effectively, the comments section is open!

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n
>If you also want to enjoy this amazing game and you have not yet signed up, <a target=\

>I invite you to Splinterlands, and I will also try my best to guide you in this game. 😎 * * * `Note:` 1. `English is not my first language. So sometimes I use 'Google Translate'. Please don't think that anything I have written in this blog has been copied from somewhere or is AI-generated.` 2. `Paragraph Dividers and all the photos are from #Splinterlands.` 3. `All the other content images and words are mine unless otherwise stated.`
>Have a Happy and Blessed day!

links.title: Mcgi review: Knowing the future
links.body:
Bro Eli Soriano taught us that the future is only known by God. God limits our knowledge and wisdom about the future, He is the only one who knows the future. Scripture warns against depending on fortune tellers, divination, or other practices that attempt to reveal hidden things apart from God. Instead, believers are encouraged to trust God’s wisdom and guidance for their lives.

Knowing the future is not presented in the Bible as the main goal of faith. Rather, God calls His people to live in obedience, faith, and readiness each day. Jesus taught His followers not to be overly anxious about tomorrow, because God already knows our needs and cares for us. The focus of the Christian life is trusting God’s plan instead of trying to control future events.

links.title: Yordano [Esp-Eng]
links.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Yordano**, el artista que logró capturar la esencia de la Caracas urbana en sus letras, fusionando el pop, el jazz y el Caribe en un lenguaje musical que es hoy patrimonio de nuestra cultura.

> We present the career of **Yordano**, the artist who managed to capture the essence of urban Caracas in his lyrics, fusing pop, jazz, and the Caribbean into a musical language that is now part of our cultural heritage. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AK2C7dS3WQeUxMBYBWvSTmvW8rJWQfFupYvbjCq5P6g6MUXtFSr6Vwmq9DWdK8f.png) # Yordano: La poética del asfalto y el legado del pop urbano

>\n\n**Giordano Di Marzo**, conocido artísticamente como **Yordano**, es una figura central en la arquitectura de la música popular venezolana contemporánea. Su carrera comenzó a finales de los setenta con la agrupación **Sietecuero**, pero fue su consolidación como solista en la década de los ochenta lo que transformó la radio nacional. Con el lanzamiento de su álbum homónimo en 1984, el artista introdujo un lenguaje sonoro que fusionaba el pop-rock con el son, el bolero y el jazz, logrando éxitos masivos como **\

**. Estas composiciones no solo dominaron las listas de popularidad, sino que establecieron a **Yordano** como un compositor capaz de retratar la bohemia y la cotidianidad de Caracas con una sofisticación técnica inédita.\n\nDurante los años ochenta y principios de los noventa, junto a su banda **Ladrones de Sombras**, el artista profundizó su rol de cronista urbano. Canciones como **\

** se convirtieron en himnos generacionales que registraban las luces y sombras de la identidad nacional. Su discografía de este periodo documenta un equilibrio entre la balada romántica y la experimentación rítmica, siempre apoyada en una ejecución instrumental impecable. Tras alcanzar la cima comercial, **Yordano** exploró derroteros más íntimos a mediados de los noventa con álbumes como *Lunas* (1995) y *Fiebre* (1997), donde el minimalismo y la introspección marcaron una nueva etapa en su proceso creativo. El cambio de milenio trajo consigo una etapa de reinvención y homenaje. En el año 2000, publicó *Qué lindas son*, una placa dedicada a los clásicos del Caribe que influenciaron su formación, rindiendo tributo a maestros como **Benny Moré** y **Barbarito Diez**. Tras superar importantes retos de salud diagnosticados en 2014, el artista regresó a la escena con una resiliencia que se reflejó en producciones como *El tren de los regresos* (2016) y *Después de todo* (2020). Este último trabajo evidenció una madurez lírica que conectó con nuevas audiencias, demostrando que su capacidad para interpretar el sentimiento colectivo se mantenía intacta a pesar de los años y las adversidades personales. En 2022, la **Academia Latina de la Grabación** reconoció su impacto histórico otorgándole el **Premio Grammy Latino a la Excelencia Musical**. Este galardón ratificó la trascendencia de una obra que abarca más de cuatro décadas de rigor artístico y honestidad compositiva. La trayectoria de **Yordano** se registra como un testimonio de la evolución del pop latino, donde la formación académica y la raíz popular convergen para dar voz a una ciudad y a un país. Hoy en día, el legado de sus primeros éxitos continúa vigente, posicionándolo como un maestro indispensable de la canción de autor y un referente dentro de la industria musical venezolana. ------

> 


### Yordano: The Poetics of the Asphalt and the Legacy of Urban Pop

**Giordano Di Marzo**, known artistically as **Yordano**, is a central figure in the architecture of contemporary Venezuelan popular music. His career began in the late seventies with the group **Sietecuero**, but it was his consolidation as a soloist in the eighties that transformed national radio. With the release of his self-titled album in 1984, the artist introduced a sound language that fused pop-rock with son, bolero, and jazz, achieving massive hits such as **\

**. These compositions not only dominated the popularity charts but also established **Yordano** as a songwriter capable of portraying the bohemia and daily life of Caracas with unprecedented technical sophistication.\n\nDuring the eighties and early nineties, together with his band **Ladrones de Sombras**, the artist deepened his role as an urban chronicler. Songs like **\

** became generational anthems that recorded the lights and shadows of national identity. His discography from this period documents a balance between the romantic ballad and rhythmic experimentation, always supported by impeccable instrumental execution. After reaching a commercial peak, **Yordano** explored more intimate paths in the mid-nineties with albums like *Lunas* (1995) and *Fiebre* (1997), where minimalism and introspection marked a new stage in his creative process. The turn of the millennium brought a stage of reinvention and tribute. In 2000, he released *Qué lindas son*, a record dedicated to the Caribbean classics that influenced his formation, paying tribute to masters like **Benny Moré** and **Barbarito Diez**. After overcoming significant health challenges diagnosed in 2014, the artist returned to the scene with a resilience reflected in productions such as *El tren de los regresos* (2016) and *Después de todo* (2020). This latest work evidenced a lyrical maturity that connected with new audiences, proving that his ability to interpret collective sentiment remained intact despite the years and personal adversities. In 2022, the **Latin Recording Academy** recognized his historical impact by awarding him the **Latin Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award**. This award ratified the significance of a body of work spanning more than four decades of artistic rigor and compositional honesty. **Yordano**'s career is recorded as a testimony to the evolution of Latin pop, where academic training and popular roots converge to give a voice to a city and a country. Today, the legacy of his first hits remains relevant, positioning him as an indispensable master of the singer-songwriter genre and a benchmark within the Venezuelan music industry. #

links.title: The Road to Rebellion: Abundance Year Episode 1979 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
links.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1914
Wednesday 27, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1979
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
(Note: All of this is available in audio on the substack channel. Come over and subscribe for free.) 
Salutations! Wellness warriors, hump day heroes, soul spirits, beautiful bags of mostly water. Welcome to another, Hump Day from paradise. 

It’s another day above ground of disco dancing with deity, mind-alignment, and our seven daily wins. We wish you wellness,  manifest magic, majesty & grace. As you continue your battles. 

One day, for no particular reason, Forrest Gump started running. And running. And running. I think the film was attempting to give this fictional character credit for starting the running craze in America, along with a couple  other 80s era fads. But maybe it was commentary on just how similar humans are to sheep. Gump was asked why he was running. If I remember correctly, there was no reason. That didn’t matter to his followers. 

Even if you aren’t paying close attention, you will come to a point on your journey when you realize that the herd is the problem. And, if you can be honest with yourself, You, are part of the same herd that is causing the problem. All the problems.   

File under, “awakening.” Damn! 

Most of the time, as is no surprise to humans that study this stuff, the problem begins with “desire.” Classic. “I wanna!” Even George Carlin pointed this out. In the 1970s! According to Buddha, desire is the root of all suffering. According to the Pope, “desire is a sin.” 

So what? We still want our goodies, and there are so many goodies available, that if we don’t have everything, we might as well have nothing. Thus we suffer. 

Because you’ve been “enlightened,” you are aware of your passions. Not only what they are, but what they mean to you. And, what you are willing to do, or not do, to keep those passions coming. 

Sometimes these passions come in solid form. Name the seven deadly addictions. But the most dangerous desires are ideas. Especially the ones that seem like they are within reach. 

“If only everybody would just… “ And now it’s your goal. No. Not just a goal. It’s your mission. No. “Mission” is still to small. It’s your “Quest” to enlighten the herd, so that your desire can be manifested. 

This is when you look over your shoulder and no one’s running behind you any more. There’s no support. No interest. Your quest requires too much mental energy for the flock. 

“I’ll listen to dudes talk about how many village girls they banged in Central America over the weekend, but I’m not interested in what you do when your lady starts crying for no reason.” 

Those lacking will be in to whatever will fill their tank, quickly, easily and with no effort on their part. And no repercussions. Which, coincidentally, are the elements of every scam from the cards on the corner, to the next Vax-Zilla being cooked up by the World Health Organization.  

Humans don’t live long enough to think in decades. I’ve heard a lot of friends say, “If I knew I was gonna alive this long, I wudda … “. 

Mind often wonders how these cats who seem to come out of nowhere build these large followings. They don’t. They have agents. Agents have teams, contacts, distribution networks & circuits. 

Ever heard of the “Chitlin circuit?” It was a collection of performance venues found throughout the eastern, southern, and upper Midwest areas of the United States. They provided commercial and cultural acceptance for African-American musicians, comedians, and other entertainers. If you wanted to earn, you played these venues, and your agent, their team, the venue, took a cut. The performer got what was left.  

Any organization has what they call, “standards.” Thus, the stable must conform to standards that might make such entertainers appear to be selling their souls. Which many of them did. And the devil came to collect before many of these entertainers could enjoy all their earnings. And the public, the herd, will bleat, “that’s too bad,” as they welcome the next entertainer that will distract them from the pressures of this thing, we call life.  

At this moment, I think the worst word in the English language is, “influencer.” It’s not only a stupid word, but an ugly word as well, because it tells you exactly how little the system respects the herd’s autonomy, it’s ability to think and choose. You must be influenced. You will be influenced. And you will comply. 

There’s kind of a battle going on against this. It’s being framed as a battle against AI, with the subheading of, “anti-harm.” It has to be boxed in the gift of protection, because, “everybody knows” if you don’t tell the herd that the candy will kill them, they will gobble up as much as they can. Complain of the belly ache, barf, and then gobble up more poison.  

Life is like a box of chocolates. When you finish one box, life will bring you another box. 

Stay strong, stay safe, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.   

PEACE  


The Road to Rebellion
Omnipotence 
Common Senses
From stubborn child to enlightened rebel. 

![1979.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmckWkvnchcZNxoMANGrd4STZCvzRYqZtaaihBJN3Tx2Bs/1979.png)

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1914_full_5-27-26_1979_rebel:0?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.
The Road to Rebellion 
Friends, frequenters, visitors and tourists, need not, “figure out” that your humble scribe is a smart-ass. We let you know upfront. No hidden fees, no bait & switch, and no promises. No salesman will call. Operators are not standing by. It is what it is. And I is what I is. The only question is, “is he more smart than ass? Or more ass than smart?” It’s like the question with advertising. “Half of all advertising works. The question is, which half?”  
Being a wise-guy is a rung on the ladder to “evil genius.” Maybe it’s halfway up that ladder. Way down near the bottom, is cute, trusting and naive. “You’re so schweet. Adorable!” The savvy mindecant has already figured out the ascension scale. The formula. The secret. The higher one ascends on this philosophical scale, the more frustrated one becomes. More cynical, skeptical, suspicious. More aware, more discerning, more enlightened. More disappointed, more self aware, more self sufficient, and less tolerant of the herd. Less tolerant, and more contemptuous. Because as you ascend this latter, and you make these self actualizing discoveries, you’re thinking, “Whoa, I gotta tell people about this. It will really help them.” It’s like you got some gospel and you think, “this knowledge can change the world.” 

And the reception you get is less than enthusiastic. It can range to much darker reactions. 

“That’s nice honey. What’s on Nutflix tonight?”

“Don’t disturb this groove. Sucka!”

Your humble vagabond is not at evil genius level yet. We’re not aiming for that level. We wouldn’t mind, “genius.” But evil is a little too much to manage. 
Here’s an abstract of the evil genius. There are a coupe of models. Model A, is born into an upper class family and sent to the kinds of private schools that still teach Latin and fencing. There’s already mild contempt for the lower classes and that contempt is amplified in this scholastic environment. They read Malthus, Darwin, Bentham, and Huxley. They admire the Dulles brothers, Harry Anslinger and Dick Cheney. Despise the Kennedys and regard FDR as a class traitor. They have a brilliance that is half nature and half nurture. And if they can manage to stay away from alcoholism and their homosexual proclivities, they will be installed into the policy making apparatus that ensures that the poor stay poor, or get poorer, the middle class continues to struggle, the upper class remains a class buffer between the wealthy and the middle classes, ensuring there will be no revolution, and the rich, continue to make policy and remain so powerful that the numbers don’t matter. 

The evil genius, isn’t evil in their own view. They are pragmatic, simply preserving the status quo. 

Then, there’s the evil genius that comes from the herd. They figure out the game. It’s a little more nature, or environment, than nurture. Nobody is nurturing these cats. They might be Ivy League smart, but can’t afford to attend. Family is, “ineligible” for some reason. This cat still has options. He can thrive in the parallel economy. This economy maybe does some damage to the community, so he figures out how to ply his talents outside of his community, and bring the profits back home. 

He wants to do right by his peeps. His hood, the friends he grew up with. But guess what. Someone on that ladder, with more ambition than brains and even less scruples, wants to shine. So he tries to mess up the whole system. Of course he’s discovered. Set up, and never seen again. 

But now our parallel economy entrepreneur, is a little more enlightened. He ascends the ladder. “All skin-folk ain’t kin-folk.” He’s a little bit smarter and a little bit harder. Closer to evil. And a little bit less visible.  

So you get the picture. Dumb doesn’t last very long, anywhere. Dumb and ambitious. Even shorter lifespans. This is across the board. 

Your boy is a proponent of the middle way. Mediocrity is not a bad word to my ears. It means balance. It’s the ends that are nearly always attacked first. The periphery. 

“Give me liberty, or give me death!” And the next morning you’re swinging from an old oak tree. 

I will take my liberties, and no one needs to know. Stroll through the gates while the watchers are watching those deemed more suspicious. More watchable. But you don’t trespass and start bragging about it to those you have trespassed against. That’s dumb. And dumb gets you vanished.  

In many ways, Vagabond Rebellion is against dumb shit. 

“When you do dumb shit, dumb shit happens.” 

Rebellion isn’t limited to the usual suspects. It also includes movements and concepts and stuff out here that excites the herd and gets them following the charlatans du jour. I see it on social media daily. I’ve monitored it for years. I have witnessed channels I’ve followed for years change their editorial presentation and lean and little further ideologically one way or the other. Then, their sponsorship revenue increased. Good for them. I don’t count their money. But I can’t count on their information anymore either. So why watch? 

I don’t call them out, any more than I’d narc on dude thriving in the black market. If I can get some European-type knock-offs, made in China, from the Senegalese “vendor,” just off El Puerta del Sol, that’s a win. I’m not gonna dime him out. We’re both fightin’ against the system in our own way. 

So even when I can clearly see what some of these accounts are up to, and I can smell the bovine excrement on this side of my screen. I don’t call them out, personally. Because it won’t even make a difference.  

If you’re gonna be a rebel. At least find a cause. 

Currently, if you are still with me. (Sometimes I don’t think fingers type this stuff to be understood.) Mind is rebelling against a cosmogony we were preparing to create a new religion from. Or at least a philosophy. Or maybe even a rebellion. 

Our groove was that the Annunaki wanted to wipe out humanity, which we would parlay into a tax exempt religion that would encourage a “re-vie-lution.” (Vie means life. Get it?)  Using reverse psychology, we’d convince the herd, to buff it up, get their minds straight and their bodies strong and prepare for the Annuanki at the gate! But the Annunaki are not the enemy. The herd is the enemy.

So much for that revolution. Maybe I level up a rung. Closer to evil genius status. A little more brilliance. A little more ruthlessness. Maybe I will sacrifice the herd to save the herd. Perfectly logical from a European perspective. But Mind is working away from those concepts. 

Emindcipation.  

These daily drops are fragments and snippets. Long plays are released every five days. On the 4s and 9s in May. On the 3s & 8s in June. Plus in June Radio Free Spirit debuts exclusively on Substack. It’s just audio. 10 PM EST. 

These audios? Well, I don’t know what they are. They are cathartic, and maybe they provide a clue to the Ultimaniac behind these keys.

links.title: Current picture of my lemon garden: Yield and struggle for survival amidst heat and drought
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5uUbXkj1eWagrzRjvsgKYSVM1CMm1XJp3ez5kUU7piV/polish_20260527_235801438.jpg)


Hello garden-loving friends, I hope everyone is well.
 Today I will show you the current state of my favorite fruit garden, especially my lemon garden. The weather and the real form of nature are revealed in our garden. Sometimes joy, sometimes a little disappointment - all together our garden. Let's see what is the state of my garden.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZogWKLquMsRvjNU3LKUNNJ6GA2vXpRbP5JYKDmHzjvpc/mix_20260527_232251.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQNY35uGW3dZpF55sRs2iesh57u21La9UVHF89GbLzAa/mix_20260527_232040.jpg)

​Bumper yield of China 3 seedless lemon:
​Let me give you the happy news at the beginning. The main attraction of my garden, China 3 seedless lemon trees, have yielded very well this time. As you can see in the picture, each tree is holding a large number of lemons in bunches. The shape of the lemons is also quite good. It really makes my heart happy to see such a large number of lemons among the green leaves. I am very happy to be able to take care of these trees.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYb9ionyLFzpH538XCxCpji664rJeFzAXRkQKDMvzXrfv/mix_20260527_232159.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpNSbfDn9d1nHRyHyrfaXbHv1HdpWs98F1UDfQd4b2dD/mix_20260527_232218.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZM7SByzvrunbH6tBa6LdF3ZFPE1dqkLqbAVnTccxy38Y/mix_20260527_232322.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme8buVaijsta3ndkZe6Nb4R742iXGCh863isRoAEfLb54/mix_20260527_232017.jpg)

​Drought and excessive heat and the struggle of the chili plants:
​Now let's talk about disappointment. In the past few days, Bangladesh has been experiencing intense heat and severe drought. This unbearable temperature was difficult for many trees to bear. I had planted several chilli plants in the lemon garden, hoping to get a lot of chilli. But due to this wrath of nature, almost all the chilli plants have died. The trees have dried up due to the scorching heat. You can see a chilli plant in the picture, sadly, this is the only one that has survived among the chilli plants I planted. I am trying my best to keep it alive.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ1C7RT4y5Q3uHZkNtwDV2k8EQRfD7L99fCQDpDk7hL55/mix_20260527_231852.jpg)

​New life: Puisha:
​Although the chilli plants died in the heat, the newly planted puishas have done quite well. Look at the picture, they are still very small. They have only sprouted a few days ago. The small young leaves look great. I hope they will grow up soon and fulfill our green vegetable needs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeykzForqRFJpBi9LxPbft9th7xZznJ841qR6LDAcJQRf/mix_20260527_231833.jpg)

​Slowly growing Thai grapefruit and pink Jackfruit:
​Among the new life in the garden, there is also a Thai Baro Masi grapefruit plant. The tree is slowly growing and has recently sprouted new leaves. Its freshness suggests that it is also adapting well. Next to it is my twelve-year-old pink Jackfruit tree. The tree is still very small. It will take a long time to see it grow. Gardening is a game of patience.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUp7385bkk7NRXuhVoEA7aTeEQF5BqD5sJfJ2X2odf2t/mix_20260527_231927.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9BK7eeb9e3NzNdcxN8CJ7zCcPmvg6Cb3ToPnU53UyMN/mix_20260527_231944.jpg)

​Building a garden amidst the various forms of nature and changes in weather is a challenge. Sometimes we succeed, sometimes nature teaches us something new. Although it is painful to lose the chili plants, the yield of lemons and the new young leaves of the puishak give me new inspiration. You can comment on how you liked this journey of my garden.

​May everyone be well, stay healthy and be with nature. Thank you.


(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

links.title: The Necromancy of Consensus: Jurisprudence as the High Magic of the Modern State
links.body:
![1000012719.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sinistry/23tm9dTo1L5drxzWjToCZNf3GwZaqsxeqaXfCrGy5gDr5BtPi6j6RsXmTjVFcc1PRVMwA.png)

For what it's worth I don't think *necromancy* is the correct word to use here, but it adds an element of decay I think overall augments the tone such that I can't bring myself to change it. Anyway, off we go...


## Abstract
This paper proposes a radical ontological reframing of contemporary legal and corporate structures through the lens of esoteric ritualism and magical theory. By analyzing the linguistic, binding, and generative properties of contracts, statutory law, and corporate personhood, we argue that the modern global economy does not represent a departure from a superstitious past, but rather the highly sophisticated culmination of formal sorcery. Utilizing a framework that bridges semantic philosophy with anthropological magic, this essay explores how the contemporary citizen is governed not merely by rational policy, but by a pervasive, invisible architecture of ritualized incantations (\

).
## Introduction: The Secular Illusion
The foundational myth of the post-Enlightenment world is that humanity successfully banished magic from the public square. We congratulate ourselves on trading superstition for science, alchemy for chemistry, and the divine right of kings for the rule of law. According to this secular narrative, the modern marketplace is a rational engine driven by empirical mechanics and calculated self-interest.
However, this disillusionment is an illusion of vocabulary. If we strip away the sanitized nomenclature of contemporary institutionalism and evaluate our societal structures by their functional mechanics, it becomes glaringly evident that we have not abolished magic; we have merely institutionalized, bureaucratized, and codified it.
The core mechanism of historical sorcery has always been the manipulation of reality through the precise application of language, ritual, and intent to bind the future behavior of matter and mind. In the modern era, this practice is not found in occult undergrounds, but in the brightly lit offices of corporate law firms and the vaulted chambers of supreme courts.
> **Thesis:** The modern legal system operates as a functional framework of high magic, wherein contracts serve as binding spells, the judiciary acts as an elite order of specialized magi, and the corporate entity exists as a legally animated, immortal golem. To understand our contemporary world, we must recognize it as a hyper-bureaucratized magocracy where human autonomy is systematically traded for structural miracles through the medium of the written word.
> 
## I. Logocentric Sorcery: Legalese as an Esoteric Language
In traditional occult traditions, a spell fails if a single syllable is mispronounced or a rune is drawn slightly askew. Magic requires an exact, specialized dialect that separates the initiate from the uninitiated. In contemporary society, this dialect is **Legalese**.
```
[Common Parlance] ---> Translated via Ritual ---> [Words of Power] ---> Reality Altered
  (\

)   (Asset Protected)

```
Legalese is explicitly designed to be distinct from vulgar human speech. It is a logocentric technology where specific phrases function as formulas that warp reality. Consider the linguistic transition required to enact a simple agreement:
 * A layperson’s promise is structurally inert; it possesses no metaphysical weight and cannot compel the state to deploy its monopoly on violence.
 * For a promise to manifest as a reality-altering force, it must be filtered through a licensed practitioner—a lawyer—who translates human intent into highly specialized \

such as *indemnify*, *ab initio*, *force majeure*, or *severability*.
The Bar Association functions precisely like a closed magical guild or an ancient priesthood. The trials required to enter this guild (the Bar Exam) do not test morality or inherent wisdom; they test the initiate’s capacity to meticulously manipulate the sacred grimoires (statutes and case law precedents) without causing a systemic backfire.
When a contract is signed, witnessed, and notarized, a formal ritual has been completed. The paper itself is irrelevant; it is merely the physical talisman hosting the spell. The true enchantment is the invisible, metaphysical bond that now tethers the signers' future actions, backed by the latent, destructive energy of the sovereign state.
## II. The School of Necromancy: The Creation of the Corporate Golem
Perhaps the most profound evidence of modern sorcery is the invention of the Limited Liability Corporation (LLC). In standard legal textbooks, the corporation is dryly defined as a \

In the terminology of the esoteric, however, the creation of a corporation is an act of pure **necromancy** and **golemancy**.
Through the ritual filing of Articles of Organization with a state authority, a group of human sorcerers creates a new entity out of thin air. This entity is granted the legal rights of a person: it can own land, sue enemies, enter into pacts, and hold property. Yet, it possesses no soul, no biological form, and no moral conscience.
### Comparative Anatomy of Manifestation
| Occult Attribute | Mythological Golem | Corporate Golem |
|---|---|---|
| **Animation Method** | Inscribing the word *Emet* (Truth) on the forehead. | Filing Articles of Incorporation with the State Registry. |
| **Composition** | Clay, mud, and inanimate physical matter. | Capital, intellectual property, and contractual obligations. |
| **Mortality** | Destroyed by erasing the activating inscription. | Dissolved only by formal bankruptcy or state revocation. |
| **Liability Shield** | The creator directs the monster; the monster takes the physical blame. | The \

protects the shareholders from personal ruin. |
The corporate golem represents a terrifying advancement in magical engineering: **functional immortality**. While its human creators, directors, and employees will eventually age, rot, and die, the corporate entity can persist for centuries, growing exponentially larger and hoarding vast sums of wealth.
Furthermore, the creators are shielded by an invisible defensive ward known as the **corporate veil**. If the corporate golem devastates an ecosystem, exploits a populace, or defaults on its debts, the ward absorbs the ethical and financial backfire. The golem is dissolved or penalized, while the mages who directed its movements walk away with their personal treasuries entirely intact.
## III. Faustian Pacts in the Digital Age: The Ubiquity of the EULA
If the corporate golem is the dominant entity of our world, the End User License Agreement (EULA) and Terms of Service (ToS) are its most pervasive hexes. In the ancient world, a Faustian bargain required a dramatic crossroads, a circle of salt, and a drop of blood. In the modern world, it requires a smartphone, a high-speed internet connection, and the click of an **\

** button.
```
                  THE FAUSTIAN TRADE-OFF
+--------------------------------------------------------+
| Divine Miracles Provided:                             |
|  - Instantaneous global scrying (Search engines)       |
|  - Omniscient pathfinding (GPS Navigation)            |
|  - Instant teleportation of goods (E-Commerce)         |
+--------------------------------------------------------+
                           ||
                           || Requires Payment Of:
                           \/
+--------------------------------------------------------+
| True Name Yielded:                                     |
|  - Biometric markers & facial recognition patterns     |
|  - Continuous location telemetry                       |
|  - Psychological profiles & behavioral predictability  |
+--------------------------------------------------------+

```
The brilliance of this mass-scale sorcery lies in its asymmetric design. The modern citizen does not read the three-hundred-line scroll of glowing text presented to them; to do so would require an impossible expenditure of time. Instead, the citizenry willingly, blindly surrenders slices of their autonomy, their privacy, and their \

(metadata, biometric signatures, behavioral profiles) in exchange for minor everyday miracles.
We live under an atmospheric blanket of these ambient spells. Our locations are tracked by digital scrying pools, our preferences are anticipated by algorithmic familiars, and our voices are recorded by domestic listening charms. We have signed away our digital souls not out of desperation, but out of sheer convenience.
## IV. The Rise of the Automaton: Smart Contracts as Unyielding Runes
We are currently transitioning from a period of human-mediated magic to an era of **autonomous, self-executing runic geometry**. Historically, if a contractual spell was broken, the injured party had to appeal to the High Magistrates (Judges) to enforce the counter-curse. This introduced human variables into the magical equation: mercy, corruption, context, and delay.
The advent of blockchain technology and **smart contracts** removes the human element entirely. A smart contract is an immutable, cryptographic rune etched into the digital ether. It operates on absolute, binary logic:
If a debtor fails to make a digital payment by a specific microsecond, the smart contract does not wait for a court order. It instantly locks the debtor out of their smart home, repositions the digital title of their vehicle, or drains funds directly from their digital wallet.
This is magic stripped of humanity. It is an unyielding, unfeeling framework where the concept of equity or extenuating circumstances is mathematically impossible. We are systematically surrounding ourselves with automated traps that execute their programmed judgments with the cold precision of gravity.
## Conclusion: Living in the Dense Web of Incantations
To view our modern world as a purely secular, rational space is to miss the invisible strings pulling upon every aspect of human behavior. We do not live in a post-magical world; we live in a world that has been utterly conquered by it.
Every time we walk down a city street, we are stepping through an incredibly dense thicket of invisible tripwires, zoning curses, corporate shields, and non-disclosure wards. The true power structure of our global society is held together not by physical chains, but by the conceptual glue of contractual agreements—words written on paper that have been granted the authority to command police forces, move armies, and reallocate billions of dollars of tangible wealth.
As we move deeper into an era dominated by immortal corporate entities and automated, self-executing digital runes, the need for a critical \
becomes paramount. If we continue to blindly click \
to every scroll placed before us, we will find ourselves entirely trapped within a matrix of our own collective casting—bound by a web of ancient legal wizardry that we chose to name \
but which functions, undeniably, as the highest form of sorcery.\n

links.title: YES, CHARITY BEGINS AT HOME.
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>
Indeed charity begins at home. Because at the end of the day, it is those that are within one's immediate environment that can truly tell if one is indeed charitable or not as long as they are not biased or aggrieved. 

![Snapchat-1678476038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyinye-chi/23tbo2h1eCdEUde3X8ykcHasNDQs79g1gGTNUwgr8N7SwyRYo5vgKn6iVuRq6Jcx23MMD.jpg)

Now, for those that do charity far away from their 'home', I believe they have their reasons, and I think I can state a few. 

One of those reasons can be entitlement mentality. Many people feel they are entitled to someone else's resources, especially if they have shown benevolence a few times. They think to themselves that \

. Therefore, they will keep coming and keep asking even for things they can work and get for themselves. And when they don't get what they predetermined in their hearts, that's when you start hearing all sorts of stories about the wealthy person. This is a wrong mentality but unfortunately very rampant. So because of this, the giver rather feigns stinginess in their immediate environment and go out there to do charity towards strangers—strangers that won't expect them to give them all the time. 

I know of a wealthy man that was free handed. Because of this, people never stopped coming to his house, and they always come with one problem or the other. In as much as he did have the money, he still felt drained. This is why I think that the givers sometimes prefer that those that know them shouldn't know that they have that much resources. 

Another scenario is that of safety. Kidnappers usually prey on people they perceive to be wealthy, and what better way to show abundance than acts of charity? 

The point mentioned above are simply my understanding as to why benevolent people tend to neglect those around them and go far away to perform acts of charity. But I don't think it should be so. I mean, even though those around them might be leeches, not all of them are. Some of them are genuinely helpless and can't seem to find their feet. Therefore, I think everyone should be done in moderation and with schedules. All these constitute wisdom. 

While planning for the far away outreach activities, the wealthy can intentionally look around their immediate environment and select a few persons that genuinely need help and actually help them. They can do this secretly from time to time. So that when other hear about it and ask questions, it will be understood that the criteria is genuine helplessness and not idleness. After all, real charity is empowerment not just free handouts.

In conclusion, the saying \

should hold true for any person genuinely doing charity. After all, it is the story of those around us that we truly know and can genuinely relate with. And in knowing their stories, we can actually extend a hand of help where it does really matter. We won't have to just give random things that they might not need immediately, and hope that they are satisfied. Thanks for stopping by my blog. See you soon. 🤗 ### peace out ✌️ ##### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE

links.title: Broken Dreams Still Build Strong People
links.body:
![schaferle-man-2037255_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaBzJmcGV5rn8h8uU2C5oJoztqeNv2vYSF8qLELqzSvdU/schaferle-man-2037255_1920.jpg)
Source : https://pixabay.com/

Hi, how are you? I hope you're all doing well. In life, not everything goes according to our plans. We look forward to some things with great enthusiasm, we adorn ourselves with them, but over time they can break. It feels like everything is over, like nothing can ever be okay. 
Friends, we even give up hope, wondering what happened to us—we had dreamed so big, and then everything suddenly shattered. 

But the truth is that a broken dream makes a person stronger from within. When we fall, we rise back up even stronger.  

Friends, I too have seen moments in my life when I thought there was nothing left of me, but time taught me that every loss is actually a lesson from which one learns how to face the world and fight back against those who come at you. 

Friends, broken cups don't mean your life is over. Your rope has only just been laid out before you, and it gives you hope. It makes you a much stronger person, because life can take us anywhere at any time. We need to be strong so that we can face whatever circumstances life throws at us. 

If today we look at our broken things and feel their pain, how will we become strong? We have to learn to live; we have to live with our shattered dreams so that we can win the race of life.

![0hhPrKlNOU3ayTxR_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/0hhPrKlNOU3ayTxR_3/0hhPrKlNOU3ayTxR_3.webp)
![bTJmIL2rCfXqxM5Z_10.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/bTJmIL2rCfXqxM5Z_10/bTJmIL2rCfXqxM5Z_10.webp)
![gvztJegCNmCG0ndn_5.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/gvztJegCNmCG0ndn_5/gvztJegCNmCG0ndn_5.webp)

</center>
</liketuimages>

OK，半夜三更的哈哈，小影来叨叨叨了，估计大家伙都睡了吧，也只有我这个夜猫子还在敲键盘了，原本打算不发文的，可还是有需要记录在HIVE的文字，既然打开电脑了，就噼里啪啦写一通吧。

在坊巷散步时发现了这粉粉可爱的周同学卡通店，这一次是摆放在商铺入口最显眼的位置，一开始我还以为周杰伦又准备来福州开演唱会了尼，反正我也抢不到票啊，还是进店参观一下躲躲周同学系列手办以及店内其他宝藏吧。

非周末期间，进店参观的人也还不少呢，看到店员也是很放松的样子，我就在拿起粉朴朴的周同学开始把玩起来，这毛绒绒的外表啊，摸起来手感还真不错，哈哈哈，不知道设计师为啥给这粉色系为主调，难道是周杰伦喜欢粉色调？？其实我个人觉得淡蓝色调的更适合他。。

我寻思着带周杰伦再来福州开演唱会之时，刚好又被我抢到票，那么我就过来买个手办，然后带去演唱会现场，哈哈哈，喜欢周杰伦的歌曲是真的，这么多年过去了，他的歌曲依旧经典耐听，不愧是周天王。。

后排的HelloKitty系列也很吸引人啊，虽然我不是它的粉丝，却也被KITTY猫可爱给萌到了，我有一个朋友特别喜欢hellokitty，为此还专门弄了一间kitty房，房间内摆放着各种样式的kitty猫，从大到小，这样收集下来也花了不少Money，不过她还是乐此不疲的，有上新，喜欢的样式就买，按照她这样买下去，恐怕还得弄一套房来收藏了。

寻福启示录，这是哪位人才画的哈，真有趣，把各大神仙介绍的明明白白，看了一圈下来，还是对几位财神爷印象最为深刻哈哈哈哈，一直都以为财神爷就只有一位，没想到啊，还分得那么细啊，有黄财神，北路财神，东路财神，中路财神，西路财神，南路财神，看样子这东南西北中路财神全聚集了哈哈哈。。OK，看到此文的朋友们，我们一起都发大财哈。。很难得凑齐这六大财神爷了。。这还不得超级大暴富一下。。

OK，这半夜写文也是越写越精神，我还是得悠着点，今天先分享到这儿了哈，晚安，祝好梦。。梦里继续财神爷唠嗑，涨财气，哈哈。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**



---

links.title: My delicious lunch: Enjoyed fried eggs, chicken and fresh salad with my family.
links.body:
> ![IMG20250404151549~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWtnJ4sqprVC9rkG1Qr9Z7CTe9TsrcvDVFqh2nJSjcvzB/IMG20250404151549~2.jpg) Hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share with you a great experience of my lunch cooking. In the midst of everyday busyness, the joy of cooking something for my family is different. Today, I took some time to prepare several delicious dishes, which my family enjoyed a lot. The main attraction of today's lunch menu was three dishes: - Special chicken cooking - Fried eggs - Fresh mixed salad **Chicken cooking:** ![IMG20250404151538~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUPck7HpLxSHaWszjy5Fq6uG1a2dhZt8AU54urQjDSVuD/IMG20250404151538~2.jpg) The main attraction of the lunch was the chicken cooked in broth. First, I washed the meat well and marinated it with chopped onion, ginger-garlic paste, cumin powder, turmeric and chili powder for some time. When the meat released oil, I added a little water and made a light broth and put it down. The color of the meat after cooking and its aroma that spread throughout the room were truly mouth-watering. **Roasted Eggs:** ![IMG20250404151549~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWtnJ4sqprVC9rkG1Qr9Z7CTe9TsrcvDVFqh2nJSjcvzB/IMG20250404151549~2.jpg) Along with the chicken, I boiled two eggs and fried them in oil with light turmeric and salt. Then I sautéed onions, tomatoes, and a little spice and roasted the eggs. The layer of yellow spices on top of the roasted eggs was as tempting to look at as it was delicious to eat. **Fresh Mixed Salad:** ![IMG20250404151542~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWDFEwkG1VMvBKFgrfgH7eVwtmkMj5TkQyXw6NdKpEzwW/IMG20250404151542~2.jpg) To keep the taste and health of the mouth healthy along with the heavy meals, I made a wonderful salad. For the salad, I finely chopped carrots, cucumbers, and red tomatoes. I mixed all the ingredients together and prepared the salad with light green chilies. This colorful salad brought a different freshness to the entire dining table. After arranging all the dishes on the table, it looked as beautiful as it tasted amazing. These delicious dishes tasted like nectar with hot white rice in the hot afternoon sun. The biggest achievement was when the whole family was praising the food. We all enjoyed the lunch together with satisfaction. This satisfaction of cooking with your own hands and bringing smiles to the faces of your loved ones is truly different. I hope you liked my cooking blog today. Don't forget to tell me in the comments what you ate for lunch today. Everyone stay well and healthy. ___ |
