body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Nada como una reincorporación de la lista de lesionados y regresar aportando al equipo. En una temporada donde el pitcheo lleva la voz cantante (el AVE colectivo de TODOS los peloteros sumados hasta ayer era de .239), es completamente vital tener hombres experimentados detrás del plato. La desesperación dentro de los equipos por ganar es tal, que han tenido la necesidad de recurrir a soluciones poco ortodoxas: desde jugar pelota \

hasta adelantar la graduación de sus mejores prospectos. Ahí tenemos el caso de Luisangel Acuña hermano menor de Ronald, quien se las ha visto muy negra con el bate al punto de perder su titularidad, en el jardín central de los Medias Blancas de Chicago. Otro caso de pérdida de titularidad lo representa el receptor de los Padres de San Diego Freddy Fermín, quien solo sale a recibir pelotas muy de vez en cuando. Todo esto lo ha causado la falta de ofensiva, ante el evidente dominio del pitcheo. Pero estamos hablando de reincorporaciones, y en este caso, del tercera base venezolano Eugenio \

Suárez. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Nothing beats a fresh activation from the IL and immediately dealing for your squad. In a season where arms are completely running the show—with the league-wide batting average sitting at a meager .239 through yesterday—having veteran presence behind the dish is absolute gold. Front offices are getting so desperate for Ws that they are forcing the envelope with some seriously unorthodox small-ball tactics and aggressively fast-tracking their top prospects to the Show. Take Ronald’s younger brother, Luisangel Acuña, who has been mired in a brutal dynamic at the plate to the point of losing his everyday job in center field for the Chicago White Sox. San Diego Padres backstop Freddy Fermín is another guy who lost his everyday spot and has been relegated to occasional late-game catching duties. It is all a byproduct of league-wide bats going completely ice-cold against this dominant pitching, but today we are talking about impact returns, specifically Venezuelan hot-corner veteran Eugenio \

Suárez.

# ---

![Suárez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xKqyD9fSGmVgRE3jhVjZuCGmQEzpBzKWcPzVjfjssBmd9QrtgGrv7BDrBqAUGHa9e8C.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/reds-vs-mets/2026/05/26/823624/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     El cuadro de Ohio sigue peleando en la difícil división central de la liga Nacional. @hosgug debiera estar de plácemes, dado que los Rojos apenas están detrás por 4 juegos de los líderes lupulosos y por la recuperación para el roster del venezolano. Ayer, en la apertura del primer episodio, en cuenta de 2-2 y con 2 outs en la pizarra, con dos hombres en las bases, Geno pescó un cambio a 89 MPH y envió la pelota entre dos de un bote contra la pared del Citi Field, para remolcar las dos primeras rayitas, de un marcador donde jamás perdieron el control de la ventaja. De éste modo, Suárez demuestra que está recuperado de la lesión que le mantuvo tres semanas alejado de la alineación. La pizarra final fue un categórico 7-2 a favor de los Rojos sobre los alicaídos Mets de Nueva York. Todo el mundo en ésta división tiene balance ganador y los chicos de Cincinnati se acercan a la vanguardia, mientras que los Mets están a 15 juegos detrás en el sótano del este en la misma liga, pensando si les tocará vender antes de la fecha límite de cambios establecida para el 3 de Agosto éste año. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The Ohio squad keeps grinding away in the loaded NL Central. @hosgug should be absolutely pumped, considering the Reds sit just four games back of the brew crew for the division lead while getting their Venezuelan slugger fresh off the IL. Yesterday, in the top of the first with a 2-2 count, two outs, and two ducks on the pond, Geno ambushed an 89 MPH changeup and crushed a one-hop ground-rule double off the wall in right-central at Citi Field. That knock drove in the first two runs of the game, putting Cincinnati in the driver's seat for good. With that swing, Suárez officially proved he is fully back from the oblique strain that kept him sidelined from the lineup for three weeks. When the dust settled, it was a convincing 7-2 victory for the Reds over the fading New York Mets. Every single team in this powerhouse division boasts a winning record as Cincinnati makes its charge toward the top, while the Mets find themselves buried 15 games back in the NL East cellar, left to ponder whether they will have to start selling pieces ahead of this year's August 3rd trade deadline.

# ---

![Eduardo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23uQrnUcgadmRywNyZHjfk5JE97LyuN9rKiaAgdwRfFt3uqqbgxw3VeLBctY2wxudb6Mn.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/d-backs-vs-giants/2026/05/26/823216/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     ¿Recuerdan cuando les dije ayer sobre la costumbre de los venezolanos en Arizona de aparecer en el movimiento de carreras del equipo? Bueno, parece que cuando el abridor criollo Eduardo Rodríguez le toca encargarse de la lomita, la tendencia se hace más marcada. Empecemos con la actuación del as ofidio: 6 episodios completos espaciando 6 imparables, aceptó 2 carreras limpias (incluyendo un cuadrangular), permitió 2 pasaportes y ponchó a 6 contrarios. Salida de calidad que permitió mantener cerca a los Diamondbacks. 4 de la 7 carreras impulsadas por los bates del desierto, fueron traídas a la goma por los bates de Ildemaro Vargas y Gabriel Moreno, ambos venezolanos convertidos en bujías junto a Carrol y Marte. Un roster ofensivo que mete miedo y mantiene a 4.5 juegos de la vanguardia, la distancia en la división oeste de la liga NAcional liderada por los Dodgers. 7 a 5 terminó el juego versus los relegados Gigantes de San Francisco, quienes no tuvieron en la alineación a Luis Arráez. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Remember when I told you yesterday about the Venezuelan players in Arizona always finding a way into the team's run production? Well, it looks like whenever Venezuelan starter Eduardo Rodríguez takes the bump, that trend goes into overdrive. Let’s break down the snake-bitten ace’s performance: 6 full frames scattering 6 hits, giving up 2 earned runs (including a big fly), issuing 2 free passes, and sitting down 6 via the punchout. That quality start kept the Diamondbacks right in the thick of it. Four of the seven runs driven in by the desert bats were knocked in by the sticks of Ildemaro Vargas and Gabriel Moreno, with both Venezuelans acting as spark plugs alongside Carroll and Marte. It is a terrifying lineup that keeps them just 4.5 games back of the top spot in the NL West, currently led by the Dodgers. When the final out was recorded, it was a 7-5 victory over the trailing San Francisco Giants, who kept Luis Arráez out of the starting lineup.

---

![Contreras.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wMcktbzAPV8K9VrCiyCBNsyh872dYavSFrpPjSacrvskmApg9idWconjCdLC3PkR3HR.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/cardinals-vs-brewers/2026/05/26/823785/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Finalmente, cuando no es el hermano mayor quien se lleva los reflectores, William Contreras se ocupa de aparecer en las marquesinas de Milwaukee. Los lupulosos recibían a los Cardenales de San Luis en el American Family Field y transcurría la baja de la quinta entrada cuando los locales decidieron emboscar al pitcheo rojo. Con una pizarra sin outs y las bases llenas, ganando por una, William se encargó de colocar distancia en el marcador al pescar una sinker a 90 MPH y mendar la pelota de un bote contra la pared del centerfield. Doble productor de dos para colocar las cosas 3-0. Al final entregó hoja de 4-2 con una anotada, dos impulsadas y par de ponches. La victoria sirvió para consolidar la ventaja de 3.5 juegos sobre los propios Cardenales ¿Una curiosidad? Milwaukee es el antepenúltimo equipo de 30 con más jonrones bateados. Es decir, sus trunfos provienen de carreras producidas por \

¿Cuanto pueden aguantar jugando así? Pues, al parecer, su triunfo ante San Luis demuestra que no necesitan de los jonrones para fabricar triunfos y eso, en una temporada donde los lanzadores no dejan nada al azar, es una bendición. Seguiremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Finally, whenever his big brother isn't stealing the headlines, William Contreras makes damn sure to get his name in lights up in Milwaukee. The brew crew was hosting the St. Louis Cardinals at American Family Field, and it was the bottom of the fifth when the home team decided to ambush the Redbirds' pitching. With nobody out, bags packed, and holding a slim one-run lead, William broke the game wide open by hunting a 90 MPH sinker and hammering a one-hop ground-rule double off the centerfield wall. That clutch two-run double pushed the score to 3-0. When the dust settled, he turned in a 4-for-2 line with a run scored, two RBIs, and a pair of punchouts. The victory helped solidify a 3.5-game cushion over those very same Cardinals. Want a fun stat? Milwaukee ranks third-to-last out of all 30 teams in the big fly department. In other words, they are manufacturing their Ws purely on the ground. How long can they keep grinding it out playing this style of baseball? Well, it looks like this victory over St. Louis proves they don't need the long ball to stack up wins, and in a season where pitchers are giving absolutely nothing away, that is a total blessing. We will keep riding.

#

body.title: A day at my mother's @silviabeneforti, small works of art, cats, and good food./ Un día en casa de mi madre, @silviabeneforti: pequeñas obras de arte, gatos y buena comida.❤️❤️
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcpZ3UB222drQef71aFjyxsCqrY2hK2G4JpW9CdVXZsum/1779897966412.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? As I told you, I've been very busy these days, but luckily I found the time to go visit my mother @silviabeneforti. Since I haven't been in great health, I went to be spoiled a little by my mother, ha ha. So for a day I didn't have to cook or clean, but just rest and watch TV series. In fact, as soon as I arrived, I sat down at my table with my laptop (I'm not someone who bothers much; I just need food and an internet connection). As soon as I arrived, I immediately found a plate of pasta with tomato sauce ready and I relaxed by watching, or rather rewatching, the first season of How Good Girls Kill. The second season comes out today, and I had to rewatch the first because I didn't remember much. Then, after lunch, I sat down to play and take pictures of Nanny, my parents' cat. She's really chubby and hilarious when she plays and has fun. The smaller cat, who doesn't see me very often, unfortunately is still a little wary, which is a shame because she's really small and cute!

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Como les conté, he estado muy ocupada estos días, pero por suerte encontré tiempo para visitar a mi madre @silviabeneforti. Como no he estado muy bien de salud, fui a que mi madre me mimara un poco, ja ja. Así que por un día no tuve que cocinar ni limpiar, solo descansar y ver series de televisión. De hecho, en cuanto llegué, me senté en mi mesa con mi laptop (no soy de las que se molestan mucho; solo necesito comida y conexión a internet). En cuanto llegué, encontré un plato de pasta con salsa de tomate listo y me relajé viendo, o mejor dicho, volviendo a ver, la primera temporada de How Good Girls Kill. La segunda temporada sale hoy, y tuve que volver a ver la primera porque no recordaba mucho. Luego, después de comer, me senté a jugar y tomar fotos de Nanny, la gata de mis padres. Es muy gordita y graciosa cuando juega y se divierte. La gata más pequeña, que no me ve muy a menudo, lamentablemente todavía está un poco recelosa, ¡lo cual es una pena porque es muy pequeña y mona!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqRT8rJQaaLcyRvPWwgV5YCwQx5Ai5eG8zzJYXDJ9Kq1/1779897966646.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNs9BuM58deT25Tt6KkamDimYATsqbFbiWfXb9vbkSzz/1779897966845.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyg8uEbdeq8TyHT2ZR7eTRj5fvDS9qyosN8zGBduA7e1/1779897967117.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSoNGuijtJrgp8nvbvCMbiPMYvnP5RVTA7JrkRmsLR6EQ/1779897967351.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXsga7WqsAUwag6PdxrRgPNuoDEesA3PUX1HxxhZjHCS1/1779901525877.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbbYLjzhNK7x3yXuEvDKThXKrNeMcdxhHMKVB899HAurq/1779901526143.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTLBKs3RRRiiLosR5GQQYniqt3jqnRHVn4xGHoKmR1P9F/1779901526419.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBgGsuVXrfYjYwxW7Wyn9KFak5bgysrN5zHnVc67veUH/1779901526571.jpg)

Then I wandered around their garden, where while hanging out the laundry I got my whole shirt wet. Luckily, the sun was shining, and the clothes and my shirt dried quickly. I really like their garden, with its many sculptures and a beautiful plum tree in bloom, and often with stray cats because my mother always leaves cat food out. Then I started photographing some of my mother's small works of art. In her typical, unique style, she created some truly cute and charming painted cards and other things she made. Unlike me, my mother has great artistic talent and creativity. And then, of course, I had dinner with my mother and stepfather, and she cooked me a delicious, hearty sausage omelette with a side of beans—a lovely, rich dish! It was lovely spending time with family, you need it every now and then!

> Luego di una vuelta por su jardín, donde mientras tendía la ropa me mojé la camisa entera. Por suerte, hacía sol y la ropa y mi camisa se secaron rápidamente. Me encanta su jardín, con sus numerosas esculturas y un precioso ciruelo en flor, y a menudo con gatos callejeros porque mi madre siempre les deja comida. Después empecé a fotografiar algunas de las pequeñas obras de arte de mi madre. Con su estilo único y característico, creó unas tarjetas pintadas realmente bonitas y encantadoras, además de otras cosas que ella misma hizo. A diferencia de mí, mi madre tiene un gran talento artístico y mucha creatividad. Y luego, por supuesto, cené con mi madre y mi padrastro, y ella me preparó una deliciosa y sustanciosa tortilla de salchicha con alubias de acompañamiento: ¡un plato exquisito! Fue maravilloso pasar tiempo con la familia, ¡se necesita de vez en cuando!




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaLAFwbHC7kzrxujwjkrPuNqBnjbEHUCugdNgRNpz7KyS/1779897992853.jpg)

body.title: The Power of Love
body.body: Love is a feeling that softens a person's heart calms the soul and makes life beautiful. It’s not just the name of attachment to one person, but love is part of every emotion where sincerity, respect and sacrifice exist. True love changes a person inspires them to become better and kindles hope in the heart. Sometimes love is silent yet its silence says so much. Caring for someone being happy in their happiness and feeling restless in their sorrow that’s the true mark of love. Love lives more in feelings than in words and this very feeling brings people’s hearts closer to each other. True love doesn’t fade with time it grows even stronger. No matter the circumstances if trust and respect remain in a relationship love can face any difficulty. That’s why the world’s most beautiful relationships are built on the foundation of love whether it’s the love of parents friendship or attachment to a special person. Love keeps a person away from hatred, arrogance and selfishness. It creates softness in the heart and gives the urge to make things easier for others. Sometimes a single loving sentence can make someone's entire day beautiful and that is the real power of love. In life, every person wants love because life feels incomplete without it. If there is truth in the heart and pure intention love always remains beautiful. Love isn’t just about gaining it’s another name for staying loyal understanding and standing by someone.

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#143
body.body: > ![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48KbeGiGTZBsS7NLkhwJxWQpAbLWAqJ9WQSDrnGGvHN5g59ty3pwBhnHZy5nczEJzk.jpg) We wtorek wróciłem do pracy, co oznaczało również powrót na biegowe ścieżki wokół bazy. Tydzień temu towarzyszyły mi ciężkie, deszczowe chmury i temperatura w okolicach 10 stopni – tym razem zastałem bezchmurne niebo i afrykańskie upały. W Belgii trudno o zrównoważoną pogodę; wpada ona z jednego ekstremum w drugie i to niemal z dnia na dzień. Gdybym miał wybierać, zdecydowanie lepiej biegało mi się w poprzednim tygodniu – wczoraj to była prawdziwa masakra. > ***[ENG] I returned to work on Tuesday, which also meant getting back onto the running paths around the base. A week ago, I was accompanied by heavy rain clouds and temperatures around 10 degrees Celsius; this time, it was clear skies and African heat. It’s hard to find balanced weather in Belgium—it swings from one extreme to another, almost overnight. If I had to choose, I definitely ran much better last week; yesterday was a total nightmare.*** ![IMG_5171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/242CnNDuemVFMvLvin5kGpXU5JBwBrKdcgWVRpp2GSW9635zkiPjUj4NYKyKxnnzMMLk8.jpg) ![IMG_5172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243q4Ko59dnZiUQWkwrLtnTC3zD1tjiUVWZqJkqZSeUSFSSTeZpy3RaUaSQNSiq2G4MkY.jpg) Początkowo udawało mi się utrzymywać dość równe tempo, ale z każdym kolejnym krokiem biegło się coraz ciężej, aż w końcu zacząłem myśleć wyłącznie o jak najszybszym dotarciu do mety. Trudno jednak przyspieszyć, skoro każdy krok przypominał ruchy „muchy w smole”. Chwilę wytchnienia od lejącego się z nieba żaru dawał jedynie krótki odcinek prowadzący przez niewielki lasek na końcu bazy. > ***[ENG] At first, I managed to keep a pretty steady pace, but with each passing step, it felt heavier and heavier, until eventually, my only thought was reaching the finish line as quickly as possible. But how do you speed up when every single step feels like moving through molasses? The only brief respite from the scorching heat came from a short section through a small woodland patch at the far end of the base.*** ![IMG_5175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xAPX17ScnXVcN1mvnyi1CukkTY5zxSKqpQe9NuJA56MnFLddvj1Kn7WTkFzn5ipViqb.jpg) ![IMG_5176.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKDgE5oEFTPESdd7Zq4LT52waiwQnNo4WuQJogeizKMFqZt8CATveLAPuiDuRFj.jpg) Inna sprawa, że po czterech dniach intensywnego chodzenia po Dublinie i poniedziałkowym rowerze moje nogi miały pełne prawo być zmęczone. Zegarek pokazał średnie tempo 6:15 min/km i łącznie 6,04 km w niecałe 38 minut. Dystans był skromniejszy niż zazwyczaj, ale w tym palącym słońcu i po tak intensywnym tygodniu – zupełnie wystarczający. > ***[ENG] Then again, after four days of heavy walking in Dublin followed by Monday's bike ride, my legs had every right to feel exhausted. I clocked an average pace of 6:15 min/km, covering a total of 6.04 km in just under 38 minutes. The distance was shorter than usual, but in that blazing sun and after the week I've had, it was more than enough.*** ![IMG_5178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wMQDP5sQEG9rwHRoMSa7GH67o6DKmFNVRR6KB4kVmpk8eBF4LbxXAceE3wrt3HoDA6E.jpg) ![screenshot-www.strava.com-2026.05.26-22_26_14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23viRAGvGwJ8j9TS2WvqZBUSQ87PAq1yhpipXeTB9Rt2LoHC5umxAvXeG6E4vQHWceu3B.png) ---

body.title: Splinterlands game buying another dragon summoner,Dragonlord Mancer
body.body:
How are you all? Hope you are all well. I play Splinterlands regularly and love to share updates about my game with you. Splinterlands is one of the most popular names in the blockchain gaming world these days. There is no substitute for strong cards to do well in this game. Especially when you go to play in a big league, a good Summoner greatly increases your chances of winning. In today's blog, I am going to share with you some information about my newly purchased Dragon Summoner and the whole process of how I bought it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRV14ATQxvncS3fFFx4o85C9ddAsRjsvCwjy45CYPyPv/1779901680852.jpg) You can see my newly purchased card in the first image, which is called 'Dragonlord Mancer'. This is a very powerful Dragon Summoner. Those of you who play this game know that Dragon element cards can be used with any other element, which gives a lot of advantages in the game's strategy. The Mana Cost of this card is 7. I really like the artwork of the card. It shows a warrior with a dragon helmet on his head and small dragons flying around him. This card is not only beautiful to look at, but it is also very powerful. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTtJhJemsbMPyrhgbXcVyv9MpiZaUMviNK3HT5awiPNE8/1779901669729.jpg) In the second image, you can see the screenshot from when I was buying the card from the marketplace. The price of this card was 39,137.79 DEC. DEC or credit is used to buy cards in the Splinterlands game. When I saw that this card was very useful for my deck or card collection, I decided to buy it without delay. However, before buying, it is important to know the capabilities of the card well. Let's see what additional benefits this summoner will give us. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTADsHJ2zVhrUWJYYvu5HW9TMidvSuqaFVEHbp1LWYWkE/1779901656848.jpg) The third image describes some of the early special abilities of the card. One of the great features of this summoner is its Bloodline Dominion. This means that you can use Saurian and Bruteborn bloodline units from any element using this summoner. It also gives the units the Scavenger ability. The advantage of the Scavenger ability is that whenever a unit dies on the battlefield, your card will regain +1 health or life. This ability is very useful for long-term battles. It increases the survivability of your card. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBrKDcTp8XNVCkKHomSEpPfyjsAotorSBtRAc9DcVAZS/1779901639992.jpg) In the fourth image, we can see some more terrifying abilities. This summoner can give two units in his party the Bloodlust and Corrupted Healing abilities. Those who play this game know how powerful Bloodlust is. If a unit kills an enemy unit, all of its stats or abilities are increased by +1. And with Corrupted Healing, it is possible to restore up to 70 percent of the health of the party cards per round, although this reduces the maximum health by 1. When these abilities work together, it becomes much harder for the opponent to win. Especially when 2 cards are given this ability, your team becomes much stronger. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxgLsuCp4jfFvcYagEMHYutzjRJoC4vC7A9gAuFtXBT8/1779901611093.jpg) I didn't have enough DEC to buy the card. So I had to use the Hive Engine to buy DEC with some Hive tokens. As you can see in the fifth image, I spent 151,012 Hive to buy 24,950 DEC. From the Hive Engine, we can easily exchange the game currency or tokens we need. It is an added pleasure to buy cards by managing funds outside the game. Here you can clearly see the price and total calculation in the screenshot. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUvd6KekWVxCzRMS8kYJx3w7qTr7wK11UoEp5ZRH7c29b/1779901594571.jpg) Finally, in the sixth image, you can see me transferring the DECs purchased from Hive Engine in-game or within the game. When 24,950 DEC were added to my game, my total balance stood at 39,383.26 DEC. You can see in the notification above that the transaction was successful. Then I successfully purchased my favorite ‘Dragonlord Mancer’ card. I am very happy to have completed this entire process. I am very optimistic about this new summoner. It will help me to devise new strategies in the Splinterlands game. This summoner of the dragon element can be my trump card, especially in big tournaments or ranked matches. Increasing your collection in the game is always a good investment. Those of you who play the game regularly can comment and let me know how you like this new card I bought. If I buy more new cards in the future, I will definitely share it with you. Everyone stay safe and healthy, thank you. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

body.title: When Money Comes Before Life
body.body: I'm Some time ago, I personally experienced a patient being denied access to urgent medical treatment because no deposit was made. While some run around and survive the harsh reality of pay before treatment , some lose their lives in the process, it's unfortunate . Growing up, some families are scared of experiencing illness that could take them to the hospital because of lack of money. The sound of illness is pain and sorrow because it's either they get the needed funds by all means or risk the life of their loved ones. It's a sad reality most people battle with silently. ![1001155846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/Eos2keDVCJYAUTJMjCdZhSSF4JYL5v3MrgGvnLe5nHE7XmbcpwprM1ss1rAKz4XP1bJ.jpg) ***** In the medical field, doctors swore an oath to save lives, but in many cases, the reverse is the case in health care facilities. Bills are first made to be paid before giving patients an attention. The other day, my friend's husband was in a coma and needed to be on life support urgently, but the doctor insisted that a deposit of 2 million naira must be made before they can touch him. The wife didn't know the husband's mobile bank PIN to transfer the money; she was helpless, but the doctor didn't care even when the husband was bleeding; all they wanted to have was the money first. ***** My friend cried and pleaded with the hospital, all to no avail. She started calling friends to help save the life of her husband, and fortunately, two people responded to her almost immediately, and they transferred the money directly to the hospital bank account , and that was when treatment commenced. What if those friends had no such huge amount of money? Life will be lost? All because of money, which can still be paid later? It's sad that even in critical condition, money is the top priority, not how to save lives. When the husband recovered, he was able to pay back those friends that saved his life and I imagined losing that man if money wasn't provided , yet we have a government and doctors capable of saving precious lives , it's sad. ***** No doubt, hospitals are never running charity work, salaries are being paid, equipment and medications are also expensive, but to the detriment of life? There should be balance to this situation if you ask me. This is because we are talking about life here not material things, somehow raising the money before the patients get discharged is not negotiable. Maybe it's high time the government should stand and take up their role. Let there be a provision where patients are treated first before talking about money, and also let the government subsidize treatments for patients. It's high time to prioritize human lives,if other countries can do so, why not in Africa countries ? ***** Hospitals can also think of adopting flexible payments inorder to assist anyone who has no access to immediate fund prior to receiving treatment , with this, some careless deaths can be avoided. Overall, money is vital, but lives remain priceless. *This post is in response to the #Hive Learners prompt on the topic titled*, **IN FOR THE MONEY**. ## Image is mine!

body.title: Pasaporte San Martiniano. Quinta Pueyrredón/San Martín Passport. Quinta Pueyrredón
body.body: Este fin de semana largo por el 25 de Mayo decidimos aprovechar unos días en familia y viajar a Buenos Aires para visitar a nuestra hija, que está estudiando en la Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias. Entre paseos, encuentros y charlas, organicé también una actividad muy especial: completar el último sello del Pasaporte Sanmartiniano de la provincia de Buenos Aires. El lugar elegido fue la histórica Quinta Pueyrredón, en San Isidro. Partimos desde el departamento el domingo desúés de almorzar. La quinta perteneció a Juan Martín de Pueyrredón, quien en aquel tiempo era Director Supremo de las Provincias Unidas del Río de la Plata. Allí se realizaron importantes reuniones con José de San Martín, fundamentales para definir aspectos esenciales del Plan Continental, la estrategia militar que permitió la liberación de Chile y Perú del dominio español. Pueyrredón fue un aliado indispensable de San Martín, brindándole apoyo político, recursos económicos, armamento y tropas para concretar la Campaña Libertadora. Actualmente, la quinta funciona como museo histórico y realmente está muy bien conservada. Sus jardines, las salas y los objetos originales permiten imaginar cómo era la vida cotidiana de aquella época. Hay muebles antiguos, documentos, retratos y muchas reliquias de la familia Pueyrredón que ayudan a reconstruir una parte importante de nuestra historia. Sin embargo, algo nos llamó mucho la atención. A pesar de la enorme relevancia que tuvo este lugar en la vida y el proyecto libertador de San Martín, prácticamente no encontramos referencias al Libertador. No había una habitación dedicada a él, ni un espacio específico que explicara la importancia de aquellas reuniones históricas. Resulta extraño que un sitio incluido en el circuito sanmartiniano no destaque más claramente el vínculo con una de las figuras más importantes de nuestra independencia. .

/> Gracias por leer y nos estamos viendo en los próximos sellos que quedan por juntar. Las imagenes fueron sacadas desde mi celular A26 * * * * * * * * * * * * This long weekend for May 25th, we decided to spend a few days with the family and travel to Buenos Aires to visit our daughter, who is studying veterinary medicine. Between outings, get-togethers, and conversations, I also organized a very special activity: collecting the final stamp for the Sanmartiniano Passport for the province of Buenos Aires. The chosen location was the historic Quinta Pueyrredón in San Isidro. The estate belonged to Juan Martín de Pueyrredón, who at that time was Supreme Director of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata. Important meetings were held there with José de San Martín, which were fundamental in defining essential aspects of the Continental Plan, the military strategy that enabled the liberation of Chile and Peru from Spanish rule. Pueyrredón was an indispensable ally of San Martín, providing him with political support, financial resources, weapons, and troops to carry out the Liberation Campaign. Today, the estate serves as a historical museum and is exceptionally well-preserved. Its gardens, rooms, and original artifacts allow visitors to imagine what daily life was like back then. There is antique furniture, documents, portraits, and many heirlooms from the Pueyrredón family that help reconstruct an important part of our history. However, something caught our attention. Despite the enormous significance this place held in San Martín’s life and his liberation project, we found practically no references to the Liberator. There was no room dedicated to him, nor a specific space explaining the importance of those historic meetings. It is strange that a site included in the San Martín circuit does not more clearly highlight the connection to one of the most important figures of our independence. Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
/>\n\nThanks for reading, and see you soon as we collect the remaining stamps.

body.title: Healthcare for Everyone?
body.body:
>



It is common for medical procedures to be among the most necessary things in society and also among the most expensive, depending on the demand. There is not a single person on this Earth who at some point will not need to see a doctor and, if you do not have the financial means to pay for it, what should you do? Should hospitals provide services even to those who cannot afford to pay? What would be the best way to solve this financial barrier between medical necessity and the ability to pay for those who simply cannot?

Well, let’s start with the “villain” of this story. Hospitals are naturally places that require qualified professionals and high-quality equipment, just imagine how much infrastructure is needed in such a place. Doctors themselves are expensive professionals, and for good reason, since they dedicate many years of their lives to becoming qualified and, consequently, are well paid. And not only doctors, but nurses and all the other professionals necessary to keep a hospital fully operational. Besides that, think about the amount of equipment, products, medicines, utensils... wow, it is not cheap at all to maintain a hospital and, considering that each patient is effectively a customer helping keep the place functioning, since everything generates costs that need to be paid, a person who cannot afford those expenses becomes a financial loss.

Of course, you may look at this and think about how lacking in empathy it sounds, but if you understand even the basics of business, you know that a company needs to stay profitable in order to survive, otherwise it will go bankrupt and, sadly, bankrupt hospitals do not treat any patients. But the question here is: should a private hospital really provide treatment to people who do not have the financial means to pay? Well, I believe that a hospital is a business like any other and, if a citizen cannot afford it, it is the duty of the state to supply that need, whether through other hospitals or by covering the cost of the procedure. Or at least that is how it should be.

I know that in some countries, if I’m not mistaken in the USA, a person who, for example, suffers an accident and is hospitalized leaves with medical bills to pay after recovering, regardless of having insurance or not. I cannot say whether the government there helps in some way regarding healthcare, but imagine someone who cannot afford it compromising their entire income just to pay hospital expenses.

Here in Brazil, we have SUS. It is a very interesting system that covers most of the national medical demand. There are hospitals, healthcare centers, public pharmacies with free medication and many procedures that would otherwise be extremely expensive, all free for the population and not only urgent procedures, but also psychological treatments among many others. It truly is something remarkable and a problem that is genuinely addressed by the government, helping many people who cannot afford medical treatment. Of course, it is not perfect and it has its flaws and areas that need improvement, but I can say that anyone can receive treatment for any illness through the public healthcare system here and, when there is no public structure available for a specific disease, private hospitals are brought in through partnerships with the government.

So, when it comes to treating a patient who cannot afford the costs, everything depends on the country and on how public administration handles the issue. From a more empathetic perspective, no hospital should deny treatment and preserving life should matter more than money itself, but we also cannot forget that every hospital is a business that needs to generate profit. In the end, I believe the real duty lies with the government and not with hospitals. The state is the one that should provide healthcare conditions for those most in need, after all, that is what we pay taxes for.

É comum que procedimentos médicos sejam uma das coisas mais necessárias na sociedade e também uma das mais caras, dependendo da demanda. Não existe uma pessoa nessa terra que em algum momento não precisará ir ao médico e, se você não tem condições financeiras de pagar por isso, o que fazer? Hospitais deveriam prestar serviços mesmo para aqueles que não possuem condições de pagar? Qual seria a melhor forma de solucionar essa barreira financeira entre a necessidade médica e a condição de pagamento para aqueles que não a possuem?

Veja bem, vamos começar pelo \

dessa história. Hospitais são naturalmente lugares que demandam profissionais e equipamentos de qualidade, imagine o quanto de estrutura é necessário nesse lugar. Médicos, por si só, são profissionais caros, e não por menos, esses profissionais dedicam muitos anos de suas vidas para se qualificarem e, consequentemente, são bem remunerados. Não somente os médicos, mas enfermeiros e todos os outros profissionais necessários para manter um hospital em pleno funcionamento. Além disso, quantos equipamentos, produtos, remédios, utensílios... uau, não é nada barato manter um hospital e, imaginando que cada paciente é de fato um cliente a manter o local em funcionamento, pois tudo gera custos que precisam ser pagos, uma pessoa que não possui condições de pagar por aquilo é um prejuízo. Claro, você pode olhar para isso e pensar o quanto falta empatia, mas se você entende o mínimo sobre empreendimentos, sabe que uma empresa, para se sustentar, precisa ficar no verde, caso contrário irá à falência e sinto muito em dizer que hospitais falidos não tratam nenhum tipo de paciente. Mas a questão aqui é: um hospital particular deve realmente prestar atendimento a pessoas que não possuem condições financeiras de pagar? Bem, acredito que um hospital é uma empresa como qualquer outra e, se um cidadão não possui condições, é dever do estado suprir essa necessidade, se não com outros hospitais, com o custeio do procedimento. Ou pelo menos assim que deveria ser. Eu sei que em alguns países, se não me engano nos EUA, uma pessoa que, por exemplo, sofre um acidente e vai ser hospitalizada, sai de lá com alguns boletos para pagar quando melhora, independentemente de possuir plano ou não. Não sei dizer se lá o governo ajuda de alguma forma na parte da saúde, mas imagine alguém que não tem condições de pagar, comprometer toda sua renda pagando hospitais. Aqui no Brasil, temos o SUS. É um sistema muito interessante que supre a maior parte da demanda médica nacional. São hospitais, postos de saúde, farmácias populares com remédios gratuitos e muitos procedimentos que seriam exorbitantemente caros, de graça para a população e não somente procedimentos urgentes, mas tratamentos psicológicos, entre muitos outros. É realmente algo sensacional e um problema que de fato é resolvido pelo governo e que ajuda muitas pessoas que não possuem condições de tratamentos médicos. Claro que não é perfeito e possui seus defeitos e necessidades de melhoria, mas posso dizer que qualquer pessoa consegue tratar qualquer doença através da saúde pública aqui e, quando não possui estrutura pública para determinada doença, hospitais particulares são acionados em parceria com o governo. Então, se tratando sobre atender um paciente sem condições financeiras para arcar com os custos, tudo depende do país e de como é a administração pública sobre isso. De forma mais empática, nenhum hospital deveria negar atendimento e preservar a vida deveria ter mais peso do que o dinheiro em si, mas também não podemos esquecer que cada hospital é uma empresa que precisa gerar lucro. Por fim, acho que o dever mesmo é do governo e não dos hospitais. Quem deve disponibilizar condições de atendimento aos mais necessitados é o estado, afinal é para isso que pagamos impostos. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png)

body.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 12-31-2019 - Clip 2 - 10X Speed
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779900889617-79a3242b4be6856f.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/267473c2)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/267473c2)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: Satay Padang Sauce With Rice Cake
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjqqH4wGWzrKY651GWqiotyhw6UGCq2mLh7NvkbJ7z6N/1779900855660.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today is a special day, so I’m making a special traditional dish: Satay Padang Sauce With Rice Cake or *Satay saus Padang dengan lontong*. It’s usually served with chicken or beef skewered on sticks, but this time I’ve added chunks of meat directly into the broth instead of skewering them. Served with lontong made from rice, it’s savory, delicious, and spicy. Alright, let’s get right to it

Ingredients:

- satay spice paste (shallots, garlic, ground chili, turmeric, ginger, galangal)
- 3 cloves
- a pinch of black pepper
- 1 cinnamon stick
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 curry leaf
- 5 cardamom pods
- 3 tbsp rice flour
- 1000 ml water
- 50 grams of small pieces of beef
- cooking oil
- 1 tbsp salt

Steps:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXeLWTPhGANL5nQqXf9WLcJBB46rbPqhNGy2t3uYCiPG/1779900880436.jpg)

- Heat cooking oil in a saucepan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdCCtAizuM31RwLAsUVbu88GSdnofdd4mNm8WDQKd4TgG/1779900894107.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc1g1c8AZaom8yACPAgmBVW8K2L8XnUYjH6S5qGXCJjqA/1779900911434.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRVJim2AL2UFqPPnzQCintUZmSVZNCxWNqaQfqtRhk1fz/1779900911620.jpg)

- Sauté the ground spices, cloves, black pepper, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, curry leaf, and cardamom pods in the pan until cooked and fragrant

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamok4mgGqpQ79uqcF7u1oDz1PutDFCi9SaXPMXJcvLDp/1779900931403.jpg)

- Once cooked, add water to the saucepan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQwL4iiPgEioojd9pFnVyW39PqfdqUmzSdnp4Hp42WsHq/1779901225337.jpg)

- Add the small pieces of beef to the saucepan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcUhf98AH3rUiJxV1n6Pzy1Jdmcc5DNp7BvBCQjLsttfB/1779901240926.jpg)

- Stir all ingredients until well combined 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmajKoZDoHWA4FsVQLooY7sQ9AJJrQeSmCdmeVZCUq8sZg/1779901260974.jpg)

- Cook the broth until the meat is tender 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma2xHJaEEEFKucLaip47eiXPajxJdTLfdkCCmmDNJvivT/1779901274956.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRDcFwvwiC4biMwcVtVQF4b1MSEiQWVZk1CiKaCdLqLUf/1779901275075.jpg)

- Once the meat is tender, add the rice flour slurry

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkWv9GJvCx5UTxmJYTAxBt2MoUcnwBoY9o9CE8qPK4BA/1779901302903.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbW8awFceidwpS7NVPFvJBE8QusruWwSrRaTYnGHLtLPn/1779901303123.jpg)

- Stir continuously until the broth thickens

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCjToSFe3sMJpcAvocnauKGbVxosqvJHWryxBbtxTLf6/1779901337950.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNrS2NcKqFZy4SwQQc1TUVexkrxyiMxnMzsG2PehnYBdv/1779901338107.jpg)

body.title: My afternoon at the last cattle market in Chandipasha School Grounds
body.body: > Eid-ul-Azha means a different kind of joy and busyness all around. The day before Eid is always a little more special. Today, the last Eid cattle market was held at our Chandipasha School Ground. Tomorrow is Eid, so naturally, today was the last day of the market. It is impossible to enjoy the atmosphere of such a festival by sitting at home. So, I could not restrain myself any longer in the afternoon. I went straight to the middle of the market with my friends. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKuazLq1WCryyaBDR5TcwMEv8v9wH98GBQnF4G5qv5nm/image.png) While going to the market in the soft afternoon light, I thought to myself that there would be a huge crowd all around, and I would see cows filling the field. But I was quite surprised when I set foot in the market. This time, the number of cows in the market was much less than in other years. There was not even half of the huge gathering that I had expected throughout the field. Seeing this empty feeling of the market, I talked to the vendors and local people and found out the real reason. In fact, people are very conscious this time. To avoid the last-minute rush of Eid, most buyers have bought their favorite cows in advance. Cow purchases had been completed in every house in the area a few days ago. Due to this, the number of people who came to the last market today to buy new cows was only a handful. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUtCr5qRwX7j5GogVeMYrr2ibvUR1unVwJWEv21Rk2FT7/image.png) Although there were fewer cows in the market, there was no lack of people roaming around, and the festive atmosphere. Many people came just to see the last-minute market prices or to share the joy of Eid with friends. Although the sellers had a slight look of worry on their faces, they were busy with some last-minute sales. All in all, the afternoon was wonderful. The hustle and bustle of the field and the exchange of advanced Eid greetings with acquaintances made this afternoon much more enjoyable for me. Happy Eid to everyone. --- --- --- Location | Nandail, Mymensingh ---|--- Photographer | @haideremtiaz --- --- Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@haideremti/my-afternoon-at-the-last-cattle-market-in-chandipasha-school-grounds-j6f)

body.title: How Low Can Oil Go If the Iran War Ends? The $60 Question Nobody Wants to Answer
body.body:
After three months of energy chaos, peace talks between the United States and Iran are finally gaining traction. Brent crude, which peaked at nearly $120 a barrel in early March, has already slipped back below $100 on signs of a potential deal. But the real question haunting energy markets isn't whether prices will fall — it's how far, and how fast.

**The War Premium Is Enormous**

To understand what peace could mean for oil, consider what war has already done. Prices surged more than 55% since the start of the conflict, with Brent crude jumping from around $72 a barrel in late February to nearly $120 at its peak, as fears mounted over supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz. Attacks on energy infrastructure and shipping disruptions in the strait, which handles about 35% of global seaborne crude oil trade, triggered the largest oil supply shock on record, with an initial reduction in global oil supply of about 10 million barrels per day.

That means there is a massive war premium baked into every barrel — and markets have already started unwinding it. Crude oil prices dropped about $5 per barrel in the first major trading session following the emergence of rough and tentative outlines of a deal to end the U.S.-Iran conflict, with Brent futures trading around $98.76 — a drop of over 4.6% from the prior close.

**The Immediate Drop: $10 to $20**

Analysts are broadly in agreement that a confirmed peace deal and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz would trigger a sharp, immediate selloff. Commodity Context founder Rory Johnston said that any reopening of the strait would likely trigger an immediate drop of between $10 and $20 in crude prices due to speculative positioning. That would push Brent into the low-to-mid $80s from today's levels — significant relief, but not a return to the pre-war world.

**The Floor: $80 to $90, Not $65**

Once the initial shock fades, where does oil settle? Most analysts point to a floor well above pre-war levels. Supply chain bottlenecks, infrastructure damage, and lingering production outages would keep the market tight, likely anchoring Brent in the $80 to $90 range rather than a full return to pre-crisis levels.

That view is echoed by Wall Street. Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer at Bleakley Financial Group, argued that oil prices would not return to $65 per barrel even if the conflict ended immediately. The World Bank forecasts Brent to average $86 a barrel for full-year 2026, assuming the most acute disruptions end in May and that shipping through the Strait of Hormuz gradually returns to pre-war levels by late 2026.

**Why a Full Recovery Could Take Years**

Even the most optimistic scenarios assume a slow normalization. Even if an agreement that opens the Strait is reached, energy markets are expected to remain disrupted for months. Goldman Sachs made a structural argument that even after the Strait reopens, prices are not expected to fall quickly back to pre-war levels — the shock has forced markets to reprice the concentration of oil production in the Persian Gulf, and that risk premium is now baked into long-dated oil forwards, not just near-term contracts.

Bank of America had previously forecast Brent averaging $80 per barrel in the second quarter of 2026, but only returning to $65 in 2027 as the pre-war surplus re-emerges. That timeline assumes infrastructure repairs go smoothly, Iranian production restarts without major hitches, and geopolitical trust is rebuilt — none of which is guaranteed.

**The Market Has Heard This Before**

One important caveat: after repeated false starts over the past three months, the market has begun to largely ignore Trump's peace announcements, instead waiting for tangible signs of an agreement. Traders have been burned before. Every ceasefire rumor has produced a price drop, only for hostilities or complications to push prices back up days later.

Today, signs of an accord sent benchmark oil prices to their lowest levels in more than a month, offering potential relief from sustained high inflation — but the market is pricing in caution, not celebration.

**The Bottom Line**

If a genuine, lasting peace deal is signed and the Strait of Hormuz fully reopens, expect Brent crude to fall sharply — likely toward the $80–$85 range in the near term, with a possible dip into the mid-$70s if the recovery is faster than expected. A return to the $65–$70 range that defined markets before the war looks unlikely for at least another year, and perhaps longer. The war may end. The damage to global energy markets will not heal overnight.

body.title: [ENG-SPN] The Lady of the Castro: A Hidden Trace in the Merindades / La Dama del Castro: Rastro Oculto en las Merindades
body.body:
![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eqb3WELCEh5gqWj95SKVi7UXfZz64EKvJv3mLKNtE3H39baHcx1rw83cHnDK8kabswZ.jpg)

A small village called Momediano, belonging to the municipality of Medina de Pomar and near Villarcayo, is a place whose current census barely fills twenty lines on a page. It not only captures our attention but also invites us to delve into some of the mysteries of a particularly charismatic region of Burgos, known by the curious name of the Merindades.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EogPmkbguYZEYkVgkqCxrQhKtY9AGubq7NTLopG4pyR9bK1kL2xRkAKFbkVmEdPzRgd.jpg)

It is not the village's parish church, dedicated to that Christian Apollo cruelly tied to a tree and pierced with arrows, Saint Sebastian, that particularly draws our attention, but rather a mysterious Romanesque hermitage. Located on the solitary outskirts of the village, it intrigues us with its antiquity, the intriguing nature of its sculptural symbolism, and the clues it offers to a devotion that instantly liberates us from the hypothetical chains that transform objectivity into speculation: Our Lady of the Castro.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoGztTxTSi7GLa5K9CarAnLBKsLzjgv5d7j7wtpNQNcUWiXUXGNJqwxk5kuzUyRskjL.jpg)

According to the hypothetical secret statutes of an equally hypothetical Master named Roncellín, the Templars' \

began and ended precisely with this mysterious figure, to whom numerous cathedrals were dedicated: Our Lady. But beyond the symbolism, which includes, among other interesting archetypes, those heralds of paganism, \

we are encouraged to continue our line of thought, knowing the Templars' interest in establishing themselves near ancient places of worship. And here, there is no doubt that, in times past, there was a strong Celtiberian presence in a completely natural environment, where the priests, the famous Druids, surely gathered the sacred mistletoe with their delicate golden sickles and offered worship to deities who, although forgotten by the rest of the world, still exert a certain influence on the subconscious of the local inhabitants.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoGzMXhVsMdDSqvZtMKWTyUBRnnutYeaMGm51qgLYub2pKeRdzfDVRuXfzfvxFR7SdW.jpg)

Dependiendo del Ayuntamiento de Medina de Pomar y en las proximidades, además, de Villarcayo, un pueblo pequeño, de nombre Momediano, cuyo censo en la actualidad apenas ocuparía veinte renglones en un folio, no sólo llama nuestra atención, sino que también nos invita a inmiscuirnos en parte de los misterios de una región de Burgos especialmente carismática, que responde al curioso nombre de las Merindades.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpXLrmQ9JvGJZihE5Jog3Qrqjxox3VheAW43FPG8CdzRu71CD2DQxH8GcfT4HrTbxMF.jpg)

No es, precisamente, la parroquial del pueblo, dedicado a ese Apolo cristiano cruelmente atado a un árbol y asaetado, San Sebastián, la que nos llama especialmente la atención, sino una misteriosa ermita románica, que, situada en las solitarias lindes del pueblo, nos provoca por su antigüedad, por lo curioso de su simbolismo escultórico y por las pistas de una advocación que libera, instantáneamente, las hipotéticas cadenas que convierten la objetividad en especulación: Nuestra Señora del Castro.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Ep5oEpyzmbhYCn2NK4oNd29kwDxrsCrzE3rKU7JPePvGmoczD8yen6fCJmnc15ctsqc.jpg)

Según los hipotéticos estatutos secretos de un no menos hipotético Maestro, de nombre Roncellín, ‘la verdadera religión’ de los templarios comenzaba y acababa, precisamente, con esta misteriosa figura, a la que se dedicaron numerosas catedrales: Nuestra Señora. Pero además y aparte de una simbología, donde no falta la presencia, entre otros interesantes arquetipos, de esos heraldos del paganismo, ‘los hombres verdes’, nos anima a seguir nuestra línea de pensamiento, sabiendo el interés que los templarios tenían por establecerse en las proximidades de lugares de culto antiguo y aquí, no cabe duda de que, en tiempos, hubo una fuerte presencia celtíbera, en un entorno completamente natural, donde seguramente los sacerdotes, los famosos druidas, recogían el muérdago sagrado con sus delicadas hoces de oro y ofrecían culto a deidades, que, aunque olvidadas por el resto del mundo, todavía ejercen cierta influencia en el inconsciente de los vecinos del lugar.

![BURGOS-ÁLAVA 252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eo6LRBSUrsHDoc66DvLfDb21ocd4ogW1RXyJrcMjhgA18gE5xrxDDdYBARk4tEoUPH2.jpg)

body.title: Why Healthcare Still Feels Unaffordable for Many
body.body:
If you compare the medical facilities nowadays have become much better than before and there has been a lot of improvement and in many places you will find such good hospitals that you cannot even imagine it. If you have money then you can find treatment for almost all types of diseases these days and you can keep yourself healthy but if you do not have money then you sit helplessly and keep bearing whatever problems you have in life. Look, in India you get a lot of treatment even in government hospitals but not every treatment is free and not everyone's financial condition is so good that he can get the treatment done. In many places, free operations are conducted in hospitals but there too, a lot of malpractice takes place and due to lack of transparency, people do not even know which person is getting operated and what is his financial condition.


![hosp.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23vrtbMHZHtDY19wNc6QVXWBzyCv9VbSK7waHhQ9wvWrfm14FDAJHt1WjxNFQr2bbfeTC.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)

See, many times it is seen that the patient loses his life because he does not get treatment on time. Due to not getting treatment, it happens that he is not able to bear the cost of the operation due to which his problems increase.
See, today through this post I would like to make a few points as to why this happens and by which things all these things can be avoided.

### Expensive cost of operations -

The first reason is that some problems or some treatments are very expensive. In India, in many government hospitals, treatment is done for free and some operations are also done at a much lower cost as compared to private hospitals, but there you get to see a lot more crowd, there is crowd in private hospitals also, but see, for those who have money, there is no shortage of any kind. In private hospitals, they get treatment done in the best hospitals and they also get the claim. If any such problem occurs in the house of a middle class person in Alwar, then he has to think from where will he get the money for the treatment.

### Free operation in government hospital - 



![hosp1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23wWtfLcbY1ip7bCtGfMXGpLFWPdo7vjmUQHKmaK3r3dj8tW7qC1RjzBEaoq6KdsQvNBv.png)


[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)

In many government hospitals operations are done for free, where I live, many of your major operations are also done there, but here you can get your treatment done in government hospitals by paying very less fees and the doctors are also very good, but see, there is a limit to everything, in a day a doctor can see or treat only a few fixed patients and if things go beyond that then even he cannot do anything. But if I talk about private hospitals, you get all kinds of facilities there 247. Government hospitals are generally open from 9:00 am to 2-3 pm in the day, after that you have emergency wards available, but in small towns even that is not available to you, if you live in a big metropolis or somewhere else, then you may get the facilities. But in many places there is a shortage of patient beds due to which they are not able to admit so many people there. So in a way, the government free operations are such that whoever comes early will get the opportunity.

### Health insurance-

When it comes to treatment, a lot of money is spent on it and in such a situation, if you do not have money, then you have to face many problems, but nowadays, if you get your health insurance done, then it proves to be of great help to you in such difficult times and whenever you take any health insurance, then you should check thoroughly as to how it can help you and what all things are included in it or are very important, so that you can investigate thoroughly about that insurance. So it seems to me that sometimes in hospitals people are not treated because it is a business model for them. I would not say that everyone does this, but mostly all hospitals have been like this. For them the patient is like a bundle of money, they feel that they will pay them and then go away.



![hosp.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23vrtbMHZHtDY19wNc6QVXWBzyCv9VbSK7waHhQ9wvWrfm14FDAJHt1WjxNFQr2bbfeTC.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)

And I am not just making empty promises, this is the reality and perhaps you too must have seen many such cases where people are looted in hospitals, I will not say that every hospital is like this, there are many doctors who treat people for free and organize free camps and even go to far off areas to treat them. See, whether to treat or not is the hospital's own policy and depends on them and probably no one will do it without money, so in such a situation you should choose a good government hospital which can help you or I would recommend you that you must take health insurance because even if you are not sick today, but tomorrow you never know that something might happen to your family due to which they have to be admitted to the hospital, so such health insurance should be taken.


See, when you do not have money in your pocket, then probably you will not feel any temptation, I do  realize this and money teaches us a lot, if you have money then you can get yourself treated well, so your focus should be on doing such things that you save yourself or at least get your health insurance done so that you do not have to face such problems.

![hive divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tbkwCohekqmu5nehKDpgCMH8M4WVpEmbEhHKB6uZZQNDq6LT9X7yoX7HBbirncwouys.png)

body.title: Superbowl/Championship Rings
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekw8VbmWGQrPwgSvEFJpJjLTyhFudj8mw7pxzg3NkLBu/1779884184727.jpg)


These Green Bay Packers Super Bowl/Championship rings are massive pieces of jewelry that are historical records of the team. 

My son has a collection of these replica custom-built rings and he and his wife took these photos so that I could share them with you. Of course, the diamonds in these rings are not the real thing! These have cubic zurconia and are made of a metal alloy. 

>The NFL provides an official allowance of roughly $5,000 to $7,000 per ring for up to 150 rings per winning franchise.  
​However, because teams want their rings to be as lavish as possible, the actual manufacturing cost easily eclipses that budget. The team owners personally cover the massive remaining balance. Owners also determine who receives a ring; franchises often distribute different \

of rings to everyone from the star quarterback and coaching staff to stadium front-office personnel, scouts, and trainers.  Wikipedia

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNLUASTPJE8A4LRWiKrVcvMYu5Mi27dSbNR1pf1r7giP/1779884184788.jpg)
 This  is a replica of Brett Favre's Super Bowl XXXI Championship Ring, commemorating  the 35-21 victory over the New England Patriots on January 26, 1997.

​It features the Packers \
logo set inside an oval football shape, completely covered in  diamonds, surrounded by the words \

engraved along with his famous number 4,  it is the only Super Bowl ring of his legendary career.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPgFExQXYf3cQpv2eHZfnMJeqkmi33oJjShAxrErt2Fy7/1779884184829.jpg)


The three large diamonds set inside  the  green football shaped background tell the story of ​The Power of Three:  The Packers are the only team in modern pro football history to win three consecutive league titles in a row: the 1965 NFL Championship, followed by Super Bowl I (1966) and Super Bowl II (1967). This was the final game Vince Lombardi ever coached for the Green Bay Packers, capping off his legendary tenure with a decisive 33-14 victory over the Oakland Raiders in Miami.
​


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeyWry2dEXtWo1ZATSzxWfyDwUGDXxszKZU5cTywTptNE/1779884184863.jpg)

Paul Hornung’s 1965 Green Bay Packers NFL Championship ring.
​
​The details show the name HORNUNG, honoring the legendary halfback, kicker, and 1961 NFL MVP. 

>This ring is significant as it was the final NFL Championship game played before the Super Bowl era began the following season. It also marked the first of Green Bay's legendary three-peat championship run (1965, 1966, and 1967) under Vince Lombardi. Gemini Ai


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNja9pPqh4jEAHBS9WnyZBWRuzQRDuhmKXXSMCjuwjXdv/1779884184892.jpg)
 
Super Bowl II (1967 season) ring.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUcVf1y2qjPXVPe4AKtSkUEYZQd2ojRQFrXN1r8zkGjUK/1779885870571.jpg)
This  ring holds a  place in NFL lore because 1961 marked the very first NFL Championship won under legendary head coach Vince Lombardi. The Packers  dominated the New York Giants 37-0 at City Stadium (which we now know as Lambeau Field) on December 31, 1961.
​


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdTzMnrF1Amp7NpFgRnTDz67hvWgnCxbFTfgNedsHoUaN/1779885870605.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPMQHt6gFgNuReSnCUfbnxumpgeXP9Dyv9Mq7vu7Ekv6/1779885870646.jpg)

That is a replica of the Green Bay Packers Super Bowl XLV championship ring,  modeled after the one presented to quarterback Aaron Rodgers following their victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers in February 2011.
​
​The centerpiece is the iconic Packers \

logo, set against a green background and filled  with diamonds.
​The four large, football-shaped stones in the corners represent the four Super Bowl titles won by the franchise (Super Bowls I, II, XXXI, and XLV).
​ WORLD CHAMPIONS, RODGERS, 12  and an engraving of of the Vince Lombardi trophy are featured on the sides. 
​The actual player rings were crafted by Jostens out of 18-karat white gold with over 100 diamonds

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYsUWxUDjYRoKEp4qPCkCbtmGEcdSEUFmK5LeoXaEeX8N/1755185374462.jpg)

Information about the rings in the photos came from Wikipedia and Gemini.

body.title: Sunday dinner 🫠went all out again 😋
body.body:
Good day, everyone. How are you all doing? The past few weeks were hectic. My husband cut himself at work. (Butcher work) So after a serious operation, he's booked off for 6 weeks. He can only use his left hand, which sucks because he's right-handed and one finger is now out of order. Haha. But he's okay, I'm just glad that he didn't lose his finger  though. 

What is nice to eat on a Sunday evening? A nice plate of good cooking food. Well, I decided to make a nice plate of food for my family, like vegetables chicken and baked potatoes, and rice.  Oh boy, my family enjoyed that. 
On Sundays, my family must have a proper plate of cooked food like vegetables and stuff. 

Come and have a look and enjoy it with us and see what I made 😄😉👇

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSW4PKfnDijeCZFezuULNNsT9cH2xYRh6AtPQun9a99ka/1779815400638.png)

I started with the chicken first. I brought pieces of chicken I add it to a microwave bowl added some spices and water, and cooked them in the microwave for about half an hour. When the chicken was cooked I put i aside let it cool down. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6BAdvV1891vR9sUe5EbmF8pCF78vkWFzHUuF2q96qd3/1779816881880.jpg)
So my chicken is done for now and I took the chicken stock and added 1 cup of rice and let the rice cook in the chicken stock until it was cooked. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxsWi9g73frTjciLn2GcrWh5Z6LbC9CSTM4QdyvMChUs/1779828878364.jpg)
I made 2 kinds of vegetables nice and sweet pumpkin and cabbage.  I started with the pumpkin I added the pumpkin to a pot added some sugar and butter and a pinch of salt, and let it cook on a low temperature. I don't cook it in water. When the pumpkins are soft I mash them with a fork. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmauoFxeZ77dAFouKZkfHSrZMEv7sPTYrm2saCXWQ28GND/1779864359256.jpg)

While the pumpkin was on a low temperature cooking I started with the cabbage. I chopped up all the ingredients, 1 onion and 1 potato, and half of a green pepper. Add everything to a pot let it cook until it is softened.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPtG9GsNdzXq3JhHMd5ioTWsF8d9f6YUtkaBcisLRnfXN/1779872311564.jpg)

I decided to make a nice white sauce for the cabbage. I also made it in the microwave it was the first time. It came out perfectly. I took some butter first. Let the butter melt. Then I took a 3/4 cup of flour and some milk and put it with the butter and mixed it together and put it in the microwave and stirred it often until it was thickened.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGdJYVX6zqD5Vnvdv43JWXyPczChEwiuneWFK9ttVfrX/1779897559758.jpg)
With the cabbage, I mashed it and then I added the white sauce to the cabbage and stirred it nicely through and it's done.  
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMha1acQz85oGcrNBytaqamPVL66avzCVjZWsPwpgSpe/1779897633822.jpg)
Now my favorite part of the plate is the chicken 😉🤣The chicken was cooled down so I took a bowl added some flour and spices to the bowl. In the other bowl, I added some milk.  Then I dipped the chicken first in the milk and then in the flour.  I did it twice. Then I deep-fried it in oil. There is my KFC chicken 🤣
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcSgdZggpRDJAyDK9wGWPvK5bbNF7CKfqdbEV1h7DcrLp/1779897851002.jpg)
I did the same thing with the potatoes. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxcpCd6FL2zwyA6JPF1Dv8nkeS8pFrZQWd9kToVbk9Hx/1779900191926.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfbW6bQQcEuAJF3mYG42FLio87RyPsC1MunpSJCWSUT8/1779900440294.jpg)

There it is my Sunday dinner for my family 😉😃
Hope that everyone is enjoying this and make you guys hungry.  Hahahaha. Be safe and be blessed.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQuS2NwY5QjiUaQpEwdKGe3CQVtCsAUEyfoMecHXmNjbp/1779900639500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMJYkf71bBcLPPuQoPf6qBiKf79iTvc1QobsgkyngzYF/1779900639550.png)

body.title: Hive Price is on Mini Support Line Below 100-Day Moving Average
body.body:
There is mini support line on Hive price chart as past. It is supporting Hive price during Bitcoin price correction. Hive price is trying to enter bullish pattern but it is still below 100-day moving average.

Here you can see daily chart of Hive price. We have seen same mini support lines on Hive price chart. If we dont see breaking down this mini support line, Hive price may enter bullish trend. Hive price tested to break up 100-day moving average lots of times. Even it broke up this average a few days ago, It can not stay above this average. If we see the new breaking up this average, we may see staying above this average. If Hive price stays above this average, it may go up slowly.


![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swgK1JW2DToMfmySVpnEpcow8bJsLsGK4fkH9W69fbZk1ecTWhASv4zeSBY2Hg5v943.PNG)

Here you can see the indicators on daily chart of Hive price. There were mini uptrend lines on MACD Indicator and they are broken down. Ypu can see what happened after breaking down before. We have not seen any bearish trend on Hive price chart after breaking down this indicator. 

Fisher Indicator is at the middle level and it reversed down. Hive price should stay solid not to break down mini uptrend line. 

There was great downtrend line on Hive price chart and It is broken up. Even great resistance broken up, Hive price could not stay above 100-day moving average. We need to see the new bullish pattern on RSI Indicator. 

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swiP6HcZowQUD1ABWkjGd5nWYe3iNwAZiEPsibN5EHDFZ5CwXGfepm7idHhesuxKMXA.PNG)

body.title: Tech Still Rules: NASDAQ 100 Climbs Above 30,000
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGMYCpPCz1b5jDDZQ2RzSdDNUE9CaQH7mUhmbGkMMCFh/img_1132.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcR5TKmTXjMAxauswiQq1trugrPb5TsRrf396GqbE62Gt/img_4678.png)

**Historic Milestone**

Record for the NASDAQ 100 Index! We crossed 30,000 points intraday for the first time ever, climbing as high as 30,099 points. What a rally. The index is up +19% YTD and +40% over the past 12 months alone. Tech continues to dominate the stock market, and that trend has been in place for many years now. Everyone invested: congratulations!

Although the chart looks like a massive spike upward on a multi-year scale, it’s important to acknowledge that this doubling actually took longer than the previous one. The $NDX first closed above 7,500 points on May 3, 2018, and above 15,000 points on July 23, 2021. So it took a little more than three years to double from 7,500 to 15,000 points. This time, it took almost five years to double again from 15,000 to 30,000.

**My guess is that it will take another 8–10 years to double from here to 60,000 points. What do you think?**

body.title: The Hidden Vulnerability in USA's Oil Boom
body.body:
![documerica-x-EG-R-bUTI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/245nA3ENJikFEQbLCLbJkdw5CJMhFb1qtfvqeEvw7sMbUFtXLfEjTwfHV8kF3omVESNJt.jpg)



Even though the United States has become the world’s largest oil producer thanks to the fracking revolution, it still depends heavily on imported crude. 

## The Paradox of Plenty

The United States is pumping more oil than ever – about 13 million barrels per day.  The U.S. fracking boom has turned America into the world’s top oil producer. By fracturing underground rock with high‑pressure water, producers have unlocked vast amounts of light, sweet crude oil – especially from the Permian Basin in West Texas. 

Yet the country finds itself drawn back to Venezuela, a nation whose oil industry has collapsed under sanctions and mismanagement. Why? The answer lies in the chemistry of crude and the design of U.S. infrastructure. 

## Light vs. Heavy: A Refinery Mismatch

Modern fracking produces light, low‑sulfur oil. But many of America’s refineries – especially the large, complex facilities in Texas and Louisiana – were built to handle heavy, sulfur‑rich crude. Venezuelan oil fits that profile perfectly. In other words, the U.S. is a superpower in light oil production but remains a net importer of the heavy oil its own refineries need to run efficiently. Building new refineries take time and probably there is economically non-attractive. 

This mismatch is why, despite record production, the U.S. has continued to import oil. And this is a geopolitical vulnerability that they try to fix.  

## Thin Margins, Big Risks

Fracking has always been a high‑cost, high‑reward business. With oil at $55 a barrel and break‑even prices for new wells ranging from $65 to $95, many U.S. producers declare bankruptcy in the past. Fraking need high prices. 

## The Geopolitical Play

The capture of Nicolás Maduro and the installation of a U.S‑friendly government in Caracas is not just about democracy or drug trafficking – it is about energy too. By this Washington hopes to secure a reliable, inexpensive source of heavy crude for its own refineries while also using that oil as a geopolitical weapon against other nations. However, major oil companies are reluctant to invest the estimated $100 billion needed to revive Venezuela’s industry without ironclad legal protections. Mainly because they lose that investments in the past with the expropiations without compensation made in the earlier 2000s by Hugo Chávez, the decease leader of Chavism Regime. 

## What This Means for the Future

Fracking consumes vast amounts of water, can contaminate groundwater, and releases methane – a potent greenhouse gas. In fact, every barrel of oil has a hidden ecological price tag. Renewable Energy is a solution, but Trump walk away that path. 

In simple terms, the United States has achieved energy independence in volume, but not in type. As long as American refineries depend on heavy crude, the U.S. will remain tied to foreign suppliers – whether Canada, Mexico, or Venezuela. The fracking revolution has brought enormous benefits, but it is not a complete solution. Addressing this structural vulnerability will require either reconfiguring refineries to run on lighter oil, finding new ways to upgrade heavy crude domestically, or developing non‑oil alternatives for transportation and industry.

I hope this post work as a stark reminder that energy independence is never as simple as it seems.

***
*Imagen tomada de (Unsplash)[https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/un-grupo-de-bombas-de-aceite-sentadas-en-la-parte-superior-de-un-campo-x-EG-R-bUTI].*
