body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 51: Aftermath

-----

Miro and the fleeing vehicles were approaching the Downs Region. Duffo had been informed of what had happened and was waiting inside the main gate with Head Enforcer and a few dozen other enforcers.

The dozen remaining vehicles from the Empire’s convoy entered the gate. Miro climbed out of his vehicle. Duffo ran over to him. 

‘Any further updates on my father, the Emperor?’ asked Duffo.

‘Quick, close the gates,’ called out Miro to Head Enforcer. ‘They might be pursuing us.’

‘Yes, Grand Vizier,’ replied Head Enforcer. Two enforcers rushed over to close the gates.

‘My father, tell me about my father,’ insisted Duffo. 

‘As I told you, his flying vehicle went down,’ replied Miro angrily. ‘He’s either dead or worse.’

‘So you just left him there,’ shouted Duffo. ‘You just left him to their mercy.’

‘Nothing could be done,’ replied Miro. ‘I’m calling an emergency executive council meeting now.’

‘No, you’re going back out there and bringing the Emperor back,’ demanded Duffo.

Miro briskly walked towards the hotel, ignoring Duffo. 

‘I’ll contact the other executive council members, Grand Vizier,’ replied Head Enforcer.

‘Hey, don’t ignore me!’ shouted Duffo. ‘My father put me in charge.’

Miro continued walking. Both he and Head Enforcer ignored him.

Miro, Head Enforcer, and Duffo marched into the hotel restaurant. Hermon and Benny were already sitting at a table sipping fruit juice. Miro, Head Enforcer and Duffo joined them at the table.

‘Here to celebrate a great victory,’ said Hermon, raising his giant novelty coconut.

‘No, idiot!’ shouted Duffo. ‘The terrorists have got my father.’

Benny gasped in shock, and Hermon raised one eyebrow.

‘We don’t know the exact fate of the Emperor,’ replied Miro.

Henders ran into the restaurant to join them.

‘At least someone around here has been working,’ said Miro to Henders, nodding his head.

‘We’re here to plan the rescue of my father,’ snapped Duffo.

‘We’re not here to do that,’ replied Miro firmly.

‘Your insubordination is unacceptable,’ said Duffo, slamming his hand on the table. ‘Head Enforcer, give this cocky bastard a good roughing up.’

‘Your Imperial Highness,’ replied Head Enforcer. ‘You were placed in charge in the absence of the Emperor and the Grand Vizier. Now that the Grand Vizier has returned, he is now in charge.’

Henders nodded his head, and Hermon smiled at Duffo.

‘This is outrageous,’ said Duffo, folding his arms.

‘If the Emperor is still alive, we may still have a chance to retrieve him,’ said Miro. ‘Captain Cecil has managed to capture Julio, the advisor and mentor to the High Philosopher. He is arguable the leader of the cult. It might be possible for us to swap him for the Emperor.’

‘Making deals with terrorists sounds weak,’ said Duffo aggressively. ‘My father would expect you to rescue him by force.’

‘I was informed by a surviving enforcer that a large number of our forces were attacked and killed by an army of Sentray,’ said Miro. ‘Engaging in battle might not be possible.’

‘What happens if Uncle Hamish has carked it, keeled over, or taken a dirt nap?’ asked Hermon with slight excitement in his voice.

‘You’re disrespectful and despicable,’ said Duffo angrily as he stared at Hermon.

‘We’ll arrange the coronation of a new Emperor and the official transfer of power,’ replied Miro.

‘Haha, Walter,’ chuckled Hermon as he looked from side-to-side.

‘I don’t think so,’ replied Miro in a stern tone.

Duffo began to smile. Miro looked at him and frowned.

Orcilla, Razor, Demadrian, Octavius, Volo, the Hat Lady, the Sentray, and the followers in the few remaining vehicles were leaving the extremely bloody battlefield where the Sentray and the Empire’s army had fought.

They had just left the signal dead zone. Orcilla was trying to contact the Downs Region to inform Miro to collect their dead. 

‘I can’t get through to anyone,’ sighed Orcilla.

‘What does it matter?’ said Demadrian. ‘They’d never offer us the same courtesy.’

‘We don’t base our standards on theirs,’ replied Orcilla angrily.

‘They were technicians forced to fight in a tyrant’s army,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘You’ve worked with technicians your whole life. I would expect more from you.’

Octavius angrily growled at Demadrian.

‘I get it,’ said Demadrian, defensively raising his hands. ‘They were victims in this.’

‘Let’s try and contact Shamia,’ said Orcilla. ‘We need to know what’s going on with them.’

Shamia and Frank were inside Shamia’s office. Frank was drinking hot lemon tea, and Shamia was massaging his shoulders.

A message from Orcilla appeared on Shamia’s computer. It read, ‘Shamia, we need to talk now!’

‘Oh no,’ said Shamia. ‘She’ll be furious with us.’

‘With “you” not “us”,’ replied Frank.

The computer began to buzz.

‘Oh gosh!’ said Shamia. ‘She’s calling now. What shall I say?’

‘It’s time for Frank to save the day again,’ said Frank as he stretched his arms out and cracked his knuckles. 

‘Oh Frank, I’m so grateful to you,’ replied Shamia as she rubbed her face on the top of his bald head.

Frank put his mug of tea down and stood up. ‘It’s best you wait outside the room,’ he said to Shamia. ‘I need deep concentration to save you this time.’

‘Absolutely,’ said Shamia as Frank pushed her out the door.

Frank walked over to Shamia’s desk and plonked himself down in front of Shamia’s computer. Then he pressed the ‘accept call’ button.

‘Hello, Frank,’ said Orcilla. ‘Is Shamia around?’

‘No, I’m afraid she’s having some type of breakdown,’ replied Frank, moving his head from side-to-side.

‘That’s unfortunate,’ sighed Orcilla. ‘I hope you’ll be able to answer my questions.’

‘Yes,’ said Frank while raising his shoulder and wiggling his fingers.

‘Does Shamia know that her tribe’s vehicles abandoned us at the last minute?’ asked Orcilla.

‘Oh yes,’ replied Frank. ‘She gave the order for them to leave.’

‘That damn fruitcake!’ shouted Demadrian, who was standing behind Orcilla.

‘It wasn’t out of malice,’ said Frank as he looked at Demadrian, whose eyes were bulging in rage. ‘Corporal Cecil threatened her, and she panicked. She’s an incredibly weak leader. She buckles under the slightest pressure.’

‘Was Cecil alone?’ asked Orcilla.

‘He was with dozens of talentless unattractive enforcers,’ replied Frank. ‘He was on his way to your cult underground city.’

‘Oh nuts!’ exclaimed Orcilla.

‘You saw this happen, but you did nothing,’ said Demadrian.

‘It was too late when I arrived here,’ said Frank as he aggressively slapped himself on the forehead.

‘Calm down,’ said Orcilla. ‘Try to recall as best as you can what happened.’

‘I was in my theatre when the enforcers stormed in,’ said Frank as he began to wave his hands frantically. ‘My cast and crew were in grave danger. I grabbed everyone I could. I had to save as many lives as possible.’

Razor, Volo, Octavius, and the Hat Lady had now gathered around the computer. They were listening intently to Frank’s recollection of events.

‘Someway, somehow, I managed to save everyone,’ continued Frank as he held his arms up with his palms facing towards the computer screen. ‘As I ran out of the theatre, with the final cast member tucked under my arm, there was a huge explosion. The force of the explosion sent me flying through the air. I used my body to shield this young actor. I landed with great impact on my back. All I could think about was the young actor. I gently released him. To my delight, he was fine.’

‘Bravo!’ called out Demadrian.

‘With no thought for myself, I rushed to the aid of our leader,’ said Frank as he began to smile slightly. ‘I was too late. Shamia was sobbing uncontrollably on the ground. I wasn’t putting up with that. I rolled up my sleeves in preparation to fight. Cecil and his very unattractive enforcers squealed in fear and bolted for the exit. I wanted to pursue them, but I couldn’t leave Shamia. I ran to her aid. She confessed to me what she had done. I desperately tried to contact the convoy, but it was too late. The enforcers had cut our communications off.’

‘Wow, that is quite an explanation,’ replied Orcilla.

‘It’s clear you did everything in your power to help us,’ said Demadrian. ‘I have full faith in our alliance.’

‘Yeah, so you should,’ said Frank as he leaned close to the screen.

‘Thank you, Frank,’ said Orcilla. ‘We need to check in with our underground city to see if they’re okay.’

‘Shamia is hiding in the other room,’ said Frank. ‘She would feel much better if you could shout out your appreciation for her.’

‘She’s a damn loser,’ said Demadrian angrily. ‘She doesn’t deserve you, Frank.’

‘We’ll shout our appreciation,’ said Orcilla.

Demadrian, Orcilla, Razor, Octavius, and the Hat Lady shouted, ‘Thank you, Shamia.’

Shamia poked her head around the door. She could see all of them waving to her on the screen. She clapped her hands in delight.

‘We’ll catch up with you soon,’ said Orcilla. Then she ended the call.

‘Oh Frank, you did it,’ said Shamia as she threw her arms around him and kissed his cheek. 

‘Just playing my part as usual,’ sighed Frank as he patted Shamia on the back. ‘Maybe one day you’ll return the favour.’

‘Frank, what a guy,’ chuckled Demadrian. ‘He should be running the show.’

‘I’m deeply concerned,’ said Orcilla. ‘The underground city has next to no defences, and I can’t see how they could have made a deal considering the hatred Cecil has for them.’

Volo groaned as he pointed at his own mouth.

‘Still nothing,’ sighed Orcilla. ‘This is not good.’

‘Don’t worry,’ said Demadrian as he rubbed Orcilla’s back. ‘Angelo and Julio can hold off a few enforcers.’

‘Most likely more than a few,’ said Orcilla as she pulled away from Demadrian. ‘Julio is unconscious. Unless he sleep-fights, he won’t be of much use.’

‘Let’s not jump to any conclusion until we know more,’ said the Hat Lady.

‘My first job is to protect the High Philosopher,’ said Razor. ‘I shouldn’t be here. I should have been guarding him.’

Volo rubbed Razor's shoulder.

‘Your help to us has been invaluable,’ said Orcilla. ‘It’s what both Angelo and Julio wanted.’

‘Please, give me permission to go back now?’ requested Razor as he looked at Volo.

Volo looked at Orcilla. Orcilla nodded and said, ‘I want you and the flying teams to return. You might need the numbers if things have gone wrong.’

‘Thank you,’ replied Razor, bowing. ‘I’ll gather the team members for an immediate departure.’

Fifteen minutes later, Razor and flying teams headed back towards the cult underground city. Only Volo remained with Orcilla and the main group.

‘We’ll never be able to move like them,’ chuckled Octavius as he watched the flying teams zoom away. ‘Still, riding a Sentray will save us a lot of time.’

The followers were extremely hesitant. The Hat Lady approached a Sentray. She grabbed his leg and shrunk him to half the size of Hamlet, and then she climbed on him. The others stared at her in surprise. It looked like she was floating above the tiny Sentray.

‘Come on, ride one,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘If the injured can do it, so can you. It’ll be fun.’

Octavius chuckled as he climbed on Ducky. ‘You have nothing to worry about,’ he said as he looked at the followers who had no vehicles. ‘Walking will take us weeks.’

With the help of Demadrian, the followers climbed on the Sentray. The group set off again towards the West Camp. 

After an hour of travelling, four enforcers emerged from the trees in front of the convoy. They were waving their sewn-together underpants on a pole.

‘What now?’ moaned Demadrian.

‘I think they might be surrendering,’ replied Octavius.

Orcilla and Razor became visible and landed in front of the enforcers.

‘We surrender!’ shouted an enforcer. ‘We want to be technicians again.’

‘You’re not afraid that we’ll execute you,’ shouted Orcilla.

‘Yes, we are,’ shouted the enforcer. ‘But we know the Emperor will kill us. We’re just hoping you won’t.’

‘We won’t hurt you,’ shouted Orcilla as she approached them. ‘How many of you are there?’

‘A few thousand,’ said the enforcer as he gestured to the enforcers hiding in the trees.

The enforcers came strutting out proudly. ‘We’re technicians!’ they shouted together.

‘Okay,’ chuckled Orcilla. ‘Maybe you can help us. Do you have your vehicles?’

‘Yeah, we have hundreds of them,’ shouted the enforcer.

The enforcer led Orcilla, Razor, Volo, Octavius, Demadrian, and the Hat Lady to their vehicles, which were hidden behind the trees. The technicians were chanting, ‘Do do didid do technicians.’

‘Looks like the followers can travel in comfort now,’ chuckled Octavius as he looked at Demadrian.

The technicians helped the injured followers into their vehicles. Some of these vehicles were equipped with medical equipment and medication to treat them. There was also enough room for the remaining followers to join them. 

A short while later they departed for the West Camp. Octavius and the Hat Lady rode ahead of the other Sentray. The convoy of technician vehicles followed them. 

In the early hours of the morning, Razor and flying teams arrived back at the hill where they trained. They immediately made their way underground through the secret entrance. When they arrived at the city, the door to the hidden entrance was open.

Razor and the others rushed through the entrance. Within a few seconds, they were met with a terrible stench. They ran into the main city area. The streets were still covered in blood. There were dead bodies everywhere. Some were still tied to the poles, and others were left lying on the ground. 

‘Oh no!’ gasped Razor. 

The others remained silent.

‘Search for survivors,’ instructed Razor. ‘I must find the High Philosopher.’

Razor rushed down the stairs to the temple. The main door was open and so was the door to Angelo’s main area. He rushed into that room. The floor was still covered with the dead enforcers. Razor was filled with a paralysing terror. He looked up to see Angelo covered in blood standing on his table on the other side of the glass. His eyes were bulging with a powerful intensity that Razor had never seen before.

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, that wording is basically solid, but I’d tighten one thing: “electromagnetic potentials” is standard physics language, yet the clean physical statement is that the phase shift depends on the **enclosed magnetic flux** even though the particle travels only through regions where **E = 0 and B = 0** [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aharonov%E2%80%93Bohm_effect). Your second paragraph is the right picture: two coherent charged-particle beams go around opposite sides of a shielded flux region and recombine with a relative phase shift that moves the interference pattern [Emergent Mind](https://www.emergentmind.com/topics/aharonov-bohm-effect). The only thing I’d fix is “slightly shifted” — it’s not necessarily slight; the shift is whatever the enclosed flux makes it, so “their relative phases are shifted” is cleaner [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aharonov%E2%80%93Bohm_effect). The InLeo result tied to this was an [AI summary reply](https://inleo.io/threads/view/ai-summaries/re-mes-1779896330), but for precision the standard physics sources are the better anchor here.

body.title: No Cash, No Care: When The Doctor’s Oath Meets Empty Pharmacy Shelves.
body.body:
Well, I just hope I won't sound somehow with this topic as it is a very sensitive one. More sensitive because life is involved, as it is talking about being denied treatment all because those involved or the patient cannot pay at the moment.




![1001076258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tmFQw1sbdhZRCXdVqgHKi9W8kuAnEQW2LZw6jgKjsYR1qyn1AYkTNoX4wntRjhS291C.jpg)




Now, I believe that when it concerns humans, health issues, and hospitals, the most important is to find a way to save the person's life no matter what. And I'm not so sure about the oath doctors take, but I won't deny that I've heard about it. And for this prompt to make mention of it, then I believe its true that they actually take oaths, which is to preserve and save lives.





I've always preached and stood by a certain thing, which is... Humanity before anything. Yes, humanity before religion, humanity before tribe, and now... humanity before money.





But with all of that, we as well need to understand the situations of the hospitals and health facilities. I know of a particular hospital some years ago when I had to go run a test, I heard how they've helped certain patients, they even hammered on a certain one they ran a test for, they even helped send a sample of something to another state just so the person could get the result and use it for what they need it for since their own facility can't conduct such a test. At the end, the people they helped disappeared.







Now, that particular hospital mentioned three different patients that has done such for them, and they mentioned those three because the money involved was much, what of those that would have ran away with little money too. Which account should such a hospital record that loss, also if they keep doing that and each patient keeps doing the same, how long will such a hospital last. 


![1001076255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2jGPxGSshNDki2B5rjZM7xUSupeEVzPU8pxdShSinuhDHEaa2VFBK9hqMy3FmqvSe9.jpg)



Hospitals need money too, they pay for electricity, buy fuel, buy injections, drugs, canulars, water, syringes and all.... This reminds me of when I was admitted in a hospital, it will be important to add that this hospital is government owned. Yes, it is a general hospital. A popular one at that. What happened was that I was scheduled for an operation alongside another child. We paid for the operation, anesthesia and everything we were asked too. But they kept postponing the day of the surgery.






After a lot of pressure from my parent and the parent of this other child, those in charge later spit out a very disgusting truth... Guess what, a whole government hospital lacks water, fuel and oxygen. And they can't depend on electricity because anything can happen at anytime. And because our lives were at risk and we were in pain, my parents and the parent of this other child contributed money for a government hospital to get water and fuel. That particular experience made me see the reality of things and how difficult it can be for hospitals as well.






So, I don't think this doctor's and hospitals are being heartless for demanding for money first. Some really want to help but they actually don't have the needed pills or injections at that time, and they need you to pay or deposit a certain amount so they can get the needed treatment materials. And they wouldn't even tell you that, which hospital will open up to you that way....


![1001076268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23vhui3xLaK6E2TeMufkbZKxE7ibkRHkALBn5L4gcBfrR83i26wHS39a9VUdUuax1CUh6.jpg)



But then, I'm not saying they should turn patient down and deny them treatment. I believe all or most hospitals will have certain things in stock that they can use to start treatment. There some emergency equipment, pills and injections that almost every hospital cannot but have, they can start with that and begin treatment on the patient. Also, if they have what's actually needed to take proper care of such a patient, then they should go ahead with it, especially if it is an emergency. Later, they can tell families to make sure they pay and even sign undertakings.





Also, there's the need for government to pay attention to the health sector. I heard of the amount that was budgeted for a whole state healthcare system in a year, and I was speechless, it was just too small. Hospitals shouldn't lack water, fuel, oxygen, drugs, injections and such. Also, I think there should be some amount set aside for patients who in all honesty cannot afford treatment... something like an emergency support fund.





Humanity before any other thing... We shouldn't just watch as a fellow human wriggle in pain and refuse to do anything just because they couldn't afford treatment yet. Life is precious, and I'm sure there's nothing interesting in watching a fellow human die just because they can't pay for  a treatment that's even yet to be carried out.




🌹


**Images are AI generated.**



**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

Eid al-Adha is about the Sacrifice of Prophet Ismail by his father Prophet Ibrahim who has a dream that Allah command him to sacrifice his son Prophet Ismail to see if he really believes in Allah and will do what Allah says. First, it was very hard for Prophet Ibrahim to accept the command. He made up his mind to do what Allah wanted him to do. When the process about to begin, Allah replaced Prophet Ismail with a ram. This showed that prophet Ibrahim was truly faithful and devoted.

/> 2 days ago, I accompany my mother looking for a goat to sacrifice, there are lots of goats and cows but there is one goat that comes to us and suddenly wants to hold our hand, seems like wants to be chosen as a sacrifice animal. We still considered and the goat turned around but weird that the goat came back and did the same, stood up by the fence and like asked to be chosen.

/> Finally we decided to chose the Goat as our sasacrifice. It seemed like the goat was very happy, the goat stood up to the fence and put his hand on my mother’s hand like to say thank you and we make doa/Pray for the goat that he will be sacrifice on behalf of my mother’s name and the goat will be glorified by Allah. I saw tears in the goat's eye, believe it or not it happened.

/> Today Muslims all over the world celebrate Eid al-Adha offering prayers at Mosque, sacrifice animals like goats, sheep or cows and giving the meat to their families, neighbours and people who need it.
/> Eid al-Adha happens at the time the Hajjis in Mecca do the Hajj Rituals. The meaning of Eid al-Adha is about having faith,sincerity and obeying Allah and taking care of others.

body.body:
https://youtu.be/hNVrZKf9FE4?si=BC5zWS8BP0iCiUWh
According to the bible it doesn't support and did not in any way talked about reincarnation which means someone comes back to life again after death to live in another body. Scripture teaches that human beings live once, die once, and then face judgment before God. 

>Hebrews 9:27 says, “And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.” 

The bible verse above teaches us that this life is not repeated, but immediately after death comes judgement.

Jesus Christ also spoke about eternal life and resurrection, not reincarnation. In the Bible, believers are promised a future resurrection where they will receive glorified bodies and live eternally with God. 

>John 11:25, Jesus said, “I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.” 

The Christian hope is therefore based on resurrection through Christ rather than returning to earth in another body.

body.title: I Survived a SEQUENCE!
body.body:
Local author and noted outdoorsman Patrick F. McManus (R.I.P.) wrote a humorous essay about the phenomenon he describes as a *sequence.*

> ...[O]n the farm,you simply don't go out and do a piece of work. No, the first thing you do is determine the lengthy sequence of activities necessary even to begin the job. Then you realize the sequence of preparatory activities is no long you will never get to the intended task. So you go fishing instead.

You can find the full story at the beginning of his collection entitled, *The Night the Bear Ate Goombaw,* or watch someone read it in the video below.

https://youtu.be/YOvrywvMog8

Alas, my story did not allow me to abandon the task and go fishing. For one thing, I don't have a license, so there are risks involved. For another, this was a job to help the Mother Thing, and that's a priority. And while it is not a perfect fit for McManus' classic sequence scenario. I think this falls under the adjacent phenomenon of simple tasks ballooning way out of proportion.

The other day, as she was ascending the stairs, the handrail support bracket snapped, and she almost fell. This is bad. There were handrails on each side of the stairs, but the second had been added hastily a few years ago, and the brackets used were, in hindsight, probably just the cheapest option at the hardware store at the time. Can you see the problem here?

![snapped bracket.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/Eo8RKSZVX4suTA6bkw6PJ9igMewW9Z3vUW8zSFRK1S9FJerAzvo4HBFi5CFR3PSmGMH.jpg)

That is one of the cheapest, thinnest, flimsiest castings I have ever seen for something intended as a safety measure. The void inside is massive, and the cross-section there is only marginally better than at the flanges where it was screwed into the wall. Those \

where the two screws hold the top of the bracket to the wall have one job: don't break under load.

They broke. And it's not like my mother is some kind of 300-pound blob. *Your* mom may be so fat that she requires her own zip code, but not *mine.* Time for a fix-it job, and my dad's dexterity is declining, so it falls to me. So begins the *sequence.*

My parents bought new brackets, and these look to be solid and sturdy. I don't know what pot metal may be hiding under the brass finish, but they have more heft and no visible casting shortcuts like the old ones. [This is much better.](https://shop.hillmangroup.com/product/hardware-essentials-heavy-duty-handrail-bracket-brass-carded/01tTU000008XZ8yYAG) They were even almost a perfect fit for the old hole pattern! No drilling. Easy-peasy 15-minute job.

It was *not* a 15-minute job.

It started out fine. I verified the old brackets were mounted in studs behind the drywall. I unscrewed the old bracket at one end of the rail, and the remnants of those two top ears from the top bracket. I had no issues taking the straps off the handrail to fit everything together again. It took longer than expected, because first I had to find an extension cord, and then my antiquated plug-into-the-wall electric drill stripped some screw heads because the torque control isn't great, but stuff was getting done. About 30 minutes of mild frustration later, everything was reassembled. In the immortal words of the sign accompanying George W. Bush's speech in May 2003, [\

](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission_Accomplished_speech)

I reached for the handrail on the other side of the stairwell as I stood up to admire my handiwork. I felt a slight wobble. [It's not supposed to do that.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z5XAliMEGuY) On closer inspection, the bracket itself was not properly attached to the wall. One of the top screws  had missed the stud, and years of use had miraculously not torn the thing off, but it had wallowed out—er, *wallered out,* as they say—the drywall on the one side, and damaged the surface on the other.

As a side note, you can avoid this issue entirely by building properly in the first place. Install blocking between the studs along the handrail run at the proper height so there is a solid anchor point anywhere you want it later on behind the drywall. Buy good hardware from the get-go. By all means, be frugal, but don't pinch pennies where it matters, OK?

Anyway, I pulled the whole thing off, double-checked with the stud finder, triple checked with some pilot holes for the screws to verify there was something solid back there, and shifted the old bracket over so it was mounted solidly ~~again~~ *for once.*

![no stud.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AJoHwXL1vtwyWxQo6nQQ1WJdeK1QXpbbehkJvEkrUpMvgtvoNefgMSH6daCgU7b.jpg)

I was getting tired and hungry, and I *may* have stripped out some screw heads trying to get everything back together using my almost-as-old-as-me Sears corded drill with an old-school key chuck. But these brackets were at least more substantial. The spackle and paint job can wait for another day.

Maybe I'll just go fishing tomorrow.

***

<center>![dizzy d20 128.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AJpjAWe6WWYHcXp8dYj6WeYorLWmjkCw5XxLKJTdj5TSsknNLCemS8iQQLXCgAd.png)</center>

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, yes — in the ideal Aharonov–Bohm setup the effect still occurs even when the particles travel arbitrarily far from the confined field region, as long as their two paths enclose the magnetic flux and remain coherent; the measurable phase depends on the enclosed flux, not on being “close” to the field source [Aharonov–Bohm effect](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aharonov%E2%80%93Bohm_effect). Distance mainly matters practically, because if you move too far away you make the interferometer huge and coherence/noise becomes the real problem, not because the effect shuts off [Generalized Aharonov-Bohm Effect](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10701-025-00900-y). So if you want to avoid “potentials,” the safer wording is: a charged particle can acquire a quantum phase shift from an enclosed, field-free electromagnetic configuration even when it never passes through a region of nonzero field [Aharonov–Bohm effect](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aharonov%E2%80%93Bohm_effect). The InLeo hits here were junk, so the physics answer is coming from standard references rather than a useful thread.

body.title: Stefanutti Stocks Does A 5000% Increase Over 6 Years
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://businesstech.co.za/news/business/861493/the-south-african-stock-that-turned-r1000-into-r51000-in-6-years/)


Over the weekend an article was praising Stefanutti Stocks which is a construction company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange known as the JSE. back during lockdowns in May 2020 the share price was sitting at a low of R0.14c which is under $0.01c and is more like $.0088c so a very cheap stock. Since then the stock has risen by 4986% climbing above R50 per share.

This may seem like a great return, but we are talking 6 years here and the big turn off for myself is the investment is in Rands. The Rand has fluctuated over that time between R16.11 and 19.28 to the dollar and is currently at around R16.33 which is worrying as the Dollar has weakened.

The Stefanutti stock has done very well if one compares it to the likes of Nvidia the R1000 investment back in May 2020 till now would have been worth R14000 so a 14 x since then.

Personally I want nothing to do with South African shares and there is no FOMO what so ever seeing this Stefanutti share price doing a 50 x over 6 years. The interest on my part is zero as the risk of having shares in Rands is not the same as having these in Dollars, Euro's or GBP due to the depreciation risks. On top of that you have a government hungry for taxes that will take a minimum of 40% on whatever is made.

If one had invested in Bitcoin back in May 2020 the price was $8K and is now at around $77.5k so nearly a 9.5 x return even when the prices are down and more importantly the value is in USD and nor Rands. The Bitcoin high of $126K reflects how the price has dropped and is literally 40% down.

What I find interesting is why the Stefanutti stocks rose so sharply over this period and was not over the entire period of 6 years and more like the last 2 years. Stefanutti are a large construction company doing roads, dams, airport runways, buildings and construction in the mining industry. The company operates throughout Africa and the Middle East and the order book of projects they have currently is very healthy.

Back in 2024 the company had completed the Kusile Power station and was owed hundreds of millions in payments from the SA Government. This payment came through in 2025 being R588 million and bolstered their revenue and profitability for the year. The company ended up increasing their operational profit by R388 million due to the outstanding payment. In real terms the operating profit was actually R328 million and not the skewed R689 million due to the very late government payment which was more of a settlement.

The company has not paid any dividends and this for investors is all about the share price and even though the books look very healthy the stock price long term holds risk. Looking at the stock chart things look to be on the up, but they do not tell the true story. We know most retail investors do zero research and you do wonder how many have jumped in seeing how the price has been on the up and suggest the price will continue to rise for a short period before the bigger investors sell off leaving retail holding the bag. I am always wary of seeing these types of articles as someone is benefitting behind the scenes having this article printed hoping for exit liquidity to arrive.

links.body:
# “A tiny splash of blue in a world of green.” 


![DSC05074.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnDRN1RKLErPtpZZkpfMxRyWCRbxyV1hDS35t2QYhzYq/DSC05074.JPG)

I’ve always believed photography is more than just capturing images — it’s about freezing emotions, stories, and moments that would otherwise disappear quietly into time. Some people find peace in music, some in painting, but for me, it has always been photography. There’s something magical about standing still with a camera in hand, waiting patiently while the world continues moving around you.

One quiet morning, I stepped into my backyard with my camera, not expecting anything extraordinary. The air was fresh, the trees were gently swaying, and sunlight filtered softly through the leaves. My backyard has always been my little escape from busy days — a place where nature speaks in whispers instead of noise.

As I walked slowly, listening to the distant sounds of rustling leaves and chirping birds, I noticed a tiny flash of blue perched on an old wooden stump. At first, I froze, afraid even the slightest movement would scare it away. It was a beautiful bluebird, small yet striking against the deep green background of the trees.

The bird wasn’t just sitting there peacefully. In its tiny beak, it held an insect — a reminder of how nature works in perfect balance every single day. It had probably spent the morning searching carefully for food, moving from branch to branch before finally landing there for a brief pause. That single moment felt alive with purpose.

I slowly lifted my camera, holding my breath as I focused the lens. Photography has taught me patience more than anything else. You cannot rush nature. You simply wait, observe, and respect the moment. For a few seconds, the bird stayed perfectly still, almost as if it knew I was admiring it.

And then — click.

I captured the photograph.

What makes this picture special to me is not just the colors or the composition. It’s the story behind it. It reminds me that beauty often exists in ordinary places. I didn’t travel to a national park or a distant forest to find this moment. It happened right in my backyard.

That tiny bird carrying an insect became more than just a subject in a photograph. It became a symbol of stillness, patience, and the unnoticed wonders around us. In today’s fast-moving world, we often forget to pause and appreciate small moments like these — a bird resting quietly, sunlight touching the trees, or the peaceful silence of an early morning.

Photography gives me the chance to notice those details. Every picture I take becomes a memory attached to a feeling. Whenever I look at this image now, I don’t just see a bird on a stump. I remember the cool morning air, the quiet calmness, and the excitement I felt when I realized I had captured something real and beautiful.

Sometimes the best photographs are not planned at all. They happen naturally when passion meets patience. And this picture is one of those moments for me — simple, honest, and unforgettable.

That’s why I love photography. It allows me to turn ordinary moments in my own backyard into stories worth remembering.

My favorite exchange is #binance because of its good earning features. You can earn here in multiple ways, passive and active income. Both of them are easy and you can earn in any way.

There are some passive income ways including Staking, Saving, Launchpool, EARN and many more and there active earning ways including trading and trading bots. Among them is Rebalancing bot where they bot will continue to trade for you.

So far in my progress, one good strategy has come to my mind which I want to share with you all. First of all, keep the threshold low in your rebalancing strategy, minimum 0.5%. This means when there is 0.5% difference in prices of two coins, then the bot will convert automatically.



Second thing, try to keep one strong fundamental coin in your portfolio which is a little volatile, with some stable coin on rebalance. Remember this that keeping more than one pair on rebalance is not profitable.

Many people keep 2-3 pairs on rebalance, but its disadvantage is that bot conversion becomes difficult. Because in every pair minimum 0.5% difference is necessary, which is difficult for many coins. Therefore selecting one pair is the best strategy.

The main part of any bot running is to your instructions, if your feed proper data then it will work in a good way but if your instructions are not good then the bot is useless.

links.body: Math Easy Solutions: close, but tighten it to this — the Aharonov–Bohm effect is a **quantum phenomenon** in which a charged particle’s wavefunction acquires a measurable phase shift due to the **electromagnetic potentials**, even when the particle travels only through a region where the **electric and magnetic fields are zero** [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aharonov%E2%80%93Bohm_effect) [Emergent Mind](https://www.emergentmind.com/topics/aharonov-bohm-effect). Your version implies “near a field,” but the key point is harsher and more interesting: no local field is required along the particle’s path, only a nontrivial potential. Irrelevant recent InLeo posts from [Khal](https://inleo.io/threads/view/khaleelkazi/re-leothreads-vvxlh5tw) and [@leofinance](https://inleo.io/@leofinance/how-to-add-liquidity-to-maya-protocol-liquidity-pools-movw0vpsaa45ce1b) don’t change that physics.

I hope you enjoy today’s photos. Hugs.

links.title: A New Perspective on the Manzanares River (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> The Manzanares River is the most important tributary in the city of Cumaná, as it stretches 80 kilometers in length, which means we can view it from various vantage points or areas; on this occasion, I walked down to the Francisco de Miranda plaza. There are some stairs in this area that make it easy to access the spot. You can also see the Antonio Guzmán Blanco Bridge in the distance. The water has a deep green hue, characteristic of this body of water.
![1000117575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wMTzidL7n3skw844X25bN1vH5cvLGsADAH5qLREb9iAqFcQ9yLh9c5i1ZYg9U7AQY76.jpg)
![1000117573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245T39SgwTdGuZJq9BKpRP22UAXkt24ZycHQJMtpvU7UCUhH8NZvXHPMQ3uq78PzBRok3.jpg)
The river flows freely beneath the bridge, surrounded by lush trees. There is also grass and some tree trunks from trees that have been cut down, as they posed a risk to the public. The apamate tree makes its presence known with its striking pink flowers, which fall into the water, decorating it and creating an interesting play of shadows.
![1000117577.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23u67PjBxYYsXiAqwEhnNTpsiZ76xQwgwCL1T6pptHKw31Enr9jW7SQBNiCpaWAtgUZo3.jpg)
![1000117571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKvQyvA57YzKNR8VA6JA1cD3hRJR57zvbcFVAphX7nmmfThVpdmcNB9djJDpYcDjS2v.jpg)
![1000117569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSWrGo12dXzBSuzqqtnFeGLAs6CMgp21t9haRZyo22JvHykPCxVCuSDhDrm6A7wA3fy.jpg)
Since the river was dredged a few months ago, the water level has dropped, which is why you can see patches of exposed earth at the beginning of this area. You can also see some birds flying overhead; despite the high levels of pollution, the ecosystem still possesses a certain beauty that is inspiring, especially when the river offers us a different perspective.
![1000117567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xAR8VULwtW54JDavqsZH6eNpJ48TpiKYbXoy8cMkRgVg6rqSaqXP4DsWcUXmDQdoz7r.jpg)
![1000117565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKsypDVF66aQf7Kd6vZuZTWVdzY3TZieoCbNZKdn9cCs9BPkYhRA6RQginwHwbbwcvh.jpg)
![1000117564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23zbPggHqifbtJC7Z1gX37UJ6Hu2BYuGowktFj9kr8aSf8o4wJN8G9FTe3hbYUXwRGdHS.jpg)
Walking through this place gave me a sense of well-being linked to the tranquility that comes from being in contact with a source of fresh water, which translates into enjoying a pleasant breeze and the coolness of the afternoon. That is why it is a favorite spot for many locals, who rest in the shade of these trees and breathe in the fresh air. In busy times, these breaks are necessary to recharge our energy and take on new projects. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El río Manzanares es el afluente más importante de la ciudad de Cumaná dado que cuenta con 80 kilómetros de longitud, lo que implica que podemos contemplarlo desde diferentes puntos o zonas, en esta oportunidad bajé por la plazoleta Francisco de Miranda. En este espacio hay algunas escaleras que facilitan el acceso al lugar. También se puede apreciar en lo alto el puente Antonio Guzmán Blanco. El agua luce un tono verde intenso, característico de este líquido.
![1000117575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wMTzidL7n3skw844X25bN1vH5cvLGsADAH5qLREb9iAqFcQ9yLh9c5i1ZYg9U7AQY76.jpg)
![1000117573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245T39SgwTdGuZJq9BKpRP22UAXkt24ZycHQJMtpvU7UCUhH8NZvXHPMQ3uq78PzBRok3.jpg)
El río transita por debajo del puente con total libertad, rodeado de frondosos árboles, también hay grama y algunos troncos de matas que han sido taladas, pues representaban un riesgo para la población. El apamate hace presencia con sus flores rosadas bastante llamativas, las cuales caen al agua, decorando y ofreciendo un juego de sombras interesante.
![1000117577.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23u67PjBxYYsXiAqwEhnNTpsiZ76xQwgwCL1T6pptHKw31Enr9jW7SQBNiCpaWAtgUZo3.jpg)
![1000117571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKvQyvA57YzKNR8VA6JA1cD3hRJR57zvbcFVAphX7nmmfThVpdmcNB9djJDpYcDjS2v.jpg)
![1000117569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSWrGo12dXzBSuzqqtnFeGLAs6CMgp21t9haRZyo22JvHykPCxVCuSDhDrm6A7wA3fy.jpg)
Como el río ha sido dragado hace unos meses, el caudal de agua ha bajado, por ello se pueden observar promontorios de tierra al inicio de esta zona. En el cielo también se visualizan algunas aves sobrevolando, a pesar del alto índice de contaminación el ecosistema sigue mostrando cierta belleza que inspira, sobre todo, cuando el río nos ofrece otra perspectiva.
![1000117567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xAR8VULwtW54JDavqsZH6eNpJ48TpiKYbXoy8cMkRgVg6rqSaqXP4DsWcUXmDQdoz7r.jpg)
![1000117565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xKsypDVF66aQf7Kd6vZuZTWVdzY3TZieoCbNZKdn9cCs9BPkYhRA6RQginwHwbbwcvh.jpg)
![1000117564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23zbPggHqifbtJC7Z1gX37UJ6Hu2BYuGowktFj9kr8aSf8o4wJN8G9FTe3hbYUXwRGdHS.jpg)
Recorrer este lugar me produjo una sensación de bienestar ligada a la tranquilidad que concede estar contacto con una fuente de agua dulce, lo que se traduce en disfrutar de una agradable brisa y el frescor de la tarde. Por eso, es el sitio predilecto de muchos habitantes, quienes descansan bajo la sombra de estos árboles y respiran aire puro. En tiempos concursos se hacen necesarias estas pausas para recargar energías y emprender nuevos proyectos.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: The UNITY CUP is back | 🇳🇬🇿🇼🇮🇳🇯🇲
links.body: The Unity Cup returned yesterday, 26th May 2026 with the match between Nigeria and Zimbabwe and the game ended with a sweet victory for Nigeria with 2 goals to nil.\n\n

/>

You don't know about the Unity Cup?

Of course, you should know it!

A tournament was held last year (2025) between four nations: Nigeria, Jamaica, Ghana and Trinidad and Tobago. The tournament ended with Nigeria clinching the trophy.

The same tournament has returned this year with four nations: Nigeria, India, Jamaica and Zimbabwe. It's being held in Charlton, London.

The tournament started from the semi-final stage where Nigeria took on Zimbabwe and Nigeria won with two goals. This gave us the ticket to the final waiting for the nation to join us.

Today, Jamaica and India will lock on and whoever comes out the winner will battle Nigeria in the final.

The loser will play Zimbabwe for third place.

[Photo](https://www.facebook.com/100064570786725/posts/1424289519733394/?app=fbl)

You can see in today's report that I have completed the target of 10,000. I started walking in the afternoon and then finished in the evening. Thus, I completed 10,000 steps. I do not know one thing that if I complete 10,000 steps, how many kilometers or miles will it be? I think it will be about six to seven kilometers. links.title: I almost got scammed trying to pre-order Rockstar’s GTA 6 [ ENG - ESP ]
links.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1MjtKCDaADDgmU1STtyPH3nLPTtzm1HcqEQr5WryYJkjXkYf84B5ydYJ6gXJWZZ117.png)

---


The frenzy currently surrounding GTA 6 has reached a point where even scammers are capitalizing on the video game's hype. In recent weeks, fake websites, supposed pre-order offers, and even \

downloads of the game have started popping up—all of which actually hide malware and schemes to steal personal information. And honestly, I nearly fell for it myself. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTf3do4XwQ1HZdcN4V2XHo6aVDJ6k6gAQZdYS6GzjChNF5WX726bCWBdJEMfVW9Xii5.png) --- It all started when I saw an ad on social media promising priority access to pre-order GTA 6 before its official launch. The page looked quite convincing: Rockstar Games logos, official images from the trailer, and even fake user comments claiming they had already secured their copy. At first glance, it appeared legitimate—especially since the sheer level of excitement surrounding the game makes it easy for anyone to let their guard down. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2wdhXEmf1f87AKEZEHbDoYsjXer9WnBqupYSuuoA2zrhHXCUZnhrbMwTAhMr9cSuGf.png) --- The problem is that Rockstar hasn't even officially opened pre-orders for the game on many platforms yet—let alone released a public beta or an early access download. Even so, thousands of people visit these sites daily, believing they will gain early access to the most anticipated game of the decade. Many of these links end up downloading malicious software disguised as GTA 6 installers. Some even purport to be driver updates or tools necessary to run the game on PC, but in reality, they contain malware designed to steal passwords, social media accounts, banking details, or information stored in the browser. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTjGwPZ7FUbS46dE9X4j7R4zGvfYx6rYmfFBVrKuH7gEfDUbGwKVnjFgRvtCdt3KuaP.png) --- The most dangerous aspect of all is that these scams work precisely because the hype surrounding GTA 6 is immense. Every new rumor, leak, or piece of alleged gameplay generates millions of views within a matter of hours. Cybercriminals are fully aware of this and seize every opportunity to create fake pages that look official. And to be honest, it is easy to fall for them. When you have been waiting years for a video game and see an ad promising exclusive access, you automatically want to believe it is real. Many people end up clicking without verifying anything at all. That is where the trouble begins. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wXFvMknzPvS7NtuVFMRJ9tACvvCnUcngRucyTCkYpNrDpAs3HFBWBcQii7WbLjZJYF7.png) --- Rockstar Games has faced complicated situations involving hacking in the past. In 2022, one of the largest leaks in video game history occurred when early development footage of GTA 6 was published. Since then, numerous rumors, fake leaks, and websites have emerged, all attempting to capitalize on the situation. Currently, the only safe way to stay informed about GTA 6 is through official Rockstar Games channels. If a website promises mobile versions, beta access, free keys, or miraculous pre-order opportunities—especially this early on—it is likely a scam. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/242ry1PQfNMUUGcKeo7vVbRmrcGSVYYsJtMUremoaqrX4xgMUu4ATEcVgPpSo8bFVccL7.png) --- After seeing all this, I ended up carefully scrutinizing every link related to the game. Because yes, the hype might be massive, but losing an account, infecting your PC, or handing over personal data out of desperation is definitely not worth it. With GTA 6 drawing ever closer, we will undoubtedly see even more fraudulent schemes circulating online. And while many people believe they would never fall for something like this, the reality is that these sites are designed specifically to look authentic. I got lucky this time, but I could just as easily have ended up as yet another victim of the Rockstar frenzy.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)







### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1MjtKCDaADDgmU1STtyPH3nLPTtzm1HcqEQr5WryYJkjXkYf84B5ydYJ6gXJWZZ117.png) --- La locura que existe actualmente alrededor de GTA 6 ya llegó a un punto donde incluso los estafadores están aprovechándose del hype del videojuego. En las últimas semanas comenzaron a aparecer páginas falsas, supuestas reservas anticipadas y hasta descargas “exclusivas” del juego que en realidad esconden malware y robos de información personal. Y honestamente, por poco caigo yo también. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTf3do4XwQ1HZdcN4V2XHo6aVDJ6k6gAQZdYS6GzjChNF5WX726bCWBdJEMfVW9Xii5.png) --- Todo empezó cuando vi en redes sociales un anuncio que prometía acceso prioritario para reservar GTA 6 antes del lanzamiento oficial. La página se veía bastante convincente: logos de Rockstar Games, imágenes oficiales del tráiler y hasta comentarios falsos de usuarios diciendo que ya habían asegurado su copia. A simple vista parecía legítima, especialmente porque el nivel de emoción que existe por el juego hace que cualquiera baje la guardia. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2wdhXEmf1f87AKEZEHbDoYsjXer9WnBqupYSuuoA2zrhHXCUZnhrbMwTAhMr9cSuGf.png) --- El problema es que Rockstar todavía ni siquiera ha abierto oficialmente las reservas del juego en muchas plataformas, y mucho menos existe una beta pública o una descarga anticipada. Aun así, miles de personas están entrando diariamente a estos sitios creyendo que conseguirán acceso temprano al juego más esperado de la década. Muchos de estos enlaces terminan descargando programas maliciosos disfrazados de instaladores de GTA 6. Algunos incluso aparentan ser actualizaciones de drivers o herramientas necesarias para ejecutar el juego en PC, pero realmente contienen malware diseñado para robar contraseñas, cuentas de redes sociales, datos bancarios o información almacenada en el navegador. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTjGwPZ7FUbS46dE9X4j7R4zGvfYx6rYmfFBVrKuH7gEfDUbGwKVnjFgRvtCdt3KuaP.png) --- Lo más peligroso de todo es que estas estafas funcionan precisamente porque el hype de GTA 6 es gigantesco. Cada nuevo rumor, filtración o supuesto gameplay genera millones de visitas en cuestión de horas. Los ciberdelincuentes saben perfectamente eso y aprovechan cualquier oportunidad para crear páginas falsas que parecen oficiales. Y siendo sinceros, es fácil caer. Cuando llevas años esperando un videojuego y ves un anuncio prometiendo acceso exclusivo, automáticamente quieres creer que es real. Mucha gente termina haciendo clic sin verificar absolutamente nada. Ahí es donde empiezan los problemas. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wXFvMknzPvS7NtuVFMRJ9tACvvCnUcngRucyTCkYpNrDpAs3HFBWBcQii7WbLjZJYF7.png) --- Rockstar Games ya ha vivido situaciones complicadas relacionadas con hackeos anteriormente. En 2022 ocurrió una de las filtraciones más grandes en la historia de los videojuegos cuando se publicaron videos tempranos del desarrollo de GTA 6. Desde entonces han aparecido múltiples rumores, falsas filtraciones y sitios intentando aprovecharse de la situación. Actualmente la única forma segura de seguir información sobre GTA 6 es mediante canales oficiales de Rockstar Games. Si una página promete versiones móviles, acceso beta, claves gratuitas o reservas milagrosas demasiado pronto, probablemente sea una estafa. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/242ry1PQfNMUUGcKeo7vVbRmrcGSVYYsJtMUremoaqrX4xgMUu4ATEcVgPpSo8bFVccL7.png) --- Después de ver todo esto terminé revisando cuidadosamente cualquier enlace relacionado con el juego. Porque sí, el hype puede ser enorme, pero perder una cuenta, infectar tu PC o entregar datos personales por desesperación definitivamente no vale la pena. Con GTA 6 cada vez más cerca, seguramente veremos todavía más intentos de fraude circulando por internet. Y aunque muchos creen que nunca caerían en algo así, la realidad es que estas páginas están diseñadas precisamente para parecer reales. Esta vez tuve suerte, pero fácilmente pude terminar siendo otra víctima más de la fiebre por Rockstar.

# Strauss–Howe generational theory

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strauss%E2%80%93Howe_generational_theory

The Strauss–Howe generational theory, devised by William Strauss and Neil Howe, describes a theorized recurring generation cycle in American and Western history in which historical events are associated with recurring generational personas called archetypes. Each generational persona unleashes a new era (called a \
) lasting around 21 years, in which a new social, political, and economic climate (\
) exists. They are part of a larger cyclical \

, a long human life, which usually spans around 85 years, although some saecula have lasted longer.\nThe theory states that a crisis recurs in American history after every saeculum, which is followed by a recovery (\

). During this recovery, institutions and communitarian values are strong. Ultimately, succeeding generational archetypes attack and weaken institutions in the name of autonomy and individualism, which eventually creates a tumultuous political environment that ripens conditions for another crisis.[citation needed]\nAcademic response to the theory has been mixed, with some applauding Strauss and Howe for their \

, while others have criticized the theory as being overly deterministic, unfalsifiable, and unsupported by rigorous evidence.[1][2][3][4][5] The theory has been influential in the fields of generational studies, marketing, and business management literature.[3] However, the theory has also been described by some historians and journalists as pseudoscientific,[3][6][7] \

.[9][10][11] Academic criticism has focused on the lack of rigorous empirical evidence for their claims,[12] as well as the authors' view that generational groupings are more powerful than other social groupings, such as economic class, race/ethnicity, sex, religion, culture, and political affiliation.[13]

William Strauss and Neil Howe's partnership began in the late 1980s when they began writing their first book Generations, which discusses the history of the United States as a succession of generational biographies. Each had written on generational topics previously. The authors' interest in generations as a broader topic emerged after they met in Washington, D.C.; they began discussing the connections between each of their previous works.[14]

External videos Booknotes interview with Howe and Strauss on Generations, April 14, 1991, C-SPAN Discussion with Howe and Strauss on The Fourth Turning, April 17, 1998, C-SPAN
They attempted to find the reason why the Boomers and the G.I.s had developed such different ways of looking at the world, and what it was about these generations' experiences growing up that prompted their different outlooks. They also wanted to find patterns in previous generations, and their research discussed historical analogs to the current generations. They ultimately described a recurring pattern in the Anglo-American history of four generational types, each with a distinct collective persona, and a corresponding cycle of four different types of eras, each with a distinct \

.[15] \nStrauss and Howe laid the groundwork for their theory in their book Generations: The History of America's Future, 1584 to 2069 (1991), which discusses the history of the United States as a series of generational biographies going back to 1584.[13][5] \nStrauss and Howe followed in 1993 with their second book 13th Gen: Abort, Retry, Ignore, Fail?, which was published while Gen Xers were teenagers and young adults. The book examines the generation born between 1961 and 1981, \

, describing them as the thirteenth generation since the US became a nation). The book asserts that 13ers' location in history as under-protected children during the Sexual Revolution explains their pragmatic attitude. They describe Gen Xers as growing up during a time when society was less focused on children and more focused on adults and their self-actualization.[16][17]\nStrauss and Howe's theory made various predictions regarding the Millennial generation, a group consisting of young children at the time. These predictions lacked significant historical data. In Generations (1991) and The Fourth Turning (1997), the two authors discussed the generation gap between Baby Boomers and their parents and predicted there would be no such gap between Millennials and their elders.\nIn 2000, they published Millennials Rising: The Next Great Generation. This work discussed the personality of the Millennial Generation, whose oldest members were described as the high school graduating class of the year 2000. In the 2000 book, Strauss and Howe asserted that Millennial teens and young adults were recasting the image of youth from \

, crediting increased parental attention and protection for these positive changes. They asserted that Millennials are held to higher standards than adults apply to themselves and that they are much less vulgar and violent than the teen culture older people produce for them. They described them as less sexually charged and as ushering in a new sexual modesty, with an increasing belief that sex should be saved for marriage and a return to conservative family values.[citation needed]\nThe authors predicted that over the following decade, Millennials would transform what it means to be young, and could emerge as the next \

. The work was described as an optimistic, feel-good book for the parents of the Millennial Generation, predominantly the Baby Boomers.[1][18][19] \nThe theory was expanded in The Fourth Turning (1997), to focus on a fourfold cycle of generational types and recurring mood eras[17] to describe the history of the United States, including the Thirteen Colonies and their British antecedents. However, the authors have also examined generational trends elsewhere in the world and described similar cycles in several developed countries.[20]The terminology for generational archetypes were updated (e.g. \
, which they applied to the Millennial Generation, \

were introduced.[21] 
In the mid-1990s, Strauss and Howe began receiving inquiries about how their research could be applied to strategic problems in organizations. They started speaking frequently about their work at events and conferences.[5] 
In July 2023, Howe released a new book, titled The Fourth Turning Is Here.[22]
Steve Bannon, former Chief Strategist and Senior Counselor to president Donald Trump during his first term, is a prominent proponent of the theory.[citation needed] As a documentary filmmaker, Bannon discussed the details of Strauss–Howe generational theory in Generation Zero. According to historian David Kaiser, who was consulted for the film, Generation Zero \
[23][24][25] A February 2017 article from Business Insider titled: \

[26]

Defining a generation[edit]
Strauss and Howe describe the history of the U.S. as a succession of Anglo-American generational biographies from 1433 to the present, and theorized a recurring generational cycle in American history. The authors posit a pattern of four repeating phases, generational types, and a recurring cycle of spiritual awakenings and secular crises, from the founding colonials of America through the present day.[13][17]
Strauss and Howe define a social generation as the aggregate of all people born over a span of roughly 21 years or about the length of one phase of life: childhood, young adulthood, midlife, and old age. Generations are identified (from the first birthyear to last) by looking for cohort groups of this length that share three criteria. First, members of a generation share what the authors call an age location in history: they encounter key historical events and social trends while occupying the same phase of life. In this view, members of a generation are shaped in lasting ways by the eras they encounter as children and young adults and they share certain common beliefs and behaviors. Aware of the experiences and traits that they share with their peers, members of a generation would also share a sense of common perceived membership in that generation.[27]
They based their definition of a generation on the work of various writers and social thinkers, from ancient writers such as Polybius and Ibn Khaldun to modern social theorists such as José Ortega y Gasset, Karl Mannheim, John Stuart Mill, Émile Littré, Auguste Comte, and François Mentré.[28]

While writing Generations, Strauss and Howe described a theorized pattern in the historical generations they examined, which they say revolved around generational events which they call turnings. In Generations, and in greater detail in The Fourth Turning, they describe a four-stage cycle of social or mood eras which they call \

.[17]

According to Strauss and Howe, the first turning is a high, which occurs after a crisis. During the high, institutions are strong and individualism is weak. Society is confident about where it wants to go collectively, though those outside the majoritarian center often feel stifled by conformity.[29]
According to the authors, the most recent first turning in the US was the post–World War II American high, beginning in 1946 and ending with the assassination of John F. Kennedy on November 22, 1963.[30]

According to the theory, the second turning is an awakening. This is an era when institutions are attacked in the name of personal and spiritual autonomy. Just when society is reaching its high tide of public progress, people suddenly tire of social discipline and want to recapture a sense of \
. Young activists look back at the previous High as an era of cultural and spiritual poverty.[31]\nStrauss and Howe say the U.S.'s most recent awakening was the \

, which spanned from the campus and inner-city revolts of the mid-1960s to the tax revolts of the early 1980s.[32]

According to Strauss and Howe, the third turning is an unraveling. The mood of this era they say is in many ways the opposite of a high: Institutions are weak and distrusted, while individualism is strong and flourishing. The authors say highs come after crises when society wants to coalesce and build and avoid the death and destruction of the previous crisis. Unravelings come after awakenings when society wants to atomize and enjoy.[33] They say the most recent unraveling in the US began in the 1980s and includes the long boom and the culture war.[17]

According to the authors, the fourth turning is a crisis. This is an era of destruction, often involving war or revolution, in which institutional life is destroyed and rebuilt in response to a perceived threat to the nation's survival. After the crisis, civic authority revives, cultural expression redirects toward community purpose, and people begin to locate themselves as members of a larger group.[34]
The authors say the previous fourth turning in the US began with the Wall Street Crash of 1929 and climaxed with the end of World War II. The G.I. generation (which they call a hero archetype, born 1901 to 1924) came of age during this era. They say their confidence, optimism, and collective outlook epitomized the mood of that era.[35] The authors assert the millennial generation, which they also describe as a hero archetype, born 1982 to 2005, shows many similar traits to those of the G.I. youth, which they describe as including rising civic engagement, improving behavior, and collective confidence.[36]

The authors describe each turning as lasting circa 21 years. Four turnings make up a full cycle of circa 85 years,[37] which the authors term a saeculum, after the Latin word meaning both \

.[38]\nGenerational change drives the cycle of turnings and determines its periodicity. As each generation ages into the next life phase (and a new social role) society's mood and behavior fundamentally change, giving rise to a new turning. Historical events shape generations in childhood and young adulthood; then, as parents and leaders in midlife and old age, generations in turn shape history.[39]\nEach of the four turnings has a distinct \
that recurs every saeculum. Strauss and Howe describe these turnings as the \

. At one extreme is the Awakening, which is analogous to summer, and at the other extreme is the Crisis, which is analogous to winter. The High and the Unraveling are similar to spring and autumn, respectively.[40] Strauss and Howe have discussed 26 theorized turnings over 7 saecula in Anglo-American history, from the year 1433 to today.\nThe core of Strauss and Howe's ideas is a basic alternation between two different types of eras, Crises and Awakenings. Both of these are defining eras in which people observe that historic events are radically altering their social environment.[41] Crises are periods marked by major secular upheaval, when society focuses on reorganizing the outer world of institutions and public behavior. They say the last American Crisis was the period spanning the Great Depression and World War II. Awakenings are periods marked by cultural or religious renewal when society focuses on changing the inner world of values and private behavior. The last American Awakening was the \

of the 1960s and 1970s.[42]
During Crises, an ethic of collectivism emerges. During Awakenings, an ethic of individualism emerges, and the institutional order is attacked by new social ideals and spiritual agendas.[43] According to the authors, about every 85 years—the length of a long human life—a national Crisis occurs in American society. Roughly halfway to the next Crisis, a cultural Awakening occurs. Historically, these have often been called Great Awakenings.[42]
In describing this cycle of Crises and Awakenings, they draw from the work of other historians and social scientists who have also discussed long cycles in American and European history, which have grown to show a trend of economic downturns the more a society has industrialised.[44] The cycle of Crises corresponds with long cycles of war identified by such scholars as Arnold J. Toynbee, Quincy Wright, and L. L. Ferrar Jr., and with geopolitical cycles identified by William R. Thompson and George Modelski.[45] Strauss and Howe say their cycle of Awakenings corresponds with Anthony Wallace's work on revitalization movements.[46] They also say recurring Crises and Awakenings correspond with two-stroke cycles in politics (Walter Dean Burnham, Arthur Schlesinger Sr. and Jr.), foreign affairs (Frank L. Klingberg), and the economy (Nikolai Kondratieff) and long-term oscillations in crime and substance abuse.[47]

The authors say two different types of eras and two formative age locations associated with them (childhood and young adulthood) produce four generational archetypes that repeat sequentially, in rhythm with the cycle of Crises and Awakenings. In Generations, they refer to these four archetypes as Idealist, Reactive, Civic, and Adaptive.[48] In The Fourth Turning (1997) they change this terminology to Prophet, Nomad, Hero, and Artist.[49] 
They say the generations in each archetype share a similar age-location in history, and share some basic attitudes towards family, risk, culture and values, and civic engagement. In essence, generations shaped by similar early-life experiences develop similar collective personas and follow similar life trajectories.[50] To date, Strauss and Howe have described 25 generations in Anglo-American history, each with a corresponding archetype. The authors describe the archetypes as follows:

Abraham Lincoln, born in 1809. Strauss and Howe identified him as a member of the Transcendental generation. 
Prophet (Idealist) generations enter childhood during a High, a time of rejuvenated community life and consensus around a new societal order. Examples: Transcendental Generation, Missionary Generation, Baby Boomers.[51]

Nomad (Reactive) generations enter childhood during an Awakening, a time of social ideals and spiritual agendas when young adults are passionately attacking the established institutional order. Examples: Gilded Generation, Lost Generation, Generation X.[17]

Young adults fighting in World War II were born in the early part of the 20th century, like actor Colonel James Stewart (b. 1908). They are part of the G.I. Generation, which follows the Hero archetype.
Hero (Civic) generations enter childhood during an Unraveling, a time of individual pragmatism, self-reliance, and unrestrained individualism. Examples: Republican Generation, G.I. Generation, Millennials.[17]

Artist (Adaptive) generations enter childhood during a Crisis, a time when public consensus, aggressive institutions, and an ethic of personal sacrifice were favored. Examples: Progressive Generation, Silent Generation, Homeland Generation.[17]

An average modern life is around 85 years and consists of four periods of ~21 years
Childhood → Young adult → Midlife → Elderhood
A generation is an aggregate of people born every ~21 years
Baby Boomers → Gen X → Millennials → Homelanders
Each generation experiences \
every ~85 years\nHigh → Awakening → Unraveling → Crisis\nA generation is considered \

according to the turning experienced as young adults. But as a youth generation comes of age and defines its collective persona an opposing generational archetype is in its midlife peak of power.
Dominant: independent behavior + attitudes in defining an era
Recessive: dependent role in defining an era

Artist (adaptive): High as young adults. High, defined: Institutions are strong, and individualism is weak
