links.title: For Artists: Your Music. Your Rules. Your Revenue
links.body: ... LOL... We can tell from years in the industry that is complete bull crap. \n\nWhat \

usually means: 30% off the top for the platform, another 50-80% if you have a label, algorithmic discovery that favors whoever is already winning or whose lable has the biggest budget, and a payout statement you need a spreadsheet to understand and not giving you any real results.

BlockTunes is a different arrangement. Flat 5% platform fee. No label required. No algorithm gatekeeping your reach. Every streaming payout goes directly on-chain to you and your edition holders the moment a qualifying play happens. You can read every transaction yourself, on the blockchain. Heck we have even built our AI credit system to work on-chain. 

Now we know that musicians and blockchains don't always mix. There is a ton of confusion and onboarding nightmares. We are working on simplifying this process the best we can, and hopefully make it even easier in the future! 

---

## Getting Started



![Screenshot 2026-05-27 at 10.42.26 AM.png](https://images.blocktunes.net/DQmX1LCCxgdVs3oF2ZgGMwtoFH8ozN9JWotP29MB5ExpWwr/Screenshot%202026-05-27%20at%2010.42.26%E2%80%AFAM.png)



**Step 1: Create a free account**

Go to [app.blocktunes.net/signup](https://app.blocktunes.net/signup) if you don't already have a Hive account. Pick a username, choose a password. Your Hive blockchain keys are generated and saved in your browser using our Smart Lock system and never sent to any server. You also need to download and save them somewhere safe. Your account is live in seconds with no third-party site and no seed phrase ceremony.

During signup, choose Smart Lock (recommended for most artists): set a 5-digit PIN and your keys are encrypted and stored in your browser. From that point on, every transaction is one click and a PIN. If you really want to run down the rabbit hole, Hive Keychain is the preferred wallet by most power users on Hive. You can install it as an extention on your browser, or use the mobile app and visit Blocktunes from inside the app. 

**Step 2: Set up your profile**

Upload a profile picture and cover image. Add your bio, genre, and links. Add your crypto wallet addresses (BTC, ETH, LTC, DOGE, XMR) if you want to receive crypto tips directly. You can also set your profile description, location, and any external link you want to use. Note, you are limited to 1 link, so if you have many, think about creating a Linktree page and using that URL. 

**Step 3: Get whitelisted**

The BlockTunes NFT marketplace uses a whitelist to maintain quality. Submit your application from the NFT Marketplace section of your profile. It asks for links to your existing music and a brief description of what you're putting out. Whitelist fees are burned, they go to no wallet anyone controls. They're permanently removed from MUSIC supply. You are required to stake 1000 MUSIC tokens in the system as well to be whitelisted, so you are just as invested in the ecosystem as the rest of us! Plus, the more MUSIC you stake, the more AI credits you get per day to use the tools, so there is a bonus right there!

**Step 4: Mint your music**

Once whitelisted, head to the Mint page. Upload your audio file and cover art. Set your edition count (up to 10 per track). Add your metadata: title, description, tags, genre, and language if you like. Set a price per edition in $MUSIC if you want to sell them, or hold all 10 yourself and earn the full holder pool on every play. Heck, you don't even have to mint editions other than just the 1 you hold. That is perfectly fine too. Again, your music, your rules!

Your NFT files are pinned to the BlockTunes IPFS node and served through our own gateway. Your music doesn't live on a third party's server hoping they stay online.

Submit. Sign the transaction. Your track is live on the Listen page and able to earn streaming revenue instantly!

---

## How You Earn

Every qualifying play of your track triggers an automatic on-chain payout split four ways:

| Recipient | Share | Genesis Era Amount |
|---|---|---|
| You (artist) | 50% | 8 $MUSIC + 0.050 HIVE |
| Edition holders (split proportionally) | 40% | 6.4 $MUSIC + 0.040 HIVE |
| BlockTunes | 5% | 0.8 $MUSIC + 0.005 HIVE |
| A&R rep (or you, if no referral) | 5% | 0.8 $MUSIC + 0.005 HIVE |

Worth calling out the HIVE piece specifically: on top of the MUSIC you earn, we pay out real HIVE from the blocktunesdao treasury on every qualifying stream. HIVE is something you can swap for Bitcoin, Ethereum, or anything else you want. Cash it out, or stake it to power up your account to earn even more Hive and have a bigger vote on posts and in chain governance if that's your thing. Your MUSIC stays as your utility token on the platform, it's what gives you access to editions, AI tools, and the wider ecosystem. So you've got two separate income streams from every play, one you can take off-platform and one that works for you inside it.

This Hive is seeded by us and will build by earning through an HBD savings endowment out of our own crypto saving, which isn't much after building the infrastructure to run all of this. We also suppliment with MUSIC tokens sales collected through curation. 

We also setup the @blocktunesdao account as a 5% beneficiary on all posts made through the Blocktunes interface. This 5% is strictly to be used for the streaming pool and endowment that is already programmed that every month, any HBD savings interest is withdrawn from the wallet and market swapped into HIVE on the internal exchange. This HIVE is then added to the pool, so the more fans that start streaming, the more we can keep up with the streaming payments. 

**The artist 50% is yours regardless of how many editions you've sold.** If you hold none of your own editions, you still earn 50% of every payout from your music forever. If you hold editions, you also earn your proportional share of the holder pool. Also, if no one referred you to the platform, that 5% A&R share comes back to you as well. So in your early days, you could be earning 55% of every payout.

---

## Editions Are a Revenue Share Tool, Not Just a Collectible



![Screenshot 2026-05-27 at 10.46.19 AM.png](https://images.blocktunes.net/DQmQ5niXsS29MeAkCLw9NmcojQWho3rCSB15Ustir8shwEi/Screenshot%202026-05-27%20at%2010.46.19%E2%80%AFAM.png)



Think carefully about how you use your editions.

Hold all 10 yourself: you earn 50% (artist) plus 100% of the 40% holder pool. Total: 90% of every payout, forever.

Sell 5 editions at 500 $MUSIC each: you raise 2,500 $MUSIC upfront, and you still earn 50% artist share plus 50% of the holder pool (since you hold 5 of 10). Fans who bought in are now financially motivated to promote your music, every play they drive earns them a return.

Sell all 10: you raise 5,000 $MUSIC (at 500 each), earn your 50% artist share on every play, and your fans earn the entire holder pool. Your superfans are now your street team with skin in the game.

There's no single right answer. It depends on whether you want immediate revenue, recurring income, or a community of financially invested fans doing your marketing for you. But we give you the opportunity to basically turn yourself into a business using our platform. 

---

## The Genesis Era Advantage

We are in the Genesis Era right now. The streaming reward is **16 $MUSIC per qualifying play**, the highest rate this platform will ever pay. The reward halves every two years, for MUSIC tokens only. Artists who mint now and build a listener base while the rate is at its peak will earn at the highest possible rate for the longest possible time.

This is not a sales pitch. It's math built into the streaming system. The earlier you're on the platform, the more the streaming rewards work in your favor.

---

## What About AI-Generated Music?

You're welcome here. Seriously. We can't wait to hear what you and your tools have made together. There is still a person behind every prompt, a person with taste, vision, and something to say and may not have known how to say it before because you may not feel like you had the talent to say it. AI can give those 'silent artists' a voice! If that's you, mint it! Heck, we even give you AI tools to help you on your journey and have more to come when we can earn more to build out our ecoysystem a bit more!


![Screenshot 2026-05-27 at 10.47.21 AM.png](https://images.blocktunes.net/DQmP3sb71BDhRh1J3np1uJsWCskwmqTaQu34pLxyEJWrFKr/Screenshot%202026-05-27%20at%2010.47.21%E2%80%AFAM.png)

---

## Get Started Now

Accounts are free. Most likely if you are reading this, you already have a Hive account, but even if you do or if not... Setup takes minutes and a little crypto investment into HIVE and MUSIC. But look at it as an investment not just in the platform, but in yourself, your music business, and the future of the industry! And the moment your track is minted, it appears on the Listen page and streaming rewards start flowing when people come and listen.

If you have questions about the whitelist process, a minting issue, or anything else on the platform, **Harmony**, the BlockTunes AI support assistant, is in the bottom-right corner of every page. She knows your account data and can answer most questions directly. If something needs a staff member, the **Submit Ticket** button in the chat opens a private support thread in the BlockTunes Discord with your full conversation already loaded as context.

The cool part about Blocktunes is that we are not just a streaming platform with a token payout, we have a whole community built in that also pays out! So you can mint your music, then make posts promoting it to the community. This is great for those without much of, or no following. The Hive/Blocktunes music community is a globally diverse community of artists just like you and the ability to build a albiet currently small, but global fan base just by getting involved!  Get likes on your posts that actually pay too! It's really kind of a win win situation that you can't find anywhere else. 

**[Create Your Account](https://app.blocktunes.net/signup)**
**[Apply for Whitelist](https://app.blocktunes.net/nfts/profile)**


Posted using [BlockTunes](https://app.blocktunes.net/@blocktunes/for-artists-your-music-your-rules-your-revenue)

body.body: > To locate Soma's longship, I chose to row a tiny boat solo through foggy waters littered with destroyed ships. After using Synin to scout a bandit camp, I quietly eliminated the guards, freed the Norse captives, and learned Soma had fled east into the swamps to lose her pursuers. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDRfE62PQ48eyKYvJ7z8i9S93ivnR4qozgLCeKHbwKPt/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZiTWbp7uThdrWc8J7Ks6x4bgkcFzbd1xvKTvii72tyu/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXh6nMS6w3qvxdsrWWtAn5mSsfRFg5HLumvSQD1rTFUCf/screenshot_3_.png) I had to find and reach Soma's longship, and I was running for it alone to find out what happened after the siege. The Summer Army's leader stayed back, which was strange given the danger as he didn't want to join me to face their battle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZmzz1QifUFcn3rSa94aux2jpNBz3WBTx3VHd1vaRYfQ3/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS1rH9HMJBhWfoWN2WZ5DVmLNcZxgTvi5ancYgeFnjeEf/screenshot_5_.png) I could take my longship and my soldiers with me to provide heavy reinforcement, but I decided to do it solo to avoid detection. So I took a tiny boat from the dock and pushed off into the reeds. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaC7FMJMYRsguhnXhUxeGDP9QQiMV895HAi3GiCeKj4wv/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqzgUutBUgWfKBU5JfUmokFdW2W59a2NcHuYLbz9wx9F/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSk9FE8UzFhRktpCke34MWERrdR267QQEeLakFiy4We7X/screenshot_8_.png) On my way through the thick fog, I noticed some drowned longship and some fallen soldiers floating on the water, showing signs of a brutal ambush. And there were marks that I scooped while I was rowing the boat along the shore. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTa5LoSHVegxj3MapWSTTLXPMFv69Mfx9bbhRz6ifb4sj/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVn3qZnx12rbKSxxV75mcXdZbXNWaKbFC5w8fX8Qg4s6p/screenshot_10_.png) Upon reaching close to the spot where the river narrowed, I called my raven, Synin, to check around from above. I noticed there was a broken longship taken to a land, and there were a lot of captured Norsemen, along with another group who was searching for something around. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrYC1x8wu2uK4xUatxiGDzGE6SmSRWaA8VZpVcqhkZB7/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSm1RERiKxCj2eZjWEiA7H58A8htSYcK3ogpQumkxESjX/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQn9LCwXUMca7DDeo3d5jJrnPA9makn8TyhYYBsiFSEQH/screenshot_13_.png) After getting to the muddy spot, I had to finally speak to Soma, who should be around in the swamps hiding from the search parties. But the whole land was crawling with bandits, so I took some time in taking them down silently first. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXcaxBc3kvmQkWWw8U7UGwjiSQTeyNaDZbDvbNX8cKYe/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfN4qDoNjEfjyTBbJjtWR75pzjJcJWeBGjFCSL7vyyfL/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHmCZj3LZfiAeUP7GvVPX7BbF5MS2EEY2BKVAxbsKnCD/screenshot_16_.png) After taking care of all the bandits, mostly with my hidden blade, I freed the captives from their bindings. One of the Norse Warriors told me Soma dragged the Saxons east from her longship to tire them out and lose them in the fog, so I checked where east goes after getting to her longship. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/6b04a121)

body.title: Vivir agotados [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![N7sHrtZzH40pRehr_1000341933.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/N7sHrtZzH40pRehr_1000341933/N7sHrtZzH40pRehr_1000341933.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Hay cansancios que no se quitan durmiendo una noche. Hay agotamientos que se meten en la cabeza, en el cuerpo y hasta en la forma en que uno mira el día. Así me sentía ayer, después de más de 40 horas de apagón en casa.


Cada día la situación en mi país parece más difícil. Cuando uno cree que ya no puede empeorar, empeora. Pasamos de tener seis horas de corriente al día, luego tres cada veinticuatro horas, y ahora apenas dos o tres horas después de treinta y cinco o más sin electricidad. Ya no existen horarios. Ya no puedes organizarte. Ya no sabes cuándo cocinar, cuándo cargar algo, cuándo descansar o cuándo simplemente sentarte un rato bajo un ventilador.


Lo peor no es solo el calor o la oscuridad. Es la ansiedad constante.
Es vivir pensando en la comida que se está echando a perder en el refrigerador. Abrir la puerta con miedo, tratando de adivinar si todavía sirve o no. Es calcular mentalmente cuánto costó cada cosa y sentir impotencia al ver cómo se pierde. Es llegar del trabajo agotada y todavía tener que cocinar con carbón porque no hay otra opción. El humo, el calor, el sudor… y aun así seguir porque hay que resolver.


Psicológicamente esto desgasta muchísimo. Uno vive en un estado de alerta permanente. Dormimos mal, comemos mal y descansamos peor. A veces siento que mi mente nunca logra relajarse del todo, como si el cuerpo estuviera funcionando únicamente por obligación y costumbre.


Ayer tenía quirófano. Siete casos largos.
Desde que llegué me sentía extraña, demasiado cansada. Era como si hubiera salido de una guardia de veinticuatro horas, aunque no era el caso. Sentía el cuerpo lento y la mente pesada. Incluso realizando las cirugías me notaba más torpe, menos ágil, más lenta de lo normal. Y eso frustra muchísimo, porque cuando trabajas en algo donde otras personas dependen de ti, necesitas estar concentrada física y mentalmente.


Pero es difícil rendir bien cuando llevas días sin descansar correctamente, sin dormir con ventilador, despertando sudada, pendiente de la corriente, del agua, de la comida y de todo lo demás.
Mientras operaba pensaba precisamente en eso: en cómo nos estamos acostumbrando a sobrevivir agotados.

Y no debería ser normal.

No es humano vivir esperando una corriente que nunca llega. No es humano trabajar así, dormir así y sostener una vida entera bajo este nivel de estrés constante. Poco a poco uno siente que el cansancio deja de ser físico y comienza a instalarse también en el alma.


Aun así, seguimos levantándonos cada mañana. Seguimos trabajando, cocinando, resolviendo y buscando fuerzas de donde ya casi no quedan. Porque al final eso es lo que hace la gente aquí todos los días: resistir, incluso cuando ya se siente demasiado pesado.




# English Version 




There are kinds of exhaustion that do not disappear after a single night of sleep. Some fatigue settles into your mind, your body, and even the way you look at the day ahead. That was exactly how I felt yesterday, after more than 40 hours without electricity at home.


Every day the situation in my country feels more difficult. Just when you think things cannot get any worse, they do. We went from having six hours of electricity a day, then only three every twenty-four hours, and now barely two or three hours after thirty-five or more without power. There are no schedules anymore. You cannot organize your life. You never know when you will be able to cook, charge something, rest, or simply sit for a while under a fan.


The worst part is not only the heat or the darkness. It is the constant anxiety.

Living with the fear that the food inside the refrigerator is going bad. Opening the fridge carefully, trying to guess whether things are still safe to eat or not. Mentally calculating how much every item cost and feeling powerless while watching it spoil. Coming home exhausted after work and still having to cook with charcoal because there is no other option. The smoke, the heat, the sweat… and still continuing because there is no choice.


Psychologically, this wears you down so much. We live in a permanent state of alert. We sleep badly, eat badly, and rest even worse. Sometimes I feel like my mind never truly relaxes, as if my body is functioning only out of obligation and habit.
Yesterday I had surgery day at the operating room. Seven long cases.


From the moment I arrived, I felt strange, overwhelmingly tired. It felt as if I had just finished a twenty-four-hour shift, even though that was not the case. My body felt slow and my mind heavy. Even during the surgeries, I noticed myself being clumsier, less agile, slower than usual. And that is incredibly frustrating, because when you work in a profession where other people depend on you, you need to be physically and mentally focused.


But it is difficult to perform well when you have spent days without proper rest, without sleeping comfortably, waking up drenched in sweat, constantly worrying about electricity, water, food, and everything else.


While I was operating, I kept thinking about how we are slowly getting used to surviving while exhausted.

And that should not be normal.

It is not humane to live waiting for electricity that never comes. It is not humane to work like this, sleep like this, and carry an entire life under this level of constant stress. Little by little, the exhaustion stops being only physical and starts settling into the soul too.


Even so, we continue getting up every morning. We keep working, cooking, solving problems, and finding strength where there is barely any left. Because in the end, that is what people here do every single day: endure, even when everything already feels too heavy.

body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 50: Terror Below
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 50: Terror Below

-----

Meanwhile underground, the Empire’s enforcers had reached the cult underground city. With close to no resistance, the enforcers were able to force their way into the city.

Maskameera was with Angelo, who was still in a state of shock from what she revealed to him through the bones of the Linap he had been cloned from.

‘Come on, Angelo,’ urged Maskameera. ‘You need to be the real you. The force that is inside you cannot and must not be contained.’

‘No, I’m me,’ gasped Angelo. ‘I’m not him.’

‘I understand,’ sighed Maskameera. ‘It’s a process. Julio has constrained your true essence. I know that’s going to change soon.’

Angelo slowly started to pull himself off the ground.

Maskameera tilted her head back and sighed. ‘Do you hear that?’ she asked. ‘I think another important stage in your process has arrived.’

Distant gunshots could be heard, followed by faint crying and screaming.

‘Something’s wrong,’ said Angelo as he was about to make his way to the door. Maskameera grabbed him hard and slammed him against the wall.

‘You must wait this out for now,’ said Maskameera calmly. ‘The final product is what you must absorb.’

The enforcers were roaming the streets of the city shooting at whomever they saw. The senior enforcers commanded enforcers to enter all buildings and homes. The followers hid and became invisible. The enforcers fired their weapons inside buildings, causing as much chaos as possible. Many of the followers lost concentration and became visible. The enforcers shot some of them and dragged others onto the streets. They even targeted children. This forced their parents to become visible. Within a few hours, several hundred followers, mostly females and children, were on the streets. 

Maskameera had kept Angelo pinned against the wall in the temple the whole time. They could both hear the screams loudly echoing through the city.

‘If they come in here, they’ll want to hurt you,’ said Maskameera in a relaxed tone. ‘That just doesn’t work for me. I need you in tiptop condition.’

Captain Cecil had just arrived at the cult underground city. His enforcers escorted him down to the streets. He looked at the surviving followers, who were being tied to posts lining the streets.

‘Where’s the High Philosopher?’ asked Cecil.

‘He’s hiding in the temple,’ replied a senior enforcer. ‘We thought we’d save his capture and torture for you.’

‘That’s truly touching,’ said Cecil, patting the left side of his chest with his right hand. ‘Let’s pay him a visit.’

Cecil and two dozen enforcers went down to the temple. The enforcers, using a battering ram, smashed down the external door to the temple. All of them entered the first room of the temple. It was the room Angelo displayed his artwork.

‘Some of this art is really nice,’ commented a senior enforcer.

‘It’s all an illusion,’ said Cecil aggressively as he turned to the senior enforcer. ‘They’re evil, vile, disgusting terrorists, who must be eradicated.’ 

‘Yes, sir,’ replied the senior enforcer.

‘Next room,’ said Cecil.

Two enforcers entered the next room. A few seconds later, the others entered. It also appeared empty. 

‘This is very disappointing,’ shouted Cecil. ‘I expected so much more from the notorious High Philosopher.’

A cheerful tune began to play. 

‘That’s better,’ chuckled Cecil. ‘A little light entertainment before death. How thoughtful.’

‘That’s why I played it,’ replied Maskameera as she became visible at the doorway they had just entered through. ‘It sets the mood for such a joyous day.’

‘Who the hell are you?’ demanded Cecil. ‘Never mind, forget it, waste the bitch,’ he added as he turned to the enforcers.

Maskameera became invisible again.

‘Shoot now!’ shouted Cecil.

The enforcers opened fire. A few seconds later, one of the enforcers’ throats was slashed. Then within quick succession, enforcers were being brutally killed. Blood gushed everywhere. The remaining enforcers frantically panicked. They opened fire in the direction they thought Maskameera was in. Their response was late. She moved around the room killing them at will. 

In little over a minute, all twelve enforcers had been killed. Cecil was the only one left alive. Maskameera became visible again.

‘Let’s try this again,’ said Maskameera as she stared at Cecil, who was pressing his body against the wall in fear. ‘I want to work with you.’

‘You can’t escape,’ gasped Cecil. ‘My enforcers are everywhere.’

‘I don’t want to escape, silly,’ replied Maskameera as she crouched in front of a bloody corpse. ‘I’m having so much fun.’

‘Fine, I’ll work with you,’ said Cecil as he watched Maskameera sink her teeth into the corpse.

‘Goody!’ replied Maskameera. She stood back up again. ‘I want to reinvigorate our High Philosopher.’

Maskameera looked at the far corner of the room. ‘Come on, Angelo. We need to see your beloved followers,’ she said. ‘Cecil, kindly escort us into the city.’

‘You’ll hand him over to us,’ said Cecil as he edged closer to the door.

Maskameera grabbed Cecil by the throat and slammed him hard against the wall. ‘You’ll take what I allow you to take,’ she said as she pressed her tongue against his cheek. 

‘Yes, okay,’ mumbled Cecil as his eyes bulged in terror.

‘I’ll let you execute the followers,’ said Maskameera.

‘They’re terrorist scum,’ mumbled Cecil.

‘Don’t interrupt me or I’ll snap your face off!’ shouted Maskameera as she squeezed Cecil’s throat tighter.

Cecil groaned, and his face became redder.

‘I can’t spare the High Philosopher,’ continued Maskameera in a relaxed tone. ‘I’ll let you have the real brains of this outfit. He’s taking a really long nap downstairs.’

Maskameera tossed Cecil to the ground. She walked over to Angelo, who was still invisible. She was able to see him because she could see part of his silhouette. She grabbed him and slumped him over her shoulder. 

‘Get up!’ growled Maskameera. ‘Let’s go.’

Cecil and Maskameera entered the city streets together. The enforcers pointed their guns at them. 

‘Put them away,’ commanded Cecil. ‘No aggression needed.’

‘We’re just here to enjoy the show,’ replied Maskameera as she lowered Angelo off her shoulder.

‘Enforcers!’ called out Cecil as he pointed to the tied-up followers. ‘Torch the lot of them!’

‘No!’ shouted Maskameera. ‘You’ll ruin their meat.’

‘Halt!’ shouted Cecil.

‘Bleed them out and collect it,’ said Maskameera. ‘Our High Philosopher needs it to help trigger his senses.’

‘Slit their throats and collect the blood,’ said Cecil as he felt Maskameera’s claw caress his back.

The enforcers began to slit the throats of the followers tied to the poles. They used their helmets to collect the blood and fill the empty barrels they had found. Loud gasps of pain filled the air and echoed around the underground city.

‘Look! Listen! Smell!’ said Maskameera as she squeezed Angelo’s face. ‘You must absorb this atmosphere. It’s pure power.’

The slaughter continued for the next hour. Finally, the gasps of suffering had stopped. Despite the enforcers’ efforts to collect the blood, the streets were completely filled with it. 

Maskameera grabbed Angelo’s thick mane of blond hair and rubbed his face in the blood flowing down the street.

‘We have defeated the enemy,’ called out Cecil. ‘The vile terrorists who only seek to destroy us have been destroyed. We will return to a safer, freer world. Thanks to you.’

One of the dead children caught Cecil’s attention. ‘You are quite a prize,’ sniggered Cecil as he pulled out his phone to photograph the dead child. ‘I’ll cherish this.’

Angelo forced his face out from the blood. Maskameera could feel his strength had grown. He turned his head to stare at Cecil. The blood did not roll off his face. It strangely clung to it. His eyes briefly glowed red before returning to blue. Cecil felt a horrid sensation in his body. He desperately wanted to break eye contact with Angelo, but it took him several seconds for him to do so.

‘The mentor, Julio, we’ll take him now,’ said Cecil as he diverted his gaze to Maskameera, who was scooping blood off the ground and rubbing it on her body.

‘Sure,’ replied Maskameera. She grabbed Angelo by the arm. She led Cecil and around a dozen enforcers to the laboratory. Julio was lying on the examination table just as they had left him.

‘What’s wrong with him?’ asked Cecil as he raised one eyebrow while looking at Julio. ‘He better not be dead.’

‘He’s going through a beautiful transformation,’ replied Maskameera while shrugging her shoulders.

‘He’s still a disgusting terrorist who we’re going to publicly execute,’ chuckled Cecil.

Four enforcers picked up Julio and carried him out of the laboratory. Angelo stared at them. They could feel his gaze upon them. It was weird and unnerving.

‘You’re done here,’ said Maskameera. ‘Go back to your great Emperor and claim a glorious victory.’

‘If he’s not content, we will be back and far more dangerous,’ said Cecil as he stood in the doorway of the laboratory.

‘Oh please, don’t build my hopes up,’ sighed Maskameera, shaking her head.

Maskameera picked Angelo up and carried him back up to the temple. She placed him on his side of the glass wall and then shut him in. Lying on her side of Angelo’s dining table was the body of a young child. There was a note written next to the body. It read, ‘Enjoy dinner, freak’.

‘How rude,’ remarked Maskameera as she glanced up at Angelo. ‘They didn’t even season it.’

Angelo’s eyes glowed a fierce red. A strange rumbling sound began to emit from above him as if a storm were forming within the underground city.

‘That’s it, release your energy,’ mocked Maskameera. ‘Be the creature you were always born to be.’

body.title: [ENG/ESP] The value of hope. Daily 5-minute message / El valor de la esperanza. Mensaje diario de 5 minutos
body.body:
Hope is that tenuous but resistant thread that the world has not managed to break, even when wars, hatred and violence seem to take up too much space. In the midst of a wounded planet, where news sometimes weighs more than dawns, hope remains an act of courage. It is not naivety: it is a form of resistance. It is to believe that humanity can rediscover its light even when the shadow insists on imposing itself.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWp8v2uiKEbizAD1TWHUCsWa3bBvnuJ2ZXvPqki3LDojg/dsci0201.jpg)



Hope is born when we recognize that, despite everything, we continue to yearn for peace, love and noble feelings. That longing does not arise from emptiness: it arises from what has been lived, from what has been lost, from what still hurts. Those who have seen darkness know how to value clarity. That is why hope is not a luxury, but a spiritual necessity. It is the engine that allows us to get up, to reach out, to forgive, to rebuild, to imagine a different tomorrow.

In a fractured world, hope is also a compromise. It is not enough to desire peace: it must be cultivated in everyday life, in the way we speak, in the way we look at the other, in how we respond to conflict. Hope becomes real when it becomes a gesture, a word, an action. When we stop repeating the violence we criticize and begin to sow the tenderness we yearn for.

Sometimes hope seems small, almost fragile. But it is precisely in its fragility that its strength lies. Because a spark is enough to light a fire, a hug is enough to stop a fall, a gesture of kindness is enough to remind us that all is not lost. Hope is contagious: when someone holds it, others find the courage to hold it too.

I believe in a world where peace is not an exception, but a custom. Where love is not a refuge, but a path. Where noble feelings are not seen as weakness, but as the true measure of human greatness. And although that world does not yet fully exist, hope is the compass that guides us to it.

Hope is the art of holding on to love, to the best possible life and to permanent family commitment.

Here I owed them two tenths that summarize the value of hope for human beings.

Title: The Hope That Saves Me

In the midst of so much war  
hope rises,  
Like light that never scares  
that makes the earth fertile.  
Although hatred is banished  
with patience and love,  
A radiance is always born  
that defies pain,  
for the peace of every day  
it is built with courage.

Hope is the seed  
That resists in the storm,  
The voice that is never absent  
when the soul kneels.  
It's the strength that shines through us,  
the embrace that calls us,  
The truth that never ignites  
And the dream that sustains us,  
'Cause in the end it always comes  
the light that the world demands.

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.

The image is my property.





ESPAÑOL 

La esperanza es ese hilo tenue pero resistente que el mundo no ha logrado romper, aun cuando las guerras, el odio y la violencia parecen ocupar demasiado espacio. En medio de un planeta herido, donde las noticias a veces pesan más que los amaneceres, la esperanza sigue siendo un acto de valentía. No es ingenuidad: es una forma de resistencia. Es creer que la humanidad puede reencontrarse con su luz incluso cuando la sombra insiste en imponerse.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWp8v2uiKEbizAD1TWHUCsWa3bBvnuJ2ZXvPqki3LDojg/dsci0201.jpg)


La esperanza nace cuando reconocemos que, pese a todo, seguimos anhelando paz, amor y sentimientos nobles. Ese anhelo no surge del vacío: surge de lo vivido, de lo perdido, de lo que aún duele. Quien ha visto la oscuridad sabe valorar la claridad. Por eso la esperanza no es un lujo, sino una necesidad espiritual. Es el motor que nos permite levantarnos, tender la mano, perdonar, reconstruir, imaginar un mañana distinto.

En un mundo fracturado, la esperanza es también un compromiso. No basta con desear la paz: hay que cultivarla en lo cotidiano, en la forma en que hablamos, en cómo miramos al otro, en cómo respondemos al conflicto. La esperanza se vuelve real cuando se convierte en gesto, en palabra, en acto. Cuando dejamos de repetir la violencia que criticamos y empezamos a sembrar la ternura que añoramos.

A veces la esperanza parece pequeña, casi frágil. Pero es precisamente en su fragilidad donde reside su fuerza. Porque basta una chispa para encender un fuego, basta un abrazo para detener una caída, basta un gesto de bondad para recordarnos que no todo está perdido. La esperanza es contagiosa: cuando alguien la sostiene, otros encuentran el valor para sostenerla también.

Yo creo en un mundo donde la paz no sea excepción, sino costumbre. Donde el amor no sea refugio, sino camino. Donde los sentimientos nobles no sean vistos como debilidad, sino como la verdadera medida de la grandeza humana. Y aunque ese mundo aún no exista del todo, la esperanza es la brújula que nos guía hacia él.

La esperanza es el arte de aferrarse al amor, a la vida mejor posible y al compromiso familiar permanente.

Aquí les debía dos décimas que resumen el valor de la esperanza para los seres humanos.

Título: La esperanza que me salva

En medio de tanta guerra  
la esperanza se levanta,  
como luz que nunca espanta  
que vuelve fértil la tierra.  
Aunque el odio se destierra  
con paciencia y con amor,  
siempre nace un resplandor  
que al dolor desafía,  
pues la paz de cada día  
se construye con valor.

La esperanza es la semilla  
que resiste en la tormenta,  
la voz que nunca se ausenta  
cuando el alma se arrodilla.  
Es la fuerza que nos brilla,  
el abrazo que nos llama,  
la verdad que nunca inflama  
y el sueño que nos sostiene,  
porque al final siempre viene  
la luz que al mundo reclama.

La imagen es de mi propiedad.

Creo que no cumplido pero me falta informacion.\n* \

body.title: Learning From Pros
body.body: Learning is for free, if ... Yes, there's always an IF, a big one and it means different things in each case. Education is free in most countries, sponsored by the government (using your money of course), and some of the higher education is also free, if you're in the right country and you're good enough to qualify, but there are also other ways to free education, you just have to discover them. One of them is self education, although I don't like to use this word. You can learn on your own, there are plenty of opportunities. When I was a kid, enrolling in different courses was the way, if you wanted to learn something, but it's 2026, we have so many ways to do that without attending courses. One of the way I like to learn is watching others. Not peeping on others, don't get me wrong, what I mean is visiting exhibitions, especially photo exhibitions and studying the exhibited works. It's an inspiration for me, a huge one and also a cheap way to educate myself, especially if it's free, which is in most cases here. I would like to say I'm learning or trying to learn from other artists too, but without any talent, those are just dreams. Anyway, let's get on with the photos I want to show you today. ![Learning From Pros.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48VFtRXvfPyhwEi4RuHqEjiXD2i1grkb9CqC1jymnq8qYK3BXNKBCdtiUq9WYXyisA.jpg) The photos I'm going to show you today are from a solo exhibition I visited in February of Alpár Czire a very talented photographer who can teach you a thing or two, if you're interested. ![20260227_115806a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Ep3fjWKMhpLbPC7Qr4Eq4opcFRSrQ1yU8ycAWBCGWjtBCgRs7ehjfKWuZYJ3d7F76Dw.jpg) *Water Snake* This was one of the photographs that made me write down the idea in case I'm around shallow waters and can find some brave people to model for me. Maybe it's a good idea for @russia-btc for his next trip in Thailand 😂 Let's see if he can replicate the idea next time. ![20260227_115850a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8x2cswqMP2atF6VG8F9iJxeucJM5DABcQZAx7LAE98MUuU6NB7RYyuE3ecT9XmjxaZ.jpg) I love how he captured the water. Too bad I could not get a better photo from a better angle, but I hope you know what I mean. ![20260227_115902a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xAZf27jF1DDfuhcoonG7LLirv5bohfWvwCkYbiAz8bgq5jZ7E346VS5UJcqkbSDN6X9.jpg) *Childhood Written In Dust* Maybe this photo looks not so much attractive to some, compared to what shiny and fake photos are in vogue sometimes these days, but for me it's gold. Look at the smile on the little girl's face. That's a real reaction to the situation, not a fake smile practiced in front of the camera. That dusty car is a nice addition to the setup, not to mention the name written on the heart. Love it! If you can replicate this photo, please tag me :) ![20260227_115907a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uFYCsuH9LyQzAtTkAnYunQeoZJ82mkFz94peUb47DyV5RAUyZG82fZjzFDV4A92Ggeq.jpg) ![20260227_115948a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wqpX4A3ZF32QWsUAfiahJGa7g152AF4woAAvJUMRCRhepTb5FgkXjStJpQuhcMXpk4p.jpg) One of the things the photographer liked to photograph is people working, especially people from the countryside. Manual work is rare these days, everything is automated, so these artisans working are precious when it comes to photography. The top one is ruined by the light, but you see two men applying the horse shoe. The bottom one is a blacksmith. ![20260227_120006a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wX3CKfe6TK34wJtRz6xveTa5Fenno3k1oZFf2gfq1ebswoCX9HCeDoD3Cp6HGrBYhT9.JPG) My granddad used to take us to the blacksmith when we were kids and we watched him working. It was really interesting, because as a city kid, you don't see that kind of activity every day. The blacksmith passed away a couple of years ago, his son is still working, he's continuing his dad's work, but he's the last one in the village. ![20260227_120017a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xpAuuYuPf1JxdphXpTFS5ZjHujvN7eC2EbZwSx5P4b5yxjXVCZZd6YjytjEwS5cDYA1.jpg) Both photos are good, but the top one is an award winning in my eyes. The problem here was reflections, glare as always and height as well as the top one was way above my head and could not get a better shot. Anyway, the angry kid in the window of an old wooden house it just fantastic. As always, it's unfortunate there are people living in these conditions, but from photographic point of view, this is priceless. ![20260227_120029a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoGzMYR7y2Pjhw9nEfNNh4yhTG6G63WwQqgB24vgzfhNqApX6veQc7gTFSSsur3Sfvr.JPG) *Late Care* Yes, this is an activity that you do if you're heating with wood and chopping wood is not an activity for winter. I love the shot. ![20260227_120037a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23x1DFFygE1v88rVX9eVmujkudqn7VJ5nDPUHaoKFfpxEYrUig9VE64kEF3hczGusPSjD.jpg) *Indian Camp* The photos had some funny titles and I'm sure you can see why this one is called Indian camp :) (Indian as in Indian from the US, not India, if you didn't get it.) Needless to say, all the photos were black and white, which is an excellent choice when it comes to subjects like these. This is it for today, let me know which one is your favorite.

></center>

body.title: Is it worth it?
body.body:
<center>
**Chapter 7 Season 2 of Fortnite is nearly complete.**

---------------------------

I have been grinding to level 413 since it began March 19th 2026 and it ends on June 5th 2026, just 9 days away. Summer is almost here! What is next?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23xKxeDtrF6tsqDgKuftwLcm4nywTiJqDGER4vtcxwbVsG1wmEqzWWbLnm3sRDpGi9eqn.png)

On may 30th there is a community day event and we will have a chance to earn the Foundation workplace variant, wearing a tie. Keep up the good work!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23wC3C54ik2VSnEYEReNacBWWRFaGxn5Qa8uhc9yYTE75LH27NpSfuAnPKCUNddNMXiQp.png)

Overwatch showed up in the last mini-update, and I earned this MV-261 ORCA glider. When you jump off the battle bus, notice where this ship lands, and you can find guarenteed loot there, and can hire Mercy if you collect enough Gold.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23vho9BUiCqoh61DNLeny5dvLHCnfDfmZsDcpXQZoKS8XR7jVGrfTCaHQHzCik4hATjo3.png)

The Rivalry Showdown pits players against eachother in 1v1 battles during battle royale, revealing eachothers approximate location on the mini-map.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23w2qBa8dKWM1EQM9VMKgKNnUuA2WhNoNYXfQ9pWXqZoM9FfjhtoaB2qokUZdbDZ5aRtE.png)

I have been doing my part for the Foundation team. The season event will have different experiences for those on my team, vs team Ice King. What will it be?


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23tRzfziyXrXEKbJt1j4Xh5Q8MEFeouM8cZYfR2w3ghXyxbAUXQ4wrHkqrEcZtX9ETJqE.png)

Each day 31k XP is awarded for completing three quests. Complete 3 rivalries, buy weapons or services from the rival billboard, and win one rivalry. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/Eo8LyQRETMksSvQPeUedYh35Dy8ZRw3wyusbrHtNiW5juS2cesxonhf3NXPfJ91YgjR.png)

Add that to 75k XP bonus for completing three sets of Daily Quests, ranking up is simply a matter of showing up and grinding. You win some, you lose some, but try to do a little better each day. I never intended to become competitive...


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/EorznWViiomWn2oUyEPEhxiEfN6voS7DgsBAy2Q1wjRuSzdp1C5mzrkHdvb1N2HwEcd.png)

Searching the map for the final Chaos Cubes, I need to visit Squibbly Shores and Frigid Fortress today. Just two left, hiding somewhere I haven't been yet.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23xATtzgM3gy9JV2kPNvEvBWNXfTxtezEFL9YCSpd8MF1HciY26fLsbHsfPKi2yz5bS9r.png)

Somewhere near the beach, there must be one hiding.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23w2q4LteibaUc9LZ3FLYRr21ECgCHoczPWF1osR3c1NsecyTfgokXKgNofyBfpiQt4rR.png)

And another in the icey wilderness, perhaps in the south-west region.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/242NaaYz1o46oCpM3ivwkMC8hMVJ1cTimnYzXkMbpDT5z2tU4SmtDkBV9QXQFjpsiDJQo.png)

On May 30th is the Fortnite Championship Series duos finale. I will one day win money playing Fortnite, look at those prizes! $250,000 USD for 1st place!!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23wCE28thif9JMioyzF5GtsswTVQEqES2WeUW8WLxNZ1YiNWDnSfMdsbdvUmbtm2bJeFU.png)

Is it worth it? Could be. Could be.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23wC5VWUs9Lf2D2SddpChWVaBAwddhhrFuu5FYUo4PKJDeaYC2knZfkrmwavXzMrQQ7Px.png)

Either way I have fun playing Solo, Duo, Trio or Squads with my friends.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23yTmRJP7VWjEU85pT65TkDeKV1f3XP7r1BGrd85yJDnmAxcSotHLAqa1oPLeauQtCEaW.png)


-----------------------


If you play Fortnite, leave a comment with your username.
Post your wins here in the <a href=\
>What is so interesting about Fortnite?,

>Fortnite_community and use tags #FortniteOnHive! (Fortnite is free to play on PC or consoles, you can just visit https://fortnite.com to download the EPIC launcher. *Add DarkPylon* !) #ProofofWin ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23w2h7ZepLdUk7WaeVoyAmgfeWdPZkMFTn1MZ75gWSuBX86sJQGJEaYH6pFRURWmnERdJ.png) # **Join us on Epic Games, Fortnite is free!** -----------------------------

**A**s usual, I'll be speaking for myself in this post, and this will simply be my opinion about something I love to do. I'm making this clear at the beginning because generally everything I write is related to myself and how I approach and understand street photography. And since I do this in such an empirical and casual way, I wouldn't want anyone to take it as an absolutely true and unquestionable fact, which could cause disagreements. remains, like a quiet sentinel that shoots without thinking or understanding, just showing off and being consumed by some kind of intuition that even he finds difficult to explain. So you end up with the camera's memory card brimming with certain anarchies that scream in an unknown language, and when we confront them on the screen of the processing and editing software, we end up cropping indiscriminately, disregarding light and shadow, simply being \

that is looking and shooting without giving the mind time to say anything...\n\n>**C**omo de costumbre, hablaré por mi mismo este post y esto será simplemente mi opinión acerca de esto que tanto me gusta hacer, y hago esta aclaratoria al comienzo, porque generalmente todo lo que escribo tiene que ver conmigo mismo y con la manera como me relaciono y entiendo el hacer fotografías callejeras. Y dado que hago esto de manera tan empírica y a la ligera, no quisiera que fuese tomado por alguien como un hecho absolutamente cierto e incuestionable, cosa la cual podría causar discrepancias. Así que hoy quise aclarar que todo cuanto escribo es eso: Mi simple opinión, cosas que por lo general aplica solo a mi mismo... , y esto es algo cierto para mi, pues (y aquí es donde desarrollo esto que quería escribir hoy) muchas veces la cosa va más allá de la fotografía y el aspecto técnico pierde totalmente su relevancia, incluso lo \
desaparece y solo resta allí el \

como un quieto centinela que dispara sin pensar ni entender, solo presumiendo y siendo consumido por algún tipo de intuición que a él mismo le cuesta explicar. Entonces uno termina con la memoria del cámara repleta de ciertas anarquías que gritan en un idioma desconocido, y cuando nos enfrentamos a ellas en la pantalla del software de procesado y edición, terminamos recortando a mansalva, despreciando luces y sombras, simplemente siendo \

title.title: [PHOTO BLOG] ŚWIT NA PILSKU / DOWN ON PILSKO
title.body:
>  

Jedyne takie zdjęcia w mojej fotograficznej „karierze”. W sierpniu 2018 roku wybrałem się z rodzeństwem na wschód słońca na Pilsko. Bardzo spontaniczne wyjście, które zaplanowaliśmy przy grillu wieczorem i po jedynie 3 h snu wyruszyliśmy w drogę.

Sierpień wiąże się z ważnym wydarzeniem astronomicznym. Przez całą wędrówkę w ciemności co chwilę widzieliśmy wypalające się w ziemskiej atmosferze perseidy. Była to jednak moja pierwsza styczność z fotografowaniem takich zjawisk i szczerze mówiąc nie podołałem zadaniu. Nie udało mi się złapać choćby jednej smugi świetlnej pozostawianej przez meteory. 

*Polski szczyt Pilska osiągnęliśmy na długo przed wschodem słońca. Zaczynało dopiero świtać. Nie zamierzałem jednak czekać, aż światło naszej gwiazdy zacznie dominować na nieboskłonie. Rozstawiłem sprzęt i zrobiłem kilka zdjęć krajobrazu z długim czasem naświetlania.*

***

### Dawn at the top of Pilsko.

The only such photos in my photographic \

. In August 2018, I went with my siblings to the sunrise in Pilsko. A very spontaneous outing, which we planned at the barbecue in the evening and after only 3 hours of sleep we set off on the road. August is associated with an important astronomical event. Throughout the journey in the dark, we saw perseids burning out in the earth's atmosphere every now and then. However, this was my first contact with photographing such phenomena and, to be honest, I did not do the task. I didn't manage to catch even one streak of light left by the meteors. *We reached the Polish peak of Pilska long before sunrise. It was just beginning to dawn. However, I was not going to wait for the light of our star to dominate the sky. I set up the equipment and took some pictures of the landscape with a long exposure time.* ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZTtiaK4237DoysbMyWHeJBkqmFvQFVvghkDuQqTp6q4P/img_9802.jpg) Nisko nad horyzontem robiło się już jasno. Pojawiły się też bardzo ciekawe kolory. Wyższa część nieba była jednak wciąż ciemna emanując głębokie i mocno kontrastowe chłodne tony. Bardzo lubię tę porę dnia, jednak niestety nie zdarza mi się wtedy fotografować. Czekam niecierpliwie na rozpoczęcie sezonu obłoków srebrzystych (NLC), które pojawiają się nad horyzontem właśnie w tym czasie i motywują dodatkowo do wyjścia w plener. > Low above the horizon, it was already getting clear. There were also very interesting colors. However, the higher part of the sky was still dark, emanating deep and strongly contrasting cool tones. I really like this time of day, but unfortunately I don't happen to take pictures then. I'm looking forward to the start of the silver cloud season (NLC), which appear over the horizon at this time and additionally motivate to go outdoors. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVd4TmVq5VarVhcofL1qohHa4ozaTYQA74kVLRWZBdP3H/img_9801.jpg) Najciekawszą częścią tej scenerii była dla mnie ciemna sylwetka Babiej Góry na tle jaśniejącego horyzontu. Celowo zrobiłem zbliżenie na królową Beskidów żeby zachować ten bardzo ciekawy pejzaż na cyfrowej kliszy. To właśnie przedstawia drugie zdjęcie. **Kolory świtu to kontrast pomiędzy ciepłymi a chłodnymi tonacjami nieba. To świetna pora do prób stworzenia zdjęć o balansujących się nawzajem zakresach tonacji, znajdujących się po przeciwnych stronach koła barw. Właśnie takie zestawienia przeciwnych tonacji uwarza się za jedne z najlepszych połączeń nie tylko w fotografii, ale i w każdej innej dziedzinie sztuk wizualnych. Od grafiki komputerowej, aż po malarstwo.** *Moim faworytem od zawsze jest połączenie pomarańczu z niebieskim.* > The most interesting part of this scenery for me was the dark silhouette of Babia Góra against the background of the bright horizon. I deliberately made a close-up of the queen of the Beskids to keep this very interesting landscape on the digital film. This is what the second photo shows. >**The colors of the dawn are a contrast between the warm and cool tones of the sky. This is a great time to try to create photos with balancing tone ranges, located on opposite sides of the color wheel. It is precisely such combinations of opposing tones that are one of the best combinations not only in photography, but also in any other field of visual arts. From computer graphics to painting.** > *My favorite has always been the combination of orange and blue.*
![KPLINEGAL2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23wW7yT4enYohesd8oh6QxhC3ECEQne5E7g2DryPYpxf2fqfMY8oFPbsL2TachijBPMpk.png)
Sprzęt / Equipment: Nikon d7100 + Nikkor 18-55
Post-produkcja / Edited In: Adobe Lightroom Classic
Lokalizacja / Location: Pilsko
Pora dnia / Time of the day: Świt/ Down

![KPLINEGAL2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23wW7yT4enYohesd8oh6QxhC3ECEQne5E7g2DryPYpxf2fqfMY8oFPbsL2TachijBPMpk.png)
Wszystkie zdjęcia i teskty są mojego autorstwa. Dziękuję Wam za wizytę i zapoznanie się z nimi. All pictures and texts are my own work. Thank you for stopping by and checking them out.

title.title: A steady journey like a river: inspiration to never lose courage, My Actifit Report Card: May 27 2026
title.body:
How are you all? I hope everyone is well and finding some peace and stability amidst the busyness of life. Today I would like to share some feelings with everyone based on a deeply meaningful and inspiring saying— “Do not lose courage, because the river that comes out of the mountain does not ask anyone on the road how far the sea is.” The more you think about this saying, the more you feel that life is actually an endless journey. There is no chance of stopping here, and there is no need for anyone else’s permission. When a river is born from the bosom of the mountain, its path is not easy. It has to break rocks, cut through mountains, and overcome many bends. But the most important thing is—the river never stops. It never sits and thinks about how far its destination is. It just moves forward, at its own natural pace, at its own pace. This river also has a deep similarity with our lives. We all walk with some goal or the other. But it is natural to encounter obstacles on this path. Sometimes failure, sometimes disappointment, and sometimes uncertainty want to stop us. Then many lose courage and lose faith in themselves. But the truth is, these difficult times make us the strongest. Just as a river does not stop in front of obstacles and finds a new path, so too do we have to find new ways in life. Each obstacle teaches us how to move forward more firmly. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/35987174-ebf1-40e9-b7cb-df90bb647079.jpg) Many times we get tired of just thinking about the destination. It seems like the goal is far away. But what is really important is to move forward one step at a time. Because small steps eventually lead to great success. The story of this river teaches us an important lesson—in life, we should not think too much about the destination, but have faith in our journey. Because the journey is what builds us, strengthens us, and transforms us. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/88aa89b0-b54a-4096-8be4-ef87c5f9acdd.jpg) So whenever fatigue comes in life, when disappointment surrounds us, remember this river. Remember, you also have that same strength within you—which does not let you stop, but rather takes you forward. In the end, it can be said that life is not a static place; It is a flowing river. And like this river, we too must move forward, constantly, fearlessly.

title.title: Steaks with onions and garlic [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Esta vez voy a compartir una receta tan sencilla como deliciosa: Bistec encebollado al ajillo. Este plato tiene un sabor increíble. El ajo y el perejil fresco se combinan para crear un sabor espectacular. Y lo mejor de todo es que a toda la familia le encanta: es muy fácil de preparar y combina a la perfección con un buen plato de arroz, pasta, verduras al vapor o el acompañante que prefieras. Espero que les guste y se animen a prepararlo. ¡Aquí te la dejo paso a paso! >This time I’m going to share a recipe that’s as simple as it is delicious: Garlic-Onion Steak. This dish tastes incredible. The garlic and fresh parsley combine to create a spectacular flavor. And best of all, the whole family loves it: it’s very easy to make and pairs perfectly with a nice plate of rice, pasta, steamed vegetables, or whatever side dish you prefer. I hope you like it and feel inspired to make it. Here’s the step-by-step guide!
![Delicious rice with chicken and smoked bacon (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23ynYVgNqHwPrQ1Kfnr3fNYLUi2rRkifwey3AEg3AuzwsMWKKrEZ3VFFsTND1qJJCx7vt.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

>
El primer paso de esta sencilla receta es limpiar los bistecs y sazonarlos con sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo, cúrcuma, paprika y vinagre. Déjalos marinar durante media hora. >The first step in this simple recipe is to clean the steaks and season them with salt, pepper, garlic powder, turmeric, paprika, and vinegar. Let them marinate for half an hour.
![Delicious coriander pasta.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23uFcDkmS24HsTGCrjZwE1vmdpkfhxY5Quie7jKZVXzJA7CCWFamTb5b8Amz5eLruKzG9.png)

>
En una sarten colocamos el aceite y cuando caliente añadimos los bistecs, freímos dandóle la vuelta varias veces hasta que estén tirnos y dorados. >Heat the oil in a skillet, and when it's hot, add the steaks; fry them, turning them several times, until they're tender and golden brown.
![Delicious coriander pasta (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23xpALfmerJas8mvFmSEtJ1GYARKQcTNARX1bRriYG4pzHUktMu9oNsA5jqstwzff14VM.jpg)

>
Saca los bistecs de la sartén y añade la mantequilla y un poco de aceite a la misma sartén para evitar que la mantequilla se queme. Añade las cebollas, cortadas en aros, y rehógalas; a continuación, añade el perejil picado, seguido del ajo triturado, y cocina a fuego lento durante unos segundos. >Remove the steaks from the pan, then add the butter and a little oil to the same pan to prevent the butter from burning. Add the onions, sliced into rings, and sauté them; then add the chopped parsley, followed by the minced garlic, and cook over low heat for a few seconds.
![Delicious coriander pasta (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23xpB6279vr3vXjHbt9kuj2P7pSLLGyDefhCNqVJ3j81f3A7cnKSA4uipPgNxDZVhMJMn.jpg)

>
A continuación, añade los bistecs, remueve y cocina durante dos minutos más hasta que los sabores se hayan mezclado. >Next, add the steaks, stir, and cook for two more minutes until the flavors have blended.
![![IMG_0410.jpeg](httpsfiles.peakd.comfilepeakd-hivetheresa16Eoc8vyvjE8LS38PW6iXdWCmxcxAVz8PkeLW4VHvVixiEBHUx8MUmNG9gD4JRaYAYCH1.jpeg) (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23u69Y5wUqNF2gUTVmCFQYewgsTDDdtH2wde31S7Ac5jkmMRK96LvBpLVqtQeqBEfNk9F.png)

>
Y ya estás listo para disfrutar de unos bistecs deliciosos y lleno de sabor. ¡Buen provecho! >And now you're all set to enjoy some delicious, flavorful steaks. Bon appétit!
![![IMG_0410.jpeg](httpsfiles.peakd.comfilepeakd-hivetheresa16Eoc8vyvjE8LS38PW6iXdWCmxcxAVz8PkeLW4VHvVixiEBHUx8MUmNG9gD4JRaYAYCH1.jpeg) (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23zkk7Q7b5zr8F5fQDFh1oqtAHN8fygNRejLoRRNXdfmNVC4J9hdFpdQ55Pu7NsccVjgy.png) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif)

Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Satriyakaal to all Hive users. Today, I'll tell you that the final solution to tension is death. All of us know that tension is in everybody's life, but tension is not like that it will get my favourite vegetable for dinner at night, it's funny. There is a little difference between thoughts and tension, and tension is an upgraded level of overthinking, but we should also not overthink because it leads to tension and anxiety in long term and most of the people think that they have tensions in their life and even a student thinks that he has a tension but, tension at a low age is a joke because only a few of the people in the society have the load of family and earning at a low age, specially the people who lost their parents or they are orphan at a low age and this is also a matter of tension because when there is no to take care of one, or one has the tension and load of whole family on him then, it is the matter of high tension because that is not confirmed that the person get the food for the day or not or his family would remain hungry for the whole day.

But that's not the tension, but it's the high level of overthinking and anxiety. Once, there was a boy who was preparing for selection in the Indian army, but he gave the exam 2 times, and now the 2nd result was going to come.

So, overthinking can mislead a person to this level, but we should not take overthinking and tensions much, and we should be chill and calm and should know how to handle every situation at every difficulty level because anything can happen anytime, I can  also not say  that my next blog will come tommorrow or will come ever. body.title: Late May and Allotment coming on...
body.body:
We've had a scorching few days here in the UK just gone, apparently 9 people died in the 'heatwave' across three days, in water related incidents. 

We aired on the side of safety with the plants and opted to not plant anything out in the super heat, we're just starting today now it's back down to 20s and not in the 30s! 

So here's the allotment as is..

### Brassicas 

These have come on nicely since last post about 10 days ago, planted with PLENTY of compost and all it takes is a good slug of water every day in the heat!

![20260526_065048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EopsRP28F2SRwxxhQskLn3W8pmL4RniRV5XW3DComDuyHZ2gmCbX1moMpMh8uW81uPB.jpg)

### Lettuce

Lettuce seem to like it here, simple but we'll use it! 

The Mizuna not doing so well. 


![20260526_064743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EoyPaGwQdrREC81Fki1DddesupmPtRTC3wBzS2VEiD9TF5m7XeHCWcZCeknMuw7Mo7V.jpg)

### Sweet Peas 

Just starting out, well mulched for this heat, should do fine! 

![20260526_065029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EoK6MiUkkyP2fu9hp5B9vyk25Ubw1qLCc4NoHz88Zd7CVCGHCnuqCbZc532ZSSfpEHj.jpg)

### And the broad beans...

Doing nicely, we do have aphids, I've pinched out where the lower pods have formed, but that's not all the plants, and sprayed. 


![20260526_064738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EopsxWnJb5y5jpEDTtA8NfAW25EvzeZKvFpeRtEY3vCsQ1VdGErL4fwLvqrnDZTt7Kn.jpg)

I am gonna get these planted in Autumn this year, then they're more fully developed before aphid season so you can pinch out earlier! 

### And next...

I've been digging this steadily, just 20 mins every evening, any luck it'll be fully planted by this coming weekend! 

![20260526_064644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EogMoYhYC9uELgWSPAQoVejwwr1Yka9NgQiY54oES3NqCtEkRdN9fNKc8xJt7eymnFu.jpg)

### Final thoughts...


Fingers crossed and next post I do towards the end of next week this plot will be FULL!

body.body:

---

Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also very well by the grace of God. Today I will introduce you to a fun game. The name of the game is Bridge Race. So Let's get started.

Bridge Race is a fun and fast-paced mobile game where players have to build bridges by collecting blocks of different colors. The main goal of the game is to build bridges before other competitors and reach the destination. Due to its easy controls and colorful graphics, the game has become very popular with both young and old.

When the game starts, a different color is assigned to each player. The player has to collect blocks of his own color and use those blocks to build stairs or bridges. The faster the blocks can be collected, the faster it will be possible to move forward. However, not only speed is important here, but also strategy. Because other players are also competing at the same time and can sometimes block your path.

Bridge Race has a variety of levels, which gradually become more challenging. Each level features new designs, larger maps, and more competitors. Players can unlock new skins, characters, and customizations as they play the game, which makes the game more interesting.

The most fun aspect of the game is its competitive atmosphere. The joy of beating others and reaching the finish line quickly encourages players to play the game again and again. Additionally, the game is easy to play in your spare time due to its short matches.

Overall, Bridge Race is an entertaining and addictive game that combines quick decision-making, strategy, and the excitement of competition. It could be a great choice for those who like casual mobile games.

👉Thumbnail source : Captured by me during the gameplay.

Thanks for watching the video.

@likhon420

---
