Hola amigos de #hive y en espacial ala comunidad de @music-community , como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. En el día de hoy paso por acá para traerles un cover de la canción \
del mexicano Carlos Rivera, un hermoso tema musical que fue el protagonista en la película de \

.






Está canción que les traigo hoy, es una canción que nos habla de las despedidas pero también de los recuerdos a través de la música. Esta canción en sí, no es más que una promesa de no olvidar a los que se han ido, en este caso la música pasa a ser el vehículo que une el presente y el pasado y la ausencia la presencia.






Esta es una canción que nos muestra que los momentos compartidos trascienden a través de las distancias y el tiempo. Esta hermosa y a la vez conmovedora canción, llega silenciosa a casa a cada rincón del pecho, dónde llega para quedarse. Yo sin más amigos, los dejo con este cover y espero que puedan ver y disfrutar de él. Saludos para todos y bendiciones miles.

Hello, friends of #hive, and especially the @music-community . As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to share a cover of the song “Recuérdame” by Mexican singer Carlos Rivera—a beautiful track that was featured in the movie “Coco.”



![1000255015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/242NuvMCN8tP6HSfQhqUCm7TRwCZWJSoBxx6hN6HTr5bt541ZSkobf1fGYxyc9kLLno4w.jpg)




The song I’m sharing with you today is one that speaks to us about goodbyes, but also about memories through music. This song itself is nothing more than a promise not to forget those who have left us; in this case, music becomes the vehicle that bridges the present and the past, and absence and presence.




![1000255016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/EprWYkfGkagi8nZeWpUVznLcBnQ8YANupS9gFwgvpG4GA41NCHnrx5FdW8kBUosw3EU.jpg)



This is a song that shows us that shared moments transcend distance and time. This beautiful and at the same time moving song quietly finds its way into every corner of the heart, where it stays. Without further ado, friends, I leave you with this cover and hope you can watch and enjoy it. Greetings to all and a thousand blessings.





![1000255014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/242YJjtryV1mWJhdprkmFhCkiA3rjQbE9FrSnvw2k3axCbiJJZDU14xtyF8baaaEPWmYu.jpg)

Está canción que les traigo hoy, es una canción que nos habla de las despedidas pero también de los recuerdos a través de la música. Esta canción en sí, no es más que una promesa de no olvidar a los que se han ido, en este caso la música pasa a ser el vehículo que une el presente y el pasado y la ausencia la presencia.






Esta es una canción que nos muestra que los momentos compartidos trascienden a través de las distancias y el tiempo. body.title: La canción terminada - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
La canción finalmente fue terminada, algo que fue todo un reto, pero nunca se rindieron hasta el final. Al salir del estudio el clima estaba frío, las calles húmedas y solas aun así la banda tenía que seguir caminando. Michelle llevaba una chaqueta sobre los hombros para el frío, Lucas caminaba muy lento, ya que tenía dolor en sus dedos mirando sus dedos, Dani tenía las manos rojas de tanto de golpear la batería durante horas, y Stewie seguía grabando, pero a la vez revisando el archivo de esa canción final. Al llegar al hotel uno de los productores portugueses les envió un mensaje que recibió, con respecto a la canción terminada, donde fue enviada a un pequeño grupo de personas de la industria musical europea y la aceptaron. Michelle se le quitó el frío de inmediato, Stewie sonrió por primera vez y comentó —Les dije que no vinimos hasta Portugal por un minuto de canción— >The song was finally finished—a real challenge, but they never gave up until the very end. When they left the studio, it was cold outside, the streets were damp and deserted, yet the band had to keep walking. Michelle had a jacket draped over her shoulders to ward off the cold; Lucas walked very slowly because his fingers were sore; Dani’s hands were red from pounding the drums for hours; and Stewie kept recording while also reviewing the final version of the song. # >When they arrived at the hotel, one of the Portuguese producers sent them a message regarding the finished song, which had been sent to a small group of people in the European music industry and accepted. Michelle felt the cold leave her immediately; Stewie smiled for the first time and remarked, “I told you we didn’t come all the way to Portugal for just a minute of a song—” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRfQQmWtCHHNrSDfbWK9S6P1YoTkJx67GN6LdpUn6KTqY/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tambores-m%C3%BAsica-7060428/) A la mañana siguiente todos regresaron al estudio, donde antes había cansancio y ahora había emoción y mucho más trabajo por hacer. En ese momento de los productores se reunió con la banda y les dijo —La discográfica quiere el videoclip inmediatamente—Todos se quedaron sorprendidos, ya que nunca habían hecho algo como eso, pero eso era la parte más importante de todos ese trabajo por Portugal. Horas después apareció el camarógrafo con muchos equipos e ideas para ese proyecto, peor antes le tocó escuchar la canción y comentó —La canción tiene fuerza por eso el videoclip debe sentirse como una batalla contra el tiempo— cada miembro de la banda opinó, comenzando desde una carretera vacía bajo una tormenta. Luego el fotógrafo añadió que el final fuera en un antiguo teatro abandonado para darle un toque distinto y en ese momento Stewie dio un paso adelante y dijo —Perfecto, entonces grabaremos ahí— >The next morning, everyone returned to the studio, where exhaustion had once reigned but was now replaced by excitement and a lot more work to be done. At that moment, the producer met with the band and told them, “The record label wants the music video right away.” Everyone was surprised, since they had never done anything like that before, but that was the most important part of their entire tour of Portugal. # >Hours later, the cameraman showed up with a lot of equipment and ideas for the project, but first he had to listen to the song and commented, “The song has power, so the music video should feel like a race against time.” Every member of the band shared their thoughts, starting with an empty highway in the middle of a storm. Then the photographer added that the ending should take place in an old abandoned theater to give it a unique touch, and at that moment Stewie stepped forward and said, “Perfect, then we’ll film there.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3KMx7j2b2tgQarRH1hSBqi4cro9oWQvhUw7inM8H8Je/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/gente-hombre-chico-camar%C3%B3grafo-2568887/) Esa misma noche comenzaron las primeras tomas, donde la Banda 17 disfrutaba de cada segundo y a la vez las cámaras estaban haciendo su trabajo. Michelle corría cantando bajo la lluvia que había creado, Lucas tocaba la guitarra encima de un carro, Dani golpeaba la batería rodeado de humo y fuego, mientras decenas de personas veían ese trabajo que estaba haciendo. Todos estaban concentrados y cuanto más avanzaba la noche, la canción y el videoclip, la Banda entendió que era el inicio de algo muy grande y todavía faltaba grabar la escena final. >That very night, filming began, with Banda 17 relishing every second while the cameras rolled. Michelle ran and sang in the rain she had created, Lucas played guitar on top of a car, and Dani pounded the drums surrounded by smoke and fire, all while dozens of people watched them at work. Everyone was focused, and as the night, the song, and the music video progressed, the band realized this was the beginning of something very big—and they still had to shoot the final scene.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
**Post de Risingstar**

body.title: Plantains Stuffed with Ground Beef and Yogurt (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> My lunch today was a delicious boiled plantain stuffed with ground beef, served with yogurt sauce. I liked this recipe because it combines protein, carbohydrates, and a tangy condiment like yogurt. I had these ingredients on hand and decided to try this combination, confident that the flavors would go well together.
![1000117542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgUDYDCczsYsksN6reHGCZ9dLVkBiHSRqGQAXtC4JDEruUmgUM1gWejHmgvzmpxV7pt.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 200 grams of ground beef - 6 sweet peppers - 2 onions - 1 carrot - 1 plantain - Yogurt - Salt to taste - 2 cups of water
![1000117534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAXvHMwziBwD93stFj85FnBLa6pinYjwvWqmhChT5wVb6hAZ4Qr2CxJTCAfMCr1PAmn.jpg)
![1000117531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23x16fUf6PVdVgkNvsCCj9jCRd3KFq8dS4KxN41ENfMbZqxkL77uZmG3EcLm8pPPWR3oo.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the herbs and the carrot. Then I cut the chili peppers in half and removed the seeds, slicing them into strips, which I then chopped into small pieces. Shortly after, I peeled the outer layers of the onions, made flower-shaped cuts, and then chopped them into small pieces. I did the same with the carrot, after peeling it first.
![1000117537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhyofHSaGwfkYJefe9qygxVGKCbYgPaon3r4bnHuFuhUaHBtbSXFeAXzxQq2is4TDhq.jpg)
From there, I heated a skillet with a little oil, added the herbs, carrots, and meat; this time I wanted to mix everything together so the flavors would blend from the start. Then I adjusted the salt and poured in half a cup of water so everything would cook perfectly. In about 15 minutes, it was ready.
![1000117540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xVKT6ETUALnKrN1cYW14HatEWpoBnrcJcmRSNfg84mfEMeZJgN56NwU75ZjX7a56E2m.jpg)
Then, in a separate pot with two cups of water, I started boiling the plantain; to do this, I cut it into three pieces and peeled it. I also added a pinch of salt. After fifteen minutes, I checked with a fork to make sure each piece was tender. I removed them from the water, let them cool for a while, cut the plantain pieces in half, and placed a generous portion of ground beef inside each one. As a bonus, I added yogurt—a touch of acidity that brought out the flavor of this dish, a combination I loved. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Mi almuerzo de hoy fue un delicioso plátano sancochado relleno con carne molida, acompañado con salsa de yogurt. Me gustó esta receta porque combina proteína, carbohidrato y un aderezo ácido como el yogurt. Tenía estos ingredientes y decidí realizar esta combinación con la certeza de que los sabores son compatibles.
![1000117542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wgUDYDCczsYsksN6reHGCZ9dLVkBiHSRqGQAXtC4JDEruUmgUM1gWejHmgvzmpxV7pt.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 200 gramos de carne molida - 6 ajíes dulces - 2 cebollas - 1 zanahoria - 1 plátano - Yogurt - Sal al gusto - 2 tazas de agua
![1000117534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAXvHMwziBwD93stFj85FnBLa6pinYjwvWqmhChT5wVb6hAZ4Qr2CxJTCAfMCr1PAmn.jpg)
![1000117531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23x16fUf6PVdVgkNvsCCj9jCRd3KFq8dS4KxN41ENfMbZqxkL77uZmG3EcLm8pPPWR3oo.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los aliños y la zanahoria. Luego dividí los ajíes a la mitad y quité las semillas, corté en tiras, las cuales se transformaron en pequeños pedazos. Poco después quité las primeras capas de las cebollas, hice incisiones en forma de flor y luego corté en fragmentos pequeños. Hice lo mismo con la zanahoria, luego de retirar previamente su concha.
![1000117537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhyofHSaGwfkYJefe9qygxVGKCbYgPaon3r4bnHuFuhUaHBtbSXFeAXzxQq2is4TDhq.jpg)
De allí pasé a montar un sartén con un poco de aceite, agregué los aliños, las zanahorias y la carne, esta vez quise mezclar todo para que se integraran los sabores desde el principio. Luego ajusté el punto de sal y vertí media taza de agua para que se cocinara todo perfectamente. En unos 15 minutos estaba listo.
![1000117540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xVKT6ETUALnKrN1cYW14HatEWpoBnrcJcmRSNfg84mfEMeZJgN56NwU75ZjX7a56E2m.jpg)
Luego, en una olla aparte, con dos tazas de agua, coloqué a sancochar el plátano, para ello lo corté en tres pedazos y le retiré la cáscara. Agregué además un punto de sal. En quince minutos, corroboré con un tenedor que cada porción estuviera blanda. Retiré del agua, esperé que se enfriaran un rato, dividí los trozos de plátano a la mitad, allí coloqué una porción sustanciosa de carne molida. Como un plus le añadí yogurt, un toque ácido que resaltó el sabor de esta plato, una combinación que me encantó.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: One day at The Time
body.body: >Pintar cuando todo cuesta el doble, vamos a hablar sobre la resistencia en punta de mata.
>Un saludo principalmente a todos los panas que forman parte de la comunidad. ‎

>Hoy vengo escribiendo desde pecho con las manos todavía un poco sucias de la última pintura y conservando el desgaste de quien patea la calle absolutamente todos los días, estas calles de Oriente caliente.

> > * * * > > * * * > > _Los que vivimos aquí sabemos que la realidad no es una mantequilla y en las últimas semanas esta situación económica se ha vuelto a apretar en el bolsillo de una forma que a veces asfixia._

>Ir hasta la bodega por algo básico como una harina arroz o un pedacito de queso pero los precios de verdad que parecieran que tienen alas propias ya que suben antes de que puedas alcanzarlos lo que ayer costaba algo o ya requiero un esfuerzo extra y no hablo solamente de la comida para lo que nos guste el arte urbano o el deporte como el skateboarding se nos ha vuelto un acto de resistencia pura mantener activa nuestras pasiones.

‎ ‎ Un spray aún o un simple rodamiento para mi patineta ahora se sienten como si fuesen unos artículos de lujo y toca dividirme entre comparar material para plasmar una idea en una pared o asegurarme una comida en el día y esta es una balanza con la que muchos de nosotros lidiamos en silencio. ‎

>Pero la calle no se rinde y Nosotros tampoco! > Frente a estos panorama siempre hay dos acciones es quedarse cruzado de brazos esperando que las cosas cambien solas o salir a la calle a buscar la forma de que cambien y yo elegiré siempre la segunda opción ya que esta crisis te obliga a ser creativo de manera que nunca imaginaste Si antes necesitabas $5 para comprar una lata de spray hoy necesitas 10 y nos toca resolver con una sola lata usando las mismas válvulas de fábrica y apoyándome en la pintura de caucho que rinde más y si no piensas de la patineta me falla pues se limpia se elija y se le echa aceite para que siga rodando hasta que no dé más.

>El graffiti y el skate me han enseñado lecciones de vida muy claras desde el primer día si le cae te sacude el polvo y te vuelve a levantar la calle no te regalará nada porque cada truco cuesta caídas y cada pared requiere constancia esa misma mentalidad es la que aplico cuando la economía aprieta porque no nos vamos a rendir y tampoco vamos a dejar que las circunstancias apaguen el color de nuestras paredes ni detengan el rodar de nuestras patinetas.

\n\n*

>En medio de toda esta complejidad contar un espacio y como el blockchain es una bendición y una herramienta de lucha real para muchos creadores en Venezuela porque esto no es solamente una red social Para pasar al rato en una vía de café económico y un puente directo con un mundo que valora Nuestro esfuerzo cada una de las publicaciones cada uno de los votos junto a cada palabra de aliento que recibo de la comunidad internacional se transforman en la fuerza que necesito para seguir comprando pintura para mantener mi tabla activa para seguir demostrando que a pesar de las dificultades aquí en punta de mata sigue creciendo un arte de calidad.

\n\n

>A todos esos hermanos que me leen de distintas partes de Venezuela y del mundo a eso que están pasando por momentos duros le quiero decir que no dejen de existir que el valor de lo que hacemos no se mide en el dinero que cueste el material sino en la pasión y el mensaje que traemos punto de mata sigue en pie.

\n\n‎
body.author: fonestreet

body.title: Después de una pausa retomo la construcción y se vienen mejoras en mi casa (Esp-Eng)
body.body: > ![BANNER HIVE BIENVENIDA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ancnoticias/23xoymWQCZ3bfy56X8hW9JkhTFGAjA3gt7HP1nDzG1E83NEPKRqUSg8Q2GxqfcHJAVtPm.jpg) ![separador png.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ancnoticias/23tbEsFFCt22wPThoHX6iQjdaaqBhdtPkEua1cg43gZFqg91pEb8JEBTRouNJwr9w4d23.png) Saludos mi gente de @homesolutions. Poco a poco nuevamente retomando los trabajos en la casa. Los que me siguen desde hace tiempo saben que ya venía mostrando parte del proceso de construcción, pero sinceramente todo se había quedado un poco paralizado por muchas cosas personales, entre ellas el nacimiento de mi hija, que obviamente pasó a ser la prioridad más grande de mi vida. Entre trabajo, responsabilidades y el cansancio del día a día, tocó poner algunas cosas en pausa, aunque las ganas de seguir construyendo nunca desaparecieron. >Greetings to my friends at @homesolutions. I'm slowly getting back to work on the house. Those of you who have been following me for a while know that I've been sharing parts of the construction process, but honestly, everything had to be put on hold due to many personal things, including the birth of my daughter, who obviously became the biggest priority in my life. Between work, responsibilities, and the daily grind, I had to put some things on hold, although the desire to keep building never disappeared.

> Pero bueno, aquí vamos otra vez, avanzando, aunque sea poco a poco, porque al final lo importante es no detenerse completamente. En la segunda habitación ya por fin logré colocar el techo, y ahorita estoy en la etapa de rellenar y nivelar el terreno para después echar el piso. Gracias a Dios me regalaron una tierra para relleno y eso me ayudó muchísimo, porque los que han construido saben que cualquier ayuda en materiales o en algo de terreno se agradece demasiado. Así que ahí voy, acomodando todo con paciencia para que quede bien. >But anyway, here we go again, making progress, even if it's little by little, because in the end, the important thing is not to stop completely. In the second room, I finally managed to put up the roof, and right now I'm in the stage of filling and leveling the ground before laying the floor. Thank God someone gave me some fill dirt, and that helped me a lot, because those who have built know that any help with materials or even just a bit of land is greatly appreciated. So, I'm getting there, patiently arranging everything so that it turns out well.

> También estoy adelantando otra área nueva de la casa donde irá el baño principal, ya que el otro baño quedó dentro de mi habitación principal y hacía falta otro espacio más cómodo para la casa. Por ahora estoy acondicionando el terreno y preparando todo. Solo me falta hacer una viga de arrastre para ya comenzar a pegar ladrillos y darle forma de verdad a esa parte, y aunque a veces uno siente que avanza lento, cuando miro hacia atrás me doy cuenta de que sí se ha hecho bastante. >I'm also making progress on another new area of ​​the house where the main bathroom will go, since the other bathroom is inside my master bedroom and we needed a more comfortable space. Right now, I'm preparing the land and getting everything ready. I just need to build a foundation beam so I can start laying bricks and really give that section some shape, and even though it sometimes feels like I'm making slow progress, when I look back I realize that I've actually accomplished quite a lot.

> Construir una casa prácticamente desde cero no es fácil, menos cuando uno trabaja todos los días y tiene responsabilidades encima, pero cada bloque, cada viaje de tierra y cada detalle tienen un valor enorme porque uno sabe todo el sacrificio que hay detrás. La verdad estas cosas cansan bastante, no voy a decir que no, pero también dan una satisfacción enorme. Porque al final uno no está construyendo solamente paredes, sino un hogar para la familia, un lugar donde poco a poco se van creando recuerdos, momentos y sueños. Así que nada mi gente, seguimos dándole. Quizás no al ritmo más rápido del mundo, pero sí con muchas ganas y con la meta clara de seguir levantando nuestro hogar poco a poco. >Building a house practically from scratch isn't easy, especially when you work every day and have other responsibilities, but every block, every truckload of dirt, and every detail has immense value because you know all the sacrifice behind it. Honestly, these things are quite tiring, I won't deny it, but they also bring enormous satisfaction. Because in the end, you're not just building walls, but a home for your family, a place where memories, moments, and dreams are gradually created. >So, folks, let's keep at it. Maybe not at the fastest pace in the world, but with plenty of enthusiasm and the clear goal of continuing to build our home little by little.
**Gracias por tu atención prestada, nos leemos en un próximo post.**
**Thanks for your attention, see you in a future post.**

_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![Delicioso almuerzo (15).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u6BhKxiLQJaZ9sZR8wZoTG6N9Cbgu3kCebSq1WJwLT7fFuR4VeHWKReaBTxvFjtMimT.jpg)

>

Hola, amigos, esta vez les traigo un delicioso y saludable pollo a la parrilla. Si estás aburrido de comer el pollo siempre guisado, frito o en sopa, aquí les traigo la solución con este pollo ideal para darle variedad a sus almuerzos. Lo podemos. Es ideal acompañar con lo que deseas, ya sea una rica ensalada, unos plátanos asados o unos vegetales. Lo bueno de esta receta es que es sencilla de preparar; por eso le comparto el paso a paso. ¡Espero que se animen a cocinarlo en casa! 

> Hi, everyone! Today I’m sharing a delicious and healthy grilled chicken recipe with you. If you’re tired of always having chicken stewed, fried, or in soup, here’s the perfect solution to add some variety to your lunches. It’s perfect. You can serve it with whatever you like, whether it’s a tasty salad, some roasted plantains, or some vegetables. The great thing about this recipe is that it’s easy to make; that’s why I’m sharing the step-by-step instructions. I hope you’ll give it a try at home! 
   

---

body.title: Cream of spinach soup with pumpkin, potatoes and chicken (Eng-Esp)
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL7PKpRUuQbBabanca3SNn8T3YtFgvvFUsTCs2i1nUvFTsAXCDixCCzCKpMFfEcRpgo.png)</center>

* Good morning friends... I love to accompany my main meals with a fresh salad or vegetable soup. I think it's a great way to take advantage of all the benefits and nutrients these wonderful ingredients offer, plus they provide a good source of the vitamins and minerals our bodies need to stay healthy. 
Next, I'll explain how to prepare a delicious \

I thought it would be great to garnish it with crispy pieces of toasted bread. To give it a special touch, I fried them in olive oil and added a pinch of pepper... The result was spectacular!

>* Buenos días queridos amigos... Me encanta acompañar mis comidas principales con \

, considero que es una buena forma de aprovechar todos los beneficios y nutrientes que poseen estos maravillosos ingredientes, además de que es un buen aporte de vitaminas y minerales que nuestro organismo necesita para mantenerse saludable... A continuación, les explico como preparar una exquisita \

. 
Me pareció genial decorar con trocitos crujientes de pan tostado, para darle un toquesito especial los sofreí con aceite de oliva y coloqué una pizca de pimienta. El resultado quedó espectacular!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243zk2FkMhAMdNFamubfDo5qa9jvM49ZmRaPP6c8hYrGeNUSSXD6LX8M8dUtanwZoudcv.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: spinach leaves, pumpkin, potatoes, bread pieces, olive oil, pepper, butter, garlic cloves, chicken breast and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: hojas de espinacas, calabaza, patatas, trocitos de pan, aceite de oliva, pimienta, mantequilla, dientes de ajo, pechuga de pollo y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xyJPawhXtVz8P9sE5vyeuhpafYsJJw8JN54koJvL7e1GN1MfM8u5jAyb8ovnZ32Ej8G.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvwCoehRrdfHGcQdFzwPoYEg324WBfhpHnqW97L6vHBnoEH6ukfrC6EiGXdDfivuPSJ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tc9ohFDTrsSFFqPqje6S7HQ3Hkh12Vg3icrgfSW3n9SHrCwbvnzGEPE62sVszLEgWro.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPRACIÓN</center>

* In a deep pot, combine the pumpkin, potatoes, chicken breast, and garlic cloves. Cover with water and cook over high heat until the vegetables are tender.
If you need to adjust the amount of water during cooking, you can do so with small splashes.

>* Incorporamos en una olla honda la calabaza, junto con las patatas, la pechuga de pollo y los dientes de ajo... Cubrimos con agua, cocinamos a fuego \

hasta comprobar que las verduras se ablandaron. 
Si consideran que durante el proceso de cocción deben rectificar la cantidad de agua, pueden hacerlo con pequeños toquesitos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL16ujUURZ5mysqmZypv82MrJnoHh4dmmzPXCm9xoNDJHRB1vpuJGL9Yx3fyevShywT.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eokf1PtvZEk6AJf69rcC7UuEEvyMRNpuU549Jvx64tzspBXb47TGiA5BNQn9LgKgyAc.png)</center>

* Once the vegetables are soft, remove the chicken (and shred it).
Next, add the spinach leaves, which have been previously washed and disinfected. Whenever I make this recipe, I usually soak the spinach in water with white vinegar for 20 minutes, then drain and rinse it well to remove the vinegary taste.
Cook for 5 minutes, which is enough time for the spinach to be ready.

>* Cuando las verduras estén blandas, procedemos a extraer el pollo (desmechamos).
A continuación, agregamos las hojas de espinacas, previamente lavadas y desinfectadas. Siempre que realizo esta receta las dejo reposar en agua con vinagre blanco durante 20 minutos, luego procedo a colar y lavar bien, para así extraer el sabor avinagrado.
Cocinamos durante 5 minutos, tiempo suficiente para que la espinaca esté lista.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvncPkFrYAooJhiLM5vTLQJg7EnwfCdEVypCJrmQHQNMuy8bQoi35SmxTyQufVsi8Dg.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242DBfoa2SYKb34eiRds59E5NqyJ7s1Q48pMkUUFkAHMtyWAKDkBcmwTm1UeF28bT1sEQ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpxqFrhF6BxPgoea9Pen18B4EhxzxaCwXSGn2kSYKkaoNizaJNzehEXEK3A9DmBwZmk.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xKxeBH7xYsRbExe1qcvL1RdTAKn8FTukyAsz8U6L7RnVJ36REHu5jMyKdRnVsLEHXrr.png)</center>

* Add the colorful vegetables to the blender, along with the cooking broth. The amount will depend on your desired consistency; I prefer a very creamy texture.
Next, add black pepper, a touch of butter, and salt to taste. Blend until smooth and lump-free.

>* Incorporamos al vaso de la licuadora nuestras coloridas verduras, añadimos el caldo de cocción, la cantidad dependerá de la textura que deseen disfrutar, en mi caso me encanta que la consistencia quede MUY cremosa. 
En este paso procedemos a colocar: pimienta negra, un toque de mantequilla y sal al gusto. Licuamos hasta conseguir una textura homogénea y sin grumos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX3hDhn7xHp6VVzqMPnVqQUzQAEjec8FPubnAHUMERQ47CpuihVM7bYJf8FpQicRePr.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFY5frBoXYY5RTbbxkc6XrYu9VhQSG6kYCRtBaT2uR1RcPHiV8hQndtwg2G5rjiyU87.png)</center>

* We fry the pieces of bread with a touch of olive oil, add a pinch of pepper... They will be ready when we check that they have taken on a golden and crispy texture.

* Sofreímos los trocitos de pan con un toquesito de aceite de oliva, añadimos una pizca de pimienta... Estarán listos cuando comprobemos que tomaron una textura dorada y crujiente.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wC9nn8U1fNS9eiXEfoGM3UrdZa2EqYqAgKtSk4TRMd6g47gibJ6AhBRv2ykv4cFcXjq.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wqiRqEje3VaG7rVBuGwAD7rSQvGFjnXarkW3jhyxSqMGJNGpapL7qY8HEet7TbGEQ6T.png)</center>

* We plate it... We decorate with the crispy bread pieces and our dish is ready to enjoy!

>* Emplatamos... Decoramos con los trocitos crujientes de pan y nuestro platillo está listo para disfrutar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242s5gvhHMb51kXgrbLFy1DkwyCZhzYFRPDCCnSnTHqAcXXLcCMYYDEeBnLriJP8oatGw.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our healthy and nutritious dish, a great option to share with your family... I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions; I'm sure you'll love it as much as I do!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Have a wonderful day!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento nuestro saludable y nutritivo platillo, una excelente opción para compartir en familia... Espero que hayan disfrutado el \

, estoy segura que lo amarán tanto como yo!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, les deseo un día maravilloso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243zk2FkMhAMdNFamubfDo5qa9jvM49ZmRaPP6c8hYrGeNUSSXD6LX8M8dUtanwZoudcv.png)</center>

* All photos are my own work
* Todas las fotos son de mi autoría

body.title: Cuadro al estilo Venecia || Painting in the Venetian style 🎨
body.body:
![1001107361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgRhyGFUSYiEqdvqshSMGNFgFn9Z6j1zubfvYhtSbtzrTYtoZwD9GSA5UB6dHdgb3ax.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Hoy retomamos los post por decimocuarta vez jajaja esta vez les quiero contar sobre un cuadro que pinté en conjunto con la triada de dientes estrellados de la que les hablé hace algunas semanas. Cuando la cliente me comentó que quería los cuadros de los dientes, este cuadro también estaría relacionado a algo de odontología, y ese mismo día por la tarde luego se conversar con su hija cambió de parecer y me pidió un paisaje y ya tenía esta idea en mente. La imagen que me compartió mostraba un cuadro hecho con acuarelas y yo nunca he pintado con acuarelas a decir verdad, pero asumí el reto y traté de adaptar la idea a la pintura al frío con la que contaba.

Hi Guys!

Today we're back with posts for the fourteenth time, hahaha. This time I want to tell you about a painting I did in conjunction with the triad of star-shaped teeth I mentioned a few weeks ago. When the client told me she wanted the tooth paintings, this one would also be related to dentistry, but that same afternoon, after talking with her daughter, she changed her mind and asked me for a landscape, and I already had this idea in mind. The image she shared showed a painting done with watercolors, and I've never painted with watercolors before, to be honest, but I took on the challenge and tried to adapt the idea to the cold-press paint I had.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000922258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xAVgbHC1ANwgZz1bZdbi5nqe8PfYtktr714EnwDc9fmBhg4W9VDNniVgkC1CwvRNijA.jpg) ![1000919150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xehwmGXQkqKZ2hzQmxkHe4xLRs2m57kzPKTU7FLUyBJm3u5eNyw6f9fVQQ4KLkdbZCy.jpg) Abri el empaque donde venía el lienzo, tracé el boceto a lápiz y luego comencé a agregar pintura, iniciando con el agua del río, pues sentí que iba a ser todo un reto y debía abordarlo primero para poder ocuparme del resto. Al principio no lograba ese efecto de acuarelas pero a medida que avanzaba me daba cuenta de que forma podía lograrlo.
![1000919149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23y8udFa5CXR2GcVYHAjHkREYvticMjARhKB2ah4CxzGUAcaGBXqNzWzTb4ddWcbs1uih.jpg) ![1000919151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23yJEB1AEHJ1bV4PSzSSNyWiaBazYnPQ5RWXx5BZbG1v9NCu1gwqhUMEzZYFvHwNbynCL.jpg) I opened the packaging containing the canvas, sketched the design in pencil, and then began adding paint, starting with the river water. I felt it would be quite a challenge and I needed to tackle it first before moving on to the rest. At first, I couldn't achieve that watercolor effect, but as I progressed, I figured out how to do it.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000919152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xySrG19tSCvWPgY41VfjvS82gSvxJd1nRymb9q1YNeLqRri7tMbXEAW4V2gW1zHC6xs.jpg) ![1000919154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wC9VsmnUxfD4NYRkaWqAcjcsvxrj5BLbBjPPkQyf2ESXpm4b3JkrfCJ8m1poxpmWxKo.jpg) Lograr los ángulos en el cuadro también fue un reto pues no soy fan de pintar cosas con formas geométricas y las paredes eran exactamente eso, varias rectas que debía replicar. Soy más de hacer pinceladas libres y ese cuadro representó para mí una prueba que sabía que podía superar pero que fue un poco incómoda por sacarme de esa zona de confort. Hice el puente, y por fin pude iniciar con la vegetación, que era la parte que más ansiaba pintar porque era lo que se asemejaba más a esas pinceladas sueltas que me encantan. Pinté primero las hojas y ya luego las flores rojas y rosadas.
![1000919153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xVHHrTMTxEEZGvvvs56jd5ZnaoBAmVxbGAsh6rJwwohkEdizb3vp7cnKk7rhT5NPp4i.jpg) ![1000919155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgKLLzuQnf1UabzLxB34TmdxsWw1kdgmSDjduQTxP2yifcZPMoyEJyMZSbZQcHbAnzk.jpg) Achieving the right angles in the painting was also a challenge, as I'm not a fan of painting things with geometric shapes, and the walls were exactly that: several straight lines that I had to replicate. I prefer free brushstrokes, and this painting represented a test for me that I knew I could overcome, but it was a little uncomfortable because it took me out of my comfort zone. I finished the bridge, and finally I could start on the vegetation, which was the part I was most eager to paint because it was the closest thing to those loose brushstrokes that I love. I painted the leaves first, and then the red and pink flowers.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000919156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wqiS9ZU4n88RuR9ccB7nGyFP8We5xgPfDJuaVuT1D2ig5uASjLcUU4EGEZkiVvtmR2R.jpg) ![1000919139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uFPUEw6tcyhgN4mU2guDqM7AWftBGsCKZ6ZefroPcFC5A6mXzXgephf6g47gBrgU3DT.jpg) Finalmente aborde la parte del fondo que eran unas pequeñas manchas simulando ser unas ventanas de edificios que estaban a lo lejos. Acá fue donde se fue que mejor dominé el estilo acuarela. Arreglé ciertos detalles, y en este punto recibí un mensaje de la cliente, quien me pedía encarecidamente que le agregara sutilmente el logo de su clínica a alguna parte del cuadro. Lo dejó a mi criterio y me pareció que lo mejor era colocarlo en el puente como una especie de chapa. Y así luego de agregar la capa de brillo protector fue que terminé este cuadro, que representó varios retos pero que siento logré superarlos con éxito. La cliente quedó súper feliz, sobretodo al ver en persona el detalle de su logo y se fue feliz con los 4 cuadros. Gracias amigos por acompañarme nuevamente en un nuevo post. Nos leemos en el próximo.
![1000919157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vhyeXe8BPgmUPjkvJDy7SyCGi9PkCAS3HoSohrnK9DaeFpf1cbKQofAKjjxNXwAW7tf.jpg) ![1000919141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xKsyoDzJqJwEaFS6oFuvLFHagCfV82JizMVwdv1nyF1yaNT4XqcRPAzRZQKsRMQM161.jpg) Finally, I tackled the background, which consisted of small smudges meant to resemble windows of distant buildings. This is where I truly mastered the watercolor style. I fixed a few details, and at this point, I received a message from the client, who strongly requested that I subtly add her clinic's logo somewhere in the painting. She left it up to me, and I decided that the best place for it was on the bridge, like a kind of badge. And so, after adding the protective gloss layer, I finished this painting, which presented several challenges, but I feel I successfully overcame them. The client was thrilled, especially when she saw the detail of her logo in person, and she left happy with all four paintings. Thank you, friends, for joining me again for another post. See you in the next one!
![1000919146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xVKE8s2fGzvjJW9wZwtRuZjNdgC4aAAL4UixwbyQqcGCFZ8BibUorhgWzkxa2ptB4JL.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/BIrki8th-cvx2.png
¡Gracias por leer, comentar y votar mi contenido! Espero haya sido de tu agrado y provecho. Un gran abrazo a todos, y nos leemos en un próximo post • Lakrearte en Hive • Att: Estefania Garcia ♥
![Banner (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/Eoc9Pc2jLqxnjQfBXKUXRL5bvNPwyxeQkBQUdS3nHsKdgJdfrHmJ7dxx5KQp53eW8tJ.jpg) Imágenes y separadores de mi autoría Portada editada en Canva Fotografías tomadas con un Moto EDGE 30 Texto traducido en Google ImTranslate v.14.27

title.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 12-31-2019 - 10X Speed
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779892490416-4651a847099f5e8b.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/093ba005)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/093ba005)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.title: Baked potatoes 🥔 with meat patties and salad 🍅 🥬
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz día para todos mis amigos amantes de la buena comida, el día de ayer preparé para nuestro almuerzo familiar un menú algo diferente; hice unas papas al horno, la cual serví acompañada de tortitas de carne y una ensalada de lechuga y tomate, un menú sencillo, balanceado y muy saludable; les muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Happy day to all my food-loving friends! Yesterday, I prepared a slightly different menu for our family lunch: I made some baked potatoes, which I served with meat patties and a lettuce and tomato salad—a simple, balanced, and very healthy meal. Here’s how I made it ![1000911946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqq7mgshvVNASYzS2xJq83yEA6LEzvchs6JszJCWLL2ZR39EhLUHggkSbZXTGvRhCv7.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** carne molida, papas, tomate, lechuga, adobo, cilantro, ají

> **
INGREDIENTS
** ground beef, potatoes, tomatoes, lettuce, marinade, cilantro, chili pepper ![1000911721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23x196F6XiPHhd82uRJhDrR4p7fGedx9GAJgr52LenYHLjrGp2rjiHgHgYZ3Bbnqcd7ip.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** La papa después de lavarla le retiré la concha, la corté en bastones gruesos, las sazoné con sal, orégano, un poco de aceite; la llevé al horno a 180 grados por aproximadamente 60 minutos. Por otro lado para preparar las tortitas de carne, en una paila coloqué ajo finamente picado, ají cilantro, añadí la carne molida, sazoné con adobo y sal, agregue un poco de harina de trigo; dividí en pequeñas porciones, hice las tortitas aplanando finamente y cociné en una sartén engrasada con aceite volteando por ambos lados

> **
PROCEDURE
** After washing the potato, I peeled it, cut it into thick sticks, seasoned it with salt, oregano, and a little oil, and baked it in the oven at 180 degrees for about 60 minutes. To prepare the meat patties, I placed finely chopped garlic, chili peppers, and cilantro in a skillet, added the ground beef, seasoned it with adobo and salt, and added a little wheat flour; I divided the mixture into small portions, shaped the patties by flattening them thinly, and cooked them in a skillet greased with oil, flipping them on both sides. ![1000913883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tmKij89hg2Qkcy6fB9qDoUv5JyFcdAMhEX96uBjE8QYqhrkvhnYGZQu2inmZgE8VXro.jpg) ![1000913884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpnFDKqw6BF5iTbKDrhooLBhWTdRNuwqzU6Z44DoNQxqGQJK3kesVEEo4R4DSxHz69j.jpg) ![1000911941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/241tUXxdHr5PpCRc1CuoKFvDuP72zDLQX5LFBVZadXZ4qWuZVXVuCgTqQjTzVeSf7koKK.jpg)
> A la hora de servir acompañé con una ensalada de lechuga y tomate . Espero haya sido de su agrado. Gracias por visitarme! Dios te bendiga🙌

> When serving, I paired it with a lettuce and tomato salad. I hope you enjoyed it. Thank you for visiting! God bless you🙌 ![1000911946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqq7mgshvVNASYzS2xJq83yEA6LEzvchs6JszJCWLL2ZR39EhLUHggkSbZXTGvRhCv7.jpg) ![1000911948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eoke5mSPBs83PKXd2GAQa7RSqM31epz3gfyDvLe5TcNUfRhKUoHhc8Zmw9xsVgYKjdw.jpg)

title.title: Each Poem Becomes A Song
title.body:
Ever, my friends drug me to what I call sweaty yoga, and I was sitting there doing it, slip sliding all around. This was like back in my 20s, right? 


So I was pretty flexible, but I was like slip sliding around, and then I had this moment where I was like, I am wearing everyone's sweat. It's like a mixture, and I literally promptly like got up and exited the building.

I was like, I cannot do this. That would be so gross to me. But if you love it, I'm happy for you.

No, no, no, no. I would never do hot yoga. For one, I have a hard enough time with, you know, making sure I'm breathing correctly.

But, yeah, that's kind of the same as Pilates, though. Pilates gets hot. I'm not going to get disgusting.

Jody, hi. Wizard, wizard, wizard, wizard. How are you? Happy Sunday.

Hey. How's everybody doing? Good. How are you feeling, by the way? I'm here.


That was beautiful. Was that new? Did you just do that today, or... Two days ago, I published that. I don't know the date.

I lose track of time a lot. I could have made this last week. It could have been six months ago.

I now have a pile. And I go through sort, and I'm like, okay, this looks good now. You know? I really couldn't tell you.

But I know it's recent, so it's still in my memory. Well, I love it. Thank you for sharing.

I just want to say, as a fellow poet, your poetry is outstanding. It's beautiful. I love reading your poetry.

I usually don't like reading poetry, as funny as that might sound. I'm not a big reader. I love listening to people recite their poetry, and then I'm just glued.

You know, my ears are open. But I just want to let you know, your poetry is prolific. It's profound.

It's beautiful, inspiring. I hope you come up and read more. I hope you're feeling better.

I know you've been going through your own stuff. And I'm always amazed and inspired when I read your poetry. It depends on who's in my feed, and you're in my feed a lot.

So I'm grateful for that. So thank you. Thanks for sharing it out loud.

It was great to hear it. Yeah, well, I did this here and there. It's just I've had issues speaking a lot, especially through some of my longer poetry.

But I'm going to go back to it, because, well, the way I see it, all of my poems are just lyrics to songs I haven't written the music to yet. And I'm getting there. Each poem becomes a song.

title.title: MEMORIES I CAN NEVER TRADE FOR ANY AMOUNT OF MONEY
title.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog today ❤️

I'm not one to keep too many friends but I have had a lot of noise memories that have shared with my friends right from our secondary school days because my best friend I've known her since second days school and we have been close but this till date although some point when I got into school and she was not able to get into school we drifted apart and we only saw during the holidays but we still kept off our friendship going when we can we call and talk about everything and anything then she traveled down to worry travel down to worry and she's spent two is the she went to complete her makeup business and this is my friend's name is Elizabeth.



So Elizabeth introduced me to confidence who is a friend of us and comfy also became born of my tight friends confidence is a Jehovah's witness likewise a list bet and they are both lovely girls and they love me so much and I love them so much one thing that is unique about our sister that we are always there for each other in our trying times when one person is going to something we all turn up and support each other in our only two way.

when I lost my dad Elizabeth came with me and she spent a whole week and my house helping in the preparations and all the running around I have to be done down to the burial date and also a week later before she left.

So during my final year Elizabeth came down to my school abia state university and we spent a good amount of time together we dance to exchange clothes or each other's clothes snapped pictures see how we look in each other's clothing and it was just so much fun for us.

So last year I spent some time with Lizzy before she traveled back again to worry to complete her makeup training session and then after that I lost my sister and the burial was scheduled to hold for on January 11th so she also came to help us in the preparations like 2 weeks before then or a week before then she was there and also confidence was there we spend a lot of time together try together last together the stood by me all true make sure that I didn't feel pain or that I wasn't alone before the left.

So recently I reconnected with Elizabeth because I had that she lost her grandmother from her mom who stays close to my house at that moment very happy she was still at worry and then she came back and I went to meet her to be my condolence visit so her so after that she told me that the burial did have been fixed and that's she have been thick for some time and I've been hospitalized but thankfully she have gotten better.

So the burial is scheduled to hold on November 27th to 28 at her village which is amber aruchuku so ask her about the burial arrangements and how is going to be and she told me it's going to be from Wednesday till Sunday because there are two burials that I've been done and we have to be there for all of them so I told her that I would be going with her for it so I am trying to be working on my plants to join her by next month to also support her in her own trying time s

Looking back at this day I will tell them thank you for the memories that you've created with me I would never forget you kind gestures and the love I'm care that you should to me.Just like @marsdave said I can't trade this memories for 850 million dollars.

Images are Ai generated

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

They have a huge catacomb of ancient scriptures from ages gone by. And he took these scriptures. It took him 40 years.

title.title: Sky above, earth below, peace within.
title.body:
There are many tourist places in India which are known for their natural beauty. These were situated in high altitude areas. People visit them to enjoy peace and serenity at these location. However there are some other places too which were not so popular. Yet they have the same aura and majestic appearance, that could mesmerize any individuals. Honestly speaking , when I get the chance to stay at Jyotipuram, I fell in love ❤️ with the place. One of the picturesque location up above the hills that bring life to standstill yet quite enjoyable. 

![1000267163.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/243WMTNSiHyZ9RxNadvzacn5yj2gy3Y88V67ohtSq6RybpYTQ8YZGCHq1qjswuEUjTW2K.jpg)


Jyotipuram is a highly sought after, peaceful township in the Reasi district of Jammu & Kashmir. It provides an ideal living environment due to its excellent civic amenities. Surrounded by many mountains it offers many scenic view all the time. Originally built for hydel project officers, it serves as a secure and modern residential hub. The place have their own gated communities that bring love to the place. At first it does not bring much excitement to visit the place, may be due travel exhaustion. But as I spent time, I fell in love ❤️ again and again. Sitting at an elevation of 750 meters amidst the Himalayan foothills, the town provides clean air, green spaces, and a cool climate. They have their own market , schools, hospitals and what more people were too friendly and polite spoken. 

![1000263821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EqL8Lu3PNnjibpFD1MHx5EfkYhSntqMG5GEMtBuoVGEX1LRJ3qLvtQtTdT4CmsJSxuh.jpg)


I spent 10 - 15 days in the natural set up and it does bring new lease of life. The place has its on view point that bring some awesome view. The valley and natural green spaces. The place has its own stadium that occasionally organize friendly matches. They have their own club houses too where every evening people spend time with friendly chit chat. I felt so refresh that I started spending most of the time outside. The favorite being the ground that has a unique charm. The only place with a green surface and open sky. It was quite pleasant to live every moment in that beautiful set up.

![1000267210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23wC5R9DEoQV7EKSR9hBVCKEQ27TK3kXoUe65UV2uxtDKeAu8VSk3TV7oSWSvJKBcYwLu.jpg)


![1000267162.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EpLfwpv3M3svy86yjT9LvZtTxkimPLmmWjupp9eZ17WAYsCo47KxX8zeJU4nhGvw42Y.jpg)


![1000267161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/244KLk2spbS8b9gn4xWjQa1HZktNsnbbY7YAWkJYGUQUwesaYrAJTsyaZPT6Ra1ooHxY3.jpg)

![1000263865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EqFrzWTvBQehNLxExq2pYa1iJ8yB72KtFVpuYAs8nPLXcWcXX76bm5onN7J3Ej3LGRM.jpg)

![1000263866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Epzz7T2FAhhi3dnBG3pyTUcX5Jv5EDHfWfYFJa8jV7xV7CDVLpqWh7AA76e3k4kEWNu.jpg)

![1000263863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EqNG4t4Dhkftu7wo8R6kXe6g6U3nyczY4goBhLbqbayQTP7NYDTSUSuoo3onmwkyyaj.jpg)

It was the place that show us the natural wonder of sleeping beauty. A naturl phenomenon where 7 different mountain make a formation look alike a sleeping women. I was so fond of seeing the beauty that I spent hours in the ridge area. It was a memorable stay and my walk always get so productive that allow to get rid of stress and anxiety.







**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

body.title: How Modern Anti-Drone Systems Are Transforming Security for Critical Infrastructure and Urban Areas
body.body:
In recent years, I have noticed a major shift in the way cities, industrial facilities, and public institutions approach security. The rapid growth of drone technology has created new opportunities for photography, delivery services, and inspections, but it has also introduced serious security concerns. Unauthorized drones can disrupt airports, invade private spaces, or even threaten critical infrastructure such as power plants and communication centers. Because of this, anti-drone systems are becoming an important part of modern security strategies.  
When researching drone defense solutions, I came across [https://eascompany.uz/en/](https://eascompany.uz/en/), which helped me better understand how counter-drone technologies work in real-world environments. Modern anti-drone systems use a combination of radar detection, radio frequency monitoring, and signal jamming to identify and stop unauthorized drones before they enter restricted areas. For example, airports can use these systems to detect drones near runways and prevent dangerous interruptions to air traffic.  
One thing I find especially interesting is how anti-drone technology is now used beyond military applications. Many urban areas are installing drone detection systems near stadiums, government buildings, and public events. A large concert, for instance, may attract thousands of people, making aerial security a serious concern. In such situations, security teams need tools that can quickly locate a drone operator and reduce potential risks without causing panic.  
Critical infrastructure protection is another area where counter-drone systems play a growing role. Energy facilities, oil refineries, and data centers often rely on layered security systems. Drones can bypass traditional fences and cameras, which is why advanced drone defense solutions are becoming necessary. Some systems can automatically track suspicious drone activity and send alerts to security teams in real time.  
I also noticed that modern anti-drone systems are becoming more compact and easier to integrate into existing security networks. This makes them practical for both large industrial facilities and smaller commercial properties. Businesses are no longer viewing drone defense as a specialized military tool. Instead, it is becoming part of everyday risk management and public safety planning.  
As drone usage continues to grow, anti-drone systems will likely become a standard feature in modern security infrastructure. From airports to city centers, these technologies help organizations respond faster, improve public safety, and reduce the risks connected to unauthorized drone activity.

body.title: Should we listen to our ancestors? | The Oldpath
body.body:
https://youtu.be/xHG3F3kdYto?si=n_0W_EKD12r1WFFf

As children of God, the Word of God should be our guide. It is a manual that assists us navigate through life efficiently. Inasmuch as we respect those who existed before we came into this world, we should not neglect the one who created them and brought them into this world.
‎
‎Every other voice that does not sound like the voice of God and counters what God says should be ignored. It is quite understandable to have respect for certain traditions and family heritage, but we should be extremely careful so as not to carry out the practices of our ancestors at the detriment of disregarding God laws.

>_**2 Corinthians 5:17 ‎**
Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new. ‎_
‎

There are some beliefs and ways of life (traditions) that we have to put aside after we have surrendered our lives to Jesus. Our ancestors and the patterns by which they lived their lives should not be the reason why we should go contrary to the path we Christians are supposed to walk in.

body.body: > It was early in the morning, the air flows quietly just beneath the mountain, with only the sound of footsteps moving forward. There he was standing in the middle of the wilderness, close to the mountain. As part of of Stegosaurus species, he chooses open areas to live in. He was standing on the rocky ground, surrounded by all the greenery that has found their way to grow in between the rocks. If he was a pet, he would probably would go with the name Spike. But, that might be a bit far from defining him. As he can only digest greens and prefer the ones on the ground. Despite his weight, he has the ability to jump. But, it is probably due to the fact that it is more convenient for him to eat the ones on the ground. It might be that, the one thing that would align with his nickname would be the fact that, he is smaller than the average Stegosaurus. # PT

>

Era de manhã cedo, o ar fluía suavemente logo abaixo da montanha, com apenas o som de passos se aproximando.

Lá estava ele, no meio da natureza selvagem, perto da montanha. Como membro da espécie Estegossauro, ele escolhe áreas abertas para viver. Estava em pé sobre o solo rochoso, cercado pela vegetação que crescia entre as rochas. Se fosse um animal de estimação, provavelmente se chamaria Espinho. Mas isso talvez não o definisse completamente, já que ele só consegue digerir vegetais e prefere os que estão no chão. Apesar do seu peso, ele consegue pular. Mas isso provavelmente se deve ao fato de ser mais conveniente para ele comer o que está no chão. Talvez o que combine com seu apelido seja o fato de ele ser menor do que um Estegossauro comum.

When people do not family or fail to nurture it, they often feel hopeless. This is the reason why we must honor, protect and invest in our families, just as Jesus did.

An inspiring instance is David, who, even while fleeing from King Saul, remained deeply concerned for his family's safety. In spite facing danger and uncertainty, David made sure his parents were protected.

Like Jesus, he showed us that true strength includes responsibility and care for family. So we must at all times thank God for fathers and for the family system He designed to sustain us.

We must never at any time take our family for granted because God is interested in our families.

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Regaining the love of parents
body.body: > https://youtu.be/vut5Ee27WIg?si=KjbdxgqLpfRCkZHb Among God's great blessings to us is the love of our parents. Strong, patient and selfless. However, due to our failures, disobedience or carelessness, we sometimes wound our parents, and lose their trust or love for a period. Saying sorry is not enough, it is also a matter of changing the heart and behavior in order to be loved again by the parents. Ephesians 6:1-2 say, “Children: obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. Honor your father and mother. This is an illustration of God's love and care for our parents. There was one time when I did something to make my mother sad. I did not listen to her, acting on my own judgment. On hearing this, she was upset and broken and stopped talking to me openly as she had done before. This made me feel very guilty inside because I knew that I hurt someone who loves me so much. It was the first time I had given much thought to my actions and I knew the importance of obeying and respecting. In order to win her trust, I had to put myself down. I approached her, apologized with great sincerity and promised her that I would change. She was very quiet at first but I didn't give up. I started to make my difference in what I did at home, by listening more, and respecting her choices. Gradually, I began to see the glint of laughter in her eyes once more. It was through that experience that I learned—and I think I can say that I understood—that love can be reconstructed, when we are sincere and consistent in doing what is right. The Bible also teaches us in Colossians 3:20, “Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.” Obedience is not only about rules, it's about love and respect. Another example is the prodigal son in the story of Luke 15:18-20. Sadly, the son disobeyed his father and squandered everything that he had, but when he came in a repentant frame of mind his father ran to welcome him with love. This teaches us that parents are sometimes willing to overlook a repentance. To sum up, we must be humble, repent, and behave well to regain our parents' love. Saying sorry is not enough – you need to demonstrate it with actions. Parents are a gift from God, and we need to value them while we have them! I've come to understand that their love can be broken and yet be mended with patience, a sincere and changed heart, and by God's direction.

body.title: Can We Reschedule? (Just Kidding, I’m Hanging with My Parents)
body.body:
![1000019682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23qrJ2uQcNBN8FfFiz5U9ZbbXwHbDs5JKQ1VCoRxAs6dB4b6cy3oE3bcRE49Kh9tKN1ub.jpg)

Hello Hive friends! It's been a long time since I last posted. It's currently the college entrance examination month, so students need extra assistance. It's the last push before summer, so I'm not complaining.

Even though I'm drowning in work and activities, I'll never say no to a family trip and breakfast by the sea! I've never been a morning person, but I love roadtrips. We headed out early today and took a short break to enjoy the coastal view.


![1000019294.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/243qFRf1sccTShp5EqMb4YgMMPqRoqy6gxNYYDXNPPxVB7QdmNB34H5pAS9gdxgAp82KS.jpg)

***Overlooking the Valladolid Coast***

This was last week, when my Mom and Dad decided to visit my uncle. It was a long drive, and as you all know, the Philippines is basically a hottie! When you plan a trip during summer, you better leave either before the sun is up OR when it's already setting, Otherwise you'll be barbecued alive. (Just look at my Mom all covered up like she's avoiding a paparazzi lol 😂)


![01456d72-7683-4a3f-adc6-6a4e2233d822-1_all_19451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/244y1vrfGJeepFpPzWZH69Qhp4qwCcW4Ac9bf5Rc4ufokRnHkPv83T7KqsCBDuQCXoDuB.jpg)

![1000019669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/245TC3aUh9ryHRwvra6676EujPGcf7S5nFxTxtT86Syd3tY7fhy8PHbkKuvXvmc5cKo3B.jpg)

We hit the road at 4 AM, taking a short break along the way since my dad can't drive for long stretches anymore. We found some street vendors selling breakfast, so while resting, we enjoyed some native coffee and But-ong (a local sticky rice best paired with muscovado sugar). Fun fact: my province is known as the sugarcane capital of the Philippines! So yeah, We are sweet. ☺️🥰


![1000019296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/haveyoumetellie/23xeoyJMfxQMMHjixhYgbE3uCGjCbidb9doK7FwV99maPSR34zmjHrYm5FEG5hfHoGYFd.jpg)

***But-ong (Sticky rice) with Muscovado Sugar***


So, there you go! Just a short post today, but a little reminder to spend time with the people you love. Despite our hectic schedules, we're never truly 'free'—so whenever you get the chance, squeeze in some moments for them.

This trip actually recharged me. Family time really is the best ever.

https://vimeo.com/1195982415
***Taken on our way home. We were lucky enough to witness a sunrise and sunset combo that day***

Until my next post, catch up soon, Friends

body.title: Money vs Humanity in Healthcare
body.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU58w9Qd9YQ36gwwWfk23ACwfbtg4jtyu54jhtwHp8QxL/1779890175648.png) Not only in the present time but also in the past time we have always seen how money matters the most to people, let it be a doctor or a normal human being values money more than anything. There are many hospitals that would refuse to do emergency treatment when patients can not afford to pay. Most of the patients belong to middle class family or street and whenever I see such situations, I have never felt good at all. Because it always felt unfair. Like, shouldn't human life matter more than a piece of paper? Doctors take an oath to save lives, then why they only save lives if the patient is able to pay. That means to them money is more important than a human life. For that reason they can neglect a person who has no money, because for the hospital, life of the poor people are valuless. They don't think that poor people's life is as valuable as a rich person’s life. Well, I do know that a hospital can not be run properly without money, like they would need money for everything such as medicines, medical equipment and the doctors and nurses, as they need salary because they are the only breadwinner of their family. So, yeah, if they don't have money, they can't continue the services of a hospital. I feel the problem is in the healthcare system, which depends heavily on business and profit. Therefore, I won't blame the doctors only. I remember news that was viral a few days ago, where a man was begging on the street for his newborn baby. It was the delivery time of his wife, so he took his wife to a nearby hospital. But after the delivery of the baby, the hospital was not allowing them to see their child. They spent hours asking relatives and neighbors for help while the child was on life support. When the people of the hospital realized that the parents were from a poor family, they stopped the life support system. Within a few minutes, the newborn baby was no more. Stories like this will haunt me forever, I do not think that healthcare should only depend on a person’s financial condition. It's really a wrong thing to do. The parents were crying their heart out while giving the interview to the reporters. This made me very emotional. It was located far away from my city, and still I felt bad that I couldn’t help them. I felt that as a human being, we failed, like there's no humanity in this. I would also blame the governments because why they do not have easier methods for poor people. There are many government hospitals, but everyone has to stand in a long line. How will the patients stand in a long line when they are ill and in need of emergency treatment? The government should take steps to improve the facilities of the hospitals so that poor people can receive treatment for free during emergencies. They can also create charity funds for patients, like patients who can not pay immediately. Also, they can take a small amount of money over time instead of taking the full payment before treatment. Hospital's first priority should be saving lives not earning profits. Also, special discounts must be given to such poor families. If these painful incidents continue to occur then doctors are going to lose their respected place. Everyone respects a doctor because they save lives and have huge responsibility. But instead of saving lives if they start valuing money more, they won't get respected anymore. In my opinion, healthcare should not ever become a business. No one should be denied life-saving treatment simply because they are poor. ____ The thumbnail is created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com), edited with [Canva](www.canva.com). ____

Esta es la información sobre sl impacto del pico al tratar una madera

Un pájaro carpintero impacta la madera a una velocidad de unos 6 metros por segundo, ejerciendo una desaceleración extrema que equivale a una fuerza de hasta 1.200 a 1.400 g (fuerzas gravitacionales) con cada golpe. Para soportar esta presión, su anatomía actúa como un casco y amortiguador natura

Los pájaros carpinteros logran soportar esta presión gracias a sus increíbles adaptaciones evolutivas:Fuerza G extrema: Cada impacto equivale a que su cabeza reciba una fuerza de hasta 1.400 veces su propio peso. Un humano sufriría una conmoción cerebral severa con solo entre 60 y 100 g.

Cráneo esponjoso: Su cráneo es muy ligero (apenas el 1% de su peso) y está formado por huesos esponjosos con pequeñas cámaras de aire que disipan la onda de choque.

Lengua como cinturón de seguridad: Posee un hueso hioides muy largo que se enrolla alrededor de la parte posterior de su cabeza y abraza su cerebro, funcionando como un sistema de protección para absorber las vibraciones.

Pico cincelado: Sus picos están cubiertos por capas de queratina resistente que soportan la compresión, con una punta afilada que les permite perforar la madera de forma mucho más eficiente.Soporte corporal:

body.title: Free vs Premium: Is the WOO Battle Pass Worth the Jump?
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Whenever a Battle Pass gets introduced in any game, there’s always one question that immediately comes to mind:

**“Do I stick with free… or do I go premium?”**

It’s a question that isn’t just about cost but about value, strategy, and how you personally engage with the game. And with WOO tying the Premium Track directly to WOO Tokens, it adds another interesting layer to that decision.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/48QQksLFUjpCuEYimL6MTuVTvV3gZpvZSyR7Q9wezNsNd8SgK1MKpcBhYUUhZyAJZh.png)

---

As a fan, I’ve been thinking a lot about how this dual-track system fits into WOO’s overall design, not just in terms of rewards, but in terms of player mindset. Because whether you stay free or go premium, the system is clearly built to make both paths feel meaningful. But at the same time? It’s also designed to make you think.

---

### 🆓 The Free Track: A Strong Starting Point for Everyone

* The Free Track ensures that every player can participate in the Battle Pass without any upfront commitment.
  
This is something I genuinely appreciate because it sets the tone for inclusivity right from the start. You’re not locked out of the system just because you haven’t invested anything yet. You can log in, start completing quests, and begin progressing immediately. As a player, that feels welcoming. It removes that initial hesitation of “Do I need to commit before I even try this?” Instead, you get to experience the system first and decide later.

* The rewards on the Free Track still provide tangible value, making progression feel worthwhile even without upgrading.
  
This is where the system earns a lot of respect from me. The Free Track isn’t just filler. It actually gives you things that matter. You’re still gaining resources, still progressing, still benefiting from the system. And that’s important because it means you’re not forced into upgrading just to feel rewarded. You can stay on the Free Track and still feel like your time is being respected.

* It acts as a gateway into the full Battle Pass experience, allowing players to understand the system before making any decisions.
  
From a design perspective, this is really smart. Instead of pushing players to commit upfront, WOO lets them experience the value first. You get a feel for the progression, the pacing, the rewards, and only then do you decide if you want more. Personally, I think that’s the best way to approach something like this because it builds trust with the player base.

---

### 💰 The Premium Track: More Than Just Extra Rewards

* Unlocking the Premium Track with WOO Tokens ties the system directly into the game’s economy, making it feel like an internal investment rather than an external purchase.
  
This is probably one of the most interesting aspects of the entire Battle Pass system. Because you’re not just spending money, you’re using a resource that exists within WOO itself. That creates a different kind of decision-making process. You start thinking about opportunity cost. What else could I do with these tokens? Is this the best use of them? And that kind of thinking adds depth to the system.

* The Premium Track offers enhanced rewards that significantly increase the overall value of progression.
  
From what I’ve seen, the difference between Free and Premium is noticeable and it’s meant to be. The Premium Track is designed to feel like an upgrade, something that amplifies your progress rather than just adding a little extra. And as a player, that creates a clear incentive. You can see the added value, and you can decide if it aligns with how you want to play.

* It introduces a sense of commitment, where players who opt in are more likely to stay engaged throughout the season.
  
This is something I’ve noticed in other games as well, and it applies here too. Once you’ve unlocked the Premium Track, you naturally feel more invested in completing it. You don’t want to leave rewards unclaimed. And that commitment can actually enhance your overall experience because it gives you a stronger reason to stay consistent.

---

### ⚖️ The Strategic Decision: Free vs Premium

* Choosing between Free and Premium isn’t just about what you get — it’s about how you plan to engage with WOO over the season.
  
This is where things get personal. If you’re someone who logs in occasionally and plays more casually, the Free Track might be more than enough. But if you’re planning to engage consistently, complete quests, and push through levels, the Premium Track starts to look more appealing. It’s not a one-size-fits-all decision but it depends entirely on your playstyle.

* The timing of when to unlock Premium can also become part of your strategy.
  
This is something I find particularly interesting. You don’t necessarily have to unlock it immediately. You can progress through the Free Track, see how far you get, and then decide if upgrading is worth it based on your progress. That flexibility adds another layer of control for players, which I think is a great design choice.

* The system encourages players to evaluate value over time rather than making impulsive decisions.
  
Because everything is laid out clearly (the rewards, the progression, the structure) you can make an informed choice. You’re not guessing. You’re not taking a risk. You’re evaluating what’s in front of you and deciding what works best for you. And that kind of transparency is something I always appreciate in a game.

---

### 🔄 How This Changes Player Mindset

* Players start thinking more long-term, considering how their decisions impact their progression across the entire season.
  
This is one of the biggest shifts I’ve noticed. Instead of focusing on immediate rewards, you start thinking about the bigger picture. What do I want to achieve this season? How far do I want to go? And that long-term thinking adds depth to the overall experience.

* The system creates a sense of ownership over your progression path.
  
Whether you stay Free or go Premium, it feels like your journey. You’re making choices, setting goals, and deciding how you want to engage with the system. And that sense of ownership makes the experience more personal.

* It reinforces the idea that WOO is not just about playing. It’s about planning and optimizing your approach.
  
This has always been part of WOO to some extent, but the Battle Pass brings it to the forefront. You’re not just reacting to the game but are actively thinking about how to make the most of it.

---

### 💭 My Personal Take

So… is the Premium Track worth it?

Honestly? I think the better question is **“How do you want to experience Season 1?”** Because that’s what it really comes down to. If you’re just dipping your toes in, exploring the system, and playing casually, the Free Track is more than enough to give you a solid experience.

But if you’re planning to commit, to log in regularly, complete quests, and really push your progression, then the Premium Track starts to feel less like an option and more like a natural step forward.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.title: Nectar and NectarEngine v1.0.0 are Live on srbde
body.body:
Hey everyone!

Today, I’m excited to announce that both **hive-nectar v1.0.0** and **nectarengine v1.0.0** are officially live.

Even bigger news: to ensure their long-term growth and maintenance, I have moved both repositories from my personal GitHub (`@thecrazygm`) to the **`@srbde`** organization.

Here is what went into these major v1.0.0 releases.

---

## 1. hive-nectar v1.0.0: Under the Hood

![screenshot-20260527-093342.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thecrazygm/Eo6CEM1gwi23KZYyDhPLCvL2BdTRr6d8BeC5FpFGqaFxN1GWBwAXe5NnEYUnUUdEWgG.png)

This release isn't just a version bump. We completely ripped out the brittle, legacy components and replaced them with modern, secure standards.

### Cryptography Rebuilt from Scratch

We completely removed unmaintained cryptographic dependencies like `ecdsa`, `pycryptodomex`, and `scrypt`. They represented real supply-chain vulnerabilities. In their place, we introduced:

- **`coincurve`**: A Python binding to the audited C library `libsecp256k1` (used by Bitcoin Core). This makes transaction signing and public key recovery blazingly fast.
- **`cryptography`**: Python’s standard library for ciphers, password hashing, and DER serialization.
- **BIP32/BIP38 fixes**: Resolved legacy key derivation and address encoding issues so HD keys work exactly as expected.

### The \

Docker Fallback

Standard wallet libraries assume they can write to the host filesystem. If you try to deploy them in restricted, unprivileged Docker containers or Kubernetes pods, they crash on startup.

We built a **transparent in-memory fallback** for the SQLite keystore. If Nectar detects it doesn't have directory write permissions, it silently falls back to an in-memory database (`file:...mode=memory&cache=shared`). It just works.

### HTTPX2 Client Upgrade

We upgraded our underlying network layer library to `httpx2` to ensure modern HTTP protocol support, better connection pooling, and resilient retry behaviors.

---

## 2. nectarengine v1.0.0: Parity and Performance

![screenshot-20260527-093338.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thecrazygm/23tbKEGubw8WvPui5qRQm9gjdcPEfna3vYCJZqBmZ3Z9LKNDDKLb4G9o1gSZgn4tkVWvV.png)

Our companion command-line tool and library for managing Hive Engine tokens has been upgraded to matching standards.

- **HTTPX2 Support**: Upgraded the client to use `httpx2` for all contract queries and node list fetches.
- **Default RPC Domain Update**: Updated the default fallback Hive Engine RPC endpoint to `https://enginerpc.com/`.
- **Resilient Caching**: Improved node list caching logic. If the PeakD beacon API goes down, the engine falls back to local cached nodes gracefully instead of throwing exceptions.

---

## What about Legacy Scripts?

I know some of you have python scripts that are almost 10 years old. The core philosophy of this modernization is that **we do not break the existing API shapes**.

---

## Check Out the Repos

Both v1.0.0 releases are live on PyPI, and the source code is hosted on the `srbde` GitHub organization:

- 🍯 **hive-nectar**: [https://github.com/srbde/hive-nectar](https://github.com/srbde/hive-nectar)
- ⚙️ **nectarengine**: [https://github.com/srbde/nectarengine](https://github.com/srbde/nectarengine)

Grab the new versions, take them for a spin, and let me know if anything weird happens.

As always,

**Michael Garcia** a.k.a. **TheCrazyGM**
