Hello, my dear friends at Hive Food, I hope you're all doing well.

When we're busy with household chores or work, we want to eat something nutritious and satisfying while we're busy. So we take a little time to prepare something delicious yet easy to make, and I'm sharing this recipe for beet salad with you.

>Hola, mis queridos amigos de Hive Food, espero se encuentren bien.
Cuando estamos muy ocupados haciendo algunas tareas de la casa o quizás algo sobre nuestro trabajo, queremos comer algo nutritivo y que nos satisfaga mientras hacemos nuestras labores. Entonces nos tomamos un tiempito para poder preparar algo rico, pero fácil de preparar, así que les comparto esta receta de cómo preparar una ensalada de remolacha.


![sx.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23tHZXAiU2C5zYPcGjyiPPAUgS2qv27iaiWx4LyU46AsCc2iDzcJq5LWV6GLq8qUVf8wW.png)


![kkk.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/Eos3fHDn4YvtdUns7P7HioYLTihDE5fejm1VT9PgPqgPJcfFWGACS3GKxkvi51vbpeP.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wqdv4GxAdCTS7qcvxgEfWXJYkbwmuLYiVid4VbUvMobe5BhppK75HMQG3mTKJ3qi1nR.png)

Preparation:
We put the beetroot, carrot, egg and potatoes in a pot with water and cook them for 30 minutes, then we let them cool and start chopping them into small pieces.

>Preparación:
Vertimos la remolacha, la zanahoria, el huevo y las papas en una olla con agua y las ponemos a cocinar por 30 minutos y luego las dejamos enfriar y comenzamos a picarlas en trocitos pequeños.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vi6BPoKpDvoNWmJkivauWk9RLmwx2pmxjgoDyN5xFwtydG9hdz5xn5vgsHboBpuPdRd.png)

Then we add 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon of mustard, stir well, and then we add a touch of vinegar. and we can serve it.

>Luego le echamos 1 cucharada de mayonesa y 1 de mostaza, revolvemos bien luego le colocamos un chorrito de vinagre y podemos servirla.

body.title: When Bloodlust Becomes a Curse
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpAxgZCyztoYs8QKVbqQzCusi5dPgq9tTncczdF2uuQ7/thumbnail_battle_of_the_day.png)

Hello Splinterlands warriors, welcome back to another *Battle of the Day* with just four days remaining before the end of the season. Usually, when the season is about to wrap up like this, the Splinterlands arena feels like a night market right before closing time. Everyone suddenly gets serious. Players who are usually relaxed start using bizarre strategies. Those who normally conserve mana suddenly bring out expensive cards like they’ve just received their holiday bonus.

This time, I experienced a battle that was both interesting and frustrating. Interesting because I felt my strategy almost worked. Frustrating because I didn’t lose due to higher enemy damage, but because I misread the ruleset. It felt like riding a motorcycle against traffic and wondering why everyone is coming straight at you.

The ruleset for this match was **Equal Opportunity**, **Reverse Speed**, and **Are You Not Entertained**. Three rulesets that, when combined, feel like three advisors with completely different mindsets.

Equal Opportunity makes all monsters target the enemy with the lowest HP. Reverse Speed causes slower monsters to move first. And Are You Not Entertained allows gladiators into modern format. This is where I started to lose focus.

The moment I saw gladiators were allowed, my eyes lit up like a kid staring at a toy store display. I got too excited about using gladiator monsters and forgot that Reverse Speed is not a ruleset you can treat carelessly.

I chose the Death element with this lineup:

* Halfling Refugee
* Thornmaw Berserker
* Ujurak Brave
* Kotriphus Bayne
* Dark Arborist
* Gravebrand Warlock

In my mind, this formation was already ideal. There’s magic reduction from Ujurak Brave, high damage from Gravebrand Warlock, and my favorite gladiator: Kotriphus Bayne.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWUPu5WzTF2wzf3Nycr1d3GqV151t8ZzYnidFtCof3Lws/round_1.png)


And honestly, without Reverse Speed, the story might have been very different.

My opponent came with the legendary Archon Lorkus and a lineup that made me raise an eyebrow:

* Halfling Refugee
* Mad Ogre Anarchist
* Barashkukor
* Venka the Vile
* Umbral Elemental
* Fenmoor Haunt

As soon as the first round started, I felt my strategy was working well. My high-damage monsters began hunting down enemies with low HP. Equal Opportunity turned the battlefield into something like a family inheritance dispute—everyone rushed the weakest target.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVEqeDwWAK37ziceLX6t7bKF3NK2cvpNX2syuskLm9Gg/round_2.png)


One by one, the opponent’s backline monsters started falling. I felt confident.

Kotriphus Bayne began to activate. Bloodlust triggered. Damage increased. Stats improved. It felt like watching a football player score a goal and suddenly believe they could dribble from midfield all by themselves.

But that’s when the curse began.

Because of Reverse Speed, every increase in speed from Bloodlust became a disadvantage. The faster my Kotriphus Bayne got, the more often he attacked later. Even worse, his attacks started missing more frequently.

At that moment, I realized something important: in Reverse Speed, Bloodlust is not always a blessing. Sometimes it becomes a curse that arrives with a smile.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTBmcJvonGyQzCYxknCcxuYE1iDA22EywVA6fsbbT4Fq/round_3.png)


Meanwhile, on the opponent’s side, Mad Ogre Anarchist turned into a terrifying monster. The Life Leech ability allowed it to drain HP from my monsters with every attack. Slowly but surely, it became bulkier. And since its speed still aligned well with Reverse Speed, it kept attacking early with very few misses.

What initially felt like a balanced fight started to shift.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ5vzdqFaqW6i4SL1UqqHen7ZAcRQa3ifRwVpp7vVTUrd/round_6.png)


I still remember the moment when it came down to Kotriphus Bayne versus Mad Ogre Anarchist. I hoped that the multiple Bloodlust stacks would save me. But every missed attack felt like watching a winning ticket get blown away by the wind.

In the end, I had to accept defeat.

Battle replay here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_90ff3ce28141cbc6d382e40124d861fe?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

But losses like this are often the best teachers. Splinterlands isn’t always about who has the highest damage or the most expensive cards. Sometimes, it’s simply about who reads the ruleset more carefully.

Reverse Speed often traps players who focus too much on damage and forget about attack order. I fell into that trap this time. Bloodlust, which is usually a winning ticket, made my monster too fast to be effective.

And honestly, that’s part of what makes this game’s community so enjoyable. Sometimes we learn not from others’ victories, but from honest stories about defeat. I’ve personally learned a lot from players who share why they lost, not just those who show off their wins.

If I had one takeaway from this battle: don’t fall in love with Bloodlust too quickly when facing Reverse Speed. Sometimes the slow, ugly, and seemingly lazy monsters are actually the most deadly in this kind of ruleset.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)</center>

body.title: Noir Wallet Just Launched and It Is a Big Deal for Zcash
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYJSwF7pHbhemQ5JkFsYeRFvgyn6ZP4VQM6HMUYg5UkCi/1000010143.png 

The crypto world is buzzing with news from the Zcash ecosystem. Noir Wallet is officially live on the public mainnet and is now available on the Chrome Web Store. This launch is a breath of fresh air for privacy coin supporters because it brings the privacy by default feature that has always been the main selling point of Zcash.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmepK4ucnF3G6ooGq6S8sFWbZxQbLkR3wwvCRMNXsEkJ3c/1000010112.jpg 


This launch is not just another app release. It is a real effort by the Zcash team to make the coin easier to use for everyday people through browser accessibility. But we still need to be critical here. Many wallets launch in the market, so we have to see if this can actually fix the accessibility issues that have been holding Zcash back for a while. The news about upcoming ZECFi or Zcash DeFi support is definitely interesting. This might be the deciding factor on whether Zcash can truly compete in a DeFi world that is usually dominated by transparent protocols.

**ZEC Price Technical Analysis**
Let’s break down the ZEC price movement from a technical perspective.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZcb25toRcdAtEYSst63MyNeJJUUTqhYQEymsf9RqDNg5/1000010124.jpg 


Looking at the big picture on the 1 week timeframe, ZEC shows a very strong recovery from the bottom. Right now, the price is testing a major resistance zone between 757.60 and 640.25 dollars. If it can break through this area, the bullish momentum could keep going.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTy2DQxMY6icYqNpdxwoiVVC6zhaoSDkg2D6srJ34wY6Z/1000010132.jpg 


​On the 1 day timeframe, the price looks like it is in a healthy consolidation phase after the recent pump. As a reference, traders need to watch the support levels. The first support is in the zone of 310.00 to 272.85 dollars, the second support is between 204.46 and 165.37 dollars, and the final critical support sits in the zone of 45.50 to 37.25 dollars.

**Market Data and Liquidations**
Here is a look at the current market condition using the latest data.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmStS927xzsUaCGjMEHdJ4eDK6f8iBuFwTstTVo7woJsmF/1000010104.png 


Trading volume shows a big jump that matches the price increase. This high volume reflects that market interest in ZEC is currently very high.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf7YgnybnjLY2RgTf6zY8drTEXtb5QK6K3wmrcienZTK9/1000010105.png 



Total liquidations over the last 24 hours are around 11.39 million dollars. About 10.28 million dollars came from long position liquidations, and 1.11 million dollars came from short positions.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW5k49jqJpTi2KbfKrj4v8XsYzmhCgzCFviwkR6MqFuuu/1000010106.jpg 



**Is This Sustainable?**
Honestly, I am a bit skeptical if we are only relying on a wallet launch to keep the price at this level. The crypto market is brutal, and often, good news is just used as an excuse to sell the news.

My criticism is simple. Zcash has a heavy burden when it comes to privacy regulation. The more successful and private they become, the more attention they get from regulators. If Noir Wallet can really protect privacy without breaking legal boundaries, that is great. But if they keep getting chased by compliance issues, it will be hard for ZEC to last in the long run.

In short, ZEC is in an interesting spot right now. Keep your eyes open, don't just look at the green charts, and watch those support zones and the liquidations happening behind the scenes.

body.title: Hivechess Lecture: Overextension
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23wMgtohPGCEysVGsCCoTGXMSKUoJALuYTxAFxHDZTmkojhDsEcs4CjRCts4VNvGRuUH6.png)
Welcome to a new Hivechess lecture, and we will be looking at a new lesson that talks about Overextension. You know that moment when you are probably watching a movie, and you tell yourself the movie has gone too far, probably because of the acting, they have created a world where things do not seem to be real, or too scary, like the way horror movies can do a number on a person. Well, I like to see overextension as something like that as well, but this time in the game of chess. Overextension is when you get carried away by your chase for an attack on your opponent, and then, in return, you leave weakness behind. So when the attack does not amount to anything, you are left to deal with the weaknesses you left behind. As an attacking player, you have to calculate to a point that you gain something out of the attack, and as a defender, you need to know when your opponent is leaving a weakness behind due to the attack they are trying to launch, then punish it. In today's lecture, we will be looking at the game between Alexey Sarana and Harsha Bharathakoti from the Chicago Open. It is very vital to note that this lesson on overextension can come in very handy with the pawns. Due to the nature of their movement of only going forward and never coming back, they can become a source of weakness when your opponent overextends them during the course of an attack. Then one starts to exploit such a weakness. **1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 d5 4. Nc3 Nbd7** The game is a product of the Queen's Gambit Declined: Barmen Variation, where black refuses to capture the c4 pawn, instead going ahead with the development of his pieces. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tbyLm7nhXhwxnYds9xAujHNzLYpC7LpWzpSACVxW2REBySoUKhyGvmSCC9Zqhb7UQKE.png) This is a simple positional setup to expect when playing the Queen's Gambit declined. The play relies on the queenside and how quickly one can develop any of their pieces, either on the queenside or the kingside, but mostly starting with the queenside. The first state of overextension came in on move **7. Qc2 h6 8. Bh4 g5 9. Bg3 Nh5** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tbyLm7mG1dp3kbPiHsCQUCp6tNbFWNPRa48EyDJA3QS6fScffhrzQ3kihUAvM7a5dd9.png) On glance, it looks like a simple attack on the white dark-squared bishop, and that does not mean much. But here is what you are not taking into consideration: when those pawns on h7 and g7 were moved, they cannot return to that square anymore, which becomes important for the black king when black goes for short side castling (0-0). After castling to the kingside, the pawns on g7 and h7 serve as cover-ups for the king. Although at this point the computer engine says it is still okay with a +0.3 EVA bar, which is not really much advantage for a win for white. Also, do not forget to play well requires precision and accuracy, and now black has left some weaknesses that could be exploited when he loses the initiative. **10. O-O-O Nxg3 11. hxg3 g4 12. Nh4 Nb6 13. e4 Be6 14. Bd3 Qg5+ 15. Kb1 dxe4 16. Bxe4 O-O-O** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23tHC21xgenBcjSrCVD2mSAaaNBkDDvrctARozqgYwpUAnL4UAnW3om92HEM8m2t1GXaC.png) An expansion of the pawns on the kingside made black go for the queenside castle since his opponent had already done the same and had prepared the open h-file for his rook and a possible launch of attack on the same side if black had castled to the kingside. But look closely, the pawn on h6 will become a weakness when the pieces are taken off the board, that is, during the endgame. **17. Bf5 Bxf5 18. Qxf5+ Qxf5+ 19. Nxf5 Nd5 20. Rde1 Nxc3+ 21. bxc3 c5 22. Re4 cxd4 23. cxd4 Rd5 24. Rh5 Kd7 25. Rxg4 Rb5+ 26. Kc2 Ba3 27. Rf4 Rc8+ 28. Kd3 Bc1 29. Ng7** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7oec2jykJyjh7QPp1dBRVXHjsWBRqPwjeMgS8n9E2tfTR6AmixshybEftF7TncQjJB.png) In the process of the endgame, it has become clear that the pawn on the h-file is now a weakness for black, and that is not all; after that, there will be a means to create a passed pawn. The movement of one's pawn can cause an overextension that one cannot recover from. Here is the game link: [Game Link](https://lichess.org/broadcast/35th-annual-chicago-open/round-7/Ss5fGQb5/Z7OTM0k1) PGN Game: ``` [Event \

] 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 d5 4. Nc3 Nbd7 5. cxd5 exd5 6. Bg5 c6 7. Qc2 h6 8. Bh4 g5 9. Bg3 Nh5 10. O-O-O Nxg3 11. hxg3 g4 12. Nh4 Nb6 13. e4 Be6 14. Bd3 Qg5+ 15. Kb1 dxe4 16. Bxe4 O-O-O 17. Bf5 Bxf5 18. Qxf5+ Qxf5+ 19. Nxf5 Nd5 20. Rde1 Nxc3+ 21. bxc3 c5 22. Re4 cxd4 23. cxd4 Rd5 24. Rh5 Kd7 25. Rxg4 Rb5+ 26. Kc2 Ba3 27. Rf4 Rc8+ 28. Kd3 Bc1 29. Ng7 Rb2 30. Rxf7+ Kd6 31. f4 Rd2+ 32. Ke4 Re2+ 33. Kf3 Rxa2 34. Rxb7 Rc3+ 35. Kg4 Rxg2 36. Ne8+ 1-0 ```
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)
![Samostically Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eo6Cie7XPvRCoFSbPcHCY2WLfe8w5upAP4o2FvnNPV8d52md62bx9Gg7vhkcHNi1hnr.png)
I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles on the 64 squares and the insights from the books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

body.title: Testing Keychain Multichain with Altera from Magi
body.body:

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=keychain/b27c81c7)


---

The future of Hive Keychain is not just about supporting Hive anymore. It’s about making Hive the easiest gateway into the broader crypto ecosystem. In this video, you can see Hive Keychain being used to:

* Log in to Altera from the @magi.network with an EVM account
* Interact with an EVM dApp directly through Keychain and holding Hive tokens at the same time
* Swap HIVE to HBD using Magi’s swap features

And the best part? Everything happens from the same wallet you already use every day: Hive Keychain.

This is exactly why Multichain matters. When Hive Keychain launches Multichain support, users will simply be able to add their EVM accounts directly into Keychain and use their favorite dApps, tokens, and networks without needing to constantly jump between wallets. No matter if you are using:

* Hive
* Hive Engine
* L2 ecosystems
* EVM chains
* Stablecoins
* NFTs
* Bridges

body.title: The Joy of Manggahan 🥭 Colorful Street Dance - Part 2
body.body: /> And here's the second part of my Manggahan Street Dance experience. The next clusters are even more colorful than the previous ones. Here's the pink cluster with their black and pink costumes. They were all wearing headdresses with mango leaves and fruit. They wear their biggest smile while waving their hands with pink lace wristbands. The people screamed so hard, especially when they saw familiar faces among the performers. These performers are government employees. Each cluster represents a local government unit. So, no doubt why people were so ecstatic when each cluster started performing.

/> * * * * * * Next, is the yellow cluster. I guess this cluster is from the Government hospital. I saw a familiar face among the performers. It was actually my neighbor's son. He works as a Rad Tech in the Provincial Hospital.

/> * * * * * * The next cluster was so creative. They have costumes similar to a Dinagyang warrior. They have headdresses made from colorful, long feathers. Their t-shirts have this Chubby Chix logo. I'm not sure if they were Chubby Chix's employees or if their costumes were sponsored by Chubby Chix.

/> * * * * * * The performers were then followed by a band. They wore festive yellow costumes with colorful headdresses for the ladies. It was so loud but fun. People were cheering for them as well. 😁

/> After the band, everything went silent. People were waiting, and waiting.... While I was waiting, I noticed the sunset. It was far, but I can still see the golden glow. After the sun sets, everything will slowly turn dark. But the question is? Where are the next performers? Everyone was puzzled. I can hear people ask each other, but no one knows the answer yet. 😁 Well, the answer is on my next blog. I hope you're not bored yet with my street dance story. * * * * * *

>Texts and Images by @vvodjiu
The lead photo was edited on Canva
All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements

[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-ai-image/medium-shot-people-open-relationship_150952893.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=6&uuid=54113d33-bba9-44f0-bcf9-c36faee5dad2&query=supportive+group+ai+generated) 
The writing momentum is bouncing back. Day 2 and I am feeling determined to get things done. From the office work to writing and meeting up with a scheduled midweek, I have been up and running and I have to do it early enough to meet up.   Yesterday was that get back on course day and I was happy I got some encouragement replies from friends on chain. Hive as a platform should be beyond just tokens although yes it adds up. If we create a much stronger bind I feel there would have been others ways we could have helped ourselves out. Let's take for instance, you can learn one of two things from me as concerning my country while I learn although from you because we have gained trust along the line.  

I hope you know not everything you see on the internet is true, not to even add the fact of it being up to date. So what am I saying here; people carry much more reliable information if they are there. For instance, if you were to search about lifestyle as concerning my local government, all you will get is a surface summary. Ask me and the entire explanation will meet up in a novel.  

Ok, I wanted to focus on the article topic; ‘it’s in you’ and it seems I am delving a little. Not much away anyway, the idea can be that we can help each other on this chain to unlock potentials aside from talks and talks concerning Bitcoin and cryptocurrency at large. Growth is impact, can we create cross-border jobs, employment, education, help and so on through this platform.  

What if the next day you introduced someone to Hive the reason wouldn't be focused more on rewards, tokens, stakes and the rest. Maybe a talk about how meeting entrepreneurs on the global stage can be very vital. How about joining to learn how to pitch a good proposal and also having access to where to find grants and loans?. These are all suggestions that can make sense if properly leveraged.  

Millions to billions of people are crawling the internet daily looking for opportunities. We are talking of remote jobs and connections here. Is it something worth considering, that we can get more attention and it will be off just tokens. Just consider what happens if a fraction of this were passing through this platform. I think this is self advertising already.   

To conclude, let me add, a friend on the chain yesterday advised I should get back gradually so I won't be talking for long. The picture here is simple, there are so many tactical ways to push this platform to the top. Many things have come up and over time have died down. I can't ignore the efforts because some have been reputable projects yet one way or the other couldn't stand.   

Nevertheless, we also have to understand that help goes beyond momentary. In short, it was something I learnt some years back, different people are meant for different purposes in your life. Some may never give you money but will connect you to it.

Early in the morning, I started the day with a simple breakfast and a warm cup of coffee that made the atmosphere feel calm and peaceful. The fresh morning air and the sound of people preparing for the celebration created a special feeling that only comes once a year. After that, I spent time visiting several places to strengthen friendship and togetherness with family, neighbors, and close friends. Moments like this are always valuable because they allow us to reconnect, share stories, and enjoy the warmth of community life. Smiles, handshakes, and sincere conversations made the day even more memorable. Later in the day, I also helped with the process of slaughtering the qurban animals. Everyone worked together enthusiastically to prepare and distribute the meat to the community. It was tiring, but there was a sense of happiness and gratitude in being able to participate in such an important tradition. Eid al-Adha always reminds us about sacrifice, sincerity, and caring for others. In the afternoon, after all activities were completed, I finally had time to relax at home and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere. The cool evening breeze and the quiet surroundings became the perfect ending to a beautiful day filled with togetherness and gratitude. ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) ![IMG_20260515_172813.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX9UMHwHjNasDwQmWQocGEHytF7UBi5sctRttMczenCG8/IMG_20260515_172813.jpg) ![IMG_20260515_172810.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXhx3KJ8sW1XB3fw9Dt3f8Ja5pWf7jUvMytTXhq4VbiQ/IMG_20260515_172810.jpg) ![IMG_20260515_172810_1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaPeTuyykdpvvowdWxysuCXDMeSQUoLzeT8EcUo8RpMKH/IMG_20260515_172810_1.jpg) ![IMG_20260515_172807.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXvX3VxrFe5NqZ7U5u16ssVqgjW3UToBoECZrVMqN4CE7/IMG_20260515_172807.jpg) ![IMG_20260515_172804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQa7qde4XuTmnKDyGJPxXs8whb25pS29VyftCdFGnkyc1/IMG_20260515_172804.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

body.title: Drawing Different Kinds of Vegetables Using Oil Pastels
body.body:
![oil pastel.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowH9YMfsu2RSpwVhtiLG4XBirx9C8oPeMuPVpCsZViLrqZt3g446FSdr7Ddv5pg6T5.gif)
Hello, how are you? My head hurts today. I thought a caramel sundae would fix it, but it's just temporary. I woke up early today to free spay and neuter, guess who got spayed? Yes Mochi! I've been so nervous for days now, and I feel relieved that she is fine now, and the doctors who operated on her are so skilled that her scar doesn't look like a stitch at all, so I am so thankful for the free program like this. So maybe I am going to post my experience tomorrow or in the next few days. So yeah, I decided to change my subjects for my oil pastels. I saw a few vegetables on the refrigerator to make as a reference photo, so I did. I use carrots, bell pepper, red onion, and garlic. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiYYhJbH3p6eAzFiiLrniRhw4j3vQfYu2j1zfQsUHrkvk7Yzxo87U2aP2H6rWqwaic.JPG) At first, I hesitated to do it, but I have had a few experiences with it. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9yTziHQACRyZBvi8vWWJ4KEtEA2gGbXAyMrpdMebp9SXq4K1eTKJU3RbLuCNvgbJ.JPG) I use dark brown to draw the line art, which is a good start. And then I added the base colors of each vegetable with light pressure so that I could blend them easily when I layer them more. -----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEsQfoYxaRyV7NdyW62PRAYafs7ERXS7K3bE734bGuhVuJFx6wrFbPYiWHUod4cPPg.JPG) Then I layer it with more pressure this time, and then I left the other part not layered so that I can add the lightest color from it. Blue is the perfect color for the background, so I did a hatching first, so when I decided to change color, it would not be hard. ----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGpfZiUbbQVGZ6cRZ833mUnRM8ZRuRXd3ehLfmwfSLugDaEcy1ygwBPvmfiuPhw2u.JPG) Then I added shadow to the vegetables to make them more dimensional. I do this to make my eyes see which part needs more lighting and shadow. ---

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7hoFYWXnXBi6Q4RJm1WgG5qAk28LRrTfXWjpDM5JWRH5dYNgf2CgBhgY7mRroaVf.JPG) In this part, I added the accent colors, and then I started filling the background. -----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopuS9yWoQEmgoL3hexZttjPuZSB9wx2HQnan8azrqb4k3xwxZX139S1AvNWGGCRnJf.JPG) I added a different shadow color, not just black, to make it more dimensional and not flat. ----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK6nAMALUsRG1zTtPZJQVdTfuFoFsQtALyE4UYipJWUrijL5Z2nWYbU6DRdrJzTiE3.JPG) Then I use this clay tool as my scratching tool for today. I forgot where I placed the usual clay tool I use for scratching. I use this to add texture to the drawing. -----

> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiVmpwfb8PkXts5pT6atVAZN2AhKH7XS3QiumStbUmDy41XMmT1Vc8bus3ZTd4Ny9z.JPG) The scratching serves as both a thin line and a highlight. Since I discovered this technique, I can't stop doing it. LOL. ----

> ![22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1Xu7VxRrS9McnjgDWopENBz8JXdDFUMyV5qtgPzd8ijqDkyshTmbh4QAtSwnTimkX.JPG) Now I use it to add my signature too, which is so cool. ------ ![24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFsBRmvPAz43arja5GdNMErHdaEw2qZXbtfq5LuYtbvcXmFqPxnhfCDic12bRcpPa.JPG) I hope you like it. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

body.title: Cuando el horno se apaga, el código se enciende: Mi lucha por recuperar mi Panadería en Venezuela 🇻🇪💻 \n
body.body:
Hola comunidad de Hive! Soy Darwin Zamora, desde Los Teques, Venezuela.

Muchos me conocen como el panadero de la Panadería Ebenezer, pero hoy mi realidad es distinta. Por falta de materia prima, el horno que cada mañana llenaba de aroma mi calle está apagado. Es una situación dura que muchos emprendedores en mi país entenderán, pero he decidido que mis manos no se queden cruzadas.

Si no puedo amasar harina, voy a \

código. 

En los últimos meses he estado aprendiendo programación (HTML/JS) desde mi móvil. Lo que empezó como una curiosidad se ha convertido hoy en mi herramienta de resistencia. He creado un Ecosistema Digital de Calculadoras para ayudar a otros comerciantes que, como yo, luchan con los retos diarios de nuestra economía:

•Calculadora de Pagos Mixtos: Para resolver el dolor de cabeza de recibir dólares y bolívares al mismo tiempo.•Generador de Pago Móvil: Para profesionalizar las ventas por WhatsApp.•Menús Digitales con QR: Para que los negocios locales den el salto a lo digital.

Mi meta es clara: usar mi talento digital para generar el capital necesario, comprar los sacos de harina y volver a encender los motores de mi panadería. No me rindo. Si el pan no sale hoy, sale una nueva herramienta web.

Gracias a todos por leerme y por el apoyo que siempre me brindan. ¡Seguimos adelante!

body.title: Delicious Sandwich For Lunch
body.body:
> Today I want to show you what lunch I prepared for my workday at the office today. It's been a long time since I brought a sandwich to work, but this day has come :) I made a sandwich with brie cheese, iceberg, smoked turkey, cherry tomatoes. For me, this is quick and easy to prepare, and it will also fill me up and bring me pleasure to eat. ![San (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ5bpb1ghYcGyhLwPEhrhWTLZS6MYdvkR4517C8ssr1rJ/San%20(1).jfif)
You only need a few products 1 loaf of bread, can be whole grain (optional) 100 g brie cheese 50 g smoked turkey meat 4-5 leaves iceberg lettuce 6-7 cherry tomatoes, cut in half Mayonnaise or mustard (optional) Salt and pepper to taste
![San (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT9FacJ53BgiNWSTgeuh2Aanp1JPgrCmCUZG3HQ9GmxyL/San%20(6).jfif) To make such a sandwich, you need to cut the bread so that you can put the products inside it. I advise you to take the brie cheese out of the refrigerator at least 30 minutes before cooking, so that it softens slightly. This will make it easier to cut it. If necessary, cut the smoked turkey meat into smaller pieces. Wash the iceberg lettuce leaves well and dry them with kitchen paper. Then cut them into thin strips. Wash the cherry tomatoes and cut them in half. ![San (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuhXmcNFqZL5UnsPpoucaa8czMaL7Aup5LjgN5Lncs5N/San%20(5).jfif) Take the bread and spread it with a little mayonnaise or mustard (if desired). This will add extra flavor and help the ingredients stick better to the bread. Then place the brie cheese on the spread. Spread it evenly to cover the entire surface. Place the smoked turkey pieces on top of the brie cheese. Make sure they are also evenly distributed to form the sandwich and not fall off. Add the chopped iceberg lettuce leaves on top of the smoked turkey. They add freshness and crunch to the sandwich. Finally, add the halved cherry tomatoes on top of the rest of the ingredients. Their sweet and juicy flavor will complement the rest of the ingredients. You can sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. ![San (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPnPcZvJFtUAuv5qDegAphcZmL2HJxHYV36cNAuBVvfF2/San%20(4).jfif) Finally, press lightly to seal all the layers. If you plan to take the sandwich with you to the office, like me :) wrap it in aluminum foil or put it in a lunch box. This will keep the sandwich fresh and ready to eat during the day. ![San (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaovRoYExxZ2R2ZwByUPcotUqAVBG8QYeWT7kvEtU2pWx/San%20(3).jfif) Bon appetit and have a good working day! :)

body.title: The wizards of lies.
body.body:
<center>[AARP](https://www.aarp.org/podcasts/the-perfect-scam.html)</center>
Yesterday, I needed to go to the bank to resolve some issues in person. While I was (impatiently) waiting in line to be served, I was very shocked to notice how people are being swayed by the recommendations of countless digital influencers who claim to understand financial investments (in a general and unrestricted way), promising rewards far above average... Through partnerships that are veritable pyramid schemes.
The number of new creators of this type of content grows absurdly every day, spreading like a virus. It is quite true that not all of them are disposable names, because there is a small percentage of influencers who really have a great base of knowledge (theoretical and practical) to work within this segment to the point of advising (or even directly influencing) other people on how they should invest their own money.
In any case, unfortunately, it is the bad side that ends up gaining more prominence within this whole scenario (because they are usually \

to partnerships that often remain hidden from the general public) and manages, without much effort, to enter the minds of these people (who tend to be more uninformed... and here it is very worthwhile to emphasize the importance of seeking the known before taking any step within this branching universe).\nWithout any exaggeration, around me, there were different types of financial content being consumed by a group of people of different age ranges while they used their smartphones or talked about this same type of subject (traditional economics and crypto economics) face to face. The \

in this scenario was precisely the digital influencers, who, like true wizards of lies, seem to cast spells on lost minds. ---
**Los magos de las mentiras.**
Ayer, tuve que ir al banco para resolver algunos asuntos en persona. Mientras esperaba (impacientemente) en la fila, me sorprendió mucho ver cómo la gente se deja influenciar por las recomendaciones de innumerables influencers digitales que afirman entender de inversiones financieras (de forma general y sin restricciones), prometiendo ganancias muy superiores a la media... A través de colaboraciones que son auténticos esquemas piramidales. El número de nuevos creadores de este tipo de contenido crece de forma desmesurada cada día, extendiéndose como un virus. Es cierto que no todos son nombres desechables, porque existe un pequeño porcentaje de influencers que realmente poseen una sólida base de conocimientos (teóricos y prácticos) para desenvolverse en este sector hasta el punto de asesorar (o incluso influir directamente) a otras personas sobre cómo deberían invertir su dinero. En cualquier caso, lamentablemente, es el lado negativo el que termina ganando protagonismo en todo este escenario (porque suelen estar “atados” a alianzas que a menudo permanecen ocultas al público) y logra, sin mucho esfuerzo, influir en la mente de estas personas (que tienden a estar menos informadas... y aquí es muy importante recalcar la importancia de informarse bien antes de dar cualquier paso en este complejo universo). Sin exagerar, a mi alrededor, un grupo de personas de distintas edades consumía diversos tipos de contenido financiero mientras usaban sus teléfonos inteligentes o conversaban cara a cara sobre el mismo tema (economía tradicional y criptoeconomía). El “hilo conductor” de este escenario eran precisamente los influencers digitales, quienes, como auténticos maestros de la manipulación, parecen hechizar a las mentes perdidas. ---
**Os magos das mentiras.**
Ontem, eu precisei ir ao banco para resolver alguns problemas pessoalmente. Enquanto eu estava (impacientemente) esperando na fila para ser atendido, eu fiquei muito assustado ao notar como as pessoas estão se deixando levar pelas recomendações de inúmeros influenciadores digitais que dizem entender sobre aportes financeiros (de um modo geral e irrestrito), prometendo as recompensas muito acima da média... Através de parcerias que são verdadeiras pirâmides. O número de novos criadores desse tipo de conteúdo cresce absurdamente a cada novo dia, se espalhando como um vírus. É bem verdade que nem todos eles são nomes descartáveis, porque há uma pequena parcela de influenciadores que realmente tem uma ótima base de conhecimento (teórico e prático) para trabalhar dentro desse segmento a ponto de aconselhar (ou até mesmo influenciar diretamente) as outras pessoas como elas devem investir o próprio dinheiro. De todo modo, infelizmente, é o lado ruim acaba conseguindo um maior destaque dentro de todo esse cenário (porque geralmente estão “amarrados” com parcerias que muitas vezes permanecem ocultas do público em geral) e consegue, sem fazer muito esforço, entrar na mente dessas pessoas (que tendem a ser mais desinformadas... e aqui vale muito à pena ressaltar a importância da busca pelo conhecido antes de dar qualquer passo dentro desse universo ramificado). Sem exagero algum, ao meu redor, haviam diferentes tipos de conteúdos financeiros sendo consumidos por um grupo de pessoas com faixas etárias diversas enquanto elas usavam os seus smartphones ou falavam sobre esse mesmo tipo de assunto (economia tradicional e economia cripto) frente a frente. O “fio condutor” nesse cenário era justamente os influenciadores digitais, que como verdadeiros magos das mentiras, parecem lançar feitiços sobre as mentes perdidas. O quão triste isso consegue ser? body.title: Thought Of Quitting?
body.body:
On several occasions, I have thought of quitting Hive, simply because I started feeling tired and discovered, but I will  tell you why. Despite those feelings, I'm still here pushing. There are three reasons for that .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUMHQN2D9UdZ7WhiySdu9o9hQkaMVFvBo1zTM2wcirTWM/ai_generated.webp)
AI generated 

The first reason I almost wanted to quit was because of people around me. Some people usually see me with my phone, always writing, engaging, and spending time on Hive. They often make jest of me and ask how much I have really made from it. Some even say that by now I should have bought tangible things with my earnings. At some point, those comments really got into my head and made me question myself. But after thinking deeply, and remembering that everyone's path in life is different  and success does not happen overnight, I told myself again never to allow people’s opinions to define my journey.

The second reason was the rewards.
 seeing the value of Hive depreciating can be discouraging. It can make someone feel like their efforts are not being seen. Sometimes I spend quality time writing a post, and trying my best to stay active on the blockchain only to receive little or no reward at all. There were times I felt like giving up completely because of this.

Then the third reason was that I initially found it difficult to engage and consistently write posts. It felt stressful thinking about what to write, topics and all that. But when I started joining different communities, everything gradually became more interesting and enjoyable.

So why do I still keep showing up here?
I keep showing up because writing is gradually becoming a part of me, In my own little way. I have seen myself improving day by day. Hive has helped me grow creatively, and personally the love and support I receive, and the beautiful connections I have built has kept me here. I have met great people with similar interests, I have met supportive minds who are willing to go extra miles with you, people who are willing to offer their encouraging words any day any time. 

Most importantly, I feel safe here. I have freedom here — freedom to express myself, freedom to share my thoughts and experiences, but freedom that is still guided by principles and respect.

So, after experiencing all these beautiful things, how can I simply walk away from Hive? I'm here to stay 😄😄😄😄. 

I just shared my experience, what about yours? @tigrace @amara24 @oluwa-tosin please come and share your reasons of staying around. 

This is @sarahbaby. Thank you all for visiting my blog.

body.title: (ESP-ENG) Lee Cronin's The Mummy | Possessions aren't always scary - Movie Reiview!
body.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>**

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tGXQbyF3WcC7nhpVoXkVzHAFxh2qa4qoE7HhUMEa2kbdSFgAykwFR2KW828UJgkgyBk.jpg)


[Source!](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/0MSZUQC9PI1F0IRPDTFK1Z65IR)

<div class=\

>Lee Cronin es un director de cine irlandés que se caracteriza por su terror bien grafico, lleno de gore y escenas bien explicitas que no dejan indiferentes a nadie. Una de sus películas más sobresalientes y conocidas fue Evil Dead Rise, parte de una trilogia que se completará este año con Evil Dead Burn. Pero no solo Cronin estuvo en este film, también James Wan, un hombre que ha hecho varios títulos de terror de mucho nombre: la saga del conjuro, Maligno, Annabelle, etc. Y por si eso no fuera poco fue producida por Blumhouse. Pero, por qué digo esto? - pues porque uno pensaría que con semejantes nombres a cargo de una historia esta sería impresionante pero para mi estuvo muy lejos de eso.

> Lee Cronin is an Irish film director known for his graphic horror, full of gore and explicit scenes that leave no one indifferent. One of his most outstanding and well-known films was Evil Dead Rise, part of a trilogy that will be completed this year with Evil Dead Burn. But Cronin wasn't the only one involved in this film; James Wan, a man who has directed several high-profile horror titles—The Conjuring series, Evil Dead, Annabelle, etc.—was also involved. And if that weren't enough, it was produced by Blumhouse. But why do I say this? Well, because one would think that with such names attached to a story, it would be impressive, but for me, it fell far short.

>Tenemos a una familia que estaba viviendo en El Cairo ya que el papá es periodista y estaba trabajando por allá. Un día, su hija Katie desaparece sin dejar ningún tipo de rastro mientras ella estaba en el jardín de su casa hablando con alguien desconocido. Como es obvio comienza una busqueda que al final no lleva a ningún lado. Pasa el tiempo, unos 8 años más o menos, y esta familia volvió a los Estados Unidos, hicieron una vida nueva, tuvieron otra hija pero el recuerdo de Katie sigue intacto en sus mentes. Todo cambia cuando los padres reciben una llamada desde Egipto afirmando que su hija perdida había aparecido pero en un estado bastante más oscuro y desolador.

> We have a family living in Cairo, as the father is a journalist working there. One day, their daughter Katie disappears without a trace while she's in their garden talking to someone unknown. Naturally, a search begins, but it ultimately leads nowhere. About eight years pass, and the family returns to the United States, starts a new life, and has another daughter, but the memory of Katie remains vivid. Everything changes when the parents receive a call from Egypt claiming their missing daughter has reappeared, but in a much darker and more desolate state. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/EnynWWKzVfnGHEq5fNuhXwBsCNMC8abVhoqKK8QPs5b9vHsMmMiLJna1hoP2TWq4yMq.jpg) [Source!](https://punchdrunkcritics.com/2026/04/cronin-65726/) --- ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wBzxmCZricVAVRfVcH34n7gX2ZbAS9ijShUAVURsWYkawHjawh55cCkw3GmGnVqJv9C.jpg) [Source!](https://time.com/article/2026/04/16/-lee-cronins-the-mummy/)

>Katie no era la misma, era un cuerpo sin alma; era un recipiente que albergaba algo mucho más siniestro y ancestral con un poder maligno inimaginable. A pesar de las claras pruebas y evidencias tanto físicas como de comportamiento que presentaba Katie de que algo no estaba bien los padres, como lo harían cualquiera, decidieron llevara a casa. Como era de esperarse las cosas nunca más fueron iguales, todo el ambiente y entorno cambió por completo convirtiendo una casa familiar en una pesadilla en donde pasan cosas muy raras. A partir de acá lo que veremos son los típicos episodios de posesiones que conocemos junto a la familia que está buscando entender que es lo que realmente está sucediendo, sobretodo el papá con la fibra periodista que tiene.

> Katie wasn't the same; she was a soulless body, a vessel housing something far more sinister and ancient, possessing unimaginable malevolent power. Despite the clear physical and behavioral evidence that something was wrong with Katie, her parents, as anyone would, decided to take her home. As expected, things were never the same again. The entire atmosphere and environment changed completely, transforming a family home into a nightmare where bizarre things happen. From here on, we witness the typical possession stories we're familiar with, alongside the family trying to understand what's really going on, especially the father, with his journalistic instincts.

>Todas las escenas en donde vemos el gore, la crudeza de lo que significa estar poseído por un demonio de unos 6 mil años de antigüedad están bien logradas, ese maquillaje es top, los efectos visuales están decentes, hay un par de cosas que no me gustaron pero en líneas generales es algo que se puede ver. Cual fue mi problema? - que nunca conecté con la parte del miedo. Los demonios y los niños se cree que son los elementos que más miedo dan en una película de terror y si los unes pues el resultado tendía que ser espectacular. Lo que me pasa es que nunca vi con ojos de miedo a Katie poseída, a lo mejor era la intención del director, seguir viendo la dulzura e inocencia de la niña debajo del físico malogrado pero la cosa es que nunca sentí el suspenso ni el terror como capaz otros si lo percibieron.

> All the scenes depicting gore and the raw brutality of being possessed by a 6,000-year-old demon are well done. The makeup is top-notch, the visual effects are decent, and there are a couple of things I didn't like, but overall it's watchable. My problem? I never connected with the fear aspect. Demons and children are generally considered the most frightening elements in a horror film, and combining them should result in something spectacular. However, I never saw Katie possessed with fear. Perhaps that was the director's intention, to continue seeing the sweetness and innocence of the girl beneath her damaged body, but the fact is, I never felt the suspense or terror that others might have. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23t79Ku4L5X8MR7BCuRVEqTzsC3B5rvHtS9XShyyYjREpGmHaD4jAVWdZDDSMMYpzYf2R.jpg) [Source!](https://www.aullidos.com/noticia/43645/primer-clip-the-mummy-lee-cronin-terror/) --- ![5.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23swc1PEMWXqc81eKnmkkGi6Lfxecp3nveZGH5wTrfQiaHh3moq1f1zDviJoTZaMSVdtL.webp) [Source!](https://www.fangoria.com/lee-cronins-the-mummy-new-clip/)

>Al final la historia no solo es una posesión y ya, le suman el hecho de que es algo antiguo y que por medio rituales es que este demonio emigra de cuerpo en cuerpo. Que tenga que ver con la historia del Egipto antiguo es cool, por lo menos le dieron un significado y una profundidad al origen de todo. Las actuaciones estuvieron bien, nada que destacar, evidentemente el trabajo de la actriz que hace de la niña es bueno, hacer esos papeles no es fácil por lo que si, hay que reconocer eso. Es un film promedio, ideal para ver si estás buscando algo ligero de terror. Le doy un 5.5/10. Tenía muchas expectativas que al final no se cumplieron. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo.

> In the end, the story isn't just about possession; it's also about something ancient, and the demon migrates from body to body through rituals. The connection to ancient Egyptian history is cool; at least they gave meaning and depth to the origin of it all. The acting was fine, nothing remarkable, although the actress playing the little girl did a good job. Playing those roles isn't easy, so that deserves recognition. It's an average film, ideal if you're looking for something light on horror. I give it a 5.5/10. I had high expectations that ultimately weren't met. I've included the trailer below. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XJ0uv-phsDk ***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos vemos en la próxima!
***

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.title: A beautiful route through the walled cities
body.body:
![_202605270827.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/23xARfJHRjqSNtReGayKFygy15vYnG8Dn1e1i5kY7fTFuxnGJ1nP89hfaacMG4sfdcdWR.jpeg)


Hello friends, today I want to share with you a very interesting tour that I did by bike in Veneto, an itinerary of which I will leave you all the information under this post, a circular tour of the Walled cities, This is the route that I found on the internet and let's say I did it in part because it is quite challenging and of course I will share with you some photos that I took during the route.

![_scatto_202605270828.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/2458G4engA8sNUQXN6bsid7xM6EHjrZjAdDyy95moUL42rxUgX8VD3WiP6YnwEQsriSpQ.jpeg)

In my opinion, especially for someone who comes to Italy by bicycle or brings his bicycle, these itineraries are very beautiful because in a very slow way they allow you to discover the territory, and I too. I practically took a train from Milan and got off at the Cittadella station. Even if unfortunately train transport in Italy is always a source of anxiety, because between delays and cancellations you never know if you will arrive, part of the circular route began from there. In fact, I did not do the whole complete tour but I practically reached the medieval city of Montagnana which I recommend you visit, in addition to that of Cittadella where I started.

![_scatto_202605271025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/241tQgLda6TcfymJSRfMP1AEHQRS5kNEwSTDDpKyXKKBDJyRfTayEF6dMa9wMfsZkDnmB.jpeg)

praticamente la bici mi era stata prestata da mio cugino Perché la mia ha dei problemi del cambio  ed è stato molto interessante perché ci sono tanti punti panoramici dove fare foto e dove  imparare anche qualcosa sulla storia , e lo trovo veramente in eccitante farlo in bicicletta perché è proprio questo turismo lento intanto non è  impattante per il traffico e poi vuoi osservare meglio e con calma tutto il percorso è quello che vedi lungo il percorso.

![_scatto_202605271027.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/23r1cEa51vS6WrhTAqabaVgJ93dnTEejcBBaRuLi7rNmU6FqbnapyS82vLaqqdVRNeqV5.jpeg)

Of course, the day was very muggy and so it is always difficult to pedal when there is this climate mainly because of the heat, but fortunately along the route every now and then you find some fountain that works, then I arrived in Montagnana from where the station is and where I took the train back to Milan, in my opinion the combination of towing and bike is something that any state should invest in Because you really make the economy go around in this way, especially on a tourist level, stay connected because I will certainly share some other routes that I will do in the next few days, because as I was telling you Lately I feel in shape so I really want to pedal, I thank you for reading See you next time.

https://www.magicoveneto.it/bike/este-montagnana-legnago/Anello-Ciclistico-delle-Citta-Murate-Montagnana-Bevilacqua-SanSalvaro-Vighizzolo-Este.htm

body.body: For a while my publications have been based on photographs. They require a large investment of time that I make because I enjoy doing them, but it is difficult to calculate the real amount of time and its monetary value. \n\nFirst I go out to explore places, exhibitions or interesting events that I then want to share. Sometimes they arise from my activities and I don't \

go out to look for them. I take the photos with my mobile phone, an iPhone.

Then I select and organise the photographs. I edit them very little, only the basics. I do this on the computer, a Mac, with the programs that come by default.

Then I write my story while I add the photos. Sometimes I also research related data and add the links of the references...

To publish I use PeakD, where I have some templates for the header and footer of the posts. As an English translator I use DeepL.

Ah, finally after posting I respond to the comments I receive. I like that dialogue with readers that also consumes a lot of time. I like to be proportionate and grateful for what I receive.

!PIMP

body.title: Mistral Medium 3.5 and Grok 4.3: When Efficiency Becomes a Competitive Advantage
body.body:
Not every advance in LLMs needs to come from trillion-parameter models. Late April and early May 2026 brought two releases that bet on a different premise: frontier-level performance at substantially lower cost, with architectures that make deliberate choices about what to optimize.

Mistral Medium 3.5: The Best Open Dense Model for Code
------------------------------------------------------

The Mistral Medium 3.5, released on May 2, 2026, is a bet against the tide. While virtually every major model in 2026 uses Mixture of Experts, the Mistral Medium 3.5 is a dense model — 128 billion total parameters, all active on every inference.

The choice is not architectural naivety. It is a product decision: dense models have more predictable behavior across varied hardware, more consistent per-inference latency, and none of the edge cases that arise when MoE routing activates unusual experts. For self-hosted deployment, that has real operational value.

### What the Medium 3.5 Delivers

The benchmark numbers are precise about where the model sits. On SWE-Bench, the Medium 3.5 scores 77.6% — better than any available open-source dense model. It falls below Claude Sonnet 4.6 and DeepSeek V4 Pro among higher-capacity models, but at half the cost of Sonnet.

The Medium 3.5 runs on four GPUs. It does not require a cluster of 8 or 16 GPUs like the larger MoE models. For operations that lack datacenter-scale infrastructure but want real code performance in production, that is the pitch: 77.6% SWE-Bench on hardware that fits in a four-GPU server.

**Specifications:**  
128 billion parameters (dense)  
256,000 token context window  
$1.50 per million input tokens via API  
Available as open weights under a modified MIT license

The modified MIT license matters: it allows commercial use without restrictions in most cases, with specific attribution requirements. More open than the Meta Llama license, less open than pure MIT.

### Positioning in the Ecosystem

The Medium 3.5 replaces Devstral 2 and Magistral in Mistral's lineup, consolidating chat, reasoning, and code capabilities into a single model. Mistral explicitly stated it will no longer maintain separate models for each function — Medium 3.5 is the unified flagship.

For engineering teams that prefer a single production model for varied tasks — rather than routing between multiple specialized models — this simplifies system architecture.

Grok 4.3: Native Reasoning and Aggressive Pricing
-------------------------------------------------

Grok 4.3, from xAI, entered beta on April 17, 2026, with general API access from May 1. It is the most significant xAI release since Grok 4.20.

### What Changed from 4.20

The 4.3 incorporates native reasoning — the model \

before responding, similar to the approach of DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI o3. Reasoning is integrated into standard inference, not a separate mode that needs to be explicitly activated.

The context window is 1 million tokens. Native video input — the ability to directly process video files, not just static images — sets the 4.3 apart from most competitors that still process video via extracted frames.

**Key benchmarks:**  
Intelligence Index: 53 (market median: 35)  
CaseLaw v2: first place among all tested models  
CorpFin: first place among all tested models  
300+ Elo gain in GDPval-AA versus Grok 4.20

CaseLaw and CorpFin are legal and financial reasoning benchmarks, respectively. Leading those categories signals relevant specialization for specific professional sectors.

### Pricing and Access

Grok 4.3 via API is priced at $1.25 per million input tokens — aggressively below GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7, and competitive with Gemini 3.1 Pro. The model has no open weights; it is accessible exclusively through xAI's API.

xAI does not have the integration ecosystem of OpenAI or Anthropic, but the pricing and benchmarks in legal and financial reasoning create a clear niche: professional services firms that need sophisticated reasoning at controlled cost.

The Logic of Efficiency
-----------------------

What Mistral Medium 3.5 and Grok 4.3 share is a positioning that does not compete directly with GPT-5.5 or Claude Opus 4.7 at the absolute performance ceiling. They compete at the second tier — models that deliver 85-90% of frontier performance at 30-50% of the cost.

For most production use cases, that second tier is sufficient. The difference between 87% and 77% on SWE-Bench matters for software engineering automation at scale. For document analysis, content generation, customer support, and most enterprise workflows, it does not.

Pricing acting as a form of technical competition is one of the most important dynamics of 2026. It is not just the best models that reshape markets — it is the good-enough models at prices that make adoption irresistible.

body.title: State of Art #1 — Seeing Differently EN-ES
body.body:
State of Art #1 — Seeing Differently

I’ve wanted to create a space like this for a while. Not because there aren’t art communities already, but because I couldn’t really find one that felt made for the kind of work I enjoy creating. >Llevaba tiempo queriendo crear un espacio así. >No porque no existan comunidades de arte, sino porque no terminaba de encontrar una donde encajara el tipo de cosas que me gusta hacer.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/23yJ81qXzLn5t8kpzttek9SF88C9RrYUYox7p6p4jT8nic72hicUnSQmsz8YVnw6pqfUm.png) This community is for conceptual images, visual experiments, photography, digital compositions, handmade edits, unfinished ideas and personal interpretations. Not necessarily perfect work. Just intentional work. >Esta comunidad es para imágenes conceptuales, experimentos visuales, fotografía, composiciones digitales, ediciones hechas a mano, ideas sin terminar e interpretaciones personales. >No hace falta que sea algo perfecto. Solo que tenga intención detrás.
One thing I’d especially like to encourage here is sharing process. >Me gustaría especialmente fomentar enseñar el proceso. Not only posting the final result. Show screenshots. Show layers. Show sketches. Show mistakes. Show paint. Show how you arrived there. >No solo subir el resultado final. >Enseña capturas. >Enseña capas. >Enseña bocetos. >Enseña errores. >Enseña pintura. >Enseña cómo has llegado hasta ahí. Photoshop, real painting, photography, collage, textures, cameras, mixed techniques… whatever your process is. >Photoshop, pintura tradicional, fotografía, collage, texturas, cámara, técnicas mixtas… el proceso que sea.
For my first post I wanted to do exactly that. >Para este primer post quería hacer justamente eso. ![ojosmovidoschica.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/EqQQ34kkf5uukMSLhtbKNk14fiNyjeZKX4Y4g9hz3p4Ys39uQL7pj7eGAzo4KxttpA8.jpg) I started from a portrait and instead of building more, I tried removing. I isolated the eye area and moved it slightly. Just enough to create tension without losing the face. >Empecé desde un retrato y en vez de construir más, probé a quitar. >Separé la zona de los ojos y la moví ligeramente. >Lo justo para generar tensión sin romper del todo la imagen. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/244ojrBcQC8CyHufxUgZZmncLHBcrm7fbkzwBGwKrimFkyeAEsD5WdjedXBAmEWwQPNTn.png) While editing I kept testing positions and proportions in Photoshop until it felt wrong in the right way. The screenshots show part of that process. ![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/23uQhpwGcKXrgeJEhDFGQdwKcaDz9VCAAdf7xLvfS25TTFjQoNBYngFhaRfyg8ykcZgrC.JPG) ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/EokcfjpmvbNHp5Q3GG5JR3Wq9SeXDkuE5ysT6SFWMm9tCgwR3gzfPP31Zut8DMbLq2c.JPG) >Mientras editaba fui probando posiciones y proporciones en Photoshop hasta que empezó a sentirse raro… pero bien. >Las capturas enseñan parte de ese proceso. The final black and white version felt more silent and more direct than color, so I stayed there. >La versión final en blanco y negro me transmitía más silencio y más fuerza que en color, así que ahí se quedó.
If you post here, I’d love to see not only what you made, but also how you made it. >Si publicas aquí, me gustaría ver no solo qué has hecho, sino también cómo has llegado hasta ello. **Welcome to State of Art** ![ChatGPT Image May 27, 2026, 10_59_22 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramon2024/23yJ81qXzLn5t8kpzttek9SF88C9RrYUYox7p6p4jT8nic72hicUnSQmsz8YVnw6pqfUm.png)

body.title: Wednesday Walk: Around The Neighborhood
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2LYgFtEryfbyS7tDQsMEqLM5fwy7YMbdSdCqhqykh45/1779888719797.png)

‎Hello everyone! Happy Wednesday to all of us joining on our lovely walk today. 🥰🌸
‎
‎Here in our place, this Wednesday afternoon turned out rainy and cloudy. I’m so glad we already decided to take our walk yesterday, Tuesday afternoon, instead. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzi5Laa5wg2df1rjtCHaRC5wTARkcNiUuDEiG6gGVbhi/1779888760911.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQePcQGYoZg99Ef8q9fd8XRi4ZG3ufqAogCjtBs8Kfyt/1779888761078.jpg)
‎
‎I invited my hubby to step out for a short stroll around our neighborhood, right around sunset time. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNc7UEHPRqW7YmXiXcHdAXpu7UGYHYeeg5H92dGEuFeL/1779888814676.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdLnoD6oyMrWRmX4q94TTvF9HaJWafvugBmcSGyxJB2Zc/1779888814774.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVgLv7SEwFbETFJe6NXWmQFkeGFyUY9vNvFvUA3hqfn1/1779888814884.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKnVnfkUiohGznfdsYxArDZErVacVhm3Ak1U1N4nk5NX/1779888815023.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgjyNuskN1KBQotT5KS1oaiB12ZtbUnFwiX8YQKzR8kD/1779888815169.jpg)

‎We brought along our two kids, Ryzen and Aiden, and they were so excited to go with us. 🥰
‎
‎It was already 5:44 PM, but the sun was still high and bright up in the sky. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaWbvwUYaJxbtUBXo5NrfmrbMjZY7JoGzRH3RhHt3iscV/1779888863843.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmebsoBYiDbFkPJ5gmcwMfp1xMdK8mg6Jm7FCtpHXG7waF/1779888863990.jpg)

‎It was also a hot afternoon, and there was no wind blowing at all. 🤦🏻‍♀️
‎
‎Every step we took, I could really feel the warmth around us. 
‎
‎It was a bit sweaty, but still fine. Our main goal was just to enjoy the beautiful sunset.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZRL6wrb8rZKGAqsuRNjmxBxSfVm1QLqdVpGQcxzizf7/1779888893819.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXu4Y1w6va8CU9q477EUzodUjzR9gnSRVosca33VKCah2/1779888894024.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnbGYDDB72v4qi1WPHtndbyNvV9mUSRHiRR6Knavoxgo/1779888894187.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLQbZ6BfXjU4DRLTDsSoxRFQnzoSA11KZ13JaQiDkWJ5/1779888894355.jpg)
‎
‎The sky looked so pretty as the sun slowly started to go down. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRLToVeDhXRVxPM3CSAYfDpvkXY8c7KdGRm6fbpA9X7J/1779888935302.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ81QrcYv1YKzRj2LGNwQk96e5Asq8pFeBmaXBRSjmZ7v/1779888935472.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaZWjo78kpKSbz8e2jrw8Mu5Qm9quydMPdeeoZdzioeaf/1779888935651.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4v3RjvNjMdUjzmut6aGCUKkd4X7h4VXhuKuSrKG5aiL/1779888935827.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPPACBeakMHMv4exT7EmmRxj2fj4PptBhd7zVXacE5s2/1779888936020.jpg)
‎
‎But on our way back home, I noticed how thick and dark the clouds were starting to gather. That explained why it rained so much today! 😅
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUmhMh4R5taL8byRF8Q4CY6ki95PcLfHnfyM1DJj8iaGE/1779888969937.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWcHqCERgeNykcp9TtF3jWMYmc45FaSXErxiVKqBFVQ8D/1779888970097.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEbYQM2NuhG2aq7BmmRPm8oFRryrNtK51xUuSi7oQkte/1779888970277.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZe97o6rbKirSphMartSsX4P8WGk8eiqoUoUtRBHAKBde/1779888970413.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbnXBFBAoXt22ZMXQe9LRGJxfV7La3SSqHvu6PamSGFST/1779888970532.jpg)
‎
‎It was just a short walk, but it still felt nice to be outside. Ryzen and Aiden also loved looking at everything around them. 
‎
‎Even with the heat, we truly enjoyed every minute of it.
‎
‎Sometimes a simple walk with the family is the best way to end the day, isn't it? 🥰
‎
‎Until my next walk... 
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎

I considered this place

 More flowers I went through as I completed my walk of the big ground of the garden . Some of these trees bear yellow and red color flowers . 

![1000090776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/244xRxhPXUexm6gvNzTtSvHMZ8WRcwS9hnWTpYLeZjbsGB4DNmokEuj9pYzhkbSndkivQ.jpg)

body.title: A Ceramic Saucer.
body.body: > Seeking the treasurer's identity, Basim questioned Kong, who demanded the return of a ceramic saucer from his rival Luca. After using an explosive jar to clear a blocked passage and climbing a shelf to retrieve the item, I returned it to Kong for intel detailing the treasurer's embroidered robe. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVtFhztHHcTT5tYdKmtjsfse58V1AEHEnztHyoETuwyux/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeTNFWymBJNLQ1RNpYXyVAFw946yodUx5U3NYhoBaQy3y/screenshot_2_.png) So I still had to look for intel in the bazaar to explore the treasure's identity through the crowded market stalls. And I started looking around for any intel, and that's when I found Kong standing near his stall. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZv486sArDp5b35dhvmCcTnyHy8m7mXKrWp7ssbuieTa/screenshot_3_.png) Basim asked Kong if he had any information about the treasurer who works for the Caliphate to trace the order's influence. But Kong said he does have something mentioning it hurts to give precious information for free, requiring a favor. Yeah, you won't need a foe if you have a friend like him. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeKCnp4BbJeS9KF1UztKEJyNmcMM696UTvfySpZCo4Pi/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVoZ9NkmjapNv56DR2H8F7Cj8dPBoCU2RuQdv5ccjeG5F/screenshot_5_.png) In the conversation, Kong said someone stole a precious ceramic saucer from him, whose name Luca and always been jealous of him. And I should be able to find the saucer in the crates near Luca's stall, so I went inside there. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKE46HUhpnjLKPaYeYaSfBixd7hRuhvJmSBLp4CwbXwx/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPHkvoL7mZjrP3EGrBCFBrYXzgRur2WfEuXhTSU2TjaM/screenshot_7_.png) Then I dragged and moved a shelf to get to a height where I found some explosive jar. I didn't know what to use them for in the immediate vicinity. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjHEENegJR4dbgsKQeFYRZusskGajZJSUU4o4pAw9sJs/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUraqLaFL3cEky7T6N7JRLfL8zNkx5sMZrzLoh134gWR/screenshot_9_.png) After getting down and exploring around the dusty corners of the storage area, I noticed there was a hole on the wall, but it was blocked. So I used one of those explosive jars to unblock the path. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme8uxg7wETLCS6DFq1tqZjp3dSKCkJXk1DRakWCKksyTM/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLZdCvWPHQWpphJG6WdZKfNvm9GgZJZDNfMmqoQG6PyG/screenshot_11_.png) Then I dragged that heavy shelf out of that wall and moved it to that place where I saw something was above near the ceiling beams. I used the height as an advantage to climb up into the hidden crawlspace. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRB7sa7tVCm4d6Tv8bnWwJuhb4akJv1vRB51zyo2C3o2U/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYLgoKGYtAMLTcSeDNhtrx6VsywW1BqrezQngpRyYH8s/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUuUevTV8cnCngWSiMXmZRXCSz6Y8nDonVzZjDwUH35r/screenshot_14_.png) After getting there through the gap, I found the ceramic saucer that Kong asked for resting safely on a desk. And then I jumped out of that place with a leap of faith into a wagon. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZTSy18esN3yJrqK8aT74u2UPkPw2vbCNz8hfhu1kVdTY/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbdVTf2aT627cxP51gPk3kDFUzACejYnWPzBjCVRrd3XA/screenshot_16_.png) I brought the saucer to Kong and the way he was talking, Basim managed to understand it was not his that someone stole. Actually I stole it for him, and then he gave me intel about the treasurer wearing a beautiful embroidered robe. Until next time, happy gaming. *Note: The icon for the thumbnail is collected from steamgriddb.com* --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=paarvez/2a288c29)

body.title: Un poco de reciclaje con el compañero Marcelo🚀♻️ //A little recycling with my colleague Marcelo🚀♻️
body.body:
Hola amigos de hive como andan?♻️🔧 En tiempos donde todo parece descartable, nosotros elegimos darle una segunda vida a las cosas. Con Marcelo venimos reciclando materiales, recuperando piezas y transformando lo que muchos consideran “basura” en nuevas oportunidades. Cada cable, cada madera, cada componente electrónico o estructura que rescatamos tiene una historia y un potencial enorme detrás. No se trata solamente de ahorrar o reutilizar: se trata de cambiar la manera en la que vemos el mundo 🌎✨. Mientras algunos tiran, nosotros imaginamos, creamos y construimos. Y en ese proceso también aprendemos muchísimo, porque reciclar es usar la creatividad, la paciencia y las ganas de hacer algo diferente. Abajo una foto de mi amigo marcelo intentando mostrar esa antiguedad jajaja.

>Hello hive friends, how are you doing?♻️🔧 In times where everything seems disposable, we choose to give things a second life. With Marcelo we have been recycling materials, recovering pieces and transforming what many consider “garbage” into new opportunities. Every cable, every piece of wood, every electronic component or structure that we rescue has a story and enormous potential behind it. It's not just about saving or reusing: it's about changing the way we see the world 🌎✨. While some throw away, we imagine, create and build. And in that process we also learn a lot, because recycling is using creativity, patience and the desire to do something different. Below is a photo of my friend Marcelo trying to show that antiquity hahaha.


![IMG_20250901_145518.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRVQWgkLSZZkArwwqdns83W8o4vUVb7p3i21EgUZhj4Tz/IMG_20250901_145518.jpg)

🛠️⚡ Lo más interesante de este camino es descubrir todo lo que puede lograrse con un poco de ingenio. Muchas veces encontramos objetos olvidados, rotos o deteriorados, y terminan convirtiéndose en herramientas útiles, proyectos electrónicos, muebles, estructuras o ideas completamente nuevas. Hay algo muy satisfactorio en ver cómo algo que parecía perdido vuelve a tener valor 💡🔥. Además, compartir este proceso con Marcelo hace que cada proyecto tenga todavía más significado: entre pruebas, errores, charlas y horas de trabajo, vamos construyendo no solo cosas materiales, sino también experiencias y recuerdos. El reciclaje termina siendo mucho más que una actividad… se transforma en una filosofía de vida 🚲🌱.

>🛠️⚡ The most interesting thing about this path is discovering everything that can be achieved with a little ingenuity. Many times we find forgotten, broken or deteriorated objects, and they end up becoming useful tools, electronic projects, furniture, structures or completely new ideas. There is something very satisfying about seeing how something that seemed lost has value again 💡🔥. Furthermore, sharing this process with Marcelo makes each project have even more meaning: between trials, errors, talks and hours of work, we build not only material things, but also experiences and memories. Recycling ends up being much more than an activity... it becomes a philosophy of life 🚲🌱.

![IMG_20250901_145306.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSom2wS1NdDYMxNGuDSgs1hGrJzKFkwKq2Jz2foebBR2E/IMG_20250901_145306.jpg)

🌿♻️ Creemos que pequeñas acciones pueden generar cambios enormes. En un mundo lleno de consumo rápido y desperdicio, apostar por reutilizar y reparar también es una forma de cuidar el planeta y de inspirar a otros a hacer lo mismo. No hace falta tener un gran taller ni miles de herramientas; muchas veces alcanza con ganas, imaginación y la decisión de no rendirse cuando algo parece no servir más 💚🔩. Ojalá más personas se animen a mirar distinto aquello que tienen alrededor, porque detrás de cada objeto olvidado puede esconderse un nuevo proyecto esperando nacer. Y nosotros vamos a seguir reciclando, creando y demostrando que siempre se puede construir algo increíble a partir de lo que otros descartan 🚀♻️

>🌿♻️ We believe that small actions can generate huge changes. In a world full of rapid consumption and waste, opting for reuse and repair is also a way to take care of the planet and inspire others to do the same. You don't need to have a large workshop or thousands of tools; Many times it is enough with desire, imagination and the decision not to give up when something seems to no longer serve 💚🔩. I hope more people are encouraged to look differently at what is around them, because behind every forgotten object a new project can hide waiting to be born. And we are going to continue recycling, creating and showing that you can always build something incredible from what others discard 🚀♻️


![IMG_20250901_145305.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPr7qetWuDjzouLUre4gdx6ccKiBy9MuUbhuQcJzpKyvA/IMG_20250901_145305.jpg)

body.title: Hide In The Wardrobe [2]
body.body:
![IMG_20260526_140928.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/23u5bbYBNjkL24K3vMxqsNBc2iChDN1mi2Fzo6CYfE27PPWS6oCbwSTbB7JK3uRfzuPCp.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

***[BEFORE....](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@kemmyb/hide-in-the-wardrobe)***
_______

<div class=text-justify>

The wardrobe was dark and suffocating, the narrow slit between the doors offering a tin glimpse of the dusty bedroom. Noora and I clung to each other, taking turns peering into the room through the crack. 

The corridor outside creaked and the footsteps stopped. I held my breath as Noora gasped softly. “What?” I whispered. Her face drained of colour as she whispered back, “they are anxious…looking towards the door.”

“Who?” 

“Our ancestors,” she breathed, gripping my hand tighter. “The portraits on the wall. Yazmin, I'm scared. What do we do?”

“How about you ask Grandma what we can do? We must take back this mansion from the Urzahk. It's ours!” I answered fiercely. Noora's wide gaze shifted from looking through the tiny slit to my face. 

I nodded, unshed tears pooled in my eyes, a familiar warning of my foresight at work. “I just *saw*. The Urzahk wanted Grandma…now it wants us. It's been waiting for many decades.”

*BLOOD OF MY BLOOD, DO NOT FEAR IT.*

A sudden coldness flooded the wardrobe and I froze, a big shudder rushing through me as my tears fell. Noora gasped softly, her nails digging into my palm as she shared my vision. Fragments of the truth came together in pyramid form before our eyes. 

Our gifts had merged through our bond and burden. The voice was grandma's from behind us, somewhere in the darkness among the hanging old coats and I could hear her. 

We had inherited the same abilities grandma once used to imprison the creature. When the gifts were not immediately passed down, the Urzahk freed itself somehow and was now after us.

“The mirrors, Yazmin,” Noora whispered, her eyes unfocused as though listening to someone. “The Urzahk cannot survive it's true form—” 

The wardrobe doors burst open and Noora yelled. The creature towered before us, it's form bulky and black, tiny electric currents running through it. The hollow eyes gleamed with hunger as it opened its mouth, displaying razor sharp teeth with fangs. 

My stomach dropped in that instant and it felt like my heart stopped beating. Noora shook me. “Now, Yazmin! Let's go.” 

I wanted to argue that it was suicide. The Urzahk was in our way but somehow we moved through its form like water, making it shriek like it had been pierced with something sharp. The portraits on the wall trembled as our ancestors watched in silent anticipation, their eyes narrowed in anger. 

Noora and I stepped towards the oval mirror, standing on either sides. “You can do this, sister,” she whispered, being the strong one while fear rooted me to the floor.

Tears slipped down my cheeks as I forced visions of a stonewalled prison in a dark pit into the glass just as Noora called upon the voices of our ancestors. The vision emitted a strong, bright light that flooded the bedroom, pulling the screaming Urzahk into it. The mirror shattered into million pieces and dissolved into sand.

The silence that followed was unnerving. Noora and I collapsed on the dusty floor, holding each other. Candles lit all around the house at once, chasing away the darkness. The portraits on the wall displayed our ancestors, smiling. The house was right again.

“We did it,” Noora said with a sigh of relief. 

“Yes,” I replied. “Its finally ours again.”
