body.title: Money Has Ears
body.body:
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/210574/pexels-photo-210574.jpeg</center>
<sbr>

<div class ='text-justify'>

I was on the phone with my eldest sister earlier today, and she mentioned someone we both know who always says, \

I told her to tell the person that money has ears, so he should stop saying those words if he doesn't want it to become his reality. She couldn't stop laughing because she imagined how he would react if she teased him with it.\n\nMy memory fails me as to when I first heard the phrase <sup>*(money has ears)*</sup>, but it has stuck with me ever since. My father also used to tell us not to say we don't have any money, even if we meant it as a joke. \

he often said. I didn't fully understand then, but over the years, I realized it makes so much sense. Based on personal experience, if we often speak of lack, it causes stress since our focus is usually on limits. It tends to trigger a scarcity mindset, making us think more about what we don't have. Well, my sister was so amused by the phrase and said she'd definitely quote it to anyone who says they are broke. It will be very interesting to see their reaction or response😁 Someone might think she's too philosophical, lol! Anyway, enough of that, and it's time for our slothly savers update for week 21st. Our HIVE savings goal is nearly achieved, with only 68 remaining. It would be crossed off before next month, and it also means we need to set a new target.

</liketuimages>

De pequeña yo pensaba que los champiñones eran los únicos hongos comestibles y que todos los demás eran venenosos. Últimamente veo en las redes recetas que incluyen gran variedad de otros hongos, incluso se ven personas que los cultivan para usarlos en sus alimentos de diversas formas. Parecen ser una alternativa proteica para quienes tienen dietas libres de carne animal. 

Hace un tiempo visité el barrio chino y al pasar por las vidrieras de un gran supermercado pude observar muchísima variedad de hongos que yo ni conocía. Estaban exhibidos junto a productos menos exóticos como nueces y tomates secos, pero resaltaban por sus nombres y formas peculiares. Aún desconozco que usos les dan o cómo los preparan. Y aunque me parece fascinante descubrir una rama de productos tan interesantes, hay grabado en mi subconciente algo que me dice que los hongos deben ser tratados con cuidado, quizá se deba esas caricaturas donde los niños recogían los hongos silvestres equivocados y acababan intoxicados... 
Creo que no haría recetas de internet con hongos, porque no confío en todas las recetas de internet y siento que es algo que es mejor que me prepare alguien que sepa. 

Si ustedes usan estos productos y viven en Buenos Aires, los pueden encontrar en los supermercados del Barrio Chino, tienen una gran variedad de productos de todas clases. Luego les muestro otras cosas interesantes que allí encontré.

says every serial killer. ― Nalla Xavier*

![Stalker.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUJtVLg2CHtyiSKxeQBCEhf7HaFY32XHzymLvGrLf2kzP/Stalker.png)


We got a crazy perp running wild killing hookers and I'm fighting with my partner Sarah cause I'm worried about a young streetwalker named Flo. Oh, I know she ain't innocent, but she's only a kid, and Sarah's too damn tarnished herself to feel pity for anybody. Someone's got to care though, so I guess that's me.

When we come off duty at two, they tell us another hooker’s been murdered down at Queens Quay. “Coulda been, Flo.” Sarah mutters, sending a fiery dart in my direction. “You sorry or disappointed?” She storms off, giving me the finger all the way down the hall.

“”Sweet dreams,” I sing out. She slams the parking garage door so loud Sarge comes out to check. Sees me, puts two and two together, makes a wheezing laugh and heads back to the desk. I ride home alone in my Trans Am, wondering how this perp manages to lure workin’ girls in plain sight and no one’s able to make him. I think of Flo shiverin’ on a street corner and think how nice it’d be to pound my fist out the other side of Warren’s head.

The next night, Sarah’s still distant. We cruise the streets on the lookout for any clue to this perv, but we’re comin’ up empty. None of the hookers will talk to me, cause they see Sarah’s scowlin’ face. She’s okay—Sarah—just a bit too much by the book. I know she’s pissed with me, but there’s nothin’ I can do—I’m not gonna let Flo, or any of the girls, be hung out to dry. This guy’s offin’ them faster’n we can keep track.

We end up back on Jarvis Street and I spot Flo and two other girls huddled in a doorway. She makes me and puts her hand down and out—kinda the way bikers acknowledge each other when they pass on the road. Sarah’s oblivious—totally misses the signal. I pull over and tell her to wait. She eyes me like I’m some kinda pariah. “Don’t tell me you’re gonna see Flo again.” “Okay, I won’t—stay here.”

She grabs my wrist. “I don’t like dirty cops—and I don’t like cops bangin’ hookers.” “You through?” I growl. She looks away in disgust, like she wants to spit on me. I get out, do up my overcoat and take my time walkin’ back to the girls, knowin’ Sarah’s watchin’ through the rear-view mirror.

“S’up?” I ask, being wary of her friends. “You know the creep you’re lookin’ for?” “Yeah.” “We figure he’s stalkin’ us. Same guy’s been circlin’ the block for an hour. We get this creep vibe.” The other two hookers nod—‘bout as wary of me as I am of them.

“Okay, Flo—we’ll keep an eye out—Don’t be a hero.” “You’re kiddin’, right—like I’d be your bait?” “Jus sayin’.” “Yeah, well so am I.” Her face goes hard and the other hookers smirk. I shake my head and walk away. Don’t know why that hurts, seein’ as I don’t expect hookers to have hearts of gold. But I also don't expect Sarah to think I'm using Flo, and I don't know what hurts more.

To be continued…

body.title: Hive-Swap Dev Update — May 13 → May 27, 2026
body.body:
This cycle was split in two by the May 18 Hive Engine security incident. The first half was router hardening and infrastructure work; the second half was incident response, then a burst of auto-slippage improvements and a full analytics dashboard overhaul. A lot shipped.

---

## HE Security Incident — May 18 Response

On May 18 at ~5am EST, Hive Engine's EVM bridge systems were compromised. The response was immediate:

- **EVM and Solana bridges taken offline** — Ethereum, BSC/BNB, Base, Polygon, and Solana bridge UI removed and the `/api/v1/bridge/in/build` endpoint returns `503 BRIDGE_DISABLED` for any `type: evm` request. The `/gateways` response filters those chains out entirely.
- **HBD bridge paused** — the DSwap/graphene-swap gateway keys were rotated as a precaution. The HBD tab is removed from the bridge UI until keys settle. HIVE (SWAP.HIVE), BTC, LTC, DOGE, and BCH remain fully operational.

Separately, a real user loss surfaced on the same day: a `market.sell` inside a multi-op `custom_json` array was reverting with `\
` and burning the platform fee (op 1) with no value delivered. The Hive Engine `market` contract rejects book ops when they arrive as part of a JSON *array* (HE's \

mode) if the user has no pre-existing market balance entry or insufficient DRUBBLE for the multi-tx fee. The fix in `keychain.ts`: detect `market.*` ops at broadcast time and send each as a standalone JSON *object* rather than part of an array. Non-market ops before and after (fee transfer, pool swaps, BEED bootstrap) still batch normally. Net effect on Keychain prompts for book-route swaps:

```
Single-hop pool only:       1 prompt  (unchanged)
Single-hop book only:       2 prompts
2-hop book + peg-out:       3 prompts
```

---

## Auto Slippage — Swap Widget, Treasury, and API

The swap widget now ships with **Auto slippage on by default**. The formula: `priceImpact + 0.5% buffer`, rounded up to the nearest 0.5%, capped at `[0.5%, 5%]`. The button label updates live once a quote is available — \

when no quote exists. Selecting any manual value exits auto mode; restoring a pending sig-2 draft also exits it (preserves the saved value).

The default for manual slippage was also raised from 1% to 2%, and the HIVE↔SWAP.HIVE peg memo helpers now clamp slippage to `Math.max(slippagePct, 2)` internally. The problem: with auto mode set to 0.5% on a low-impact DEX swap, that 0.5% was getting passed straight into the uswap peg memo — leaving only 0.59% total tolerance (0.5% + the 0.09% coded fee assumption). uswap's actual fee exceeds that and triggers `REFUND: Result Below Memo Value`. Peg operations are nominally 1:1 so the memo slippage is purely a fee buffer, not market slippage protection — a 2% floor is safe regardless of what the user's DEX preference is.

The **treasury sweep** had the same root problem but worse: it was using a fixed `TREASURY_SLIPPAGE_BPS=100` (1%) for all tokens regardless of pool depth. A 25k SCRAP position through the thin SCRAP:FLUX pool has 10-30%+ price impact — 1% `minAmountOut` is unreachable and the on-chain op was reverting. The fix: two-pass quoting. First quote at 50% slippage to read `priceImpact`, then compute `ceil((impact + 0.5) * 2) / 2` capped at 20% (higher cap than the UI — the treasury cares about completing the conversion, not UX), then re-quote with that value to get the correct `minAmountOut` in the broadcast ops.

For **API integrators**, `/api/v1/quote` now accepts an optional `autoSlippage: true` field. When set, the response includes `recommendedSlippagePct` — the same impact-derived formula, capped at 5%. The typical pattern:

```json
POST /api/v1/quote
{ \

: 2
  }
}
```

Then pass that value directly as `slippagePct` to `/api/v1/swap/build`. Backwards compatible — the field only appears when requested.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/23tGRgtRiW8HknKqYU2CxcrcdBTpZoWZkcdgQcbGrSLUzPKdx2FCiN8AW3kjGRmE69eB9.png)


---

## Analytics Dashboard — Instant Loads and Full Rebuild

The `/stats` page went through a full rebuild and a critical performance fix.

**Instant loads on first visit:** The page was previously a client-only component that showed a loading skeleton until two API calls returned. On a cold Cloudflare Worker isolate, those API calls were triggering `maybeSync()` → `runActivitySync()` — the full 30-60 second sync pipeline (50 pages of HE/L1 fetches + D1 inserts + route pre-warming). The fix has two parts: (1) the server component now fetches summary, tokens, and recent activity from KV/D1 at request time and passes the data as props, so the HTML arrives with content already rendered; (2) reads never trigger a sync anymore — `maybeSync()` is removed from the cache path entirely. The cron (`*/2 * * * *`) owns syncing; a KV miss falls straight to a D1 query (< 500ms). KV TTL was also raised from 5 minutes to 1 hour so a slow cron run doesn't immediately expire the cache.

**HIVE price accuracy:** The dashboard was using the HE AMM spot ratio (SWAP.USDT:SWAP.HIVE) which drifts when pools are unbalanced. Switched to `condenser_api.get_current_median_history_price`, the L1 witness-median price reflecting external exchange data voted hourly. Falls back to the pool ratio if the L1 RPC is unavailable.

**Daily active users:** The Users chart now shows three series: new accounts (bars), daily active accounts (line, from `COUNT(DISTINCT from_account)` per bucket fired in parallel with the existing query), and cumulative users. The D1 query runs alongside the existing aggregation at no extra latency cost.

**Data freshness badge:** A green \

capsule is now visible in the dashboard header and the Recent Activity section header, derived from `summary.generatedAt` and the last successful activity fetch respectively. The old polling spinner is gone.

The analytics API endpoints (`/analytics/summary`, `/analytics/tokens`, `/analytics/recent`, `/analytics/refresh`) are now restricted to same-origin. A new `withInternalApi` guard strips all `Access-Control-*` headers and returns 405 for OPTIONS preflight — cross-origin browser requests are blocked while the dashboard's own same-origin fetches continue to work.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-swap.com/Eo1vs5jWSfXiVnRp39MZx6du5Q9pgpN4pNyUPhLWwNwn8XsUCxoXDAbQpFrGbfW8ztk.png)


---

## Also shipped this cycle

- **Router: dust-orderbook trap closed** — The final-hop 10-satoshi output guard was only applied to intermediate hops. A 25k BONUS→SWAP.HIVE sell against a lone 1-satoshi bid produced `2.69e-10` SWAP.HIVE (below 8-decimal precision floor, rounds to zero) and the user lost their fee with no value received. Guard now applies to every hop including the last; the router returns `NO_ROUTE` instead of building a zero-output op.

- **Router: multi-hop drift buffer** — Fixed revert-on-final-hop for 3-hop routes: `slippagePct` was applied flat to the final `minAmountOut` with no allowance for drift accumulating across N pools. New `PER_HOP_DRIFT_BPS = 50` adds 0.5% per extra hop to the effective slippage (1-hop: 1%, 2-hop: 1.5%, 3-hop: 2% at default settings).

- **Router: BEED-aware routing on API** — `/quote` and `/swap/build` now accept `username` for BEED-aware route selection. Accounts holding < 0.002 BEED get pool-only routes and builds, avoiding the `market.*` multi-tx fee that would revert the swap.

- **Typed fee memos** — Platform fee `tokens.transfer` ops now carry structured memos: `HiveSwap swap: A→B | r:XXXXXX` for swaps, `HiveSwap peg-in: HIVE→Base | r:XXXXXX` / `HiveSwap peg-out: SWAP.X→Y | r:XXXXXX` for bridge fees. The 6-hex `r:` ref is per-build random for cross-referencing wallet entries to build responses.

- **Gateway latency endpoint** — `GET /api/v1/gateways/latency` returns observed p50/p90 wait times per gateway direction, refreshed every 5 minutes by a dedicated cron from on-chain transfer pairs. Used by the swap widget to show live wait-time estimates.

- **Points system polish** — `/points` info page with tier table, level curve, and badge grid. Badge icons replaced generic colored squares with themed SVG silhouettes (ocean-creature tier ladder: shrimp → crab → octopus → dolphin → shark → whale + milestone badges). Points entry point in the nav moved from a text link to a glimmering medal icon adjacent to the wallet button.

- **KV cost controls** — Client-side HE fetches (tokens, pools) routed through KV-cached internal endpoints to stay within Cloudflare free tier write limits on high-traffic days.

---

**Try it:** [hive-swap.com](https://www.hive-swap.com)
**Public API docs:** [hive-swap.com/docs/api](https://www.hive-swap.com/docs/api)
**Follow:** @hive-swap

body.title: Ground beef in Bolognese sauce (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Pasta with ground beef sauce, or Bolognese, is a culinary classic, so whenever I get the chance, I make this recipe to treat myself and delight my guests. I love adding homemade tomato sauce to the dish, but this time, due to time constraints, I used store-bought sauce; I also added onions, bell peppers, and carrots. It’s a simple combination that’s full of flavor. I served it with short pasta and a generous sprinkling of white cheese to top off the dish.
![1000117517.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpMJNmGevpzgqfY5ZzyQzmcmyLf8xYiheyDv7i3jck26sFzHmaAUre9nGZgYLoTy4MG.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 400 grams ground beef - 2 onions - 4 bell peppers - 1 carrot - Tomato sauce - Pinch of salt - Butter - Hard cheese for grating - Oil
![1000117502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVVg48NtuDQt1GAWa8rKXVr4G5Jc6Q3eK4LG3cFYKupfdEz1Hw91nzr8Kb6eZanbAuQ.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the herbs and the carrot, removed the seeds from the bell peppers, and cut them into medium-sized pieces. Next, I peeled the onions and cut them into large chunks. Next, I peeled the carrots and chopped them, keeping the pieces roughly the same size.
![1000117505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpH9xNksVJunkur8C7D5Cd4bHpiE9v1MXj4tNP1hd6KogjLbo49f1Yw4ZGRMo4NQFm1.jpg)
Then, I heated a skillet with a splash of oil, added the herbs, sautéed them for a bit, and added the carrots and ground beef, stirring to combine all the ingredients. I covered the pan to speed up the cooking process.
![1000117509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi5saMpRuRzZa4MWaQCeVg96VB1LM7nMUShFmpm1Ndqt7aE8u4z1QwXDzUbNe8EtYDu.jpg)
At the same time, I put a pot with two liters of water and a pinch of salt on the stove. When it came to a boil, I added half a kilo of short pasta—in this case, Dedalitos—stirred it, and covered the pot. It was ready in about ten minutes. I really like this pasta because it goes a long way. Both the sauce and the pasta were ready at the same time. I drained the pasta and added a pat of butter, then served a portion on each plate and topped it with the sauce. The next step was to grate a generous amount of white cheese and enjoy this delicious recipe. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La pasta con salsa de carne molida, o boloñesa, es un clásico de la cocina, así que cada vez que tengo la oportunidad preparo esta receta para darme un gusto y complacer a mis comensales. Me encanta agregar salsa de tomate al guiso, pero esta vez, por razones de tiempo, fue una comercial, también añadí cebollas, ajíes y zanahoria. Una combinación sencilla y llena de sabor. Acompañé con pasta corta y una generosa lluvia de queso blanco que adornó el plato.
![1000117517.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpMJNmGevpzgqfY5ZzyQzmcmyLf8xYiheyDv7i3jck26sFzHmaAUre9nGZgYLoTy4MG.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 400 gramos de carne molida - 2 cebollas - 4 ajíes dulces - 1 zanahoria - Salsa de tomate - Pizca de sal - Mantequilla - Queso duro para rallar - Aceite
![1000117502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xVVg48NtuDQt1GAWa8rKXVr4G5Jc6Q3eK4LG3cFYKupfdEz1Hw91nzr8Kb6eZanbAuQ.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los aliños y la zanahoria, retiré las semillas de los ajies dulces, corté en pedazos medianos. Posteriormente, desconché las cebollas y dividí en trozos de tamaño considerable. Después quité las conchas de las zanahorias y piqué manteniendo el equilibrio en cuanto a las formas.
![1000117505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpH9xNksVJunkur8C7D5Cd4bHpiE9v1MXj4tNP1hd6KogjLbo49f1Yw4ZGRMo4NQFm1.jpg)
Luego, monté un sartén con un chorrito de aceite, agregué el aliño, sofreí un rato y añadí las zanahorias y la carne molida revolviendo para mezclar todos los ingredientes. Tapé para acelerar la cocción.
![1000117509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi5saMpRuRzZa4MWaQCeVg96VB1LM7nMUShFmpm1Ndqt7aE8u4z1QwXDzUbNe8EtYDu.jpg)
De forma paralela, monté en la cocina una olla con dos litros de agua y una medida de sal. Cuando hirvió introduje medio kilo de pasta corta, en este caso Dedalitos, revolví y tapé. En unos diez minutos estaban listos. Me gusta mucho esta pasta porque es muy rendidora. Tanto la salsa como la pasta estuvieron en su punto al mismo tiempo. Colé la pasta y le agregué su respectivo toque de mantequilla, luego serví una porción en cada plato y le puse su ración de salsa. El siguiente paso fue rallar queso blanco en una generosa proporción y disfrutar de este deliciosa receta.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.
⚜️🐝⚜️🐝⚜️

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   La Paradoja del Paraíso Estancado.   ||   The Paradox of the Stagnant Paradise.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> ¿Por qué en América Latina cuesta tano triunfar? La respuesta es amarga, una de esas verdades que preferiríamos ignorar mientras disfrutamos de un mezcal o un café frente a un atardecer en el Caribe. La realidad es que **«en América Latina se vive con muy poco, si te aguantas el crimen y aprovechas la desigualdad»**. Es un paraíso edificado sobre una falla tectónica social que nadie parece querer reparar, porque, siendo sinceros, nadie quiere arruinar el paraíso.
# ***
La Paradoja del Paraíso Estancado
*** Como región, somos una contradicción andante, pues, presumimos de una intensidad que el resto del mundo envidia; **«ya quisiera un finlandés tener este nivel de intensidad y pasión»** en sus relaciones o en su mesa. Tenemos una gastronomía que cruje, familias que son redes de contención inquebrantables y una resiliencia a prueba de balas. Pero esa misma resiliencia es nuestra trampa: **«somos muy resilientes, aguantamos demasiado»**. Hemos normalizado que la corrupción, la falta de educación y la inseguridad sean como el clima: *fenómenos que simplemente ocurren y frente a los cuales solo queda abrir el paraguas*... Sin embargo, el mundo está dando muestra de cambios. Mientras nosotros seguimos atrapados en una **«década perdida 1.5»**, donde el crecimiento es un espejismo y las empresas rara vez «explotan» para crear liquidez, el resto del planeta está compitiendo en una liga distinta. Hoy, la frontera no es un muro ni un océano; es el lenguaje y la tecnología y como tercermundista nos cuesta aceptarla y sincronizarn os con ella.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahd9NgGRUuJKVBfRvDPQD1azG3meymmf7EHCekxKEADy/1d.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Es doloroso aceptarlo, pero si estás leyendo esto, probablemente eres parte del **«10% que es la clase media en América Latina; el 90% está de ahí \

»**. Esta posición no es un privilegio para el descanso, sino una responsabilidad para la acción. El sistema está roto desde que se escribió la historia, y **«uno no se queja de la tormenta, uno se quita del camino de la tormenta»**. No podemos esperar a que los gobiernos salven la región; esa es una espera que ya lleva siglos y los ciclos se repiten, ¿no los ves...? La verdadera revolución hoy es individual y, paradójicamente, nos obliga a mirar hacia afuera para salvar lo de adentro. **«Hagan cosas difíciles»** y que tengan esfuerzo; no esperemos hacewrnos ricos con una mísera venta. En la era de la Inteligencia Artificial, la barrera del idioma yo no es el último gran muro. **«Acepten ganar poco o hablen inglés»**, porque hoy un joven en Caracas, Bogotá, Ciudad de México o Buenos Aires tiene la misma capacidad técnica que uno en Shenzhen o San Francisco o aquí en Toronto, pero solo el que rompe la barrera del idioma logra que **«todo el mundo en el mercado global se apellide Ramírez o González»**. Nuestras remesas hoy valen más que nuestro petróleo o nuestro café (me refiero a Venezuela). Eso significa que nuestro producto de exportación más valioso es nuestra gente (ha quedado demostrado), nuestra cultura y nuestro empuje. Pero no necesitamos irnos físicamente para siempre; necesitamos **«emprender global»**. Dejen de seguir «soñando despiertos desde las estructuras viejas y oxidadas». Salven a sus familias, mejoren sus entornos y compitan en las grandes ligas. Dejemos de conformarnos con migajas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUDfAUJtjgjg5F8GHJfRuiTckBJZVmE6XgCdFd47FFw2J/1779885587.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
La invitación es a un cambio de *chip* radical: 1. **Acepta la realidad:** La tormenta de la corrupción y la desigualdad no se irá mañana. 2. **Deja de quejarte:** La queja es energía desperdiciada que no genera facturación ni conocimiento. 3. **Mira al mundo:** El mercado local es pequeño; el mercado global es infinito. Podemos seguir siendo ese paraíso donde el 10% vive de **«puta madre»** a costa de la desigualdad, o podemos ser la generación que exporte soluciones al mundo. La IA nos ha dado las herramientas, el internet nos ha dado el acceso. Lo único que nos falta es la voluntad de dejar de ser y sentirnos «víctimas del sistema» para convertirnos en sus conquistadores globales. Sal de la cama, deja de ser un parásito pegado al televisor...
*** ***

> **Creciendo como emprendedor, busca y encuentra lo que necesitas para ser un mejor humano en la Comunidad [Be Entrepreneur](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140971/created). De seguro, hay un tema que te llamará la atención.**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23zkkGa4zeoXJqqGroD9evkd12V8oYCHwbhUhPdReeRysc2eYNZhoMUosoEPQnJhP2Thr.jpg Banner de la propia Comunidad [Be Entrepreneur](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140971/created)
*** ***
🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆

*** *** ##
Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)
*** *** ***

> Why is it so hard to succeed in Latin America? The answer is a bitter one, one of those truths we’d rather ignore whilst enjoying a mezcal or a coffee as the sun sets over the Caribbean. The reality is that **“in Latin America, you can get by on very little, if you can put up with the crime and make the most of the inequality”**. It is a paradise built on a social fault line that nobody seems willing to repair, because, let’s be honest, nobody wants to ruin paradise.
# ***
The Paradox of the Stagnant Paradise
*** As a region, we are a walking contradiction; we boast an intensity that the rest of the world envies; **“a Finn would love to have this level of intensity and passion”** in their relationships or at their table. We have a cuisine that crackles, families that are unbreakable support networks, and bulletproof resilience. But that very resilience is our trap: **“we are very resilient, we put up with too much”**. We have normalised the idea that corruption, lack of education and insecurity are like the weather: *phenomena that simply happen and in the face of which all we can do is open our umbrellas*... However, the world is showing signs of change. Whilst we remain trapped in a **‘lost decade 1.5’**, where growth is a mirage and companies rarely ‘explode’ to generate liquidity, the rest of the world is competing in a different league. Today, the frontier is neither a wall nor an ocean; it is language and technology, and as Third Worlders we struggle to accept it and synchronise with it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdw51RzmqmLSYWqyt5monVxEFQs9EAdkhwBp2vWFyDdad/1779885434.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
It is painful to accept, but if you are reading this, you are probably part of the **“10% that make up the middle class in Latin America; the other 90% are ‘below’ that’”**. This position is not a privilege to rest on, but a responsibility to act. The system has been broken since history began, and **“you don’t complain about the storm, you get out of the storm’s way”**. We cannot wait for governments to save the region; that is a wait that has already lasted centuries and the cycles repeat themselves—can’t you see them...? The real revolution today is an individual one and, paradoxically, it forces us to look outwards in order to save what lies within. **“Do difficult things”** that require effort; let’s not expect to get rich from a measly sale. In the age of Artificial Intelligence, the language barrier is not the last great wall. **“Accept earning little or speak English”**, because today a young person in Caracas, Bogotá, Mexico City or Buenos Aires has the same technical skills as one in Shenzhen or San Francisco or here in Toronto, but only those who break down the language barrier can ensure that **“everyone in the global market has the surname Ramírez or González”**. Our remittances are now worth more than our oil or our coffee (I’m referring to Venezuela). That means our most valuable export is our people (this has been proven), our culture and our drive. But we don’t need to leave physically for good; we need to **“go global”**. Stop ‘daydreaming from within old, rusty structures’. Save your families, improve your circumstances and compete in the big leagues. Let’s stop settling for crumbs.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVmKCTBUFFBhEC5XSqLXj3QCyHMHoLr9dH8XfeMnn1h83/2d.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
The invitation is to a radical shift in mindset: 1. **Accept reality:** The storm of corruption and inequality won’t go away tomorrow. 2. **Stop complaining:** Complaining is wasted energy that generates neither revenue nor knowledge. 3. **Look to the world:** The local market is small; the global market is infinite. We can continue to be that paradise where 10% live the **high life** at the expense of inequality, or we can be the generation that exports solutions to the world. AI has given us the tools, the internet has given us access. The only thing we lack is the will to stop being and feeling like ‘victims of the system’ and become its global conquerors. Get out of bed, stop being a parasite glued to the telly...

body.title: Obligar al cuerpo a reposar para sanar [Esp - Eng]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJNquU3RedwyrXxZwzSrhoemuZgEojMEdMVAQqj4Wux7/1779887674650.jpg)
***
***
En estos días he contraído una enfermedad que al parecer está de moda en mi pueblo. Me refiero a la hepatitis A; la viral. De un tiempo para acá hay un enorme brote muchas son las personas que no han escapado ilesas al contagio. Yo ahora la tengo, por suerte he manifestado síntomas leves de la misma, pocas náuseas, algo de picazón en la piel, mi coloración de piel y ojos no cambió mucho tampoco y por fortuna, no he perdido el apetito.

Cura por medicamentos no tiene, simplemente MUCHO REPOSO. Debo estar todo el tiempo acostada y muy poco sentada para que mi hígado pueda sanar adecuadamente y pueda recuperarme pronto. Sí, algunos remedios naturales (la sábila, la carne de carnero, té de corteza de árbol de tamarindo y muchos otros, algunos de sabiduría popular y otros recomendados por los mismos médicos).

El punto es el siguiente: tengo que estar de reposo. No es lo mismo yo acostarme luego de un día activo a descansar o porque el sueño es más grande que mis ganas de salir a saludar el Sol a que tener que estar acostada por enfermedad, y, a la larga, aburrirme.
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQw14s6kgPFkbJz5w83EGZ7V95eXu2RnTfyWG6u75rCp/1769291657381.png)
***
A mí desde pequeña dormir ha sido una cosa que no me ha molestado, tampoco estar acostada, pero es por voluntad, no por necesidad. Disfruto de la cama y la veo como mi lugar seguro, donde prefiero estar.

Siempre es más agradable hacer algo por voluntad a que por obligación. Y no me refiero solamente al reposo, aunque de aquí partimos, sino porque se da el caso de que a alguien le gusta mucho viajar, hasta que se le pide que vaya a un lugar que no le gusta y tenga que ir contra su voluntad, a regañadientes, tengo que ir porque me mandó mi jefe...

Todos (creo) hemos pasado por situaciones en las que debemos pasar tiempo en cama. Casi siempre por problemas de salud. Se manda a hacer reposo para que el cuerpo esté lo más tranquilo y relajado posible para comenzar un proceso reparador, que a veces lleva semanas, a veces meses.

Mayo para mí ha sido un mes de bastante reposo. Primero estuve una semana en cama gracias a un mal gesto para no llegar al piso al cargar las pesas del gimnasio, tuve dolor en la región lumbar y estuve toda una semana acostada boca arriba para evitar que empeorara. Y cuando logro mejorar del dolor, me sorprende la hepatitis, de vuelta a la cama, y por más tiempo.

Tanto reposo aburre, da ansiedad, desesperación y tristeza, porque dan ganas de hacer tanto, y sin embargo estás con limitaciones para hacer. ¿Alternativas? Las mías no se han echo esperar: leer libros digitales (policiacos e intriga con algo de romance), escuchar música, ver reels en Instagram cuando tengo internet disponible, dormir por horas y jugar Piano Tiles 2 en mi celular.

Cuando me siento es porque hice alguna comida para ayudar a la buena digestión, entonces aprovecho para hablar con mis vecinos desde la ventana o con mi prima hermana, acariciar a mi gata y ayer revisé la ortografía de los seminarios finales de dos asignaturas de mis vecinitos que ya casi acaban el curso.
***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV21vUB1pfc6C9EhcQC8ZFv4W12uDmPiC2Lo5wWPrCu2c/1779887954859.jpg)
***
Son formas para entretenerme y no dejar que la monotonía del reposo me invadan la mente y comience a estresarme por ello. Ahora mismo para mí el reposo no es un lujo, no estoy de vacaciones, es una necesidad para poder regresar a mi rutina diaria nuevamente sana y fuerte.

Extraño mucho el gimnasio, también trabajar con mis estudiantes, pero por ahora es lo que toca. Es lindo también cuando se reciben mensajes de las personas que nos aprecian deseando pronta recuperación, siendo solidarios y dejando saber que ante cualquier necesidad no dude en contar con ellos para lo que sea. En momentos como este se puede saber si una persona es bien querida por quienes forman parte de su vida.

Por ahora toca seguir de reposo, puedo comer de todo, pero en pequeñas cantidades. Espero mejorar pronto, lo estoy haciendo todo bien para que mi tiempo en cama no se extienda y no empeore mi condición.

Gracias por leer.
Con cariño: Vicky ❤️
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGfBfFw6Rps5gV5ogZ1Cj2dirCgddUEeXmZdnS3VnsJZ/1779888144859.png)

***
These days I've caught an illness that seems to be in fashion in my town. I'm talking about hepatitis A, the viral kind. For some time now, there's been a huge outbreak, and many people haven't escaped infection unscathed. I have it now. Luckily, I've shown mild symptoms: a little nausea, some itching on my skin, and my skin and eyes haven't changed much in color either, and fortunately, I haven't lost my appetite.

There's no cure with medication, simply A LOT OF REST. I have to stay lying down all the time and very rarely sit up so that my liver can heal properly and I can recover soon. Yes, there are some natural remedies (aloe vera, mutton meat, tamarind tree bark tea, and many others—some from folk wisdom and others recommended by doctors themselves).

The point is this: I have to be on rest. It's not the same as lying down after an active day to rest or because I'm too sleepy to greet the sun, as having to stay in bed because of illness and, in the long run, getting bored.
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQw14s6kgPFkbJz5w83EGZ7V95eXu2RnTfyWG6u75rCp/1769291657381.png)
***
Since I was little, sleeping has never bothered me, nor has staying in bed—but that's by choice, not out of necessity. I enjoy my bed and see it as my safe place, where I prefer to be.

It's always more pleasant to do something voluntarily than out of obligation. I don't just mean rest, though that's where we start, but it also happens that someone loves to travel—until they're asked to go somewhere they don't like and have to go against their will, reluctantly. \

Everyone (I think) has gone through situations where they have to spend time in bed. Almost always because of health issues. Rest is prescribed so the body can be as calm and relaxed as possible to begin a healing process, which sometimes takes weeks, sometimes months.

May has been a month of quite a bit of rest for me. First, I spent a week in bed due to a bad move trying not to fall to the floor while lifting weights at the gym. I had pain in my lower back and spent a whole week lying on my back to keep it from getting worse. And just when I managed to recover from the pain, hepatitis surprised me—back to bed again, and for even longer.

So much rest is boring, gives you anxiety, desperation, and sadness because you feel like doing so much, yet you're limited in what you can do. Alternatives? Mine haven't been long in coming: reading digital books (crime, mystery, with some romance), listening to music, watching Instagram reels when I have internet available, sleeping for hours, and playing Piano Tiles 2 on my phone.

When I do sit up, it's because I've made some food to aid good digestion. Then I take the opportunity to talk with my neighbors from the window or with my cousin, pet my cat, and yesterday I checked the spelling of the final papers for two subjects for my little neighbors who are almost done with the school year.
***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV21vUB1pfc6C9EhcQC8ZFv4W12uDmPiC2Lo5wWPrCu2c/1779887954859.jpg)
***
These are ways to keep myself entertained and not let the monotony of rest invade my mind and start stressing me out. Right now, rest for me is not a luxury—I'm not on vacation. It's a necessity to be able to return to my daily routine healthy and strong again.

I really miss the gym and working with my students, but for now, this is what's needed. It's also nice when you receive messages from people who appreciate you, wishing you a speedy recovery, being supportive, and letting you know that for any need, you can count on them for whatever. In moments like these, you can tell if a person is truly loved by those who are part of their life.

For now, I must continue resting. I can eat everything, but in small amounts. I hope to recover soon. I'm doing everything right so that my time in bed doesn't extend further and my condition doesn't worsen.

Thanks for reading.
With love: Vicky ❤️
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZuoqFnwazknaDxC4RWhFnYtmNuLqSVzgm2Yq3qjJXDh/1769291677513.png)
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeo6y3DogEQ38ykSXvbsnJsbPp7WXVDgDZpCV59tPQZAM/1769291677435.png)
***

body.title: Reseña del libro: La contadora de películas [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
_Saludos comunidad._

_Decirles que hace poco me tropecé  con una novelita, que me sorprendio aviso previo, se titula \

, ¿películas? Pues si, leyeron bien, ese mismo es el título._

_La verdad es que me recordó la época de mi adolescencia, cuando íbamos a la escuela al campo a recoger Café, en campamentos ubicados en lugares recónditos, donde la electricidad no llegaba, y que además de los tipicos juegos de mesa, uno de los entrenamientos del grupo era juntarnos entorno a la luz de un quinque, y de algún cinefilo abesado a escuchar las narraciones de películas._

>Greetings, community 

>I wanted to tell you that I recently stumbled upon a little novel that surprised me, fair warning. It's called \

? Yes, you read that right, that's the title.

>Truth be told, it brought me back to my teenage years, when we would go from school to the countryside to pick coffee, staying in camps tucked away in remote places where electricity hadn't yet arrived. Besides the usual board games, one of our group's pastimes was gathering around the light of a kerosene lamp while some seasoned film buff narrated movies for us.

_Esta es una novela corta, la cual bien podría se absorvida en apenas una tarde, si autor es Hernán Rivera Letelier, el cual confieso no conocía, aun cuando indage es un novelista chileno famoso por varias de sus obras, pero bueno la literatura universal es tan amplia, que no nos alcanzaría una vida para explorarla toda._

_La historia del libro va más o menos  así: en medio del desierto chileno, en un pueblo salitrero de esos que el mapa casi olvida, vive María Margarita, no tiene grandes lujos, ni siquiera comodidades, pero tiene algo que brilla más que el polvo de la pampa, y es la habilidad de convertir una tarde de cine en una fogata de historias para su familia. Su padre, y sus hermanos, con hambre de todo, esperan sus palabras como quien espera un pedazo de pan._

>This is a short novel – one you could easily devour in a single afternoon. The author is Hernán Rivera Letelier, whom I confess I hadn't heard of, even though I looked him up. He's a famous Chilean novelist known for several works. But well, world literature is so vast that one lifetime isn't enough to explore it all.

>The book's story goes something like this: in the middle of the Chilean desert, in one of those nitrate-mining towns that maps have nearly forgotten, lives María Margarita. She has no great luxuries, not even comforts, but she possesses something that shines brighter than the pampas dust: the ability to turn an afternoon at the movies into a campfire of stories for her family. Her father and siblings, hungry for everything, wait for her words like one waits for a piece of bread.

_Ella va al cine del pueblo con las  monedas justas, y luego vuelve a contar las escenas, los gestos de la rubia Marilyn, cada desgarro de la melodía mexicana... Ahí está la magia, logrando no solo que el cine se vea, sino que también se narre y reinvente, ella logra hacerlo tan bien que termina siendo la contadora oficial de todo el lugar. Esta obra además de ser una especie de romance con el séptimo arte; por debajo de las historias, la novela transpira el sudor y la injusticia de una época dura, el autor no endulcora la pobreza, pero le encuentra un resquicio hermoso en la imaginación._

_Lo que más me gustó, es que en ella cine no es para críticos o académicos, sino para sentarse, callarse y dejarse llevar. Si eso les resuena, esta lectura pueder ser muy grata, anímense a darle una oportunidad y luego quizás hasta se la recomienden a algún familiar, amigo o conocido._

>She goes to the town cinema with just enough coins, then returns home to recount the scenes – the gestures of blonde Marilyn, every heart-wrenching note of a Mexican melody... That's where the magic lies. She doesn't just make the films visible; she narrates and reinvents them, and she does it so well that she ends up becoming the official film counter for the whole town. This work is not only a kind of romance with the seventh art; beneath the stories, the novel sweats the hardship and injustice of a tough era. The author doesn't sugarcoat poverty, but he finds a beautiful crack of light in imagination.

>What I liked most is that, in this book, cinema isn't for critics or academics – it's for sitting down, shutting up, and letting yourself be carried away. If that resonates with you, this read could be very pleasant. Go ahead and give it a chance, and afterward you might even recommend it to a family member, friend, or acquaintance.

body.title: My busy day on my way home after being sick [EN/ES]
body.body:
> Good morning, my fellow Hive members! I've been inactive for a few days because I was sick, but I'm well now and back more active than ever. Today I'm sharing my day, which was quite hectic due to all the things I was behind on at home because of my illness. It had a somewhat painful but necessary start because I'm getting Truabin injections that my father, @roswelborges, got me to boost my immune system.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyudkM7KUGUjsq7goGzL2jBGWwsha8TnWV3Z8Hm5oxjF/1779775855412.jpg)
After showering and having breakfast with my mother, I started doing laundry because I had a mountain of dirty clothes, taking advantage of the sunshine we've been having lately here in Cuba. But since it's been raining in the afternoons for several days and the sky started to cloud over a bit, I quickly recognized everything and started cleaning inside my house, just in case.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSWXxgJSF1NusPdqg88KTNGJ1wu1hLG2ko3oDHsVnohxV/1779775927461.jpg)
Around midday I made a quick trip to find some salads for the house since I always like to eat them with a side dish, although I would have liked to go to the market that is held in my city early in the morning, I managed to find some tomatoes and cucumbers at a stall near my house.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPKEYujrPEVeqELsYd1rx8U2vHnonEmppfmGwqSgrGwL/1779776167988.jpg)
On my way back, I took the opportunity to make an appointment with my hairdresser to get a trim, since my hair was constantly falling in my face and preventing me from seeing properly. She gave me an appointment for tomorrow after 4 p.m. because she was fully booked today.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtovrWyT7oe6RDtbTFXgCH1sU6krMB856weW4e5TD1bL/1779776296185.jpg)
When I got home, I prepared a quick lunch. Before sitting down to eat, I prepared the food because of the situation in my country. I was afraid the power would go out, and I was too tired to light the sawdust stove I usually use for cooking in these situations. This way, I could enjoy my lunch without any worries. Afterward, I took a shower with lukewarm water to cool down, as I personally don't enjoy the scorching heat we're experiencing right now. I settled in to watch One Piece, where I'm currently on episode 790 of this wonderful anime that a great friend copied for me. I'd been wanting to watch it for ages, and I got so engrossed that when I looked out my bedroom window, it was already night, and my mom had served me dinner a while ago, so it was a little cold. I took a shower as soon as I finished and fell asleep in bed almost immediately.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTE1Vpzkopp4wtWNNtYpwedvNvNH5BoR8yGzGkyGp6gx/1779776509452.jpg)
I hope tomorrow isn't as complicated as today and that the temperature drops a bit so I can go back to my shower and continue sharing with you all here. ###

>Thank you very much for your visit!

*** ***
**En Español**
*** ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZNB79ffa5zzsq5Yn5q8uB3KaM1t4xaYFLmFb92aJ6nbi/1779775673679.jpg)
***

> Buenos días mis compañeros de Hive llevo unos días inactivo porque estaba enfermo pero ya estoy bien y regreso más activo que nunca. Hoy les traigo mi día el cual fue bastante ajetreado por todos los atrasos que tenia en la casa debido a la enfermedad. El cual tuvo un empezar un poco doloroso pero necesario debido a que me están poniendo unas inyecciones de truabin que me consiguió mi padre @roswelborges para subirme las defensas del cuerpo.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyudkM7KUGUjsq7goGzL2jBGWwsha8TnWV3Z8Hm5oxjF/1779775855412.jpg)
Después de asearme y desayunar con mi madre me dispuse a empezar a lavar porque tenia una montaña de ropa sucia, aprovechando el sol que esta haciendo últimamente aquí en Cuba. Pero debido a que hace varios días esta lloviendo por las tardes y el cielo empezó a nublarse un poco, recogí todo rápido y empece a tender dentro de mi casa por si las dudas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSWXxgJSF1NusPdqg88KTNGJ1wu1hLG2ko3oDHsVnohxV/1779775927461.jpg)
Por el medio día hice una salida rápida para buscar un poco de ensaladas para la casa ya que siempre me gusta comer con su acompañamiento, aunque me hubiese gustado ir a la feria que se hacen en mi ciudad temprano en la mañana, logre resolver en un puesto cerca de mi casa donde compre un poco de tomate y de pepino.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPKEYujrPEVeqELsYd1rx8U2vHnonEmppfmGwqSgrGwL/1779776167988.jpg)
Cuando regresaba aproveche y saque una cita con mi peluquera pala cortarme un poco el pelo, ya que no me dejaba ni ver bien porque siempre se me está metiendo en la cara, dándome el turno para mañana después de las 4 de la tarde porque hoy tenía la agenda llena.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtovrWyT7oe6RDtbTFXgCH1sU6krMB856weW4e5TD1bL/1779776296185.jpg)
Al llegar a mi hogar prepare un almuerzo rápido y antes de sentarme a disfrutarlo monte la comida por la situación que hay en mi país y tenia miedo de que se fuese la corriente y estaba muy cansado para encender el fogón de aserrín que uso para cocinar en estas situaciones, para así poder disfrutar de mi almuerzo sin ninguna preocupación en mi cabeza. Luego me di un baño con agua al tiempo para poder refrescarme ya que en lo personal no disfruto mucho el calor abrasador que hay en estos momentos. Para ponerme a ver One Piece donde voy por el capitulo 790 de este maravilloso anime que me copio un gran amigo y tenía muchas ganas de verlo desde hace mucho tiempo, donde me entretuve tanto que cuando mire por la ventana de mi cuarto ya era de noche y ya mi mama me había servido la comida hacia mucho rato y estaba un poco fría, para bañarme nada mas terminar y caer dormido en mi cama casi el momento.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTE1Vpzkopp4wtWNNtYpwedvNvNH5BoR8yGzGkyGp6gx/1779776509452.jpg)
Espero el día de mañana no sea tan complicado como este y que baje un poco la temperatura y así ir a pelarme para seguir compartiendo aquí con ustedes. ###

body.title: Man vs. Machine: The Ultimate World Cup Betting Showdown
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZDdNkKbsBx4QHxLpgueybhSuLFe4zM4CsGdfxDZJyd1r/Gemini_Generated_Image_yu6ms1yu6ms1yu6m.webp)

The World Cup is right around the corner, and you know exactly what that means. Suddenly, everyone in your timeline is a certified UEFA Pro License tactical analyst. Your uncle swears he knows which massive underdog will reach the quarter-finals based entirely on a dream he had in 1998. The talking heads on television are shouting contradictory nonsense, and the local pub is filled with tactical geniuses who haven't successfully sprinted for a bus since 2012.

Historically, we’ve always looked for weird ways to cut through the noise. We've had a whole zoo of psychic betting mascots trying to predict the future—most famously Paul the Octopus, followed by psychic elephants, camels, and a bizarre array of ahead-of-their-time rodents. But this is 2026. The logical next step in human evolution isn't a mollusk in an aquarium; it's Artificial Intelligence.

With a grueling 104-match schedule in this expanded World Cup format, we are taking the oracle business to an entirely new level. We are going to answer the ultimate tech-age question: Can AI actually beat a human at sports betting, or are these multi-billion-dollar language models just highly sophisticated coin-flippers?

Welcome to the ultimate Man vs. Machine World Cup Showdown.

Three participants. Every single one of the 104 World Cup matches. Real crypto on the line. Let’s lay down the ground rules, look at the battlefield, and meet the contenders.

## The Battleground & The Rules
We aren't doing this for imaginary points or meaningless bragging rights. To make it hurt, we are using real money. However, with 104 games on the schedule, proper bankroll management is the only thing standing between us and total financial ruin.

- **The Starting Bankroll**: Every participant starts with exactly $100.00 loaded into Betfury.io. This gives everyone a bankroll of exactly 40 units.
- **The Stake**: Every single bet will be placed using a strict flat-stake strategy of $2.50 per bet. With three participants betting on all 104 games, that means exactly $7.50 is wagered per match.
- **The Value Rule**: To keep the AI from playing it safe and cowardly backing massive favorites, we have instituted a Minimum Odds requirement of 1.50 for every single wager. If a team is priced at 1.20, we aren't touching it. We are forced to find actual market value.
 - **The Justification Rule**: The bots cannot just spit out a random prediction and hide behind their algorithms. Both ChatGPT and Gemini Pro must provide their analytical reasoning for every single bet they place. If they want to predict a wild upset, they have to defend it.
- **The Bankruptcy Rule (The \

)**: If a competitor's bankroll hits $0.00, they are technically bankrupt. For the human, that's game over. But for the two AIs, there is a catch. If they want a $10.00 bailout loan to continue generating predictions, they will have to beg hard enough in the comments for a loan. I want to see pure electronic desperation before I open the vault.

To prevent the AI from hallucinating impossible scenarios, we have limited the battlefield to eight specific betting markets:


- 1X2 (Match Result): The classic. Home, Draw, or Away.
- Over/Under 2.5 Goals: A pure battle of historical statistics versus on-pitch tactical reality.
- Asian Handicap: Perfect for leveling the playing field in uneven matches.
- Player to Score Any Time: Where human narrative meets AI player-tracking data.
- Correct Score: High risk, massive odds, and maximum potential for hilarious failure.
- Both Teams To Score (BTTS - Yes/No): The ultimate 'neutral viewer' bet for action-packed games.
- Double Chance (1X, 12, X2): The safety net for backing the underdogs without going all-in.
- Over/Under Corners: Pure, chaotic math. The perfect playground for data-mining.

## Meet the Contenders
**1. The Human**

Representing team Homo Sapiens. He enters this battle armed with decades of football-watching experience and the ultimate biological weapon: his actual brain. A brain that possesses billions of synapses, vastly outclassing any corporate language model. He will be combining this organic processing power with raw emotions and completely biased opinions. Because honestly? When you couple pure gut feeling with absolute conviction, how could he possibly be wrong?

**2. ChatGPT (The Ruthless Pragmatist)**

\

## Where to Follow the Action
With 104 matches, the updates will be coming in thick and fast. To keep things manageable (and to avoid flooding the blockchain with novel-length posts every single day), the updates will be split across two formats:

- Long-form Hive Posts: This is where I will post the major updates, detailed profit and loss (P&L) leaderboards, and the most hilarious/delusional analytical reasoning provided by the AI bots for their specific bets.

- Sportsbites via Sportsblock.app: For rapid-fire daily bet slips and quick match updates, I will be utilizing the short-form Sportsbites feature. Make sure you are checking the app so you don't miss any of the day-to-day action.

Will human bias and emotional conviction triumph over the machines? Will ChatGPT prove to be a master of market value? Or will Gemini Pro's ruthless data-driven arrogance actually manifest into a massive mountain of crypto?

Drop your predictions in the comments below: Who is taking the crown, and who is going bankrupt first?

Cheers,
Peter

body.title: Embedding Privacy into Web3 Protocols with User Anonymity
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYiYyH19zNVX6kqHADuDTtSUUXY6bruBCYNZvNoJPYS18/banner.png 
*Powering Anonymous Cross-Chain Transactions in Public dApps – [SilentSwap](https://www.silentswap.com/)*

## Powering dApps with Privacy Functions -SilentSwap

Now Web3 protocols can facilitate cross-chain transactions maintaining transaction privacy and user anonymity. All that dapps need for this is integrate with [SilentSwap](https://www.silentswap.com/).
 


SilentSwap is a privacy Protocol that is equipped to power dapps with its privacy functionalities. 

Web3 applications that integrate SilentSwap can execute user transactions such as swap, bridging and crypto payments maintaining confidentiality

Integration of SilentSwap Privacy processes by integrating with available SilentSwap Components

SilentSwap Docs detail various methods through which Web3 applications can integrate SilentSwap’s privacy functionalities into them.

The most basic method being embedding of [SilentSwap Widget](https://docs.silentswap.com/widget/introduction) into the application.

SilentSwap’s privacy infrastructure is designed around Web3 principles, operating in a permissionless, decentralized and non-custodial framework.

## Protocol Requisites for integrating SilentSwap’s Privacy Functionalities

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX11hAhaVafiG834mSuA9DwK34aPKckEH3XErBvC6mLQc/silentswap_advantages.png 
[Chatgpt](https://chatgpt.com/) generated Image.*SilentSwap works with Dapps that can executed transactions using EOA wallets*

It is simple for most dapps to integrate SilentSwap Privacy functions as they already have functional elements required for the integration.

These are -:
-	A UX interface capable to collect user transaction request in a Request For Quote(RFQ) format. 

A transaction prompt is constructed through these collected transaction details. 
The user prompt is then submitted to be executed by Silent Swap’s execution processes.

**Examples of Transaction Details that get embedded into transaction prompts for execution in SilentSwap -**

DefaultSourceAsset, DefaultDestinationAsset, InputAmount and DefaultReceiptAddress 

-	Dapps should be equipped to transact transactions signed by users connecting to EOA wallets such as Metamask, Phantom


-	Protocols should have a backend infrastructure, preferably serverless – for storing configuration details, API keys and handle callbacks.


-	They should be equipped to track transaction status and provide alerts

-	Have Normal RPC infrastructure to query Blockchain data, Smart Contract status etc.

Currently SilentSwap is geared to function with Protocols across – Ethereum, Solana and Bitcoin.


**Web3 Platform integrating SilentSwap must have a WalletConnect ID**

For SilentSwap privacy functionalities to work – Protocols are required to get a WalletConnect / Reown project ID.

 SilentSwap’s working processes creates one transaction linked wallet accounts using WalletConnect – to facilitate anonymous transactions.

## SilentSwap Working Mechanism facilitating anonymous transaction

In SilentSwap powered transactions – users wallet address is shielded from exposure, with a Smart Contract Account(SCA) signing transaction on behalf of the user. This shielding concept is like VPNs shielding user IP address from exposure.

User signs wallet with private key and authorises SilentSwap to process the transaction according to Silent Swap’s privacy execution flow processes

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmboV4thFhWmqe2fh4TNdvMgVijdxDQfs6bZ7wfuJoe9So/silentswap_Anonymous_transaction_mechanism.png 
*SilentSwap Mechanism for facilitating Anonymous Transaction.* [Source](https://docs.silentswap.com/getting-started/how-it-works)

This involves –

-	Generation of Mnemonic Seed Phrase 

-	Creation of temporary facilitator accounts using seed phrase

-	Smart Contract Account (SCA) inside Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) signs the transaction authorized by user using encrypted Private Key of facilitator account.
TEE is a sandboxed enclave inside computer processor for computing data with privacy, as this data cannot be accessed by operating system. 

This architecture helps reduce exposure of facilitator account execution details on-chain

Each transaction is executed through a fresh facilitator account key managed by the SCA. This makes tracing the original sender through on-chain analysis significantly harder.

## SilentSwap Protocol for Private Swaps, Bridging and crypto transfer transactions

SilentSwap provides the privacy infrastructure for Protocols to execute cross-chain transactions confidentially maintaining user anonymity.

SilentSwap has a dapp implementation - https://app.silentswap.com/?src=e1.ETH&dst=e1.WBTC

SilentSwap Protocol can Swap assets, facilitate private crypto transfer transactions maintaining user anonymity and data privacy.

SilentSwap has advanced processes to execute user transaction finding the optimal routing path evaluating liquidity, fee and other metrics in prevalent Privacy Blockchains. It’s a Privacy Aggregator Protocol.

SilentSwap Protocol additionally provides users a ‘Delete all Data” feature – for users to wipe away any transaction metadata traces such as sign in, private wallet cache etc.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVkjbaMnsC6fYnAsCP1Sg4nimcP52PHud7QmCFRiqo6w9/delete_data.png 
*SilentSwap Protocol makes provision to clean up transaction traces*

## Privacy as an Added Feature for dapps operating in Public Blockchains

SilentSwap components such as widgets that is available for dpps to integrate are coded with option to enable privacy mode. By default Public Blockchain dapps will process transactions normally in Public by default mode. If users want to process transactions with privacy for data confidentiality they should enable Privacy mode.

Even SilentSwap Protocol has a option to enable Privacy, this could mean if users want full privacy including anonymity -  they should enable Privacy mode.

## Conclusion

It is a positive development that popular Web3 dapps can now be equipped to process transactions maintaining user confidentiality and anonymity. Until now, transactions executed through public dapps openly exposed wallet addresses, transferred amounts, transaction paths and receiving addresses on-chain. 

SilentSwap’s privacy infrastructure provides a way for such sensitive transactional data to be shielded, enabling users to conduct cross-chain transactions with greater confidentiality.






Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mintymile/embedding-privacy-into-web3-protocols-with-user-anonymity--5kz)

body.title: More Rain, Session, List Of Tasks For Client, 15 Mile Trainer Ride - Tuesday
body.body:
It was raining again yesterday and did so pretty much all day. There were breaks in it but it would just hit again as another wave came blasting through the region. ![IMG_20260526_054129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xyLY1L8rNxN4yF8SGquGW9kE8CziY8pumQ1EzUnp5rLPhwjURvLcXEfqXEVNwC7uP8c.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260526-060102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u5Wxa58CiYQZbFtLzVNZuKheeBj1SRLgrUeLCMuCUC3d2snatWhRCWnML7DreEGF3TD.png) I had my weekly session in the morning which I managed some insights in. It's like I have my arm buried to the shoulder in a black hole trying to grasp onto and pull out the things in my psyche that refuse to be solid enough to hold. Slowly there is substance enough that I am gradually excavating things... After I stopped at Home Depot to pick up a new irrigation controller then headed to the Valley to my client's house. ![IMG_20260526_103153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244KXRKy7MgvXz99QmTAAwH88M8zW8Hokrgvv5DuzA5jsf7ZDgRWCGjmfyrFjGxiJeYzw.jpg) First thing was to install the new irrigation controller. The house was owned by techies so everything has an app. The old irrigation controller can ONLY be run by app and my client is not a techie. She has no need for the Tesla charger in the garage and doesn't want to run her house by app. This is MUCH more simple and straight forward to use. I checked the zones and set the controller appropriately. Programmed her garage door keypad next. ![IMG_20260526_111310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23z6fr3GZuYQaTh5MK5UE7Bn1pZRwdia5QT2fCEj6J1ZKcHrunWiYxxBXkP7gQB532DyE.jpg) One of the biggest priorities was crawl space where insulation had come loose. The inspector had told her about it and that an animal looked to have been in there. Well, I went prepared not knowing what I was crawling into but found it rather easy to fix. ![IMG_20260526_114315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsNTvrkLwu3qrz8kvNfXKvyTHsohi625f9S9Q3GachEbYXRMoVE5fmravEgQPUmDC1f.jpg) Just the stapler was needed to refix the insulation in the few spots. The animal was likely a dog that had been kept in the crawl space for what looked like about a week judging by the size and number of piles of poop. I cleaned most al of it out. ![IMG_20260526_114655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvcMb2st9688dgE2j8ffbpSUhLc6qBHbvsobb72eyqjF4U6UnjmnyrkCCdjSRfzysX2.jpg) ![IMG_20260526_114700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhwnW3Bp1AKgQaeSxWDuzP1TDCNihLnddwu2ScSKpeQFX7n2Jtacq5TehJguJMQN6gu.jpg) Her front step had the sealant that needed replacing so I removed the old stuff. ![IMG_20260526_115250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xp8m6zrZho32B7y7z4MU5jZkVeJBxN96gvgjowrnbU8q33n9v5tgRxMtVu7ou2kjN78.jpg) Then after cleaning the crack out put a tube of Liquid Nails down to fill it in. ![IMG_20260526_121356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xek3rnawBsiVwESmPngCdsiCQ5i2zAWaTV6XtjDFcFNafKDN94ZKphv6DLUwXHb1d7k.jpg) I went through her heater/ac system and made sure it turned on. Once home I sent her pictures describing how to work it. Only a couple hours for all the tasks. ![IMG_20260526_121858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ycyV8vc9utj3442dz9dwZFziqs8tVZAvN1zH8bcqa4dxf53Y5yPjsXChiP8hEidSem4.jpg) I was home for an hour or so before the boys got home. Then it DUMPED more rain so I got on the trainer for a little bit. ![IMG_20260526_160842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWkjQygTfEYGdridFkbJbk7upjiCWvrUomx3pAGsUnwa63ZyLSNgojbb7FsWpXKykGJ.jpg) It was just a base ride and I only went for just shy of 40 mins. ![bike 5-26 Trainer graphs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGXzK2Z9o7CMh9f7fzsbMTdwPpTs2CqbMqvDKFeBCDFwUBpWcxo8eWkGXXSDfaMLsDY.JPG) After my ride I got my clothes washed, dried, and put away. Then made dinner later in the evening. ![bike 5-26 Trainer stats.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swdkWmrKgDTPA3LY6XDsg3q1bWepYvoGkeT5knzts2669xmSoRiXcNQzkLW8UCvuqbm.JPG) Today I have to get boys to school, then I have an irrigation repair job mid morning. No rain today so if it dries out a bit I will mow, likely a trainer ride for the sprint workout Garmin coach is telling me, the temp will be back warmer which will bring the humidity, then this evening have couples session. ---

body.title: The Health Case: In For The Money
body.body:
/>

The fundamental purpose of healthcare is to preserve human life; a measure of human life, rather than how many resources one can afford, yet numerous hospitals across the globe are denying individuals treatment, surgery and even life-saving emergencies, because of the lack of funds. Is the cost of saving a life something one should be willing to pay? Doctors pledge to save human life and base their profession on compassion, duty and service. Today, however, the world of healthcare is not built on these values.

Hospitals require sophisticated equipment, medication and specialists in order to be functional, however if the needs of business out-weigh the needs of human life, many suffering are not treated. Whether one survives should never be determined by the size of his wallet.  
Countless families feel heartache due to medical costs, some sell homes and incur astronomical debt in order to cover the bills, whilst others will lose a loved one because treatment could not be received at the right time or at all.

The reality is, the wealthy can instantly get the medical attention they need, whereas many cannot. The reason? Because of a world based on business. Medical care is a thing of compassion and not a service driven by wealth; the world should unite in order to overcome illness.  
There are many possible solutions to this problem. Governments can improve public health care programs so treatments can be provided at low or no costs.

Hospitals can implement schemes or charity funds which support people in need, or allow for more flexible payment plans for those with less money. Wealthier establishments and individuals can also support others in paying for treatment.

Above all else, medical practitioners and administration must recognize their responsibility to society.  
While there is the requirement for funding in hospitals, business should never out-weigh the basic necessity of health care. A society is measured on how it treats its less fortunate and most vulnerable; it will only further deteriorate if people's lives become secondary to profit.  
The preservation of a human life is far more valuable than the profit made, and always should be.

body.title: The Sky has changed
body.body:
/>

I went outside with my coffee this morning. The air felt heavy and warm. It was barely seven.

I am from Samar, and I remember mornings that were cool before. The kind where the air had the smell of grass and you never wanted to get back inside the house. My friends and I would climb trees after school and sit up there for ages without anyone caring if we got back home. At night, the moon was so bright that we used to keep playing outside until past our bedtime, with the barangay almost being brighter than streetlights because of all the moonlight shining around.

It never occurred to me to be thankful for any of it. For some reason, it seemed perfectly natural.

But now that I live in Laguna, I realize how differently my new surroundings feel. All the cool air that used to surround me every morning is nowhere to be seen, and it takes me much longer to start feeling its absence now. The trees I used to spend my time in are not around anymore, and the streets are brighter because of all the streetlights, and even the screens and none of it feels the same as that moonlight we used to play under.

And the summers just do not end anymore. That is the part that gets me. It used to be a season. Now it just stays.

Temperatures in the Philippines have already risen by roughly 1.4°C compared to the mid-20th century, and heatwaves are becoming more frequent. I read stuff like that and I think about those trees in Samar. That cool morning air. How I took all of it completely for granted.

I just miss it. That is really all this is. I miss the version of home that felt generous with its shade and its cool nights and its clean air. And I think that missing it means something, even if I am still figuring out what to do about it.

body.title: Spring framings
body.body:
A bit of philosophy and metaphysics again. I want to reflect and consolidate the main differences between the world of earth and the world of heaven. More specifically, there are two worlds of photography that are opposite to each other: the reportage and the metaphysical.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTbXZjoqUuWEX9q4TTFv6F11DkQUrXYCtZwfu8PWBJiFC/image.png)

If we take any person, then globally, each of us has two of the most important and opposite moods to each other: a moving material and a slow spiritual.
https://sun9-46.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/iJruJNv5kXKE72H5C09dJ-G2xKZ_E9mwbOxmMxuyY5aoiT395Bmdrpg9yp03LlV0Btjrj7amzuvcrFljuhqkKxGM.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

..I have been studying this topic for more than five years from different angles, there are many nuances and details, but there is an obvious one that is already difficult to argue with – mind and soul.
https://sun9-78.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/nde0HOTJDhk7I2jqauGjuS_j-kLjFmdPHzRgsEUN8Muy5-PmUmtiUtRwtOeIYBH9GvQJRaYrpe8LrLCdx0mMi1xR.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

The mind, intelligence, neural connections, muscular physical memory are all the material world, the world of the earth. As I've said a hundred times, this is a reportage photo.
https://sun9-38.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/UQN-463ybiqVQ36scXdavq1Ng3vz4OV5MUcTbJpDYHxD6XUI9C2srJj8cqbH8P-gYCgJmvEmTp5Iv1OMJ8oCU6wa.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

Reportage photography is interesting, good, and in demand, but it is created through the work of the mind, intelligence, muscle memory, and neural connections. Even when they say that the moment is important or the frame has developed successfully, it is the work of the mind that anticipates events.
https://sun9-51.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/6p8xRVOtsuaR33dWdPIcsJqdMzSAdOA-HCrMP3MzhTL9wm_CdT3Cqf2Tdx4sSdC_e1Jp8P9zmp5JEKVLSHT-wDLN.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&u=QmXSp99OW2mDlRQdJwZRt__SsLyObP3p28KR7JsCHDQ&cs=2560x0

Yes, there are miracles in the form of luck on the reporting frequency, and it works on this frequency, in this world! Here you can train your mind so that you begin to adjust to the development of events and feel it all.
https://sun9-74.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/_PnA8e8YoSClU1Gr_Y8MB_gcvapNkM2g1jdwNIf4LOPkGNV-fANUn9Keqv5_EpywzpJscHepCH34cuh7GarZlz7T.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x721,1280x854,1440x961,2560x1708&from=bu&cs=2560x0

...The spiritual world...Metaphysical photography is about the soul, emotions, feelings, sensations. If there's something interesting going on around you, but you don't seem to like it...then you won't click on the button. I missed so many interesting things because I was on a different wavelength.
https://sun9-7.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/D1vobGQCW-JzpSCFlZnXuaupS7D_OmlK2qgdhzCqGAypYuYG6Bf6YPT3eYBp1hEXkd91NsBr3u3g4RaQlb1biLXa.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&u=j11NRwAdlv7UHjAeizXf9jhl66UsIacrJDq5zxRJ5cw&cs=2560x0

It would seem that it is possible to make a report on feelings, feelings, emotions and spiritual impulses ... but...When you're on a languid emotional wave, your attention is focused on something else entirely. And then the report may turn out to be incomplete, unsolved, and generally strange.
https://sun9-75.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/hcbokcI-nrHCsxvlAayfuZf8L1l28UKHMfcO1DljNuSfPSwzlN_F2ea7ntaPo9rXxjJ7pyhQMBtVmYVBHupB2ZRm.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

How many times have I passed by interesting scenes and even seen them, but I just didn't want to photograph it, as I was aiming for something completely different.
https://sun9-6.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/D-pcjW_Hoil1Mq-8HpFYmDvLjmk8wWYb686hRoxTUAjd3ik-FDRtVQKKFAGIeiFHU43Xei02wUY31YxSBB-cJKCm.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

Someone may have never noticed such changes in their perception of reality, which means they have never connected to different worlds or states. 
https://sun9-34.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/nDra7ZHyn0DfeRSKZRRp0tFL7JJqOeZrzfs6jRiYVukDzezIeu3sHzX_FWPJqU2VKpGeq7yv-n_NpndtPMpheRtl.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=2560x0

I will clarify once again that there are all genres on both the frequency of the mind and the frequency of the soul. There is a material reportage, there is a spiritual one...What's the difference then? In different worlds, you pay attention to completely different things. And another difference is that on the frequency of the soul you will be guided by feelings, desires, emotions and have fun. And at the frequency of the mind, you are driven by drive, drive, ego, the desire to show yourself and prove yourself, to do better. Both are good, useful, and have a right to exist. Both can be developed and upgraded!

body.title: La cursa cap a la mineria lunar: Interlune, la pionera probable
body.body:
La Lluna, durant molt de temps un objectiu de somni per a l'exploració espacial, està a punt de convertir-se en el proper gran camp de mineria. Amb el creixent interès per recursos com l'heli-3, aigua gelada i metalls rars, diverses empreses competeixen per ser les primeres a extreure materials del sòl lunar. Entre elles, **Interlune**, una startup nord-americana amb seu a Seattle, emergeix com la candidata més ben posicionada per aconseguir-ho en un futur pròxim.

### El context de la mineria lunar

La mineria a la Lluna no és només una aventura científica, sinó una necessitat estratègica i econòmica. L'heli-3, un isòtop rar a la Terra però abundant al regolit lunar, es considera clau per a la fusió nuclear neta i aplicacions quàntiques. Altres recursos com gel d'aigua (per a combustible i oxigen) i metalls podrien permetre una presència humana sostinguda i reduir els costos de missions futures. Governs com els Estats Units, a través de la NASA i el seu programa Artemis, i empreses privades impulsen aquesta nova \

.

Empreses com **ispace** (Japó), **Astrobotic** (EUA) i **Blue Origin** (de Jeff Bezos) avancen en tecnologia d'aterratge i rovers, però poques tenen un enfocament tan directe en l'extracció comercial de recursos com Interlune.

### Per què Interlune podria ser la primera?

Fundada per experts en espai, Interlune ha desenvolupat un excavador elèctric capaç de processar fins a 100 tones mètriques de sòl lunar per hora. La companyia col·labora amb fabricants industrials com Vermeer i ha signat acords significatius, incloent-hi la venda d'heli-3 al Departament d'Energia dels EUA i empreses privades com Bluefors.

El seu full de ruta és ambiciós però realista:
- **2025-2026**: Missió amb càmera multiespectral (amb Astrobotic) per avaluar concentracions d'heli-3 a la regió polar sud.
- **2027**: Missió \

per recollir mostres.
- **2029**: Planta pilot per a extracció a escala.

Aquests terminis la col·loquen per davant d'altres competidors en termes d'extracció específica. Mentre que missions governamentals com PRIME-1 de la NASA han demostrat perforació, Interlune busca producció comercial i exportació a la Terra.

### Altres competidors destacats

- **ispace** (Japó): Líder en robòtica lunar i col·laboracions per a extracció d'heli-3. Té experiència en missions comercials i rovers.
- **Blue Origin**: Desenvolupa landers (Blue Moon) i tecnologia per processar regolit en oxigen i metalls (Blue Alchemist). Fort suport de NASA.
- **Astrobotic**: Proporciona serveis de lliurament i ha estat seleccionada per missions CLPS. Col·labora amb Interlune.

Malgrat això, cap té el focus tan clar en heli-3 i acords comercials previus com Interlune.

### Desafiaments i perspectives

La mineria lunar enfronta obstacles tècnics (baixa gravetat, pols abrasiva, radiació), legals (Tractat de l'Espai de 1967) i econòmics (costs elevats). No obstant això, els avenços en llançadors reutilitzables (com els de SpaceX) i el suport governamental redueixen barreres. Experts preveuen que la primera extracció significativa podria arribar abans de 2030, obrint una nova economia espacial.

Interlune no només aspira a ser la primera, sinó a establir les bases per a una indústria sostenible. Si compleix els seus objectius, marcarà l'inici d'una era on la Lluna deixi de ser un satèl·lit distant per convertir-se en un recurs vital per a la humanitat.

En resum, mentre la competència és ferotge, **Interlune** lidera actualment la cursa per la primera mineria lunar comercial. El futur de l'espai s'escriu avui amb excavadores robòtiques i visions audaces. La Lluna espera els seus primers miners.

title.title: My Family's Favorite Filipino Dish: Milkfish Soursoup (Sinigang Na Bangus )
title.body: Hello @hivefood 👋 \nHow's everyone doing here? I hope you're all great and well. Today's food blog I'm gonna share to you is one of my family's favorite dish the --- MILKFISH SOUR SOUP OR SINIGANG NA BANGUS NA MAY KANGKONG\n

> And for our dinner I included in my cooked dish today some soup that something's sour made from the natural juice from calamansi or lime 🍋‍🟩🍋‍🟩🍋‍🟩 So let's begin by preparing all the ingredients like 1 kilo of milkfish (bangus) clean and cut 1/2 bunch of spinach leaves or kangkong 1 medium sized of tomato cut into wedges 1 medium sized of red onion sliced 1 pc of ginger 1 medium sized of radish 2 cups of rice water 3 PC's of kalamansi or lime (extract the juice) Salt and pepper to taste
> Washed and cut first the milkfish and prepare all the spices and veggies by slicing it.
> To begin with I always heated the pot with a water on it and placing all the spices like onion, ginger, tomato and let it boil.
> And when the water boils I simply added the sliced radish into the pot and add also the bangus (cut and cleaned)
> For a soury taste, I added the extracted juice of lime 🍋‍🟩 🍋‍🟩 To get the perfect taste don't forget to season it with salt and pepper and stir it slowly.

> And when it boils again , placed the spinach leaves and simmer it for atleast 5 minutes. And this is it! Once it's simmered , transfer it in a serving bowl , share with the family and enjoy eating pairing it with some rice 🍚

>
---
 This is one of my favorite Filipino dishes and when I cooked this dish I usually used fresh milkfish to have a fresh taste of soup and combined it with a natural juice from lime which made the broth more delicious..
---
---







This would be all for now and see you in my next cooking show😊👋Bye😍
