body.title: The Invisible Mask For Hidden Pain
body.body:
Not until the mask are masked on faces just like those mask parties before we get to know that people are now hiding the real life they live behind the ones shown to the public.

![1000717350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23tvVYiTtyoUsDnfmPUPHVD3JbzrA1NwGHXUy4pRLWToAUDM1MhEitQEqjbwsAwZYT8Bb.jpg)

The toll rate of people's death increases day by day, not because it's the natural death taking them but they are leaving at their primetime because they keep struggling with battles well known to them alone which could be a means of getting ridiculed if they show it to people around them. And until they die in silence, those around them never know what these people are passing through.

In fact, they may even be criticized for not showing up for family gatherings or being supportive financially as a voluntary donation that was placed out but which eventually turned to an indirect compulsory donation. 
Even when it's unknown to them that the focused-on person to donate is actually struggling to survive on their own for their daily upkeep but all they keep seeing is a packaged smile in a once purchased beautiful dress that makes them look elegant like they own millions in her account.

Society has turned so selfish that we don't want to care until gone too soon is posted and then the attention to details we failed to give when the person was alive now becomes a priority to us. 
The sickness we so much disliked and caused us to detach ourselves from the victim becomes our point of discussion to chase clout about the deceased. That is how far the society's deadly masks are.

![1000717356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23swi69JViTG6rfzhVprZSy8Dj9br5uU37t5w4qD27b3jZWrpWiesuWmijAhcmQP6uzLc.jpg)

Many are masking pain of daily survival, pain of loneliness, pain of bad health and all we can see from the outside are all shades of smile and radiant faces with makeovers for the female and great haircuts for male. As long as the face speaks so well then we are fine and good to go but then the secret battle lies there in the heart and mind.

Having a trusted person to talk to goes a long way. In this kind of terrible economy and world we av moulded to live in, dying in silence is the worst thing anyone can do to themselves.

It is not only about showing happiness, it's about been happy genuinely.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Scifi Multiverse Prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗

body.body:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUt2bNJrQBjTRYWaqv2MLtwsHyioEA2BvZP7naNeqwfwF/peggy_marco_atm_1524870_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/atm-withdraw-cash-map-ec-card-1524870/)

---

# Crónicas de lo Absurdo #20  
## El Efectivo  

Hola querida comunidad @holos-lotus, regreso una vez más para compartir una nueva entrega de esta serie:

#### Crónicas de lo Absurdo.

> Esta es una serie de crónicas sobre lo cotidiano, sobre esas escenas que se repiten tanto que dejan de parecernos extrañas. Aquí no hay exageración ni ficción forzada. El absurdo no se inventa, se observa. Son textos nacidos de la experiencia diaria, de la espera, de las normas sin sentido, de los gestos que todos conocemos y que casi nunca cuestionamos. No pretenden dar respuestas, solo detenerse un momento y mirar con atención eso que hemos aprendido a aceptar.

En esta la vigésima edición retomo un tema que, por su persistencia en la vida cotidiana, vuelve una y otra vez a la experiencia diaria. No es un tema nuevo, pero sí uno que sigue sin resolverse en la práctica.

#### El efectivo.

---

Hay temas que no desaparecen aunque se hablen muchas veces.

Y este es uno de ellos.

No porque sea nuevo, sino porque sigue presente.

Y también porque cambia de forma.

En la actualidad, una gran parte de los ingresos se deposita directamente en tarjetas bancarias. En teoría, esto debería facilitar los pagos, modernizar las transacciones y reducir la dependencia del efectivo.

Sobre el papel, la idea es simple.

En la vida cotidiana, no siempre lo es.

El salario llega.

Pero su uso no siempre es inmediato ni completo en la práctica diaria.

El efectivo escasea.

Y cuando aparece, lo hace de forma limitada, con restricciones, horarios o condiciones que no siempre coinciden con las necesidades reales de las personas.

Retirar dinero se convierte en muchas ocasiones en una tarea incierta. No siempre hay disponibilidad, no siempre se sabe cuándo habrá, y no siempre es posible acceder a la cantidad necesaria.

Mientras tanto, la vida cotidiana no se detiene.

Comprar alimentos, pagar servicios, resolver necesidades básicas… todo sigue ocurriendo en un entorno donde el efectivo continúa siendo, en muchos casos, la forma más práctica de intercambio.

Y aquí aparece una contradicción importante.

Se cobra en un sistema.

Pero no siempre se puede usar en el mismo sistema dentro de la vida real.

Y en medio de esa contradicción, muchas personas organizan su día a día en función de algo que no controlan del todo: la disponibilidad de efectivo.

No se trata únicamente de un problema técnico o bancario.

Se trata de una desconexión entre la forma en que se entrega el dinero y la forma en que se necesita utilizar.

A veces el problema no es cobrar.

Es poder convertir ese cobro en vida cotidiana real.

---

👉 En este punto es importante aclarar algo: aunque este tema ha aparecido de forma indirecta en crónicas anteriores, aquí se aborda desde otro ángulo. No desde cómo se paga o se acepta el dinero, sino desde su circulación real después de ser cobrado.

---

Y en esa diferencia se hace visible el absurdo.

Porque el dinero existe.

Está registrado.

Está depositado.

Pero su acceso físico no siempre está garantizado.

Y la vida cotidiana, sin embargo, sigue funcionando en muchos espacios donde el efectivo sigue siendo necesario.

El resultado es una adaptación constante.

Una especie de organización diaria basada no en lo que debería ser, sino en lo que en cada momento es posible.

---

A veces, el problema no es cobrar.

Es poder usar lo cobrado.

---

Hasta aquí esta vigésima crónica. Gracias por leer y espero comentarios al respecto. Las imágenes son de Pixabay y utilicé el traductor de Google para la versión en inglés.

🇬🇧 In English

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUt2bNJrQBjTRYWaqv2MLtwsHyioEA2BvZP7naNeqwfwF/peggy_marco_atm_1524870_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/atm-withdraw-cash-map-ec-card-1524870/)

---
# Chronicles of the Absurd #20  
## Cash  

Hello dear @holos-lotus community, I come once again to share a new entry in this series:

#### Chronicles of the Absurd.

> This is a series of chronicles about everyday life, about those scenes that repeat themselves so often that they stop seeming strange to us. Here there is no exaggeration or forced fiction. The absurd is not invented, it is observed. These are texts born from daily experience, from waiting, from meaningless rules, from gestures we all know and almost never question. They do not seek to give answers, only to stop for a moment and look carefully at what we have learned to accept.

In this twentieth edition I return to a topic that, due to its persistence in daily life, keeps reappearing in everyday experience. It is not a new topic, but it is one that remains unresolved in practice.

#### Cash.

---

There are topics that do not disappear even when discussed many times.

And this is one of them.

Not because it is new, but because it remains present.

And also because it changes shape.

Currently, a large part of income is deposited directly into bank cards. In theory, this should make payments easier, modernize transactions, and reduce dependence on cash.

On paper, the idea is simple.

In everyday life, it is not always that simple.

Salaries arrive.

But their use is not always immediate or fully accessible in daily practice.

Cash is scarce.

And when it appears, it does so in limited amounts, under restrictions, schedules, or conditions that do not always match people’s real needs.

Withdrawing money often becomes an uncertain task. Availability is not guaranteed, timing is unclear, and accessing the needed amount is not always possible.

Meanwhile, daily life does not stop.

Buying food, paying for services, solving basic needs… everything continues in an environment where cash remains, in many cases, the most practical form of exchange.

And here a contradiction becomes visible.

Money is received in one system.

But it cannot always be used in the same system within real life.

And in the middle of that contradiction, many people organize their daily routines based on something they do not fully control: cash availability.

This is not only a technical or banking issue.

It is a disconnect between how money is delivered and how it is actually needed.

Sometimes the problem is not getting paid.

It is being able to turn that payment into real daily life.

---

👉 At this point it is important to clarify something: although this topic has appeared indirectly in previous chronicles, here it is approached from a different angle. Not from how payments are made or accepted, but from the real circulation of money after it is received.

---

And in that difference, the absurd becomes visible.

Because money exists.

It is recorded.

It is deposited.

But physical access to it is not always guaranteed.

Yet daily life still operates in many spaces where cash remains necessary.

The result is constant adaptation.

A way of organizing life based not on what should be, but on what is possible at each moment.

---

Sometimes, the problem is not getting paid.

It is being able to use what has been paid.

---

This is the end of this twentieth chronicle. Thank you for reading, and I look forward to your comments. The images are from Pixabay and I used Google Translate for the English version.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

body.title: A simple lifestyle with simple food from vegetables in the home garden #23, Stir-fried sugar pea with eggs in oyster sauce.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTvetR9SijVDFSCpaY3H8um5xVA1RHniGwhA5yNzyHxiU/1779871036487.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Since I tried planting sugar pea in two plastic baskets, the vegetables have thrived and remained completely healthy. This is the first time I've plant this type of vegetable. And now these sugar pea have grown significantly compared to the last 2-3 weeks, They are about 10 centimeters tall and can be harvested for cooking. Now that my wife has free time, so she is picking all sugar pea from two plastic baskets to cook a simple dish. This time, she cooked stir-fried sugar pea with eggs in oyster sauce.

Sugar pea in two plastic baskets that my wife picked for cooking this time.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvmjPoZyXRwdzxN5AyAdQzcMaYp9Bmtask5JQpw1nHds/1779871036531.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPtS2AAnt7Ccib3JH5ryRURhTmGgtwmBw6Det88i1BC2/1779871036675.jpg)

Stir-fried sugar pea with eggs in oyster sauce, this dish has only a few simple ingredients, Let's check them out.

sugar pea
egg
oyster sauce
garlic
pork flavour seasoning powder
oil
water 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsTZA6soi9Ede4GZQZuFA1zks1LMUjwpCg4zgj4YmWNt/1779871391723.jpg)

How to cook stir-fried sugar pea with eggs in oyster sauce : Put a pan on the stove and heat a little oil. Then add the garlic to the pan and stir-fried until fragrant. Then add a little water to the pan and stir for a while until the water boils. Add sugar pea to the pan and stir-fry for a while until the vegetables are soft.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUxw284FTtZY3iAAEz72ojUobyQxDJ4o77q9LX3rcxZX6/1779871391985.jpg)

Then add the eggs to the pan and stir-fry until the sugar pea and eggs are cooked. Add oyster sauce and stir. Season with pork flavour seasoning powder.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXGwimY2ihXT55fVacsAWFfEaf1jbjRZVT4Zfzf3mJSJr/1779871391906.jpg)

It's finished, stir-fried sugar pea with eggs in oyster sauce.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQgUyBt9vo2JSmxvXqp9aNftCQPjsyfax1ygwFb7gCCN/1779871392064.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUdFsXuacXsxLXNpUgo1EtP53TCStwSUg3UXNp3F1t8CS/1779871391822.jpg)

Since my sugar pea planting was a success, so I plan to plant more of them in the future. I have already ordered sugar pea seeds from an online store, and they will be delivered to my home in about 3 to 4 days. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

📷 Take photo By Smartphone Vivo V30.

body.title: [生活日记]面馆.超市.海边
body.body:
一连下两三天雨了，感觉空气有点潮湿，当晚洗的衣服牛仔裤，一晚上醒来没有晾干。这可不好办了。姑娘勉强穿了自己不太喜欢的另一条牛仔裤去上课。

姑娘去上课我继续收拾家务。中午11点信息又来了。妈，我手机马上要没电了，就两格电了，一个捂脸的表情包。妈，我想下课在学校门口吃个饭，可是手机电不足了，又一个捂脸的表情。真愁人🙃。“等着吧，我穿好衣服出去接你”我连忙放下手中活出门接应去了呵。
其实自己已经在家里做好了中午要吃的米饭🍚。姑娘想吃面，那我就陪着吃面吧。米饭只好留晚餐吃了。
这家兰州拉面店就在学校马路对面的美食街上，距离校门口不到千米远。中午的时候面馆很火，总有学生在这吃午餐。这是一家新疆人开的兰州拉面馆，店里的特色就是有各种面，拉面炒面，拌面。还有特色的烤肉串。不过我和姑娘这次只消费20块钱，每人一份传统牛肉拉面。


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVMGtdXNjqMJoSXES7dTntkgHwE6P9BSoT8LAwEZHLUi/1779882466416.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRUcPknf5b2UzPSCodn5Mt3SDVihQq4g2AYQwRAHSDU6/1779882498812.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9mWVhZc5CR68DnYeNMWbQmiK932iKSis3fFnZTyyqqG/1779882498879.jpg)

中午休息了一会儿，下午又开始出去转转了，转转就消费。今天虽然是周二但傍晚的超市学生还是很多。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaeHAeuT26cgobxZ36MP9xgUm2KjTvBthmakFCnpfjxuw/1779882609668.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ86RsWgSDe9iaN5uonp857cn4fxLA6H1iPCzrryZcGMy/1779882609741.jpg)
我主要是想过来买些酸奶，结果消费35元还多。
这学校附近的一条街很多特色小吃店。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaieY2VXBuxnXpidrVCfs57atcW7BSxS8viY57ipacmeL/1779882843253.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSnZDHYM5RHQaLFaWUyC3dQaA31oFDsMzbxCr8XZiYvXZ/1779882843150.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaG2JTfB4uUpxk8s1Vd7vZjtshuymeLXJyWrChFEDDtq/1779882843353.jpg)
在去超市之前，我是去海边绕了一圈的，上午下雨了，下午就有雾了，雾气还没散，海面上雾蒙蒙的看不清远方。傍晚是涨潮的时候，没有什么人在海边了，走近时，只见两位钓鱼爱好者在垂钓，很专业的样子，海边人是不是都会钓鱼呀？
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6uWeggT5j9HowmzksEx5cv442bMFhgQLdVtBgnsqP7o/1779883171041.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRS9YdyxA2AAWoeAQhDA4t8UKGdVbZzpHH1G5b7tFzEox/1779883171132.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4coVsChHGfieBajN2DjP1PJnqt2jNQNooG8M3hNtWFm/1779883171319.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYaRiPjy5tMFTzUrPBhodNUCJHe8NvTnCvCbVcdZuaS1E/1779883171234.jpg)
鱼船船桨，以前我从来没想过我会随意就能看到它哈，因为我家附近是没有海也没有鱼船的。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcFAV3tJ7NN8VTJJFDNY7ANFq53EXJdaCmhMufw63FoE/1779883171424.jpg)

body.title: Why is Pushkar Camel Fair Perfect for a Rajasthan Ride?
body.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/4c2a33ec507718a8f77104b86d004eda0476dd51a677159aef689fdd988cdaaa)

The Pushkar Camel Fair is one of the largest and oldest cultural festivals in India. Every year, thousands of camels, horses, traders, performers, photographers, and travelers gather in Pushkar for this iconic event. The [Pushkar Camel Fair 2026](https://www.brahmandtour.com/blog_detail/71/combination-of-pushkar-camel-fair-with-rajasthan-motorbike-trip) is scheduled to run for 9 days, from November 17 to November 25, 2026. The event, centered around the auspicious Kartik Purnima full moon, includes cultural performances, camel trading, and competitions.

Key Details for 2026:

Dates: November 17, 2026 – November 25, 2026.

Duration: 9 Days.

Main Events: Camel processions, folk performances, and local handicrafts.

Peak Day: November 24, 2026 (Kartik Purnima, full moon).

Location: Pushkar, Rajasthan, India. 

Tip: The first few days are busiest for camel trading, while the final days are focused on religious celebrations at Pushkar Lake. It is advised to book accommodations several months in advance for this popular festival.

For motorcycle enthusiasts, the fair becomes more than just a stop on the route. It becomes a cultural celebration after days of riding through Rajasthan’s desert highways and heritage cities. The atmosphere during the fair is unlike anywhere else in the country. You will witness camel parades, folk dances, music performances, local competitions and colorful markets filled with handmade crafts.



\#rajasthanmotorbiketour #motorcycletourinindia #motorcycletourrajasthan #rajasthantour #pushkarcamelfair #camelfairinrajastahan #brahmandtour #pushkarfair2026

title.title: Building the best team
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUnKRWpnMBSER5LUM9j6MWAcftQ5phnb32ZCorpvH6ZZX/PXL_20250418_214945490.webp)

---------------------------------------

It's always a bit interesting just how different the division II softball field can be from the division I group of teams.  For example, in division I we are now down to 8 teams in the Women's College World Series, and of those eight teams, three of them are a number 1 seed.  Three more of the teams are 2 seeds, and then you have Mississippi State with a five seed and Texas Tech with a three seed.

By contrast in the division II World Series, we have four 1 seeds, two 2 seeds, a three seed, and a four seed.  I guess when you look at it like that, it isn't too far off, but I still think it gives you a broader view of how much the teams are spread out.  

I think it becomes a different thing when you have players playing because they love to versus players playing because they are getting paid to.  That isn't to imply that the division I players don't love what they are doing, but I think at the top level in the power conferences, the love of the sport has somewhat been factored out.

It's not surprising that the top schools can make their way to the finals because they have the money to bring in the best talent to make it so.  However, on the D2 side of things, they just don't have that scholarship or NIL money like the big schools do.  These players know they are likely playing some of the last softball games of their career.  There isn't a pro contract waiting for them.  

In fact, they might just go on to coach, or then again, they might never touch a softball again except in church league.  

It's hard to say, but I feel like there is a bit less pressure at the lower level, and that lower pressure allows less likely teams to rise to the top.  Sure, you still have some recruiting powerhouses, but there is a lot to be said for passion, and sometimes things just fall into place for a team where you really can't explain it.  

In the same vein, there are times a team that on paper should be running the field completely implodes.  You just never know.  

For the D2 group of eight we have Saint Leo, CSUSM, West Texas A&M, STTAQN, MO SOU, UNG, McKendree, and Glenville getting ready to start their double elimination play tomorrow.  I am really looking forward to seeing how it all shakes out.

title.body:
>

Saludos comunidad de TopFiveFamily, hoy me uno al [Concurso Observa Piensa Escribe](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6) de esta semana, con la fotografía compartida por @lanzjoseg. Invitando a @yetsimar a que participe.  

---

<center>

# Mi amor y alergia por los peluches.</center> 

---

<center>![FxX5caie56yoV2jPEs63ESHNPjabC1hfpPxhQk2eVHWMqFUVxfHTyXD36k3CYbNKukjBcK2pBiMf4xeHtTvAThVez17ki71kgAt9tQT2YFEN.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo8TpAT28wJgb1tNbtCZU7K1eVpHyzxNus5qXP3FWkKa9mFLvV8nJETGXgmkJ1Zo3gf.png)
Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg</center>

---

![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png)

---

<div class=\

>Desde que tengo uso de razón, siempre me han gustado los peluches, de diferentes tamaños y formas, pero sucedía algo y es que soy muy alérgica, por ende la pelusita que botan estos me resultan algo fastidiosa a mi nariz; no obstante, mi mamá tampoco es que me prohibía tenerlos, ya que sentía que eso haría que mi sistema inmunde se adaptaba y realmente paso casi así, o por lo menos ya no me dan esas alergias horribles de pequeña, incluso ese hecho me hizo poder tener mascotas, porque también era alérgicas a los pelitos del mismo, pero el convivir con estos, desarrollo mejores defensas en mí, por lo menos no tan intensas como de pequeña. En lo personal, he tenido peluches de muchos tipos, de los que más recuerdo y aun conservo son una vaquita que me gustó mucho y mi tío, quien vive en otro estado, no dudo en regalármelo y por ello, le tengo mucho aprecio, ya que, para él, hemos sido también como sus hijas. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

>Otros de los peluches que les tengo mucho cariño, es un conejito que mi mamá me regaló cuando me gradué de bachiller y es el que más guardo con recelo, pero vino mi sobrino y le despego una de sus orejitas, ahora tengo que limpiarlo, porque de paso pareciera que lo rastro por el piso, y lo tenía era porque en mi cuarto antes se mojaba y aprovechó de jugar con el mismo. Además de mucho más, que cada uno tiene su historia y nunca la olvido, también esta uno que fue muy significativo, pues unos amigos, luego de perder a unos perritos en el año 2023, para mi cumpleaños me regalaron un peluche de perrito y no sé, pero eso me hizo llorar, porque era como si me dijeran que todo pasaría e incluso al peluchito le puse el nombre de una de ellos y le tengo mucho cariño y cuidando de uno de mis perritos mas joven que lo quiere volver trizas, no sé porque, pero tiene algo con el mismo. Siento que más allá de juguetes, todo reside en la intención de porque te lo dan, sean por desearte felicidad, amor, consuelo, cariño y muchas más y lo que los hace valiosos, yo no los considero ni adornos ni nada por el estilo, los considero unos cofres de recuerdos y emociones. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

>

Greetings TopFiveFamily community, today I'm joining this week's [Observe Think Write Contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6) with the photo shared by @lanzjoseg. I'm inviting @yetsimar to participate as well.

<center>

# My love and allergy for stuffed animals.

---

<center>![FxX5caie56yoV2jPEs63ESHNPjabC1hfpPxhQk2eVHWMqFUVxfHTyXD36k3CYbNKukjBcK2pBiMf4xeHtTvAThVez17ki71kgAt9tQT2YFEN.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo8TpAT28wJgb1tNbtCZU7K1eVpHyzxNus5qXP3FWkKa9mFLvV8nJETGXgmkJ1Zo3gf.png)
Image courtesy of @lanzjoseg</center>

---

![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png)

---

<div class=\

>Ever since I can remember, I've always loved stuffed animals, of all different sizes and shapes. But there was a catch: I'm very allergic, so the fluff they shed really bothered my nose. However, my mom didn't forbid me from having them, as she felt it would help my immune system adapt, and it almost did. At least I don't get those horrible allergies I had as a child anymore. This even allowed me to have pets, because I was also allergic to their fur. Living with them helped me develop stronger immune systems, or at least not as intense as when I was little. Personally, I've had many kinds of stuffed animals. The ones I remember most fondly, and still have, are a little cow that I really loved. My uncle, who lives in another state, didn't hesitate to give it to me, and I'm very fond of it because, to him, we've been like his daughters. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

>Another stuffed animal I'm very fond of is a bunny my mom gave me for my high school graduation. It's the one I keep most carefully, but my nephew came along and pulled one of its ears off. Now I have to clean it, because it looks like he's been dragging it all over the floor. I had it because my room used to get wet, and he took advantage of that to play with it. Besides many others, each with its own story that I'll never forget, there's also one that was very meaningful. Some friends, after losing some dogs in 2023, gave me a stuffed dog for my birthday. I don't know, but it made me cry, because it was like they were telling me that everything would be alright. I even named the stuffed animal after one of them, and I'm very attached to it. I'm taking care of one of my younger dogs, who wants to tear it to pieces. I don't know why, but he has a thing for it. I feel that beyond toys, everything lies in the intention behind giving them to you, whether it's to wish you happiness, love, comfort, affection, and much more, and that's what makes them valuable. I don't consider them decorations or anything like that; I consider them treasure chests of memories and emotions. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

title.title: The Silent Weight Of Adulthood.
title.body:
People like to think weight is always something physical, like carrying a heavy bag, lifting a load, or standing on a scale and seeing numbers you don’t like, but honestly, some of the heaviest things people carry cannot even be seen.

I realized that properly one evening while sitting outside our compound with my friend, Tunde.

NEPA had taken light, as usual, and the whole street had that soft evening noise of generators humming from far away, children playing football with slippers as goalposts, and one woman somewhere shouting at her child for entering gutter water.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4P6yJ94LF4UM8BJ8i258d259u32wCpKCVijmVgLGkpn/1779882454796.png)

Tunde was unusually quiet that day.

Now this is somebody that normally talks too much, the kind of person that can gist for Nigeria and still have extra stories left, So when he sat beside me quietly for almost ten minutes, I knew something was wrong.

“You dey alright?” I finally asked him.

He forced a smile, “Yeah, I’m good.”

I laughed immediately, “See your face. That one no be ‘I’m good’ face.”

He stayed quiet again before shaking his head slowly.

“Omo… I’m tired.”

The way he said it caught me off guard because it didn’t sound like normal tiredness, It sounded heavy.

“What happened?”

He leaned forward and rested both elbows on his knees.

“Everything just feels like pressure lately.”

I didn’t even interrupt him after that because sometimes people don’t really need advice first, they just need space to talk.

“My younger sister’s school fees is due, my mom keeps calling me about house rent,foodstuff etc,  work is stressing me, and I am trying to act like I have everything under control”, He laughed weakly, “Meanwhile, I don’t even know what I am doing anymore.”

That one hit me.

Because being young men, especially here in Nigeria, there is this silent expectation that you should always be strong no matter what , always composed, and always figuring things out.

Nobody really prepares you for the emotional weight that comes with adulthood.

People only talk about responsibilities like they are motivational quotes until you are the one carrying them.

I looked at Tunde and honestly, I understood him more than he knew.

Because even me, there were days I felt overwhelmed too, days where I smiled and joked around but deep down my mind was carrying too many things at once.

Bills.

Expectations.

Fear of failure.

Trying to become something in life before people start calling you, “potential man”

That pressure alone can weigh on somebody.

“You know the funny thing?” Tunde suddenly said, “Everybody thinks I am doing well.”

I nodded slowly.

“That is how it always is.”

Sometimes the people carrying the heaviest weight are the ones still laughing the loudest.

For a while we just sat there quietly, the streetlights still had not come on because, well… Nigeria.

Then he looked at me again.

“How do people even handle all this?”

I laughed softly, “I don’t think anybody truly knows, I think most people are just trying their best and hoping it works out.”

That made him laugh for real this time.

Small, but real.

Then I told him something my mum once told me years ago.

“Life becomes heavier when you try to carry everything alone.”

He repeated it quietly like he was thinking about it properly.

And honestly, I think that is true.

A lot of us are carrying emotional weight silently because we feel like we must, like asking for help somehow makes us weak.

But sometimes just talking changes things a little.

Not because the problems disappear immediately, but because the weight no longer feels like it is crushing only you.

That evening did not magically solve Tunde’s problems.

His responsibilities were still there.

Nigeria was still Nigeria.

But after that conversation, he seemed lighter somehow.

And I understood something too.

Weight is not always what you carry in your hands.

Sometimes it is what you carry in your mind, sometimes it is expectations, sometimes it is fear, sometimes it is pretending to be okay when you’re actually struggling.

And the truth is, almost everybody is carrying something, some people just hide it better than others.

For a group with deep Italian roots — born from the merger of FCA and PSA — this signals serious, long-term alignment between corporate strategy and Europe's green transition agenda.

>This isn't a one-off move. Just days ago, Stellantis unveiled FaSTLAne 2030, a sweeping €60 billion five-year industrial plan built around six strategic pillars: brand portfolio optimization, targeted EV platform investment, industrial partnerships, and stronger regional autonomy. The Mulhouse announcement fits perfectly into this framework — proof that Italy's largest automaker isn't just talking electrification, it's funding it.

Four straight sessions of gains. The market is clearly buying in.

title.title: A Must Watch! Ladies First (2026) || Movie Review
title.body: /> I went into this movie blind mostly because Rosamund Pike and Fiona Shaw starred in it. I assumed the plot would be female-focused which turned out somewhat true though not in the way I had envisioned. Imagine an existence where gender roles are reversed; not patriarchal but a matriarchal world where women behave the way men traditionally do. This is a topic that has sparked global conversations, more so in this decade but seeing the scenario play out in a movie makes the idea feel vivid and unsettling in a comedic way. **Ladies First (2026)** is an American comedy directed by Thea Sharrock and inspired by French comedy *I Am Not An Easy Man* (2018). It stars actors like Rosamund Pike and Sacha Baron Cohen as leads with Fiona Shaw, Richard E. Grant, Emily Mortimer, Charles Dance and others as supporting cast. Richard E. Grant (Pigeon Man) does voice-over introducing Damien Sachs (Sacha Baron Cohen) in the opening scene as a wealthy but chauvinistic staff of Atlas, an advertising agency. In a weekend campaign meeting with Guinness on how to promote their drink to women, they remarked their reluctance to work with Atlas because there are no women in the agency's top staff. Damien lies that a female creative director has just been promoted so he can secure the deal.

/> When he resumes work on Monday, he meets Alex Fox (Rosamund Pike) whom he had chosen through his PA as the new creative director. At a meeting with other men about the Guinness campaign, they shut her out, debating vulgar ideas and jokes on how to run the campaign.

/> Alex discovers she's on the creative board for optics and not for her brain, so she argues with Damien and quits. While he chases her out of the building, ridiculing her for being ‘emotional’, he ogles a blonde on the street and blindly hits his head on a pole. He falls and passes out for a few seconds. When he comes to, he's shocked to find himself in a world where women rule and the men struggle to get ahead. How will Damien find his way out of this alternate existence? Can he endure this reality? #### My Review And Rating This comedy took me by surprise and I found myself chuckling through most of the scenes. The plot is brilliant even though it's what most women have imagined at some point in their lives but seeing this vividly onscreen makes it funny but in a reflective way. I like that the director makes viewers imagine a world where men face the same prejudices that women have faced for centuries. This reversal is reflected both in the workplace and at home. Half-naked men appear on buses, magazine covers etc. Boys make themselves pretty while girls run around free. The women lounge in front of the TV with the remote while men tie on aprons and get busy in the kitchen. A scene that stands out for me is a funeral where the priest is a woman and she prays “in the name of the Mother, Daughter and the Holy Ghost” to which the people replies, “a-women”. Did these scenes look awkward? Yes and funny too.

/> The flaw of this movie in my opinion is the lack of creativity in the reversed roles. I find it sort of irritating that the women dress and act like men which feels unnatural. Their performance shows the vulgarity and chauvinism within our society yet it's unsettling to watch women embody these traits. Societies where women rule do not adopt the same behaviour, custom, and fashion as men. I wish the women in this movie had embraced their femininity in this alternate reality instead of acting like men.

/> Still, I like that the core message behind this movie is for society to recognise how patriarchy hurts women. Sacha Baron Cohen plays his role convincingly as a chauvinist and also a changed man. Rosamund Pike as always embodies her role beautifully. She's a timid, hardworking mother yet becomes bold and ambitious as Atlas’ top executive. Fiona Shaw and Kathryn Hunter are also remarkable and funny in their roles. Rating this movie, I'd give it 7.5 stars out of 10 for the excellent acting. The flaw I pointed out undermines this movie and I wonder whether it would make any difference in our society. Still, it's a good effort by the creators to lend voice to the shifting dynamics in the world's gender politics. https://youtu.be/yeetI2DfbaE?si=rjmibi0n5GgBdAwb

/>  
*All images above are screenshots from the movie*

[*Poster image source*](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Las_damas_primero-888669592-large.jpg)

*Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

title.title: 特别简单平淡的🎂生日宴
title.body:
这天是个比较特别的日子，世界电信日…更是我家熊孩纸过生日🎂！

可是过得格外朴素平淡！他既不要生日蛋糕的仪式感，也没要特别的生日礼物🎁 就说只想吃一顿好的！哈哈哈哈这孩子倒是很随我的性格，无所谓那么多讲究！开心随意便知足了！

 

上个礼拜他还跟我说他童鞋过生日特别隆重，还定制了生日横幅以及安排酒店卡拉OK… 过得可狂欢啦！🎉 

然而轮到他自己生日，他居然这么的坦然又通透！

他说没必要跟风请客，也不喜欢去攀比，别人的隆重很好，但我只想简简单单在家吃一顿合心意的家常饭！安心自在的休息一天，就足够圆满啦！实际上也是因为咱们家条件不好🤦🏻‍♀️

 

听到这番话，作为老母亲的我，真的格外欣慰啊！熊孩纸看起来大大咧咧很随性！有时候可爱的一面呵呵～跟我吵的时候我也被他气半死，不过一会儿咱俩就没事了！真的是太像我了！

​

他心里知道那些仪式感固然重要，但不是一定非得要，咱们从不眼红别人的光鲜，也不刻意追赶潮流排场，日子过得舒心自在，知足常乐就好！

​

![MEITU\_20260527\_165756311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annepink/AKxnE74ms8sWyLuRBeqzhapCYCU2J21CD4eFirAXRfk4aEitKcb2yp9nzD1N8td.jpg)

​

![MTXX\_20260517\_182504562.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annepink/AKWvivD6S1QRNfd1E9yvGURgV7eFgbBjpXYSS8QqFHuWJWhrnhXrD4DLnKFS8o1.jpg)

​

![MTXX\_20260517\_182155480.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annepink/AKRBQzaLAEamvCtoN5i7QdmTW7Y2NJYFsfhi8n11eX5mcujE8HdubDZ4gHdJgCL.jpg)

​

![MTXX\_20260517\_182135689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annepink/AKqb6eH8fiXdjNia6DFf8ZqKzBLy7x8kKkWa9TrjVycT9YNLj2Ri9ydFjLVU7Xx.jpg)

​

![MEITU\_20260511\_161159949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annepink/AKGcebzLsRweEXkb6eA8v51CxrhBfqxXFNoP9XUxjKThbWxf9WepzA87JK6HyFA.jpg)

​

原本我是有想着生日总得有生日蛋糕才算完整！

问过他要不要订一个生日蛋糕！

没想到他一口回绝，说并不想吃蛋糕！

其实咱们都喜欢奶油蛋糕的🧁香甜软软的滋味😋 但都不是很贪恋生日形式的那种热闹场景… 

他说不买蛋糕也好，随意一点，简单一点也未尝不可！哪天咱们想吃蛋糕了还是随时可以有哈～

 

仪式不必刻意，偏爱一定要兑现！熊孩纸心心念念想吃我弄的红烧猪脚，那必须立刻安排上呀！😂

​

他念叨好久没吃到我做的猪脚了！就独独馋这一口家里的味道！

我原本还备好了鲜活鲈鱼、网购的臭鳜鱼… 想着多做几道菜丰盛一些，可他满心满眼就惦记着红烧猪脚哈哈哈～

 

红烧猪脚，我也是很久没搞了，我的厨艺不精但也不赖哈！我儿喜欢就好！这么多年我把他养活的还算壮实，不是吃荤多，而是跟我一样吃蔬菜贼香哈哈！😎

​

还有一盘清爽下饭的西芹炒肉，也是很久没弄芹菜了！很普通的小炒菜一样是咱们平日餐桌上的欢喜～还有一个是我妈家拿来的鲜嫩空心菜！简简单单三个菜，就是咱们这次的生日家宴了～🤭

 

我弄的猪脚卖相还可以哈！皮黏筋软，吸饱了浓郁的酱汁，咬一口胶质满满，真的是久久吃一次香而不腻！我儿吃得可心满意足了！

​

他大口吃肉直呼好过瘾！整整一大碗猪脚，大半都进了他的肚子…🤣🤣🤣 

其实，这次买的猪脚骨头偏多，没有啥肉！

他说吃了半天怎么一点肉都没吃到的感觉，哈哈哈我说可能是后腿猪蹄吧！

卖肉的称的，我也不知道啊！

我又被卖肉的忽悠了！🤦🏻‍♀️ 但好在咱们就喜欢啃骨头😂

​

当然，我们最爱的还是猪蹄上那层满满的胶原蛋白…… 那叫一个香辣过瘾！😋😋😋

 

咱们慢悠悠地吃好… 随口闲聊的话题不断，吃到肚子圆滚滚哈哈哈哈～ 主打一个生日干饭快乐！🥳

就这样平淡的一天过生日… 没有繁花似锦，只是简单的，糊涂的快乐就好！哦对了，他也不要我包🧧给他，还好每年都有我妈给他的生日大红包在我这！这份祝福都令我们感动❤️

祝福我的男孩，十七岁生日快乐！🎂不求你光芒万丈，只愿你赤诚坦荡，自在随心，平安喜乐，岁岁无忧！🌈🌈🌈🍀🍀🍀

当然可以！Cove 是一个充满哲思与情感的概念，象征着避风港与安全感。在这个瞬息万变的世界里，找到一个能够放松心灵的“角落”显得尤为重要。无论是自然的宁静还是心灵的寄托，Cove 都提醒我们珍惜那些温暖的瞬间和与自我的连接。每个人都需要一个属于自己的空间，去倾听内心的声音，让自己重新焕发活力。

title.title: 10 Kilo in 100 Tagen
title.body:
Ich wollte bis zum Sommerurlaub einiges an Gewicht verlieren. Das Ziel ist noch nicht erreicht, aber der Urlaub ist ja auch noch ne Weile hin.

Da ich beim Essen sehr undiszipliniert bin, brauchte ich irgendwie eine Unterstützung. In der Firma gab’s da vor ein paar Monaten eine Diskussion über Körperfettwerte und Kalorien tracken. Und da kam halt auch diese App zur Sprache


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcGv9j1PeKgo5BasuE8jXoC7KtGSAGZ4RyJ2qx78f31t/img_5088.png)

Die kann dein Essen einfach tracken, an dem du ein Foto von dem Gericht machst oder den Barcode einscannst. Und schon wird dir angezeigt, wie viel Kalorien du zu dir genommen hast.

Das Schöne an der ganzen Geschichte und dem, was mir die Kollegen auch erklärt haben, ist, dass im Endeeffekt nur die Kalorien, die du zu dir genommen hast und die du verbraucht hast, zählen, natürlich sicherlich auch so ein bisschen in den einzelnen Bereichen ob das Fett Eiweiß oder Proteine sind. Aber am Endeeffekt ist doch egal ist wann du isst und was du isst, Hauptsache du bleibst unter den gesetzten Kalorien

Mit der ki Funktion habe ich mein Zielgewicht und das Ziel Datum eingegeben und so habe ich ein Anhaltspunkt bekommen, wie viel Kalorien ich pro Tag zu mir nehmen darf.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmakgh5y7JAvtebqCoQZ5FRxoB9KqvHpitTtLSYVrn2Vwy/img_5087.jpg)

Das mache ich nun seit 100 Tagen genau und habe auch zehn Kilo abgenommen. Natürlich habe ich mein Essen ein wenig umgestellt aber halt nicht so radikal wie bei einer Diät und dadurch dass du halt wirklich genau siehst was du noch essen kannst mit der Motivation abzunehmen hat das perfekt für mich funktioniert.

Drei Kilo sollte ich noch in den nächsten 30 Tagen schaffen. 

Das finde ich, ist auch mal eine schöne Anwendung von KI.
￼￼

body.title: Pollo al horno/ Roasted chicken
body.body:
![Presentación Diapositivas Negocio Catering Comida Ilustrativo Verde y Beige_20260526_102437_0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23xypUWwrGg4pJqCDRkaKcMxGCDZCjZ9REMRodatr2qvoaM8sZG3C2Q6Jv38r8LeVA666.jpg)

<div class=\

> Hola amigos de esta bella comunidad: Hive Food. Les deseo tengan un bello día y que Dios los bendiga. Hoy les quiero contar cómo preparo el pollo al horno, aprendí a cocinarlo así por mi papá. Queda muy sabroso y vale la pena intentarlo.

> > *Hello, friends of this lovely community: Hive Food. I hope you’re having a good day and may God bless you. Today I’d like to tell you how I make roast chicken; I learnt to cook it this way from my father. It’s really tasty and well worth a try.*
![1779803079837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wqvwmKKBHQ2FajFSGfR18eunRnvJTuouMwtfvXdm3wJREmVKeU46PyuQKEz6eRfPa9t.jpg)

> # Ingredientes: ## Para adobar el pollo: 10 muslos de pollo 10 dientes de ajo 2 cucharadas de vino seco 1 cucharada de vinagre 2 hojas de orégano 1 cucharada de ketchup 1 cucharada de mostaza 1 cucharada de aceite Sal al gusto ## Para el mojito: 1 cucharada de vino seco 8 dientes de ajo 6 cebollas pequeñas 6 hojas de albahaca 2 hojas de orégano 1 cucharada de aceite Sal al gusto

> # Ingredients: ## To marinate the chicken: > *10 chicken thighs 10 cloves of garlic 2 tablespoons of dry wine 1 tablespoon of vinegar 2 sprigs of oregano 1 tablespoon of ketchup 1 tablespoon of mustard 1 tablespoon of oil Salt to taste* ## For the mojito: > *1 tablespoon of dry wine 8 cloves of garlic 6 small onions 6 basil leaves 2 sprigs of oregano 1 tablespoon of oil Salt to taste*
![1779803466965.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wMWcbdRjh5nsuNbNrRLx8C29Li6SppLJNs7C1nTLVmkFAozBYai9MQLA4fpEbLAB63J.jpg)
> # Paso a paso ## Paso 1 Comencé quemando las plumas que le quedaban al pollo.

> # Step by step ## Step 1 > *I started by singeing off any remaining feathers from the chicken.*
![1779803342821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EpA5Px88jmJbLcGDRbFwQzvxyvo3aJxkjXupoa2trjN4EZx2vAaRMZpPJFymQwT5WV8.jpg)
> ## Paso 2 Hice unos cortes a los muslos de pollo para que les entre bien el adobo y tengan mejor sabor. Incorporé a las piezas de pollo todos los ingredientes del adobo que les mencioné arriba

> ## Step 2 > *I made a few cuts in the chicken thighs so that the marinade would penetrate properly and they would taste better. I added all the marinade ingredients I mentioned above to the chicken pieces.*
![1779803221235.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wCDwM3M3ibXcLLw3U5M2PUSmPiaoPVPBiwXUvFCzcTrRed1jqBcasQ4ZVPc4HSgZKco.png)
> ## Paso 3 En este momento tuve que masajear bien el pollo para que se incorporen bien todos los sabores.

> ## Step 3 > *At this point, I had to massage the chicken thoroughly so that all the flavours would be well incorporated.*
![1779803127208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EoeGNaToE1zifPdsTV5voCaK2qCsPK8U1YsrucR42PCgYyyFSV4N5ycHni1pwRNCSNQ.jpg)
> ## Paso 4 Dejar reposar al menos 30 minutos. Mientras más reposo le demos mejor será el sabor y más intenso pero yo estaba apurada porque ya se me había hecho un poco tarde para la cena.

> ## Step 4 > *Leave to rest for at least 30 minutes. The longer you leave it to rest, the better and more intense the flavour will be, but I was in a hurry because I was already running a bit late for dinner.*
![1779802469528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23x1551U2vdtAYBV1EiR7pfgQZL3DnGUigRrs2w3AbRaMdkAQFfX7ze6FFjLS4p5adRGo.jpg)

> ## Paso 5 Durante este tiempo fui preparando el mojito que le voy a echar al pollo en dos momentos, al principio y luego en medio de la cocción. Para hacerlo corté finamente las cebollas, el orégano, la albahaca. Machaqué y corté fino el ajo. Y mezclé todo con el aceite y el vino seco. Condimenté con sal a mi gusto.

> ## Step 5 > *Meanwhile, I prepared the mojito mixture that I’m going to add to the chicken in two stages: at the start and halfway through cooking. To make it, I finely chopped the onions, oregano and basil. I crushed and finely chopped the garlic. Then I mixed everything together with the oil and dry white wine. I seasoned it with salt to taste.*
![1779802399265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23yTb7DRW5PEKQBsFrJ25cjAgEyEuMpsP3pvSf2yvN5XAogNAb37asKyoqqe1aGN3p22n.jpg)
> ## Paso 6 Engrasar la bandeja de horno y precalentar el horno. Mientras tanto fui sellando cada muslo de pollo en un sartén con aceite.

> ## Step 6 > *Grease the baking tray and preheat the oven. Meanwhile, I seared each chicken thigh in a frying pan with oil.*
![1779802298776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wCC9dYw1h4myBtWNR1vZrpGDonvGoUAX5maFghBe9CQShamw16eZJ8Sq8kReZ5149bS.jpg)

> ## Paso 7 Fui colocando cada muslo de pollo en la bandeja. Y le agregué la mitad del mojito que preparé anteriormente. Para aumentarlo lo mezclé con el adobo del pollo que me había quedado en el fondo del recipiente donde tenía los muslos de pollo.

> ## Step 7 > *I placed each chicken thigh on the tray. I added half of the mojito I had prepared earlier. To make more, I mixed it with the chicken marinade that had remained at the bottom of the bowl where I’d had the chicken thighs.*
![1779802195979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23vsQY4iBiWwtPHrnp51UvTko7QDALFL1iW4k58xYfVmkk6Xss7T5sQNSMJCgNCyRFaCg.jpg)

> ## Paso 8 Hornear los muslos de pollo con la llama media baja durante 30 minutos. Transcurrido ese tiempo, saqué el pollo, le dí la vuelta a cada muslo y les agregué el resto del mojito. Los volví a meter en el horno hasta completar 1 hora en total de cocción. Lo serví con arroz blanco y a mi familia me encantó. A mi papá le alegró mucho ver que sigo sus consejos para la cocina aunque todavía no cocino tan bien como él. ¿Y ustedes, cómo preparan el pollo al horno? Espero que les haya gustado la receta. ¡Hasta pronto!

> ## Step 8 > *Bake the chicken thighs at a medium-low heat for 30 minutes. After that time, I took the chicken out, turned each thigh over and added the rest of the mojito. I put them back in the oven until they had cooked for a total of 1 hour.* > *I served it with white rice and my family loved it. My dad was really pleased to see that I’m following his cooking advice, even though I don’t cook quite as well as he does yet. How about you – how do you make roast chicken? I hope you liked the recipe. See you soon!*
![1779802974538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23yJXegmhrRmC6LLaeBjp7GWRWPawUtvtnT6MdZd2NoCEeq8qEjibKn165umoGduocUnG.jpg) ![1727200831373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23xpK5kpZ75tEsz4233k9kmVifKKpMkFC3xzzHxhDNCZLaaWbSm2ctz27wonuzWvWULae.jpg)

body.title: CELEBRATING CHILDREN AND THE WOMEN BEHIND THE JOY
body.body: > Today is the 27th of May, a day that has always held a special place in my heart growing up because, over here in Nigeria, it is a day set aside to celebrate children, the Children’s Day. As a child, this was one of my favorite days of the year. The excitement, the joy, the celebrations, the little treats, the feeling of being seen and celebrated simply for being a child, it was always beautiful. And now that I am older, I find myself looking at this day from a completely different perspective. Personally, I cannot talk about Children’s Day without giving a huge shout-out to every woman out there. Only a few men may fully understand this perspective, but there is a unique kind of joy that comes with celebrating these beautiful little bundles of joy... and headaches 😅💛. Naturally, many people desire to have children, but in many homes, especially in the typical Nigerian setting, women are often the ones left to handle the bulk of the child-rearing responsibilities while the man is seen primarily as the provider. Now, I am not saying that providing financially is wrong. Not at all. Every role matters. But on a day like this, I can’t help but think about the unseen sacrifices behind the celebration. The sleepless nights. The endless worrying. The emotional labor. The patience required during tantrums. The constant care, attention, and sacrifice that often go unnoticed. Yes, in many homes, the man may provide most of the money, but it is often the woman who ensures that those resources are properly used which includes making sure the children are fed, clothed, cared for, comforted, and nurtured. She remembers school schedules. She notices when a child is unusually quiet. She stays awake through feverish nights. She becomes doctor, teacher, chef, counselor, referee, and comforter, sometimes all in one day. ![natasha-hall-9rBmRhysF9Y-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugenia7499/242DWkwpxqj7msPA8ghULBn8rQauBYxiCDX8kNsRNUheJGHKTZQQ1kSdpb9He9wyuJfVR.jpg) **[SOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-black-dress-sitting-on-chair-9rBmRhysF9Y)** And somehow, she still shows up the next morning and does it all over again. That kind of strength deserves recognition. So yes, today we celebrate children in Nigeria, and rightly so because children are blessings, joy, hope, and the future. But this year, I also choose to celebrate the women who make that joy possible every single day. The mothers, guardians, caregivers, and every woman carrying the invisible weight of nurturing children with love and resilience. To every child in Nigeria and around the world, may your laughter never fade, may your dreams remain bright, and may you always be protected and loved. 💛 And to every mother out there, whether biological, adoptive, guardian, or simply a woman showing up with love. Today, I celebrate you too. Because behind every happy child is someone who sacrificed comfort, sleep, time, and energy to make that happiness possible. HAPPY CHILDREN’S DAY TO EVERY CHILD IN NIGERIA!💛 HAPPY CHILDREN’S DAY TO EVERY CHILD AROUND THE WORLD! 🌍✨ AND HAPPY TROPHY DAY TO EVERY AMAZING WOMAN OUT THERE, TODAY WAS ONLY POSSIBLE BECAUSE OF YOUR TIRELESS EFFORTS. 🏆💐💛

body.title: Mi Opinión de Ao no Hako/My opinion of Ao no Hako [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @TheAnimeRealm, saludos a todos, vengo en esta ocasión para hablarles sobre un anime que me pareció lindo en cuanto amor de jóvenes, así como también el entender que si no eres capaces de expresar tus sentimientos es muy difícil que la otra persona entienda lo que quieres, sobre todo si te gusta, si dejas todo para después no podrás avanzar con ello y podrías perder la oportunidad de estar a su lado. --- ![MV5BNTA3MjVhZmItMWNlZC00N2NmLWIyYmQtMjdhMjFjN2EwYjFkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMgpxoSALZgktXGASdA3rNb3QgrXkaAG6HHCDCKToyBZe1VeD2vuN13tXk5FuVoCwsn.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm2554552321/) ---

> Se trata de Ao no Hako, es la historia de Taiki un joven estudiante, jugador en progreso del equipo de bádmiton varonil, enfocado en siempre mejorar y ganar las nacionales, sin embargo, no todo es puro el deporte, está enamorado de Chinatsu una estudiante un año mayor que él, enfocada en su equipo de baloncesto femenino, que a simple vista no se ve interesada en el amor, solo en graduarse y llegar a las nacionales con su equipo, por lo que a Taiki no se le hará sencillo llegar a ella, pese a que por cosas del destino terminan viviendo una temporada en la misma casa. --- ![MV5BYTNhNmQ0ZjgtY2M4ZS00NTlhLTg1MDQtNDA2MzhkOTMyMzdmXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ynUtuudgHhqNCUxigZwwZ68745KQZzBTnLriq477VCh49LBcCKTBrqNiEtWubnMYp4x.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm1304589313/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

> Ciertamente para Taiki esta sería una gran oportunidad para acercarse a Chinatsu, pero no todo será tan sencillo porque la personalidad de este jovencito es un poco digamos algo inocente en ese punto, le cuesta hablarle y relacionarse con ella, pero su admiración y amor que siente lo hace cada día intentar y tener la oportunidad de saber poco a poco más de sus gustos y personalidad, pero no todo será tan simple porque su mejor amiga Hina, quien siente algo por él, hará que el camino de Taiki se vuelva algo confuso y complicado para poder decidir si seguir con sus sentimientos de siempre o ver de otros ojos a su amiga. --- ![MV5BMTRiYzMzN2YtZDFjNC00OTg1LTk0ZTQtOTlhZjYxZTAwNWYzXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23y8uo1GpyJPVZfVNNbEo6misRyfBELNue3Y9Pi3EfaTETiEUwGHWrrM3Td9sFtyUNQFN.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm1443591937/) ---

> Es una historia dulce, muy enfocada a ese primer amor, a entender con exactitud los sentimientos, lo que quieres decir y lo que sientes se pueda expresar de manera correcta, así como la manera en el que te desenvuelves con todos, y como pese a querer algo más con esa persona no implicaría que dejes tus sueños atrás, como en el caso de Taiki le gusta el badmitón, pero apoya a Chinatsu con el baloncesto, él tiene como objetivo ganar con los mejores pero no se detiene a que pueda comenzar una relación amorosa con aquella que siempre ha visto con otros ojos. --- ![MV5BYWZlNjAyODUtYzVjNS00NGI1LThkNGQtOGMyMjI0YzU4ZGU3XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xL9TQzo9wqQQ3MmWqzQDQy9KJPYunFZb1EjiDNfaNAv6mTwwP23iaqiRALyz8u5vEUm.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm3248907009/) ---

> Cuenta con una animación hermosa, la paleta de colores es delicada, con colores pasteles que te endulzan, cuenta con su primera temporada de 25 capítulos, a la final Taiki deberá decir si seguir con el amor y admiración que siempre ha tenido por Chinatsu, o darle la oportunidad a su amiga que siempre ha estado con él y lo ha apoyado todo el tiempo, ¿Con quién creen que se quede? ---

allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

**Mangaka Koji Miura, género comedia romántica, deportes (baloncestos y bádmiton), escolar, spokon. Estudio de animación Telecom Animation Film.**

<div class=\

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)

> Hello dear friends of @TheAnimeRealm, greetings to all, I come on this occasion to tell you about an anime that I found cute in terms of young love, as well as understanding that if you are not able to express your feelings is very difficult for the other person to understand what you want, especially if you like, if you leave everything for later you can not move forward with it and you could lose the opportunity to be by his side. --- ![MV5BNTA3MjVhZmItMWNlZC00N2NmLWIyYmQtMjdhMjFjN2EwYjFkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMgpxoSALZgktXGASdA3rNb3QgrXkaAG6HHCDCKToyBZe1VeD2vuN13tXk5FuVoCwsn.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm2554552321/) ---

> Ao no Hako is the story of Taiki, a young student, a player in progress of the men's badminton team, focused on always improving and winning the nationals, however, not everything is pure sport, he is in love with Chinatsu, a student a year older than him, He is in love with Chinatsu, a student a year older than him, focused on his women's basketball team, who at first glance is not interested in love, only in graduating and reaching the nationals with his team, so it will not be easy for Taiki to reach her, although by fate they end up living in the same house for a season. --- ![MV5BYTNhNmQ0ZjgtY2M4ZS00NTlhLTg1MDQtNDA2MzhkOTMyMzdmXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ynUtuudgHhqNCUxigZwwZ68745KQZzBTnLriq477VCh49LBcCKTBrqNiEtWubnMYp4x.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm1304589313/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

> Certainly for Taiki this would be a great opportunity to get closer to Chinatsu, but not everything will be so simple because the personality of this young man is a little bit let's say something innocent at that point, he finds it hard to talk to her and relate to her, But not everything will be so simple because his best friend Hina, who has feelings for him, will make Taiki's path become somewhat confusing and complicated to decide whether to continue with his usual feelings or to see his friend from other eyes. --- ![MV5BMTRiYzMzN2YtZDFjNC00OTg1LTk0ZTQtOTlhZjYxZTAwNWYzXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23y8uo1GpyJPVZfVNNbEo6misRyfBELNue3Y9Pi3EfaTETiEUwGHWrrM3Td9sFtyUNQFN.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm1443591937/) ---

> It is a sweet story, very focused on that first love, to understand exactly the feelings, what you want to say and what you feel can be expressed in the right way, as well as the way you get along with everyone, and how despite wanting something more with that person would not imply that you leave your dreams behind, as in the case of Taiki likes badminton, but supports Chinatsu with basketball, he aims to win with the best but does not stop to start a romantic relationship with the one who has always seen with different eyes. --- ![MV5BYWZlNjAyODUtYzVjNS00NGI1LThkNGQtOGMyMjI0YzU4ZGU3XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xL9TQzo9wqQQ3MmWqzQDQy9KJPYunFZb1EjiDNfaNAv6mTwwP23iaqiRALyz8u5vEUm.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32639706/mediaviewer/rm3248907009/) ---

> It has a beautiful animation, the color palette is delicate, with pastel colors that sweeten you, has its first season of 25 chapters, at the end Taiki must say whether to continue with the love and admiration he has always had for Chinatsu, or give the opportunity to his friend who has always been with him and has supported him all the time, who do you think he will stay with? ---

body.title: You know it's the right decision when it feels like this
body.body:
So for the past ten months or so, I've been working with this studio which meant semi-regular classes, which in turn allowed me to connect with some semi-regular attendees and more importantly, with people who were on the same wave-length and vibe. Something I was and am tremendously grateful for.

But something that also made me linger in place far longer than was healthy for me, and also made me tolerate behavior that wasn't really professional or appropriate.

Like many at the beginning, like many kind and generally well-meaning, like many wandering the world a little lost, I held on to the illusion of security that this place represented for me.

*\

* It took a lot of repeating and mounting disappointments and disillusionment for me to say, finally, no it's really not. And certainly not enough to continue in this relationship. #### Just because you want it to work doesn't mean it's working. Though I held on to that a lot. I guilt-tripped myself over being away too much, over not being flaky. If only I try more. Except as in many things in life, it doesn't really matter how much you try (which isn't to say you should just stop trying). Some things just aren't meant to work for you. But I wanted it. I poured myself into it. I customized the flow even for the one person in the class who was non-paying anyway. I hustled. I showed up. I brought treats. I'm not resentful. I genuinely loved doing it and still do. Guess I'm trying to show (myself) here I tried. But when, even after almost a year of actually trying, nothing improved, well, there comes a time when you gotta call a spade a spade.

>


#### Putting up with shit tells people exactly what you're willing to tolerate.

Something that took a looot of learning in my private life. Apparently didn't transfer over in the professional part. Oh well. Guess I had to learn that lesson again. Down the months, there were many weird, inappropriate, outright creepy moments working for this studio (not to mention the crass lack of professionalism on their part that was there from day one).

At first, I chose to work there because they didn't ask for money (a lot of studios do, and it's up to you to make it back, then make something on top to actually live with). But cheap is as cheap does, and this place reminded me time and again that I was choosing something inferior. It took a long time, especially as I'm not in a place to pay for studio space at the moment, but it did finally lead me to the conclusion, 

**Fuck it, I'd rather pay, and not have the hassle.**

#### The comfort of the known has you in a chokehold, even if you don't realize it.

I'm someone who quite enjoys adventure and the unknown. I have in me something of a gipsy, wandering (and wondering, for sure) soul. But that didn't stop me from anchoring here temporarily and letting the comfort of familiarity scare me off the great unknown.

I was running in circles with the idea \

. Ultimately, the real question turned out to be -- can I be content with this little? With this crumb of what it could be that's draining energy and time? It's not always easy letting go and making space in your life, but if you never do, where will new, better things settle, eh? In the end, after a very long time of debating and putting it off, I bit the bullet yesterday and texted the studio owner that Friday would be my last lesson at their place. And boy, was it a relief. Is this what people with jobs feel when they stick it to an annoying boss? Gotta say, I got the charm. It felt so good, so freeing, even if I don't know how it will continue. If I'll lose the few people who are regulars. If I'll drift for a while, not knowing where to settle. It felt right, and this morning, all the people who have become regulars congratulated me and wished me luck in this new phase. I know it's pretty standard and all... ...I just don't know how I allowed myself to forget the excitement and potential of, the reason to congratulate yourself for new beginnings.

body.title: Expect the Unexpected
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20260328_134619728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23ywip8CfjjpS1V76kZ4xTkdX4CVfhZfTEphfBup5xJJBqF2LQkJctCebxVPtn8wNj274.jpg)</center>

-----------------------


If you ask someone who has known me for a while to describe me, \

is probably a word they would not use.  Unfortunately, the gene for doing things on the spur of the moment seems to have flown right by me.  Instead, I am the kind of person who likes to plan things out.  Even when I try to do things with little to no planning, I always seem to end up planning something.

I think I get it from my mom, but it's honestly hard to say.  I'd like to think I just have an analytical mind like that, but if that were the case, I would think I'd be a lot more successful in general than I am.  Perhaps my ADHD works against my analytical side to make me just your average sort of guy.  After almost half a century on this planet, I will likely never know.


<center>![PXL_20260524_141602145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vsKyqmy33o73T4kxetDjYpd27NkhLP3Qn4x41gSAwWze8gtmz78fxsJwRfBJnN4DvP3.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

As I mentioned before, @mrsbozz and I went on a camping trip this past weekend. It was our first one of the year and while it didn't go exactly as we had planned, it was still a good time.  I believe I pointed out the fact that the weather wasn't exactly the greatest, but that gave us lots of time to read, relax, and talk.  In fact, there was a point where my wife almost didn't know what to do with herself.  It always takes her a little bit to settle back into the summer mode with fewer responsibilities when school gets out.  We aren't quite there yet, but we are close, and she is still adjusting a bit.


<center>![PXL_20260523_164459735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wCC9F9DWq197JwoGBt3tHxmMwXk8ve5d3vhXdMWEdV93xpwtxNTB6YQgE9D6W8gu22i.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

Through the course of our camping trip, we started talking about money.  It's not that we don't talk about money other times, but for the most part @mrsbozz trusts that I have the finances under control.  She actually prefers it that way.  Her aunts think she is crazy for giving all that \

to me, but honestly, I'd happily make it a joint thing if she wanted it that way.  It's not like I am doing shady stuff behind her back or anything.  

The money talk also got us talking about our house and some of the major things that we need to get taken care of with it.  It's been a long time coming, but we really need new windows, a new roof, and a few other things in the house.  I've been putting it off because we have also talked about moving, and I don't see the point of putting a bunch of money into a house we won't be in five years down the road.

Unfortunately, the real estate market is kind of crap right now.  If we move again, it will likely be our last time in a long time, so we are kind of being picky about the \

of a new home.  


<center>![PXL_20260522_204804027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wgFUEvHUBDjU47Wpd7YyvKV6kzQdJXFWDQjsKm44ZqE9BVDCXVuaa69xVZyso1D7Ziy.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

Which got us talking about finally doing the upgrades we have been putting off.  It's stressful for me on a couple of levels.  First off, it's a lot of money and I don't like spending a lot of money.  I tend to get a bit of anxiety when I have to make big decisions like that and spend a lot of money.  I've been working on getting a emergency fund built up for us, and I know this could put that in jeopardy.  

I also know that if we do some of these upgrades, it's likely going to mean I need to take out a loan.  I hate taking out loans.  I have never like the feeling that I owe someone something.  It's a necessary evil though, unless HIVE goes to $5 or something tomorrow, there is no other way the money is going to just show up.

<center>![PXL_20260524_185719208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vsEEMGZU9kPgCNj4pV2F9MBUb1Hs9grWs8WcshXG6oMdFbB2VfAdU9rkgpJxfQnPaug.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

I know it has to be done though.  When we moved in ten years ago or so, the home inspector pointed out the fact that we need a new roof.  When the Winter wind shifts to the East and comes off the Saginaw Bay, you can actually see the blinds move on the inside of the house.  That's how bad our windows are.

In addition to that, my wife also wants new flooring in the house, which honestly seems like it wouldn't be that difficult.  Wishful thinking.  As I was getting out of the shower this morning I was looking at the floor in the bathroom and realized that new flooring throughout the house would basically require a full bathroom remodel as well.  We could maybe skip that room and leave the flooring as is for now, but I don't think she would be a fan of that.

It's funny how what seem to be simple renovation projects like that can turn into much more than you bargained for.  I'm sure @fullcoverbetting can attest to that.  Even our simple window job could balloon into something crazy if they start pulling the old windows and find \

.  It stresses me out just thinking about it.

I'm not really sure where I am going with this post.  Just looking for some encouragement I guess.  I have a feeling there might be some stressful times ahead for me...

body.title: The daily life of a fruit seller to earn a living.
body.body:
>I hope everyone is doing well. Today I will take you to an interesting place in Rangpur city. Especially in front of the supermarket, there are some fruit shops. They sell fruits here every day. There are different types of fruits here including oranges, apples, grapes, mangoes, bananas. We know that fruits are very important in improving the health of the human body.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDxbeTBwAZRzAsXJ4KBBWucYf8RKNLpHXqqtEtWATDvw/1777643986825.jpg)

Here you see a fruit seller on a bicycle. He usually buys fruit from a big market and keeps it at home. And from there he comes to the market on a bicycle and sells the fruit. I have seen that there are small markets in small places in the villages. Usually, when people sell fruit in these markets, most of the people try to take the change. That is why he uses this strategy and comes to the market and sells the fruit in cash. I think cash is much better than the change. Because there is no account of debts. He usually sells grapes, apples, oranges, malta and guava.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8P1625EMhMYSjTmcym61ezupRX5ya3eWvA6rdN5AYdC/1777643986745.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQdHfCALLdq7Fb68vTeJtdVB1esfGmMTVP6sEmFGFtGv/1777643986793.jpg)

Here you can usually see different fruits. These fruits are usually considered worthy of sale in this place in Bangladesh by the sellers. There is a lot of crowd and people coming and going here. So they have chosen this place as a worthy place to sell fruits. They earn a living by selling these fruits on the side of the road. According to our Bangladeshi prices, apples are usually 300 taka per kg. Oranges are available between 350 and 320 taka. The greenest apples cost more than 400 taka per kg. Ata fruits cost 350 taka per kg. Grapes cost 280 taka per kg. Shopkeepers sell these special prices at a much higher price. However, on the occasion of 2026, this right has been reached.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSo1gn4icsxjmg9vi7uowYAVdr2KPQa5EfYa4tsazHH2k/1777643986868.jpg)

Ata fruits are usually sold at a higher price here. However, they sell these fruits for a profit of 20 to 50 taka per kg.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcBa22Yu1DzPpXspdmUH39ymrQXqzP64CPbqBvgt2yuB8/1777643986900.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrC4pDsVZfHor8C16uEWD4JYhp7XgAX7KBi9JPU8F8Po/1777644014197.jpg)

Here, apples, oranges, along with guava, are among the freshest and most delicious fruits. So let's help our families eat fruits. And keep ourselves busy in protecting the health of our families by buying different types of fruits.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbaBXcSCWsrhs1bFJZrK8FbS74RJMJtjdN3dSG88C9M82/1777644014244.jpg)

However, do not hesitate to buy the best and freshest fruits in the market. It is better to buy fresh fruits at a higher price than to save a little money. Many fruits are soft, which will have harmful effects on the body. Surely you recognize fresh fruits when you see them. Check the color of the fruit and whether the fruit is soft or not, you will understand whether it is actually a long-lasting fruit or a good fruit. I am always grateful for giving your valuable time here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7K3y1Fr1VvemUKHHNqhYqGjwwfgk7jF4dcesFMxfqqX/1777644014283.jpg)

 Wow, here is the tamarind, which makes everyone's mouth water. But it is one of the most tempting fruits.

![18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdakash62/EoAUXZjGAPyY3oMMK4f3oHgNhH1gR25mTMmu7pBuiWx6a2eAfCbUiUbmkLz3qgzSuJv.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYH7g5td7TFYfVNmCcnCQArAAiER1da6iZk4LRfG46Tiu/1762630356965.gif)

<center>[Twitter](https://twitter.com/Mdmrakash262?t=RQKbgDAGm72Ta-N2_rPaeA&s=09) [Discord](https://discord.gg/t6CY6qs8)</center>
‎

body.title: Cloudy Twilight in My Hometown
body.body:
Hello hive👋
Nice to meet you all.
My name is Djisamsoe. I'm new to the hive platform and very excited to finally join this community full of creativity, ideas, and a spirit of sharing.

****
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3VMSjk1VCmm6suHyQb3u7gcBAU6wuNhrJGeLvdknwA3/1779880005748.jpg)

Today, the village sky looked completely different. Dark clouds slowly filled the afternoon sky, as if signaling that rain would soon fall. Despite the overcast weather, the village atmosphere remained beautiful and serene. The vast expanse of rice fields, green trees, and the evening breeze created a truly soothing sight.

****
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUgCH6KwvAQ3SREigfjNdbeLSRKZnFPuf2pRGzLbsKX2t/1779880063677.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVp3mezb9JbE9bhx9D9u8i4sLzEeSFt9s9zNu9ZTm4FyT/1779880063812.jpg)

In front of the house, a large yellow truck was parked on the side of the road. The lingering afternoon sunlight reflected off the truck, making it stand out against the darkening sky. This simple sight is common in villages, but if you look at it calmly, it holds a unique beauty.

I really enjoyed the afternoon atmosphere. The air felt cooler than usual. The coconut trees and greenery surrounding the house seemed to move gently in the breeze. From a distance, the sounds of vehicles and the sounds of nature blended into a peaceful atmosphere.

****
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWdfUd5u31a93pMfGa85EYmouGV2QWjteqZrCa2xhYkk/1779880137758.jpg)

Sometimes we don't have to travel far to enjoy the beauty of nature. Even from our own backyard, we can still see extraordinary views. A cloudy sky, which initially seems ordinary, can actually create a calming atmosphere and help the mind feel more relaxed.

****
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUXFit1GiVbYq4SQ9GSDfa6f9x5fx1jDaQE5DJpFTjWSu/1779880200650.jpg)

I took this last photo while relaxing on my porch, enjoying the afternoon atmosphere. Even though the day was overcast, I was grateful to still be able to enjoy the tranquility of the village and the fresh air that's so rare in the city.
Thank you for stopping by to read my simple photo essay today. I hope you too can enjoy the small beauties found around your homes.

body.title: A time to share some birds.
body.body:
First up is this Cape Robin-chat (Cossypha natalensis), as he landed in the bright sunlight.
![054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/244orDrGjQgKkpqhbXBtvH8uWr3KqVqV5JURogzt713NAfx2wt14qeRh3yY14rP2fvq1j.jpg)

So, it was just to open the study window silently, and to allow my camera to do its thing. As usual I was happy with the results after I downloaded the shots on my PC, and I posted the shots now untouched. I have several feathered species in here for you to enjoy, and for a change I did not have to hunt for the shots, as they all presented themselves to my view. No effort and the worst that could happen was that I could spill some hot coffee on my lap :)

 When a robin flips its tail like this, then one can know that there is a female around somewhere, and sadly I could not see her. 
![052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242hqM56W9iePV2X9f7EDZhtS3pzw1F2Vfe2g59MRyH56uBdA9JdJ3Ry8j86cA7jxUNFq.jpg)

![050.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/2424HHMEiK7BnHNyaUCZ7sgAGaP6RGqsbGkrCCLhY4m2YbXN5uFKBqPEg4tkuLqwvDSUa.JPG)

A real handsome cutie that any female will fall for, but I think Robbie is married, and it's time for mating :)
![051.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242P4SvZSTnsFLv5iUjJSU4PuPNmGEhDFCdCjhwfzsSEBBQk5mU5a5tccK4BhFMQBPBV4.JPG)

Below, I saw the Red-eyed doves (Streptopelia semitorquata) landing on top of a tree across the road, and as I lined them up with the camera, the one took off.
![068.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23yJGU86viKgh36HzWDrEXbBjEGVdsTjVZhUoKFHkndozyVB8knXWMJRtMVgfofdTKjyh.JPG)

Now what have we here? Maybe a bird that wants to be a model? :)

As we pulled our car out to go to the shop, this juvenile Olive Thrush (Turdus olivaceus) was eyeing me on the sidewalk of our neighbor's house. 
![007.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tmBGw4FtXCKVz4HGdABMCLMVKfhygeH2EA6tpKaRLTuUeqx46LV9WZjxFCjebTKQANz.JPG)

So, it was easy to roll the car slowly forward, and to ask the missus to lower her car door's window. Then, I snapped it as the car came very slow alongside it in the road.
![009.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoAZgtWrKBHWFwvQ5BXFj9TA1oyJBRsmDnyVf26Q4ztddhNsWzsoe35o83GNSXQxNbv.JPG)

I heard the Helmeted Guineafowl (Numida meleagris), and at first couldn't see it. They normally hunt for worms under the fallen leaves in the gutters of the road. But not this one, as it was a first for me to see one between the thorns of an Acacia tree.
![031.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep1WyUKdtPJYRP17dmTBjYe61WRYghoaeQDTQi4rGqo5i1Mukfp9dM2pXSQn8uEtnj2.JPG)

A stray dog, or some other kind of predator must have scared it.
![032.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoprxCpLCqxW2DfUijCwRAn9jjRsCFViST9a5GQgDAVPjJ3MCeanVAajXUz4qfZnwZR.JPG)

Then as we were finally on the way, I saw the Redwing Starlings (Onychognathus morio) sitting on a high lamp post.
![011.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EortdPK6nuyN9dDKg3Ass9VSmkJ4Enxc1CySvRTUVUmXusQMdguS8cZgeQZH3Jcm52y.JPG)

All of this within an hour, and I think that all of the birds were out to enjoy the sunny day, as the poor things suffered during the dark storms that we had recently. We are just happy that they all have survived the storms, and it is solid evidence that Mother nature looks after her wild residents. But in fact, not all is well, as we also have bird species that are threatened with extinction. For several reasons, but mostly due to the loss of their habitats.

*Although an ever-growing list of species is exciting for birders, we should not lose sight of the fact that worldwide, increasing numbers of birds are becoming of conservation concern. The fates of threatened birds are tracked by BirdLife International and the IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) which jointly produce the global Red Data list for birds.*

Source: Book: Birds of Southern Africa. ISBN: 978-1-77584-668-0.  

Maybe I should just say here, such is life.

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved. 

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge Camera. 

Until next time, cheers!
