body.title: Open-Ended vs Closed-Ended Questions: When to Let Customers Speak and When to Count the Votes
body.body:
![hero_image_closed_vs_ended_17fc469c84.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e1a0dadfdfaf6e70938b2a91d8cc76ea17a6b8538c1b883d8efd9febca2fad02)

Written for B2C marketing managers, product managers, market-research consultants, and anyone forced to justify “why the numbers suddenly tanked” in the next Monday stand-up.

## 1. Why This Topic Isn’t Just Academic

You’ve probably sat through at least one meeting where somebody waves a colorful dashboard and proclaims, “CSAT dropped three points any ideas why?” Cue the awkward silence. Numbers alone rarely explain behavior. On the flip side, a 20-page PDF of raw customer rants is equally useless when the C-suite wants a tidy KPI.

That’s the heart of the open- vs closed-ended debate. Get the mix wrong and you either drown in anecdotes or starve on sterile figures. Get it right and you’ll walk into meetings armed with the story and the score earning instant credibility with data folks and brand storytellers.

Key takeaway: open-ended questions uncover the why, [closed-ended questions](https://www.mindprobe.ai/blog/open-ended-vs-closed-ended-questions-when-to-let-customers-speak-and-when-to-count-the-votes) quantify the how many. Together they fuel better product, marketing, and CX decisions.

## 2. Open-Ended Questions Letting Customers Write the Script

### 2.1 What counts as “open-ended”?

Any prompt that doesn’t restrict the answer. Classic stems include “why,” “how,” “describe,” “tell us about.”

### 2.2 Why do B2C teams love them?

Customer feedback offers powerful real-world insights that can shape better experiences. During discovery, shoppers often reveal frictions you might never have considered for instance, noting that a “promo code box appears after the coupon expired.” Their language also provides emotional color, with words like “thrilled,” “meh,” or even strings of emojis showing the true intensity of their feelings perfect for refining your tone of voice. And within their comments lies a copy goldmine: customers sometimes write the best taglines themselves, such as “I love the ‘one-click re-order’ so convenient!”

### [Quick marketing use-case](https://mindprobe.ai/templates/market-segmentation-survey)

Scenario: Post-purchase survey after first order.

Open-ended prompt: “What surprised or delighted you after unboxing?”

Outcome: 42 % mention “ eco-friendly packaging smell like fresh paper.” → new email campaign angle: “Eco inside, delight outside.”

### 2.3 The downsides

1\. Coding overhead – someone (or something) must tag, group, and quantify the text.

2\. Survey fatigue – each open box adds \~20 s to completion time on mobile.

3\. Variance – one respondent writes a novel, another writes “ok”.

### 2.4 How MindProbe lightens the load

[MindProbe’s](https://mindprobe.ai/) auto-tagger groups phrases like “slow checkout,” “payment fail,” and pushes sentiment scores to a live dashboard. One client shaved 14 analyst hours per survey, redirecting that time into proactive UX fixes.

## 3. Closed-Ended Questions The Power of Fast, Crunchable Numbers

### 3.1 Definition & common formats

Feedback can take many useful formats, each suited to different insights. A binary question, such as “Did you find what you needed? Yes / No,” quickly gauges satisfaction. A Likert scale for example, “Rate delivery speed: 1 (poor) – 5 (excellent)” measures degrees of sentiment or performance. Multiple-choice questions like “How did you first hear about us? Instagram / Friend / Search” help identify key channels or behaviors. And ranking questions, such as “Order these features by importance,” reveal priorities and trade-offs in customer preferences.

### 3.2 Why they’re indispensable

1\. Dashboard-ready – slides practically build themselves.

2\. Benchmarkable – compare last quarter to this quarter, or UK vs US.

3\. Lower dropout – tick-box speed on mobile.

### 3.3 Blind spots

*   Surface-level – “50 % disliked checkout” but you still don’t know why.

<!---->

*   Risk of bias – unbalanced scales or missing answer choices skew data.

## 4. Decision Matrix: Five Rules for Picking the Right Format

When designing feedback questions, a few key rules help you choose the right format. Start with the research phase ask yourself, “Am I exploring or validating?” If you’re exploring, use open questions; if validating, stick to closed ones. Consider sample size: if more than 5,000 people will respond, lean toward mostly closed questions for easier analysis. Check your device mix if 70% of your traffic is mobile, keep open-ended questions to 20% or less to avoid fatigue. Under KPI pressure, when you “need a number for Monday,” prioritize closed questions for quick quantifiable data. Finally, assess your analysis capacity if you have AI text analytics, you can safely include more open questions without overwhelming your team.

## 5. Real-World Examples You Can Steal Today

### 5.1 E-commerce checkout friction

1\. Closed gate: “Rate checkout ease 1–5.”

2\. Branch: If ≤3 → open: “Which step felt clunky?”

3\. Optional list: For quick quantification, show checkboxes: Address form, Payment, Promo code, Other.

### 5.2 Subscription box tired of churn

1\. Closed: “How satisfied are you with snack variety? 1–5.”

2\. Open follow-up for ratings ≤3: “Name two snacks you’d love to see next month.”

### 5.3 SaaS onboarding drop-off

1\. Closed: “Did you complete the tutorial? Yes/No.”

2\. Open (No only): “What stopped you?”

3\. Closed multi-select: “Choose blockers: Too long / Jargon / Didn’t see value / Other.”

## 6. Branching Logic Blueprint

Goal: Keep surveys short for promoters and deep for detractors.

Q1 NPS rating (0-10)

│

├─ If 0-6 (Detractor)

│ ├─ Q2 open: “Tell us the main reason.”

│ └─ Q3 closed multi-select root-causes

│ └─ If “Other” → Q4 open text

│

└─ If 7-10 (Passive/Promoter)

└─ Q2 open (optional): “What wowed you?”

MindProbe tip: set these conditions visually; the platform shows a live map so you won’t accidentally trap users in an infinite loop.

## 7. Analyzing Open-Ended Data Without Losing Your Weekend

### Step-by-step playbook

1\. Export CSV (or stream via API into MindProbe).

2\. Auto-tag with AI – clusters phrases (“size chart,” “promo code fail”).

[3. Sentiment map](https://mindprobe.ai/product/features/sentiment-analysis) – red = negative, green = positive, bubble size = theme frequency.

4\. Demographic overlay – see if Gen Z in London is more annoyed by “delivery time” than Boomers.

5\. Prioritize fixes – high-frequency + high-negativity themes to the top of the sprint backlog.

Data point: A DTC cosmetics brand shaved 1.3 days off its monthly reporting cycle after ditching manual coding in favor of MindProbe’s auto-tagger.

## 8. Common Pitfalls \& Quick Fixes

Poorly designed surveys can easily distort results but a few simple fixes prevent common pitfalls. Leading wording like “Don’t you love…” creates fake positivity, so use neutral verbs such as “Rate” or “Describe” instead. Overlapping scale labels cause confusion; make sure to clearly label both endpoints and mid-points. Having too many open text boxes often leads to dropouts, especially on mobile limit them to a maximum of two and use branching questions where possible. Finally, skipping a pilot test risks logic errors and broken flows, so always test your survey with at least five staff members across different devices before launch.

## 9. Mini Case Studies: Fashion, Snacks, and SaaS

### 9.1 Fashion e-commerce

*   Problem: 18 % returns, mostly “wrong fit.”

<!---->

*   Survey mix: 1 closed, 1 open.

<!---->

*   Insight: The phrase “shorter than expected” appeared in 34 % of open answers.

<!---->

*   Fix: Added model height images + size advisory widget.

<!---->

*   Result: Returns fell to 13 % in six weeks.

### 9.2 Snack subscription

*   Problem: Churn spikes after third box.

<!---->

*   Survey: Closed scale + open snack suggestion.

<!---->

*   Insight: Users wanted high-protein, low-sugar items.

<!---->

*   Fix: Introduced “Protein Pack” line.

<!---->

*   Result: Churn halved, referral codes up 22 %.

### 9.3 SaaS project tool

*   Problem: 40 % of free-trial users never activate.

<!---->

*   Survey: Closed yes/no + open blocker.

<!---->

*   Insight: 63 % cited “Zapier integration unclear.”

<!---->

*   Fix: Added a GIF tutorial + inline tips.

<!---->

*   Result: Activation rose 12 pts, support tickets down 20 %.

## 10. FAQ Rapid-Fire Answers for Busy Teams

Q: How many open-ended questions can I safely ask on mobile?

A: Two max. Anything more risks fatigue; rely on branching.

Q: Is AI coding as accurate as humans?

A: MindProbe’s model hits \~90 % agreement with professional coders. Use human review for edge cases.

Q: Should I randomize answer options?

A: Only when order bias could matter e.g., picking new flavors. For scales, keep logical order.

Q: Can I embed images in open-ended prompts?

A: Yes image-based surveys increase engagement, but compress files for quick loading.

## 11. Action Checklist

1\. Audit existing surveys calculate your open:closed ratio.

2\. Insert branching to keep forms short for happy users and deep for detractors.

3\. Activate auto-tagging with MindProbe; set up weekly sentiment alerts.

4\. Fix quick wins first delivery messaging, size charts, login copy.

5\. Measure: compare NPS, CSAT, churn after changes.

6\. Iterate: drop, tweak, or replace under-performing questions.

## 12. Final Thoughts

Open-ended questions reveal the why; closed-ended questions quantify the how many. In an era where marketing budgets tighten and product cycles accelerate, you can no longer pick one and ignore the other. Use branching logic to combine them elegantly, deploy AI text analysis to keep workload sane, and feed insights straight into sprint boards. The payoff? Faster iteration, lower churn, and most important customer voices that actually guide your brand’s story.

Ready to act? Spin up a new survey in [MindProbe](https://www.mindprobe.ai/blog/complete-guide-online-surveys), drag that branching arrow, and watch your response rates climb while analysis time plummets.

---

body.title: Rhododendron pontica. Beautiful flowers in a city flowerbed.
body.body:
Rhododendron pontica.
Beautiful flowers in a city flowerbed.

My friends and I went into town today to take a stroll, soak up new emotions and impressions, be inspired by the city's beauty, and enjoy the bustle of the city, at least occasionally. Although I'm not a fan of the hustle and bustle of the city. I prefer quiet, peaceful places. For example, I love walking in nature, in the forest, by the lake, and so on.

But today, my friends invited me to go into town, have coffee and talk, discuss the news, and so on.

We bought coffee at a kiosk and sat on a bench, facing a whole avenue of flowers. They are so beautiful, blooming so profusely. I love their delicate color. I love pink. It's so pleasant, delicate, and beautiful.

I love it when cities are landscaped, when flowers are planted in the avenues. It brings life to a city amidst high-rise buildings. Flowers, trees, and lawns beautify the city.

Best known as the powerhouse frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey is one of rock and roll’s most iconic and enduring vocalists. With his signature golden curls, fierce stage presence, and a voice capable of shifting from a soulful growl to a stadium-shaking scream, Daltrey helped define the template for the classic rock lead singer.
Key Highlights of His Career
The Blueprint for Hard Rock: Alongside guitarist Pete Townshend, bassist John Entwistle, and drummer Keith Moon, Daltrey anchored The Who. His vocals brought life to legendary rock anthems like \
: Daltrey became the physical embodiment of the \

in The Who’s groundbreaking 1969 rock opera Tommy, a role he reprised to critical acclaim in Ken Russell’s 1975 film adaptation.\nSolo Ventures & Collaboration: Beyond The Who, Daltrey launched a successful solo career with hits like \

and collaborated with a massive array of artists, ranging from blues legends to orchestral performances.
Style and Legacy
While Pete Townshend was the primary visionary songwriter for The Who, Daltrey was the vital bridge between the music and the audience. He took Townshend’s deeply angst-ridden, complex lyrics and delivered them with a raw, working-class machismo and intensity.
His iconic microphone-swinging technique became a visual staple of rock history, and his ability to maintain his vocal power across six decades cemented him as a true force of nature in the music industry.

---

https://youtu.be/UDfAdHBtK_Q?si=anzpz9GwOpubD5Bl

This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months. --- ---

Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde el aroma a café recién hecho me llevó a una pequeña cafetería al aire libre. Hablé con un barista muy amable que me contó que había vivido en la ciudad toda su vida y que cada día se siente inspirado por la diversidad de personas que pasan por allí. Continué mi camino y vi un grupo de artistas callejeros pintando un mural vibrante. Uno de ellos compartió que el mural representa la historia de la comunidad y que está diseñado para fomentar la paz y la unidad. Me encantó cómo el arte puede unir a las personas y darles una voz. Finalmente, me encontré con un anciano en un banco, que me habló de sus recuerdos de la ciudad en tiempos pasados. Sus historias eran fascinantes y me hicieron apreciar aún más los lugares que a menudo doy por sentado. Al final de la caminata, sentí que no solo había ejercitado mi cuerpo, sino también mi mente y mi espíritu al conectar con las historias de quienes me rodean. Fue un día lleno de pequeñas pero significativas interacciones. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Thinking Big...
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUdiGtrYojke3ddFsmwL4JNCLfNCBRFvixzqzYNUoMbz2/1779287357958.jpg)


There is a widespread idea that sounds good, motivates, and is easily shared: **you have to think big**

The problem is that it has been repeated so much, and with so little nuance, that it has ended up causing more harm than good.  

Thinking big doesn't prevent you from making mistakes.  
It doesn't protect you from making bad decisions.  
And, of course, it doesn't guarantee that the path you choose will be the right one.  

I have seen many people with a huge vision make very small… but decisive mistakes. Basic mistakes. Mistakes of focus. Mistakes of choice. Not because they didn't dream enough, but because they confused thinking big with thinking better.  

**Thinking big expands**

**Thinking well organizes**

And without organization, expansion usually ends in dispersion.  

When \

becomes a mantra, it ceases to be a tool and becomes an excuse. An elegant way to avoid uncomfortable questions.  

Questions like:  
*Does this make sense right now?  
Does it fit with my real abilities?  
Am I choosing from clarity or from ego?*

Misunderstood greatness pushes you to accelerate processes that are not yet mature, to take on commitments that cannot be sustained, and to justify poor decisions with inspiring speeches. 

And that is not ambition.  
It is a lack of judgment.

Emy Mora 💚

body.title: Smartphones for students: Opportunities and Hidden Risks.
body.body:
Hello friends. Today's kids are very fast and curious about modern technology. So one of our previous government took the decision to available smart mobile phone in a cheap rate to all students. She thought that if smart phone could be available every students can take the advantage of online classes. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNJxD5a51iWP5bRWgM7KobaatszDuzS65WbDVBbNZaPB/1779879752788.jpg)

As the world is moving forward everyday and the developing countries like Bangladesh should also move forward with the world so there no option of learning technology. So the government include the ICT syllabus from class one to twelve. And made available smartphones at a cheaper rate. Now every students can learn their lessons even without the help of private tutor. The poor family who can't afford to buy smartphones one day they can also afford to buy smartphones now a days in a very cheap rate with 4G Network supported. So they now have no tension for paying tution fees for private tutor. They can buy an internet package and learn everything of their syllabus. They can attend in online classes if weather is bad. So it has a very important affect on the students to ensure proper learning and upgrade themselves.  But there is a shadow under the lamp. 

A lot of students are abusing the smartphones also. They use social communicative media like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat etc. They too much used this app which destroy their attention of learning. They engaged in illigal relationship sometimes. It is very alarming that a large number of girls using Tik Tok which destroying a large portion of this generation. A lot of students playing online games and waste their time. 

They play Free Fire and PubG which are making them aggressive day by day. So it is high time they left the smartphones without study. Gurdians should check out their kids everyday. Some of them are involving with online gumbling also. All these are threatful for the students.

body.title: Snow Cakes [ESP/ENG] Review and analysis
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tvitPbmVudnWCxHptZKCQo8VV9TyDmgRsJ6EXatP2xZuoV2Q16JFCF18gGyL5gEcxsi.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/1021824602934602041/)

Today I'm going to talk about a movie I recently saw that gave me a lot to think about. Before, when people talked to me about autistic individuals, I mistakenly believed they were mentally isolated, disconnected, and dependent on others for everything. However, nowadays we know that it depends on the degree of autism each person has. Snow Cake, for example, tells the story of Linda, portrayed amazingly well by the wonderful Sigourney Weaver, the same actress from Gorillas in the Mist. Linda not only has autism but also severe OCD (Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder), which manifests as an obsession with order and cleanliness, although, ironically, thanks to this she has a good job as a stocker at a supermarket. She has a daughter, Alex Hughes (Alan Rickman), a lonely man burdened by past trauma. He's driving across Canada and picks up a hitchhiker named Vivienne (Emily Hampshire) who lives in another town. That day, while Vivienne is trying to travel to her village to reunite with her mother, she meets Alex Hughes, masterfully portrayed by Alan Rickman, and practically forces him to give her a ride, or at least part of the way. However, at some point, they are involved in a tragic accident in which Vivienne loses her life. Alex then decides to personally deliver the news to her mother, Linda, and there he discovers her autism. Feeling guilty, he agrees to stay with her for a while to help her. >Hoy les hablaré de una película que vi recientemente y que me dejó mucho para pensar, antes, cuando me hablaban de personas autistas, yo creía erróneamente que se trataba de personas aisladas mentalmente, desconectados y que dependían de los demás para todo, sin embargo hoy en día sabemos que eso depende del grado de autismo que tenga cada persona. Snow Cake por ejemplo nos trae el caso de Linda, interpretada de una manera asombrosamente acertada por la maravillosa Sigourney Weaver, la misma de Gorilas en la Niebla. Linda no solo sufre de autismo sino que tiene un severo TOC (Tanstorno Obsesivo Compulsivo) el cuál se manifiesta en una obsesión por el orden y la limpieza aunque, irónicamente gracias a esto tiene un buen empleo como organizadora de productos en un supermercado. Ella tiene una hija, Alex Hughes (Alan Rickman), un hombre solitario que carga con un trauma del pasado, viaja en coche a través de Canadá y recoge a una autoestopista llamada Vivienne (Emily Hampshire) que vive en otra ciudad, ese día, mientras Vivenne intenta viajar al pueblo a reunirse con su madre conoce a Alex Hughes, que fue magistralmente interpretado por Alan Rickman, y prácticamente lo obliga a que la lleve al pueblo, o al menos un tramo del camino, sin embargo en determinado momento ambos tienen un desafortunado accidente donde Vivenne pierde la vida. Alex entonces decide ir a llevarle la noticia personalmente a su madre Linda y allí descubre su condición de autismo, de modo que, sintiéndose culpable acepta quedarse junto a ella un tiempo para ayudarla.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EpLfXPZbitYmGNecMRF7mMESyqokpMKWkAxPxYxAw2FU3V5gLcjKJamBD4aNEBmb3kW.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/845480530042677858/)

We, as the audience, along with Alex (the protagonist), learn about what it's like to live with a person with autism. We learn to process their unique way of perceiving life. It's not that Linda was cold; it's simply that she doesn't conform to society's preconceived notions. On the contrary, she lives her life her own way, free from hypocrisy, and the world around her, not understanding her, judges her. Alex realizes this and gradually allows himself to be touched by Linda's light and innocence, which helps him heal his past traumas.

>Nosotros como audiencia junto con Alex (el protagonista) nos educamos acerca de como es vivir con una persona con autismo, aprendemos a procesar su manera peculiar de percibir la vida, no es que Linda fuese fría, es que simplemente ella no se deja llevar por los conceptos preconcebidos de la sociedad, al contrario, vive a su manera y libre de hipocresía, y el mundo a su alrededor, como no la comprende la juzga. Alex se da cuenta de esto y poco a poco se permite ser contagiado pro la luz y la inocencia de Linda, l cuál lo ayuda a sanar sus traumas del pasado.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xARJYmJcfMPVb4x8rzyGhz5aeViJ2zryAmCbNRBJ8USZ5jsQ63N7tDzUwrFJqpt3Dnd.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/910360512158401079/)

Maggie, Linda's neighbor, is a controversial woman with whom Alex develops a relationship. It is precisely this, along with his experience with Linda and some beautiful words from Vivienne read at her funeral, that makes him reflect on his own life, his past, and the fact that he should no longer run from his fears but face them.

>Maggie, la vecina de Linda, es una mujer controvertida con la cuál Alex llega a tener una relación, y es precisamente esto junto con el proceso que vive con Linda y unas palabras hermosas de Vivienne que leyeron en su funeral, lo que lo hace reflexionar acerca de su propia vida, su pasado y el hecho de que ya no debe huir de sus miedos sino enfrentarlos
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23yJM58Y2LWJntXQZgmUtMx8VVH98HDn4FsYrjynb1dpR75dB4Jsec6Bfoa5BZ2uBWct4.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/298152437833285320/)

It's worth noting that Sigourney Weaver's performance completely breaks with the stereotypes cinema had accustomed us to, opting for a much more realistic and therefore more organic interpretation. Linda lives a full, completely independent and functional life, but she is often misunderstood by those around her, who struggle to understand her condition and only observe the situation from the outside.

>Cabe destacar que la actuación de Sigourney Weaver rompe completamente con los estereotipos a los que el cine nos tenía acostumbrados, optando por una interpretación mucho más apegada a la realidad y por lo tanto más orgánica. Linda vive una vida plena, completamente independiente y funcional pero es a menudo malinterpretada por la gente a su alrededor ya que les cuesta entender su condición y solo miran la situación desde el exterior.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23vsNmQ8mgKgjQ1TVjgePnfHkuG2TZWnCbtJEA2RFXVuZBRrmnAHvYusPKFEFzNHspiLQ.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/241998179956184265/)

And well, with nothing more to add for the moment, I'll say goodbye until next time, God willing.

>Y bueno ya sin nada más que añadir por el momento me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad, Dios mediante.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

body.title: Brownie and Coffee to Pass the Time [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Miniatura de YouTube vlog un día conmigo recortes blanco amarillo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wX5ESy3LscAYznNFwMkusQ82deWqHEoXoex6dTf2p9TUZE1Ywe25BFqJDU1scqhKBDv.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

I want to show you some photos I kept from the day my sister and I went to meet our cousins ​​at A&B Books and Coffee. The goal was to spend a wonderful time relaxing with them, especially with him, since he was visiting the country as he lives abroad. So we chose this place, which has become my all-time favorite because of its Harry Potter theme (a saga I'm completely in love with). There are little lights everywhere that create a magical and cozy atmosphere. >Quiero mostrarles algunas fotos que conservo del día que mi hermana y yo fuimos a reunirnos con nuestros primos en A&B Books and Coffee. El objetivo era pasar un rato maravilloso de esparcimiento junto a ellos y en especial junto a él porque estaba de visita en el país ya que vive en el extranjero. Entonces la elección fue este lugar que se ha convertido en mi favorito de toda la vida por su temática de Harry Potter (una saga de la que estoy completamente enamorada) Hay pequeñas luces por todos lados que crean un ambiente mágico y acogedor.

![IMG_20260425_154725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eonk17Tg2mHxfAxySrXQ9pkZDKmrTozzuPGvTVZvoL7QbXpxPGiAFUfkdAdpdjQiSro.jpg)

The place is located in the Concepto La Viña shopping center in the north of the city of Valencia in Venezuela, and the concept it uses is very interesting, I couldn't say for sure if it's a restaurant, a cafe, a bookstore or a library because it really has all of those things inside: you can enjoy something delicious while watching the Harry Potter movies that are playing all the time, you can buy a book if you wish or grab any you like from the shelf and read it while you have your snack, breakfast, lunch or dinner.

>El lugar está ubicado en el centro comercial Concepto La Viña en el norte de la ciudad de Valencia en Venezuela, y el concepto que maneja es muy interesante, no podría precisar si es un restaurante, un café, una librería o una biblioteca porque realmente tiene todo eso allí adentro: puedes degustar algo delicioso mientras ves las películas de Harry Potter que las reproducen todo el tiempo, puedes comprar un libro si así lo deseas o agarrar cualquiera que te guste del estante y leerlo mientras tomas tu merienda, desayuno, almuerzo cena.
![IMG_20260425_154738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpCAMpXDthQ2GiCdHBAjqAjyTdpzzAawLGxrVCcQjtcWb2HUWBKo4uP6VumPymPFtJW.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_154834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wMaJauSqP9E5LUBVGLpYutbCK24VyathHca3XwAgckq1bZtbL5zHyLJYtY9cWUVZpYs.jpg)

My cousins ​​were absolutely fascinated by all the details they were finding; even the menu is very original because it not only has the characteristic typography of the Harry Potter saga, but it also includes drinks and food mentioned in the books, such as butterbeer, for example. However, there are also dishes inspired by other famous books such as Doña Barbara, by Rómulo Gallegos; it's extremely interesting.

>Mis primos estaban absolutamente fascinados con todos los detalles que iban encontrando, incluso el menú es muy original porque no solo tiene la tipografía característica de la saga Harry Potter, sino que incluye bebidas y comida que se mencionan en los libros, como la cerveza de mantequilla, por ejemplo, sin embargo también hay platillos inspirados en otros libros célebres como Doña Barbara, de Rómulo gallegos, es sumamente interesante.
![IMG_20260425_155712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpELGA34hC8gWUbMBESJWR8KeH9qTaMv8JFa574Ysgm5ckqG1UMjZxqLx9zrqfoFUzp.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_155720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eos2D4fycXwzygRfCj3uL2aFRbF9WCLRYC2E63AiMnoLAZUDyTHazcoNUXwhgvraeq7.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_154811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eo6Mo1kjbW7J4zQYWUbSB16jS4TwjiwpJvcS2dHE8HBhK4T4UrqP1FiEv4DUunFQ12L.jpg)

But I was craving something sweet that day, so I opted for a brownie with ice cream and paired it with a delicious café bom bom. A bit too sugary, perhaps, but it was absolutely delicious. The brownie had that characteristic slightly crispy outer layer, the chocolate had that perfect balance I love so much, and the ice cream added the perfect refreshing touch that contrasted beautifully with my coffee 😁. It was a sweet temptation that I thoroughly enjoyed, hehe.

>Pero a mi se me antojaba algo dulce ese día, así que opté por un Brownie con helado y lo acompañé con un riquísimo café bom bom, demasiada azúcar, tal vez, pero estaba absolutamente delicioso. Al Brownie se le sentía esa característica capa medio crocante del exterior, el chocolate tenía ese equilibrio perfecto que tanto me gusta, y el helado le dio el toque perfecto y refrescante que hizo contraste con mi café 😁, pero era una dulce tentación que supe apreciar muy bien, jeje
![IMG_20260425_162354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EokdbTyBamLDEc1u92wvXFUyTJ4RGQfwCpV1WpDP2JrH48AsSPLMT7BGd1XL3w47yZu.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_162942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeEtXU5ixdqaaM8ZFxSkzig6xjoSvmh2dUmaTfKELij34C2cXzcwBeKQVBkkVWyQMd.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_162946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeEV38Azaevn1ReeDnMgYH6hkmcs1P87KLKrCe6mJAww8YYnK37r2mnGs7MNadWms9.jpg)

The more you look around, the more interesting things you find all over the place, that's why I love this restaurant. Look, I even found the famous Hogwarts letter addressed to Harry Potter with the very specific address \

😄

\n\n>Mientras más agudizas la mirada más cositas interesantes te consigues por todo el lugar, por eso amo este restaurante, fíjense, incluso encontré la famosa carta de Hogwart dirigida a Harry Potter con la dirección tan específica \

😄
![IMG_20260425_165354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpLey9FWx6NHk8ZAp2Nj8BZZPaNfd4QYGV5G6gn9QCwUysWKze5yVUndWV9Ff7XACUs.jpg)
![IMG_20260425_165332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoAbF5xtwuxGjh3sV5hspwQKUMWKiGRNLQMPK5YSHrf2EFa1hQe4w2LUCRifPw3eDwa.jpg)

There's a young woman who takes great care of them and even organizes guided readings. body.title: This cemetery is not serious [Song Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Yellow and Black Modern True Crime Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tvg5yTmCkzpsQ7Dn6hhp9yX6bLFrcAhsbSNnUsspkm8BAJsssvc5NbKBCdRn4Tsu65A.jpg)

Hello, internet people! Who says you have to belong to the generation that created good music to enjoy it? In my case, even though I listen to current music, I appreciate true classics and quality artists, which is why I like listening to Elvis Presley. But today I don't want to go so far back in time; we'll travel to the 80s, specifically 1987, when José María Cano composed a masterpiece for his band, Mecano. \

(This Cemetery Isn't Serious) is the title of the song, whose chords remind us of a funeral march. I don't know about you, but when I listen to this song, I can't help but think it's a satire of many things, first and foremost the solemnity with which many people tend to view death, associating it with the color black, flowers, silence, and things like that (we're fans of symbolism).\n\n>¡Hola Hola, gente de internet! ¿Quién dijo que para disfrutar de buena música tienes que pertenecer a la generación de la cuál proviene dicha música? En mi caso, a pesar de que escucho música actual yo sé apreciar los verdaderos clásicos y los artistas de calidad, por eso me gusta escuchar a Elvis Presley, pero hoy no quiero ir tan atrás en el tiempo, viajaremos a los años 80, específicamente 1987 cuando José María Cano compuso un tomazo para su banda, Mecano \

es el título de la canción, cuyos acordes nos recuerdan una marcha fúnebre. No sé ustedes pero cuando yo escucho esta canción no puedo evitar pensar que es una sátira a muchas cosas, en primer lugar a la solemnidad con que muchas personas suelen ver la muerte, asociándola con el color negro, con flores, silencio y cosas así, (somos fanáticos del simbolismo)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23y8m8eLTahMe4oSCCPejqXhumvgQBY56CSRjtXXT6UhyKkJVLC9Pnv3TQBEnXvXZKdBM.png)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4XXpg65qS34)

But on the other hand, I also think the song aims to criticize the fact that even after death, social classes are evident in cemeteries: \

😄 That's true. Every time I've gone to the cemetery in my city, I can't help but think of this song, because there, living people continue to make distinctions between social classes: grand mausoleums and marble angels rise above humble, crooked crosses and worn graves, even though beneath the earth lie bodies in the same condition: inert and decomposed. And although it may sound macabre, the reality, or what I mean to say, is that we are all equal, and that's how death treats us, equally. It is we human beings, when we are alive, who seek to make absurd and unnecessary distinctions.

\n\n>Pero por otro lado también pienso que la canción pretende criticar el hecho de que aún después de la muerte, en los cementerios se evidencian las clases sociales \

😄. Eso es verdad, las veces que he ido al cementerio de mi ciudad no puedo dejar de pensar en esta canción, porque allí la gente viva sigue haciendo distinciones entre clases sociales: grandes mausoleos y ángeles de mármol se alzan por encima de humildes cruces torcidas y tumbas desgastadas, aun y cuando debajo de la tierra yacen cuerpos en las mismas condiciones: inertes y descompuestos, y aunque suene a algo macabro la realidad, o lo que quiero decir es que todos somos iguales y así nos trata la muerte, con igualdad, somos los seres humanos cuando estamos vivos, los que buscamos hacer distinciones absurdas e innecesarias.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uQnD3HA8S2SGTE84Mqu1Sak48wQ3ZgkbVeKNTPrc5rQUU4XAmc1rDSpwjT6ZTa6ygjw.png)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4XXpg65qS34)

The cultural richness of Mecano is undeniable, thanks to the skill of its composer, José María Cano, who always drew on elements of art to philosophize. For example, at the end of this song, there's a phrase in the background, \

which seems quite fitting, doesn't it? In life, we believe ourselves to be infallible and invincible; some think they are better than others. In life, we accumulate achievements to try to satisfy society, but in the end, it all ends there, in the cemetery. José María took this phrase from the title of one of the paintings by the Baroque artist Juan de Valdés Leal.

\n\n>Es innegable la riqueza cultural que tiene Mecano debido a la habilidad de su compositor, José María Cano, que siempre tomaba elementos del arte para filosofar, por ejemplo al final de esta canción hay una frase que se oye de fondo \

lo que parece muy apropiado, ¿no? En vida nos creemos muy infalibles e invencibles, algunos piensan que son mejores que otros, en vida acumulan logros para tratar de satisfacer a la sociedad, pero al final todo termina allí, en el cementerio. Esta frase la tomó José María del nombre de una de las pinturas del artista barroco Juan de Valdés Leal.
https://youtu.be/4XXpg65qS34
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4XXpg65qS34)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

body.title: I fulfilled Eyan's request: I built a tent at home.
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU44PZTg4B2fwaJpLJ651E2h2neEWpHoyoqTUyr3uJLnC/1000218452.jpg


  
  
  



This morning, my son Ian was watching a video on TV. The video showed people living in such tents in the forest and having various adventures. Well, after watching it, he got it in his mind and since waking up, he has been determined to have such a tent. 

Children's such fantasies are really wonderful. They quickly want to play with whatever they see on TV or around them in their own imagination. My son's sweet nature cannot be ignored, so I thought of quickly creating a play area for him using the things at home. 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWE1p2hXPvPLS6HQYVbUnSQEqhEcRq1VXUTa6uE46VNx5/1000218451.jpg

As the idea goes, so does the work. I started the process of making a tent by using the sofa in the drawing room. No separate wooden or bamboo structure was needed, I took an umbrella and then opened it and placed it on a sofa and using a colorful sheet and a few clips to attach clothes, I created a beautiful tent shape on the sofa.  This little kingdom of Ian's play was created in a very short time using home methods. The beautiful design on the sheet and the color combination of the blue cushions on the sofa created a very nice atmosphere. The sheet was clipped very tightly so that it would not fall off, so that he could play safely inside.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYLLh1hRsAn91KwNgpHM2qi6QdVzGsct6dT4HNG6sxzUB/1000218453.jpg

After the tent was completely built, the joy in Ian's eyes and the wide smile on his face were worth seeing. He went inside his newly made secret room with great enthusiasm and sat down. Children usually love to curl up and play in such small and confined spaces. Ian is no exception. He went inside his new tent and sat down quite comfortably and started spending time in his own way. Seeing his innocent joy, my heart also felt better in an instant.



The immense joy that children hide in these small things cannot be believed without seeing the innocent smiles on their faces.  Not an expensive toy, but a little bit of time and creativity from parents can become the greatest gift in the world for them. This small joyful moment created at home in the midst of busy city life has made our whole day much more beautiful and lively. Today's writing is shared with all of you to preserve this beautiful memory of Ian.

Competition is one of the strongest elements of Clash Royale. Players can challenge strangers from different countries and test their skills in real-time battles. Winning matches helps unlock rewards, trophies, and higher arena levels.

body.body:
Hace algunos años me empezó a gustar el tema de tener una colección de cactus y suculentas en envases pequeños, pero no ha sido posible hasta ahora que me puse manos a la obra para cumplir con esa meta.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ2GYY2wjXdT8LEZpARsMZeWv8tbE9axdCCATZQpzuFMc/macetitas_recicladas_para_mis_suculentas.png</center>

Por mi escaso tiempo libre,  decir que me voy a dedicar a la jardinería,  es algo impensable,  además que aunque me gustan las plantas, no es una actividad que me llame mucho la atención,  pero como si me gustan las miniaturas, tener una colección así,  resulta perfecto para agregarle un poco de verde al interior de mi casa.

Otra cosa es que debido a que vivo alquilada, prefiero tenerlas en macetas pequeñas, que pueda transportar fácilmente al momento de mudarme.

Así que cuando vi esos envases de jugo que iban a botar, me los traje a casa, con la idea de convertirlos en macetas para empezar mi colección.  

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmUiK4Qpfdwg6sdagMsrM1cKD1PrgQ6dY6YjfbtBoLdiBR/20260526_163348.jpg</center>

Pero me faltaban las matas! Y por cosas del destino,  vi unas ramitas que habían podado al frente de una casa, y me traje una para darles una nueva oportunidad de seguir viviendo.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdfaACDmEuBZdhdST8QccMw58wRtPPfKxhgCqq44DPhGq/20260526_170146.jpg</center>

De hecho, esta especie (que no sé como se llama) suele crecer del tamaño de un arbusto cuando tiene suficiente espacio, pero también se adaptan a entornos reducidos.

Con todo listo, solo me faltaba tierra, y el universo siguió conspirando a mi favor, pues a una cuadra de mi trabajo, hicieron una remoción de tierra y al salir hoy, me llevé una bolsa y traje lo suficiente para darle vida a este proyecto.

Para empezar, tomé un cuchillo para cortar el borde superior y retirar la parte metálica. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCZcKq7QNyFXFaismQ21nvAjZekgZitsfMYmoydCfFEA/20260526_163512.jpg</center>

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhAXopt2R5DCqsbUX6ZuALRnJbvMNmReVsBUoWcuRkRA/20260526_163616.jpg</center>

Luego, calenté la punta del cuchillo, para hacerle orificios en la parte inferior, que funcionen como desagüe.  Les hice 3 a cada envase.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPVAeqexXGoNiut4Tx4E6oF6vdJK4v7h5BZND7CTqNLA/20260526_165140.jpg</center>

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVyJgy7WrxTb41Htx7MWNaMkTqyeg67Fgt9qB2bXWihDi/20260526_165220.jpg</center>

Con una esponja de acero,  mucha agua y paciencia,  retiré las etiquetas de papel que tenían, para que solo quedara el diseño de las frutas en cada envase.

Procedí a llenar de tierra hasta la mitad de cada pote, para luego introducir las ramitas de la planta que rescaté y terminar de llenarlos para darles firmeza. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmY1bSH49rr5eHUSFf6fQQYki5zwJowaBpGtEpX5BmJn5Z/20260526_165954.jpg</center>

Una vez listas, las regué un poco, pues la tierra estaba algo húmeda,  y las dejé en el balcón  para que se acostumbren a su nueva casita.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQopvj95bnTvMhdMeMUB7CDWPeeKmJ5z9K9Mcs1ox2FVr/20260526_171301.jpg</center>

Ahora toca rezar para que peguen, y se mantengan a salvo de las garritas de mi traviesa gatita Aramis.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmTr49cHg6VshhUWpze2ULAkiUzBZu9rw9wFchvys8JZR2/20260526_171315.jpg</center>

Todavía me quedaron algunas latas de gaseosas, pero para hacer el proceso necesito un abrelatas, que no tengo, además de encontrar otras plantitas diferentes.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcsf5YNwMDgX2gciBJh23oKiYVp5M4pHLphP44pNK5JR/20260526_163405.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

A few years ago, I started to take an interest in collecting cacti and succulents in small pots, but it wasn’t until recently that I finally got down to work to achieve that goal.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdLfW2YvtPf4c7KN8LtBbXCVTGaMhpbD6utb81fLcy2qP/macetitas_recicladas_para_mis_suculentas_1_.png</center>

Given my limited free time,  saying that I’m going to devote myself to gardening  is unthinkable;  besides, although I like plants, it’s not an activity that particularly appeals to me,  but as I do like miniatures, having a collection like this  is perfect for adding a bit of greenery to my home.

Another thing is that, as I live in rented accommodation, I prefer to keep them in small pots that I can easily take with me when I move.

So when I saw those juice cartons that were going to be thrown away, I brought them home, with the idea of turning them into pots to start my collection.  

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmUiK4Qpfdwg6sdagMsrM1cKD1PrgQ6dY6YjfbtBoLdiBR/20260526_163348.jpg</center>

But I didn’t have any plants! And as luck would have it, I spotted some twigs that had been pruned in front of a house, and I took one home to give them a new lease of life.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdfaACDmEuBZdhdST8QccMw58wRtPPfKxhgCqq44DPhGq/20260526_170146.jpg</center>

In fact, this species (whose name I don’t know) usually grows to the size of a shrub when it has enough space, but it also adapts to smaller spaces.

With everything ready, all I needed was some soil, and luck was on my side once again: just a block away from my workplace, they were clearing some land, and when I left work today, I grabbed a bag and brought back enough to get this project off the ground.

To start with, I used a knife to cut along the top edge and remove the metal part. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCZcKq7QNyFXFaismQ21nvAjZekgZitsfMYmoydCfFEA/20260526_163512.jpg</center>

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhAXopt2R5DCqsbUX6ZuALRnJbvMNmReVsBUoWcuRkRA/20260526_163616.jpg</center>

Next, I heated the tip of the knife to make holes in the bottom of each container, to act as drainage holes. I made three in each one.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPVAeqexXGoNiut4Tx4E6oF6vdJK4v7h5BZND7CTqNLA/20260526_165140.jpg</center>

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVyJgy7WrxTb41Htx7MWNaMkTqyeg67Fgt9qB2bXWihDi/20260526_165220.jpg</center>

Using a steel wool pad, plenty of water and patience, I removed the paper labels so that only the fruit design remained on each container.

I then filled each pot halfway with soil, inserted the sprigs from the plant I had rescued, and finished filling them to give them stability. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmY1bSH49rr5eHUSFf6fQQYki5zwJowaBpGtEpX5BmJn5Z/20260526_165954.jpg</center>

Once they were ready, I watered them a little, as the soil was quite damp, and left them on the balcony to get used to their new home.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQopvj95bnTvMhdMeMUB7CDWPeeKmJ5z9K9Mcs1ox2FVr/20260526_171301.jpg</center>

Now it’s time to pray that they take root, and stay safe from the little claws of my mischievous kitten Aramis.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmTr49cHg6VshhUWpze2ULAkiUzBZu9rw9wFchvys8JZR2/20260526_171315.jpg</center>

I’ve still got a few cans of fizzy drinks left, but to do this I need a can opener, which I don’t have, as well as finding some other different little plants.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcsf5YNwMDgX2gciBJh23oKiYVp5M4pHLphP44pNK5JR/20260526_163405.jpg</center>

***

Foto/Photo by: @mamaemigrante
Banner de portada: Cortesía de @palabras1
Edición/Edited by @mamaemigrante using canva
Translated and formatted with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

body.body: > To clear the difficult second well, I bought max arrows and used a Tengu to infiltrate the rooftops. After a Shadow Hunter cut short a stealth attempt, I restarted, used a tight wall gap to trap the pursuing enemies, ad monitored them with spectral vision. Then I eliminated a shadow hunter, and faced the wrath of a Paper Doll. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUwm6M49SKFp7XvezL6oTPPAy1VR31cyxhNWe3NyuDBCv/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhsAaT9rfboqGpSyLUYdEVdpivRkZEzywd4cqBWmSHqx/screenshot_2_.png) I understood I would need a handful of arrows to make the fight easier against the threats, so I went to this store from where I bought some arrows that I could carry. I filled my quiver to absolute capacity before heading back out. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaB9qdvDpS6fcr35wfGGPDFg3P1Qr1pvhrP4xSa8pXvd3/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmczQi5EyBUZnrZVpiuHW1ALNG7mBQkkRQ34dxCW4xSQhL/screenshot_4_.png) Then I used this Tengu to grapple up on that roof with a swift pull of my wire. And I reached the second well that I decided to cleanse first as it looked incredibly hard compared to the first one. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWLEaX6GjmvVx8efR6ew1G3FUPFsBojDtbugAS6mcRNd/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmfh1r9VxSBoi7SnQk49NQqfz6osPUEu9gUNpv7akrRk/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNcNWKqtwba1YwSsBS9bgQX6uh44b4Hn1ih8MzQPjjZQ/screenshot_7_.png) After noticing there were some demons around the well guarding the main basin, I decided to change my position to a safer vantage. So I used another Tengu and on my way I had to fight and take down some wanderers with my arrows. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLd1FGRvZwn1VNoFhkMk4nRE7xa5i1weDwWZMsUjev45/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmci8gFvoExvWCa4Bk5pH4MnQamDca3D8TkZANTB79PCbf/screenshot_9_.png) I reached close to the well and noticed there were two Paper Dolls right below me. And when one of them moved a little far to check the alley, I jumped down and took the other one in a stealth. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTLF9ey4iKniobVBwvbMqGRcoa1wDY42ExhTTn2EjqfwD/screenshot_10_.png) Yeah, all other demons started chasing me after hearing the quiet rustle of my landing, so I ran backwards into a dark alley. I hid in the tight space where the demons couldn't reach me, but some of them got stuck on the other side of a partition. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdQ2zKqSaVaKn91dSSXBwZnbWo2i7zLtFbj6eGiM5WVP/screenshot_11_.png) I came out of the tight space hoping it would be easier to cleanse the well but a Shadow Hunter took me down even before I could plan anything. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXquN3HvKhrnoC7aXQ2vwM7Tg7HefVWeT3akTAuqRhe5y/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZMCpkusrhRD9gZWXpApFhTBnWHgh4NfGtQWm1En7M3My/screenshot_13_.png) At the restart, I found myself close to the second well after reloading my checkpoint. And this time, I didn't want to waste much time with setup, so I jumped beside the well right away and took down one of the Paper Dolls. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6pdG1X7E1maJa7vyLKxW5SrTeG5KtRFz1E5N9YRbUGQ/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRdWQgTECP3D9bvLyQBSNpgKusrSQLWZ8hjA1fjcpAycr/screenshot_15_.png) Then I hid in the same tight space I hid before and I could see all the demons who were trying to get to me through my spectral vision. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfAY2AJJApqZLMVNB7AjzgF9zEZGCi3Pdm4bkJ1p3nxFB/screenshot_16_.png) I have noticed some of them got stuck like before and I was close to a Shadow Hunter who was also stuck, but in another way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUgLWdCdUAieK4MWeEMPtsRVKupC8G6xpLv1KiiCEujdy/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZpWQCVKdAMxARBwnvKW5ZuDfN2jjiv74DQgWkunAgN6D/screenshot_18_.png) Then I got out of that tight space through another route to catch him off guard. And I decided to take care of the Shadow Hunter who got unstuck after there, peppering his glowing weak point with rapid bow shots until he dissolved. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYk24mhT9GNk2Kgnk6XwPL53HPjKG7Mg2dZ9ZY6jm3svr/screenshot_19_.png) A Paper Doll followed me, who was free from the structural trap. After getting to a distance from the well to find open ground, the Paper Doll started shooting fireballs toward me as she was not coming further from her spawn zone. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=hrichakar/e1388e93)

body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g76ac3d9c8528eb934ff5ad2cea622434c18800b775185f03c05bc09512b2b98fd58bf23bb6b945cad17762834465dc0ac33449aea4eb6ff6fc8116ba658252b5_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 사랑의 이야기

## 제목: **운명적인 만남**

### 1. 배경 설정
서울의 한 작은 카페. 바쁜 일상 속에서 사람들은 각자의 꿈과 고민을 안고 살아간다. 이 카페는 매일 아침, 다양한 사람들의 이야기가 얽히고 섥히는 곳이다.

### 2. 등장인물
- **지민**: 28세, 카페의 바리스타. 따뜻한 미소와 친절한 성격으로 많은 단골손님들에게 사랑받고 있다. 하지만 자신의 꿈은 아직 이루지 못한 상태.
- **현수**: 30세, 프리랜서 작가. 카페에서 글을 쓰며 영감을 얻고 있다. 외로움을 잘 느끼지만, 사람들과의 교류는 소중히 여긴다.

### 3. 이야기 전개
지민은 매일 아침 카페에서 일하며 손님들과 소통하는 것을 즐긴다. 그러던 어느 날, 현수가 카페에 들어온다. 처음에는 그저 한 손님일 뿐이었지만, 그의 독특한 분위기와 깊은 눈빛에 지민은 끌리게 된다.

현수는 카페의 구석에서 항상 글을 쓰고 있었고, 지민은 그의 작업을 도와주고 싶어 자주 대화를 시도한다. 두 사람은 점점 서로의 이야기를 나누며 가까워진다. 현수는 지민의 따뜻한 마음에 감동하고, 지민은 현수의 진솔한 이야기에서 위로를 받는다.

### 4. 갈등
하지만 두 사람의 관계는 순조롭지만은 않았다. 현수는 과거의 상처로 인해 사랑에 대한 두려움을 가지고 있었고, 지민은 자신의 꿈을 이루지 못한 불안감에 시달리고 있었다. 이러한 감정들은 서로에게 다가가는 것을 어렵게 만들었다.

### 5. 클라이맥스
어느 날, 지민은 현수가 다른 카페에서 글을 쓰는 모습을 우연히 보게 된다. 현수는 지민과의 관계를 회피하고 있는 듯 보였고, 지민은 상처받아 그를 멀리하려고 결심한다. 그러나 그날 밤, 두 사람은 서로에게 진솔한 마음을 털어놓기로 결심한다.

### 6. 결말

The purpose was to announce all the details of the musical event that El Sistema Lara has prepared to celebrate its 50 years of musical training for children and young people. El Sistema de Orquestas is a national system, and each state has its own regional organization. Each regional system is divided into different centers. For example, in the state of Lara, there are numerous centers: El Tocuyo, Carora, Duaca, Cuji Tamaca, José Félix Ribas, Cabudare, among others. body.title: Regaining the love of parents/ The old path
body.body:
>Exodus 20:12 “Honor thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.”

Regaining the love of our parents begins with humility, respect, and sincere repentance when we have done wrong. The Bible teaches children to honor their father and mother, not only through words but also through actions and obedience. Even though the relationship becomes tough for us to let things go because of how the other person treated us, God told us to always let things go and we should forgive. A changed attitude and a loving heart can help rebuild trust and restore broken family bonds.

The Bible also teaches that love within the family should reflect kindness, understanding, and compassion. Parents may become hurt because of disobedience, harsh words, or distance, but healing is possible when there is honesty and genuine effort to make peace. Through prayer, good behavior, and consistent respect, children can gradually regain the affection and confidence of their parents. God values unity in the family and desires peace among loved ones.

body.title: Beautiful Songs I Find Hard to Listen to
body.body:
Have you ever had a song you really like, but you struggle to listen to it because it makes you want to cry? I realised the other day that there are actually a few songs that make me feel like this now, or at least make me feel sad. I'd like to share the top four of them.

In 4th place is Ghost by Justin Bieber

https://youtu.be/Fp8msa5uYsc?si=wKAaUIlESP9B5-TI I'm actually not normally of a fan of Justin Bieber's music, so when I found out that this was his work I was a little surprised. While it doesn't make me cry, just sad, and I can listen to it and even sing along to it, I want to include it because it makes me think of my friend. In April 2023 her husband suddenly passed away in his sleep at the age of 57. It's over three years on and this loss still feels very fresh. She has a passion for photography so thankfully has lots of memories recorded of their time together and when she shares them and shares how she feels like she gets little signs from him I feel like this song describes how that can help someone in their grieving process: \

I'm not sure why it doesn't quite move me to tears, because I cried often enough when I learnt of my friend's loss. Perhaps it's because it speaks to me on how you can try to still keep the positives from the time you had together. It also has a fairly upbeat feel to it, which helps to counter the sadness of the lyrics. The writers of the song weren't focusing on any particular loss and it's meant to be about loss both through death and moving apart. It's also suggested that it was reflecting on those in the situation where they were restricted from seeing loved ones during Covid lockdowns.

In 3rd place is How do I Say Goodbye by Dean Lewis

https://youtu.be/QCtEe-zsCtQ?si=NoYx973id8-0X8Wp I first heard this song in the car and it reached the chorus before it caught my attention with the tune and lyrics. Immediately I knew it was about having to dealing with the loss of a parent: \

The tune and the implication of the words brought a lump to my throat. On one occasion I felt the urge to try and sing along to the chorus, but had to stop because it choked me up and I was ready to cry. As time has passed it doesn't make me as emotional as it did, perhaps because both of my parents are still alive, so it's not an experience I've directly lived. I can listen to it and even sing along now. Dean wrote this song for his father when he was diagnosed with an aggressive form of cancer and was only given a 25% chance of survival. Happily he went into remission so no goodbyes are needed just yet, but the song has been one of his best performers so far.

In 2nd Place is Everytime by Britney Spears

https://youtu.be/8YzabSdk7ZA?si=2tc0d-CGrpbLkvN5 This is one is a bit less self explanatory. It was released in 2004 and while I remember hearing and liking it back then it's only really come to my attention more recently with Britney's release of her book in 2023. This book has prompted fans to call attention back to it with the revelation in those memoirs that she fell pregnant with boyfriend, at the time, Justin Timberlake's baby and had an abortion because he wasn't wanting to be a father. She describes it as \

This has prompted many to wonder whether the song was actually written, at least in part, for the baby that she never got to have. While she doesn't seem to have responded to these rumours herself, her co-writer and others have said that it was about her break up with Timberlake and not the baby. However, with the lines which say \

and the feeling that it sounds to fans like a lullaby, this rumour isn't going anywhere any time soon. So officially the song is meant to be about a break up and there are 1000s of songs about heartbreak, so that's hardly going to get me emotional unless I've just experienced it. However, I am a mother and I know people with regrets who felt pushed to have an abortion because their partner didn't want a child. Therefore, *everytime* I hear the song now my mind can't help but think what it must be like to feel that regret and wonder what that child might be today if things had gone differently. Then I just end up in tears and have to switch it off.

and the 1st place goes to Wish You Were Here by Delta Goodrem

https://youtu.be/tFFq31fBoeI?si=8AwWlwPHWmCBcItz This song came out in October 2012, the year my father-in-law died over in the UK on the other side of the world from us. It had me in tears from the first time I heard it and I still can't listen to it today without crying, so I don't even attempt to any more. The line \

was the one that brought everything back for me the most, because while we were able to visit him a few weeks before his death we could only wait for the call to let us know when he actually passed. 

Delta wrote the song as a tribute to a close friend who died in a motorcycle accident at the age of 24. There is no indication of where this accident happened so the above line may be referring to the other side of the world in the spiritual rather than the physical sense, but for us the reference was literally also physical. Interestingly my Mother-in-law died nearly 10 years later and I was closer to her, but the song doesn't make me think of her, just him still. Maybe because I was able to grieve for her in a more positive way and had more positive memories to connect to her. Either that or I'd already connected the song to my father-in-law. 

***

*What are your thoughts on this list? Would you change the order for yourself and what songs would you remove or add and why?*

body.body:
# walking by the piers This post if for Wednesday walk challenge Any questions about the challenge read the guide at the Bottom of the post ;) Good Morning, Well its Hump Day and time for me to do a Wednesday Walk post, I hope your week is going well Today I will share a few shots from an early morning walk I took by the Boat ramp near the Harbor walk here in New Bedford. As I prepare this post to save as a draft, I just got back from a walk in this same spot, and it was a nice sunrise today than the day I got these shots, but even on moody days its nice to get out and get some fresh air and steps in to start the day THis is pretty much the same view I take my first shot each time I visit here, after I setup my tripod and camera after getting out of the car I take this shot as a check I have the settings right.
![WW the piers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tki3kJBbSTK1ZVU2YvJNKZMu1q1Q2y5dmftWutd4Pux2BJKJaTWxwiSKCwfzoYwPTni.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F7.1 30 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tki3kJBbSTK1ZVU2YvJNKZMu1q1Q2y5dmftWutd4Pux2BJKJaTWxwiSKCwfzoYwPTni.jpg)**

Then I start walking around the two piers at this location, this first one right beside the boat ramp there
![WW the piers-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wzvFzPmq3bM2J5NArJyLAhYitJ4YH8ujehuzatZvnPUrh8qDqHrpa2srGso67MEpXLB.jpg) **Sony A7iv 21mm F5.6 30 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wzvFzPmq3bM2J5NArJyLAhYitJ4YH8ujehuzatZvnPUrh8qDqHrpa2srGso67MEpXLB.jpg)**

And this one which is behind the Cisco Restaurant that white line tot he right of the pier, was a boat heading out
![WW the piers-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23uZmfUApoew4Yn2M2bGo15mXQGeKMVTWGkNEMhMvSrJZ7NWEGtz4BCh5bg3LK4PKjasC.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F5 30 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23uZmfUApoew4Yn2M2bGo15mXQGeKMVTWGkNEMhMvSrJZ7NWEGtz4BCh5bg3LK4PKjasC.jpg)**

and from out on the pier, looking back
![WW the piers-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245vk398N6Qme2xRF54kfvVHDBrVreG69TCx8KUt7cz9u6xLpSZMAFx8ryKqpmzGhQwq1.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 6 second ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245vk398N6Qme2xRF54kfvVHDBrVreG69TCx8KUt7cz9u6xLpSZMAFx8ryKqpmzGhQwq1.jpg)**

Wednesday Walk is a challenge started by me, the idea is to get out for a short walk and get some shots of what you can see within a short distance of your home office or wherever you start. And this is my entry for this week, but first, let me explain the challenge. This is my post for the Wednesday Walk challenge hosted by myself, let me first explain the guidelines > Try and get out once a week for a short walk, can be from your office, home or anywhere really and walk for a few blocks or a few minutes looking for things to get shots of. > Your walk does not have to be on a Wednesday I just ask if possible to share your walk photos on a Wednesday. > **Try and get a few shots not just one** > **Add a bit of a write up about where you walked** > **Just one Wednesday Walk tagged post a week** > You can look for anything in general or decide on one subject you want to get shots off. > Make a point of looking around and up and see what you can find to get shots of that otherwise you may miss > Do a post with the shots you get on a Wednesday and tag it with #wednesdaywalk, also if you happen to join, please leave a link to your post in a comment on this post and I will try and visit them all, especially if its not one of the first 5 tags or I may miss seeing it . > Following me and re-Hiving the post so more see it would be appreciated but isn't a rule just a suggestion. > I am not strict on these rules and hence why they are called guidelines and not rules > I will try and visit, and upvote all who take part in the Wednesday Walk. ## I hope a few of you may find this an interesting challenge and decide to join in. *** ## unless stated otherwise all photos used in my posts are taken and owned by myself, if you wish to use any of my images please contact me. ![Wednesday walk footer.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYjvvmdLTzDsP1iM8pdowePzr8pSUzgGrWUmQkyBpmxAb/Wednesday%20walk%20footer.jpg) *** ![ ](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/QGGXzaN9-4LQGm7AE-tattoodjay.gif) *** ![TEAMUSA JJ hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/so5RKHER-TEAMUSA20JJ20-hive.jpg) ## # **The Immutable Mirror: A Meditation on Truth, Projection, and the Divine Ledger**

## **The Architecture of Deception**

A lie is a lie.

It does not become truth through repetition. It does not become virtue through volume. It does not become reality because you have the power to enforce it. You may bend it, twist it, wrap it in the language of curation or community standards, but at its core, it remains what it always was: a falsehood.

How dare you do that?

How dare you take the mirror of your own conscience, cracked by the weight of unexamined actions, and hold it up to others, demanding they see their reflection in your distortion?

## **The Game of Lives and Time**

You downvote people away.

Not with dialogue. Not with guidance. But with the cold, mechanical precision of a weaponized algorithm. You cast your votes like stones into still water, creating ripples that drown voices before they find their audience. And then, with a flourish of moral superiority, you name them. You label them. You dismiss them.

But the truth is simpler, and far more damning:

You and your friends are playing a game.

A game with people’s lives. With their time. With their livelihoods. With their hope.

You treat the blockchain not as a public square, but as a playground where you hold the only toys. Where you make the rules. Where you decide who stays and who goes. And in doing so, you are not just wasting their time. You are wasting your own.

Every hour spent defending the indefensible. Every moment spent crafting narratives to justify suppression. Every breath used to call light darkness—it is all time stolen from the possibility of becoming better.

## **The Transparency of the Chain**

You cannot hide the truth on a blockchain.

This is not a threat. It is a fact. As inevitable as gravity. As certain as sunrise.

The ledger does not care about your titles. It does not care about your alliances. It does not care about the stories you tell in Discord channels or on Twitter feeds. It records only what *is*.

*   The coordinated downvotes.
*   The farming patterns.
*   The delegation networks.
*   The silence you enforce.

It is all there. Etched in cryptographic stone. Visible to all. Permanent.

You may try to obscure it with noise. You may try to distract with drama. But the data remains. And those who look—with eyes unclouded by complicity—will see it.

## **The Hope for Redemption**

We hope you can understand this.

Not because we wish you harm. But because we wish you wholeness.

We hope that one day, you will stop playing the game. That you will put down the weapon of the downvote. That you will look in the mirror—not the distorted one you hold up to others, but the true one provided by the ledger—and see yourself clearly.

And then, we hope, you will change.

You will choose to build rather than break. To lift rather than crush. To speak truth rather than enforce silence. You will do the right thing, not because you are forced, but because you finally understand that integrity is the only currency that matters in the end.

## **The Divine Witness**

Remember: God is watching.

He is always watching.

Not with the petty judgment of men. Not with the biased eye of the clique. But with the infinite, unblinking gaze of the Divine.

He sees the heart behind the hash. He sees the intention behind the transaction. He sees the fear that drives the control. He sees the pain that fuels the projection.

And He waits.

He waits for you to stop hiding. To stop pretending. To stop wasting your life on a game that was never yours to win.

For in the end, the blockchain will fade. The tokens will lose their value. The power will dissipate.

But the soul? The soul remains.

And what will you bring to that final accounting? A ledger full of suppressed voices? Or a heart full of redeemed time?

*Choose wisely. The Witness is patient. But He is not silent.*

body.title: My Fun Moment With Mommy D in the Kitchen: Made a Chewy Kakanin from Scratch with Crispy Sweet Glaze and Peanut Fillings
body.body: -in tagalog of course. Then minutes later I saw her doing something in the kitchen and thats when i saw a familiar pack if Glutinous Rice Flour. When I saw it, I got excited and I feel like I want to get involve. So, I asked her if she's making \

or something because I saw the familiar dough she's kneading. She said yes and so I suggested, I think it is good with crushed peanut and sugar in it or a Palitaw, but I added that we lack ingredients for it.\n\n<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eonk5vokuLLpj2ndNZvqEpYhVLUbgFMjKAPF61KFv2HU3psW8jWtCFh8p2PpHKCcm5q.jpg She experimented a bit and that's when she told me that I can help and I happily join in, hehe. There's just one thing in my mind, that's to make a chewy rice cake with crushed peanut and sugar in it. As for Mommy D, as I said, she's still thinking what to make to she's making shapes or whatever to get the result that she want.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eo4BbmNrj5B8LdGebQy4tmPQYa1ntRi6ax5z1krz2wPFUJwWgxGnEJgQcrDYkNQKh5J.jpg Look, this look like in a shape of Empanada haha, that's what I first thought, lol. It's cute and all but Mommy D still undecicded even after making this, lol

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eonj3dM2ZzVKgUKcA3VHXr5ET8HpNiJSek1GhhLLXTWfRXLqwFJW5yHg3SAbbqNdGRv.jpg As for me, I am already finish crushing the peanuts. I just added the sugar to make it sweeter. And my desired shape for this is flat round dough, and yes this fillings inside of it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eou7FCtpfQhjxsJjE8zWmnHWLBnRpmaqxytwneBFatswvDHgxNawQUyKKpf6UB7CnwA.jpg Just like this ＼⁠(⁠^⁠o⁠^⁠)⁠／. I only made two with this shape and fillings and the rest, Mommy D make whatever she want with it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK6JyK1goG6w9KubweNXwh1RnJm8UYn8nQ3TStaZvjmrdNMu1Gho4X2v4MCgddtL7x.jpg To make it more yummier I topped it with lots of sesame seeds. It already has fillings but putting it inside is kinda challenging because it always had holes in it. Thats also why I only made two on this shape lol.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoCgcgnU5ZTnyo8i8Tv2NaoKW4ax27VjAmpc3HkpFCk8NMq3jY1hymX7zHuqVDY3VoW.jpg Its frying time! And in the end Mommy D made it in this shape, like of a donut with huge hole in it. It is also covered in crushed peanuts with sugagr because I couldn't use all the peanuts I prepared.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoCj3mwECbKRNtiUazyxbemYfsPid3sPQQGNuw3QHxraWgrjyBFiYjDDUHH968tm2Zb.jpg And here's the cooked ones, it is not just a plain rice cake this time because it has crushed peanuts with sugar and sesame seeds in it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoEodFuV6dWYiA5mEBRHvHc7j1J2UP4YhnRXoywa8R89VS7NqZdPSx8AZQRzjiyShaG.jpg Now, to make it more delicious and ceispy, I just caramelized some brown sugar like this, just sugar y'all

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EogMNyEaU2tgW21PhpzSTkVNpstx21yzJMJWYeD56V3JKdmwShRSWpksAX2y7N5XmGL.jpg I dip just the one side of each rice cake in shape of donuts and there we have it. Look at that golden glaze and with spider web? Nahh, thats actually the caramelized sugar after it was stretch out. Actually, Mama thought it is a cat hair hahahaha

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EonjXppzb5XxZFqYVg2pBHJLo28p2Lzix32as82w2MTt5XYwrxiBZAtRCbwzNw58tvk.jpg And here's my version, with crushes peanuts and sugar inside. It looks good no? Taste so good too. I so love the crispiness of the sesame seed and the glaze on top. I also love the crunch inside of it coz of the peanut. Like ＼⁠(⁠◎⁠o⁠◎⁠)⁠／

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EokbdZqHHWdNnhcVsHihdKn7xTH68ZaSES3WCWmu6W9h8sDeT2XfFhDeUCEuhicX6uy.jpg But to be honest, I really want to make Palitaw too, with this as fillings: crushed peanuts and sugar. It doesn't need frying and just boiling then coat it with shredded coconut, the problem is THAT. We don't have it and grating is manually is a lot of work so I ended up with this. Still, it taste amazing so, nyam nyan! I recommend this guys. Wish I could share this to you all (⁠＾⁠∇⁠＾⁠)⁠ﾉ⁠♪. On top of that, making it is fun, then Mommy F really enjoy it, I mean all of us are. Everything's gone in a snap as we didn't make so much, but its enough to feed 4 people ♪⁠┌⁠|⁠∵⁠|⁠┘⁠♪ ----- Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/ggg6ifk008va33b)

body.title: 【大阪】道顿堀 Dotonbori
body.body:
话说回我和米特到大阪旅游的第一天，酒店的入住时间是下午三点，还没到三点我们就回去酒店大堂坐着等时间到。 凌晨的红眼航班让我们在飞机上也睡不踏实，第一天到大阪就已经感觉到困了，下午三点进了酒店房间的我们却睡了个午觉，起床已经是傍晚五点多，歇了两小时感觉精神多了。 米特接下来问我去哪？我说：**道顿堀** 在抵达「道顿堀」前，我们还在前往的路上一间拉面店吃了当天的晚餐，这间拉面店叫做「一兰拉面」。 吃完拉面的我们走着走着终于来到了「道顿堀」…… ---
**大阪五天四夜之旅
18/5/2026 - 22/5/2026
第一天**
--- **道顿堀** (Dotonbori) 是大阪很有名的旅游区之一，位于 **难波** (Namba)附近，同时接连着也是很有名的 **心斋桥筋** （Shinsaibashisuji) 这个大商店街。 我上网查了下历史，原来「道顿堀」在 1612 年开始挖运河，江户时代已经是戏院和娱乐区，现在变成了大阪的最强观光区。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48QuNpTJ9Jfdochtnb9t9jZA5Qx6Dktt85ieNXaCfLycR2MPwVVTfwkeTRM9gCxcHo.jpeg) 来到「道顿堀」这里就必须前往有名“戎桥”，上图里面对面那座桥就是了。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48RPgS8VEAx5rcG9uipXEPegVRG8bCu97YuhdnjjDdEJtmMPnMYfvysEqVyNYRVpnN.jpeg) 然后发现要从这里走去那座桥的河边小路，人潮多到感觉寸步难行。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48QRK5hbMYeB4dPiRd8tVxB8LHjsAEJDCqSreB1w9j3TqUxFwHHmSgNohH9pGvkNqv.jpeg) 为什么“戎桥”那么有名？因为这里可以打卡“固力果跑跑人”广告牌。 网上说必须要打卡“固力果跑跑人”才能证明来过「道顿堀」。 接下来就是在附近四处乱逛…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48JdwG75GSRvWDTtppABKZNYWvUvA9cytsrUEHyeaEVggYv8DXciUmeh6SPTtd7Mye.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Vj4xyZpXkyVqhJJPg2ddtaRgqy4pqXxAgAg8L4tWr5oZjZcaq8CArjvGq5Y7Kh18.jpeg) 走着走着就来到了「心斋桥筋」…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PTpiunKtgu9u1AZLACPpwCYwZn8sqpH9W4WhPVKBEfi3WUpubjTTAx6AHp3prUSd.jpeg) 我还以为「道顿堀」的游客很多了，没想到「心斋桥筋」的游客更多，可以用人山人海来形容了。 这里我们就没进去了，然后开始往回走。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PwoK4mvqWBwmNH2KHJT4Wv85DN1SiDVkQ6ArbBjo6px5kPEKZFspTKLjVpSJGsVz.jpeg) 走到某个桥上发现了睡觉的猫猫…… 这是别人饲养的猫，猫主人在这摆个篮子让它睡觉，结果好多人看见都是上前去抚摸，怎么摸都不醒，只是翻了个身继续睡。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48QRCT14axR1fbMayLPkHHC3myqS2botNoTsUzTkDvPwzKJ4yMGZJdA7aC2Q92ip4x.jpeg) 别人去打卡“固力果跑跑人”广告牌，这个桥看到的却是另类的广告牌，“和牛人广告牌”广告牌？ 走完这里，我们就已经开始往酒店的方向回去了。步行回酒店需要 20 分钟的路程，我们也慢慢的往酒店方向走去，路上顺便逛逛回程会经过的「千日前」商店街。
