body.title: And More Windows - May 25 & 26, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Big laundry day crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23vsJNP8dCm6drDtkMWrZ2bT4Fzm9XFwueyfiyJBPmv57YTUihN2UMNKFoohyNSvugGyu.jpg)

Monday morning I wasn’t moving too fast. It was cold and rainy outside, but warm inside due to woodstoves. I decided to get all my winter stuff washed so I can put it away soon. I’m really late doing this.

![Butter - 6.94 lbs crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoeDx8FJaHpkALgtXwaLnRp2ebNoUp7QuxAKUjaDK3Mxh9a7PvkfcWDMo2kNjcfLYjV.jpg)

I’d remembered I’d forgotten to do the butter on Sunday, so I got it packaged and weighed. We got 6.94 lbs.

![always.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23u657Wyda5xj8FgxW6kmnz88CABv6NZheZe1kde2M3naKseZ2eqkzNoT87CDJgRhJqqr.jpg)

During the afternoon I watched ‘Always’ which has a cameo of Audrey Hepburn in it. It was the last movie she did. It’s also the last movie of hers, besides ‘My Fair Lady’ that I have. I watched ‘My Fair Lady’ recently, so I’m not watching it again.

I ordered a couple of her movies from the library so I’ll have those to watch soon.

After that I sat and read and kept the laundry going until bedtime around 8PM.

![Last of the tulips from Corky crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eoc773NLnepLEuxk8PxKXq3WnhN9pFZRxcVtC5CRx3cYUqBMKHScWuER4aofwb3QAWP.jpg)

On Tuesday morning as I was closing up the house, I found a bucket of tulips on the porch. My youngest brother had brought them home from CT on Monday night from my oldest brother who works on a tulip farm. They are the last of the tulips there.

![Trashing for windows collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/243BiRDE1oVb6brwBhYmEmbmTpiCoav1p4J1Z41vtHGcXF42frdg7qhXDgYd5MwdzHKxc.jpg)

I was finishing up the laundry and prepping the living room for doing the 2 biggest windows and the last of the smaller ones. I had to take down all the seedlings and shelving to do this.

![Window prep supervisor crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eokc5MSoHBTZB98FERYTfUmMjCGMSmcyqHC7ju8NCrHEpvG8vznvMcSPEDf4c6Bhek6.jpg)

*Window prep supervisor asleep on the job*

I managed to get a load of dishes into the dishwasher just before my window guy arrived at 9AM. We got started on the windows in the living room but only did the big ones, as we were trying to avoid the sun on them.

While I was washing windows, he went to the office and moved all the stuff from the 3 big windows in there. We moved the operation into the office and got those 3 big windows done.

Then we got the doors to the office done and put the screens in finally. We went back to the living room and got the small window done as the sun was now off it. And finally we got the back porch door and trim finished. He had to go and I was wiped out.

![Oxalis flower crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/242rnntc37iSuGFqX4KG8UmeN2jWHZvjVcHFBi4GSyyXTEy7KnBcxzLhVa4rMZotxHrAe.jpg)

*Oxalis in flower*

My helper friend had arrived at 10:30AM and I asked him if he thought he could get the tomato stakes in by himself. But they are new tall ones and he needs someone to hold them while he pounds them in. So I asked him to clean the black fridge in the kitchen instead. 

Once that was done he had errands to run and was back just before 2PM. He decided to go home then to his AC.

![MA Drought Map 05-22-26 2_0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23yxC6eTkYxujRy66rfQgxZAccSUVaToMGiFRp47MBqFBGtgArQaa28FhTQG38vGp6NsJ.jpg)

*[source](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/drought-status)*

We’ve gotten some rain but apparently not enough and our drought status has worsened. 

I made some lunch and was in bed by 3PM and slept until 6PM under all my blankets, even though it was to reach 85F outside. I know I’m much too tired when I am that cold.

I got up and ate some supper and read for a while. I got the house opened up and was in bed by 9PM.

On Wednesday my window guy comes back for the last time. We need to put all the seedling shelves back up, put the furniture back, wash the back door in the office, and go to the cellar to put away all the storm windows. If there’s still time, we will also put away all the plant shelving that got taken down there a month ago.

It’s to hit the mid 80’s again so no gardening. I need to finish the laundry, folding it and putting it away and sorting out my winter clothes to be put away. I’ve also got to finish cleaning up the kitchen.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

# **The Immutable Mirror: A Meditation on Truth, Projection, and the Divine Ledger**

## **The Architecture of Deception**

A lie is a lie.

It does not become truth because you repeat it. It does not become virtue because you cloak it in the language of curation. It does not become justice because you wield it with the power of a whale.

No matter how much you try to bend reality, no matter how much you twist the narrative to fit your needs, the core remains unchanged. Deception is a hollow structure. It may look like a castle from a distance, but up close, it is made of smoke.

And when you project your own fractures onto others—when you call *them* scammers, *them* farmers, *them* spammers—you are not diagnosing the community. You are revealing yourself.

## **The Psychology of Projection**

How dare you?

How dare you take the chaos within your own spirit and paint it onto the faces of those who simply wish to speak?

You downvote people away. You silence voices that challenge your comfort. You erase content that threatens your monopoly on attention. And then, with a straight face, you label *them* the abusers. You call *them* the farmers. You call *them* the spammers.

This is not curation. This is projection.

It is the psychological reflex of the guilty: to accuse the innocent of the very crimes you commit in the shadows. You play a game with people’s lives, with their time, with their livelihoods. You treat their labor as disposable, their voices as noise, their presence as an inconvenience to your curated empire.

But in doing so, you are wasting your own time. You are spending your precious, non-renewable hours defending what is wrong. You are building a fortress around a falsehood, knowing that the foundation is rotting beneath your feet.

## **The Blockchain as Confessional**

You cannot hide the truth on a blockchain.

This is not a metaphor. It is a technical reality. The ledger does not care about your press releases. It does not care about your alliances. It does not care about your self-righteous posts.

It records:
*   The coordinated downvotes cast without skin in the game.
*   The rewards farmed through interconnected accounts.
*   The silencing of dissent while preaching freedom.

Every action is etched in cryptographic stone. Every pattern is visible to those who know how to look. You may hide behind pseudonyms, but you cannot hide behind mathematics. The truth is there, waiting for you to acknowledge it.

We hope you can understand this. Not as a threat, but as an invitation. An invitation to stop running. To stop hiding. To stop pretending.

## **The Possibility of Redemption**

We hope that one day, you change.

Not because we force you. Not because we shame you. But because you choose to.

Because you realize that power is not a weapon to be wielded, but a trust to be honored.
Because you realize that community is not a clique to be protected, but a garden to be tended.
Because you realize that truth is not an enemy to be defeated, but a light to be followed.

Do the right thing. Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. But now.

Stop the downvotes. Stop the projection. Stop the game.

## **The Divine Witness**

And remember: God is watching.

He is always watching.

Not with the petty judgment of men. Not with the biased algorithms of whales. But with the quiet, unblinking eye of eternity.

He sees the harm you cause.
He sees the lies you tell.
He sees the pain you inflict on those who only sought to be heard.

And He sees the potential for redemption within you.

The choice is yours. Will you continue to build a legacy of shadows? Or will you step into the light, admit your errors, and begin the hard, holy work of repair?

The ledger remembers. The world watches. And God waits.

*For in the end, truth does not need defenders. It only needs time. And time is running out.*

You move your pieces—your delegated accounts, your coordinated votes, your allied whales—as if they were tokens on a board. You strike when it suits you. You defend when it benefits you. You play with people’s lives, their time, their livelihoods, their creative spirits.

Eid al-Adha means the festival of sacrifice, a great sign of unconditional love for Allah. And one of our main tasks around this Eid is to sacrifice animals for the satisfaction of Allah. The main purpose of sacrifice is not just to slaughter an animal, but behind it lies a great lesson: to sacrifice one's inner pride, greed, and animalistic nature. For the satisfaction of Allah Almighty, Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) was ready to sacrifice his most beloved thing. In memory of that historical sacrifice, we sacrifice animals every year. body.title: Virat Kohli Father Name Age Profession and Family
body.body:
Indian cricket star Virat Kohli is one of the most successful batters in world cricket. Fans are always curious to know about his personal life, especially details related to [virat kohli father](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/virat-kohli-father-mother-name-age-death-date-photos-profession-mother-tongue-more-19139/), mother, family background, and childhood struggles. Virat Kohli was born on November 5, 1988, in Delhi, India, into a Punjabi Hindu family. His father played a major role in shaping his cricket career from an early age.

The name of **virat kohli father** was Prem Kohli. He worked as a criminal lawyer in Delhi and was known for supporting Virat’s cricket dreams since childhood. Despite having a busy professional life, Prem Kohli made sure his son attended cricket practice regularly and received proper coaching. Virat has often spoken emotionally about the sacrifices his father made for his career.

Virat Kohli’s mother’s name is Saroj Kohli. She is a homemaker and has always been a strong emotional support for the Indian cricket icon. Virat shares a close bond with his mother and frequently credits her for keeping the family united during difficult times. He also has an elder brother named Vikas Kohli and an elder sister named Bhawna Kohli.

One of the biggest emotional moments in Virat Kohli’s life came in 2006 when his father passed away due to a brain stroke. The death date of Prem Kohli was December 18, 2006. At that time, Virat was only 18 years old and playing a Ranji Trophy match for Delhi against Karnataka. Even after hearing the heartbreaking news, Virat returned to the field the next morning and completed his innings for Delhi. This incident showed his dedication and mental strength, which later became a major part of his cricket identity.

The story of **virat kohli father** continues to inspire millions of cricket fans across the world. Virat has openly admitted that losing his father at a young age changed his life completely and motivated him to achieve success in cricket. He considers his father as the biggest inspiration behind his journey from Delhi streets to international cricket stardom.

Virat Kohli’s mother tongue is Punjabi, though he speaks Hindi and English fluently. Growing up in Delhi helped him develop confidence and aggression, which are now visible in his batting style and leadership skills. Today, Virat Kohli is married to Bollywood actress Anushka Sharma, and the couple has become one of India’s most admired celebrity pairs.

From a young cricket enthusiast in Delhi to becoming one of the greatest batters in modern cricket, Virat Kohli’s journey is deeply connected to the support and guidance of his parents. The contribution of **virat kohli father** Prem Kohli remains an unforgettable chapter in the cricket legend’s life story.

body.title: Horses, Robins and Squirrels on My Wednesday Walk
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmbuhXZ4kcFJhH4ZV39kShLpgWZE8fTJjaCmvHyD5j3sx8/file_00000000548471f4aab5b9c5f7d91ac5.jpeg

While I’m cat and house sitting for a friend, I have been getting out for a little walk around the area each day. Today, for my #wednesdaywalk initiated by @tattoodjay, I started off near the horse's field to walk up to the village park.  Can you spot the little robin on the ground?

https://images.hive.blog/DQme8bsq3kCAGd8NTxY1tMjquZe9j7DkcXGHaavTRW6yQqo/20260527_095857.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUJBMd3kkA3bnADMFjBHWTdxPkrxC3byp4eL3KppVxv6q/20260527_095957.jpg
Today, the weather was much better. It was still warm, but not as hot as it has been lately, which was a relief. I still found myself stopping in the shade now and then to cool down for a few minutes.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmX2qMaWmAxE6BNHZm4sKKdm7Eb36RQZ6oBvpD3tHRstq1/20260527_095944.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRMUsDRbBqnNHjPAaAX8XkCtS4JT8DYEYEt27vjokBD3C/20260527_100515~4.jpg
As I walked along the footpath by the park, there was lots of cow parsley growing at the side.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTUSny9jWryqEhiUUE9jkxN7Zt61PyQh49uhkJmQ5Mdn/20260527_100210.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSFVgbFGCK9VKCcsR4j3tnsd2PSMB38NtztkdKjGo83LC/20260527_100450.jpg

Can you spot the squirrel?  It stayed there for a while listening out for me.  Unfortunately, I needed to go through this entrance so the squirrel finally ran off.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmacd8yk3ooavrxXeLLdM8ScmTRQkT7g7zuC3UaMyyUXrA/20260527_100739.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRmS99RWHwUJzfTqauezZhexEuWz9Yxp7Fyo9QwjpvLey/20260527_100630.jpg

The park itself was quiet, after the bank holiday, with only a few people out enjoying the cooler weather.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPy88PCKPPXjtGpF3kDwH72o1bs39QhHihMx4JjXgWJpe/20260527_101404.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVwpV9n9hGZGd6DXGow3fUUeEEThUWXznr3Ufj4cP4kRv/20260527_100920.jpg

I also decided to do a small litter pick while I was there. I spotted a few empty bottles lying near the park benches. With all the hot weather we’ve had recently, I honestly expected to find much more rubbish, so it was nice to see the park looking fairly clean overall.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

***

# The Secret Lives of Penguins: Social Dynamics and Communication in the Cold

Penguins are often perceived as simple, charming creatures waddling across icy landscapes, but beneath their adorable exterior lies a complex social structure and sophisticated communication methods. In this post, we will explore the fascinating social dynamics of penguins and how they communicate in their frigid habitats.

## Social Structure

Penguins are highly social birds that thrive in colonies, which can range from a few dozen to several thousand individuals. Their social structures are intricate and can vary significantly between species. Here are some key aspects of their social dynamics:

### 1. **Hierarchy and Roles**
Within a colony, penguins establish a hierarchy based on age, size, and breeding status. Dominant individuals often have priority access to resources such as food and nesting sites. During breeding season, the roles become even more defined, with some penguins taking on the responsibility of incubating eggs while others forage for food.

### 2. **Cooperative Breeding**
Many penguin species, such as the Emperor Penguin, exhibit cooperative breeding behaviors. This means that individuals within the colony may assist each other in raising chicks, providing protection and sharing food. This cooperation enhances the survival rates of the young and strengthens social bonds within the group.

### 3. **Parenting Partnerships**
Penguins are known for their strong pair bonds. Many species mate for life, and both parents share the responsibility of incubating eggs and feeding their chicks. This partnership is crucial in the harsh environments they inhabit, where food can be scarce.

## Communication

Penguins have developed a variety of vocalizations and physical displays to communicate with one another. Here are some of the most notable methods:

### 1. **Vocalizations**
Penguins are vocal birds, and their calls serve multiple purposes, including attracting mates, signaling danger, and maintaining group cohesion. Each species has its own unique set of calls, and individual penguins can often recognize the calls of their mates and chicks among the cacophony of the colony.

### 2. **Body Language**
In addition to vocalizations, penguins use body language to convey messages. For example, a penguin may bow its head or flap its wings to assert dominance or to court a potential mate. These non-verbal cues are crucial for maintaining social harmony within the colony.

### 3. **Chemical Communication**
Recent research has suggested that penguins may also use chemical signals to communicate. These signals can convey information about an individual’s reproductive status or health, further enriching their social interactions.

## Conclusion

The social dynamics and communication methods of penguins are as intricate as the icy landscapes they inhabit. Understanding these behaviors not only deepens our appreciation for these remarkable birds but also highlights the importance of conservation efforts to protect their habitats. As climate change continues to impact their environments, safeguarding penguin colonies is essential for the survival of these fascinating creatures and the intricate social systems they have developed.

By observing the secret lives of penguins, we gain valuable insights into the complexities of animal behavior and the importance of social structures in the animal kingdom. Next time you see a penguin, remember that there’s much more to these charming birds than meets the eye!

body.title: Wednesday Walk: A Walk Toward Health, Happiness, and Reflection
body.body:
***Wednesday afternoons have slowly become one of my favorite moments of the week. Amid busy schedules, responsibilities, and the stress life sometimes brings, there is something comforting about taking a simple walk with my cousins. It may sound ordinary to some people, but for me, those walks are more than just a form of exercise. They are moments of healing, bonding, self-reflection, and appreciation for the beauty that surrounds us.***

![123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/48SMMt1fWK7amgyNYYtLeS7rg2gHFadMrbTXq8HytiQTvkKsuQCqE7EUCscMu9G3Kp.jpg)

Every Wednesday afternoon, when the heat of the day slowly softens and the cool breeze starts to appear, my cousins and I prepare ourselves for our usual walk. We wear comfortable clothes, bring water bottles, and head outside with excitement. The walk is not about reaching a destination quickly. *Instead, it is about enjoying every step, every conversation, and every peaceful moment along the way.*

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoMF7ySYgcMZ4EGKxy77r5cRF8WZCJtwULc2pEpmUv7eUQGwXhPPV9HAhEQ3NxLkZ1n.jpg)

***As we walk together, I realize how important it is to prioritize health.*** In today’s fast-paced life, many of us often forget to take care of our bodies because we are too busy with work, responsibilities, and personal concerns. Sometimes we spend hours sitting, scrolling on our phones, or overthinking stressful situations. Because of this, I decided to slowly change my lifestyle by making walking a regular habit. Walking may seem simple, but it gives many benefits to both the body and the mind.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/245cesauFrUVJeifimmfKdS8xJ8aEPsBaW98uRkykHwkLU7oBnSFvyXybWEM83USnmboa.jpg)

***During our Wednesday walks, I feel my body becoming lighter and more active.*** The movement helps improve my energy and makes me feel refreshed after a tiring day. More importantly, walking gives me peace of mind. It allows me to breathe deeply, release stress, and clear my thoughts. Instead of worrying, I focus on the rhythm of my steps and the beauty around me. It reminds me that health is not only about physical appearance but also about mental and emotional well-being.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/2432FbjvtVkPuFVMS9by3L9iRLVdA3eF5jPxXgHhY7hR2P5wz6B4WiUi6Wx5zJTzH5wdt.jpg)

***One of the best parts of our walk is the bonding time with my cousins.***Life becomes busier as we grow older, and sometimes it becomes difficult to spend quality time with family members. That is why I treasure these Wednesday afternoons so much. While walking, we talk about many things — funny memories, future dreams, life struggles, and even simple random topics that make us laugh. Those conversations create priceless memories.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xyQuyox5UTbqmg12AWTfRxopzpQMZUuwXuma6mUp7n2MRh1QZy52Fk8YCUQ7NnWsH61.jpg)

***There are moments during our walk when we suddenly burst out laughing over old childhood stories.*** Sometimes we tease each other, share our personal experiences, or enjoy the comfortable silence as we walk side by side. These bonding moments remind me that family is one of the greatest blessings in life. Having people who walk beside you not only physically but also emotionally makes life lighter and happier.

***Aside from the bonding and exercise, another thing I truly love during our walks is discovering beautiful spots around us.***Sometimes we pass by quiet streets lined with tall trees dancing with the wind. Other times, we see beautiful sunsets painting the sky with shades of orange, pink, and gold. There are also peaceful corners where flowers bloom naturally, small stores filled with life, and open spaces where the fresh air feels calming.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EpT4iBWkJDA3i5TXGXAQiYKMSyJR8o5G9FAB5zNnzf1PPCm2wBLwBrr77aLPbTtxPeq.jpg)

***As someone who appreciates peaceful and beautiful surroundings, these simple views bring joy to my heart.***I realize that beauty does not always have to be expensive or grand. Sometimes, the most beautiful things are the ordinary scenes we often overlook because we are too busy. Watching the sunset during our walks reminds me to slow down and appreciate life more. The calmness of the afternoon sky gives me comfort and hope, especially during stressful days.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23zkdXcmceKFHmBrZPXVMAfdFKTwsxBWziA8uZatmZ5Lo4SRpApQT2XGfUec7JcysNq9n.jpg)

*Walking also became a time for self-reflection. While taking every step, I often think about my life, my goals, and the kind of person I want to become. The quiet moments during our walk help me organize my thoughts. I reflect on my growth, my struggles, and the lessons I continue to learn every day.*

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23wMgp3wxQtWBkkLHSGNLWZiaqzcu7UGy3TPD3oW9pe95BjEhJpyweYSWTBF7RTEmrTxB.jpg)

***There are times when life feels overwhelming, especially with work responsibilities and personal pressures.*** But during our Wednesday walks, I feel emotionally lighter. I remind myself that progress does not always have to be fast. Just as walking is about taking one step at a time, life is, too. Every small effort toward self-improvement matters. Every step toward a healthier lifestyle matters. Every moment spent with loved ones matters.

***These walks also taught me the importance of balance.***Life is not only about working hard or chasing goals. It is also about taking time for yourself, taking care of your health, and creating meaningful memories with the people you love. Sometimes the best therapy does not come from expensive things. Sometimes healing comes from simple walks, heartfelt conversations, fresh air, and peaceful sunsets.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/244KZwV6g5pPCr5oKwLQYzxUFyD3PRM3vCejQP22ehUWN8HXLACKKHJW5ZUwCDLvMZJNV.jpg)

***As Wednesday afternoons become part of my routine, I know these walks will always hold a special place in my heart. They remind me to slow down, appreciate life, and stay connected with the people who matter most. More than just a physical activity, our walks became a symbol of self-care, family bonding, gratitude, and inner peace.***

***Indeed, every Wednesday walk is not just about exercise. It is a journey filled with reflection, laughter, beautiful scenery, and love — simple moments that make life truly meaningful.***

body.title: My Quiet ME Time at DK Press
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8VkbmEsVXmvqk6pjJyYTE1JcjBZ6X8kP9tphqNygT24/img_6324.jpg)

*In my 30s, I realized how important it is to spend quality time with yourself.*

*When I was younger, I thought having fun always meant being with other people. But now, I learned that spending time alone is important too. Life gets busy and work is usually stressful. As we get to adulthood, we tend to focus on our responsibilities that we forget to take care of ourselves.*

*So I decided to slow down and spend more time for myself, working on both my physical and mental well being.*

---------------------------------------------------------------------

Once a week, after work, I spend my ***\

*** at **DK Press**, a coffee shop near both my office and my house. I love it because it is convenient, but more than that, I love the ambiance. I usually go around 1:30 PM when the cafe is still quiet. There are only a few customers, soft jazz music is playing, and the place feels peaceful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavBhiSeFYkuoKsSCzbXvvAaAYRFmoi5TuUjcCYYWsEYC/img_6307.jpg)
> ***Pastries and desserts to choose from.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVetpJmFaiu49qR4D5kcvZTdoEPfzXJLAJ4ZF5xRxJ5V4/img_6312.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgRAQCBqe2HTM7KTvT29RLXBc26eaBFoC9et1mdqvXYt/img_6325.jpg)

*This time, I ordered an iced sugarcane drink with tea and lemon and paired it with blueberry cheesecake. The drink was refreshing.* Honest review though that their cheesecake is just 2 stars over 5 compared to what I usually have at starbucks, what did I expect? It's cheeper anyways. 

After I finished the cheesecake, it was still too early to go home so I ordered another one to give their pastries a chance. This time it is a caramel cheesecake.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdoFsnL3isGNpGpZp6KqZtytNeUBvsyMb2nwTaJtzKM6o/img_6317.jpg)

**Too sweet.**

At that point, I gave up on the cafe's pastries and desserts. 
But I did not let that ruin my mood. I came there to relax, enjoy my own company, and slow down for a while.

Let me show you what makes this place relaxing:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxhKiW4rLvCyN1Y6kuTSASMSzbJdfu3Y8j2RQUzaThFz/img_6309.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPi6SbYELsZ7h1Sfvsw5u5yGKx8nkFaGCKLouQLcKAuB/img_6310.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYeJyygzovPXS7rRceQzBCVAePK6vp6ou4ZmGxa3yUk45/img_6308.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtjpWBNDiQ8AoHsBZy1HS6Vrn6TTHEKeqhKH29cmejE2/img_6311.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPefyLJJbT3mAqM3kFveF89hkcQfYMaJahNtYUQ6WGXM1/img_6314.jpg)
>**Proof that I was here: mandatory mirror selfie.**

As I get older, I learned that being alone does not always mean being lonely. Sometimes, happiness is simply sitting in a quiet place, listening to good music, enjoying a cold drink, and finding peace in your own little corner of the world.

I hope you felt relaxed while reading this as well.

The ETABS [Training](https://aeodc.com/education/etabs-structural/) Course at [AEODC](https://aeodc.com/education/) is designed for civil engineers, structural engineers, and construction professionals who want to develop strong expertise in structural analysis and design using industry-standard tools. This comprehensive program combines beginner fundamentals with intermediate and professional-level workflows to ensure complete mastery of structural modeling and design practices.

This ETABS Structural Design Course focuses on real-world applications, enabling learners to work on building structures such as residential, commercial, and high-rise projects using advanced structural engineering concepts.

Candidates who successfully clear (achieving more than 85%) the AEODC evaluation exam post training may be offered an opportunity to work with AEODC on live structural and BIM-based projects as an Intern and/or Contract basis with the possibility of converting to full-time.

Freshers may be selected for structured internship programs to gain hands-on project experience, while experienced professionals may be considered for contract-based or full-time roles based on performance, skill alignment, and project requirements.

All opportunities are strictly performance-driven and aligned with AEODC’s quality standards.

body.title: Patent Registration for Startups: Must Do Before Launch Product
body.body:
# What Startups Must Do Before Launching Your Product

Innovation is something that adds value to your business, especially more important for startups. In the case, when you do new inventions whether it is new software or new devices or chemical formulas or AI-based innovation, protecting these types of intellectual property rights is more important before being introduced in the market. Some of the founders or owners focus on capital, branding and marketing as well, but forget to focus on intellectual property assets to protect.

Knowing about the [patent filing](https://iprindiaonline.org/patent-registration.php) process can help startups to secure their inventions, protect from misuse and also increase their brand value. Before launching a product in a market, founders or owners must focus on intellectual property laws and prepare according to that so that their intellectual property can be protected.

This article will help to understand all the things that startups should consider before starting patent filing and other marking activities.

## Meaning of Patent

A patent is one of the types of intellectual property rights that gives exclusive legal rights to use or sell or license their registered innovation.

The patent is generally valid for 20 years from the application filed date. For that, inventors need to publicly disclose technical details of how the invention works actually so people can learn from their invention.

## Why Does Patent Registration Matter?

Patent registration has several reasons to matter, specially beneficial of startups are:

Stop Copying : Helps to prevent competitors from copying and selling your invention in any forms.

Investor Opportunity : Attract the investor by getting protection for your business ideas.

Competition Blocks : Get opportunity of market monopoly for up to for the period of 20 years.

Increase Prices: Get opportunity to accept an acceptable hike in price because of no direct competitors.

Rewards : Get reimbursed for the time and money that the inventor spent on development. 

## Requirements Before Patent Filing

Before starting the patent filing process, startups must check that their invention satisfied all legal requirements as per the patent law.

### New or Novelty

An invention must be new and not be disclosed on a public platform. Before filing, public disclosure may destroy their patent registration such as: 

*   Demonstrations of product

*   Publication of website

*   Announcements on social media

*   Research publications

Startups must maintain confidentiality agreements and avoid prior disclosure before starting patent filing.

### Inventive Step

The invention must have inventive steps that are not common or easy to a person who is technically skilled. Minor changes to existing technology generally do not qualify for patent registration.

### Industrial Uses

The invention must have industrial uses i.e., practical uses not just a theoretical base. Ideas, business methods without technological significance, and discoveries that exist in nature may be subject to objection.

### Prior Search

Patent searching is one of the most crucial activities before filing for a patent. It assists in finding out if there is any similar invention present.

Patent research will minimize the chances of rejection and help the startup determine how commercially capable the invention is. Usually, the patent authority investigates:

*   Check the existing patent databases

*   Specifications of published patent

*   Scientific journals

*   Technical documentation

*   International patent records

A detailed analysis of the patent search can also assist in drafting stronger claims and avoid future infringement.

## Major Legal Considerations of Patent Registration in India

When startups are registering patents in India, it becomes imperative for them to comply with the provisions of the Indian Patents Act, 1970. The Indian Patent regime operates on the basis of the 'first-to-file' system.

### Provisional vs Complete Specification

Startup companies normally begin with a provisional specification for an invention that is still under development. It allows you to get an early filing date and extra time to develop the invention before filing the complete specification.

Complete specification includes:

*   Description of the invention

*   Patent claims

*   Technical drawings if necessary

*   Abstract of the invention

*   Best mode of carrying out the invention

Objections regarding inadequate disclosure of the invention can be raised by the Indian Patent Office.

## Benefits For Startups Under Indian Patent Rules

The Government of India also introduced the several benefits for startups are:

*   Lower filing costs

*   Fast examination procedures

*   Intellectual property facilitation support

*   Faster processing times

These are major benefits that encourage new innovation and also simply the patent registration process for businesses.

## How to Register a Patent Before Product Launch

Some of the startup owners or founders think to launch first and get legal protection later. But this can lead to legal and other commercial risks for startups.

### Maintain Confidentiality

Before starting talking about your invention with vendors or developers or investors or startups should execute:

*   Non-disclosure agreements (NDAs)

*   Employment confidentiality agreements

*   Intellectual property assignment agreements

These documents help establish ownership rights and also make it difficult to copy or steal your business secrets.

### Patent File Before Public Presence

Inventors need to register a patent before launch in any public platform or commercial release.Public disclosure may risk your patentability.

By early filing, startups can better their legal position in case of future legal disputes or infringement.

### Prepare Draft for Strong Patent Claim

Patent claims define what extent the patent will cover legally. Poorly constructed claims might limit your ability to enforce your patent rights commercially.

Professional patent drafting generally includes:

### Independent Claims

It defines the broad scope of protection.

### Dependent Claims

They include further technical restrictions and serve as fallbacks at the time of examination or litigation.

The drafting process of claims will make them stronger legally and increase their licensing possibilities.

## Common Mistakes Startups Must Avoid

### Delay in Legal Protection

Most Startups avoid filing for intellectual property protection because of cost issues but they don’t know delays can result in losing your rights when others file.

### Rely on Trademark or Copyright

Copyrights protect expressions, while trademarks protect brand identity. Inventions usually need to have patents to get exclusive rights to sell the product.

### Ignoring International Filing Guidelines

If a startup plans to expand internationally, consideration of international patent protection filing strategy through PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty) or direct international filings must be considered.

### Poor Documentation

Maintaining invention disclosure records, development timelines, research notes, and inventor agreements can help during hearing and future legal disputes.

### Legal Enforcement and Its Commercial Value

A patent grant is more than just a certificate. The following are some of the uses of patent grants in businesses:

*   Attracting investors

*   Enhancing startup value

*   Technology licensing

*   Merger and acquisition processes

*   Market exclusivity

Patent owners can initiate infringement proceedings against unauthorized access and get compensation in the case of court orders, damages, or royalty claims under applicable law.

**Also read:** Latest IPR tracking blog to [track patent application status](https://iprindiaonline.org/articles/track-online-ip-ipr-applications-india.php) from official government portal.

### Conclusion

Startups that want to be competitive in Indian markets must make their  intellectual property as per their business strategies. Complete knowledge of the Indian patent process can help Startups to protect innovations, avoid infringement, and also build long commercial benefits.

Before releasing a product in the market, startups should carefully consider issues of patentability, conduct proper patent searches, maintain confidentiality, and file all relevant legal documents. Early application for patents does not only provide inventors with better protection but helps to build trust among investors, partners, and clients.

body.title: My Personal Space Is My Comfort Zone. Loh290.
body.body: > My favourite safe heaven for relaxation is honestly a space where I am alone with my thoughts and the things I like, Maybe with things like my phone, my laptop, my earpod, good music, and just peace around me, seriously that is really it for me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmauvPeQhfZTYtXgbryfDsH5bUgyawJ1vhE9qCptZfdr3a/1779876311690.jpg) Some people find relaxation in crowded places, parties, outings, or always being around people, but for me, I genuinely enjoy my own company sometimes, therebis just something calming about being in a quiet space where nobody is stressing you, nobody is asking questions, and nobody is expecting anything from you at that moment. That kind of space feels safe to me. And honestly, it is not even about doing anything serious sometimes I just lie down with my earpod in and listen to music for hours other times I scroll through my phone, watch random videos, or just sit there thinking about life, funny enough, those little moments help me relax more than anything expensive ever could. I think one reason I love that kind of environment is because life can already be too loud, there is always something happening, responsibilities, conversations, work, family matters, overthinking, social media, pressure from life itself… everything just comes at you nonstop, so whenever I finally get a moment alone, it feels like my mind can breathe again. That is my favourite safe heaven. My own little corner where I can just exist without trying too hard. And I have noticed that those quiet moments help me reconnect with myself too, sometimes when I am alone with my thoughts, I understand myself better there, I do reflect on things, I calm down emotionally, and sometimes I even figure out solutions to any problems that have been stressing me before, It is like my brain works better when there is less noise around me. Another thing is that being alone doesn’t automatically mean being lonely, I think people confuse those two a lot, for me, my alone time is actually comforting, it is peaceful, It is where I recharge myself mentally and emotionally. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYSmpKkjgZ9sQ8Zwso6WPi5FkKyfzooTJDh68HvrJCui/1779876385752.png) There are days I can stay in one position with my music playing softly and feel completely okay with life, no pressure, no competition, no trying to impress anybody, just me enjoying my own little world for a while. And honestly, I think everybody deserves a safe space like that, aplace where they can relax and fully be themselves without feeling watched or judged, mine just happens to be very simple. No fancy setup. No deep explanation. Just me, my gadgets, good music, silence, and peace of mind. Seriously....that is enough for me. Because at the end of the day, sometimes the best kind of relaxation is not found in expensive places or big activities, sometimes it is simply found in having a small moment to yourself where your mind can finally rest. And honestly? That is my favourite feeling in the world. ***First Image Is Mine, Second Image Is Modified With ChatGpt*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.title: Street Photos From My Chiang Mai Walk
body.body:
Thailand is paradise in many ways, and I guess everyone has their own idea of what paradise looks like. For some, maybe it is the beaches, the mountains, or the temples. For me, during this visit, paradise also appeared in the ordinary streets of Chiang Mai.


![1000161867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23y8wwhGKLybmRg1vJFyfnVuuHrsXwacuSx4wD6catQN97bkNUQg8CaL952GCCiRnAQvn.jpg)






Chiang Mai is one of Thailand’s best places to travel, but I also think it is a good place for digital creators. It has the calm vibe, interesting corners, good cafes, unique neighborhoods, and a lot of visual stories happening everywhere. It is the kind of place where you do not really need to plan too much. You can just walk around with your camera and somehow there will always be something worth capturing.


![1000161866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/243M5ShZgtZiUThMf5CcKdyKe5fNJAVJXF3FZy36o68CV3vugGzNNj6m41TRDqPs27rW2.jpg)

![1000161865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/243WPu7u3WWqZM7pKaxhn1T9Gdfv3d27uj34KnfrQ73dVVnEcziyfYqghkeDeYwyD5iTh.jpg)

![1000161864.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/244KRL18m8NTgHJB3cM3gk2kLQBoMvxgT4qKz8xMCQbRidpmqG6H3EWRbGc6oJT1NQoEK.jpg)

![1000161862.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/241tfhogC6umvGgVfyv9qD6aBoWMX95FMZuAWvPDHg494G61sNw5BSscSYEW9KZ41do1y.jpg)

![1000161858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23xKxj6eLEXQt5NwEFHkLSyCQZ3Xcd26ctp2YPi9SfDP2REmnmcdY2L9kc7LxTBAVdqqH.jpg)


For me, what makes Chiang Mai special is its raw beauty. I don’t know exactly how to explain it, but almost every aspect of the city feels interesting to photograph. Maybe because I am not used to seeing this kind of local community and street life every day. The buildings, the signs, the food stalls, the vehicles, the dogs, and even the electric boxes on the sidewalk all have their own character.

![1000161868.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoyRRRRZWXwvxjbguREYbwqb2qNXhi7agBAWQsJP3QRoRfYksNyPnTfJDzuEPU7nqPm.jpg)

One of the first things that caught my attention was the taxi. In Chiang Mai, they have these three-wheeled vehicles that also serve as taxis. They are really eye-catching, especially with their small body, black color, shiny metal parts, and that classic “TAXI” sign on top. I have never seen anything like it before in my daily life, so seeing one parked along the street already felt like a good photo subject. It looks fun to ride around the city in one of those LOL.


![1000161856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpT4iBMy8wiF6vZK4Z5318Y51V9NiHzLGwM4gBgacqEpfqy1qkwBZNXaXYxogRfpo27.jpg)

![1000161857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJYbMqm5N8GRvEFepe8Z3MVbsn2oKGmbineBwtLyxvscbRE1j9VkhL6aw5gv1SqCSn.jpg)


And then, of course, there are the dogs of Chiang Mai. I feel like they rule the streets in their own peaceful way. They are everywhere, sleeping, resting, walking, and just existing comfortably around people. What I like is that the locals seem to respect them and allow them to be part of the street scene. I saw one dog relaxing under the sun, and it looked like it had no worries at all. That kind of calm energy is also part of Chiang Mai’s charm.


![1000161880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23xVMJdSyXLJHbqbNhZZRgUP34z2tnJj62WCchGT5PqMpwhPHQ3scFiTfh8GMKzbVGDr4.jpg)

![1000161881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA3YipUKUjHAdsavjQ7LvhZsuFqwZjUNzKEs6mQVen7XLGGBeHAYy1XquZLEJZZs4b.jpg)


Another thing I enjoy about the streets here is the food scene. Many small restaurants and food stalls proudly show their menus and mini kitchens right in front of the street. The noodle stalls, fruit drink carts, and small local kitchens make the sidewalk feel alive. They are not fancy, but they feel authentic. Just by looking at the signs and the setup, you can already imagine the smell of soup, grilled food, and fresh drinks nearby.


![1000161882.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23zkphZGcauR6iStjBuk8tZthsc3bjWGJkWWeGh7zqqJnHpN9q4Z25iYQ5cDw4josvhid.jpg)


I also noticed the graffiti and street art around the city. Some electrical boxes are covered with tags, stickers, and drawings, and instead of looking plain, they somehow become part of the visual personality of the street. I like how Chiang Mai has this artistic side that appears in unexpected places. It feels casual, free, and expressive.


![1000161859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23xKxZpZjuiQFC6PVTidG8VWE15aG9WmfGxeBsmqvUWqUUJFTTAvg6RCpUh2p4vADDTRW.jpg)

![1000161860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/243qBDsPF1pmPwMPza67YaSEhUqMoDN66MQsPzJS5cs79XjemsQuTuKUQYS2eVieuzohg.jpg)

![1000161861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23tvgpxwR4VfDgFRR4zhkZgPumukAB9fUbiCJDXL7YKnecBYMstbMQ7gEGpnoHQRZTQhM.jpg)


The motorcycle riders are also part of the scene. They move through the traffic like they already know the rhythm of the city very well. Some moments are blurry because everything happens fast, but I actually like that effect because it shows motion and energy. It makes the street feel alive.


![1000161855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23y8ot9ktmMbsMERCvx3pQabw5PFaNShh3g693RuRCVa2GiKhzii8D5NHssxCFMpcvZgv.jpg)


***Overall, these photos are not about famous landmarks or perfect tourist spots. They are about the small details that make Chiang Mai interesting. Sometimes the best travel memories are found in the ordinary things we notice while walking.***

## See you on my next adventure!

body.title: Security Guard Services for Construction Sites: Prevent Theft & Vandalism
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcxE2swUtBgNYbVSgoQhdKqn2jrjhwQSz2XvaxHPpRn3n/Security%20Guard%20Services%20for%20Construction%20Sites%20%20Prevent%20Theft%20&%20Vandalism.jpg 

The construction industry is a potential gold mine for thieves and vandals. As of 2026, construction site theft in the United States leads to an estimated $1 billion in annual losses, driven by stolen machinery, heavy equipment, metals such as copper, materials, and tools. High-value materials and heavy machinery contribute the most and have become primary targets for both regular thieves and organized crime syndicates.

## Why should you care?

Insurance only covers a fraction of the actual damage. While it can compensate you for the stolen equipment or damaged inventory, indirect costs, including project delays, labor downtime, and liquidated damages, are often far more significant. At Reliable Security Staffing, we strongly believe that professional security guards are the best way to safeguard your construction site against these mounting risks. In this article, you’ll learn all about  [Security Guard Services](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/)  for Construction Sites, how they work, and why they are important.

## Why Do Construction Sites Need Professional Guards?
Construction sites can be uniquely challenging to protect. They are constantly evolving and have expensive equipment and materials scattered throughout the site. Traditional security measures, such as temporary fencing and unmonitored CCTV, are hardly enough to prevent trespassing and vandalism, especially at night.

Compared to over 92% of construction companies that experience theft on their sites, only about 25% ever recover stolen equipment.

Prevention is the key here. Criminals choose sites based on vulnerability, ease of access, the presence of high-value assets, and the lack of physical security, especially during non-operational hours. Having a trained security guard on site 24/7 can ensure prompt intervention, deter criminals, and greatly reduce the risk of significant damage.

## Do I Need Physical Guards Even If I Have CCTVs Installed?
Yes. While digital surveillance can actively monitor and record incidents, it lacks the physical ability to prevent crime.

Technology works best when combined with human judgment and action. At Reliable Security Staffing, all our security solutions combine modern digital surveillance with the active presence of professional guards on site to ensure comprehensive protection for your assets and staff.

## Construction Site Security Guards Vs. CCTVs

### 1. Real-Time Intervention

A camera records a crime for later analysis and investigation. A security guard prevents the crime through real-time intervention. When a perimeter breach occurs, our guards take immediate action to prevent crime in its tracks. This includes verbal warnings and use of force (if necessary). In most cases, thieves can steal valuables within minutes. Waiting for the police seems illogical. Having an on-site professional ensures prompt intervention.

### 2. Access Control and Accurate Recording

The risk of construction site theft can be greatly reduced by limiting property access or preventing unauthorized visitors. Professional guards actively manage all entry points, verifying identities, stopping unauthorized access, and maintaining digital logs, especially after work hours. Whether it’s a subcontractor or a delivery person, every visitor is verified and recorded. Active access control and visitor checks help deter criminals.

### 3. Equipment and Material Accountability

Small yet expensive materials, such as copper wiring, are often stolen in parts to avoid detection. This often goes unnoticed until the end of a project or phase. We avoid this by conducting routine patrols specifically to monitor and manage high-risk storage areas. By verifying that containers are locked and that heavy machinery is properly secured with ground anchors or chains, we minimize the risk of opportunity thefts.

The Economic Impact: Why Hiring Construction Security Guards Makes Sense
The cost of professional security staffing is often far lower than the monetary loss from a single major theft at a construction site. Take a look at the data below:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWMNCpDSxjWCTexP9zm8RYM1rn33Wbzkfc3yfqHnvbUxU/download%2077.png 


## Beyond Theft: What Else Can Security Guards Prevent?
While theft is the primary challenge, construction sites are also vulnerable to unauthorized access (trespassing) and vandalism, which can lead to both property damage and legal liabilities. In 2025, several lawsuits were filed by individuals who injured themselves on unsecured construction sites.

Our guards are trained to protect your property against all kinds of risks and liabilities.

- Prevent Unauthorised Access: They prevent unauthorised personnel from entering your site.
- Safety Hazards: They look for and manage open trenches, unsecured scaffolding, and fire hazards to minimize the risk of accidents.
- Vandalism Prevention: Active physical presence deters graffiti and intentional damage to your property, which can cost thousands in repair.
- Compliance: During operational hours, they ensure that all workers and visitors on-site use required safety gear, avoiding OSHA-level violations and the risk of project shutdowns.

## Why Choose Reliable Security Staffing For Your Construction Site
Tailored Security Solutions based on risk level and construction phase:

We understand that not all sites are the same or all phases of construction carry the same risk profile. Reliable Security Staffing offers protection tailored to your project’s specific vulnerability and security goals. We can scale protection to meet your evolving security needs at different stages of the project.

Rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach, we build a custom security plan that fits your site’s topography, specific vulnerabilities, access points, and local crime trends. This includes the strategic placement of guards at all high-risk areas and potential choke points.

**Professionalism and Discretion**

Our security guards aren’t just highly professional and well-trained. We use experienced personnel who understand the construction environment. They are trained to detect and prevent potential threats, de-escalate conflicts, and maintain professional communication at all times. They protect your assets, staff, and privacy and reduce the risk of breaches through active vigilance.

## Conclusion: Hire A Professional Security Guard for Your Site Today!
Even a single major theft or vandalism incident can cause a serious dent in your construction project’s profit margins. Don’t just rely on luck or passive surveillance technology for the protection of your valuable assets.

 [Hire professional security guards in Atlanta today!](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/contact-us/) 

Reliable Security Staffing combines advanced digital surveillance technology with expert physical presence to actively deter, detect, and defend. We maintain 24/7 visibility, routine patrolling, and detailed incident logs, giving project managers the peace of mind that their site is well-protected.

Contact Reliable Security Staffing for a site-specific risk assessment and personalized security plan tailored to your project, location, and risk profile.

body.title: Pain, Prayers, and Distance
body.body:
Some verses leave such a deep impact on the heart that it feels as if someone has quietly given words to emotions hidden inside us. When I read this poetry today, I truly felt that love is not only about being together; sometimes it is also about distance, prayers, and silent waiting.
“Let’s see on which day God reunites us,
And which night our prayers are finally accepted.”
These lines created a strange feeling in my heart. Sometimes a person loves someone so deeply that they leave the meeting to destiny and prayers. At that point, there are no complaints or demands left — only a silent hope remains in the heart.
Nowadays, people often consider love to be just temporary emotions, but true affection is actually reflected in a person’s patience, character, and respect. If someone becomes distant from our life, it does not mean we should start hating them. Some relationships end, yet they leave respect behind in the heart. That, in my opinion, is the real meaning of love.
Personally, I have always believed that some relationships change a person forever. Not every bond is meant to be completed. Some people come into our lives only to teach us patience, silence, or the reality that not every wish comes true. But if respect still remains in the heart after everything, then the connection was genuine.
Another verse from this poetry touched me deeply:
“A lifetime has passed in the separation of my beloved,
Yet I do not know on which day death will arrive.”
This is not just about separation; it reflects the quiet waiting that continues inside a person for years. Some people may appear happy on the outside, but deep inside, they carry a silent sadness and longing. Perhaps this is why some faces become quieter and more serious with time.
In today’s social media world, people build and break relationships very quickly. Small misunderstandings often turn into disrespect and harsh words. But we should never forget that every person deserves dignity and respect. Even if someone leaves our life, we should still speak about them with kindness and honor. True humanity is shown when respect remains even after separation.
If love stays in your life, be thankful for it. And if distance comes, learn patience from it. Not every story ends the same way, but every story teaches us something valuable. Sometimes incomplete relationships give us the deepest understanding of life.
In the end, I would simply say this: instead of breaking hearts, pray for them. Time changes, people change, but good manners, respect, and sincerity are always remembered.

body.body:
![1000479411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000479411.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

> Hello, friends of #blackandwhite, how’s life treating you? Over here, they just got the power back on, and I’m rushing to post in the community. I wanted to let you know that May 17 is the International Day Against Homophobia, and coincidentally, it’s also Farmers’ Day; so Yilmer says to me: “Muha!” Let’s take some photos of the event and you can come with me—I’ve never been before! Of course, he didn’t have to ask me twice; I grabbed my camera, and I was ready to go.

> Saludos, amigos de #blackandwhite, ¿cómo les lleva la vida? Por este lado del mundo me acaban de poner la electricidad y estoy corriendo para publicar en la comunidad. Les cuento que el pasado 17 de mayo se celebra el Día contra la homofobia, y casualmente también es el Día del campesino; entonces me dice Yilmer: ¡Muha! Vamos a hacer fotos del evento y así me acompañas, ¡que nunca he ido! Por supuesto, no había que decírmelo dos veces; agarré la cámara, y ya estaba listo. ![1000479417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000479417.jpg)
> Every year they throw a party for this occasion, and at times it can get pretty violent, so I was prepared to see it all. But no, everything was pretty peaceful.

> Todos los años hacen una fiesta por tal motivo, y en momentos se llega a poner muy violenta, así que iba preparado para ver de todo. Pero no, todo fue bastante pacífico.  ![1000479415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000479415.jpg)

• • •

body.title: 3 reasons why EVs look so ugly. Also valid for the newly unveiled Ferrari Luce, a 600K EV sports car?
body.body:
3 Gründe warum Elektro-Auto so hässlich aussehen:

### 1. Fokus auf Effizienz und Reichweite, nicht auf Design

Das Grundproblem, warum Elektro-Autos vor allem in der Anfangszeit so hässlich ausgesehen haben ist, dass die Hersteller Effizienz gegenüber der Ästhetik priorisiert haben. Die ideale Form wäre eierförmig mit einem besonders niedrigen Drag-Koeffizienten.

Alle Design-Entscheidungen müssen sich daher der Effizienz unterordnen, selbst praktische Türgriffe müssen wegen der Reichenweiten-Angst weichen.

Das wäre so ähnlich also würde man bei der Wohnungssuche nur auf die Energieeffizienz, nicht aber auf die Raumaufteilung und Lage der Wohnung achten.

### 2. Neuer Form-Faktor, Neues Design

Ein zweiter Grund ist, dass Elektro-Autos neue Form-Faktoren ermöglichen, da man keine großen Motoren mehr unter der Motorhaube unterbringen muss. Das ändert das Design und die gewohnten Proportionen dramatisch.

EV-Sportautos mit extrem kurzer Motorhaube wirken nicht mehr so mächtig und leistungsstark. Ein Problem, an meiner Meinung nach auch der neue Ferrari Luce leidet.

Anstatt an der gewohnten Design-Identity festzuhalten, dachten viele europäische Autohersteller, dass sie bei Elektro-Autos auf ein neues vermeintlich futuristisches Design setzen müssten, was bei den bisherigen Kunden der Marke nicht so gut ankam.

### 3. Ausrichtung auf den chinesischen Markt, nicht auf den deutschen

In der EU hergestellte Autos werden zunehmend zu einem Luxusprodukt, den man sich mit einem normalen Gehalt kaum noch leisten kann.

Paradoxerweise versuchen deutsche Autobauer bei EVs vor allem die Bedürfnisse des schnell wachsenden chinesischen EV-Markts anzusprechen und kopieren zunehmend chinesische Trends anstatt auf ihre über ein Jahrhundert bewährte und ausgeklügelte Design-Sprache zu setzen.

Das verärgert viele loyale Kunden vor allem bei den deutschen Prämium-Marken.

Andererseits muss man den Ferrari Luce eher als exotisches Sportauto sehen, das sich bewusst optisch von den Verbrenner-Modellen unterscheiden möchte. 

Stellt euch vor, ihr wärt Milliardäre und hättet schon ein Dutzend Ferraris, dann wäre dieses Design-Update vielleicht tatsächlich eine willkommene Neuerung, um sich sofort als EV-Fahrer erkennbar zu machen.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Wie gefällt euch das Design des Ferrari Luce?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23vhsM8RvkjWs5CFEFN2Y624hmo5kjjjXpepp2cjx9fECUyeftYtQQrCga291Q1exTyAi.png)

https://x.com/Polymarket/status/2059006516678574591

https://x.com/vikisecretscom/status/2059286625104826464

https://x.com/pitdesi/status/2059041680934998107

https://x.com/TedPillows/status/2059209630249607372


## English

3 reasons why electric cars look so ugly:

### 1. Focus on efficiency and range, not design

The fundamental reason why electric cars looked so ugly, especially in the early days, is that manufacturers prioritized efficiency over aesthetics. The ideal shape would be egg-shaped, with a particularly low drag coefficient.

All design decisions must therefore be subordinated to efficiency, even practical door handles have to be sacrificed due to range anxiety.

This is similar to looking for an apartment and focusing only on energy efficiency, but not on the floor plan or location of the apartment.

### 2. New form factor, new design

A second reason is that electric cars enable new form factors, since there is no longer a need to house large engines under the hood. This dramatically changes the design and the familiar proportions.

EV sports cars with extremely short hoods no longer appear as powerful and high-performance. A problem that, in my opinion, the new Ferrari Luce also suffers from.

Instead of sticking to their familiar design identity, many European automakers thought they had to adopt a new, supposedly futuristic design for electric cars, which didn’t go over well with the brand’s existing customers.

### 3. Focus on the Chinese market, not the German one

Cars manufactured in the EU are increasingly becoming a luxury product that is barely affordable on a normal salary.

Paradoxically, German automakers are primarily trying to address the needs of the rapidly growing Chinese EV market with their EVs and are increasingly copying Chinese trends instead of relying on their sophisticated design language, which has been proven over a century.

This upsets many loyal customers, especially among German premium brands.

On the other hand, the Ferrari Luce should be viewed more as an exotic sports car that deliberately seeks to distinguish itself visually from combustion-engine models. 

Imagine you were a billionaire and already owned a dozen Ferraris, then this design update might actually be a welcome innovation to immediately identify yourself as an EV driver.

What do you think? How do you like the design of the new Ferrari Luce?

body.title: Haette ich fuer alles beim Staat nachgefragt, ob ich das Ausprobieren darf, dann wurde ich heute noch auf dem Stand vor fuenf Jahren rumhupfen, an Wissen und Entwicklung!
body.body:
Zumal man in der Diskussion um Reallabore fuer entsprechend technologische Weiterentwicklungen wie zum Beipiel Zeitketten und Kuenstlicher Intelligenz, wieder untergeht, das nicht die jetztige Situation, die zu diskutierdende ist, sondern diese, Ergebnis, aus der vorherigen Bereitschaft war, auch in das eigene Risko, vor allem in Sachen der Haftbarkeit zu gehen und in das bekannte kalte Wasser zu springen.

Wuerde ich fuer alles nachfragen, das ich entwickele, statt einfach halbwegs Transparent in Echtzeit Veto Moeglichkeiten zu offerieren, taete ich nicht halb so weit gekommen sein mit meinen Entwicklungen in den Fachbereichen, wie ich es bereits bin.

Es zaehlt also auch fuer die Zukunft, das der Entwickler, sicher nicht der Gesellschaft hinterherzulaufen hat, denn diese, wird nicht der Entwickler sein, sondern stellt sich oft genug als Bremsklotz und Hemschuh heraus, mit ihren Auflagen vor allem an technologischen IT System zu vermeintlichen Sicherheit aller anderen, die Hand drauf zu legen.

Entsprechende Reallabore, sind also immer am Laufen, da wird keiner, der wirklich am Schaffen ist, jemals nachfragen wollen, ohne zu Wissen, das ihn die Frage selbst schon Behindern wird.

Auch geht mir in der Diskussion, wieder einmal unter, das man offene Standarts zum ueblichem kapitalistischem Marktverhalten schlicht vergisst und nichteinmal bedenkt.

Nicht jeder Entwickler ist daran interessiert, der naechste Elon Musk zu werden mit seinem Geldbeutel, sondern vielleicht daran, entsprechende Verbesserungen fuer andere aus viellerlei weiteren Gruenden einfach zu bauen.

Wenn Schaeden entstehen, die man entsprechenden Versuchen zuordnen moechte, stellt sich auch hier wider die Frage, wer ist Verantwortlich? 

Der Entwickler, oder die Gesellschaft? Ich wuerde sagen, keiner wirklich, weil es Schwer nachzuvollziehen waehre, auf den Punkt zu bringen, wo die Wurzel der Ursache ist, da wir alle irgendwie, mit den Vorherigen Entwicklungen anderer herumspielen und neue bauen.

Hier weitere Steine in den Weg gelegt zu bekommen, oder staendig nur mit Fokus auf das schnelle Geld verdienen zu legen, ist HINDERLICH fuer echte Innovation, die niemals aus solchen Antrieben entsteht, sondern nur eine Weiterentwicklung von den Ideen und Konstruktionen der Macher in monetarisierter Form zu sehen.

Anders gesagt:

Einer hat die Idee, und der naechste, macht Geld draus.

Salve

Sascha Pürner

Ich beziehe mich auf diesen Beitrag der Sitzung des Bundestags im Ausschuss zum Thema.

body.title: Cynara cardunculus cardunculus - Asteraceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Cynara cardunculus cardunculus (ENG) Cynara cardunculus is a perennial herbaceous belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has a robust root system, erect stems that can exceed 1.5 m and large pinnate, glaucous and spinescent leaves. The flower heads, similar to those of the artichoke, are rich in leathery bracts and purple tubular flowers. It is a typical species of the Mediterranean basin, rustic but sensitive to intense frosts: the minimum cultivation temperature is 5 °C. ![cardo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/Eq9Y8gJmqRAmhd2uybgkaMroX41yqfZZAwhLDQKdbV5GivnxSwP2zARhDxebttfh864.png) image created with canva.com The balsamic period of the leaves is July, when the concentration of phenolic compounds is maximum. Drying must be rapid and carried out in a ventilated and shady environment: it is in fact during this process that dicaffeoylquinic acid transforms into cynarin, one of the main causes of choleretic and diuretic activities. Cynarin is thermolabile, so prolonged cooking drastically reduces its presence. Active ingredients **The plant is rich in bitter compounds and organic acids, including: Cinaropicrin (bitter-tonic, hepatoprotective) Chlorogenic acid (antioxidant, hypoglycemic) Malic and succinic acid (energy metabolism) Dicaffeoylquinic acid, precursor of cynarin** The main phytotherapeutic activities include: Hepatoprotector: promotes liver regeneration and detoxification. Cholagogue and choleretic: stimulates the production and outflow of bile. Diuretic: increases diuresis and promotes the elimination of nitrogenous waste. Hypocholesterolemic: reduces intestinal absorption of lipids. Vegetable curdling: Dried flowers are traditionally used in cheese making. Food: the stems (thistles) are consumed as a vegetable. **Toxicity is low, but the plant is contraindicated in case of gallstones, as the increased bile flow can cause colic. It is prudent to avoid supplements during pregnancy and breastfeeding and consult a doctor before taking phytotherapeutic preparations.** Traditional preparations **Mother dye** 15 g of chopped fresh leaves Maceration 21 days in 100 ml of 86° hydroalcoholic solution Conservation: 3 years Traditional use: 100 drops/day for hepatoprotective and cholagogue functions **Acetolyte** 10 g of dried leaves Maceration 21 days in 100 ml of mixture: 45 ml 96° alcohol, 30 ml water, 25 ml vinegar Conservation: 3 years Traditional use: 30 drops/day for diuretic, hypocholesterolemic and choleretic activities According to Theophrastus (372 BC), Greeks, Etruscans and Romans cultivated a thistle called cardui pineae due to its resemblance to the pine cone. Pliny the Elder considered it one of his favorite vegetables and considered the thistles from Carthage excellent. **The domestication of the modern artichoke derives from Cynara cardunculus, selected over the centuries to obtain fleshier and less thorny flower heads.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Cynara cardunculus cardunculus (ITA) Cynara cardunculus è un’erbacea perenne appartenente alla famiglia delle Asteraceae. Presenta un robusto apparato radicale, fusti eretti che possono superare 1,5 m e grandi foglie pennate, glauche e spinescenti. I capolini, simili a quelli del carciofo, sono ricchi di brattee coriacee e fiori tubulosi violacei. È una specie tipica del bacino mediterraneo, rustica ma sensibile alle gelate intense: la temperatura minima di coltivazione è 5 °C. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Il periodo balsamico delle foglie è luglio, quando la concentrazione dei composti fenolici è massima. L’essiccazione deve essere rapida e condotta in ambiente ventilato e ombroso: è infatti durante questo processo che l’acido dicaffeilchinico si trasforma in cinarina, uno dei principali responsabili delle attività coleretiche e diuretiche. La cinarina è termolabile, quindi la cottura prolungata ne riduce drasticamente la presenza. Principi attivi **La pianta è ricca di composti amari e acidi organici, tra cui: Cinaropicrina (amaro-tonica, epatoprotettiva) Acido clorogenico (antiossidante, ipoglicemizzante) Acido malico e succinico (metabolismo energetico) Acido dicaffeilchinico, precursore della cinarina** Le principali attività fitoterapiche includono: Epatoprotettore: favorisce la rigenerazione epatica e la detossificazione. Colagogo e coleretico: stimola la produzione e il deflusso della bile. Diuretico: aumenta la diuresi e favorisce l’eliminazione di scorie azotate. Ipocolesterolemizzante: riduce l’assorbimento intestinale dei lipidi. Cagliante vegetale: i fiori essiccati sono tradizionalmente usati nella caseificazione. Alimento: i gambi (cardi) sono consumati come ortaggio. **La tossicità è bassa, ma la pianta è controindicata in caso di calcoli biliari, poiché l’aumentato flusso biliare può provocare coliche. È prudente evitare integratori in gravidanza e allattamento e consultare un medico prima di assumere preparati fitoterapici.** Preparazioni tradizionali **Tintura madre** 15 g di foglie fresche sminuzzate Macerazione 21 giorni in 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica 86° Conservazione: 3 anni Uso tradizionale: 100 gocce/die per funzioni epatoprotettive e colagoghe **Acetolito** 10 g di foglie essiccate Macerazione 21 giorni in 100 ml di miscela: 45 ml alcol 96°, 30 ml acqua, 25 ml aceto Conservazione: 3 anni Uso tradizionale: 30 gocce/die per attività diuretiche, ipocolesterolemizzanti e coleretiche Secondo Teofrasto (372 a.C.), Greci, Etruschi e Romani coltivavano un cardo chiamato cardui pineae per la sua somiglianza con la pigna. Plinio il Vecchio lo considerava uno dei suoi ortaggi preferiti e riteneva eccellenti i cardi provenienti da Cartagine. **La domesticazione del carciofo moderno deriva proprio da Cynara cardunculus, selezionato nei secoli per ottenere capolini più carnosi e meno spinosi.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/alimenti/verdure-ortaggi-e-tuberi/cardo/ https://www.cure-naturali.it/enciclopedia-naturale/alimentazione/nutrizione/cardo.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: 诺基亚在AI时代重新杀回来啦
body.body:
最近除了SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic这三家史诗级的美股IPO外，其实还有一家公司表现亮眼，那就是诺基亚！

![nokia.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779875118817-biqyz.jpg)
诺基亚（来源：网络）

2025 年中诺基亚股价还在 4 美元一线徘徊。到 2026 年 5 月 22 日，股价站到 15.47 美元，单日跳涨 9.1%，一年时间近 4 倍。当下市值约 850 亿美元。

![nokia2.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779875413541-y10sk.jpg)
诺基亚股价（来源：英为财情）

那么，在大家眼中的旧手机一哥是如何华丽转身又出现在舞台上呢？

诺基亚在AI时代的\
引人注目。从曾经的手机巨头到电信设备商，再到如今的AI基础设施关键供应商，这家拥有160年历史的公司完成了重大转身。以下是其业务变更和战略做法的详细梳理：\n\n## 一、核心战略定位：从\
\n\n诺基亚在2025年11月的资本市场日（Capital Markets Day）上正式提出全新战略口号：**\
**（Nokia changed the world once by connecting people — and will again by connecting intelligence）。\n\nCEO Justin Hotard 明确表示，诺基亚定位为\

，其技术正为AI超级周期（AI Supercycle）提供动力。


## 二、组织架构大重组：从四大板块到两大核心

2026年1月1日起，诺基亚将运营模式**大幅简化为两大核心业务板块**，这是其AI转型最核心的组织保障：

### 1. 网络基础设施（Network Infrastructure）——增长引擎

| 维度 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| **定位** | 增长型业务板块，主攻AI数据中心互联（DCI） |
| **业务单元** | 光网络（Optical Networks）、IP网络（IP Networks）、固定网络（Fixed Networks） |
| **负责人** | David Heard |
| **核心逻辑** | 抓住全球AI与数据中心快速建设带来的爆发性需求 |

**关键动作：**
- **收购Infinera**：2025年完成整合后，诺基亚在北美光网络市场份额从不到10%飙升至25%以上，获得了低功耗相干光（Coherent Optics）核心技术。
- **客户结构质变**：2026年，来自亚马逊、微软、Meta等云巨头的订单已占据光网络业务增量的四成。这些巨头在构建全球AI推理网络时，迫切需要诺基亚的1.6T光模块与PSE-6s芯片来连接庞大的Blackwell集群。
- **财务目标**：2025-2028年网络基础设施净销售额CAGR增长6-8%，营业利润率13-17%。

### 2. 移动基础设施（Mobile Infrastructure）——技术护城河

| 维度 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| **定位** | 核心网与无线网络技术及服务领导力 |
| **业务单元** | 核心网软件（Core Software）、无线网络（Radio Networks）、技术标准（Technology Standards，原Nokia Technologies） |
| **负责人** | Justin Hotard（暂代） |
| **核心逻辑** | 引领行业向AI原生网络和6G演进 |

**关键动作：**
- **云原生核心网**：全年净销售额在市场整体下滑2%的背景下仍实现6%增长，云原生核心网解决方案带来5个百分点的营业利润率提升。
- **AI-RAN革命**：与英伟达深度合作，将AirScale产品线全线集成Grace Hopper/Blackwell算力卡，使全球数百万基站变身为分布式\

。
- **技术标准变现**：维持约14亿欧元的年化合同净销售额，通过3GPP标准专利实现强劲现金流。
- **财务目标**：移动基础设施毛利率48-50%。

### 3. 剥离非核心资产——Portfolio Businesses
将以下业务划入独立的投资组合业务板块，2026年内决定最终去向：
- 固定无线接入用户终端设备（FWA CPE）
- 站点部署与外线工程
- 企业园区边缘
- 微波无线

这些业务过去12个月合计净销售额约9亿欧元，但运营亏损约1000万欧元。

### 4. 独立孵化：Nokia Defense
设立独立的防务业务单元，作为美国、芬兰及其他盟国国防级安全连接解决方案的研发与市场中心。


## 三、五大战略优先方向

诺基亚新战略围绕以下五大支柱展开：

| 优先级 | 战略方向 | 具体内涵 |
|--------|----------|----------|
| 1 | **加速AI与云业务增长** | 聚焦AI数据中心互联、云原生网络 |
| 2 | **引领AI原生网络与6G** | 从5G-Advanced向AI-native网络演进 |
| 3 | **与客户和伙伴共同创新** | 与英伟达、云巨头等深度协同 |
| 4 | **资本聚焦差异化领域** | 剥离非核心，集中资源于光传输、AI-RAN等 |
| 5 | **解锁可持续回报** | 目标2028年可比营业利润27-32亿欧元 |



## 四、关键外部合作：英伟达10亿美元战略投资

2025年，英伟达向诺基亚**战略注资10亿美元**，并建立深度合作伙伴关系：

- **技术协同**：英伟达为诺基亚无线网络系统提供专用AI算力硬件支持
- **AI-RAN落地**：诺基亚anyRAN软件在英伟达GPU加速的AI-RAN平台上与T-Mobile、Indosat、SoftBank等成功完成功能测试
- **生态扩展**：与BT、Elisa、NTT DOCOMO、Vodafone等运营商推进AI-RAN，合作伙伴包括Dell、Red Hat、SuperMicro等
- **商业模式创新**：通过AI-RAN，诺基亚引导运营商将闲置基站算力租给自动驾驶车队或开发者，获取软件分成，将基站从\

来源。


诺基亚的AI转型并非\
，而是一次**基于技术基因（光通信、无线标准、网络架构）的系统性重构**。其正确性体现在：\n\n1. **方向正确**：从\

，顺应AI算力爆发的基础设施需求
2. **路径正确**：收购（Infinera）+合作（英伟达）+剥离（非核心资产）的组合拳
3. **组织正确**：大刀阔斧的架构简化，确保战略执行力
4. **节奏正确**：在5G投资放缓期及时转向AI数据中心互联，避免陷入存量竞争

正如CCS Insight首席分析师Ben Wood所言：**\
** 这家从1865年造纸厂起家的公司，再次证明了其穿越周期的生存能力。\n

body.title: Virat Kohli Wedding Details Venue Dress Ring And Photos
body.body:
Indian cricket superstar Virat Kohli and Bollywood actress Anushka Sharma had one of the most talked-about celebrity weddings in India. The grand [virat kohli wedding](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/virat-kohli-wedding-dress-ringdatephotos-sherwani-price-venue-colour-more-19137/) took place on December 11, 2017, in Tuscany, Italy, in the presence of close family members and friends. Their wedding instantly became a trending topic across social media because of its dreamy location, elegant outfits, beautiful decor, and private celebration style. 

The couple chose the luxurious Borgo Finocchieto resort in Tuscany as their wedding venue. The scenic location featured green hills, vintage architecture, and a royal atmosphere that perfectly matched the intimate ceremony. Reports suggested that the wedding was kept highly confidential to maintain privacy and avoid media attention. 

One of the biggest highlights of the virat kohli wedding was the wedding attire. Virat Kohli wore an elegant ivory sherwani designed by famous fashion designer Sabyasachi Mukherjee. His traditional look was completed with a matching safa and handcrafted embroidery that gave him a royal appearance. On the other hand, Anushka Sharma stunned everyone in a pastel pink lehenga with floral embroidery. Her bridal look became an instant fashion trend in India and inspired thousands of brides. 

The wedding ring ceremony also attracted massive attention. Virat and Anushka exchanged elegant diamond rings during the ceremony, symbolizing their strong relationship and commitment.
