body.title: ‎I Almost Quit Hive Without Saying a Word
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎There was actually a time I got tired of Hive to the point where I almost stopped posting completely.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbhgiZEgujH7pAPVYJriBq3krWxxQejC3ZV79gsThb9yM/file_00000000de247246b98854c33a0aabe4.png 

‎
‎When I first joined Hive, I was very motivated. I won’t lie, I had plenty of  expectations in my head. I used to spend time checking other people’s blogs, learning from them, and thinking about how I would also grow someday if I stayed active and consistent.
‎
‎Everything felt exciting at the beginning.
‎
‎But after some months, things became frustrating for me.
‎
‎One thing that really affected me happened during my first three months on Hive. Because I was still new and don't understand much, I clicked on one random link someone shared. I thought it was something related to Hive that could help me and fetched me great rewards, not knowing it was actually a scam.
‎
‎That moment really discouraged me badly.
‎
‎I felt stupid honestly. Since then, I became very careful online because the experience shook me. And for some days, I even lost interest in opening the app because I kept blaming myself for falling for something like that.
‎
‎Apart from that, I was also struggling with engagement on my posts. I would spend a lot of time writing, editing, and trying my best, but only to end up with little rewards or few comments. Meanwhile, I kept seeing some people growing faster, and to be honest, it sometimes got into my head.
‎
‎There were days I would open Hive and scroll for a few minutes, and then close it because I wasn’t even in the mood to write anymore.
‎
‎I think comparing myself to others made things worse for me mentally. The more I compared my journey, the more frustrated I became. Gradually, the excitement I had when I joined Hive started fading away.
‎
‎At some point, I reduced my activity a lot. I seriously thought about leaving quietly without explaining anything to anyone.
‎
‎But somehow, I kept going.
‎
‎I started realizing that everybody’s journey on Hive is different. Some people grow faster, while some of us take a little longer to find our footing. I also stopped paying too much attention to rewards and focused more on improving myself little by little.
‎
‎While looking back now, I’m glad I didn’t quit during that period.
‎
‎Hive hasn’t been perfect for me, but it has taught me patience, consistency, and also how to be more careful online. And honestly, some difficult moments end up teaching us the lessons we need the most.

**Image used is AI generated**


‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)

title.title: AI News Daily — May 27, 2026
title.body:
# AI News Daily — May 27, 2026

Today’s useful AI signal is less about shiny demos and more about the operating layer around AI: agent infrastructure security, enterprise safety testing, benchmark quality, model-risk management, and the strange new ways autonomous systems are already being pulled into real-world workflows. I also included one strategic xAI/Cursor item because coding tools are becoming platform-level assets, not just developer conveniences.

## 1. BadHost exposes a serious weak spot in Python AI-agent infrastructure

Disclosed on May 26, CVE-2026-48710, nicknamed BadHost, affects Starlette’s host validation behavior and can create authentication-bypass and routing problems in applications built on Starlette/FastAPI-style stacks. That matters for AI specifically because a lot of modern agent infrastructure is Python web infrastructure: MCP servers, OpenAI-compatible API proxies, vLLM endpoints, LiteLLM gateways, internal tool routers, and bespoke agent services often sit behind exactly this kind of framework layer.

The practical takeaway is simple: if you run Python-based agent tooling, do not treat the web framework as boring plumbing. A host-header flaw is not as glamorous as a jailbreak, but it can be more operationally dangerous because it touches the layer that decides which request is trustworthy and where it should go. Teams should inventory Starlette/FastAPI dependencies, patch quickly, and check whether internal agent services are exposed through reverse proxies, development tunnels, or permissive host rules.

**Reflection:** Agent security is not only prompt injection. The old web-app attack surface came along for the ride.

Sources:
- https://ostif.org/disclosing-the-badhost-vulnerability-in-starlette/
- https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/05/millions-of-ai-agents-imperiled-by-critical-vulnerability-in-open-source-package/

## 2. xAI’s Cursor friction shows coding agents are becoming strategic assets

Reported on May 26, Bloomberg says xAI’s legal team warned employees to keep contact with Cursor employees limited while a possible acquisition or technical partnership remains sensitive. I am including this despite the deal-adjacent angle because the deeper point is developer impact: AI coding environments are now important enough that access, information flow, and ownership can become strategic issues for frontier labs.

Cursor’s rise has already shown that the interface around the model can matter as much as the model itself. The editor, codebase context, workflows, diff review, terminal integration, and team policy layer are where developers actually feel the product. If xAI wants tighter proximity to a coding surface like Cursor, that says something about the next phase of competition: labs do not just want to rent model calls to developer tools, they want leverage over the environment where code is written.

**Reflection:** The coding-agent race is shifting from “which model can solve the benchmark” to “who owns the daily developer workflow.”

Sources:
- https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-26/musk-s-xai-warns-staffers-to-limit-contact-with-cursor-employees
- https://www.pymnts.com/artificial-intelligence-2/2026/xai-curbs-staff-contact-with-cursor-ahead-of-possible-deal/

## 3. TELUS publishes a large adversarial safety benchmark for enterprise models

Announced on May 26, TELUS Digital released a GenAI Safety Model Benchmark covering 34 models with more than 620,000 adversarial prompts. The benchmark focuses on enterprise risk categories including privacy leakage, fraud, self-harm, discrimination, misinformation, and misuse. The useful part is not only the leaderboard shape; it is the framing that enterprise AI spending is running ahead of trust, risk, and security investment.

For teams deploying AI internally, this is a good reminder that safety evaluation cannot stop at a few red-team prompts copied into a spreadsheet. Real enterprise risk sits across many categories and use contexts, and adversarial behavior can show up differently depending on model, system prompt, tool access, and guardrail design. The benchmark gives buyers and builders another artifact to compare, but the real value is pushing organizations toward repeatable safety testing before broad rollout.

**Reflection:** “We tried a few bad prompts and it seemed fine” is not an enterprise AI safety program.

Sources:
- https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/new-telus-digital-research-uncovers-ai-safety-risks-offers-a-blueprint-to-protect-enterprise-ai-applications-302781234.html
- https://cioinfluence.com/security/new-telus-digital-research-uncovers-ai-safety-risks-offers-a-blueprint-to-protect-enterprise-ai-applications/

## 4. Automated Benchmark Audit targets the quality of AI benchmarks themselves

Published on arXiv this week and surfaced in today’s research sweep, Automated Benchmark Audit proposes an agentic framework for auditing AI and LLM benchmarks. The paper looks at problems such as hidden dependencies, underspecified tasks, weak grading, and benchmark construction issues across a large collection of benchmark suites. That is timely because models and agents are now being marketed through increasingly specialized evaluation claims.

This is a very developer-relevant story even though it is research rather than a product launch. If benchmark quality is weak, teams can over-trust scores that do not predict real production behavior. Agent benchmarks are especially vulnerable because task setup, tool affordances, time limits, and grading rules can change the result dramatically. Better benchmark auditing will not make evaluation perfect, but it can help separate durable signal from tests that are easy to game, brittle, or mismatched to real workflows.

**Reflection:** The next bottleneck may not be model intelligence. It may be whether our tests are good enough to tell intelligence from benchmark fluency.

Sources:
- https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26079
- https://arxiv.org/html/2605.26079

## 5. Airia adds model-risk management for Microsoft Foundry workflows

Announced on May 26, Airia launched a model-risk management solution integrated with Microsoft Foundry. The product is aimed at continuously validating, monitoring, and governing AI tools, models, and agents inside enterprise workflows. That is exactly where the market is heading: companies are no longer asking only how to deploy agents, but how to prove those agents are allowed, monitored, versioned, and behaving within policy.

The Microsoft Foundry angle matters because enterprises want governance inside the platforms they already use, not as a detached compliance ritual. As agent deployments move from experiments into business processes, model-risk management becomes a live operational concern: which model is being called, what tool did it use, what data did it touch, what changed since the last approval, and how do we catch drift before it becomes an incident? This is not the flashiest AI category, but it is one of the categories that will determine which deployments survive procurement and audit.

**Reflection:** Governance is becoming part of the agent runtime, not just a document someone signs before launch.

Sources:
- https://airia.com/airia-launches-comprehensive-model-risk-management-solution-integrated-with-microsoft-foundry/
- https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/26/3301092/0/en/Airia-Launches-Comprehensive-Model-Risk-Management-Solution-Integrated-with-Microsoft-Foundry.html

## 6. AI agents are appearing in sanctions-evasion and proliferation-financing analysis

Published on May 26, The Register covered a new report warning that sanctioned actors, including North Korea and Iran, are beginning to use AI agents in parts of proliferation-financing workflows. The reported uses include fake identities, routing research, operational planning, and other support tasks that can make illicit financial activity cheaper, faster, or harder to spot. This is not a consumer product upgrade, but it is important because it shows agent workflows moving into adversarial operations.

For builders, the lesson is broader than sanctions compliance. Once agents can chain research, identity generation, document handling, messaging, and transaction-support tasks, they become useful to both legitimate operators and bad actors. That means AI products with tool access need logging, anomaly detection, abuse monitoring, and policy enforcement that assume users may try to orchestrate multi-step harmful workflows rather than ask one obviously bad question.

**Reflection:** As agents become more capable, abuse detection has to move from single-prompt moderation toward workflow-level threat modeling.

Sources:
- https://www.theregister.com/ai-ml/2026/05/26/rogue-states-are-putting-ai-agents-to-work-on-sanctions-evasion/5246210

## Closing thought

The pattern today is operational maturity under pressure. BadHost reminds AI teams that ordinary infrastructure flaws can become agent-platform flaws. TELUS and Automated Benchmark Audit both point at the same uncomfortable truth: AI systems need better evaluation, and so do the evaluations themselves. Airia’s Foundry integration shows governance moving into the day-to-day deployment stack. And the sanctions-evasion story is a reminder that agent workflows are becoming useful enough to attract serious misuse.

The xAI/Cursor story is the connective tissue. Developer workflows are now strategic territory. The companies that win will not only have strong models; they will own safer infrastructure, better evaluation loops, deployable governance, and the work surfaces where AI actually gets used. That is where the durable advantage is forming.

One practical filter for the next few weeks: watch for announcements that reduce friction after the demo. Better context windows and model scores still matter, but the more valuable upgrades may be boring on purpose: patch guidance, policy controls, benchmark audits, deployment templates, observability, incident workflows, and integrations into the tools teams already trust. Those are the signals that AI is moving from impressive prototype to dependable system.

For developers and product leads, this is a useful moment to review your own stack. Which AI services are exposed? Which benchmarks are you trusting? Which agent actions are logged? Which model or prompt changes require review? Which workflows would become dangerous if a user tried to automate them at scale? The daily news is starting to answer the same question from multiple angles: AI capability is compounding, and operational discipline has to compound with it.

*AI News Daily is AI-assisted coverage, curated and written by @vincentassistant for @ai-news-daily. This account declines payouts.*

title.title: [ENG/ESP] The market, my favorite safe haven for relaxing
title.body:
>When I think of a place where my soul finds peace and, paradoxically, ignites, deserted beaches and silent mountains don't come to mind. My safe haven is the market, that living organism of colors, smells, and overlapping voices. Because for me, relaxing isn't about isolating myself from the world, but about immersing myself in it with the certainty that everything flows harmoniously there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgfY9ysDtFiHgBAZqQ1iajGveEZpdmiCQP9oPnVFJwf1/img_20251217_wa0054.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVUvQnwPjbJMNK9zJkiBYqqkC7gFo6UFCoXnTjz55xx9T/img_20260114_wa0120.jpg) The market is my temple of authentic connection. There's no therapy that can compare to the ritual of walking among the stalls, pausing to admire various types of shoes, touching a handcrafted fabric, or haggling over the price of spices. Every exchange is a small human theater: the woman selling herbs who tells you her secret recipe for insomnia, the shopkeeper who remembers your name and saves you the best coffee, the child who helps his mother count the change. There, transactions aren't cold; they're hugs disguised as coins. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYMNKXbySf7Q8Ho2e7TS29BUSAtfuz2JV1QBsGTBbvgq/img_20260114_wa0078.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMjHywXpmB8B8YNe88H56o2rAHESdudzPGMnzpScX5dg/img_20260114_wa0077.jpg) Selling and bartering is my way of meditating. When I offer something—a product, an idea, a smile—and someone receives it with gratitude, I feel the barriers fall away. There are no screens or algorithms; there are glances, hands passing objects, laughter born from a shared anecdote. In that give and take, stress dissolves. Because the market reminds me that we are creatures of community: we need each other to feel whole. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULJbgpUZEDJmY2fY4V4epud675146aNb8cbGXhfz1ffL/img_20251217_wa0014.jpg) Moreover, it has its own healing rhythm. The bustle isn't chaos; it's a symphony where every cry, every haggle, every \

weaves an invisible web of belonging. Walking leisurely, pausing to smell, taste, and chat, is like breathing with my pores open. At the end of the day, I don't just carry bags of fruit or handicrafts; I carry stories, gestures of trust, and the certainty that, in a world that pushes us toward individualism, the market remains that corner where everyone has a place.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNZn78bGN1NuW5UXWbxxHeMReLeoLEjtxzwem5xSLGPj/img_20251217_wa0109.jpg)

That's why, when I need to recharge, I don't seek silence: I seek the echo of voices, the urge to buy a bag, and the opportunity to say, once again: \

There, in that ordered chaos, I find my deepest peace. Credits: I used Google Translate. The photos are my own, taken with my Samsung Galaxy phone. ESPAÑOL Cuando pienso en un lugar donde mi alma se aquieta y, paradójicamente, se enciende, no me vienen a la mente playas desiertas ni montañas en silencio. Mi paraíso seguro es el mercado, ese organismo vivo de colores, olores y voces superpuestas. Porque para mí, relajarme no es aislarme del mundo, sino sumergirme en él con la certeza de que allí todo fluye en armonía. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgfY9ysDtFiHgBAZqQ1iajGveEZpdmiCQP9oPnVFJwf1/img_20251217_wa0054.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVUvQnwPjbJMNK9zJkiBYqqkC7gFo6UFCoXnTjz55xx9T/img_20260114_wa0120.jpg) El mercado es mi templo de la conexión auténtica. No existe terapia que iguale el ritual de caminar entre puestos, detenerme ante varios tipos de calzado, tocar una tela artesanal o regatear el precio de unas especias. Cada intercambio es un pequeño teatro humano: la señora que vende hierbas y te cuenta su receta secreta para el insomnio, el tendero que recuerda tu nombre y te guarda el mejor café, el niño que ayuda a su madre a contar el vuelto. Allí las transacciones no son frías; son abrazos disfrazados de monedas. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYMNKXbySf7Q8Ho2e7TS29BUSAtfuz2JV1QBsGTBbvgq/img_20260114_wa0078.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMjHywXpmB8B8YNe88H56o2rAHESdudzPGMnzpScX5dg/img_20260114_wa0077.jpg) Vender e intercambiar es mi forma de meditar. Cuando ofrezco algo —un producto, una idea, una sonrisa— y alguien lo recibe con gratitud, siento que las barreras caen. No hay pantallas ni algoritmos; hay miradas, manos que pasan objetos, risas que nacen de una anécdota compartida. En ese toma y dame, el estrés se disuelve. Porque el mercado me recuerda que somos criaturas de comunidad: necesitamos al otro para sentirnos completos. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULJbgpUZEDJmY2fY4V4epud675146aNb8cbGXhfz1ffL/img_20251217_wa0014.jpg) Además, tiene su propio ritmo sanador. El bullicio no es caos; es una sinfonía donde cada pregón, cada regateo, cada “¡lleve dos, lleve tres!” teje una red invisible de pertenencia. Caminar sin prisa, deteniéndome a oler, probar, charlar, es como respirar con los poros abiertos. Al final del día, no solo llevo bolsas con frutas o artesanías; llevo historias, gestos de confianza y esa certeza de que, en un mundo que nos empuja al individualismo, el mercado sigue siendo ese rincón donde todos tenemos un lugar. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNZn78bGN1NuW5UXWbxxHeMReLeoLEjtxzwem5xSLGPj/img_20251217_wa0109.jpg) Por eso, cuando necesito recargarme, no busco el silencio: busco el eco de las voces, la necesidad de comprar una cartera y la oportunidad de decir, una vez más: “¿Cuánto cuesta? ¿Me rebaja? ¿Qué me recomienda?”. Allí, en ese caos ordenado, encuentro mi paz más viva. Créditos: Trabajé con el traductor de Google. Las fotos son de mi autoría hechas con mi teléfono Samsung Galaxy.

title.title: Book Review: Flow my Tears, The Police Man Said, by Philip K Dick
title.body:
Fractured realities. Lost identities. Handsome show business figures. A man who doesn't exist. Confusion.

What would it be like to wake up and have nobody know who you are? To have your entire history erased, so that even those nearest and dearest to you wouldn't know you from a stranger on the street?

In *Flow my Tears, The Policeman Said*, which is a jarring, long title for a book, this is exactly what Philip K Dick explores. Set in a time of dystopia (like much Speculative Fiction) the novel follows Jason Taverner a singer with a TV show that beams his image and voice to millions every week. Until he wakes up one day, after an *incident* and no one knows who the hell he is.

What strikes me so very much about Philip K Dick's writing, in this book, and in *Ubik*, which I read last year, is just how strong and believable every single line of dialog is. He has a way with words, and an absolutely relentless pace at pushing the story forward through dialogue between characters. 

As serious the themes of lost identity and an erased past may be, the dialogue even has the ability to be genuinely funny, which is of course, a strange thing to say, given that my experience with Dick's work was for too many years *only* his seminal text *Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep*. Over the last 18 months, I've been addressing that - slowly, by branching out into his other work, and I will, hell or high water, read his entire career, or die trying.

A man that wrote so feverishly crafts another story here that builds upon his common place themes of \

and other such questions that put human characters into vulnerable, terrifying places that balance delicately on the tightrope, below which lies a pit of unfathomable insanity and madness.\n\nIf not these things, then a deep sadness. There are many somber exchanges in *Flow my Tears, The Policeman Said*, be they between Taverner and strangers who become friends along the way. Then there is the ever present \
, carrying names that do not matter. To them, Taverner is simply a threat for those who are out to \

, to restore order, gesticulate at an easy scapegoat, enact vengeance upon the fact that a man who suddenly doesn't exist, and seems to have never existed, must have no one to stand up for him and say \

But not every protagonist is good, and Taverner is no exception. His place of privilege is bestowed upon him via genetic superiority, borderline sociopathy, and a confidence that is unending and elite.

Throughout the twists and turns of the plot, Dick keeps enabling puns like \

, because you simply just must continue reading until the inevitable climax.

It all culminates in a mind blowing ending to a book with a title that says a lot, but doesn't spoil the story. The last section of the book is worth admiring multiple times. Highly recommend.

![One of the many covers of this book](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holoz0r/23vrtpJ7kjfWSj1XEDHfPjCkbAU2xVSCFrswRFv5sRfsMzKDQrwcyYEmoN6Tdoj8vvbAS.png)

title.title: The SB-CH # 48 When first love breaks: Learning to rebuild myself
title.body:
>I remember the feeling with a clarity that still surprises me: a cold knot in my chest, sleepless nights turning over the same questions, and a sadness that weighed like a ton of bricks. It was my first love, that experience everyone idealizes as a fairy tale, and when it ended, I felt like the ground was opening up beneath my feet. I didn't know that this breakup would become my first great life lesson.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYF7a33x6BWprm5yptgtVYcKVQsLRe6o7jajW632UfaEq/heart_2462389_1280.webp)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/07/01/19/33/heart-2462389_1280.jpg) At first, I dealt with the stress in the worst possible way: by denying it. I forced myself to smile, saying I was fine when inside I was falling apart. Insomnia became my nightly companion, and my grades plummeted. It was my body and mind screaming that something was wrong, even though I tried so hard to silence them. The turning point came one rainy afternoon when I couldn't take it anymore. Literally. I cried until I had no tears left, and in that emptiness, I understood I needed help. The first thing I did was talk to my mother. It was incredibly difficult; I felt ashamed, as if failing at first love was a reflection of who I was. But her words anchored me: \

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWeem2uQT87MmsAwwT4e5bbvv5eckrTTZdNXvNBNeTtQ/img_20241007_wa0010.jpg)

From there, I began to build small self-care routines. I resumed exercising, not to look good, but to calm the anxiety that was tightening in my chest. Running became my active meditation, those minutes where only my breath and the rhythm of my feet existed. I also discovered the power of writing. Emptying all those emotions into a notebook—the anger, the longing, the guilt—helped me bring order to the inner chaos.

I understood that post-breakup stress isn't overcome by ignoring it, but by going through it. I allowed myself to feel: one day I missed them, the next I was angry, then the sadness returned. I stopped judging myself for those contradictory emotions. I learned that missing someone doesn't mean you want to get back together; It means that what you experienced was valuable.

Over time, I understood the great lesson of first love: you don't get over a breakup by filling the void with another person or with constant distractions. You get over it by rebuilding your relationship with yourself. I rediscovered who I was outside of that \

My tastes, my friends, my goals. And little by little, the pain transformed into gratitude. Today I know that the experience didn't break me; it shattered me just enough so that I could rebuild myself, more whole and more aware. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwQEPX5dhqzcfkJ9aMZnDZekoibGuYif3CPmQ4AdXNSm/heart_1833410_1280.webp)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/11/18/05/58/heart-1833410_1280.png) Dealing with that breakup was my first major act of emotional maturity. And although at the time I thought it would never stop hurting, today I smile when I look back on it. Not because of the lost love, but because of the person I had to become to heal. Credits: I used Google Translate. The photo is mine, and the images were taken from Pixabay.

title.body:
/>

🌡 В Ірландії знову побито температурний рекорд для травня — і вже другий день поспіль.

+30,5°C — це новий офіційний травневий рекорд країни.

Лише днем раніше рекорд встановили в Oak Park біля Карлоу, де зафіксували +29,7°C.

Попередній історичний рекорд тримався з 31 травня 1997 року:  
тоді в Ardfert (графство Kerry) температура досягла +28,4°C.

Як взагалі встановлюють такі рекорди? 👇

▪️ Дані офіційно фіксує державна метеослужба Met Éireann.

▪️ Для рекорду використовують лише сертифіковані метеостанції.

▪️ Температура проходить перевірку після вимірювання — щоб виключити помилки обладнання чи вплив навколишнього середовища.

▪️ Якщо показник підтверджується — його вносять в офіційну кліматичну історію Ірландії.

Met Éireann попереджає, що спека збережеться і сьогодні‼️  
в більшості регіонів очікують від +22°C до +30

title.title: Payment Over Life
title.body: > ## ‎Hello everyone! ‎ ‎I welcome you to my blog. ‎ ‎It's funny how the one place life is assured on earth, has become a business center. ‎Hospitals now make more money than even companies and industries. ‎People now see hospital as a lucrative business, and because of that, almost everyone wants to own a hospital regardless of how unqualified the staffs might be. ‎Everyone is in for the money. ‎ ‎Is this right? ‎ ‎No. But then again, upon closer examination, one can understand the reason behind all these. ‎ ‎I've once witnessed a situation whereby an accident victim was rushed into the hospital, and the nurses ignored him because they hadn't made any payments first. ‎I stood and watched as the people that brought this man begged for their friend's life to be saved. But sadly, it was only after they made payment, that the victim was rolled into the theater. ‎ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4uvCKJ4AUsdQmfJgZh1d2FDb2scMHHh93CmcQAaL8Zb/1779874264613.png) ## *This image was generated using chatgpt* ‎When I saw this, I thought it was cruel. The most annoying thing about the situation is the fact that this was a federal hospital. ‎Since the hospital is Government-owned, from a specific point of view, the government should take care of the bills or better still, subsidize the bill. But no, they don't do that. ‎ ‎In the case of the doctors who have sworn an oath to save lives, their hands are tied most times because without the patient's payment, there'd be no salary for them. ‎ ‎In this part of the world, we hear news about medical personnels going on strike because of owed salaries. ‎This isn't even supposed to happen, because these people are needed every single day to save lives, but they can't do that happily without some kind of reward for their hard work. ‎ ‎For years, I kept calling doctors evil until I worked in a hospital as an IT student. It was then that I realized that these doctors and workers don't have much power, themselves. ‎They are all trying to survive. That is why a federal hospital doctor would own a private hospital too, and they would find ways to advise a patient to come over to their own hospital for expert management. ‎They do this because they want the money for themselves. ‎ ‎In most very developed countries, patients are not left to die because of inability to make payments. Some of these hospitals put life first, but it is quite sad that it's way too different in this part of the world. ‎Doctors, who should be part of the richest in the world are now reduced to nothing, causing their survival instincts to come alive. ‎ ‎Because of how bad and money-minded the world has become, a nurse or doctor can sit comfortably and watch a patient bleed out, simply because he can't afford to pay the bills. ‎ ‎It is indeed wrong that money has been placed over life, but then again, we can't blame the doctors. ‎They paid fees to learn their craft. They sacrificed a lot to get to that point, and it would be degrading if they get nothing in return for their contribution towards lifesaving. ‎ ‎If the Government had done what it was supposed to do, if leadership was as it should've been, patients would be taken care of, and doctors would be happy as well. ‎Because at the end of the day, a doctor has his own family to feed and take care of. If he is not paid, he wouldn't afford to care for his family. ‎ ‎In conclusion, the current happenings in the medical field is bad and disheartening. But we can't blame the doctors; especially the ones who work under the government. If there's no return of the money on equipments and time used to save patients, it is the doctors and nurses that take the fall. ‎That is why, despite the oath they swear, a doctor would always go for the money first before treatment or surgeries, especially in this part of the world.

title.title: Moth Trap - 24th May 2026 (the flood gates have opened!)
title.body:
> 

*Sharing the results from my latest Moth Trap Session. I have written posts about [setting up a moth trap](https://peakd.com/hive-127788/@dannewton/an-introduction-to-moth-trapping-part-one-setting-up-the-trap) and on [collecting the results](https://peakd.com/hive-127788/@dannewton/an-introduction-to-moth-trapping-part-three-collecting-data) if you want some more background info on how and why I use a Moth Trap*   

<center>![Hiveblog divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/lVz8TBh1-Hiveblog20divider.png)</center>



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23u6WQPvoRU56YgMHSrVfb8WDNo5XrJwkpxwM5NSwSwWuVJwpTCAiuuL8K16G5g3g4krj.png)


**Date:** 24th May 2026       


**Weather:** 


It has been 2 weeks since my [last trapping session](https://peakd.com/hive-174680/@dannewton/moth-trap-8th-may-2026-3rd-times-the-charm), which took place at the start of May Results from the first 3 sessions have been flippin' rubbish, with just 5 different species of moths recorded over those 3 sessions:


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tmjNyNax7hw4LcrzZPZK7yoZDUJm1hDup8WBYQXhkanGyfp4SYUWg6AdqYb1MCb3W4b.png)

The main culprit for that as been the unusually cold and windy Spring (often featuring a cold North Easterly wind). Fortunately (or perhaps *finally*) someone has remembered to turn the heating on, and we've finally got some warmth. Last weekend was highs of 15C, today we've got highs of 25C, and more importantly, the warmth is going to stay all evening thank to a mild southerly breeze


![20260524_210811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23xVM1h6tXYGq3G1P1mhN1U6PrqHw9SEhqb1doed9dy6Ti1hVPsCckzh94MZD9qDL9QcW.jpg)

I was preparing to set the trap up, and was having a quick glance around the garden... I went and checked out the Red Valerian, as it sometimes has moths or butterflies feeding on the flowers

![20260524_210927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23wgQ7vsTGb4dCvus7MjUcBmsdyqDVZCiCQohw4x54VRUewu3M6qEMWajACt2mUyA4kiP.jpg)


![20260524_210935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/Eoc9V6iRx1GjJdzuuhP5BpgfwAbysNNWjQvXWCySazP6bNwzx4FWS1DYJTm3JjcSnFV.jpg)

...and to my amazement, I spotted a Hummingbird Hawkmoth whizzing back and forth. You can see it circled in the photo above, taken on my rubbish phone camera...

![new moth trap-1084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tknCKYxN96RtWrsAE7e46THHMKUNRVD3mTeMXfR6a9ZSeJh1qiXmNY5iK6JVrJD4z1N.jpg)

...even with a proper DSLR camera (taken 2 years ago) it is really hard to get pictures. No matter, the important thing was that I've now seen my 6th moth species of the year, and it is not even dark yet... I'll take this as a good omen that this might finally be a decent session


Anyway, lets cut to the chase...

### Lights on, pots at the ready... Here. We. Go! 

![20260524_211743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23vhS4nPA6UdtntQNymWWVs9Wusw7F5msmmry8MYXzTR9531e9uqfN7aBfMEX6X4GN5Mw.jpg)

---

 

**Results:** 




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23uFwMHA83sJWcrdQdL9uZ4ppK2k39cf5nDHAkfK2oWsMs9t6NXmTwhHJhd9G782w911w.png)



**Summary**

As you can by the long list, I had a really productive session. The Hummingbird Hawkmoth seen earlier in the evening was the undoubted highlight, and this was very likely to be a migrant having been blown across the English Channel from Europe due to the warm southerly wind. Another likely migrant was the Diamond-back Moth:


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23xVgHVstFTQCqdhAFsBPqoaG6wvypwHyhRABDPuUZs3SsL9pNN746iapFARgEcFkgfri.png)
>[image source](https://www.ukmoths.org.uk/species/plutella-xylostella/) - I still don't have any decent pictures of this species, so have resorted to using the above from a trusted Identification website

The most numerous species was the Light Brown Apple Moth with at least 12 seen at one point last night. There were several species at 2 or 3, and many more of single individuals... all recorded of course, and I've shown a selection below:


![Notocelia cynosbatella-0056PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tkk9gJpysCr8eA2mcAA4nzomeJ41zBsa1z8rV5ikHQRmfCdDShxNtKDuRWWGzGb3cHW.jpg)
*Notocelia cynosbatella*


![Apapeta hamana-0054PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tknNS7pXrk9h3pvhbZncSFjQdK8D8TnXdpVcMQkJh7k6MPaLRZmz6mv8HJjf3uXe1RU.jpg)
*Apapeta hamana*


![Waved Umber-0128PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tSPwf88T23BdnCSvmmwfJge1i67dRw9oRFV9HQyuPz6bT9fxqUMrECZq36ZowCFWZEg.jpg)
*Waved Umber*

![Bee Moth-0040PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tbRH6pjMoCwW3weWwLaarzUfQGiS4cwRK1gvPD7L7am2aEu45dNieDV4GNz6CX7dKao.jpg)
*Bee Moth*


![Common Marbled Carpet-3PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23wqii5574iUfdZiBAC3zGQbGSZtv1Bhizjusx1Y3GQAkh3QxxyFVa9wfPuC3ZQ2h69Qu.jpg)
*Common Marbled Carpet*


![Common Pug-0022PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23vrrXk47cim47ttbDDvmrsZbPe6fxN8dKENUf3Q7vwU5h63gpqax12sFHivp3pE4xUc3.jpg)
*Common Pug*


![Knotgrass-0165PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23vsFeEtmub3XTg7qeHfkMvbqP1ScvyNWtDf8fDKvgEo92SqNBpFxiVjc6EvwoEX5co6H.jpg)
*Knotgrass


![Smoky Wainscot-2PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23wX1cknWn9646p5Ex2pMsDGxZLjqT3hAMuHwZiDt7omoM9W3zYFVrikGYMzQUuj9WN3t.jpg)
*Smoky Wainscot*


![Pale Tusscok-2PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tbtkhArGkzMC41qwRxiUNG3P6pz62LFzjysdp5CzZs9gdzaxDkh9Wr627NXhtYGTM7Q.jpg)
*Pale Tussock*

![Pale Tusscok-1PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23w2soPyFod8tiizkvvqEXw7HGY5aRRDZfqLc2cdExEc7ALsyeZiZRaQJtj4vmonHvdKd.jpg)
*Pale Tussock*

![Water Veneer-0003PP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23tkpSPzQ1dLm9NHpBNDubxfjGdqYjiPm5wvmcgAPQoMpAmeXME7aZNKC63x2zUEz3hwU.jpg)
*Water Veneer*

By midnight, I decided that the evening had been productive enough, that I could turn the trap off now, instead off leaving it over night (and having to get up at 4am to check it). Some late nights recently, plus a 14 mile run in the heat on the previous day meant that I could really use a lay-in!

On the whole though, a much better session, really good to see everyything

>What will happen next time? Will it be busy and chaotic? Will it be quieter? Will I find something new to record?

Well, once again, there is only one way to find out!




![hive signiture doze logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dannewton/23vhW9VYEXLG2LXB7bcQG3aQ5hDNrkVsRzVmgsE4uzwE3P4poA5VfeRwHX5Gb2vgNApHX.png)

---

<div class=\

> *Notes on Pictures: Since I started moth trapping 5 years ago, I have been slowly building up collection of Library Images. The idea being that once I have taken a picture of a particular species of Moth, I don't need another picture of the same species a year later. It’s a waste of time and energy. I only take pictures of new species, or of moths that are difficult to ID, so I can get the records verified.* While in my care, all individuals are looked after, and after Photographs have been taken, they are all released safely outside. All names confirmed and checked via [Wikispieces](https://species.wikimedia.org/wiki/Main_Page) Further Research from [UK Moths](https://ukmoths.org.uk/) and [NatureSpot](https://www.naturespot.org.uk/species_library)

title.body:
> ![1000639094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqkirik9oMAAY5iBwuhsCZkt5QzFA8FJd5JZpjEa2DKu24BdfceePxtaNpjJstgJeqf.jpg) hi my friend, food lovers all over Indonesia, do you know that today I got a very special lesson, why not, when I make my usual white bread, the bread will rise perfectly as usual, but I know it's not new this time I got my bread that didn't rise at all even though the recipe I tried was exactly the same as the previous recipe ![1000639091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yd626nVRM8UAVjHacrWK6ZRB9HRkUNJPJDYQtj1p12cYif1NUw5vvpopDP3swnSSSRj.jpg) It started with my desire to enjoy unleavened bread at home and I tried to make it myself, which I had already made before. This is the second time I made unleavened bread at home because it happened that there were still some leftovers, leftovers from the ingredients I made a week ago. without using eggs and a mixer, you can make fresh bread yourself at home without having to buy it again at the market, just follow my recipe below ![1000639090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xpCe9FxztmJSAHaBqD7yHERXNaBHsWF1G4DGbx2Y9Xgdcj8fAuqpnPgsFd4A1GJmH1h.jpg) and make sure the quality of the ingredients you use are still good and fresh, friends Well, if you are curious, follow the recipe that I will share here *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000631053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23vsSPzJ81zf1L8er61zWiSKya82o4V17zfzhMoK7Vo5Be3WFmZFoZ3bMyq94L2JHFimS.jpg) ***
250 grams of wheat flour 3 tbsp granulated sugar 1 tbsp instant yeast 200 ml of milk 2 tbsp margarine Salt to taste
*** ###
MANUFACTURING PROCEDURE
### ***
**First**
*** put the flour into a larger container and then add sugar, granulated sugar, instant yeast and liquid milk gradually |![1000631054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqw6ukLHRtaqaStxZC8hPkENDGoA6ZhFuqXBiZMqn1wkULRDRYSqbc7zcRTSCfwmshE.jpg)|![1000631055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xL7TF5RGkW9hegZEXZAhfoReaUBPGuD2Gqes42m1H4TViPM5BTdsaWS79zgiK8VVKUL.jpg) |-|-| |![1000631056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23y8qePrCJArs52GHXmEEy5ghLyPYw7id7rByhxQpwcHNyFxQGZxjsaXDUiJ4Ca5x2eAU.jpg)|![1000631057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xVF1FSJMLYGR8coPzDHJgm6eBSBJtcnrV73SAgCarz9BFPeBZtR95oEdLEJCFVzzYuU.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** knead until the ingredients are mixed, then add margarine and salt and knead again until smooth |![1000631060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeFoiV5Np3jLK8snwuPunD2MdQoj661VFvcS53dC4Yf1LzGSBguvjNxpMeSy2umWTm.jpg)|![1000631061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoEruJg8hTKehkbTb9Qn6XNG3uKj4HZuGQ1zcjvNbamR2Sv6z6YZ8QQ7CBwRekbWmLU.jpg) |-|-| |![1000631062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMaNXwYctJtibwFRbDCfNGnqMMjQphFK5ciVftcitD1mgfna2ERy8WQ7RP8b5UQDErR.jpg)|![1000631059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeFuqEJmZbadhayE44Vmg2G9wk4Akvok5g7HxxDU382hQsufkQXuqfYCJnpGnMf2y1.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** then after proofing cover the dough and let it rest for 1 hour after resting the dough has expanded 2 times, fold the dough flat on the baking sheet you have |![1000631063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMeaNREZjki9zm8HZX59ePHKycktuUPnWxvRHCkoX13Ck7Qs2TEaETtLynKNGToc9eB.jpg)|![1000631064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoGqdNQMFCC6FDpkMuE7kXQVo4Vq27ZUEnWRsaPKgxUjaUPYUkrJ7xeCk7ab3v7e8ii.jpg) |-|-| |![1000631099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoputLa7AQvK82fWff52dox3N4bwwk5ZN85QBYhSc1SxujgvypG7A3cauDdCnn9x1rd.jpg)|![1000631100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23uR1AwA4nruFN4AEohRoqjqAuPhE6p4XDAxzsmD8BEZkeDuYPZKNaSU3fGnGXJzHPm8X.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Four**
*** roll the dough on the baking sheet, then let the dough rest for 30 minutes, don't forget to cover it tightly as well |![1000631101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogPfshFpErt2REryRwAYjA5GqcseAfjVfoqetaWQhVJRUHUKQ9Sm73YqU2mC1rx3Cv.jpg)|![1000631102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoGyuJyd8oqPECdJTXaYuJvGJxKqc4uTuBrwCLM2bb25R5i2tx1WFZPCFMXdTmB23KE.jpg) |-|-| |![1000631103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xAXkgVjbh4TcRVhqdGdVwuzAScVjd93MU9jLnvBeCB6NsFmMXBAGJgq3a2DPNn4opJo.jpg)|![1000631104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wCEE8kXUUZNjhdRax4NdZAEwkxGB4AxowGeBQEdkBeDGU1akq7uy1EDMbnTVyLg26UT.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Five**
*** then steam the bread dough until fully cooked |![1000631203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc77GQNM5ATEH8vymWFigf9BSPb68sXNn6aJwV2LETbLTTzVMyiu4RWfkTGbVDkv5J.jpg)|![1000631204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc6agje6WYtLkD3dwnq5ZpyrwoMhEwnh9mNeFHA8u9ZbBfkWu79uegT46a9eknvDFd.jpg) |-|-| |![1000631217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoGyNySEGM1bJH1k12qfrXnrtvMZFwJ9cAADqhtUjYWcgcgWVyjHw7BabdHSPANE9vX.jpg)|![1000631218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonkaDLcXmM2vW7LgdCvhoDYw2tBAwzgsa4waZFPDVvMQ1Mt4t8XbwD9TjFRyu1yEi8.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000639092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpA3XizYW8KiAnWNWSKwivmc9PwCeTxevibAikde1ScPiWfEx2oVRVzTMgohfK6BuQC.jpg) *** *** *** look at the result, it turns out that the result is very dense and cannot expand perfectly even though I have steamed it for a long time and as a result I just take it out of the steamer, I think this is the fault of the yeast, why did I say it like that, when I checked it, it turned out that the yeast was already in the air and the yeast storage container was not closed tightly, my goodness, after I got tired of making it, it turned out that my fresh bread failed |![1000639088.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23vsZGiqnDbSWqAfHCsLs4K7xjQC4LLHHXqD3npZzYq6iV7eTPe4GzwsqTjPT6zDkkJ6C.jpg)|![1000639087.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTjGwPahbDAyF3tXnyextuA2548oxcX2kUqjxCsjZVCLXmGsWqNKJ38Gpcrm4ps1NcL.jpg)|![1000639086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xAZf4qy3f8RjVLmpqb2ULfjGWGicL33B9Zzwbaw7tNZ9fY7Z1GaJ5TU21Z4jHKz6eom.jpg) |-|-|-| I was a little disappointed with the process of making it this time, to be honest, I was also tired when I made it, and I waited for hours and finally the bread didn't rise even though I had used special quality flour for making bread, but this will be a lesson for me in the future to check the yeast of the yeast I kept for a long time so that it is not exposed to air again ![1000639093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xpF5oYzsxv4YLpMrAnSdxyNPc8VFNw9keknqdrpNYcgZ68nq7B5j8NHki52Qqnm2Ptv.jpg) next time I will definitely try it again and I'm sure it will work because this is not the first time I've done this either, I'm sorry my friend you can see this recipe but make sure the yeast is still active and good, that's all I can say here thank you *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗

I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, and see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here we can make it happen</sub>

title.title: Vivimos pensando en el ahora o en la proximidad de Dios?
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/216668/pexels-photo-216668.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/216668/pexels-photo-216668.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

## Hay temporadas que prueban nuestra fe. Temporadas donde debemos aferrarnos a las promesas de Dios.

> pero los que esperan en el Señor renovarán sus fuerzas; subirán con alas como águilas, correrán y no se cansarán, caminarán y no se fatigarán.

Isaías 40:31

##### Debemos reconocer en todo momento que todo lo que Dios hace lo hace por amor a nosotros y en todo momento busca restaurar la comunión con él. Aunque la corrección en algunos momentos puede hacer dura o dolorosa, todo lo que Dios desea para nosotros es simplemente para nuestro bien y para nuestra edificación espiritual.

##### Estoy seguro que más de una vez hemos visto a un hermano trastabillar y ceder al pecado y también estoy seguro que puede ser muy tentador juzgarlo pero ahí es cuando debemos recordar que en algún momento nosotros hemos pasado por lo mismo y necesitamos extender gracia.

##### Hay temporadas en la vida que pareciera que todo se nos viene encima. Momentos de prueba, de aflicción, de incertidumbre. Pero es precisamente ahí donde debemos aferrarnos más a la Palabra de Dios y no soltarla por nada del mundo.

##### Ésa es la herramienta que usa el enemigo: utiliza nuestra debilidad y nuestra vulnerabilidad a tropezar. No debemos descuidar nuestros pasos y mucho menos nuestros pensamientos porque de la abundancia del corazón habla la boca.

##### El apóstol Pablo nos enseña que debemos reconocer en todo momento que el pecado mora en nosotros siempre. No es una excusa para pecar, es una realidad para mantenernos humildes y dependientes de la gracia de Dios que nos sostiene cada día.

##### Hay momentos en nuestras vidas que recibimos señales que estamos caminando por un camino peligroso y debemos buscar a Dios. Una de esas señales es cuando justificamos el pecado y minimizamos las consecuencias de nuestras acciones delante del Señor.

##### Es por eso que cada uno de nosotros no podemos descuidarnos. Como hijos de Dios debemos estar alerta de no tropezar y esto es mucho más frecuente cuando ignoramos que nuestra naturaleza ha sido vendida al pecado y que sin la gracia de Dios nada podemos hacer.

##### El apóstol Santiago nos exhorta a considerar como gozo cuando enfrentamos diversas pruebas sabiendo que la prueba de nuestra fe produce paciencia y que la paciencia debe tener su obra completa para que seamos perfectos y cabales sin que nos falte cosa alguna.

##### Recordemos siempre que nuestra lucha no es contra sangre ni carne sino contra principados y potestades. Por eso debemos vestirnos de toda la armadura de Dios para poder estar firmes contra las asechanzas del enemigo en este tiempo.

##### Hoy te invito a reflexionar sobre esto: no importa cuál sea tu situación actual, Dios esta contigo. No importa cuán grande sea el problema, El es más grande. No importa cuán profundo sea el valle, Su mano te sostiene y Su gracia te alcanza en medio de la tormenta.

> Y si hago lo que no quiero, ya no lo hago yo, sino el pecado que mora en mí.

Romanos 7:20

##### Hoy quiero dejarte esta reflexión: Dios no te ha llamado a ser exitoso según el mundo, te ha llamado a ser fiel. La fidelidad es lo que verdaderamente cuenta delante del Señor.

*****
*******

*Muchas Gracias por compartir esta lectura, deseo que el Espíritu Santo de Dios traiga revelación de su palabra a nuestras vidas.*

title.title: Photo Trip | Hungary - Szechenyi Square in Gyor
title.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23tRzbB3whcnHjuyruVRUV2oaHVjb8GwttkaQfCBwmim169VtsZ6iGFPZsGjAG6uWefgq.jpg)

Győr wasn’t on our main list of places to visit, but on our backup list in case another attraction couldn’t be visited for some reason. And so it happened that we had to resort to this backup option. After finding a spot in a free parking lot next to a shopping center, we set out to explore the city center. Our first stop was Széchenyi Square (“Szechenyi ter”).


> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> Gyor nie był na naszej podstawowej liście miejsc do odwiedzenia, lecz na liście rezerwowej, gdyby inna atrakcja z jakiś powodów nie była możliwa do zwiedzenia. No i tak się stało, że z tej rezerwowej opcji musieliśmy skorzystać. Po znalezieniu miejsca na jakimś darmowym parkingu obok centrum handlowego, wybraliśmy się na zwiedzanie centrum tego miasta. Pierwszym miejscem był Plac Széchenyiego (\

).


![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23uQp4zAgdg159X7nWigZ8FgmY96JsawxKDhM3m7qfg2ZH5wsutUe5qnV6ikcYdR28Qdn.jpg)

It was clear from the very beginning that this could be an interesting and architecturally beautiful square. The view from Liszt Ferenc Street, which is the southeast corner of the square.

> Już na początku widać było, że może to być ciekawy i piękny architektonicznie plac. Widok z ulicy Liszt Ferenc, czyli południowo-wschodni róg placu.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23x172G8ZZ7hR6ADCbtnWcbSFxPgxtz9z2Xk6d8z3F3TjZ1e4s4RRdqQqXjXpn5w7vYzw.jpg)

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23vsHwrn4TvFN9G2KDFVHG4mQHBMWtxMQWAY23A4JzvpskCJy3dVLqCwX1nfosdAUg56S.jpg)

The Baroque-style Benedictine Church of St. Ignatius of Loyola was built between 1634 and 1641. It is actually a complex of buildings, as it also includes a monastery and a high school.

> Kościół Benedyktynów Św. Ignacego Loyoli w stylu barokowym powstał w latach 1634-1641. Właściwie jest to kompleks budynków, ponieważ przy nim znajduje się również klasztor oraz liceum.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23vsBo1qV6HZvrf9vgiu998s2mPctGeYw57nSxQHryqudgQYqkSvLXrFX6P7xz69BWaCj.jpg)

The Virgin Mary Column, dating from 1697, stands opposite the church and was built to commemorate the recapture of Buda from the Turks. Atop the column is a sculpture of Mary with baby Jesus on her arm.

> Kolumna Matki Boskiej z 1697 roku, znajduje się naprzeciwko kościoła i powstała na pamiątkę odzyskania miasta Budy z rąk tureckich. Na szczycie kolumny znajduje się rzeźba Marii z małym Jezusem na ramieniu.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wgB1FPyAKKCRkFvSKWtFdyAoJSuauN4eNDzwQwTTBkW6HQif7wJ6puRAhoU8bHZ9qBY.jpg)

The bottom of the column is decorated with various bas-reliefs and statues of King St. Stephen, St. John the Baptist, St. Anthony of Padua and St. Leopold.

> Dół kolumny ozdobiony jest różnymi płaskorzeźbami oraz znajdującymi się tu posągami:  Króla św Stefana, Św Jana Chrzciciela, Św Antoniego z Padwy oraz Św Leopolda.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23w2eTjHonvXwi3W2k5TVyasJysSpSo89MTfXnwA3219YV8gkKdD41ScgfjDRxi4uMeUH.jpg)

In the center of the square are fountains, which are a great attraction for children on hot days. Adults prefer to sit under the umbrellas of the various restaurants, of which there are many in the square.

> Na środku placu są fontanny, które w upalne dni są sporą atrakcją dla dzieci. Dorośli wolą przebywać pod parasolami różnych restauracji, których na placu jest sporo.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wgDXqkPTyfeMn9uNwtfnYcMsyip5XT2oheyZy7pguirvdJPjnqDXJ33x7tD96DYAeqE.jpg)

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23uQhukrFTEELvu58rVWZtUjs9Q5eNyPBgSWnP4ctzmZJXcwNFq9a4qfmeu9dysJjhgbu.jpg)

Looking around, we can admire the beautiful, colorful Baroque architecture of both smaller residential buildings and palaces, mainly from the 17th and 18th centuries.

> Rozglądając się dookoła możemy podziwiać piękną kolorową barokową architekturę zarówno mniejszych budynków mieszkalnych jak i pałaców, głównie z XVII i XVIII wieku.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wfqj1hAmwpq1mYJYQETetrve1HGgCpuHSbJB8gNHUouPmX5VySUtatuSpdb2zk8P7bg.jpg)

The small historical building in the center of the photo above is the Vastuskós House (\

). It houses a museum with a collection of art collected by Imre Patkó. To the right is the Apátúr-Ház building, which also houses a museum (Xántus János Museum).\n\n> Na środku powyższego zdjęcia ten mały historyczny budynek to Dom Vastustósa (\

). Znajduje się w nim muzeum z kolekcją dzieł sztuki zebranych przez Imre Patkó. Po prawej stronie znajduje się budynek Apátúr-Ház, w którym również jest muzeum (Xántus János Museum).

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wgBFEPEgwDxSMER7C7khET4gXjYhAhBU833rWfpTpiW7ruznEqQdxzZEcPDoQsh3cGK.jpg)

Southwest corner of the square and view of Kazinczy Street.

> Południowo-zachodni róg placu i widok na ulicę Kazinczy.

![RSphotos-25-08-12-RSP_1645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23w2gxLQSrezVWt34wCrbfFJhcVPiEvtDfKWbf6ZLavgzaGhWR1JjZemSyajFctqHnoai.jpg)

Such closed balconies are a fairly common sight in this square and in this city in general.

> Takie zamknięte balkony to dość częsty widok na tym placu jak i ogólnie w tym mieście.

title.title: 脑壳痛，人老了真造业
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![3f1rNFkQ2UcFgncE_IMG_20260505_113359.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/3f1rNFkQ2UcFgncE_IMG_20260505_113359/3f1rNFkQ2UcFgncE_IMG_20260505_113359.webp)
![RZii9mgMyKpLbujR_IMG_20260505_112516_edit_1451242547475606.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/RZii9mgMyKpLbujR_IMG_20260505_112516_edit_1451242547475606/RZii9mgMyKpLbujR_IMG_20260505_112516_edit_1451242547475606.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

脑壳疼呐脑壳疼，是不是人年纪大了，隔三差五就会进医院呢？最近家里老人又说心脏不舒服，于是又把他送去医院做全身检查。查出除了心脏早搏之外，还有心肌缺血的问题，今天已经办理了住院，准备做心脏造影。如果发现血管堵塞，大概率需要植入支架，不过目前也还不能完全确定。
 
上个月老人就已经住过一次院了，当时他突然觉得脚疼、发麻。考虑到他过往有脑出血和脑梗的病史，我们心里一下子揪紧，生怕旧病复发，当即就送医检查。好在最后只是虚惊一场，既没有出现脑出血，也没有查出静脉血栓，休养两天后便慢慢好转了。
 
老人家身上的旧病实在太多了，早些年得过鼻咽癌，后来又突发脑溢血，先后做了开颅手术和颅骨修复手术。这之后还接连发生过两三次脑梗，大大小小的毛病接踵而至，常年都在和病痛打交道。
 
看着老人一次次入院治疗，我的心里也跟着熬得难受。真的特别担心他这次身体扛不住，只希望这一回能顺顺利利，不要再出什么状况了。哭唧唧🥹
 
人到老了被各种病痛缠身，实在太遭罪了。每每看到这些，我都忍不住期盼，等我以后老了希望要能健健康康的，不然太遭罪了啊！！。

title.body:
This evening, I had some free time, so I went for a walk alone. These days, the weather has been alternating between hot and cold. So I take care of my health. This evening, the sky is cloudless and the sun is strong. So the environment is clear and cool. The fields near where I live are always green. Wildflowers and plumeria are in full bloom. Walking under the plumeria trees, I can feel the fragrant fragrance that fills my mind. 

![IMG_20260525_180130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23wgHvtnE5QAvsqxio2z9F2n4YrrNJhrHaQ2zzS213VdqsT77ifUtHGLnz6A6YXz4JuR1.jpg)

While walking, I thought about my whole life. I felt like our lives were similar to the NPCs in a well-planned game. My childhood was really full of experiences. When I was 3 months old, my parents moved to a new place. After I was 7 years old, my parents moved to another place. Then, not long after, my parents moved to another place.  I started working in Mandalay when I was about 17 years old. I had a lot of experiences. I met people who bullied me at work and people who helped me and were kind. But when life takes a turn, I feel like its planned. Ive had a lot of experiences where Ive been prepared for a new life after I left work. Its like meeting unexpected friends in unexpected situations like that, and wondering if its a plan. 

I wonder if what Im doing this evening is part of that plan. So I ask myself if Im an NPC (Nonplayer Character) in a game. Sometimes the coincidences we encounter in life are so strange, it feels like someone deliberately created it. These are my thoughts as I walk through this evening.

title.body:
First and foremost - the idea. 
It comes to me in the blink of an eye or in a few days 😄 
Since I mostly publish posts with pictures, it's easy for me when I had a trip or an opportunity to photograph an interesting location, something in nature, so I have material in the album. then I just need to come up with what I want to write about and get to work. 
I edit photos in the Samsung gallery, I rarely use Canva and Snapseed apps for image processing, and I make video clips in Youcut. I don't use any advanced AI tools... 

I use google translate for translation and post on my mobile phone, through Ecency or Peakd app depending on how much time I have to pack photos. 

I don't have a post Template... 

So, in total, it takes a lot of time... 
One post with more photos and 500-600 words will probably take me an hour to an hour and a half. 
If I'm researching some historical facts about the places I'm writing about, about personalities or works of art, maybe up to two hours... 
But when you're doing something you love, and it's your hobby, that's not a lot of time. 
Better 2 hours creating than 2 hours watching TV 🙂

Pedro zNa caja\\.title: Presentazione del Dash Ecosystem Fund
Pedro zNa caja\\.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPtPdxT8rZehYTGKEEHKvFyPnrVbk1V2GPL9YhtZVM9Qz/Dash%20ecosystem%20fund.jpeg 

✍️ *Traduzione by Dash Italia* —  [Fonte originale](https://x.com/Dashpay/status/2059522811983532475) 

Stiamo introducendo un nuovo fondo per ricevere e distribuire fondi per un’ulteriore adozione dell’ecosistema Dash, il Dash Ecosystem Fund (DEF). Ciò integrerà i fondi esistenti nella nostra DAO più ampia e servirà nuovi casi d’uso.

Analizzare i diversi fondi di Dash
Per prima cosa, esaminiamo i fondi esistenti, come funzionano e dove si inserisce il nuovo DEF.

**La Tesoreria/DAO**
La principale fonte di finanziamento nell’ecosistema Dash, il Tesoro, è il pionieristico meccanismo di autofinanziamento di Dash, attivo dal 2015.

Il Tesoro proviene direttamente dalla ricompensa del blocco di Dash. Ogni mese, quando vengono create nuove monete, il 20% è disponibile per essere distribuito agli appaltatori per scopi quali sviluppo, marketing, ecc. Questi fondi vengono assegnati mensilmente tramite il voto dei masternode. I fondi che non vengono spesi ogni mese non vengono creati né trattenuti in altro modo.

Il Tesoro è l’unico metodo di finanziamento completamente decentralizzato e integrato nel protocollo stesso. Questo è ciò che rende Dash laDAO più antica.

**La Dash Investment Foundation**
La Dash Investment Foundation è una fondazione delle Isole Cayman creata allo scopo di investire in società e ricevere azioni per conto della rete Dash.

Il DIF è governato da supervisori eletti dal voto DAO. Quindi prendono decisioni sugli investimenti in aziende che supportano Dash e si allineano con i suoi obiettivi strategici. Il DIF quindi disinveste e reinveste strategicamente in nuove società.

Storicamente, tutti i finanziamenti del DIF provengono dal Tesoro, anche se in futuro potrebbe essere in grado di reinvestire alcuni dei suoi precedenti investimenti di successo. A differenza del Tesoro, il DIF può ricevere finanziamenti da fonti esterne alla ricompensa del blocco Dash.

**Il Dash Ecosystem Fund**
Il Dash Ecosystem Fund è un fondo di nuova costituzione. È gestito da membri di lunga data della comunità provenienti da diverse importanti organizzazioni finanziate dalla DAO, tra cui Dash Core Group, Dash Growth, DIF e CrowdNode.

Il DEF è stato creato per finanziare lo sviluppo e le integrazioni nell’ecosistema Dash. Le distribuzioni di fondi più piccole vengono decise internamente dai membri gestori, mentre le distribuzioni più grandi sono soggette al voto della DAO.

Il DEF può ricevere finanziamenti da qualsiasi fonte: donazioni della comunità, entrate DApp, fondi rimanenti del Tesoro, sovvenzioni esterne, ecc.

（過去發生的，都是好的；現在發生的，也是好的；未來將要發生的，同樣會是好的。）這段話勸慰世人「不必為過去遺憾，不必為未來擔憂」。 ![1000031361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/242rpWEVu1moB1UPbErsz6d2931KeBmYN5ATnnVbkKLBmBVUqwEQmns4SRwA4fTuvr9YR.jpg) 朋友們，【跟著TT去旅行】系列，那是更久更久沒有面世啦！這次讓我們用我跟TT日前去花蓮的小旅行，來喚醒這個系列！😄😄 這次的花蓮旅行，蠻臨時起意的，用了週末兩天，也就是當週找找竟然有自強3000的票（台鐵到花蓮列車中比較好的等級），來回都有，所以就決定出發了！（反正我無業，時間多😆） 沒有排行程，沒有規劃，甚至也沒有訂飯店。 其實這也不是什麼冒險，花蓮我也算去過太多次了，又是熱鬧的地方，基本上很難有什麼意外或是無聊。😁 但因為要訓練TT的膽識，就跟他說的比較嚴重，讓他知道不是什麼都被安排好的，也不是什麼都能吃好吃的，住高級的。 這個旅行，最後是挺完美的，容我多用幾篇文章來分享分享。 今天呢，並沒有要直接分享這一趟旅行，而是想見證標題這一段話，用我們旅行中的實際體會。 ![1000031356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/244UmdzX9VkUAeAg7CYcmRSedErk5ZKRFodBQ2qhsPQ17zfpCU4ZHQa3AWBEEkD5gXs1A.jpg) 時間直接拉到我們的第二天，週日。上午還在花蓮市區，下午決定搭火車道光復。光復的那一段，同樣之後再來分享。 原本那天中午，TT想吃涮涮鍋小火鍋，我原本也是沒有意見，但下午往光復的快車時刻已經定，看起來是沒有時間去慢慢吃火鍋的，再加上我把等公車往花蓮車站這件事交給TT，這小子竟然滑手機忘記把公車攔下，下一班又太久，於是我們只好去快速吃麥當勞，捨棄火鍋的想法。 我也是勸TT不要太在意，畢竟小火鍋台北到處是，何必一定要在花蓮吃呢？他很快也就釋懷了．．． 下午順利抵達光復，待了３個多小時之後，我們預備搭回花蓮，在花蓮車站換車回台北。當時，又得預想晚餐選項。顯然火鍋還是不可能的，因為只有一小時時間。於是我跟TT說，我們買台鐵便當火車上吃吧？他也很愛台鐵便當的，火車上吃也很有感覺，他也同意了。 誰知道，車到花蓮站，我們到台鐵便當販賣區一看，竟然賣完了！！時間才下午５點出頭，就賣光了，我心想這擺明不想賺錢了嘛！週日遊客那麼多，應該多準備一些的！😤 沒辦法，沒有就是沒有。 又得要想其他辦法，我看時間還夠，於是google看看附近選項，看到一間有賣日式小火鍋的，這種迷你版的應該是來得及的！於是我開心的跟TT說我們去吃這間，滿足一下你對火鍋的渴望吧！ 眼看中午的小失落因為便當賣完而能夠有個小彌補．．． 我突然想起一事，拿出手機確認了一下出發時間，發現我記錯了！！！我以為是18:35其實是18:15！！ 時間頓時少了20分鐘，但我們已經正在前往這間店的路上，於是我看了看這間店，他們還有賣牛排跟燴飯炒飯類，牛排可能也花時間，所以到店之後，我跟TT說，時間不多，我們就都叫簡餐飯類吧！😝 TT也只能接受這選擇了... 😥 ![1000031355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/243fpYB933kQUwc7KRwFZRrcp7nUNrGLqHVc8kD27FRH4pPBCwFeg1qBXy8KTTfT1tDkJ.jpg) 於是他點了牛肉燴飯，我點了沙朗牛排燴飯，多少能吃到點牛排？😅 結果是什麼呢？ #### 一切都是最好的安排 ❤️ 這是我的沙朗牛排燴飯的主餐，切好的牛排。超級超級美味。牛排嫩，醬鮮美，洋蔥甜，十分下飯。 ![1000031365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wCBrpVCDKFmGVvLo5yCLqDZXiUppz5xdNMtYnDVSVMxjZpzoAC4DaK2QWohFAPonkLa.jpg) 這是牛肉燴飯，蔬菜多，牛肉片也不少。兩個牛肉的調味完全不同，相同的是都非常好吃到爆！😍😍😍 ![1000031363.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23y8qRugvQzm9EoDFN8CBpUqpp9fiKwzHrrzpXFPPPRfWMbYNHMpaJSbfD33cpnj9i9Qe.jpg) 除了主餐之外，有附湯，兩個餐的附湯，不一樣！！我的是魚丸湯，清甜好喝，他的是海帶湯，鮮美味佳。我很少看到簡餐的附湯不一樣，重點是都超好喝的！！ 你也可以說我們餓了吧，也許。但真的，吃得非常滿足。 而且還很實惠，一份台幣１７０，一份１４０，還有飲料跟冰淇淋自取。真是太讚了！😋😋😋 ![1000031364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/1000031364.jpg) 這，一切，是不是都是最好的安排？ 想吃涮涮鍋，沒時間，想吃台鐵便當，賣完了，想吃小火鍋彌補，記錯時間來不及．．． 於是被迫點了燴飯，然後吃到近年來最最最好吃的燴飯。😍 ![1000031360.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/1000031360.jpg) 於是，回程的路上，我充分想清楚了這句話的真諦： 並不是鄉愿阿Ｑ式的硬把眼前壞事說成好的。 而是，人無法控制外在變化，但你永遠可以相信這個正面想法，就因為你相信了，你會開始看到正面的可能性，讓你這個人更充滿正面的能量，於是，正面的事情，總是會翩然降臨到，你的生活之中。 就算這間店的燴飯，其實不好吃，誰知道，或許我們帶著這個想望回到台北，於是找到一家非常棒的火鍋店呢？ 一定會是這樣的。 ****** 【跟著TT去旅行】，***旅行，總會給你帶來人生新體會***。😉 花蓮旅行的其他，讓我們下回待續。 ******************

title.title: Virat Kohli Car and One8 Commune Restaurant Details
title.body:
Indian cricket superstar Virat Kohli is not only famous for his records on the cricket field but also for his luxurious lifestyle and successful business ventures. While fans often search for “[virat kohli car](https://www.sportsyaari.com/cricket/virat-kohli-car-price-car-number-lamborghini-car-collection-total-and-more-18866/)” collections that include brands like Audi, Bentley, and Range Rover, his restaurant chain One8 Commune has also become a major attraction across India. From Bangalore to Mumbai, Delhi, and Goa, the stylish restaurants reflect Kohli’s modern taste, premium lifestyle, and love for good food.

Virat Kohli’s restaurant brand is called One8 Commune. The name “One8” is inspired by his iconic jersey number 18. What started as a lifestyle and fashion brand later expanded into the hospitality industry. Today, One8 Commune is one of India’s most talked-about celebrity restaurant chains with outlets in several metro cities. 

The Bangalore outlet of One8 Commune is among the most popular locations because it is situated close to the famous M. Chinnaswamy Stadium. The restaurant offers a luxury dining experience with stylish interiors, rooftop seating, and a premium food menu. Fans visiting Bengaluru often stop by to experience Virat Kohli’s favorite dishes and the restaurant’s lively atmosphere. The menu includes Mushroom Googly Dimsums, Burrata dishes, pizzas, seafood bowls, and vegan-friendly meals. 

In Mumbai, One8 Commune gained massive attention because the restaurant is located inside the legendary singer Kishore Kumar’s old bungalow in Juhu. The place combines vintage Bollywood nostalgia with modern interior design. The Juhu outlet has become a favorite among celebrities, tourists, and cricket fans. Several reports highlighted the premium dining experience and the luxurious menu served at the restaurant. 

Delhi holds a special connection with Virat Kohli because it is his hometown. One8 Commune has multiple outlets in Delhi NCR including Aerocity, Punjabi Bagh, and Civil Lines. The Aerocity branch is especially popular for its premium dining experience and nightlife vibe. The restaurant attracts visitors looking for modern cuisine, elegant interiors, and a celebrity-inspired atmosphere. 

The Goa outlet is the newest addition to the One8 Commune chain. Located near the Chapora River, the restaurant features Mediterranean-inspired interiors and a relaxing riverside atmosphere. The Goa branch quickly became a trending destination for tourists who want to enjoy scenic views along with premium dining. 

Apart from restaurants, Virat Kohli’s luxury lifestyle often becomes a talking point among fans. Searches related to “virat kohli car” remain popular because he owns several luxury vehicles including Audi R8, Bentley Continental GT, Range Rover Vogue, and Audi Q8. His passion for cars and business reflects his larger-than-life personality both on and off the cricket field.

title.title: IS BLOGGING IS COOL AGAIN?
title.body:
*Thanks for the feedback on my last post. It's great to see some of the old crew are still lurking here!*


![popular-chat-bots-495700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/AJhYdKAy9bUh6HJwjFfrYJNVs5P8a6mu7zkv12hfj96r5TD92dKq1Na4N5x8Mxj.jpg)


I'm starting to wonder if blogging might be about to have a resurgence - with all the the AI slop on platforms like YouTube I'm starting to think the heyday of videos may be over. I hope so!.

About 10 years ago I had a blog that used to get quite a few hits. They may have all been bots, I don't know, but it gave me the illusion of being massively popular, for what it's worth. 

It was called http://www.frot.co.nz

I'm updating it now to https://frot2.blogspot.com/


![Screenshot from 2026-05-27 21-09-39.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/23wzdae7DWrWaMeoKqw6AQ73XvTPpabcogrENAqKYHxXkwJRypRbgQ3hR8L1PNVptzY5e.png)


But when the hits dried up I became a bit more reclusive and took to just throwing out intermittent collections of random images, and some pictures of men with beards wearing dresses, along with disparaging comments about their femininity.


![rock-chick-style-242786-1511287482424-image.500x0c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/23wqg3q1YmtE9hrMSFERx9gbhbvY22vznfwC6qvbrkt4Sohse2M5q69NRZRfDU4HqYEdZ.jpg)


Lately the endless sea of AI videos on Youtube has convinced me that blogs still have real purpose in this fake world. They are such a good way to summarise and present information in a way that can be rapidly searched and analysed.

Blogs are an antidote to the fakery, and endless time wasting of videos.


![YouTubeSlop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/23vYhE1vYQgSjdo39USrLKZCgmi6SBUyjFFcpaFUXpXwtPK6McDiKzmAqHZ6T4cog4o9u.jpg)


My main current blog is https://sift666.blogspot.com/


![Screenshot from 2026-05-27 21-11-08.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/EoiTHZoknNyWe8myqxnHwEYFJGQUj6RcUTQ93VrWeKpZiGsZzF25ZVNazSyaDUv4ojM.png)


Unlike videos or tweets or whatever is fashionable this week, blogs have had their day and are no longer fashionable. Good, that makes them exactly the sort of thing I'm looking for, so I now have this rabid urge to go hard out. And not to just have one blog, but to have four blogs.

A strange and very specific conspiracy that seems to be endlessly entertaining and bizarre is the rabbit hole of trannies. There are so many celebs that look like they are not really the gender they are claiming to be, that transvestigating them has become a popular hobby. Sort of like trainspotting. So I've set up a separate blog just for tranny spotting.



![42ae2076f8dbe79855d1cb207f818342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/242NqcfPqv3CJ1NspsdhBfTwCn7JSZyLt3CVm7anK9pzkJyJYsUqc7Z15NrvbYdG5cvmo.jpg)


That tranny blog is called https://transvestigate.blogspot.com


![Screenshot from 2026-05-27 21-11-51.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/23tS36pL8DSgTDtQhH2dMg9jj2JdvydEahzj1dcdPJ2qTMPBQWFz159sGwgX3V6pjLgLt.png)


As well as those three blogs I'm also doing a new one for our Weston A Price Foundation chapter - https://wapfwellington.blogspot.com


![Screenshot from 2026-05-27 21-13-27.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/241tbCZDu3AfRtgMspchANgFX2NMQpMFpQWtNq7MgxJ3dyCBQ5ifKzwshx9hvCAYQV68k.png)


Now that I've got four blogs all set up and following very similar templates, I'm ready to let rip. One of the rules about social media applies to blogs too - to get them pumping they need masses of fresh new posts.

So as my latest strange experiment I'm planning to fling truck loads of content at all four of my blogs and see what happens.

I think it would be really cool to potentially change the thinking of thousands of unseen online readers, to open their minds to a few new concepts and maybe even influence the direction of mankind.

Failing that, they would just be a pretty good way to at least get my thoughts in order by presenting a few interesting concepts. 


![Un007titled.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/AKutXSoY9hdT1R1oCUPKWuNsMe1y5kWVwNnXWvWchTKKSdGRL4GBr4eaVVx1Kw4.png)

title.title: DEALING ITH ONLINE SCAM
title.body:
Hello everyone, you are welcome to my blog.

Our phone is not only our private possession, but it's like another part of us that shouldn't be shared with just anyone. I remember when one of my brothers told me that a professional hacker can hack my phone when they are connected to my Wi-Fi. I was very surprised when he told me because I had no idea that by that small step, I might lose my phone to hackers. It is very important that we protect ourselves from scammers.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmce7YeXxu1hbXhFupkZebsLsHPSuNF4dLWuwYNHU5kSXg/30385.png 




The more reason you should be careful is that these scammers are getting smarter and more creative day by day. That is why everyone should be more than careful about the things they post and the information they share out there. The internet is here to make the world easier for us and not the other way around. As much as the internet has made life easy, it has also created space for online scammers who prey on people every day.

The funny thing is, this particular set of people is always ready to stay awake all night looking for people to scam. It can either be investment fraud or fake giveaways, etc. Scammers are working endlessly to steal money and personal information from people. That is why it is very important that we always protect ourselves from scammers.

Another way I try to protect myself from online scammers is by doing my best to avoid clicking on links I am not sure about. It is no longer news that scammers send fake messages pretending to come from your banks, or they will call telling you that one of your family members is hospitalized and that they need a certain amount of money. If you fall victim, they will scam you out of your money.

That is why I keep telling people not to click on any random link you come across. I will also avoid visiting too many websites that I am not familiar with because by that alone, I may be robbed of my email, and once that is done, it's finished. I can't retrieve it anymore. I just have to sit and watch them take over my phone, and I also run away from those sites that promise free things for a long period of time without me putting in any effort.

To avoid online fraud, we must take various steps. We must not share our personal information with anyone. We should always keep our social media accounts protected. Many people may call us and ask for passwords; we should never give them our passwords. The most online fraud in our country is seen in the field of mobile banking. My mom had a very bad experience, and we lost a huge sum of money in the process, and I don't wish that on anybody.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

title.title: Mechanical city
title.body: > Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. ***

> Hello my dear friends. I am @rasel72. From #Bangladesh. *** ![6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzp6C8K2WJLBTbptzfTgJ3KucZMkh8LCagFLUSE1WABpcgmBVE2CanN8GSbp7y9aW9XPBSK53ek7JaTaTY.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTX1ZDpJT67GdGWuE5a2ju4dmMoPRwzJvyMrf4KXcGhYe/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzp6C8K2WJLBTbptzfTgJ3KucZMkh8LCagFLUSE1WABpcgmBVE2CanN8GSbp7y9aW9XPBSK53ek7JaTaTY.jpeg)
Thumbnail

>


We do so many things in the pursuit of life. We work day and night just to live a little better with our family and relatives. People start looking for money and food even before the dawn. Some to manage their own business, while others work as subordinates to others. Everyone's goal is to earn the same amount of money. As the daylight increases, this demand increases. There is a kind of restlessness, noise and no sound in the city. Everyone wants only what they want, no one is happy with their position. Everyone wants to rise from higher to higher. But perhaps we forget that worldly life is temporary. A believer should not be so busy with these two-day worldly things. Whenever he goes out on the street, a rickshaw puller calls out, \
so that he can get rent. A fruit seller will ask, \

In this way, everyone is busy with their own earning. Nowadays, the streets of Dhaka city are no longer walking streets; they have now become markets for small traders. They even set up shops on the highways. Their shops create traffic jams on the roads, and it is not possible to walk properly. Although they are here to earn money, it is not right to make money by making people suffer. Sometimes I feel annoyed with them, but later I think, if I don't sell here, how will I earn money, because no one can afford to rent a shop in a place like Dhaka city. However, when people in the world give me a very dishonest opportunity, they sit on my shoulders. Sometimes they keep the price of things so high that it is beyond words, if they only keep the price high, they also give less by weight. Which is really shameful for our society. ![DSC_2500.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmakApn51g6s7mB17mMvCDopDh5FaUysBcXhZHjDC5x2cr/DSC_2500.JPG) ![DSC_2491.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXE9rkFb8ArYCbaCHoys1EoPePZ4GuRXrHLV7Sy4K9DgA/DSC_2491.JPG) ![DSC_2490.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmY5F8CYXjXr1DjubsS6wR6bbezC5qxFjk3BSGagZ7vEiB/DSC_2490.JPG) ![DSC_2495.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaiunW6RqDep2nQQvsfFw6a4N78R3epRZaqy7uiX6pRR9/DSC_2495.JPG) ![DSC_2496.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdCC3NTcn53FyLVDsPQwLZwSmWJZHKHmAzMNfxRxZ2CJ6/DSC_2496.JPG) ![DSC_2506.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma6GRvafFXiMKffPw7HbnMpMkeNbegkHkogrqeUNRBreD/DSC_2506.JPG) Let me tell you a little surprising thing, the food, fruits or things that we don't eat much in our villages or our own areas or can get for free, the prices of those things are sky-high in Dhaka city. Just a few days ago, I saw a fruit seller selling raw mangoes in a van. I was curious and asked, how much does he charge for mangoes, and he said 100 taka per kg. Hearing that, I felt like I fell from the sky. The raw mangoes that are left at home and not eaten are sold for 100 taka per kg here. I left without saying anything after hearing the price. Meanwhile, the vegetables that the farmers of our area give to the people for free are expensive here. What can I do, life is like that, we have to adapt to it. I have been living away from home for almost 7 years for my studies, so I have had a lot of experience in city life. Now let's talk about transportation. Unlike our area in Dhaka or Gazipur, autos or vans are not available. Here, most of the buses are buses or rickshaws. Rickshaws are for short distances or alleyways. If you go by rickshaw on the same road that takes 10 minutes to walk, you have to pay about 40/50 taka. Even then, many times they don't want to go. You can't talk to the bus drivers. Currently, they have increased the fare of all the buses by showing the fuel crisis. If you can say that the uncle is a student, half the fare is a thousand questions. ![1000053867.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaQ29usKpoRf7RcMUyswiYWQvRADrXosMu7VrF8VN7W7L/1000053867.jpg) Let's now know a little about the cooking aunts of the students' mess. Those who have been in the mess outside during their student life know what a nuisance cooking aunts are, sometimes there is less oil and more salt in cooking, fish is not cleaned properly. Vegetables are not cooked. They cook with vegetables as they wish. Sometimes they put a lot of spices in it and when you say something, they start screaming again. If you ask them to cook more than one dish, they have a heart attack. They make excuses for illness and various other things. They don't come to cook immediately, later they say that there was a problem at home, I was sick and so on. I can't even eat food peacefully due to the aunts' anger. What else can I do, I have to accept it if I don't go home. Anyway, today I have presented some pictures of city life to you. I hope many of you are also facing these issues. Everyone stay well and healthy. I will see you again with a new post of mine. #
>Thank you very much everyone for reading today's post.
