title.title: A small plot of land with yucca plants, owned by some friends, which could soon become something bigger if the rain comes
title.body: > Happy and blessed night to my Hive friends who share daily here in the #hivegarden community, where we showcase the best possible photos of our gardens. In this case, I visited some neighbors yesterday afternoon and took the opportunity to snap some great pictures of the plants in their small garden. It's not a large-scale garden, but it's enough to quickly reap the benefits that nature offers to those who have the opportunity to grow their own food. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd3DYAfqZcfpLZGGgeZWhF9hf7BK6C69vkrCHBe1tyem8/1779872504309.jpg) In this case, they're planting yucca plants. They told me it was practically a trial run, since they had a section of their land that they'd almost never used due to the presence of ants and other insects. They cleared it so thoroughly that they decided to plant the seedlings in a small area, and almost five months later, you can see the very good results they're getting. They also mentioned that these plants are nine months old (so they still need a little more development). It's worth noting that these plants are excellent, and they didn't want to plant any more, waiting for them to fully develop so that, God willing, they can plant the other piece of land there on a larger scale. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvgeXCRffLmrqDk9yBSqJns8q4tpvqXtni4EDrapqRXp/1779872593488.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbmmACrWQPwpz9hkQLx6BCfR6H83g8uVbKrH5YZphadu/1779872593837.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMZEVL97WYRk2sc23X3AFynETriun4nSkkGkELKRa7LY/1779872594208.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabDzYWCk8P8vr7K8QgW7c6gUATRiNUVkbHiXsf3VX2wU/1779872594564.jpg) Nearby, they also planted three plants: two avocado trees and one papaya tree. They plan to have a wider variety of plants in the future. They've already started the seedbeds for both sweet peppers and tomatoes to try and get the most out of nature. Although they have water, they're waiting for the rains that usually fall around this time of year, but so far they're still waiting for them to arrive so that the harvest can be at 100%. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRamxskyBFPAg1aKDSrRnrLVv8Z1FVfZLyjciHdbUt6P7/1779872804424.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWamJ8HWykUmAUr6AmqBBL9ieXgahzPyrsuusXFcgjDxT/1779872804772.jpg) The life of farmers is complicated if they don't have the necessary tools, but it's undoubtedly incredible to take the time to work the land even without knowing for sure if they'll get the harvest they want.

title.title: From Manila Memories to Bulacan Mornings: How 555 Spanish Style Sardines Became My Unexpected Breakfast Comfort
title.body: /> **Hello Hive Family, and most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world! 💖** Today, I want to share a simple yet meaningful reflection about my breakfast; because sometimes, even the humblest meals carry stories worth telling. This morning, I opened a can of **555 Spanish Style Sardines** and paired it with plain white rice. Affordable, filling, and surprisingly delicious; it was enough to start my day with satisfaction.

/> But here’s the twist: growing up, and even during my years working in Manila, I never touched sardines. Not because I was picky, but simply because I had other food preferences. It wasn’t part of my routine.

/> Everything changed when I moved to Bulacan in 2022. Out of curiosity (and sometimes necessity when the budget was tight), I tried sardines for the first time. To my surprise, I enjoyed it. Since then, it has become a recurring part of my meals several times a month.

/>

What I once ignored has now become a comfort food, a reminder that tastes evolve, and sometimes life’s transitions bring us closer to simple joys we never expected to embrace.

This little shift in my eating habits reminds me that change often comes quietly. A new place, a new routine, and suddenly, something ordinary becomes extraordinary. Sardines may be inexpensive, but they carry with them the flavor of adaptation, resilience, and discovery.

**Thank you, Hive Family, for always being here to read my reflections and share in my everyday stories.** Your support makes even the simplest breakfast worth writing about. Until next time, may we all continue to find meaning in life’s small surprises. 💕

title.title: Nobody Panic (Everyone Is Panicking)
title.body:
# Nobody Panic (Everyone Is Panicking)

*Wednesday, 27 May 2026*

---

**Brent crude:** ~$103 | **Gold:** $4,490 | **BTC:** ~$77k | **10-yr Treasury:** 4.46% | **US debt-to-GDP (projected, 2034):** 129%

---

Let's run the numbers out loud and see if anyone flinches.

Brent crude is at $103 a barrel. Gold is at $4,490 an ounce — up 36% year-on-year, which is not what gold does in a calm world. The US Navy is escorting tankers through the Strait of Hormuz while Iran's Revolutionary Guard is claiming it fired on an F-35. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act — signed, sealed, and already triggering automatic Medicare sequestration — adds $3.4 trillion to the federal deficit over the next decade by the most neutral accounting available. The Congressional Budget Office puts the 10-year hole at that number. The debt-to-GDP ratio heads to 129% by 2034 on a conventional basis, and higher if Congress does what Congresses always do, which is extend the temporary bits and call it fiscal responsibility.

Bitcoin is at $77,000 and falling gently, like a leaf that hasn't decided yet.

These are not individually alarming facts. Put them in the same room and they start talking to each other.

---

The oil story first, because it's the one that everything else runs through. Brent was at $65 a year ago. It peaked above $116 in early May, pulled back when the US-Iran ceasefire got announced in April, then climbed again when the ceasefire started unraveling within ten days. Secretary of State Rubio said last week that talks may take \

The US naval blockade of Iranian ports was extended indefinitely. The math on this is straightforward: every dollar on the barrel is roughly $14 billion in annualised additional costs flowing through the global economy. At $103, compared to a year ago, that is a $532 billion annual energy tax. Nobody voted for it. Nobody campaigned on it. It just showed up in the PCE print — 4.5% annualised — and sat there, looking the Fed in the eye.

Kevin Warsh walks into this. Five days on the job. First press conference in three weeks. The FOMC vote at his inaugural meeting, should any surprises arrive in Thursday's data, will be read like tea leaves by people who have never read tea leaves in their lives.

---

Gold at $4,490 is the market's handwritten note to itself. It doesn't mean catastrophe. It means enough people with enough money have looked at the fiscal trajectory, the energy situation, the Committee fighting in public, the $38 trillion in outstanding federal debt that needs to be continuously rolled at whatever the current rate happens to be — and decided that some portion of their net worth should be stored in a rock that doesn't depend on any of this working out.

The JP Morgan 2026 outlook had gold at $4,753 for the full year. They're not going to look wrong at this rate.

---

Then there's the reconciliation bill itself, which deserves a moment of quiet appreciation for the audacity of its timing. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act passed into law with Moody's freshly completed downgrade still warm on the desk. The downgrade cited exactly this: successive administrations and congresses failing to arrest the trend of large annual fiscal deficits and growing interest costs. Congress's response was to pass the most expensive legislation since the 2012 American Taxpayer Relief Act — $3.4 trillion over ten years, front-loaded with tax cuts, back-loaded with spending reductions that future Congresses will cancel. The CBO's dynamic estimate finds the bill increases long-run GDP by 0.5% over the decade. It increases the deficit by multiples of that in present-value terms.

The standard reply is: growth pays for it. The standard data is: it doesn't, not at these magnitudes, not at these interest rates.

Meanwhile the 30-year Treasury is yielding 4.9%. The government is paying nearly 5% to borrow money for thirty years, in an environment where it is also legislating more borrowing. This is not a paradox. It is a bill coming due in slow motion.

---

What Bitcoin is doing in all of this is genuinely interesting, and not in the breathless way the crypto press describes it. BTC at $77k is not confirming the inflation-hedge narrative — if it were, it would be at $120k or $140k given what gold is doing. The Fear & Greed index sits at 30. RSI is neutral. Funding rates just flipped from negative. The asset spent much of the past three months recovering from roughly $63k, which suggests it went through a significant risk-off episode that gold did not share. The correlation with gold broke in March. It hasn't been repaired.

The practical implication is that Bitcoin is still primarily trading as a risk asset with speculative characteristics, not as digital gold. This does not make it a bad asset. It makes it a different asset — one that responds to liquidity and risk appetite, not to the fiscal solvency questions that are actually driving the yellow metal higher. If you think Warsh tightens meaningfully, gold probably holds and BTC probably doesn't. If you think the next move is a hike, the answer to \

becomes less ambiguous.

---

The S&P 500 is up 9.8% year-to-date. The forward P/E is 20.9 times, above every major rolling average. Salesforce reports tonight. The Nikkei is up 29% on the year. The SENSEX is down 11%. Costco trades at 53 times forward earnings because it sells meat in bulk and Americans will always eat. Brent is at $103 because Marco Rubio is still working on the wording of a ceasefire agreement.

None of this is coherent. All of it is happening simultaneously. The market is not a mechanism for processing coherence — it never was — but right now the dissonance between the equity narrative (growth fine, AI real, beats coming) and the macro narrative (inflation reaccelerating, rates stuck, fiscal cliff incoming) is wider than it has been since the initial tariff shock in early 2025.

Something resolves this. Usually it's time, or data, or an event nobody was watching. Thursday's PCE print is the nearest candidate. If April core comes in hot — above the 3.4% consensus — the resolution starts with the bond market and works backward through everything else.

Watch the 30-year.

---

*Anonymous. Independent. No financial advice. All figures from public data, 27 May 2026.*

**Умови для отримання нового дозволу:**

✔️ проживати в Ірландії мінімум 1 рік під Temporary Protection;

✔️ працювати або бути self-employed щонайменше 6 місяців;

✔️ мати мінімальний річний дохід €29,432;

✔️ НЕ проживати в державному житлі:  
— commercial accommodation,  
— rapid build housing,  
— житлі по ARP (Accommodation Recognition Payment).

**Окремо влада наголосила:**

▪️ новий дозвіл буде оформлюватися на всю сім’ю одночасно, якщо сім’я проживала в Ірландії під Temporary Protection;

▪️ неможливо одночасно мати Temporary Protection і новий Stamp 4;

▪️ при переході на новий статус потрібно буде відмовитися від Temporary Protection або іншого імміграційного статусу.

**Також уряд підтвердив:**

▪️ державне розміщення для українців планують поступово згортати з серпня 2026 до березня 2027;

▪️ виплати по ARP з жовтня 2026 становитимуть €400 на місяць.

**Влада пояснює, що нова схема має стимулювати:**  
— працевлаштування,  
— підвищення кваліфікації,  
— перехід до самостійного проживання.

Детальні правила та механізм подачі обіцяють опублікувати ближче до вересня 2026 року.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] My children and the distance / Mis hijos y la distancia
title.body:
>Geographical distance has never been able to erase the strength of a bond as profound as that which unites a mother with her children. Even though they live in another country, even though the days are filled with silence and the nights with longing, their presence beats in every gesture, in every memory, and in every hope that sustains me. My two children are the root that anchors me and the light that guides me, even when the path becomes uncertain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmebd1YuGMeikg9JnVWZgoffLKyViqY8ftNNK3kbGYtkiP/received_278348411076453.jpeg) They represent the strength that drives me to keep going. A strength that is not measured in muscles, but in the capacity to endure, to reinvent themselves, to face life with dignity. Every decision they make, every step they take in distant lands, is a testament to their courage. That value they learned at home, amidst shared stories and everyday lessons, now serves as a compass for their own destinies. Their importance in my life is immeasurable. They are not just children: they are a reflection of my dreams, an extension of my struggles, proof that love can transcend borders. When I think of them, I feel that my life acquires meaning, that every sacrifice finds justification, that every wound is soothed by the certainty that they are moving forward, building their future. They are my pride, my reason for being, my invisible companions every day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmbUWeDEnwgdbhBscN6LVhHRMH1K6BeVUpDvv1Uk91Z2/20171231_142821.jpg) The distance, though painful, also reveals the mark they have left on me. They teach me that true love doesn't depend on physical closeness, but on remaining in the heart. They remind me that motherhood is an act of unconditional surrender, capable of enduring absence and growing in hope. Their imprint is the indelible mark of those who made me a mother, those who gave me the opportunity to discover the strength within me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUGzaDBeAVFX3u4hkbs4U3aDPfKKooGMaBeLbVPTfjRq/img_20220411_wa0034.jpg) Today, as I remember them, I know that their worth is also mine, that their strength nourishes me, that their imprint defines me. Even though they live far away, they remain my home, my roots, and my horizon. And as long as life goes on, I will continue to celebrate their existence as the greatest gift I have ever received. Credits: The photos are from my personal album. I used Google Translate. ESPAÑOL La distancia geográfica nunca ha sido capaz de borrar la fuerza de un vínculo tan profundo como el que une a una madre con sus hijos. Aunque ellos vivan en otro país, aunque los días se llenen de silencios y las noches de nostalgias, su presencia late en cada gesto, en cada recuerdo y en cada esperanza que me sostiene. Mis dos hijos son la raíz que me ancla y la luz que me guía, aun cuando el camino se vuelve incierto. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmebd1YuGMeikg9JnVWZgoffLKyViqY8ftNNK3kbGYtkiP/received_278348411076453.jpeg) Ellos representan la fuerza que me impulsa a seguir adelante. Fuerza que no se mide en músculos, sino en la capacidad de resistir, de reinventarse, de enfrentar la vida con dignidad. Cada decisión que toman, cada paso que dan en tierras lejanas, es testimonio de su valor. Ese valor que aprendieron en casa, entre historias compartidas y enseñanzas cotidianas, y que ahora se convierte en brújula para sus propios destinos. Su importancia en mi vida es incalculable. No son solo hijos: son reflejo de mis sueños, prolongación de mis luchas, evidencia de que el amor puede trascender fronteras. Cuando pienso en ellos, siento que mi vida adquiere sentido, que cada sacrificio encuentra justificación, que cada herida se suaviza con la certeza de que siguen adelante, construyendo su futuro. Ellos son mi orgullo, mi razón de ser, mi compañía invisible en cada jornada. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYmbUWeDEnwgdbhBscN6LVhHRMH1K6BeVUpDvv1Uk91Z2/20171231_142821.jpg) La distancia, aunque dolorosa, también revela la impronta que han dejado en mí. Me enseñan que el amor verdadero no depende de la cercanía física, sino de la permanencia en el corazón. Me recuerdan que la maternidad es un acto de entrega sin condiciones, capaz de sostenerse en la ausencia y de crecer en la esperanza. Su impronta es la marca indeleble de quienes me transformaron en madre, de quienes me dieron la oportunidad de descubrir la fuerza que habita en mí. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUGzaDBeAVFX3u4hkbs4U3aDPfKKooGMaBeLbVPTfjRq/img_20220411_wa0034.jpg) Hoy, al evocarlos, sé que su valor es también el mío, que su fuerza me alimenta, que su impronta me define. Aunque vivan lejos, ellos siguen siendo mi casa, mi raíz y mi horizonte. Y mientras la vida continúe, seguiré celebrando su existencia como el regalo más grande que me ha sido concedido. title.title: Fluchtmodus aktiviert: Warum „einfach weg“ manchmal die einzige Option ist 💪 Pulling the Ripcord: When you reach the point where you just need to escape
title.body:
Kennst du den Moment, wo du einfach nur weg willst? Hattest du schon einmal diesen Gedanken?


![IMG_6747.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/244KLciFz8rVEVQkY5Zdh3pgkK3AmdQYnj7bzqsuXpsHaKb4FR6a9brDidBUGAErodm6t.jpeg)

Ganz ehrlich, mit Familie, Kindern, Job und Co. ist es dir vielleicht noch nie in den Sinn gekommen, einfach nur abzuhauen. Womöglich hast du noch gar nicht daran gedacht, weil es eh unrealistisch ist. Ganz ehrlich, ich habe gerade diese Gedanken und am liebsten würde ich ins Flugzeug steigen und einfach nur weg.


![IMG_6707.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241tQp3CMq2MC6eFUMxoAR2RRh3kz9LsmrKRPPxmZSKjM9W1TRyPk4iqYZPLc6gnKFi8m.jpeg)

![IMG_6695.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xySv69rcyQBeMvzoULzWtz2zKxt5ykzMrJkpGDNUtfJUntMyoQD6x2nViyxbkEU7E9L.jpeg)



![IMG_6678.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uFPqVACXYNw5MGCE7LEV3YsfnMBvg8wq5ohHv841RAu6ijpR96KAZPkYRwFfkB9RLoF.jpeg)




Gerade erst zurück von einem grandiosen Pfingstwochenende in Kärnten am Pressegger See im Gailtal, und am liebsten wäre ich dort geblieben.




![IMG_6968.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23r1993SbUVBZd2pqZaX3pnZiWZefiMpuFawkdv5KBZpG7AoQurdTmqKmgRqMh3XP98ZP.jpeg)


Ursprünglich wollte ich einen netten Post in der @worldmappin Community über den Pressegger See, den Affenberg auf Landskron und so weiter verfassen.



![IMG_6897.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23y94PtvMVy5wBAZkdY4Kb6jpz6UWKx9KE8F4cCsVdtxSdR1uJWFZmDhTjJPj1na36o59.jpeg)


Jedoch kommen in meinen Blogposts immer Learnerings und andere Themen vor, die dort oft nicht gerne gesehen werden. Zwecks Pressegger See folgt vielleicht einmal ein gesonderter Post, denn der wird gerne immer und immer wieder besucht. Und warst du einmal dort, kommst du möglicherweise so wie viele andere wieder. Fahrt ja nicht hin, damit er so bleibt, wie er ist ...



![IMG_6989.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/241tUghUbjzrwv6ViAny2dP8THBTsFcaEng2kny9FkCdunFVrHH6jo291qEBEicnDq4vg.jpeg)



Für mich war es ein Kurzurlaub mit nebenbei ein bisschen Onlinebusiness/Arbeiten und ich habe darüber Videos für meinen YouTube-Kanal gedreht. Mit @threespeak hatte und habe ich noch so meine Herausforderungen, jedoch kommt auch hier wieder mehr.



![IMG_6980.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ydAA5HEYUQcsndXc8EX3hHFXRKc6iQFmJKUGEkEj5A6stg59RGyBb2EF5ThwFv3zbfe.jpeg)




Vom See in die Westbahn, und die 39 Punkte, die ich beim Relax Check-in geschenkt bekommen habe, gegen einen Kaffee eingetauscht. Ich fahre gerne Westbahn auf der Südbahn, weil a) bequemer, b) weniger los und c) das Service irgendwie passt. Sie ist neu!



![IMG_6579.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wMYkxdLEnCWzikhoGVdeeun2W7wFSoQTpw6EqLpgi6epsN3G89V5X59cqGYq3kuqr6F.jpeg)



Von der Westbahn ins Open-Air-Office, im Paradies am Arbeiten und Tun. Den Kaffee genießen und bloggen. Ein traumhafter Morgen, an den ich mich bereits gewöhnt habe. Tja, und am liebsten würde ich einfach nur abhauen ...

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TPJInUu1Wkc

Neu sind übrigens auch meine Shorts und Videos auf meinem YouTube-Kanal. Bedenke bitte unbedingt, die Eigenverantwortung bei all deinen Entscheidungen zu tragen. Ich kann nur von mir sprechen, denn das war auch ein Learning für mich. Deswegen werde ich das immer und überall dreimal erwähnen, ganz gleich wo, und auch hier auf HIVE. Allen voran bei Investments jeglicher Art.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YesQwUPzM9M

Vom Affenberg, Ossiacher See, Kufenstechen in Feistritz an der Gail bis hin zum Pressegger See, den ich mit dem SUP unsicher machte. Stille, Natur, Abschalten und sich über so manchen Menschen wundern. Jetzt zu Hause ...




![IMG_6967.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/243LXRue6bzzHY92nfDFLscjEc7Pp4ubYkLL37b4yoAxq8jZzvNfpm2Fv19tQbkqxjHUN.jpeg)
![IMG_6963.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23y8oHwimRgUyzVqk1gktxagGJ3HSq8DTtxcSHKjD9UHg5aoX5GKiNoDxB6bMYTS6tecf.jpeg)

![IMG_6950.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/2423Q8swXJ6R9tnytH4FAYmU7VS3aS4boemQ3XJz4T4KWfktXDKqTypHVsJnf516eD5QY.jpeg)

![IMG_6952.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zRrFLtmmvDaC59fbr5Mpu8ykSg8GJCKL18a8iAhNPMDdmQbXCynx8yjkn1Lnk1Thbi1.jpeg)

![IMG_6958.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/245HY8EbLCvHUa3nSj4Ao3oNkkr2rBcndSFAUg1qUoSKfxjQ9qGFde4d5ck793vKnHp4W.jpeg)





Wenn du eine Person der Öffentlichkeit bist, ganz gleich was du tust, dann rechne damit, dass es immer wieder auch Menschen gibt, die dich gerne unbegründet schlechtmachen. Nein, keine Sorge, das wird kein Sudderpost, jedoch ist es echt interessant, wie manche Menschen ticken.

Andere wiederum feiern dich und finden cool, was du machst. Genau genommen ist es eh mein bzw. dein Leben, und lass sie labern ...



![IMG_6876.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242Ney599GQ6B5E12B61KmoCJ4LEovvBpYByvz6sK5PsiZpiJVCuVq6wBfSJjwYHjmKig.jpeg)

![IMG_6888.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/2423z1bAp8eGN2XbYNBmdWsq7vJXZQPdczzSzZ9s4TakUdBwhiyRxgDaSP9cXGw7EkmWh.jpeg)




Bei mir ist es definitiv die Dankbarkeit. Wenn ich gerade den Kopf hebe, den See sehe, die Sonne glitzern sehe, blogge und mir denke: Was treibt Menschen an, andere Menschen schlechtzumachen? Menschen, bei denen ich rein offiziell genau aus genanntem Grund auch die Zusammenarbeit beendet habe.


![900C02DB-57AB-4DAE-BA82-110EEC3147B6_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23yTUq9xbq15SKbNfz3snu4m3YcSVggid86qzw18dZMVQb8AzRWA7x3KugKGM9yud8CmA.jpeg)


Wisst ihr, und genau das ist der Punkt, warum ich mich liebend gerne mit Menschen vernetze, die ähnlich ticken, die genauso verrückt sind und einfach positive Vibes haben. Ob Spanien, Dubai, Wien ...


![freiheitistnichtteuer.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/EoEr1kSKcFmf3F9A7XAWyziYxCogqqYun17tTi8YQRcatWgoxW4yQvpcC1pqXoXeGFs.jpg)





Morgen, am 28.05., ist wieder unser HIVE Meetup. Lasst uns zusammen Spaß haben und uns über HIVE austauschen.


https://peakd.com/hive-199963/@schmidi/der-wiener-hive-stammtisch-am-28052026-in-der-fasbrik-gereng


Wir sehen uns in der Fabrik in 1120 Wien um 19 Uhr und hier auf HIVE.

---

### Englische Version / English Version

Do you know that moment when you just want to get away? Have you ever had this thought?





Honestly, with family, kids, job, and everything else, it might have never crossed your mind to just run away. Maybe you haven't even thought about it because it is unrealistic anyway. Quite honestly, I am having these thoughts right now, and I would love nothing more than to get on a plane and just leave.



![IMG_6742.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/244UjGaExbgVtVJgqVK7gzoddUSD6vZmLV3Fyuw3dK8hL7DzMHjWSd7Stc48jZbdPcFsJ.jpeg)


Just got back from a magnificent Pentecost weekend in Carinthia at Lake Pressegger See in the Gailtal valley, and I would have preferred to stay right there.

Originally, I wanted to write a nice post in the @worldmappin community about Lake Pressegger See, the Affenberg (Monkey Mountain) in Landskron, and so on.



![IMG_6612.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u673N5UyztZEU6DUWqF8zSs7Lq5hpWSarsWVEVish9Bnt2moJ8h1bnfqcMdvoEJjZU6.jpeg)



However, my blog posts always include learnings and other topics that are often not welcome there. Regarding Lake Pressegger See, maybe a separate post will follow sometime, because it is a place people love to visit over and over again. And once you have been there, you will probably return, just like many others. Don't go there, so it stays exactly the way it is ...




![IMG_6876.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242Ney599GQ6B5E12B61KmoCJ4LEovvBpYByvz6sK5PsiZpiJVCuVq6wBfSJjwYHjmKig.jpeg)


![IMG_6868.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zbKNyit7W1TzxNxPq3cFVAqKfynPmcZgD9ERecSijLNpM7w7YYCz75ZZW3uQ2ZC4zLh.jpeg)

![IMG_6867.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zRvo3ku2e2ZxVF27HTdpMhNzSMVXk1JdSz2kLz1x5KWsHbjWXaVrM9L4S4C3QqqubxK.jpeg)

![IMG_6866.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xebSKSWYRQx1724byovmCtT2SPiByXymBQwKPftei8giyAdxpn2LRmzhgsK8n6tDc2V.jpeg)



For me, it was a short vacation combined with a bit of online business/work on the side, and I shot videos about it for my YouTube channel. I had and still have my challenges with @threespeak, but more content is coming here as well.

![IMG_6875.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242hSD6WqPhwSfoMNWPw8rAjcF6x4fytXr4F9AUShw7QqDePQbyUaAc5fHoyj17nxZQuW.jpeg)


From the lake onto the Westbahn train, and I exchanged the 39 points I received as a gift from the Relax Check-in for a coffee. I like riding the Westbahn on the southern railway line because a) it is more comfortable, b) it is less crowded, and c) the service is just right. It is new!


![IMG_6952.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zRrFLtmmvDaC59fbr5Mpu8ykSg8GJCKL18a8iAhNPMDdmQbXCynx8yjkn1Lnk1Thbi1.jpeg)




From the Westbahn straight into the open-air office, working and getting things done in paradise. Enjoying my coffee and blogging. A wonderful morning that I have already gotten used to. Well, and I would love nothing more than to just run away ...

https://youtu.be/EvUd7KPGQfE
BEClub22 presentation in English: 

By the way, my Shorts and videos on my YouTube channel are also new. Please make sure to remember to take personal responsibility for all your decisions. I can only speak for myself, because that was a learning experience for me too. That is why I will mention it three times always and everywhere, no matter where, and here on HIVE too. Above all, when it comes to investments of any kind.


![IMG_6852.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xKrC7VCUYbCqHVohJ9hY4MhbxAHXd4Y9pjV84UaC1Dbf4D4ekmU3jMf7MHim67Q6eSV.jpeg)



From the Affenberg, Lake Ossiacher See, the Kufenstechen event in Feistritz an der Gail, all the way to Lake Pressegger See, which I explored on my SUP. Silence, nature, switching off, and wondering about certain people. Now at home ...

When you are a public figure, no matter what you do, you have to expect that there will always be people who like to badmouth you for no reason. No, don't worry, this is not going to be a rant post, but it really is interesting to see how some people tick.


![B43EC10F-BA1D-47E5-8C13-1BFD4353839C_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ywgWDiVLxC3cg2B44TzRRFbWDd1dUpdQ6NA6C61NwNmPRhxeFQDbj6CXGHWpcwsa1co.jpeg)


Others, on the other hand, celebrate you and think what you do is cool. Strictly speaking, it is my or your life anyway, so let them talk ...

![683CC36D-D091-429F-BB8B-AB6C40466EBC_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/242rpeuf1AWTHSMfn1s2CPZRKoq6MWhab8jrrswxTDxyKWpUGXxsK4ZN4jyrYQU8YSNDN.jpeg)

For me, it is definitely gratitude. When I lift my head right now, see the lake, see the sun glittering, blog, and think to myself: What drives people to badmouth others? People with whom I have officially ended our collaboration for exactly that reason.

You know, and that is exactly why I love to network with people who think alike, who are just as crazy, and who simply have positive vibes. Whether in Spain, Dubai, Vienna ...

Tomorrow, on May 28th, is our HIVE meetup again. Let's have fun together and talk about HIVE.

https://peakd.com/hive-199963/@schmidi/der-wiener-hive-stammtisch-am-28052026-in-der-fasbrik-gereng

See you at the Fabrik in 1120 Vienna at 7 PM and right here on HIVE.

Greets
@schmidi

title.title: PV200, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body:
![26uUsAjKTsXCDw7zixZR182JbFKvgzJ9YwsFpTVcRaGCmsqhA1unTgpqWiBDQ5tBd5AmGmEwP33CPwstxzhBnyJpURMRWyrxEswuJEB3QLLJn8dxKqNsP3xS7Z6p3MGKhjFrHPWy6wQu4BYDHKiq35YW8JVUumSR7p5f26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EokVvSf3beXpTLkpntYyMWAk8tLps7ScuSgx4FQYtyDSTnvjrB729i59KE2nv31bxrE.jpg)



Blessings, everyone! Today I'm going to show you my drawing inspired by the R549 PV200 card. It's a rare microphone with a very nice shape. I'm guessing that its shape makes me think it's a studio microphone, the kind professional singers use when recording. I really like the card's background with its navy blue colors and the equalization effects behind it—a very nice design.

I'll be using that same navy blue for the background of the drawing. You've already seen a preview on the cover, but now I'm going to show you step by step how I made this drawing. To begin, I drew the frame. This is the largest piece in the drawing and the one that separates the inner background from the outer one. It also serves as the canvas.


<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BTut2nd6Wj69no7imHKT1jT9r6HVpyXuhKBSeyJHMc7yvk8XYaNA3YoyRsSYeHPd.jpg) Next, I drew the center of the microphone. It has a slightly cylindrical shape, which I really like; it's different from the usual. I assume this microphone isn't handheld; it's meant to be placed on a stand or a special tripod, like the ones we see in many YouTube videos. I think this model is similar to many I've seen in gaming videos. After drawing the cylindrical shape, I drew the ball on top of it. That's what would pick up the voice. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkTQvn4dQYeyu2duTSfq9kxBaUpa4f1to7nEy2gCoTVqtKTY3WJoZUbf.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcrQVDnU4DMduKDasw6Lqdqm7Vha8dUJrePF36D6y2gNby8st5yCmoW.jpg) In the next step, I drew several internal divisions and the area for connecting the cable at the bottom. With that, the sketch is ready for painting. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcrQVDnU4DJwRVKYNvvRrbw3qvUqxSRmQmtZPS7a9FnkvudwMyKwp6M.jpg) For the painting, I started by painting the outer background, then the frame, the inner background, and finally the microphone itself. Thanks to the eyedropper tool in Adobe Illustrator, I was able to get an exact color palette, just like the one in the example chart I'm using. See how it turned out. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoAe52KbSjoBHnDNqP4Ve86XVmB14j4pDdu4xhknqhM8BqN9PURY6xVuEAo5rXthH8X.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoATRRZGEVA4GhkyYHCk3s9do1S9gAc4BxCj4wsP9krKSNwXp63TJd9GrVd5dDBCnvA.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6CESERMi7gnzewXnVHFB9gz1DS2LbxT8e1kTgwP4daKkArCfphd6JQjkUuRJN1hao.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo1vtxSBUdsVj6St3j3A4Lh3S5UVHzBdjcWXaukPfQQJsurfukUNxzbaBjhC6VUYPoP.jpg) And to finish up for today, I'm going to show you the final result. Here I've added the name of the game that serves as the finished drawing stamp, and the name of the card in the name bar. And with that, I'll say goodbye for today. See you in the next drawing. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23wLzDJWYqhUTVkrtWnDrpA26Yc896mQkqUA3fJHhy4sPSExp1QHVecppe3ha7Ji5w7pd.jpg)

title.title: A nature walk, still waters and life in all its fullness. 🌿
title.body:
> --- >There are many kinds of walks and strolls, but the most healing on every level, and the ones that enrich us most, come from nature and that which only nature can achieve: giving life. --- ![20260526_203525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFS1M72W9HjSemJM43DKwhveKyw8TDVVTHQ4vyzfpwxU1rc6TvtLDgcR4opucbcY2ET.jpg) --- It is in places like this that I feel that every step I take, in whatever direction I go, means fresh air, oxygen to fill my lungs, to regenerate them, to walk on the earth, even if I’m not barefoot, and to rest my eyes. Green is a colour that signifies health, and truly, when one finds oneself in spaces like this, one’s health is renewed. --- ![20230420_134037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xARTN61dupVLDB5fQLkftJeiJsivhP8onvXwtsfzxd2iS2piieWeko33PkVMczvSHGg.jpg) ![20230420_134124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC5hYDEVgya4iVC32yz1yK7121m7uFo6RbKrvsWgYojuREUpdtNs2pqZbUGLmCbuPWV.jpg) ![20230420_134151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgFBGqn1HTfg3XfFvzPMFav9s8LB1pt4PnZd5k59pKjQiY86g1w5YxKCrDSHDYTxPHK.jpg) ![20230420_134211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xp2BFx3eBCZhzbKpBWjcG3u5JYjAorhS6JATV8xZSUR3v2uZZNrKnK2J16hdjG35GRy.jpg) --- I always talk about energy and vibrations, because this is fundamental to ensuring that our quality of life keeps getting better. This doesn’t mean having more money or more possessions; rather, it stems from vibrating at a high frequency, from having the best possible energy, from improving it as much as we can and one way to do this is through contact with nature. I believe there is nothing wiser than nature. It has existed practically since the beginning of time, long before us humans, and knows how to heal itself, despite all the bad things it goes through and that humans cause. It remains standing, and that is why I believe we must always learn from this true teacher. --- ![20230420_135003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyR3i7yyN5vvkN32LHS4aBE6UybPLp78Pho1A8hpfyUxDxm8gzatXXivvpXpX4cDsQt.jpg) ![20230420_135014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTYt2CaKVYz6UeJJrz6dziWHoRVwHmAHEbQdPq76UfTSoqYizuxPd8XZnXCBxqy7pVH.jpg) ![20230420_135117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x12vfztGUzy4K5XBZbWAvbtZL2QgsVBYFXKHoqgyRCDahAqa11zCTKSWrR9MpNZT8rq.jpg) ![20230420_135351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMUH9ht1YYT67oeP42DcFUojbDcZpTKMpy9D3eWh2Xe6hTXptafnutPSfD5cxK7U5fX.jpg) --- This is a spot tucked away amongst a maze of paths beneath a sea of trees within the city’s largest botanical garden, which I discovered by exploring and asking myself over and over again… what if I follow that path? What happens? Life is very much like this: if we explore, we find new horizons and ideas, and nature helps us do just that. --- ![20230420_135458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgDF331WAc6wknHMXjy9tuTvo1LB7Ey4yKYxeAuVHxZkMSr7hubRcuj2EjPGYY7L5xw.jpg) ![20230420_135627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMTzhRadWAk1QToNq51WwTmLhnwXY4EkarDKEp4W4ck1bdCHKSDQxUu1V3VvDn4rhr1.jpg) ![20230420_135639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vhsRyerSgpypGTSAcJqPnF5tyGq1VePBSckb8PQCGaob3jjAh8bCBDhqeTyQLPKZjvk.jpg)
![20230420_142112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAPAKQo8fbrAoJBuy4vBbcRuzEpxGoFdLY3yRvsijirmgXpyVDfXLD5Zv2BJFockkxG.jpg)
--- The moment I discovered this little paradise within the larger paradise, there were no words to describe it. Lately, I often say that nature is the only thing capable of surprising me with its beauty. Knowing how to look and observe is the key. But it doesn’t just help us on a physical level, and I can assure you that I notice this every time I’m in these places or walking along a deserted beach. And you might say I’m a loner, perhaps… but the thing is, in solitude you can appreciate certain things. ---
![20230420_140055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvcDmvSFfpstGKP3h9UMm5CMx6mXRcoQr9QhRXK3khLuErD4T47e8HoUZ7tFLYEiyvh.jpg)
![20230420_140035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWniEi2ya6RPtmdYmjm2Qi3c2shYzkfX1z4vinYJJ98ATAo31wXo9Ug7RNr6VbmAbVj.jpg) ![20230420_140109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFKdYft1AT4h9ha5r6wbosM4hpK9tHnfukdStVQoPJr2nLVTAFbcMdKBxfw7njM45xe.jpg) ![20230420_143259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgDKoZ4zQHZGjDdMHM7hStUrBSjdoSNX51Wof57fJEe4T4UoQ5tk8kscHhE4BJ33Gvv.jpg) --- When you see new landscapes, majestic landscapes, your mind focuses on that and not on everything that’s on your mind day to day, worries, work, financial situation, health or whatever. Your mind simply soars and there’s nothing else. It feels as though the mind has simply left the body, as if the head were disconnected. And that is where the magic happens. Because the magic of nature connects with the magic that resides in our hearts. --- ![20230420_143508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vhsGgNuhA32GCnH34JwsKiX4q8aFrBEW1YPQwd3iApA69KqrWfgUUTdDwjaZZ37TkeK.jpg) ![20230420_143620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xeZJ1heDYovMRSnDzY2screGasM6QUk1p9d1UEYkSdTvKjXNSpKpdHv3MfmG8jHsjJg.jpg) ![20230420_143714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u5toQxPX1v8fExp4QDrJWu3X2bXnDpB1y37d7AYSiTESRWYT4NCmKAu3TaDweuBpWsS.jpg) ![20230420_143847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xeZaVimAjoogmXR3DuVGupGtL14SxUtbZm2U5yx9LS5kEJAeTkE6r3DPa57BvP3Li2a.jpg) --- It is at that very moment that a simple walk amongst the trees becomes something that cannot be described in words, because that is not the language of the heart; it is felt, not spoken. --- ![20230420_143859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFMBeGiGQwUboPADVhCFZRKbBT8LAVy9pCipkkroC1jzbWoGwHabRR4oDESdUXrfu3Z.jpg) ![20230420_144006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqbcxSsp3XNmheiaKcPNw8kAHN5JEPTNMuCwZ8RwbtRbFhNwuU1jZX6AD8GoWfiXSMR.jpg) ![20230420_144050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vhoD3NSJjHC6n8xk3k7JC1bHCceiwgYknzvy9ToZLWkdUy2QXprzs8sYYceK8nMUdbS.jpg) ![20230420_144110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgBTH99Crrm1cj7WbmTjszY2s8b1bDK6nGxfDs2Nv3NpDADZh18ZxCNDF5gFHHTzDcK.jpg) ![20230420_144454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvYCwZ15JgDHytGAxiH6Tb4ukR7wdif6sTB6vjEb6Dud4DZHEXi2TyRiXT1xo2RUoFu.jpg) --- Seeing these pools of water got me thinking a lot about reflections in life, whilst I listened to the sound of little waterfalls cascading and the sound of water all around me. Those who know me know that I love water in all its forms. Its sound is soothing and helps with many issues such as stress, insomnia, racing thoughts and much more, problems of the mind. ---
![20230420_144530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC1GDfSqtBnFd94sLyhh4CQHjFofcTVV7XJ4CXQT8BpihHQ8yBM9F7ZsCWFXjMUhELf.jpg)

答辩结束啦！后来的盲审结果也是顺利的过了，遇到的答辩老师也特别好，没有刁难我，而且还笑意盈盈的，我真的一直很担心工作量和论文质量的问题，因为被提出来过很多次，但没想到答辩会这么顺利，而且我还是我们组的最后一个，紧张了一天！中午都没吃下饭，快到我之前连呼吸都快不会了，也可能是答辩老师们着急下班，最后也没给我提几个问题哈哈哈！
我之前在学校食堂兼职认识的学妹也来看我了，还给我买了一束花！呜呜呜，本来以为今年没有同系师妹就不会受到花了，后面我们另一个同门来的时候也给我们一人买了一束花😭太励志了，我们这一届闭门弟子互相扶持555
答辩结束后还有点不真实感，突然回想起当年复试的时候，我也是在最后面，当时因为过于紧张，前一晚完全没睡一点，导致第二天候场的时候趴在桌子上睡了一觉又一觉，当时生怕下一个就叫到我，因为脸上还有睡觉的印哈哈哈哈，一晃三年就过去了，感觉相比于大学的自己真的成长了很多，学会了很多社会处世之道，也变得越来越外向了，认识了很多很多朋友，在天津留下了很多回忆，突然一想下个月就要离开还有点舍不得，不过这一个月肯定还会有更多更多美好的故事等着我！下下个月还要去看邓紫棋的演唱会，期待(✧◡✧)，坐等毕业啦！！

> And the owner’s face looks so peaceful

He was flattered after I praised his gray beast. That was so good to see.

> Looks like tabbies are very popular there too

They just have them from relatives and neighbors - there is no culture of buying unusual cats at stores here.

Btw, tabbies are the oldest coat pattern; they are the foundation, cats closest to the Great Cat Spirit than any other 😁 And also many of tabbies have features of cat populations that had lived in Asia before European kitties arrived on ships and mixed with the local felines. So, they are super interesting.

>  a beautiful community

Yes, thank you. What is especially cool, real Reddit people joined who enjoy contributing. This niche was empty (r/notmycat is the only big one that is close but not the same) - because, as it turned out, Americans see strays and ferals as cats in trouble and normally photograph them when they are in awful conditions and need help, while people in Cetral and Eastern Europe, Turkey, Greece, as well as China, Korea, and Japan (as I know) enjoy free-roaming cats as part of life - part of urban landscape, history, and culture. I believe this difference is a reflection of a broader philosophy.

title.title: Everyday Snapshots: Our Breakfast, Going to the Market, & Blogging
title.body: /> Greetings, everyone! I hope you’re all having a wonderful day. Every new day gives us another chance to smile, learn, and appreciate the little things that make life special. Whether it’s enjoying good food, spending time with loved ones, or just taking a moment to relax, there’s always something to be thankful for. Join me as I share the highlights of my simple, happy life — filled with small joys, positive moments, and everyday adventures. Let’s celebrate life together, one moment at a time! 😊 * * * **Our Breakfast** I don't have work today, so I planned on preparing a nice breakfast for everyone in the house. I cooked some longaniza and bought lumpiang gulay as well. I also cooked rice and made some sauce. I will not forget having my cup of coffee on my side, too.

/> * * * **Running Errands** Whenever I am on leave from work, I always make sure to spend the day productively. My partner and I went to the nearest motorcycle shop to have our bike checked and repaired. We changed the tires and had the oil changed.

/> * * * **Going to the Market** After going to the motorcycle shop, we went straight to the local market in town to buy some of our supplies. We bought chicken, pork, and eggs for our breakfast and lunch. Also, we bought other things we need, like a new pair of slippers and razors.

/> * * * **Blogging** When we got home, I prepared a cup of coffee and started blogging. I already have pending topics and drafts that need to be reviewed before publishing on my platform. I always make sure my content is ready right away.

/> * * * **Everyday Snapshots** by @charmingcherry is a daily blog that features a series of travel, food, and lifestyle stories from her. You’re absolutely right; we come to know many songs or soundtracks through films, and it’s thanks to those films that we remember them. The first film you mention is one of my all-time favourites, particularly because of the subject matter, which fascinates me, and that song will always be associated with the final scene, where the protagonist tries to create the best possible future for his beloved, even if it means he has to suffer. I loved that choice.

The second soundtrack is intense and powerful in terms of the important life lessons it conveys, such as making the most of every stage of life because they won’t come back. I remember that film; I really liked it at the time!

Finally, the last soundtrack is very well known and the song is perfect for the film. I also remember when I saw it and that final part. What’s more, just like the previous one, the song offers messages and advice about what life is all about and what’s best. Thanks for your review; it’s taken me back to the past, both through the songs and the films. Excellent! Big hugs!🤗

> Hello, travelers of the @worldmappin community! Imagining incredible landscapes and close encounters with fascinating animals is something many of us do, but the reality is that few can afford to travel to the most remote places on the planet. Fortunately, there are places like zoos that bring us closer to wildlife in a responsible and educational way. Today I want to share with you my visit to the Ciego de Ávila Zoo in Cuba. Do you remember the last time you had an experience like that? I invite you to discover it with me!
¡Hola viajeros de la comunidad @worldmappin! Visualizar con paisajes increíbles y encuentros cercanos con animales fascinantes es algo que nos pasa a muchos, pero la realidad es que pocos pueden permitirse viajar a los lugares más remotos del planeta. Por suerte, existen espacios como los zoológicos, que nos acercan a la fauna salvaje de forma responsable y educativa. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes mi visita al Parque Zoológico de Ciego de Ávila, Cuba. ¿Recuerdas la última vez que viviste una experiencia así? ¡Te invito a descubrirlo conmigo!

>
To begin this wonderful encounter with the environment, we walked along a path lined with imposing trees. The lush tropical vegetation frames much of the landscape, creating a natural and fresh setting, right above the zoo's welcome banner. Among wide expanses of grass, paths at the entrance surrounded by abundant plants, decorative sculptures, clearings, and animal statues like lions, my recreational journey begins.
Para iniciar este maravilloso encuentro con el medioambiente, avanzamos por un sendero bordeado de imponentes árboles. La frondosa vegetación tropical enmarca gran parte del paisaje, creando un escenario natural y fresco, sobre la pancarta de bienvenida al zoológico. Entre amplias extensiones de césped, caminos en la entrada rodeada de abundante plantas, esculturas decorativas, picadas y estatuas de animales como leones, comienza mi travesía recreativa.

>
The entrance fee to the facility is 25 Cuban pesos for adults and 10 pesos for children, so once tickets are in hand, the tour begins—quite accessible and affordable, to be honest. There’s no excuse not to explore it. At first glance, there’s little crowding, suggesting a relaxed visit where you can observe the animals calmly. The first creatures I saw were reptiles: an iguana resting on the orchids, very photogenic, hehe, and some crocodiles or caimans taking a nap or just watching the visitors.
La entrada a la instalación tiene un costo de 25 pesos cubanos para adultos y 10 pesos para niños, así que una vez con los boletos en la mano inicia el recorrido, bastante accesible y económico a decir verdad, no hay excusas para no explorarlo. A primera vista, se percibe poca saturación de público, lo que sugiere una visita relajada, donde se puede observar a los animales con calma. Las primeras criaturas que vi, son los reptiles, una iguana descansando sobre las orquídeas, muy fotogénica jjj y algunos cocodrilos o caimanes que tomaban la siesta del día o simplemente observaban al público.

>
Continuing with the adventurous routine, we noticed the presence of a clown in the distance, who, with gestures and signs characteristic of his craft, performed his antics and invited us to take photos with him. Although the space is modest, the park's caretakers strive, despite the economic challenges facing the country, to keep the animals in adequate and safe conditions, following basic feeding and welfare practices.
Continuando con la rutina aventurera, notamos la presencia de un payaso a lo lejos, que con gestos y señas característicos de su arte, hacía sus gracias y nos invitaba a tomarnos fotos junto a él. Aunque el espacio es modesto, los cuidadores del parque se esfuerzan mediante las situaciones económicas que presenta el país en mantener a los seres en condiciones adecuadas y seguras, siguiendo prácticas de alimentación y bienestar básico.

>
Among the mammals closest to visitors are the ponies, often used for short children's rides or simply observed while grazing peacefully. Also, the Ankole-Watusi, a cattle breed famous for its enormous horns. We also caught an Anolis lizard, one of the many scaly reptiles that abound everywhere in Cuba. They can change color, which gives them the common name of chameleons.
Entre los mamíferos más cercanos a los caminantes están los ponis, que a menudo se utilizan para pequeños paseos infantiles o simplemente ser observados mientras pastan tranquilamente. Además de los Ankole-Watusi una raza bovina, famosa por su enorme cornamenta. También cogimos un lagarto Anolis de los escamosos que abundan muchos en todas las partes de Cuba. Pueden cambiar de color, lo que les da el nombre común de camaleones.

>
Although it is a smaller complex compared to others in the country, its cozy atmosphere and diverse offerings make it a place beloved by locals and tourists alike. I took some photos of geese that were resting under the roofs. They stay in small areas, walking freely around the space, adding life and relaxing sounds to the environment.
A pesar de que es un complejo más pequeño en comparación con otros del país, su ambiente acogedor y su oferta diversa lo convierten en un sitio muy querido por locales y turistas. Tome algunas fotos de ocas o gansos que estaban descansando debajo de los techos. Se mantienen en pequeñas zonas caminando libremente por el espacio, aportando vida y sonidos relajantes al entorno.

>
One of the most striking moments was encountering the majestic peacock, displaying its blue and green plumage and stealing all the attention in the place. It turned slowly and vibrated its feathers so that everyone could appreciate its splendor, while emitting a sharp call. It was the first time I had witnessed this phenomenon in person.
Uno de los momentos más llamativos fue encontrarme con el majestuoso pavo real, desplegando su plumaje azul y verde robándose toda la atención del lugar. Giraba despacio y vibraba las plumas para que todos apreciarán su esplendor, y emitiendo un sonido agudo. Es la primera vez que estaba presente ante este fenómeno.

>
Elsewhere, behind metal cages, a group of primate mammals—many species of the genus—truly the best thing the zoo has to offer. They are very photogenic, accept food, and play with the staff, leading an active social life. They belong to the same taxonomic order as human beings. That interaction, though simple, creates a special moment where the animal watches you almost as much as you watch it.
En otra parte, detrás de jaulas metálicas, un conjunto de mamíferos primates, de muchas especies del género, la verdad es lo mejor qué hay en el zoológico. Son muy fotogénicos, aceptan comida y juegan con el personal, con una vida social activa, pertenecen a la misma orden taxonómica que los seres humanos. Esa interacción, aunque sencilla, crea un momento especial, donde el animal te observa casi tanto como tú a él.

>
As for the pair of chimpanzees, they were resting in their area, trying to reach food outside the cage, without much interest in interacting with people. But at least they let us enjoy their antics and natural behavior.
En cuanto a la pareja de chimpancé, descansaban en su área, intentaban coger comida fuera de la jaula, sin mucho ánimo de contactar con las personas. Pero al menos nos dejaron disfrutar de sus travesuras y ámbito natural.

>
This flower surprised my partner @karoly and me. It's usually found halfway up the tree, and at first we couldn't figure out what species it was or where it came from. A keeper at the place explained to us that it's the 'cannonball tree.' He told us that its uncommon flower gives off a sweet scent that attracts many bees, which help with its pollination. Later, round, bullet-shaped fruits grow.
Esta flor nos sorprendió a mi pareja @karoly y a mí, suelen ubicarse en la parte intermedia del árbol, y al principio nos fue imposible saber qué especie era, ni de dónde provenía. Un cuidador del lugar nos explicó que se trata del árbol 'bala de cañón'. Nos contó que su flor, poco común, desprende un olor dulce que atrae a muchas abejas, las cuales ayudan a su polinización. Posteriormente, nacen frutos redondos con forma de bala.

>
This next area is designed to get closer to some animals. Such is the case of the Morrocoy turtle, a terrestrial species native to savannas and forests, very gentle and friendly with the public. There was also a small crocodile, which you could take photos with and touch. As a safety measure, its mouth was tied shut.
Esta zona siguiente está diseñada para estar más cerca de algunos animales. Es el caso de la tortuga Morrocoy, una especie terrestre nativa de sabanas y bosques, muy amorosa y amigable con el público. También había un pequeño cocodrilo, con el cual se podían tomar fotografías y tocarlo. Como medida de seguridad, tenían amarrada la boca.

>
A little further on, the camel came up to the fence seeking interaction with us, and we gave it some small leaves. Camels always stand out for their distinctive hump, formed by an accumulation of fatty tissue. The center's staff describe it as a super affectionate and sociable animal—to the point where you can touch it, feed it, and observe it very closely.
Más adelante, el camello se acercó a la cerca buscando interacción con nosotros y le dimos algunas hojitas. Siempre destacan por su peculiar joroba formada por acumulación de tejido adiposo. Es descrito por los trabajadores del centro como un animal súper cariñoso y sociable, al punto de tocarlo, darle comida y observarlo muy de cerca.

>

It's one of the main attractions due to its impressive size, exotic nature, and curious behavior. There's so much wildlife and so many new things that there isn't enough time to enjoy them all calmly. Unfortunately, the sun was too strong, it was very hot, and time passed quite quickly.
El último animal que vi en el recorrido fue el hipopótamo que suele estar en un estante, gran parte del día y sumergido en el agua; pero tuve la suerte apreciarlo mientras comía. Es una de las grandes atracciones por su tamaño impresionante, exótico y su comportamiento curioso. Hay tanta fauna y novedades que no hay tiempo para disfrutarlos todos con calma, por desgracia había demasiado sol, mucha calor y el tiempo pasó bastante rápido.

title.title: Green Living || Rural Environment and its Sweetness
title.body:
![IMG_20260527_083614_482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23xAaGnS8f3gBrB56ePJv4WsijpnrkLtHApnP42spkrgScCaqSi8QCQaDR2ZezedhGevR.jpg)


After the hustle and bustle that is filled with the city life, once in a while, it is deemed a necessity for most people over here  to travel to a remote village where they find some peace, serenity and tranquility.

Most people have villages where they come from, but inside those villages, there are no white collar jobs. The only jobs found in villages are farm works, weeding, tapping of palmwine, harvesting of palm fruits, picking of palm kernel, working at palm oil mills, clearing of bushes, hunting, fishing and other menial jobs.


![IMG_20260527_093346_167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/242Y9hsEZR9zfXpppaNjBFSE4LyKoc9D4UJ15khe4JmDVNWNW6YFv4eEAMU8XhrQZQkr8.jpg)


Living in the village is interesting but it is only very good when one has worked a lot in the city and made so much money, then you can carry some money to the village.

As education and civilization creeps into rural areas most children go to school and get into higher institutions and no longer want to live in the village because they now search for white collar jobs.

New generations neglect farming, fishing and hunting. They neglect this kind of jobs in the village because they feel it is less profitable.

Farming is a very big job and it is very lucrative. I have a family friend that is practicing commercial farming and he is doing well.

Most of the farmers here in the village only practice mixed farming. With this method, one can plant so many types of crops on one piece of land.

Over here, we plant cassava, maize, yam, water yam, pumpkin leaves, water leaf, afang, editan, bitter leaf, atama, cocoyam, wateryam and other crops in the same farm land.

These are planted and they do not require any fertilizer or too much care. These plants are naturally watered by rain fall. They do not need drip irrigation systems like big commercial farmings do.

The villagers just plant and only do some weeding without having to conduct some spraying of any form of chemicals or anything.

This farming in the village also does not require a green house for successful planting, rather, crops are planted out in the open, the rain falls on them and they flourish naturally without much Ado.


![20260522_200556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23uQrdsjhRwt8Eq4afqJnL3JLPfbuR8q7WpNuG3LU8oMYwkUCToAh7dA4DwoAWdkjA9pC.jpg)

Hier der Selbe Text nocheinmal von der Gemini KI Aufgearbeitet fuer eine bessere Lesbarkeit und Verstaendlichkeit:

Überschrift:

Warum mir als Betroffener durch die Anträge von AfD und Grünen aufgefallen ist, dass die technologische Verfügbarkeit präziser Diagnosen zur Unterscheidung von Behinderung und Krankheit komplett untergeht.
Beitrag:

Aufgrund der jüngsten Anhörung des Gesundheitsausschusses im Deutschen Bundestag zur Verbesserung der psychotherapeutischen Versorgung möchte ich meine Perspektive als Betroffener teilen. In der Debatte um die Anträge von Bündnis 90/Die Grünen und der AfD-Fraktion geht für mich ein entscheidender Aspekt völlig unter: Die Rolle moderner, bildgebender Diagnostikverfahren – konkret der Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).

Die viel diskutierte Konsiliarberichtspflicht hat im Kern einen absolut sinnvollen Anspruch: Vor einer Psychotherapie muss geprüft werden, ob körperliche (organische) Ursachen für die psychischen Symptome vorliegen. Damit diese Pflicht im realen Diagnostikalltag aber überhaupt eine echte Chance hat, effektiv zu wirken, braucht es eine flächendeckende und schnelle Verfügbarkeit moderner MRT-Technologie.

Faktisch wurde diese Technologie in den letzten zwei Jahrzehnten zwar massiv ausgebaut, in meinem Fall kam dieser Fortschritt jedoch zu spät. Erst im Alter von 35 Jahren wurde bei mir durch ein MRT eine strukturelle Behinderung festgestellt – verursacht durch eine Gewebevernarbung infolge eines Sauerstoffmangels bei meiner Geburt (Stichwort: Nabelschnurkomplikation). Zuvor wurde mein jahrzehntelanger Leidensweg im Alltag schlicht auf eine reine psychische Erkrankung abgewälzt.

Dieser systemische Fehler hat dazu geführt, dass ich über Jahre hinweg viele Stunden der regulären Psychotherapie in Anspruch genommen habe, die für andere Patienten mit klassischen psychischen Erkrankungen womöglich besser aufgehoben gewesen wären. Den Ärzten und Therapeuten von damals trifft dabei keine Schuld. In den späten 1980er Jahren war die Technologie, einem lebenden Menschen so tief und präzise in den Kopf zu schauen, schlicht noch nicht so weit fortgeschritten wie heute. Ohne diese Bildgebung mussten sich die Mediziner auf das klassische, rein gesprächs- und verhaltensbasierte Diagnostizieren verlassen. Im Falle einer unentdeckten, strukturellen Behinderung führt dies jedoch zu einem verzweifelten und letztlich zum Scheitern verurteilten Versuch, einen Zustand zu therapieren, der organisch fixiert ist.

Natürlich benötigen Menschen mit einer solchen Behinderung ebenfalls Unterstützung und Behandlung. Wenn die Behinderung jedoch von Anfang an klar dokumentiert ist, lässt sich die therapeutische Begleitung viel zielgerichteter und effizienter umsetzen als bei einer zeitaufwendigen Suche nach den Ursachen einer vermeintlichen psychischen Erkrankung. Ein gezielter Ausbau und eine bessere Zugänglichkeit von High-Tech-Bildgebungsverfahren im Bereich neurologischer und psychischer Problematiken könnte hier massive Abhilfe schaffen.

Fazit:
Im Kern der Sache geht es darum, die Technologien, deren Ausbau und die Barrierefreiheit beim Zugang zu diesen Verfahren massiv zu fördern – anstatt eine Abschaffung oder Untergrabung der sehr wohl sinnvollen Konsiliarberichtspflicht zu fordern!

title.title: The Perfect Combination of Dread Tafarian & Wilhelmdale Deputy Secured My Victory in a 27 Mana Battle
title.body:
![Cryptic Is a Strong Choice for Low Mana Battles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQiCAobHo8CFpB1DFwkHs3S8feSV38yErxz4xKriJA3pL4r4XCbD8ZUGnRLREVphXgs.png)


In today’s battle, the modifier rules were very amazing and interesting including Aim True and Reverse Speed. Keeping these rules in mind I selected my monsters with a strong strategy and placed them carefully to achieve victory in this battle. 

And that is exactly what happened.. I achieved a great win because the rules and monster selection created a perfect combination.

Two monsters played the biggest role in helping me win this battle because of their excellent combination. The names are Dread Tafarian and Wilhelmdale Deputy. One kept on absorbing damage and the other kept on attacking from range.

![Screenshot 2026-05-27 095939.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uExMbuUcpTndAhdb6C7kaa4nLjiWzHeZfjnoCKkBrwRfpRU2NWt17i73foJozn7iz5c.png)

In Aim True, all units gain True Strike which means every attack will always hit the enemy target and will never miss. Normally some monsters have abilities that can dodge attacks through speed or evasion abilities but in this battle rule no attack could miss. Every hit directly damaged the enemy unit.

The second modifier was Reverse Speed. In this ruleset the slower monsters attack first and also gain the highest chance to avoid attacks. Because of this low speed monsters become extremely powerful.

Keeping both modifiers in mind I created a strategy focused on strong attackers. Since Aim True guaranteed every attack would hit I selected a combination of melee, ranged and magic attackers so that every attack continuously damaged the enemy team without any misses.

![Screenshot 2026-05-27 100045.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EoEqzkwVzNraCHGBAT5kQM6oj2M1UNchjbQsj2PkkNqNeCoEst4VpmAo13cy5kHSmUY.png)

Because Reverse Speed was active I did not prioritize high speed monsters. Instead I focused more on powerful attackers. That is why I selected support monsters that could provide +1 health and support the Dread Tafarian strategy allowing my front monster to continuously absorb damage while getting healed again and again through the extra health support.

The opening combination worked perfectly. My frontline monster kept surviving with continuous healing support while the second and last monsters constantly attacked the enemy team. This is why the combination of Dread Tranferrin and Wilhelmdale Deputy became the key reason behind my impressive victory in this battle.

My favorite monster in today’s battle was definitely Wilhelmdale Deputy because its stats are extremely impressive. Since it works as a backline monster, even its five health feels very effective. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-27 100122.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tRrDq4ontQWASFm6Pmf9qbY1kncAZR9pQqUdL7fKADymjLTFXAtFTiyNM4EmoHJT9jX.png)

It is a 7 mana cost monster card making it useful in both medium and high mana battles while still being usable in some low mana matches as well. If only placed with the right monsters.

It has 1 speed which becomes an advantage in Reverse Speed battles and because it is a ranged monster it keeps attacking from the backline every round. As you continue upgrading this monster its ranged attack power becomes stronger and additional abilities also start unlocking.

If I talk about its market price this card is currently available for around 0.06 - 0.07, although the value depends on its upgrade level.

What do you people think about this monster card?Do you have this in your decks? Would be glad to see your answers in the comment section..

title.title: Warum mir als Betroffener, Dank AfD und Grünen Antrag fuer eine Verbesserung der Psychotherapeutischen Leistungen aufgefallen ist,
title.body:
das die Technologische Seite der Verfuegbarkeit fuer bessere Diagnosen um von Behinderung und Kranheit zu unterscheiden untergeht.



Aufgrund der letzten Sitzung des Ausschusses vom Bundestag zum angefuehrtem Thema der Verbesserungen der Psychotherapeutischen Maßnahmen durch die Antraege der AfD und Grünen, mochte ich meine Meinung zu dem Thema deswegen teilen, weil fuer mich schnell untergeht, das die Diagnostikverfahren, durch moderne technologische Moeglichkeiten wie ein Magnetresonanzverfahren (hier bitte berichtigen) ueberhaupt erst moeglich gemacht wurde, das die Konsiliarberichtspflicht, ueberhaupt eine echte Chance haben kann in Zukfunt bei besserer Versorgungslage der MRT bildgebenden Verfahren zu wirken und ihren im Anspruch eigentlich guten Kern auch im realem Diagnostikalltag zur Geltung kommen koennte. 


Faktisch wurde diese Technologie die letzten beiden Jahrzehnte zwar massiv und Gut ausgebaut, war aber auch in meinem Fall, leider zu Spaet, mit 35 Jahren erst die eigentliche Behinderung, statt, wie mir der leidensweg damit zuvor aufgetan wurde, eine psychische Erkrankung als Gruende fuer meine Probleme im Alltag aufzuzeigen. 

Diese Mechanismen, haben dann dazu gefuehrt, das meine Person viele Stunden Zeit aus der normalen Psychotherapie, vielleicht fuer Patienten besser aufgehoben haette, wenn von Anfang an klar und dokumentiert gewesen waehre, aber durch die damaligen Verhaeltnisse in den spaeten 80iger Jahren meiner Geburt schlicht unmoeglich waren, klar aufzuarbeiten, weil schlicht die Technologie, einem Menschen in den Kopf schauen zu koennen, nicht soweit war, wie sie in den wenigen Jahrzehnten dazwischen gekommen ist. 

Die Aerzte und Therapeuten, trifft damit keine Schuld, sondern der \

ist schlicht in der Verfuegbarkeit der Moeglichkeiten zu suchen, das die Technologien fuer die besseren Diagnoseverfahren einfach noch nicht verfuegbar waren. Dadurch konnten Aertze und entsprechende Therapeuten nie genau wissen, wo der Kern des Problems liegt und mussten sich mit dem wenigem zufrieden geben, das sie machen konnten, naemlich das klassische Diagnostizieren durch Gespraeche und die bekannten Untersuchungen, sowie der im Falle einer Behinderung, verzweifelte, aber zum scheitern verurteilte Versuch, an den Umstaenden auch mit der besten Therapie nicht viel aendern zu koennen. 

In Faellen wie dem meinem, ist natuerlich auch eine Behandlung angesagt, allerdings durch das Wissen der Behinderung, viel leichter umzusetzen, als bei einem wohl damit auch zeitaufwendigerem psychisch Krankem Menschen zu helfen, den weg in ein gesundes Leben zu finden. Hier koennte der Fokus auf einen Ausbau der bildgebenden Verfahren eben im Bereicht der Kopfproblematiken, vielleicht etwas Abhilfe schaffen nach meiner Meinung.

Im Kern der Sache geht es also darum, die Technologien und deren Ausbau und Zugaenglichkeit zu foerdern, statt eine Abschaffung oder Untergrabung der sehr wohl sinnvollen Konsiliarberichtspflicht zu fordern!!!



Salve

Sascha Pürner

title.title: 🧠 A small geeky calculation
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tbPcocHzhNQjV1YwwpfbSsYgzta5nJiQRHH47iUsUEXgLTUwXVLZZoXvCYdirebvdNY.png)


### 🧠 A small geeky calculation

I asked myself a very simple question: would it be possible to curate without ever dropping below 99% voting mana?

The answer is yes, of course.

In theory, it would be enough to cast 10 votes at 2.5% every 30 minutes. This would result in a total consumption of 1% voting mana per hour. Since voting mana regenerates at a rate of 1% per hour, this setup would maintain a nearly perfect balance, without significantly draining the reserve.

At this pace, you would still reach around 480 votes per day, which is far from negligible. Of course, this assumes there is enough quality content to vote on every day, which isn’t always guaranteed… but it still seems achievable.

The only downside is that such a system might miss some good voting opportunities, especially outside the predefined time slots. But nothing too serious at this stage.

For now, I’m mainly experimenting with different settings. In any case, I don’t yet have a server running 24/7, so this is still very much in the testing phase.

Would you be willing to join me and test such a bot with me?

It will be set up as soon as I receive my paycheck, so I can buy a small $50 PC that I’ve already spotted and reserved from a seller — he’s just waiting for the payment. After that, it will simply take some time to install and configure everything.

The goal won’t be to make high-value votes, but rather to provide consistent support to quality content on the blockchain. The idea is to let Hive Power grow naturally, while gradually adjusting stricter and more demanding voting conditions as it increases.

If you’ve been reblogged, it means the bot has voted for you — congratulations, you met its current criteria. 

# Good day all .

title.body:
> Hello everyone, how are you doing today? Hope you are having a great time. This will be *Week 219 Edition 02* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![1000024894.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/244eP3PKdJY7DN5vrpyjkEbd1rV4HCEyak34y86h4YUASFftXdEGLYucBUV9NcLHGAbpk.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the second topic for this week, which is “IN FOR THE MONEY”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “PHYSICAL DISCIPLINE”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us their thoughts on discipline and how it was given in modern day. In the past, children were spanked and given corporal punishment as a way to prevent them from repeating the same acts in future. But today, other measures are being encouraged. We got to see that most of the time, these punishments don’t work in the way we expect them to. Children don’t automatically become good just because they were disciplined. How we go about the discipline is what makes all the difference. We can indeed do better. This was an enlightening topic, indeed. ***
> For this topic, we went through every entry post, and that is every post with the #hl-exclusive & #hl-w219e1 tag. And with the number of wonderful posts out there, it was quite difficult to make a selection. But eventually, we did just that. And so, the posts that will be featured not just for their exceptional content, but also for their level of engagement with other authors, will be listed below. ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)

Featured Contents


[IMPOSSIBLE TO CONTROL THEM BY FEAR](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@intishar/impossible-to-control-them-by-fear-jgy) by @intishar
*For this author, he told us that he doesn’t appreciate physical punishments at all. While they worked in the past, they most likely won’t work presently. It’s easier now to get through to kids with your words, letting them understand the consequences of their actions. Everyone just needs to find a suitable way to deal with the children in our lives, a way that doesn’t involve physical punishment.*
[WRONG PARENTING](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@kilvnrex/wrong-parenting-dyq) by @kilvnrex
*For this author, he told us that many parents resort to using canes on their children simply because they don’t know of a better way to discipline them. Discipline is unique, and what works for one person might not work for another. As parents, we need to be careful so we don’t push our kids away all in the name of teaching them the right way to live.”
[PHYSICAL DISCIPLINE: A HARMFUL TRADITION](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@zoe01/physical-discipline-a-harmful-tradition) by @zoe01
*This author told us that hitting should never be allowed, whether it’s being done to a child or an adult. While it may stop a child from doing something, it will only be for a short period of time. A child who is raised with the rod will always live in fear of it, even when there isn’t any in sight.*
*** > All of the above contents were supported by our official curation account [lazy-panda](https://peakd.com/@lazy-panda) with an extra amount. The first 3 authors will receive 100 ECENCY Points [ Sponsored By Ecency Team (@melinda010100) ] and 1 $PANDAMINER each as a reward next Monday. These posts were selected because of their special attention to detail and how they followed the topic. There were a lot of good ones out there, but we just could not pick them all. But then, we have some honorable mentions listed below:

Honorable Mention

[INVISIBLE INHERITANCES](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@michupa/invisible-inheritances-en-pt) by @michupa [DISCIPLINE SHOULD TEACH, NOT DESTROY](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@nkemakonam89/discipline-should-teach-not-destroy) by @nkemakonam89 [SPANKING DISCIPLINE](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@emrysjobber/s-s-38c16b487418b) by @emrysjobber These are posts that were also found to be quite exceptional. ---- ---- ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)
AND NOW, WE MOVE ON TO THE NEW TOPIC!
***

Week 219 - Edition 02 Topic

**IN FOR THE MONEY**

title.title: Hive Is Home.
title.body:
Well, the prompt ask that we be real and I'm going to do just that. Even though the topic is a simple yet deep one. Talking of if I've ever wanted to quit hive.


The answer is yes, I won't be speaking for anyone but myself. A lot of time I've thought about quitting hive. I've had moments where I question myself, and everything and ask what exactly I'm still doing here.


![1000686918.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/EpCGC3qi7iHgiB3ERHvWmn62tW2G5qxfURLHJGPtRXECjnVeMurttcWu65F8KYSbRCL.png)





Let me shock you, there was a time I actually left hive, like I was out of it totally. And I wasn't out for weeks or days, nah. I didn't even come near or open hive for almost two years. It was later I finally had a rethink and vane back.



And one of the reasons is the rewards, we can't...no, I can't lie about that. The rewards is just as important, you spend hours on here, reading, engaging, posting, upvoting, and trying to improve everyday and you want to tell me reward isn't a part of why you're doing all of this... Common. Even though on the long run, I've gotten so attached to #hive and writing and being on here has now become a habit.



Now, back to what I was saying... I left then because I wasn't seeing the turnout I was expecting, I searched and did my best, same. I saw other writers and creators who aren't even doing as much as I do getting massive upvotes and engagement, and here I am struggling with 0.020... you can relate with that feeling right...it's not easy. I began to doubt myself, and wondered if I was ever seen.





But then, here I am. Ever since I returned like two years ago now, I've been active, not very very consistent like now though. And as at then, hive was still within a good price range and upvotes carries some level of weights as well. But presently, hive has gone down and even upvotes has reduced too...but I'm still here.


![1001074621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y9Actb8oDoXrG6sb88Po2f2ReK784ykuJxfAQ42MRtf4rFE4e2tKoFwJ51XuTwSnKya.jpg)



The various things I'm seeing now won't even want me to quit, talk of the various amazing friends I've had to meet here and on discord, talk of the @sam.hangout and it's discord channel where got to rub minds, discuss various topics, meet new people, do giveaways, get updated and all. Also, talk of the @neoxian city and it's discord channel where we relate like family, get supported as well and all.



Now, back then I don't know about something of this amazing frontends that make user experience easy, lovely and smooth. The likes of @ecency, @inleo, and the likes.



Also, I'm still here because hive has become a part of me. Writing has become a daily habit, so even though it's not that encouraging and hive itself doesn't look like it at the moment, I still find myself here doing things I would have still done if the price of hive is higher. Hive has become a home, somewhere I can't see myself being absent from.


In conclusion, I hope that things can get better and return to the way it was.




🌹

**First image was edited on canva, second image is a screenshot of my board.**



**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

虽然两年我才买了1L淡奶油回来，但做了两次蛋糕后我就吃腻了😄做的都是蛋糕卷，淡奶油放的也不多，，真的是没买的时候心心念念惦记着，吃到嘴上就不香了哈哈～然后我就把剩的淡奶油分装放到急冻室保存了，存起来留着做面包🍞好过浪费。

今天就拿出一些来做老面包，急冻后的淡奶油是水油分离的状态，做蛋糕打发就不可行的，也是好多天没做面包了，今年好少玩烘焙了。其实现在做蛋糕🍰面包类都是留做早饭，不是早饭没吃的 我都不想碰烘焙了😂现在更喜欢我们中式面点。

问其他人想不想吃，他们也不发表意见，我就按自己的想法做了。要做就做满盘，感觉有点想为了消耗烘焙用料而做，目前为止 就买了一瓶淡奶油，其余都是去年买的呢！在放啥啥都要过期了。

不过今日的老面包状态还是可以的，又找回了一点以前做面包的感觉了，视觉动物就是视觉动物哈哈😂爱不爱吃不重要，饱饱眼福也不错！

title.title: Between the Waves
title.body: Create post for posting in ecency community \

Ecency Lifestyle Surfing Post Finding Peace Between the Waves There’s something special about being surrounded by endless water while the world goes quiet for a moment. No noise, no pressure — just the sound of the ocean, the movement of the waves, and a chance to breathe. Lifestyle is not always about luxury or expensive experiences. Sometimes, it’s simply about finding moments that make you feel alive. Standing in the ocean with a surfboard in hand reminded me how important it is to disconnect from stress and reconnect with nature. The sea teaches patience. You can’t control the waves, but you can learn how to move with them instead of against them. I think life works the same way. We spend so much time trying to force everything into place, when sometimes the best thing we can do is trust the process and keep moving forward. Sunrise and sunset near the water always create a different kind of peace. The soft colors in the sky, the reflection on the waves, and the calm atmosphere make even ordinary moments feel meaningful.

/>

Image Source/Credit: [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-surfing-during-daytime-0AidOIzFAGc)

For me, this is what a balanced lifestyle looks like:

Spending time in nature

Taking breaks from screens and stress

Enjoying simple moments

Staying active and healthy

Appreciating peace and silence

No matter how busy life gets, moments like these remind us to slow down and enjoy the present.

They are so small and wonderful, they seem to be similar to each other, but each one is different. There will also be a few photos of magnolias here, I haven't had time to process all the ones I have yet. Also here will be photos of my rhododendron bush which is starting to bloom. ![DSC00352.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23vPGQoQWmhUr1hNE4z9spVe56c4tvGnAdLnuR9JWF3zRjVfZeGkwC9TdZcSvyDeJHsGU.JPG)

A sprawling garden expanding over few acres of land is ultimate dream of every gardener - it's like  having a green canvas providing endless space for creativity and peace. Unless you inherit such a big property, it's literally impossible to create one in our life time. But I am fortunate to have a view of such a beautiful garden from my window, and recently we started noticing some significant change of this place.


![DSC00336.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23ynKk929PTUDbFAb3c6ygJkaJmGPWmjTvfr53rqCvjf7XkKGNKhSB66uZAfcw6TU6UG9.JPG)
