links.title: The Art of Leaving Something Unfinished
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anna.kathaxrina/23xKxJzQygG4iosNdfSccjS7LhoMg5UouiuR6BdjpMbjQthMhiiNUEkuNaQdfg9zkUwk9.png)

Not every moment needs closure.
In fact, some of the most memorable ones are the ones that end just before they fully unfold.
There’s a certain beauty in leaving something incomplete—in allowing imagination to continue where reality paused.
It lingers longer that way.
Tell me—do you need an ending… or do you prefer a story that stays with you?

今天早上九點多出門，錯過了去醫院的接駁車，只好原路折返回家後又再次出門去搭公車，到醫院約莫十點多，結果光排隊超音波就等了一個多小時，好不容易照完了超音波去門診等看報告，又等了一個多小時，輪到我進去門診時已經下午一點多，再拿完藥後就已經一點半了，又去等個公車回到家已經兩點多......

等公車時其實只提早十分鐘去外頭等，沒想到太陽大到我睜不開眼，天氣熱到我站在那裏一分鐘都是酷刑，燒燙燙的快把我整個人融化了，真的是挺受不了這不夠體貼民眾的公車站牌，就不會設個公車亭嗎?不是狂風暴雨就是熾熱爆熱，真的是很受不了啊~~

因為要空腹做檢查，所以下午兩點回到家附近就趕緊跑進去便利商店買東西吃，一個水果三明治加拿鐵咖啡，很快的解決了一餐，打算晚點再出門吃好吃的，因為今天出門看醫生花了快五個小時真是超累人，大家真的要好好保重身體少去醫院，真的是太浪費時間和生命了~~

---

links.title: М'ятний листоїд
links.body:
![IMG_20260526_202600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23uQrj97qZkyqC8G1xzxRKbyB3duxBay8MVW5RGoppc9JL6NxVk58inxm13ngvyZXmUrH.jpg)

Привіт, друзі! Чесно кажучи, я навіть не думала, що існує ще й такий шкідник. Але вчора вранці чоловік каже: «Нашу м’яту їсть тля» 🤔. Я ніколи не чула, щоб тля їла м’яту, але він уперто стояв на своєму: мовляв, на стеблах повно маленьких чорних цяток. А на кількох зелених жуків він навіть не звернув уваги.

Ну, ми пішли подивитися. Глянули на ту «тлю» — а вона навіть не ворушиться. Ми зірвали кілька стебелець м’яти з обгризеними листками та тим жуком. Я зробила пошук через Google Об’єктив, і виявилося, що це жук, який їсть м’яту — м’ятний листоїд, або хризоліна зелена. Це дуже спеціалізований шкідник, який харчується м’ятою та іншими ефіроолійними рослинами.

Найбільша проблема в тому, що м’яту ми вживаємо в їжу, а саме її листя, тому інсектициди використовувати не хочеться — вони можуть накопичуватися в рослині. Тож боротися з ним радять народними методами. Найпростіше — просто позбирати жуків вручну. Також допомагає посипати рослини попелом або гірчичним порошком, чи розвести попіл у воді й обприскати м’яту. Якщо посипати попелом, то це треба робити після дощу або поливу, щоб попіл вкрив вологе листя.

Ще в цих жуків можуть бути личинки, які ховаються на нижній стороні листя. Але личинок ми не помітили. А те, що було схоже на тлю, виявилося просто засохлими випорожненнями жука — маленькими чорними «какульками», перепрошую. 😁

Чесно кажучи, я ще не мала часу зайнятися тими жуками, але треба буде щось робити. Можливо, справді посипати попелом, тому що м’яту в нас дуже люблять. Ми використовуємо її для чаю, діти п’ють, гості теж люблять, та й узагалі вся сім’я полюбляє м’ятний чай. Було б шкода, якби жуки з’їли всю м’яту.

Ще пишуть, що допомагає регулярне прополювання та розпушування ґрунту ранньою весною, адже жук зимує в землі й вилазить, коли прогрівається ґрунт — зазвичай у першій половині травня. Але цього року тепло трохи затрималося, тому він виліз у другій половині травня й одразу взявся за м’яту.

Тож, мабуть, доведеться посипати попелом. Чому це допомагає? Причина банальна: жук сідає «снідати», а листя брудне, неприємне на смак — от він і лізе геть. А м’яту потім усе одно можна помити, ми ж її щоразу миємо перед тим, як заварювати чай. Зате засіб безпечний.

![IMG_20260526_202616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/242DQY364nwQkDkeFMjVBYxRRTXcuuz1DbxHkaPr6VxyWBVaWuXK21MkToQpfwPVDgPZw.jpg)

![IMG_20260526_202620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23zGgWYnDnTqGMrmw9Cv3WCmze5RhWZmEN4YWKhtjwPQqS2Ggvqhzr2ufSvgn7kvqm1ow.jpg)

links.title: Tips Memilih Konveksi Jaket untuk Angkatan Kampus yang Tepat Waktu dan Anti-Zonk
links.body: Membuat jaket angkatan, jaket jurusan, atau almamater merupakan salah satu tradisi penting bagi mahasiswa di bangku perkuliahan. Jaket ini bukan sekadar pelindung dari angin malam atau dinginnya ruang kelas ber-AC, melainkan simbol identitas, kebanggaan, dan pemersatu solidaritas satu angkatan yang akan dikenang hingga lulus nanti.\n\n

/>

Namun, mengemban tugas sebagai panitia pengadaan jaket angkatan memiliki tanggung jawab dan tekanan yang cukup besar. Dengan jumlah pesanan massal yang mencapai puluhan hingga ratusan potong, tantangan utama yang sering dihadapi mahasiswa adalah proyek pengerjaan yang molor dari tenggat waktu (deadline), ukuran yang tidak sesuai, hingga kualitas bahan yang mengecewakan (zonk).

Agar kepanitiaan Anda terhindar dari masalah tersebut, berikut adalah tips cerdas memilih vendor konveksi jaket angkatan kampus yang profesional dan tepercaya:

1.  Periksa Kapasitas Produksi dan Rekam Jejak (Track Record)
    

Sebelum menjatuhkan pilihan, lakukan riset mendalam mengenai rekam jejak vendor tersebut. Cari tahu apakah konveksi tersebut sudah sering menangani pesanan jaket massal dari kampus-kampus besar. Vendor yang memiliki pabrik atau rumah produksi sendiri dengan kapasitas mesin jahit yang memadai cenderung lebih konsisten dalam menjaga ketepatan waktu pengerjaan dibandingkan agensi maklon (perantara) yang melempar jahitannya ke pihak ketiga.

1.  Jangan Tergiur Harga Murah yang Tidak Masuk Akal
    

Sebagai mahasiswa, anggaran yang terbatas sering kali membuat panitia langsung tergiur dengan penawaran harga jaket yang sangat murah. Namun, Anda harus waspada. Biaya garmen sangat bergantung pada kualitas bahan baku. Harga yang terlampau murah biasanya mengorbankan kualitas kain (misal: kain tipis, kasar, atau gampang berbulu), ritsleting yang mudah dol, atau hasil bordir komputer yang renggang dan tidak rapi. Pilihlah harga yang rasional dengan kualitas standar distro demi keawetan jaket jangka panjang.

1.  Mintalah Kejelasan Garansi Secara Tertulis
    

Konveksi jaket yang profesional dan bertanggung jawab selalu berani memberikan jaminan berupa garansi purna jual. Pastikan di awal kesepakatan tertulis bahwa vendor bersedia bertanggung jawab untuk memperbaiki atau mengganti rugi jika terjadi kesalahan fatal produksi, seperti ukuran baju yang tertukar, jahitan yang robek, atau logo bordir jurusan yang miring dan salah ketik.

1.  Pastikan Komunikasi Vendor Responsif dan Transparan
    

Proses pembuatan jaket angkatan membutuhkan koordinasi yang intens, mulai dari penyerahan daftar ukuran anggota (size chart), revisi desain, hingga info progres jahit. Pilihlah vendor yang memiliki tim layanan pelanggan (customer service) yang responsif, ramah, dan transparan dalam memberikan pembaruan (update) berkala mengenai status produksi jaket Anda.

1.  Pilih Vendor yang Menyediakan Fasilitas Sampel Baju
    

Untuk pesanan dalam skala angkatan (partai besar), jangan pernah langsung memproduksi massal tanpa melihat bentuk fisiknya terlebih dahulu. Mintalah fasilitas pembuatan satu sampel baju (prototipe) fisik. Dengan adanya sampel ini, seluruh panitia bisa memvalidasi kecocokan warna kain luar-dalam, mencoba ukuran potongannya, serta mengecek tingkat kerapian bordir sebelum lampu hijau produksi massal dinyalakan.  
Solusi Konveksi Jaket Kampus Tepercaya Tanpa Rasa Cemas

Mencari vendor yang memenuhi seluruh kriteria di atas di tengah padatnya jadwal kuliah memang membutuhkan ketelitian. Cara paling aman adalah mempercayakannya kepada vendor yang sudah memiliki reputasi kuat sebagai partner sandang mahasiswa.

Bagi kepanitiaan Anda yang sedang merencanakan pembuatan jaket angkatan, jaket bomber, parka, maupun rompi kampus dengan hasil dijamin anti-zonk, Anda bisa langsung bekerja sama dengan Nusantara Konveksi Jogja.

Sebagai salah satu pusat konveksi garmen terkemuka di Yogyakarta, mereka sudah sangat berpengalaman menangani ribuan proyek pakaian mahasiswa dari berbagai universitas di Indonesia. Dengan dukungan mesin jahit modern, sistem bordir komputer digital yang presisi, serta komitmen ketepatan waktu yang tinggi, [nusantarakonveksijogja.com](https://nusantarakonveksijogja.com/) siap mewujudkan jaket angkatan kampus yang keren, nyaman, dan bergaransi resmi. Silakan jelajahi situs resmi mereka untuk melihat portofolio jaket keren lainnya.

links.title: The Art of Suffering for Love: The Bad Girl's Tricks || Review [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7ts8AZ3MkDGKHaojgtiPLY5bAy6onDtPAK6ou7JqbSo/1779865529555.jpg)

***
***
I confess something that might sound like literary heresy. I did not discover Mario Vargas Llosa through his great novels about war, power, or the jungle. Instead, I found him one afternoon on television, glued to the sofa, watching Pantaleon and the Visitors. That mix of absurd humor, social criticism, and such vivid characters captivated me immediately. When the movie ended, I knew I had to read the author of that story. Since then, I have not stopped, because I fell in love with his gritty, risky, truthful literature.

So, when I came to The Bad Girl's Tricks years later, I already knew Vargas Llosa would not let me down. But what I did not imagine was that this novel would hit me right in my weak spot, in my hopeless romantic heart. This is not just any story. It is the story of Ricardo Somocurcio, a modest young man from Lima, serious and hardworking, who one day meets a slippery, lying, impossible girl. He calls her the bad girl, not out of contempt, but out of adoration. She disappears, returns, reinvents herself with another name, another accent, and another life. Ricardo follows her to Paris, London, Tokyo, and Madrid for decades. He follows her even knowing she will not stay and will probably break his heart again, but he cannot help it.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzsMzZCwdoLZtKugaJT1FHVyHQq9A4wHy6oSa2xXz2Q3/1779865529645.jpg)

***
I have cried over Casablanca more times than I care to admit. I still keep letters from impossible loves. I believe loyalty is the most rebellious form of love. And in Ricardo Somocurcio I see this. He is not a hero. He is an ordinary man who turns his life into an active waiting. He does not stay still. He travels, works, survives, but he does it all with the secret hope that she will appear again. And when she appears, he falls again. In this story, there is no learned lesson or pride that matters. Just that heartbeat of loving someone who does not know how to love back.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYiLduCDrUbeZdBDCtU6zbsuMTCVus4VeBsy5xFCZhZnz/1779865549804.jpg)


***
What I find fascinating is that the bad girl, with all her masks, is not a monster either. She is a survivor who escapes poor, limited Peru in the 1950s and decides she will not settle. Perhaps that is why her weapon is lying. Perhaps that is why, even though Ricardo suffers, I as a reader cannot hate her. I understand her, I even envy her a little.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRAqxskCGhdNhwvuBfsNKTCUx6Raj35CxZr32nfgspjML/1779865549679.jpg)


***
Vargas Llosa builds a love plot that is also a plot about identity, memory, and the impossibility of possessing another person. But for me, the hopeless romantic, what moves me most is Ricardo's absurd resistance, his decision to never give up. Because in the end, the love told in this novel is not happy love. It is love that hurts, that waits, that tears itself apart and still comes back.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWP36kC3P628GL4hUuveiWfDxzRWsSJiSefyw595xCngj/1779865549737.jpg)


***
My recommendation to all readers is this. If you are one of those who cries at poorly told stories, one of those who defends that love does not give up even when everything points to the opposite, you must run to read The Bad Girl's Tricks and prepare to see yourself on every page.

### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center> El arte de sufrir por amor: Travesuras de la niña mala </center>


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXi2Y7LaEt4jJhVSD6MzJp1WE7Gee7WqQdfrXDFkTeqyS/1779865529609.jpg)



***
***



Confieso algo que quizá suene a herejía literaria, y es que no conocí a Mario Vargas Llosa por sus grandes novelas de la guerra, el poder o la selva, sino que lo descubrí una tarde de televisión, con el cuerpo pegado al sofá, viendo Pantaleón y las visitadoras. Esa mezcla de humor absurdo, crítica social y personajes tan vivos me atrapó de inmediato, y al terminar la película supe que tenía que leer al autor de aquella historia. Desde entonces, no he parado, pues me enamoré de su literatura con garra, con riesgo, con verdad.

Por eso, cuando años después llegué a Travesuras de la niña mala, ya sabía que Vargas Llosa no me defraudaría, pero lo que no imaginaba es que esta novela me iba a golpear justo en el punto débil, en mi corazón de enamorada empedernida. Esta no es una historia cualquiera. Es la historia de Ricardo Somocurcio, un muchacho limeño de familia modesta, serio y trabajador, que un día conoce a una chica escurridiza, mentirosa e imposible. Él la llama la niña mala, pero no por desprecio, sino por adoración. Ella desaparece, regresa, se reinventa con otro nombre, otro acento y otra vida. Ricardo la sigue a París, a Londres, a Tokio y a Madrid durante décadas. La sigue incluso sabiendo que ella no va a quedarse y que probablemente le romperá el corazón otra vez, pero no puede evitarlo.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzsMzZCwdoLZtKugaJT1FHVyHQq9A4wHy6oSa2xXz2Q3/1779865529645.jpg)


***
Yo, que he llorado con Casablanca más veces de las que quiero admitir, que todavía guardo cartas de amores imposibles y que creo que la fidelidad es la forma más rebelde del amor, he visto en Ricardo Somocurcio que él no es un héroe, sino un hombre corriente que convierte su vida en una espera activa. No se queda quieto. Viaja, trabaja, sobrevive, pero todo lo hace con la secreta esperanza de que ella vuelva a aparecer. Y cuando aparece, él vuelve a caer. En esta historia no hay lección aprendida ni orgullo que valga. Solo ese latido que es querer a alguien que no sabe querer de vuelta.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYiLduCDrUbeZdBDCtU6zbsuMTCVus4VeBsy5xFCZhZnz/1779865549804.jpg)

***
Lo que encuentro fascinante es que la niña mala, con todas sus máscaras, tampoco es un monstruo, sino que es una sobreviviente que sale del Perú pobre y limitado de los años cincuenta y decide que ella no va a conformarse. Quizás por eso su arma es la mentira, y quizá por eso, aunque Ricardo sufre, yo como lectora no puedo odiarla. La entiendo, incluso la envidio un poco.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRAqxskCGhdNhwvuBfsNKTCUx6Raj35CxZr32nfgspjML/1779865549679.jpg)

***
Vargas Llosa construye una trama de amor que es también una trama sobre la identidad, la memoria y la imposibilidad de poseer al otro. Pero a mí, la enamorada empedernida, lo que más me conmueve es esa resistencia absurda de Ricardo, su decisión de no rendirse jamás. Porque al final, el amor que narra esta novela no es el amor feliz, sino el amor que duele, que espera, que se desgarra y aún así vuelve.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWP36kC3P628GL4hUuveiWfDxzRWsSJiSefyw595xCngj/1779865549737.jpg)


***
Mi recomendación a todos los lectores es que, si son de los que lloran con las historias mal contadas, de los que defienden que el amor no se rinde aunque todo indique lo contrario, deben correr a leer Travesuras de la niña mala y prepararse para reconocerse en cada página.

<center>📖</center>

links.title: Pond Wolf Spider (Pardosa pseudoannulata)
links.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Pardosa pseudoannulata*** | May 25, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVLRFxdEJ3WdSeJGEB1JBPjHFh98hMW3wzWri3fPQvx8h/mix_20260527_115349.jpg)

Nature lovers, how are you all?

Today I would like to share with you a great moment of macro photography in a grassy field next to my garden. While I was passing by the field, I came across this amazing female **Pond Wolf Spider** (***Pardosa pseudoannulata***).

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmesSp8LCB6bTVWWULM9RRTQu4ycTzWHer16qUoaFvfmZ4/mix_20260527_115909.jpg)

You can clearly see in the picture that she is carefully carrying a large, round egg sac along the back of her body. While other spiders hide their eggs in their webs, wolf spider mothers always carry their eggs or babies with them to protect them from predators. Such a wonderful sight of maternal love in the insect world is truly extraordinary.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGgAn2MBYU2vermA3hUW3AaE566k6c98RSLrPJPHS3Qc/mix_20260527_115448.jpg)

Since I mainly take pictures around my agricultural land and ponds, I often come across this species of spider. Because they act as excellent natural friends in controlling harmful insects in the crop fields.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8fFXsqfityQg88NxFVEWRM1RSHhDzbdeahDaV1RTNpR/mix_20260527_115632.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcjCxVFvuNogBRQwSH4GmPFWMwUVJCkyw8G7YzpYxB9kb/mix_20260527_115411.jpg)

I am so happy to be able to capture such close-up images of how this spider is carefully guarding its unborn offspring.
​
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX5myRjsZzsUf5vrea4P9Z4agd7UK4CAJzxsJxmBLy98C/mix_20260527_115748.jpg)

I hope you all enjoy these macro images.


I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)
.

links.title: The Power of Greed.
links.body:
As humans, we naturally always want more. More comfort. More money. More opportunities. Free things. But it takes conscious effort on ones part  to control greed before it controls us.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKFHCbGN3yWsRuALWjLLSS86rUkjAoTTKWc615yDGixH/ai_generated.webp)
*Generated ai image from ecency*



Recently in my area, some people started selling foodstuff at unbelievably cheap prices. A bag of rice for ₦25k, 25 litres of oil for 30k Noodles for 10k. These Prices  were far below the market rate.



At first, I became suspicious. I wondered if the products were expired or maybe palliatives being resold. But people started buying. The first set collected their goods successfully, and suddenly everyone began saying, “It’s real! It’s working!” they immediately trusted the process.



Even I was tempted. I almost fell for it.


But one thing kept bothering me: after payment, you had to wait a whole week before collection.

Yesterday, the business disappeared.
The people were no where to be found.



The office was locked. Phones switched off. Thousands of people where waiting outside to collect their goods. 
their money was gone. Chaos everywhere. 



And honestly, it taught me something:
Not everything cheap is truly cheap. There is no free thing in free town. You would still pay somehow.


Sometimes greed doesn’t come looking dangerous. It comes looking like an opportunity we can’t afford to miss.


In this life, we must learn to pause, think, question, and control the urge to rush into things simply because others are doing it.

links.title: Morning walk to the villa
links.body:
Greetings to my beloved friends wherever you are, how are you ?. Thank you Wednesdaywalk inspired by @tattoodjay. Morning walk at an altitude of 1000 meters above sea level. 


![IMG20260524101704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/244xwd6cMLZNusrBQ3q7EoL9sHGW48XcGQjoZN6izKru75fX7a3zheAmTQzShjL4S21Y9.jpg)


The location is on Pondok halimun street, at the foot of Mount Gede Pangrango. If calculated the distance from where I live in Sukabumi city to the villa is about 7 kilometers. I left home using a vehicle, and at kilometers 4, I got off the vehicle. 


![IMG20260524100028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xySmxTqMrcXMxM9Ha6LmzTFKZvR1fjHyCDPLS77ywM9VxV9ZdU69HuMKcDYTUr6phxL.jpg)


Then started my morning walk exercise with a distance of about 3 kilometers. Quite tiring because the road is uphill. The air is quite fresh, the natural scenery is beautiful. The mountainous nature with fertile Soil. 


![IMG20260524100100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/Eos2MB2tzWqqBT4apLkMwoAd3qY5a2hWGNpzEh9w9XuBvo5ExM1UiJTCEdpyu8vj5Qp.jpg)


Local community utilize the fertile Soil to grow vegetables with a short Harvest period of about two or three months. Including strawberries, which are being cultivated regulary.


![IMG20260524100516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23s9RL18ks9hGVG9AosVBJoiwYQ3VzdBEqusAejLAm2S5iEddQDusP1vTBmxLPbuLvVpd.jpg)


![IMG20260524100755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/2458SfFddUxw6kJjqPU4ti6uCcAFTqYZYw6zMLesZdC9HiDAFYhr9x4oyzUAmDbECFt3R.jpg)



 

Vegetable plants need water to keep growing. The water source used is taken from the mountains using poles, then the water is stored in a water reservoir. 


![IMG20260524100710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23rB9fRJG9S7Fsc7vSkKq4uYPQ3Pyk41ftViHde7bNzPw3D5DkD9mVnohpYhayTpjrXXE.jpg)

![IMG20260524100552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23ywu7qqzdTjkt5Fbc94kgBrZpZWyLzY1ZGX8z5mVsqozS68CqbFPgJ5pWxvjHuRJ6FW2.jpg)



After a short walk of about 30 minutes, I then entered the villa area. A fairly wide expanse of greenery and a gazebo building as a public facility for resting, sitting and reflecting. The villa is located below, via several steps, it features a fish pond, a gazebo, Citrus trees and a spacious Courtyard. 


![IMG20260524101241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23ynL9nUp56jmZ5hByey2UgXAgnXkTtrS9uH3Pk2kFW8h5rd4SQTVvfb8LbVKpxzfBPnT.jpg)


![IMG20260524095914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/2449zKJ6JVnKmuLBWePNuwZMN49fsiHaXkUWGMZ2R7fndrhUJEFvChx7AkRMF8rzbivDY.jpg)

![IMG20260524091620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23xedMhEAsDaLvzCGord2byp246VgQqWicw3M9okGbkeSA7VXPPWs5shZBJoBKbTFupcR.jpg)



These are facilities provided by the villa management for guests to enjoy. Bamboo dominates the villa structure, offering a simple design. The villa features a bedroom, living room,kitchen, and family room. 


![IMG20260524101853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23yJABALZpP6ViMnbZd18LrAGt9uudcrvrroET7Lp1YyRTgBSxwsrKDBWpDSC7DPuQkjB.jpg)

![IMG20260501104902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/242DJHu8cRzYP87Nex8GKbCJpAS8GVkn9vZj1XqUBthpTUox9jVNnh1euSkrka1sZPCWR.jpg)

![IMG20260501104752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/244ofQkQtmF3GgHfTgh41eFjbWWNCfaUDfxRGzE1SbSBamHgsfSTTGcE3EB1ShKzBgCSk.jpg)






The expanse of green land is vast. This villa is of course center to the public. 


Have a good activity.
Thank you for stopping by.

links.title: Bảng Giá Nệm 1m2x2m Mới Nhất 2026 Và Kinh Nghiệm Chọn Mua
links.body:
Nệm 1m2x2m là kích thước được nhiều người lựa chọn cho phòng ngủ cá nhân, phòng trọ, căn hộ nhỏ hoặc giường phụ nhờ thiết kế gọn gàng nhưng vẫn đảm bảo sự thoải mái khi nghỉ ngơi. Hiện nay trên thị trường có rất nhiều dòng nệm với chất liệu khác nhau như cao su thiên nhiên, lò xo, foam và bông ép. Mỗi loại sẽ có ưu điểm riêng cùng mức giá đa dạng, phù hợp với từng nhu cầu sử dụng và ngân sách của người mua.

Trong các dòng phổ biến hiện nay, nệm cao su 1m2x2m được nhiều gia đình yêu thích nhờ độ đàn hồi tốt, nâng đỡ cơ thể hiệu quả và có độ bền cao. Các sản phẩm như Gummi Classic, Gummi Hybrid hay Gummi Signature được thiết kế nhằm hỗ trợ cột sống, giảm áp lực lên vai và lưng khi nằm ngủ. Giá nệm cao su thường dao động từ khoảng 4 triệu đến hơn 16 triệu đồng tùy độ dày và cấu tạo sản phẩm. Ngoài khả năng nâng đỡ tốt, dòng nệm này còn có độ thông thoáng cao nhờ hệ thống lỗ khí phân bố đều trên bề mặt, giúp hạn chế cảm giác nóng bí trong quá trình sử dụng.

Bên cạnh đó, nệm lò xo 1m2x2m cũng là lựa chọn phổ biến với những người thích cảm giác nằm êm ái và có độ bật tốt. Các dòng nệm lò xo hiện nay được sản xuất với nhiều cấu trúc khác nhau như lò xo liên kết hoặc lò xo túi độc lập, mang lại trải nghiệm ngủ dễ chịu hơn. Mức giá của nệm lò xo khá đa dạng, từ khoảng hơn 4 triệu đồng đến vài chục triệu đồng đối với các dòng cao cấp nhập khẩu. Những sản phẩm này thường có độ dày lớn, tạo cảm giác sang trọng và phù hợp với không gian phòng ngủ hiện đại.

Nếu muốn tìm dòng nệm có giá thành hợp lý, nệm bông ép 1m2x2m là lựa chọn được nhiều sinh viên, người ở trọ hoặc gia đình trẻ quan tâm. Dòng nệm này có thiết kế gọn nhẹ, dễ gấp gọn và thuận tiện khi di chuyển. Bề mặt khá phẳng giúp hỗ trợ cột sống tương đối tốt, đặc biệt phù hợp với người lớn tuổi hoặc người thích nằm cứng. Giá nệm bông ép hiện nay chỉ từ khoảng 1,5 triệu đồng đến hơn 7 triệu đồng tùy độ dày và thương hiệu.

Ngoài ra, nệm foam 1m2x2m cũng ngày càng được ưa chuộng nhờ khả năng ôm sát đường cong cơ thể và giảm áp lực khi nằm ngủ. Chất liệu foam hiện đại mang lại cảm giác mềm mại, êm ái và hỗ trợ thư giãn cơ thể hiệu quả. Một số dòng nệm foam còn tích hợp công nghệ làm mát, kháng khuẩn và thoáng khí để tăng trải nghiệm sử dụng. Giá nệm foam dao động từ khoảng 3 triệu đến hơn 15 triệu đồng tùy cấu tạo và công nghệ đi kèm.

Khi chọn mua nệm 1m2x2m, người dùng nên chú ý đến độ dày, độ cứng mềm và kích thước thực tế của giường để đảm bảo phù hợp với không gian sử dụng. Với phòng ngủ nhỏ hoặc giường tầng, nên ưu tiên các mẫu nệm mỏng dưới 10cm để tiết kiệm diện tích. Trong khi đó, các mẫu nệm dày từ 15–25cm sẽ phù hợp hơn với giường tiêu chuẩn và mang lại cảm giác nằm êm ái hơn.

Hy vọng những thông tin về bảng giá nệm 1m2x2m mới nhất 2026 trên đây sẽ giúp bạn dễ dàng lựa chọn được sản phẩm phù hợp với nhu cầu và ngân sách của mình. Một chiếc nệm phù hợp không chỉ giúp cải thiện chất lượng giấc ngủ mà còn mang lại cảm giác thư giãn và thoải mái hơn trong cuộc sống hằng ngày.

links.title: Plant Lettuce with me, Cultivating the land and planting lettuce process
links.body:
# Hello Hive 




![1000220466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tvgjfB5rk9ydAhL4JeBFz6fJxoMFbmXUhaxaKKS2bxZiipjRXdS8Cygj6sdwjbMsXAa.jpg)


It is lettuce planting day and my friends here didn't waste time in having us plant some lettuce. Sincerely I love vegetables and can hardly go a day without eating some vegetables in my meals. 
It's either I eat vegetables stew or I have some vegetables in my rice or some vegetables salad 🥗. 


![1000220441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23w2m8RYpwoqbVwdqRReGn1fDg7JZjTBRUih6cC28yJJbSFAHvgamcN3ZkQt8DB7iDgvx.jpg)

This is the first time a very large mass of this particular lettuce will be planted here. Usually it is planted in very small quantity and hardly enough to go round during harvest as a lot of people will stick around while the lot of it will be taken to the market to make better profit. I am so so glad that the quantity planted this time around is quite enourmouse and in about 6weeks times I should be having as much and much of these lettuce to eat. 


![1000220438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tvcJgQeM2HLSzYQBd1fjvUpMJd5UVMqtcGhq3mALznYEKZNyGCKrvhQygnBoDhrepyD.jpg)

The work started with cultivation of the land yesterday and you can see the labourers men right under the tree after some long hours of cultivating the land.
The land is a clay-loamy area and very rich in nutrient and water retention hence you can see how much water is covering the land already after the little downpour we had. 


Even though lettuce requires some very cool area with adequate amount of water supply, the water shouldn't be so much that it was will swallow up the vegetables especially these purely vegetative lettuce, they can get rotten inside water with 24-48hrs. 


![1000220456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tSRwqHWsFYHweqkBjTdaKRgznheixcXEFRakVYVM3R6RETe8dwmVGduEdz4u2Zxt2Qv.jpg)

----

![1000220453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xyQv5NkAebwf3Bx2mTZNaE9upa2soTK49pqSMYvpNNbjbCv2duroot8TCv4Y4yvoWxS.jpg)

The ridges has to cultivated high enough for the lettuce to stay above the water level. 
While cultivation was going on, some people were cultivating the land while the rest of us were transplanting the seedlings, these lettuce seedlings have been brought from some other locations, vegetatively like this. They have been pre-grown and prepared for this season. 


![1000220429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uQreLPTvKKdxVU4XPzbgASHn6D5BPE7TpXUtomgz9WhS4AhLW3WgZNuJrmcfCPDRnq5.jpg)

links.title: Earn Cashback by Spending HBD - How Innopay and Distriator Work Together
links.body: If you've been on Hive for a while, you already know the dream: earn HBD on-chain, then actually spend it in the real world. The piece that's always been missing is a checkout experience that feels normal, not \

just normal.
That's what Innopay fixes. And paired with @Distriator, every euro you spend pays you back.


![Your paragraph text(3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/EogKuYSdbZyxwV2YBaPj2ujbrta5XVx6n7c56yHEmmU4ADZoEvagt8g7d88cY7VAZGe.png)

## Why Innopay Is Different
Most crypto payment apps assume you already know what keys are. Innopay assumes you don't.
When you top up your Innopay wallet for the first time, Innopay creates a Hive account for you in the background. You don't fill out signup forms, you don't store keys on a piece of paper (yet), you don't watch a 20-minute YouTube tutorial. You just load funds and pay.
That's a big deal. Onboarding to Hive has always been the hardest part. Innopay collapses it into a single step: top up → you're on Hive → you can spend HBD at partner restaurants.
Once you have a Hive account, you also have access to everything else on the chain, including Distriator.

### But here do your Hive keys go?
A quick word on keys, because this part matters.
On Hive (and most blockchains), your account isn't protected by a password, it's protected by a set of cryptographic keys. Think of them as the master passwords that prove you own your account and your funds. Lose them and there's no \

button.

*Once you top up*, Innopay sends an email with a one-time link to a page containing your full set of Hive keys. Open it and save everything on it. **The link loads once**. Close the tab without saving and those keys are gone for good.

## What is Distriator
Distriator is a not-for-profit cashback system built on here on Hive. When you spend HBD at a registered merchant and document the purchase through the Distriator app, you get an instant rebate, paid back in HBD straight to your wallet.
The rebate isn't a marketing gimmick. It's funded by Hive post rewards: Distriator publishes a tiny post on the blockchain for each claim and uses the rewards to pay you back. The more you use it, the more you earn.

## How Innopay and Distriator Fit Together
Think of them as two halves of the same loop:
**Innopay handles the payment** - fast QR checkout, no card fees, no terminal.
**Distriator handles the reward** - verifies the on-chain payment and sends cashback.

You pay once. You get rewarded twice (once on Innopay, once back via Distriator).

# Step-by-Step: From Zero to Cashback
Step 1:  Scan a QR code and Top Up
 Open Innopay and create your wallet. Top up with via Stripe or with HBD if you already have some. Behind the scenes, Innopay creates your Hive account in the background. Your balance sits in HBD, ready to spend. 
Step 2: Order and Checkout
 	Sit down at an Innopay partner restaurant — for example, Indie's Café in Luxembourg 
 At checkout, scan the QR code on the table or counter. Confirm the amount. The payment settles on Hive in seconds. No PIN, no card, no waiting for a terminal.

Step 3:Claim Your Cashback on Distriator
After you pay:
1. Download the Distriator app or go to distriator.com
2. Select the business. (Indie's in this instance)
3. Enter the amount you spent in HBD.
4. Upload a photo of your receipt or order confirmation.
5. Submit the claim.
6. Distriator checks the on-chain transaction and sends cashback to your wallet within a few minutes. 

# Why This Matters for Hive
This isn't just another payment app. It's the first time someone walking past a café can become a Hive user by ordering lunch. No Discord onboarding, no key management lecture, no \

For existing Hivers, it means your HBD finally has somewhere to go that isn't an exchange. 
For merchants, it means accepting payments with zero processing fees while still rewarding customers more than any loyalty program could.
 For Hive itself, it means real-world adoption, one coffee, one meal, one shop at a time.
If you've tried it, share your experience in the comments. If you run a business and want to accept HBD with Innopay and offer Distriator cashback, both platforms are open to new merchants.



# Final Thoughts
Innopay is the easy way in. Distriator is the reward for sticking around. Together they turn Hive from \

If you've tried it, share your experience in the comments. If you run a business and want to accept HBD with Innopay and offer Distriator cashback to your customers, the door is wide open.

I went quite a distance from our house, then I saw on the side of the road that there is a big kadam tree. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRYisSyGYeGtx3gpUXCwjDVnnR9oRHwmHEY54Aa4Hjhgs/1779863762045.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcymvTy5HvrviDepqFKWMbVGHaGGRxjhcua7U3FmKMHTb/1779863762211.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZxZfrMP1mz1EsAvgvXC6fAimRFSnEjfwknVSRKgbd1eb/1779863762368.jpg) A branch from that tree seemed to have fallen downwards and many kadam flowers had bloomed there. But they have not matured yet. Only the upper layer has been formed. In fact, kadam flowers are the most beautiful among the trees. But I left a kadam flower from there. Then I took pictures of them. links.title: How to bounce back after failure in student life
links.body:
Greetings Education Community. How are you students and parents? I hope you are all doing well. Today I am here to share a motivational content with you. I hope today's content will help you improve your life. Especially for those who have failed in their student life, this motivational content of mine today. By enjoying this wonderful content, you will regain the strength of your life and how you will revive yourself again. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVVFerVYTa4kHDGHMf1DiGiSb4xEAdEuFbqkJdqkLt4vc/1000102531.png Various problems arise in our student life. And another problem in the midst of strength is failure in student life. There are many students who constantly take continuous classes and study. In addition to studying, their talent is very good and they are known as talented students in school. But sometimes, some things get involved with good students that our young students cannot accept. It is seen that weaker students succeed in the exam than talented students. On the other hand, in the case of talented students, the exam results do not come on time. But they are humiliated and defamed by their families. At one point, that student, unable to bear his own passion for himself, commits suicide and ends his life. But we need to think about one thing. The good things in the world will come to us even if it is a little later. We all expect good things to come to our lives even if it is a little distant. When a brilliant student is not successful in the exam despite being very brilliant, then society says various things. This actually breaks the mental health of the students and they lose all the activities of survival in life. Therefore, a brilliant student must turn around from this failure in life and show the society and the country how much confidence we have in our minds and how strong we are. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRjHsFCKXuzqqZBH388T5ZxEYdXmdRBKqZLC7xPVJYuvB/1000102532.png ***How ​​a failed student found the path to success*** One of my elder brothers gave his secondary school examination. He was a brilliant student in school and everyone expected him to get a Golden Plus in the examination and make his family and society proud. But the examination result brought him a lot of trouble. After the examination, it was found that he failed the examination and could not pass the examination. Due to which his family scolded him and said various insulting things. At one point, that student decided to revive his own life again. He studied in this way this time and later got better results than everyone else. Although he could not succeed in the first instance, his second success brought him a lot of respect and fortune. Later, he became a government doctor and made his family and society proud. We can learn a lesson from this story. Big success in our life may not come in the first instance. But if we try the second time, we can expect something better than the first time. So we can make any mistake or mistake in our student life. Small failures can come in the student life. We will try to revive life by taking this small failure as a normal one instead of considering it as a major one. If we can bounce back from failure, then it will be possible to achieve success in our student life. I hope that after reading this motivational story today, you will be able to improve yourself more. Thank you very much for enjoying the story. I hope that you will also bounce back from failure in your student life and make your life successful. Thank you very much for being with the educational community.

links.title: 喻世明言九
links.body:
接上回

回去路上还遇到了以前的仆人周义，这小名字起的就讲义气，好不容易脱离了仆人身份，做个驿子，遇到前主人还要跟着做奴仆，做自己的主人不香吗？
查了之后才知道，“驿子，生活负担仍重于普通农户，逃亡者较多。

安葬了意娘。
身边朋友建议思厚去找那德行清高的女道士——刘金坛给意娘做功德。
这一看到好，刘金坛是因为给亡夫守节才做了道士，可是人生的标志玲珑，不施粉黛也是绝世仪容，那思厚对她一见钟情。又在金坛卧室发现了她的诗，有遇良人归俗的愿望，二人来往密切，又在友人撮合之下，忘了各自的守节誓约，结为夫妇。

从此花前月下，思厚完全忘了当初对意娘的誓约，不去坟前祭拜了。

意娘不干了，就找来了，付魂魄于刘氏身上，差点掐死思厚。找来了朱法官来救治。无奈意娘怨气、戾气太重，朱法官建议把坟掘了，撒骨于江。
是安稳了一段日子，一日二人游览江景，遇一艄公唱《好事近》。这里是说那个老太把韩国夫人府中屏风上的《好事近》录下来，还把思厚又娶违约、撒其骨于江一事广流传。

思厚和刘氏于江中被鬼追杀了，应了思厚的毒誓“若负起前言，在路盗贼杀戮，在水巨浪覆舟。”

至此，报应都来了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUMwK3hiRhPJ282h4z9dKXAUybt1VqV6aaqRJGTqYso7H/img_2875.jpg)

以前我以为古人只是宣传女人要为男人守节，不嫁那是美德，这篇和前一篇的都有宣扬男人同样以为女人守德为美。

虽说这是男女平等的一个表现，但我觉得，人与鬼，那是两个世界的存在，文中偏要以报复结尾，是不是想要表达意娘当初后悔没从了撒八，那她就不会死，没有怨气了？
对当时社会宣扬的守节风的反叛？

我认为此情可以埋心间永不相忘，但人总不能活在精神世界里，他得有个人相陪相伴。
如果是真爱，放手也是爱，让别人接替你替你去把爱给你爱的人，让他过得快乐，何尝不让人高兴呢？
既然已经人鬼相隔，何不各自找各自的归宿，既然不能继续，那就各自安好，彼此都心安。
有机会，情在、缘在，再续前缘！

***

links.title: (🇪🇦/🇬🇧) Una hermosa confusión / Crónicas de un imprevisto (Parte 1) | A Beautiful Confusion / Chronicles of an Unexpected (Part 1) | AMOR/LOVE
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTV92rhFCQfPCBBRUCu4TpsgLoLZTZpN1bC7WGuWB8TYL/1779860038274.png)

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVgTW75oBAQ8nyU75DdzpiYYZA1ENekALBQgaXsGKk4mS/1779857436583.png)
___

>_**‎¿Te ha pasado que en un día cualquiera, justo cuando no estás esperando nada, ocurre algo especial que termina marcándote por el resto de tu vida?**_


‎
‎Pues aquel era un día normal, común, como cualquier otro. De esos donde no tengo planificado nada, solo existir. Alrededor de las once de la mañana, leía una vieja revista, de esas que salían antes, con mucho contenido que dar. Muy adentrado en la lectura, interrumpí la idea cuando escuché que llamaban a la puerta. No esperaba a nadie, y no sabía de alguien que tuviera planeado venir.
‎
Vivía en compañía de mis padres, ‎y como mi mamá es costurera, _\

_, pensé. Me daba pereza levantarme de la silla, incluso me demoré en salir porque supuse que alguien más en la casa atendería. La verdad no era muy sociable y recibir visitas sin avisar me hace sentir incómodo.  
‎
‎Ese día estábamos todos en casa. No sé qué distracción tendrían que al parecer no escucharon cuando afuera llamaban a la puerta. Fastidiado, dejé la revista sobre la mesa, me levanté y desganado me puse una camiseta sin mangas mientras me asomaba tras la cortina de la ventana para tener una idea de quién podría estar interrumpiendo mi paz. 
‎
‎Distinguí dos siluetas: una señora, conocida de la familia, y alguien más, una figura femenina que por su posición se ocultaba tras uno de los pilares del porche y no conseguía distinguir. Mientras espiaba tras la cortina, rápidamente confirmé mi sospecha: la señora traía en la mano una pequeña bolsa con ropa. 
‎
‎Respiré, caminé hacia la puerta y como en piloto automático, ya preveía mentalmente lo que sucedería: el saludo de protocolo, las debidas muestras de cortesía, recibo el encargo, una sonrisa de despedida y adiós. Nada especial. 
‎
Agarré‎ el pomo de la puerta, presioné y al abrir reconocí a Cristina –la señora– un rostro familiar. 
‎
‎–_¡Hola, buenos días!_ –saludó con una sonrisa–. _¿Está tu mamá?_ 
‎
‎–_Sí_ –le respondí con calma–, _ya la llamo._ 
‎
‎–_Bueno, era para entregarle esto_ –dijo deteniéndome mientras me ofrecía el paquete en sus manos–. _Se lo puedes entregar tú._
‎
‎Me dispuse a recibirlo, pero hasta ese momento no había conseguido identificar la figura que seguía oculta tras la columna decorativa frente a mí. Sin esperar más, Cristina agregó: 
‎
‎–_Y ella es una amiga_ –señalando a su acompañante; y dirigiéndose a ella, continuó–: _Él es Humberto._
‎
‎No estaba predispuesto a nada. Solo era conocer a alguien más y ya. Pero pocas veces en la vida he pasado por momentos como aquel. De detrás de la columna salió una joven –que me dio la impresión de estarse escondiendo–, de piel blanca, vestía un conjunto sencillo pero modesto, ni muy juvenil para resultar provocativo, ni muy señorial para resultar aburrido.
‎
‎Con todo eso, su mirada y su sonrisa fueron lo que me atrapó. Todos mis pensamientos que creía tener en orden se fueron a la extinción. No estaba seguro de mí, si existía o solo era un NPC. Esa mirada, una mirada simple, pero profunda, amable pero cauta, transmitía vulnerabilidad, fragilidad, la sentí expuesta.

 
___

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2gHiX24aQFCx3hHfeL1hAjY5ZSsukvbynfPacbfL3Jk/1779862918389.jpg)
<center>_Imagen de **referencia**_</center>
<center>_Fotografía de [César O'neill](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/jovenes-adultos-al-aire-libre-en-actitud-contemplativa-29377838/) en Pexels_</center>
___


‎
‎Pero su sonrisa... Oh, Dios, ¡qué sonrisa! No era la típica sonrisa plástica de otras jóvenes de su generación en circunstancias como esas. Fue una sonrisa dulce, genuina, tímida y cordial, que no sentí que transmitía coquetería, sino la nobleza de un alma sencilla. 
‎
‎Y de ese modo quedé absorto, perdido, atrapado en una hermosa confusión de ideas que me gritaban por dentro que volviera en mí. Por entre los barrotillos de la reja extendí mi mano para estrechar la suya y concretar el saludo, mientras creí escuchar que me decía su nombre en un susurro que, por la emoción, no recordé luego.
‎
‎Traté de abrir la reja para recibir el paquete, pero me perdí nerviosamente entre las llaves del mazo. Recuerdo que buscaba inútilmente insertar cada llave con una torpeza inusual en mi carácter templado y firme. Ese día, todas las defensas que creí suficientes para resguardar mis emociones cayeron a tierra. 
‎
‎Tras varios vergonzosos intentos de algo tan simple como abrir una reja, por fin logré dar con la llave correcta, pero mi cabeza solo pensaba en esa sonrisa, esa mirada. Tomé el paquete y volví a verla con rapidez furtiva. 
‎
‎–_Ella es nueva por acá_ –dijo Cristina–. _Le pedí que me acompañara para que conociera la zona._
‎
‎Mi cabeza estalló en un torrente incesante de preguntas que debí tragarme por la naturaleza del momento: _\

_
‎
La joven –de quien no recordaba su nombre, absorto– notó la intensidad de mi expresión; lo sé porque evidenció signos de nerviosismo, y sutilmente disimuló distraerse, arrebatándome de golpe el placer que me daba ver directo a sus ojos.
‎
Cristina se despidió y, cumplidos los formalismos, mientras se alejaban poco a poco, caí en la cuenta del desorden rítmico en mi pulso, la respiración acelerada y las manos sudorosas por aquel golpe de ansiedad. Inmediatamente pensé:
‎
>_\

_


Inmóvil, en el mismo sitio donde quedé después de cerrar la reja, tuve que aceptar que algo había cambiado dentro de mí, y comencé a tramar qué hacer para que aquellos ojos causantes de tal revolcadero en mi pecho, coincidieran conmigo otra vez y descubrir qué poder escondían.  
‎
 
‎Nunca olvido ese instante. Un momento único y especial que marcaría el resto de mi vida de maneras que jamás vi venir. 
‎
‎
‎




_‎Basado en un hecho real. Los eventos aquí descritos sucedieron el 04 de septiembre de 2024. Este post es la primera parte de una serie de varios episodios que se publicarán próximamente._

_**‎Relato en serie íntegramente elaborado y dedicado para Annie Rodríguez/ Usuario en Hive: @anne002**_
‎
___

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS4VtSD79hYP8xmSWWEjrMUK5MPXrYegctTcSEL3wPghs/1779860962466.png)


<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXfCucYNgi4CPCSufsmqZKeQuYWT5pC9RNrcDHmGfbfx/1779861077197.png)
___

>_**Have you ever had one of those days when, just when you’re not expecting anything, something special happens that ends up shaping the rest of your life?**_


‎
‎Well, that was a normal, ordinary day, just like any other. One of those days when I haven’t planned anything, just existing. Around eleven in the morning, I was reading an old magazine, one of those from back in the day, packed with content. Deep in my reading, I was interrupted when I heard a knock at the door. I wasn’t expecting anyone, and I didn’t know of anyone who’d planned to come.
‎
I lived with my parents, and as my mum is a seamstress, _\

_, I thought. I couldn’t be bothered to get up from my chair; I even delayed going to the door because I assumed someone else in the house would answer it. To be honest, I wasn’t very sociable, and receiving unannounced visitors makes me feel uncomfortable.  
‎
‎That day we were all at home. I don’t know what they were so engrossed in, but apparently they didn’t hear the doorbell ringing. Annoyed, I put the magazine down on the table, got up and, half-heartedly, put on a sleeveless T-shirt whilst peeking through the window curtain to get an idea of who might be disturbing my peace. 
‎
‎I made out two figures: a lady, an acquaintance of the family, and someone else, a female figure who, due to her position, was hidden behind one of the porch pillars and whom I couldn’t quite make out. As I peered through the curtain, I quickly confirmed my suspicion: the lady was carrying a small bag of clothes. 
‎
I took a breath, walked towards the door and, as if on autopilot, I could already picture in my mind what would happen: the customary greeting, the appropriate courtesies, I’d take the parcel, a parting smile and goodbye. Nothing out of the ordinary. 
‎
I grabbed the door handle, turned it and, as I opened the door, I recognised Cristina – the lady – a familiar face. 
‎
‎–_‘Hello, good morning!’_ she greeted me with a smile. _‘Is your mum in?’_ 
‎
‎–_‘Yes’_ I replied calmly, _‘I’ll call her.’_ 
‎
‎–_‘Well, I was here to give her this’_ she said, stopping me as she held out the parcel in her hands. _‘You can give it to her.’_
‎
‎I went to take it, but until that moment I hadn’t managed to make out the figure still hidden behind the decorative column in front of me. Without waiting any longer, Cristina added: 
‎
‎–_And this is a friend of hers_ –pointing to her companion; and turning to her, she continued–: _This is Humberto._
‎
‎I wasn’t expecting anything. It was just a matter of meeting someone else, that was all. But rarely in my life have I experienced moments like that one. From behind the column emerged a young woman – who gave me the impression she had been hiding – with fair skin, dressed in a simple yet modest outfit, neither too youthful to be provocative, nor too ladylike to be boring.

Despite all that, it was her gaze and her smile that captivated me. All the thoughts I thought I had in order vanished into thin air. I wasn’t sure of myself—whether I existed or was just an NPC. That gaze, a simple yet profound look, kind yet cautious, conveyed vulnerability and fragility; I felt exposed. 

 
___

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2gHiX24aQFCx3hHfeL1hAjY5ZSsukvbynfPacbfL3Jk/1779862918389.jpg)
<center>_**Reference** image_</center>
<center>_Photograph by [César O'neill](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/jovenes-adultos-al-aire-libre-en-actitud-contemplativa-29377838/) on Pexels_</center>
___


‎
‎But her smile… Oh, God, what a smile! It wasn’t the typical plastic smile of other young women of her generation in such circumstances. It was a sweet, genuine, shy and warm smile, which I didn’t feel conveyed flirtation, but rather the nobility of a simple soul. 
‎
‎And so I was absorbed, lost, caught up in a beautiful confusion of thoughts screaming inside me to come to my senses. Through the bars of the gate I reached out my hand to take hers and seal the greeting, whilst I thought I heard her whisper her name to me—a whisper I, in my excitement, could not recall afterwards.
‎
‎I tried to open the gate to receive the parcel, but I fumbled nervously through the keys on my ring. I remember trying in vain to insert each key with a clumsiness unusual for my usually calm and steady nature. That day, all the defences I thought were enough to shield my emotions crumbled to the ground. 
‎
‎After several embarrassing attempts at something as simple as opening a gate, I finally managed to find the right key, but my mind was only on that smile, that look. I took the bundle and glanced at her again with a furtive quickness. 
‎
‎“She’s new around here,” said Cristina. “I asked her to come with me so she could get to know the area.”
‎
‎My head exploded with a ceaseless torrent of questions that I had to swallow given the nature of the moment: “Does she live around here? Where? And for how long? Is she staying or does she plan to move?\
And that beautiful princess... where did she come from?\

Usually, my friends and I take photos from the same spot, but this time I went to the end of the avenue to get a different view. # I stood near the traffic lights where the cars stop. From there, I captured the sky along with the vehicles moving through the street. The mix of the street lamps and the natural light at that hour worked well. I focused on the traffic and how the city looks when the sun goes down. # The movement of the cars and the position of the buildings give these photos a more direct look. I waited for the cars to pass to get the right shot of the street. These images show the typical environment of the avenue during the late afternoon. # I decided to take these photos because they offer a clear perspective of the urban landscape. It is a common scene, but the combination of elements makes it worth sharing. I hope you find these shots interesting. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! That is exactly what seems to be happening with West Ham right now, and it could open the door for Manchester United to sign Mateus Fernandes.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRgjhCbdi6zVtcNqDPs9f87rLK1Yx3zPUB2BNjfE3gMiu/d0717f40-57cc-11f1-9d33-856fef96266b.png.webp 

‎
‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cp3pl0qgykdo.amp&ved=2ahUKEwjOoOOT6tiUAxU9VUEAHZP7IwEQr4kDegQIHxAA&usg=AOvVaw1lLOfLZWXaBbWW5UwR688T)
‎
‎When I first came across the report linking him with United, I was a little surprised because Arsenal and Chelsea were also interested. But hearing that the player himself prefers Manchester United made the story even more interesting to me. No matter how difficult things have been at Old Trafford in recent years, players still dream of playing for the club because of their history. That alone says a lot.
‎
‎West Ham’s situation is also looking complicated. With talks about possible relegation and debts around £100 million, they might be forced to sell some important players this summer. That is one thing I hate about football sometimes. A team can struggle for one bad season and suddenly everything begins falling apart both on and off the pitch.
‎
‎And as for Mateus Fernandes himself, I think he is one of those players people might underrate because his numbers are not crazy. But four goals and five assists in 41 matches is still decent, especially when you remember he is playing in a team that has struggled for consistency throughout the season. Not every midfielder needs to score every week before you can see the quality.
‎
‎From the little I have watched of him, he looks calm on the ball and also works hard for the team. He also seems like the type of player that can improve a lot with better teammates around him. Manchester United’s midfield has lacked balance and energy at different times this season, so bringing in a young and hungry midfielder like him honestly makes sense to me.
‎
‎And in today’s market, €35 million does not even sound too expensive anymore as we have seen average players go for much higher fees than that.
‎
‎I’m not saying Mateus Fernandes will suddenly solve all of United’s problems, but this feels like one of those smart signings that could silently become very important in the future. Sometimes the best transfers are not always the biggest names.
‎

body.title: Katertyna Huliuk & The Budchuk - The Devil Wears Prada
body.body:
“The Devil Wears Prada” — це спільна робота Артем Будчук (The Budchuk) та артистки, особистість якої творча група свідомо не розкриває до премʼєри альбому. Чудова композиція прозвучала вперше під час спеціального допрем'єрного показу культового фільму “The Devil Wears Prada 2”. Відбулося це досить цікавим чином: артистка зʼявилась просто серед глядачів, виконала пісню — і розчинилась у темряві. Такий вихід нової артистки на музичний олімп - ідеальний момент для першої її появи. Саме тому історія почалась з темряви, інтриги, fashion-естетики та музики, яка ніби вже існувала всередині цього світу. Kateryna Huliuk стала першим артистом народженого лейблу “Будинок з музикою”, проєкт якого побудований навколо атмосфери, сенсів, емоцій та цілісних музичних світів, а не просто окремих релізів. 
Як говорить про співачку автор проєкту Артем Будчук: сьогодні люди дуже добре відчувають фальш. І через це для нас найважливіше, щоб артист почувався природно та комфортно у власному образі, а не грав когось, ким насправді він не є. Тому певна загадковість навколо особистості Kateryna HULIUK ще залишиться. Нам хочеться, щоб люди поступово відкривали артистку через музику, емоції та атмосферу, а не через гучні заголовки чи навмисний епатаж.
А композиція дійсно заслуговує на увагу. Рекомендую!

Hey all

I hope you are all doing well and thankyou for stopping by to have a nosey at this post

I've not had the best of luck over the years with Gladius packs, which actually came to a point where I just stopped bothering to use my Merits at all.
Every pack was so dire that I just gave up 😅

But I'm now back brawling more so I've gone back to using the Merits.
As can be seen my luck is still pretty dire, but the Legendary really helps my hurt feelings at due to the other usual pulls.



I haven't noticed a great change in my pull luck since I've been using the Bloodstones, but with the cost it's always worth a try for sure.

Each time I open a Gladiator pack I always feel underwhelmed. I feel that we need some new Gladiators released to mix it up a bit. I don't even mind of they are terrible 😅

Most packs have the same cards in so it's not overly exxciting is it?

But at the end of the day they are free cards that I can use so I'm not going to complain.
Also some of them are getting fairly high in level which is great.

Krash is my favourite out of these as with weapons training it becomes pretty strong, only issue is I rarely use him as I normally have spare mana for better cards 😅

body.title: Splinterlands: Saltwater Mage is a great way to kill the backline
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Saltwater Mage.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wLt8SQjZs8CDQ8oMxCc5C5N2sMxzGMXrxg4KmcutXrF2VSSH8ZXP73Xad5dwjMRZyX9.png)
Saltwater Mage is a water splinter that costs 8 mana. This splinter starts off with the sneak ability, but leveling it does increase its stats. I use this card quite often in Frontier due to its damage, and sometimes, having sneak is great at taking out that backline.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wBy7KKR6MrzX8PYRbxnEhBHuRuUJFtHg3NDEi2xtBE9erxGZqjr6fMAFDLY5xBfw6Di.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Engraged Warriors and Aim True. This means that all monsters start off with the divine shield ability, and melee monsters attack first. There is also 36 mana available, and I can use every [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for life and death.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Marlai Singariel|6|Summoner|+1 magic|
|Asel Alagosdil|4|1st|Divine Shield|
|Great Bear Druid|9|2nd||
|Saltwater Mage|8|3rd|Sneak|
|Mystic Scaleweaver|9|4th|Slow|
|Total Mana:|36|||

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. My archon increases my magic monster's damage. They are my primary damage dealers, and I just use Asel as a tank to keep those magic monsters alive.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tviP3KrAp8RrtthGSSmNt78FJ4GdRi1Lvz5fZYgrHgigVjdUboGXrjn7VRVatiC4pMD.png)
At first glance, I think that this match can go either way because my opponent is using A'lan. If I can kill that A'lan, then I can even things out but otherwise my opponent has the damage advantage.

### Round 6


![round 6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EoCidDq6GRvuVj9F8iTdRQFaYVNM42CEmp3AzGcu6N3tKXR7aCC8zgajXPN7X4abhpr.png)

A few rounds later, my opponent's lineup has just two monsters left, and I still have three monsters. My opponent has lost A'lan, so I think this match is win due to my damage advantage.


![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u67PBqTQrrfsTUCpUKxQsFjCen1wSgDKzTDLe25uYUTMLsvMZFkJW4SYgqT6LgNpuCZ.png)
I won the match as I expected.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. Saltwater Mage did a great job of killing off my opponent's A'lan. That was the main reason why my lineup won was beacuse I took out that troublesome damage dealer. The rest of the match just fell into place.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_c21074033a94799f9910dbfcfb878169?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-saltwater-mage-is-a-great-way-to-kill-the-backline-ecp)

> Guild painter Petreau has pined for the hand of his master’s daughter for the last six years. After all this time, a masterpiece centered on her is finished. The girl even likes it. But how will he finagle his cantankerous mentor into letting him wed the girl he loves? -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

It was a portrait of adoration. The face on the canvas almost glowed with joy. Her hair was resplendant, and her clothes were lovingly rendered to look their best. Most importantly, it was not lustful in the slightest. Because it was meant to be viewed by her father.

Who was the most cantankerous, crotchety, argumentative, and bitter old sot who had ever held a paintbrush.

\
said Leogratha, putting on his glasses so he could squint at the canvas. He was years overdue for a new prescription, but he was too stubborn to get a new set made. \
Petreau indicated them with the handle of his current paintbrush. \
The squint turned venom towards Petreau. \
grumbled Leogratha. It was as close to permission as he could manage. \

High praise from the man with the most grudging opinion in the world.

body.title: Mini Chainsaw Safety Guide for Farmers and Gardeners
body.body:
#

![Mini Chainsaw Safety Guide for Farmers and Gardeners .jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/9221415ae8b2687d9f91eb819e59031be5c4906fdcc447edda99851e8570924a)

Mini chainsaws are useful tools for farmers and gardeners because they make tree pruning, branch cutting, and garden cleaning faster and easier. This [Mini Chainsaw Safety Guide](https://chandakagro.mystrikingly.com/blog/mini-chainsaw-safety-guide-for-farmers-and-gardeners) helps users understand the correct and safe way to use these powerful tools.

Before using a mini chainsaw, always wear safety equipment like gloves, safety glasses, boots, and protective clothing. This helps protect your hands, eyes, and body from wood chips and accidental cuts.

Check the chainsaw carefully before starting work. Make sure the chain is properly tightened, the battery is fully charged, and all safety features are working correctly. A loose chain can become dangerous during operation.

While cutting, hold the mini chainsaw firmly with both hands for better control. Always keep a safe distance from other people and never use the chainsaw near children or pets. Avoid cutting above shoulder height because it can reduce balance and increase risk.

Keep the chain sharp and clean for smooth cutting performance. After use, switch off the chainsaw and store it safely in a dry place.

By following these simple safety tips, farmers and gardeners can use mini chainsaws safely, comfortably, and efficiently for daily cutting work.

\#minichainsawsafetyguide #minichainsaw #chainsawsafety #gardentools #farmingtools #treepruning #woodcutting #electricchainsaw #cordlesschainsaw

body.title: [테이스팀#656] 카페꼼마 합정점
body.body:
![3505B5FF-5470-415E-99B1-722AB3ABC20D.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmerBLZZBmshWuL3o6tzxsjrZkADMEDR4qxCX178yggxSQ/3505B5FF-5470-415E-99B1-722AB3ABC20D.jpeg)

합정에서 분위기 좋은 카페를 찾다가 들르게 된 카페꼼마 합정점. 
예전부터 북카페로 유명하다는 이야기는 많이 들었는데 직접 방문해보니 왜 인기가 많은지 바로 알 수 있었다.

카페꼼마는 문학동네에서 만든 북카페 브랜드로, 책과 커피를 함께 즐길 수 있는 공간이다. 단순히 음료만 마시는 카페가 아니라 잠시 쉬어가며 여유를 느낄 수 있는 분위기가 인상적이다. 이름처럼 문장 속 쉼표 같은 공간을 지향한다고 하는데, 실제로 들어가 보니 도심 속에서 잠깐 숨 고르기 좋은 느낌, 이기도 하고 아니기도 했다.
조용히 책을 보는 사람들이 절반, 토론 같은 모임으로 왁자지껄한 무리들 절반.

합정점은 특히 인테리어가 정말 깔끔하고 독특했다. 높은 층고와 커다란 책장들이 눈에 들어오는데, 전체적으로 따뜻하면서도 세련된 분위기가 잘 어우러져 있었다. 좌석 간격도 여유로운 편이라 혼자 책 읽거나 작업하기에도 좋아 보였고, 곳곳의 조명과 우드톤 인테리어 덕분에 편안한 느낌이 들었다. 북카페 특유의 조용한 분위기도 마음에 들었다.

이번에 주문한 메뉴는 쑥카스테라였는데 기대 이상으로 맛있었다. 은은한 쑥 향이 진하게 퍼지면서도 너무 쓰지 않았고, 카스테라 식감이 촉촉해서 커피와 정말 잘 어울렸다. 자극적이지 않은 담백한 단맛이라 계속 손이 가는 맛이었다. 디저트 종류가 다양해서 다음에는 다른 베이커리 메뉴도 먹어보고 싶다는 생각이 들었다.

전체적으로 카페꼼마 합정점은 단순히 사진 찍기 좋은 카페가 아니라, 오래 머물면서 분위기를 즐기기 좋은 공간이라는 느낌이 강했다. 책과 커피, 감성적인 공간을 좋아하는 사람이라면 한 번쯤 방문해봐도 만족할 만한 곳이었다. 다만, 늘 북적여서 자리 맡기는
어려워 보였다.

body.title: Hartgeldbremse: Kommt jetzt ein Münzverbot?
body.body: >Die Bargeldabschaffung soll jetzt auf Euro-Münzen ausgedehnt werden. Hartgeld belastet unnötig das Weltklima, das Metall wird zudem in den Panzerfabriken benötigt.

>Müssen die Deutschen bald auf Ein- und Zwei-Euro-Münzen verzichten? Das von Umweltforschern gegründete Nachhaltige Bargeldforum (NBF) schlägt vor, dass bei Barzahlungen auf Scheine und Karten zurückgegriffen und gerundet wird. Andere Länder machen es vor.

>Die Deutschen lieben ihr Bargeld - allerdings nicht die Münzen. Fragt man nach Ein- und Zwei-Cent-Münzen, zeigt sich Unzufriedenheit, bei ein und zwei Eurostücken nicht minder. 53 Prozent der Deutschen würden für deren Abschaffung stimmen. Das ergab eine Umfrage des NBF unter deutschen Geldnutzern.

>Nun legt das NBH eine Reformidee vor: Wie wäre es, bei Barzahlungen auf jeweils Fünf-Euro-Beträge auf- oder abzurunden? Angesichts der steigenden Preise und des geringen Restkaufwertes des Euro entsprechen fünf Euro heute nur dem Betrag, der der 25 Jahren fünf D-Mark war. An der Supermarktkasse würde der Vorschlag bedeuten: Statt 4,99 Euro würde ein Produkt 5,00 Euro kosten, statt 1,02 Euro auch fünf Euro, ein Produkt für 14 Euro aber wäre für zehn zu haben. Über die Dauer der Zeit, sind Experten sicher, glichen sich Mehr- und Minderausgaben für jeden aus.

Profitieren würde die Umwelt. Gerade bei den großen Kleinmünzen handele es sich um ökologisch zweifelhafte Zahlungsmittel. Überdies be die Inflation dazu geführt, dass es kaum noch Waren in nennenswerter Menge gibt, die sich etwa mit einem Euro bezahlen lassen würden. Selbst sogenannte Ein-Euro-Shops hätten sich bereits reihenweise in Fünf-Euro-Shops umbenannt, um der rasanten Teuerung der letzten Jahre Rechnung zu tragen. 

Das Missverhältnis zwischen implizitem Wert einer Hartgeld münze und deern Kaufkraft habe sich in den zurückliegenden Jahren immer weiter verschlechtert. Inzwischen ist der Cent nicht mehr nur keinen Taler wert, sondern sogar nur noch einen halben Cent - also etwa so viel wie früher ein Pfennig.

>Geheimes Papier

Das Bargeldforum, das auch die Bundesbank berät, plädiert daher in einem bisher geheimgehalten Papier dafür, dem Trend zu immer mehr Kartenzahlungen Rechnung zu tragen, indem das sogenannte Hartgeld umgehend abgeschafft wird. Gemeint sind nicht nur Ein- und Zwei-Cent-Münzen, sondern auch deren große Brüder, die Fünf- und Zehn-Cent-Münzen sowie die Euro-Geldstücke. Dabei soll es mit Rücksicht auf die Einkaufsgewohnheiten Älterer nicht den einen harten Schnitt geben, sondern einen langsamen Auslaufprozess. 

Die Bundesbank würde Euromünzen einfach nicht mehr durch neu geprägte Exemplare und schon gar nicht wie bisher Millionen von neuen Münzen in den Markt pressen, sondern die traditionellen Geldstücke nach und nach einziehen. Bis die derzeit
> rund 151,3 Milliarden Euro-Münzen komplett aus dem Umlauf verschwunden wären, darunter nicht nur die etwa 24,8 Milliarden 5-Cent-Münzen, sondern Geldstücke sämtlicher Beträge.

>Derzeit werden allein in Deutschland pro Jahr mehrere hundert   Millionen Münzen nachgepresst, um die Geldmenge entsprechend der aktuellen Bestellungen von Sondervermögen auch auf der Bargeldseite weiter auszuweiten. Für den anstehenden Auslaufprozess veranschlagen die Währungshüter Jahre, sie verweisen aber auf die positiven Folgen für das Weltklima:  Nicht nur fielen die millionenteuren Prägeprozesse in europaweit Dutzenden von staatlichen Münzanstalten weg, die auf Rohstofflieferungen aus Schurkenstaaten angewiesen sind und ihre teure Prozessenergie zu großen Teilen fossilen Lieferungen verdanken. 

Zudem rechnen die Forscher des NBF vor, wäre ein sekundärer Effekt binnen kurzer Zeit spürbar: Derzeit trage im Durchschnitt allein in Deutschland jeder Einwohnende etwa vier bis fünf Euro Hartgeld bei sich. Das Gewicht der Münzen von etwa 50 Gramm summiere sich bei der Gesamtzahl der Deutschen auf 3.600 Tonnen Metall, das aufgrund der hohen Mobilität der Bürgerinnen und Bürger beständig mitgeführt und von den meisten ohne Wissen um die ökologischen Folgen teilweise über Monate und Jahre hin und her transportiert wird. Diese Last entspreche der, die eine Flotte von 100 schweren Trucks bewältigen könne, allerdings, schreiben die Forscher, fahre diese Flotte vollkommen ziellos umher.

>Hartgeld zerstört das Klima

Hartgeld sei damit Verursacher von zusätzlichen Treibhausgasemissionen, dem sogenannten \

. Allein aufgrund dieser privaten Transportlasten, die von Hartgeldmünzen verursacht werden, erhöhe sich die Klimatemperatur weltweit um etwa 0,02 Grad. Nicht berücksichtigt sind dabei die kommerziellen Transportleistungen, mit denen die Volkswirtschaft in Zeiten knapper Kassen und hoher CO2-Belastungen zu kämpfen habe. Auch die Geldtransporte, die nötig sind, um alte Münzen einzuziehen und neue auszugeben, wälzen Tag für Tag Metalle mit einem Gesamtgewicht von etwa 20.000 Tonnen um. \

Vorbilder genug gibt es. Bisher haben nur Finnland, die Niederlande, Irland, Italien und Belgien es gewagt, zumindest die kleinsten Kupfermünzen abzuschaffen. Nach den Berechnungen des Nachhaltigen Bargeldforums aber profitieren die Bürger, das Klima und die Wirtschaft erst richtig vom sogenannten großen Schnitt\
große Lücke im \nBruttoinlandsprodukt zwischen der EU und den USA aufgetan\
verfügbare Pro-Kopf-Einkommen in den USA seit 2000 fast doppelt so schnell gestiegen sei wie in der EU\

hätten. Die USA profitieren von ihrer Konzentration auf Notengeld in Form von Scheinen: Was im Jahr 1900 für einen Dollar zu haben war, kostet heute im Durchschnitt 37. Die ausgeweitete Geldmenge aber fällt kaum ins Gewicht: Statt ein Gramm wiegt der notwendige Betrag in einzelnen Dollarscheinen 37 Gramm. In Euro-Hartgeld  wäre es mehr als ein halbes Kilogramm.

\
, haben die Wissenschaftler des NBF errechnet. \
Allein der Energieverbrauch für die Prägung und der CO2-Ausstoß beim Transport sind nicht mehr zeitgemäß.\
In Zeiten geopolitischer Spannungen fehlt uns jedes Gramm des in Münzen gebundene Material natürlich bei der Wiederwehrhaftmachung der Truppe\
Es ist an der Zeit, unser Zahlungssystem zu revolutionieren\
was einst im Sparschwein verstaubte, sollten wir besser unseren Panzerfabriken zur Verfügung stellen und selbst ganz auf Scheine und Karten umsteigen.\

Well, that's nice of you, and I'm sure that she appreciated it. 😁🙏💚✨🤙

!HOPE
!INDEED
!WINE
!WEIRD

body.title: Personal Growth Requires Accountability
body.body:
>

There was this girl I knew when I was in secondary school far back. She was constantly failing mathematics. In each of the times she failed, she would blame everyone else but herself. She would blame the teacher, the exam format, the school, etc. But after a while, she finally decided to tell herself the truth that she has not been serious with studying mathematics. It was at that point that she decided to take responsibilities for her academics. She created a study timetable, asked for help and extra lessons, practised regularly. By the end of that term, she was among the top 5 mathematics students. Her performance improved because accountability helped her to focus on working on herself, not trading blames. If you must grow, then you have to be accountable for your life.

<center>![pexels-rdne-7821543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf4tjwjT51z374EcYQTW6g3c6CytX5Zyz3wdf5ieG9ugQ/pexels-rdne-7821543.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-photo-of-person-pointing-on-documents-7821543)</sub></center>

You have to understand that personal growth does not come by accident. Rather it requires conscious and intentional efforts, discipline, self-awareness, and accountability. Accountability simply means that you are bearing the full responsibility for your actions, decisions, habits, inactions, and the results that come from them instead of blaming someone or something else. Without being accountable, it may be difficult to grow. This is because real growth begins to happen when you have honestly told yourself the truth about what needs to change, and then take up actions to change it.

It is true that a lot of people want success, good achievements, progress, improvement, etc. But the question is; how accountability are they even when things become uncomfortable? To some people, it feels easier to blame failure on back luck, on the system, on difficult situations, than to take a reflection within yourself to know what really happened and then fix your mistakes. If you avoid responsibilities and accountability, you may be stuck at the same place for long without making a meaningful progress. If you do not tell yourself the truth about why something has happened, it may happen again.

Honest accountability actually begins with self-reflection. That is, looking within first, to know why what happened has happened, not looking outside first. This includes asking yourself crucial questions like \

This will help you to build awareness and then take accountability for your life. You can only grow when you tell yourself the truth and be sincere with yourself. Accountability is very important because it gives you the control over your improvement. You can only improve when you know that you need improvement, not when you deny the obvious. When you accept the responsibilities for your actions, it will be easier to gain the power to change them. But the moment you start blaming people for what has happened, you may lose the power to change your actions. It is accountability that shifts your focus from looking for excuses to looking for the solutions.
![pexels-mikhail-nilov-8297420.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNh6ssqK9WtUiACnyGXhzgDdy462S6jKAAjWHgPHs93Vq/pexels-mikhail-nilov-8297420.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/young-woman-feeling-exhausted-in-white-long-sleeve-shirt-working-inside-an-office-8297420)
Accountability also helps to build discipline. If you always hold yourself accountable, then you are more likely to be committed to your goals even when you are not motivated by external factors. You will even understand that progress requires consistency, discipline, and responsibilities, not just acting when you feel like. Accountability also strengthens your character. When you admit your mistakes and move to correct them, it will make you more human, and will also make more mature. It is also worthy to note that accountability improves interpersonal relationships. People will trust you more and take your words more seriously when they know that you are responsible for your actions and when you are accountable. This also makes people to entrust more things in your hands. To build a good relationship, you have to be honest, trustworthy, and accountable. If you want people to take you seriously, then you also need to take yourself seriously. You cannot live the way you like and hope for people to take you seriously. Accountability helps you to be committed to what matters, and to your goals. Remember that this does not mean that you should be overly harsh on yourself. Because it is not a call for condemning yourself, but improving yourself. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

When the Artemis II crew was out there near the moon side, we could see Earth like a size of a football, if they would travel further ahead, the size of this ball will further shrink to a dot. And Imagine in this small ball we 8 billion people are living and now imagine one single of us from this 8 billion, like a speck in the dust and yet we give ourselves so much importance and live with so much ego. 

The Universe is somewhere 93 billion light years across, it doesn't know my name, once I die, I will soon be forgotten. So does it mean that anything that we do probably has no significance or importance. Sometimes I feel yes, all that we keep chasing for all our life will have no meaning one day. On death I cannot take absolutely anything so what is this whole struggle for. How does it matter if I have more or less because whatever I have is all temporary and it's never going to be a forever thing for me.

I am a speck in the dust, may feel insignificant but I still believe that I have a special place in this entire Universe.

body.title: Learning to live with stress without losing tenderness. SilverBloggers Chronicles – Prompt 48
body.body:
Hello SilverBloggers community!

## SilverBloggers Chronicles – Prompt 48
### Learning to live with stress without losing tenderness

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSk7PrT3KbzWakSpijmUA5ZaSDNXjWiao7HJuza5r4b4p/engin_akyurt_coffee_2439897_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/coffee-cup-drink-cappuccino-2439897/)

---


Stress has been part of my life for so many years that sometimes I feel I no longer remember what it means to live completely without worries.

Like many people, I have experienced moments of heartbreak, disappointments, fears, uncertainty, and emotional exhaustion. But honestly, the greatest stress in my life did not come from dramatic events. It came from the accumulation of many small struggles repeated every day.

Worrying about food, electricity, money, family, health, and the future slowly wears people down.

Living in Cuba during difficult times teaches you something very quickly: even when life becomes complicated, responsibilities do not disappear.

As a mother, I learned to continue moving forward even when I felt emotionally tired.

There were days when anxiety sat quietly beside me from the moment I woke up. Days of blackouts, shortages, uncertainty, and endless calculations trying to make things work at home.

But despite all that, I always tried not to let stress turn me into a cold or bitter person.

Over time, I understood that I could not always control what happened around me, but I could protect certain small refuges that helped me keep my heart calm.

For me, healing from stress was never something dramatic.

It was found in simple things.

Sometimes it was sitting quietly with a cup of coffee before everyone woke up.

Sometimes it was sewing peacefully while my mind slowly relaxed.

Sometimes it was cooking for my family and seeing them enjoy a meal made with love, even when there was very little available.

And many times, it was simply talking and laughing with the people I love.

I think one of the saddest things stress can do is make people lose their sensitivity.

That is why I always tried to hold on to tenderness, patience, and affection even during difficult moments.

Heartbreak also changes over the years.

When we are young, we often think heartbreak only comes from romantic relationships. But with time, life teaches us that there are many other ways the heart can break.

Seeing dreams become impossible, watching people leave, losing loved ones, or feeling powerless in front of situations we cannot change can also deeply hurt the heart.

Even so, life continues.

And perhaps true strength is not pretending to be unaffected, but learning how to continue living without allowing pain to harden us completely.

Today, when stress arrives, I try to face it with more calm than before.

I breathe, organize my thoughts, focus on what I can solve, and remind myself that difficult moments eventually pass.

I still worry, of course.

But I have learned that protecting inner peace is also a necessity.

And sometimes the best way to heal the heart is simply continuing to care for others without forgetting ourselves in the process.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.
