Hola comunidad de SilverBloggers!

## SilverBloggers Chronicles – Prompt 48
### Aprender a vivir con el estrés sin perder la ternura

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSk7PrT3KbzWakSpijmUA5ZaSDNXjWiao7HJuza5r4b4p/engin_akyurt_coffee_2439897_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/coffee-cup-drink-cappuccino-2439897/)

---


El estrés ha sido parte de mi vida durante tantos años que a veces siento que ya ni recuerdo lo que significa vivir completamente sin preocupaciones.

Como muchas personas, he pasado momentos de tristeza, decepciones, miedos, incertidumbre y agotamiento emocional. Pero sinceramente, el mayor estrés de mi vida no vino de grandes dramas. Vino de la acumulación de muchas pequeñas luchas repetidas cada día.

Preocuparse por la comida, la electricidad, el dinero, la familia, la salud y el futuro desgasta lentamente a las personas.

Vivir en Cuba en tiempos difíciles te enseña algo muy rápido: incluso cuando la vida se complica, las responsabilidades no desaparecen.

Como madre aprendí a seguir adelante incluso cuando me sentía emocionalmente agotada.

Hubo días en que la ansiedad se sentaba silenciosamente a mi lado desde el momento en que despertaba. Días de apagones, escasez, incertidumbre y cálculos interminables tratando de hacer que todo funcionara en casa.

Pero aun así, siempre intenté no permitir que el estrés me convirtiera en una persona fría o amarga.

Con el tiempo entendí que no siempre podía controlar lo que ocurría a mi alrededor, pero sí podía proteger ciertos pequeños refugios que me ayudaban a mantener el corazón tranquilo.

Para mí, sanar el estrés nunca fue algo dramático.

Lo encontré en cosas simples.

A veces era sentarme en silencio con una taza de café antes de que todos despertaran.

Otras veces era coser tranquilamente mientras mi mente se relajaba poco a poco.

En ocasiones era cocinar para mi familia y verlos disfrutar una comida hecha con amor, incluso cuando había muy poco disponible.

Y muchas veces era simplemente conversar y reír junto a las personas que amo.

Creo que una de las cosas más tristes que puede provocar el estrés es que las personas pierdan la sensibilidad.

Por eso siempre traté de aferrarme a la ternura, la paciencia y el cariño incluso en los momentos difíciles.

El corazón roto también cambia con los años.

Cuando somos jóvenes solemos pensar que el dolor del corazón solo viene de relaciones románticas. Pero con el tiempo la vida nos enseña que existen muchas otras formas en que el corazón puede romperse.

Ver sueños volverse imposibles, observar cómo las personas se marchan, perder seres queridos o sentirse impotente ante situaciones que no podemos cambiar también hiere profundamente.

Aun así, la vida continúa.

Y quizás la verdadera fortaleza no sea fingir que nada duele, sino aprender a seguir viviendo sin permitir que el dolor nos endurezca completamente.

Hoy, cuando el estrés llega, intento enfrentarlo con más calma que antes.

Respiro, organizo mis pensamientos, me concentro en lo que sí puedo resolver y me recuerdo que los momentos difíciles eventualmente pasan.

Claro que todavía me preocupo.

Pero he aprendido que proteger la paz interior también es una necesidad.

Y a veces la mejor forma de sanar el corazón es simplemente seguir cuidando de los demás sin olvidarnos de nosotros mismos en el proceso.

Gracias por leer.

body.title: Predicting The Future And Building Aura On Xmarket
body.body:
[XMarket on BNB Chain](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) is one of those projects that sounds deceptively simple until you actually start using it and suddenly realize you’ve been gambling on internet opinions for three hours straight.

The concept is easy, as people create prediction markets around future events and traders buy “YES” or “NO” shares depending on whether they think something will happen.

Sports, politics, crypto prices, AI narratives, cultural drama… if people can argue about it on CT then it can probably become a market. You get a share of the profits if it gets viral! 

If your prediction is right when the market resolves your shares pay out at full value. If you panic halfway through because the timeline starts screaming you can always sell early and preserve whatever dignity remains.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWNVX5nChwnKP88GwVuHZq86yBuBVvRXSpCZTthTYKNz4/image.png)


What makes [XMarket](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) more interesting than the average prediction platform is the creator economy angle. Anyone can create a market and if enough people trade on it, the creator earns part of the fees generated.

Early presale backers can also farm a slice of that revenue which turns every decent prediction into a tiny decentralized business model. I had absolutely no clue what [XMarket](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) even was before the Airaa Aura Sprint campaign went live.

Then suddenly the entire timeline was talking about aura, leaderboards, multipliers and AI market energy like we had all joined a digital cult overnight. Naturally… I joined immediately.

The whole Airaa x XMarket campaign fully embraced degen psychology. Deposit more, trade more, grind the leaderboard harder and pray your aura multiplier carries you into the rewards zone.

I ended up creating two markets myself. One around the $BTC price and another linked directly to the Airaa Aura Sprint leaderboard, and went big with buying shares! 

At that point people could literally speculate on whether Leafswan finishes the top of the charts. We have officially financialized social media schizophrenia.

There’s also a presale phase before markets go live. A market needs to attract enough interest and hit at least $100 in commitments before activation. If it gains traction then both creators and early supporters share in the fees generated from trading volume.

Here's where things are not that great! [XMarket](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) doesn't have Polymarket volume and probably will never reach that magnitude. What users can earn from fees is limited! 

I created four markets and invested in other six... using $233.6 for the gig! I earned only $18.25 from revenue and $1.25 from fees, which takes me down 90% of what committed! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9SpXsLdG9ZqMrbYG65QtnwVJGKYzaq3oE4uQScNepGg/image.png)


I launched a market asking whether $BTC would close above $73,000 by March 15th and the market ended up doing $76 in volume. Not exactly Wall Street numbers, but enough to make me realize people will speculate on absolutely anything if you wrap it in Web3 terminology.

The Aura Sprint itself turned into pure leaderboard warfare. I took advantage of the PvP mechanism and kept buying shares for Leaf\_Swan to finish first at the end of the sprint! 

At one point I was sitting around 15th place after the first week, then down to 35th. Eventually I clawed my way back up the rankings and finished 24th overall which landed me a $300 reward.

More importantly, I managed to hit the full 8x multiplier on the Airaa Aura Sprint which felt less like an achievement and more like surviving a psychological endurance test disguised as a marketing campaign.

The end of the [XMarket](https://xmarket.app/referrals/x7QBs6EwqHJeJV6) aura sprint was on fire! Managed to climb same spots in the last day and ended 24th in the ranks! Leaf got the crown but it was a Hollywood ending! Love it!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7L1ESUm4Bcw25pha8aiGpCmyE4d14cuNoYKB6zQQ3cL/image.png)

Somehow I turned  aura points into a small profit, an 8x multiplier and a top 24 leaderboard finish. Crypto really is the only industry where this sentence makes perfect sense.

I bought 180 shares for $102 and turn it into $78 profit, and added $300 from my final rank in the charts. Deduct the money I lost on presale and my win for two months of hustle was only $158 USDC! 

Need to make this W bigger but the market options are limited, probably due to the pre-sale drama. So far I turned $28.86 into $48.10 on the Eurovision prediction, and going strong.

The 66.6% ROI sounds diabolical but is not! It's a mix of maths and calculated risks. I am waiting for CZ to post less this month and for the South Korea elections for more wins!

title.title: My Diary For Week 22
title.body:
Hallo zusammen (English version below),

hier mein von mir und meinem Agenten erstellter Wochenrückblick für die Woche vom 8. bis 14. Mai 2026.

# 📅 Wochenrückblick: 15.05.2026 – 21.05.2026

*Geschrieben am Freitag, 22. Mai 2026*

---
# Wochenzusammenfassung 15.05.2026 – 21.05.2026

## Freitag, 15.05.2026

Sehr schlechter Schlaf (ca. 22:00–2:30 Uhr, dann wach geblieben). Entsprechend erschöpft. Am Mittag am OpenClaw/Hive-Projekt gearbeitet: Erfolgreich Daten aus HiveSQL extrahiert und das Wiki um Hive-Einträge ergänzt. Danach Lineke beim Zugriff auf ihre Mailbox unterstützt. Am Abend Civilization und Northguard gespielt.

## Samstag, 16.05.2026

Besser geschlafen als in der Nacht zuvor. Hühnerstall gereinigt und Holz im Garten gesägt. Am Nachmittag mit Annette in der Gemeinde – potentiellen Pastor kennengelernt; positiver Eindruck. Seit Mittag wieder sehr schlapp, Energielosigkeit. Abends allein \

(Arnold Schwarzenegger) gesehen – Film als schlecht bewertet, vorzeitiges Ausschalten.

## Sonntag, 17.05.2026

Gemeinsam mit Annette zum Gottesdienst. Anschließend Spaziergang und Lektüre (\

von Dr. Ehrman). Abends Badewanne. Anika und Thomas zum Abendessen zu Gast. Fühlte mich deutlich besser als am Samstag.

## Montag, 18.05.2026

 Joggen: 6,5 km in 43 Minuten (inkl. kurzem Gespräch mit Toni). Anschließend Arbeit an Openbao – Durchbruch: Server sowohl im Docker-Container (Privat-PC) als auch in Podman (Arbeit) zum Laufen gebracht; erste CLI-Befehle erfolgreich ausgeführt; große Aha-Effekte. Am Nachmittag undichten Kaminofen erfolglos versucht zu reparieren und Holz gehackt. Abends mit Annette \

geschaut.

## Dienstag, 19.05.2026

Nach der Arbeot U.a. Arbeit an neuer Webseite zur Angebotserstellung für IT-Dienstleistungen. 

## Mittwoch, 20.05.2026

Am Streik der Telekom teilgenommen. Mit dem Bus nach Köln gefahren.

![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23xpAuuZyAgxumuE8p1h4cphwwWwwN42brCCMgyWL3TgmVw7iV2QVLu55uDvK5NdFdCe8.png)



---

**Zusammenfassung:** Die Woche war geprägt von technischen Durchbrüchen (HiveSQL-Integration, Openbao/Docker/Podman-Erfolge), sozialen Aktivitäten (Kennenlernen des neuen Pastors, Besuch von Anika und Thomas, Telekom-Streik) und handwerklicher Arbeit (Holz hacken, Kaminofen, Hühnerstall). Der Gesundheitszustand schwankte: Freitag und Samstag starke Erschöpfung, Sonntag deutliche Besserung, Montag wieder fit. Ein Film (Vendetta) enttäuschte.

---

## English Summary

*Written on Friday, May 22, 2026*

---
# Weekly Summary: May 15 – 21, 2026

## Friday, May 15, 2026

Very poor sleep (approx. 10:00 PM – 2:30 AM, then stayed awake). Consequently exhausted. working on the OpenClaw/Hive project: Successfully extracted data from HiveSQL and added Hive-related entries to the wiki. In the afternoon, assisted Lineke with accessing her email inbox. Played *Civilization* and *Northgard* in the evening.

## Saturday, May 16, 2026

Slept better than the previous night. Cleaned the chicken coop and sawed wood in the garden. In the afternoon, attended a community gathering with Annette—met a potential pastor; left with a positive impression. Since noon, felt very lethargic again—a complete lack of energy. In the evening, watched \

(Arnold Schwarzenegger) alone—rated the film as poor and turned it off early.

## Sunday, May 17, 2026

Attended church service together with Annette. Afterward, went for a walk and did some reading (*How Jesus Became God* by Dr. Ehrman). Took a bath in the evening. Hosted Anika and Thomas for dinner. Felt significantly better than I had on Saturday.

## Monday, May 18, 2026

Went for a jog: 6.5 km in 43 minutes (including a brief chat with Toni). Afterward, worked on Openbao—a breakthrough: Managed to get the server running in both a Docker container (on my home PC) and in Podman (at work); successfully executed the first CLI commands; experienced several major \
moments. In the afternoon, I made an unsuccessful attempt to repair a leaking wood stove and chopped some wood. In the evening, Annette and I watched \

## Tuesday, May 19, 2026

Among other things, I worked on a new website for generating quotes for IT services.

## Wednesday, May 20, 2026

I participated in the Telekom strike. I took the bus to Cologne.

![grafik.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/achimmertens/23xpAuuZyAgxumuE8p1h4cphwwWwwN42brCCMgyWL3TgmVw7iV2QVLu55uDvK5NdFdCe8.png)



---

**Summary:** The week was characterized by technical breakthroughs (HiveSQL integration; successes with Openbao, Docker, and Podman), social activities (meeting the new pastor, a visit from Anika and Thomas, the Telekom strike), and manual labor (chopping wood, working on the wood stove, the chicken coop). My health fluctuated: I experienced severe exhaustion on Friday and Saturday, saw significant improvement on Sunday, and was back to full fitness on Monday. One movie (*Vendetta*) proved to be a disappointment.

title.title: TIB - An Investors Journal #811 - Silver Mining, Gold Mining, Uranium, US Oil, Japan Utility, ASX Stocks
title.body:
A week to absorb last week's busy options expiry - just tinkering around the edges and writing the next cycle of covered calls and sold puts ![May22Trades.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23yx5wUXaecNS6kmW35EFbM1gHYjxPcBkqYPcRg13HANvWaktLFFEJjZdLEiR6LRgoqfh.png)

Portfolio News

In a week where S&P 500 rose 0.88% and Europe rose 3.11%, my pension portfolio dropped 0.57%. A divergence in performance based on not enough tech stocks and too many gold and silver and uranium holdings relative to the market. Big movers of the week were Delivra Health Brands (DHB.V) (25%), Island Pharmaceuticals (ILA.AX) (24.3%), CleanSpark (CLSK) (21.8%), Standard Uranium (STND.V) (17.5%), Northern Minerals (NTU.AX) (16.7%), Lightning Minerals (L1M.AX) (15.8%), TDK Corporation (6762.T) (12.6%), Tyro Payments (TYR.AX) (12.1%), Sunrise Energy Metals (SRL.AX) (12%), Dream Finders Homes (DFH) (11.4%), American West Metals (AW1.AX) (10%) Only 11 stocks in the big movers list tells a story of its own. It is a ragtag of quite different things. Big themes are from the top: marijuana (1 stock), uranium (1 stock), rare earths (1 stock), gold/silver mining (1 stock), alternate energy (2 stocks). Another choppy week this time a little more focused on oil and yields and US Dollar rather than the war. Records there were. ![May22News.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSz8J2xCtgHSv96xS1E8YJCE8VMHUZECRzZLXguQFw1bAA8H26wzRKjDZcjK1NEBUby.png) **Crypto Drifts** Bitcoin price pushed higher and then sagged before finding buyers finishing the week 0.1% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 5% = a quiet week stranded in no-mans lad between levels. ![May24BTC.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EvHnbNPKZnGjxz7JMSctSertRKE4eMXSiZwKEW26TSAQvdu1tkawz58wowokP2ZbM.png) Ethereum price did much the same finishing the week 1% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 6.9% - also a quiet wobbling around a key level (the green line). ![May24ETH.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRLAoq1PgdLppf57dE5aQx5oAzsk3Vi6oUrTJZhYKwVAedXTi5hu9VkVx116u1r8nYr.png) This is the telling chart - Ethereum vs Bitcoin - a 16% drop in Ethereum suggests who is winning the crypto war as funds shift to Hyperliquid and ZCash for high TPS action. ![May24ETHBTC.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tHbKfYhjT7DnD5CVGGbS6ysYyR9yshP6K2mHa6xTPSBWhrTZjMHKVWfCeCuqewvJ2zq.png) Did not see this coming - there were a few privacy coins that were locked out for Australian residents some while back. Pretty sure I closed out my holdings then. Will be exploring this again ![May24ZECBTC.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23t8CSNv24vgy25sXCLz7CjBK8rw2GHxAqMxnyk2CWHHxxXGucefEU4obNMNmzL9mffPZ.png) One that is in my portfolios is NEAR Protocol (NEARBTC) - a 92% pop on the week ![May24NEAR.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wgo9C98iWEc4G5Jm8g8cC5eoedJiHaxqAX84JZ2P1b2pZBBNuoupv2gYKVbLcAMymYb.png) Cosmos (ATOMBTC) looks like it wants to break higher with the moving averages crossing over and making a higher low with a 16% pop also making a higher high ![May24ATOM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRL6XW65vgRTCrYQZTVMp54cqRmrVQAhtBDpfTkJCzQhuVpukkoPUxMDSzTuW8hwnx8.png) Injective Protocol (INJBTC) continued the run started the week before alos making higher high with a pop of 27% ![May24INJBTC.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTPWCbdLqAHd96VBnqq9V4FP7ZNkPECiW59QpqY2CqFnWsoMzKFnBxMMER5oBBKRH5.png) **Nuclear Energy Holdings** One addition only and a 2.6% drop in valuations. ![May22NuclearChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTAxfuT5TknqDgRCnLEtFMgUzn9jJnvJMHNkg73QE5Uy6jM9juz6TLCPAaVdY7eD5R.png) One change in mix of holdings with Paladin Energy (PDN.AX) moving up two places into slot 8. Share of Others drops half a point to 49.1%. Share of portfolios drops half a point to 30.9% ![May22Nuclear.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245wawKy4YJnjBuZsH6NvtefxfkpfHGrm3MJZ2uaQxyoEfhiRhA2onm5gcmVcZCwKQ1cC.png) Holdings by Stage sees a drop in Physical, a 0.7 point increase in Producing with the addition there, modest changes in the remaining stages apart from 0.5 point increase in Technology. ![May22NuclearbyStage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vspH85MMUYULT1knbTgbMGJQi13ag4yV1HBm2RDuSQumGLc3xuC3rQPQCzerBgMhUMn.png) **Alternate Energy Holdings** No changes in holdings and a 1.3% drop in valuations ![May22LithiumChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoeLeoX8kFvaXX5VwnoDXXPoKhMcd9PavWi93qWGi3Phyvx7gecaYVKtCLvHpfpRhRd.png) No change in the ranking of Top 10 but some key changes in shares. JinkoSolar Holding Co (JKS) down 1.3 points and Chargepoint (CHPT) up 1.1 points. Share of portfolios comes down 0.1 points to 5.1% ![May22Lithium.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244yGfwMpFG18jwKXknyM99jYuz9EE8mM42QZ5j7FCgmNGNxfKBMnWxmHvHp9xm4jPzgR.png) **Precious Metals Holdings** Two additions - one in gold and one in silver - and a 5.1% drop in valuations. ![May22PreciousChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vspH7fkNjEPVmJRvBoz4LAD8uY9zyZvuLHGDHJs6gSN3SQbTCyRw1fLtZfPY1Co7zcM.png) One change in the mix of holdings with GoGold Resources (GGD.TO) and Alamos Gold (AGI) swapping places in slot 8 and 9. Share of portfolios comes down 0.4 points to 10.8% ![May22Precious.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244oqwUTs5uDUBQin7giimA8G4jhHZ2PPZqzrkVHsiVXTTgrsBdNE13M39Yde4et6NszD.png)

Bought

Used the sell off moment in gold and silver to add to two holdings in pension portfolio - scales in at a lower cost. Been following quite a few interviews about the mispricing of silver mining stocks which market is valuing on silver price around the $40-50 mark. With price higher than that there has to be upside when the liquidity fear goes out of the markets **First Majestic Silver Corp** (AG): Silver Mining. Picked this as price has been pummelled quite hard. A bit of digging after the event. First a table from their corporate factsheet - 4 mines producing between 15 and 16.7Moz per year at a weighted average AISC between $22.71 and $26.85 per ounce. In the past 60 days silver price has ranged between $70 and $85 - currently $75.45 (May 22). This gives massive free cash flow - way ahead of the annual capex expenditures (like 32% ahead of 2026 budgets) ![May18AG.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcCBeqt1J3B9gz1cfMxSD7Z5xTit8tSjexjw7irioaj4UdZyC9kWVs19WJmUW1UAWKz.png) Next a few comparison charts - the Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL) comparing the Top 15 holdings and going back to the cycle low. On this one can see that First Majestic Silver Corp (AG - dark blue line) has tracked the ETF and is 13 points ahead only. The right hand dotted vertical line is the more pertinent line - the start of the Iran War - let's see that ![May18AGvsSIL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTJdMmnHyAc2DmziHaC3evvatHt87TnHFWg4i5MPr9gKjcZ1ym8zMxd7saGsSj5pjz.png) This is what I saw in the charts I was looking at - the premier silver mining stock lagging the ETF by 15 percentage points. ![May18AGvsSILShort.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRKsyifwUE2CD5yHdQ8F9oboDrirkHsuVma3MqvJbayJy9jTrVtRkSbJWdb9K51MWXv.png) Quite frankly one could buy any of these stocks and watch what happens when the war ends. **Equinox Gold Corp** (EQX): Gold Mining. Picked this gold stock to scale in in pension portfolio based on interview of the CEO, Darren Hall, following the merger with Aura gold - building a world class deposit in a solid jurisdiction. Wrote covered call for 1.03% premium with 19.7% price coverage. ![May18EQXvGDX.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wCbc11necTDDDfUSbXmEvs1qBp9oWGf6rshGBKaNGjyiXC1esdvQUakjvqeWyLtgv5n.png) Did the comparative charts again to Van Eck Vectors Gold Miners ETF (GDX - the bars) going back to the cycle low. EQX is not in the Top 15 - added it in - the orange line - lagging by 15 points. The notable stock on this chart is the bottom one - Northern Star Resources (NST.AX) - I have a very large holding in pension portfolio. This is sitting on one of the world's largest gold fields in the Pilbara, Western Australia. Will not be selling down just yet. ![May18EQXvSGDXShort.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3CQCafJ7Focu7ya4ZxwDjNbyewQNPfmLqcwef5bJT9zmULa4LaWwiQWVwVkUdobbp8.png) Go back to the chart from the day the war started - there Equinox Gold Corp (EQX) is 2nd from the bottom and lagging the ETF by 9 points - hence looking attractive. The market has not factored in the merger benefits yet. **Energy Fuels Inc** (UUUU): Uranium. Added a parcel in personal portfolio on a down day - the whole uranium market feels like a coiled spring. Japan has 42 reactors of which only 17 are currently slated to restart. Imagine what the fuel demand will be in the next 18 months if they move to restart the ones that are safe. [Thanks: Rick Rule for the thought]. With oil sentiment going the way it is, they have no real choice. Wrote covered call for 1.6% premium with 39.7% price coverage. Got to love the implied volatility. More than 1% premium for a month's hold and 39% leeway. **88 Energy** (88e.ax): US Oil. Stock has made it to big movers list a few times. Looks like they are making headway on Prudhoe drilling and a new well underway. Added to holding in personal portfolio to average down entry price.

Sold

**Tess Holdings Co** (5074.T): Japan Utility. Closed out in pension portfolio for 174% profit since February 2024 - stock screen idea. ![May22TESS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSzR6hh3NubAAEXdeN9eKkinVM38hLNhL9M7jTZyGm6zpzj9gUXevvf7qXFtDs8Mu3V.png) Quick review of the charts shows the entry in early 2024 with price breaking the downtrend and making higher high and higher low. Did not maintain the momentum and traded sideways for 18 months with a few tries above the entry level. And then the break worked.

ASX Portfolio

The segment reports trading in ASX fractional share portfolio. Trade entries are made based on stock screens looking for undervalued stocks (price to book, price earnings, price to sales) that are showing technical signs of breaking a downtrend. Exits are made at 35% profit or 25% if 52 week high is lower than 35% advance. New buys are in $500 lots. Scale ins and top ups in $250 lots **Top Ups** **NIB Holdings** (NHF.AX): Health Insurance. Dividend yield 3.83% ![May20NHF.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoAh3NvVpJNW1FCqX5L8eX3HVH2TAJYEETnFL35E1CXiEivt69oeaxyL3M1Pmy8PYTL.jpg) Chart shows a messy journey from the first entry with price drifting lower and then falling hard on earnings in mid 2025. Something of a recovery then - did not see the signals to average down in early 2025 (or ignored them). Price has now reversed and made higher lows. Plenty of scope to make a 52 week high target around the recent highs. This is above the two broker targets - might be making an exit there just above breakeven **Kelsian Group Limited** (KLS.AX): Shipping. Dividend yield 3.81%. ![May22KLS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tHb6kVWVTzjWP87xCQKzrbKjzPqiBQvXgfpPKVWQRm6ddVMvFWVaeoSTrrhXAt2PLT1.png) Chart shows a less than happy investment path and the weakness of the early investing approach. title.title: Cuando alguien recuerda mis pequeños gustos. Cosas pequeñas que me sostienen #20 por veramfund. [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
- - -

## Cosas pequeñas que me sostienen #20 
*Cuando alguien recuerda mis pequeños gustos*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPSAzsp14u5fTQvomfcxpDFtvb8nJ5XyhL4CJqeF6ANC/vinaconstanze_ice_cream_1613798_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/ice-cream-dessert-brownie-summer-1613798/)

---

Hola comunidad @ladiesofhive nuevamente con ustedes con el vigésimo primer capítulo de las **Cosas pequeñas que me sostienen**.

Hace unos días quedé con varios amigos de la universidad después de muchísimo tiempo sin vernos.

Entre trabajos, rutinas, problemas de transporte y horarios distintos, las reuniones se vuelven cada vez más difíciles de coordinar. Así que cuando finalmente logramos coincidir, decidimos vernos en una heladería cerca de la playa.

Y por supuesto, comer helado era parte importante del plan.

Pero el transporte, como suele pasar tantas veces, decidió jugar en mi contra.

Después de esperar bastante tiempo sin resultados, terminé tomando un taxi moto para no llegar todavía más tarde.

Aun así, cuando llegué, todos ya estaban sentados conversando y esperando el pedido.

Después de los saludos, las bromas y ese afecto que aparece incluso cuando ha pasado mucho tiempo sin verse, uno de mis amigos me dijo algo que me sorprendió más de lo que esperaba:

“Te sigue gustando el helado de naranja piña, ¿verdad? Porque ese fue el que pedimos para ti.”

Y casi sin pensar respondí:

“Sí… pero con un brownie de chocolate.”

Entonces él se rió y contestó:

“Por supuesto. Sabía que era así.”

Y aunque parece una conversación completamente simple, hubo algo en ese momento que me hizo sentir muy querida.

Porque a veces el cariño aparece de formas pequeñas.

En descubrir que alguien todavía recuerda detalles sobre ti incluso después del tiempo. Que entre tantas personas, conversaciones y cambios, ciertas cosas tuyas permanecen en la memoria de alguien más.

No era solo el sabor del helado.

Era sentir que me habían tenido presente antes incluso de llegar.

Y creo que esos pequeños gestos tienen más peso del que imaginamos.

Porque nos recuerdan algo muy humano:
que ser vistos también significa ser recordados en los detalles más simples.

Y honestamente, en un mundo donde todo parece ir tan rápido, encontrar personas que todavía prestan atención a esas pequeñas cosas…

también me sostiene.

---

 *Esto es Vera, aprendiendo a sostenerse en lo simple.*

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha utilizando Google Translate.

- - - 
# *English Version*
- - - 

## Small Things That Sustain Me #20 
*When Someone Remembers the Little Things I Like*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPSAzsp14u5fTQvomfcxpDFtvb8nJ5XyhL4CJqeF6ANC/vinaconstanze_ice_cream_1613798_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/ice-cream-dessert-brownie-summer-1613798/)

---

Hello @ladiesofhive community, once again with you with the twenty-first chapter of **Small Things That Sustain Me**.

A few days ago I met up with several university friends after a very long time without seeing each other.

Between work, routines, transportation problems, and different schedules, gatherings become harder and harder to organize. So when we finally managed to coincide, we decided to meet at an ice cream place near the beach.

And of course, eating ice cream was an important part of the plan.

But transportation, as happens so many times, decided to work against me.

After waiting for quite a while without success, I ended up taking a motorcycle taxi so I would not arrive even later.

Even so, by the time I arrived, everyone was already sitting together talking and waiting for the order.

After the greetings, the jokes, and that affection that appears even after a long time without seeing each other, one of my friends said something that surprised me more than I expected:

“You still like orange-pineapple ice cream, right? Because that’s the one we ordered for you.”

And almost without thinking, I replied:

“Yes… but with a chocolate brownie.”

Then he laughed and answered:

“Of course. I knew that too.”

And although it may seem like a completely simple conversation, there was something about that moment that made me feel deeply appreciated.

Because sometimes affection appears in small ways.

In realizing that someone still remembers little details about you even after time has passed. That among so many people, conversations, and changes, certain things about you remain in someone else’s memory.

It was not only about the ice cream flavor.

It was about feeling that they had thought about me before I even arrived.

And I think those small gestures carry more weight than we imagine.

Because they remind us of something very human:
being seen also means being remembered in the simplest details.

And honestly, in a world where everything moves so fast, finding people who still pay attention to those small things…

also sustains me.

---

 *This is Vera, learning to sustain herself in the simple things.*

The images are from Pixabay.  
The English version was made using Google Translate.

title.body:
Hi, guys!

Yesterday I signed up for a trial lesson at a new gymnastics studio that opened near my home. I'm hoping there'll be a good coach there, because it's a great opportunity for me to get back into aerial gymnastics close to home. So I'll go today, check what I remember, what I don't, and see if I like the girl who's teaching. I also want to start taking private exotica lessons with the coach I used to work with. She's very nice, and I feel comfortable with her. We'll see, maybe I'll schedule a lot of training sessions to get back into shape. I don't really have a clear idea of ​​how it will all work out yet.

The important thing is that I want to reorganize my schedule now so that it has room for everything I need to do. I'm nervous about this, but I need to pull myself together and just get this mechanism working. I think I should be able to do it now because I'm very motivated. It might not work out all at once, but it should work out nonetheless. At the very least, I'm mentally prepared.

So now I'll get back to all the things I need to do: music, drawing, sports, walks, healthy eating, and, of course, working on my novel. I hope I hit all the marks.

Have a great day, everyone!

## The Heartbreak No One Talks About
## Silver Bloggers Chronicles Prompt #48

- - -

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSz7McqCNqy8WCRMwmUbugJFG48LgBbRdUxSaNTpqwtEE/sammy_sander_doctor_5708102_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/doctor-corona-covid-19-quarantine-5708102/)

---

Hello @silver-bloggers community.

How did you deal with stress or heartbreak?

When people speak about heartbreak, most imagine the end of a relationship or the loss of someone they love. And of course, those wounds are real.

But over the years, I have discovered another kind of heartbreak — quieter, slower, and in some ways more difficult to explain.

The heartbreak of watching people slowly give up on the lives they once dreamed of.

- - -

As a doctor, I have seen this happen many times.

Not in dramatic moments, but in conversations during hospital shifts, in tired voices during late-night coffee breaks, in the silence that sometimes appears after someone says:

“I’m leaving.”

At first, those words used to surprise me.

Now they hurt in a different way.

Because I know what usually exists behind them.

- - -

I remember a specialist I deeply admired during my early years in medicine. He was brilliant — the kind of doctor who seemed capable of understanding both illness and people with unusual clarity. Patients trusted him immediately. Younger doctors listened carefully whenever he spoke.

He had dedicated years of his life to medicine with a seriousness that inspired everyone around him.

And yet, little by little, I watched exhaustion replace enthusiasm.

Not because he stopped loving medicine.

But because loving something is not always enough to survive inside difficult realities.

- - -

One night after a long shift, we were sitting outside the hospital for a few minutes before going home. The city was unusually quiet.

He looked tired in a way that had nothing to do with sleep.

Then, almost casually, he told me he had decided to leave the country.

I remember the silence that followed more than the words themselves.

Not because I judged him. I didn’t.

How could I?

I understood perfectly the weight behind that decision: the economic pressure, the frustration, the feeling of seeing your effort become increasingly disconnected from the life you hoped to build.

But still, something inside me broke a little.

Because I also understood what he was leaving behind.

Years of study.
A vocation.
A version of himself.

- - -

Later I heard he was working abroad doing something completely unrelated to medicine.

And strangely, what saddened me most was not the change of profession itself, but the idea of everything that had been quietly abandoned along the way.

Dreams do not always disappear dramatically.

Sometimes they fade out of pure exhaustion.

- - -

I think this has become one of the deepest sources of stress and heartbreak for many people in my generation.

Watching talented friends leave.
Watching hospitals lose valuable professionals.
Watching entire lives redirected not by passion, but by necessity.

And at the same time, understanding why it happens.

That is perhaps the hardest part.

The absence of anger toward the people leaving, because deep down you know they are only trying to survive.

- - -

How do I deal with that feeling?

Honestly, I don’t think there is a perfect answer.

Some days I read.
Some days I work quietly and try to focus on the people I can still help.
Some days I simply listen when a friend needs to speak about their doubts before leaving.

And sometimes, I remind myself that heartbreak is not always a sign of weakness.

Sometimes it is simply proof that something truly mattered to us.

- - -

Perhaps that is why these departures hurt so much.

Because behind every goodbye, there is usually a life someone once imagined very differently.

Thank you for reading.
See you in the words.

## El corazón roto del que casi no se habla
## Silver Bloggers Chronicles Prompt #48

- - -

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSz7McqCNqy8WCRMwmUbugJFG48LgBbRdUxSaNTpqwtEE/sammy_sander_doctor_5708102_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/doctor-corona-covid-19-quarantine-5708102/)

---

Hola comunidad @silver-bloggers.

¿Cómo lidian con el estrés o con un corazón roto?

Cuando las personas hablan de un corazón roto, la mayoría imagina el final de una relación o la pérdida de alguien querido. Y claro que esas heridas existen.

Pero con los años he descubierto otra forma de tristeza — más silenciosa, más lenta y, en cierto modo, más difícil de explicar.

La de ver cómo las personas poco a poco renuncian a la vida que alguna vez soñaron.

- - -

Como médica, he visto esto muchas veces.

No en grandes escenas dramáticas, sino en conversaciones durante las guardias, en voces cansadas durante un café nocturno, en el silencio que aparece después de que alguien dice:

“Me voy.”

Antes, esas palabras me sorprendían.

Ahora me duelen de otra manera.

Porque sé todo lo que normalmente existe detrás de ellas.

- - -

Recuerdo especialmente a un especialista que admiraba mucho durante mis primeros años en la medicina. Era brillante — de esos médicos capaces de comprender tanto la enfermedad como a las personas con una claridad poco común. Los pacientes confiaban en él casi de inmediato. Los médicos jóvenes escuchábamos con atención cada vez que hablaba.

Había dedicado años de su vida a la medicina con una entrega que inspiraba a todos alrededor.

Y aun así, poco a poco, vi cómo el agotamiento reemplazaba el entusiasmo.

No porque hubiera dejado de amar la medicina.

Sino porque amar algo no siempre basta para sobrevivir dentro de ciertas realidades.

- - -

Una noche, después de una guardia larga, estábamos sentados afuera del hospital antes de regresar a casa. La ciudad estaba extrañamente silenciosa.

Se veía cansado de una manera que no tenía que ver con el sueño.

Entonces, casi como quien comenta algo cotidiano, me dijo que había decidido irse del país.

Recuerdo más el silencio que vino después que las palabras mismas.

No porque lo juzgara. No podía hacerlo.

¿Cómo hacerlo?

Entendía perfectamente el peso detrás de esa decisión: la presión económica, la frustración, la sensación de ver cómo el esfuerzo de tantos años se alejaba cada vez más de la vida que uno esperaba construir.

Pero aun así, algo dentro de mí se rompió un poco.

Porque también entendía todo lo que estaba dejando atrás.

Años de estudio.
Una vocación.
Una versión de sí mismo.

- - -

Tiempo después supe que trabajaba en otro país haciendo algo completamente ajeno a la medicina.

Y curiosamente, lo que más tristeza me produjo no fue el cambio de profesión en sí, sino la idea de todo lo que había quedado abandonado silenciosamente en el camino.

Los sueños no siempre desaparecen de forma dramática.

A veces simplemente se desgastan por agotamiento.

- - -

Creo que esta se ha convertido en una de las fuentes más profundas de estrés y tristeza para muchas personas de mi generación.

Ver marcharse a amigos talentosos.
Ver hospitales perder profesionales valiosos.
Ver vidas enteras redirigidas no por pasión, sino por necesidad.

Y al mismo tiempo, entender perfectamente por qué sucede.

Quizás esa sea la parte más difícil.

La ausencia de enojo hacia quienes se van, porque en el fondo sabes que solo están intentando sobrevivir.

- - -

¿Cómo lidio con ese sentimiento?

Honestamente, no creo que exista una respuesta perfecta.

Algunos días leo.
Otros días trabajo en silencio e intento concentrarme en las personas a las que todavía puedo ayudar.
Y algunas veces simplemente escucho cuando un amigo necesita hablar de sus dudas antes de partir.

Y a veces me recuerdo algo importante: un corazón roto no siempre es señal de debilidad.

A veces es simplemente la prueba de que algo realmente nos importaba.

- - -

Tal vez por eso estas despedidas duelen tanto.

Porque detrás de cada adiós, casi siempre existe una vida que alguien imaginó de una manera muy distinta.

Gracias por leerme.
Nos encontramos en las palabras.

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al ingles fue hecha en DeepL Translate.

---

title.title: Strolling Around the Heart of Ormoc City
title.body: > Happy Wednesday Hivers! ## Ormoc City is one of the largest cities in the province of Leyte. One of the things the city is known for is its sweet pineapples. There are large pineapple plantations in the area, which is why pineapples have become one of the city’s proudest products. In fact, this is also one of the highlights celebrated during their festival. Ormoc City is quite far from our house, but transportation is not really a problem even if you do not have your own vehicle because there are many buses and vans traveling from our place to Ormoc. The estimated travel time is around two and a half hours, so the trip really takes some time. Still, the journey becomes worth it once you get to see the beauty and relaxing atmosphere of the city. Come and join me as I give you a virtual tour around Ormoc City! ## ![IMG_4279.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23xyXNTqB63cMeNsiBx72z9RAVM3Zx6csWeTuLDBaahqXcmZ5x2mtuSTj39T1KTV9GVRj.jpeg) ## I arrived in Ormoc City almost around lunchtime, so I decided to eat first before strolling around the city. While having lunch at Chowking, I noticed an old church located just across the street. After finishing my meal, I went there to visit the church. The front side of the church clearly showed its old and historic design, while the side portion already looked more modern because it had been renovated over the years. ## ![IMG_4276.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23zkg8V8amsR7wxPbxkXHE3vh1oAaeGv7K53LB4MJdQcxe6DVXWrnL14mwyrkMexcPcdK.jpeg) ## As I looked around another corner, I spotted an old building. At first, I thought it was the city hall, but I later found out that it was actually their tourism office and at the same time a national museum. In front of the building stands the statue of Jose Rizal, the national hero of the Philippines, with the Philippine flag proudly waving behind it. Beside the statue, there is also a fountain that adds beauty to the area. ## ![IMG_4282.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/243WPooFwVawFB7SYUKyDYp2jmv2wRoypeqirJwQ495BDtj137oonCjmowcyo6PMuAXu9.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4284.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23ycyhFp9TSWsK8v9geBxFo5ov2PpkQo3aFhd79ThUaHnJJNgvDDmjFogDgJ3dSvaJrhd.jpeg) ## I continued strolling around until I found the pathway leading to the coastal area, where their plaza can also be seen. Since Ormoc City is known for its large pineapple plantations, the plaza features several pineapple statues scattered around the area. On top of the pineapple designs is a figure of a woman that looks like she is gracefully dancing. Across the plaza, you can also see their large stage where they usually hold different events and celebrations. ## ![IMG_4285.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23yJCAUVWG6piZ5PXCGtLkX3HdCvXTJvpJ1re4MiiT8NGZFauLiPPsQtvVUvn8VjrqrTa.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4286.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/242Y3LCZEoAAFaPzoV5fvAeUgtSybhphvqKcY156txcg8gz9XgmP3VZV7HEpGjWWdyUmF.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4292.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23ynSNRbjpJ67cLbupq8HXrhYpq75XVoDinpNRmX3x1tuciSjvvLqtGjeQPS3pWMVSWnu.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4291.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23zbRcbdUEXBew9wWEsy53kC9kKMePy8UHJmwevPL1BKbvEXYWSRgMwKEKxPWGTNa1mHt.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4293.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EprT2K1KraeqHxdiP7EscTpnBXHWsH2pCjaSu3cCTbMqoBE1NSjHK8DuZY8Vmgd85JK.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4287.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EpnCkAKcwgWhQp1NZhXD4Px6oppnrZbNNe4YZPvHNp77Rys9gd8WM78RD7TsiLSKfZR.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4290.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23z7Bux4xEjVm4vJ1EaNz1C7YfrgKNdMDB5wUvzmYScbvLFgUigDdJkrw2iJQkbFLpadY.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4302.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/243M2iTh33sQbBbgXtNqLvHPQxJgStbMSnw7jp4PARRaBou7v6v4QWsQaF2H6UNgMoUDa.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4299.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wCDgqMPyy3jj5vaHKfKB99sMWXKGgZtHfnp1V25RCE7oZXsLo6RENk1vVPDLUkrhpEs.jpeg) ## Beside the stage, you can see Veterans Park. It is actually a nice place to hang out because it is shaded and cool, thanks to the many trees, and it is also located near the sea. Since the weather was extremely hot, I decided to rest for a while in the park. Even though I was alone, I did not feel bored because the surroundings were peaceful and relaxing. ## ![IMG_4303.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/242rnZS3aNX9Yq5oPecs61zApcP4h7z5V3nnv36hgY1YeZSF7qQJ25yV45Zvxfe3cKR3E.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4311.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/243qCzYHDoyDmY24nmGABEzLF2K546kL2nM8xW9Biz9LjjtyAnDRxMx1Fho4m1YvKRCT6.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4304.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23xydb7BzS6DLewKXEiirAKqiDGQ6sLVGcuCn7i5oDNgiw6TKqmziye24jLajPYM5s94M.jpeg) ## After that relaxing break, I continued my stroll. Right across from Veterans Park, you can clearly see their Superdome, which is one of the city’s well-known landmarks. After that, I proceeded further and eventually saw the lighthouse ahead. ## ![IMG_4310.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23zRy9wM8b2qNGdEeaWJqRkrzHEtpUBpU5V1JCkXCA5zqbfopTS71Rf4xhrUn8QYpj4Mb.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4313.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wWpJDdhHCunfsLGJtFbwKiFkw4L6Hfhj6PTqUUZm9tyCeNhU7sZfvJrr67rGrYoJ569.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4309.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23uQnHhEzWNZ7TeEC2zrqP2zZvHVamWJinwQq1pdYYqni4onwnwZCUSKj4RyZyj3sAr5X.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4312.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wgBPSfm9DnS4hsaBAiCPhaVT8YNyq4ZtVox1fftLiV2Q1KzBXuoKrjxeNAXP6BLJyhX.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4306.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23zGWGheUGvWV6Wc1rCJVqsvko6mCH8vaLKvmCeHi15bRs697NLHz1jwFM6L88aDszuWz.jpeg) ## ![IMG_4308.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/Eq5DVHGC3gHR2QegfFBZJyV2nDEpwpGwPndHQBAnx4BTTACqtzywDicKNXUu5ZTCbmR.jpeg) ## That is what you will see when you take a stroll around their plaza in Ormoc City. It is a simple yet refreshing place to explore, where different landmarks are close to each other and easy to visit on foot. From historical spots to relaxing open spaces, the area gives a mix of culture, nature, and local life that makes the stroll enjoyable and worth your time. ## ![IMG_4315.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/242hRqm2Tp3u3iMqM4gNieFZXeJQYxTdSG5GtchGyhXdiKrJZ8uFkezmM6H4fgFnoEgp8.jpeg) ## ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

title.title: Canticum Merú 💓 avanzando en los ensayos [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Life Estar community! Today I’m joining you here to share another day in my life with you. This time, it’s about the latest rehearsal with the Canticum choir. As I mentioned in previous posts, Canticum Merú will be performing in Caracas as part of a tribute marking the 100th anniversary of Modesta Bor’s birth. We’ll be joining other choirs, as this is a national event. So we’ve been working pretty hard to pay a fitting tribute to the memory of this great woman. I’m sharing with you some of the photos I took at today’s rehearsal.

\n\n

>By the way, today we were filming a video for a friend of the choir who wanted to feature this regional women’s choir. I’ll tell you more about that in the coming days. That’s why we’re all dressed in our uniform and our iconic pink flower. We usually wear casual clothes (some of us come straight from work, or it’s just more comfortable for singing), but for occasions like this, we wear a casual uniform that still makes a statement. I particularly like this one because the fabric is cool, doesn’t wrinkle, and fits nicely thanks to its cut. Overall, we’re all pretty anxious to record that video and hope everything goes well. And it did.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de life estar el día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta ocasión se trata sobre el nuevo ensayo en el coro de Canticum. Como les había comentado en publicaciones anteriores Canticum Merú se estará presentando en Caracas por homenaje al centenario del nacimiento de Modesta Bor. Junto con otros coros, pues es un encuentro nacional. Así que hemos estado trabajando bastante duro para poder rendir un buen tributo a la memoria de esta gran mujer. Comparto con ustedes algunas de las imágenes que tomé del ensayo de hoy.

\n\n>

>Por cierto para el día de hoy estuvimos grabando un video para una amistad del coro, que deseaba cierta presencia de este coro regional y femenino. De eso les hablaré más adelante en los días siguientes. Por eso es que todas estamos vestidas con nuestro uniforme y nuestra icónica flor rosada. Usualmente solemos usar vestimentas informales (algunas vienen directo del trabajo o simplemente es más cómodo para poder cantar), pero para ocasiones como estas usamos un uniforme casual pero con bastante presencia. A mí particularmente me gusta bastante este porque la tela es fresca no se arruga y queda bonita al cuerpo por la calle que tiene. En general todos estamos bastante ansiosas por grabar ese video y que todo saliera bien Y así fue.

![IMG_4788.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23x1FTy43qkrrWwYuEnwwK9UmvpWAZUNNCkUATE57VKemn9CKdA3q3VrVzcu4zxwM5eYU.jpeg) ![IMG_4787.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq7NoXuqT5VTzmG61NMk17Uh66zyDhiTJhdemWdbz58tRjQ9d9S96nBaWYV3dk8mZC3.jpeg) ![IMG_4790.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Epzz8Y1iFfmAjYstZNT1FZnLKJFjhDr9UBQEhbXBiqYs4yYtYbd7LruJGoomYV5UCJQ.jpeg)

>On the other hand, as for the music, I’d like to mention that the repertoire is coming along quite well, and I’m very happy to notice some positive changes (at least in my voice), which show that the constant rehearsals with the choir (that is, at the academy) and at home (the ones we do on our own) have paid off, as there is indeed more uniformity, beauty, and a higher quality compared to the first rehearsals. This is based on my own perception and, of course, is much more focused on the new songs, since the older ones were already mastered (especially by the more experienced singers). I’m happy to be able to move forward with the group. It’s exciting—it won’t be long now. Without further ado, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Por otra parte, en cuanto a la música, les comento que el repertorio va bastante bien y me alegra mucho notar ciertos cambios favorables (al menos en mi voz), evidenciar que los ensayos constantes en el coro (es decir, dentro de la academia) y en casa (aquellos que nosotras hacemos en casa, particulares) han rendido frutos, pues efectivamente hay más uniformidad, belleza y una calidad superior a los primeros ensayos. Esto es en referencia a mi propia percepción y por supuesto, va mucho más enfocado en las nuevas canciones pues las antiguas ya existía dominó (sobre todo en las cantantes más longevas). Me alegra poder avanzar junto al grupo. Es emocionante, ya falta poco. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

title.body:
<center>
![lukas_rychvalsky-man-2915187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theinkwell/23wMMuSKTXr3b137JkAdJgN2WT3bC92DgwSegsr2NVkQkEJTYH3T8aCSecDXY8vzFyrdn.jpg)
</center>

<sub>Source: [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-loneliness-sea-evening-2915187/)</sub> 

## Welcome to the Weekly Writing Prompt from The Ink Well
We provide *one weekly writing prompt* for short story writers. You may choose to use the prompt to write a fictional story (made up from your imagination) or a creative nonfiction story (based on your real life experiences). 

**IMPORTANT**: To be considered for curation, you *must* include one of these tags on your post:
* Fictional stories: #fiction
* Creative nonfiction stories: #creativenonfiction

You must also read and comment on the work of two other community members. Remember: We look for this when we curate your story. If we don't see this engagement, we will provide a reminder.

It is also *very* helpful to the admin team when authors add Fiction or Creative Nonfiction (or CNF for short) to the story title!

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)


### Before You Post in The Ink Well
Be sure to check out our community rules before posting in this community. You can find them at the top of our [home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created). They also appear at the top of a new post window.

Please also check out these additional helpful resources:
* Learn more about our community and the expectations of community members in our [FAQ post](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/important-faqs-about-the-ink-well-dos-and-donts-rules-and-tips) and our [treasure trove of tips and guidelines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-treasure-trove-of-tips-reminders-and-guidelines).
* Peruse our collection of great writing resources on everything from character development to how to write dialogue in our [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well). 
* Learn more about creative nonfiction, how it differs from fictional stories, and tips for success in [our post on creative nonfiction tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/creative-nonfiction-what-it-is-and-tips-for-success).
* Remember that we are *always* about quality first. Never about *quantity.* To achieve awards in The Ink Well, take the time to write quality stories and check them for errors. See the topic of the month, \

in the [March 2025 newsletter](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-walking-alone-on-a-field-in-dense-fog-16254468/) to learn about using tools (and using them properly) if you are not already doing this. **We do notice when you don't take the time!**

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Last Week's Winning Story of the Week

Thank you to everyone who shared a story for the last prompt, \

!

Each week we pick one of our favorite stories of the week and award the author 5 Hive. 

And we have a winner! Congrats to @henryjnrr for his story [*The Receipt Inside His Wallet*](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@henryjnrr/the-receipt-inside-his-wallet). 

Here's what our curators had to say:

> @henryjnrr writes a highly emotional story in staccato style.  The contrast between the heavy emotional content and spare narrative is effective.  The events speak for themselves.  The weeping and gnashing of teeth that usually comes with the end of a marriage would not make this tragedy more striking. The author delivers a great autopsy of a marriage in its final throws.  The end is  triggered by a receipt.    

Congratulations, @henryjnrr! 

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Short Story Writing Prompt of the Week

This week's prompt is: \

But don't rush off and start writing just yet. We have a special request. For this prompt, you must not write about physical weight that can be measured on a scale. Instead, we are looking for the kind of weight that sits invisibly between one's shoulder blades.

- It can be the weight of doubt about a purchase or a decision made.
- It can be the weight one feels when they must impart bad news.
- Or the weight some people carry in their hearts when they know they have caused another person pain or sadness
- It can also be the weight of responsibility when there is too much to do, and too many people are depending on that one key person.

Any of these things can cause a person to feel humbled, oppressed, and weighted down as if by massive dumbbells. 

Write about any of these scenarios that inspires you. **But most importantly**, how is it resolved? Sometimes a person just needs to talk to another person — a friend, a parent, a pastor or a therapist — and thus  finally release the weight by talking about it. Sometimes, there is a defining moment, such as forgiveness, or a life change that provides a new perspective. Sometimes an understanding person says something that causes tears to flow and a reckoning to happen. That resolution is vital. It is rare for anyone to be able to carry that heavy weight on their shoulders indefinitely... not without becoming physically or mentally ill. 

Tell us a story! Which one will you choose?
* Your own creative nonfiction story about how you dealt with a \

on your shoulders? 
* Or a fictional story about a character who is coping with a tremendous emotional weight of some kind — fear, dread, foreboding, guilt or sadness — 

As always, you do not need to actually use the prompt word(s). They are here to inspire your creativity!

We look forward to reading the product of your imagination or your personal experience! 

Good luck! And of course, you are welcome to use AI to generate ideas and images, but the writing must be *your own*! We do not accept stories that are AI-generated or heavily edited by AI. Only use tools like Grammarly to fix spelling and grammar issues.

Remember, as always, we are looking for the elements of *story*. These include: 

* Great first lines
* Good settings
* Well-developed characters
* Integration of action, dialogue and narrative
* A conflict that intrigues the reader
* A \

which results in the resolution of the conflict and brings the story to a satisfying conclusion
* And of course, we are looking for well-edited stories that are not littered with typos or grammatical errors — please use the free Grammarly tool for grammar and spelling checks (and not AI writing or rephrasing tools for revising)

You can find more on all of these topics in the [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well).

If you don't feel inspired by this prompt or the featured image, feel free to peruse any of our past prompts or our collection of idea-generators:
- [50 Loglines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-writing-prompts-50-story-loglines)
- [50 Story Ideas](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-fiction-prompt-6-50-story-ideas)
- [50 Imagination Ticklers](https://peakd.com/fiction/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-prompt-13-50-imagination-ticklers)


## Rules:
1. ***Accepted content***: Remember that we only accept short stories (fiction or creative nonfiction). We do not accept advice columns, personal development articles, reviews, chapter stories, recipes, etc. We also do not accept posts about violent, gory, bloody, brutal, sexist or racist themes, NSFW (not safe for work) stories like erotica, stories with a political or religious agenda, or stories featuring abuse of any kind. (We have a complete article about [The Ink Well stance on violence and brutality](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/violence-and-brutality-in-fiction-the-ink-wells-stance) for more information.) And do NOT use AI tools to write or manipulate your stories. You must provide *your own* unique content.
1. ***Post link***: Please be sure to publish your story in [The Ink Well](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created) community, and post a link to your story in a comment on this post.
1. ***Hashtags***: Use the #fiction tag for fictional stories and the #creativenonfiction tag for creative nonfiction stories. You can also use #writing, #inkwellprompt and #theinkwell.

1. ***Images***: Please only use images from license free and creative commons sites, like [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/), [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/) and [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/). You can also generate them with AI tools. Images you find on the Internet are copyright protected and cannot be used. Be sure to provide all image source links.

1. ***Length***: We request that story word counts are a maximum of 1,500 words in length and ideally 750-1000 words. This is *just a guideline*. Longer stories are okay too, but they tend to get fewer readers. Additionally, The Ink Well admins appreciate keeping to that maximum story length for our time management. (Note: We generally consider stories less than 750 words \
and they tend to be missing important character development. See the \

topic of our [September 2025 newsletter](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/september-2025-updates-and-monthly-fiction-contest-from-the-ink-well) for resources on how to improve and further develop your stories.) 1. ***Translations***: If you post a story that has been translated from another language, please include the English version first, followed by content in the original language. 1. ***Community support***: When you post in The Ink Well, please be sure to visit the work of at least two other community members and comment on their work. #### Past Prompts After 241 straight weeks of fiction prompts (and nearly as many creative nonfiction prompts) we have started a fresh new series! If you'd like to see the full list of previous fiction prompts, you can find them at the bottom of [fiction prompt #241](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-inkwell-fiction-prompt-241). Thank you for being a part of The Ink Well! @jayna, @gracielaacevedo, @agmoore and @yaziris. ![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)
#### Interested in joining our community? Start by joining Hive! **Join [here](https://hiveonboard.com/?ref=theinkwell) at Hive Onboard**
Already a Hive member? Click **Subscribe** at the top of [The Ink Well community home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created).
*
Questions? Ask The Ink Well on [Discord](https://discord.gg/Bng7mMsaQj).
* ![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)
We invite lovers of creative writing to visit [The Ink Well](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created), a Hive community started by @raj808 and @stormlight24 and run by @jayna, @gracielaacevedo, @agmoore and @yaziris

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 26 2026
title.body:
Hey Actifiters! Today sure was a busy day. The 3-day weekend compressed some work into my day and I am taking Friday off to go with flip on a field trip so that leaves me with a little more pressure to make sure I get everything done. I need to. Feels kind of like. I'm trying to fit a 5-day work weekend to 3 days, but made a lot of great progress today and I am just doing what I can to stay focused and get the work done. Weather yesterday evening and this week is odd. For this time of year. The temperature really dropped and we got a little rain last night and there's some more rain in the forecast for today. Noting how much cooler the day was going to be, I worked through my lunch and took a late lunch break to go for a walk around the duck ponds. Days that I don't run. I am trying to make sure I get some other form of activity. Over the weekends. That's pretty easy with yard work and other projects. But during the week if I don't do something intentional about it then then I could end up just sitting at my desk all day long. Something I'm trying to avoid. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/566f910f-f352-4b27-ac0f-7b3ba3c757a6.jpg) Anyways, even though it was cool and chilly, it was great to take a little break and get some fresh air and stretch my legs The geese were out in full force. Enjoying the cool weather as well. Was kind of fun to see all the babies growing up. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9f7a8b1d-902c-461f-aa38-82738a17e152.jpg) The evening brought flips last baseball game for the Little League season. And Eliza's second to last game of t-ball. It's been some extra work and I feel like I could have done some things better, but overall I've had a really fun season being her coach. It makes me realize that sometimes things in life just need people to show up. It's giving me some thought in my own life. What are some ways I need to show up in my life?

title.title: Calzado para la flor / Shoes for the flower
title.body:
<center>

En mi bolso negro,
traigo algo nuevo,
unos zapatos violetas y bellos,
es que los míos estaban viejos.

Los dejo en la sala,
sobre el piso, de forma ordenada,
los estrenaré mañana,
cuando a pasear salga. 

>In my black bag,
I’m carrying something new,
a pair of beautiful violet shoes,
because mine were worn out.

>I leave them in the living room,
neatly arranged on the floor,
I’ll wear them for the first time tomorrow,
when I go out for a walk.

![57188.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/243BsAi4nDkUGScLW5XS83Sp9mEjm2AhvHTqGgXL22B8TbvUijS66n2tsUtwRwzoxnq5S.gif)

En la sala tengo un girasol
y al salir, los zapatos miró,
llamaron su atención 
y de la matera se bajó.

Se midió los zapatos
y perfectamente le quedaron 
comenzó a dar algunos pasos
y cuando llegué, la vi andando.  

>I have a sunflower in the living room,
and as she was leaving, she noticed the shoes,
they caught her eye,
and she climbed down from the planter.

>She tried on the shoes,
and they fit her perfectly,
she began to take a few steps,
and when I arrived, I saw her walking.  

![57191.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xyg7BNe7DzttDYmGZxFY5bStWiVLKr9bk6sSEUztpe2SCYtMdAvGaWLcugyZnghvWJH.gif)

Muy elegante se ve la flor,
con los zapatos que compré yo
le ayudé a caminar mejor
y le dije que fuéramos a otra locación.

Salimos a caminar por la ciudad
y ella muy feliz va,
es una flor sin igual 
con un calzado bien original. 

>The flower looks so elegant,
in the shoes I bought for her,
I helped her walk better
and suggested we go somewhere else.

>We went for a walk around town,
and she’s walking along so happily,
she’s a flower like no other,
wearing such unique shoes.

title.title: Regain energy and manage time
title.body:
>

I've been a bit caught up in some emotional turmoil these past few days, and honestly, the whole situation has left me feeling pretty unstable. My routine is usually something I try to stick to even when I'm sad or tired, but this time it hit me harder than I expected. I hadn't exercised since Wednesday, and for someone who lives between the gym, a bit of running, and maybe boxing, trying to keep myself constantly active… it felt strange.

Today I finally managed to get back into it a little. I didn't do a full routine or an intense workout, just three upper-body exercises, but honestly, it was just what I needed to get going again. Sometimes you think that if you can't do it \

then it's not worth it, but even just slowly getting back into it counts. And although I'm still not feeling completely well emotionally, at least today I took a small step toward getting out of that state where I felt like I had no energy for anything.

> He estado un poco envuelta en líos emocionales estos días y, sinceramente, toda esa situación me ha mantenido bastante inestable. Mi rutina normalmente es algo que intento sostener incluso cuando estoy triste o cansada, pero esta vez sí me golpeó más de lo que esperaba. Desde el miércoles no había hecho ejercicio y para alguien que ya vive entre el gym, un poco de running y quizás boxeo, tratando de mantenerme siempre en movimiento… se sintió raro. Hoy finalmente pude retomar un poco. No hice una rutina completa ni un entrenamiento intenso, solo tres ejercicios de tren superior, pero honestamente era justo lo que necesitaba para volver a arrancar. A veces uno piensa que si no puede hacerlo “perfecto” entonces no vale la pena, pero incluso regresar de a pocos también cuenta. Y aunque todavía no me siento del todo bien emocionalmente, al menos hoy di un pequeño paso para salir de ese estado donde sentía que no tenía energía para nada.
![IMG_1272.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY5X12onJNmHLswYTDgDvtMyHNbr5ZNGNPf2hcAvNxs2o/IMG_1272.jpeg)

title.title: Quit Hive keh?
title.body: I have been on this platform for 4 years and even in the midst of the worst events, I have never thought of quitting. My reasons are not what a lot of people writing this prompt are saying; they are just different, real, unique, and never made up to entice people or follow the crowd.\n\n

_

I have a friend of mine on this platform who always gives me this question anytime I make a post about Hive on my WhatsApp status. She finds it so unbelievable to see that I'm still on Hive and she keeps wondering why I'm still here. This friend stopped a very long time ago, even before the price of Hive dropped to 0.2. In fact, she still gifts me her Ecency points once in a while.

I have a lot of people who come around and make it sound weird that I’m still blogging on Hive. They stopped a long time ago due to the dip that started affecting earnings from posts.

In all of this, I have never thought of following in their footsteps and opting out of the system. And that’s not going to happen anytime soon unless the system crashes completely.

I have never thought of quitting because the little cents I earn here are still very useful. Oh yeah, this is one of the reasons I’m not leaving anytime soon. I’m a big fan of little drops that make an ocean. The Hive I’m earning here now, if I succeed in keeping it until the price increases, is going to be a big flex. Just imagine a situation where Hive hits $1.

I also know that a lot of people who stopped writing here are still going to be richer than me due to the amount of Hive and HP they accumulated already, but I don’t care. It’s my own progress that interests me.

Before I left the other platforms I used to blog on, I found a new and better one, which is Hive. And that’s how my system works. I don’t just quit and remain idle; I like to hold on to something. So until a better option comes out, I’m not leaving here. Also, I’m not leaving as long as the cents are still dropping into my wallet, even if it’s on a very small scale.

A lost star in a tiny galaxy. Science fiction writers tried to convince us that galaxies can be tiny, and we saw this in the movie Men in Black, and you know, there's quite a bit of truth in that fantasy lol. Yes, and tiny galaxies must be home to equally tiny stars, and judging by the fact that few people ever see them, someone must have lost them, or perhaps thrown them away because they weren't needed, as in the case you see in this photograph. Macro photography involves photographing tiny objects from a close distance, as in my case, or using a macro lens, which I don't have. But I have a wide-angle lens on my camera, which allows me to take pseudo-macro photographs from close range. There's a complication here: the closer the object, the better it needs to be illuminated. But in the case of a tiny and rather dim galaxy, which was half the shell of a discarded zucchini, hardened and stiffened by the sun, and an equally dim star, which was the inner junction of the same zucchini's stem, it was perfectly illuminated. To add even more mystery to this galaxy, I decided to immerse it all in negative photography. So, for a brief moment, I was immersed in a previously unknown cosmos. ![1tyurtyPHOTO_20190228_085021.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTqwn74iLEhArFLkwk6fcoazt46zLLcJRu53tM9T4oKXf/1tyurtyPHOTO_20190228_085021.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.title: Зламана праця
title.body:
Сьогодні багато де можна зустріти якусь таку дику байдужість до чужої праці. Іноді це навіть викликає не просто обурення, а сльози. Адже ти стараєшся іноді не тільки для себе, а й для інших, для того щоб якось красиво було. І розумію, що багато хто одразу скоментує - не подобається щось, то не роби, хто тебе просить, зроби для себе, і охороняй.

Так, таких вумніків сьогодні достатньо, які палець об палець не вдарять, та ще й чуже не поважають. А коли квітка виросте, то перші в черзі стоять, щоб зірвати і до себе в хату потягти. Свинство. Та клумби клумбами, тут вдоволено-невдоволених завжди вистачає, усім не вгодиш, а ще коли ти мега незалежний в усьому, а тобі чи твоїм дітям вказують, як що робити та пальці віялом, волосся дибки і в напад. 

Нехай. Та свинство ще більше, коли оця скотина лізе в чужий город. Це вже не спільне, а моє, роблю собі як вони і самі ж сказали що хочу і те і охороняю. Чого лізеш, ламаєш і ше й де зламав там і кинув?  Ну просто слів немвє тій неповазі і байдужості. Що за культуоа сьогодні? А банально іти і привітатись з су,ідами?- ні , не чули не бачили. Рожа в телефоні чи ще десь там. Що діти, що батьки, чесне слово. Страшно з такими сусідами. Нє?))))

title.title: Lulubox Makes Mobile Gaming More Enjoyable for Everyday Players
title.body:
/>

Mobile gaming has become one of the biggest entertainment trends across the world. Millions of users spend hours playing action, racing, survival, and multiplayer games on their smartphones every day. As games become more advanced, players also search for tools that can improve their gaming sessions without making things complicated. This is where Lulubox has attracted the attention of mobile gamers.

Lulubox is not a game itself. It works as a supporting mobile application designed to help users manage plugins, unlock certain game skins, and improve the overall gaming experience. Instead of replacing games, the app supports games already installed on a device. Many players prefer using tools like this because they add convenience and customization options that standard game settings may not provide.

One reason behind the growing popularity of Lulubox is its simple design. Many gaming utility apps look confusing for beginners because they contain too many settings and technical options. [**Lulubox**](https://luluboxofficial.org/) focuses on keeping things organized and easy to understand. Even first-time users can navigate the app comfortably without needing advanced knowledge.

Another major attraction is the ability to access game skins and visual enhancements. Modern mobile games often lock cosmetic items behind expensive purchases. Not every gamer wants to spend real money just to change character appearances or weapon designs. Lulubox gives users an alternative way to enjoy stylish visuals and extra customization features without additional cost.

The app is also known for plugin support. Plugins are useful tools that help optimize gameplay for supported games. Some users install plugins to improve performance, while others prefer smoother controls or reduced lag during matches. This becomes especially useful for players using mid-range smartphones that may struggle with heavy graphics and demanding online gameplay.

Many gamers become frustrated when games lag during important moments. Delayed controls and slow performance can ruin the entire experience, especially in competitive multiplayer games. Lulubox helps reduce such problems by offering optimization support that can make gameplay feel smoother and more responsive.

Another positive aspect of the application is convenience. Instead of searching different websites or applications for gaming tools, players can manage several supported features in one place. This saves time and creates a cleaner gaming setup for users who regularly play mobile games.

Lulubox has also gained attention because it is beginner-friendly. Some gaming support apps require technical setup procedures that discourage casual users. Lulubox keeps things direct and accessible. Most functions are easy to locate, and the overall interface avoids unnecessary clutter.

Customization has become an important part of modern gaming culture. Players enjoy creating unique gaming experiences that match their personal style. Some focus on graphics, while others prefer unlocking special appearances or improving gameplay performance. Lulubox supports these preferences by offering flexible gaming support options inside a single application.

The lightweight nature of the app is another reason why many users appreciate it. Heavy applications can slow down smartphones and consume large amounts of storage. Lulubox is designed to remain practical and manageable for everyday mobile users. This makes it easier for gamers to install and use the app without affecting device performance significantly.

The popularity of mobile gaming continues increasing every year. Developers release new games regularly, each filled with advanced graphics and premium features. However, many users cannot afford in-game purchases or expensive devices. Because of this, support tools that help improve gaming experiences remain highly attractive among smartphone players.

Lulubox stands out because it combines multiple useful features into one platform. Instead of focusing on only one area, the app supports customization, plugin management, and smoother gameplay together. This balanced approach makes it useful for different types of gamers.

Many users also appreciate the clean visual layout of the application. Complicated menus often create frustration, especially for people who simply want quick access to gaming tools. Lulubox keeps the experience comfortable by maintaining a straightforward interface that avoids unnecessary distractions.

Gaming communities often discuss applications that help improve gameplay convenience. Players are constantly searching for methods to enhance their sessions while avoiding technical difficulties. Lulubox has become part of these discussions because it offers practical features without making the process difficult for users.

Another reason behind its growing recognition is accessibility. The app does not demand professional-level gaming knowledge. Casual players, students, and everyday smartphone users can understand the functions quickly. This broad appeal has helped Lulubox gain popularity among different age groups and gaming communities.

As mobile games continue evolving, users will likely keep looking for ways to improve graphics, unlock visual content, and enjoy smoother controls. Applications that support these needs will continue remaining relevant in the gaming world. Lulubox has already established itself as a popular option among users who want additional gaming flexibility without unnecessary complexity.

In conclusion, Lulubox has become a widely discussed mobile gaming support tool because it offers useful features in a simple and accessible format. From unlocking skins to improving gameplay performance and managing plugins, the application provides several benefits for mobile gamers. Its easy navigation, lightweight structure, and customization support make it appealing for both beginners and experienced players. As smartphone gaming continues expanding, tools like Lulubox will likely remain important for users seeking a more enjoyable and flexible gaming experience.
