title.title: [ENG/ESP] A Wednesday that slips by amid responsibilities and sweet treats.
title.body: > **Happy Wednesday, dear friends of this wonderful #wednesdaywalk community. Here I am again, just like every week, joining you with great joy to take part in the wonderful initiative of our dear @tattoodjay, which I enjoy so much and has become a special part of my weekly routine—something I always look forward to. It’s always a pleasure to share with you a little piece of my days, my walks, and those little moments that make life more beautiful. Today I want to tell you how my day began early this morning. My husband and I woke up intending to carry out our work routine, as we usually do. It was time to chlorinate and disinfect the main tank at the Sunsol Unik Hotel, a task that is now part of our daily routine, but one we always perform with responsibility and dedication. The weather, as has been the case lately in Margarita, was a bit strange at dawn. At times it looked like it was going to rain; the sky turned gray and then just changed, as if it were in a mood, but in the end what we were left with was intense heat—the kind that envelops and suffocates. That’s how this beautiful island is: capricious, warm, unpredictable, but above all, always very beautiful.**

> *Feliz miércoles, queridos amigos de esta bella comunidad de #wednesdaywalk. Aquí estoy nuevamente, como cada semana, acompañándolos con mucha alegría para participar en la hermosa iniciativa de nuestro querido @tattoodjay, que tanto disfruto y que se ha convertido en una parte especial de mis rutinas semanales, la cual espero con ansias. Siempre es un gusto compartir con ustedes un pedacito de mis días, mis recorridos y esos pequeños momentos que hacen la vida más bonita. Hoy quiero contarles cómo comenzó mi recorrido desde temprano en la mañana. Mi esposo y yo nos levantamos con la intención de cumplir con nuestra rutina de trabajo, como solemos hacerlo. Tocaba realizar la cloración y desinfección del tanque principal del Hotel Sunsol Unik, una tarea que ya forma parte de nuestro día a día, pero que siempre hacemos con responsabilidad y dedicación. El clima, como ha estado ocurriendo últimamente en Margarita, amaneció un poco extraño. De momentos parecía que iba a llover, el cielo se ponía gris y el después solo cambia, como si fuera de humor, pero al final lo que nos quedó fue un calor intenso, de ese que abraza y sofoca. Así es esta hermosa isla, caprichosa, cálida, impredecible, pero siempre sobre todas las cosas muy hermosa.*

> **We arrived at the hotel, our first stop of the day, and got right to work. We carried out the entire process calmly and meticulously, checking each parameter until it was set to the correct values. When we were done, everyone was very pleased with the work, and that satisfaction always motivates us to keep moving forward with a positive attitude.**

> *Llegamos al hotel, nuestra primera parada del día, y nos pusimos manos a la obra. Realizamos todo el proceso con calma y precisión, verificando cada parámetro hasta dejarlo en los valores correctos. Al finalizar, todos quedaron muy complacidos con el trabajo, y esa satisfacción siempre nos impulsa a seguir adelante con buen ánimo.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA1Z3WEHPmYjhvNJWZrY3jrcNiAULAYovFcxLhosufE1ngVA9uNypMzvtiQymBMJhq.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq369uviBaAVibEMVbgn85dFnSQP6qRSzCLDVfq6UD1AK2Bn9JrjepdwiUUNsQoTPu7.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFsWYp8ynKCxumr9nchcG3YRwUhfkumqQJDsvousj5m5yttzSs9RQjxcaXBoWn8ykH.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSUyrhxVDVu3HBny8rmX1Ka96Qjb7ozWjjfFgPa4Zgfz7BQ8VjjmmxEVLUf2DKy8fk.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJaVTN5AjtHJ52gJoSmZ8nP5Nbt4fCn7cRyV2u4T4RgR5YRQYJj4iuFfA9tRW6kJ69.jpg)

> **Then we moved on to the second task of the day: submitting a quote at the Parque Costa Azul Shopping Center. It was a quick, hassle-free process, and since we had a little free time left, we decided to treat ourselves. We bought a delicious ice cream cone at McDonald’s—which, in my opinion, is one of the creamiest and tastiest you can get at this mall. That little treat sweetened our day and gave us a little boost of energy to keep going.**

> *Luego pasamos a la segunda tarea del día: entregar un presupuesto en el Centro Comercial Parque Costa Azul. Fue un trámite rápido, sin complicaciones, y como nos quedó un pequeño instante libre, decidimos darnos un gustico. Nos compramos una deliciosa barquilla de helado en McDonald’s, que para mí son de las más cremosas y ricas que se pueden disfrutar, en este centro comercial.  Ese pequeño detalle endulzó nuestro día y nos dio un empujoncito de energía para continuar.*
![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHyUwpVreHHLtEthdUABtFSJYx7SVo4ASrSmvttjUdNKg6cQ1JAde5reKDxc84XTcX.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptZaUWkUfpBR4CfXJxXH6KktYSjdgigcsuwDR4DxnqjGADYa7QawewLAG9MFwjBJFs.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xyZaLqex23JJoHhDf6Y1nPgQZATXHNAsnSfFbA43fyyKLAxgPSBxiHrvGcw6qTeYCyN.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wCJTSfBUE3o2eb72vhucP6S7y2M4wa4LN9s7DU58j8tjn6mFBnj37oCBQaCfhr2C7zE.jpg)

> **With renewed energy, we set off for the day’s final task, which, though it was the last, was no less important. As we made our way, we took in the scenery the island always has to offer: mountains that look like they’ve been painted, a sky that shifts hues by the minute, and that breeze that sometimes blows in to remind us that we live in paradise.**

> *Con el ánimo renovado, seguimos camino hacia la última tarea del día, que aunque era la última, no por eso menos importante. Mientras avanzábamos, íbamos apreciando los paisajes que la isla siempre tiene para regalarnos; montañas que parecen pintadas, el cielo que cambia de tonos a cada minuto, y esa brisa que a veces se asoma para recordarnos que vivimos en un paraíso.*
![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Epvhrdt65ppF5D8auEGP9fRXWev8pLEqJFoVdtfysSsXjRKMnbd7eB6hocNyfik24fu.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7MrvVsFUcZyKUGjLc3NaLix3cifS643V8RFLS5aB1GL1teo2LX5GSa7fJaHs5ofje.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT2iSK8sXhgBFjkD3SRSztE4r2wwrcaVPQ8QwrcEp35RhUqzxLTkrSbu4QtHetjn42.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-34 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYskXN34VGubCPAayJczQPe5ysDNqbmjb2H5DkY9CkyoW2zuBmaDfjgdenLm3NQytX.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprS5nv6w3kuXi4NXdNCrcvRX82P5UXMAE56BRaSqFDjCCbWqPtaKimVWyLrRNA7HuG.jpg)

> **We arrived at the farm supply store where we bought organic feed for our birds. We always save this task for last because it’s on our way home, so we can make the most of the trip. With the feed in hand and the satisfaction of having completed everything on our to-do list, we set off for home in high spirits.**

> *Llegamos a la agropecuaria donde compramos los alimentos ecológicos para nuestras aves. Siempre dejamos esta tarea para el final porque nos queda de camino a casa, y así aprovechamos el recorrido. Con los alimentos en mano y la tranquilidad de haber cumplido con todo lo planificado, emprendimos el regreso a casa muy contentos.*
![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Epzyc5kA9mHxKLhbqQs17KVzTpDsZ3DZysgdMMepHWAQq7j99MjuzaYPSL4pKmHLUEp.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-27_00-10-21 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXKUvzG4mQtUgVDkaWknLTpmqfKKpDACBWjDL1Prt5LfnjjfaVN7Q5e2SpSioeXiPb.jpg)

> **That’s how our Wednesday went—filled with work, beautiful scenery, little pleasures, and the satisfaction of ending the day with everything in order. I hope you found this post enjoyable too, and that you enjoyed it as much as I did writing it. See you next Wednesday. Bye.**

> *Así transcurrió nuestro recorrido de miércoles, entre trabajo, paisajes, pequeños placeres y la satisfacción de cerrar el día con todo en orden. Espero que este paseo también haya sido agradable para ustedes y que lo hayan disfrutado tanto como yo al contarlo. Nos vemos el próximo miércoles.   Chao.*

title.title: A different day: Movies and Sushi [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

Greetings, dear friends in the community. How are you today? I’m feeling good, and I hope you are too. There are times when you need to break out of your routine, try new things, and do things you haven’t done in a long time; it’s a great way to disconnect from the stress of the past few days, and I’d say that’s exactly what it meant to me, so join me for a different kind of day filled with movies and sushi.

Saludos, queridos amigos de la comunidad. ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Yo me siento bien y espero que ustedes también lo estén. Hay ocasiones en que uno debe salir de la rutina y probar cosas nuevas y hacer otras cosas que quizás no has hecho en un largo tiempo; es una buena forma de tener una desconexión del estrés de los días anteriores y diría que esto fue lo que significó para mí, así que acompáñenme en un día distinto lleno de cine y sushi.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/24243wbrwoAMMm6amJwpihv7uVnwTLD53rfYp2f5ynBszUVZKBYTGZPjzSgyLzGPVLRPc.png

>

My girlfriend and I are trying to go on different dates whenever we can, and she had sushi at a place she really liked, so she wanted me to go with her. Since it was in a different part of town from where we live, it meant taking a little trip of about an hour, so I thought it was a good idea, especially since, given that she liked the sushi, it was something she’d want to do again.

Junto a mi novia, estamos intentando tener distintas citas siempre que se pueda, y ella comió sushi de un sitio que le gustó bastante, por lo que quería que yo fuese con ella y, al ser en un lugar distinto a donde vivimos, tocaba hacer un pequeño viaje de una hora y algo, así que me pareció una buena idea y más tomando en cuenta que, como a ella le gustó el sushi, sería un plan que le gustaría repetir.

>

To be perfectly honest, I had never tried sushi before that moment, and if I’m being completely honest, I didn’t like it that much, but I didn’t dislike it as much as I thought I would either. The thing is, the sushi had cream cheese, and I’m not a fan of any kind of cheese; that, let’s say, kind of ruined the sushi for me a bit, but without the cream cheese, I’d say I would have liked it more, without a doubt. Even so, it’s something I could eat again, as long as it doesn’t have cream cheese, but I really liked everything else, and the place is very nice, with excellent service and a great atmosphere for hanging out.

Siendo muy sincero, yo nunca había probado sushi hasta ese momento y, si les soy muy honesto, no me gustó tanto, pero tampoco me desagradó como pensé que sucedería. Pasa que el sushi tenía queso crema y yo no soy amante de ningún tipo de queso; eso, digamos que me dañó un poco el sushi, pero sin el queso crema diría que me hubiese gustado más, sin duda. Aun así, es algo que podría volver a comer, siempre y cuando no tenga queso crema, pero el resto de cosas me gustó bastante y el local es muy bonito, con una excelente atención y buen ambiente para pasar el rato.

>

Since we’d already made the trip, we couldn’t just leave without doing something else, so I suggested we go to the movies, she wanted to see the new Michael Jackson movie, so we took the opportunity to do just that. Honestly, it had been years since I’d been to the movies; I usually watch movies at home, it’s more comfortable, but since it was a movie my girlfriend wanted to see on the big screen, I couldn’t say no, and I have to say I really liked the movie. I’ve always loved learning about what a singer’s life was like before fame and stardom, and Michael Jackson was certainly no exception. You end up empathizing with him a lot more, and although I really like his music, let’s just say I’m not that big of a fan and I don’t know that much about him, but I really enjoyed learning a little more, and now we just have to wait for the second part; we’ll go see that one too.

Como ya habíamos hecho ese viaje, no nos podíamos solo ir sin hacer alguna otra cosa, por lo que le propuse ir al cine, ya que ella quería ver la nueva película de Michael Jackson, así que aprovechamos para hacerlo. Yo, honestamente, tenía muchos años desde que no iba al cine; normalmente veo las películas en mi casa, es más cómodo, pero al ser una película que mi novia quería ver en la gran pantalla, no podía negarme y debo decir que la película me gustó bastante. Siempre me ha encantado el poder conocer cómo es la vida del cantante antes de la fama y del estrellato y, sin duda, Michael Jackson no fue la excepción. Uno termina empatizando mucho más y, aunque me gusta mucho su música, digamos que no soy tan fanático ni sé tanto de él, pero realmente me gustó conocer un poco más y ya solo nos queda esperar por la segunda parte; iremos también.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGTYw8WPioqQCr9oYLknqDs2kVgnnJNveRXv5SnMN1pK5stU2U2v1oWUwsr1SHTh3Wx.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5ZhAwvVbTwXzWyq5sdXWCTfWaPFKYZ2BDgHRhzSgS9638e9kPmao5cE87MfxF7LqGx.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23ycydpNuNkQ9HaHU6iaePx2Fj1RbHoNXPxE6jKXTJW41DsMn3BXt4csmdLheHM7Xa938.jpg

>

Although it might seem like just two activities that don't take much time, they actually took us several hours; I’d say easily about 7 hours, and then we had to head back home, so we were already tired, but it really was a great date idea and I’d like to do it again, maybe not exactly the same thing, but definitely travel again and keep doing different things, since sometimes you end up getting bored of doing the same old things where you live.

Aunque pareciera que fuesen solo dos actividades que no llevan mucho tiempo, realmente se nos fueron varias horas; diría que perfectamente unas 7 horas, y luego debíamos regresar a donde vivimos, por lo que ya estábamos cansados, pero realmente fue una buena idea de cita y me gustaría repetirla, quizás no el hacer lo mismo, pero sí el viajar nuevamente y así seguir haciendo cosas distintas, ya que uno a veces se termina aburriendo de repetir las mismas cosas donde vive.

>

That's all for today. Thank you so much for reading; I hope you enjoyed what I wrote and some of the photos I took. I hope you all have a wonderful day. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy. Muchas gracias por leerme; espero que disfrutaran de lo que escribí y también de alguna de las fotografías que hice. Espero que todos tengan un estupendo día. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

/>

\n

title.title: Healthy egg recipes/Recetas saludables con huevo(EN/EG)
title.body:
![51c57bcd-9cf2-4e45-a38a-bfebcc982c6a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvjw15UEsdFHY3stM4oURQB4znYsVrKPXuAEkT4N98j4/51c57bcd-9cf2-4e45-a38a-bfebcc982c6a.jpg)



Friends, today I have come to you with a very healthy recipe. I hope you are all well, and by the grace of Allah, you are doing very well. We all know that eggs are superfoods, and this food has been introduced as our superfood. However, we can make different types of recipes with eggs. Today I will present to you a very simple recipe.

Eggs
potatoes
 onion
 green pepper
salt
bay leaves
 turmeric powder
dried chili powder
cumin powder
oil
roasted cumin seeds

To prepare this simple recipe today, we will need several ingredients, but it is still very easy; you must be waiting to know how. Your wait is over. Let's start here. First, I will put a pan on the stove, then I will add chopped onion and a bay leaf. When it is hot for a while, I will add oil there and fry the onions continuously until they turn brown.

![e6b8b207-e5ad-434a-91db-919440dc59d4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUmJN1Huien323HPjdks37VFBpevACbEsMXaJgpj7bbGL/e6b8b207-e5ad-434a-91db-919440dc59d4.jpg)

![a4e41426-e220-4383-b5c9-440236b09b2c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQZ1FVJaKvmqPaxBMqWQtkKvqgY1zcXY42yiP966r626s/a4e41426-e220-4383-b5c9-440236b09b2c.jpg)

![54436135-38d6-4629-a397-aea356e886e5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQdS7914AePt5J6UpqcywCkRKnUJBxKD61i8uRSRQv2w2/54436135-38d6-4629-a397-aea356e886e5.jpg)

The latter stage will depend on the frying of the onion. Once the onion is fried, I will add a little water immediately. But here I have prepared everything, like all the spices, ginger, and garlic paste. But I will add everything after that. But again, you have to take five minutes to cook it because the better it is cooked, the more the taste of the cooking will increase.

![c2cb66be-f7ab-4d67-b991-a8b22b0f1f31.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwy2cA6fYz8nGqMPHXn2tH5KyeJkYCUsSzdaDdKWfqsA/c2cb66be-f7ab-4d67-b991-a8b22b0f1f31.jpg)

![2b7f9bb6-481f-4384-927f-a92480a237fa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUR3rugKumk6D498dZCX8qwAM1vSqBwZXYw8q9EorGSpr/2b7f9bb6-481f-4384-927f-a92480a237fa.jpg)

Anyway, for the next step, once my spices are ground, I'll add the boiled potatoes my  has and mix everything well. Let's cook it again for about ten minutes, and in the meantime, the heat on the stove must be low.

![81863bfe-f528-4db4-a8f3-d0e77dd5f700.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR51UonDfgdYrHKktFEj5c51wqJ52HjWQVArAXonQifb4/81863bfe-f528-4db4-a8f3-d0e77dd5f700.jpg)

![95a9fa82-61db-4945-bbd2-7a29d8db2280.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQwNy2YhfY96VzXn4RF2xKLZi7LFrsbjdYQhCRTk6yyfE/95a9fa82-61db-4945-bbd2-7a29d8db2280.jpg)

![afffa888-a904-41fd-81b7-7343e86c4b72.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBAgfJM11jzrnm7LxWYnZ8K9vVY7G4xh35SkfvYJHi97/afffa888-a904-41fd-81b7-7343e86c4b72.jpg)

Next, we need to measure the eggs, so I put four eggs in a bowl here, add salt there, and in the meantime, I will add chopped onion and green chilies and mix everything well.

![1ecbeef3-8bc8-42b6-886d-fb5bd5105783.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcVQhMVkFGRh9rdZiwUMydy3Twtqa33JsFeu681ccge2d/1ecbeef3-8bc8-42b6-886d-fb5bd5105783.jpg)


![2b70bd81-196b-4d13-bf08-9bf779ed9d8d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7xwYKtpCJ6ytQRGAJcCVnXaoqeJxKfpiuLv3HCzembT/2b70bd81-196b-4d13-bf08-9bf779ed9d8d.jpg)

![fc7202f6-a44e-49c9-a153-58dd52f9b891.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQt79PQx7YfU28ScpTZG3trJwdcZEteE39m8wc6bNqwGJ/fc7202f6-a44e-49c9-a153-58dd52f9b891.jpg)

This is not the end. Then from here I will go to the stove, put a frying pan there, and add oil. As soon as the oil is hot, I will add the egg that I have prepared here. Of course, I will fry the egg well, and if it seems big, I will cut it into pieces and cook it several times in the potatoes I have cooked. I will add the egg.

![58d8a56b-bcc9-4cd9-85b8-5a7d6359c340.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQu78w6odcucFWxyPoVCYJF1xkuDtVkrN57CGBjzSFax3/58d8a56b-bcc9-4cd9-85b8-5a7d6359c340.jpg)

![07db771e-d99f-469c-a850-5b5979fc2b31.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ5zhVbjBu6ByMLmaggE9JiMvbiX2DQJsbJkJ9DgekoY6/07db771e-d99f-469c-a850-5b5979fc2b31.jpg)

![6642d1c8-70b9-4965-bb73-8a8f993c784d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRCWDNapknvM3EN8tukzyg5cAD6M7Xvd2tSmFFbvrM1aA/6642d1c8-70b9-4965-bb73-8a8f993c784d.jpg)


![03fd4e26-57f9-4cc7-9522-04d6769e8fcd.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWYoaSDUsGgKHoCydSSPUGDNUp26DsTaWvQjEoQcrCpE4/03fd4e26-57f9-4cc7-9522-04d6769e8fcd.jpg)

![d1f28464-b820-4f7b-8e19-6ee551285e64.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeAoAWaLbsddjN68eBRpxEAbHUaJmc8Cg8zDQbStJBxX2/d1f28464-b820-4f7b-8e19-6ee551285e64.jpg)


![7334da0f-632a-408c-8512-463dfb2de2dd.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSWLWeAVCRmtf4zipv8a1ANiJi6Ny6SPmzgXavTaKUK9g/7334da0f-632a-408c-8512-463dfb2de2dd.jpg)

![fe8a2540-c730-4c3b-8d6b-e903bd10daf5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQL1FyLmxNZ2e2UnuJAibnwjY6UXQbjydMB26fBNmDnGh/fe8a2540-c730-4c3b-8d6b-e903bd10daf5.jpg)

![3e7ab71a-cd94-4941-84fe-7cc9704cd561.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYWVeoM5ge4szQq8s8168tS1ajs7b5cz6kr7VbAfVwzpa/3e7ab71a-cd94-4941-84fe-7cc9704cd561.jpg)

![ab5bb7b8-b62e-4526-a713-d415494e9c48.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQdm67vqiRLHqUzXAbzAtM19ZLhpZwwuT4mXj4UyxSvCb/ab5bb7b8-b62e-4526-a713-d415494e9c48.jpg)

Then I will cook it for a while, but then there will be no need to cook it much because my eggs are already taken here, frying . Then I will add enough water, add salt, add cumin seeds, and for the final cooking, I will wait for 10 minutes again. By then, the cooking will be complete, and immediately take it out in a bowl and prepare it for serving. Eat it with hot rice, but it is quite tasty. You can try it once. I am saying goodbye today. May Allah Hafez.

j4/51c57bcd-9cf2-4e45-a38a-bfebcc982c6a.jpg)

Amigos, hoy les traigo una receta muy saludable. Espero que estén todos bien y, por la gracia de Dios, que se encuentren muy bien. Todos sabemos que los huevos son un superalimento, y este alimento se ha popularizado como tal. Sin embargo, podemos preparar diferentes tipos de recetas con huevos. Hoy les presentaré una receta muy sencilla.

Huevos
Papas
Cebolla
Pimiento verde
Sal
Hojas de laurel
Cúrcuma en polvo
Chile seco en polvo
Comino en polvo
Aceite
Semillas de comino tostadas

Para preparar esta sencilla receta, necesitaremos algunos ingredientes, pero es muy fácil; seguro que están ansiosos por saber cómo. ¡Su espera ha terminado! Empecemos. Primero, pondré una sartén en la estufa, luego agregaré la cebolla picada y una hoja de laurel. Cuando haga calor, añadiré aceite y freiré las cebollas continuamente hasta que se doren.

![e6b8b207-e5ad-434a-91db-919440dc59d4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUmJN1Huien323HPjdks37VFBpevACbEsMXaJgpj7bbGL/e6b8b207-e5ad-434a-91db-919440dc59d4.jpg)

![a4e41426-e220-4383-b5c9-440236b09b2c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQZ1FVJaKv mqPaxBMqWQtkKvqgY1zcXY42yiP966r626s/a4e41426-e220-4383-b5c9-440236b09b2c.jpg)

![54436135-38d6-4629-a397-aea356e886e5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQdS7914AePt5J6UpqcywCkRKnUJBxKD61i8uRSRQv2w2/54436135-38d6-4629-a397-aea356e886e5.jpg)

La última etapa dependerá de la fritura de la cebolla. Una vez frita, añadiré un poco de agua inmediatamente. Pero aquí ya tengo todo preparado: todas las especias, el jengibre y la pasta de ajo. Después añadiré todo lo demás. Recuerda que hay que cocinarlo durante cinco minutos, porque cuanto mejor se cocine, más intenso será el sabor.

![c2cb66be-f7ab-4d67-b991-a8b22b0f1f31.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwy2cA6fYz8nGqMPHXn2tH5KyeJkYCUsSzdaDdKWfqsA/c2cb66be-f7ab-4d67-b991-a8b22b0f1f31.jpg)

![2 b7f9bb6-481f-4384-927f-a92480a237fa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUR3rugKumk6D498dZCX8qwAM1vSqBwZXYw8q9EorGSpr/2b7f9bb6-481f-4384-927f-a92480a237fa.jpg)

Bueno, para el siguiente paso, una vez molidas las especias, añadiré las patatas cocidas y mezclaré todo bien. Lo cocinaré durante unos diez minutos más, manteniendo el fuego bajo.

![81863bfe-f528-4db4-a8f3-d0e77dd5f700.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR51UonDfgdYrHKktFEj5c51wqJ52HjWQVArAXonQifb4/81863bfe-f528-4db4-a8f3-d0e77dd5f700.jpg)

![95a9fa82-61db-4945-bbd2-7a29d8db2280.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQwNy2YhfY9 6VzXn4RF2xKLZi7LFrsbjdYQhCRTk6yyfE/95a9fa82-61db-4945-bbd2-7a29d8db2280.jpg)

![afffa888-a904-41fd-81b7-7343e86c4b72.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBAgfJM11jzrnm7LxWYnZ8K9vVY7G4xh35SkfvYJHi97/afffa888-a904-41fd-81b7-7343e86c4b72.jpg)

A continuación, necesitamos medir los huevos. Pongo cuatro huevos en un bol, añado sal y, mientras tanto, agrego cebolla picada y chiles verdes. Mezcla todo bien. ![1ecbeef3-8bc8-42b6-886d-fb5bd5105783.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcVQhMVkFGRh9rdZiwUMydy3Twtqa33JsFeu681ccge2d/1ecbeef3-8bc8-42b6-886d-fb5bd5105783.jpg)

![2b70bd81-196b-4d13-bf08-9bf779ed9d8d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7xwYKtpC) J6ytQRGAJcCVnXaoqeJxKfpiuLv3HCzembT/2b70bd81-196b-4d13-bf08-9bf779ed9d8d.jpg)

![fc7202f6-a44e-49c9-a153-58dd52f9b891.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQt79PQx7YfU28ScpTZG3trJwdcZEteE39m8wc6bNqwGJ/fc7202f6-a44e-49c9-a153-58dd52f9b891.jpg)

Esto no termina aquí. Luego, iré a la estufa, pondré una sartén y añadiré aceite. En cuanto el aceite esté caliente, agregaré el huevo que preparé. Claro, freiré bien el huevo, y si parece grande, lo cortaré en trozos y lo cocinaré varias veces con las patatas que ya cociné. Luego le añadiré el huevo.

![58d8a56b-bcc9-4cd9-85b8-5a7d6359c340.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQu78w6odcucFWxyPoVCYJF1xkuDtVkrN57CGBjzSFax3/58d8a56b-bcc9-4cd9-85b8-5a7d6359c340.jpg)

title.title: Bikes for Cambodian Kids: 26 Bikes Built on Pure Grit
title.body: I've watched a lot of good intentions die in Cambodia. Someone shows up wanting to help, hits one hard \

the fundraising stalls, and the idea quietly gets shelved next to all the other half-finished plans expats carry around. So when I tell you that 26 bikes for Cambodian kids rolled out of a school courtyard in Siem Reap last week, understand that the bikes aren't really the story. The story is the woman who refused to let the idea die for two and a half months while everything tried to talk her out of it.


Her name — for this article — is Lisa. If you read <a href=\

>her story here on Roaming Sparrow, you already know the broad strokes: European, early sixties, came to Cambodia after her old life came apart, and ended up putting down roots in Siem Reap instead of passing through like most people do. What that piece didn't cover is what she actually does with her days. A lot of it goes to kids who have almost nothing, and these bikes were her latest stubborn idea. This one's about follow-through. About what it takes to get an idea across the finish line when the finish line keeps moving. ![20260526_094434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23xp4B3XLWgeWfticw5uCo8gxxYrw6tY1EDmNqKWYUXjFQE8hPXJtJcJGKYvp1iN9FA4o.jpg)

The Woman Behind the Bikes for Cambodian Kids

Lisa volunteers with

>ABCs and Rice, a Siem Reap NGO that's been feeding and educating local kids for sixteen years. I wrote about the school after stumbling into one of their fundraisers. The short version: they tie school attendance to monthly rice rations for families, which keeps kids in class instead of out working. It's a simple, practical fix to the real reason a lot of Cambodian children drop out — their families need them earning, not studying. Lisa found her way there not long after she landed in Cambodia, and the kids became the reason she gets up before dawn. She's told me as much, and you can hear it when she talks about them. Whatever she went through to get here — and it was a lot — these kids are where her energy goes now. She's tried a dozen ways to turn that energy into money for them. She's sold her own small-batch yogurt. She's run raffles. She's worked auctions and community events, leaning on the same crowd of expats and long-termers over and over. None of it is glamorous. Fundraising in a town this size means asking the same hundred people for money until they either give or start avoiding you at the bar. She's honest about how tiring it gets, and she's honest about the cynical side of charity work too — the people more interested in their cut than the cause. She's seen it. It hasn't stopped her. Then she landed on the bikes. Check out the YouTube Video here https://youtube.com/shorts/cUNd_GhD9qo?feature=share

Months of Fundraising and One Stubborn Idea

The idea was simple, which is usually the sign of a good one. A lot of the kids at the school live too far to walk comfortably, and getting to class is half the battle when your family already needs you doing something more useful than studying. Hand a kid a bike and you've handed them a way to show up — reliably, on their own schedule, without depending on anyone for a ride. It's the same logic the school already runs on: find the practical thing standing between a kid and an education, then remove it. Simple to say. Not simple to fund. I've known Lisa about four months now, and she'd been grinding on this bike project for roughly two and a half of them. That's a long time to chase a goal with no guarantee it lands. She hit the usual walls — donations trickling in slower than she needed, the math never quite working, the quiet voice that tells you to just scale it back or quit. She talked to me about those hard stretches more than once. What stuck with me wasn't that it was hard. Everything worth doing here is hard. It was that she never once put quitting on the table. I threw some money in myself at one point, so I've got a small stake in how this turned out. So did a lot of other people — twenty here, fifty there, the slow accumulation that fundraising actually looks like when there's no big check on the way. ![20260526_094019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23wCEDiQJFDQVVkUZMysgFSdKT1y4131ZVT53X2tHyaR3EAEBYHMq9ckqS34GDCVwU7Mn.jpg)

Two Benefactors and Over $1,000

The break came from two men I'll call Mr. M and Mr. O. Mr. O I never met — I'm told he's based in Singapore — but he put money in. Mr. M is here in Siem Reap, and he's the one who showed up when it counted. Between the two of them, they donated over $1,000. After months of scraping together small bills, a thousand dollars landing at once is the thing that turns an idea into a plan with a date on it. That's the part people miss about this kind of work. The grind isn't glamorous and it rarely gets you to the goal on its own. But the grind is what's running when the right person finally walks in the door. Lisa had spent two and a half months making this real enough, public enough, and credible enough that when Mr. M and Mr. O decided to help, there was something concrete and ready to fund. You don't get the benefactor without the months that come first. The two are connected, even though only one of them looks like the story.

Inside Osaka Bike Shop

Last Tuesday, Mr. M, Lisa, and I went to buy the bikes, a student from the school along with us. The shop is

>Osaka Bike Shop — ហ៊ាងលក់កង់អូសាកា — and we got there on the kind of Siem Reap afternoon that has you sweating through your shirt before you're even off the tuk-tuk. Mr. M and Lisa were already out front when I rolled up. We walked in together, started looking over what was on the floor, and one of the owners waved us into the back. The back was the real story. A warehouse space stacked with a mountain of used bikes — every size, every style, frames piled on frames, the raw inventory of a business that runs entirely on secondhand machines. That's where you actually shop for bikes in Cambodia. Not the tidy showroom out front. The pile in the back. We worked through sizing with the owners and settled on mid-size and large frames to fit the students. Lisa handled the negotiating, and she's good at it — she got the price down to around $45 or $46 per bike. We put a deposit down to hold the order, agreed the bikes would be cleaned up and road-ready, and set delivery for one week out: the following Tuesday, dropped straight at the school. ![20260519_105458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23vi3x9wPS6eL6jdTEz4SjMH66ZPFB2Ymmudwsq2ZTjpDafmysjMZzkCyHEhBp1oLhB5r.jpg)

Why Cambodia Runs on Used Japanese Bikes

Worth a word on the bikes themselves, because once you notice them you'll see them everywhere here. What Lisa bought are what Japan calls mamachari — the everyday step-through city bike. Front basket, rear rack, a dynamo light that runs off the wheel, often a built-in frame lock. Nothing fancy. Built to haul groceries, kids, and whatever else daily life throws at them. They flood Cambodia for a straightforward reason. Japan churns through these bikes and offloads the used ones constantly, and they get shipped out by the container to markets across Asia. Cambodia's bicycle imports come chiefly from Japan, China, and Taiwan, and shops like Osaka buy them in bulk, recondition them, and resell them for around fifty bucks a piece. The bikes that arrived for the kids proved the point: used, but with new tires, clean seats, working lights, front and rear baskets, and a few even had wheel locks. For a school buying in quantity, a reconditioned Japanese city bike is the sweet spot — cheap, sturdy, comfortable, and easy to find parts for. You can read more about

>the mamachari and Cambodia's secondhand bike trade if you want to go down that rabbit hole.

Handover Day: 26 Bikes for Cambodian Kids

The following Tuesday I got to the school around 9:30, and the kids were already on it. The 26 bikes were lined up out in the courtyard, and the students were circling them, sizing them up, picking favorites with their eyes before anyone said they could touch a thing. The director ran it clean. \

she said, and the girls went and claimed their bikes — a quick scramble, a lot of pointing, the serious business of picking exactly the right one. Then the boys got the call and went for theirs. We pulled everyone together for a big group photo — 26 kids and their new bikes — and the grins in that shot are the entire point of the exercise. Then they rode off. I mean that literally. I walked back out to the courtyard a little later and there was nobody there. No kids, no bikes. They'd taken them home, which is exactly what's supposed to happen. You don't give a kid a bike so it can sit in a courtyard looking nice. I don't know the long-term fate of all 26. Maybe some get ridden to school every day for years. Maybe a few get wrecked doing wheelies, because kids are kids. Maybe a family in a tight spot sells one for food money — and honestly, if that's the call a parent has to make, that's their call to make. The bike did its job the moment it gave them the option. ![20260526_093926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23u65PyUpL8gNnA5u9ytNs3Zi4baXGZ3oSFccdaS2d6Fuj8kWXM4B7jzpcHded2AL45KA.jpg)

The Harder Question About Giving

On the tuk-tuk ride back, Lisa said something that's stuck with me, and it belongs in here even though it complicates the feel-good version. Foreigners, she said, have to be careful about giving kids gifts. Do it enough and kids start associating Westerners with handouts — every foreigner becomes a walking present instead of a person, and that quietly teaches the wrong lesson. The goal is kids who work toward their own better path, not kids trained to wait for the next generous stranger to roll through. She's right, and it's the kind of thing the cheerful charity posts never touch. When you come from a place of relative abundance and you want to help, it's genuinely possible to help in a way that hurts — to create dependency while feeling good about yourself. I don't have a clean answer for it, and neither did she. It's a real tension anyone doing this work honestly has to sit with. What I'll say is that these bikes were tied to a school the kids already show up for and earn their place in — not handed out cold on a street corner — and that's about the best version of giving I can point to. But the question doesn't disappear, and I'd rather name it than pretend it isn't there. That's a longer conversation for another article.

Why 26 Bikes for Cambodian Kids Is Really About Dedication

Strip away the logistics and this was never about bikes. It was about deciding to do a thing and then not stopping until it was done. That's what I keep coming back to. Lisa had every reasonable excuse to let this one go — the slow money, the hard weeks, the easier path of just running the next raffle and calling it enough. She didn't. She kept the idea alive long enough for the right people to find it, and 26 kids got bikes because one person refused to quit on an idea for two and a half months straight. I think most of what actually gets done in this world runs on exactly that. Not talent, not luck. Just somebody who won't put the thing down. And she's already onto the next one. Her goal now is to raise $3,000 to put fresh fruit into the kids' school lunches for a full year. Fruit for a year isn't a flashy headline. It won't make anyone cry at a gala. But it's the kind of small, steady, genuinely needed thing that adds up over time — and after watching these bikes for Cambodian kids come together against the odds, I'd put money on her getting it done. If you've ever talked yourself out of something because the road looked too long, let these 26 bikes be the nudge. What's the idea you've been sitting on? Drop it in the comments — I'd genuinely like to know what you're still chasing.
This article was reviewed by ABCs and Rice ahead of publication, and all photos are used with the school's permission. If you'd like to support their work, you can donate directly at
>abcrice.org. For more on getting around the Kingdom, see our

>Cambodia travel guide. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/EoyQTwgZgE9jtUm1ERNfq58zDpfXWH3rbL1oNXbQNLRfJ1QW1BKdyyguA8z2Cadu6w5.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 13.363108 lat 103.856470 long Buying bikes for Cambodian kids took one woman months of stubborn fundraising. d3scr)

title.title: Coming back from the island vacation
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e2c29e08-eddd-4d4f-9d7e-8856ada90311.jpg) Today was our last day on the island, I was finishing up all the stuff that needed to be done around the property and loading and unloading our car also resulted in some major steps for me. When we are on the island it is really nice, I feel really relaxed and even sleep deeper and longer. Island life is really relaxing, I can see why they say island time. It is really hard to work on the island. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ded71505-c02e-4827-b922-5031e42dbfa1.jpg) On the way back we stopped by the beach and saw this blue heron. The smell of the ocean, the sun and gentle waves were really nice. We missed our ferry just by a few minutes so we were a second car in line, so we got a spot right in the very front of the ferry. It was an interesting experience, we saw the ferry dock in Mukulteo in a way we never saw before. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/020b7fae-26da-4f10-9b6c-6785dd28f354.jpg) While we waited for half an hour for our ferry we had a man approach our car and he was collecting signatures for repeal of the new ten percent income tax. Right now it applies to high income earners only, but I have several problems with the new income tax. First it sets a precedent for income taxes in Washington and second what is now high income is going to be common income in a few years. That's just how inflation works. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5256317d-c89b-4000-9b16-441c8e7b358e.jpg) Another issue is that Washington state traditionally relied on high property taxes that are raised every year based on annual appraisal. It is not like California where you pay property taxes based on your purchase price for the house. Another issue is that on top of high property taxes we have high gas taxes and high sales taxes that are around eleven percent we now will have state income tax, that is just too much and could lead to business exodus out of our state. So we signed the petition. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f4896fa0-b9a5-4c31-8f49-0edb659fc915.jpg) Coming back from the island feels like coming back from vacation. Tomorrow I took a day off to go to my endodontics appointment. So I will not be going back to the office tomorrow. Instead I will find out if I have to redo a root canal or if I have a second set of wisdom teeth coming up. Apparently there is such a thing as second set of wisdom teeth. Around one percent of people have those... I will also use my time off to drive our daughter to school and shopping at Costco as well as a few other errands that need to be done. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/56635846-8417-449d-a62f-c2daf133f323.jpg) Coming back from our vacation I am also trying to get my mind around what is happening with Iran. It seems that we are in a short cease fire that has kind of held for about a month. There is talk of a deal, but question is if it is going to done soon or if it is going to drag on for months, perhaps even past midterms. It seems that the oil stockpiles are going to be depleted and prices are going to stay high or even go higher... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/686c797b-8181-4239-8cb0-ffc6e8e92870.jpg)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@seattlea/actifit-seattlea-20260527t050735970z)_

title.title: Where The Wild Flowers Grow
title.body:
I came across clusters of red campion flowers while on a hike in the woods. The flowers are native to Europe but introduced to the Americas, where they took root. I read that you rarely see them in the wild, so I was a little mystified about why there were so many everywhere. 

<center>![wild pink flower09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoiVDpXwLvB4pvzyRZZzx7vHCZqq9FoEQKePi37No3NQcrX7RdFkaSCKBcVKFAaBw4q.jpg)</center>

The whole trail was awash in colour with buttercups adding brilliant  splashes of yellow to the scene.

<center>![wild pink flower08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpGQBdq58FfYWVRGtKdT59DiPbVQp7HV25nReKviyPrMNhBYMrziFqKLL4mza8hzFD2.jpg)</center>

<center>![SP Trail Flowers 01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep7thew9iPUAwwcqbTjNanA758DqaxuQeYVVxFvZX1RM9LHpU2VFyUzyHgo7rDcHSZr.jpg)</center>

They are a biennial wildflower that thrives on woodland edges where it's nice and shady, but more often than not, they are found on gardens.

<center>![wild pink flower01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EogMNPqGZrYkXmMvD7YEyaKpqG8FnPbatxV6sm7c9oxYgjfpPcY9CQhv9sK6g3zLBDA.jpg)</center>

<center>![wild pink flower05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoEp3jA7JZS8jA7kpnvcxeKkCXqB2KE3SNa3iQ3yYPdFPQJssyFEBQ3ZEgUdtfjQoqh.jpg)</center>

The flowers are edible with medicinal properties, though this sounds more like folklore than science.

<center>![wild pink flower02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoCgAF6Njd4TwACJQa85eHDpUC6WwF38g7gjKs3CHzkq1fnB1d7orVsBGxRrLF1sXwb.jpg)</center>

<center>![wild pink flower07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EowG2ZUGCxkhQu1neFhsxuzRoLP4deRwBnAirBj1x9bE6cPpt3Gww6v3eMBs8mvgej7.jpg)</center>

It is known as the \

on the Isle of Man, where it is said to be a guardian of honey, among other legends. 

<center>![wild pink flower06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EogMRA98eDpNKZxJQCfY5Puz2q2c9aTL1zKXrDsG5cK2J6rTZJAMbUuyq71P9xsSbzR.jpg)</center>

I'm still wondering about these mystery flowers. There were so many of them in full bloom. What a spectacle!

<center>![wild pink flower04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoeDzmEXVkQ75YqttnTuZifeFzF6v3AVfa6dG8GsyPs41THbN7dbMHdLDUKhQpo5Pjg.jpg)</center>

<center>**My Transactions**</center>

 - 74300.39379507 CENT + 168.250 TRIBE
This was the headline move—stacking CENT hard while pairing it with TRIBE for that community-token energy and steady ecosystem exposure.
 - 55.76170886 CENT + 0.060589 LBI
A small add, but I like these “micro-top-ups” for keeping niche positions alive without overcommitting.
 - 1.41763434 SWAP.HBD + 18257.07221214 CENT

<center>**Pie Graph of Transactions**</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holovision.cash/23qrQUzQyzhhiPRv8ApaeApNscbMFz4o4JZTbXcoUBQG3mSv2NBG3C2C3DBZTXehcsPg3.png) Image Source: ChatGPT</center> <center>**My Thoughts / Reflections**</center>

What stands out today is the sheer concentration:

CENT was the entire story — the raw amounts make it obvious I was prioritizing depth in CENT-related pools over spreading out.
The “extras” were deliberate — TRIBE and BEED got paired with big CENT adds, while LBI was more of a tiny maintenance sprinkle.
I still kept the infrastructure pieces healthy — SWAP.HIVE : SWAP.BTC and the SWAP.HBD : CENT add both feel like keeping the plumbing strong while I scale the main position.

title.title: Pork Chops with Pumpkin and Bulgur\\Schweinekoteletts mit Kürbis und Bulgur
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll be cooking meat in mayonnaise in a frying pan. Besides the meat (in my case, it was a piece of pork chop), the dish also includes pumpkin, onions, and mayonnaise. Bulgur with raisins is used as a garnish. The meat is tender and cuts easily with a fork; no knife required. Let's  go, it's going to be meaty!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUwb8AeNJSWcFZpuCryFVFPBRZBykK36aKTP59yLsZ8TP/1.jpg)




Ingredients:
● Pork chop - 400g
● Onion - 2 pcs
● Pumpkin - 600g (5 wedges of butternut squash)
● Mayonnaise - 1/3 cup
● Bulgur - 1 cup (water - 2 cups)
● Raisins - 1/2 cup
● Butter - 30g
● Vegetable oil for frying, green onions, salt, sugar, cumin, spices, black pepper - to taste

1.Cut the pork chop into finger-thick pieces. Using a meat mallet, lightly pound the chop, but be careful not to splatter the sides. Choose a number of pieces of meat that cover the bottom of the pan in a single layer, overlapping if desired. Now coat the meat with mayonnaise and refrigerate for 1 hour.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQEJAKNJrs8TBp2QYNe4LqZ5QLFSs65hgStYxsS7Nsbdw/2.jpg)


2.Heat a frying pan and add a little vegetable oil for frying. Place the mayonnaise-covered meat pieces on the bottom. Sprinkle the meat with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Cut the onion into half rings and place them on top of the mayonnaise-covered meat. Sprinkle the onion with cumin or, for example, khmeli-suneli.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2mY68KniJA1XZZgwV9QNxz6AHrDNhwwTds6px8fkRME/3.jpg)


3.Cut the long, seedless part of the pumpkin into wedges. Cut the wedges in half and place them on top of the onions. Don't remove the skin; it will stew and be perfectly edible. Sprinkle the pumpkin with cumin and cover the pan with a lid. Reduce the heat and simmer for 60 minutes.



![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNkQrGEegW77zUMuXW54hbmkr5N68UR1erTvutMeL11m9/4.jpg)


4.During this time, all the ingredients will be thoroughly simmered, and the pumpkin will become very soft. We need to quickly cook the bulgur. Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the bulgur, stir, and fry for a couple of minutes. Pour in two cups of boiling water and add a pinch of salt and pepper. Cover the saucepan with the bulgur and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. This will allow all the water to evaporate and be absorbed by the bulgur, and the bulgur will cook thoroughly. Add a little butter to the bulgur and stir.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWRbQRQgQDywdSXYvm2N61wN35oh73D6C1N36wfZGfgix/5.jpg)


5.Transfer the bulgur to a plate using an upside-down cup. Place the pumpkin chunks and pork chop in mayonnaise and onion sauce next to it. You can serve ketchup with this dish. A very good combination! Delicious and very tender meat! The pork chop won't be so dry anymore.



![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbBMewfRWZoQuQNBJhcHpBSVDjAMqLDnFzgTYxoWH1yUS/9.jpg)


Shall we cook it?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute braten wir Fleisch in Mayonnaise in der Pfanne. Neben dem Fleisch (in meinem Fall ein Schweinekotelett) gehören Kürbis, Zwiebeln und Mayonnaise dazu. Bulgur mit Rosinen dient als Garnitur. Das Fleisch ist zart und lässt sich leicht mit der Gabel zerteilen; ein Messer ist nicht nötig. Los geht's, es wird ein herzhaftes Gericht!

Zutaten:
● Schweinekotelett – 400 g
● Zwiebeln – 2 Stück
● Kürbis – 600 g (5 Butternusskürbisspalten)
● Mayonnaise – 80 ml
● Bulgur – 240 g (Wasser – 480 ml)
● Rosinen – 120 g
● Butter – 30 g
● Pflanzenöl zum Braten, Frühlingszwiebeln, Salz, Zucker, Kreuzkümmel, Gewürze, schwarzer Pfeffer – nach Geschmack

1.Das Schweinekotelett in fingerdicke Stücke schneiden. Mit einem Fleischklopfer leicht klopfen, dabei darauf achten, dass nichts spritzt. Die Fleischstücke so in die Pfanne legen, dass der Pfannenboden bedeckt ist (nach Belieben überlappend). Das Fleisch mit Mayonnaise bestreichen und 1 Stunde im Kühlschrank marinieren lassen.

2.Eine Pfanne erhitzen und etwas Pflanzenöl zum Braten hineingeben. Die mit Mayonnaise bestrichenen Fleischstücke auf den Boden des Topfes geben. Mit einer Prise Salz und schwarzem Pfeffer würzen. Die Zwiebel in Halbringe schneiden und auf das Fleisch legen. Mit Kreuzkümmel oder beispielsweise Khmeli-Suneli bestreuen.

3.Den länglichen, kernlosen Teil des Kürbisses in Spalten schneiden. Die Spalten halbieren und auf die Zwiebeln legen. Die Schale nicht entfernen; sie wird beim Schmoren mitgegart und ist essbar. Den Kürbis mit Kreuzkümmel bestreuen und den Topf mit einem Deckel abdecken. Die Hitze reduzieren und 60 Minuten köcheln lassen.

4.Währenddessen sind alle Zutaten gut durchgegart und der Kürbis sehr weich. Nun den Bulgur schnell zubereiten. Die Butter in einem Topf schmelzen, den Bulgur hinzufügen, umrühren und einige Minuten anbraten. Zwei Tassen kochendes Wasser angießen und mit einer Prise Salz und Pfeffer würzen. Den Bulgur in den Topf geben und bei schwacher Hitze 20 Minuten köcheln lassen. So verdampft das gesamte Wasser und wird vom Bulgur aufgenommen, der dadurch gar wird. Etwas Butter unterrühren.

5.Den Bulgur mit einem umgedrehten Glas auf einen Teller geben. Kürbisstücke und Schweinekotelett in Mayonnaise-Zwiebel-Sauce daneben anrichten. Dazu passt Ketchup. Eine köstliche Kombination! Zartes und saftiges Fleisch! Das Schweinekotelett ist nun nicht mehr so ​​trocken.

Sollen wir es kochen?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

title.title: The Easiest Way to Buy, Stake and Earn on Hive-Engine || This Guide Will Help You a Lot
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 26, 2026, 10_20_59 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tvq73u3fF5G9tC8rNTCPW9HxTwd9UHuk7AiK63KowP1wAuGSgur2AFkG7oSe8raLnkx.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


The Hive ecosystem is a great blogging platform where people write content, explore each other’s cultures and learn about different lifestyles and traditions. Along with this it has also become a great source of earning for many users. 

One of the most important parts of this ecosystem is #Hive-Engine which is a decentralized Hive exchange where you can easily trade all Hive based tokens.

On Hive Engine you get many useful features. You can trade tokens, meaning you can easily buy or sell any token. You also get a staking option where the tokens you purchase can be staked to earn rewards. 

Another useful feature is the swap optio, which allows instant swapping between different tokens. Along with this you can also use the lease feature where you can lease Hive Power to others or take Hive Power on lease yourself. These are some of the many features available on #Hive-Engine.

---
### HOW TO DEPOSIT HIVE
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 215547.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EocAqWM4nqWwZx7jV91zrSmqM6BzC9kpT4DvMqsZs3kFQMGvvhz54j3X2G4FC38So2n.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220239.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u6QdP29DDN8uhiSkvzAVCosbVm49hJQZh7uHttnU8UYqfXNHkxwe8EkvbRcF286Z5Mq.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Today I will explain #Hive-Engine step by step for new users that how to deposit Hive, buy tokens, stake them, unstake them and withdraw them back. This guide is specially for those new users who still do not have proper knowledge about #Hive-Engine.

To start trading or buying any Hive token, first open the #Hive-Engine website and log in with your Hive account. You can log in through Hive Keychain or HiveSigner but I recommend using Hive Keychain because it is easier and safer.

After logging in you will see options like Market, Swap, Lease, More and Wallet at the top. Below that,you will see Deposit and Withdraw options. Further below you will see the list of tokens you currently hold.

If you want to invest in any token first you need to deposit Hive. Simply click on Deposit Hive. After that select the token you want to deposit. Since you want to deposit Hive, type “HIVE” then enter the quantity you want to deposit and click on Deposit Hive.

After doing this Hive Keychain will ask you to confirm the transaction because you are transferring Hive from your wallet to the #HiveEngine account. Within one or two minutes your Hive balance will appear in Hive Engine and then you can buy any token you want.

---
### SEARCH TOKEN NAME TO TRADE
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220308.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tHTDfiULmnfQ8duR51tuFwRXcuJhzJfJZA9D1dqBskkQBTh5P7Qi46KMUAGBQQoNjzU.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220340.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EokhQXaU6ZPtE6EJzDYfW2vUPpqxXXSyQCcFXTkf7ZB9uEizXS1jZ1tpaaEevGgW5fW.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


In the search token section, type the name of any token. For example if I type HELIOS the trading page of HELIOS will open. There you can see bids and asks. Simply enter the price at which you want to buy the token, add the quantity and click on Buy.

If there is enough trading volume and sellers are available you will instantly receive the HELIOS tokens. Otherwise you may need to wait until your order gets matched.

Once you buy the token it will appear in your wallet. If you want to stake it you will see a lock icon with the Stake option. Simply click on Stake, enter the amount you want to stake and confirm it. By staking you can earn good APR rewards.

---
### STAKING AND UNSTAKING
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220407.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uR7LWV4zxn52BbLYzneqBkCFzRtpwyPGme7pqycM4xyLNejW4ygmqRB7VHtSscj7ALx.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220348.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo6Qegw4H1D3q4QLqwyiYiXHoGpY3nzj46CbG82zC7xbpPk7W4g3h1Yuy8FKcA9wxBP.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

For unstaking different tokens have different unstaking periods usually ranging from a few days to several weeks depending on the token rules.. Majority of them have 4 weeks unstaking period..

If you want to withdraw your Hive back to your main wallet then simply click on Withdraw, select HIVE, enter the amount and confirm the withdrawal. Within one or two minutes the transaction will complete and your Hive will return to your wallet.

---
### WITHDRAW
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-26 220421.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uFuZmECEAjUVrsUMAjAPevDFGWZwQ5cSXsvaR4PMnc8B3Svzi3h2A2oasDcSycKsZ7z.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


These are very simple steps for trading, staking, leasing, and withdrawing on Hive Engine. I hope this guide gives you a better understanding of how Hive Engine works and helps new users use the platform more easily.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: The Fall of Aspirational Branding of Starbucks
title.body:
![DSCF1671.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uFKEst51ZJu5th47qsQAWdF6kYcHCxYEPpnztJ3SvpSBTfCANH5UwCYrMeP2BsGJ2dG.JPG)
# Starbucks is no longer the aspirational coffee cup and is slowly losing its crown. In South East Asia, there was a time when if you drink Starbucks, that could mean your salary is higher than most people and you have a certain *taste*. It was not just a bitter liquid that boosted your day but also a status symbol. Yet recently something has shifted, with many chains offering more premium options, locations, and more aspiration style, Starbuck fades into just that coffee chain that serves fast coffee. ![DSCF1686.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23vsBhpe831hw1pHeYx1mCKebhw4akX7NQ5n5k4o2yKCTSJc9Z1Boj2NvizVLX7rrMqcv.JPG) These days, Starbucks is being squeezed by %Arabica and Harland + Holden which offer more trendy and even exclusive experiences. Starbuck is simply no longer the king of premium coffee in South East Asia. While the price point of these three brands are similar, the exclusivity of the location of %Arabica adds a factor that screams, not everyone can even afford it. Even for me, many asked me why I still love going to Starbucks despite its decline. These days with local chains all over serving better coffee, there was still something missing from all of them, the consistency of taste. It is still the place to go when you do not want to gamble with taste as well as a place to go for its generous discounts. Compared to chains like Kopi Kenangan and Tomoro for example, they do not offer as generous discounts and freebies as Starbucks. When it comes to taste, local chains still lack unity across its stores where the taste that we could get varies a lot. ![DSCF1672.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uQiBcc9B6YXE8QiVVuXUmPcny32XKvN9QzoBsxAqwG5nwuKF1hYt5Zbjh2VytDCAGz4.JPG) With Starbucks also available in most rest areas around Java, that also dilutes the branding image of it. They are now just like how it is in the US, an everyday coffee, everyone could afford and somewhat tastes mediocre. ![DSCF1684.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23vhsCtBL8qr2rssjcasKsckGdAszZhiwErGSToQY4jq5eRxnN1ErZjC1r8MQmjszpjbZ.JPG) Now, why go to Starbucks when local chains do it better, have better places and at a lower price point? For regular customers, that is their consideration. In this economy, people would opt for more affordable options to also fuel their caffeine addiction. And for me, I go there just to cash-in on my rewards and the freebies I get quite few times in a month. Other than that, I would opt for other places, more local or local chains.

title.title: How I Manage And Deal With Unpleasant Memories
title.body:
MEMORIES FOR SALE
Hello @scifimultiverse friends, Happy midweek. I trust your day is going well. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJ1ofyPTqG53jqgSwVj8CkMC9EPadLMvWcLteCz411Ns/1779856621069.jpg)

I have heard and seen so many unthinkable things, especially in the state where I reside. One day like that, I heard I could farm and sell maggots to Fish farmers. At first, I screamed and even screamed harder when I was shown the pictures and videos of the hatched ones, both dried and fresh ones, awaiting delivery to Farmers as Fish feed. I got home that day and couldn’t eat for some time because of the sight.

Imagine getting to know a place where memories could be sold. So many questions will come to mind. Why would I want to sell my memory? What will be the consequences after the sale? Can I ever live happily after the sale?

Memories are in different states: the good, the bad, and the ugly. There are days when bad memories cause mood swings that put me in bad shape. Likewise, the good ones and ugly memories. 

Therefore, I must do a thorough findings on the consequences of selling and whether the type of memory sold matters, and confirm if the feedback seems promising to enable me to make a good decision. For example, if I decide to sell the ugly memories and find out that there are no dire consequences. I will go ahead and sell the ugly memories. This is because it brings pain to my heart anytime I go down memory lane and interact with those moments.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2viqTm2653aJmax3cvM53py6KjwPDD7ehm4nrbnjKSL/1779856498870.png)

**AI Generated Image**
There was a time when I was coming home from work, at a particular popular bus stop in my state of residence, a tanker loaded with fuel failed brakes on a sloppy bridge. What I saw that day was horrible, terrific, and unimaginable. I was shaken and so afraid of life. I was visibly shaken and couldn’t move for some time. My heart nearly failed. Each time I pass that area, I remember that memory. Most often, I fight hard to stop remembering the scene, but it keeps coming.

I would want to sell that kind of memory and be free from the torment and fear it brings to mind each time a tanker comes close to anywhere I am, or just the sight of a tanker sends those cold feelings around me. In fact, I will be very happy to sell that kind of memory forever and walk away free from the pain of remembering that memory. It might not be necessary for money, but rather to get rid of the torment.

However, if I get a good offer to take off something that disturbs me, why not, as long as it does not have dire consequences, just like the example, I will go with it.

Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-69-edition-1-or-sell-your-memories-or)

title.title: A little pressure
title.body: >Siempre he odiado las matemáticas y desde que mío hijo nació le tenía temor al día que me tocara explicarle matemáticas, porque, aunque sea la cosa más sencilla de matemáticas a mi me cuesta el triple de entender que alguien normal, básicamente he tenido que aprender de nuevo muchas cosas que había olvidado y que me reviven traumas terribles. Aunque mi esposo me ha ayudado bastante, ya que el es mejor en ese tema que yo, pero igual no es para nada facil, sobre todo en días como el de hoy donde por el trabajo mi esposo no pudo hacer la tarea de matemáticas con mi hijo. > I've always hated math, and ever since my son was born, I've dreaded the day I'd have to explain it to him. Even the simplest math concepts are three times harder for me to understand than for the average person. Basically, I've had to relearn so many things I'd forgotten, and it brings back terrible traumas. My husband has helped me a lot, since he's better at math than I am, but it's still not easy, especially on days like today when he couldn't do math homework with my son because of work. ![photo_2026-05-26_21-12-04 (4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xp6TwTtXwbrJ2WpYQFZdtx3S44qxEmZRjkn6NH3GFrCuggD85Bqp9JNkZ1jWbmDNy5K.jpg)

>Y mi hijo tambien heredo mi mente poco receptiva para las matemáticas ya que ha sido bastante complicado que entienda cosas bastante sencillas, aunque a veces siento que mas que no entender es que le falta confiar en si mismo un poco más, a veces sabe la respuesta y se cohíbe de decirla pensando que es la respuesta incorrecta y entendería ese comportamiento de un niño que es castigado cuando no sabe algo pero es al contrario, siempre lo corregimos de la mejor manera cuando se equivoca y le aplaudimos muchísimo cuando acierta. > And my son also inherited my somewhat unreceptive mind for mathematics, as it has been quite difficult for him to understand even simple things. Although sometimes I feel that more than not understanding, it's that he lacks a little more self-confidence. Sometimes he knows the answer but is hesitant to say it, thinking it's the wrong answer. I would understand that behavior from a child who is punished for not knowing something, but it's the opposite; we always correct him in the best way when he makes a mistake and applaud him a lot when he gets it right. ![photo_2026-05-26_21-12-03 (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23yd3hzJoBX7Rowkg9N9sWbyBVxnXVitQSWG25WQCEmnUd26ZVqdDTAANF8UXCYgFCm8z.jpg)

>Hoy sufrí una migraña tremenda por la tarea y otras cosas que pasaron en la escuela, pero aun asi luché muchísimo para poder mantenerme cuerda y explicarle de la mejor manera jaja. Me preocupa pensar en el futuro cuando este mas grande y me toque ayudarlo con ecuaciones complejas, creo que en ese momento tendré que buscar ayuda profesional porque sinceramente hasta ahí no llega mi cerebro jajaja. > Today I had a terrible migraine because of homework and other things that happened at school, but I still fought really hard to stay sane and explain things to him as best I could, haha. I'm worried about the future when he's older and I have to help him with complex equations. I think at that point I'll have to seek professional help because, honestly, my brain just won't be able to handle that much, hahaha. ![photo_2026-05-26_21-12-03 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xATT2seGwXJq4Kd5vVbCmWib2Rk8MSV1v1FkcsYd5qPr6DRPfydW5KQ4HE1FwR5N9dP.jpg)

>Y sí, mientras mi hijo resolvía la tarea de matemáticas yo pintaba mándalas para calmarme porque sino iba a morir del estrés. > And yes, while my son was doing his math homework, I was painting mandalas to calm down because otherwise I was going to die of stress.

title.title: My entry to the Phone Photography Contest #114 [En-Es] A little jumper spider
title.body:
**Hello friends, a few days ago I saw a small spider near the laundry area.**

>**Hola amigos, hace días vi una pequeña araña cerca del lavandero.**

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSwAY7JdFvKVaXZVsQxH6bErfF8PYG3RQ21LRG5CikFf/1779856254861.jpg)

</center>

**Its restless and curious attitude was typical of a jumping spider, but what caught my attention the most were its colors, which sometimes seemed metallic or iridescent.**

>**Su actitud inquieta y curiosa era la típica de una araña saltarina, pero lo que mas llamó mi atención fueron sus colores que a veces parecían metálicos o iridescentes.**

<center>
![20260501_093149(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/EoeJhSXvXcPbif1M9MAxn3AfXPtENSeZBt8HpdQzWZZC8zQvQf3PCodPC69LYJTRDwy.jpg)
</center>

**In fact, it has yellow-gold areas on the abdomen and cephalothorax.**

>**De hecho, tenía zonas amarillo-doradas en el abdómen y el cefalotorax.**
 
<center>
![20260501_094538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23ynbGDx3LGmYjxuMEJUftrnzFNNBR9fJp3n4FUoLQrhiDyE3jhAJkT2NKX6LfEn76mGK.jpg)
</center>

**It was about 6 millimeters in size and had hair all over its body.**

>**Su tamaño era de cerca de 6 milímetros y tenia pelos en todo el cuerpo.**

<center>

However, in a busy city life, taking care of fresh flowers, watering them every day or changing them when they dry out, becomes difficult for many. And this is where artificial flowers have become a popular home decoration accessory these days. We see this beautiful flower made of a combination of bright yellow and red. It truly showcases the perfection of modern artificial flower craftsmanship. The arrangement of its petals and the contrast of colors are so exquisite that at first glance, it could be mistaken for a fresh flower. It doesn't require any watering, pruning, or exposure to the sun. Placing these types of brightly colored flowers in a beautiful vase on the center table of the living room, dining table, or in an empty corner of the room can change the atmosphere of the entire room. Neon yellow and red flowers like the one in the picture It can instantly brighten and enliven a dark corner of the room. It is also possible to create a wonderful indoor bouquet by combining such dark-colored flowers with light pink or white artificial flowers. Finally, it can be said. Artificial flowers are no longer just plastic toys, they are a modern artistic medium to express the aesthetics of the home. If you want to maintain a touch of nature and a color match even in your busy life. But today, you can make room in the corner of your room for some beautiful artificial flowers.

title.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps part 2:   Inkwater Marsh
title.body: This huge and sprawling game has a lot more exploration than \

and this is becoming quite evident very early on in the gameplay.   It isn't always clear where you are supposed to go and this can be good sometimes but even with the map the areas you are meant to travel do will not be clear until you stumble upon them.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/Eo43tkKa4ZUQtcJFsrgP4ryksvfiNQdKuRJAAKxeqLCyBnMFoFKJNfEQYwo6akGKwKk.png)
</center>

Me revealing maps isn't a spoiler really guys, this map is so huge and really isn't terribly useful for the most part anyway but if that bothers you I'm sorry but honestly, I rarely use the map other than to get some sort of sense of a *Very general direction* to head in because pathways are never as cut and dry as \

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tbMLBio1RDjxm8sxtfUK8ecYBWB3oKdQR4Qz75cSSf5DbmL1A8PgXDfZoXPaF8h9nbG.png)
</center>

Combat remains rather basic at this point and I have only encountered a couple of enemies that had some sort of strategy associated with them such as shields on the front.  For the most part you can just whack whack whack your way through almost anything and strategy is kind of optional.   The real quests now is the platforming, which remains fun and is rarely a question of getting just a few pixels between you and making it to the next platform.  For the most part, if you see a platform above that you cannot get to using normal means, it is almost certainly something that you are not yet meant to be able to get to.  So you are better off just moving on and exploring a bit more

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tkUh7GeEU7xSYWBLT6pygQGik2w1qJijSFUEeoCxehguUHoFV24PYU96dtMNYFMAAsb.png)
</center>

We continue to move towards where our little owl friend is trapped and because I already know the tone of the \

games I would be willing to bet that there is going to be some sort of heartbreaking end to our little feathered friend.  But we must carry on!   Our Moki friends keep giving us hints about how we can get to him but as you might expect, this normally mans heading to the right.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/Eo6D5Ukq3kZSeWeEiN1DQvgF8XbS861bgPsutiKQxjCZ8QHhaivNUaJSjSRvd5XbUsJ.png)
[src](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/oriandtheblindforest/images/a/ae/Ori_spirit_arc.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/250?cb=20200415024144)</center>

We find another tree, release the light, and as is often the case at these things we get prepared for a new skill which now is the Spirit Arc, which is a bow-like thing that helps us out with being able to pick off enemies from afar.  

It also will open pathways that you previously couldn't get to and a few places in the past where you saw something that appeared to be shoot-able may come to mind.  If you can think of one I think you should probably just save it because it has been my experience that you are going to be doing a lot of wandering anyway and there is no reason to intentionally backtrack just yet.  Chances are you will get lost over there at some point anyway.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23w2a7AQYsCJr4jykPWHawKdp6JZzsEBrpWmpwPWQEA1BHgTXLJUGpUAgcHTahHEMpgJk.png)
</center>

Now we open a pathway leading to the East and it's really cool.  

But there is one thing that veteran players of the Ori series are probably going to start to notice is taking form.  The game is slowly but surely transitioning you to increasingly difficult platforming instead of rather simplistic to the point where you can't really lose, combat.  

It doesn't really matter if you have the game on easy, mid, or hard at these points, the platforming is largely the same.  This can be frustrating to some people, or a joy to others.  For me, I think it is important to only play this for an hour or so at a time and if some mechanic is starting to annoy me, I will warp out of there and go explore for some of those places I couldn't access previously.  This isn't going to make the difficult bit any easier, but for me anyway, it takes my mind off of the frustration and therefore I am less likely to quit. 

Kwolock's Hollow is next and you will notice right upon entering that the things you have to interact with are very heavily involving the bow you just picked up.  What an unbelievable coincidence?   

See you next time!  

<sub> unsourced images are screenshots from my own gameplay </sub>

title.title: Bundles of Joy (Pomeranians) - Phone Photography Contest #114
title.body:
Hello everyone! 👋 

Today, I'll be introducing The Poms: Belle and Teddy for this week's #phonography contest which is initiated by none other than @untilwelearn. 

One afternoon three months ago, my brother turned up at my doorstep with his arms full of these fluffy little darlings. I got very excited; everyone came out from their \

and welcomed these new additions to our family compound.

Teddy and Belle look so sweet. These photos were taken when they first arrived. They seemed to be smiling at everyone. We even put them in a box! 😆

One thing I've learned about Poms: once you put them down, they become little lunatics, loud and jumpy. But the moment you carry them in your arms, there is an immediate transformation. My, they're such sweetie pies. 🥰

Teddy (male) is the white and gold, and Belle/Bella (female) is the other. They're siblings, which is probably why they settled so quickly into their new home. Pampered like babies.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvy4F6HewGoiYJgFsZKEAG4t1hHNuy7jtb2X9gjAJXAH/1779851520135.jpg)

Brotherly love/kiss. 🥰 \

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU8GkUNWwBpnXDTJkWkNjzo3brH8G1SyFT2euCp7kJE5a/1779851520308.jpg)

Contagious smile. 😁

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTb4QTMjjr8HNGP5zTvESoofCnKnk8RUdczWqgT17ABXL/1779851520472.jpg)

Sweet little Belle. ❤️

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma9HCpcqNZ9tMApht5Bg2S8fG1rsZKEWyN3oxiRnCiTEH/1779851520623.jpg)

Handsome little Ted.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRTU87mMv29rr5hPqdF4dqGPRoAvHoxMe4xQEY3theLQ/1779851520775.jpg)

Entertaining their new family was obviously  exhausting, so they fell asleep in a heap. I'm so glad they have one another, especially after being separated from their mother and original home. 

After three months, they're now taller and sporting a new hairstyle this summer season.

Thanks for the visit and support. Have a good day and a great week ahead. 🐶✨💞
