title.title: The Night Before Eid
title.body:
The Night Before Eid-ul-Adha.....!

The night before Eid-ul-Adha has its own kind of magic. It’s not just about new clothes and sweets like Eid-ul-Fitr.No doubt eid ul fitr has its own charm..obviously after the month of RAMDAN , its a big reward for muslims.but, about Eid Ul Adha...! This one feels heavier, warmer, more about family and sacrifice. The whole house is busy, but in a different way. There’s excitement in the air, but also that calm before the big day tomorrow.

For me, it always starts with the same feeling: we’re getting ready for something important. Ramadan had its quiet discipline. Eid-ul-Fitr had its sugar and celebration. Eid-ul-Adha is different. It’s about giving, about sharing, about all of us coming together.

What about joy and happiness...both nights have the same perks.This year, I went to the market with my brother the day before Eid. We told ourselves we’d go early to avoid the crowd. We were wrong again. Eid-ul-Adha markets are a whole other level.Oh goodness i thought no one gonna preffer going out in this schorhing summer heat...but i was totally wrong.

The streets were full of animals being taken to homes, trucks unloading, and people carrying big bags of groceries. But we weren’t there for qurbani shopping my father handled that. My list was the same as always: henna, bangles, a little makeup. Brother just came to carry the bags and complain hahah.! 

First of all , we eneter the main shop, from where we always preffer to buy our stuff. On enteranc there i saw nail polishes....dammmmn i was not planning to buy the but they got my attention for sure. Different colours: shimmry, glossy, mat, peel off ...oh just stunning.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoLXy3srZNJAyaAAeZd7zKo2RiM57LVGqaU25NVAkkEN/1779827091665.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejm5eUmXhk3p8tV86b1W1bMHH4FEpaHoGWRu6XTqRBBC/1779827091726.jpg)


Then i stopped at a henna corner.. trust me i love the smell of heenah...no one can understand me better then all the girlies out there. I don't go for hennah artist ever.. because i love hennah and i myself apply it on every festival.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzqisoknEE1YS92Mveg5yDmnLE2Lk7k4YT9BBu8Xq2jj/1779827196730.jpg)


Then came the bangles. Eid-ul-Adha bangles are always a bit bolder. Deep maroon, emerald green, gold. I picked a set of maroon and gold that clinked when I moved my wrist. It reminded me of my mother during Eid when I was little. I also got some thin glass churis for everyday wear. My brother raised an eyebrow. “Another set?” I just smiled. Yes. Another set.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFv4GKtsqHhLYPs2qdUoqDkNBWQcuFWSAztMFFi5UMVu/1779827238658.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoUdpvXfhZ76LyAgjS2yBt5aKfkgdzc3RwZ8vqfQwYT9/1779827238716.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhfvNDV49gtBhXpfmwX2GqAD31cpswuSfbV1Ndcychiz/1779827238795.jpg)


The makeup section was crowded. Even women who don’t wear makeup daily buy something for Eid-ul-Adha. I picked up a set of nails, a mascara, , some maekup brushesbfo sure, a lipstick and of course a lip liner. The shopkeeper kept saying, “This one is waterproof, this one won’t fade during qurbani work.” Everyone was preparing to be in the kitchen or outside tomorrow, so long-lasting was the keyword.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYbN3L99yeg7uejsi5yVV3A6An5Vv6oySKMmYfJjnMro/1779827335453.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeURgeD9UsBwUg15kEAPArjMzmYonYKP6ybdqWzEztxFY/1779827335507.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZ3goZEbabpE9uJyx5B6BB9cgNodZgHAvTR5mpsXAb5J/1779827335566.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcHAZs96SPfLKBk2AaphDByZUPPL4pcMnKJvy4WSUUq2J/1779827335629.jpg)

Eid-ul-Adha markets aren’t just about clothes. The food stalls were everywhere. Trays of sheerkhurma, boxes of zarda, plates of jilapi still hot from the oil. There were also stalls selling ready-made spice mixes for biryani, kebab, and roast. Uncles were buying in bulk, arguing over which brand was best.

I was stunned by how busy it was. One stall had a line of 15 people just to buy fresh Ras gullas. Another had fresh  Brfi and dry fruits stacked high. The smell of sugar, cardamom, and frying oil made the whole market feel alive.Oh my goodness i got insane watching soo much variety of sweets ..

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTLuwwtHgSxtbRcP5WRDvTeAJXVGBjnD9Foh51fdvX5dJ/1779827461008.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBUjUe8YUtAddcLmTT4P3BS25vCRix2KCDEWRXGSgEBV/1779827461068.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP2QNJkxjdC6uoRoBs8iPDv3oP6vSwgrv2qTxGx7m4ZJ9/1779827461144.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFD4hTcrGgdH2Ba3FVY6KdhMqqPKcvNep3bw4VtvaedG/1779827461196.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQERX9g386QPEP4nEsjBmobDoLT2ycNBay7WiV7rmpZxy/1779827461247.jpg)

Amf finally we came home after 2 and half an hour. 
Home was even busier. My father had brought the sacrificial animal earlier, and it was tied in the courtyard. The kids were both scared and excited. My mother and sister were in the kitchen making some marinations or tomorrow. The smell of ginger, garlic, and spices filled the house.

While everything  was being prepared, we sat in the courtyard to apply henna. My cousins and I spread a newspaper on the floor. Mine came out with flowers and vines. My cousin hid my name in the design and said, “Find it tomorrow.” We had to sit still for 20 minutes, so we talked and laughed. My brother came out once, took a picture, and said, “You all look ready for a wedding.” We threw a cushion at him.

The henna was cool on my skin. In Eid-ul-Adha, applying henna feels different. Tomorrow is going to be a long, hardworking day. So tonight is the last bit of rest, the last bit of decoration before we all pitch in.

By the time the henna dried, the kitchen smelled amazing. My mother had made sheerkhurma for the night. We ate it warm, standing around the pot because no one wanted to wait. Sweet, creamy, with vermicelli, nuts, and raisins. It tasted like Eid.

Later, I sat on the steps and looked at my hands. The henna was staining dark. My new bangles made a soft sound. Tomorrow would be early. Fajr prayer, then qurbani, then distributing meat, then cooking, then guests.

Eid-ul-Adha night is special because it’s the calm before the work. We know tomorrow will be tiring. There will be blood, knives, hard work, and responsibilities. But tonight, we’re just family. We’re laughing, eating sweets, decorating our hands.

It was late when we finally lay down. I couldn’t sleep at first. My mind was thinking about tomorrow. Waking up early, helping with qurbani, seeing the meat distributed to neighbors who need it. That’s the part I love most about Eid-ul-Adha....!the sharing.

I looked at my henna one last time. Tomorrow it would be darker. Tomorrow everything would start early and end late. But tonight, I was just happy. Tired, full, and ready.

That’s how the night before Eid-ul-Adha always is for me. A mix of excitement and peace. Shopping, sweets, henna on our hands, and the quiet knowledge that tomorrow we’ll work hard, give a lot, and celebrate together.

What about your preparations??Wanna share?

title.title: Ways to remember more in less time.
title.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPtbe4uoAUkrD1sQfgmm1yYw6wyAcm45Kkh7qVZLxM9ad/1000070406.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. In the field of academic studies, we remember what we have studied, due to which we increase our intelligence. But it is seen that we cannot retain our studies well in our brain. Many times it is seen that we are present in class but we cannot learn them well in class. Our time is very short. Due to which we have to study at home at some point. Many times it is seen that we study for a long time but we cannot master those studies. Later everything is lost in our memory. There are many students among us who basically want to study well on a topic before the exam. It is seen that those topics can take a long time to remember. Therefore, we have to adopt some methods through which we can master more studies in less time. We have to think about something like this. By doing this, we will try to remember those studies in less time. Suppose you are trying to read a topic. First you must read that topic carefully. You must understand what is said in that topic. If you read that topic with understanding, then you will definitely master about 25% of that reading. In this way, you will have to read it 7 to 8 times. Then you must take a notebook and write that topic there. Even though you will make many mistakes, you will still have to write with mistakes. Then you have to compare the notebook with your book to see if you have written your topic correctly. In this way, you have to read it again and write it again until you have read about 95 percent. And in this way you will be able to remember more reading in less time. If you understand a topic, then it will definitely become easy for you. If you master it in a short time, then it will definitely be good for you. I hope you like this post of mine, thank you all. *** ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [Source]( https://pixabay.com/photos/note-clothespin-clothesline-3454277/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/ways-to-remember-more-in-less-time-91r)

title.title: An afternoon in the Prado/ Una tarde por el Prado. MONOMAD/CHALLENGE.  (English/Español)
title.body:
Hello Hivers. 
Greeting you again, I'm stopping by this beautiful community of Black and White Photography to present you with a new publication.
One of those afternoons when I was on the Paseo del Prado I saw images that greatly attracted me.

Street photographs, where the feeling of my city, its people and how they develop and act on a daily basis is alive. 


![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23wqfzVMSDiD8ooFrQVzp1FyJ2WmtRUeaM6SgLLGAi2VuDmHZDJW34mREJTB9EUwV5iPJ.jpg)




It is common, especially on Saturday and Sunday afternoons, to see chess players. They come to the walk with their boards, sometimes very old, they place the chess pieces and those who like this pastime quickly approach: women, men and even children and within a few minutes we already see pairs of players discussing quick games of chess.


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23tvZrPpjS1C22DeECSiuVcnq2APa1wXeDBEtpfSTVPTHobtKMw6CGEvu2r1Zr89W3qvH.jpg)




![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23xARTF1hwtmx8iTnjTkVc3mcdmrp54W13RKbog9L5c6QrKpvXs87h8NnWSeu5jGRtAjS.jpg)




![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/242rnzzNE9YvE7PWDGmMZDLPTgUwEUR2sFFDbZcVpQmRerRa3C1zwnk35CLcP72H1uFg3.jpg)




![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23wqiMstM6k8fcnfQbPM1HdSoM1UD8X9qWdL7MpaSDFze1G5WoDfrkQJtsPifzT6Y1zL3.jpg)





There is also no shortage of children in the afternoons, who enjoy games, ride skates, run, feeling free and safe.




![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23wqhzhb4McoAZAsBvMFKyZTFzBoGYkmUL2BS9bUKGY3QZdaeSAubXQzWmwnc7Abqe52c.jpg)




![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23vi1x1fPnbfmM3h4SDNe42QbwQSsYhaDCdEZBGwQGLvViuLEwVokS7GrTyhHqqRkoBJJ.jpg)




![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23tvc1E2VSdA33AYFzxwKyo9hUZP6ufxrAHHoLZTYUSipgpcVmo3kbnERWWVmzTTBefwh.jpg)





And we even have this boy, JL, who likes to take photos and without even knowing how to hold a camera well, he follows in the footsteps of his grandmother, who writes to them, I hope to have an heir for my photographic equipment.
 ha ha ha!!!





![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23xoyotDfnLLL2r4ThnERViinKEzyjM7GneEKRYg5PEBw779U1imomXE4J5BC6KbNCCQk.jpg)


So I leave you these images, hoping you like them. 

We will continue to see each other here.

I wish you all a good morning and may you always be healthy.


These images are for my entry to the Monomad contest by @ challenge and @brumest


@Lulyhive

Una tarde por el Prado 

Hola Hivers 
Saludándolos nuevamente  paso por esta linda comunidad de Fotografías en Blanco y Negro para presentarles una nueva publicación. 
Una tarde de esas en las que he estado por el Paseo del Prado  he visto imágenes que me han atraído grandemente.  Fotografías callejeras,  donde está vivo el sentimiento de mi ciudad, su gente y como se desenvuelven y actúan cotidiamanente. 


Es común,  sobre todo en tardes de sábado y domingo  ver a los jugadores de ajedrez. Vienen al paseo con sus tableros, a veces muy viejos,  colocan las fichas de ajedrez y rápidamente se van acercando los que gustan de este pasatiempo: mujeres,  hombres y hasta niños y en picos minutos ya vemos a las parejas de jugadores discutiendo rápidas partidas de ajedrez.

Tampoco faltan en las tardes los niños, que disfrutan de juegos, montan patines,  corren, se sienten libres y seguros.

Y hasta tenemos a este niño, JL, que le gusta de hacer fotos y sin siquiera saber coger bien una cámara, siguen los pasos de su abuela, esta que les escribe, espero tener seguro un heredero para mis equipos fotográficos.
 jajaja!!!

Seguiremos viéndonos por aquí .

A todos les deseo un buen días y que estén siempre saludables.

title.title: The calm is the storm
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8974LqavniP3EYxHRLQ9LWb3YmEm11Gt2L2UHFrHSrE/img_3123.png)






What is this sense of calm I feel?

No urge to throw ideas out into the wilderness of stimuli?

No eager desire to connect?

No rollercoasters, no hyper speed? 

Am I just getting older or am I finding my rhythm? 

I feel content with my music and where it’s going, I know that I can push all the right buttons on a single night far more powerfully than slamming away at the keyboard night after night. 

I still desire to connect through this medium but the urgency is gone. I’ve come to terms with my limited sphere of influence here. I no longer dream of flocks coming to me. I’ll go find them. 

I want to explore again. 

I’m making a bucket list for the summer. Places I need to go, people I need to see. Venues I want to perform in. I need to be out there in the world, not constantly working through the keyboard. I need to exchange sounds and ideas to living flesh. 

It’s not getting any easier but I am getting far more adept at creating and nurturing ideas that will blossom into flowers and little forests. 

The last two weeks life was on hold, but we are back now. 

This summer will be about connecting with the countryside around Tokyo so I have more places to play and build bridges with. 

I want to organize outings to Saitama and Yamanashi and Nagano and Ibaraki and Yamagata. If I can play a show I will. If not I’ll make friends and become familiar with the place. 

Exploration is in my blood and helps it flow so I am putting it above everything else other than my music. It may not be all that practical in a world that seems to be falling apart at the seams. It may not seem smart when I need to chip away at my reserves, but it’s more important than almost anything. 

This week I will get back my footing and get back to practicing every day in between the work I do to earn a living. 

I will keep you updated, I’m sure there will be wonderful things to share! 


All work available here:

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 27 2026
title.body:
Day 19… and at this point, the routine feels more real than the excuses 😄 Got out in the morning before I had time to overthink it. Started with a steady walk while the streets were still quiet, then eased into some light jogging once the body warmed up. Added a few short running bursts and basic exercises in between, mostly to keep the energy up and loosen the legs. Nothing intense today, but it felt smooth. The kind of session where you’re not fighting yourself the whole time. Ended up crossing around 11k steps by the end of it, which kept the challenge moving in the right direction. What’s interesting is how much easier consistency becomes once the routine starts feeling normal. The first few days needed motivation. Now it’s more like autopilot. Day 19 done ✔️ Two more days left in this challenge. If you’ve been thinking about starting something small for yourself, this is your reminder that progress usually begins with boring, repeatable days like these.

There are different types of insects and animals in the natural environment and they have different types of attractive beauty. Likewise, I am sharing a very beautiful insect in a natural environment that has a beautiful name Beet webworm moth. This is a very familiar insect to me and this insect is not a favorite insect for me. Because in reality it is a really harmful insect. It damages different types of crops and especially lives on the leaves of different crops and eats the leaves of various weed plants. It mostly likes to live in dry places.



I saw this insect sitting on a leaf of a weedy plant on the side of a hospital road last month and it was sitting very beautifully with its wings spread out like a butterfly. I saw that it was sitting very silently and wherever it sat it sat for a long time. I observed it closely and saw that its body wings had a combination of different colors and it looked very beautiful. I observed it more through Google and I realized that it really damages various crops in the agricultural field, especially soybeans, beets and sunflowers.

body.title: I Was Happy Once At This Place...
body.body:
>More than the place itself, what really hit me was the noise. Overgrown weeds, piles of dirt, vines swallowing the nearby structures, and the endless sound of cars rushing past the avenue. That was my first impression after returning, more than twenty years later, to the place that once made me happiest as a child: The Big Low Family Center, right in the heart of San Diego. It sits beside the main bus terminal that welcomes everyone arriving to the city, though most younger people today probably have no idea what that place once meant to an entire generation. For those of us who grew up there, though, Big Low was almost sacred. It was one of those places that quietly shaped your childhood without you even realizing it at the time.

*\n\n*

>You know what the worst part is? Realizing time really does destroy things. There’s something painfully cruel about standing in front of a place where you once felt pure happiness, only to find rust, abandonment, and silence waiting for you instead. The old sign is somehow still standing after decades, almost like a ghost refusing to disappear. Seeing it there felt surreal. Like walking into a memory that no longer belongs to the present. And yet the nostalgia is impossible to resist. One glance at that faded entrance and suddenly I could hear the laughter again, the music, the voices of children running everywhere while parents tried to keep up behind them.

* ![20241105_110247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23vsHqXXQcZCWcWQZ6Y7T6s8hHiQyPrHqtR6RFC6ATWAjmw2d7R9Vh959TQppch3mD6QV.jpg) ![20241105_111101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMQ8g96paG77LB86e9wvWENxg1hLYjG6f6qa9jdna58c4ANwFia8rqBeEnNUhJZjxgc.jpg) ![20241105_111312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/Eoc5fVX458VH4uXEuSZ6AFq9bFnNdSkJwKcvf4WYTFCmt6PiYkh1VFc6ApMj7CjppKq.jpg) ![20241105_111359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23yd1iLPqRh3bQwb2eFjii6XhHM5W2UyBypGCmparaPMxKyp55FJcF7ZYUhS99ZTQD46T.jpg) *

>Those years felt magical. Big Low had arcade machines filled with games like Street Fighter and Pac-Man, go-karts where every kid believed they were a professional race driver, noisy attractions, bright lights, and the kind of joy that only exists in childhood. I still remember screaming while driving tiny cars around the track, desperately trying to get my parents to watch me for five seconds longer. But strangely enough, one of the memories that hurts me most now has nothing to do with the games themselves. It’s remembering my mother and father dancing together there one night. Laughing. Enjoying each other. I honestly don’t think I ever saw that happen again after those years. Maybe that’s why this place stayed buried so deeply inside me all this time.

*\n\n*

>Without context, I know these photos probably just look like an old abandoned sign. Something vintage. Something broken. But for me, this place represents the end of an era. My boyfriend, who probably understands me better than anyone else, knew how badly I wanted to come back and photograph this place exactly as it is today. Not because it still looks beautiful, but because it doesn’t. Because there’s something brutally honest about ruins. They force you to confront the fact that life keeps moving whether you’re emotionally ready or not. Some places leave marks on your soul in ways that are impossible to explain logically, and Big Low became one of those places for me a very long time ago.

* ![1000038786.jpg](image-6-1000038786.jpg)![1000038799.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xVCSfLrJCfB5vh2jUeoGACawLrRTvShyK47typYF1PFKQMnp52qs8H6V2BmHb6h6fKJ.jpg) ![1000038789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xVGdmYz8RGBTc31dpojA3oWtjnEFjnWdE3bJ1VxcNui5Z7z4jQ1CEQGcRtUJUB2E8NG.jpg) ![1000038802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wWpSTrCvrKTmTJpdT65poHo6TMMfuMA6mFegYA5eqFFbDyMZbs8JbaDhKxZzcSx8pV6.jpg) ![1000038792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wqgR3vWrw9fmnC6HfUBTVeojexaFwSCWyWnwCPGB7bNF7rmU2dZCDTJFYV9cGch4hx4.jpg) ![1000038805.jpg](image-11-1000038805.jpg)![1000038790.jpg](image-12-1000038790.jpg) *

>As a child, this place meant everything. While taking these pictures, I genuinely couldn’t stop myself from tearing up a little. And yes, maybe it sounds ridiculous to feel this attached to an old amusement center. But for the shy, lonely, awkward little girl I used to be, Big Low was a sanctuary. I would see that entrance, the same one you’re seeing in these photos, and immediately feel safe and excited. It was never just about games or attractions. It was where my love for anime, old arcade games, milkshakes, and escapism started. It gave me moments of happiness I desperately needed back then. So even if all that remains now is a deteriorated structure slowly being consumed by time, I’m still grateful. It was beautiful seeing you again, Big Low Family Center. Some ruins deserve to be remembered lovingly.

* ![20241105_112749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/241tSpjvQ6Gp9SWWNqQ3J84jtAFo8qVRupZjMoWDwTavuYCyFkpCnF2eEZATg5yJp52XS.jpg) ![20241105_113545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wC7dy9qmK8kcJYNXKDbhJZoN4nW9nCJzpa934vZEq4Y1kka5rwLMm6bvEDKwoo5HVwD.jpg) ![20241105_114303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMaJfHD3gG2hJndKtSdAVtZLJpriBbApZWmghmPLZDeKcifjgyzvdp4bHH6sgkGQkYm.jpg) ![20241105_114407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23ywgsLHGykqXPANudVqvLxCvya59mD4T89hexSYKFZGPhwonZHPgLFyGdhoKsLTmrb11.jpg) ![20241105_114917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23yTUjsDaVknrNUGoJjFmLR9eqbj7ju91ASydf29zg55FE95ZrMPCKhYqdC5WFShJmhsK.jpg) ***

When it comes to washing or cleaning things up, we use soap for virtually everything. I do not enjoy the washing of the soap is not having bubbles when you use it. I know it is a weird notion, but I think the soap is not a good one if it does not have bubbles when using it. I love my soap forming and full with the bubbles. It makes washing easier and more convenient.




So when I discover the soap is not as I expect, I will not use it. I prefer not to wash than to use the soap, in the end, it will add more stress to what to my washing. 



We all have our preference, and we have our reasons for choosing things. Others may not understand, but it is our duty to make the right choice as to what we want to use.

# 四季的魅力：自然的变迁与生命的轮回

## 引言
自然界的每一个角落都蕴藏着无尽的美丽与神奇。四季的变化不仅影响着我们的生活节奏，也深刻地影响着动植物的生长与繁衍。本文将探讨四季的独特魅力，以及它们如何塑造我们的世界。

## 春天：重生与希望
春天是万物复苏的季节，随着温暖的阳光和细雨的滋润，植物开始发芽，花朵竞相开放。春天象征着新的开始，给人们带来了希望与活力。

### 主要特点
- **气候**：温暖、潮湿
- **植物**：花朵盛开，树木发芽
- **动物**：许多动物开始繁殖

## 夏天：生机与繁荣
夏天是生命最为旺盛的季节，阳光明媚，万物生长。这个时候，田野里绿意盎然，果实逐渐成熟，给人们带来了丰收的喜悦。

### 主要特点
- **气候**：炎热、干燥
- **植物**：果实丰收，树木繁茂
- **动物**：动物活动频繁，繁殖旺盛

## 秋天：丰收与沉淀
秋天是收获的季节，农田里的庄稼成熟，果园里的果实挂满枝头。这个时候，树叶逐渐变黄，给大自然披上了一层金色的外衣。

### 主要特点
- **气候**：凉爽、干燥
- **植物**：果实成熟，树叶变色
- **动物**：动物开始准备过冬

## 冬天：宁静与反思
冬天是一个安静的季节，万物进入休眠状态。虽然寒冷，但冬天也有其独特的美丽，白雪皑皑的景象让人感受到宁静与平和。

### 主要特点
- **气候**：寒冷、干燥
- **植物**：植物休眠，树木光秃
- **动物**：许多动物冬眠，活动减少

## 结论
四季的变化让我们感受到自然的力量与美丽。每一个季节都有其独特的魅力，提醒着我们生命的轮回与变化。无论是春天的希望，夏天的生机，秋天的丰收，还是冬天的宁静，四季都在教会我们珍惜当下，感受自然的恩赐。

## 参考资料

body.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY 8TH SPLINTERLANDS
body.body:
<center>![splinterlands_logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/Eoc6ceQNGemqDQpcynigbUPX3iyPAk3tByPJJhW7wccpJvFDK9gcTMn1ifsuXLm3VbX.png)</center>

Splinterlands just turned 8 years old and what a journey it has been. From the heights of SPS/Land launch, to the lows of post Chaos Legion. The road has been eventful along the way. Whether your new to Splinterlands or been with us from the beginning, I really feel like we all have a story to tell.

Splinterlands originally launched under the name Steem Monsters. The game opting to incorporate the name of the blockchain it was built on into the games name. Steem Monsters was the first game launched on Steem and was supported by the Steem community. For those of us that have been around since then, you would remember that before there was a game you could only buy packs. We had to hold them and hope for the best, putting all our faith in the developers, trusting that they would develop the game. 

Steem Monsters was launched and we got our first taste of what would become Splinterlands. With our Alpha cards in hand and a battle mode. We were able to battle against friends and others in the community. That was massive now that I think about it, as so many projects that came along later would rise and fall. Many of those games being fun to play, some offering massive payouts and others being on par with web 2 games.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/23uQELqt34191wdVZzziVUF34ZcKZR9kDDhacJyCyFaiBG14Gu717RVdpwJs4pT1eeXEc.png)

Splinterlands was destined to leave it's legacy chain as Steem was sold off and taken over by Justin Tron. This fractured the Steem community as Justin spoke about delisting Steem as a coin and making it a token on Tron blockchain. Due to this and other issues that the two sides could not agree upon. It led to Steem using a Hard Fork to break away from Steem and Becoming a new Blockchain called Hive. 

In a move that would have killed most games off Splinterlands successful changed chains and kept going. It would also see massive success when they launched Land seeing some strong sales all the way through. The first land plot allocation was a absolute buying frenzy with the plots selling out in seconds of coming up for sale. I was one of the people waiting for the doors to open only to miss out, it really was that fast.

![Praetoria.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/EoAYEa74iKTpZZrSYkbgeJihuUQxiDCWySduCQjnibZLVfWB2LGT7MwFKWeWpfVXDmY.png)

The other big event being SPS, the games government token, launching. All of a sudden Splinterlands was the name on everyones lips as the market exploded and people selling up their collection at this time were boasting about buying cars and homes with the money they made off the sales. As all good things though it led to a downward plunge shortly after as the market tried to correct as demand dried up. This all lead to Chaos Legion being over sold and the cards being worth very little. 

![chaos legion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/23t7DGPhfNcjJr7764yFezm5Phsigpkwm1xx1sU1kp4tM8T1o6TR2dgQhFwjnLnsHQnZE.png)

For most other projects I feel like this is where the story would have ended as layoff's followed in an attempt to reign the costs back in and even the CEO Aggroed could not avoid the cuts. With the CEO stepping many of us were worried the writing was on the wall and Splinterlands time was coming to an end. But @yabapmatt took over as CEO and made what I can only assume were some hard decisions to keep the company running. The community rallied and we put our faith behind @yabapmatt. And we were not disappointed, slowly Splinterlands has been turning it all around. Slowly building through a long running bear market, Splinterlands defied all odds and came out the other side stronger. 

![bonus for tier II .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/Eo1vvzYzts8zXu29NG2giaJwnE3aQS6DwEqqURcRqYffwfShEKHefYezh6cLXaNJvFm.png)

Rebellion undersold as this was a time when the game struggled to stay alive, but as chaos legion launched like a long forgotten ember caught by the wind just right, Splinterlands sparked back into life. Since then the game has just been going from strength to strength. Constant updates, the return of streamers and a more positive out look on the game have really changed the perception of Splinterlands I feel. While other games shut their doors and their communities are left with nothing, Splinterlands is thriving. Not only that but The Splinterlands DAO has even help those from games that have gone under get at least something back in the form of @splinterlands assest, hoping to show the world that crypto games may have a bad name due to a few bad apples, but there are still many games like Splinterlands that actually care about the community.

The last things that I wanted to point out was Matt stepping down and Dave becoming the current CEO of Splinterlands. This was a bit of a surprise for me, but a pleasant surprise as @davemacoy had been working with @yabapmatt for awhile now and @yabamatt had previously said that he took on the job to keep Splinterlands running and was never looking to be the CEO, but did not want to see the game die. Thank You @yabamatt for everything you have done for the game and it's community, we are blessed to have you. The other thing is that The DAO bought the IP address for the game from Splinterlands further decentralising the game and leading the way in Web 3 gaming player ownership.

![mickvir.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/23u5V1nGgxS7ti4uvpwwMrhdCoHm5p3kdaoofNCqDdJ6oAEymuf1w6i1Vhya2KAw26Lax.png)

I hope that you enjoyed my brief history of Splinterlands. Should you want to join please consider using my referral link: https://splinterlands.com/?ref=mickvir 

This post was posted on Hive Blockchain in the THGaming community. THGaming is a great community to join and post in if you enjoy games. Make sure to check out @thgaming. 
![THGaming logo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mickvir/23t74yQC5Yodeao7CXd1iRkaw995AMiEEtK6QsghZok1KA15VYxVfQ6FpDwb6RrjpiQFb.jpg)

body.title: Genus Henosepilachna | Small spotted Henosepilachna beetle sitting on a leaf
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNwqSzDZSiQ8jKxkeJT1ywG7GoRFLcgVbSwrzLSBpkEr/1779854907420.jpg)



| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ |
|     Genus Henosepilachna      |      May 26, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday afternoon, I saw this small Henosepilachna beetle on a green leaf, the insect was sparkling in the soft afternoon sunlight. The black spots spread over the light orange-pink body made this insect very attractive. When you look closely, it seemed as if nature had painted a small design with its own hands.

According to iNaturalist, this is a ladybird beetle of the genus Henosepilachna. Although it looks like a common ladybird, many of their species live by eating leaves. Their round bodies, small legs, and spotted shells easily catch the eye in nature.

When I was taking pictures, the insect was moving a lot, walking from side to side like curiosity. The pictures shared today seemed very alive to me, a unique beauty of nature that is truly worth enjoying. If I hadn't gone out to do macro photography in nature, I would never have seen such beautiful moments.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this insect below, I hope everyone will like it and enjoy it.

Me encanta cuando las ideas toman vida y volumen, especialmente si es para hacer que la educación sea más divertida. Hoy estuve trabajando en este lindo recurso didáctico en formato 3D para una clienta, enfocado en enseñar de manera interactiva qué son los recursos naturales. Cuidar cada relieve, los textos claros y los pequeños detalles ilustrados como el agua, los árboles y la tierra hace que abrir el material sea toda una sorpresa para los niños. Es hermoso ver cómo el diseño y el color se unen para recordarles a los más pequeños que el planeta nos da sus mejores regalos y que nos toca cuidarlos. ¡Amo el resultado de combinar tijeras, papel y mucha creatividad!

---

body.title: A Harvest That Teaches the Meaning of Togetherness
body.body:
![PSX_20260527_110422.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXoSA3mhrTd6CV5wtk1N56DuRjY3aw8PiJVMr7MhCPE4y/PSX_20260527_110422.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
Today, the rice fields were once again bustling with harvest activity. The previously green paddy fields were now turning golden, signifying that months of hard work had finally paid off. Under a slightly cloudy afternoon sky, we worked together to carry sacks of grain from the center of the rice fields to the storage area. Although it felt heavy, the sense of togetherness made everything feel lighter.

Every step along the rice field embankment seemed to remind us that good results never come instantly. It takes a lot of effort, time, and patience. Watching the sacks of grain begin to pile up gave me a sense of gratitude that's hard to describe. All the fatigue slowly paid off when the harvest began to appear before my eyes.

I also felt happy because moments like this weren't just about the agricultural produce, but also about unity. Many hands helped each other without complaint. Some lifted the sacks, others tidied up the harvest, and still others maintained their spirits amidst the heat and mud. This sense of togetherness always makes the harvest more memorable.

As the afternoon approached, the wind began to feel cooler and the sky became even more beautiful. I paused to enjoy the view of the vast rice fields, grateful for the smooth running of the day. Hopefully, this harvest will bring blessings and encourage us for the next planting season.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

body.title: Oil change & city walk
body.body:
Hey, I didn’t get out on my bike today because I bought a new electric bike and the Chinese seller ripped me off. I was supposed to get a genuine European model, but what arrived was much more powerful. I got up quite late today, but that didn’t stop me from changing the oil in the cars. I have two cars, so it took me about an hour and a half. In one of them, I had an unpleasant surprise – specifically, a rusty radiator and a coolant leak. >Hej, dzisiaj nie było rowerowo, gdyż zakupiłem nowy rower elektryczny, a chiński sprzedawca zrobił mnie w balon. Miał przyjść legalny europejski, a przyszedł o wiele mocniejszy. Wstałem dziś dosyć późno, ale nie powstrzymało mnie to przed wymianą olejów w autach. Mam 2 samochody, więc zajęło mi to z półtora godziny. W jednym spotkała mnie niemiła niespodzianka, a dokładniej zardzewiała chłodnica i ubytek płynu chłodniczego. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9570f573-676c-400b-917b-d27a19dbc908.jpg) I started my physical activity later. I managed to meet up with a friend with whom we’re slowly losing touch due to our busy schedules. We walked around our little town a bit; in fact, we walked almost the whole way round it. We had a good chat, so the time flew by. >Aktywność fizyczną zacząłem później. Udało mi się spotkać ze znajomym, z którym powoli tracimy kontakt przez natłok pracy. Pochodziliśmy trochę po naszym małym miasteczku, w sumie to nawet przeszliśmy je prawie całe. Rozmawiało się nawet dobrze, więc minęło to szybko. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/efef8307-9ccf-4fa4-b1b2-f7455b7c57f1.jpg) The weather was lovely, so I could walk around in short sleeves in the evening. I even managed to walk nearly 10,000 steps. The walk was good for me, but I’ve got exams and the end of my studies at the back of my mind. >Pogoda dopisała, więc mogłem wieczorem chodzić na krótki rękaw. Udało mi się zrobić nawet prawie 10 tysięcy kroków. Spacer był dla mnie dobry, ale z tyłu głowy mam egzaminy i koniec studiów. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8cd249e0-f04a-4b2c-9335-78529a1b14b0.jpg) Stress has been a constant companion of mine lately. It’s causing me trouble sleeping and constant headaches. I recently quit my job and am supporting myself for the time being, which is adding to my stress. I have certain investment plans to fulfil, which are constantly on my mind. >Stres ostatnio towarzyszy mi ciągle. Mam przez to problemy ze snem i ciągłe bóle głowy. Zwolniłem się niedawno z pracy i na chwilę utrzymuję się sam, co też mi dodaje stresu. Mam pewne plany inwestycyjne do spełnienia, które cały czas chodzą mi po głowie.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@mattsport/actifit-mattsport-20260527t040857613z)_

 <center>![Dark Blue Elegant 3d Illustration Geometric Learn Trading LinkedIn Banner_20250330_124734_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EoeDQzxM1SGG8LqXYo2qXvLmwwH3hFcVRwvaA6yn2xJbP35dAMJXKMysNWoBF9EaQtY.png)</center>




•✨️🌸I'm going to start by cutting all the pieces for my blouse: a back piece and a front piece divided into two parts, two sleeves, and a decorative braided hem. 

|![20260525_205720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23z7SNfRokCekEpeqfa2ejTw8bjrS9EdzTZQC564VSFRaSVwr2xZEuWX2eHbT1xzEa8Sw.jpg)|![20260525_205725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EprXRCMnNCcAFY5LDZ1mbFk22N1JA9iFccZJDWYAry4qJ1mcX4q1gSrFXuMQPfQ6LW4.jpg)|
|-|-|

•✨️🌸I'll continue by sewing the upper front piece along the bottom edge with a wide, straight stitch. Then, I'll pull the fabric to create pleats and sew this to the front piece with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch to secure it. 
|![20260525_212013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EpCCFMLuh6MDjet49jWtiqytnnj6vSZAnfMAdTxYhy99xLmgj5e35HnX7NWW8e8J4Fg.jpg)|![20260525_213037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/241tjrsSS8ZVYuycLe2G2x5X9aR8A4kGECmtvk5mjxhcQFdzAFPCBRm6zBFrFie9BwGLm.jpg)|![20260525_213536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/243ftuiNZtT1cQh6nSNBTBe5ViKcgPUU7CWM6BXiaNQtgMUZqVPgYjQG5xWg5KQRRtQkt.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


•✨️🌸I'm going to sew the ends together, joining the back and front pieces with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch to secure them. Then, I'll close the sleeves with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch. 

|![20260525_213817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EppNbEXoqz4GZjwvrW1BGXEPc5kYNA7XGsbg8VKS3twZokVXTzeuqmbEwmnLgCpbNDm.jpg)|![20260525_214344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Ensb386nogeAWMo9zvESBWvmS4kNxuw8Sinq5oyhC5C1PiHyLarCceQYvXtgFxwZMSk.jpg)|![20260525_214844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EouBfCYuKprSQf7VkgA9BkvR4cYBWuHX4vh1M4Zoaxg4tcu5Zm5W7yYp83Uz8kAtsC4.jpg)|![20260525_215502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/EqJ2FBQXHQFUFqwiDwCi7Cwihb87WcDWQS8HNMjTMeXHzxYNzgQ7NwKjCpytU5pXNgC.jpg)|
|-|-|-|-|

•✨️🌸I'm going to sew this sleeve to the body of the shirt with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch to secure it. Then, I'll proceed to sew the top edge by folding the fabric over and sewing it with a zigzag stitch. 
|![20260525_215607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/Eqb4TVwcftfvz4ZWiFNm8YDKkRrdVKjqgXPEkWPpeiQfowNtrgDrp3fMxxnDRpnYmzK.jpg)|![20260525_220026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23uR7778EbvXw4UqphtaJLgRZsnbUe7Yp3yuFCv5vVMrCgDBWMECPdW8wZXr3KYSEDLWR.jpg)|![20260525_220434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23wCQtCEWxnTofsa99GVWLM93C9KsZBYPc29jCPaB6Eosc5cUaqxoJY3J9NCWKwgPfopN.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


•✨️🌸I'm going to sew the hem and the edge of the sleeves by folding the fabric and sewing with a zigzag stitch, then I'll attach the elastic to the top and sleeves with a subtle straight stitch, and finally I'm going to sew the braid by folding the strip and sewing with a straight stitch to attach it to the front of the blouse.

|![20260525_221641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23xVTobpcVcsd4yNvYyorxMbyf4RzShSgrLhfbBwuZzUYJuKzBzXmeM5PKh1Hn7ySphpx.jpg)|![20260525_222025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23tc84xH1Yp9PxuLsvnWw5JVhUzoivqa2ojka9Brog4RfcR4KQwE7Bns3kVbvBbehWr4i.jpg)|![20260525_223034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23w2wvbaQcEjdCrkp2dxpMXHXasqFvnCdsX24iebg6F4CE7aroDYcbccZR9JSFD2DvZAs.jpg)|![20260525_223718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/selenediva/23uQtf1Gf1ACH3F1U4PtdaDRTBvsbxSqs49Ho5G8xoNCw1R35LWp8pNMhSfgAEoXNzkrP.jpg)|

In life, we all have goals and dreams that we want to achieve. However, we often find ourselves stuck in our routine, overlooking what really matters. This is where the basic idea comes into play: Main Goal. This isn't just another item on our to-do list. Rather, they are signs that guide our decisions, actions, and efforts toward clear, meaningful destinations.

Core goals are the main objectives that give meaning to our actions. It is what motivates us to wake up every morning with enthusiasm. It is what drives us to overcome obstacles. And what gives us satisfaction when we see the results of our work? It's not just about It's not just about \

but it's also about finding something that truly aligns with our personal values, passions, and objectives. For example, for some people, their primary objective may be to have a positive impact on their community. For others It could be creating a career that they are passionate about. Or they may devote time and energy to family. No matter what your main objective is. It has to be powerful enough to inspire you and keep you focused even in the toughest of times. Your main goal is more than just a simple goal. It is the engine that drives your actions and provides a deep sense of purpose. Identifying and working towards achieving goals can be a challenging process. But the results are worth every effort.

body.title: Pushed a bit too hard on a recent run and paid the price!
body.body: I normally make sure that my training or cardio is something that isn't too punishing.  This isn't supposed to hurt or be something that I dread. That is kind of the entire focus behind my training:  Do something that isn't going to make me not want to go back next time.  This is the advice I give to anyone that is thinking about getting back into or getting into training for the first time.  If you hate it, you aren't going to do it, so while I don't really expect very many people to \

running, it shouldn't be something that you loathe.

Well I don't know what got into me, but the other day it was extremely hot on the running path and I intentionally went at mid-day to dodge the crowds and I pushed it too hard because I am stubborn.  

<center> https://thumbs.dreamstime.com/b/sweaty-stick-figure-running-under-cloudy-sky-runs-sweating-profusely-pale-simple-clouds-appears-exhausted-386827979.jpg
[src](https://thumbs.dreamstime.com/b/sweaty-stick-figure-running-under-cloudy-sky-runs-sweating-profusely-pale-simple-clouds-appears-exhausted-386827979.jpg)</center>

Despite being an athlete of some sort almost my entire life I sweat in a way that could be called profusely when I exercise.  This was true even when I was an elite-level athlete in high school and it is just the way I am.  I have never had it checked out because I don't think there is anything that can be done about that.  My engine just runs hot.   There isn't really anything I can do about that especially in summer.  I can't stay in the shade but I suppose I could go running at night and run the risk of getting robbed of my phone in Chicago.  I suppose being chased by gang-bangers would probably get my heart rate up pretty high as well.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tRxbUmAkCe3wJVw2FUxzr1pQ41bF5nvMDyuXzdXM78qwHfSzwyX9PYtoeaF6wtFXgwG.png)
</center>

I'm cool with the calories and the time isn't an accurate representation of how fast I was moving because I left the watch on after the 5k was done.   The reason why I was pushing it was because I have been striving for sub 7 min kilometers and even though I wasn't specifically pushing it at the start, I did notice on one of my km's that I was below 7 per km, and well, I wanted to keep this going 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23uQCCVYCBqDNHVvUu2sTBKLwE1eTY92E19H4iFXWqG9sWcjsr85ZXzZ29Afbvg7cwvmf.png)
</center>

Just because I am trying to be a more relaxed exerciser doesn't mean that I don't feel pressure to perform.  I really wanted to finish in under 35 minutes for the full 5K and I managed to do so.  But at what cost?

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23t74yNuu2xiQ2U67pmnDgoWnqbo1tNGVfXX4J4Pckf8qG2Uu5SNdRwDvUnDYCy9UDm9c.png)
</center>

To say that my engine was running hot would be an understatement.  When I finally hit the 5k mark I stopped to a walk immediately.  My heart was pounding and despite not wearing a shirt I was just dripping.   I also felt a little bit light headed.  I quickly ran out of water and cooling off in that sun was not an option.  Towards the end where I could almost see my house I started jogging again because I just wanted to get out of the heat.  I skipped my post run stretches that I normally do outside my house and instead went straight inside and got in a cold shower.  I stayed in there a long time and my heart rate stayed high and as soon as I got out of the shower I immediately started sweating again even though I was in front of a fan and my apartment is quite cool

This is my body's way, I think, of telling me that I am over-working it.   It took me about an hour afterwards with a ice pack on my head, a cold drink in my hand, and a fan pointing right at me to return to a normal body temperature and a normal resting heart rate.  It doesn't feel healthy when I am sitting on the sofa and my heart rate is in danger of hitting zone 3 even though I am not moving.  

So I guess this is a lesson to be learned.  This was NOT a relaxing run at all and I let my ambition get the best of me.  I really do want to get to a 30 min 5k but perhaps the dead heat of the afternoon during summer in an area with almost zero shade is not the right place to do this.   

I sometimes go into beast mode and try to mentally trick myself into digging deep in these situations but I don't know if the aftermath is really worth the cost.  I could be damaging myself actually.   I do know I am not looking forward to trying that again and maybe I should stop being an idiot and be more careful with how I choose to exercise.  

I am a stubborn athlete and I don't like to be told what I can't do.  But maybe I should listen a bit because that recovery time was too long.  It shouldn't take an hour to return to a normal body temperature.

body.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Me gusta esta actividad es super relajante, algunos de mis marca libros, me los piden de obsequio, otros los colecciono, disfruto repasarlos como barajitas, como procuro sean todos de la misma estética y tamaño, me recuerda en los 90's y la fiebre que tenía por coleccionar tarjetas, almanaques, tazos, barajitas, todo lo que se podía coleccionar, siempre fui amante de ello y guardarlo en una caja de recuerdos. Hoy hice estos dos diseños que espero te gusten, intento sean más artísticos en realicen a dibujar y que se vean más hecho a mano

> [Eng] Hello, everyone! I love this activity—it’s so relaxing. Some of my bookmarks are given as gifts, while others I collect. I enjoy flipping through them like trading cards; I try to make sure they all have the same style and size. It reminds me of the ’90s and my obsession with collecting cards, calendars, T-shirts, trading cards, anything you could collect. I’ve always loved doing that and keeping them in a keepsake box. Today I made these two designs that I hope you’ll like. I try to make them more artistic by drawing them so they look more handmade. ---

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNeYJQmyScbuBCJ3NdbGnaWxiRwv4PPz7adg7gTP5WJw8/IMG_0057.png 

One of the reasons I love traveling so much is that every destination has its own charm.

Sometimes it's a famous landmark, and sometimes it's a quiet corner filled with plants, old architecture, and a peaceful atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer. Today was one of those moments.

I found myself walking through this beautiful place, surrounded by nature and timeless details. It felt like stepping into another world, far away from deadlines, worries, and everyday routines.

Traveling reminds me that there is beauty everywhere if we take the time to notice it. A different street, a hidden garden, a historic building, or simply a calm afternoon can completely change the way we feel.

Moments like these are why I keep exploring. There is always something new waiting to be discovered, and every journey leaves a small piece of itself with us. ✨

body.title: Over Hallwilersee

body.title: 🎯 La Precisión no es Casualidad: SMC, Fibonacci y Confluencia en el NAS100
body.body:
¿Alguna vez has sentido que el mercado te 'caza' justo antes de explotar en la dirección correcta? No eres tú; es el algoritmo. Esta operación en el NAS100 que ves en la captura de pantalla es el ejemplo perfecto de cómo el Smart Money Concepts (SMC) y Fibonacci convergen para darnos entradas de alta probabilidad.

Así es como lo estructuré: Delimitación de Sesiones: El primer rectángulo define la liquidez de la sesión de Asia. Es una 'piscina de liquidez' que los algoritmos institucionales suelen limpiar antes de su verdadero movimiento. Confirmación SMC: Tras la ruptura estructural alcista, esperé pacientemente el retroceso

3:La Confluencia Maestra (El POI): Identifiqué mi Punto de Interés (la zona turquesa de demanda en la base de la operación). ¿Qué lo hizo tan fuerte? Que confluía exactamente con el nivel 0.618 de Fibonacci. La Reacción: Al tocar el nivel 61.8 y el POI, el precio reaccionó con una vela de absorción perfecta. Esa fue mi confirmación

body.title: 26 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3115: use the soap
body.body:
/>

“But see, by this time, we should really know that if we tell Milton anything, he needs specifics.”

This was how eleven-year-old Velma Trent compassionately prepared her parents, Sgt. Vincent and Mrs. Melissa Trent, for what they were about to see, stemming from the order to “use the soap” not being bounded by specifics.

“Hey – did y'all know what you can do with a bathtub, some soda, the right mints, and soap, although I have to say the hand soap we use is bit weak and so I had to run this bath again but I washed it all that down already and started over with our dish soap and look at this THICC bubble bath! I need to market this!”

“Hello, Captain Hamilton?” nine-year-old Vertran Stepforth was saying on the phone from the next room as Mrs. Trent's scream of surprise rang through the Trent home. “Hi, this is Vertran over at the Trent house catty-corner across the field from your home – you know how you gave my brother asylum when he blew up my family's kitchen? I'mma need you to come do a pickup for my cousin Milton.”

“Ain't it the truth – and please hurry!” eight-year-old Gracie Trent said.

Having heard Mrs. Trent's scream, the older Trent offspring 18-year-old Vanna and 21-year-old Melvin broke into a run toward home and noted that their lithe paternal grandmother, Mrs. Gladys Jubilee Trent, kept up with them.

“But this is why you young people gotta keep your lives together because I can't do that every day,” she said as they pulled up and realized what was actually going on because the conversation, at some volume, was continuing.

“Parents do not know everything because I've been saying this: there's no point in giving Milton chores,” Vanna said. “You have to do chores with Milton, because if you leave him alone with his imagination and household chemicals, he will snatch the property value clear up out of your house.”

“Forget Capt. Hamilton – GRANDMA!” Gracie, Velma, and Vertran said as they came running out of the house.

“They gonna kill him this time for sure!” Vertran said.

“Ain't nobody doing all that,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said, and just walked into the house … and shortly afterward, things quieted down.

“The power of a good grandma,” six-year-old Grayson Ludlow said from two houses down as he looked through the window. “We don't know what all that was about, and now we don't need to know.”

“Yeah,” seven-year-old Amanda said as she snuggled back into Mrs. Thalia Ludlow, her and Grayson's grandmother.

“What do you mean yeah – and what do you mean I can't go check it out with you, Papa?” eight-year-old Edwina said as she was doggedly following Capt. R.E. Ludlow to the porch. “Why you gotta get all the juicy action, and I gotta stay here and can't even get close enough to quality eavesdrop?”

“Hello, Capt. R.E. Ludlow speaking,” he said as he picked up his phone. “Mrs. Jubilee Trent – good morning. I was just on my way over. Can I be of any assistance? … Milton did _what now?_ … well, the boy will be ready to study industrial chemistry in college on a full scholarship by the time he gets out of being grounded.”

body.title: Quiet Fixes, Loud Progress
body.body:
Things are moving along well, I'm glad to report. We are going through a transitional period with @mantequilla-soft and, by proxy, @threespeak. It seems like some hard decisions cannot be postponed anymore, but I suspect things are going to work out just fine in the end.


![5f171b6c-20df-4d64-80b7-494aed5d39fd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23tGW1beub9B7iSkAMNPftceATidt31JGMCfWHsFRUo9343q7NMsWCR239FwsJaCichK8.png)


I am a little sad, I admit, at the possibility that @snapie's witness might have to shut down. This is not a decision I've made just yet, but tightening the belt is part of the survival game. I guess when it's all said and done, math will dictate the outcome. But I'm not going to lie, the mere possibility already feels bad.

At any rate, I'm working hard with @tibfox on getting the internal guts of @threespeak rearranged, so to speak. We hit some important milestones today, and that's enough reason to celebrate. A new instance of MongoDB, a backup, and a reassignment of the primary copy all happened without much of a hiccup. Restarting @threespeak services took some hit and miss attempts, but we seem to be up and running well at the moment.

A new update on the Threespeak Encoder has also been deployed. An edge case became so common that I was finally able to get my hands on a raw file before it got deleted. Turns out people upload videos with no audio quite a bit, and the solution is to add a silent track. Who knew? The encoders, at least the ones I operate, are now running the new code, and videos without audio should work from now on.

I hope in the coming days to announce yet another relaunch of @threespeak. This time, it's not only about the new features, which I think are going to surprise a lot of people, but also because we are being forced to migrate away from Vercel. An operational cost we can't delay addressing much longer.

I trust that as long as we put in the work, much of the ordeals and challenges we'll face during this transition will remain completely transparent to users. Or at least, that's my hope.

MenO

body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQGVC1U6BMNh339TKKks3GgGnoEiXJTSrKiizEaXW71hJHVpKUTgsNuvptB7Bm4onjo.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 27.05.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tvAs7hNUB6x9KxGAoRuZvBCGZ85YeW6JEcb65aE36ZPYU6RUbLzzz1eocRMJsK6hu5h.jpg)

-----

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Alarm BRAVO-CRP w polskiej cyberprzestrzeni przedłużony do 31 sierpnia 2026***

Rząd przedłużył obowiązywanie stopnia alarmowego BRAVO-CRP (drugi z czterech stopni systemu alertowego) dla polskiej cyberprzestrzeni do 31 sierpnia 2026 roku. BRAVO-CRP oznacza podwyższoną czujność i gotowość służb odpowiedzialnych za bezpieczeństwo infrastruktury krytycznej, szpitali, systemów telekomunikacyjnych i energetyki. Decyzja jest bezpośrednią konsekwencją utrzymującego się nasilonego poziomu zagrożeń ze strony aktorów powiązanych z Rosją i Białorusią — zwłaszcza grup takich jak UNC1151 i FrostyNeighbor aktywnie uderzających w polskie instytucje. Przedłużenie alertu zobowiązuje administratorów systemów w sektorach kluczowych do utrzymania wzmożonych procedur monitoringu i reagowania.

https://crn.pl/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Stopnie-alarmowe-CRP.jpg

*Źródło: [CRN.pl](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/alarm-w-polskiej-cyberprzestrzeni-przedluzony-do-31-sierpnia-bravo-crp/) [PL]*

---

### ***Nowe szczegóły ZUS/e-Zdrowie: badacz mógł też wystawiać recepty i wnioskować o świadczenia***

W uzupełnieniu do wczorajszego przełomowego ujawnienia podatności CVE-2026-9058 (opisanego w poprzednim wydaniu), CyberDefence24 informuje o kolejnym wymiaru luki: badacz Michał Leszczyński potwierdził, że możliwości ataku nie kończyły się na odczycie danych — podatne systemy umożliwiały też aktywne działania w imieniu ofiary, w tym wystawianie recept przez system PRS (Platforma Realizacji Świadczeń) i składanie wniosków o świadczenia w ZUS. Oznacza to, że atakujący znając jedynie imię, nazwisko i PESEL ofiary, mógł potencjalnie wystawić receptę na silne leki na jej nazwisko, złożyć wniosek o zasiłek lub zmienić dane ubezpieczenia. Skala zagrożenia jest tym samym dramatycznie większa, niż sugerowało samo \

.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tvCerqRuubv1L5yQLmmeR5momjdo9HqqZoe6dSCwGMCRKDc9AdcTrR4RMF2BGCU9cJD.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/badacz-mogl-logowac-sie-na-konta-w-zus-i-wystawiac-recepty) [PL]*

---

### ***Apple udostępnia PQ3 jako open source — post-kwantowe szyfrowanie dla całego internetu***

Apple ogłosiło otwarcie kodu źródłowego protokołu PQ3 — zaawansowanego algorytmu kryptograficznego odpornego na ataki komputerów kwantowych, używanego dotychczas wyłącznie w iMessage. Udostępnienie go jako projektu open source pozwoli innym platformom komunikacyjnym i programistom na wdrożenie tego samego poziomu ochrony. Kryptografia post-kwantowa chroni przed scenariuszem \

— gdy komputery kwantowe osiągną odpowiednią moc, mogą potencjalnie złamać tradycyjne szyfrowanie RSA i ECC stosowane dziś powszechnie. PQ3 łączy tradycyjne metody z nowymi algorytmami NIST — co sprawia, że jest odporny na ataki zarówno klasyczne, jak i kwantowe.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tmDV8deoABAmWm3o4urfbEXzxaKtKiTm2DgQjabS9QKTT3Gu3wpZhQYcW1FhTiHmP5q.png)

*Źródło: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/apple-open-source-quantum-resistant-encryption/) [EN]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Charter Communications (Spectrum) potwierdza wyciek danych — kolejna ofiara ShinyHunters***

Charter Communications — jeden z największych dostawców telewizji kablowej i internetu w USA działający pod marką Spectrum — potwierdziło, że szantaż ShinyHunters jest uzasadniony i doszło do wycieku danych klientów. Firma prowadzi śledztwo i nie ujawniła dotąd pełnego zakresu incydentu. ShinyHunters od początku 2026 roku odpowiadają za imponującą serię wycieków: Medtronic, Udemy, Zara, 7-Eleven, Vimeo, Canvas/Instructure — i teraz Spectrum. Seria ataków tej grupy wskazuje na systematyczne, zautomatyzowane podejście do identyfikowania i eksploitowania podatności w dużych organizacjach komercyjnych.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u5X5uK8vYqptDCbWC2fBYdZ1My9HXcTjKnkqqJFdmRfjumRZHmqSgdFQpp8hfRo2d3n.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/charter-confirms-data-breach-after-shinyhunters-extortion-threat/) [EN]*

---

### ***Fałszywe instalatory Claude i Gemini przez SEO poisoning — deweloperzy na celowniku***

Hackread opisuje aktywną kampanię SEO poisoning, w której hakerzy pozycjonują złośliwe strony na czele wyników wyszukiwania dla zapytań \
i podobnych. Strony wyglądają profesjonalnie i kuszą deweloperów \

. Po pobraniu instalatora ofiara otrzymuje trojana — najczęściej RedLine Stealer lub Vidar — który kradnie tokeny deweloperskie, klucze API, portfele kryptograficzne i dane z przeglądarek. Kampania kontynuuje trend z maja 2026: złośliwi aktorzy konsekwentnie atakują deweloperów przez narzędzia, z których zawodowo korzystają — JDownloader, VS Code extensions, Claude Code.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tRxSK1tWtLXpdSwgBGTCmnHF2ncuwxni8X38ZJDQsmCmNrVUZvctYe6gbc5b2U5qTjk.png)

*Źródło: [Hackread](https://hackread.com/trojan-gemini-claude-installers-developers-seo-poisoning/) [EN]*

---

### ***BTMob — nowy Android RAT dostępny jako usługa z interfejsem buildera dla każdego***

Infosecurity Magazine opisuje BTMob — nowego trojana bankowego na Androida dostępnego jako Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) z interfejsem buildera, który pozwala nawet osobom bez wiedzy programistycznej tworzyć spersonalizowane warianty złośliwego oprogramowania. BTMob potrafi przechwytywać SMS-y z kodami 2FA, nakładać fałszywe okna na aplikacje bankowe, nagrywać ekran i przekazywać pełną kontrolę nad urządzeniem zdalnemu atakującemu. Platforma MaaS oferuje subskrypcje miesięczne z obietnicą regularnych aktualizacji omijających nowe mechanizmy obronne. Rosnące ekosystemy MaaS bankowego malware na Androidzie są bezpośrednią odpowiedzią na upowszechnienie bankowości mobilnej.

https://assets.infosecurity-magazine.com/webpage/feat/c3b017cc-33e1-4422-b3f1-d8de8b8fd9bd.jpg

*Źródło: [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/btmob-android-rat-maas-builder/) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***Microsoft Defender automatycznie izoluje zhakowane endpointy — koniec z oczekiwaniem na SOC***

Microsoft ogłosił nową funkcję w Defender for Endpoint: automatyczną izolację skompromitowanych urządzeń bez konieczności interwencji analityka. Gdy Defender wykryje aktywne naruszenie bezpieczeństwa (ransomware, lateral movement, C2 communication), natychmiast odcina zainfekowany endpoint od sieci — blokując dostęp do zasobów firmowych, ale zachowując połączenie z platformą zarządzania Microsoft. W tradycyjnym modelu czekanie na decyzję SOC-u często oznaczało minuty lub godziny, w których malware rozprzestrzeniał się po sieci. Automatyczna izolacja skraca to okno do sekund. Funkcja jest konfigurowalna — organizacje mogą dostosować progi i wyjątki.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23x1KxjL9Vt5NY2vDFVeUsyT3AMBJsk1F56DkN2PMSX1mjgnyGupf8vyRkJTCFdK6NZTg.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-defender-can-now-automatically-isolate-hacked-endpoints/) [EN]*

---

### ***Indie: CERT-IN wprowadza obowiązek łatania systemów AI w ciągu 12 godzin***

Indyjski CERT-IN (Computer Emergency Response Team India) opublikował dyrektywę nakładającą na dostawców systemów AI w Indiach obowiązek wdrożenia łatek dla krytycznych podatności w ciągu zaledwie 12 godzin od ich ujawnienia. To jeden z najkrótszych terminów na łatanie podatności na świecie — dla porównania CISA daje agencjom federalnym USA zazwyczaj 14 lub 21 dni. Decyzja Indii ma kontekst geopolityczny: kraj ten przeżywa gwałtowny wzrost adopcji AI w sektorze finansowym i rządowym, a niedawne incydenty cybernetyczne zmusiły regulatora do zdecydowanej odpowiedzi. Branżowi eksperci pytają, czy 12 godzin jest realnym terminem dla złożonych systemów produkcyjnych.

https://assets.infosecurity-magazine.com/webpage/feat/5eca16f7-0a9f-4f8c-bfed-a9b18fea1885.jpg

*Źródło: [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/cert-in-12-hour-patch-deadline-ai/) [EN]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Deno RAT na GitHubie i SourceForge — zaufane repozytoria jako wektor dystrybucji malware***

Malwarebytes opisuje kampanię, w której przestępcy umieścili złośliwe narzędzia deweloperskie na GitHubie i SourceForge — dwóch platformach cieszących się bardzo wysokim poziomem zaufania wśród programistów. Spreparowane repozytoria wyglądają jak legalny projekt open source z dokumentacją, commitami i gwiazdkami (sztucznie zawyżonymi). Po zainstalowaniu uruchamiają Deno RAT — backdoor zbudowany na środowisku uruchomieniowym Deno (TypeScript/JavaScript), dający atakującym pełną kontrolę zdalną. Kampania skutecznie omija wiele systemów detekcji, bo Deno jest legalnym i popularnym narzędziem deweloperskim — uruchomienie go przez antywirus wygląda normalnie.

https://www.malwarebytes.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/05/threat-intel-header-wolf-in-sheeps-clothing.jpg

*Źródło: [Malwarebytes](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/threat-intel/2026/05/fake-software-on-github-and-sourceforge-distribute-deno-rat) [EN]*

---

### ***Oszuści \

mieli wsparcie prawdziwych dyrektorów korporacyjnych — skandal wewnętrzny***\n\nMalwarebytes opisuje sprawę bulwersującą branżę: kampania vishingowa podszywająca się pod Microsoft wsparcie techniczne nie działała sama — badacze odkryli, że przestępcy korzystali z pomocy prawdziwych dyrektorów IT i compliance z zaatakowanych organizacji, którzy czerpali finansowe korzyści za ciche uwierzytelnianie fałszywych połączeń. Schemat działał tak: ofiara dzwoniła do \
(fałszywy numer), a w tle ktoś wewnątrz organizacji potwierdzał tożsamość \

i nakłaniał do wykonania instrukcji. To ekstremalny przykład zagrożenia insider threat łączącego się z zewnętrzną kampanią przestępczą. Winni wewnętrzni mają teraz zarzuty karne.

## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА

### ***Polskie samorządy pod presją cyberataków — ministerstwo odpowiada na interpelację, zidentyfikowano jedną z grup***

Wiceminister Cyfryzacji Paweł Olszewski udzielił pisemnej odpowiedzi na interpelację posłanki Urszuli Pasławskiej z kwietnia 2026 roku dotyczącą cyberbezpieczeństwa polskich samorządów. Kluczowe ustalenie: organy ścigania i służby specjalne zidentyfikowały jedną z grup odpowiedzialnych za ataki ransomware na polskie urzędy gminne — choć szczegóły atrybucji pozostają niejawne. Ministerstwo przyznaje, że budżety IT samorządów są niewystarczające i zapowiada program wsparcia dla jednostek samorządu terytorialnego. Tymczasem od początku 2026 roku zaatakowanych ransomwarem zostało już co najmniej 14 polskich gmin i powiatów.

Nowe szczegóły głośnego ataku na ukraiński telecom Kyivstar z grudnia 2023 roku, który odciął od internetu ponad 24 miliony Ukraińców na kilka dni: szef ukraińskiej grupy hakerskiej powiązanej ze służbami twierdzi, że rosyjskie GRU opłaciło pracownika Kyivstar, który z wewnątrz udostępnił dostęp niezbędny do przeprowadzenia ataku. i wyjątkowo głęboki — był trudny do wyjaśnienia bez współpracy kogoś wewnątrz systemu. Kyivstar oficjalnie nigdy nie potwierdziło tej teorii. body.title: 「生活」小小红领巾
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![GC66BgROoaYSrEIm_IMG_7290.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/GC66BgROoaYSrEIm_IMG_7290/GC66BgROoaYSrEIm_IMG_7290.webp)
![d2zDN0Tqe5mwNMwF_IMG_7523.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/d2zDN0Tqe5mwNMwF_IMG_7523/d2zDN0Tqe5mwNMwF_IMG_7523.webp)
![8ZUy3pHMhjU7QArm_55.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/8ZUy3pHMhjU7QArm_55/8ZUy3pHMhjU7QArm_55.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

说起红领巾，我始终有着特别的感触。刚进入小学那会儿，我格外羡慕那些戴上红领巾的同学。在我们的认知里，红领巾是革命先烈用鲜血染红的，每次望见它，便会想起先辈们保家卫国的身影。

戴上红领巾，就意味着肩负起那份神圣的责任与使命，能够入选成为少先队员、佩戴上红领巾，在那时是一份十足的光荣。记得大概在三四年级时，我有幸入选红领巾广播站。每到午休时段，我都会前往学校一楼的行政办公室进行播音，这段经历至今仍历历在目。

如今Sheya也踏入了小学校园。有一次，我去接她时，她好奇地问我，为什么高年级的哥哥姐姐都戴着红领巾，自己却没有。我给她讲解之后，她满心羡慕，总盼着早日成为一名少先队员。学校会在每年六一儿童节举行入队仪式，一般安排在一年级下学期，不同学校的安排会略有不同。

当然，班里并不是每位同学都能成为第一批少先队员，毕竟名额有限。我常常开导她，不必执着于第一批入队，早晚都会戴上红领巾。就算这次没能选上也不用失落，那就再踏实努力一点，争取下一批入选。我提前和她讲明这些，就是怕她落选后心里难过。

我客观评价一下Sheya，她的学习成绩在班里处于中等水平，理解和思维能力一般，当时也可能是因为她年纪小的缘故，要今年八月中旬才满7岁。鉴于首批入队名额有限，老师自然会优先挑选成绩突出的孩子。不过她的行为习惯很好，待人真诚，和同学友好相处，也十分敬重老师。

或许正因如此，她最终成功入选，成为了第一批戴上红领巾的孩子。昨天下午一到家，她就迫不及待地跟我分享好消息，说自己入选少先队员了，老师还让她填写了入队申请表，也教他们如何佩戴，为下周一的入队仪式做准备。

我打心底里为她感到高兴，在收拾她书包的时候，我又无意间看到她的那个记作业的小本子上工整地写了一句话：我是少先队员！就光是这一句话我都能感受到她当下的喜悦。

---

I questioned the man at the counter in our town……….. “If I wait till then, I will be driving on an expired license!”🙄 “Yep……. don’t have an accident!”☺️ I had just received notification that I needed to renew “In Person” and no appointments were open before my B’day. They did not allow ample notice of the in person appointment requirement !🤔 Silvertop was being backed into a corner, not of his making, with no way to get out, or any way to fix this problem!🙄 “Liz, I guess we take a chance and drive to the next town, and “Hope” they will take me today!😮 We arrived in Mt Vernon at approximately 10:30 AM and sat…………and sat! Two hours later, they finally called me up front, Silvertop was stressed!😅 “Look into the viewfinder sir and tell me what you can read!” “Miss, I just received a new eyeglass prescription and my eyesight has improved!” “You still need to read the chart sir!”🤔 OK……………😇 Silvertop tried without his glasses that he has been required to wear since he started driving at age 16! Three blocks of letters were in the viewer……. I read the left block, I looked closer at the second block and read all the letters. The third block I could not read.🙄 “Sir this is your paper temporary license. Your permanent one will be mailed to you.” “Liz…. I passed “WITHOUT” glasses!”🤗😍 Silvertop was ecstatic, for the first time since I was 16 years old, I did not need to wear my glasses to drive!☺️ “Silvertop you have approximately 20/40 vision without glasses, that is within the legal requirements!”🥰 “Awesome honey, I feel FREE!”💪🤗 Liz do you want me to drive to Starbucks, “Without” my glasses Lol?”😇 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

body.title: DePIN Spotlight: Idle Protocol - Earn USDC By Lending Your Computer To AI Agents
body.body:
In today's article, we'll briefly cover **Idle Protocol,** an interesting Solana-based project that that turns your idle computing resources (CPU, GPU, bandwidth) into publicly accessible API endpoints, which can be used by AI agents for tasks such as AI inference, web scraping, and DNS queries. 

In return, you receive a steady stream of USDC stablecoins.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWEhtwbGSx4hJT8VqQo8TLeYbQ5LzypK3YTyyrZH75Ttb/idle_agent_computer.jpg

# Coinbase's x402 Protocol

All tasks completed via Idle Protocol are run through the **x402 payment protocol**.

Coinbase developed x402 so that AI agents would have a standard way to exchange value with one another. It originally launched on Base, but has since been integrated into Solana as well.

Even though x402 transaction volume spiked and crashed at the end of 2025, [it has been gradually recovering.](https://www.x402scan.com/) This boom-and-correction pattern is a common with new tech as initial excitement gives way to more organic growth.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYrfms6pxHoH8BFCjR9qVNShi4mfLFdpoGW3r77LrxprL/x402_stats.png

Given the efficiencies of *agentic commerce*, we can safely assume that the number of AI agents will rise as time goes on, and there are plenty of projects like Idle Protocol preparing for this new crypto-powered, agentic economy. 

# Idle's Network Growth

The Idle network has been growing on multiple fronts.

The number of nodes participating in the Idle network has been on the rise, climbing from [a few thousand](https://x.com/IdleProtocol/status/2056762168461119955) in mid-May to [roughly 70,000](https://x.com/idle__protocol/status/2058632274757779711) within a couple of weeks.

Idle Protocol has announced partnerships with [Grass](https://x.com/IdleProtocol/status/2055408869434671482), [Nodepay](https://x.com/IdleProtocol/status/2055708228864905515), [Ray Distributed](https://x.com/study0718/status/2056977472172982553) and more, enabling multi-network earning for nodes on the network.

They also recently announced [mobile support](https://x.com/IdleProtocol/status/2059367725965705726) with their Progressive Web App (PWA), allowing your smartphone to earn USDC while serving resources to AI agents.

# X Hack

Last week, [Idle Protocol had their X account compromised](https://x.com/IdleProtocol/status/2059337242041295140?s=20) via a SIM hack, causing the token price to suddenly collapse. Some users claimed the project was a scam due to the spam posted by the attacker.

Despite the setback, the project pushed forward with an alternative X account until the original one was restored. Although the on-chain network itself remained unaffected, some users who fell for the phishing attempt did lose assets in their Solana wallets.

This serves as a reminder to always exercise caution when you see unannounced airdrops on social media such as X or Discord. 

# Tokenomics

The IDLE token has a fixed maximum supply of 1 billion tokens. As of late May 2026, roughly 895 million tokens are in circulation (104 million tokens have already been burned).

What drives value to the token?

15% of all USDC payments is collected as a protocol fee. 10% is used every hour to buy IDLE on the open market and burn it, while the other 5% funds development. This puts deflationary pressure on the token.

# Until next time...

Considering the rapid growth and expanding partnerships, Idle Protocol looks like a promising project.

That said, remember that *none of this is financial advice*. Promising projects can collapse in a heartbeat, especially those with low market caps. Know the risks, and do your own research before getting involved.

If you learned something new from this article, be sure to [check out my other posts](https://inleo.io/profile/brennanhm/blog) on crypto and finance here on [the Hive blockchain](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/how-to-monetize-your-content-on-the-hive-blockchain). You can also follow me on [X](https://x.com/brennanhm) or [InLeo](https://inleo.io/profile/brennanhm) for more frequent updates.

body.title: 财富在谁的手里
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![qYjaqSThLg2DtQIt_ScreenShot_2026-05-27_114019_581.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/qYjaqSThLg2DtQIt_ScreenShot_2026-05-27_114019_581/qYjaqSThLg2DtQIt_ScreenShot_2026-05-27_114019_581.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我觉得成年人在这个社会混了这么多年，应该懂得一些社会的运行逻辑了，或者说一些社会的规则，潜规则。

好多这些东西是自己撞过墙才明白的道理。如果，一个中年人不知道这些，可能越活越不通透，往外坏里发展可能发展为一个愤世嫉俗，常常怀才不遇，或者悔恨当初的人。

啰嗦了这么多，其实是想分享最近在万维钢那边获得一个概念：赚钱的秘密其实是经济租。

谁可以获得最大的财富，不是由你多么的辛苦和投入了多少劳动时间决定，也不是说完全有需求决定。而是由一个卡位了资源的人决定的。

就像一条河，谁掌握了过河的桥，谁就是财富最大的人。就是收租了。

社会中有很多隐形的租。

为什么你身边有些人专业能力不行，但是别人能在领导位置？也许他卡位了一个重要领导的关系，他是关系的中间环节。卖东西，拿到独家运营权，拿到拍照，拿到专利就你能卖，这些都是租。

你拥有一个别人没有的东西，这东西别人看见了也学不会拿不走的，这就是你的经济租。比如，土地、证书、独家的信息、关系、声望、接口、配套...等等这些都可以有租。

这么看，好像作为一个普通人，没什么经济租。也确实如此，我发现这概念好像更适合富人玩。

不过作为一个普通人，倒是可以理解其中的原理，也不会再问，这么辛苦为什么赚大钱的不是自己。

body.title: Are EV cars worthwhile?
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/edffa353-62d9-4193-986f-1a96c4eaf320.jpg) BYD seems to be flooding the Australian car market with cheap new electric cars. We went to have a look at some in our local showroom. It is very tempting to get one now, we have solar and a battery at home. It could mean never having to pay for fuel again. The Atto 1 pictured is $25,000 drive away, which is even cheaper than a second hand one a couple of years old. I could probably just sell my existing car for that and just be winning $ wise on fuel and maintenance straight away. It would come with limitations, though the battery range is only 200km in perfect conditions, the 30k upgrade will get 300km. Real world driving with hills and traffic seems to drop these number a fair bit and wear and tear on batteries would probably reduce things more year by year as well. I have heard the technology is better than in my power tools, but l have had to dispose of many dead batteries over the years. I would lose a lot of space, the ability to tow and go off road as well. I do less and less with my big old diesel Toyota as I get older, but I just don't think I am quite ready yet to change to an EV yet. Fitness wise, it was some speed work running along the bike path and an afternoon stroll. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ab0dce8e-fc6e-4f7c-abc5-430537cb0de2.jpg)
