body.title: My paradise, where I feel at peace 🏡🌊🕊️
body.body: > Greetings, my dear Ladies of Hive. I hope you are all doing very well and enjoying good health and well-being. I’m back in the community to participate in the 290th edition of the contest that our beloved Ladies of Hive invite us to join every week. This time, I’ll be answering one of the questions posed by our friend @saffisara: 1️⃣ What is your favorite safe haven to relax in, and why? My favorite safe haven will always be my house—the place I’ve made my home. It doesn’t matter where I am, because for me, a true refuge has more to do with the sense of peace and tranquility I manage to create in a space. I must also admit that my dream haven would be a simple, cozy little house full of light—if not right on the beach, then at least very close to it. I’ve always felt that the sound of the waves, the breeze, and that vast blue expanse have something deeply healing about them.

> Saludos, mis queridas Damas de Hive. Espero que se encuentren muy bien con abundante salud y bienestar. Estoy de vuelta por la comunidad para participar en la edición #290 del concurso al que nos invitan, semanalmente, las estimadas Damas de Hive. En esta ocasión, daré respuesta a una de las preguntas que nos ha propuesto la amiga @saffisara: 1️⃣ ¿Cuál es tu paraíso seguro favorito para relajarte y por qué? Mi paraíso seguro favorito siempre será mi casa, el lugar que haya convertido en mi hogar. No importa dónde esté, porque para mí el verdadero refugio tiene más que ver con la sensación de paz y tranquilidad que logro construir en un espacio. También debo admitir que mi paraíso soñado sería una casita sencilla, acogedora y llena de luz, si no justo frente al mar, al menos muy cerca de él. Siempre he sentido que el sonido de las olas, la brisa y esa inmensidad azul tienen algo profundamente sanador. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tRvSEWHKkL5Vss4dcr91BuqjNes2xKhSdihd8ku4GsGAqRJCXaCoHYt9rXCSYoaPMYG.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/Eou9kMeDFXn5rrLSc8Nf96VSgUKJsmyGgqrZLbYgpGuPjnqMRdaTEiVj9RJ3BWmr5bT.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/EoiUoFdtiAWXCEr1arZKUXvfWYbkb9kJLTw35gPYXXwmmu5tjyfxyeeC88b4Vno4ukk.png| |--|--| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tRvSEWHKkL5Vss4dcr91BuqjNes2xKhSdihd8ku4GsGAqRJCXaCoHYt9rZ8uUptztfr.png)

> Even so, I’ve learned that often the little moments can feel like paradise too. Sometimes all it takes is a cup of hot coffee, a quiet afternoon, and a cozy corner where I can sit and think while the world goes on. I really enjoy cozy spaces, especially cafés where soft music plays and the atmosphere invites you to stay a little longer. Another of my favorite havens—and most of my loved ones know this—is knitting and embroidery. There’s something deeply therapeutic about creating with my hands. In those moments, I feel my mind rest and my heart find balance. It’s as if time slows down and treats me gently. Definitely, my safe haven is anything that allows me to feel tranquility, inspiration, and connection with myself—and, moreover, where I can take a deep breath, feel calm, and remember the importance of caring for the soul.

> Aun así, he aprendido que los pequeños momentos también pueden parecer un paraíso. A veces basta con una taza de café caliente, una tarde tranquila y un rincón acogedor donde sentarme a pensar, mientras el mundo sigue su curso. Me encantan los espacios acogedores, sobre todo las cafeterías donde suena música suave y el ambiente invita a quedarse un rato más. Otro de mis refugios favoritos, y la mayoría de mi gente y afectos lo sabe, es el tejido y el bordado. Hay algo profundamente terapéutico en crear con las manos. En esos momentos siento que mi mente descansa y mi corazón encuentra equilibrio. Es como si el tiempo fuera más lento y me tratara con delicadeza. Sin duda, mi refugio es todo aquello que me permita sentir tranquilidad, inspiración y conexión conmigo misma; y, sobre todo, donde pueda respirar profundamente, sentirme en calma y recordar la importancia de cuidar el alma. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tRvSEWHKkL5Vss4dcr91BuqjNes2xKhSdihd8ku4GsGAqRJCXaCoHYt9rXCSYoaPMYG.png ![photo_2026-05-26_23-16-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23zkg7AF4iULsYM9XDetXJxr2Sqae1ckg7Tqfc89WJLTb3aos3ym8JqhrEvB764Ek8F6b.jpg) |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23u69F4GMxRsBFUMgpzafy2MSEGDThTGnP5ELwfYCqCJgUUVzYMeYW8ERKfNkAsRRxtmh.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xozPgwxhrH29fGkNP5b9keYTmkmbu7Yi2M4wdcaWr8fDS4AH5pNCBCqxLNFDMmucoMn.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tRvSEWHKkL5Vss4dcr91BuqjNes2xKhSdihd8ku4GsGAqRJCXaCoHYt9rXCSYoaPMYG.png **My love to all. body.title: Tres de leches de chocolate | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
body.body:
![1000550806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xVPP8yUD4BqSvR2ZnNHCtwE4iVvtcNwo6UZFJGTntzWuengJDHAgKXSisbodE8VpRnT.jpg)





<div class=text-justify> 

La torta tres leches ya quedó registrada entre mis pasteles favoritos para preparar; es fácil de preparar y nunca falla. El único secreto está en que, al batir los huevos y el azúcar, se logre el punto de cinta y, claro, también es muy importante que, al añadir los ingredientes secos, se haga en varias tantas y con suaves movimientos envolventes para no dejar escapar el aire de la mezcla, lo cual garantizará un ligero bizcocho.


***¡Acompáñame a preparar esta exquisita torta tres leches!***

> The tres leches cake has definitely earned a spot among my favorite cakes to bake; it’s easy to make and never fails. The only secret is to beat the eggs and sugar until they reach the ribbon stage, and, of course, it’s also very important to add the dry ingredients in several batches, folding them in gently so as not to deflate the mixture, which will ensure a light sponge cake.


> ***Join me in making this delicious tres leches cake!***


------------------
#### <center>Ingredientes <sup>(Ingredients)</sup> </center>
------------------------------


<div class=\

> *Bizcocho* * 6 huevos. * 180 g de azúcar. * 155 g de harina leudante. * 30 g de cacao. *Remojo* * 170 ml de crema de leche. * 30g de chocolate bitter 70%. * 300 g de leche condensada. * 360 g de leche entera. * 2 cucharadas de cacao en polvo. *Merengue suizo* * 2 claras de huevo. * 100 g de azúcar.

> * *Sponge Cake* * 6 eggs. * 180 g sugar. * 155 g self-rising flour. * 30 g cocoa powder. *Filling* * 170 ml heavy cream. * 30 g 70% dark chocolate. * 300 g condensed milk. * 360 g whole milk. * 2 tablespoons cocoa powder. *Swiss Meringue* * 2 egg whites. * 100 g sugar. ------------------ ####
Preparación (How to make it)
------------------------------ * Batir los huevos y el azúcar hasta lograr el punto de letra. En batidora de pedestal lo obtengo batiendo a velocidad 8 durante 10 minutos. Cernir la harina junto con el cacao. Añadir en 3 o 4 tandas a la mezcla de huevo y azúcar con movimientos envolventes. >Beat the eggs and sugar until stiff peaks form. In a stand mixer, I achieve this by beating on speed 8 for 10 minutes. Sift the flour and cocoa powder together. Fold them into the egg and sugar mixture in 3 or 4 batches using a folding motion. ![1000550874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wX5r56RmQSSKbLdxecwKQmcA6ip5L748Z22NcmRhVJicqJoo23jCGNF8yKgNSdM9mZA.jpg) * Colocar en una bandeja y llevar a hornear en horno precalentado a 175 grados durante 20 minutos. > Place on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated oven at 175 degrees for 20 minutes. ![1000548613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u67BcBnQzLjmMUTL5jScWXdLRMWT7i9RzZ55vb95iS8WfdX7qK9HrxPfRFLxU82qawZ.jpg) Para preparar el remojo lleva todos los ingredientes a una olla y cocina a fuego bajo hasta que el chocolate se derrita. > Para preparar el remojo, lleva todos los ingredientes a una olla y cocina a fuego bajo hasta que el chocolate se derrita. ![1000550875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uFY5EVcTKUvFNMtgThEcC7CLXKZxevbFYYoZ988UWvpBiLnBXpUAFjVHvpYSrt8e7Wd.jpg) * Cuando el bizcocho salga del horno, pérforalo y ve colocando el remojo sobre él. > When the cake comes out of the oven, poke holes in it and pour the syrup over it. ![1000548616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23yJGJwVpKY1AoioSJcobS2PYC86kLhz9WnjZ3j6E6neQaYkaLabTe4tk6HqTBx5v1GCE.jpg) ![1000548617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23tSUESpP3KL3ubz8G5fXK7WrJLAnfzYn5dGtA3AeW3C7pduWiSRcaNMeZv9VGkQ29FLp.jpg) ![1000548633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uQtaeUCxXqJijc5WKMRjEEXx2QrcdhUcNC9VewXUx6NkyDqtrnojhfJ5n9nvGPsgFcS.jpg) ![1000548638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23tvcJfRQ1ZPxAmx4g6nGDtVmoe28ZSkbAhfXQ8NgwJcYGMhXSzYfhAdfLK3Ts6bisBAL.jpg) * Decora con merengue suizo, [aquí.](https://peakd.com/hive-120586/@eugelys/tres-leches-con-parchita-or-foodiemood-or-esp-eng) Explico cómo se prepara la crema chantilly. Adicione chocolate bitter rallado por encima y algunas chispas de chocolate blanco. > Garnish with Swiss meringue, [here.](https://peakd.com/hive-120586/@eugelys/tres-leches-con-parchita-or-foodiemood-or-esp-eng) Here's how to make the whipped cream. Top with grated dark chocolate and a few white chocolate chips. ![1000548843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wCJNGD9EnWXtLJwmzP4qHTvkJTuqybSdFGY5CKHQpf9JNWd4U5PY4AdKG1xQWcXetNm.jpg) ¡Esta torta es una explosión achocolatada, exquisita y muy atractiva!
**¡Espero que te guste esta receta, cocina fácil y con sabor**!
**I hope you like it!**

links.body:
## مقدمة
أعلنت حكومة البرتغال اليوم عن افتتاح أول كمبيوتر فائق في البلاد، يُدعى مشروع “بوب” (Bob) ويُسْنَع بمدى قدراته على معالجة البيانات بسرعات غير مسبوقة. يقع هذا الجهاز في معمل **فاماليكاوش**، جهة شماليّة تُعد قاعدةً تموضعاً استراتيجياً لتسهيل تبادل البيانات وتسهيل المشاريع البحثية المتقدمة.

## لماذا يختلف بوب؟  
يتتبع “بوب” تقنيات التصميم الحديثة للكمبيوتر الفائق التي تعتمد على مزيجٍ من معالجات **CPU** المتقدمة وحوسبة **GPU** المتخصصة. يتجرد من العوامل التالية:

1. **سرعة معالجة**: يمكنه معالجة أكثر من **10^17** عملية في الثانية، ما يعادل تدفق بيانات أحر من سهم النسر اليميني.  
2. **الستراتيجيّات المتقدمة**: يشمل إدارة الطاقة الذكية وتوزيع الحمل الذكي عبر البنى التحتية السحابية.  
3. **المربوطة**: يرتبط بشبكة الخوادم الأوروبية، ما يمكّن الباحثين من التفاعل مع معايير البحث التقليدي والبيانات الضخمة في الوقت الفعلي.

## تأثير “بوب” على البحوث البرتغالية  
الإستثمار في “بوب” يُعد خطوة مطلوبة من أجل صيانة رصيد البرتغال كمركز هندسي مرغوب، جودةً تابعاً للمتطلبات العالمية للبحث العلمي. اقتبس أحد الباحثين في جامعة البرتغال:  

> « إذًا نستخدم جهازًا يوفر لنا 3 أضعاف قدرة عمليات الحوسبة مقارنةً بما نعمل عليه قبل المواجهة، فهذا يغيّر قواعد اللعبة»  

تشمل الاستخدامات المتوقعة الجوانب التالية:

- **الطب**: تحليل الجينات السريعة، وصياغة أدوية مُخصصة.  
- **الطاقة**: نماذج إنبعاثات الكربون وتحسين استخدام الطاقة المتجددة.  
- **الهندسة**: نماذج حاسوبية للمواد الذرية وتطور التصميم الميكانيكي.  

## الحوار حول المستقبل  
من المهم أن نضع نظرة جامعية في هذا السعي:  
- **آلية التمويل**: الدعم المرتبط بإعتماد التعاون الدولية يُسهم في توسيع العقد.  
- **تعاون دولي**: توافق مع حاضن المدعوم في أوروبا من أجل حصص متماثلة في الاستفادة.  
- **دعم التقنية الكبرى**: يتطلع الباحثون إلى توظيف إمكانيات “بوب” في تحسين محرك الذكاء الاصطناعي.

## خاتمة  
بتأسيس “بوب” في فاماليكاوش، يفتح البرتغال الأبواب أمام ربحية متطورة في عيالم الحوسبة والبحث العلمي. تمتد بصمته إلى معايير الطاقة ومستوى المعيار الذي يضعه في مجالات متعددة، ويعد بمستقبلًا مُفعماً بالانفتاح على قمة التطور التكنولوجي.

[**Read the full story here 🚀**](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNTXF2UXRUajVZSFhzcDdTZTlBNFpzMURiM0kxSjJ4NzM1Y2xsQnFvaFlNSzRVZWVnWjFoOTV1T2JnZk9tR1pmYWJIOUs1WU9RMmh0X3A1cW16dXdoRVRMWGRCU2czREFSQlhNTGpTTU5lM3lfcW9iMEZtTzlqUDRHa2ludDkzb0dRM2l5TWFoUlVZTE9JTTZ4VGhuaw?oc=5)

The Biblical Account

Enoch is primarily mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, where his legacy completely breaks the normal cycle of life and death: 

The Length of His Walk: According to Genesis 5:21-24, Enoch lived 365 years and walked faithfully with God for 300 of them after the birth of his son Methuselah.

The Transfiguration: The scriptures state, \

.

The Hall of Faith: The Hebrews 11:5 passage in the New Testament confirms this event, noting that he was taken away so that he did not see death because his testimony pleased God. 

- Bible Gateway
 
The Meaning of \
\nIn the original Hebrew, the word used for \

implies an ongoing, interactive, and deliberate habit of life. 

Continual Fellowship: Rather than a one-time spiritual experience, Enoch’s walk represents 300 years of daily companionship.

An Active Life: Despite the reputation of his era as corrupt and ungodly, Enoch did not retreat into monk-like isolation. He was a family man with sons and daughters.

Saying Yes to God: Walking with God is often interpreted by theologians as making a habit of saying \

to sin, aligning one's life to be in step with the divine. 

Ancient Texts and Traditions

Beyond the Bible, Enoch features prominently in ancient apocryphal and pseudepigraphical writings, such as 1 Enoch and 2 Enoch. These texts (preserved notably within the Ethiopian Orthodox Church) expand on his visions and offer detailed accounts of his ascent into heaven.

links.body:
>

En Pica. Todos sabemos que las flexiones en pica son geniales, porque permiten transferir el peso corporal de un lado a otro. Trabajan los hombros, trapecios, tríceps y espalda; sin embargo, con la aplicación de variantes vamos a darle acción a otros grupos musculares. Durante la ejecución del siguiente circuito, te darás cuenta de lo poderosa que puede ser esta postura y de las variantes que podemos aplicar en cada estación. Así que amigos míos; vamos a continuar entrenando duro el núcleo, en compañía del tren superior y piernas. No lo dejes pasar, porque estarás perdiendo la oportunidad de adquirir mucho poder y salud. >In the plank position. We all know that plank push-ups are great because they allow you to shift your body weight from side to side. They work your shoulders, trapezius muscles, triceps, and back; however, by incorporating variations, we’ll engage other muscle groups. As you go through the following circuit, you’ll realize just how powerful this position can be and the variations we can apply at each station. So, my friends, let’s keep training our core hard, along with our upper body and legs. Don’t miss out, because you’ll be missing the chance to gain a lot of strength and health.

![1000462458.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKp9YbdjAZWSnFt9ExEdEfqh8yf1Qaufa2UtPZA1w91AeQAUXo3mLwG2E3WgC4N.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **ESQUIVES LATERALES MÁS GANCHOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas un poco más allá del ancho de hombros; brazos en posición de combate. >[**Warm-up 1**, **SIDE DODGES AND HOOKS**]() >[Stance]() >Feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart; arms in a fighting stance.
![1000462431.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKVVC3QUXX8kabqR1t4TXYMxg2rMBswqL7wrVAqSsqi1kDhZCZ9XGvLdLriURfM.gif)
[Ejecución]() Flexionamos las rodillas y el torso; bajamos el cuerpo y lo llevamos de lado a lado, finalizando con un golpe de gancho con el brazo opuesto. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Bend your knees and torso; lower your body and move it from side to side, finishing with a hook punch with the opposite arm. 3 minutes of action.
![1000462433.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKbE6kwpuEWpsWBi8weeL7JCzbYSMV9LYFJFPBrB4ziPmHNhzzCkTsyocJcYcym.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TROTE CON GOLPES FRONTALES ALTERNOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos en postura de combate. >[**Warm-up 2**, **JOGGING WITH ALTERNATING FRONT PUNCHES**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; arms in a boxing stance.
![1000462435.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKVVC3TQVXEAfwrCmYRk72oYkfd4xywnsWzJbnqL82dA6cT7XKGLX5UtKSWZHoR.gif)
[Ejecución]() Ejecutamos el trote de forma continua; mientras vamos dando golpes frontales alternos opuesto. Se eleva una rodilla; se da el golpe con el brazo contrario. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >We jog continuously while performing alternating front punches with opposite arms. Lift one knee and punch with the opposite arm. Continue for 3 minutes.
![1000462437.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKScfgLA6cCXU7fo3qgJiQExLo1Ekj6sH6kjA2cgu3PCryLBTnH2cGNCK6Bbszt.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **FLEXIÓN DE RODILLAS AL RAS DEL SUELO, A PARTIR DE POSTURA EN PICA EN ELEVACIÓN**]() [Postura]() Podemos usar dos muebles, dos sillas, dos bancos; o simplemente realizarlo en el piso. En mi caso; colocamos las manos sobre un mueble y los pies sobre el otro. Pies en puntillas y cadera elevada, formando una V invertida. >[**Station 1**, **KNEELING PUSH-UP, STARTING FROM A HIGH PLANK POSITION**]() >[Position]() >You can use two pieces of furniture, two chairs, or two benches; or simply do it on the floor. In my case, place your hands on one piece of furniture and your feet on the other. Stand on your toes with your hips raised, forming an inverted V.
![1000462439.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL7N1wDQAguXm8GLmiLsNCeiyDo7nV5f8TwFjYFtXTrkTm9i3bpF5v7sCjSiX1t.gif)
[Ejecución]() Este ejercicio permite activar el núcleo y todo el tren inferior, mientras se mantiene tensión en el tren superior; un movimiento verdaderamente poderoso. Para llevarlo a cabo; flexionamos ambas rodillas, las bajamos al ras de suelo; la cadera baja y el torso se pone recto. Realizamos 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise engages the core and the entire lower body while maintaining tension in the upper body; it’s a truly powerful movement. To perform it, bend both knees and lower them until they’re parallel to the floor; keep your hips low and your torso straight. Do 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000462441.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL5vnHp5P8qCbFuUivNKa9hxjN7kNSAdcSMnvDQxJjAr8cs15tWWNrsDshPr3Qj.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **FLEXIÓN HINDÚ MÁS RODILLAZOS LATERALES**]() [Postura]() Manos en el piso, apoyo de pies en puntillas; vamos cerrando la posición elevando la cadera y formando una V invertida. >[**Station 2**, **HINDU PUSH-UP WITH SIDE KNEES**]() >[Posture]() >Hands on the floor, feet on tiptoes; bring your body closer by lifting your hips to form an inverted V.
![1000462443.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKbERkdwnVFNzXwQ8dcqs8apJbbjy3EhHmmPAKwWAQetS1X6uzpeEaNjgsHKUaW.gif)
[Ejecución]() Trabajo increíble para todo el tren superior, dando énfasis a los tríceps, hombros y trapecios. El núcleo se activa de manera importante y las piernas trabajan de forma formidable. Para ejecutarlo; flexionamos los codos, vamos bajando el cuerpo y casi llegando al piso, realizamos como una ola subiendo la parte superior del cuerpo. Nos quedamos en esa posición, para dar un rodillazo lateral con cada pierna. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >An incredible workout for the entire upper body, with a focus on the triceps, shoulders, and trapezius muscles. It engages the core significantly and gives the legs a great workout. To perform this exercise, bend your elbows, lower your body, and just before touching the floor, push your upper body back up in a wave-like motion. Hold that position, then perform a side knee tap with each leg. 20 total repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000462447.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKe6tP44UtQbt3TsbM9Lc9pY3WFSekUTSrjoS7QuaHXWB7ZAEyedtrcrGw3FVEp.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **BAJANDO Y SUBIENDO CADERA, MÁS RETRACCIÓN ESCAPULAR**]() [Postura]() Adoptamos la postura de flexiones en pica; con la salvedad de que el apoyo se lleva a cabo con los antebrazos. Igualmente se forma una V invertida. >[**Station 3**, **HIP FLEXION AND EXTENSION, PLUS SCAPULAR RETRACTION**]() >[Position]() >Assume the push-up position, except that you rest on your forearms. This also forms an inverted V.
![1000462449.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKWvkhYkg6EJK3fqR916ckVQmVZhuJoAArqFGpjDrci3adCqA1KQxwykHxvAdfX.gif)
[Ejecución]() La activación total le corresponde al núcleo y a los hombros. Simplemente; bajamos la cadera, llevando los hombros un poco hacia adelante y ubicando el cuerpo al ras del suelo. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise primarily engages the core and shoulders. Simply lower your hips, bringing your shoulders slightly forward and keeping your body parallel to the floor. We’ll do 20 repetitions for 4 sets.
![1000462451.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKYMxUSGqYgwt5whL4HKXjJnAXLgZzZfcXY1ybVFbQszeU4wKMfynGVyqtwgFSx.gif)
[**Relajación**, **GIRO CORPORAL, EXTENSIÓN DE TRICEPS Y FLEXIÓN DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Relaxation**, **TORSION, TRICEPS EXTENSION, AND ELBOW FLEXION**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000462454.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKbE8brou6AJdwr2xU1JLEBWir1xkvQDzcb2QU2z8ssy9uBRzSeFmWKH66nx2Ks.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, giramos el cuerpo a un lado, extendemos un brazo posando la mano opuesta sobre el tríceps del brazo extendido; estando en esa posición, flexionamos el codo. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; after 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, turn your body to one side, extend one arm, and rest the opposite hand on the triceps of the extended arm; while in that position, bend your elbow.
![1000462456.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKbE5Wzqu7P2LSnzwxityCSC1jdkydhS45zdW7wqoTBRkPSLZcvtts5GbyiPrC2.gif)

Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

links.title: Just being myself today 🖤✨
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPub3Wgy8KKvSxJnEbgeo8Bn1C3879QgrfHBzMQwroTjM/IMG_9555.PNG 

Not every day is exciting.  
Not every day comes with a big adventure or a perfect story to tell.

Sometimes it's just about getting ready, looking in the mirror, and reminding yourself that you're doing better than you think.

Lately I've been trying to focus less on what I haven't achieved and more on how far I've already come.

Life moves fast, and it's easy to spend too much time comparing yourself to others.  
But everyone is fighting battles that nobody sees.

So today I'm choosing gratitude.

Grateful for another day.  
Grateful for the lessons.  
Grateful for the chance to keep building the future I dream about.

One small step at a time. 🤍

links.title: Thunder strategy works like gold bringing them up 3-2 in the series
links.body: I have been saying that the OKC Thunder are the best team in the NBA and that only team that could possibly stop them on their way to Championship gold would be the San Antonio Spurs or most notably, Victor Wembanyama, who a lot of people call \

just because that name is too hard to remember.

I have said that the OKC strategy has to be focused on shutting down Wemmy and they had been doing exactly that.  When they can hold Wemmy to less than 25 points they win, do it not, and they lose.   I think in game 4 the strategy was to really stick to the tall center from San Antone, but they also failed to really turn on any offense as the Thunder had their lowest score in any game since 2001.   They came back with a vengeance in game 5 to cruise to a rather easy looking victory 127-114.

<center> https://www.nbc.com/sites/nbcblog/files/styles/scale_862/public/2026/05/gettyimages-2277004256.jpg
[src](https://www.nbc.com/sites/nbcblog/files/styles/scale_862/public/2026/05/gettyimages-2277004256.jpg)</center>

As much as I harp on about how crucial Wemmy is to San Antonio, the same could also be said of probably league MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander , who many just refer to as \

He is the team leader and while the Thunder aren't as completely dependent upon him the way the Spurs seem to be on Wemmy, if he isn't hot, there are a ton of missed shots and poor performance on offense the likes of which was on full display in game 4.   SGA's high of 33 points (more than anyone else in the game) along with 9 assists and 2 steals really pushed OKC to a cruising victory.   To make matters worse for San Antonio, SGA went to the free-throw line and shot 16-17.   

Now this brings me to a point that I am not going to dwell on for too long because it is league-wide and is not just an OKC problem although the haters on the internets right now are saying that it is.  OKC had a lot of flop and flop attempts in game 4 and then also spent a lot of time arguing with the referees instead of playing quality basketball.  

<center> https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/05/1200/675/shai-gilgeous-alexander-okc-thunder-fox-news-002.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1
[src](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/05/1200/675/shai-gilgeous-alexander-okc-thunder-fox-news-002.jpeg?ve=1&tl=1)</center>

It's a trash portion of the NBA and yes, it is more common now than it was 10, 20 , or 30 years ago and yes, a lot of people hate it.   Even if my team wins I don't want it to be because of flops and many people are getting really sick of this.   The tactic of doing a run to the basket and aiming for your opponents arms instead of actually trying to make the bucket has become a very common way of getting points and fans and other players alike are getting quite frustrated with this. 

In game 4 of the playoffs this year vs. the Spurs, it appeared as though this was the Thunder's main strategy and well, I'm actually very happy that it didn't pay off.  This isn't soccer/football and we don't want it to become that.  For me, I would like to see review of footage after the games are over and having severe penalties for players that do flop, especially serial floppers.   

In game 5, the Spurs knew this game was over before the final buzzer and this was evidenced by San Antonio sending Wembanyama to the bench, where he remained, with over 2 minutes remaining in the game.  There wasn't really any point in keeping their main weapon out there, they were down by 14 and in the history of the NBA there have been only a handful of times that teams come back from being double digits down with only 2 minutes remaining.   

The question now is what are the Spurs going to do in the locker room to attempt to counter this?  The bit of magic that they had in their 2 victories out of 5 games was pretty special to watch, but mostly what I have said has remained true.  If they can hold Wemmy to low points the other players on the Spurs seem to really struggle with filling in the gaps.   It's not a great situation when the opposing team has a really good idea who you are going to dish the ball to on almost every play.  

The Spurs seem to dish to Castle or Julian Campagnie for 3's on a lot of plays when Wemmy is locked up and sometimes that works.  What can I say?  They made more than half of these shots but that simply isn't enough.   It probably doesn't help when overall your team shoots 12-41 from 3 and 37-92 on all field goals.   

The likely final game takes place on Thursday evening before OKC heads to their 2nd final and likely 2nd championship in a row.  

This game will be in San Antonio, so who knows?  maybe something magical could happen in the locker room to force a game 7.  The bookies actually think a game 7 is likely and are giving San Antonio a slight betting favorite as the spread is +3.5 in favor of the Spurs.  Me?  I think that the Thunder are going to end it in the next game.   
What do you think?

links.body:
<center>![Copy of TradFi (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tm96hdboZ2FcZG1xyW9z85ChV622hNPwoaEkhdRn6UZn7TKoy1UJELEy8hEtT7FYUkw.png)</center>

Another Guilds Brawl passed by Splinter-buds and HIVEees so here I am sharing experiences and gains on my Splinterlands journey. Hoping you have a great time of your life right now readers and more to come of course. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tRvehHLZJQe7XVTG51aRRxhdzYagcqNYVg3VxkW4Rk1gtrcpU43x4k5RZ2evUqxe2ok.png)</center>

I ended up winning 8 matches and 1 lost in this time's brawl with reward of good amount of merits and fair enough SPS. With our Guild a tier 3, this might be the best reward or this is one of the best rewards out there for this tier. We ended up rank 2 this time so we claimed that much.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tbMLGRhYkHXG8P14mSAqjfierXFYVrzGjYVodabZmixjKFrdrwzuogS8Yq1UyTwu1AV.png)</center>

Its not that much away from the 1st placer of this time's braw so I guess we did okay compared to other previous guild brawls.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tbMYgzwCPgPHWaYuAFm8ZVc51epEugao1Ya63YZG8H9H5mkF49ZDuvsu6WWAExrTvy1.png)</center>
I can afford 2 gladius cases and I am on constantly on buying and opening this type of  rewards for it is one of the essence the game experiences. I also looked forward to this type of activity because of the fun it give me. The thrill is still there so the fun is still there. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/48HeUpPU8cs1YBPP2jJuAvwKEZ91sTLsbygWUHwRDnU9skoNDgqpPJkdGVMpgibZ9J.png)
</center>

Not much luck to grab gold foils or legendary cards for this time minting. But still grab a few good gladius cards that can add to my card collection and might upgrade some of this cards.

# Sample Guild Brawl Battle #

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGdnnfzM9rU3S5zoKtmcZhbxsnAoU2VMyaPkhSuiaoBcuyak2BoGFXx3G4kB97p1bD9.png)</center>

In this Guild Brawl sample battle I would like to feature Witch of Warwick being part of my team battle. It came from the common rarity of Gladius cards and got the Life Leech and Berserk ability. Coming from the Death splinters, Witch of Warwick provide a good impression of splinterlands to me because it is one of the cads that I utilized the most in Guild Brawls on my early days of splinterlands. Also, Death splinters is one of my sought teams that time that also give me a good team to send to the battle field. Death splinters good traits are debuffing and curses. These negativities are traits that let me stick to Death splinters from old times. Well that's past and the game is developed to the extent that I am even confused which is which. Well anyways, this brawl battle sample is battle between Life Splinters and Death Splinters. So, my team is Death splinters, obviously, and It started with Arcane Curator as the tank. Lenore Nevermore is placed second for the reason it got a decent amount of health even though it is a range damage dealer without the ability to fire attack even placed in the front most of the team. Sorrow Harvester, one of the most utilized frontier card was used to perform HP negativity to the opponents team because it got ability to decrease Health.  A'lan Musketeer is added for additional offensive capabilities. Little Sister and Witch of Warwick was added to the team for their magic damage and Life Leech ability and placed this cards in the back most of the team. This battle is played with the Keep your Distance and Fog of War in the rulesets. This is high mana battle with 59 capacity. But take note that you can summon only Frontier and Gladius card series for this is Guild Brawl Battle restriction in my Fray.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGcPNjp1gjcQ8N5rWKGbR659W1UbJnZhwL7L9dM5sqib65WVDLsWtxW5Ru58pCDbiZ6.png)</center>
In round 1, both of our front card was out on this round and I had the edge because i even took the second card of my enemies team.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGbncXpfZ4KNfj9zoxJb8FBCcB2NDnxKJvR4g2C4ygxcpmemJXjixDvbbuuxmtFnUrB.png)</center>
This is where my Witch of Warwick triggered the Bloodlust ability that is a great boost to its offensive and survivability capabilities. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGZw5QQRcwPJXdPtgnAucrrTQztNNkJm9uhvQRGbpufcgLnFbWf22peXwmJGn7HcgJQ.png)</center>
Round 3 is where I claim victory. 

- Witch of Warwick although belong to the common rarity, its abilities and capabilities should not be looked down upon. Remember that when ever you started with your Gladius case colllection, common cards got the highest rate of your minting chances.

links.title: 石总被抓和喝酒误事的劳总
links.body:
朋友来我这里聊天，闲聊时提到了石总。

我问他最近有没见石总？怎样了？

朋友吸了口烟，淡淡地跟我说，

“被抓了！”

我起初有些惊讶，但稍微想了下又觉得也不算突然。石总发财走的那种野路子，所谓夜路走多了，迟早都能碰到鬼。

还是去年8月份的时候，朋友跟我聊起了石总，说去过他办公那边，现在做的很大，看起来行业很赚钱。石总之前也跟朋友提过，想拉朋友入伙，只是朋友觉得对那个行业不熟悉就没参与，等看到石总做起来的时候，再提起当初拉他入伙没答应，脸上不免还是有点后悔的样子。

而这次，朋友显然又有些庆幸，

“还好当初没入股，不然现在也脱不开身了。。。” 朋友说完，又猛抽了几口烟，一副放松的样子。

我问是怎么回事？朋友讲了下，本来搞法律咨询的就是个幌子，之前规模小，有些投诉还好说，后来做大了，接的案子多，金额也大，但还跟之前一样，拿了钱有时候办不了事，投诉的人自然就多，投诉多了，也就被盯上了。。。

“也是挺倒霉的，赚到钱还没捂热。。。” 朋友讲了句。

其实想一想，这种被投诉多了，迟早出事。我觉得跟运气倒是没太大关系。


![05_27_001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdi34n3VkAWv5SRPF9vxiR3tRW3Ef8CUbkqN2eQ2PGiDQ/05_27_001.jpg)

![05_27_002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1GdpCQgjPsKFuTKFQATDneyoHXXRE34q5mYzmspkFtk/05_27_002.jpg)


这天外出，经过的时候，忽然想起尚总就在附近办公，打了个电话，他就在办公室，于是便直奔他办公室。

这次见面，尚总明显身体恢复了许多，不像之前刚放出来，身体消瘦的让人不免吃惊。

尚总现在在做女性内裤生意，主打一个杀菌，也不知道是真是假，反正看起来挺那么回事的。:)

闲谈时提到劳总，劳总跟尚总关系很好，算是铁哥们。

尚总叹了口气，

“进去了”

听他这么说，我有些奇怪，

“怎么？”

尚总跟我关系很熟，劳总我也认识，他也不避讳，就讲事情缘由讲了出来。

劳总前阵子跟朋友喝酒，酒后去找了小姐，结果结账时不知道怎么，跟小姐就发生了口角，那个朋友打了小姐，那小姐就要报警，老总气不过，也跟着可能打了下小姐。。。

结果呢，这小姐就声称要报警说被强奸，讹了一笔劳总那朋友，那朋友给了一万五就走了。。。

而劳总呢，可能是觉得这小姐讹人，加上是你情我愿，坚决不给钱。。。于是那小姐果真报警说被强奸。。。

于是劳总就这样进去了。。。

唉，大千世界，什么事儿都有。

不过话说回来，劳总平时就喜欢喝酒，也经常喝大，这真是喝酒误事啊！

links.title: The Chopping Block - Dinsoo Wireless Nintendo Switch Controller
links.body: I have no patience in my life for defective things. Nothing is built to last forever. When items break, they inevitably do it at an inconvenient time. While they will ultimately be thrown away since they can't be repaired, I find it therapeutic to destroy them before they make their way to the trash. I had help cutting down a curly willow tree that was obnoxious and dropped branches all over the backyard. I had to pick up the branches before I could mow the lawn. I now use the stump for cutting wood and for destroying defective items already on their way to the trash heap. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWcwyJvBLd9jauDAjJ9rtCkEkvVbY8uuNib6JBNoWN2jo/1734808223322.jpg) Today's item on the chopping block is a Dinsoo wireless controller for the Nintendo Switch 1 and 2. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPysSxtS6KVyrvfpcQsWjkQCa27wRumfhXNBNC17roHNf/1779852101187.jpg) It started having issues lately. Over the weekend, I found the left joystick had become crushed into the unit. I don't know if someone sat on it, it got crushed between the couch and the end table or what. Even once I got it unstuck, sensor was clearly damaged as it was in a permanent state of scrolling left. These controllers are unavailable now, but they only cost me $30 for two of them on Amazon, so this piece of junk had to go! Two chops later and... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2hQrkF5xBun2dHSRJ3aV17Qc2Rq4aBmTK7b1mExcBNA/1779852234803.jpg) This is what was left! Good riddance to garbage! Silly me of course forgot about the internal battery pack. Fortunately, all I did was nick it so it just smoked for a few minutes and that was the end of it. Thanks for stopping by! links.title: A Blessed Wednesday Walk: Eid Peace and a Green Route
links.body:
Today is Wednesday. It's a great day to share in the Wednesday Walk community. Because today is not only the middle of the week, but also a very precious and special day for Muslims: the first day of Eid al-Adha.


![IMG_2740.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23yTb2tES7qkX3uPb2TLU18kzGGNXvfxfAnZFSYrpkvzC5o6f9VHG1a7Hw8zPrLXJPrEF.jpeg)


Holiday days always have a special place for me. There is a sweet rush in the houses. Candies and chocolates are taken. Doors are knocked, elders are visited, prayers are said. People say nice words to each other. Even a small smile is enough to describe the spirit of the holiday. The spiritual meaning of Eid al-Adha is much deeper. People who have the opportunity sacrifice. This can sometimes be sheep, sometimes rams, sometimes cows. Not everyone's condition is the same. Therefore, this is for those who have the power of worship. The important thing is not only to sacrifice, but to share, to be grateful and to beautify the intention in the heart.


![12A55F2F-49EC-4CD6-BE15-E9655879B66C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23tS2VWK8nhcsgz8xsWa2y6fGNHZqovZZ3QAgLc3uCBK6mA5K3kEzGBaSkJDcGKVF5FYw.jpeg)


I started the day very peacefully this morning. I watched the sunrise while drinking my tea on my balcony. As the sky slowly brightened up, very good feelings formed in me. It was as if a new page was opened. The sun rising over the city reminded me of both the abundance of the holiday and the small but very precious moments of life. The birds were floating in the sky, the streets were still very quiet. At that moment, I just watched, thought and thanked.


![IMG_2723.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/242DJJ3kgrsk1kLEncrgpK4SM4PW6aQopdqcTUZyhin3zo49YKfwSFrEUQ842vL6bjGgo.jpeg)

![IMG_2724.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqhPk1yp6haPYuAwNzcZ2pLtVAVDydJm1kypxYKF9pvbsM5XSWdKYWCTiaWxmhzPFgP.jpeg)

![IMG_2725.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eq5DbJ4hjRUydyVwHmbPQHLFwLBAGLu1PYzoXFjMB8RzFZUdj1NzNDtBzNeKxavEzLp.jpeg)


I walked on a very nice walking route yesterday. In fact, I found this walk even more meaningful to share with you today. Because I always had good prayers while walking. Greenery, flowers, trees, small sounds of water and calm walking paths along the way were very good for me. As you will see in the photos, the route was really peaceful. Although it is in the city, one feels calmer, lighter and happier.


![IMG_2726.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoeGJXpbb2ECs3kwBbjTMNQD4V4iB1wbNT1D8WBtdJGtQYjSMvMLTyRthkYP4SUNjhN.jpeg)

![IMG_2727.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoyR2uDkA69PT9uk1RiSbPBBTdCyEo2HtbiRVggz3nmKe2HTVngKLYC2DHgjpTEZNCY.jpeg)

![IMG_2733.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eos1NhF54frMkUhA9TjkYHExoefv7USzgBVcgZmq1Q8exxtVW9vhEMNNNiXyAsy11vp.jpeg)


Especially the small areas where the water flowed was very beautiful. The sound of water flowing through the stones gives people peace. Sometimes just standing in the shade of a tree, sometimes even walking on a flowery road rests one's heart. I felt the beauty of spring more while passing under the trees full of pink flowers. Everywhere was lush. Grass full of small white flowers, long walking path and buildings visible in the distance created a very beautiful view.


![IMG_2734.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EogNNj1F1TWuB9enTYGQnqHgA7yVygTGfBpYCu1X2zxk4PYFZFn4tQRe3MybdZ8FP3x.jpeg)

![IMG_2735.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpzyCBE77ApSQEmDEhqXz4R2kykmPFQR55xv8e34a8TuoZHVYXNvtKqpoVVgdCd4Q9J.jpeg)

![IMG_2736.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpJZ4gUd2dbXRv95BdzBqRqv7vYh4aFxgf7dtnC7YbJsNW6uyxvBtunbGmWezoLCtH2.jpeg)


While walking, not only my body, but also my soul rested. Sometimes I walked fast, sometimes I slowed down. I stopped in some places and took pictures. Because I just didn't want to see these beauties myself. I wanted to share it with you too. That's my favorite part of the Wednesday Walk community. We all share our different walks from different places. Sometimes a city street, sometimes a park, sometimes a seaside, sometimes such a lush route accompanies us.


![IMG_2737.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpVB8A2e9jfep3YV9aC8KsMNGwDh1Sebiq9Kjg5oWP6dFNT7cjZgvBGu3c9op1eiohr.jpeg)

![IMG_2738.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/242hPqj5UZnw4L1WzqUN47dRgY1sbtop9eZqPg4B2GbVm5NvMJBrFpKCHpM27HKFbXnmA.jpeg)

![IMG_2739.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/2432FyVkpCsrJXBTCoKHDd9ZMvweRUz2jCwi8TetiLkbfTWr9eZZUnQJpjG6DwBt2cq3V.jpeg)


During this march, I prayed for all humanity. I prayed for everyone who is in a difficult situation in the world, struggling with the disease, struggling with a living, feeling lonely, heartbroken. May God give health to everyone. May he grant everyone the best according to their hearts. May he give halal sustenance materially and spiritually. May he bring peace to our homes, abundance to our tables, and goodness to our hearts.


![IMG_2741.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vi2ATQpfQgakLGoSxeAvKhgSaSULJsAAQVs2AoKvZ2J53Qyd5P2U7Jz4vz6iGx2CwUM.jpeg)

![IMG_2745.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpVCW139iByyqLVoXx6M3KGTviRAw1yQc7BRbC19p8zaY74JaCebCuqMimeNnCXB9UR.jpeg)

![IMG_2747.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vhyN9BMpADmrNvPUX63gr1mNKCY8t2Br11MCy7pFeM71QojjTK6craiy7YfuGKjD5d2.jpeg)


Since today is the first day of Eid al-Adha, this post has become even more special for me. I think the holiday is not only a day of joy, but also a day of sharing, mercy and prayer. That's why I send my best wishes from the heart to everyone who reads this article.


![E7FF3B29-E81A-40C7-ABAD-294782CBEBB9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xepCNX4GbaF5ecv7CzipoQj4YKnKWPC8y6xd3kcwbGKbMTV6W8Zh35nMBEbL6K4dNMN.jpeg)

![IMG_2750.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/2423v1HwDViTkXeG6iRU6S3NWe1VcEAUp3QyqKhJuZjf9hDpzPJTApbi46UmSMrw4qz39.jpeg)

![IMG_2751.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqQNe1WAbo8yJEqdtNshuPEUDWyeD5DrPgBBK3VuN78gJiCe9WPb2DP9bmZRGseXNsS.jpeg)


Have a blessed holiday. May this beautiful day bring goodness, abundance, health and peace to all people. May my Lord grant us all roads full of beauty. Hope to see you in many peaceful walks.

links.title: These are my favorite movie soundtracks [ENG-ESP]
links.body: >Greetings, dear friends @youhive. While browsing @avdesing’s posts and interacting with her in the travel community, I saw a post on her profile that caught my attention: movie soundtracks—a topic I’ve always loved. In fact, I once participated in a contest on one of the movie communities. It’s the topic of the month, and I love it—I really decided to participate and share my perspective on it. Soundtracks are crucial in any film; they add intensity to the scenes. If it’s a drama, it feels like our own; if it’s an action, fiction, or fun scene like those in Back to the Future, we feel happy and excited about what’s going to happen; if it’s a horror film, the fear intensifies even more._

>Soundtracks sometimes replace dialogue and foreshadow what’s to come—suspense, horror, romance, sadness, and even great fun that later brings us lots of laughter and smiles. Although I won’t post the video, I remember a very old horror movie, The Omen. Just by hearing the chant, we knew something very bad was going to happen, and it left us frozen and speechless. We start to like certain songs simply because we hear them in our favorite movies—has that ever happened to you? At least that’s how it was for me with several movies. One of them is *The Butterfly Effect*, a movie starring Ashton Kutcher. The main character (Evan Treborn) set out to change the past to improve his life in the future and be with the woman he loved, Kayleigh Miller. When he saw that his attempts had failed, he made a decision that took him away from her forever.
https://youtu.be/VY4ZEuXxkns?si=QydklQTXnZlpB0za [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VY4ZEuXxkns)

>Besides liking the song itself, there’s an important aspect I enjoy reflecting on: the song’s significance in relation to the movie. In the final scene of *The Butterfly Effect*, Evan Treborn and Kayleigh run into each other on the street, look at one another, and go their separate ways—he knowing who she was and what she had done. Despite everything, sadly, they couldn’t be together in the end. The song playing in that scene is “Stop Crying Your Heart Out” by Oasis, a British band. The title translates to something like “Stop Crying Your Heart Out,” referring to accepting what you can’t change, letting go of the past, wiping away your tears, and moving forward with life. Even though there are difficult moments in life, they don’t last forever.

>Another soundtrack I really liked was the one from the movie *13 Going on 30*, starring Jennifer Garner as Jenna Rink. A 13-year-old girl wanted to be 30—a huge leap to escape the trials and tribulations of adolescence. I liked almost all the songs from this movie, including the “Thriller” dance by Michael Jackson (well, who doesn’t?), but I’ll just mention two of my favorites. The first was “Love Is a Battlefield” by Pat Benatar. In the scene, Jenna is at a sleepover with several 13-year-old girls who are complaining about love. During the conversation, Jenna tells them, “We’re young,” encouraging them not to give up because relationships aren’t easy and you have to fight for them like in a war, with the risk of getting hurt or coming out victorious. Then, they all dance to the song and have a lot of fun.
https://youtu.be/wGTY4XuMMCI?si=x86juuBykDXpeztE [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGTY4XuMMCI&list=RDwGTY4XuMMCI&start_radio=1)

>Another one of my favorite soundtracks from this same movie is the song “Vienna” by American singer Billy Joel. At 30, Jenna realizes she didn’t appreciate her teenage years or the time she spent with her parents, so she goes back to see them because she misses them. When she arrives at her parents’ house, she finds her room exactly as she left it, and she’s overcome with nostalgia for those years. The song “Vienna” is a call to reflection, a tribute to life, a call to calm, which is captured in one of its lines: “calm down, crazy kid.” We must live each stage, enjoy it, and let everything happen in its own time, because life isn’t a marathon.
https://youtu.be/Y8_n4PtcFWo?si=-b8DyQcLg17MDoeK [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8_n4PtcFWo&list=RDY8_n4PtcFWo&start_radio=1)

>Finally, another soundtrack that really made an impression on me was “Bitter sweet Symphony” by the English alternative rock band The Verve. This song was epic in the final scene of the movie “Cruel Intentions,” serving as a key part of the triumph of one of the main characters, Annette (Reese Witherspoon), over her step-siblings with corrupt and frivolous intentions, Kathryn (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Sebastian (Ryan Phillippe). The film was released in 1999 and centers its plot on power, jealousy, money, gambling, sex, deception, vanity, discredit, and manipulation. The song’s lyrics urge us to find the true path in life, without looking back, just as the characters did in the film.
https://youtu.be/DWUmkIjdD7c?si=jllwzGVNsVfpTF3l [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DWUmkIjdD7c)

> All these bands are great, and I liked them so much that I downloaded the songs to my iPod.
# Thank you for reading
The cover photo is original taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 phone. The editions were made with the [GridArt application](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US)
![1779851842619.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTJy67wYTHKTPWj7epS5UGBjUfrM6cyeKes5SvNUYXJKm/1779851842619.jpg)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos @youhive, revisando las publicaciones de @avdesing mientras hacía interacción con ella en la comunidad de viajes, vi en su perfil una publicación que llamó mi atención, bandas sonoras de temas de películas, un tópico que siempre me ha gustado y por allí alguna vez participé en un concurso propuesto en una de las comunidades de cine. Es el tema del mes y me encanta, de verdad me propuse a participar y compartir mi punto de vista al respecto. Las bandas sonoras son cruciales en todo film, trasmiten más intensidad a las escenas, si es drama, este se sentirá como nuestro, si es una escena de acción, ficción y diversión como las de Volver al futuro, nos sentimos alegres y expectantes de lo que va a suceder, si es de terror, el miedo se intensifica aún más._

>Las bandas sonoras, en ocasiones reemplazan a los diálogos y preceden lo que vendrá, el suspenso, el horror, el romance, tristezas, hasta una gran diversión que luego nos saca muchas risas y sonrisas. Aunque no colocaré el video, recuerdo una película de terror muy antigua, La Profecía, con solo escuchar el cántico, ya sabíamos que algo muy malo iba a suceder, además de dejarnos helados y sin habla. Algunos temas musicales nos comienzan a gustar por el solo hecho de escucharlos en nuestras películas favoritas, les ha pasado?, al menos así me pasó a mí y con varias películas. Una de ellas es el “Efecto Mariposa”, película que protagonizó Asthon Kutcher. El personaje principal (Evan Treborn) se propuso a cambiar el pasado para mejorar su vida en el futuro y estar con la persona amada, Kayleigh Miller. Al ver que sus intentos fueron fallidos tomó una decisión que lo alejó de ella para siempre.
https://youtu.be/VY4ZEuXxkns?si=QydklQTXnZlpB0za [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VY4ZEuXxkns)

>Además de gustarme el tema musical, hay un elemento importante que me agrada considerar, el significado de la canción en relación a la película. En la escena final del Efecto Mariposa, Evan Treborn y Kayleigh se topan en la calle, se miran y siguen su camino, él sabiendo quien era ella y lo que había hecho, pese a todo, tristemente, al final no pudieron estar juntos. La canción que suena en aquella escena es \

, de Oasis, una banda de origen británico. Traducido es algo así como “Deja de llorar desconsoladamente”, en alusión a aceptar lo que no puedes cambiar, soltar el pasado, limpiar las lágrimas y seguir adelante con la vida. Aunque en la vida hayan momentos difíciles, estos no duran para siempre.

>Otra banda Sonora que me gustó mucho, fue la que tomó partido en la película “si tuviera 30”, protagonizada por Jennifer Garner, representando al personaje, Jenna Rink. Una chica de 13 años quería tener 30, un gran salto para evadir las dolencias propias de la adolescencia. De esta película me gustaron casi todos los temas musicales, incluyendo el baile de “Thriller” de Michael Jackson (bueno, a quien no?), no obstante, solo citaré dos de mis favoritas. La primera de ellas fue, “El amor es un campo de batalla”, de Pat Benatar, en la escena, Jenna está en una piyamada con varias chicas de 13 años que se quejan del amor. En la conversación, Jenna, les dice “somos jóvenes”, las motiva a no rendirse porque las relaciones no son fáciles y hay que hacer su lucha como en la guerra, con riesgos de ser lastimados o salir victoriosos. Luego, todas bailan la canción y se divierten mucho.
https://youtu.be/wGTY4XuMMCI?si=x86juuBykDXpeztE [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGTY4XuMMCI&list=RDwGTY4XuMMCI&start_radio=1)

>Otra de mis bandas sonoras favoritas de esta misma película es la canción “Vienna” del cantante estadounidense Billy Joel. Jenna, al tener 30, se da cuenta que no valoró su etapa de la adolescencia, el tiempo con sus padres y regresa a verlos porque los extraña. Al llegar a casa de sus padres, encuentra su cuarto igual como dejó y le invade la nostalgia de aquellos años. La canción “Vienna” es un llamado a la reflexión, es un tributo a la vida, un llamado a la calma, la cual cita en una de sus frases “cálmate, niño loco.” Debemos vivir cada etapa, disfrutarla, cada cosa en su tiempo, porque la vida no es un maratón.
https://youtu.be/Y8_n4PtcFWo?si=-b8DyQcLg17MDoeK [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8_n4PtcFWo&list=RDY8_n4PtcFWo&start_radio=1)

>Por último, otra banda sonora que me causó impacto fue “Sinfonía agridulce” de la banda inglesa de Rock alternativo The Verve. Esta canción fue épica en la escena final de la película “Juegos sexuales” ó “intenciones crueles”, como parte importante del triunfo de uno de los personajes principales, Annette (Reese Witherspoon), sobre los hermanastros con intensiones corruptas y frívolas, Kathryn (Sarah Michelle Gellar) y Sebastian (Ryan Phillippe). La película se estrenó en el año 1999 y centra su trama en el poder, los celos, el dinero, las apuestas, el sexo, los engaños, la vanidad, el descrédito y la manipulación. La letra de la canción exhorta a encontrar el verdadero camino de la vida, sin mirar atrás, tal como lo hicieron los personajes en la película.
https://youtu.be/DWUmkIjdD7c?si=jllwzGVNsVfpTF3l [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DWUmkIjdD7c)

>Todas estas bandas son geniales y me gustaron tanto que bajé las canciones a mi IPod.
# Gracias por leer
La foto de portada es original tomada con Xiaomi Redmi 9 phone. Las ediciones las hice con la aplicación [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US)

links.title: The Uneasy Mind of a Messy Thinker: Travel to Unwind ft. Bagungon with Coconut Milk
links.body:
*It takes me forever to get over anything. I get upset everytime I hear something unpleasant. I can't stop feeling bad about it, and it makes me feel uneasy*. 

![1000097364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23ynayndqNFz9XLWTpgszHrwhTmUyDggsvi4qqxszUCRT925saDPmTebFASozMRUtfqLd.jpg)


After processing the letter of financial assistance to the Mayor's Office, I decided to take a short break. Kidding aside, I thought I'd be able to help my aunt at her store, so I went to visit. 

When I was about to head out, I wondered if I could ask my mother for additional money. I was doubtful she might scold me, but I still needed to try even though I had some money. Right before I asked, she said things that made me feel bad. Even though she was right, I can't stop thinking about it. It bothers me- it's lingering in my mind, this feeling of being a burden for not being able to provide for myself.

After what happened, my pride and ego couldn't take the things I heard. I thought about it a lot while I was still at home and came up with the bad idea of not taking the money. I didn't take it and just left it there. My heart was heavy and I felt like I was about to shed some tears. It wasn't my mother I felt anguished toward- it was myself, for being a failure and for not being strong to face the reality of life. 


![1000097241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/Epxqrnu17EDAGUa2wSbauUxNnrucMEvSEBJw5KA4THob9YwpzM35dtN7pL3VKn2DVys.jpg)
While traveling, my thoughts were strolling- thinking that adulthood is surely scary. Things and happenings flashes back to me and it seems to be painted in my mind. Because of so much thoughts on my own story I forgot I have been traveling far enough and almost reach my first stop. 


![1000097247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EoMFbPWtm5Zgw4hjJchdH4WdMqtYMEB1NppBqefR4JUzRXUT4RjbDyktCRzrfyjYAtV.jpg)

I chose that day to travel because I could reduce my expenses- my aunt's partner was going to the city to buy supplies for their store and I'll be tagging along. I told them I'd be going to church first and we will meet after.  


![1000097379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23viAVaeYnRkwTzAdz46f99aBP7PgcSAP6oTBdzrj5o5Tqi11bo8pMpcDTa8jixDzmAc5.jpg)

After I went to church, I wandered around looking for water and passed by the public plaza. I found a 7/11 store at the corner of the plaza, so I went inside, bought water, and got two packs of cookies for my cousin. 

![1000097380.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23xVPg3g3TDy91JxfXXFyE7UTmgGKkGAy74Yc5u1w4RQ74fdgm9AjK5hoABN4bzEVv1Ny.jpg)
It was time to travel from the city to my aunt's house. The sky looked like it was going to rain, but thankfully it didn't. 

I passed by some beautiful scenery, and I couldn't help feeling excited everytime I passed through this place. It was awesome. The place is even more beautiful around 5 AM and 6 PM, when the sun is about to set. 

![1000097309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EowH6pCjkjSV3p82VBpY9ynT1cutQUVxvE1R7paiFvTJv4CYYhTZq9784eeTfxPDzvJ.jpg)

My aunt's partner and I headed to their store and they ordered *batchoy*, perfect for the gloomy weather. 

![1000097311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EoiUL4fuibQTq82sDdBYrotTy82Th4g82d5q44U4jVVLR1GfcxWpNVqmvCQTpFx7mnc.jpg)
Not long after we arrived, the rain poured. We couldn't really predict what would happen in a day. 

![1000097317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EpT3EmcWFahoerqw3T5aYqyD8nQBPKhBuAQxdsyhJD3i9NMTz3N9rswskzkJq5WP7dd.jpg)

![1000097320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EpZRpkksfUhYWe7qrWDT2JTCGQZWc1qZMvwX4Ka6uyEscqwqYr1GLAkWnrPXpELerao.jpg)
Everything was settled, and it was almost 6 PM, so I decided to head out early to prepare for our dinner.

![1000097338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EoAceFsfiZC3zPZNPpxPkJvW1enwukWhQZtH8FSQvELUen5m8Si3wBkJNNNS4UjViRE.jpg)
I cooked *bagungon* with coconut milk and *gabi*. It was delicious, thankfully! Lol. I poured a lot of water 💦 HAHAHA. I thought my cooking skills were only exclusive at home. 

And everything made my day. The heavy feeling became a little bit better. 

---

This ends my blog. Thanks for reading. Love lots 😘
--emmin◉⁠‿⁠◉msss

links.body:
> Just yesterday I posted about how “Liquidity Pools” work and how to buy SPS without worrying about its absolute floor—though this can actually help you with any financial asset you choose to follow—but I left out the most important part: how to calculate returns and how to take advantage of this if you’re already immersed in the world of “Land.” I’ll cover some key points on how to leverage these pools for your own benefit. This post will be geared toward intermediate to advanced players who’ve already spent some time immersed in the game and its land plots. Ultimately, this is an economic simulation game where strategies for success are vital. That’s why I want to focus today’s post on the “Liquidity Pools” offered by Splinterlands in relation to the resources that can be farmed on “Land Plots.” Although I’m not directly involved in farming, I am able to handle the economic and financial aspects of developing strategies, Furthermore, as I mentioned in my previous post, this post complements it perfectly, since the idea is for you to learn how to manage your liquidity and resources to take advantage of price fluctuations—though I’ll reiterate, just as I did in the previous post: This is NOT an investment RECOMMENDATION, so please view this content solely from an educational perspective. **So, if you want to learn about liquidity and how to manage and optimize these processes, read on to the end—I’ll try to be as clear as possible.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# How can you use Pools to speed up your progress in the “Lands”?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Like any resource management game, you need to spend the very resources you extract from the game to keep the snowball rolling. After all, if you want to construct buildings and feed your workers—though all of this depends on your production points, which isn’t the main focus of this post—you always need to manage your resources effectively or create a system that allows you to hedge against any potential shortfalls caused by the type of land and production you have. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
But how does it work?

>* **The Problem:** For example, many plots of land specialize in a single type of resource—in a hypothetical scenario, “Grain”—which is the case for most, especially the common ones. However, this means you’re exposed to price increases for all other resources, so when you need to upgrade a level or construct a building, you’ll always spend more than you earn. The idea is that you can generate more resources to cover these costs. > >* **The Strategy:** Depending on what you produce and earn from your lands, the idea is to place the rest in the “Liquidity Pools” for the resources you don’t produce in the game. This will allow you to earn both DEC and those resources you don’t naturally produce, which will help you pay for upgrades or the construction of this building. On the other hand, this will prevent you from having to buy those tokens on the market, which would often be more expensive because, as I mentioned in yesterday’s post, each exchange charges a specific fee, and the idea is to earn that fee by acting as liquidity providers rather than paying it. --- ***Note: These pools are really small; they don’t handle much volume, and the total value locked (TVL) is low. This means that “slippage” could be higher. But for those who don’t know, slippage is what causes the price to be significantly impacted due to low liquidity. As a result, when making trades, the fee could be higher—and nobody wants to pay that, least of all you, who want to be liquidity providers.***

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# How can you calculate the annualized APR for these Splinterlands pools? https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Now, I’ll show you step by step how to calculate your earnings—or rather, the annualized APR—so you don’t get lost. Understanding these calculations or knowing how to do them will give you an advantage over more than 70% of players who have no idea how a liquidity pool works. So, in this second part of the post, you’ll see how the calculations work, taking into account the existing numbers for the pools that are already available: GRAIN/DEC, WOOD/DEC, STONE/DEC, and IRON/DEC. **To do this, the following image shows all the data I will use to perform the calculations:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Calculations

![POOLS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23swcKComMrS8fXBwBjRZws4WMDTUfYRtjWp7PuXPp8H2tRRfyzkmZVbStce14zYGuUiV.png) To calculate this, we’ll use data from the last 30 days, which is more accurate and consistent. You could also use data from the last 24 hours, but ideally, we should take a long-term approach to this—or at least a medium-term one at the very least—since that’s best for your financial health and your accounts in general. Management is everything in these cases, so let’s look at a quick practical example: --- **The Formula:** * **APR = (30-day volume × LP rate (0.05)) × 365 / Total liquidity × 100** In this case, I'll use the (GRAIN/DEC) pool, but the same applies to all the others so you can do your own calculations. * **Total Cash: $38,049.09** * **Activity over the past 30 days: $7,325.95** Calculate the fees generated for LP pools over 30 days. One thing I didn't mention is that I believe the pool distributes 5% among the liquidity providers. * **$7325.95 x 0.05= $366.29 USD** Next, we need to calculate the average daily profit * **$366.29/30 = $12.21 por día** Next, we'll project that profit, but this time over a one-year period * **$12.21 × 365 = $4,456.65 USD per year** Finally, to wrap things up, let’s now look at the annual percentage rate (APR). * **($4456.65/$38049.09) x 100= 11.71%** --- ***Note: So, based on this, we know that if we add liquidity to this pool, we’ll earn 11.71% annually on our investment—that’s 0.96% per month, which is quite low, but what gives liquidity pools a good APR is if the volume exceeds the TVL of the liquidity in the pool; in other words, it would have to move more than $38,493.25 for it to be worthwhile. Although I already told you in the first section how to take advantage of this.***

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Final Thoughts https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> So, over the course of two posts, we’ve learned how to act as liquidity providers, analyze pools, calculate the annualized APR, and explore some other details and strategies related to land plots. # ¿De qué manera puedes aprovechar las Pools para acelerar tu progreso en las “Tierras”?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Como todo juego de gestión de recursos, esos mismos recursos que extraes del juego necesitas gastarlos para que la bola de nieve siga corriendo, ya que, si quieres construir edificios, alimentar a tus trabajadores, aunque todo esto depende de tus puntos de producción que no es el tema central de este post, necesitas siempre tener una buena gestión o crear un sistema que te permita cubrirte contra los posibles déficits que tengas por el tipo de tierra y la producción que tengas. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
¿Pero de qué forma funciona?

>* **El Problema:** Por ejemplo, muchas de las parcelas de tierra están especializadas en un solo tipo de recurso, en un caso hipotético el “Grano”, que son la mayoría, en especial las comunes, pero en cambio, te expones a que todo el resto de los recursos suban de precio, por lo que, cuando necesites actualizar el nivel o construir un edificio, siempre gastaras mas de lo que recibes, y la idea es que puedas generar más para ello. > >* **La Estrategia:** Dependiendo de lo que produzcas y ganes en las tierras, la idea es colocar el resto en las “Pools de Liquidez” de los recursos que no produces en el juego, esto te permitirá ganar tanto DEC como ese recursos que nativamente no produces, lo que te ayudará a costear esas actualizaciones o las creaciones de este edificio. Por otro lado, esto evitara que tengas que comprar en el mercado dichos tokens que en muchas ocasiones saldría mas costoso por el hecho de que como comenté en el post de ayer, cada intercambio cobra una comisión especifica y la idea es ganarnos esa comisión siendo proveedores de liquidez y no pagarla. --- ***Nota: Estas pools son realmente pequeñas no mueven mucho volumen y el total bloqueado el TVL es pequeño, eso quiere decir que el “Slippage” podría ser mayor, pero, para los que no lo saben, el Slippage es el causante de que el precio tenga un alto impacto debido a la baja liquidez, por lo que, al realizar intercambios la comisión podría ser más alta y nadie quiere pagarla y no ustedes que quieren ser proveedores de liquidez.***

# ¿Cómo puedes calcular el APR anualizado de estas Pools de Splinterlands? https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> Ahora, les ensañare el como pueden calcular sus ganancias o mas bien el APR anualizado paso a paso para que no se pierdan, estos cálculos, o saber hacerlo les dar ventaja por encima del 70% de los jugadores que no tienen idea de como funciona una pool de liquidez. Así que, en esta segunda parte del post, verán cómo funcionan los cálculos tomando en cuenta los números existentes de las que ya existen que son (GRAIN/DEC – WOOD/DEC – STONE/DEC -IRON/DEC). **Para lograr esto, en la siguiente imagen podrán ver todos los datos que tomare para hacer los cálculos:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Calculos

![POOLS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23swcKComMrS8fXBwBjRZws4WMDTUfYRtjWp7PuXPp8H2tRRfyzkmZVbStce14zYGuUiV.png) Para lograr calcular esto, usaremos los datos de los últimos 30 días que son más exactos y consistentes, podría utilizar también 24 horas, pero, lo ideal es que trabajemos a largo plazo con esto, o a mediano en el peor de los casos, ya que es lo mejor para la salud del dinero y sus cuentas en general, la gestión lo es todo en estos casos, así que vamos a un caso práctico rápido: --- **Formula:** * **APR= (Volumen 30d x Tasa LP (0.05)) x 365 / Liquidez Total x 100** Para este caso usare la pool de (GRAIN/DEC), pero, es lo mismo con todas las demás para que ustedes hagan sus cálculos. * **Liquidez Total: $38049.09** * **Actividad en los últimos 30d: $7325.95** Calcular las comisiones generadas para los LP en 30 días. Algo que no mencione es que me parece que la pool reparte el 5% entre los proveedores de liquidez. * **$7325.95 x 0.05= $366.29 USD** Ahora lo que sigue es calcular la ganancia diaria promedio * **$366.29/30 = $12.21 por día** Lo siguiente que haremos es proyectar esa ganancia, pero ahora a un año * **$12.21 x 365= $4456.65 USD al año** Por ultimo y para terminar ahora si vamos con porcentaje de rendimiento anual APR * **($4456.65/$38049.09) x 100= 11.71%** --- ***Nota: Entonces con esto, sabemos que si agregamos liquidez en esta pool ganaremos el 11.71% anual de nuestra inversión, eso sería 0.96% al mes, algo que, si es bastante bajo, pero, lo que le da un buen APR a las pools de liquidez, es si el volumen supera al TVL a la liquidez que hay dentro de la pool, es decir, tendría que mover mas de $38493.25 para que sea interesante. Aunque ya les dije en la primera sección de qué forma aprovechar esto.***

links.title: 順德開吃(2)
links.body: 在順德，開吃很重要，但也不是唯一的，也要到處逛逛才行，所以第一天我喝完早茶後，就先去了順德博物館參觀一下。\n\n

/> 雖然是星期六，但博物館人挺少的，我看到的人加起來應該不到30人。順德的古代史沒什麼驚天動地的大事件，所以展館展示的都是傳統習俗及文化比較多，而這些跟香港也挺接近，所以對我來說不是很吸引，反而幾個副館包括香雲紗、李小龍及粵劇展及吸引我。 李小龍及粵劇相信大家都知道是什麼，香雲紗則被稱為紡織界的軟黃金，是中國唯一純植物及礦物全手工絲綢，是非遺之一，用一種叫「薯莨」的汁液去浸染，天然晾曬而成，它輕薄涼爽防水，很適合在廣東穿著，而且製成禮服也很高級，我在展館就看到幾件，摸上手還很舒服。 看完博物館已經是飯點了，但早茶吃太多還不餓，就直接去了清暉園參觀，這是嶺南四大園林之首，也是中國十大名園之一，始建於明朝，佔地2.2萬平方米，不過它本來沒那麼大的，是政府在復修時擴建了幾次。
/> 園內有很多展板講解了整個清暉園的格局、建築及裝飾結構等，為何園南要有一個大水池，園北建築卻越來越多都是有原因的，只可惜這裡現在也是一個網紅拍照地，到處都是拍照的人，人太多，我也逛得有點煩燥，所以沒有逛很久。 這個時間開始餓了，要開吃了，就去了清暉園旁邊的華蓋路步行街，一條民國西式騎樓街，重點是很多吃的，而我在第一間店何姨葛水已經吃了很多...
/> 我先點了一個魚皮和雙皮奶，雙皮奶其實真的是有兩層奶皮，首先煮滾的牛奶冷卻後先有一層奶皮，這時廚師會在奶皮刺孔把奶倒出來加蛋白和糖，奶皮留在碗裡，奶再倒進碗裡燉蒸會再形成一層奶皮，所以叫雙皮奶。而順德的水牛奶乳脂高遠8%，所以奶皮特別厚，口感特別爽，奶也特別香滑，真的，比香港的好吃。 至於魚皮則是用當地的淡水草魚，皮厚特別爽脆。
/> 這是倫教糕，吃上去像白糖糕，但後來我才知道這不是正宗的，正宗的倫教糕是倫教區自家米打成米漿天然發酵，會有一種輕微的酒香及微酸，而我吃這個應該只是會酵母粉來發酵，吃上去就跟白糖糕差不多。大良區這邊也有倫教老字號開的分店，不過我錯過了。

/>

最後來到何姨葛水當然要喝碗葛水，這裡的葛水是用本地的粉葛加上甘蔗、竹蔗、紅蘿蔔和馬蹄煮成，有點點像湯，但真的是很清甜解暑，明顯是沒有額外添糖，都是來自粉葛自身的甜味，這個我很推薦。

其實這店只是在清暉園和華蓋路之間的一條小巷，我都還沒有正式進入華蓋路......現在，我終於要去華蓋路再吃了。
