links.title: Ferrari LUCE: Luxury and the Temptation to Become “More Practical” 🚗 🤔 [Eng+Spa] Entre el lujo y la tentación de volverse “más práctico” 🚗
links.body: * * * * * * (Versión en español más abajo). ------------------------------- * * * * * * I was intrigued by the news that Ferrari was unveiling its first electric car (and that it was a 5-seater). While the press article piqued my curiosity, let's be honest, this type of car is way beyond my budget and my purchasing priorities. Even so, Ferrari has always been an instantly recognizable brand thanks to its racing successes, its symbolic weight in the Italian automotive industry, and even those references that pop up in old movies when they want to shout “this is luxury.”

/>

[Image source.](https://www.italpassion.fr/es/ferrari/ventas-de-ferrari-2024-vs-2023-quienes-son-los-ganadores-y-quienes-los-perdedores/)

What Really Changes
-------------------

The most talked-about aspect isn't just Ferrari going electric, but also that its first fully #electric\_car model is being presented with five seats, four doors, and a more family-oriented focus. This shift is huge for a brand that built its image around the pure supercar, the exclusive vehicle, and the idea that not everyone can own one.

Furthermore, the data shows they're not talking about a timid experiment: the model boasts over 1,000 horsepower, a top speed approaching 310 km/h, a range exceeding 500 kilometers, and a price tag of around €550,000. Ferrari is selling it as a technological and emotional statement, not simply a vehicle for getting from point A to point B.

The Risky Bet
-------------

It seems to me there's a clear tension here: Ferrari wants to grow without losing its aura, but those two things don't always go hand in hand. When a brand thrives on scarcity, anticipation, and a sense of privilege, opening itself up too much to the market can dilute precisely what makes it desirable.

That's the underlying risk. If Ferrari starts to seem more like a \

brand, it could approach a territory where it ceases to be an aspirational symbol and begins competing in a different league, with different rules and different buyers. And in the luxury sector, selling more doesn't always mean being worth more in people's minds.\n\n

/>

[Image source.](https://ev.iphonemod.net/first-look-ferrari-luce-1050-hp/)

What it makes me think
----------------------

I'm not Ferrari's target audience, neither in its classic version nor in this new electric era. But precisely for that reason, I find it interesting: it sparks my curiosity to see how a brand so associated with status, exclusivity, and the fantasy of \

decides to reach a wider audience. In the end, many luxury brands sell less for real utility and more for identity. And therein lies the big question: What does a company gain when it tries to sell to more people if, in doing so, it risks losing the mystique that made it special? Between tradition and the future -------------------------------- I also understand that Ferrari can't remain frozen in the past. The market is changing, electrification is advancing, and major brands have to adapt if they don't want to become obsolete in a few years. The difference lies in how they make that leap: evolving is one thing, but appearing to abandon their own DNA is quite another. Perhaps that's the key: trying to ensure the electric future still smells like Ferrari, even if it has more doors, more space, and a less wild profile than one might imagine upon hearing the name. And that, honestly, is the part that will generate the most conversation.

/> [Image source.](https://www.italpassion.fr/ferrari/voici-la-ferrari-luce-et-ce-quen-pensent-vraiment-les-proprietaires-ferrari/) In closing ---------- In short, I find this news interesting not because I'm going to buy one, but because it shows how even a brand with an almost mythical reputation can be tempted to change course to grow more. And when that happens at a company like Ferrari, the debate isn't just about engines: it's also about identity, prestige, and how much it costs to remain exclusive. * * * * * *

> (English version above). ------------------------ * * * * * * Ferrari LUCE: Entre el lujo y la tentación de volverse “más práctico” 🚗 ======================================================================== Me llamó la atención la noticia de que Ferrari estaba presentando su primer carro eléctrico (y que era un auto de 5 puestos). Aunque el artículo de prensa despertó mi curiosidad, seamos honestos, este tipo de autos está muy por encima de mi presupuesto y de mis prioridades de compra. Aun así, Ferrari siempre ha sido una marca que uno reconoce al instante por sus éxitos en las carreras, por su peso simbólico en la industria italiana y hasta por esas referencias que aparecen en películas viejas cuando quieren gritar “esto es lujo”.

/> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://www.italpassion.fr/es/ferrari/ventas-de-ferrari-2024-vs-2023-quienes-son-los-ganadores-y-quienes-los-perdedores/) Lo que cambia de verdad ----------------------- La parte que más ruido hace no es solo que Ferrari se pase a lo eléctrico, sino que su primer modelo totalmente eléctrico se presente con cinco plazas, cuatro puertas y una orientación más familiar. Ese giro es enorme para una marca que construyó su imagen alrededor del superdeportivo puro, del coche exclusivo y de la idea de que no todo el mundo puede tener uno. Además, los datos muestran que no están hablando de un experimento tímido: el modelo llega con más de 1.000 caballos, una velocidad máxima cercana a 310 km/h, autonomía superior a 500 kilómetros y un precio de alrededor de 550.000 euros. Ferrari lo está vendiendo como una apuesta tecnológica y emocional, no como un simple vehículo para ir del punto A al punto B. La apuesta arriesgada --------------------- A mí me da la impresión de que aquí hay una tensión clara: Ferrari quiere crecer sin perder su aura, pero esas dos cosas no siempre caminan juntas. Cuando una marca vive de la escasez, la espera y la sensación de privilegio, abrirse demasiado al mercado puede diluir justo lo que la hace deseable. Ese es el riesgo de fondo. Si Ferrari empieza a parecer más una marca “útil” o “familiar”, puede acercarse a un terreno donde deja de ser un símbolo aspiracional y pasa a competir en otra liga, con otras reglas y otros compradores. Y en las marcas de lujo, vender más no siempre significa valer más en la mente de la gente.

/> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://ev.iphonemod.net/first-look-ferrari-luce-1050-hp/) Lo que me hace pensar --------------------- Yo no soy el público de Ferrari, ni en su versión clásica ni en esta nueva etapa eléctrica. Pero justamente por eso me parece interesante: me despierta curiosidad ver cómo una marca tan asociada al estatus, a la exclusividad y a la fantasía de “tener algo que casi nadie tiene” decide mirar hacia un público más amplio. Al final, muchas marcas de lujo se venden menos por utilidad real y más por identidad. Y ahí está la gran pregunta: ¿qué gana una firma cuando intenta venderle a más gente, si en ese camino corre el riesgo de perder el misterio que la hacía especial? Entre tradición y futuro ------------------------ También entiendo que Ferrari no puede quedarse congelada en el pasado. El mercado cambia, la electrificación avanza y las grandes marcas tienen que moverse si no quieren verse obsoletas dentro de unos años. La diferencia está en cómo hacen ese salto: una cosa es evolucionar y otra muy distinta es parecer que están renunciando a su propio ADN. Quizás ahí esté la jugada: intentar que el futuro eléctrico siga oliendo a Ferrari, aunque tenga más puertas, más espacio y un perfil menos salvaje de lo que uno imaginaría al oír el nombre. Y esa, honestamente, es la parte que más conversación va a generar.

/> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://www.italpassion.fr/ferrari/voici-la-ferrari-luce-et-ce-quen-pensent-vraiment-les-proprietaires-ferrari/) Para cerrar ----------- En resumen, la noticia me parece interesante no porque vaya a comprarme uno, sino porque muestra cómo incluso una marca con fama casi mítica puede verse tentada a cambiar de rumbo para crecer más. Y cuando eso pasa en una casa como Ferrari, el debate no es solo de motores: también es de identidad, prestigio y de cuánto vale seguir siendo exclusivo. * * * * * * #tribe #community #lifestyle #thoughts #pensamientos #reflexiones #ferrari #luxury * * *

links.title: El cumpleaños número 9 de mi pequeño Diego
links.body: >Hoy es un día para celebrar la vida de mi mini mi. Hola a todos, es un verdadero gusto pasar por aquí, un rincón que aprecio para dejar plasmadas mis memorias de lo que ha sido el paso del tiempo y de la vida misma, que a veces se nos va más rápido de lo que asimilamos y por suerte nos quedan las fotografias para volver a revivir el momento.

>Hoy está de cumpleaños una personita sumamente especial para mí: mi hijo pequeño. Él es alguien a quien quiero con todo mi corazón y con quien, además, finalizo por completo la etapa de la maternidad. Es por eso que cada actividad que realizo con él en la escuela me la disfruto al máximo y la vivo con mucha intensidad, porque en el fondo sé que será la última vez que experimente esas vivencias escolares de primera mano. Verlo crecer es hermoso, pero también te deja esa nostalgia de querer congelar el tiempo o que dure mucho más.

\n\n

>Hoy está cumpliendo 9 años de vida. Él es un niño alegre, muy inteligente y bastante competitivo, por lo que siempre termina destacando en sus actividades escolares, y yo, como su madre, me siento inmensamente orgullosa de cada uno de sus logros y de brindarle siempre compañía.

\n\n>

>Today is a day to celebrate the life of my little one. Hello everyone, it’s truly a pleasure to stop by here—a little corner I cherish for capturing my memories of the passage of time and of life itself, which sometimes slips away faster than we can process, but luckily we have photographs to relive those moments.
Today is the birthday of a very special little person to me: my youngest son. He is someone I love with all my heart and with whom, moreover, I am completely wrapping up my journey as a mother. That’s why I enjoy every activity I do with him at school to the fullest and experience it with such intensity, because deep down I know it will be the last time I get to experience those school moments firsthand. Watching him grow is beautiful, but it also leaves you with that bittersweet longing to freeze time or make it last much longer.
Today he turns 9 years old. He is a cheerful, very intelligent, and quite competitive boy, which is why he always excels in his school activities, and I, as his mother, feel immensely proud of each of his achievements and of always being there for him.

\n\n

>En esta oportunidad, yo tenía una idea diferente en mente; quería celebrarle la fiesta de cumpleaños el fin de mes, específicamente el día 30. Mi plan era esperar un poquito para así tener más dinero disponible y comprar más cosas para consentirlo. Pero él insistió tanto en que la celebración fuese el mismo día de su cumpleaños que me convenció, terminé cediendo y haciéndolo así, tal cual él quería. Al final, los hijos tienen una forma especial de convencernos.

>A pesar de las carreras por la fecha, logré realizar la torta que tanto quería. Para prepararla, apliqué técnicas de repostería que antes no había usado jamás y, afortunadamente, todo fue fluyendo de manera perfecta para que me quedara tal cual la imaginaba. Es más, siendo sincera, el resultado final superó por completo mis expectativas y me dio una gran satisfacción.

>Fue una reunión muy íntima, justo como las que a mí me gusta realizar. Es el tipo de festejo donde solo invito a las personas más cercanas y queridas, y para mí estuvo más que bien. La verdad es que no me gustan las reuniones en mi casa con tanta gente; prefiero la tranquilidad y la conexión real con los pocos que asisten.

>This time, I had a different idea in mind; I wanted to throw his birthday party at the end of the month, specifically on the 30th. My plan was to wait a little while so I’d have more money available and could buy more things to spoil him. But he insisted so much that the celebration be on his actual birthday that he convinced me; I ended up giving in and doing it just as he wanted. In the end, kids have a special way of convincing us.

>Despite the rush to meet the deadline, I managed to make the cake I wanted so much. To prepare it, I used baking techniques I’d never tried before, and fortunately, everything went perfectly so it turned out exactly as I’d imagined. In fact, to be honest, the final result completely exceeded my expectations and gave me great satisfaction.

>It was a very intimate gathering, just the kind I like to host. It’s the type of celebration where I only invite my closest and dearest friends and family, and for me, it was more than enough. The truth is, I don’t like having so many people over at my house; I prefer the tranquility and the genuine connection with the few who attend.

\n\n

>Para hacer el día aún más perfecto, vino su mejor amigo, y ver la cara de felicidad de mi hijo al recibirlo no tuvo precio. Él estaba realmente contento. Compartimos un rato muy ameno, comimos y pudimos, en familia, celebrar un año más de vida de mi pequeño Diego. Cerramos el día agradeciendo profundamente a Dios por su vida, por su gracia y por su gran inteligencia. Sé que con el favor de Dios será un hombre de bien en el futuro y que podrá cumplir cada una de las metas que se proponga en la vida. ¡Felices 9 años, mi amor!

\n\n>

>To make the day even more perfect, his best friend came over, and seeing the look of joy on my son’s face when he greeted him was priceless. He was truly happy. We had a wonderful time together, ate a meal, and celebrated another year of my little Diego’s life as a family. We ended the day by giving heartfelt thanks to God for his life, for His grace, and for his great intelligence. I know that, with God’s help, he will grow up to be a good man and will be able to achieve every goal he sets for himself in life. Happy 9th birthday, my love!

World Dracula Day is a holiday celebrated 
annually on May 26th, commemorating the publication of Bram Stoker's novel **Dracula.** Since its release in the late 19th century, this book has left an indelible mark on literature and, many years later, on film.

> El Día Mundial de Drácula es una festividad que se celebra anualmente el 26 de mayo y conmemora internacionalmente la publicación de la novela \

de Bram Stoker. Desde su lanzamiento a finales del siglo XIX, este libro dejó una huella imborrable en la literatura y, muchos años después, en el cine.\n\nAlthough vampires have existed in folklore for thousands of years, it wasn't until ***Bram Stoker's*** masterpiece that they were considered a real and threatening evil force. That's probably why Dracula has endured through the years in one form or another. And that's probably also why this holiday is celebrated every year. Vampires are a fundamental element of horror literature, and Dracula has been and always will be its king. links.title: [EN/PT] Coffee and cake: the perfect combination
links.body: > # [EN] Today my wife was craving cake, and I couldn’t say no. I went to a cake shop near our house to pick one up for us. She actually wanted corn cake, but unfortunately they didn’t have any. So I ended up choosing a cake-pudding instead. It’s not as good as corn cake, because corn cake has that homemade flavor that I really enjoy. Cake-pudding, on the other hand, is much sweeter, especially because of the sugar syrup on top. Even so, I brought it home because between having no cake at all and bringing a different option, it was better not to come back empty-handed. I really enjoy having cake with coffee. For me, it’s a combination that’s hard to beat. My favorite is still carrot cake with coffee — to me, that’s the perfect pairing. But I didn’t let the opportunity pass, and I enjoyed the evening having cake-pudding with a hot cup of coffee. Cake-pudding isn’t really my favorite because it’s very sweet, but since there was no corn cake, it did the job pretty well. And for anyone who enjoys sweeter desserts, it can be a great choice. In the end, what mattered most was enjoying that simple moment at home, sharing coffee and a slice of cake with my companion and making the evening a little more pleasant. ---- # [PT] Hoje minha esposa ficou com vontade de comer bolo, e eu não poderia negar. Fui até uma casa de bolos aqui perto de casa para buscar um para nós. Na verdade, ela queria bolo de milho, mas infelizmente não tinha. Acabei escolhendo um bolo-pudim. Não é tão bom quanto bolo de milho, porque o bolo de milho tem aquele sabor mais caseiro que eu gosto bastante. Já o bolo-pudim é bem mais doce, principalmente por causa da calda de açúcar. Mesmo assim levei para casa, porque entre ficar sem bolo e levar uma opção diferente, melhor não voltar de mãos vazias. Eu adoro comer bolo com café. Para mim, é uma combinação difícil de superar. Meu favorito continua sendo bolo de cenoura com café — para mim é a combinação perfeita. Mas não deixei a oportunidade passar e aproveitei a noite comendo bolo-pudim acompanhado de um café quentinho. Bolo-pudim não é muito do meu gosto justamente por ser bem doce, mas, na falta de um bolo de milho, acabou cumprindo bem o papel. E para quem gosta de sobremesas mais doces, pode ser uma ótima escolha. links.title: Finally pulling the bowling back together
links.body: I started the bowling league for foreigners here in Da Nang and from the beginning I have been one of the better bowlers in the league.   This doesn't mean I was always the best but I was one of the people that could be counted on to always do better than most.  \n\nWhen we introduced a championship belt into our group, I was the first person who won it.   I will admit that I \

only a single week because at that point I had the belt for 13 weeks in a row and it was getting kind of old having the same person dominate.  I dropped it like a WWE scripted wrestling match to a guy that we had nicknamed \

who unfortunately is no longer with us or anyone else on earth because he died. I'll get into that story another day because it is a cautionary tale, but instead of dragging down the mood lets stick with the bowling and how in the past month, I think I have finally gotten my swing figured out and now I am regularly bowling over 150 and rarely miss spare pickups.

>
[src](https://images.stockcake.com/public/7/b/2/7b2f1935-0745-443a-a8e7-2d4ca2f3d673_large/bowling-joy-unleashed-stockcake.jpg)</center>

I bowl with a left to right curve.  If I roll the ball faster the hook is less profound, if I roll it softer the curve is going to be more extreme.   I don't actively TRY to curve the ball because that is a fantastic way to always miss the mark and isn't controllable.  The curve that I have is just the natural way in which I release the ball with the movement of my hand and I do not use the thumb hole.   I think it was actually one of you here that used the term \

and basically that is what I do (I think it was @bozz that gave me that term) in that I turn my hand slightly at release of the ball. Anyway, I had a problem in the past with figuring out my release and this was holding me back and even sometimes having the ball fly kind of out of control and very off target at times. I seem, through having gone to our practice days on Tuesdays the last 4 weeks, to have figured out hot to make it simply happen instead of forcing it. I have been doing this style of release for so long that I honestly cannot roll a bowling ball without curving it, and this can sometimes be a problem when I have a single pin remaining on the right hand side of the lane.
https://bryanbowls.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/spare1.jpg?w=300
The only way I can get one of these is to cross the entire lane from a far left position and know how it is that my spin that moves the ball from the right to the left is going to interact with the oil and make my ball start to go straight right at the end and move forward hitting the last remaining pin. If you throw it too hard it gutters on the right, throw it too soft and the spin causes the ball to curve and miss the pin. While it might not seem this way to an onlooker, getting the single 10 pin is one of the most difficult things that I do while I am out there and this is due to my inability to roll a ball straight. Most bowlers would just try to go really straight on the right gutter along the side but I cannot do that. If I start the ball over there my ball is going to end up somewhere in the middle of the lane by the time it gets down there. Confused yet? Well then

>
[src](https://media.tenor.com/cuTFXQnJeGsAAAAe/obviously-youre-not-a-golfer-big-lebowski.png)</center>

yesterday during practice bowling I had an absolutely outstanding day.   I kind of screwed up in the first frame, knocking down 3 and then 4 on my first two balls but from that point forward I was basically unstoppable.   I closed every single frame from 2-10 and ended up with a 187, which was the highest score of anyone in our 5-person practice group.

My other two games were not as great but I did get over 150 on all 3 games.   I am very happy with that because even though I have been doing this for many years I still only have around a 130 average.  I think I may have finally figured out how to do this game.

https://images.bowl.com/bowl/media/legacy/uploadedimages/Welcome/Welcome_Home/KeyPinDiagram.png

Something I always struggle with is if I have leftover pins that are two in the same zone.   a 1/5, 2/8, 3/9 both being leftover at the same time is something I normally have a tough time cleaning up because I can't bowl straight at the pins.  The only way I can get them is if my curve just hits the headpin perfectly on my \

and pushes the head pin back to knock down the one behind it.   Thankfully, when you bowl with a curve and thanks to just normal physics, people that bowl with a curve will not often have these two pins leftover because of the ball moving from right to left as well as forward.  Straight bowlers end up with this sort of leftovers on a regular basis.  \n\nThis is called a \

and it is actually very common with straight bowlers.  I almost never have one of these left over and my pickup percentage is probably less than 20% success.   I only had one of those yesterday but I picked it up as well.  \n\nI only missed a single, single-pin pickup across 30 frames.  This is a very good day for me and I had the best scores out of all of us even though I was there with 2 people that have recently been the overall champion.  I haven't had \

in probably a year.   

I think if I can continue along this path that I will soon be the champion though.  I just need to not get arrogant. 

I was gloating about this to my friend who used to live in SE Asia and was a good friend of mine and then he showed me his son's league scores where he scores around 220 for his average.   Little punk.

links.title: A Loyal Companion in the Fields
links.body:
Today I want to share a black and white photograph that I captured in our village fields. A hardworking man named Abbas came to our farm with his tractor to prepare the land for cultivation. He earns his living by helping farmers make their land ready for crops.
![20260519_082017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX689R4KWuvqGWpBez2jXymA8MKAs957hmkfjyH9GjUiZ/20260519_082017.jpg)

While Abbas was busy working in the field, his beautiful dog stayed close by his side. The dog was moving through the tall grass and looking around carefully, as if he was protecting his owner and watching the surroundings.
I really liked the natural beauty of this moment, so I captured this photograph. After converting it into black and white, the image looked even more emotional and artistic. The contrast between the grass, the dog’s fur, and the peaceful village background created a very special scene.
Village life is full of simple but meaningful moments like these. Loyal animals and hardworking people always create beautiful stories for photography lovers.
I hope you will enjoy this black and white capture from our rural fields.
Thank you for visiting my post

links.body:
/>

¡Salud Hivers! Especial saludo para la comunidad @es-literatos . Gusto saludarlos.

Quizás el pensamiento comienza cuando dejamos de repetir.

Comparto estos versos escritos desde la duda, la sospecha y el cansancio ante las certezas prefabricadas.

Un abrazo fraterno,

ANTONOMASIA DE UN RUMIANTE

Qué bello es el mundo sin la histeria  
que llena al elocuente que la venera,  
además piensa que tener llena la nevera  
asegura su grandeza y hace feria.

Qué mejor despertar en la aurora  
qué esquivar las fútiles verdades  
que cuentan con seniles nimiedades  
del ayer, del futuro y del ahora.

No sé quién aviva tanta histeria,  
remedar con nimias unciones,  
banales y terribles alocuciones  
que hacen ahondar nuestra miseria.

Yo quiero un meticuloso desempeño  
Lector, si te enfocas en leerme  
es mejor llegar al fondo que inerme  
caer en suave senda de despeño.

La verdad es un ave que no posa  
en la facultad de quien la esgrime  
si no pasa el difícil pero sublime  
camino de la historia enjundiosa.  

Si has comprendido que copié  
y has captado la idea en la memoria  
te convido a dudar de toda historia  
en cuyo fondo no has afincado el pie.

Deliberadas promesas cautivantes  
precisamos anteojos para ahondarlas  
no se nos llene el plexo al mirarlas  
antes afilemos el ojo de ignorantes.

**¡Que les vaya bonito!  
Gracias por tu visita. 😍☀️**

<h4 style=\

></center>

**Greetings, Hivers! A special greeting to the @es-literatos community. It is a pleasure to greet you.**

Perhaps thought begins when we stop repeating.

I share these verses written from doubt, suspicion, and weariness before prefabricated certainties.

A fraternal embrace,

**ANTONOMASIA OF A RUMINANT**

How beautiful the world is without hysteria

that fills the eloquent one who venerates it,

who also thinks that having a full refrigerator

secures his greatness and makes a spectacle.

What better awakening in the dawn

than to evade futile truths

that speak with senile trivialities

of yesterday, the future, and the now.

I do not know who fuels so much hysteria,

mimicking with petty anointments,

banal and terrible allocutions

that deepen even more our misery.

I long for a meticulous endeavor

Reader, if you focus on reading me

it is better to reach the depths than, inert,

to fall along a gentle path of ruin.

Truth is a bird that never rests

upon the faculty of the one who wields it

unless he traverses the difficult yet sublime

path of vigorous history.

If you have understood that I copied

and have captured the idea in memory

I invite you to doubt every story

whose depths your feet have never reached.

Deliberate and captivating promises

require spectacles to examine them deeply

let not our plexus swell when beholding them

beforehand, let us sharpen the eye of the ignorant.

**Have a beautiful day!  
Thank you. 😍☀️**

Los cumpleaños en casa son muy importantes, y el de nuestra mami tratamos de hacerlo muy especial, casi siempre es a la que mas cumpleaños le cantamos, el 15 de mayo empezó su celebración con una cena en casa entre nosotros, recibió sus primeros regalos y le cantamos su primer cumpleaños, en esta oportunidad tuvimos la dicha de estar todos juntos algo muy simple pero muy significativo para nuestra mami, ella siempre dice que su mayor regalo lo encuentra en nosotros❤️.

Welcome, dear virtual friends!💕

🙋‍♀️Hey, everyone!❤️. I hope you're all doing great and had a wonderful day. Over here, everything's fine, thank God✨.
Birthdays at home are very important, and we try to make our mom’s birthday extra special; she’s almost always the one we sing “Happy Birthday” to the most. On May 15, her celebration began with a dinner at home just for us; she received her first gifts and we sang “Happy Birthday” to her. This time, we were blessed to be all together—something very simple but very meaningful to our mom. She always says that her greatest gift is us❤️.

links.title: Not only creation, but also protection is also necessary.
links.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/4354570/pexels-photo-4354570.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/person-holding-a-silver-ring-and-a-polishing-tool-4354570/ ) There are many people in this world who want to do many things, even exemplary ones, but many do not know that not only creation is the real thing, but protection is also a big deal. There are many people in this world who have created many things but could not protect them. In fact, many can create many things, but not everyone has the ability to protect them. There are many who build huge houses but do not know or cannot protect them, such as keeping them neatly and neatly arranged. As a result, despite building a huge house, it is not a symbol of beauty or beauty in any way. In fact, when you create something, it is also very necessary to protect it. We always have to keep in mind how to protect that thing before creating anything. We built a house, but if we do not keep it neatly and protect it well, then that creation has no value. However, if we had built that house before creating it, we had thought about how to protect it and protected it along with it, then only then would it be created properly. In fact, there are many people in this world who do not want to understand the thing they are protecting, and they keep blaming others and seeing others' destruction and themselves. We must have a plan to protect everything along with the plan to create it. Because it may happen that we are creating on the one hand and on the other hand the thing we have created is being destroyed or destroyed. If we create on the one hand and cannot protect it on the other hand and it is destroyed carelessly, then of course our efforts and plans will be in vain. And if our efforts are in vain, then that creation will not get any appreciation in any way. It is not only about the creation or destruction of houses that we have to focus on. There are many things in this world that we create and destroy due to negligence and not protecting them, and after a long time we can notice that the thing we have created has been destroyed. If we cannot protect everything along with creating it, then at some point we will realize that it is not possible for us to protect anything, but we will not be able to create anything else later and we will be much more broken in terms of humanity. And as a result, our next generation or our family members will be afraid of us and they will also be afraid to create anything and will fall behind. If we ourselves are able to create and protect that thing along with balancing it properly with the right plan, then the people around us and our family members will also be able to learn a lot from us and they will also get the encouragement to create different things. Also, when we do something new or create something new and can protect it beautifully, it will become an exemplary thing and along with that, our evaluation will increase a lot. People are always remembered and evaluated by other people through their actions. So when we can create something good and can protect it for a long time, then we will definitely get respect from others and we will be appreciated a lot and we will be known especially for that creation of ours. By creating different things, we can express our skills beautifully and in order to express our skills and bring it to the people of the society, there is a special need to protect our creation beautifully. When we create something and cannot protect it properly, everyone will criticize us and sometimes say bad things behind our backs and sometimes to our faces. But if we can protect our creations properly, we will definitely become a worthy person who can create and protect the things we create. Also, if we only create and do not protect, then all our money, time and effort will be wasted, but if we can protect the things we create, then our effort, time and money will be completely worthwhile. So, we must know how to protect as well as create. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/moral-degradation-on-social-media-3wf)

links.title: Calabrese pizza with homemade tomato sauce (Eng - Esp)
links.body:
> **
ENGLISH
** Greetings to my esteemed community of food lovers and those who appreciate good flavor, #Hivefood! May God bless you, and I hope you are enjoying good health and have a happy and blessed start to the week. Today I'm sharing my recipe for a pizza with homemade tomato sauce, which will be my entry for [Qurator's: Hive Top Chef! | Tomatoes](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-tomatoes-tfd0om). Although pizza isn't a traditional Venezuelan dish, it's enjoyed on various occasions such as celebrations and family gatherings, and it's a favorite among children. There are also many recipes for making it at home that can be adapted to local ingredients. Additionally, shopping malls offer a variety of pizzas in different sizes and with a wide range of recipes. I invite you to join me in the preparation process.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Saludos estimada comunidad amante de la comida y el buen sabor #Hivefood, que Dios les bendiga, deseo se encuentren disfrutando de buena salud y tengan un feliz y bendecido inicio de semana. Hoy les comparto la preparación de una pizza con salsa de tomate casera, que será mi entrada para el [Qurator's: Hive Top Chef! | Tomatoes](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-tomatoes-tfd0om), la pizza a pesar de no ser un plato propio de Venezuela se consume en diferentes ocasiones como celebraciones, compartir en familia y es la favorita de los niños, además hay muchas recetas para prepararlas en casa que se adaptan a los rubros de las regiones, también en los centros comerciales hay varios locales donde se vende pizza con variadas recetas y tamaños, les invito me acompañen en el proceso de elaboración, ![PIZZA (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eoc9zTQT3qwWEeZN7PDPN4qVKyAJoMBGXsSZSfAF6JpFgwRjhMAN2FwZyZcmCbmNgy6.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48KdB5B72XkQeKQAr4b7QsaNMpYXUQYoEuWMYHiRrnKRixExzLPsQTBFMUJrsHkJEb.png
> **INGREDIENTS** Wheat flour (850 g) Tomatoes (8) Mozzarella cheese (500 g) Calabrese peppers (400 g) Oregano (1 tbsp) Garlic (7 cloves) Chili pepper (1) Salt and pepper to taste

> **INGREDIENTES** Harina de trigo (850 gr) Tomates (8) Queso Mozzarella (500 gr) Calabreza (400 gr) Orégano (1 cuchara) Ajo (7) Ají (1) Sal y pimienta al gusto ![pizza (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsGPgpgNTWkqXaSs699FqRR68CAKy1S1BuFE4vkdiuiEzNm5gmnsmv95Ge2FXkxh1Ff.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48aZjd6YAm29RfFrqnTw6b9efGPpLchpYRe1LPSBfufuigsvYK1M8w5Pz1PizT8syK.png

> **PREPARATION** Once I had the ingredients ready, I started by washing the tomatoes thoroughly with water and vinegar. I brought a pot of water to a boil, added the tomatoes, and let them cook for 3 minutes to make peeling easier.

> **PREPARACIÓN** Organizados los ingredientes, inicié lavando los tomates con suficiente agua y vinagre, llevé al fuego una olla con agua, al hervir agregué los tomates y dejé en cocción durante 3 minutos para retirar la piel con mayor facilidad. ![pizza (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23x1FXq2sJ9AjTvbDqHc41dz2qDCan8FMeMvmffHUc7gpB8Bedra6TtfEboSwMVNa6PZJ.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48TLUygzYRqXKJoAG6EgeQwe9tnpjp4LJwu9mnbM2f4rBxPKESBMy2KtEmyVa8Zotb.png
> When the tomatoes have cracks in their skin, it's time to peel them. Using a utensil, the skin comes off with minimal effort.

> Cuando los tomates tienen grietas en la piel ya es momento de retirarlos y con ayuda de un cubierto se retira la piel con poco esfuerzo. ![pizza (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xKxMJRzPKnJjH9C1zpPxm38ErXJK5MaJ3NkaaJX2zQToBjQR6EC7FJnBXwMd1oDfmtw.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48TLUygzYRqXKJoAG6EgeQwe9tnpjp4LJwu9mnbM2f4rBxPKESBMy2KtEmyVa8Zotb.png

> After peeling the tomatoes, I put them in the blender and blended until smooth. I didn't add any water, as the tomatoes already contain enough, and I wanted a thick sauce. Then I added a spoonful of oregano, a chili pepper, and the crushed garlic. I blended again and added salt and pepper to taste.

> Retirada la cáscara de los tomates, los llevé a la licuadora y licué hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea, aquí no agregué agua, ya que ellos contienen suficiente, y quería lograr una salsa espesa. Luego añadí una cuchara de orégano, un ají y los ajos triturados nuevamente licué y y agregué sal y pimienta al gusto. ![pizza (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsQYUi5FmLL9TaeVDVFWAyW7Nz1P3bKmFiMqHMXyN5WzD8jKcDzivbJZFQd7MHWKQj7.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48aZjd6YAm29RfFrqnTw6b9efGPpLchpYRe1LPSBfufuigsvYK1M8w5Pz1PizT8syK.png
> I brought the mixture to the heat and left it to cook over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spatula until the desired consistency was obtained, then removed it and let it cool.

> Llevé la mezcla al fuego y dejé en cocción a fuego medio, removiendo constantemente con una paleta de madera hasta obtener la consistencia deseada, retiré y dejé enfriar. ![pizza (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsNEYH6gekd98MVmg7hZQ2DewaERsPFSgMQxqwx1ayiK4vECmp6X19CHT5tRXtZT4dn.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48TLUygzYRqXKJoAG6EgeQwe9tnpjp4LJwu9mnbM2f4rBxPKESBMy2KtEmyVa8Zotb.png

> With the sauce ready, the next step was to knead the wheat flour. I added the flour to a bowl, made a space in the center, a sort of volcano, added the water and mixed until I obtained a smooth dough. I took the dough to the work surface, sprinkled it with flour and divided it into two portions.

> Con la salsa lista, lo siguiente fue hacer amasar la harina de trigo, agregué en un bowl la harina, hice un espacio en el centro, especie de volcán agregué el agua y mezcle hasta obtener una masa suave, llevé la masa al mesón de trabajo,espolvoreé harina y dividí en dos porciones. ![pizza (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tmL1YiSnFnzsnrWdHT8qoMx42KVcyCcoY2i4SQDfrPJceAutNEP1ckuwVbcDQtHx295.jpeg)

> With the help of a rolling pin, I stretched the dough until it was approximately one centimeter thick. Then, I placed it on a floured tray, added the sauce and grated mozzarella cheese, covering the dough.

> Con ayuda del rodillo estiré la masa hasta lograr el grosor aproximado de un centímetro luego, llevé a la bandeja previamente enharinada, agregué la salsa y el queso mozarella rallado, hasta cubrir la masa. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoEsvviKddVDBrVSY3j8spZXc8FpuztuEG5t2U1gS7N1D1MgfavvumJZTh1w2FJK73z.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tHBsrchHy9KUAJJY6RQ7Twxonem3BV1jM4B6gmcguUap7cCm8k4Va5qhdAo8XDaYHRV.png) ![pizza (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tvnuKSQi7FsYEDgvFMcawaaXbGXxrw5vTnfLqzND57aYnvst6BBnPzNkD7khs1Bx7uD.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48aZjd6YAm29RfFrqnTw6b9efGPpLchpYRe1LPSBfufuigsvYK1M8w5Pz1PizT8syK.png
> Then I added the slices of Calabrese sausage and put it in the preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius, left it to cook for 10 minutes, removed it and let it cool.

> Luego agregué las rodajas de calabresa y llevé al horno previamente calentado, a 180 grados centígrados, dejé en cocción durante 10 minutos retiré y dejé enfriar. ![pizza (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsStwqB96EdJaUBM5MJWb3i68zcxNMTPKHRY91GHWDZNZe4um4aEZAok4qxShRUMtb1.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48aZjd6YAm29RfFrqnTw6b9efGPpLchpYRe1LPSBfufuigsvYK1M8w5Pz1PizT8syK.png
> The pepper, combined with the chili and garlic, adds a delicious touch of spice to the sauce. After several minutes, I cut the pizza and served it. 🍕

> La pimienta combinada con el ají y el ajo, agregan un delicioso toque de picante a la salsa, pasados varios minutos corté la pizza y serví.🍕 ![PIZZA (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eoc9zTQT3qwWEeZN7PDPN4qVKyAJoMBGXsSZSfAF6JpFgwRjhMAN2FwZyZcmCbmNgy6.jpeg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48aZjd6YAm29RfFrqnTw6b9efGPpLchpYRe1LPSBfufuigsvYK1M8w5Pz1PizT8syK.png
> Espero sea de su agrado y se animen a prepararlo.
> I hope you like them and are encouraged to prepare them. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kattycrochet/48KdB5B72XkQeKQAr4b7QsaNMpYXUQYoEuWMYHiRrnKRixExzLPsQTBFMUJrsHkJEb.png

> Blessings!
![DESPEDIDA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243WqEKGwvRY9RJ1qZPnXLts1w4aWsLKabKrmKPX156MYbtap5Lt35s16Pe5M5JnrSXfA.jpg)
Translated with https://www.deepl.com/translator ![belk cocina.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23vsoyHCWGGhpPKfmkrwEvoELiwPBFSf1w1PZuRyvBmcLwMUgmxQejvswQxZXpia1WJAH.jpg) All images are my own. Todas las imágenes son de mi autoría.

links.body: >Unsplash 今天接著帶一些小說內容，最近看到一段劇情是，一對是家族明日之星的堂兄弟在對話，對話中堂弟開心表示，長輩新定的家規，可以在犧牲相當利益後，取得較平穩的發展，不用像家族起頭發展時，那麼艱辛冒險。 堂兄則是有點責備的語氣，應該反而要想，他們這一輩不爭氣，長輩實在放不下心，才要去更改制度，做晚輩的應該感到羞愧，而不是洋洋得意，堂弟聽完後也是默然不語的反省。 拿到現實生活來看，就像是家族企業、帝王傳承一樣，創業的第一代艱辛，第二代可能也體驗過一段艱困的日子，所以可以保持上代的精神，第三代出生開始就已經生活較為優渥，從小只是聽過之前的經驗，並沒有心裡的深刻感受。 長輩可能會擔心後輩這種生活經歷不夠應付未來環境，所以會提前佈好局面，要讓有能的族人、外人留下，又要搞好權力分立，但往往生前所想的，到死了以後都會變了樣，畢竟預先安排好的都是死的，還活在世上的人是會變通的。 之前看影劇太平年，每一個皇帝都已經盡量安排好了，但最後還是因為時局混亂，體制缺陷，導致連續好幾個朝代都只傳了一兩次就變天，就算是宋朝，過了兩代經歷亂世的兄弟後，第三代就明顯遜色很多。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/f9rwd)

links.body:

起初我乘坐的B大巴车，掉头返回安检站接人时，我知道后是不开心的(应该说车里的人全都不开心，后排的几位美女子问我是不是在车队的群里?她们要投诉云云……

我说没有，只是几个认识的朋友组建的群，也没有车队电话，投诉可能得明天联系小程序客服吧，现在都下班了

而Gbuss司机也许猜到了大家会有情绪，下车时拜托了Bbuss司机给大家道歉，并说会和公司沟通，帮大家申请退款。

大概22:00左右，突然得到一个消息Gbuss司机会因此事被开除。然后了解详情的大家都很吃惊，纷纷表示G司机很好心热心，有些疏忽，但不应该承担全部责任(返程司机没有乘客电话，上车数人头，等掉队的人没等到，且其他乘客不愿意耽误时间，要求启程)

掉队的人大家都不认识，还是次日晓得对方被帽子叔叔扣住了，ta又没师傅电话，得知自己掉下来后，打了12345等热线投诉司机，车队领导还有合作方才都知道了……

PS昨天下午收到了最新通知，G司机没有被开除，扣了一天工资(嘿嘿两车的乘客联名给车队打电话证明不是司机的全责，希望不要开除司机

对了图片不是听八卦，与文章无关，就纯纯看到了耳机试戴了下，木有声音😂

**感谢你的支持和阅读！祝阖家安康！财源滚滚🤑**

**“Sun” en español es _sol_**, y tu ejemplo **“El sol está fuerte”** suena natural y claro para estudiantes. Si quieres una versión un poco más estándar en uso cotidiano, también encajan **“Hace mucho sol”** o **“El sol está muy fuerte”**. [SpanishDict](https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/sun) y [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english-spanish/sun) lo recogen como **sol**, sin drama ni misterio.

La imagen funciona bien porque hace dos cosas a la vez: **vocabulario básico** y **apoyo visual inmediato**. Eso ayuda bastante a quien aprende por asociación, que suele ser la forma menos aburrida de fijar palabras nuevas.

Como contexto de tu serie, también aparece reciente **[@aljif7 – A Daily Word in Spanish (412) Piedra](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-412)** dentro de la misma línea educativa. La idea de combinar inglés, español y chino es **bastante inteligente**, porque no solo enseña una palabra: enseña **puentes entre idiomas**.

## ENG
---

Greetings, Hive Open Mic community. I hope you are all doing great. Here is my new entry; the new theme for the week is interesting, and I’ll tell you why below.

It so happens that I was about to record my entry when the electricity went out for several hours. I managed to record my take quickly, although I don't really like doing it that way. Afterward, I had to fix the bathroom sink faucet because a hose broke. Then, while closing the main water valve to the house, it snapped and broke off in my hand. Fortunately, I managed to fix that too. On top of that, I’ve been having some chest pain, and for a moment while doing those chores, it started to hurt more, but I declare healing over my life in the name of Jesus.

Aside from that, many might call this a very bad day, but I didn't let anything worry me. Instead, I laughed at every incident and handled it with total calm and a sense of humor. I honestly enjoyed my bad day.

Without further ado, here is the video. I hope you enjoy it! Thank you, Hive community!

---

## ESP

----

Saludos, comunidad de Hive Open Mic, espero que esten excelentes, aqui les presento mi nueva entrada, es interesante la nueva tematica de la semana, aqui a continuacion les digo porque.

Sucede que iba a grabar mi entrada y se fue la electricidad por muchas horas, logre grabar rapido mi entrada aunque no me gusta de esa manera, luego tuve que arreglar la llave de el lava mano, porque se rompio una manguera, luego cerrando la llave que hace que pase el servicio de agua a la casa se parte y me queda en la mano, afortunadamente arregle eso, y pude lograr hacer eso, de paso ando con un dolor en el pecho y por un momento haciendo esas cosas empezo a doler mas, pero declaro sanidad en mi vida en nombre de Jesus.

De resto este dia muchos podrian llamarlo muy malo, pero no me inquiete por nada, mas bien me rei de cada suceso, lo lleve con suma tranquilidad y con mucha diversion, de verdad disfrute mi mal dia.

links.title: Lisa's Story, Musical Duo
links.body:
Warm greetings, dear friends! In this new story, I'm going to share the life of Lisa. As you'll see, she's a singer at Buskeria who finds herself in a situation with her friend Sofia. They're very close friends. If you want to find out what happens, well, you know what to do: read the story. I hope you enjoy it. So buckle up, because it's about to begin!

> Saludos cordiales queridos amigos, en esta nueva historia les voy a compartir la vida de Lisa, como verán ella es una cantante dentro de Buskeria que se ve envuelta en una situación con su amiga Sofía. Ambas son muy buenas amigas. Si quieren enterarse de que es lo que les pasa pues ya saben a leer la historia, espero que les guste. Pues abróchense los cinturones que esto ya está arrancando.

<div class=\

> ![1770737800689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xefsJXXLxzNaRMHg1TaP6hBJYrHHUHqQaFMYA2SsCVKPRtzy4NeEeCcR2C8JBBSDgES.jpg) Image created by me in canva **Post translated with Google Translate** Even as children, the two girls knew each other, as they lived in the same house. Lisa was the daughter of the homeowners, her parents, and Sofia was the daughter of the neighbors. They left Sofia with her and her parents all day because they had to work far away. They paid Sofia's parents a salary to look after her. Lisa and Sofia became very good friends. Since they were together all day, they spent their time playing all sorts of games, the best of which was pretending to be singers. They would sing as best they could, repeating the chorus of whatever song they remembered. Their parents laughed a lot at them because they genuinely believed they were real singers. Their love for music developed and grew so strong that their parents had to do something about it. They enrolled them in music lessons so they could learn. Both girls loved what they were learning, excelled, and prepared themselves to the best of their ability to go to Buskeria and win everyone over. At this point, they went their separate ways because each needed to build her own image and career. However, their friendship never cooled; neither the distance nor the absence of the other diminished their feelings for each other. They would be friends forever. They supported each other a lot through phone calls and were always happy for the other's progress. > Siendo niñas las dos ya se conocían, y es que Vivian en la misma casa. Lisa era la hija de los dueños de la casa, es decir sus padres, y Sofía era la hija de los vecinos. Pero ellos se la dejaban todo el día con ella y con sus padres porque tenían que trabajar muy lejos. Le pagaban un salario a los padres de ella para que la cuidaran. Lisa y ella se hicieron muy buenas amigas. Como estaban todo el día juntas se la pasaban jugando a mil cosas distintas, entre esos juegos estaba el mejor ser cantantes de mayores. Se la pasaban cantando como podían y repitiendo el pedazo de estribillo de la canción que se les grabara. Los padres se reían mucho de las dos porque en verdad creían que eran cantantes de verdad. > Su amor por la música se fue desarrollando y haciéndose tan grande que los padres de ambas niñas tuvieron que hacer algo al respecto. Las pusieron a estudiar música para que pudieran aprender. A ambas le encantaba lo que aprendían, destacaron mucho y se prepararon de lo mejor para salir a Buskeria a ganarse a todos. En este punto se separaron porque cada una debía construir su propia imagen y carrera. Eso si, su amistad jamás se enfrío, ni la distancia ni la falta de la presencia de la otra hizo que lo que sentían la una por la otra se apagara. Serían amigas por siempre. Se apoyaban mucho en llamadas y cada una estaba feliz por el progreso d de la otra.

> ![vitaly-gariev-TLBt_IbTMrg-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/242YE9LWaz9Vg2XrfhkJFwYrH2mkFmSKyxXcFB3qnqNKJ54nCSpeocypn5KN97uyaT6aP.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) As time went on, the two continued to grow at a rapid pace. Lisa became a pop singer, and Sofía a rock singer. They were two very different genres, and each mastered hers to the fullest. Lisa released several albums that were among the most listened-to pop songs on Buskeria for days, earning her a lot of respect in the industry. And Sofía released several incredible rock albums that people loved. At this point in their careers, many singers drift apart from their original friends or become competitors of those who were once their friends. But not these two; they went against the grain. They remained friends, best friends. After many years, they decided to reunite in the same house where their dreams had begun and where they used to play at being singers. At that get-together, they decided to do something big together. Their first collaborative album would be a pop/rock mix, a perfect blend to unite the best of both genres. They were both overjoyed. The two friends working together for the first time. > Pasando el tiempo las dos continuaron creciendo a un gran ritmo, Lisa por su lado se hizo cantante de pop, y Sofía de rock. Eran dos géneros muy distintos y cada una lo dominó al máximo. Lisa logró lanzar varios discos que fueron de los más escuchados del pop en Buskeria por días, eso le valió ganar mucho respeto de la industria. Y Sofía lanzó varios discos de rock que fueron increíbles, a la gente les encantó. En este punto de sus carreras muchos cantantes se distancian de sus amigos originales o se vuelven competencia de los que una vez fueron sus amigos. Pero ellas dos no, iban a contra corriente. Seguían siendo amigas, las mejores amigas. > Luego de muchos años decidieron reunirse de nuevo, en la misma casa donde los sueños habían comenzando y donde jugaban a ser cantantes. En esa reunión social decidieron hacer algo grande juntas. Su primer disco en colaboración, seria de pop/rock una mezcla perfecta para unir lo mejor de ambos géneros. Las dos estaban súper contentas. Las dos amigas juntas trabajando por primera vez.

> ![cord-allman-CI4ULe0Z22w-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wg9PJTyWD1Y3qcnGJTsyVynFRUKe4kYbBzexrWWobLsL8eKhh7w9msN4o5KwF6vb7K8.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) It took them about a year to create and produce the special collaborative album. When they released it, it was exactly what they expected; it wasn't even a surprise, it was a huge success. But it didn't end there. They embarked on a tour together throughout Brazil to perform live for all their fans. It was going to be amazing because it was the first time they'd ever performed together. But there were things Lisa was going to discover about Sofia that she didn't know. On the tour, at their first concert, Lisa noticed that Sofia always used playback for every song. It really struck her as odd because there was no need to do it. When the concert ended, she asked Sofia why she did it, and Sofia just said it was because she got tired. This bothered Lisa a little because she knew that if she were caught doing it, it could affect her musical career. Sofia ignored her and continued using playback at every concert on the tour. She was confident that nothing would ever happen; if nothing had happened so far, why would it? > Tardaron cerca de 1 año en crear y producir el disco especial en colaboración. Cuando lo lanzaron era lo que esperaban, es que ni siquiera les cogió de sorpresa, fue todo un éxito. La cosa no terminó ahí porque iniciaron una gira juntas por toda Buskeria para cantar en directo para todos sus fans en conciertos. Sería genial porque era la primera vez que hacían un concierto juntas. Pero había cosas que Lisa iba a descubrir de Sofía y que no sabía. En la gira, en su primer concierto Lisa se dio cuenta que la otra siempre usaba playback en todas las canciones. A ella le llamó mucho la atención porque no había necesidad de hacerlo. > Cuando acabó el concierto le preguntó por que lo hacia y ella solo le dijo que porque se cansaba. Eso molestó un poco a Lisa porque sabía que si la descubrían a ella haciendo eso podría afectar su trayectoria musical. Sofía no le hizo caso y siguió usando playback en todos los conciertos de la gira. Estaba confiada de que nunca pasaría nada, si hasta ahora no había pasado porque iba a pasar.

> ![aditya-chinchure-ZhQCZjr9fHo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/EpQoZNEwMkNBrdHMnPy6xqr9jwnwar8r48mgxSC7DQCcwy5dCpVRHMNvZ2Z46ub3DDa.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) She got complacent because, in the middle of a concert, she slipped on stage and the singer kept singing as if nothing had happened. Just as everyone was about to realize the deception, Lisa acted quickly, throwing herself to the floor with her and placing her microphone between them in such a way that people would think they were still singing. They dodged a bullet. And from that day on, Sofía stopped using it—thankfully, Lisa was there to save her. The tour continued and was another huge success. Now they're planning more collaborations together; they're still best friends. But what a scare they had! > Se confió porque en medio de un concierto ella se resbaló en el escenario y la voz continuó cantando como si nada. Cuando todos se iban a dar cuenta del engaño Lisa actuó rápido y se tiró al piso con ella y puso su micrófono entre las dos de tal formas que la gente pensara que aún seguían cantando. Se libraron de una buena. Y desde ese día Sofía dejó de usarlo, menos mal que Lisa estaba ahí para salvarla. La gira continuó y fue nuevamente un gran éxito. Ahora planean hacer más colaboraciones juntas, siguen siendo las mejores amigas. Pero que susto pasaron.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2355).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wWy6f4AcbKyoBJ6yS3cxkztpLinPQvZANEW8bDs2kya1GnxXvtUEfzpgdKjJVCZaLP7.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

links.title: Three Tune Tuesday || Paraulata and her musical reminiscences (En–Es)
links.body:
<center>

![Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (12).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48RscBMZuBxzpo5Dr6UrXYnqyzyTT9EiAMUgsWbzpw7vzhHNJJjawzmeQJ7wPhHhL7.png)
</center>

#
<center>

## “Music is the art form that is closest to tears and memory.” 
(Oscar Wilde)
</center>

#
<div class=\
> **Hey #Music friends, I'm flying high with my Caribbean rhythm, which fills me with excitement. Sending you a virtual hug and sharing my songs with @ablaze and #ThreeTuneTuesday.** **¡Suenala DJ!**

> >![Spanish] > > “La música es el tipo de arte que está más cerca de las lágrimas y la memoria.” (Oscar Wilde) Hola amigos de #Music, volandito ando con mi ritmo caribeño, que me pone a vibrar de emocion. Les dejo un abrazo virtual y mis canciones para compartir con @ablaze y #ThreeTuneTuesday. ¡Suenala DJ!
![Romantic and unforgettable melodies from the movies (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/EoEsWUKxaZMvY6e6sighBh3JJdyMy43T9UkUJNSmqATVgqRgaRr26QcVyTvzk5WZg1m.png)

>

I've mentioned before that I never felt alone as a child or teenager, because I was part of a group or brotherhood. There were siblings, cousins, and very close friends. I like all kinds of music. I remember them sitting with the record player listening to music. Of course, this was after doing homework and all their chores. Everyone in my family had their daily tasks. Our lives were spent going from Grandma Bertita's house to our own home.

My dad was a seaman; from his teens he worked fishing on the high seas. When he said, \

everyone would run to get in the car, except for Mom. She didn't like the sand, the sea, or the sun. And since Paraulata was the dark-skinned one, she tried to keep her from getting in the car. But before she knew it, Paraulata was always the first one in. In 1970, he got an ulcer and had to do other things. He sold ice cream, and when he was laid off, he bought his first cart.

He started doing taxi rides, as they used to be called. What we call taxis these days. What can I tell you about the gang? Well, we were terrible and always playing pranks. The only thing that could stop us was Grandma Bertita's cake-baking paddle; she had a real way of persuading people. The gang was always together; I still don't know how we all fit in Dad's car, and whoever couldn't fit followed us on their bikes.

Today I want to share some songs from the older ones: my brothers Luis and Diame, and my cousin Alexander, the funny one of the gang. He told terrible jokes and would get annoyed if we didn't laugh. They're no longer physically with us, but they're in my heart. The others—my older brother Moises, and my cousins Marlene and Indira—are living abroad.

I remember them with their macho shoes, bell-bottoms, floral shirts, wide belts, and long hair. My brothers and cousins couldn't have long hair because of the threats. The boys would sneak off to dance at places called \
; I still remember the name. OMG! Every self-respecting mother back then imitated \
My mom had amazing aim: wherever she aimed, she'd land her slipper. I turn on my jukebox or memory machine and get ready. ## Play it, DJ!

>
> Anteriormente les he comentado que nunca me sentí sola de niña ni de adolescente, pues formaba parte de una tropa o hermandad. Donde hermanos, primos y amigos muy cercanos. Me gustan todos los ritmos musicales. Los evoco sentados con el tocadiscos escuchando música. Por supuesto, después de hacer tareas y todas las obligaciones. Pues en mi hogar todos tenían sus oficios diarios. Nuestra vida transcurrió de casa de abuelita Bertita's a nuestro hogar. 
Mi papi era un hombre de mar; desde su adolescencia trabajó pescando en alta mar. Cuando él decía \

, todos corrían a meterse en el carro, excepto Mami. A ella no le gustaba la arena, ni el mar ni el sol. Y como Paraulata era la morenita, ella pretendía que no se subiera al carro. Pero cuando se daba cuenta, la primera era Paraulata. En el año 1970 se enfermó con una úlcera y tuvo que dedicarse a otras cosas. Vendio helados y cuando lo liquidaron compro su primer carrito. Se dedico a hacer carreritas como se les decia antes. Lo que en la actualidad se les dice taxi. ¿Qué les puedo decir de la tropa? Pues eramos terribles y echadores de broma. Lo único que nos bloqueaba era la paleta de batir torta de abuelta Bertita?s, tenie un gran poder de convencimiento. La tropa siempre andaba unida, todavia no se como entrabamos en el carro de papi, y el que no podia nos seguia en sus bicicletas. Hoy les quiero compartir canciones de los mayores; mi hermanos Luis y mi hermana Diame, y del primo Alexander, este ultimo el comico de la tropa. Echaba unos chistes malisimos y se molestaba si no nos reiamos. Ellos ya no estan fisicamente en este plano terrenal , pero si en mi corazon. Los otros: mi hermano mayor Moises, mi primas Marlene y Indira, se encuentran fuera del pais. Los evoco con sus zapatos machotes, pantalones acampanados, camisas de flores, cinturones anchos y pelos largos. Mis hermanos ni primos los pudieron usar largos por las amenazas. Los varones se escapan a bailar para unos lugares llamados “Las petatecas”; todavía recuerdo el nombre. ¡OMG! Toda madre que se respetaba en esa época imitaba a la “Má Linda de Memim Pinguin”. Mi mami tenía una puntería: donde ponía el ojo ponía la chancla. En estos años estuvieron de moda: Los Darts, Los Impala, Nicola Di Bari, Los Ángeles Negros, Los Beatles, The Rolling Stones entre otros. Como les decía Papi: “Los wachi, wachi”. Mientras escribo, me brotan lágrimas de saber que no volveré a ver a mi tropa reunida ni a mi familia unida. A estos seres especiales, hermanos y primos y amigos que conformaban la tropa, les dedico las tres canciones que traigo para compartir con ustedes en #ThreeTuneTuesday. links.title: I Tried to Build a Startup From Scratch… and Hit Every Roadblock Possible
links.body:
# Hey everyone — long time no see

# The Big Idea

I thought the website would be simple. Turns out… not so much.

# The First Roadblock

Eventually I found a local dev, paid a deposit, and we got started. He completed the home page — then told me the project was way too big for him to handle alone. That was the first big hit.

**Trying to Find a Dev Team**
So I spent two weeks researching dev teams. I emailed four different companies. After four weeks, only one replied.

We had a web meeting, they seemed good, and then they quoted me $100k+ to build the platform. They said they’d send me info about using an AI website builder so I could get a head start and then they’d help after that.

They never emailed me again.

# Trying to Build It Myself

Since then, I tried using an AI website builder — but I don’t have the funds to pay for it. The free version only lets you do 2–3 actions per day for 7 days, then you have to wait until the next month.

After the first week I didn’t want to lose momentum, so I exported the code into my own code editor (even though I can’t code at all) and tried to continue using AI. That… didn’t go well either.

# Where I’m At Now

Do I give up

Do I try to find more funds and take what I’ve built back to my local dev

Or do I aim higher and somehow find the $100k to get a full team to build it properly

I’m honestly stuck between all three options.

****Any Ideas?****
If you’ve got thoughts, advice, or even a different angle I haven’t considered, I’d really appreciate it. I’m not giving up on the idea — I just need to figure out the smartest next step.

Thanks for reading, and thanks in advance for any feedback.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@bobcarj/i-tried-to-build-a-startup-from-scratch-and-hit-every-roadblock-possible-b2h)

links.title: A Day in the Fields with Abbas's Dog
links.body:
Hello friends of the Photography Lovers community 
Today I want to share some beautiful moments that I captured in our village fields. A man named Abbas came to our land with his tractor to prepare the soil for cultivation. He works very hard and earns his living by making people's land ready for farming.
![20260519_080349.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeGw8p4myiJ4oG8geTBytKvqcyZPAspqaPNHqPEvTHQnr/20260519_080349.jpg)

While he was busy working in the fields, his loyal dog was sitting nearby and watching everything carefully. I really liked the calm and innocent expressions of the dog, so I decided to take a few photos.
![20260519_082018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPkJ5vy38MjvL47sxjCjY99fiFjLU8HpwXjhYzvLs3wHF/20260519_082018.jpg)

The dog looked very friendly and faithful. Sometimes he was sitting quietly, and sometimes he was walking around the tractor as if he was protecting his owner. Village life always gives simple but meaningful scenes like these.
I love capturing natural moments from daily rural life because they show real emotions and hardworking people. 
![20260519_082012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeoHYgY7o5XrxEL2kg4fw6sfT3wpxW2FfRq7bmHq3Bfy8/20260519_082012.jpg)
Animals also become an important part of village life, especially dogs who stay with their owners all day.
I hope you will enjoy these photographs of Abbas’s loyal companion.
Thank you for visiting my post

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU6G1Y42DLW1KnCPPywePfSXv3oiFPaSZLjtuxacvwPkk/1779850109235.jpg)

Hello friends!
Happy  #aliveandthriving Monday evening to you, and thank you for your visit!
✨🙋🏻‍♀️✨ 

So friends, this evening I have just a few photos of my #aliveandthriving Monday that I would like to share with you especially the Seagulls!

So in the afternoon I rode the bike over to the Park and I saw the Snowy Egret in the stream,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcX3CnkaHEmR8oSdbCVQCFu92fzTzDMgnja8pBS7uUAs/1779850144631.jpg)

It headed out in the water a little,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmco56ajFtBJzeLxKAKH2s2zLNtjP5zUKw8oN88SgA6Wwd/1779850155568.jpg)

And then went over to it's buddy the Tri-Colored Heron, under a dead tree,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9skENPDXjGwhu25aEWQveNySE8RwZJsgqHByXkk922Z/1779850174733.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSiwFfysq85PSLF4R2SFunVYfSyRWrno4jXu3EusrymE9/1779850174847.jpg)

I decided to leave them alone and I rode a little further into the Park and saw that the Fishing Pier had  a few people fishing,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdC1HgrYgEnq3TbTMtvcXqL4fWispUpp3MYTaSxcZ6tHp/1779850244997.jpg)

Then... One of them dumped a bucket of Shrimp on the Shoreline, got in his car and left...
Well then,
This Seagull came by, grabbed one and left,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUj3nrwCXnTdXukwHgUiMb3TzurFsMD9r1VuKj8YqSe9T/1779850282373.jpg)

This one turned in mid air,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8PHhzd55fEJeBmyfjDR7XV9maiKShK6ifPyQt45DUyM/1779850294702.jpg)

This one is leaving with one as well,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc6tRJur3hTJkRN7mTZUA5M8MGxXLeNFTDs6iTWWAEUAS/1779850309187.jpg)

Then there were three,

Now they are attracting the attention of all the others in the area!

Hello everyone, my Hive friends!

Today I'm super excited because I'm going to draw **Toji Fushiguro** again to see if I can do a much better job this time than last time.

**Toji Fushiguro** is an amazing character from the **Jujutsu Kaisen** series, known as the \

Toji is one of my favorite characters for several reasons. First, he's super tall and strong, with muscles that look like steel 💪. His black hair is always messy, like he just rolled out of bed, which gives him a really cool look. 😴 Also, his eyes have that slightly tired look, but that only makes him look braver, and he has a little mark near his mouth that adds to his personality.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/Eos3GYfq8HqhTv2yxiGifNKhcesXk1iZgDwxwfhkqPJk8A9wGvQef7g6ZJGdGYX5qTb.png)

____

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23vi8P24ziJkunoTREk4DDcG2TBebHAQF6QqS7viWDCr5XfneqUK3bPsDihRePhCs1kAU.png)



**Toji** isn't one to dress up; he always wears a tight black t-shirt and baggy pants. This allows him to move freely, which is great because he's a warrior who needs to jump and run. 🏃‍♂️ He also has several disguises, like a samurai outfit, street clothes, and a sweater, but what I love most about him is that he doesn't need a fancy costume to be the most powerful. He trains a lot and is very disciplined, which inspires me to improve my own drawings and everything I do.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoAcfsFexeq9cA793x7diHqG1AnSeGYAqZtXDYnJXbeG1KvuDbcmDUk9LqKB7Tu6LJR.png)

____


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wqpot4pstN4Awxom6F6tdsZ78mfbDWpbb46tSrF9cesycC8J3fKrs7jS5NLKxFdE5g3.png)

Today I'm going to use some templates I found on a YouTube channel that teaches step-by-step drawing. I hope my new drawing of Toji turns out much better than the last one. I promise I'll do my best! 🎨✨ Don't miss the video, it's awesome!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23w2x1ribS1zSnC6LS5utkkyoGGD4BBKNsukHxWKXLXu7wMZRU1pSphD49p9MitvtrdK8.png)

____

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoiYC9uMoqHbKs9tAbfyDzY5yMJ2TRcFcW7tmagXVe4n3Q2hXUSYMx59wQpq4QC53oN.png)

____

*Photos taken with a Redmi 13 phone
Video recorded with a Redmi 13 phone and edited with Capcut
I use Google Translate*


____

### ESPAÑOL

Hola a todos amiguitos de Hive.

Hoy estoy muy emocionado porque voy a dibujar a **Toji Fushiguro** nuevamente para ver si esta vez lo hago mucho mejor que la vez anterior.

**Toji Fushiguro** es un personaje increíble de la serie **Jujutsu Kaisen**, conocido como el \

. Toji es uno de mis personajes favoritos por varias razones. Primero, es súper alto y fuerte, tiene unos músculos que parecen de acero💪 Su pelo negro siempre está despeinado, como si se hubiera levantado de la cama, y eso le da un toque muy cool. 😴 Además, sus ojos tienen esa mirada un poco cansada, pero eso solo lo hace ver más valiente, y tiene una marquita cerca de la boca que le da personalidad.

**Toji** no es de esos que se visten elegante, él siempre anda con una camiseta negra apretada y pantalones anchos Eso le permite moverse libremente, lo cual es genial porque es un guerrero que necesita saltar y correr. 🏃‍♂️ También tiene varios disfraces, como el de samurái, el de calle y el de suéter, pero lo que más me gusta de él es que no necesita un gran disfraz para ser el más poderoso. Se entrena mucho y es muy disciplinado, lo que me inspira a mejorar en mis propios dibujos y en todo lo que hago.

Hoy voy a usar algunas plantillas que encontré en un canal de YouTube que enseña a dibujar paso a paso. Espero que mi nuevo dibujo de Toji salga mucho mejor que el anterior. Les prometo que me esforzaré al máximo 🎨✨ No se  pierdan el video está super.

image.title: 26 de mayo 2026: Tras muchas horas sin dormir [ESP/ENG]
image.body:
<center>  
https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCSHmDxTJRGcFyPCPif9w6BhrDaGKic81qnGsj4hbruq/mi_portada.jpg
</center> 
 

 <center>  
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
</center>  

<div class=\
> \n \n<div class=\

> No, no padezco insomnio amigos, es sólo que mi hijo ha estado con tos y desde que soy madre, casi no duermo mientras cuido a mis amores durante la noche cuando se enferman. Incluso me mudo a su habitación. Ya son tres noches de sobresaltos y poco sueño, a causa de su tos. Eso me hace sentir un poco aletargada durante el día. Ayer, a lo sumo, dormí dos horas, antes de las 3:30 A.M. Entonces decidí llevarlo hoy al médico de la empresa donde trabajo, prefiero parecer exagerada, a que ellos se compliquen por no haber sido atendidos a tiempo. A las 7:15 ya lo estaba anotando en la lista de pacientes, era el número 24, pero habían tres doctoras; así que en realidad era el número 8.

> No, I don't have insomnia, friends—it's just that my son has been coughing, and ever since I became a mother, I hardly sleep at all when I'm taking care of my little ones at night when they're sick. I even move into their room. It’s been three nights of waking up and getting little sleep because of his cough. That makes me feel a little sluggish during the day. Yesterday, I slept two hours at most, before 3:30 a.m. So I decided to take him today to the doctor at the company where I work; I’d rather seem like I’m overreacting than have things get complicated because he wasn’t seen in time. At 7:15 a.m., I was already signing him up on the patient list; he was number 24, but there were three doctors, so he was actually number 8. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxoT13pZ8q1aWsgCKDAQQRhjC7Eo4dCzyLVLeWKLeF1n/20260526_213854.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Nos sentamos cerca de una ventana, el aire acondicionado no funciona, sin embargo, la mañana estuvo lluviosa y la brisa era fresca. Me sentí agradecida por tener un sitio donde ir para recibir atención médica primaria, sin costo. Además, me sentía tranquila porque sabía que él estaría bien. Tres horas después mi hijo fue atendido, la doctora nos dijo que sus pulmones están bien, que probablemente tengo algo viral o alérgico. Gracias a Dios. Le indicó algunos medicamentos, reposo por 5 días y consulta al terminar el reposo, para saber si está en condiciones de retomar sus actividades cotidianas. Al salir de allí, mi esposo fue por él, para que yo pudiera ir a mi trabajo.

> We sat near a window; the air conditioning wasn’t working, but it had rained that morning and there was a cool breeze. I felt grateful to have a place to go for primary care at no cost. I also felt at ease knowing that he would be okay. Three hours later, my son was seen; the doctor told us that his lungs were fine and that he probably had a viral or allergic infection. Thank God. She prescribed some medication, ordered five days of rest, and scheduled a follow-up appointment after the rest period to determine if he was ready to resume his daily activities. When we left, my husband picked him up so I could go to work. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmduox6MDa38HmTrKuL8f14ej5PSqnMqpWfEJWKigvVZHL/20260526_213946.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Después de regresar a casa y almorzar, mi esposo y yo fuimos a la farmacia a comprar el tratamiento indicado por la doctora, entonces a él se le ocurrió comprar allí 3 sobres de figuritas del mundial de futbol 2026 para el álbum de nuestro príncipe. Al llegar a casa le entregó uno a cada uno de nuestros hijos y él se quedó con uno también. Mi hijo estaba dormido, pero cuando mi esposo abrió su sobre, lo llamó lleno de emoción y lo despertó. Le dio su sobre de cartas para que él las volteara sobre la mesa una a una. Y entre las cartas de ese sobre ¡estaba Messi! ¡Todos quieren a Messi!

> After getting home and having lunch, my husband and I went to the pharmacy to buy the medication the doctor had prescribed, and then he decided to pick up three packs of 2026 World Cup stickers for our little prince’s album. When we got home, he gave one to each of our children, and he kept one for himself, too. My son was asleep, but when my husband opened his pack, he called out to him excitedly and woke him up. He gave him the pack of cards so he could flip them over on the table one by one. And among the cards in that envelope was Messi! Everyone loves Messi! ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmcBZSpqRncx15inNfKsn5J6hJej4udkM33nVn8hpypS17/20260526_213734.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Todos estábamos muy contentos y, después de la euforia, yo le comentaba a mi hijo, que pensara en el hecho de que habíamos ido a la farmacia en ese momento por las medicinas indicadas por la doctora, gracias a que fuimos a la consulta médica en la mañana, por su tos. Él no quería ir al médico hoy y menos yo hubiera querido que él tuviera tos; pero fue gracias a eso gracias a eso, que él obtuvo el sobre de figuritas que contenía a Messi. Lo que traté d explicarle y que por fortuna él captó, es que casi siempre, hasta las contrariedades traen algo bueno.

> We were all very happy, and after the excitement died down, I told my son to think about the fact that we had gone to the pharmacy at that moment to pick up the medicine the doctor had prescribed—all because we’d gone to the doctor’s office that morning because of his cough. He didn’t want to go to the doctor today, and I certainly didn’t want him to have a cough; but it was thanks to that—thanks to that—that he got the sticker pack with Messi on it. What I tried to explain to him—and fortunately he understood—is that almost always, even setbacks bring something good. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQme5mnu967t3ZZ9agYXNM7UwSK9XWdDk71mFBXC18YxCea/20260521_173613.jpg
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Bueno, me emocioné escribiendo, a pesar de que tampoco encontré el momento de dormir durante el día y no he descansado. En este momento son las 10:47 P.M.en mi país, Venezuela, así que ya me voy a mi camita, con fe de que todos dormiremos plácidamente. Hasta la próxima.

> Well, I got carried away writing, even though I didn't find a moment to sleep during the day and haven't had a chance to rest. It's currently 10:47 p.m. here in my country, Venezuela, so I'm off to bed, hoping we'll all sleep soundly. Until next time. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
***
> \n \n<div class=\

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
